### [1] [How Vision Transformers Represent Position: A Mechanistic Comparison of Absolute and Rotary Positional Encodings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13992)
*Mahmoud Mannes,Nikhil Maturi,Parva Mehta,Jiwon Jeong,Aravind Singaram Kannappan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过机制可解释性分析，揭示APE和RoPE在ViT中以不同内部机制编码空间位置信息，并证明二者对分类任务具有因果重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT中位置编码对区分不同空间排列至关重要，但学界尚不清楚不同位置编码选择如何塑造模型内部的空间表征。作者希望从机制层面理解APE与RoPE的差异。

Method: 结合稀疏自编码器与因果干预分析ViT内部表征：用SAE从APE模型中恢复行/列特定特征；对RoPE模型施加干预，识别编码行列信息的旋转组件；通过选择性禁用行或列旋转、置换APE位置特征及消融关键注意力头来验证因果关系。

Result: APE将位置存于显式特征，RoPE在注意力内部构建并在被移除时重建位置；RoPE存在分别编码行和列信息的旋转组件，可独立移除并部分重建，部分由轴特化注意力头完成；置换APE位置特征使top-1准确率下降24–31点，消融RoPE主重建头旋转的损害大于其他任何头。

Conclusion: 位置编码选择从根本上改变了ViT内部空间信息的组织与处理方式；机制分析可揭示模型构建、重建与维持结构化表征的方式，并为视觉模型的定向干预提供基础。

Abstract: Positional embeddings encode the spatial position of each image patch in a Vision Transformer (ViT), allowing the model to distinguish different spatial arrangements of visual content. However, we know little about how the choice of embedding shapes a vision transformer's internal representation. In this work, we show that Absolute Positional Embeddings (APE) and Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) encode spatial position through different internal mechanisms: APE stores position in explicit features, while RoPE builds it inside attention and rebuilds it when it is withheld. Specifically, in APE models, sparse autoencoders recover causal row- and column-specific features, whereas interventions on RoPE reveal distinct rotary components that separately encode row and column information. Additionally, causal interventions selectively disabling RoPE's row or column rotations show that decodable row and column information can be independently removed and, once rotations are restored, partly reconstructed, in part by axis-specialized attention heads. Both mechanisms are causally important for classification: permuting APE's positional features across patches reduces top-1 accuracy by 24--31 points, and ablating the rotations of RoPE's primary rebuilding head reduces it more than ablating those of any other head. Our findings show that the choice of positional encoding fundamentally changes how spatial information is organized and processed inside Vision Transformers. More broadly, our work demonstrates how mechanistic analysis can reveal how models construct, reconstruct, and maintain structured representations, providing a basis for targeted interventions in vision models.

</details>


### [2] [SharedSAE: a unified sparse dictionary across u-net blocks and denoising time for diffusion models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13997)
*Longhao Lei,Lan Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SharedSAE用一个跨四个U-Net注意力块和50个去噪步的共享稀疏字典，实现扩散模型中概念表示的统一定位与干预，并将NudeNet阳性生成从139降至1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型稀疏自编码器只能提供逐块或逐时间步的字典，无法得到统一的特征字典来定位和干预网络中的概念表示。

Method: 学习一个在SDXL 1.0四个U-Net注意力块和全部50个去噪步间共享的稀疏字典；用块特定的低秩输入适配器对齐各块残差分布，再用含共享时间步分支与块-时间步校正分支的时间条件模块吸收时间非平稳性。

Result: 共享字典保持连贯结构；局部特征抑制将I2P检测器阳性子集中的NudeNet阳性生成从139降到1；追踪稀疏特征发现概念表示随去噪进行从最早下采样块向中间和更晚块重新分配。

Conclusion: SharedSAE为扩散模型提供统一、可解释、可干预的表示空间，可在任意覆盖的块和去噪步进行概念分析与擦除。

Abstract: Concept representations in diffusion models drift across network depth and denoising time, yet existing sparse autoencoders offer only per-block or per-timestep dictionaries, leaving no single feature dictionary for localization and intervention in the network. We present Shared Sparse Autoencoder (SharedSAE), which learns one sparse dictionary shared across four U-Net attention blocks and all 50 denoising steps of SDXL 1.0. A block-specific low-rank input adapter aligns the residual distribution of each block before the shared encoder, and a temporal conditioning module with a shared timestep branch and a block-timestep correction branch absorbs temporal non-stationarity. Despite spanning both axes, Shared SAE preserves a coherent dictionary structure. Built on the shared dictionary, localized feature suppression reduces the number of NudeNet-positive generations in the I2P detector-positive subset from 139 to 1. Tracing sparse features across the trajectory further reveals that concept representations are redistributed across U-Net blocks during generation, shifting from the earliest downsampling block toward intermediate and later blocks as denoising proceeds. SharedSAE thus provides a unified, interpretable, and intervention-ready representation space for diffusion models, enabling concept analysis and erasure at any covered block and denoising step.

</details>


### [3] [Pristine Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14091)
*Anirudh Sundara Rajan,Krishna Kumar Singh,Richard Zhang,Yong Jae Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Pristine Models，通过在预训练阶段将安全与不安全概念知识分离到独立参数分支，实现推理时可解耦的不安全概念，兼顾生成质量与安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广泛未过滤数据训练能提升生成质量，但会学到不应生成的概念；仅用安全数据训练则质量下降，因为含不安全概念的样本也提供有用知识。现有的事后概念遗忘方法随概念增多会导致灾难性遗忘。

Method: 设计一种文本到图像生成架构，采用注意力机制鼓励将安全与不安全知识分离到独立参数化的分支中。分支特定参数在训练时学习，推理时可断开不安全分支。

Result: 在ImageNet上，Pristine Models生成更安全，同时保留全数据预训练的大部分效用，图像质量和文本对齐优于仅安全数据训练及事后概念移除方法。扩展到CC12M后，在更大更开放的世界预训练场景中依然有效。

Conclusion: 在预训练阶段对不安全概念知识进行分区、并在推理时禁用的思路可行，为兼顾安全与生成质量提供了新方向。

Abstract: Training on broad, unfiltered data enables high-quality image generation, but can also teach models concepts that should not be generated; restricting the training data ensures safety, but reduces quality because examples containing unsafe concepts also provide useful knowledge that is not itself unsafe. Existing approaches largely address this trade-off post hoc through concept unlearning, which can lead to catastrophic forgetting as the number of concepts to remove grows. We instead ask whether unsafe concept knowledge can be compartmentalized during pretraining so that access to it can be disabled at inference. We introduce Pristine Models, a novel text-to-image generation architecture with an attention mechanism that encourages the separation of safe and unsafe knowledge into independently parameterized branches. The branch-specific parameters are learned during training, while the unsafe branch can be detached at inference. On ImageNet, Pristine Models enable safer generation while retaining much of the utility of full-data pretraining, achieving higher image quality and better text alignment than training only on safe data or applying post-hoc concept removal. We further scale our approach to CC12M, demonstrating that it remains effective in a substantially larger and more diverse open-world pretraining setting.

</details>


### [4] [Human Pose Estimation by Probabilistic Mixtures of Gaussian and Uniform Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14093)
*Santiago Reina Alguacil,Ezequiel López Rubio*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需重训练的后处理连续概率框架，将热图建模为带均匀分布的GMM，改善HPE的坐标提取、测试时增强、不确定性量化与3D扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代HPE从离散热图进行确定性坐标提取，在密集遮挡和OoD歧义下系统性失效；需无需改架构/重训练的改进方法。

Method: 拦截原始热图，用GMM+空间无关均匀分布建模；用GMM空间期望做解码，用概率分布聚合做TTA，并将多模态参数与MRF等几何正则结合，扩展到多视角3D。

Result: GMM空间期望精度与领先亚像素解码器持平；TTA缓解多尺度热图污染；校准几何协方差体在严重遮挡OoD检测优于峰值强度启发式；自适应Softmax融合在分布内校准匹配或降低AUSE；可扩展至多视角3D，绕过O(N^3)体素内存瓶颈。

Conclusion: 连续概率密度建模为HPE提供通用后处理方案，提升解码、增强、不确定性量化与3D扩展性，同时揭示2D运动先验在透视缩短和视觉退化下的脆弱性。

Abstract: Despite advancements in sub-pixel decoding, modern Human Pose Estimation (HPE) architectures remain constrained by deterministic coordinate extraction from discrete heatmaps, which systematically fails under dense occlusions and Out-of-Distribution (OoD) ambiguities. To address these limitations, we propose a post-hoc continuous probabilistic framework that intercepts raw heatmaps and models them as a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) augmented with a spatially agnostic uniform distribution, requiring no architectural modifications or retraining. This continuous representation allows us to comprehensively explore the distinct contributions of density modeling to HPE. We show that the spatial expectation of our fitted GMM achieves precision parity with leading sub-pixel decoders without heuristic post-processing. Leveraging this continuous space, our test-time augmentation aggregates probability distributions rather than discrete activations, mitigating multi-scale heatmap poisoning. Furthermore, because our multimodal GMM parameterization isolates competing spatial hypotheses, it naturally interfaces with geometric regularizers such as Markov Random Fields. However, our analysis exposes the inherent vulnerabilities of 2D kinematic priors under perspective foreshortening and visual degradation. Crucially, this density formulation yields significant improvements in uncertainty quantification: our calibrated geometric covariance volume outperforms standard peak-intensity heuristics in OoD anomaly detection under severe occlusion. For in-distribution calibration, dynamically fusing our geometric metric via Adaptive Softmax reduces or matches baseline Area Under the Sparsification Error (AUSE) across benchmarks and degradation levels. Finally, we establish that this continuous parameterization is extensible to multi-view 3D architectures, bypassing the $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ voxel memory bottleneck.

</details>


### [5] [Scenes as an Attack Surface: Uncovering Scene-Grounded Safety Failures in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14094)
*Tongxi Wu,Yuyang Cheng,Jiacheng Xian,Hu Huang,Zhihao Wu,Menglin Yang,Jian Zhang,Yang Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文揭示多模态大模型的一个新安全漏洞：仅凭任务相关的场景语义（无额外攻击指令）即可使模型从拒绝转为顺从，并提出 SceneSafetyBench 基准与 Scene-Grounded Attacks (SGA) 攻击方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态越狱攻击多依赖专门构造的视觉输入来承载有害意图，但作者发现：即使视觉输入不引入额外攻击指令、原任务意图不变，仅任务相关的场景语义就能使 MLLM 从拒绝转为顺从。这一被忽视的安全风险需要被形式化并系统研究。

Method: 将该失败形式化为 scene-grounded visual safety vulnerability，构建 SceneSafetyBench（覆盖 8 类风险、9 个白盒与黑盒 MLLM）；分析任务相关视觉证据如何影响下游安全表征。在此基础上提出 Scene-Grounded Attacks (SGA)：在保留原任务的前提下构造经验证的 scene-grounded 查询，并组合其独立响应。

Result: 在 9 个目标 MLLM 上，SGA 平均攻击成功率 (ASR) 达 86.17%，比最强基线高 8.55 个百分点，并在 8 个模型上取得最高 ASR。

Conclusion: 场景语义是 MLLM 中被忽视的攻击面，且更强视觉 grounding 与稳健多模态安全对齐之间存在日益加剧的张力。

Abstract: Existing jailbreak attacks have exposed serious safety weaknesses in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Most prior attacks rely on specially constructed visual inputs to carry or support harmful intent. In this paper, we uncover a different vulnerability: task-relevant scene semantics alone can shift an MLLM from refusal to compliance, even when the visual input introduces no additional attack instructions and the original task intent remains unchanged. We formalize this failure as a scene-grounded visual safety vulnerability and introduce SceneSafetyBench to investigate it across eight risk categories and nine white- and black-box MLLMs. Our analysis reveals that this failure is associated with how task-relevant visual evidence influences downstream safety representations, suggesting that visual grounding alone cannot fully explain the observed safety shift. Building on this finding, we propose Scene-Grounded Attacks (SGA), which preserve the original task while constructing validated scene-grounded queries and combining their independent responses. Across nine target MLLMs, SGA achieves an average attack success rate (ASR) of 86.17%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 8.55 percentage points and achieving the highest ASR on eight models. Our results identify scene semantics as an overlooked attack surface in MLLMs and highlight a growing tension between stronger visual grounding and robust multimodal safety alignment.

</details>


### [6] [Elephant in the Fridge: Constant-Memory Frame Packing for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16118)
*Shuo Gao,Chenhao Zheng,Zhongzheng Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FramePack-U 是一个免训练、即插即用的帧打包框架，将任意长视频压缩为固定长度视觉表示，实现恒定内存开销，在多个长视频基准上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频、流媒体和电影级内容使 VLM 超出承载极限：逐帧编码视觉 token 导致序列随视频长度线性增长，内存与推理延迟过高。现有 token 缩减和关键帧选择方法虽缩短序列，但仍保持 O(n) 缩放，未解决根本瓶颈。

Method: 提出 FramePack-U：无需微调或改架构，可直接接入现成 VLM 推理。内容感知压缩策略在固定 token 预算下：1）按帧与文本提示的语义相似度打分，并以多样性驱动方式排序；2）将所选帧以不同分辨率打包进定长上下文窗口，使内存集中于指令相关且视觉多样的帧。

Result: 在 LongVideoBench、MLVU、Video-MME 上持续优于全分辨率基线及先前 token 缩减/关键帧选择方法，跨模型族、参数规模和帧预算均有效。Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 在 128 帧预算下分别提升 +12.9%、+10.6%、+9.7%。

Conclusion: FramePack-U 以恒定内存将任意长视频压缩为固定大小视觉表示，理论可打包任意多帧，并给出稳健泛化的经验实例，证明其在长视频理解中的有效性与通用性。

Abstract: Hour-long videos, streaming feeds, and movie-length content are pushing vision-language models (VLMs) past their breaking point -- the standard recipe of encoding each frame into visual tokens yields sequences that grow linearly with video length, causing prohibitive memory consumption and inference latency. Existing approaches, such as token reduction and keyframe selection, shorten the token sequence but leave the O(n) scaling intact, failing to resolve the fundamental bottleneck. We propose FramePack-U, a strikingly simple, training-free frame packing framework that compresses arbitrarily long videos into a fixed size visual representation at constant memory cost. FramePack-U requires no fine-tuning or architectural modification -- it plugs directly into off-the-shelf VLMs at inference time. Inspired by FramePack from the generation literature, we propose a content-aware compression strategy for visual understanding under a fixed token budget. Specifically, FramePack-U (1) scores each frame by its semantic similarity to the text prompt and ranks frames in a diversity-driven manner, and (2) packs the selected frames at varying resolutions into a fixed-length context window. This concentrates the memory budget on frames that are both instruction-relevant and visually diverse. While FramePack-U can in theory pack arbitrarily many frames into the fixed budget, we identify an empirical instantiation that generalizes robustly across settings. Extensive experiments on LongVideoBench, MLVU, and Video-MME show that FramePack-U consistently outperforms full-resolution baselines and prior token reduction and keyframe selection methods across diverse model families, parameter scales, and frame budgets. Notably, on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with a 128-frame budget, FramePack-U yields gains of +12.9\%, +10.6\%, and +9.7\% over the official model on the three benchmarks, respectively.

</details>


### [7] [TrajCFG: Token-Wise Classifier-Free Guidance via Denoising Trajectory Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14153)
*Jingyu Liu,Hao Jiang,Yikang Ding,Huafeng Shi,Xu Yang,Xiaoqiang Liu,Guoxin Zhang,Pengfei Wan,Kun Gai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TrajCFG 是一种无需训练的方法，为流匹配模型根据引导速度方向的历史变化，实现逐 token 的自适应无分类器引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 CFG 对所有 latent token 使用统一缩放，但各 token 的速度预测在采样过程中变化不同，缺乏细粒度引导。

Method: 将历史方向变化反馈映射为有界缩放，对变化大的 token 施加强引导、变化小的施加弱引导；融合相邻步与区间归一化的长跨度反馈，复用标准 CFG 预测而无需额外模型评估。

Result: 在文生视频、图生视频、文-音-视频、文生图、图生3D 等任务多个骨干上均优于基线；文生视频中 VBench 总分比最强基线提升 0.30-0.75 分。

Conclusion: 历史方向反馈可作为广泛适用的细粒度引导分配信号。

Abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) typically applies a shared scale to all latent tokens, although their velocity predictions evolve differently during sampling. We introduce Trajectory-Adaptive Classifier-Free Guidance (TrajCFG), a training-free method for flow-matching models that adapts token-wise guidance using historical changes in guided velocity direction. TrajCFG maps this feedback to bounded scales, assigning stronger guidance to larger directional changes and weaker guidance to more consistent directions. It combines adjacent-step and interval-normalized longer-span feedback, reusing standard CFG predictions without additional model evaluations. Controlled diagnostics and ablations examine the roles of directional feedback, token-wise allocation, and history-span fusion. Experiments on text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-audio-video, text-to-image, and image-to-3D generation show improvements over base samplers across multiple backbones. For text-to-video generation, TrajCFG improves VBench Total scores by 0.30-0.75 points over the strongest evaluated baseline on each of three backbones. These results support historical directional feedback as a broadly applicable signal for fine-grained guidance allocation. The project page is available at https://jyliu-98.github.io/trajcfg-project-page/.

</details>


### [8] [EventLens: Event-Structure Reinforcement Learning for Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16172)
*Guowen Zhang,Boshen Xu,Zihao Yue,Ziheng Wang,Xiaokun Liu,Xin Tao,Wenyu Qin,Pengfei Wan,Qin Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EventLens，以事件结构恢复为核心的视觉中心强化学习框架，通过三级时间本体与可验证任务进行GRPO训练，并用MT-OPD蒸馏整合，提升MLLM的视频时间理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多模态大模型在视频问答上表现强，但难以恢复使视频连贯的时间结构，如合并相邻事件、遗漏事件进展或推断不合理跨事件关系。作者认为根源在于现有后训练目标与时间推理不匹配：字幕式监督让模型依赖语言捷径而非视觉时间落地。

Method: 提出EventLens，一个视觉中心的强化学习框架，通过事件结构恢复学习视频理解。不重建字幕，而是在受控扰动下恢复时间结构，如改变时间粒度、反转进展、打乱事件顺序。基于三级时间本体构建三类可验证任务：事件分割、进展判别、多事件关系推理，具备确定性奖励，支持任务专用GRPO训练，无需人类偏好标签或学习奖励模型。进一步提出多教师在线策略蒸馏MT-OPD，将专用策略整合为统一模型。

Result: 在Qwen3-VL主干上，时间落地和事件敏感推理基准上取得一致提升，同时保持通用视频问答性能。学习曲线显示，与直接混合RL优化相比，EventLens以显著更低的训练成本实现相当的下游迁移效果。

Conclusion: 以事件结构恢复为目标的视觉中心RL训练可有效弥补MLLM时间理解缺陷，确定性奖励与多教师蒸馏提供了高效、无需偏好标注的可行路径。

Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong results on video question answering, yet often fail to recover the temporal structure that makes a video coherent. They may merge neighboring events, miss single-event progression, or infer implausible relations across events. We study structured temporal understanding as the ability to recover event structure from visual evidence, including event boundaries, single-event progression, and multi-event relations. We argue that this gap arises from a mismatch between current post-training objectives and temporal reasoning, where caption-style supervision allows models to rely on language shortcuts rather than visual temporal grounding. To address this, we propose EventLens, a vision-centric reinforcement learning framework that learns video understanding through event-structure recovery. Instead of reconstructing captions, EventLens trains models to recover temporal structure under controlled perturbations, such as altered temporal granularity, reversed progression, and shuffled event order. We instantiate this framework with a three-level temporal ontology and derive three verifiable task families: event segmentation, progression discrimination, and multi-event relation reasoning. These tasks admit deterministic rewards, enabling task-specialized GRPO training without human preference labels or learned reward models. We further introduce multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MT-OPD) to consolidate specialized policies into a unified model. Experiments on Qwen3-VL backbones show consistent improvements on temporal grounding and event-sensitive reasoning benchmarks, while preserving general video-QA performance. Learning curves further demonstrate that EventLens achieves comparable downstream transfer with significantly reduced training cost compared to direct mixed RL optimization.

</details>


### [9] [Video-Arena: A Scalable Agentic Video Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14158)
*Kuan Zhang,Yukun Chen,Zhihao Yang,Yue Su,Xiangnan Wu,Zirong Chen,Run Luo,Tao Tan,Yinhe Zheng,Yiming Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Video-Arena 基准，将竞技游戏转化为可扩展、可验证的视频世界状态理解测试，含感知事件、解读状态更新、跟踪状态三类任务，最佳系统 F1 分仅 [空] 与 [空]。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频基准难以判断模型能否对动态世界状态保持连贯理解；真实视频世界状态仅部分可观测，标注难以获取。

Method: 以竞技游戏为可扩展可验证测试载体，借鉴人类理解动态事件的方式，评估时空世界状态理解与跟踪，分三类任务；从游戏记录规模化生成视频与对齐标签；精选 9 款游戏 180 个任务的黄金集，采用原生视觉理解与工具辅助智能体分析两种评测协议。

Result: 最佳系统在两种协议下 F1 分别为 [空] 与 [空]；原生模型难以可靠感知事件，工具辅助系统改善事件恢复，但解读状态更新与持续跟踪状态仍困难。

Conclusion: Video-Arena 揭示当前模型在动态世界状态理解上的不足，提供可扩展、可验证的评测路径。项目页：https://videoarena-bench.github.io

Abstract: Understanding and tracking a dynamic world are fundamental to visual intelligence. Existing video benchmarks provide limited insight into whether models can maintain a coherent understanding of evolving world state. Building such a benchmark from real-world videos is challenging because the underlying world state is partially observable, making annotations hard to obtain. To close this gap, we introduce Video-Arena, a benchmark that turns competitive games into scalable, verifiable tests of how well models understand evolving world states from videos. Specifically, inspired by how humans understand dynamic events, we evaluate spatiotemporal world state understanding and tracking through three task categories: perceiving critical events, interpreting state updates, and tracking the resulting states. Our pipeline can generate videos and aligned reference labels from game records at scale. To keep evaluation affordable and reproducible, we curate a golden set of 180 tasks across 9 games and run evaluations under two protocols: native visual understanding and tool-assisted agentic analysis. The best-performing systems achieve F1 scores of and under the two protocols, respectively. The result highlights that native models struggle to perceive events reliably, while tool-assisted systems improve event recovery but still struggle to interpret state updates and track the resulting states consistently over time. Our project page is in https://videoarena-bench.github.io

</details>


### [10] [Token-Budgeted Candidate Retrieval for 3D Scene-Grounded VLMs: Category Names vs. Pairwise Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14207)
*Michał Zakrzewski,Mariia Shpir,Taras Rumezhak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在固定token预算下，3D场景VLM视觉上下文选择中，语义检索（物体类别名匹配）显著优于手工设计的成对几何评分，且小编码器MiniLM/BGE-small表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在固定上下文预算下，3D场景VLM应优先看到哪些物体和关系，探索语义检索与几何评分哪种候选选择策略更有效。

Method: 在ScanRefer gt_val及Nr3D/Sr3D自定义20% scan-id划分（35,504查询）上，评估token预算下的候选检索，使用轴对齐框、token比例指标、免训练基线、两个小编码器（匹配查询与物体类别名）以及QCRR确定性成对几何评分器；并用修正的3DGraphLLM测试框架验证下游精度。

Result: 加法名词匹配在ScanRefer达R@10 0.864，QCRR仅0.626；MiniLM与BGE-small达0.911-0.913（ScanRefer）、0.941-0.947（Nr3D）。下游精度：Random 0.44、QCRR 0.56、MiniLM 0.67、oracle 0.70。

Conclusion: 语义检索优于手工几何设计，上下文选择会改变匹配物体预算下的下游精度；将发布协议、检索器实现及逐查询输出，便于替换新选择器。

Abstract: Under a fixed context budget, which objects and relations should a 3D scene-grounded VLM see first? On ScanNet indoor referring benchmarks (Dai et al., 2017), matching the query to object category names outperforms pairwise geometry scoring at every reported K. The gaps are largest at high recall. Analytic pairwise cues beat per-object cue scoring and query-agnostic kNN graphs, including on paraphrases. MiniLM and BGE-small still score higher on those splits. We evaluate token-budgeted candidate retrieval with axis-aligned boxes, a token-ratio metric, training-free baselines, two small encoders that match q to each object's category name, and QCRR (Query-Conditioned Relation Retrieval), a deterministic pairwise-geometry scorer. Across ScanRefer gt_val plus a custom 20% scan-id split of Nr3D and Sr3D (35,504 queries; not official ReferIt3D val), additive noun matching reaches R@10 0.864 on ScanRefer against QCRR's 0.626; MiniLM and BGE-small reach 0.911 to 0.913 on ScanRefer and 0.941 to 0.947 on Nr3D. A corrected 3DGraphLLM harness (native Acc@0.25 0.67 on the full graph, n=300 ScanRefer queries) shows that context selection changes downstream accuracy under a matched object budget (Random 0.44, QCRR 0.56, MiniLM 0.67, oracle 0.70). Semantic retrieval beats hand-designed geometry on that harness. We will release the protocol, retriever implementations, and per-query outputs so new selectors can be swapped in without rewriting the analysis.

</details>


### [11] [GHOST: Geometry-Constrained Hybrid Diffusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16455)
*Changqun Feng,Wangxiandi Yin,Xin Hu,Ruiting Dai,Feiyang Yang,Jielei Wang,Tao He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GHOST：几何约束混合扩散框架，用于开放词汇3D场景图生成，通过几何-约束-谓词去噪流程提升空间关系预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇方法难以处理空间谓词，因为语言相似度反映的是语义共现而非显式几何关系，缺乏几何一致性。

Method: 联合建模连续节点几何与离散边谓词；采用几何-约束-谓词去噪流程；引入语言约束归纳，将谓词嵌入映射为可微几何约束以指导布局细化与谓词重加权；并用几何-拓扑协同去噪器，通过噪声自适应交互与朝向建模耦合节点和边推理。

Result: 在3DSSG数据集上，闭集与开放词汇场景均达SOTA，空间谓词较RelationField提升超过17个点。

Conclusion: GHOST通过将几何约束引入扩散过程，有效解决开放词汇3D场景图中空间关系预测的几何一致性问题。

Abstract: 3D scene graph generation requires understanding both object semantics and metric spatial relations. However, existing open-vocabulary methods often struggle with spatial predicates because language similarity reflects semantic co-occurrence rather than explicit geometry. We propose GHOST, a Geometry-constrained Hybrid diffusion framework for Open-vocabulary 3D Scene graph generaTion. GHOST jointly models continuous node geometry and discrete edge predicates, following a geometry-to-constraint-to-predicate denoising process to ensure geometrically consistent relation prediction. It introduces language-grounded constraint induction, which maps predicate embeddings to differentiable geometric constraints that guide both layout refinement and predicate reweighting. A Geometry-Topology Collaborative Denoiser further couples node and edge reasoning through noise-adaptive interaction and orientation-aware modeling. Experiments on 3DSSG demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both closed-set and open-vocabulary settings, including over 17-point gains over RelationField on spatial predicates.

</details>


### [12] [CAPTOR: a vision-language foundation model for Chest-Abdomen-Pelvis Oncologic CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14226)
*Séléna Jean-Mactoux,Sophie Loizillon,Ghina Jardali,Amandine Crombé,Nathalie Lassau,Alexandre Bône*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAPTOR 是一个面向肿瘤胸腹盆 CT 的对比式视觉-语言基础模型，在分类、生存预测和检索任务上超越现有 CT 基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肿瘤胸腹盆 CT 解读需要与临床情境对齐的基础模型，而现有 CT 基础模型未必针对肿瘤场景优化。

Method: 基于多中心回顾性数据（北美、欧洲、亚洲，以肿瘤病灶检查为主），采用对比视觉-语言预训练策略，支持单/多序列采集；在疾病检测、生存预测、图像检索三类下游任务上评测，并与最先进 CT 基础模型对比；采用 bootstrap 估计置信区间、置换检验做配对比较。

Result: 训练与测试分别使用 25,512 和 10,794 对 CT-报告。CAPTOR 全面优于基线：CAP 子集 AUC 0.767（95%CI 0.734-0.793）vs 次优 0.695；肿瘤子集 AUC 0.784 vs 0.734（p<0.001）；四项肿瘤预后基准中三项排名第一；CAP 与肿瘤子集检索性能更优。

Conclusion: 在肿瘤富集的 CAP CT 数据上训练的基础模型在其目标临床情境中优于现有先进模型，凸显临床对齐预训练的重要性；代码与权重已开源。

Abstract: Purpose : To develop and evaluate CAPTOR, a deep-learning vision-language foundation model for oncologic chest-abdomen-pelvis (CAP) CT interpretation.
  Materials & Methods : CAPTOR (Chest-Abdomen-Pelvis foundaTion model for Oncologic Radiology) is a contrastive vision-language model, trained using a pretraining strategy for oncologic CAP CT (in single- or multiple-series acquisitions), on a multicenter retrospective dataset from North America, Europe and Asia, predominantly from tumor lesion examinations. CAPTOR was compared with state-of-the-art CT foundation models on three downstream tasks: disease detection, survival prediction using TumorImagingBench and image retrieval. Classification and retrieval were both evaluated on held-out internal and public test sets, stratified by anatomical coverage and indication. Bootstrap resampling was used to estimate confidence intervals, and pairwise comparisons were performed using permutation tests.
  Results : CAPTOR was trained and tested on 25,512 and 10,794 CT-report pairs respectively. TumorImagingBench datasets comprised between 134 and 421 studies each. CAPTOR outperformed all baseline models, on the classification task, on the CAP subset (AUC 0.767, 95%CI: 0.734-0.793, vs. 0.695, 95%CI: 0.645-0.736 for the next-best, p<0.001) and oncologic subset (AUC 0.784, 95%CI: 0.759-0.805, vs. 0.734, 95%CI: 0.703-0.767 p<0.001), ranked first on three of the four oncologic prognostic benchmarks, and achieved superior retrieval performance on CAP and oncologic subsets.
  Conclusion : A foundation model trained on oncology-enriched CAP CT data outperformed relevant state-of-the-art models in its target clinical context, underscoring the importance of clinically aligned pretraining.
  We release our preprocessing, training and inference code : https://github.com/Guerbet-AI/CAPTOR and model weights : https://huggingface.co/Guerbet-AI/CAPTOR

</details>


### [13] [World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17434)
*Junyi Wu,Zekun Li,Chenhongyi Yang,Chen Guo,Lingchen Yang,Yongan Zhang,Xinyi Zhang,Hongbing Hu,Bartek Rymkowski,Srinath Sridhar,Yan Yan,Xijie Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: World-T3 是一种相机控制的视频世界模型，通过测试时训练记忆将过去的观测整合进模型参数，实现长时程一致生成，并以少步蒸馏支持实时交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视频世界模型依赖生成模型自身保留历史信息，导致超出活跃上下文后空间记忆衰减，长时程生成一致性差。

Method: 提出测试时训练记忆，把历史观测整合到专用参数；用递归最小二乘规则以相机位姿为键在线更新快权重状态，实现恒存储、恒计算的记忆读取；并通过双教师分布匹配将自回归模型蒸馏为少步生成器以支持实时交互。

Result: 在长时程重访基准上，重访 PSNR 从 13.52 提升到 18.31 dB，绝对旋转误差从 3.344 降至 1.075；在单张 NVIDIA B200 上以 1280×704 分辨率维持 20.6 FPS。

Conclusion: World-T3 通过测试时训练记忆与少步蒸馏，兼顾长时程视觉记忆一致性与实时交互生成，显著优于最强基线。

Abstract: Recent advances in video world models have enabled plausible interactive environments, yet long-horizon generation places a fundamental demand on visual memory: the previously observed world must remain consistent as the model continues to generate. Existing autoregressive approaches often implicitly rely on the generative model itself to retain such information, leading to spatial memory decay beyond the active context. We introduce World-T3, a camera-controlled video world model with a test-time training memory that consolidates past observations into dedicated model parameters. To robustly update this memory, we propose a recursive least-squares rule that incrementally absorbs novel visual features via online pose-keyed memory updates. Our TTT memory reads out previously observed scene features from the fast-weight state by camera pose, enabling consistent generation with constant storage and per-step computation regardless of rollout length. To facilitate real-time interactive generation with this robust memory, we further distill the autoregressive model into a few-step generator via dual-teacher distribution matching. On a long-horizon revisit benchmark, World-T3 raises revisit PSNR from 13.52 to 18.31 dB and reduces absolute rotation error from 3.344 to 1.075 relative to the strongest baseline on both metrics, while sustaining 20.6 FPS at 1280 x 704 on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU.

</details>


### [14] [Latent World Action Model for GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14228)
*Seungjun Yu,Hojun Choi,Seojeong Park,Jaeyo Shin,Hyunjung Shim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将GUI世界建模的预测目标从像素级全屏重建改为隐空间中的动作诱导未来信息，用大模型共享表征加动作头与转移头，并用动作感知对比目标缓解身份捷径，成功率最高相对提升31.9%/40.6%，推理延迟降低98.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素空间世界模型采用"预测屏幕—重新感知—选动作"两阶段范式，存在两问题：L1像素重建计算成本高；L2需重建大量与动作选择无关的外观细节，导致身份捷径（future-state预测近似保持当前状态而非捕捉动作引发的改变）。

Method: 将预测目标由全屏重建转为隐空间中的动作诱导未来信息。使用大 multimodal 模型作为隐空间世界模型，其共享表征支持两个专用头：动作头将隐表征直接转成动作选择，转移头捕捉动作条件下的未来信息；并引入动作感知对比目标，促使转移表征学习判别性的动作诱导变化。

Result: 在离线与在线GUI设置下，方法相比像素空间世界模型成功率相对提升最多31.9%和40.6%，推理延迟最多降低98.9%。

Conclusion: 把GUI世界建模从像素重建转为隐空间动作诱导信息建模，可有效避免身份捷径并大幅降低推理开销，验证了隐空间世界模型在GUI agent中的有效性与效率优势。

Abstract: Pixel-space world models have recently emerged as a promising approach for GUI agents, predicting future screens prior to execution and subsequently re-perceiving them for action selection. However, this two-stage paradigm faces two key challenges in GUI environments: (L1) the high computational cost of pixel reconstruction and (L2) the need to reconstruct large and diverse appearance-level details beyond what is required for action selection. In practice, this screen-generation objective can induce an identity shortcut problem, where future-state prediction largely preserves the current state rather than capturing action-induced changes. In this work, we reformulate GUI world modeling by shifting the prediction target from full-screen reconstruction to action-induced future information in latent space. Concretely, we leverage a large multimodal model as the latent world model, whose shared representations support two dedicated heads for both action selection and predictive transition modeling. The action head directly translates these latent representations into action selection, while the transition head captures action-conditioned future information. To mitigate the identity shortcut, we further introduce an action-aware contrastive objective that encourages the transition representations to capture discriminative action-induced changes. Extensive experiments across offline and online GUI settings show that our method achieves up to 31.9% and 40.6% relative gains in success rate over pixel-space world models, respectively, while substantially reducing inference latency by up to 98.9%. Our code is available at https://github.com/sjyu001/latent2world.

</details>


### [15] [SliderEdit++: Improved Slider Trajectories in Instruction-Based Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14253)
*Arman Zarei,Sayan Nag,Bryan Wang,Franck Dernoncourt,Varun Manjunatha,Nedim Lipka,Soheil Feizi,Samyadeep Basu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SlideBench 基准与 SliderEdit++ 方法，实现基于滑块的连续、可控图像编辑，性能提升 18.5% 且速度快 3-20 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于滑块的图像编辑难以提供可靠的连续可控性：滑动时出现视觉跳变、非单调变化，且多个滑块相互干扰。

Method: 引入 SlideBench 基准（含单调性、感知连续性、滑块解耦指标）；提出 SliderEdit++，通过速度与语义空间的轨迹正则化、谱控制及解耦目标来约束整个编辑轨迹。

Result: 在 SlideBench 上达到 SOTA，整体分数相对最强基线提升 18.5%；借助少步编辑骨干，速度比现有滑块方法快约 3-20 倍。

Conclusion: 轨迹级正则化与解耦设计有效提升了滑块编辑的连续可控性与交互响应速度。

Abstract: Slider-based control aims to give users continuous, fine-grained control over the intensity of individual edits in instruction-based image editing. However, existing approaches fail to deliver reliable continuous controllability: traversing a slider can produce abrupt visual jumps and non-monotonic changes, while jointly controlled sliders can interfere with one another. To systematically study these limitations, we introduce SlideBench, a comprehensive benchmark for continuous image editing spanning diverse editing categories and equipped with a unified suite of metrics quantifying monotonic progression, perceptual continuity, and inter-slider disentanglement. Building on these observations, we propose SliderEdit++, which explicitly regularizes the intermediate editing trajectory rather than supervising only its endpoints. Our method combines velocity- and semantic-space trajectory regularization with spectral control to encourage smooth, predictable slider traversal, together with a disentanglement objective that reduces interference between independently controlled edits. On SlideBench, SliderEdit++ achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the overall score by 18.5% relative to the strongest baseline. At the same time, using a few-step editing backbone makes our method approximately 3x to 20x faster than existing slider-based approaches, enabling substantially more responsive interactive editing.

</details>


### [16] [GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18694)
*Rong Li,Shijie Li,Jiangyong Huang,Lingdong Kong,Jiaming Zhou,Dongyue Lu,Zeying Gong,Baoxiong Jia,Junwei Liang,Siyuan Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GeoReader 框架，让 VLM 学习可直接使用的几何表征，通过轻量几何读取器生成连续几何 token，并由冻结 VLM 的几何描述监督，从而显式注入几何信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 在 RGB 观测中难以捕捉度量和多视角关系。已有几何基础模型虽能恢复结构，但要么与视觉 token 融合、仅靠问答学习使用，要么对齐 VLM 隐层与几何特征。然而捕获几何不等于使用几何：将特征对齐模型的已对齐隐层置零后，准确率不变，说明几何信息未被真正利用。

Method: 1) 训练轻量 Geometric Reader 产生连续输入 token，用冻结 VLM 解码出的几何描述做监督，使几何表达为接收模型可直接读取的形式；2) 冻结 Reader 保持该接口，在空间问答上微调 VLM，并按问题条件注入几何；3) 训练时几何描述仅作监督目标，推理时 VLM 直接基于连续几何 token 作答，不生成几何思维链。

Result: 从 RGB 图像预测几何后，在 MindCube-Tiny 上 Qwen3-VL-4B 达 94.3；结合多源 QA 混合训练，Qwen3.5-9B 在六个额外空间基准上平均 72.5。

Conclusion: 有用的几何表征应能被接收模型直接使用，而不仅是可从中重建几何。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with metric and multi-view relationships that remain implicit in RGB observations. Geometry foundation models recover this structure from RGB, but existing methods either fuse the estimated features with visual tokens and learn to use them from question answering alone, or align VLM latents with geometry features. Capturing geometry, however, does not ensure its use: zeroing the aligned latents of a released feature-alignment model leaves its accuracy unchanged. We introduce GeoReader, a framework that learns geometric representations for the VLM that reads them. First, we train lightweight Geometric Readers to produce continuous input tokens, supervising them with geometry descriptions decoded by a frozen VLM, so that the Readers express geometry in a form the target model can already read. We then freeze the Readers to preserve this interface while fine-tuning the VLM on spatial QA, with geometry injection conditioned on the question. Geometry descriptions serve only as training targets: at inference, the VLM answers directly from the continuous geometric tokens without generating a geometry chain of thought. With geometry predicted from RGB images, our approach reaches 94.3 on MindCube-Tiny with Qwen3-VL-4B and, with a multi-source QA mixture, an average of 72.5 across six additional spatial benchmarks with Qwen3.5-9B. These results suggest that a useful geometric representation is one the receiving model can use, not merely one from which geometry can be reconstructed.

</details>


### [17] [Image Diffusion Models Are Good 3D Human Motion Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14254)
*Siyuan Yang,Chong Wang,Hao Cheng,Jun Liu,Bihan Wen,Alex Kot,Hedvig Kjellstrom*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究能否用图像扩散架构，通过兼容图像的统一表示建模不同骨骼布局的3D人体动作，并在HumanML3D与KIT-ML上验证共享训练的优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到动作生成通常依赖数据集特定骨骼表示，不同关节布局的基准需分别训练模型，缺乏跨异构骨骼布局的通用建模方式。

Method: 将根中心关节轨迹组织为拓扑感知的关节-时间图像，并用互补潜在流建模全局根动态；动作自编码器以根潜变量为条件解码局部运动；文本条件SiT联合生成两个潜流，并对解码后的3D关节位置施加监督。

Result: 在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上，数据集专用模型达到最新最优性能；在数据集上共享训练单个自编码器与单个SiT后，两个基准均进一步提升。

Conclusion: 图像扩散架构可用于统一建模异构骨骼布局的3D动作，无需骨骼重定向，共享建模能带来跨基准性能增益。

Abstract: Text-to-motion generation typically relies on dataset-specific skeletal representations, with models trained separately for benchmarks with different joint layouts. We investigate whether image diffusion architectures can model 3D human motion through a common image-compatible representation that accommodates heterogeneous skeletal layouts while preserving motion-specific kinematic structure. To this end, we organize root-centered joint trajectories into topology-informed joint--time images and model global root dynamics through a complementary latent stream. A motion autoencoder conditions local-motion decoding on the root latent, while a text-conditioned Scalable Interpolant Transformer (SiT) jointly generates both latent streams, with supervision on decoded 3D joint positions further constraining generation in motion space. In addition to dataset-specific models, we train a single motion autoencoder on HumanML3D and KIT-ML, followed by a single text-conditioned SiT shared across both datasets, preserving their respective skeletal definitions without skeleton retargeting to a common joint layout. Abstract: Recent advances in multi-modal large language models have shifted toward the "thinking with images" paradigm to improve reasoning faithfulness, yet existing methods rely heavily on explicit coordinate- based grounding. Abstract: Humanoid face robots can now move their lips in sync with speech and show detailed facial expressions. All thresholds are fixed on FaceForensics++, and every result is compared with real human faces that went through the same processing as the robot videos. At a threshold that flags 5% of real faces, three detectors flag almost every physical robot frame, while two flag fewer than 7%. The response is also fragile, and light JPEG compression is enough to push most robot frames below the threshold for some detectors. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在图像超分中感知质量出色，但对文本内容会产生文本幻觉（不存在或扭曲的文字），改变场景语义并损害可靠性。现有方法只是笼统地增强文本生成，未能从根本上解决幻觉问题，作者认为核心在于缺乏选择性控制。

Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image super-resolution (SR) by leveraging strong generative priors to enhance perceptual quality. While recent methods focus on enhancing text generation, they do so indiscriminately, leaving hallucinations fundamentally unresolved. We argue the core problem is a lack of selective control. Therefore, we reformulate text SR as a selective generation problem: text is resolved only when reliable generation is expected, while other scene content is fully super-resolved. We introduce TGSR (Text-Grounded Super-Resolution), a test-time framework that progressively identifies and suppresses likely hallucinated text regions during generation. To enable this, we train dedicated detectors on a large-scale dataset curated from diverse diffusion-based SR outputs. TGSR consistently improves text fidelity across multiple backbones, increasing recognition precision by up to 17.68 points without degrading perceptual quality, underscoring the value of selective control in generative SR.

To address this challenge, we propose GeoFix, a unified framework that improves geometric consistency and visual quality with a single geometric reward, applicable to both training and inference-time reward alignment. Our reward measures cross-view depth consistency in static scene regions, targeting structural inconsistencies without directly constraining appearance or penalizing valid object motion. Crucially, depth agreement increases with camera field-of-view overlap even in real videos and 4D datasets, allowing a smaller camera movement to be mistaken for better geometry. We account for this effect by calibrating the reward against the overlap-dependent trend. GeoFix achieves a 39% improvement in WorldScore 3D consistency and a 4% increase in VBench Quality Score.

### [25] [EV-JEPA: Elastic V-JEPA for Any Device and Cross-Device Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14324)
*Anxhelo Diko,Jieyu Lin,Stefano Ambrogio,Ziyun Li,Mahmoud Assran,Théo Moutakanni,Barbara De Salvo,Chiao Liu*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型（如V-JEPA）通常被视为固定容量网络并绑定单一设备，无法适应异构边缘-云连续体的可重构算力预算与跨设备协作。现有方法只能解决单一维度：slimmable/NAS仅提供宽度弹性但假设单设备推理，split-computing仅支持固定分区与静态容量的跨设备协作。
