This system shows the feasibility of real-time, edge-based tumor classification, providing quick diagnostic support for medical professionals and enhancing patient care in resource-limited healthcare facilities and underserved areas.

</details>


### [87] [Region Aware Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks for Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15079)
*Jack Roberts,Praneeth Tummala,Kavi Sarna,Jeova Farias Sales Rocha Neto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出将SE模块中的全局平均池化替换为空间引导池化，实现区域感知的通道重校准，并设计了BASE、SPASE、MAPSE、PLEASE四种模块，在多个分割与分类基准上优于SE及相关空间-通道注意力方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始SE模块通过全局平均池化建模通道依赖，但将空间结构压缩为单一通道描述子，限制了其在图像分割等密集预测任务中的效果。

Method: 用空间引导池化替代全局池化，提出四种区域划分方式：BASE用规则网格；SPASE用SLIC超像素；MAPSE用冻结通用网络生成的语义图；PLEASE用轻量分配网络端到端学习软区域分配。每个通道在每个区域获得一个门控，像素注意力反映其区域归属，从而连接通道与空间注意力。

Result: 在CUB、DUTS、ECSSD二值分割，PASCAL VOC 2012、ADE20K语义分割及mini-ImageNet分类上，多数基准中取得最优结果，优于SE及相关空间-通道注意力变体。部分模块几乎不增加参数，部分不增加可测延迟。

Conclusion: 空间引导池化可有效泛化SE，实现区域感知的通道重校准；PLEASE还能在推理时附带输出软区域分配，提供结构化空间可解释性。

Abstract: Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) modules improve convolutional networks by modeling channel-wise dependencies, but global average pooling collapses spatial structure into a single per-channel descriptor, limiting their effectiveness for dense prediction tasks such as image segmentation. We generalize SE by replacing global pooling with spatially guided pooling, enabling region-aware channel recalibration through four modules with complementary cost profiles. BASE formalizes Tiled Squeeze-and-Excite using a regular grid; SPASE pools over SLIC superpixels for image-adaptive regions; MAPSE obtains regions from semantic maps produced by a frozen, general-purpose network; and PLEASE learns soft region assignments end-to-end through a lightweight assignment network. Each channel receives one gate per region, so attention at each pixel reflects its region membership, bridging channel and spatial attention. PLEASE also produces its soft assignments as a byproduct of the forward pass, providing structured spatial interpretability without post-hoc analysis. The modules offer complementary computational tradeoffs: some add essentially no parameters, while others add no measurable latency. Across binary segmentation on CUB, DUTS, and ECSSD, semantic segmentation on PASCAL VOC 2012 and ADE20K, and classification on mini-ImageNet, our modules outperform SE and related spatial-channel attention variants on most benchmarks, achieving the majority of best results.

</details>


### [88] [VLCQ: Post-training quantization for deep neural networks using variable length coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15092)
*Reem Abdel-Salam,Ahmed H. Abdel-Gawad,Amr G. Wassal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VLCQ：一种放松定点编码约束的后训练量化方法，通过变长编码实现更低比特宽度，无需训练数据或微调即可超越FP32与PWLQ。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高性能后训练量化方法多依赖INT8定点整数，进一步降低比特宽度会导致显著性能下降，难以在低比特下兼顾压缩率与精度。

Method: 提出VLCQ后训练量化方法，放松定点编码约束，采用变长编码来更灵活地探索量化方案，无需访问训练数据或模型微调。

Result: 在图像分类、分割与目标检测上优于SOTA后训练量化。逐通道量化下超过FP32精度与PWLQ，较FP32最高6倍压缩、较PWLQ最高1.7倍；以压缩优先时较FP32最高12.25倍压缩且性能损失小于4%。逐张量量化下与DFQ相当，并提供更大灵活性。

Conclusion: VLCQ通过变长编码放松定点约束，在低比特下实现更优压缩与精度平衡，适用于多任务与多模型的后训练量化场景。

Abstract: Quantization plays a crucial role in efficiently deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained devices. Post-training quantization does not require access to the original dataset or retraining the full model. Current methods that achieve high performance close to baseline results typically require INT8 fixed-point integers. However, achieving higher model compression with lower bit-widths often leads to significant performance degradation. In this paper, we propose VLCQ, a post-training quantization method that relaxes the fixed-point encoding constraint, enabling more flexible exploration of quantization techniques through variable-length encoding. This approach achieves competitive or improved performance while reducing bit-widths, without requiring access to training data or model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on image classification, segmentation, and object detection demonstrate that VLCQ improves model compression and accuracy compared with state-of-the-art post-training quantization approaches. For per-channel quantization, VLCQ surpasses FP32 accuracy and Piece-Wise Linear Quantization (PWLQ) on most evaluated models, achieving up to 6x compression compared with FP32 and up to 1.7x compared with PWLQ. When prioritizing compression with limited accuracy loss, VLCQ achieves up to 12.25x compression compared with FP32 with less than 4% performance degradation. For per-tensor quantization, VLCQ is competitive with Data-Free Quantization (DFQ), while providing greater flexibility to achieve lower bit rates across different tasks and models.

</details>


### [89] [TIDE: Trajectory-Informed Skill Distillation for Efficient Text-to-Video Prompt Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15098)
*Chengxing Zhou,Yuliang Huang,Jingwei Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TIDE将昂贵的prompt优化搜索过程蒸馏为一个可解释、可复用的prompt重写Skill，仅需一次LLM调用和一次T2V生成即可达到搜索式方法的优化效果，并可迁移到未见过的视频生成模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T2V模型对prompt特异性高度敏感，但现有迭代式prompt优化需要反复生成视频并用视觉语言模型评估，推理成本高昂且难以复用。

Method: 将prompt重写建模为一组源条件规则模块，每个模块针对一个语义维度；蒸馏后冻结Skill，激活相关规则，单次LLM调用同时生成正负prompt，仅进行一次T2V生成，无需测试时视觉搜索或骨干微调。

Result: 仅用100个prompt、14小时进化，性能即可媲美计算昂贵的搜索式方法；迁移到未见过的视频生成模型时，优于专门为该模型设计或训练的方法。

Conclusion: TIDE将prompt优化从推理时搜索转化为可复用的Skill，实现高效、可迁移的T2V提示优化。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) models are highly sensitive to prompt specificity, while iterative prompt optimization typically improves generation quality only through repeated video generation and vision-language model evaluation at inference time. We propose TIDE, a framework that distills this costly search process into an interpretable and reusable prompt-rewriting Skill. TIDE formulates prompt rewriting as a set of source-conditioned rule modules, each targeting a distinct semantic dimension. Once distilled, the frozen Skill activates the relevant rules and generates both positive and negative prompts in a single LLM call, followed by only one T2V generation, without test-time visual search or backbone fine-tuning. Evolved using only 100 prompts over 14 hours, TIDE achieves prompt-optimization performance comparable to computationally expensive search-based methods. Moreover, when transferred to previously unseen video-generation models, TIDE outperforms existing approaches specifically designed or trained for those models. Code is available at https://github.com/xiningin/TIDE_T2V.

</details>


### [90] [Drive3R: Block-wise Streaming Geometric Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15112)
*Tianyi Yang,Haojun Yang,Jipeng Xiao,Xuesong Chen,Shaoshuai Shi,Li Jiang,Zhipeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Drive3R 提出块式流式几何基础模型，通过块式因果注意力与置信度感知重锚定，解决长时序自动驾驶多视角3D重建的可扩展性与漂移问题，在多个数据集上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真闭环仿真依赖密集多视角3D重建，但将前馈几何基础模型应用于连续长时序驾驶序列时，受GPU显存限制和全局注意力二次复杂度影响难以可行。现有扩展策略中，因果流式方法存在误差累积导致的尺度漂移与轨迹偏离，而"分块后对齐"启发式方法割裂全局上下文并产生轨迹不连续。

Method: 提出Drive3R，一种块式流式几何基础模型。核心包括：(1) 块式因果注意力，在缓解全双向注意力可扩展性瓶颈的同时，避免纯因果流式丢失局部未来上下文；(2) 置信度感知重锚定，通过检测不可靠的流式状态、重新初始化KV缓存，并借助SE(3)对齐拼接刷新片段，以缓解长程漂移。

Result: 在nuScenes、KITTI和Waymo上达到新的SOTA。在nuScenes上相较DVGT-2基线，AbsRel从0.1806降至0.1081，点云Accuracy从0.6750提升至0.5344，ATE从1.5812降至0.9092。

Conclusion: Drive3R通过块式因果注意力与置信度感知重锚定的结合，有效解决了长时序驾驶序列中几何基础模型的可扩展性与漂移问题，为自动驾驶闭环仿真提供了高性能的密集多视角3D重建方案。

Abstract: High-fidelity closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving increasingly relies on dense multi-view 3D reconstruction. While recent feed-forward geometric foundation models have revolutionized per-scene optimization, applying them to continuous, long-horizon driving sequences is computationally intractable due to GPU memory limits and the quadratic complexity of global attention. Existing scaling strategies are fundamentally limited, as causal streaming suffers from compounding scale drift and trajectory deviation, while rigid "chunk-then-align" heuristics fragment global context and produce trajectory discontinuities. To address these limitations, we introduce Drive3R, a block-wise streaming geometric foundation model. Its block-wise causal attention resolves the scalability bottleneck of fully bidirectional attention while avoiding the loss of local future context in purely causal streaming. Its confidence-aware re-anchoring further mitigates long-range drift by detecting unreliable streaming states, re-initializing the KV cache, and stitching refreshed segments through SE(3) alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Drive3R establishes a new state-of-the-art on nuScenes, KITTI, and Waymo. Specifically, on nuScenes, it improves over the recent DVGT-2 baseline from 0.1806 to 0.1081 in AbsRel, from 0.6750 to 0.5344 in point-cloud Accuracy, and from 1.5812 to 0.9092 in ATE.

</details>


### [91] [RIECNN: Real-Time Image Enhanced CNN for Traffic Sign Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15127)
*Reem Abdel-Salam,Rana Mostafa,Ahmed H. Abdel-Gawad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出实时图像增强CNN（Real-Time Image Enhanced CNN）用于交通标志识别，在多个数据集上达到最高识别率与实时性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通标志识别对自动驾驶和道路安全至关重要，但现有深度学习算法受环境影响（如亮度、对比度变化）且实时性差，需要一种能应对多样数据集并满足实时约束的方法。

Method: 提出Real-Time Image Enhanced CNN方法，结合实时图像增强与CNN，针对GTSRB、BTSC和rMASTIF三个数据集进行实验。

Result: 识别准确率：GTSRB 99.75%，BTSC 99.25%，rMASTIF 99.55%，均为最高；预处理加推理时间不超过1.3 ms/图像。

Conclusion: 所提方法实现高精度与实时性能，且对环境亮度与对比度变化具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Traffic sign recognition plays a crucial role in the development of autonomous cars to reduce the accident rate and promote road safety. It has been a necessity to address traffic signs that are affected significantly by the environment as well as poor real-time performance for deep-learning state-of-the-art algorithms. In this paper, we introduce Real-Time Image Enhanced CNN ({\our}) for Traffic Sign Recognition. {\our} is a real-time, novel approach that tackles multiple, diverse traffic sign datasets, and out-performs the state-of-the-art architectures in terms of recognition rate and execution time. Experiments are conducted using the German Traffic Sign Benchmark (GTSRB), the Belgium Traffic Sign Classification (BTSC), and the Croatian Traffic Sign (rMASTIF) benchmark. Experimental results show that our approach has achieved the highest recognition rate for all Benchmarks, achieving a recognition accuracy of 99.75\% for GTSRB, 99.25\% for BTSC and 99.55\% for rMASTIF. In terms of latency and meeting the real-time constraint, the pre-processing time and inference time together do not exceed 1.3 ms per image. Not only have our proposed approach achieved remarkably high accuracy with real-time performance, but it also demonstrated robustness against traffic sign recognition challenges such as brightness and contrast variations in the environment.

</details>


### [92] [TRIG: Toward Measuring Texture Realism in Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15164)
*Zhiwei Xu,Jiali Cui,Zhiqiang Lao,Heather Yu,Liang Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TRIG指标，用纹理数据集预训练的GAN判别器作为骨干，专门评估生成图像的纹理真实性，与人类真实感评分更一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成图像质量评估指标依赖为分类或图文对齐训练的骨干，这类目标鼓励对携带纹理的低层变化保持不变性，导致特征主要编码语义和全局结构，难以显式捕捉纹理真实性差异。

Method: TRIG以纹理数据集预训练的GAN判别器作为骨干，提供自然纹理局部统计的先验；微调一个plausibility head识别局部纹理退化，同时将自然失焦和传感器噪声视为正例；在骨干特征上计算真实参考集与生成集之间的标准分布距离。

Result: 在多个生成模型上应用TRIG，其与人类真实感评分的吻合度优于基线指标。

Conclusion: TRIG通过引入纹理先验的判别器骨干，为生成图像的纹理真实性评估提供了更贴合人类感知的度量方式。

Abstract: This paper studies the backbone used by metrics for evaluating the quality of generated images. Although generative models have advanced rapidly, some outputs still exhibit unrealistic texture characteristics, and these differences are difficult to measure. Widely used evaluation metrics provide limited insight into texture realism, since they often rely on a backbone trained for another objective, such as image classification or image-text alignment. Such objectives typically encourage invariance to low-level variations that carry texture, so the resulting features primarily encode semantic and global structure. As a result, texture-specific discrepancies may not be explicitly captured. We propose TRIG, a metric directed at the texture realism of generated images. Its backbone is instead the discriminator of a generative adversarial network pre-trained on a texture dataset, which provides a learned prior for the local statistics of natural textures. A plausibility head is fine-tuned to identify local texture degradations, while preserving natural defocus and sensor noise as positive cases. On the features of this backbone, we compute a standard distributional distance between a reference set of real images and a set of generated ones. We apply TRIG to several generative models and observe closer agreement with human realness ratings than baseline metrics.

</details>


### [93] [ExeWorldBench: Benchmarking Code-Based Executable 3D World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15166)
*Xinge Peng,Zhen Fang,Ruibing Wang,Yongxuan Lv,Haodong Li,Guohui Zhang,Xiaoxiao Ma,Yiting Lu,Lin Chen,Zehui Che,Feng Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ExeWorldBench，首个通过代码化 3D 世界构建来综合评估"世界理解"与"可执行实现"能力的基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体已从复现世界外观转向构建可执行世界，需要"可执行世界建模"能力（世界理解+可执行实现）。但现有基准仅零散评测物理推理、视觉保真或行为正确性，未评估二者整合。

Method: 构建 ExeWorldBench，包含三个递进任务：1) 机制可执行性（从视觉观察实现单个机制）；2) 组合可执行性（多阶段系统，含空间、机械、因果依赖）；3) 意图驱动的可执行世界合成（从高层目标与物理需求构建可执行世界）。

Result: 对前沿模型的大量实验揭示了其在可执行世界建模上的显著局限。

Conclusion: 为开发更具物理基础、因果连贯的世界构建系统提供了洞见。

Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly evolving beyond reproducing what a world looks like toward constructing executable worlds that capture how a world works. This shift calls for executable world modeling, which integrates two core capabilities: world understanding, reasoning about the underlying structural, mechanical, and causal principles of a world, and executable realization, translating that understanding into a code-based system whose behavior emerges from physical interactions. However, existing benchmarks provide only fragmented evaluations centered on physical reasoning, visual fidelity, or behavioral correctness, leaving the integration of these capabilities insufficiently assessed. To bridge this gap, we introduce ExeWorldBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark to comprehensively evaluate world understanding and executable realization through code-based 3D world construction. ExeWorldBench comprises three progressively challenging tasks: Mechanism Executability, which evaluates the realization of individual mechanisms from visual observations; Compositional Executability, which extends to multi-stage systems with spatial, mechanical, and causal dependencies; and Intent-Driven Executable World Synthesis, which requires constructing executable worlds from high-level goals and physical requirements. Extensive experiments on frontier models reveal substantial limitations in executable world modeling, offering insights into the development of more physically grounded and causally coherent world construction systems.

</details>


### [94] [GeoBridge: Evolving Transferable Decoder Topologies for Geometric Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15280)
*Rui Wang,Haoyu Zhang,Ran Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoBridge 提出可迁移解码器拓扑的进化搜索框架，使单一搜索的解码器拓扑可跨深度估计、高斯重建等几何视觉任务复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度估计与高斯重建都需多尺度特征处理，但预测接口和训练目标不同；仅搜索算子配置无法改变变换的组织方式，解码器内部计算能否优化一次并复用于多系统仍是结构设计问题。

Method: 将阶段内部拓扑设计为可搜索：通过残差、串行、并行方式组合可配置算子，并用保形组合保持固定多尺度支架的阶段接口；采用功能树编码支持阶段感知交叉与分层变异，用梯度敏感性对齐代理免训练评估候选，并做多目标进化权衡性能代理、计算量与参数量；最后将选定拓扑实例化并在目标任务特定接口下训练。

Result: 一次源搜索约需 12 GPU 小时。GeoBridgeNet-A3 在 NYU Depth V2 和 KITTI 上、相同编码器与训练协议下，深度精度优于四个适配解码器基线；同一拓扑在 RealEstate10K 高斯新视角合成达 27.11 dB PSNR，其精炼表示还支持 LERF 开放词汇分割。

Conclusion: 结果表明解码器拓扑可作为可复用设计对象，在所评估的几何视觉系统中实现跨任务迁移。

Abstract: Depth estimation and Gaussian reconstruction share a need for multi-scale feature processing, yet use different prediction interfaces and training objectives. Whether a decoder's internal computation can be optimized once and reused across these systems remains a structural design question. Search over primitive configurations alone leaves the organization of transformations fixed. To address this gap, we propose GeoBridge, an evolutionary framework for transferable decoder topologies. First, GeoBridge makes stage-internal topology searchable through residual, sequential, and parallel composition of configurable primitives. Shape-preserving composition retains the stage interfaces of a fixed multi-scale scaffold. Second, a functional-tree encoding supports stage-aware crossover and hierarchical mutation, while a gradient sensitivity-alignment proxy evaluates candidates without training. Multi-objective evolution balances this proxy with computation and parameter cost. Third, selected topologies are instantiated and trained in target systems with task-specific prediction interfaces. A single source search takes approximately 12 GPU hours. GeoBridgeNet-A3 achieves the best depth accuracy among four adapted decoder baselines under a common encoder and training protocol on NYU Depth V2 and KITTI. The same topology reaches 27.11 dB PSNR in Gaussian novel-view synthesis on RealEstate10K, and its refined representations support open-vocabulary segmentation on LERF. These results support decoder topology as a reusable design object across the evaluated geometric vision systems. Code and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/EMI-Group/GeoBridge-NAS.

</details>


### [95] [Protein Crystallization Segmentation and Classification Using Subordinate Color Channel in Fluorescence Microscopy Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15286)
*Truong X. Tran,Marc L. Pusey,Ramazan S. Aygun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于荧光发射光谱次级颜色通道（长于峰值波长）的百分位强度分割方法，用于TFL蛋白结晶试验图像检测，显著降低误分类率并提高准确率至约94%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 荧光显微图像中蛋白晶体检测对高通量自动化系统至关重要。虽迹量荧光标记(TFL)可高亮晶体，但反射与染料发射并非总来自晶体区域，故仅分析发射光谱峰值波长往往不够有效。

Method: 利用发射光谱峰值波长以外、对应更长波长的次级颜色强度，构建基于次级颜色百分位强度的分割方法，用于TFL蛋白结晶试验图像。

Result: 相比主颜色通道，次级颜色通道方法将"可能先导物/晶体误判为非晶体"的错误率从9.71%降至2.02%（依分类器而定），分类器准确率提升1.77%–5.53%，达约94%准确率且误分类低于1%。在Con A与AbIPPase两种蛋白的新湿实验中误分类率亦低于1%，验证了泛化性。

Conclusion: 使用次级颜色通道更有助于TFL蛋白试验图像分类，可有效提升蛋白晶体检测精度。

Abstract: The accuracy of detecting protein crystals for fluorescence microscopy images is very critical for high throughput and automated systems. Although the trace fluorescent labeling method could highlight protein crystals, reflection and emission from the fluorescence dye is not always due to crystal regions. Therefore, the analysis of the peak wavelength in the emission spectra of a fluorophore may not always yield effective results. In this paper, we show that using the subordinate color intensity corresponding to longer wavelengths than the peak wavelength of the emission spectra could improve the accuracy of protein crystal detection. Hence, we have built a segmentation method based on the percentile intensity of the subordinate color for trace fluorescently labeled (TFL'd) protein crystallization trial images. Compared to using the dominant color channel, our segmentation method on subordinate color channel was able to reduce the misclassification rate of likely-leads or crystals as non-crystals by the percentage of from 9.71% to 2.02% depending on the classifier. Similarly, the accuracy of classifiers were increased by the percentage of from 1.77% to 5.53%. Our method reached around 94% accuracy while keeping misclassification of likely-leads and crystals as non-crystals below 1%. Moreover, to evaluate the generalizability of our method, we have conducted new wet lab experiments on two proteins, Concanavalin A (Con A) and Ab inorganic pyrophosphate (AbIPPase), and the misclassification rate was below 1%. Our experiments show that using the subordinate channel may be more helpful for TFL'd protein trial image classification.

</details>


### [96] [ASM-6D: Fast Certified Pose-Shape Inference with Complete Correspondence Flow Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15287)
*Ho Jin Choi,Minku Kim,Nadia Figueroa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ASM-6D，通过生成式完整几何预测与显式类别级位姿-形状推断（共享对应关系）耦合，实现类别级6D位姿与形状估计，在ROPE和HouseCat6D上达到SOTA，并支持形状补全、跟踪与机器人抓取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类别级6D位姿与形状估计需在缺乏精确实例模型的情况下，从部分观测中恢复物体的位姿与几何。现有方法往往需要单独的对应关系分配阶段，效率与精度受限。

Method: 给定RGB-D图像，ASM-6D生成多个完整的3D对应假设，其点身份与类别级Active Shape Model（ASM）共享（含遮挡点）；每个假设直接拟合旋转、平移、度量尺度与实例形状，无需单独对应分配。作者解析地消去平移与形状系数，将拟合简化为九变量的缩放旋转优化问题，支持多假设实时批量评估。

Result: 在ROPE和HouseCat6D基准上取得SOTA性能。消融实验表明生成式对应预测与主动形状变化的重要性。该表示还支持形状补全、依赖形状的位姿歧义、跟踪和机器人抓取，速度依推理预算为6–38 Hz。

Conclusion: ASM-6D通过共享对应关系耦合生成式完整几何预测与类别级位姿-形状推断，避免了独立对应分配，实现高效实时拟合，并在多项任务中展现通用性与实用性。

Abstract: Category-level 6D pose and shape estimation requires recovering an object's pose and geometry from partial observations without an exact instance model. We present ASM-6D, which couples generative complete-geometry prediction with explicit category-level pose-shape inference through shared correspondences. Given an RGB-D image, ASM-6D generates alternative complete 3D correspondence hypotheses whose point identities are shared with a category-level Active Shape Model (ASM), including occluded points. Each hypothesis is fitted directly for rotation, translation, metric scale, and instance shape without a separate correspondence-assignment stage. We analytically eliminate translation and shape coefficients, reducing fitting to a nine-variable scaled-rotation optimization problem that enables efficient batched evaluation of multiple hypotheses in real time. ASM-6D achieves state-of-the-art performance on ROPE and HouseCat6D benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate the importance of generative correspondence prediction and active shape variation. The representation also supports shape completion, shape-dependent pose ambiguity, tracking, and robotic grasping at 6-38 Hz, depending on the inference budget.

</details>


### [97] [HGA-Quant: Heterogeneity-Aware Quantization for AutoRegressive Visual Generation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15297)
*Xinmeng Liu,Xianglong Yan,Kaicheng Yang,Weisheng Dong,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的ARVG后训练量化框架，含T-BGR与CAPS，实现低比特下近乎全精度图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ARVG模型生成质量高但计算和内存开销大，难以部署在边缘设备；现有PTQ方法在低比特量化下图像质量严重下降。

Method: 免训练PTQ框架，包含两部分：T-BGR引入尾部感知重建目标校准权重量化器，对分布尾部系数赋予更高权重以保留细节，且不增加参数或高精度分支；CAPS通过联合考虑各生成阶段的重要性和计算成本，在给定比特预算下进行从粗到细的激活精度调度，实现高效混合精度分配。

Result: 在多个ARVG骨干网络上实验，框架在激进低比特量化下持续提升鲁棒性；在Infinity上以W4A5.6有效激活精度接近全精度生成质量，而现有方法在W4A6仍有明显质量下降或不稳定。

Conclusion: 该免训练PTQ框架能有效缓解ARVG低比特量化质量退化问题，实现高效低比特部署。

Abstract: Recently, AutoRegressive Visual Generation (ARVG) models have emerged as a competitive paradigm for high-quality image synthesis. However, their substantial computational and memory demands make them difficult to deploy on resource-constrained edge devices. Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) provides a promising solution to reduce the computational and memory costs of ARVG models, yet existing methods often suffer from substantial image quality degradation under low-bit quantization. In this paper, we propose a training-free PTQ framework for ARVG, consisting of Tail-Aware Bounded-init Grid Refinement (T-BGR) and Coarse-to-Fine Activation Precision Scheduling (CAPS). T-BGR introduces a tail-aware reconstruction objective for weight quantizer calibration, assigning greater importance to distribution-tail coefficients and preserving fine-grained information without introducing additional parameters or high-precision branches. CAPS performs coarse-to-fine activation precision scheduling by jointly considering the importance and computational cost of different generation stages, enabling efficient mixed-precision allocation under a given bit budget. Extensive experiments on multiple ARVG backbones demonstrate that our framework consistently improves robustness under aggressive low-bit quantization. Notably, on Infinity, our framework achieves near full-precision image generation quality at an effective W4A5.6 activation precision, while existing methods at W4A6 still exhibit noticeable quality degradation or inconsistent performance. Code is available at https://github.com/lxm-lc/HGA-Quant.

</details>


### [98] [Channel Match: Calibrating Shape Latents for Few-Step 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15321)
*Di Yang,Zhihao Li,Yanhai Xiong,Yufei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出少步蒸馏框架加速原生3D生成，并发现采样导致的隐空间漂移会破坏PBR纹理合成，提出免训练Channel Match校准修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原生3D生成器用flow transformer建模结构化3D隐变量质量高，但高分辨率生成因迭代采样计算昂贵；同时少步生成存在被忽视的失败模式。

Method: 连续自一致性训练+自定义JVP FlashAttention核+稀疏结构化3D隐变量的解析速度回归目标；自适应损失权重策略自动平衡优化；提出免训练、自适应逐通道隐变量校准方法Channel Match。

Result: 在TRELLIS.2的1024^3设置上验证：两步模型几何采样提速4.5倍且几何质量接近多步教师模型，Channel Match进一步恢复几何与外观生成间的隐空间接口，提升渲染质量。

Conclusion: 少步蒸馏可显著加速原生3D生成，且需关注采样引起的隐分布漂移对下游纹理合成的影响，Channel Match无需改动生成器即可修复。

Abstract: Recent native 3D generators achieve high-quality asset creation by modeling structured 3D latents with flow-based transformers, but their high-resolution generation remains computationally expensive due to costly iterative sampling. In this work, we introduce a few-step distillation framework for native 3D generation, enabled by continuous self-consistency training with a custom JVP FlashAttention kernel and an analytic velocity regression objective for sparse structured 3D latents. To stabilize joint optimization, we further introduce an adaptive loss weighting strategy that automatically balances them without manual tuning. Beyond acceleration, we reveal a previously overlooked failure mode of few-step native 3D generation: sampling-induced latent distribution drift preserves geometric correctness but disrupts downstream PBR texture synthesis, causing texture artifacts on geometrically valid assets. To address this issue, we propose Channel Match, a training-free adaptive per-channel latent calibration method that restores the latent distribution without modifying either generator. We validate our approach on TRELLIS.2 at the $1024^3$ resolution setting. Our two-step model achieves $4.5\times$ faster geometry sampling while maintaining geometry quality comparable to the many-step teacher, and Channel Match further improves rendering quality by recovering the latent interface between geometry and appearance generation.

</details>


### [99] [TempoKV: Predictive KV Cache Quantization for Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15324)
*Jiahui Hu,Weile Mo,Peiliang Cai,Jiacheng Liu,Jinkui Ren,Xiantao Zhang,Xiaobing Tu,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的预测式KV缓存量化框架，利用视频KV缓存的可预测性和Key/Value不对称依赖，仅存低精度残差，实现最高6.71倍压缩且质量优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型可实现长视频流式生成，但KV缓存快速增长带来显著显存开销。现有KV缓存量化方法主要针对LLM设计，迁移到视频模型效果差，因为视频激活统计特性不同且具有强时空冗余。

Method: 观察到视频KV缓存随时间高度可预测且存在不对称性：Key可由其时间历史高度预测，Value主要依赖当前Key并需少量前序Value。据此提出免训练预测式KV量化框架，按不同依赖分别预测Key和Value，仅以低精度存储残差。两个预测器轻量，通过少量BF16样本离线线性回归校准一次，在不同提示和生成过程中保持固定。

Result: 在Self-Forcing、Causal Forcing和LongCat-Video-13B上，本方法在相当或更高压缩比下生成质量持续优于现有KV缓存量化方法，最高达6.71倍KV缓存压缩，取得最佳质量-效率权衡。

Conclusion: 利用视频KV缓存的预测性和Key/Value不对称依赖，可用免训练、轻量的预测加残差量化替代直接量化，实现高压缩与高质量平衡，代码将开源。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable streaming generation of long videos but suffer from significant memory overhead due to the rapidly growing KV cache. Existing KV cache quantization methods are primarily designed for LLMs and transfer poorly to video models, where activations exhibit different statistics and strong spatiotemporal redundancy. We observe that the video KV cache is largely predictable over time, with a clear asymmetry. Keys are highly predictable from their temporal history, while values depend primarily on the current key and need a short history of preceding values. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{\method}, a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for AR video generation. \method predicts keys and values according to their distinct dependencies and stores only the residuals at low precision. Both predictors are lightweight, calibrated once offline by linear regression on a small set of BF16 samples, and remain fixed across prompts and generation runs. Experiments on Self-Forcing, Causal Forcing, and LongCat-Video-13B show that \method consistently achieves higher generation quality than existing KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to $6.71\times$ KV cache compression with the best overall quality--efficiency tradeoff. Our code will be released on GitHub.

</details>


### [100] [BaT-SAM: Introducing Inductive Bias into SAM via a Mixture of Convolutional Experts for Brain Tumor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15330)
*Sumiaya Jannat,Md Mahedi Hasan,Md Shamimul Islam,Md Nur Hossain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BaT-SAM：通过Conv-LoRA和自提示框回归器实现全自动脑肿瘤分割，参数高效（<5M）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MRI脑肿瘤分割对诊疗关键，但人工勾画费时费力；现有方法或任务专用泛化差，或推理时依赖用户提示。

Method: 在冻结的SAM ViT编码器中用Conv-LoRA注入局部归纳偏置，特征经稀疏门控多尺度卷积专家混合处理；并引入轻量自提示框回归器，用计划采样与适配器联合优化，从图像嵌入直接预测肿瘤位置。

Result: BRISC2025上加权平均IoU 0.832，超越SOTA；跨数据集泛化：Figshare Dice 0.702，LGG MRI Dice 0.784；微调参数<5M（<1%）。

Conclusion: BaT-SAM以极少参数实现全自动、可泛化的脑肿瘤分割，兼具高效与领先性能。

Abstract: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosis and treatment planning; however, manual delineation is labor-intensive and time-consuming. Existing approaches are either task-specific with limited generalization or rely on user-provided prompts during inference. We present BaT-SAM, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework that enables fully automatic brain tumor segmentation with the Segment Anything Model (SAM). BaT-SAM injects local inductive bias into SAM's frozen Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder via Conv-LoRA, where image features are processed by a sparsely gated mixture of multi-scale convolutional experts. This design compensates for the limited translation-equivariant inductive bias of vanilla ViTs while fine-tuning fewer than 5M parameters (less than 1% of the full model). To remove the need for user prompts, we further introduce a lightweight self-prompting box regressor that is jointly optimized with the adapter using scheduled sampling and predicts tumor locations directly from image embeddings. On the BRISC2025 benchmark, BaT-SAM achieves a weighted mean IoU of 0.832 while outperforming state-of-the-art benchmarks. It further demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization, achieving Dice scores of 0.702 on Figshare and 0.784 on the LGG MRI Segmentation dataset.

</details>


### [101] [StimFlow: Synthesizing Brain Activity from Images via Stimulus-conditioned Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15341)
*Bui Van Hung,Dang Thanh Vu,Hoang-Son Vo,Mai Duc Minh Huy,Mai Tien Dung,Soo-Hyung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StimFlow 使用条件流匹配在原生体素空间直接合成 fMRI，结合 DINOv2 结构特征与 CLIP 语义特征，单样本即可媲美需平均五次采样的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: fMRI 响应跨试次存在固有变异性，促使将刺激到响应映射视为生成问题。现有生成编码器多工作在压缩潜空间且主要依赖语义特征，对早期视觉皮层缺乏低层线索。

Method: 提出 StimFlow，采用线性路径的条件流匹配在原生体素空间直接生成 fMRI，对齐训练与推理分布；特征上融合 DINOv2 结构特征与 CLIP 语义特征以匹配视觉层级。

Result: 单样本达到每体素 Pearson 相关 0.371，与平均五次采样的基线相当；体素空间生成支持直接 ROI 分析与概念定位，无需解码器；仅一小时扫描即可恢复超一半的全数据性能。

Conclusion: StimFlow 证明原生体素空间生成可行且高效，减少对平均的依赖，并有利于跨被试快速适应。

Abstract: The inherent variability of fMRI responses across trials encourages a generative view of the stimulus-to-response mapping. Prior generative encoders often operate in compressed latent spaces and condition predominantly on semantic features, which provide limited low-level cues for early visual cortex. We propose StimFlow, which synthesizes fMRI directly in native voxel space using conditional flow matching with a linear path. This design aligns training and inference distributions, enabling competitive performance with a single sample and reducing reliance on averaging. To match the visual hierarchy, StimFlow combines structural DINOv2 features with semantic CLIP features, which prove complementary along the cortical processing stream. With a single sample, StimFlow achieves a per-voxel Pearson correlation of 0.371, matching baselines that average five draws. Generation in voxel space allows direct ROI analysis and concept localization without a decoder. Furthermore, it recovers over half of full-data performance from just one hour of scans, supporting efficient cross-subject adaptation.

</details>


### [102] [Across Viewpoints and Time: Trajectory-Generalizable Physical Attacks on World Models and Video Understanding Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15343)
*Song Xia,Meiwen Ding,Chenqi Kong,Wenhan Yang,Xudong Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TARA，一种轨迹感知的物理对抗纹理攻击方法，可在不同视角轨迹下用单一可打印纹理解持续性误导世界模型与视频理解模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型与视频理解模型日益部署于动态视觉环境，但其对物理对抗威胁的鲁棒性研究不足，尤其是跨视角、跨轨迹场景下单一物理纹理的攻击有效性尚未被探索。

Method: TARA包含三部分：轨迹感知优化以捕获打印纹理在真实场景中的几何变化；轨迹感知对比对齐，使不同视频-轨迹实例的被攻击表征趋近共享对抗区域；轨迹感知任务细化，将对齐表征转化为任务级预测错误。另构建几何驱动的跟踪管线，在EPIC-KITCHENS-100与Something-Something V2上生成物理合理的对抗区域与时间一致轨迹。

Result: 在标注基准及真实打印-重拍视频上验证，单一可打印对抗纹理能在物理条件下持续干扰世界模型与视频理解模型，攻击在不同轨迹与实例间保持有效。

Conclusion: 研究表明物理对抗纹理对世界模型与视频理解模型构成根本性安全挑战，所构建基准与真实数据为未来评测提供了可复现测试平台。

Abstract: World models and video understanding models are increasingly deployed in dynamic visual environments, yet their robustness to physical adversarial threats remains largely underexplored. We study whether a single physical adversarial texture can mislead the victim model across different real-world scenarios where observing viewpoints vary along uncontrolled object--camera trajectories. We identify that heterogeneous video semantics and trajectories induce poorly aligned gradients for optimizing the adversarial texture. To address that, we propose the Trajectory-aware adversarial Alignment and Refinement Attack (TARA), which incorporates trajectory-aware optimization to capture the evolving geometric variations of a printed texture under real-world scenarios. To improve cross-instance optimization compatibility, TARA incorporates trajectory-aware contrastive alignment to encourage attacked representations from diverse video--trajectory instances to approach a shared adversarial region and then performs trajectory-aware task refinement to translate the aligned representation into task-level prediction errors. For reproducible evaluation, we develop a geometry-grounded tracking pipeline that provides physically plausible adversarial regions with temporally consistent trajectories on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 and Something-Something V2. We further collect real-world print-and-recapture videos to validate attack effectiveness under physical deployment conditions. Together, the annotated benchmarks and real-world captured data form a reproducible testbed for future evaluation. Notably, our results reveal that a single printable adversarial texture can persistently disrupt world models and video understanding models under physical conditions, highlighting the fundamental security challenge.

</details>


### [103] [Video-Based Sexual Harassment Detection Using Fine-Tuned Video Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15354)
*Jubayer- Al- Mahmud,Md Shamimul Islam,Md Nur Hossain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将性骚扰视频(SHV)数据集扩展至600段YouTube短视频并标注为骚扰/非骚扰两类，微调VideoMAE、ViViT、TimeSformer三种视频Transformer做二分类，TimeSformer以92.27%测试准确率最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 性骚扰是普遍的社会问题，大量事件因证据不足和干预延迟而未被举报；实时智能监控可辅助执法并起威慑作用。但视频骚扰检测面临服装、光照、遮挡、低分辨率、视角多变等挑战，且因缺乏大规模标注视频数据集而研究稀少。

Method: 将SHV数据集扩展至600段来自YouTube的短视频，按统一标注指南分为骚扰与非骚扰；基于Kinetics-400预训练的三种视频Transformer（VideoMAE、ViViT、TimeSformer）进行二分类微调。

Result: 三种模型均取得有竞争力的分类性能，TimeSformer测试准确率最高92.27%，优于VideoMAE的91.71%和ViViT的91.16%。分析表明性能受数据集规模、视频质量、帧采样策略和模型架构显著影响。

Conclusion: 本文对现代视频Transformer在该敏感现实任务上进行了全面评估，为该领域提供了基准与经验性洞见。

Abstract: Sexual harassment represents a pervasive societal challenge, with a substantial proportion of incidents remaining unreported due to insufficient evidence and delayed intervention mechanisms. Smart surveillance systems capable of detecting such incidents in real-time could assist law enforcement and serve as a deterrent. However, video-based harassment detection poses significant challenges, including variations in clothing, illumina- tion, partial occlusions, low resolution, and diverse camera view- points. Despite its social importance, this problem has received limited research attention, primarily due to the scarcity of large- scale annotated video datasets. To address this gap, we extend the Sexual Harassment Video (SHV) dataset to 600 short video clips sourced from YouTube and annotated into harassment and non-harassment categories using consistent labeling guidelines. We fine-tune three state-of-the-art video transformer models, VideoMAE, ViViT, and TimeSformer, pretrained on Kinetics- 400, for binary harassment classification. Experimental results show that all three models achieve competitive classification performance, with TimeSformer attaining the highest test accu- racy of 92.27%, outperforming VideoMAE 91.71% and ViViT 91.16% on the extended SHV test set. Our analysis reveals that performance is notably influenced by dataset size, video quality, frame sampling strategy, and model architecture. This work presents a comprehensive evaluation of modern video transformers for this sensitive real-world task.

</details>


### [104] [UniForge3D: Joint 3D Reconstruction and Generation in a Shared Anchor-Guided Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15357)
*Wenjue Chen,Wenyue Chen,Heliang Zheng,Rongfei Jia,Yuan Liu,Meng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniForge3D 通过锚点引导的共享空间统一重建与生成，解决坐标不匹配问题，并用逐体素视图选择引导细节生成，在 Toys4K 和 GSO 上取得最优外观与几何结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀疏无位姿图像生成完整 3D 资产需同时保留已观测几何并补全未见区域。联合重建与生成可兼顾两者，但相机相对的重建与规范空间的生成存在坐标不匹配，且对每个 3D 位置不加区分地条件化所有视图会混入无关图像内容，损害局部细节恢复。

Method: 提出 UniForge3D，在锚点引导的共享空间（遵循锚点视角方位、保持物体直立）中联合建模重建与生成。两分支双向交换特征，预测逐视图点图与完整稀疏体素结构；并以生成结构条件化点图预测，建立像素到体素的对应关系，为每个体素选择信息量最大的输入视图，用其特征引导细节形状生成。

Result: 在 Toys4K 和 GSO 数据集上取得最优的外观与几何表现，生成更高质量的完整 3D 资产。

Conclusion: UniForge3D 通过统一坐标空间与视图选择机制，有效结合重建与生成，显著提升完整 3D 资产的保真度。

Abstract: Generating complete 3D assets from sparse, unposed images requires preserving observed geometry while completing unseen regions. Joint reconstruction and generation offers a way to address both goals: reconstruction recovers the geometry observed in the input images, while generation contributes learned shape priors. However, combining camera-relative reconstruction with canonical-space generation introduces a coordinate mismatch that makes direct geometric interaction more difficult. Moreover, conditioning each 3D location on all views without accounting for their relevance may mix useful geometric evidence with unrelated image content, hindering local detail recovery. We present UniForge3D, which jointly models reconstruction and generation in a shared anchor-guided space, resolving their coordinate mismatch. This space follows the anchor view's azimuth while keeping the object upright. The two branches exchange features bidirectionally to predict per-view point maps and a complete sparse voxel structure. We further condition point-map prediction on the generated structure to establish pixel-to-voxel correspondences and select the most informative input view for each voxel. Features from the selected views then guide detailed shape generation, helping preserve observed geometric details. Our method achieves state-of-the-art appearance and geometry results on Toys4K and GSO, generating complete 3D assets with improved fidelity. Project webpage: https://xishuxishu.github.io/uniforge3d-project/

</details>


### [105] [VideoEvoHarness: Self Evolving Agent Harness from Unlabeled Videos for Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15389)
*Weixin Xu,Yifan Liu,Yi Wang,Mingfei Rong,Zhenyu Yang,Zhisheng Zhong,Shengsheng Qian,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VideoEvoHarness 提出从无标注视频中联合进化 Questioner 与 Solver harness，冻结模型参数，实现自进化视频理解智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化方法依赖标注视频问答或仅更新模型参数，从未标注视频进化 harness 的方向探索不足；而提升 harness 通常需要大量人工投入。

Method: 联合进化 Questioner 与 Solver harness，模型参数冻结。Questioner 从视频记忆记录构建问题并计算参考答案，借助问题质量评估与 Solver 执行轨迹修订出题策略；Solver 基于执行反馈进化技能、策略、超参数和工具，用可执行代码策略定义工作流。每轮在相同验证问题上比较候选 harness，保留经验证的改进。

Result: 在基准及专用问题集（视频与进化视频不重叠）上，整体准确率高于初始水平，跨骨干网络可迁移增益，且随轮次逐步提升。

Conclusion: 为从无标注视频进化 harness 提供了基础框架，开辟自进化视频智能体的有前景方向。

Abstract: Video understanding agents rely on a harness to acquire evidence, use tools, and reason, but improving it requires substantial effort. Recent self evolution methods seek to optimize harnesses through execution feedback to reduce human intervention. However, existing methods often rely on annotated video questions and answers or focus on updating model parameters, leaving harness evolution from unlabeled videos underexplored. VideoEvoHarness jointly evolves a Questioner and a Solver harness from unlabeled videos with frozen model parameters. The Questioner constructs questions and computes reference answers directly from video memory records. Question quality assessments and Solver execution trajectories guide question generation policy revisions. The Solver supports evolving skills, strategies, hyperparameters, and tools using execution feedback. Executable strategies define workflows in code, reducing repeated interpretation of natural language instructions. Each round, candidate harnesses are compared on identical validation questions, with validated improvements retained for later use. Experiments on benchmarks and a dedicated benchmark question set, using videos disjoint from evolution videos, show higher overall accuracy than initially and transfer gains across backbones. Overall accuracy on this set also improves progressively across rounds. This supports our foundational framework for harness evolution from unlabeled videos, opening a promising direction for self evolving video agents. Code is available at https://github.com/Wei-Xin-Xu/VideoEvoHarness.

</details>


### [106] [OmniRSI: Taming Latent Diffusion for Unified Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15414)
*Hebaixu Wang,Jing Zhang,Haonan Guo,Di Wang,Jiayi Ma,Bo Du*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 OmniRSI，一个统一的多模态遥感图像生成模型，通过遥感专用VAE、ControlNet增强的Stable Diffusion 3.5及免训练循环潜对齐机制，实现多模态重建、生成与翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖对自然图像生成模型的传感器特定微调，缺乏共享表示与稳健条件机制，限制了统一多模态生成能力。

Method: 1) 遥感专用VAE，捕获多模态先验并促进局部平滑潜空间；2) 全面适配Stable Diffusion 3.5并加ControlNet分支，支持文本与视觉线索条件；3) 免训练循环潜对齐机制，迭代用生成信息丰富不完整视觉条件；4) 构建RSI-MM数据集（11.5M多分辨率图像+文本标注+部分配对数据）。

Result: 大量实验验证 OmniRSI 在多模态重建、生成与翻译任务上均取得优越性能。

Conclusion: OmniRSI 通过统一表示与稳健条件机制，实现了遥感图像统一多模态生成，并配合大规模数据集推动该领域发展。

Abstract: Multimodal remote sensing image generation emerges as a promising paradigm for recovering complete and complementary observations from heterogeneous and partially observed remote sensing data. However, existing methods predominantly depend on sensor-specific fine-tuning of natural image generation models, limiting unified multimodal generation capacity due to the absence of shared representations and robust conditioning mechanisms. To address these challenges, we propose OmniRSI, a unified multimodal remote sensing image generation model. Specifically, we develop a remote sensing-specific variational autoencoder that captures multimodal priors and promotes a locally smooth latent space for unified representation and robust reconstruction across diverse observed data. Building upon that, we fully adapt Stable Diffusion 3.5 with a ControlNet branch to support unified multimodal generation and translation conditioned on textual and visual cues. Besides, we devise a training-free cyclic latent alignment mechanism that iteratively enriches incomplete visual conditions with generated multimodal information, progressively improving guidance reliability while preserving observed measurements. We also construct RSI-MM, a large-scale dataset comprising 11.5M multi-resolution images with text annotations and partially paired data for training and evaluation. Extensive experiments verify that OmniRSI achieves superior performance in multimodal reconstruction, generation and translation.

</details>


### [107] [Harnessing SPAD Noise: Test-Time Gated Attention for Indoor Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15431)
*Yiquan Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HSN框架，将SPAD噪声视为有用先验而非干扰，通过测试时门控注意力提升单目深度估计的度量精度与零样本泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目深度估计存在尺度模糊、边缘溢出和零样本泛化差的问题。现有多模态方法虽引入1D/3D SPAD数据，但多将SPAD噪声当作需去除的有害伪影或直接忽略，未挖掘其信息价值。

Method: 提出轻量级测试时门控注意力框架HSN，认为原生SPAD噪声隐含确定性环境特征。针对室内场景，结合1D SPAD直方图与门控适配器(GAs)，经三个互补优化阶段生成通道级门控注意力向量，在推理时动态调整编码器特征图。

Result: 在具挑战性的真实室内基准上，域内设置达到SOTA度量深度精度，零样本泛化到陌生环境潜力更大。可解释性分析显示门控注意力机制在SPAD噪声增强时自适应转向更深语义层。

Conclusion: SPAD噪声可作为有信息量的先验加以利用，HSN以低计算开销有效解决尺度模糊与边界问题，兼具精度、泛化性与可解释性。代码将公开。

Abstract: Monocular depth estimation (MDE) has emerged as a cost-effective alternative to hardware-dependent 3D sensing modalities, yet predicting precise metric depth remains a persistent challenge due to intrinsic scale ambiguity, edge bleeding, and limited zero-shot generalization in unseen environments. Recent multi-modal approaches incorporate 1D/3D Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) data to resolve these ambiguities, but they mainly treat SPAD noise as a harmful artifact required for denoising or leave the noise ignored. In this paper, we present an essentially different insight: native SPAD noise is an informative prior that implicitly encodes deterministic environmental characteristics. Driven by this paradigm shift, we introduce a novel, lightweight Test-Time Gated Attention framework by Harnessing SPAD Noise, therefore dubbed HSN. Tailored for indoor scenarios, HSN leverages the synergistic combination of 1D SPAD histograms and Gate Adapters (GAs). Through three complementary optimization phases, it generates channel-wise gated attention vectors to dynamically adjust encoder feature maps at inference time, effectively resolving ambiguous scale and boundary challenges without the heavy computational overhead or dense 3D modalities that other TTA methods suffer from. Extensive experiments on challenging real-world indoor benchmarks show that HSN achieves state-of-the-art metric depth accuracy in in-domain settings, while exhibiting even greater potential under zero-shot generalization to unfamiliar environments. Furthermore, interpretability analysis reveals that the proposed gated attention mechanism adaptively shifts attention toward deeper semantic layers under intensifying SPAD noise. Code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [108] [Rethinking Supervision in Document Unwarping: A Self-consistent Flow-free Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15445)
*Shaokai Liu,Hao Feng,Wengang Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DRNet是一种新的文档图像畸变矫正深度网络，利用几何一致性、由粗到细网络及无需扭曲网格标注的监督方式，在DocUNet基准上取得最优效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能手机拍摄的文档图像常存在畸变，影响数字保存和下游应用，需要有效的畸变矫正方法。

Method: 提出DRNet，基于三个设计：1）利用文档图像内在几何一致性指导矫正学习；2）设计由粗到细的矫正网络，充分利用畸变图像表示；3）提出以无畸变文档图像进行监督的新视角，无需现有方法中的扭曲网格真值；通过低层像素对齐和高层语义对齐联合学习畸变与无畸变图像的映射关系。

Result: 在具有挑战性的DocUNet Benchmark数据集上评估，刷新了一系列最优记录，优于现有基于学习的方法；并通过全面的消融实验验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: DRNet通过几何一致性、由粗到细结构和无网格监督有效实现文档图像畸变矫正，性能达到领先水平。

Abstract: In recent years, the proliferation of smartphones has led to an upsurge in the digitization of document files via these portable devices. However, images captured by smartphones often suffer from distortions, thereby negatively affecting digital preservation and downstream applications. To address this issue, we introduce DRNet, a novel deep network for document image rectification. Our approach is based on three key designs. Firstly, we exploit the intrinsic geometric consistency inherent in document images to guide the learning process of distortion rectification. Secondly, we design a coarse-to-fine rectification network to leverage the representations derived from the distorted document image, thereby enhancing the rectification result. Thirdly, we propose a unique perspective for supervising the learning of rectification networks, where undistorted document images are employed for supervision, which is free of warping mesh as ground truth in existing methods. Technically, both low-level pixel alignment and high-level semantic alignment jointly contribute to the learning of the mapping relationship between deformed document images and distortion-free ones. We evaluate our method on the challenging DocUNet Benchmark dataset, where it sets a series of state-of-the-art records, demonstrating the superiority of our approach compared to existing learning-based solutions. Additionally, we conduct a comprehensive series of ablation experiments to further validate the effectiveness and merits of our method.

</details>


### [109] [EmoTrace-Bench: Diagnosing Emotional Expression in Text-to-Video Generation through Controlled Cues and Intensity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15452)
*Yeheng Wang,Liudan Shi,Yi Zheng,Jingke Li,Shiyuan Liu,Xin Tao,Yuanxing Zhang,Guoyu Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EmoTrace-Bench，一个可控制情绪强度和情感线索的细粒度诊断基准，用于评测T2V模型的情感视频生成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2V模型的评测方法主要依赖整体视频-文本对齐，无法判断失败来源于目标情绪表达、强度控制还是特定情感线索的缺失。

Method: 构建包含448个受控提示词的基准，覆盖8种情绪、2个强度等级和多种线索条件；用12个T2V模型生成5,376个视频；从目标情绪存在性、感知强度和10个视听情感表达维度进行评测，并使用经人工标注校准验证的自动评估器。

Result: 不同模型和提示设计差异显著；明确描述人物情绪反应的提示比仅描述事件或场景更可靠；增加情感线索或更明确的电影化视听语言并未稳定提升情感生成效果。

Conclusion: 整体对齐分数会掩盖目标情绪表达、强度控制和线索实现方面的局部差异；EmoTrace-Bench提供可追溯、可解释的诊断框架，且不改动现有生成流程，并公开提示词与评估规则。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly used to generate videos with targeted emotional expressions, yet existing evaluation methods mainly rely on holistic video-text alignment and provide limited insight into whether failures arise from target-emotion expression, intensity control, or specific affective cues. We introduce EmoTrace-Bench, a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark that controls emotion intensity and selected affective cues in prompts and evaluates generated videos at multiple levels. EmoTrace-Bench contains 448 controlled prompts covering eight emotions, two intensity levels, and diverse cue conditions. Using 12 T2V models, we generate 5,376 videos and evaluate target-emotion presence, perceived intensity, and ten audiovisual dimensions of emotional expression with an automated evaluator calibrated and validated against human annotations on a subset of the data. Results reveal substantial differences across models and prompt designs. Prompts that explicitly describe a character's emotional reaction are followed more reliably than prompts that describe only events or scenes, whereas adding more affective cues or using more explicit cinematic audiovisual language does not consistently improve emotional generation. These results illustrate how aggregate alignment scores may overlook localized differences in target-emotion expression, intensity control, and cue realization. EmoTrace-Bench provides a traceable and interpretable framework for diagnosing emotional video generation without modifying existing generation pipelines, and we release the prompts and the automated evaluation rules.

</details>


### [110] [Semantic Saliency from Multi-Modal Large Language Model Scene Understanding Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15467)
*Ziqi Wen,Shravan Murlidaran,Jonathan Skaza,William Wang,Miguel P. Eckstein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AUTO-SUM，一种无需拟合人类数据、基于MLLM的全自动语义显著图计算方法，用对象对场景理解贡献量化语义显著性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低层图像显著性无法捕捉影响人类注意力的高层认知因素，现有方法需要拟合人类数据。

Method: 自动分割并逐个移除场景中的对象，用多模态大模型(MLLM)描述原始与被修改场景，通过文本嵌入计算描述间语义相似度，衡量每个对象对场景理解的贡献。

Result: AUTO-SUM能预测人类场景理解图(H-SUM)中最重要对象；在自由观看和场景描述任务中预测最受注视对象，优于低层GBVS、Itti-Koch模型及Meaning Map，与基于注视训练的DeepGaze相当。

Conclusion: AUTO-SUM可作为语义显著性模型，补充低层显著性模型，代码已开源。

Abstract: Image-computable low-level image saliency has shaped perceptual psychology and computer science, but is limited by its inability to capture human high-level cognitive factors that influence attention and eye movements. Here, we propose a new fully automated method to compute semantic saliency by quantifying each object's contribution to scene comprehension without fitting any parameters to human data: the Automated Scene Understanding Map (AUTO-SUM). AUTO-SUM automatically segments and removes individual objects from a scene, uses multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to describe the original and modified scenes, and measures the semantic similarity between these descriptions using text embeddings. We show that AUTO-SUM can predict which object is most important in a human-measured scene understanding map (H-SUM) estimated using human scene descriptions. We also show that AUTO-SUM can predict the object most fixated by human observers during free viewing and scene description tasks better than a low-level saliency model (GBVS, Itti-Koch), a saliency model trained based on human meaning ratings (Meaning Map), and comparable to DeepGaze, which is trained on human fixation data. We contend that AUTO-SUM can be used as a semantic saliency model that complements lower-level saliency models. Code are available at https://github.com/starsky77/AUTO-SUM-Source-Code .

</details>


### [111] [Structured Stateful Relational Scripts with a High-Quality Dataset for Multi-Shot Audio-Visual Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15512)
*Chen Zhao,Lehan Shen,Qilong Huang,Hongyu Li,Zhuoliang Kang,Xiaoming Wei,Jian Yang,Ying Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SSRS结构化脚本表示与MSAV-Script-100K数据集，用于提升多镜头音视频生成的一致性与对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多镜头音视频生成需保持身份一致、描述状态演变并跨镜头协调声音，但现有密集字幕难以说明哪些实体持续存在、状态如何改变及声音来源。

Method: 提出SSRS文本监督表示，将持久实体与声音身份同镜头特定的视听状态分离，显式编码声源绑定与时间关系，并用全局音视频事件序列连接跨镜头的局部动作与声音；同时构建MSAV-Script-100K大规模数据集。

Result: 实验表明跨镜头一致性、指定状态变化遵循度及音视频对齐均有提升。

Conclusion: SSRS与MSAV-Script-100K有效支持连贯的多镜头音视频生成，数据集已公开。

Abstract: Coherent multi-shot audio-visual video generation requires maintaining consistent identities while depicting evolving states and coordinating sounds across shot boundaries. Although dense captions describe individual shots in detail, they rarely specify which entities persist, how their states change, or which entities and actions produce sounds. To address this limitation, we propose Structured Stateful Relational Scripts (SSRS), a textual supervision representation that separates persistent entity and voice identities from shot-specific visual and auditory states. SSRS explicitly encodes sound-source bindings and temporal relations, while a global audio-visual event sequence connects local actions and sounds, including events that continue across shot boundaries. We further introduce MSAV-Script-100K, a large-scale dataset of curated multi-shot audio-visual videos paired with detailed SSRS annotations, enabling models to learn identity persistence, state transitions, and event continuity from structured supervision. Experiments demonstrate improvements in cross-shot consistency, adherence to specified state changes, and audio-visual alignment, highlighting the effectiveness of our SSRS and MSAV-Script-100K for coherent multi-shot audio-visual generation. Our proposed dataset is available at \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/shenlehan/MSAV-Script-100K}{MSAV-Script-100K}.

</details>


### [112] [Semantically Steerable Image Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15515)
*Danilo de Goede,Mohammad Mahdi Derakhshani,Yuki M. Asano,Cees G. M. Snoek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GIST，一种由像素级和语义级目标误差联合控制的自适应图像分词器，语义误差在冻结DINOv3特征空间中度量，可导向指定的语义保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应分词器用像素级误差指导token分配，但像素误差对承载图像含义的空间结构不敏感，重度压缩时易突然丢弃关键内容token。

Method: GIST用像素级和语义级目标误差联合控制token分配，语义误差在冻结DINOv3编码器特征空间中度量。将语义目标设为零并放宽重建目标，可实现语义保护，丢弃像素细节而保留图像所描绘的内容。

Result: ImageNet-100受控对比中，各token数下均优于像素控制的KARL，LPIPS最高降低30%、DreamSim最高降低37%；降低语义目标每token的LPIPS下降速度平均为降低重建目标的2倍，低token区间达5倍。

Conclusion: 语义保真度是自适应分词的有效控制信号，使分词器能"看见"并因此保留图像所描绘的内容。

Abstract: Adaptive image tokenizers compress an image into a variable number of tokens matched to its complexity, and recent work makes this allocation controllable: conditioned on a target reconstruction error, the tokenizer itself decides how many tokens an image needs. However, the fidelity measure guiding this allocation shapes which aspects of the image are preserved under compression. The pixel-wise error used in prior work is blind to the spatial structure that carries an image's meaning, and under heavy compression such tokenizers are prone to abruptly discarding tokens that encode essential content. We introduce GIST (Guided Image Semantic Tokenizer), an adaptive tokenizer that can be steered toward a requested semantic fidelity. Its token allocation is jointly controlled by pixel-level and semantic target errors, with semantic error measured in the feature space of a frozen DINOv3 encoder. This joint control enables semantic protection: with the semantic target fixed at zero, the reconstruction target can be relaxed to discard pixel detail while preserving what the image depicts. In a controlled comparison on ImageNet-100, GIST outperforms its pixel-controlled counterpart KARL at every token count, with up to $30\%$ lower LPIPS and $37\%$ lower DreamSim. On average, lowering its semantic target reduces LPIPS $2\times$ faster per token than lowering the reconstruction target, and up to $5\times$ in the low-token regime. Semantic fidelity is thus an effective control signal for adaptive tokenization: it lets a tokenizer see, and so preserve, what an image depicts.

</details>


### [113] [UMAS3D: Unified Mask-Free 3D Editing with Region-Adaptive Source Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15533)
*Xianlin Zeng,Xiaolong Shen,Ruijie Quan,Yi Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UMAS3D是一个无需训练、无需反转、无需外部3D掩码的统一3D编辑框架，支持多条件与多任务编辑并保持源内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D编辑方法依赖任务特定训练、源3D反转或外部3D掩码，缺乏统一框架支持多样编辑条件与任务。

Method: 将文本、边界框、参考图及其组合转化为通用目标视图引导，使添加、删除、修改、外观与姿态编辑共享同一3D生成流程。核心为在线编辑区域估计与区域感知源保留：MARM从源-目标视觉差异初始化Edit/Keep先验并随目标结构演化逐步精化；SGPS约束Keep区域状态保留源几何与外观且不抑制目标驱动变化。

Result: 实验表明UMAS3D支持添加、删除、修改、外观与姿态编辑，同时有效保留未编辑的源内容。

Conclusion: UMAS3D为跨多样编辑条件的灵活且源保留的统一3D编辑框架。

Abstract: 3D editing aims to modify an existing 3D asset according to user intent while preserving geometry and appearance outside the intended edit region. Existing methods often rely on task-specific training, source-3D inversion, or external 3D masks, and lack a unified framework for diverse editing conditions and tasks. We propose UMAS3D, a unified 3D editing framework that is training-free, inversion-free, and free from external 3D masks. UMAS3D converts text, bounding boxes, reference images, and their combinations into common target-view guidance, after which addition, deletion, modification, appearance, and pose editing share the same downstream 3D generation process. Our key insight is to couple online edit-region estimation with region-aware source preservation. Mask-Free Adaptive Region Modeling (MARM) initializes an Edit/Keep prior from source-target visual differences and progressively refines it as the target structure evolves, while Source-Guided Preservation Steering (SGPS) constrains the current Keep-region states to retain source geometry and appearance without suppressing target-driven changes. Experiments show that UMAS3D supports addition, deletion, modification, appearance, and pose editing while effectively preserving unedited source content. These advances make UMAS3D a unified framework for flexible and source-preserving 3D editing across diverse editing conditions.

</details>


### [114] [ELECT: Settling Identity Before Rendering for Scalable Story Visualization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15555)
*Mehrajul Abadin Miraj,Md. Mahmudul Hasan,Meherun Farzana,Aniket Joarder,Mahmudul Hasan,Abir Chakraborty Partha,Md. Ahasanul Alam,Redwan Ahmed Rizvee,Md. Fahim Arefin,Md Mahmudur Rahman,Md. Tanvir Alam,Md Mosaddek Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ELECT提出无需参考图、免训练的story visualization方法，通过语言引导的场景-实体映射与从模型自身草图中选举的静止锚点，在最终渲染前确定跨帧身份，使每帧渲染成本与故事长度无关，可扩展至1000场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 免训练、无参考图的story visualization需在帧间保持重复实体一致，并扩展到长叙事。现有方法通过让每帧条件于同故事其他帧来维持一致性，导致生成时间或VRAM随故事长度增长。

Method: ELECT在最终渲染前确定跨帧身份：使用语言引导的场景-实体映射，并从模型自身草图中选举静止锚点（stationary anchors）。因此最终渲染阶段每帧成本与故事长度无关。

Result: 联合注意力在32场景时显存超96GB，而ELECT从10到1000场景保持8.3秒/帧、低于20GB显存。在Story50长故事基准上，ELECT aCCS达0.833，优于十轮细化的0.826且生成成本为其1/7，但文本对齐略低（0.327 vs 0.340）。在1000场景下，ELECT比十轮细化高0.017 aCCS，比最近的flat-cost基线高0.091，文本对齐也超过细化，生成时间仅为其1/24。

Conclusion: 长时程一致性不必随故事增长而需要越来越昂贵的帧间条件化。

Abstract: Training-free story visualization without reference images must preserve recurring entities across frames while scaling to long narratives. Existing methods typically maintain consistency by conditioning each frame on other frames of the same story, coupling generation time, VRAM, or both to story length. We introduce ELECT, which instead settles cross-frame identity before final rendering through a language-guided scene-entity mapping and stationary anchors elected from the model's own drafts. This makes the per-frame cost of the final rendering pass independent of story length. Joint attention exceeds 96 GB of VRAM at 32 scenes, whereas ELECT remains at 8.3 s per frame and under 20 GB VRAM from 10 to 1000 scenes. On the Story50 long-story benchmark, ELECT reaches 0.833 average Character Consistency Similarity (aCCS), compared with 0.826 for ten-round refinement, at one seventh of its generation cost, with lower text alignment (0.327 vs. 0.340). At 1000 scenes, to our knowledge, the first evaluation of training-free story visualization at this length, ELECT exceeds ten-round refinement by 0.017 aCCS and the nearest flat-cost baseline by 0.091, while also surpassing refinement in text alignment at one twenty-fourth of its generation time. These results show that long-horizon consistency need not require increasingly expensive inter-frame conditioning as stories grow.

</details>


### [115] [A Plausible Future Is Not a Causal Future: Can Video Models Generate How the World Unfolds?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15562)
*Jialiang Li,Zhengning Xu,Zongyang Ma,Shaobo Cui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 CausalCascade 基准，用 50 个 Blender 场景和事件图评估视频生成模型实现完整因果级联的能力，发现模型时空演化与反事实响应普遍不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视频生成模型被视为通往世界模型的有希望路径，但其能否捕捉因果一致物理动态尚不清楚。现有评估多关注视觉质量、提示遵循或宽泛物理合理性，无法判断模型能否忠实实现完整的因果级联（初始事件经因果依赖交互传播至最终结果）。

Method: 构建 CausalCascade 模拟器基准：包含 50 个事件丰富的 Blender 场景及结构化事件图、基于图的诊断性 VQA、三个层级的未来事件规格，以及 2,832 个受控反事实变体；据此评估九个图生视频模型，提供运动、事件与反事实三个层面的诊断。

Result: 生成运动的**空间定位**比正确的**时空演化**更可靠；更丰富的未来事件规格能改善事件恢复，但物理实现仍受限；反事实评估显示模型对物理干预的选择性响应较弱；多数审查到的失败属基础性问题，出现在场景一致性或事件发生阶段。

Conclusion: 将因果级联生成定位为世界建模的**过程级测试**，强调模型需同时做到：恢复预期未来、忠实实现其物理演化、选择性响应物理干预，并在时间上维持一致的物理世界。

Abstract: Large-scale video generation models are increasingly viewed as a promising path toward world models, yet their ability to capture causally coherent physical dynamics remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations largely emphasize visual quality, prompt adherence, or broad physical plausibility, leaving open whether a model can faithfully realize a complete causal cascade, in which an initiating event propagates through causally dependent interactions to a terminal outcome. We introduce CausalCascade, a simulator-grounded benchmark centered on 50 event-rich Blender scenes with structured event graphs, graph-grounded diagnostic VQA, three levels of future-event specification, and 2,832 controlled counterfactual variants, and use it to evaluate nine image-to-video models with complementary motion-, event-, and counterfactual-level diagnostics. Across the evaluated models, generated motion is more reliably localized spatially than realized with correct spatiotemporal evolution, while richer future-event specification improves event recovery but leaves physical realization limited. Counterfactual evaluation further reveals weak selective responsiveness to physical interventions, while most audited failures are foundational, arising at scene consistency or event occurrence. Together, these results position causal cascade generation as a process-level test of world modeling and highlight the need to jointly recover the intended future, faithfully realize its physical evolution, selectively respond to physical interventions, and maintain a coherent physical world over time. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SJTU-DeepDeltaLab/CausalCascade .

</details>


### [116] [Genesis: Visual Augmentation Primitives for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15565)
*Fan Yang,Lifeng Chen,Yipu Wang,Han Wang,Feilong Chen,Yidong Ma,Zhiyang Chen,Chaoyang Zhao,Lingxiang Wu,Hanqi Jiang,Yibo Chen,Xu Tang,Yao Hu,Ming Tang,Xiaojie Jin,Xiaolong Zheng,Jinqiao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VAP数据增强管线与多模态CoT rubric强化学习，让视觉推理真正锚定视觉证据，并构建UNREAL基准；4B模型超越8B基线，可扩展至32B。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型在STEM基准接近人类水平，但在复杂真实场景下能力退化。原因是链式推理大多局限于语言空间，很少将每一步锚定在视觉证据上，根源在于训练数据缺乏此类样例。

Method: 提出Visual Augmentation Primitives (VAP)训练数据增强管线：利用SOTA视觉生成模型，将基本算子作用于种子图像生成多样逼真样本及对应推理文本，并在生成过程中构建连贯的多模态推理链。进一步提出基于rubric的多模态链式思维强化学习，不仅奖励文本推理，还通过对中间推理步骤的逻辑性、完整性和一致性打分来奖励视觉推理。同时构建UNREAL基准，在可控难度下评估超写实场景的视觉推理。

Result: 基于该框架的4B模型超越8B基线，且随模型规模扩展至32B性能持续提升，验证了视觉推理的scaling law。

Conclusion: 通过数据增强与强化学习让模型在每一步都感知视觉内容并进行逻辑推理，可显著提升复杂真实场景下的视觉推理能力，并展现出良好的可扩展性。

Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models achieve promising results on visual reasoning tasks, approaching human-level performance on existing STEM benchmarks. However, these capabilities degrade under complex real-world scenes. We identify that chain-of-thought reasoning remains largely confined to the linguistic space, rarely anchoring each step in visual evidence. The main cause is the absence of such data during training. In this work, we introduce a training data augmentation pipeline, \textbf{Visual Augmentation Primitives} (VAP), which leverages state-of-the-art vision generative models to synthesize diverse photorealistic training samples and corresponding reasoning text. VAP introduces some basic operators and applies them to a seed image and gets a variant. It also constructs coherent multimodal reasoning chains throughout the generation process. Such training data force models to perceive visual content and perform logical reasoning according to them at every step. We further introduce multimodal chain-of-thought rubric-based reinforcement learning to enhance this. It rewards not only text reasoning but also visual reasoning by scoring intermediate reasoning steps for logical validity, completeness, and consistency. Moreover, we construct the UNREAL benchmark to systematically evaluate visual reasoning on hyperrealistic scenes across controllable difficulty levels. Experiments show that a 4B model built on this framework surpasses 8B baselines, with performance improving consistently as the model scales to 32B, validating the scaling law for visual reasoning.

</details>


### [117] [Ellipsoids from Tangents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15580)
*Efrat Dahan,Michael Werman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于切线与切点表示的多椭球检测与拟合算法，适用于2D及高维数据，通过参数空间聚类鲁棒求解线性方程，性能优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统椭球拟合仅依赖离散点，每个点仅提供一个约束方程，导致所需样本多、迭代次数高，难以鲁棒恢复所有椭球。

Method: 用椭球切线与切点替代单纯点表示，每条切线贡献d个独立方程；将问题建模为线性方程组，通过参数空间聚类鲁棒恢复椭球参数。

Result: 算法支持任意维度，在2D场景下优于当前最先进方法，并成功实现多椭球检测与拟合。

Conclusion: 该切线表示法降低了样本需求与迭代次数，且可推广至线性方程的鲁棒求解，用途不限于椭球拟合。

Abstract: This paper presents an algorithm for detecting and fitting multiple ellipsoids in 2D, 3D and higher-dimensional data. The representation is based on tangents to the ellipsoid together with their contact points, rather than on points alone. A tangent contributes d independent equations where a point contributes one, so each hypothesis needs fewer samples, which in turn reduces the number of iterations required to recover every ellipsoid. The problem is posed as sets of linear equations whose solutions -- the ellipsoid parameters -- are recovered robustly by clustering in parameter space. The algorithm works in all dimensions and outperforms the state of the art in 2D. The approach applies in general to the robust solution of linear equations, and so has utility beyond ellipsoid fitting.

</details>


### [118] [FireNav: Decision-Oriented Reconstruction Evidence Routing for Vision-Language Navigation in Indoor Fire Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15595)
*Hongbo Ding,Xiang Chen,Jiangxin Dong,Jinshan Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FireNav，通过决策导向的重建证据路由框架，将视觉修复与VLN导航效用对齐，并贡献FireVLN-Bench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 室内火灾环境中视觉退化严重影响视觉语言导航的指令理解、路点预测与长程探索。现有图像修复方法以重建保真度为目标，未必提升导航决策，甚至可能破坏任务关键线索。

Method: 构建FireVLN-Bench配对基准（保留任务语义的干净参考、安全监督、连续导航与机器人执行匹配设置）；FireNav保留原生视觉token，将潜在重建特征作为辅助证据，用轻量路由器结合视觉特征、任务上下文与执行状态决定是否采用及权重；引入决策效用校准，通过比较有无候选证据时的动作预测损失来监督证据选择。

Result: 在多种评估设置下，FireNav在导航成功率和路径效率上均持续优于现有最先进基线。

Conclusion: 决策导向的重建证据路由能有效将视觉修复服务于导航任务，验证了按导航效用选择性融合重建证据的有效性。

Abstract: In real-world indoor fire environments, visual degradation severely impairs instruction grounding, waypoint prediction, and long-horizon exploration in vision-language navigation (VLN). Although image restoration offers a natural means to mitigate such visual degradation, existing methods primarily optimize reconstruction fidelity, which does not necessarily translate into better navigation decisions and may even corrupt task-critical cues when applied indiscriminately. In this paper, we present FireNav, a decision-oriented reconstruction evidence routing framework that aligns visual restoration with navigation utility in VLN. To advance this task, we first contribute FireVLN-Bench, a paired indoor fire navigation benchmark with clean references preserving task semantics, safety supervision, and matched settings for continuous navigation and robot execution with simulated dynamics. Our FireNav retains native visual tokens and treats latent reconstruction features as auxiliary evidence, where a lightweight router leverages visual features, task context, and prior execution states to determine whether such evidence should be admitted and how strongly it should contribute to the visual tokens. To learn when reconstruction is beneficial, we further introduce decision utility calibration, which compares action prediction losses with and without candidate evidence under the same state, thereby supervising evidence selection according to its contribution to waypoint, heading, and arrival prediction. Experiments demonstrate that FireNav consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both navigation success and path efficiency across evaluation settings.

</details>


### [119] [Squeeze-Aware-YOLO: Early Channel Recalibration and Multi-Scale Fusion for Real-Time Traffic Sign Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15604)
*Mizbaul Haque Maruf,Syed Samin Sadaf,Syed Tamzid Bakht,Md. Hasanul Kabir,Sabbir Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级交通标志检测框架 Squeeze-Aware-YOLO，通过多分支瓶颈模块、注意力机制与多尺度特征融合，在保持实时推理效率的同时，在三个数据集上超越现有 YOLO 类方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通标志检测对智能交通系统安全至关重要，但光照变化、恶劣天气、运动模糊和部分遮挡等挑战性条件会降低检测性能，尤其对小目标或退化标志，关键空间信息易丢失，现有实时检测器难以准确识别。

Method: 提出多分支瓶颈模块，结合不同尺寸卷积核与 Squeeze-and-Excitation 机制以增强特征提取和自适应通道加权；引入多分支辅助特征金字塔网络（Multi-Branch Auxiliary FPN）和重参数化异质多尺度模块，以强化多尺度特征表示与融合，同时保持实时推理效率。

Result: 在孟加拉交通标志检测数据集、CSUST 中国交通标志检测基准 2021 和德国交通标志检测基准上分别取得 74.7%、79.4% 和 84.0% 的 mAP@0.5，持续优于近期最先进的 YOLO 类交通标志检测器。

Conclusion: 结合多尺度感受野、通道注意力与增强特征融合，可实现更准确、鲁棒的交通标志检测，同时保持实际部署所需的计算效率。

Abstract: Traffic sign detection plays a vital role in intelligent transportation systems, supporting the safe operation of advanced driver assistance systems and autonomous vehicles. Despite significant progress in real-time object detection, accurately identifying traffic signs under challenging conditions remains difficult. Variations in lighting, adverse weather, motion blur, and partial occlusion often reduce detection performance, especially for small or visually degraded signs where important spatial information can be lost. To address these challenges, we propose Squeeze-Aware-YOLO, a lightweight traffic sign detection framework that introduces a multi-branch bottleneck module combining convolutional kernels of different sizes with a Squeeze-and-Excitation mechanism to improve feature extraction and adaptive channel weighting. In addition, we integrate the Multi-Branch Auxiliary Feature Pyramid Network and Re-parameterized Heterogeneous Multi-Scale modules to strengthen multi-scale feature representation and feature fusion while preserving real-time inference efficiency for practical deployment. The proposed approach is evaluated on the Bangladeshi Traffic Sign Detection Dataset, the CSUST Chinese Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark 2021, and the German Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark, achieving mAP@0.5 scores of 74.7%, 79.4%, and 84.0%, respectively, while consistently outperforming recent state-of-the-art YOLO-based traffic sign detectors. These findings demonstrate that combining multi-scale receptive fields, channel attention, and enhanced feature fusion enables more accurate and robust traffic sign detection while maintaining the computational efficiency required for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [120] [Lesion-Aware Attention for Mammography Segmentation with Heterogeneous Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15612)
*Di Dai,Bo Liu,Liwei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究混合监督下的开放词汇乳腺X线病灶分割，提出双分支框架，利用分割掩码和图像级标签联合学习，并通过病灶感知注意力分类器提升分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乳腺X线精确病灶分割对计算机辅助诊断很重要，但稠密像素级标注昂贵且有限。现有公开分割数据集仅覆盖少量病灶类型，而大型数据集常只有图像级诊断标签，导致标注不匹配，难以训练能泛化到罕见或弱标注病灶类别的分割模型。

Method: 提出双分支框架，同时从分割数据和分类数据学习。分割分支从标注掩码学习病灶边界，分类分支引入额外图像级语义监督。并引入Lesion-wise Attentive Classifier，维护类别特定特征原型并生成病灶感知注意力图用于前景特征池化，减少背景组织影响，促使更紧凑的病灶表示。

Result: 在多个乳腺X线数据集上，该方法在基础和新颖病灶类别上持续优于开放词汇分割基线，同时缩小了与需要稠密目标域掩码的全监督模型的差距。定性结果表明，方法对小尺寸、低对比度和视觉不明显的乳腺X线病灶能产生更完整的病灶定位。

Conclusion: 所提方法有效解决了混合监督下开放词汇乳腺X线病灶分割问题，利用图像级语义监督提升病灶定位和泛化能力，为减少昂贵像素级标注提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Accurate lesion segmentation in mammography is important for computer-aided breast cancer diagnosis, but dense pixel-level annotations remain costly and limited. Existing public segmentation datasets usually cover only a small set of lesion types with manually delineated masks, whereas larger mammography datasets often provide only image-level diagnostic labels. This annotation mismatch makes it difficult to train segmentation models that can generalize to rare or weakly annotated lesion categories. To address this problem, we study open-vocabulary mammographic lesion segmentation under a mixed-supervision setting, where pixel-level masks are available for base lesion categories and image-level labels are available for a broader set of categories. We propose a two-branch framework that jointly learns from segmentation data and classification data. The segmentation branch learns lesion boundaries from annotated masks, while the classification branch introduces additional image-level semantic supervision. To better transfer image-level supervision to lesion-relevant regions, we further introduce a Lesion-wise Attentive Classifier that maintains category-specific feature prototypes and generates lesion-aware attention maps for foreground feature pooling. This design reduces the influence of background tissue and encourages more compact lesion representations. Experiments on multiple mammography datasets show that the proposed method consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation baselines on both base and novel lesion categories, while reducing the gap to fully supervised models that require dense target-domain masks. Qualitative results further indicate that our method produces more complete lesion localization for small, low-contrast, and visually subtle mammographic findings.

</details>


### [121] [1Step-WAM: Your World Action Model but Faster using 1-Step Action Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15625)
*Rundong Su,Pengtao Chen,Haohan Geng,Sha Zhang,Zhihang Yuan,Yicheng Rong,Chong Yu,Hao Huang,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 1Step-WAM将WAMs的多步动作去噪压缩为单步前向，借助轻量校准器修正首步速度并配合带宽约束解码，使动作生成与视觉预填充并行，显著加速推理并保持任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: World Action Models (WAMs) 统一了视觉世界建模与动作生成，但实际部署受制于迭代式动作去噪，以及视觉预填充与动作预测的串行执行（imagination-then-action）瓶颈。

Method: 作者观察到WAMs中的动作去噪轨迹近似直线，因此首步速度可作为最终动作方向的有力估计。基于此，提出1Step-WAM：用轻量校准器直接修正首步速度，并通过带宽约束的动作解码进一步降低校准后单步动作的误差；将动作生成压缩为单步后，可与视觉预填充并行执行，打破串行瓶颈。

Result: 在RoboTwin和LIBERO上，1Step-WAM仅需约13.4M可训练参数即可基本保持多步任务成功率，相比FastWAM、ImageWAM、Kairos分别实现7.44×、5.98×、24.84×的推理加速；基于FastWAM骨干的真实机器人部署也验证了7.44×的一致加速，且成功率接近多步基线。

Conclusion: 1Step-WAM通过单步动作生成与并行执行，有效突破了WAMs的串行推理瓶颈，在保持任务成功率的同时实现大幅加速，代码已开源。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) unify visual world modeling and action generation, yet their real-world deployment is heavily bottlenecked by iterative action denoising and the sequential execution of visual prefilling and action prediction. We demonstrate that the action-denoising trajectories in WAMs are approximately straight, rendering the first-step velocity a strong estimate of the final action direction. Building on this observation, we introduce 1Step-WAM, a framework that transforms multi-step action denoising into one single forward. Specifically, we employ a lightweight calibrator to directly correct the first step velocity, and use bandwidth-constrained action decoding to further reduce errors in the calibrated one-step actions. Compressing action generation into a single step enables it to execute in parallel with visual prefilling, completely breaking the sequential bottleneck of the traditional imagination-then-action paradigm. Evaluations on RoboTwin and LIBERO show that 1Step-WAM largely preserves multi-step task success with only about 13.4M trainable parameters, while achieving inference speedups of $7.44\times$, $5.98\times$, and $24.84\times$ for FastWAM, ImageWAM and Kairos, respectively. Furthermore, real-world robotic deployments using the FastWAM backbone confirm a consistent 7.44$\times$ speedup while maintaining close success rate to the multi-step baseline. Code is avaliable at https://github.com/changdong1687/1Step-WAM.

</details>


### [122] [Robust Detection of Directional Adversarial Attacks in Deep Neural Networks for Radiological Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15628)
*Tristan Malatyński,Joanna Jaworek-Korjakowska*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种利用随机噪声后续攻击与Sigmoid变化分析来检测医学影像对抗扰动的框架，在三个医学数据集上对方向性攻击检测达99.8%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习在放射影像诊断中广泛应用，但对对抗攻击极为脆弱（医疗扫描攻击成功率超90%），可能导致漏诊癌症或误报；而2023年已有约30%美国医院在影像中使用AI，因此亟需有效检测对抗攻击及其方向性的方法以保障DNN医疗系统的可信度与可靠性。

Method: 提出新型检测框架，借助随机噪声进行后续攻击来识别对抗扰动；利用Sigmoid函数的变化分析区分真实医学图像与被对抗操纵的图像，通过比较干净图像与攻击图像、以及不同对抗版本之间的预测差异来提升检测精度。

Result: 在'Chest X-Ray Images for Classification'、'Retinal Fundus Multi-disease Image Dataset'和'Brain Tumor Dataset'三个数据集及多种攻击场景（含随机噪声）下评估，对对抗方向性攻击识别准确率高达99.8%，显著优于现有防御机制，并在不同攻击强度下稳定识别对抗样本且保持低误报率。

Conclusion: 该框架展现出强可靠性及临床部署潜力，为真实世界应用提供了可能。

Abstract: Deep learning is now central to radiology, helping detect changes on X-rays, CTs, and MRIs. However, these systems are highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks - small, crafted perturbations that mislead models while appearing unchanged to humans. Such errors risk missed cancers or false positives. Studies show over 90% attack success on medical scans. Almost 30% of US hospitals use AI in imaging in 2023.
