Thus, an effective method of detecting such attacks and their directionality is crucial to ensure the credibility and reliability of medical systems based on DNNs. We propose a novel detection framework that leverages subsequent attacks using random noise to identify adversarial perturbations. Our approach uses the analysis of variations in the Sigmoid function to distinguish genuine medical images from adversarially manipulated ones. Specifically, we compare prediction differences between clean and attacked images, as well as between different adversarially altered versions, to improve detection accuracy. We evaluated our method on three popular medical datasets including 'Chest X-Ray Images for Classification', 'Retinal Fundus Multi-disease Image Dataset' and 'Brain Tumor Dataset' under various attack scenarios, including random noise. Our framework achieved up to 99.8% ACC in identifying adversarial directional attacks, significantly outperforming existing defense mechanisms. It consistently identified adversarial samples across varying attack strengths while keeping false positives low, showing strong reliability and potential for clinical use. Furthermore, our proposal highlights its potential for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [123] [SurgCast: Action-Conditioned Future Skeletons for Controllable Surgical World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15645)
*Wanhao Liu,Rulin Zhou,Liangjing Shao,Zhaocheng Lin,Dongyue Li,Jinsong Lin,Guoheng Ma,Hangheng Yang,Zhiqing Tang,Jing Chen,Panshuo Li,Hongliang Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SurgCast 通过预测未来器械骨架及其运动语义，用作控制接口来生成手术视频，显著提升视觉质量与器械一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术世界模型需将机器人动作转化为视觉真实且结构一致的器械运动，但现有直接动作条件方法难以保证结构一致性。

Method: 先根据当前结构、机器人状态和未来动作预测未来器械骨架，再通过双路径注入（几何残差＋条件调制）结合骨架几何与器械运动描述子，并保留原生动作条件，蒸馏为四步因果学生模型。

Result: 在 SutureBot 和 SRTH-Porcine-Cholei 上，教师与学生模型在全部七项质量与器械一致性指标上均优于直接动作基线；教师 FVD 分别下降 37.6% 和 67.3%。消融显示未来动作提升骨架预测，双路径注入在预测骨架下六项指标最佳。

Conclusion: 预测的关节结构与运动语义可作为手术视频预测的有效控制接口。

Abstract: Surgical world models must turn prospective robot actions into visually faithful, structurally consistent instrument motion. We introduce SurgCast, which predicts future instrument skeletons from current structure, robot state, and future actions, then uses the forecast to control video generation. Dual-path injection combines skeleton geometry with derived, instrument-specific motion descriptors through geometric residuals and conditioning modulation. Both paths complement native action conditioning and are retained in a four-step causal student. On SutureBot and SRTH-Porcine-Cholei, the teacher and student improve all seven reported quality and instrument-consistency metrics over their respective direct-action baselines; teacher FVD decreases by 37.6% and 67.3%. Ablations show that future actions improve skeleton prediction and that combining both injection paths performs best across all six metrics under predicted skeletons. These results support using predicted articulated structure and its motion semantics as a control interface for surgical video prediction. Project videos and examples are available at https://surgcast.netlify.app/.

</details>


### [124] [Sparse All-Layer Connector for Domain Generalised Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15660)
*Ruoyu Guo,Xin Kun Lin,Maurice Pagnucco,Yang Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Sparse All-Layer Connector (SALC)，实现跨基础模型的非深度对齐、稀疏自适应融合，提升域泛化语义分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有域泛化语义分割的多模型融合局限于深度对齐层，隐含假设不同模型同深度层信息互补。但不同预训练目标的基础模型具有不同表示层级，且域敏感性随深度变化不同，故深度对齐融合并非最优。

Method: SALC允许每层访问另一模型的更浅层信息，随深度增加候选层增多；通过自适应学习选择稀疏的有信息层，并引入候选dropout正则化增强稀疏性、鼓励探索多样层以获得更鲁棒选择。

Result: 在四种基础模型组合和三个DGSS评测设置下，SALC均比传统深度对齐融合具有更强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 跨模型融合不应受深度对齐限制，稀疏全层连接结合候选dropout能有效提升域泛化语义分割。代码已开源。

Abstract: Domain generalised semantic segmentation (DGSS) has recently benefited from combining multiple foundation models, such as vision-language and vision foundation models, to leverage their diverse representations for generalisation. Existing multi-model approaches share a common design choice: cross-model fusion is restricted to depth-aligned layers, implicitly assuming that mutually beneficial information resides at the same depth across models. However, foundation models pretrained under different objectives may develop distinct representation hierarchies, making the optimality of depth-aligned fusion questionable. Moreover, we observe that the foundation models exhibit different depth-wise domain sensitivity. Motivated by these observations, we propose a Sparse All-Layer Connector (SALC) that enables each layer to access information from preceding layers of another model. As the number of accessible layers grows with depth, dense aggregation may hurt generalisation. SALC therefore learns to adaptively select a sparse subset of informative layers. We further introduce a candidate dropout regularisation that strengthens sparsity and encourages SALC to explore diverse layers, leading to more robust selection. Across four foundation model combinations and three DGSS evaluation settings, the proposed design demonstrates stronger generalisation than conventional depth-aligned fusion. The code is available at https://github.com/RuoyuGuo/SALC.

</details>


### [125] [A Persian Vision-Language-Action Dataset and Benchmark for Ambiguity- and Infeasibility-Aware Instruction-to-Plan Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15666)
*Abdollah Pourasghari,Saeedeh Sadat Sadidpour,Mohammad Roustaei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首个波斯语视觉-语言-动作数据集（258实例/230真实照片），含歧义、不可行性标注与CoT理由，用于自然语言指令到可执行动作计划的生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多针对英语、模拟或视频环境，且假设指令清晰可执行，缺乏波斯语与真实场景资源。

Method: 构建258实例数据集，标注参考计划、歧义/不可行标签、消歧QA与自动CoT；消融检索增强、CoT提示与agentic消歧；提出PGOS-FA指标（步骤顺序敏感、过度生成惩罚、波斯语嵌入）并采用LLM-as-judge与人工相关性研究。

Result: 36组配对检验显示检索增强效果大且显著；更细粒度方法方向一致但不显著；LLM-judge在此任务近乎无区分力而PGOS-FA有效；PGOS-FA与人工判断相关性至少不弱于LLM-judge；开放权重与闭源规划器差距主要源于生成质量而非能力；最佳配置显著优于外部基线。

Conclusion: 提供了首个波斯语真实场景VLA数据集与更可靠的PGOS-FA评测指标，验证检索增强的关键作用并揭示LLM-judge局限。

Abstract: Converting natural-language instructions into executable action plans conditioned on a scene image is a core capability for embodied human-robot interaction, but existing benchmarks target English, simulated or video-grounded environments, and largely assume instructions are clear and executable. We introduce the first Persian vision-language-action dataset for this task: 258 instances over 230 real household/office photographs, annotated with reference plans, deliberate ambiguity and infeasibility labels, disambiguating question-answer pairs, and an auto-generated chain-of-thought rationale for training. Using this resource, we ablate retrieval-augmentation, chain-of-thought prompting, and an agentic disambiguation step, evaluated with an LLM-as-judge protocol and a new metric, PGOS-FA, extending prior work (PG2S) with step-order sensitivity, an over-generation penalty, and Persian-adapted embeddings. Paired statistical testing across 36 comparisons shows retrieval-augmentation is a large, robustly significant effect, while finer-grained additions are directionally consistent but not statistically distinguishable from noise at this scale, and the LLM-judge metric has near-zero power where PGOS-FA succeeds. A blind human-correlation study on 79 real outputs shows PGOS-FA tracks human judgment at least as closely as the LLM-judge. Testing generalization beyond the ablation's single backbone, we find that most of the gap between an open-weight and a substantially stronger closed planner is attributable to open-weight model generation rather than to the closed model's capability specifically, and that our best configuration significantly outperforms an independently reproduced external baseline despite a weaker backbone. The dataset, PGOS-FA implementation, and evaluation code will be made available upon reasonable request.

</details>


### [126] [ProtoPur: Prototype-Purity Pseudo-Labeling for Weakly Supervised Instance Learning in Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15669)
*Chen Shu,Chengyang Zhang,Boyu Fu,Ting Yin,Wenchuan Zhang,Jie Chen,Yuhao Yi,Hong Bu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ProtoPur：基于原型的纯度伪标签方法，实现弱监督病理WSI实例级学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WSI实例级标注昂贵且模糊，弱监督MIL虽袋级分类强，但注意力/预测/负袋/空间精修等实例监督难以识别类特异局部证据。

Method: 用冻结基础模型特征构建原型区域，估计类平衡局部纯度，给高纯度区域分配伪标签；纯度优先、覆盖度仅作补充。附PAC式风险分解分析。

Result: 三个公开WSI数据集、两种病理基础编码器、多个MIL骨干上一致提升实例级性能，袋级性能有竞争力；两数据集伪标签质量对比更强。

Conclusion: 基础模型特征蕴含可利用的实例级监督信号，ProtoPur无需密集实例标注即可从弱袋标签中揭示并利用这些信号。

Abstract: Weak bag-level labels are widely available in computational pathology, whereas reliable instance-level annotations for whole-slide images remain expensive and ambiguous. Weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) achieves strong bag-level classification, but instance-level supervision from attention scores, model predictions, negative bags, or spatial refinement may fail to identify class-specific local evidence. We propose ProtoPur, a prototype-purity pseudo-labeling method for weakly supervised instance-level learning in pathology whole-slide images. ProtoPur estimates class-balanced local purity over prototype regions constructed from frozen foundation-model features, and assigns pseudo-labels to high-purity regions strongly associated with a target class. This purity-first design separates class-specific evidence from negative or shared morphology, with coverage used only to ensure sufficient pseudo-label assignment. We provide a PAC-style analysis showing that the risk of an instance classifier trained with ProtoPur pseudo-labels can be decomposed into a standard uniform-convergence term and a ProtoPur-specific pseudo-label noise term, comprising selected-region mismatch and a coverage residual. Experiments on three public whole-slide image datasets with two pathology foundation encoders show that ProtoPur consistently improves instance-level performance across multiple MIL backbones while maintaining competitive bag-level performance. Pseudo-label quality comparisons on two public datasets further demonstrate that prototype-purity selection provides stronger instance supervision. These results suggest that the foundation-model features contain exploitable instance-level supervision signals, and ProtoPur is a way to reveal and use these signals from weak bag labels without requiring dense instance annotations.

</details>


### [127] [Rethinking Human Intent-to-CAD: Parametric CAD Model Generation via Cooperative Multi-Task Alignment and Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15681)
*Qingwang Zhang,Jiahao Li,Xiangdong Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出HiCAD方法，直接将多层级人类意图（草图+文本）映射为可执行的参数化CAD代码，并构建了首个相关大规模数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念设计阶段的设计目标以不完整、非结构化的模态（手绘草图和文本描述）表达，从人类意图进行参数化CAD建模仍具挑战性，且现有方法假设目标CAD模型已存在。

Method: 提出统一方法直接映射多层级人类意图到可执行代码；构建HiCAD数据集，对齐手绘草图、文本描述与参数化CAD代码；提出两阶段框架：协作多任务对齐（弥合异构输入表征差距）与空间感知强化学习（保证几何与拓扑一致性）。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在多个任务上显著优于现有基线，验证了将异构人类意图转化为高保真参数化CAD模型的有效性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 重新思考人类意图到CAD的流程，无需假设目标CAD模型先验存在，通过统一框架实现从异构意图到高保真参数化CAD模型的有效转化。

Abstract: Parametric Computer-Aided-Design (CAD) modeling from human intent remains challenging, particularly during the conceptual design stage, where design goals are expressed through incomplete and unstructured modalities (e.g., hand-drawn sketches and textual descriptions). In this work, we rethink the human intent-to-CAD pipeline and propose a unified method that directly maps multi-level human intents to executable codes, without assuming the prior existence of target CAD models. To support our study, we construct HiCAD, the first large-scale dataset aligning hand-drawn sketches, textual descriptions, and parametric CAD codes. Based on this, we introduce HiCAD, a two-stage framework comprising Cooperative Multi-Task Alignment to bridge the representational gap between heterogeneous inputs, and Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning to enforce geometric and topological consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines across multiple tasks, validating its effectiveness and robustness in transforming heterogeneous human intents into high-fidelity parametric CAD models. Our project page: https://zqwlearning.github.io/HiCAD.

</details>


### [128] [PhySimCode: A Benchmark and Evaluation Method for Physics Video to Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15722)
*Souraja Kundu,Aditya Gupta,Joel Julin,Yizhou Zhao,Liuyue Xie,Laszlo A. Jeni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PhySimCode基准，评估MLLMs从原始视频推断物理规律、恢复参数并生成可运行仿真代码的能力，揭示视频到仿真的显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLMs擅长视频理解与代码生成，但能否从视频中恢复底层物理规律（对可执行仿真和机器人物理监督至关重要）尚不明确。现有基准只评估合理性、属性估计或未来预测，无法反映模型能否将视觉动态转化为可运行仿真代码。

Method: 构建PhySimCode基准，包含160.6K程序化生成样本、162种物理现象，涵盖SciPy解析仿真与PyBullet刚体/关节/流体/接触场景。每个样本打包仿真代码、物理参数、渲染视频及结构化思维链。评估10个闭源与开源MLLM，从物理定律正确性、仿真等价性、代码可执行性、参数恢复四方面衡量。

Result: 模型能可靠陈述物理定律（4.27-4.93/5），但从视频推断仅得1.51-2.47/5；最佳系统Claude Sonnet 4.6在±20%内仅恢复7.7%真值参数，暴露显著的视频到仿真差距。评估集2430个视频已开源。

Conclusion: 当前MLLM具备物理知识却难以从视频中推断并重建动力学，视频到仿真代码生成仍是重大挑战。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are good at video understanding and code generation, but it remains unclear whether they can recover the physical laws underlying videos, a capability essential for converting videos into executable simulations and for providing structured physical supervision in robotics. Captioning motion video does not imply that a model has inferred its governing dynamics, estimated quantitative parameters, or can regenerate the observed scene from code. Existing video-physics benchmarks evaluate plausibility, property estimation, or future-state prediction, but offer limited insight into whether models can translate visual dynamics into runnable simulation code. We introduce PhySimCode, a benchmark for physics video-to-code generation: given only a raw video, a model must infer the relevant physics, recover parameter values, and generate runnable Python that reproduces the input video. The dataset contains 160.6K procedurally generated samples spanning 162 physics phenomena across analytic SciPy simulations and PyBullet-rendered rigid-body, articulated, fluid, and contact-rich scenes; each sample bundles the simulation code, physical parameters, rendered video, and a structured chain-of-thought covering observations, laws, ODEs, numerical methods, and validation checks. We evaluate ten state-of-the-art closed- and open-source MLLMs along physical-law correctness, simulation equivalence, code executability, and parameter recovery. Models reliably state physics laws (4.27-4.93/5) yet score only 1.51-2.47/5 on inferring them from video, and the best system (Claude Sonnet 4.6) recovers just 7.7% of ground-truth parameters within $\pm 20\%$, exposing a substantial video-to-simulation gap. The 2,430-video evaluation set is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/SourajaKundu123/PhySimCode and the evaluation code at https://github.com/SourajaKundu/PhySimCode

</details>


### [129] [Visually Legible but Adversarial: Watermark-Constrained Attacks on End-to-End VLMs for Document Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15728)
*Qingzhe Han,Fan Dang,Shengqi Chen,Xinyi Sun,Haoyu Xiong,Lingkun Li,Di Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AR-AWM，一种针对端到端文档理解VLM的白盒对抗水印攻击：仅优化空间分布的水印文本像素即可严重破坏文档问答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可见水印常用于表示文档所有权、机密性和状态，但可能成为对抗信号载体。现有研究未充分探索水印形状支撑作为文档VLM对抗攻击面的潜力。

Method: AR-AWM构造小型、空间分布的水印文本支撑，仅优化其像素以扰乱视觉表示。攻击无目标、与问题无关：生成时不使用问题、答案、解析提示、语言模型梯度或输出。每个受攻击页面可复用于下游查询。在白盒设置下对Qwen2.5-VL-7B和InternVL2.5-8B进行优化。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，覆盖7.98%页面像素的水印支撑使DocVQA精确匹配从0.899降至0.150，ANLS从0.939降至0.212。未优化支撑和匹配随机扰动分别保持ANLS为0.932和0.933，表明对抗优化是性能下降主因。布局匹配矩形优化后ANLS为0.276，显示文本形状几何的增量收益。AR-AWM还降低了OmniDocBench上所有文本、公式、阅读顺序和表格指标。在InternVL2.5-8B上ANLS从0.922降至0.046，弱跨模型迁移表明强编码器特异性。

Conclusion: 在评估的白盒设置下，常规水印形状支撑是文档VLM的对抗攻击面，AR-AWM能有效破坏多种文档理解任务，且具有强编码器特异性。

Abstract: Visible watermarks convey document ownership, confidentiality, and status, but can also carry adversarial signals. We introduce Auto-Regional Adversarial Watermarking (AR-AWM), a model-aware white-box attack on end-to-end visual language models (VLMs) for document understanding. AR-AWM constructs a small, spatially distributed watermark-text support and optimizes only its pixels to disrupt visual representations. The attack is untargeted and question-agnostic: generation uses no questions, answers, parsing prompts, language-model gradients, or language-model outputs. Each attacked page is reused across downstream queries. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, a watermark support covering 7.98% of page pixels under the reporting threshold reduces DocVQA exact match from 0.899 to 0.150 and average normalized Levenshtein similarity (ANLS) from 0.939 to 0.212. Selected qualitative cases retain visually legible source fields. The same support without optimization and with matched random perturbations retains ANLS of 0.932 and 0.933, respectively, identifying adversarial optimization as the primary cause of degradation. Layout-matched optimized rectangles yield ANLS of 0.276, showing an incremental benefit from text-shaped geometry. AR-AWM also degrades all reported text, formula, reading-order, and table metrics on OmniDocBench. Separate white-box optimization on InternVL2.5-8B reduces ANLS from 0.922 to 0.046, while weak cross-model transfer reveals strong encoder specificity. These results identify conventional watermark-shaped supports as an adversarial surface for document VLMs in the evaluated white-box setting.luated white-box setting.

</details>


### [130] [ScenePlacer: Reformulating Scene-Level Object Pose Estimation as Visibility Field Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15734)
*Ken Deng,Jiarui Liu,Guibiao Liao,Kunming Luo,Mochu Xiang,Hongyu Yan,Yebin Liu,Shenghua Gao,Yizhou Yu,Ping Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ScenePlacer 将物体生成与位姿估计解耦，通过条件可见性场学习实现生成物体的场景级位姿估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有场景生成方法要么直接在场景坐标中生成物体（破坏规范空间先验），要么从完整生成形状回归位姿（病态问题，对尺度模糊和部分观测敏感）。

Method: 将对齐重述为条件可见性场学习：给定观测部分点云和生成网格，在物体空间预测可见性场，再通过将部分观测对齐到网格可见部分来估计刚体变换；采用预训练3D形状VAE作为骨干，保持网格先验并条件于单独编码的观测；引入可见性感知、半径约束监督，仅用物体级网格和渲染视图合成训练对，无需场景级位姿标注。

Result: 在3D-FUTURE上，无论GT还是单目深度估计均优于现有放置和位姿精化基线；生成物体下估计深度Chamfer距离0.0077、F-score 92.40，GT几何下提升至0.0023和98.27。

Conclusion: ScenePlacer无需修改生成流程即可实现场景级位姿估计，性能优越且摆脱场景级位姿标注依赖。

Abstract: We present ScenePlacer, a framework for scene-level pose estimation of objects generated by state-of-the-art native shape generation models, placing generated 3D objects into scenes given a partial geometric observation without modifying the underlying generative pipeline. Existing scene generation approaches either generate objects directly in scene coordinates, compromising their canonical-space priors, or regress poses from complete generated shapes in the shape generation process - the latter being a poorly conditioned problem that is sensitive to scale ambiguity and partial observations. ScenePlacer decouples object generation from pose estimation by reformulating alignment as conditional visibility-field learning. Given an observed partial point cloud from reconstruction and a generated mesh, it predicts a visibility field defined in object space, then estimates the rigid transformation by aligning the partial observation to visible parts on the mesh. We propose a pretrained 3D shape VAE as our backbone, preserving its mesh prior while conditioning it on a separately encoded observation. We further introduce visibility-aware, radius-constrained supervision and synthesize training pairs using only object-level meshes and rendered views, eliminating the need for scene-level pose annotations. On 3D-FUTURE, ScenePlacer consistently outperforms existing placement and pose-refinement baselines under both ground-truth and monocular depth estimation. With generated objects, it achieves a Chamfer distance of 0.0077 and an F-score of 92.40 under estimated depth and improves to 0.0023 and 98.27, respectively, under ground-truth geometry.

</details>


### [131] [RSAJEV: Training-Free Abstaining Prototype Memory for Eliminating Silent Hallucination in JEV-Based Remote Sensing Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15742)
*Man Chen,Antai Chen,Shuai Xu,Chengjie Gu,Huaping Zhou,Kelei Sun,Tao Wu,Yongjie Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示MLLM遥感场景分类中"字母绑定"读出头在词表外失效导致"静默幻觉"，提出免训练的原型检索读出RSAJEV，通过槽表示检索+Mahalanobis校正恢复可靠分类与拒识能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM场景分类依赖将候选类名映射为字母选项并用LM头打分，该方法在训练词表内高效（UCM 97.71% OA），但词表外表现极不稳定：跨数据集零适配精度在7.35%–96.40%间波动，开放集下置信度反转（AUROC 0.38），对未见类给出更高置信，形成"静默幻觉"，缺乏可信拒识通道。

Method: 保留原slot表示，替换读出机制为RSAJEV：一个免训练、可弃权的原型记忆。每类缓存K张参考图像的slot表示作为原型，分类转为最近邻检索，并用shrinkage-Mahalanobis几何校正精化。该读出在机制上同构于RAG，但作用于判别决策，是首个针对MLLM slot表示的检索式读出。

Result: 16参考/类、零梯度更新下，UCM跨数据集门达89.43% OA，AID达96.90%；开放集ID-ness分数在两数据集上达0.91–0.99 AUROC，在四种开放集设定中均超符号置信（0.38–0.96）。支持零额外推理成本的类别增删（离线重打分缓存矩阵）。

Conclusion: 检索式读出替代字母绑定可有效缓解词表外静默幻觉，恢复可校准的弃权通道，并支持灵活的类别增删，为MLLM判别式应用提供稳健、免训练的读出范式。

Abstract: Scene classification of remote sensing imagery with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is formulated as a single-forward-pass decision problem: candidate class names are lettered options in the prompt, a registered answer slot is conditioned on the prompt, and classification is read out by scoring letter tokens with the language-modeling head. We show that although this letter binding is highly effective within its training vocabulary (97.71% OA on UCM), it behaves erratically out of vocabulary: zero-adaptation accuracy across four cross-dataset directions fluctuates between 7.35% and 96.40%, and under out-of-vocabulary weights its confidence fails inversely on open-set evaluation, assigning higher confidence to unseen than to seen classes (AUROC 0.38), a failure we term silent hallucination. We retain the slot representation and replace the readout with RSAJEV, a training-free abstaining prototype memory that performs retrieval-based prototype matching: K reference images per class are cached as prototypes via their slot representations under the same prompt, and classification becomes nearest-neighbor retrieval over the prototypes, refined by a shrinkage-Mahalanobis geometric correction. This readout is mechanistically isomorphic to retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) but operates on discriminative decisions; it is the first retrieval-based readout for MLLM slot representations. The retrieval readout reaches 89.43% on the UCM cross-dataset gate with 16 references per class and zero gradient updates, and 96.90% on AID. Its ID-ness scores attain 0.91-0.99 AUROC on open-set evaluation over two datasets, exceeding symbolic confidence (0.38-0.96) in all four open-set settings, restoring a calibratable abstention channel and supporting class addition/removal at zero extra inference cost via offline rescoring of the cached matrix.

</details>


### [132] [SpikeOcc: Towards Resilient Multimodal 3D Occupancy Perception via Spiking Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15745)
*Yiding Sun,Zijie Xu,Hongqiang Lin,Jiajun Cao,Dongxu Zhang,Kai Tang,Jihua Zhu,Wenxuan Liu,Zhaofei Yu,Tiejun Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SpikeOcc，利用脉冲神经网络（SNN）构建更鲁棒的多模态3D占用预测，通过Spiking Mixture-of-Experts与Sensor Availability Learning应对传感器缺失问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要通过复杂融合提升精度，但对传感器缺失时的鲁棒性关注不足。SNN的离散特性导致优化困难，需克服该问题以构建更鲁棒的多模态感知。

Method: SpikeOcc包含两部分：(1) Spiking Mixture-of-Experts（SMoE），将RGB、LiDAR及联合融合组织为专门通路，实现全宽单模态表示，同时通过有界残差保留原始多模态特征；(2) Sensor Availability Learning（SAL），采用分阶段课程学习与显式路由监督，逐步提升严重感知条件下的鲁棒性。

Result: 实验表明，SpikeOcc在保持有竞争力的全传感器精度的同时，显著提升了传感器失效时的性能下限。SAL对传统模型也带来明显增益。

Conclusion: SpikeOcc展示了神经形态计算在自动驾驶中的潜力，指向更可靠、更节能的自动驾驶方向。

Abstract: Multimodal 3D occupancy prediction underpins safe autonomous driving through comprehensive scene understanding. However, existing methods have largely pursued higher accuracy through sophisticated fusion, leaving resilience to missing sensors underexplored. In this paper, we investigate spiking neural networks (SNNs) as a means of building more resilient multimodal perception. Still, the discrete nature of spiking neurons makes optimization challenging. To overcome this difficulty, SpikeOcc is introduced with two complementary components, a Spiking Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) and Sensor Availability Learning (SAL). Specifically, SMoE organizes RGB, LiDAR, and joint fusion into specialized pathways, enabling full-width unimodal representations while retaining the original multimodal features via a bounded residual. Beyond sensor dropout, SAL employs a staged curriculum with explicit routing supervision, progressively improving robustness under severe sensing conditions. Remarkably, SAL also yields notable gains for conventional models, highlighting its broader potential for resilient multimodal learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SpikeOcc maintains competitive full-sensor accuracy while markedly raising the performance floor under sensor outages. SpikeOcc illustrates the promise of neuromorphic computing, pointing toward more reliable and energy-efficient autonomous driving.

</details>


### [133] [Frozen History: When Temporal Losses Stop Accumulation in Learned Real-Time Supersampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15752)
*Hao Yu,Guoying Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示时间一致性损失在准确配准下会抑制累积（网络复制warp历史导致静态内容冻结），并识别四种被训练掩盖的配准错误。修正配准后，小时间权重配合归一化采样累加器使普通配准网络在QRISP上PSNR提升0.34–0.62 dB，静态方差为DLSS 2的四分之一，且无重训练下在Arm Bistro上超经典方法4.4 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时超采样沿运动向量累积抖动低分辨率样本，常用时间一致性损失减少闪烁，但作者质疑该损失在配准准确时可能反而抑制累积、掩盖配准错误。

Method: 通过无模型oracle量化正确配准的收益，识别四类可被训练掩盖的配准错误（携带抖动的运动向量、两种分辨率格网共用单运动场、抖动深度、未配准skip路径）；进行受控训练实验，跨三种网络族与两种尺度验证，并设计归一化样本累加器配合小时间权重。

Result: 准确配准使静态像素冻结成本降低两个数量级；时间权重大小对PSNR影响发生反转，权重0.25时静态帧损失0.7–0.9 dB。修正后QRISP PSNR提升0.34–0.62 dB（×2/×3/×4至1080p），×2静态标准差为DLSS 2的四分之一，无重训练在Arm Bistro超经典法至少4.4 dB，×4模型H200上2.03 ms/帧。

Conclusion: 时间一致性损失与配准质量紧密耦合，正确配准是发挥累积优势的关键；修正配准并采用小时间权重和归一化累加器可同时提升精度、稳定性和效率。

Abstract: Learned real-time supersampling accumulates jittered low-resolution samples along motion vectors. Many methods use a temporal consistency loss to reduce flicker. We show that with accurate registration, this loss can suppress accumulation: on static content, the network copies its warped history at almost no temporal cost. Camera jitter in motion vectors raises this cost and can hide the effect. We identify four registration errors that training can conceal: jitter-carrying motion vectors, one motion field for both resolution lattices, jittered depth, and an unregistered skip path. A model-free oracle shows that correct registration makes freezing two orders of magnitude cheaper on static pixels. Controlled training shows that registration reverses the temporal weight's effect on PSNR. Under exact registration, increasing the weight reduces pixel variance at the expense of accuracy and perceived quality, with a 0.7 to 0.9 dB loss on static frames at weight 0.25. This reversal recurs across three network families and two scales; the loss also reduces accuracy on unjittered STSS data. With a small temporal weight and a normalised sample accumulator, a plain registered network improves the best published QRISP PSNR by 0.34 to 0.62 dB at $\times$2, $\times$3 and $\times$4 upscaling to 1080p. At $\times$2, its static pixel standard deviation is one quarter that of DLSS 2. Without retraining, it outperforms classical temporal upsampling by at least 4.4 dB on Arm's jittered Bistro capture. Our most accurate $\times$4 model runs in 2.03 ms per 1080p frame on an H200. Code: https://github.com/CV-AC/Frozen_history

</details>


### [134] [SlotAVS: Object-Centric Audio-Visual Segmentation via Bi-Modal Slot Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15764)
*Arnav Sharma,Anand Mishra,Renu Rameshan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SlotAVS提出以竞争性双模态slot attention驱动的object-centric框架，将范式从全局跨模态融合转为显式竞争绑定，在多源音视频分割任务上取得S4 88.6%和MS3 71.7% mIoU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多源场景中并发声源在共享视觉表示中相互纠缠，标准以对齐为核心的Transformer架构会导致掩码被合并或专业化不稳定，需要一种能显式分离不同声学实体的方法。

Method: 从时序音频序列初始化离散object slots，并在空间视觉token上强制严格的slot间竞争；引入匈牙利匹配策略，用空间与边界重叠将slot与真值对象最优对齐；配合数值稳定、置信度感知的掩码融合机制聚合多源预测。

Result: 在AVSBench数据集上，Single-Source (S4) split取得88.6% mIoU，Multi-Source (MS3) split取得71.7% mIoU。

Conclusion: 显式竞争绑定对复杂音视频场景理解至关重要，可在不单纯依赖基础模型容量的情况下有效利用其先验。

Abstract: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) requires predicting pixel-wise masks of sounding objects by grounding acoustic signals in visual space. In multi-source scenes, concurrent sound sources often remain entangled within shared visual representations, leading to merged masks or unstable specialization when using standard alignment-focused transformer architectures. To address this, we present SlotAVS, an object-centric framework driven by competitive bi-modal slot attention. While robust foundation models provide rich semantic priors, SlotAVS shifts the paradigm from global cross-modal fusion to explicit competitive binding. By initializing discrete object slots from temporal audio sequences and enforcing strict slot-wise competition over spatial visual tokens, our method structurally mitigates the blending of distinct acoustic entities. Further, to stabilize instance-level learning, we introduce a Hungarian matching strategy that optimally aligns slots with ground-truth objects using spatial and boundary overlap. Coupled with a numerically stable, confidence-aware mask fusion mechanism, SlotAVS robustly aggregates multi-source predictions. Extensive experiments on the AVSBench dataset demonstrate the efficacy of our approach, achieving 88.6% mIoU on the Single-Source (S4) split and 71.7% mIoU on the Multi-Source (MS3) split. These results show that explicit competitive binding is critical for complex audio-visual scene understanding and effectively leveraging foundation-model priors without relying solely on their capacity.

</details>


### [135] [Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement for Navigation via Policy-Synchronized Language-Action Dual Bootstrapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15782)
*Songze Li,Haoming Gu,Ziyang Gong,Zhitong Wang,Gengze Zhou,Zun Wang,Yuhan Zhu,Tianxiang Jiang,Juanzi Li,Qi Wu,Weinan Zhang,Yu Qiao,Wenwei Zhang,Yi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RSI-Nav是一个数据中心的递归自改进框架，通过策略同步的语言-动作双重自举，统一指令跟随与指令生成，在R2R-CE上达68.6% SR、RxR-CE上达72.4% SR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言导航需要高质量语言监督，但人工标注昂贵。现有合成方法要么分离导航与指令生成模型，要么用特定组件耦合两者；且多数用固定模型一次性标注全轨迹再更新，导致生成监督滞后于演进的策略。

Method: RSI-Nav先经监督微调建立基础能力，然后小分片处理未标注轨迹：当前模型为轨迹生成指令、执行以评估目标完成度与路径效率、保留合格样本，并在处理下一分片前立即更新自身，实现分片式更新使监督与策略对齐。同时引入空间理解数据以增强空间推理。

Result: 在R2R-CE上达到68.6%成功率，RxR-CE上达到72.4%成功率，并有更强的指令生成效用与适度提升的空间理解能力。

Conclusion: 分片式策略同步的递归自改进能有效统一导航与指令生成，缓解监督滞后问题，提升导航性能及多任务效用。

Abstract: Vision-language navigation requires agents to follow natural-language instructions to reach target locations, making high-quality language supervision essential. Since human annotation is costly, prior work has explored scalable data synthesis methods. However, existing methods typically either use separate models for navigation and instruction generation or couple the two tasks through task-specific components; most also annotate the full trajectory corpus with a fixed model before updating, which can cause generated supervision to lag behind the evolving policy. Therefore, we introduce RSI-Nav, a data-centric recursive self-improvement framework for navigation via policy-synchronized language-action dual bootstrapping, which unifies vision-language-to-action instruction following and vision-action-to-language instruction generation within a shared model. Specifically, after supervised fine-tuning establishes fundamental capabilities, RSI-Nav progressively processes unlabeled trajectories in small shards. The current model generates instructions for these trajectories, executes them to evaluate goal completion and path efficiency, retains qualified samples, and immediately updates itself before processing the next shard. This shard-wise update keeps newly generated supervision aligned with the evolving policy. We also incorporate spatial understanding data, since stronger spatial reasoning benefits navigation. Extensive experiments show that RSI-Nav reaches 68.6% SR on R2R-CE and 72.4% SR on RxR-CE, while providing stronger instruction-generation utility and modestly improved spatial understanding after recursive evolution.

</details>


### [136] [Reference-Efficient Multimodal Bitstream-Corrupted Video Recovery via Depth-Conditioned Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15806)
*Tianyi Liu,Jiaojiao Wang,Ye Lu,Kejun Wu,Chengtao Cai,Zhengguo Li,Chia-Wen Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出多模态比特流损坏视频恢复（MBSCVR）框架，利用传输前深度几何信息与单个选取的非局部RGB参考，提升损坏视频恢复质量并降低资源开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖局部残差和非局部RGB参考，但解码后二者可能不可靠，且使用更多参考会增加接收端计算与内存负担。

Method: 提出MBSCVR框架，使用可靠性感知多模态选择器结合有效外观与深度兼容性，在编码前选取单个非局部RGB参考；引入深度条件参考自适应（DCRA），将RGB证据引入特征补全与内容生成，并用帧对齐深度引导补全查询。

Result: 在完整BSCV基准（oracle masks）上，YouTube-VOS达32.30 dB、DAVIS达28.93 dB，分别超过全参考B2SCVR 0.27和0.33 dB，SSIM亦有提升；接收端前向测量显示延迟降低36.8%、峰值内存降低40.8%。

Conclusion: 紧凑几何引导与自适应外观处理可改善多媒体恢复的质量—资源权衡。

Abstract: Recovering visually faithful content from damaged video bitstreams is important for reliable multimedia communication and storage. Existing methods exploit local residuals and non-local RGB references of the input video sequence, but both sources can become unreliable after decoding, while processing additional references increases receiver computation and memory. This paper studies multimodal bitstream-corrupted video recovery (MBSCVR) using RGB and depth information, where pre-transmission depth-based geometry aids reconstruction when the received appearance is corrupted. We propose a novel MBSCVR framework that selects and effectively utilizes a single selected non-local RGB reference per recovery window to achieve higher performance. It integrates a reliability-aware multimodal selector that combines valid appearance with depth compatibility before reference encoding. Depth-Conditioned Reference Adaptation (DCRA) introduces selected RGB evidence into feature completion and content generation, while frame-aligned depth conditions completion queries. On the complete BSCV benchmark with oracle masks, MBSCVR uses one selected reference to achieve 32.30 dB on YouTube-VOS and 28.93 dB on DAVIS, surpassing full-reference B2SCVR by 0.27 and 0.33 dB and improving SSIM on both subsets. Matched receiver-forward measurements show 36.8\% lower latency and 40.8\% lower peak memory. These results demonstrate how compact geometric guidance and adapted appearance processing improve the quality--resource trade-off of multimedia recovery.

</details>


### [137] [Totem: Object-Centric 3D Memory for World-Consistent Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15807)
*Zichen Wan,Tianyu Huang,Fan Li,Kai Wang,Hongzhi Zhang,Wangmeng Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Totem：以对象为中心的3D记忆框架，实现世界一致的视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大视角变化下，现有视频生成方法难以维持单个物体表示的稳定性，缺乏统一底层世界的一致性。

Method: 将每个选定物体表示为对齐共享世界坐标系的持久3D记忆并赋予专属状态；设计双流3D条件架构，结合物体记忆与场景几何进行目标视角合成；用3D结构信息约束注意力以保留物体表面与相对空间布局。

Result: 在世界生成与对象中心基准上，面向挑战性相机轨迹生成物体一致性更强的3D世界视频，并支持多种应用。

Conclusion: 物体中心3D记忆有效提升大视角变化下视频生成的3D世界一致性与多任务适用性。

Abstract: Generating coherent videos grounded in a unified underlying world remains a major challenge, particularly under large viewpoint changes, where existing methods often struggle to maintain stable representations of individual objects. To this end, we introduce Totem, an object-centric 3D memory framework for world-consistent video generation. Totem first represents each selected object as a persistent 3D memory aligned to a shared world frame, assigning it a dedicated state. Based on these memories, we design a dual-stream 3D conditioning architecture that combines object memories with scene geometry for target-view synthesis. Moreover, these object memories constrain the model's attention with 3D structural information, thereby preserving object surfaces and relative spatial layouts. Extensive experiments on world-generation and object-centric benchmarks demonstrate that Totem generates videos depicting a more object-consistent 3D world under challenging camera trajectories, while supporting versatile applications.

</details>


### [138] [Adaptive Look, Flexible Thought: Learning How and How Long to Think in Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15810)
*Quanlin Chen,Xiuwei Chen,Kun Xiang,Zehua Ma,Chunjin Ye,Boqiang Guo,Xianming Liu,Xiaodan Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出L2T统一推理框架，将工具产生的视觉状态离散化为视觉token，与文本推理共享自回归空间，联合优化视觉感知与文本推理，在保持竞争力的同时实现1.7-3.6倍吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有快慢推理范式主要调控文本推理长度，将外部工具或视觉token带来的视觉计算视为辅助部分，导致MLLM无法联合优化视觉感知与文本推理。

Method: L2T将工具产生的视觉状态离散化为视觉token，将视觉感知与文本推理纳入统一自回归空间；引入模态感知路由奖励选择合适推理模式，并采用难度感知快慢策略根据任务复杂度调整推理深度。

Result: 在通用感知与推理密集型任务上验证有效性；相比显式工具调用方法，保持竞争性能的同时吞吐量提升1.7-3.6倍。

Conclusion: L2T通过统一视觉与文本的自回归空间并自适应调控推理模式与深度，实现了视觉感知与文本推理的联合优化，兼顾性能与效率。

Abstract: The introduction of long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and external tools has substantially improved the performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on general and reasoning tasks. However, existing fast-slow reasoning paradigms mainly regulate textual reasoning length, while visual computation introduced by external tools or visual tokens is often treated as an auxiliary component. This separation prevents MLLMs from jointly optimizing visual perception and textual reasoning. To address this issue, we propose L2T (adaptive Look, flexible Thought), a unified reasoning framework that jointly optimizes the form and depth of computation. L2T first discretizes tool-produced visual states into visual tokens, bringing visual perception and textual reasoning into a shared autoregressive space. Based on this unified representation, L2T introduces a modality-aware routing reward to select appropriate reasoning modes and a difficulty-aware fast-slow strategy to adapt reasoning depth according to task complexity. Experiments on general perception and reasoning-intensive tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of L2T. Compared with explicit tool-calling approaches, L2T maintains competitive performance while achieving 1.7--3.6 times higher throughput.

</details>


### [139] [ChangeT$^3$: Evaluating Vision Test-Time Training for Remote Sensing Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15813)
*Sharukshan Niranjan,Oshadha Samarakoon,Nichula Wasalathilaka,Roshan Godaliyadda,Parakrama Ekanayake,Vijitha Herath*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ChangeT$^3$,将分层 ViT$^3$-Tiny 与 ChangeFormer 多尺度解码器结合成孪生结构,在 LEVIR-CD+ 上达到 80.61 F1,优于 ChangeFormer 的 78.84,但未零样本迁移且速度更慢。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双时相遥感变化检测需要既保留空间细节又捕捉上下文信息的表征。视觉测试时训练(test-time training)可通过将紧凑内模型适配到每张图像,作为显式 token-to-token 注意力的替代方案。

Method: 采用原生孪生配置:共享 ViT$^3$-Tiny 分层编码器参数,但两路图像流独立计算 fast weights。每个编码块保留全局简化 SwiGLU 与局部自适应深度卷积分支。时间比较由解码器在四个分辨率上学习融合成对特征,再粗到细聚合做二值预测,无需额外时间交互模块。

Result: 在 LEVIR-CD+ 上从头训练,同解码器、配方与预算下,ChangeT$^3$ 三种子 F1 为 80.61±0.90,ChangeFormer 为 78.84±0.21;关闭两个内更新后同编码器为 78.63±0.20。两模型均无法零样本迁移到 SYSU-CD、DSIFN-CD、WHU-CD;尽管参数量与运算量相近,ChangeT$^3$ 在小输入下更慢。

Conclusion: 内更新(image-conditioned inner updates)在受控设置下带来一定性能提升,但增益有限,且不改善跨数据集泛化,计算效率反而下降。

Abstract: Bitemporal remote sensing change detection requires representations that preserve spatial detail while capturing contextual information relevant to changes between acquisitions. Visual test-time training offers an alternative to explicit token-to-token attention by adapting a compact inner model to each image. This letter describes ChangeT$^3$, a vanilla Siamese configuration combining the existing hierarchical ViT$^3$-Tiny encoder with the multiscale ChangeFormer decoder. The two image streams share learned encoder parameters, while their fast weights are computed independently from their respective spatial features. Each encoder block retains the inherited global simplified SwiGLU and local adaptive depthwise-convolution branches. Temporal comparison is performed by the decoder through learned fusion of paired features at four resolutions, followed by coarse-to-fine aggregation and binary prediction. This separation provides a direct setting for examining image-conditioned inner updates without introducing an additional temporal interaction module. Trained from scratch on LEVIR-CD+ with the same decoder, recipe, and budget as a ChangeFormer control, ChangeT$^3$ reaches an F1 of 80.61$\pm$0.90 against 78.84$\pm$0.21 for ChangeFormer (three seeds each); as in the standard protocol for this dataset, checkpoints are selected on the test split. Trained with both inner updates disabled, the same encoder reaches 78.63$\pm$0.20. Neither model transfers zero-shot to SYSU-CD, DSIFN-CD, or WHU-CD, and ChangeT$^3$ is the slower of the two at small inputs despite similar parameter and operation counts.

</details>


### [140] [Mobility Helps Learning: Unsupervised Model Adaptation for Object Recognition via Movement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15846)
*Yanan Ma,Yihang Tao,Zhengru Fang,Senkang Hu,Xianhao Chen,Yuguang Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MoCaFe，利用移动 agent 观察同一物体时的预测方差进行无监督测试时自适应，显著超越现有TTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时自适应方法将测试数据视为独立快照，未利用 agent 从不同距离和视角观察同一物体时预测质量变化这一独特监督信号。

Method: 1) 运动校准的伪标签过滤：用逆方差权重融合跨视角预测构造可靠伪标签；2) 用过滤后伪标签选择困难样本学习；3) 可选扩展p-MoCaFe用公开数据集为样本赋权，得到有界偏差的干净损失估计。

Result: 在自动驾驶（nuScenes、KITTI）和具身agent数据集上，MoCaFe显著优于SOTA TTA方法，准确率提升最多约20%。

Conclusion: MoCaFe是一种模型无关、超参不敏感的范式，有效利用运动引起的预测方差实现无监督自适应。

Abstract: Movable agents, such as autonomous vehicles and robots, should be able to autonomously adapt their pre-trained object recognition models to new environments without human annotations. While existing test-time adaptation (TTA) methods address label-free model adaptation, they typically treat test data as independent snapshots, without constructively exploiting a rich, unique source of supervision: the significant variance in prediction quality as an agent observes the same object from different distances and viewpoints. To capitalize on this, we propose \texttt{MoCaFe}, a model-agnostic and hyperparameter-insensitive paradigm that leverages motion-induced prediction variance for unsupervised adaptation. Specifically, we first develop mobility-calibrated filtering of pseudo-labels, which constructs reliable pseudo-labels by fusing cross-view predictions using inverse-variance weights. The filtered pseudo-labels then guide the selection of ``hard samples'' for effective learning. To further suppress pseudo-label corruption, we introduce \texttt{p-MoCaFe}, an optional extension that uses a public dataset to assign weighting factors to data samples, yielding an estimator of the clean loss with bounded bias. Extensive experiments on autonomous driving (nuScenes, KITTI) and embodied-agent datasets show that \texttt{MoCaFe} significantly outperforms state-of-the-art TTA schemes, achieving up to approximately 20% accuracy gain.

</details>


### [141] [Sharper Frames, Worse Rooms: Viewpoint Coverage Dominates Image Quality in Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15854)
*Alibek Dadajonov,Hikmatillo Umarhojiyev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在小帧预算的多视角重建中，帧选择应优先考虑视角覆盖而非图像清晰度，因为最清晰帧反而导致最差重建效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 室内场景的空间推理依赖多视角几何重建，但前馈重建模型受固定帧预算限制，帧选择成为关键上游决策。传统上偏好选择清晰帧，作者怀疑这种偏好在小预算下可能有害。

Method: 对九组手持室内扫描做实验：从200帧候选中选16帧，比较“选最清晰帧”与“均匀时间采样”等策略；开展2×2因子实验独立操纵视角分布和单帧清晰度；改变帧预算观察趋势；测试推理阶段多视角一致性分数和视觉语言模型的置信度能否检测该失败。

Result: 选最清晰的16帧是最差策略，房间尺寸误差达48%，而均匀采样仅3%。失败源于清晰帧多出现在慢速运动时，导致视角集中在一个狭窄角度区域，遗漏192°（最差超过300°）的房�间。因子实验显示视角分布的主效应约是清晰度的三倍，在9组中有8组“模糊但分布广”优于“清晰但聚集”。随着帧预算增加、角度覆盖饱和，该优势减弱。重建模型的多视角一致性分数反而随误差上升，视觉语言模型的置信度与其空间估计误差无关。

Conclusion: 小视角预算下，视角覆盖比单帧图像质量更重要，而推理阶段可用的不确定性信号都无法揭示这一上游失败。

Abstract: Grounded spatial reasoning about indoor scenes rests on a geometric reconstruction that the multimodal system does not itself produce. Feed-forward multi-view reconstruction models operate under a fixed view budget, making frame selection a critical upstream decision. We show that under this setting the conventional preference for sharp frames can be actively harmful. Across nine handheld room scans, selecting the sharpest 16 of 200 candidate frames is the worst strategy we test, reaching 48\% room dimension error where uniform temporal sampling reaches 3\%. We trace this failure to a coupling between image quality and camera motion: sharp frames tend to occur during slow motion and therefore concentrate the selection in a narrow angular region, leaving $192^\circ$ of the room unobserved in the case we illustrate and over $300^\circ$ in the worst cells. A $2\times2$ factorial experiment that independently manipulates viewpoint spread and per-frame sharpness shows that spread has roughly three times the main effect of quality, and that blurry but well spread selections outperform sharp but clustered selections in 8 of 9 captures. The advantage also diminishes as the frame budget increases and angular coverage saturates, consistent with this mechanism. Finally, we ask whether the failure is detectable at inference: the reconstruction model's multi-view consistency score increases with reconstruction error, while a vision-language model given the same frames reports confidence unrelated to its own spatial estimation error. Under small view budgets, viewpoint coverage is a more important constraint than per-frame image quality, and neither uncertainty signal available at inference reveals this upstream failure.

</details>


### [142] [Learning Multimodal Sensor Fusion with JEPA Representations for Breathing Activity and Pose Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15891)
*Yunxiang Luo,Constantino Álvarez Casado,Xiaoting Wu,Nhi Nguyen,Le Nguyen,Manuel Lage Cañellas,Miguel Bordallo López*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将冻结的V-JEPA2特征迁移到RGB、深度和雷达等异构传感器，通过共享融合模型在39名OMuSense-23受试者上评测多模态缺失场景下的子集监督、池化容量与表征迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测式视频表征本身无法说明多模态系统应如何处理缺失传感器，因此需要在异构传感器和传感器子集缺失条件下进行受控评测。

Method: 冻结V-JEPA2特征迁移到RGB视频、深度视频和雷达时间序列；共享融合模型使用模态查询、固定传感器槽位和显式可用性，对全部七个非空传感器子集进行呼吸活动与姿态分类；采用五个受试者分组折和三个随机种子评测子集监督、池化容量与表征迁移。

Result: 在匹配下游参数量时，最终模型在七个子集上的录音级活动宏F1均值为75.23%±0.60；每批监督所有子集相比匹配的query-pooling对照提升1.923个百分点（条件95%受试者bootstrap区间[0.647, 3.209]）；平衡监督下query pooling相比匹配mean pooling无明显优势；雷达探针支持超越池化小波像素的迁移；64-token推理大致保持平均活动性能；Consensus-JEPA损失相对其精确对照无实测收益。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了多模态缺失传感器场景下子集监督、池化容量和表征迁移的受控评测，表明全子集监督有效、query pooling优势不明确，且部分扩展方法未带来实测收益。

Abstract: Predictive video representations do not by themselves specify how a multimodal system should handle missing sensors. We transfer frozen V-JEPA2 features to a set of heterogeneous sensors comprised by RGB video, depth video, and radar time series. A shared fusion model uses modality queries, fixed sensor slots, and explicit availability to classify breathing activity and pose from all seven non-empty sensor subsets. The contribution is a controlled evaluation of subset supervision, pooling capacity, and representation transfer on 39 OMuSense-23 subjects with five subject-group folds and three seeds. With matched downstream parameter counts, the final model reaches recording-level activity macro-F1 of $75.23%\pm0.60$ averaged across seven subsets. Supervising all subsets in each batch improves the matched query-pooling control by 1.923 percentage points (conditional 95% subject-bootstrap interval [0.647, 3.209]), while query pooling shows no clear advantage over matched mean pooling under balanced supervision. Radar probes support transfer beyond pooled wavelet pixels, 64-token inference approximately preserves mean activity performance, and the tested Consensus-JEPA loss adds no measured benefit against its exact control.

</details>


### [143] [Gen Through the Lens: Camera-Controllable Video Generation via Cross-Coordinate Conditioning Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15900)
*Shuai Li,Jinxu Xiang,Xinyuan Li,Hanlei Guo,Xiyang Tan,Alan Zhao,Xiaotong Zhao,Ran Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Gen Through the Lens 框架，通过三个坐标系（相机、世界、物体）分解与融合控制信号，实现相机可控的图像到视频生成，效果优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型将相机运动视为抽象条件或依赖单一坐标系，难以实现真实且物理一致的相机操作控制。

Method: 显式分解并在三个坐标空间中融合控制信号：相机坐标（内参）、世界坐标（空间几何提示）、物体坐标（目标主体的3D边界框），通过跨坐标条件融合统一异质线索。

Result: 在多样化相机操作下产生可控且视觉一致的结果，在真实感和可编辑性上均超越现有方法。

Conclusion: 多坐标系分解融合策略可精确控制相机运动、对焦与构图，同时保持时空一致性，为相机可控视频生成提供有效方案。

Abstract: We present Gen Through the Lens, a camera-controllable image-to-video generation framework that synthesizes videos from a given reference image while enabling realistic and physically consistent camera operations. Unlike previous models that treat camera motion as abstract conditioning or rely on a single coordinate system, our approach explicitly decomposes and fuses control signals across three coordinate spaces: the camera coordinate (modeled by intrinsic parameters), the world coordinate (represented by spatial geometry hints), and the object coordinate (described by 3D bounding boxes of target subjects). Through cross-coordinate conditioning fusion, these heterogeneous cues are unified to guide the generative process, enabling precise control of camera motion, focus, and framing while preserving temporal and spatial coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces controllable and visually consistent results across diverse camera operations, outperforming existing approaches in both realism and editability.

</details>


### [144] [VIEWCRAFT: Evolving What Multimodal Agents See and How They Read It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15915)
*Binxiao Xu,Ruichuan An,Bocheng Zou,Weihua Du,Xinyu Wei,Hangyu Guo,YiFan Zhang,Renye Yan,Chengqi Duan,Hang Hua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViewCraft联合演化可执行证据接口与阅读程序，提升多模态智能体任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可复用技能无需更新权重即可提升多模态智能体，但效果取决于证据呈现与读取方式。作者认为证据构建与阅读应作为耦合的可复用技能联合优化。

Method: ViewCraft联合演化可执行证据接口（选择、变换、组织观察）与其阅读程序；利用失败轨迹指导修订，通过重放与配对评估保留有用改动，并用接口投影从合格的被拒联合提案中恢复视觉编辑。

Result: 在八个基准上，任务得分平均提升6.1分，且每个基准均有增益；在相同输入token预算下优势保持。五个多源任务中，学得接口比初始技能少用8%-15%输入token。技能可跨执行器迁移，并在所有迁移评估中优于直接执行。

Conclusion: 证据构建与阅读作为耦合可复用技能，能有效提升多模态智能体并具有良好的token效率与迁移性。

Abstract: Reusable skills improve multimodal agents without updating model weights, but their effectiveness depends on both the evidence presented and the procedure used to read it. We introduce ViewCraft, which jointly evolves an executable evidence interface and its reading procedure. The interface selects, transforms, and organizes observations; the reader interprets the resulting views. Failure traces guide revisions, replay and paired evaluation retain useful changes, and interface projection recovers visual edits from eligible rejected joint proposals. Across eight benchmarks, ViewCraft improves over direct execution by an average of $6.1$ points in task score, with gains on every benchmark. The advantage persists at a matched input-token budget. On all five multi-source tasks, the learned interface uses 8%-15% fewer input tokens than Initial skill. The learned skills also transfer across executors and outperform direct execution in every evaluated transfer, supporting evidence construction and reading as a coupled, reusable skill.

</details>


### [145] [Frequency-Step Cache: Separating Synchronization and Repair for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15922)
*Kerry Xu,Param Misra,Zachary Stenglein,Athri Karunamurthy,Fanjiang Ye,Yuke Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Frequency-Step Cache (FSC)，将自回归视频扩散模型缓存中的“同步”与“修复”两个决策解耦，在多个骨干上提升速度-质量权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频生成需反复前向传播大型扩散Transformer，训练-free缓存的现有控制器将“何时精确同步缓存”与“同步间修复多少计算”两个决策耦合，导致性能受限。

Method: FSC分离两者：在密集到稀疏轨迹上调度精确全计算锚点；用基于频率分辨漂移与token age的轻量潜在空间风险信号控制锚点间修复（整步重放、选择性token重算或全修复）。

Result: SkyReels-V2上整步复用贡献主要加速，选择性token计算最适合作保真修复；受控消融显示单一反应信号会降低匹配延迟下的保真度。FSC-Speed达2.36x加速（MotionCache 2.275x）且SSIM+0.019、PSNR+0.5dB；匹配速度下FSC-Quality SSIM+0.031、PSNR+1.0dB、LPIPS-0.024；无重调迁移到14B模型2.12x（MotionCache 1.79x）。

Conclusion: 将缓存同步与计算修复解耦能持续改善多自回归视频骨干的速度-质量权衡，并具备良好迁移性。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video generation enables long-horizon synthesis but requires repeated forward passes through large diffusion transformers. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing intermediate computation, yet existing controllers often couple two decisions: when to synchronize the cache exactly and how much computation to repair between synchronizations. We introduce Frequency-Step Cache (FSC), which separates these roles. FSC schedules exact full-computation anchors on a dense-to-sparse trajectory, while a lightweight latent-space risk based on frequency-resolved drift and token age controls inter-anchor repair through whole-step replay, selective token recomputation, or full repair. On SkyReels-V2, whole-step reuse provides most of the acceleration, while selective token computation is most effective as fidelity repair. A controlled ablation shows that using one reactive signal for both synchronization and repair reduces fidelity at matched latency, with the same separation advantage observed on FramePack and Matrix-Game. Across multiple autoregressive video backbones, FSC improves speed-quality trade-offs. On SkyReels-V2, FSC-Speed reaches 2.36x speedup versus MotionCache's 2.275x while improving SSIM by 0.019 and PSNR by 0.5 dB. At MotionCache-matched speed, FSC-Quality improves SSIM by 0.031 and PSNR by 1.0 dB and lowers LPIPS by 0.024. Without retuning, FSC-Quality transfers to SkyReels-V2 14B at 2.12x speedup versus 1.79x for MotionCache.

</details>


### [146] [When Trackers Fail: VLM-Guided Verification and Recovery for Robust Video Object Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15929)
*Valay Bundele,Susmit Agrawal,Mehran Hosseinzadeh,The Nam Nguyen,Hendrik P. A. Lensch*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Dual-Agent 失败感知跟踪框架，用显式验证与恢复补充传播机制，缓解身份漂移，并在多个基准上提升 SAM3 等跟踪器性能且可免重训迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 SAM 等基础模型的跟踪器依赖掩码传播，但在遮挡、重现或干扰下错误预测会进入跟踪循环并随时间传播，导致持续的身份漂移；现有方法仅改进记忆与时序建模，一旦失败无法显式识别或纠正。

Method: Dual-Agent 包含两个智能体：视觉-语言验证智能体基于时空上下文判断是否仍在跟踪目标；检测到失败后，纠正智能体利用时序上下文恢复目标再继续跟踪。纠正智能体在真实 SAM3 失败数据上训练，并辅以身份切换和干扰物扰动增强。

Result: 在 LVOS-v2 和 SecVOS 上分别将 SAM3 提升 1.2 和 2.7 J&F；无需重训即可迁移到 SAM2.1、SeC、Cutie 以及 LaSOT-ext、TNL2K、VOT-LT2022 等长期视频目标跟踪基准。

Conclusion: 显式推理跟踪何时失败以及如何恢复，为鲁棒跟踪提供了超越单纯改进传播的互补路径。

Abstract: Recent trackers built on foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) achieve strong performance by propagating object masks through memory. However, this strength is also a key source of failure: under occlusion, reappearance, or distractors, an incorrect prediction can enter the tracking loop and be propagated over time, resulting in persistent identity drift. Existing approaches seek to prevent such failures through improved memory and temporal modeling, but once a failure occurs, the tracker has no explicit mechanism to recognize or correct it. We address this gap with Dual-Agent, a failure-aware tracking framework that complements propagation with explicit verification and recovery. We address this gap with Dual-Agent, a failure-aware tracking framework that complements propagation with explicit verification and recovery. A vision-language verification agent first reasons over spatio-temporal context to determine whether the tracker is still following the target. When a failure is detected, a correction agent uses temporal context to recover the target before tracking continues. The correction agent is trained on real SAM3 failures, augmented with targeted identity-switch and distractor perturbations that expose it to challenging ambiguities during recovery. On LVOS-v2 and SecVOS, Dual-Agent improves SAM3 by 1.2 and 2.7 $J\&F$, respectively. Importantly, the proposed framework transfers without retraining to SAM2.1, SeC, and Cutie, as well as to long-term video object tracking benchmarks including LaSOT-ext, TNL2K, and VOT-LT2022. Our results show that explicitly reasoning about when tracking fails and how to recover provides a complementary path to robust tracking beyond improving propagation alone. Project page: valaybundele.github.io/Dual-Agent.

</details>


### [147] [Meaningful Moments: A Corpus of VLM-Derived Temporal Importance Labels for Video Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16009)
*Cameron Keith,SouYoung Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Meaningful Moments (MM)语料库，含约458万条VLM生成的分段重要性分数，覆盖近50万个类标注视频（SSv2、K400、Diving-48，622个动作类别）。通过冻结分类器仅改变时间采样，验证VLM重要性标签能提升动作识别，且效果依赖类别结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频中并非每一帧对动作识别都同等重要，少数决定性时刻往往承载关键证据。然而现有视频数据集很少提供大规模、以动作为条件标注"哪些短片段携带证据"的数据。本文旨在探究VLM能否大规模识别有意义时刻，以及这些标签能否提升动作识别。

Method: 构建MM语料库，用VLM生成约458万条逐段重要性分数。方法上冻结动作分类器，仅改变时间采样，通过α参数化的"重要性主导选择"与"重要性反转对照"比较，分离VLM信号带来的增益与可变密度采样本身的增益。并进行直接打分与贪心移除的比较，以及四VLM跨oracle研究。

Result: 三个数据集上VLM重要性均有信息量。Diving-48上重要性主导快进可保持完整视频识别性能，反转对照坍塌约30个百分点；K400上硬切选择比均匀采样高1.45个百分点，阈值选择下达2.05；SSv2上标签有信号但无法恢复完整视频性能。直接打分在约25倍更少oracle调用下与贪心移除在噪声范围内持平，四VLM跨oracle趋势一致。

Conclusion: VLM可在大规模上识别有意义的动作时刻，其重要性标签能有效提升动作识别，且效果受类别结构影响。研究发布了重要性标签与评估协议（CC-BY-4.0），SSv2类字符串保持CC-BY-NC-4.0。

Abstract: Not every moment in a video is equally useful for recognizing an action. A few decisive moments often carry the evidence: the instant an object moves, the peak of a dive, or one object placed on another. Existing video datasets rarely provide large-scale, action-conditioned labels for which short segments carry that evidence. This work asks whether vision-language models can identify meaningful moments at scale and whether those labels improve action recognition.We introduce Meaningful Moments (MM), a corpus of about 4.58 million VLM-generated per-segment importance scores for nearly 500,000 class-labeled videos spanning Something-Something v2 (SSv2), Kinetics-400 (K400), and Diving-48 across 622 action classes. We freeze the action classifier and vary only temporal sampling. An alpha-parameterized comparison of importance-led selection against an importance-inverted control separates gains from the VLM signal from gains caused by variable-density sampling alone. Across all three datasets, VLM-derived importance is informative: at the hard-cut endpoint, keeping VLM-important segments outperforms keeping VLM-designated filler. Usefulness depends on class structure. On Diving-48, importance-led fast-forwarding preserves full-video recognition while the inverted control collapses by roughly 30 percentage points. On K400, hard-cut selection beats uniform sampling by 1.45 percentage points, rising to 2.05 under threshold selection. On SSv2, the labels carry signal but do not recover full-video performance. Direct scoring matches greedy removal within its noise floor at roughly 25 times fewer oracle calls, and a four-VLM cross-oracle study shows consistent downstream trends. We release the importance labels and evaluation protocol under CC-BY-4.0; SSv2 class strings remain under CC-BY-NC-4.0.

</details>


### [148] [Removing the Compute Bottleneck for Event-based Visual Place Recognition with Spiking Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16022)
*Somayeh Hussaini,Tobias Fischer,Michael Milford*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 训练两层SNN+STDP得到双峰稀疏权重，利用event稀疏性在CPU上实现数十微秒的事件VPR查询。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机天然稀疏、低延迟，但多数event-based VPR在下游重新引入稠密帧式计算，丧失了传感器的延迟优势。

Method: 用加性STDP训练两层SNN，使权重呈强双峰分布以便大幅幅值剪枝；推理时只读取查询活跃像素对应的剪枝权重，且存活权重幅值近似均匀，神经元得分简化为匹配突触的整数计数（非加权求和），计算量小到可驻留CPU片上缓存。

Result: 在三个event-based VPR基准上，稀疏SNN召回率超过LENS，查询延迟降低5.5-6.2倍至数十微秒；召回率与稠密变体及SAD基线相当，但读取权重少10倍；并刻画了召回率与延迟随活跃像素数和参考地点数的变化规律。

Conclusion: 事件输入的稀疏性与学习权重的稀疏性可共同被利用，在传统处理器上实现低延迟推理。

Abstract: Neuromorphic sensing and computing promise low latency and high energy efficiency for robotics, yet most event-based visual place recognition (VPR) pipelines reintroduce dense, frame-like computation downstream of an inherently sparse sensor, forfeiting the sensor's latency advantage. In this paper, we address the problem of resolving an event-based VPR query in tens of microseconds on a commodity CPU. We train a two-layer spiking neural network (SNN) with additive spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), which drives the learned weight matrix towards a strongly bimodal distribution, amenable to aggressive magnitude pruning. At inference, our pipeline exploits this sparsity by reading only the pruned weights corresponding to the query's active pixels. As surviving weights share a near-uniform magnitude, each neuron's score reduces to an integer count of matching synapses instead of a weighted sum, lowering per-query latency. This computation is small enough to remain resident in a CPU's fast on-chip cache. On three event-based VPR benchmarks, our sparse SNN exceeds the recall of LENS, an existing event-based SNN, while reducing per-query latency by 5.5-6.2x to tens of microseconds. It matches the recall of a dense variant of our network and of the sum-of-absolute-differences (SAD) baseline, while reading 10x fewer weights than the dense variant. We further characterise how recall and latency scale with the number of active pixels and reference places. These results suggest that the sparsity of both event-based input and learned weights can already be exploited for low-latency inference on conventional processors.

</details>


### [149] [From Failure Prediction to Component Selection in Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16058)
*Minhui Kang,Yiyao Zhang,Peizhe Long,Jiafeng Qi,Hongyu Jin,Jiayun Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以决策为中心的分割可靠性评估框架，区分"分数预测什么、从其输入场能学到什么、排序带来什么价值"，揭示适应后的MetaSeg优于预测熵但不及直接概率排序，且重用完整输入场可提升预测与保留性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义分割中组件失败预测器虽支持"信任/保留/检查"决策，但其预测性能并不能完整刻画选择结果的真实价值，缺少将预测性能与实际决策收益联系起来的评估视角。

Method: 构建决策中心评估框架，围绕三个问题展开：可用分数预测什么、从其既有输入场能学到什么、其排序带来什么效果。在Cityscapes与ACDC上对三种分割系统开展实验，包括适应MetaSeg与预测熵、直接概率排序的对比，图像嵌套源实验，以及将固定预测对映射到条件对数损失风险的选择分析。

Result: 90%保留率下，适应MetaSeg在全部12组架构-人群对比中均优于预测熵降低保留失败，但未显示出相对直接概率排序的失败优势。图像嵌套源实验表明，复用完整输入场在两种学习器、三种系统中均改善预测与保留损失；原始OCRNet探针提升预测但选择增益不明。固定预测对到条件对数损失风险的映射产生混合选择效应。

Conclusion: 该框架区分了拟合分数的性能、其输入可获得的价值及其使用后果，为决定是否采用新分数、重学既有输入场或修正选择规则提供实用依据，并可解释组件级可靠性方法的成败。

Abstract: Reliable scene understanding requires deciding which predictions to trust, retain, or inspect. In semantic segmentation, component failure predictors support these decisions, but their predictive performance does not fully describe the value of the resulting selection. We develop a decision-centered evaluation framework that connects three questions: what an available score predicts, what can be learned from its existing fields, and what its ranking delivers. Across three segmentation systems on Cityscapes and ACDC at 90% retention, adapted MetaSeg reduces retained failure relative to forecast entropy in all twelve architecture-population comparisons, but does not establish a failure advantage over direct probability ranking. Image-nested source experiments reveal a different opportunity: reusing the full field set improves predictive and retained-loss performance under both learners in all three systems, while the raw OCRNet probe improves prediction with unresolved selective gains. Mapping a fixed prediction pair to conditional log-loss risk produces mixed selection effects, which we examine through the components exchanged by the two rankings. These findings distinguish the performance of a fitted score from the value obtainable from its inputs and the consequences of its use. The framework provides a practical basis for deciding whether to adopt an additional score, relearn existing fields, or revise a selection rule, and for explaining the gains and failures of component-level reliability methods.

</details>


### [150] [PIGEONS: Incremental Long-Video Captioning with Persistent Identity Gallery and Evolving Overarching Narrative Summary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16066)
*Xinlong Chen,Weihong Lin,Yuanxing Zhang,Xinyu Liu,Yue Ding,Bozhou Li,Bohan Zeng,Yang Shi,Qiang Liu,Pengfei Wan,Liang Wang,Tieniu Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PIGEONS模型，通过持久身份画廊与演化式整体叙事摘要，解决长视频字幕生成中的主体引用不一致和叙事碎片化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频字幕方法主要针对短视频，扩展到长视频受限于模型上下文窗口。简单分段拼接会导致主体引用不一致和长程叙事碎片化。

Method: PIGEONS先扫描整段视频构建身份画廊，捕获关键主体及其视觉参考作为稳定锚点；随后在持久画廊和逐步更新的整体叙事摘要条件下进行逐片段字幕生成；并采用结合监督微调与强化学习的三阶段训练策略。

Result: 实验表明PIGEONS显著提升长视频字幕性能，在准确性、完整性和主体引用一致性上优于现有方法，同时在短视频字幕上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: PIGEONS通过身份画廊与演化叙事摘要有效缓解长视频字幕的主体一致性与长程叙事问题，兼具长视频与短视频良好表现。

Abstract: Detailed video captioning has become an essential semantic interface for multi-modal understanding and generation. While existing methods mainly target short videos, extending them to long videos remains challenging, primarily due to limited context windows of current video understanding models. A naive solution is to adopt segment-wise captioning followed by concatenation, yet this paradigm often suffers from inconsistent subject references and fragmented long-range narratives. To mitigate these issues, we introduce PIGEONS, an incremental long-video captioning model built upon a Persistent Identity Gallery and an Evolving Overarching Narrative Summary. Before caption generation, PIGEONS scans the entire video to construct an identity gallery that captures key subjects along with their visual references, thereby providing a stable referential anchor. The model then performs clip-by-clip captioning conditioned on the persistent gallery and an evolving overarching narrative summary, which compactly maintains and updates essential long-range contextual information after each captioning step. To enable these capabilities, we develop a three-stage training strategy that integrates supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PIGEONS markedly improves long-video captioning performance, achieving superior accuracy, completeness, and subject referential consistency over existing methods, while maintaining competitive performance on short-video captioning.

</details>


### [151] [Regime-Aware Router Learning for Multi-Domain Medical Image Generation with Diffusion Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16082)
*Yaoshuai Ma,Wei Yao,Yongxiang Liu,Feifan Wang,Da Chang,Pengxiang Xu,Shixun Zhang,Yonghong Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究多域扩散模型中固定专家池的路由学习策略，比较Server-Only与Anchor-Delta(AD)两种方法，发现用去噪损失证据蒸馏的AD路由器在异构四域医学图像生成上优于仅依赖服务器图像的Server-Only。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构医学图像数据催生了领域专用扩散专家，但专家如何专精并不能决定采样时如何组合其预测。服务器仅有有限且可能不具代表性的图像，使学习全局路由器尤为困难。因此需要研究在固定专家池下如何有效学习路由。

Method: 研究两种路由器学习策略：Server-Only从服务器图像及组件标签学习输入与时间步相关的专家分配；Anchor-Delta(AD)使用相同图像和冻结专家，从去噪损失中获取额外证据，蒸馏融合该证据与当前路由器分配的目标，并用代理门控控制后续精炼步骤。组件标签描述数据来源，专家损失衡量经验预测性能。

Result: 在异构四域设置中，AD训练的路由器相比Server-Only提升了生成指标；单独服务器数据研究显示，在留出路由上优于修正路由对比方法；额外配对评估表明推理时证据混合的效果因基准而异。

Conclusion: 服务器数据可用性与专家预测性能是学习多域扩散模型路由器时两个相互独立的考量因素。

Abstract: Heterogeneous medical image data motivate domain-specialized diffusion experts, but expert specialization alone does not determine how their predictions should be combined during sampling. Learning a global router is particularly challenging when the server has limited, potentially unrepresentative images. We study two router-learning strategies for a fixed expert pool. Server-Only learns input- and timestep-dependent expert assignments from server images with component labels. Anchor-Delta (AD) uses the same images and frozen experts to obtain additional evidence from denoising losses. It distills targets that combine this evidence with the current router's assignments, while a proxy gate controls a subsequent refinement step. Component labels describe data origin; expert losses measure empirical prediction performance. We evaluate these distinct signals through routing analyses and paired medical image generation. An AD-trained router improves generation metrics over Server-Only in a heterogeneous four-domain setting, and a separate server-data study shows gains in held-out routing over a corrected-routing comparator. Additional paired evaluations show that the effect of inference-time evidence mixing varies across benchmarks. These findings establish server-data availability and expert performance as distinct considerations in learning routers for multi-domain diffusion models.

</details>


### [152] [Geometry-Guided Semantic Reconstruction for 3D Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16122)
*Yuanhao Su,Shaofeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文将2D到3D的语义迁移建模为掩码语义重建任务，并提出几何调制的语义注入，实现3D实例分割的SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯3D编码器几何结构强但外观语义弱；直接拼接2D先验虽注入语义，却无法保证与3D结构良好对齐。

Method: 将2D-to-3D语义迁移作为掩码语义重建：遮盖部分背景2D先验，训练3D编码器恢复缺失语义；并提出几何调制语义注入，用原始3D几何在稀疏编码前调制2D先验。

Result: 在两个基线框架上，于ScanNetV2和ScanNet200的全数据与少样本设置下均取得SOTA。

Conclusion: 掩码语义重建与几何调制注入能有效融合2D语义与3D几何，缓解分布差异。

Abstract: 3D instance segmentation requires representations that are both geometrically structured and semantically discriminative. Pure 3D encoders model spatial structure well but often lack strong appearance semantics, while directly lifting 2D priors into 3D by concatenation injects rich semantics without ensuring that they align well with the underlying 3D structure. In this paper, we address this problem by formulating 2D-to-3D semantic transfer as a \textbf{masked semantic reconstruction} task. Specifically, we mask a subset of background lifted 2D priors and train the 3D encoder to recover the missing semantic priors, providing explicit supervision for distilling rich 2D semantics into the 3D backbone. We further propose \textbf{geometry-modulated semantic injection}, which uses raw 3D geometry to modulate lifted 2D priors before sparse encoding, so that geometry explicitly controls semantic injection and alleviates the distribution gap between 2D semantic features and 3D geometric features. Experiments on two baseline frameworks demonstrate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art results in both full-data and few-shot settings on ScanNetV2 and ScanNet200. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/yharoldsu0627/Geometry_Guided_Semantic_Reconstruction

</details>


### [153] [A Concept-informed Interpretable Artificial Intelligence Framework for Breast Ultrasound Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16128)
*Shengzhou Zhong,Ziying Wang,Liang Li,Lihua Yan,Shuochun Chen,Yudie Zou,Jifan Zhang,Wenhao Li,Huiling Zhang,Jiayin Lu,Ziting Xu,Qianjin Feng,Zhenwei Shi,Yan Chen,Yingjia Li,Yu Zhang,Zhenyuan Ning*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出IBUS，一个整合BI-RADS描述符的乳腺超声AI系统，基于20个独立数据集、9941名患者构建，在多中心测试中展现泛化能力与临床决策支持价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有乳腺超声AI主要依赖图像预测，缺乏BI-RADS知识与放射科医生中间评估流程的融入，导致可解释性差、与临床实践契合度低。

Method: 构建迄今最大规模多中心乳腺超声数据集（9941名患者、20个独立数据集），配对结构化BI-RADS描述符；开发IBUS系统，融合BI-RADS描述符进行风险分层，并通过预测BI-RADS等级与恶性概率的交叉校验识别内部不一致预测。

Result: 在14个测试数据集上，IBUS在不同临床中心与成像条件下保持一致的泛化性能；BI-RADS描述符实现细粒度风险分层；交叉校验能发现需额外临床复核的内部不一致预测。八名放射科医生的阅读者研究显示，IBUS辅助提升了初级与高级读者的诊断敏感性。

Conclusion: IBUS可作为第二阶段决策支持系统，通过提供额外风险估计与可解释证据辅助放射科医生处理诊断困难病例。

Abstract: Most existing artificial intelligence systems for breast ultrasound rely primarily on image-driven prediction, with limited incorporation of the knowledge from the Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System (BI-RADS) and the intermediate assessment processes underlying radiologists' workflow, thereby constraining their interpretability and alignment with clinical practice. We curated, to our knowledge, the largest multicenter collection of breast ultrasound images paired with structured BI-RADS descriptors, comprising 9,941 patients across 20 independent datasets. Across 14 testing datasets, IBUS demonstrated consistent generalization performance across different clinical centers and imaging conditions. Incorporating BI-RADS descriptors enabled fine-grained risk stratification, while cross-checking predicted BI-RADS grades against malignancy probabilities identified internally discordant predictions that may warrant additional clinical review. In a reader study involving eight radiologists, IBUS assistance increased diagnostic sensitivity among both junior and senior readers, with the potential of guiding radiologists to make targeted revision in risk stratification. Overall, IBUS exhibits its potential as a second-stage decision-support system that complements radiologists by providing additional risk estimates and interpretable evidence for diagnostically challenging cases. The demo video of IBUS platform is publicly available at https://github.com/zsz1997/IBUS.

</details>


### [154] [ProMoDD: Dataset Distillation for 3D Human Motion via Prototype-Conditioned Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16134)
*Yijin Wei,Yawen Zou,Wenqi Cai,Guang Li,Hangli Ge,Katsuya Hotta,Chunzhi Gu,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ProMoDD，利用类原型条件化的动作扩散模型生成合成序列，并结合特征空间混合选择构建紧凑训练集，用于骨架动作识别的数据集蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 骨架动作识别的数据集蒸馏需要保留判别性动作变化，同时不破坏关节体的几何与时间连续性；直接优化关节坐标会违反这些约束，而单纯生成合理动作也不保证是有用的训练样本。

Method: 以类级原型（来自时间分辨的识别特征）条件化动作扩散模型，并针对动作数据定制扩散训练以建模骨骼构型及其时间演化；随后通过预算感知的混合选择构建紧凑集：代表性真实序列覆盖识别空间的密集区域，生成的候选样本在稀疏区域补充，在固定每类序列预算下平衡真实动作的可靠性与合成动作的多样性。

Result: 在 NTU RGB+D 60 单人类别按难度分层的五个子集上，ProMoDD 在紧张蒸馏预算下增益最大：Full49 上每类三条序列达到 40.32% top-1 准确率，比 class-wise k-means 高 4.57 个百分点。同一蒸馏集无需重新生成即可训练 ST-GCN、MS-G3D 和 CTR-GCN。

Conclusion: 将原型引导的生成与特征空间选择相结合，可有效提升骨架动作识别的数据集蒸馏效果，尤其在严格预算下，且蒸馏集具有跨模型通用性。

Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to retain the training utility of a large dataset in a much smaller set of examples. For skeleton-based action recognition, this requires capturing discriminative motion variation without disrupting the geometry and temporal continuity of articulated bodies. Directly optimizing joint coordinates can violate these constraints, while plausible motion generation alone does not ensure useful training examples. We propose Prototype-Conditioned Motion Dataset Distillation (ProMoDD), which conditions a motion diffusion model on class-wise prototypes of temporally resolved recognition features. We further tailor diffusion training to motion data, enabling the generator to model both skeletal configurations and their temporal evolution. We then construct each compact training set through budget-aware hybrid selection: representative real sequences cover densely populated regions of the pooled recognition space, while selected generated candidates complement them in less-populated regions. This couples prototype-guided generation with feature-space selection, balancing the reliability of observed motions with the variation of synthesis under a fixed per-class sequence budget. Across five difficulty-stratified subsets of the single-person classes in NTU RGB+D 60, ProMoDD achieves its largest gains under tight distillation budgets, reaching 40.32% top-1 accuracy on Full49 with three sequences per class, 4.57 percentage points above class-wise k-means. These gains reflect the complete framework. The same distilled sets train ST-GCN, MS-G3D, and CTR-GCN without regeneration.

</details>


### [155] [All-St3R SLAM: Real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM with Pixel-wise Motion Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16143)
*Yewon Kim,Paul Hongsuck Seo,Sang Chul Ahn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种仅依赖RGB输入的实时动态SLAM框架，利用DUSt3R自运动预测与All-Tracker点跟踪的差异，在像素级精准剔除运动物体，实现约10 FPS，显著优于现有密集动态SLAM（0.5-3 FPS）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态环境SLAM方法存在两大问题：过度剔除（如对象级掩码会把暂时静止部分也一并移除）和计算成本高（密集动态SLAM仅0.5-3 FPS），难以实际应用。

Method: 结合DUSt3R基于自运动预测的像素运动与All-Tracker的点跟踪，通过分析两种运动来源的差异，在像素级识别并仅剔除真正运动的像素；不依赖预定义标签或分割模型，仅用RGB输入，并通过每3帧采样实现实时性。

Result: 在标准30 FPS视频流上以约10 FPS运行达到实时性能；相比现有最优密集动态SLAM（0.5-3 FPS）有显著速度提升，且仅依赖RGB输入。

Conclusion: 该方法通过像素级运动剔除和帧采样策略，在保证精度的同时大幅提升动态SLAM的实时性与实用性，为实际部署提供了高效方案。

Abstract: SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) is a core technology in autonomous systems that enables them to estimate their own position and build a map of unknown environments simultaneously. SLAM systems in dynamic environments are of great practical importance. However, existing dynamic SLAM approaches still have several limitations like over-removal and high computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose a real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM framework that precisely removes moving objects at the pixel level without relying on predefined labels or segmentation models. Our system combines pixel motion predicted by ego-motion using DUSt3R with point tracking from All-Tracker, removing only actually moving pixels by analyzing discrepancies between the two motion sources. Unlike object-level masking methods, our approach eliminates only currently moving regions, allowing temporarily static parts to be utilized for tracking. Operating at approximately 10 FPS, the system achieves real-time performance on standard 30 FPS video streams by subsampling every 3 frames. Relying solely on RGB inputs, this significantly improves upon state-of-the-art dense dynamic SLAM approaches (0.5-3 FPS), presenting a highly practical solution.

</details>


### [156] [Unravel: Recovering an Interactive 3D Scene from a Single Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16146)
*Hui Shan,Keyang Luo,Binjia Zhou,Ming Li,Kai Li,Xin Wang,Zhenyang Li,Zesong Yang,Weikai Chen,Runze Zhang,Xin Wang,Yanwei Fu,Zhen Chen,Xiangru Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Unravel是一个免训练框架，将单张图像转化为可交互的3D场景，其中每个物体都是独立可移动的资产。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成器要么生成无法移动物体的纠缠几何，要么一次性预测所有物体而无法检测或修复错误猜测。

Method: 先分解场景再重组：用智能代理框架逐层剥离图像，以点云为主要模态恢复空间关系；视觉语言模型规划完全可见物体，图像编辑器移除并修复遮挡区域，每次编辑经核验；再按逆序重建，使支撑物体先于被支撑物体放置；将观测点作为物体尺寸下界；最后物理沉降消除悬浮与穿模，并通过代理审计修正残余错误。

Result: 在多样化室内场景上的大量实验表明，Unravel比现有方法恢复更多物体、放置更忠实，且生成的场景物理上更合理。

Conclusion: Unravel通过分解-重组策略有效实现单图像到可交互3D场景的生成。

Abstract: We present Unravel, a training-free framework that turns a single image into an interactive 3D scene, where every object is an independent and movable asset. Existing generators either produce one entangled geometry in which no object can be moved, or predict all objects in one feed-forward pass, where a wrong guess cannot be detected or repaired. Unravel instead takes a different approach: it first takes the scene apart, and then puts it back together. Starting from the input image, an agentic harness that iteratively peels the image layer by layer, and adopts point cloud as major modality for spatial relationship recovery. Specifically, a vision-language model plans which objects are fully visible, an image editor removes them and restores the occluded regions. Every edit is verified before being incorporated into the reconstruction. This process gradually turns occluded parts of the scene into direct observation, allowing objects to be reconstructed when they are best exposed rather than hallucinated from the original image alone. The scene is then rebuilt in reverse removal order, so that the supporting objects are naturally placed before the objects they support. Since a single-view image only reveals part of an object, we treat the observed points as a lower bound on its size: an asset may grow to cover its points, but can not shrink away from them. Finally, we physically settle the reconstructed scene to remove floating objects and interpenetrations, followed by an agentic audit that corrects remaining placement errors. Extensive experiments on diverse indoor scenes show that Unravel recovers more objects, places them more faithfully, and produces scenes that are more physically-plausible than existing methods.

</details>


### [157] [Esports World Model Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16166)
*Weiyu Ma,Zeyuan Gong,Xuhui Liu,Wenxuan Zhang,Jian Ding,Xinyu Cui,Jian Zhao,Mohamed Elhoseiny*

Main category: cs.CV
