TL;DR: 论文提出Esports World Model Dataset (EWM)，涵盖星际争霸II、Dota 2、CS2三款竞技游戏，共3053场比赛、约4880玩家视角小时，通过回放时钟对齐将渲染视频与游戏原生动作、结构化状态与事件连接起来，支持多玩家交互世界模型研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型需刻画多参与者如何共同改变共享环境、同时各自只能观测部分信息。竞技游戏是这一挑战的具体体现：玩家合作与竞争，而战争迷雾、团队视野、镜头位置决定了各自能看到什么。建模这些交互需要能连接个体观测与动作、共享状态与事件的数据，但此类数据稀缺。

Method: 构建EWM数据集，覆盖StarCraft II、Dota 2、CS2，包含3053场比赛与地图、约4880玩家视角小时。数据规模：4628个完整星际争霸II视角、303场Dota 2比赛的全部十视角、CS2每回合最多十视角。以回放时钟对齐，将渲染视频与游戏原生动作、结构化状态及事件对齐。三款游戏提供互补观测条件：私有战争迷雾、共享团队视野、第一人称视角。星际争霸II中玩家特定的实体记录进一步区分实时观测与记忆快照，并跨对立视角关联共同观测实体。

Result: 通过时间对齐与玩家特定信息记录，研究者可区分合理的信息差异与对共享状态的分歧；数据集提供多视角、跨游戏、动作-状态-事件对齐的多玩家游戏数据。

Conclusion: EWM将人类决策、共享动力学与玩家特定信息相连接，支持面向联合控制的多玩家世界模型研究，以及由人类对局中学得的队友与对手所构成的交互环境研究。

Abstract: Interactive world models must capture how multiple participants jointly change a shared environment while observing different parts of it. Competitive games make this challenge concrete: players cooperate and compete, while fog of war, team vision and camera placement determine what each can see. Modeling these interactions requires data that connect individual observations and actions to shared state and events. We introduce the Esports World Model Dataset (EWM), a collection of human gameplay spanning StarCraft II, Dota 2 and Counter-Strike 2, with 3,053 games and maps and approximately 4,880 player-view hours, including estimated hours for the ongoing CS2 extension. It includes 4,628 completed StarCraft II views, all ten perspectives for 303 Dota 2 matches, and up to ten views per round in CS2. Across these views, replay-clock alignment connects rendered video with game-native actions, structured state and events from the same match. The three games expose complementary observation conditions: private fog of war, shared team vision and first-person viewpoints. In StarCraft II, player-specific entity records further distinguish live observations from remembered snapshots and link co-observed entities across opposing views. Together with temporal alignment, these records allow researchers to distinguish legitimate information differences from disagreement about shared state. By connecting human decisions, shared dynamics and player-specific information, EWM supports research toward jointly controlled multiplayer world models and interactive environments populated by teammates and opponents learned from human play.

</details>


### [158] [Geometric Parrots: Rule Absence vs. Rule Fragility in Spatial and Physical Reasoning for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16170)
*Bilal Jawaid,Hamza Hanif,Muhammad Maaz Uddin,Anas Zafar,Inad Alqurashi,Aizan Zafar,Osama Farooqui,Sheheryar Khan,Ferhat Sadak,Shaina Raza,Rizwan Qureshi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GRIP基准和双环评估，区分VLM的规则缺失与规则脆弱两种失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM虽能答对几何物理问题，但在交互中面对自信但错误的用户断言时会放弃正确答案。单轮准确率无法区分这种"投降"与有益的纠正。

Method: 构建GRIP受控基准：34个程序化生成的推理域、10万张图像、60万道题，覆盖几何/空间/视觉/物理推理；场景由确定性代码生成，答案直接由场景状态推导，得到精确真值。提出双环评估：闭环用五步组合问题阶梯定位推理失败点；开环在受控挑战（同伴模型响应、无依据的用户断言）下重新诱导答案。

Result: 由于真值精确已知，答案变化可标记为纠正（错→对）或投降（对→错），从而分离规则缺失与规则脆弱两种失效模式。

Conclusion: GRIP提供了可控制、无需人工标注的评测框架，揭示VLM推理的规则脆弱性问题。数据集与详情已公开。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer many geometric and physical reasoning questions correctly, yet still behave inconsistently in interaction, for example, abandoning a correct answer when confronted with a confident but incorrect user assertion. Standard single-turn accuracy cannot distinguish such capitulations from beneficial corrections because it scores each response in isolation. We introduce GRIP, a controlled benchmark with 34 procedurally generated reasoning domains, 100,000 images, and 600,000 questions spanning geometric, spatial, visual, and physical reasoning. Each scene is generated by deterministic code, and every answer is derived directly from the underlying scene state, providing exact ground truth without human annotation. On GRIP, we propose Dual-Loop Evaluation. A closed loop probes each image with a five-step compositional question ladder to localize where reasoning fails. An open loop then re-elicits the model's answer under controlled challenges, including peer-model responses and unsupported user assertions. Because ground truth is known exactly, answer changes can be signed as corrections (wrong-to-right) or capitulations (right-to-wrong), separating two failure modes: rule absence and rule fragility. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/bilaljawaid980/GRIP-Benchmark, with further details at https://bilaljawaid980.github.io/grip-benchmark/.

</details>


### [159] [EgoAlign: Situated 3D Understanding without Situation Descriptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16176)
*Yiyang Li,Tianyi Ma,Zehong Wang,Yanfang Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoAlign通过以agent为中心的坐标框架和自中心对齐阶段，直接利用数值位姿建立空间上下文，无需文本情境描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Situated 3D QA方法依赖自然语言情境描述来传递agent位姿，但实际部署中该描述可能不可用或获取成本高；虽引入数值位姿，但随机打乱位姿对性能影响很小，说明模型对数值位姿依赖有限。

Method: 提出EgoAlign，一个简单的3D语言模型：以agent为中心坐标框架表示场景，并设计自中心对齐阶段，包含四个互补任务——物体类别识别、自中心方向预测、度量距离估计和空间关系预测，在任务微调前先教会模型相对agent位姿一致地理解场景几何。

Result: 在SQA3D、Real-3DQA和MSQA上取得对比方法中最强性能且高效；移除文本情境描述后性能相当或更好，而打乱数值位姿则导致显著性能下降。

Conclusion: EgoAlign能直接从数值位姿建立以agent为中心的空间上下文，无需文本情境描述。

Abstract: Situated 3D Question Answering requires models to interpret a 3D scene relative to an agent's pose. Existing methods commonly convey that pose through a natural-language situation description, which may be unavailable or costly to obtain in real-world deployments. While some methods additionally incorporate numerical pose, we find that randomly shuffling the agent pose causes little performance degradation, indicating limited functional dependence on the numerical pose. To address this gap, we introduce EgoAlign, a simple 3D language model that represents a scene in an agent-centric coordinate frame, together with a dedicated egocentric alignment stage comprising four complementary tasks: object category recognition, egocentric direction prediction, metric distance estimation, and spatial relation prediction. This stage teaches the model to consistently interpret scene geometry relative to the agent's pose before task-specific fine-tuning. EgoAlign achieves the strongest performance on SQA3D, Real-3DQA, and MSQA among compared methods while remaining highly efficient. More importantly, removing textual situation descriptions yields comparable or better downstream performance, whereas shuffling EgoAlign's numerical pose causes substantial degradation. These results show that EgoAlign establishes agent-centric spatial context directly from numerical pose without requiring textual situation descriptions.

</details>


### [160] [DIGS: Distribution-Informed Gaussian Splatting for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16177)
*Zhifan Zeng,Wenbo Xiao,Arcot Sowmya,Changming Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DIGS是一个免训练的开放词汇3D高斯分割框架，通过类别无关建图与多模态编码两阶段解耦实例发现与语言命名，实现高效且高精度的3D分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇3D高斯分割通常将语义特征绑定到每个高斯原语，依赖逐场景梯度训练(1-4小时)或闭式蒸馏，均迫使每个原语对应单一特征；跨越多个2D实例的边界高斯被迫硬决策，导致检索精度下降和渲染时掩码边界不稳定。

Method: 提出DIGS，免训练两阶段框架：(1)类别无关建图与多模态编码解耦实例发现与语言命名；高斯级采用分布感知表示，为每个原语维护显式top-M标签分布，通过退火Dirichlet规则更新，保留边界原语的多峰分布供late-argmax渲染器恢复清晰边界；双向状态机将分布聚合为持久类别无关实例本体。(2)实例级编码融合实例隔离3D足迹的CLIP视觉嵌入与LLM生成属性描述的CLIP文本嵌入，区分视觉相似实例。

Result: 单张A100上，LERF-OVS每场景建图与实例编码耗时1.0-3.2分钟(取决于是否启用LLM融合)，原生3D查询5.4ms。LERF-OVS上mIoU达71.95%，优于免训练SFS和训练型LaGa。在LERF-Mask和3D-OVS取得最高平均mIoU，在Replica上超过Gaga和ObjectGS。

Conclusion: DIGS通过解耦实例发现与语言命名并保留边界多峰分布，实现了高效、免训练且边界清晰的开放词汇3D高斯分割，在多个基准上达到领先性能。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D Gaussian segmentation typically binds semantic features to the per-Gaussian state via per-scene gradient training (1-4 h) or the more recent closed-form distillation. Both commit each primitive to a single feature; therefore, boundary Gaussians spanning multiple 2D instances are forced into a hard decision that degrades retrieval accuracy and yields unstable mask boundaries at render time. We present DIGS, a training-free framework with two stages, class-agnostic mapping and multi-modal encoding, that decouples instance discovery from linguistic naming. At the Gaussian level, our distribution-informed representation maintains an explicit top-$M$ label distribution per primitive, updated by a tempered Dirichlet rule; preservation of multi-peaked label distributions at boundary primitives allows a late-argmax renderer to recover clean instance boundaries. A bidirectional state machine aggregates these distributions into a persistent class-agnostic instance ontology. The instance-level encoding stage then fuses the CLIP visual embedding of each instance's isolated 3D footprint with the CLIP-text embedding of an LLM-generated attribute description, disambiguating visually similar instances. On a single A100, DIGS completes mapping and instance encoding on LERF-OVS in 1.0-3.2 min per scene, depending on whether LLM fusion is enabled, and serves native 3D queries in 5.4 ms. It reaches 71.95% mean mIoU on LERF-OVS, outperforming both the training-free SFS and training-based LaGa baselines. DIGS also achieves the highest mean mIoU on LERF-Mask and 3D-OVS and surpasses Gaga and ObjectGS on Replica under their respective evaluation protocols. Code is available at https://github.com/ZephyrZos/DIGS.

</details>


### [161] [VGGA: Geometry-Grounded Autoencoder for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16204)
*Chaofan Gan,Yian Zhao,Shijie Li,Tieyuan Chen,Zicheng Zhao,Mehrtash Harandi,Weiyao Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VGGA，一种几何感知视频自编码器，通过深度、运动对应与投影变形三种几何约束学习结构化隐空间，显著提升视频生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频自编码器仅优化像素级重建，对学习结构化隐表示监督不足。论文认为视频应被视为动态3D世界的2D投影，具有明确几何属性。

Method: VGGA在重建过程中显式引入几何约束，沿三个互补维度grounding表示：结构深度、运动对应、投影变形。这些目标统一于一个视频几何解码器中，该解码器用共享时空上采样主干联合优化几何学习与RGB重建。

Result: 在几何中心和人体运动领域均持续提升视频生成，RealEstate10K上gFVD降低28.1%，Taichi-HD上降低37.7%，同时保持相当的重建质量。

Conclusion: 几何grounded的表示学习能产生更有效的隐空间，为视频生成带来显著提升。

Abstract: Autoencoders are the core component of latent video generative models, compressing high-dimensional videos into compact latent spaces for downstream generation. However, existing video autoencoders are primarily optimized for pixel-level reconstruction, providing limited supervision for learning structured latent representations. We argue that videos should not be treated merely as signals to be reconstructed, but rather as 2D projections of dynamic 3D worlds that exhibit explicit and well-structured geometric properties. Building on this insight, we propose \textbf{V}ideo \textbf{G}eometry \textbf{G}rounded \textbf{A}utoencoder (\textbf{VGGA}), a geometry-aware video autoencoder that explicitly incorporates geometric constraints into the reconstruction process. Specifically, VGGA grounds the learned representations along three complementary geometric dimensions: \emph{Structural Depth}, \emph{Motion Correspondence}, and \emph{Projective Warping}. These objectives are unified within a Video Geometry Decoder, which employs a shared spatio-temporal upsampling trunk to jointly optimize geometric learning and RGB reconstruction. Through these geometry-grounded objectives, VGGA encourages the latent representations to capture the underlying 3D structure and motion of dynamic scenes. VGGA consistently improves video generation across both geometry-centric and human-motion domains, reducing gFVD by 28.1\% on RealEstate10K and 37.7\% on Taichi-HD. Notably, these substantial generation improvements are achieved while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality, demonstrating that geometry-grounded representation learning yields a more effective latent space for video generation.

</details>


### [162] [MP-MNCA: Morphology-Prior Masked Neighbor Cross-Attention for Efficient Spatial Domain Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16212)
*Sidharthan Sivacoumar Chitra,Sanjeev Manivannan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MP-MNCA是一种形态先验掩码邻居交叉注意力框架，保留3000维高变基因表征并在空间邻居间路由分子信息，以组织学相似度作为注意力先验，在DLPFC数据集上实现更快收敛且不损失聚类质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间转录组学方法通常只在训练后期检查点比较，掩盖了收敛效率的差异。作者希望同时评估收敛轨迹与聚类质量，揭示不同方法在收敛速度上的差别。

Method: 提出MP-MNCA：形态先验掩码邻居交叉注意力框架，保留完整的3000维高变基因表征，选择性在空间邻居间路由分子信息，并将组织学相似度作为连续注意力先验，采用自监督掩码邻居对比目标训练。在12个DLPFC切片上与现有空间域基线比较，使用收敛轨迹和逐epoch空间域可视化进行评估。

Result: MP-MNCA用显著更少训练epoch即达到连贯空间域结构（收敛曲线定量体现、渐进空间网格定性体现）；平均峰值refined ARI为0.546（最强基线STAIG为0.549），平均refined NMI最高为0.657（STAIG为0.640）。在12个切片中，ARI有7个、NMI有11个优于STAIG。

Conclusion: MP-MNCA在保持空间域质量的同时实现更快收敛，在收敛效率与聚类质量之间取得更好平衡，证明评估收敛轨迹的重要性。

Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics jointly captures molecular state, tissue morphology, and spatial organization, yet spatial-domain methods are typically compared only at late training checkpoints, obscuring differences in convergence efficiency. We introduce MP-MNCA, a morphology-prior masked neighbor cross-attention framework that preserves the full 3,000 dimensional highly-variable-gene representation while selectively routing molecular information across spatial neighbors, with histological similarity incorporated as a continuous attention prior under a self-supervised masked neighbor-contrastive objective. Across 12 heterogeneous human dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) sections, MP-MNCA is evaluated against established spatial-domain baselines using both convergence trajectories and epoch-wise spatial-domain visualizations. Our results show that MP-MNCA (i) reaches coherent spatial-domain structure in substantially fewer training epochs, as reflected quantitatively by convergence curves and qualitatively by progressive spatial grids, and (ii) maintains strong clustering quality, achieving a mean peak refined ARI of 0.546 versus 0.549 for the strongest baseline (STAIG), while attaining the highest mean refined NMI of 0.657 versus 0.640. Moreover, MP-MNCA outperforms STAIG on 7 of 12 sections in ARI and 11 of 12 in NMI, demonstrating faster convergence without sacrificing spatial-domain quality.

</details>


### [163] [Look Back to Move Forward: Learning to Revisit for Agentic Compositional Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16224)
*Zixu Wang,Xiaoran Zhao,Yahui Liu,Feng-ao Wang,Junhao Xiao,You Shu,Bing Liu,Yiting Liu,Songlei Jian,Zhiliang Tian,Dongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GenRevisit智能体框架，通过联合选择"续接状态"和"动作"进行迭代式文本到图像生成，并设计NACA奖励分配方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有迭代式智能体方法将续接状态固定为最新图像，而迭代编辑并非单调，可能在图像已退化时仍继续精修，导致性能受限。

Method: 将动作选择扩展为"续接状态+动作"联合选择，使智能体可基于交互历史选择待编辑的图像候选；采用SFT加智能体强化学习训练，并提出归一化动作信用分配（NACA），将正优势按各动作对降低剩余目标的贡献重新分配。

Result: 在GenEval2上，使用Qwen-Image-2512和Z-Image-Turbo分别达到GM 84.3和74.4，超过同生成器最强基线12.7和10.9分；在GenEval、GenEval++和GenEval2上达到SOTA。

Conclusion: 联合决定"从何处续接"与"如何精修"能有效提升复杂组合生成能力，NACA缓解了GRPO的粗粒度信用分配问题。

Abstract: Text-to-image models have made remarkable progress in visual fidelity and instruction following, yet complex compositional generation remains challenging. Existing agentic approaches address this limitation through iterative generation and editing, adapting their actions based on interaction history. However, they typically fix the continuation state (i.e., the image from which refinement proceeds) to the latest image. Since iterative editing is not necessarily monotonic, the agent may continue refining from the latest image even when it has already degraded. In this work, we introduce GenRevisit, an agentic framework that extends action selection to joint continuation-state and action selection. The agent can not only use interaction history to adjust editing instructions but also select an image candidate to edit, jointly deciding where to continue from and how to refine. We train GenRevisit with SFT followed by agentic reinforcement learning. To address the coarse credit assignment of final outcome reward in GRPO, which assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, we further propose Normalized Action Credit Assignment (NACA) to redistribute positive advantage according to each action's contribution to reducing the remaining objective. On GenEval2, GenRevisit achieves GM scores of 84.3 and 74.4 with Qwen-Image-2512 and Z-Image-Turbo, surpassing the strongest baselines using the same generators by 12.7 and 10.9 points respectively. GenRevisit achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval, GenEval++, and GenEval2 among baselines.

</details>


### [164] [Seg2Click: Learning Pixel-Level Action Masks for GUI Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16234)
*Jingchao Wang,Dingjiang Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Seg2Click，将GUI视觉定位重构为可执行区域预测：用边界框监督预测可点击区域掩码，再通过确定规则计算点击点，超越坐标生成与patch打分方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI视觉定位需将指令映射到密集截图中的目标。单点监督的坐标生成把空间上延展的目标压缩为一个点，忽略多个有效点击位置；基于区域patch打分虽缓解歧义，但空间决策受限于可能跨越目标、邻近控件和背景的视觉token足迹。

Method: Seg2Click将GUI定位重新表述为可执行区域预测，即识别指令可有效执行的点击位置。使用边界框监督预测可执行区域掩码，并通过确定性规则计算最终点击点。该表述捕捉有效点击位置的空间范围，实现超越视觉token网格的精细定位，适用于小而密集的控件，且无需验证器或放大流程。

Result: 在两个模型系列的五个骨干配置上验证有效。Seg2Click-9B在ScreenSpot、ScreenSpot-v2、ScreenSpot-Pro上分别达92.06%、94.10%、55.22%；同骨干对比显示优于坐标生成与基于patch的定位方法。

Conclusion: Seg2Click通过可执行区域预测与确定性点击规则，有效解决单点监督和patch打分局限，在多个基准上取得领先性能。代码将于GitHub开源。

Abstract: Visual grounding is a central challenge for GUI agents, requiring an instruction to be mapped to a target within a crowded screenshot. Coordinate generation with single-point supervision reduces a spatially extended target to one position, despite the presence of many valid click locations. Region-based patch scoring alleviates this ambiguity, but its spatial decisions remain tied to visual-token footprints that may span the target, neighboring controls, and background. To address these limitations, we propose Seg2Click, which reformulates GUI grounding as executable-region prediction: identifying where a click can validly execute the given instruction. Using bounding-box supervision, Seg2Click predicts an executable-region mask and computes the final click point through a deterministic rule. This formulation captures the spatial extent of valid click locations and enables finer localization beyond the visual-token grid, making it well suited to small, densely arranged controls without requiring a verifier or zoom-in pass. Experiments across five backbone configurations from two model families demonstrate the effectiveness of Seg2Click. Seg2Click-9B achieves 92.06\%, 94.10\%, and 55.22\% on ScreenSpot, ScreenSpot-v2, and ScreenSpot-Pro, respectively, while matched-backbone comparisons show improvements over both coordinate generation and patch-based grounding. Code will be available at https://github.com/jcwang0602/Seg2Click.

</details>


### [165] [MFlowHOI: Whole-Body Human-Object Interaction Generation via Part-Aware MeanFlow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16252)
*Qiang He,Yonghao Zhang,Yinda Zhang,Chenyu Meng,Liufei Ouyang,Haoxiang Hu,Cangjun Gao,Xiaoming Deng,Cuixia Ma,Hongan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MFlowHOI提出一步式全身人-物交互生成框架，通过Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE构建结构化潜空间，配合ST-DiT单次MeanFlow评估生成完整交互，并支持迁移到不同体型3D高斯化身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全身人-物交互生成需协调身体、手指、物体轨迹与时变接触；现有方法依赖迭代扩散或测试时优化，推理成本高。一步生成虽高效，但各HOI组件在结构与尺度上差异大，难以直接生成。

Method: 1) Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE将身体、手、物体与接触信号组织为结构化潜空间，共享解码器保持全局协调；2) ST-DiT建模时序与跨部件依赖，通过单次MeanFlow评估生成完整交互；3) 预测物体局部接触对应关系，实现几何细化与交互保持的迁移，适应不同体型的逼真相貌3D高斯化身。

Result: 实验表明MFlowHOI在运动质量与文本对齐方面优于现有基础生成器，同时大幅降低推理时间。

Conclusion: MFlowHOI实现了高效一步全身HOI生成，兼顾质量与效率，并支持跨体型化身迁移，具备下游应用价值。

Abstract: Whole-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires coordinating body and finger motion, object trajectories, and time-varying contacts. Existing methods typically rely on iterative diffusion or test-time optimization, resulting in high inference costs. Direct one-step generation is highly desired in downstream applications due to efficient inference. However, it is challenging because these HOI components differ substantially in structure and scale. We present MFlowHOI, an efficient one-step framework for whole-body HOI generation. A Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE organizes body, hand, object, and contact signals into a structured latent space, with a shared decoder preserving their global coordination. An ST-DiT then models temporal and cross-part dependencies in this space and generates a complete interaction in a single MeanFlow evaluation. Predicted object-local contact correspondences further enable geometric refinement and interaction-preserving transfer to photorealistic 3D Gaussian avatars with different body proportions. Experiments demonstrate that MFlowHOI outperforms existing base generators in motion quality and text alignment while substantially reducing inference time.

</details>


### [166] [EgoWholeView: Camera-Only Head-Mounted Capture of Body and Bimanual Hand Motion for Embodied Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16256)
*Yaoqing Hu,Xuguo He,Daohan Cui,Yukun Shi,Kai Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoWholeView是一个由六个同步广角RGB相机组成的可穿戴动作捕捉系统，通过角色分工的流水线实现头戴式全身与双手动作捕捉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一第一人称相机存在视野受限、尺度模糊和手-物遮挡问题，难以支持自化身、遥操作和具身示范等应用。

Method: 系统采用六个同步广角RGB相机：外侧视角定位装置于世界坐标系，一对重叠的向下相机独立预测SMPL-X身体和MANO手部参数，两个预测器适配鱼眼第一人称数据；通过预测自身得到的可靠性线索对关节旋转加权融合，形状跨视角帧聚合，基线固定度量尺度，三角测量恢复根平移。

Result: 相比单目预测，融合使身体PA-MPJPE降低3.7%、手部降低11.2%；时序优化使角加速度幅值分别降低32.2%和31.0%。六相机录制中无需重调参即产出共享世界坐标系的身体与手部状态，时序优化使手部加速度幅值降低41.08%。

Conclusion: 仅用RGB相机且无需第三人称视角，EgoWholeView为第一人称交互数据提供了一条低成本、便携的获取途径。

Abstract: Head-mounted body and bimanual motion capture supports self-avatars, teleoperation, and embodied demonstrations. However, a single egocentric camera is vulnerable to a limited field of view, scale ambiguity, and hand-object occlusion. We present EgoWholeView, a wearable capture system of six synchronized wide-angle RGB cameras with a role-specialized pipeline. The outward views localize the rig in a world frame, while an overlapping downward pair independently predicts SMPL-X body and MANO hand parameters. Both predictors are adapted to egocentric fisheye data. To combine the two, reliability cues measured from the predictions themselves weight the fusion of body and hand joint rotations, while shape is aggregated across views and frames. The pair's baseline fixes metric scale, and triangulation recovers root translation. Relative to monocular prediction, fusion reduces PA-MPJPE by 3.7% for the body and 11.2% for the hands, and temporal refinement lowers angular-acceleration magnitude by 32.2% and 31.0%, respectively. On our six-camera recording, the pipeline produces body and hand states in a shared world frame using benchmark-fitted gates without retuning, and temporal refinement lowers hand acceleration magnitude by 41.08%. Using only RGB cameras and no third-person view, EgoWholeView offers a low-cost, portable route to egocentric interaction data.

</details>


### [167] [Graph3R: Unifying View Graph Initialization with Feed-Forward Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16272)
*Jingwen Yu,Hengli Wang,Jianhao Jiao,Zhonghang Liu,Ping Tan,Hong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Graph3R 将视图图初始化与前馈重建通过共享几何表示统一，实现单骨干从无整理图像集中分离并重建多个不相交场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际图像集常包含多个不相交场景的视图，联合重建会破坏相机位姿和几何。现有流程将视图关联与重建分成独立阶段，二者耦合松散。

Method: 基于 π³ 多视图特征，用轻量验证头预测成对共视性构建视图图，划分场景组；对每组屏蔽共享特征后再解码相机位姿与稠密几何，单次骨干前向即可分别重建各场景。

Result: 三个基准上，100% 精度下平均最大召回率较基线提升最多 8.99 个百分点，混合场景输入重建质量提升；多会话建图中提升跨会话定位，位姿精度有竞争力，重建查询组时约 35.9 倍加速。

Conclusion: 将学习式视图关联与几何推理整合，向无整理图像集的端到端重建迈进一步。

Abstract: Feed-forward reconstruction recovers camera poses and dense geometry from image sets whose views are assumed to come from a single scene. In practice, uncurated image collections often contain views from disjoint scenes, and reconstructing these views jointly can corrupt camera poses and geometry. Existing pipelines typically resolve view associations in separate stages before final reconstruction, leaving view graph initialization and reconstruction inference only loosely coupled. We introduce Graph3R, which unifies view graph initialization with feed-forward reconstruction through a shared geometric representation. A lightweight verification head predicts pairwise covisibility from the multi-view features of $π^3$ to construct a view graph. This graph classifies the input views into scene groups. For each group, we mask the shared features before decoding camera poses and dense geometry. Reusing the multi-view features allows Graph3R to reconstruct disjoint scenes separately with a single backbone pass. Across three benchmarks, Graph3R improves average maximum recall at 100% precision by upto 8.99 percentage points over the baseline, while improving reconstruction quality on mixed-scene inputs. Regarding the multi-session mapping task, Graph3R improves cross-session localization and achieves competitive pose estimation accuracy, while delivering a runtime speedup of approximately $35.9\times$ over the baseline when reconstructing the query group. By integrating learned view association with geometric inference, our approach takes a step toward end-to-end reconstruction from uncurated image collections.

</details>


### [168] [FlowAvatar: Real-Time Full-Body Avatars from Sparse Egocentric Inputs on Consumer XR Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16277)
*Chenfeng Gao,Taeyoung Yeon,Sungheon Park,Vasco Xu,Anish Prabhu,Mar Gonzalez-Franco,Karan Ahuja*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlowAvatar 在消费级 XR 设备上实现实时个性化化身，统一全身姿态、手部、面部与视线追踪，并揭示追踪完整性与个性化外观的互补作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究分别考察追踪完整性和个性化外观，但均需专用实验室设备，二者在消费级硬件上的交互作用尚不清楚。

Method: 提出 FlowAvatar，基于 Meta Quest Pro 的稀疏自我中心输入，实时追踪全身姿态、手部关节、面部表情与视线，并采用综合时空损失及架构与损失消融。

Result: 在 AMASS 基准上取得有竞争力的空间精度和最先进的时序一致性，且可实时运行；两项用户研究（N=12、N=10）表明追踪完整性提升运动质量感知，仅二者结合才能实现正向总体具身感。

Conclusion: 追踪完整性与个性化外观具有互补作用，二者结合是实现正向具身感的关键，为消费级 XR 化身设计提供依据。

Abstract: Prior avatar embodiment research has studied tracking completeness (how faithfully the body, hands, and face are sensed and reproduced) and personalized appearance in isolation, each requiring specialized lab equipment. How these factors interact on consumer hardware remains an open question, because no existing system unifies body pose, face, hands, and personalized appearance on a standalone headset. We present FlowAvatar, a system enabling real-time personalized look-alike avatars with full-body pose, hand articulation, facial expression, and eye gaze tracking from sparse egocentric inputs on consumer XR devices (Meta Quest Pro). Our pose model achieves competitive spatial accuracy and state-of-the-art temporal consistency on the AMASS benchmark against prior works with comprehensive spatial and temporal losses validated through architecture and loss ablations, while running in real-time. Two user studies (N=12, N=10) provide converging evidence that tracking completeness and personalized appearance serve complementary roles: tracking completeness broadly improves perceived motion quality, while only their combination achieves positive total embodiment.

</details>


### [169] [DepthTile: Depth-Guided Existing-Image Self-Tiling with Input-Side Tileability Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16278)
*Rui Wang,Xi Chen,Hui Dai,Piaopiao Yu,Yixue Hao,Long Hu,Min Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DepthTile，一种深度引导的自平铺方法，将单目深度转为空间保真先验融入 Tiled Diffusion 的掩码机制，无需重训扩散主干；并引入 STAS 预测自平铺可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像自平铺需在弱编辑（保留源内容但残留周期接缝）与强编辑（提升可平铺性但易内容漂移）间权衡；基于扩散的管线虽缓解边界不连续，却缺乏对几何重要区域的感知与保留。

Method: DepthTile 将单目深度转化为空间可编辑性图（spatial editability map），与 Tiled Diffusion 的时间步相关差分扩散掩码融合，在近景区域增强源保留、在兼容背景边界保留编辑灵活性；无需重训扩散主干。另提出 STAS，一种基于 RGB、梯度、深度及深度梯度线索的轻量输入端预测器，评估输入的自平铺可行性。

Result: 在 335 张图像基准上，相比默认 Tiled Diffusion 管线，MAE、LPIPS 和 Tiling Score 分别降低 12.8%、26.7% 和 8.4%；STAS 可可靠实现难度感知分析，并支持兼容性感知的成对图像平铺。

Conclusion: DepthTile 通过深度引导的掩码融合，在无需重训的前提下改进了自平铺的保真度与可平铺性平衡；STAS 提供了输入端可行性预测，并拓展至成对图像平铺等应用。

Abstract: Existing-image self-tiling aims to transform a given image into a seamlessly repeatable tile while preserving its original semantics and local details. This task requires weak editing to retain the source but leave periodic seams, whereas strong editing improves tileability at the large risk of content drift.Existing diffusion-based tiling pipelines alleviate boundary discontinuities, yet lack awareness of which regions are geometrically important to preserve. In this work, we propose DepthTile, a depth-guided self-tiling method whose generation module requires no retraining of the diffusion backbone. It converts monocular depth into a spatial preservation prior and integrates it into the timestep-dependent masking mechanism of Tiled Diffusion. DepthTile converts depth into a spatial editability map and fuses it with the differential diffusion mask. This strengthens source preservation in near-field regions indicated by the monocular depth prior while retaining editing flexibility near compatible background boundaries. To access when self-tiling is feasible, we introduce the Self-Tiling Ability Score (STAS), a lightweight input-side predictor based on RGB, gradient, depth, and depth-gradient cues. On a 335-image benchmark, relative to the default Tiled Diffusion pipeline, DepthTile reduces MAE, LPIPS, and Tiling Score by 12.8%, 26.7%, and 8.4%, respectively. STAS reliably enables difficulty-aware analysis and further supports compatibility-aware pairwise image tiling.

</details>


### [170] [ProGAN-Based Synthetic Image Generation for Industrial Visual Inspection of Metallic Parts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16287)
*Hossein Omid Beiki,Sepehr Asgari,Oliver Petrovic,Christian Brecher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文利用ProGAN（Wasserstein损失+梯度惩罚）生成合成图像，缓解金属部件缺陷检测中训练数据稀缺、多样性低的问题，并在MVTec AD和MPDD数据集上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金属部件的自动化视觉检测对高效维修与回收至关重要，AI缺陷检测非常契合这一需求，但常受限于训练数据稀缺且多样性不足。

Method: 构建ProGAN流水线，采用Wasserstein损失与梯度惩罚，在MVTec AD（metal nut）和MPDD（tube）两个公开数据集上评估关键超参数。

Result: 训练保持稳定，模型生成了逼真的图像。

Conclusion: 合成图像可增强训练数据、提升鲁棒性，并降低采集稀有缺陷数据的成本。

Abstract: Automated visual inspection is essential for efficient repair and recycling of metallic components. AI-based defect detection is a strong fit. However, it is often constrained by scarce, low-diversity training data. To address this gap, we study Generative AI-driven synthetic image generation using Progressive Growing GANs (ProGAN). We implement a ProGAN pipeline with Wasserstein loss and gradient penalty and evaluate key hyperparameters on two public datasets, MVTec AD (metal nut) and MPDD (tube). As a result, training remained stable and the model yielded realistic images. These images can augment training data, improve robustness, and reduce the cost of collecting rare defects.

</details>


### [171] [3D Gaussian Splatting for Fine-grained Urban Scene Reconstruction via Semantic-guided Density Control and Loss Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16292)
*Yueling Liao,San Jiang,Xing Zhang,Zhongwen Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SG-GS：一种语义引导的3DGS方法，将SAM语义分割引入高斯密度控制与损失函数设计，实现复杂城市场景细粒度结构重建，PSNR较原3DGS提升约2.7%~5.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始3DGS在复杂城市场景重建细粒度结构时，存在密度控制粗糙、损失函数缺乏语义信息（语义盲）的问题，导致线性结构伪影和边界模糊。

Method: 以SAM语义分割为约束，系统性融入两方面：(1) 语义约束自适应密度控制，按语义区域动态分配梯度阈值，并引入边界增强致密化策略，将新高斯导向结构关键区域；(2) 多特征引导损失函数，通过分阶段渐进训练逐步引入细粒度监督信号，缓解基本损失缺乏语义约束造成的伪影。

Result: 在三个数据集上重建精度一致提升，PSNR较原3DGS提高约2.7%~5.2%，线性结构伪影与边界模糊得到有效缓解。

Conclusion: SG-GS可有效服务于城市场景的细粒度三维重建。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has been becoming a promising 3D reconstruction technique because of its advantage of high-fidelity rendering effect with high efficiency. However, it still suffers from coarse density control and semantically blind loss functions when reconstructing the fine-grained structures in complex urban scenes. Thus, this study proposes SG-GS, a semantic-guided 3DGS method for fine-grained structure reconstruction. It takes the semantic segmentation deduced by the Segment Anything Model (SAM) as a constraint and systematically integrates it into both Gaussian density control and loss function design. On the one hand, a semantic-constrained adaptive density control mechanism is constructed, which dynamically allocates gradient thresholds to different semantic regions of the scene and introduces an additional boundary-enhanced densification strategy, so that new Gaussians are directed to structurally critical regions. On the other hand, a multi-feature guided loss function is designed, and fine-grained supervision signals are gradually introduced through a phased progressive training strategy, alleviating the artifacts caused by the lack of semantic constraints in the basic loss. Experiments on three datasets show that the proposed method consistently improves reconstruction accuracy. Compared with the original 3DGS, the PSNR increases by approximately 2.7% to 5.2%, while artifacts on linear structures and boundary blurring are effectively mitigated. The method can serve the fine-grained 3D reconstruction of urban scenes.

</details>


### [172] [ClothAtlas: Joint Garment Identification and State Estimation under Self-Occlusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16293)
*Jens Lundell,Alberta Longhini,Lei Shu,Hemal Arora,Evan Robert,Carlota Parés-Morlans,Marcel Büsching,Mårten Björkman,Jeannette Bohg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ClothAtlas 从局部、自遮挡点云联合识别衣物并估计完整配置，用共享图条件流匹配模型采样并排序候选网格，无需重训练即可加入新衣物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 衣物操作需要同时推断衣物身份与完整配置，但局部自遮挡观测导致鸡生蛋问题：补全需衣物专属形变先验，而识别又需能解释观测的配置。

Method: 共享的图条件流匹配模型为每个候选网格采样配置，并按与观测的拟合度排序候选；模型兼容不同网格形状、顶点数与连接关系，仅凭规范网格即可添加新衣物。

Result: 在 DexGarmentLab 留出衣物上，22 件中单次平铺观测即可将正确网格排为 221 候选中的第一；单次自遮挡观测识别 15/22，优于确定性图估计器的 8/22。持久顶点身份支持真实衣物抓取定位，平均误差由 15.4 降至 6.4 cm，遮挡目标由 17.0 降至 8.3 cm。

Conclusion: ClothAtlas 统一解决了衣物识别与完整配置估计，具备跨网格泛化能力，并提升真实抓取定位精度。

Abstract: Garment manipulation requires inferring both garment identity and complete configuration from partial, self-occluded observations. This creates a chicken-and-egg problem: completing a partial observation requires a garment-specific deformation prior, while identifying the garment requires a configuration that explains the observation. We introduce ClothAtlas, which jointly identifies garments and estimates their complete configurations from partial point clouds and a library of canonical meshes. A shared graph-conditioned flow-matching model samples configurations for each candidate mesh and ranks candidates by observation fit. The model accommodates different mesh shapes, vertex counts, and connectivities, allowing new garments to be added from canonical meshes alone without retraining. On held-out DexGarmentLab garments, ClothAtlas ranks the correct mesh first among 221 candidates for all 22 test garments from a single flat observation. From a single self-occluded observation, it identifies 15/22 garments, compared with 8/22 for a deterministic graph estimator. Persistent vertex identities support grasp-target localization on real garments, reducing mean error from 15.4 to 6.4 cm overall and from 17.0 to 8.3 cm on occluded targets compared with dense descriptor matching. Project page: https://clothatlas.github.io/

</details>


### [173] [Learning Temporal Evidence Selection for Video Anomaly Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16299)
*Hangil Park,Seungheon Kim,Tae-Kyun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将视频异常理解(VAU)的时间采样重构为面向下游任务的可学习证据选择问题，提出语义条件化的Temporal Sampling Q-Former，在HIVAU-70K上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VAU流程依赖以异常为中心或预定义的时间采样策略，虽能高效突出可疑时刻，但忽略了上下文线索、物体交互以及推理所需的时间分布证据。受长视频问答中可学习时间选择的启发，作者将VAU时间采样重新视为与下游对齐的证据选择问题。

Method: 提出语义条件化的Temporal Sampling Q-Former，通过VAU生成目标学习选择时间视觉证据。由于通用VAU提示缺乏视频特定指导，采样器以从输入视频自动提取的CLIP嵌入物体标签为条件；这些标签仅用于时间证据选择，不拼接到LLM生成提示中。采样器在视觉token空间运行，基于帧级表示计算软时间选择权重，并在生成响应前合并重复选择。

Result: 在HIVAU-70K数据集上，该模型在所比较的微调模型中取得最佳性能。消融实验表明，可学习时间采样优于固定的异常聚焦采样，且CLIP嵌入物体标签条件优于通用提示条件。

Conclusion: VAU中的时间采样应与面向解释的证据效用对齐，而非仅依赖异常显著性。

Abstract: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) aims to generate language-level interpretations of anomalous events in long videos, requiring visual evidence that supports explanation beyond anomaly detection alone. Existing VAU pipelines commonly rely on anomaly-centric or predefined temporal sampling strategies, which efficiently emphasize suspicious moments but overlook contextual cues, object interactions, and temporally distributed evidence needed for reasoning. Motivated by recent progress in learnable temporal selection for long-video question answering, we revisit VAU temporal sampling as a downstream-aligned evidence selection problem. We introduce the semantic-conditioned Temporal Sampling Q-Former that learns to select temporal visual evidence through the VAU generation objective. Since generic VAU prompts provide weak video-specific guidance, we condition the sampler on CLIP-embedded object tags automatically extracted from the input video. These tags are used only for temporal evidence selection and are not appended to the LLM generation prompt, separating sampler conditioning from prompt augmentation. The proposed sampler operates in visual-token space, computes soft temporal selection weights from frame-level representations, and merges duplicated selections before response generation. Experiments on HIVAU-70K show that our model achieves the best performance among the compared fine-tuned models, while ablations demonstrate that learnable temporal sampling improves over fixed anomaly-focused sampling and that CLIP-embedded object-tag conditioning further improves over generic-prompt conditioning. Our results suggest that temporal sampling in VAU should be aligned with explanation-oriented evidence utility rather than anomaly saliency alone.

</details>


### [174] [RAR: Rate-Adaptive Rollout for Time-Consistent Interactive World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16302)
*Yaoyang Liu,Dongyu Yan,Yihua Du,Shengju Qian,Zeke Xie,Xin Wang,Ying-Cong Chen,Long Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RAR框架，通过Stride-RoPE实现可控时序速率的交互式世界模型，解耦时序速率与生成吞吐/物理时长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型固定时序速率训练与部署，导致运行时速率适配受限及物理时长覆盖问题（temporal-rate coupling）；单一时序速率下时间粒度与物理时长存在固有权衡。

Method: RAR框架，核心为Stride-RoPE，将对齐不同速率采样的隐帧映射至共享物理时间坐标，支持多速率一致生成、未见速率泛化及在线切换且不丢弃历史；并用多跨度视频采样联合学习细粒度动态与长时演化。

Result: 在动作与相机控制环境中，RAR实现时序一致的多速率生成与在线速率切换，保持高帧率生成质量，并在相同训练预算下扩展物理时长；可迁移至预训练世界模型且保持感知质量。

Conclusion: RAR通过速率自适应生成解决时序速率耦合问题，为可控时序速率的交互式世界模型提供可行方案。

Abstract: Video-based interactive world models aim to enable real-time, user-controllable environments. Yet most existing systems are trained and rolled out at a fixed temporal rate, limiting both runtime-rate adaptation and physical-horizon coverage -- a limitation we term temporal-rate coupling. Specifically, when runtime generation throughput differs from the learned temporal rate, the generated world evolves unintentionally more slowly or quickly. Moreover, using a single temporal rate imposes an inherent trade-off between temporal granularity and physical horizon: higher rates capture finer motion but cover a shorter duration under a fixed context window. To address both limitations, we introduce Rate-Adaptive Rollout (RAR), a framework that enables interactive world models to roll out at controllable temporal rates. At its core, Stride-RoPE aligns latent frames sampled at different rates on a shared physical-time coordinate, enabling consistent multi-rate rollout, unseen-rate generalization, and online rate switching without discarding history. Meanwhile, RAR uses multi-stride video sampling to enable joint learning of fine-grained dynamics and long-horizon evolution. Across action- and camera-controlled environments, RAR achieves temporally consistent multi-rate rollout and online rate switching while preserving high-rate generation quality and extending physical horizons under matched training budgets. RAR also transfers to pretrained world models while preserving perceptual quality.

</details>


### [175] [Building age estimation based on widely available multi-source1 geospatial data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16320)
*Jialu Sui,Hongsheng Zhang,Rui Liu,Jing Ling,Ruisheng Wang,Hao Wu,Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个深度学习框架，利用多源地理空间数据在像元和实例级别估计建筑年龄，并构建香港基准数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑年龄对城市基础设施安全与规划至关重要，但现有方法依赖难以获取的信息或仅用局部纹理，且忽略年龄类别的时间顺序。

Method: 用大预训练骨干加微调适配器提取特征；像元级用金字塔解码器与余弦引导专家混合(CMoE)融合多源栅格；实例级用注意力池化和PCAdaIN整合属性；引入时间序数约束损失(TOCL)保持年龄排序。

Result: 在自建的香港建筑年龄基准上实现像元与实例级的统一估计与综合评估。

Conclusion: 能有效利用易获取的地理空间数据估计建筑年龄，代码与数据集已开源。

Abstract: Building age is fundamental for urban infrastructure safety, operation, and planning, as it directly affects structural safety, and sustainable development. Existing methods mostly rely on detailed building information such as street view, function, or materials, which are harder to obtain than geospatial data like satellite imagery and Digital Surface Models (DSMs). However, existing methods based on those geospatial data mainly rely on optical imagery and local texture features, limiting their ability to capture structural information and distinguish buildings from different periods. Moreover, the inherent temporal ordering among building age categories is often overlooked. To address these limitations, we propose the first deep-learning framework for multi-building age estimation using widely available multi-source geospatial data, including remote sensing data and their derived products, as well as building footprint information that estimates age at both pixel and instance levels within a unified pipeline. Specifically, a large pretrained backbone with fine-tuning adapters extracts representative features, and raster-derived and property-derived fusion modules support pixel-wise and instance-wise predictions. Pixel-level estimation employs a pyramid decoder with Cosine-guided Mixture-of-Experts (CMoE) to fuse multi-source raster data across scales, capturing fine-grained building age differences, while instance-level prediction uses attention pooling and Property-Conditional Adaptive Instance Normalization (PCAdaIN) to extract instance-level representations and integrate property attributes. A Temporal Ordinal Constraint Loss (TOCL) enforces the sequential ordering of predicted ages. We also construct a building age benchmark for Hong Kong to enable comprehensive evaluation. The source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/littlebeen/RS-buildingAge.git.

</details>


### [176] [Anomaly-Guided Observation and Two-Level Semantic Feedback for Training-Free Video Anomaly Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16324)
*Hangil Park,Seungheon Kim,Tae-Kyun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种免训练语义反馈框架，通过VAD引导的主动观察生成异常描述，并将其反馈以精炼视频异常检测，UCF-Crime和XD-Violence上均有提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练VAD方法虽利用更广的时序与语义上下文，但通用上下文不一定能突出异常事件，且未明确视频级语义应如何修正局部异常分数。

Method: 从上游异常分数曲线出发，采用基于推理的迭代帧选择：高分区域作为观察种子，异常分数与VLM相关性评估引导时序探索；冻结视频语言模型对所选帧生成开放描述。反馈分两级：视频级决定分数分布抑制/保留/锐化并选择性视觉复核，局部级检索事件相关窗口并在目标局部视觉验证后提升分数。所有模型权重冻结，反馈仅应用一次。

Result: HIVAU视频摘要评估中，VAD引导观察在合理性、细节和一致性上优于CLIP引导。VAD方面，语义反馈将上游检测器UCF-Crime从84.36%提升至86.25% AUC，XD-Violence从68.07%提升至72.58% AP，最终AUC达91.74%。

Conclusion: 语义反馈框架在免训练条件下有效提升视频异常检测性能，VAD引导的观察优于通用语义引导。

Abstract: Training-free language-based video anomaly detection (VAD) uses frozen vision--language models (VLMs) and large language models (LLMs) to localize abnormal events without task-specific model-weight optimization. Existing approaches increasingly exploit broader temporal and semantic context, yet generic context does not necessarily foreground abnormal events or specify how video-level semantics should modify local anomaly scores. We introduce a training-free semantic feedback framework that uses VAD-guided active observation for video anomaly understanding (VAU) and returns the resulting anomaly-focused description to refine temporal detection. Starting from an upstream anomaly-score curve, we adapt reasoning-based iterative frame selection: high-score regions seed the observations, and anomaly scores together with VLM relevance assessments guide subsequent temporal exploration. A frozen video-language model generates a single open-ended anomaly description from the selected frames. The description is returned through two complementary feedback levels: video-level feedback determines whether the score distribution should be suppressed, preserved, or sharpened, with selective visual rechecking, while local feedback retrieves event-related windows and promotes scores only after target-local visual verification. All model weights remain frozen, and feedback is applied once without regenerating the description. On the HIVAU video-summary evaluations of UCF-Crime and XD-Violence, VAD-guided observation improves GPT-rated reasonability, detail, and consistency over the matched CLIP-guided variant. For VAD, semantic feedback improves the re-evaluated upstream detector from 84.36% to 86.25% AUC on UCF-Crime and from 68.07% to 72.58% AP on XD-Violence, where the final AUC is 91.74%.

</details>


### [177] [Explicitly Aligned Multi-View Breast Cancer Risk Prediction from Variable-Length Screening Histories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16329)
*Solveig Thrun,Zijun Sun,Suaiba A. Salahuddin,Kristoffer Wickstrøm,Elisabeth Wetzer,Stine Hansen,Robert Jenssen,Michael Kampffmeyer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FlexLMV-Net，乳腺级别的纵向多视角框架，显式对齐CC/MLO视图并支持可变次数的历史检查，用于乳腺癌风险预测，并在EMBED和CSAW-CC上优于现有方法；同时发布基准BCRBench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确的风险预测对分层筛查至关重要，可利用纵向组织变化及CC/MLO互补信息，但现有方法存在缺陷：隐式特征对齐缺乏空间一致性、各视图独立建模、显式方法仅限单次历史检查。

Method: FlexLMV-Net跨筛查检查联合建模CC和MLO视图，适应可变数量的历史检查；显式对齐纵向特征图，通过跨视角时间融合和双流注意力模块整合互补视角。同时构建BCRBench基准，统一预处理、训练、推理和评估协议。

Result: 在EMBED和CSAW-CC数据集上，FlexLMV-Net在乳腺密度、癌症亚型及人口统计学子群上持续优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 结果表明显式纵向对齐、多视角建模和灵活利用筛查历史具有优势；BCRBench为单/多次时间点风险预测模型提供公平可复现的比较平台。

Abstract: Accurate breast cancer risk prediction from screening mammography is essential for improved risk stratification and personalized screening. It can benefit from both temporal breast tissue changes across longitudinal examinations and complementary anatomical information from craniocaudal (CC) and mediolateral oblique (MLO) views. Leveraging longitudinal information requires identifying corresponding tissue regions across examinations, yet most approaches rely on implicit feature alignment without explicitly enforcing spatial consistency. Recent work has demonstrated the benefits of explicit temporal alignment; however, existing methods model each view independently, preventing them from exploiting complementary CC and MLO information. Furthermore, explicit approaches have been limited to a single prior examination. To fill these gaps, we propose (github.com/sot176/FlexLMV-Net), a breast-wise longitudinal multi-view framework that jointly models CC and MLO views across screening examinations while accommodating a variable number of prior examinations. FlexLMV-Net explicitly aligns longitudinal feature maps and integrates complementary views through cross-view temporal fusion and a dual-stream attention block. Evaluated on EMBED and CSAW-CC, FlexLMV-Net consistently outperforms existing approaches across breast density, cancer subtypes, and demographic subgroups, highlighting the benefits of explicit longitudinal alignment, multi-view modeling, and flexible use of available screening history. We further introduce (github.com/sot176/BCRBench), an open-source benchmark that unifies state-of-the-art single- and multi-timepoint breast cancer risk prediction models under standardized preprocessing, training, inference, and evaluation protocols, enabling fair and reproducible comparison of existing methods.

</details>


### [178] [BAT3R: Robust Online 3D Reconstruction with Bayesian Adaptive State Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16330)
*Lijian Li,Yuanpeng He,Yudian Zheng,Chung-ju Huang,Linyu Li,Dongming Jin,Wenpin Jiao,Zhi Jin,Chi-Man Pun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BAT3R是一个无需训练、基于贝叶斯的流式3D重建框架，通过SIG与BASU两模块缓解长序列推理中的误差累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈Transformer在3D视觉中取得进展，但二次复杂度使其难处理长视频；现有流式/循环架构虽用恒定内存处理，却忽视观测本身的可靠性及历史状态的累积置信度，导致长序列上渐进式性能退化与严重误差累积。

Method: 提出免训练贝叶斯适配框架BAT3R，含两协同模块：(1) State Innovation Gating (SIG)，作为分布正则项，将状态演化锚定到其几何初始化以抑制长时推理的表征漂移；(2) Bayesian-guided Adaptive State Updating (BASU)，在卡尔曼滤波框架下将状态更新重构为递归贝叶斯推断，通过信息论增益建模观测的时间可靠性、通过交叉注意力图建模空间相关性，实现非对称时空状态融合：对已充分整合的历史区域避免冗余更新，对真正新颖的场景内容则积极纳入。

Result: 在7-Scenes、TUM、ScanNet、KITTI等标准基准上，BAT3R持续优于最先进的在线3D重建方法，在长序列与复杂场景上提升最为显著。

Conclusion: 通过引入贝叶斯可靠性建模与非对称时空融合，BAT3R无需训练即有效缓解长序列误差累积，在长序列与复杂场景中取得显著优势。

Abstract: Feed-forward transformer models have driven remarkable progress in 3D vision,yet their quadratic complexity renders them impractical for long video sequences. Streaming 3D reconstruction addresses this bottleneck by processing frames sequen?tially with constant memory. However, existing recurrent architectures inevitably suffer from progressive degradation over long sequences, as they fail to account for the intrinsic reliability of observations and the accumulated confidence of the historical state, leading to severe error accumulation. To address these issues, we introduce BAT3R, a training-free Bayesian adaptation framework comprising two synergistic modules: State Innovation Gating (SIG) and Bayesian-guided Adaptive State Updating (BASU). SIG acts as a distributional regularizer that anchors state evolution to its geometric initialization, effectively arresting representational drift during long-term inference. Building on this, BASU reformulates state update as a recursive Bayesian inference process within a Kalman filtering framework. By jointly modeling the temporal reliability of observations via information-theoretic gain and spatial relevance via cross-attention maps, BASU achieves an asymmetric spatio-temporal state fusion: well-consolidated historical regions are protected from redundant updates, while genuinely novel scene content is aggressively incor?porated. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks (7-Scenes, TUM, ScanNet, KITTI, etc.) demonstrate that BAT3R consistently outperforms state-of-the-art online 3D reconstruction methods, with the most significant gains observed on long sequences and complex scenes.

</details>


### [179] [WorldRoPE: Probabilistic World-Centric Rotary Embedding for Multi-View Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16337)
*Mijeong Kim,Kyujin Lim,Bohyung Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldRoPE 提出一种以世界坐标系为中心的概率式 RoPE，通过体素高斯原语建模 patch 的多重 3D 支撑，闭式积分 rotary 算子，实现多视图 Transformer 的跨视图位置编码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视图场景中 patch 坐标各自定义于单张图像，同一 3D 点在不同视图坐标不同，无法建立跨视图对应关系。

Method: 每层将 patch token 反投影为共享世界坐标系中的体素高斯原语，表示多种合理 3D 支撑（深度假设、不确定性、patch 视锥空间范围）。将 key 支撑投影到 query 视图得到分布，对该分布闭式积分 rotary 算子：按混合权重组合投影原语中心的旋转，并施加协方差相关的衰减。支撑退化为点时还原为确定性 RoPE。几何与特征跨层相互迭代优化。

Result: 在新视图合成、深度估计和 3D 几何重建任务上验证了有效性。

Conclusion: WorldRoPE 使注意力对 query 视图中不确定的 key 位置更鲁棒，无需栅格化或 warp token 特征，有效提升多视图 Transformer 性能。

Abstract: Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) is widely used to encode relative positions in Transformers. In multi-view settings, however, patch coordinates are defined independently in each image: the same 3D point can therefore have different coordinates across views, making them insufficient for establishing cross-view correspondences. We introduce WorldRoPE, a probabilistic world-centric RoPE for multi-view attention. At each layer, WorldRoPE back-projects each patch token into a set of volumetric Gaussian primitives in a shared world frame. These primitives represent multiple plausible 3D supports for a token, jointly capturing alternative depth hypotheses, depth uncertainty, and the finite spatial extent of its patch frustum. When a key token's support is projected into a query view, it induces a distribution over where that key may appear in the query image. WorldRoPE integrates the rotary operator over this distribution in closed form, combining rotations at the projected primitive centers according to their mixture weights with covariance-dependent attenuation. This makes attention less sensitive to uncertain key locations in the query view, without rasterizing or warping token features. The formulation reduces to deterministic RoPE when the support collapses to a point. Across layers, the predicted geometry guides cross-view attention, while the updated features refine the geometry used at the next layer. Experiments on novel view synthesis, depth estimation, and 3D geometry reconstruction demonstrate the effectiveness of WorldRoPE for multi-view Transformers.

</details>


### [180] [SyncReward: Human-Aligned Synchronization Reward for Audio-Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16338)
*Kaisi Guan,Ying Ba,Wenjing Wang,Xihua Wang,Chen Li,Jing Lyu,Ruihau Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文围绕音视频同步问题，构建了数据、基准与奖励模型三方面的工作，提出SyncReward-Data-80K数据集、SyncReward-Bench基准及SyncReward奖励模型，显著提升与人类判断的一致性并改善生成同步性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音视频联合生成虽进展迅速，但生成语音和声音常与视觉事件在时间上错位。核心瓶颈在于缺乏人工标注数据、可靠的评测基准以及同步感知的评测模型。

Method: 开展覆盖数据、基准与奖励建模的综合研究。构建SyncReward-Data-80K（8万条专业同步评分，覆盖Speech、Onset、Instrument、Ambient四类声音事件）；构建含1K片段的SyncReward-Bench并由多位专家独立评分；提出SyncReward奖励模型，结合真实片段的语义-时序对比预训练与生成片段上的人类监督。

Result: 系统评测专用同步指标与全模态模型，发现其与人类判断存在显著偏差；SyncReward作为评测指标在与人类评分一致性上最优；作为奖励模型可通过推理时best-of-N选择与强化学习后训练改善同步性。

Conclusion: 工作同时解决音视频同步的数据、评测与奖励建模问题，SyncReward在评测与生成优化两方面均有效，并将开源数据、基准、模型与代码。

Abstract: Recent years have witnessed rapid progress in joint audio--visual generation. However, audio--visual synchronization remains a challenge, as generated speech and sound often temporally misalign with visual events. A key bottleneck is the lack of human-annotated data, reliable evaluation benchmarks, and synchronization-aware evaluation models for generated audio--visual outputs. To address these limitations, we conduct a comprehensive study spanning data, benchmarking, and reward modeling. We first introduce SyncReward-Data-80K, a dataset containing 80K professional synchronization ratings for clips from eight audio--visual generators. A taxonomy-guided construction pipeline covers four sound-event families: Speech, Onset, Instrument, and Ambient. We further construct \textbf{SyncReward-Bench}, a held-out benchmark of 1K clips, each independently rated by multiple professionals. Using this benchmark, we systematically evaluate specialized synchronization metrics and omni-modal models, revealing their substantial misalignment with human judgments. Finally, we develop SyncReward, a reward model that combines semantic--temporal contrastive pretraining on real clips with human supervision on generated clips. As an evaluation metric, SyncReward achieves the strongest agreement with human ratings among the evaluated methods. As a reward, it improves synchronization through inference-time best-of-$N$ selection and reinforcement learning based post-training. We will release the data, benchmark, model, and code at https://github.com/WeChatCV/SyncReward.

</details>


### [181] [VideoSlate: Stateful Commit Control for Temporally Grounded Agentic Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16357)
*Shuo Zheng,Yuanjie Dang,Peng Chen,Jianjun Xiang,Ronghua Liang,Mohammed Bennamoun,Qiuhong Ke*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VideoSlate：一种基于共享证据的有状态提交控制框架，用于智能体视频推理中的时序状态控制与选择性修订。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体视频推理跨阶段搜集证据并选择相关视频片段作为视觉证据。新候选与观察会触发对当前片段的重新评估，但修订既可能纠正定位错误，也可能丢弃当前片段中已有的有用证据。因此系统需要将跨阶段的证据组织与时序状态控制相连接，让累积信息共同支持修订评估，同时用显式的采纳决策控制评估结果如何影响下游视觉证据。

Method: 提出VideoSlate框架，围绕共享证据构建。使用类型化证据黑板（blackboard）链接候选片段、来源、构造过程与验证器观察；由相对现任（incumbent-relative）认证器基于候选、当前片段及相关提案评估修订支持度；控制器依据认证结果授权修订或保留当前片段，将证据积累与状态更新分离，并在黑板上记录每次决策及其证据。

Result: 在视频定位与基于定位的问答基准上的大量评估表明，VideoSlate能通过选择性修订改进时序定位。

Conclusion: 通过分离证据积累与状态更新、显式控制采纳决策，VideoSlate有效支持智能体视频推理中的时序状态控制与选择性修订。

Abstract: Agentic video reasoning systems gather and assess video evidence across stages, selecting relevant spans as visual evidence for answering questions. New candidates and observations prompt reassessment of the current span, but revisions can correct localization errors or discard useful evidence already present in the adopted span. Systems therefore need to connect evidence organization across stages with temporal state control, allowing accumulated information to jointly inform revision assessment while explicit adoption decisions govern how assessment outcomes affect downstream visual evidence. We introduce VideoSlate, a stateful commit-control framework built around shared evidence. A typed evidence blackboard links candidate spans, provenance, construction, and verifier observations, enabling an incumbent-relative certifier to assess revision support from the candidate, current span, and related proposals. Based on certification, the controller authorizes a revision or retains the current span, separating evidence accumulation from state updates and recording each decision and its evidence on the blackboard. Extensive evaluations across video grounding and grounded question-answering benchmarks show that VideoSlate can improve temporal localization through selective revision.

</details>


### [182] [From Sound to Sense: An Anatomy of Semantic Supervision for Speech-Driven Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16364)
*Zhongyu Pang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SemEcho框架，将冻结的Whisper语音通路嫁接到VLTVG定位宿主上，共享解码器，并以配对的文本作为训练教师和文本上界。通过线性语义探针剖析三种语义注入通道，并发布Audio-DIOR-R和Audio-DIOR-Comp数据集。核心发现：直接对齐是否优于ASR级联取决于识别器质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音驱动的遥感视觉定位（RSVG）旨在消除文本输入的瓶颈，保留韵律意图，实现免手动目标获取。近期RSTalker采用直接音频范式（绕过ASR直接映射到边界框），但这类定位器实际学到了什么语言尚不清楚，缺乏衡量手段。

Method: 提出SemEcho：将冻结的Whisper语音通路嫁接到VLTVG定位宿主，使语音与文本共享同一解码器；利用合成语音语料（由DIOR-RSVG表达生成）得到免费配对文本，作为训练教师与同宿主的文本上界。用线性语义探针剖析三种语义注入通道：特征模仿蒸馏、词级CTC监督、两阶段ASR预训练。发布Audio-DIOR-R（80,973训练片段；10种音色×K=3；Qwen3-TTS合成，在线sox噪声λ∈[0,0.4]）和Audio-DIOR-Comp（2×2声学-语义协议下留出17个属性-类别组合的重划分）。

Result: 直接对齐与领域训练ASR级联的优劣由识别器质量决定：对弱领域内级联（CTC 0.53），直接法以9.0个Acc@0.5点胜出，且转录错误集中在空间关系词上；但对强领域内级联（CTC 0.029），其达到文本上界（80.8 vs 81.0），比最强直接模型还高8.8个点。反ASR前提仅在面对弱识别器时成立。

Conclusion: 反ASR的前提只在识别器较弱时成立；当识别器足够强时，ASR级联可逼近甚至匹配文本上界，并显著超过直接对齐模型。这表明RSVG中直接音频范式的优势并非普遍成立，而取决于ASR识别质量。

Abstract: Speech-driven visual grounding in remote sensing (RSVG) removes the typing bottleneck of text-based interaction and is intended to preserve prosodic intent, enabling hands-free target acquisition in time-critical missions. The direct-audio paradigm, mapping raw speech straight to a bounding box and bypassing automatic speech recognition (ASR), was recently adopted by RSTalker, but what such grounders actually learn about language remains unmeasured. SemEcho grafts a frozen Whisper speech pathway onto a VLTVG grounding host so that speech and text share one decoder, making the paired text, free by construction since speech corpora in this task are synthesized from DIOR-RSVG expressions, a training-time teacher and a fair, same-host text upper bound. On this instrument we dissect three semantic injection channels (feature-mimicry distillation, word-level CTC supervision, and two-stage ASR pretraining) with linear semantic probes, and release Audio-DIOR-R (80,973 training clips; 10 timbres x K=3; Qwen3-TTS synthesis with online sox noise lambda in [0, 0.4]) and Audio-DIOR-Comp, a re-split holding out 17 attribute-category combinations under a 2x2 acoustic-semantic protocol. Our anatomy yields four findings. (i) Whether direct alignment beats a domain-trained ASR cascade is decided by recognizer quality: against a weak in-domain cascade (CTC 0.53) direct wins by 9.0 Acc@0.5 points with transcription errors concentrated on spatial-relation words, but a strong in-domain cascade (CTC 0.029) reaches the text upper bound (80.8 vs. 81.0) and beats even the strongest direct model by 8.8 points; the anti-ASR premise holds only against weak recognizers.

</details>


### [183] [Throwing4: Phase-Aware Pose Modeling for Throw-Distance Prediction in Elite Athletics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16383)
*Bikash Kumar Badatya,Kartike Tiwari,Jyotirmoy Amin,Ravi Hegde*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Throwing4数据集与阶段条件化方法，验证显式技术阶段对齐可提升精英投掷项目距离预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精英投掷具备结构化生物力学动作序列和客观连续结果（投掷距离），适合性能导向的运动分析。作者想探究在真实转播条件下，显式的姿态动态阶段对齐是否能改进投掷距离预测。

Method: 构建Throwing4数据集（500个精英投掷视频，涵盖标枪、铁饼、链球、铅球，含二维姿态序列、帧级阶段标注和官方距离标签）。将转播姿态的投掷距离预测建模为回归问题，对比全序列建模与阶段条件化方法——将每次投掷划分为四个技术阶段并融合各阶段运动表征，在多种图姿态编码器上验证。

Result: 在多种基于图的姿态编码器上，引入阶段结构后预测误差一致降低，说明阶段对齐建模比将整个动作视为无结构序列提供更稳定的表征。

Conclusion: 显式生物力学阶段信息是精英投掷姿态性能建模的有效归纳先验。除分数预测外，该数据集与协议为细粒度技术分析、可解释运动分析和转播视频鲁棒建模奠定基础。

Abstract: Elite athletics throwing provides a structured biomechanical action sequence together with an objective continuous outcome, namely throw distance, making it a suitable setting for performance-oriented sports analytics. In this work, we investigate whether explicit phase alignment of pose dynamics improves throw-distance prediction under realistic broadcast conditions. To support this study, we curate Throwing4, a dataset of 500 elite throwing clips spanning javelin, discus, hammer, and shot put, with corresponding two-dimensional pose sequences, frame-level phase annotations, and official distance labels. We formulate throw-distance prediction from broadcast-derived pose as a regression problem and compare full-sequence modeling against a phase-conditioned approach that partitions each attempt into four technique stages and fuses phase-specific motion representations. Experiments across multiple graph-based pose encoders show a consistent reduction in prediction error when phase structure is incorporated, indicating that phase-aligned modeling provides a more stable representation than treating the entire motion as an unstructured sequence. These findings suggest that explicit biomechanical phase information is a useful inductive prior for pose-based performance modeling in elite athletics throwing. Beyond score prediction, the dataset and protocol provide a basis for future work on fine-grained technique analysis, interpretable sports analytics, and robust modeling from broadcast video.

</details>


### [184] [Recovering from Pose-Selection Failures in Repeated Visual Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16409)
*Jaehyun Kim,Wonseok Kang,Tae-Wan Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HPR利用过去定位输出的粗略位置预测来区分当前候选，在几乎不损失成功query的前提下显著提升视觉定位召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复结构会使错误位姿获得比正确位姿更多的内点支持，导致视觉定位误选错误候选。

Method: 用最近最多五次的定位输出做粗略位置预测；最佳拟合预测提出一个替代候选，仅当所有良好拟合预测都远比本地化器位姿更接近该候选时才接受；无需里程计，返回选中候选不变，仅用于选择而非位姿优化。

Result: 单一开发集阈值下，在HLoc、MASt3R位姿生成和JIST检索的全部12个主配置中，5米10度内召回均提升，失败query损失低于0.4%。NAVER Gangnam B1上修正97个HLoc失败、仅损失6个成功；三个HLoc测试集在0.25米2度内收益持续。HLoc候选上中位运行时间低于1毫秒（不含位姿生成）。

Conclusion: HPR是一种轻量、无需里程计的选择机制，能有效纠正重复结构导致的定位错误，但定位频率降低时恢复效果减弱。

Abstract: Repetitive structures can give an incorrect pose candidate more inlier support than an accurate one, causing visual localization to select it. History-Guided Pose Reselection (HPR) uses coarse position forecasts from up to five past localization outputs to distinguish well-separated current-query candidates. The best-fitting forecast proposes an alternative; HPR accepts it only if every well-fitting forecast is much closer to it than to the localizer's pose. HPR needs no odometry and returns the selected candidate unchanged, using prediction for selection rather than pose refinement. With one development-set threshold, HPR improves recall within 5 meters and 10 degrees in all 12 main configurations of Hierarchical Localization (HLoc), MASt3R-based pose generation, and JIST-based retrieval, losing successes on fewer than 0.4 percent of queries. On NAVER Gangnam B1, HPR corrects 97 HLoc failures and loses six successes; gains persist within 0.25 meters and 2 degrees on all three HLoc test sets. Median HPR runtime on HLoc candidates is below one millisecond, excluding pose generation. Recovery weakens under less frequent localization.

</details>


### [185] [Not All Challenges Are Equal: Evaluating Interactive Liveness Detection Against Real-Time Face Swaps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16417)
*Anton Firc,David Drtil,Martin Perešíni,Milan Šalko,Vojtěch Staněk,Kamil Malinka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文评估随机手势挑战用于人脸活体/换脸检测，发现主动手势窗口AUC达0.988，优于静态基线0.878，且响应时间可作辅助信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程身份验证假设摄像头流为真人，但实时换脸工具可在到达验证方前替换人脸。被动检测器泛化差，而交互式挑战的手势选择往往缺乏针对当前攻击有效性的证据。

Method: 在108个实时会话中评估随机手势挑战，涉及6名受试者、24个被冒充身份，以及通过虚拟摄像头注入的DeepFaceLive和FaceFusion两种换脸工具。使用冻结的UCF空间检测器，比较静态校准段与各主动手势窗口，并分析端到端响应时间。

Result: 静态校准段会话级AUC为0.878；主动手势窗口平均值达0.988。姿态与组合手势点估计最高，表情无明确提升。针对配置遮挡掩码的FaceFusion，手部遮挡低于静态基线。满足验证器的端到端时间会话级AUC为0.732，但该信号包含合成与传输延迟。

Conclusion: 挑战集应针对当前攻击配置进行测试，响应时间可作为额外的、部署特定的信号。

Abstract: Remote identity verification assumes that a camera stream shows a live person, yet public real-time face-swap tools can replace that person before the stream reaches the verifier. Passive deepfake detectors generalize poorly to new generators, while interactive challenges are often selected without evidence of which gestures expose current attacks. We evaluate randomized gesture challenges in 108 live sessions with six subjects, 24 impersonated identities, and two face-swap tools, DeepFaceLive and FaceFusion, injected through a virtual camera. The static calibration segment reaches a session-level AUC of 0.878 with a frozen UCF spatial detector, while the mean across the active-gesture windows reaches 0.988. Pose and combined gestures have the highest point estimates, whereas expressions show no clear improvement. Hand occlusion against FaceFusion, configured with an occlusion mask, scores below the static baseline. The end-to-end time required to satisfy the validator also distinguishes attacks from genuine sessions, achieving a session-level AUC of 0.732, although this signal includes synthesis and transport delays. These results show that challenge sets should be tested against current attack configurations and that response time can provide an additional, deployment-specific signal.

</details>


### [186] [VisExMEM: Visual Evidence-Based Explainable Multimodal Evaluation Metric](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16441)
*Subhadeep Roy,Christoph Leiter,Steffen Eger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出VisExMEM，一个无参考的图像-文本评估器，通过将caption分解为原子断言、定位视觉证据并逐一验证，实现可解释的细粒度评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像-文本评估多依赖全局分数，难以揭示哪些语义细节被图像支持；可解释指标虽提供理由，但支撑理由的视觉证据仍难以验证。

Method: 将caption分解为原子断言，定位每条断言的视觉证据并验证，再将claim-level支持度平均为全局分数；解释与决策共享同一证据。基于Qwen3.5训练4B和9B模型，使用100K样本，采用多任务SFT、反事实精炼和证据感知GDPO。

Result: 在八个基准上，VisExMEM-9B取得开源评估器中最高的描述性综合分，超过VQAScore 11.7分，并与GPT-5.6 Sol相当；新提出的AGITA-Bench含600个人工标注图文对和8.7K原子断言。分解式提示在未调优模型上比整体提示提升3.6-5.1分。人类评估显示其解释优于以往可解释指标并接近GPT-5.6 Sol。

Conclusion: VisExMEM通过原子断言分解与证据定位，实现了兼具细粒度可解释性和强评估性能的图像-文本评估，并提供新基准AGITA-Bench推动该方向研究。

Abstract: Current image-text evaluation often relies on a global score, which gives limited insight into which semantic details are supported by the image. Explainable metrics provide rationales, but the visual evidence supporting those rationales can still be difficult to verify. We introduce VisExMEM, a reference-free evaluator that decomposes captions into atomic claims, localizes visual evidence, verifies each claim, and averages claim-level support into a global score. Explanations use the same evidence and decisions. We train Qwen3.5-based 4B and 9B models on 100K samples with multi-task SFT, counterfactual refinement, and evidence-aware GDPO. Across eight benchmarks, VisExMEM-9B achieves the highest descriptive composite among open-source evaluators in our comparison, exceeding VQAScore by 11.7 points while remaining competitive with GPT-5.6 Sol. We also introduce AGITA-Bench, containing 600 human-annotated image-text pairs and 8.7K atomic claims for global and claim-level evaluation. For untuned Qwen3.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol controls, decomposed prompting raises the same composite by 3.6-5.1 points relative to holistic prompting. Human evaluation shows that VisExMEM explanations outperform prior explainable metrics and approach GPT-5.6 Sol.

</details>


### [187] [Pixels or Code? Benchmarking Instruction-Guided Visual Artifact Operation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16444)
*Shun Guo,Shuizhou Shi,Boao Wang,Wei Xiong,Siyu Sun,Jiangtong Li,Jie Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出视觉artifact操作（VAO）任务及VAO-Bench基准，涵盖1573个任务、9类artifact和3个难度级别，评测像素、代码、agent三类范式在直接编辑、依赖更新、内容保持等维度的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图表、技术图示、网页、文档等视觉artifact是科研、商业和工程流程的基础，其编辑需要直接修改、依赖感知更新、保持未受影响内容和满足领域约束，但此前基准仅测试部分问题（如图表级联更新），缺乏跨视觉领域、跨范式（像素/代码/agent）在同一图像输入协议下的统一评测。

Method: 提出VAO-Bench基准，包含1,573个经人工筛选的任务，覆盖9类artifact和3个难度级别；使用可执行artifact和确定性渲染追踪参考变换，并标注直接编辑、依赖更新与保持约束；所有系统使用相同的源图像和指令，统一评测像素空间编辑器、代码生成多模态系统和工具使用agent。

Result: 实验表明可执行代码系统更能支持依赖更新，像素空间编辑器执行更快且视觉质量强；显式声明依赖能同时提升两类范式，说明隐式更新推理是核心瓶颈。

Conclusion: VAO-Bench为跨生成范式的可靠视觉artifact编辑提供了可复现的基础。

Abstract: Visual artifacts such as charts, technical diagrams, webpages, and document pages underpin scientific, commercial, and engineering workflows. Editing these artifacts requires direct modification, dependency-aware updates, preservation of unaffected content, and compliance with domain constraints. We define this capability as Visual Artifact Operation (VAO). Prior benchmarks test parts of this problem, including cascading updates in charts. We study direct edits, dependent updates, and preservation across visual domains and pixel, code, and agent paradigms under one image-only protocol. We introduce Visual Artifact Operation Bench (VAO-Bench), comprising 1,573 manually screened tasks across nine artifact categories and three difficulty levels. VAO-Bench uses executable artifacts and deterministic rendering to trace reference transformations and annotate direct edits, dependent updates, and preservation constraints. All systems receive the same source image and instruction; we evaluate pixel-space editors, code-generating multimodal systems, and tool-using agents on direct-edit accuracy, dependency-aware update, content preservation, domain validity, and visual quality. Experiments show that executable-code systems better support dependent updates, while pixel-space editors offer faster execution and strong visual quality. Explicitly stating dependencies improves both paradigms, identifying implicit-update inference as a central bottleneck. VAO-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for dependable visual artifact editing across generation paradigms.

</details>


### [188] [Tikhonov-Stabilized Bezier Representation Forecasting for Training-free Diffusion Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16448)
*Lei Zhu,Mujie Lin,Ruochong Zheng,Guangyi Wang,Hao Li,Peng Jin,Chang Liu,Jie Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BeziCast：一种无需训练、通过低阶Bézier轨迹预测输出近端去噪表示的扩散模型加速框架，在FLUX.1上最高加速4.79倍、HunyuanVideo上最高4.11倍，且生成质量显著优于竞品。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型（尤其Diffusion Transformers）推理成本高，因需反复评估去噪器。现有特征缓存方法多依赖泰勒式有限差分外推，在长缓存间隔下不稳定，且预测局部模块输出会导致误差在后续去噪块中累积。

Method: BeziCast无需训练，用低阶Bézier轨迹预测输出近端去噪表示；通过Tikhonov稳定拟合估计Bézier控制点，实现平滑、容量可控的时间参数化，避免显式高阶导数估计，并将轨迹容量与缓存查询密度解耦。为抑制激进外推，推导等价预测权重并引入凸包启发的护栏，检测高风险预测并软性拉向保守的单纯形投影估计。

Result: 在先进图像与视频扩散模型上广泛评估，BeziCast使FLUX.1最高加速4.79倍、HunyuanVideo最高加速4.11倍，同时保持显著优于竞争加速基线的生成质量。

Conclusion: BeziCast是一种部署友好、无需重训练或修改采样器的扩散加速方案，通过Bézier轨迹预测与护栏机制在加速与质量间取得更好平衡。

Abstract: Diffusion models, particularly Diffusion Transformers, achieve strong image and video generation quality but remain expensive at inference time due to repeated denoiser evaluations. Feature caching offers a deployment-friendly acceleration strategy by reusing or predicting intermediate representations without retraining the generator or modifying the sampler. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods often rely on Taylor-style finite-difference extrapolation, which can become unstable over longer cache intervals, and typically predict local module outputs whose errors may accumulate through subsequent denoiser blocks. We propose \textbf{BeziCast}, a training-free diffusion acceleration framework that forecasts output-proximal denoising representations using low-order B'ezier trajectories. BeziCast estimates B'ezier control points via Tikhonov-stabilized fitting, providing a smooth, capacity-controlled temporal parameterization that avoids explicit high-order derivative estimation and decouples trajectory capacity from cache-query density. To moderate aggressive extrapolation, we further derive equivalent forecasting weights and introduce a convex-hull-inspired guardrail that detects high-risk predictions and softly pulls them toward a conservative simplex-projected estimate. Extensive evaluations across advanced image and video diffusion models demonstrate the effectiveness of BeziCast. In particular, BeziCast accelerates FLUX.1 by up to (4.79\times) and HunyuanVideo by up to (4.11\times), while preserving substantially better generation quality than competing acceleration baselines.

</details>


### [189] [Not Every Cue Is Evidence: Cue Supportability for Forensic Distillation in Face Forgery Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16452)
*Binjia Zhou,Dawei Luo,Shuai Chen,Feng Xu,Haoyuan Li,Jia wen Seow,Jiachi Wang,Jie Lei,Zunlei Feng,Yijun Bei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"双支撑性审计"方法，在知识蒸馏前过滤特权线索，以解决可解释人脸伪造检测中的"答对证据错"(CAWE)问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可解释人脸伪造检测需要图像支撑的取证证据，但训练线索来自伪造生成流程，而模型所获图像质量与分辨率有限，难以观察到这些细粒度痕迹。将此类线索作为特权监督会加剧问题，使学生被教导去表达其无法感知的证据，导致模板化或过度泛化的表述，引发"答对证据错"(CAWE)失败。

Method: 提出双支撑性审计，在蒸馏前过滤特权线索。每条候选线索需同时满足两个条件：(1) 可从剩余特权上下文中预测；(2) 与当前图像中高归因的视觉区域存在因果关联。仅同时满足两条件的线索才获得实质性蒸馏权重，从而防止无支撑细节泄漏给学生。

Result: 在八个基准测试上，该方法在保持或提升检测准确率的同时，相比现有范式显著提高了可解释性/解释忠实度。

Conclusion: 通过在蒸馏前对特权线索进行双重支撑性过滤，可有效缓解CAWE失败，在保证检测性能的同时提升解释忠实度。

Abstract: Explainable face forgery detection requires not only correct judgments but also forensic evidence supported by the input image. However, training cues are typically derived from the forgery generation pipeline. Since images available to the model are of limited quality and resolution, it is difficult to observe the fine-grained traces these cues refer to. Training methods that further supply such cues as privileged supervision exacerbate the problem, as the student is taught to articulate evidence it cannot perceive. The student consequently resorts to templated or over-generalized expressions, giving rise to the correct-answer, wrong-evidence (CAWE) failure. We propose a dual supportability audit that filters privileged cues before distillation. Each candidate cue must be predictable from the remaining privileged context and causally tied to high-attribution visual regions in the current image. Only cues satisfying both conditions receive substantial distillation weight, preventing unsupported details from leaking into the student. Experiments across eight benchmarks show that our method maintains or improves detection accuracy while significantly raising explanation faithfulness compared to existing paradigms.

</details>


### [190] [Teaching Vision-Language Models to Decline: Support Completion Against Mirage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16465)
*Alfaj Uddin Ahmed,Md. Shaown Miah,Md Arid Hasan,Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed,Sayeed Shafayet Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出TIDE训练目标，让模型在缺失图像证据时学会拒绝回答，以缓解视觉语言模型的"mirage"（幻觉）问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型会对从未见过的图像作答，这种"mirage"失败中答案可能正确但缺乏证据支撑，在缺乏输入核查的场景下危害很大。作者将问题归因于交叉熵目标：它仅靠答案与图像的互信息区分"看图"与"忽略图"，且没有训练样本奖励"拒绝回答"。

Method: 提出support completion（TIDE）：除正常问题外，额外提供空白图像、同域错误图像、域外图像三种反事实条件，目标要求模型在这些情况下拒绝作答，并给出理论证明。

Result: 理论证明：TIDE下所有图像盲预测器每例至少次优1.04 nats；最优解恰在反事实类型上拒绝且保持有效图像行为；任何有限模型的答/拒决策误差下界由有效与无效证据的可分性决定。Qwen2.5-VL-7B实验：三条件前身将无效证据mirage率从0.759降至0.097，空白图像率从0.700降至0.003，误拒代价0.126；无标签grounding反而升至0.859，似然优势对比仅0.718。

Conclusion: TIDE通过构造反事实拒绝样本可有效抑制mirage，但错误的正则化会重新打开幻觉；四条件协议在三个基座模型上的种子与组件消融仍在进行，尚未报告。

Abstract: Vision-language models answer questions about images they were never shown, a failure called mirage. Such an answer can be correct without being justified by the evidence, and the difference matters wherever a model's output is checked by someone who did not see its input. We locate the failure in the training objective: cross-entropy separates a model that reads the image from one that ignores it by only the conditional mutual information between answer and image, and no training example rewards declining. We formalise support completion, TIDE, which also shows each training question with a blank image, a same-domain wrong image and an out-of-domain image, with targets that decline, and prove that under TIDE every image-blind predictor is suboptimal by at least 1.04 nats per example, that the optimum declines exactly on the counterfactual kinds while keeping its behaviour on valid images, and that for any finite model the error of its answer-or-decline decision, declining on valid input plus answering on invalid input, is bounded below by how well its representation separates valid from invalid evidence. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B under a frozen held-out protocol with two judges, the three-condition predecessor of TIDE reduced the invalid-evidence mirage rate from 0.759 to 0.097 and the blank-image rate from 0.700 to 0.003 at a false-abstention cost of 0.126; label-free grounding raised the rate to 0.859, a likelihood-advantage contrast moved it only to 0.718 because its empty-image term carries no gradient, and grounding applied after support completion re-opened the mirage. The four-condition protocol on three base models, with seeds and component ablations, is in progress and not reported here.

</details>


### [191] [Auditing Observation-Quality Shortcuts in the Evaluation of Person-Centered Motion for Video Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16471)
*Chaehyun Kim,Changwon Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 视频异常检测中，人体观测质量（检测、姿态估计、追踪）可能成为捷径，导致基于运动的异常判别被高估。本文提出观测质量感知评估框架，发现控制质量后多线索运动确实优于仅质量特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VAD方法报告的高性能可能并非源于对异常运动的理解，而是来自人体检测、姿态估计和追踪可靠性差异带来的观测质量捷径。作者希望验证基于运动的异常判别究竟反映任务相关的运动信息，还是观测质量差异。

Method: 提出观测质量感知评估框架，包含四部分：质量诊断、质量平衡、运动正交化、鲁棒性分析。在UCF-Crime以人为中心的类别上，先比较仅质量特征与多线索运动特征的判别力，再通过基数匹配（cardinality matching）将11个质量变量控制在预设边际平衡阈值以下，最后用Logistic Regression、Random Forest和RBF-SVM评估运动判别是否仍占优。

Result: 原始队列中，仅质量特征即可匹敌甚至超过多线索运动的判别力，揭示强烈的观测质量捷径。经基数匹配后，多线索运动在三种分类器上一致优于仅质量特征，ROC-AUC提升0.046–0.141。但非线性仅质量预测在匹配后仍高于随机水平，说明结果体现的是超出已测量边际质量的额外判别力，而非无质量依赖或因果性的运动理解。

Conclusion: 高VAD性能不能直接解读为异常运动建模能力，必须审计人体观测流程的可靠性。本文提供了系统化协议，用于评估观测质量捷径，并检验运动判别在显式控制检测、姿态估计与追踪可靠性后是否依然成立。

Abstract: Video anomaly detection (VAD) identifies deviations from normal patterns, but such deviations do not necessarily correspond to safety-critical events. We focus on human-centered emergencies and violence and investigate whether motion-based anomaly discrimination reflects task-relevant motion information or observation-quality differences arising from person detection, pose estimation, and tracking. We introduce an observation-quality-aware evaluation framework that combines quality diagnostics, quality balancing, motion orthogonalization, and robustness analyses. On human-centered categories of UCF-Crime, quality-only features match or exceed the discrimination of multi-cue motion in the original cohort, revealing a strong observation-quality shortcut. After cardinality matching brings all 11 measured quality variables below a prespecified marginal balance threshold, multi-cue motion consistently outperforms quality-only features across Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and RBF-SVM, yielding ROC-AUC gains of 0.046-0.141. Because nonlinear quality-only prediction remains above chance after matching, we interpret this result as additional discrimination beyond measured marginal quality rather than as evidence of quality-free or causal motion understanding.
