TL;DR: 论文通过挖掘40万目标数据库并引入SSFA方法，揭示多模态3D检测融合中三个不成立假设，并构建模态可靠性图注入检测器提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多模态3D检测假设相机与LiDAR广泛互补，但各模态在特定位置的信任权重由学习得到，既无法刻画也不可审计。作者希望将可靠性从权重中"解放"出来，作为一个可在部署前审查的量。

Method: 按检测到目标的模态对每个真值目标打标签，跨nuScenes、KITTI、Waymo构建0.4M目标数据库；提出Spatially Stratified Feature Attribution (SSFA)，将Shapley归因条件化于距离区间以暴露全局归因平均掉的结构；将挖掘的结构编译为Modality Reliability Map，通过轻量注意力层注入四个预训练融合检测器。

Result: 发现模态偏好边界跟随物体本身（交通锥被相机单独看到的概率接近卡车的6倍，16.8% vs 2.9%，与距离无关）；相机单模态检测在10-30m达到峰值，落在通常让给LiDAR的区间；失败驱动因素不可叠加，距离-密度交互作用超过视角主效应；模态主导具有方向非平稳性，车后物体比车前更偏LiDAR。注入可靠性图后性能提升最多1.3 mAP，仅微调不到4%参数，2-3 GPU小时。

Conclusion: 可靠性可以被显式刻画和审查，而非隐藏在融合权重中，这是多模态感知安全度量应当依赖的基础。

Abstract: Multi-modal fusion for 3D object detection assumes that cameras and LiDAR are broadly complementary. In practice, how much each modality is trusted at a given location is decided by learned weights that are neither characterized nor auditable. We label every ground-truth object by which modalities detected it, then mine the resulting 0.4M-object database across nuScenes, KITTI, and Waymo. Because the patterns shift with distance from the ego vehicle, we read the mined model through Spatially Stratified Feature Attribution (SSFA), which conditions Shapley attribution on distance zones and exposes structure that global attribution averages away. Three assumptions built into the current fusion design do not hold. The modality-preference boundary tracks the object itself: a traffic cone is nearly six times as likely as a truck to be seen by the camera alone (16.8% vs. 2.9%), regardless of range. Camera-only detections peak at 10-30 m, inside the band usually ceded to LiDAR, and fall away on either side. The drivers of failure are not additive either: the distance - density interaction alone outweighs the entire main effect of viewing direction. We further find that modality dominance is directionally non-stationary, with objects behind the vehicle being markedly more LiDAR-dominant than those in front. We compile the mined structure into a Modality Reliability Map and inject it into four pretrained fusion detectors through a lightweight attention layer. This improves performance by up to 1.3 mean Average Precision (mAP) while fine-tuning under 4% of their parameters in 2-3 GPU-hours. Our work lifts reliability out of the weights and treats it as a quantity that can be examined before deployment. That is what a safety measure for multi-modal perception must rest on.

</details>


### [227] [ConDenseDrive: Knowledge-Dense, Token-Sparse Visual Encoder for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16908)
*Shengzhen Li,Yongkang Li,Hao Gao,Chenxi Wu,Yajing Sun,Lu Hou,Wenyu Liu,Xinggang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ConDenseDrive 提出一种"知识密集、token 稀疏"的视觉编码器，通过三阶段训练提升端到端自动驾驶的表征质量与推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端驾驶系统多用通用图像预训练初始化视觉编码器，并逐帧/逐视角密集处理所有 patch token，导致表征质量受限、推理效率低。

Method: 三阶段框架：(1) 从三个视觉基础模型蒸馏视觉、语义、几何知识，使编码器"知识密集"；(2) 将编码器适配多帧端到端驾驶，把时空上下文整合进 register token 用于规划；(3) 采用 register 引导的 token 压缩，实现"token 稀疏"，减少冗余 patch 计算。

Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 上取得 94.5 PDMS，NAVSIM v2 上 90.8 EPDMS；HUGSIM 零样本评估达 37.4 HD-Score；token 压缩带来 2.0× 加速并同时提升规划性能。

Conclusion: 视觉编码器设计是通向可靠、高效端到端自动驾驶的有效路径。

Abstract: End-to-end driving requires rich spatiotemporal representations to support scene understanding and trajectory planning under strict latency constraints. However, most systems initialize their visual encoders from generic image pretraining and densely process all patch tokens for each camera view and input frame, limiting both representation quality and inference efficiency. To address these challenges, we present ConDenseDrive, a knowledge-dense and token-sparse visual encoder for end-to-end autonomous driving. Our three-stage framework first makes the encoder knowledge-dense by distilling complementary visual, semantic, and geometric knowledge from three vision foundation models. It then adapts the distilled encoder to multi-frame end-to-end driving and integrates spatiotemporal context into register tokens for planning. Finally, it makes the encoder token-sparse by applying register-guided token compression, reducing redundant patch computation and yielding a 2.0$\times$ speedup while improving planning performance. ConDenseDrive achieves 94.5 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.8 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, and reaches 37.4 HD-Score in zero-shot evaluation on HUGSIM. Extensive experiments and qualitative analyses demonstrate that visual encoder design provides an effective route to reliable and efficient end-to-end driving.

</details>


### [228] [FOCUS: A Subspecialty Foundation Model for Intraoperative Central Nervous System Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16914)
*Xing Liu,Yifan Guo,Hongtai Lv,Lei Lou,Yuyi Tan,Jiang Du,Xijia Zhang,Ming Zhang,Chao Pang,Minglei Li,Wei Liu,Xiaobo Zhu,Song Zhang,Rong Yu,Hanlin Shu,Wenzhuo Xu,Tao Jiang,Cheng Lu,Jie Tian,Qing Chang,Zhenyu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FOCUS是一个在中枢神经系统冰冻切片上预训练的专科病理基础模型，在诊断和生物标志物预测任务上表现领先，并能显著辅助神经病理医生进行术中诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 术中冰冻切片诊断对CNS病变的手术决策至关重要，但受限于伪影、诊断复杂性和时间压力；现有病理基础模型对CNS冰冻组织暴露不足。

Method: 构建FOCUS基础模型，在27,930张富集CNS组织的冰冻切片上预训练；设计11项内部诊断任务和12项生物标志物预测任务；将10项诊断任务组织为WHO对齐的诊断层级，并单独评估淋巴瘤检测；由6位神经病理医生进行读者评估。

Result: 诊断任务平均AUC为0.969，生物标志物预测任务平均AUC为0.877，在时间和外部队列中保持领先。FOCUS辅助使初级读者在层级诊断中接近或超过无辅助的高级读者，并将初级读者的淋巴瘤敏感度从81.6%提升至94.7%。

Conclusion: FOCUS可提高诊断准确性和精细度，辅助淋巴瘤相关切除决策并提供临时分子信息，展现为术中CNS病理提供稳健、临床可操作支持的潜力。

Abstract: Intraoperative frozen-section diagnosis of central nervous system (CNS) lesions guides surgical decisions but is challenged by artefacts, diagnostic complexity and time constraints. Most pathology foundation models have limited exposure to CNS frozen tissue. Here we present FOCUS, a subspecialty foundation model pretrained on 27,930 frozen-sections enriched for CNS tissue. FOCUS led 11 internal diagnostic and 12 biomarker-prediction tasks, with mean AUCs of 0.969 and 0.877, respectively, retaining leading performance in temporal and external cohorts. To provide more comprehensive diagnostic information, we further organized ten diagnostic tasks into a WHO-aligned diagnostic hierarchy and separately evaluated FOCUS for lymphoma detection, a critical task for intraoperative surgical decision-making. In reader assessments by six neuropathologists, FOCUS assistance enabled junior readers to approach or exceed unassisted senior readers in hierarchical diagnosis and raised junior readers' lymphoma sensitivity from 81.6% to 94.7%. FOCUS could improve diagnostic accuracy and granularity, inform lymphoma-related resection decisions and provide provisional molecular information. Such capabilities highlight the potential of FOCUS to provide robust, clinically actionable support for intraoperative CNS pathology.

</details>


### [229] [UniMetric: Universal Metric Scale Recovery for Visual Geometry Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16945)
*Lei Yang,Yuner Zhang,Ziyang Liu,Ziying Song,Kai WU,Yiyang Gao,Jiangtao Su,Yiming Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniMetric无需额外传感器或度量监督，利用VLM对熟悉物体的高度先验，为几何基础模型恢复共享度量尺度，并发布MetricBench评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态基础模型推动了具身推理，用互联网视频做具身预训练需可靠的物理尺度标注；但视觉几何基础模型重建场景结构与相机运动时常缺失可信的度量尺度。

Method: 提出UniMetric训练无关的通用度量尺度恢复框架：先由度量先验获取从VLM提取物体高度区间；语义-几何对齐沿支撑面法向测量各帧重建物体高度，将先验转为尺度区间；全局尺度恢复用凸目标协调区间，重叠时得联合可行尺度，否则得唯一折中，并统一应用于重建点与相机平移。

Result: 真实VLM先验实验表明结合多观测可提升尺度精度；提出含12个具身子集的MetricBench。在9个几何基础模型上，平均深度Abs Rel、重建Chamfer距离、轨迹误差分别降低54.2%、83.8%、65.6%，三项任务上均全面提升。

Conclusion: 熟悉物体的不确定尺寸先验可联合约束重建共享尺度，UniMetric为GFM提供无需监督的度量尺度恢复，并开源代码与MetricBench数据。

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models, exemplified by GPT-6 Astra, raise the prospect of general-purpose embodied reasoning and planning. Using Internet videos for embodied pretraining calls for reliable physical-scale annotations. Yet visual geometry foundation models often recover scene structure and camera motion without reliable metric scale. We show that uncertain size priors of familiar objects can jointly constrain a reconstruction's shared scale. Building on this insight, we present UniMetric, a universal and training-free metric scale recovery framework for geometry foundation models, without additional sensors or task-specific metric supervision. Specifically, Metric Prior Acquisition elicits object height intervals from a vision-language model. Semantic-Geometric Alignment measures reconstructed object heights along the estimated support-surface normal in each frame and converts the priors into scale intervals. Global Scale Recovery reconciles these intervals through a convex objective, yielding a jointly feasible scale when they overlap and a unique compromise otherwise. The estimated sequence-level scale is applied uniformly to reconstructed points and camera translations. Controlled experiments with real VLM priors show that combining observations improves scale accuracy with exact relative object heights. To evaluate metric accuracy on GFM reconstructions without ground-truth scale alignment, we introduce MetricBench, covering twelve embodied, driving, and roadside subsets with sensor-derived ground truth. Across nine geometry foundation models, UniMetric reduces mean depth Abs Rel, reconstruction Chamfer distance, and trajectory error by 54.2%, 83.8%, and 65.6%, respectively, improving every model on all three tasks at the suite level. We release the UniMetric code and MetricBench data.

</details>


### [230] [DDVR-Net: Degradation-Aware Decoupling and Visibility-Guided Restoration for Historical Document Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16956)
*Jiu Sha,Yu Weng,Mengxiao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DDVR-Net，通过退化感知解耦与可见性引导修复，解决历史文档混合可见性字符识别难题，并构建藏、蒙、维三种低资源语言基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史文档存在墨水侵蚀、结构损坏等严重退化，导致字符序列可见性混杂。传统OCR在证据有限时表现不佳，而上下文语言模型可能过度修正视觉上清晰的字符。

Method: DDVR-Net在特征层面将内在字形结构与物理损坏解耦，预测局部可见性以估计字符可靠性；通过可见性引导门选择性激活上下文解码器，在修复退化字符的同时保留清晰视觉识别。此外构建覆盖藏文、蒙文、维吾尔文的低资源多语言基准，含18.7万文档对，结合大规模合成数据、渐进训练与真实标注缩小合成-真实差距。

Result: 在三种语言及多种阅读顺序下，DDVR-Net持续优于现有方法。

Conclusion: DDVR-Net为低资源历史文档识别提供了有效框架与基准，代码与基准已开源。

Abstract: Historical document analysis is crucial for cultural heritage preservation and low-resource language digitization. However, real historical documents often suffer from severe degradation, such as ink erosion and structural damage, causing mixed-visibility character sequences. Conventional OCR systems struggle in such evidence-limited scenarios, while contextual language models may over-correct visually clear characters. To address these challenges, we propose DDVR-Net, a degradation-aware decoupling and visibility-guided restoration framework for historical document recognition. DDVR-Net decouples intrinsic glyph structures from physical corruption at the feature level and predicts local visibility to estimate character reliability. A contextual decoder is selectively activated through a visibility-guided gate, restoring degraded characters while preserving clear visual recognition. Furthermore, we construct a low-resource multilingual benchmark covering Tibetan, Mongolian, and Uyghur scripts with 187000 document pairs, combining large-scale synthetic data and progressive training with real-world annotations to reduce the synthetic-to-real gap. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DDVR-Net consistently outperforms existing methods across three languages and diverse reading orders, providing an effective framework and benchmark for low-resource historical document recognition. Code and Benchmark: https://github.com/Shajiu/DDVR-Net

</details>


### [231] [Proactive Physical AI through Continuous Observation and Timely Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16967)
*Zhenhua Yang,Jiafeng Liang,Xingyu Zhou,Yi Jiang,Xiayu Cao,Zui Chen,Luqi Wang,Haiyang Sun,Yufei Xiang,Chang Li,Rongchuan Mu,Bowen Chi,Zihe Tong,Mingyu Li,Huijie Ma,Yiqiao Yang,Baoqi Ren,Zhiming Ma,Zhihao Zhu,Jiahao Ji,Zhuoyao Wang,Qianyu Wang,Xiangyu Liu,Wang Zixiang,Shunliang Zhang,Ming Liu,Xiaocheng Feng,Duyu Tang,Bing Qin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Proactive Physical AI概念，开发ProAgent系统，通过主动时机模型StreamingJev和响应模型实现物理世界中的主动干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Physical AI围绕显式指定任务展开，但现实中重要任务往往在人们明确表述前就从持续变化的世界状态中涌现，需要系统主动识别并适时干预。

Method: 构建端到端系统ProAgent，包含两个组件：Jev风格的主动时机模型StreamingJev（判断是否需要及何时干预）和响应模型（生成回应或调用设备能力执行物理动作）；并设计自动化数据管道将视频转化为主动时机的监督数据以支持大规模学习。

Result: 实验显示在显式目标和固定角色两种设定下均具强主动性能，相比源骨干基线实现更准确的干预时机和更少误触发；真实机器人评估验证了识别新现需求并转化为适当物理动作的能力。

Conclusion: Proactive Physical AI是任务驱动Physical AI的互补方向，ProAgent证明系统能主动识别并适时响应物理世界中的新现需求，具备实际部署潜力。

Abstract: Physical AI is commonly formulated around an explicitly specified task: given a goal or instruction, a system perceives, reasons, and acts. In many real-world settings, however, important tasks emerge from continuously changing world states before a person explicitly formulates them. We study this complementary problem as Proactive Physical AI, where an AI system continuously observes the physical world, identifies situations that warrant intervention, and initiates appropriate actions at the right time. We develop ProAgent, an end-to-end system built around two components: a Jev-style proactive timing model (dubbed StreamingJev) that determines whether and when intervention is needed, and a Response Model that generates responses for people or invokes available device capabilities for physical execution. To support learning at scale, we develop an automated data pipeline that converts videos into supervision for proactive timing. Experiments demonstrate strong proactive performance under both explicit objectives and standing roles, combining more accurate intervention timing with fewer false triggers than the source-backbone baseline. Real-robot evaluations further demonstrate ProAgent's ability to identify emerging needs and translate them into appropriate physical actions.

</details>


### [232] [The Value of Being Wrong: Self-Mined Visual In-Context Learning from Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16977)
*Shu Zhao,Tan Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SMILE：用模型自身错误构建离线困难负样本池，测试时以预测为方向信号检索最可能复发的历史错误作为反事实演示，统一支持闭集分类和开放视觉问答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉上下文学习效果高度依赖演示样例选择；现有反事实选择方法需多阶段流水线（属性抽取、描述工程、组合图像匹配），复杂且昂贵。

Method: 观察到模型自身预测错误即为天然反事实演示，能直接编码其失败模式。SMILE离线记录目标VLM的错误，构建模型专属困难负样本池；测试时将预测作为方向信号，在语义嵌入空间中检索当前查询最可能复发的历史错误，无需任务特定设计。

Result: 在四个基准和四个VLM上，SMILE相比SOTA基线平均任务得分提升+3.09分，同时延迟降低5倍。

Conclusion: 利用模型自身错误作为反事实演示是更简单有效的视觉ICL选择范式，兼顾性能与效率，并统一适用于分类与开放问答。

Abstract: Visual in-context learning (ICL) enables vision-language models (VLMs) to adapt at test time via demonstration examples, but its effectiveness depends critically on the examples selected. Recent counterfactual selection methods improve ICL by constructing demonstrations that expose how individual attribute changes affect the answer. However, they require multi-stage pipelines involving attribute extraction, caption engineering, and composed image matching. We propose a simpler alternative grounded in a key observation: a model's own prediction errors are natural counterfactual demonstrations that directly encode its failure modes. Our method, SMILE (Self-Mined Visual In-Context Learning from Errors), builds a model-specific pool of hard negatives offline by recording the target VLM's own mistakes. At test time, the prediction serves as a direction signal that surfaces, in the semantic embedding space, the past mistakes most likely to recur for the current query. This prediction-conditioned identification provides a unified mechanism for both closed-set classification and open-ended visual question answering without task-specific design. Across four benchmarks and four VLMs, SMILE delivers an average task-score gain of +3.09 points over the SOTA baseline at 5x lower latency. Project page: https://tree-shu-zhao.github.io/SMILE/

</details>


### [233] [AUGUstus: Autonomous Driving VLA Model with Unified Generation and Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16985)
*Yuqi Ye,Caigao Jiang,Zhuonan Wang,Congyuan Pei,Chao Qu,Changhao Peng,Junhong Lin,Qize Yu,Zetian Song,Guangzhao Fu,Chongruo Wu,Shiyu Huang,Shuchang Zhou,Honggou Yang,Wei Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 AUGUstus，将扩散动作生成与自回归 CoT 理解统一于一个 VLA 模型，仅用 CoT 辅助动作生成，实现低延迟、安全可解释的自动驾驶规划，多项基准达 SOTA 并可在实车 12 Hz 运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 自动驾驶模型存在两难：1) 退化为 VA 模型，直接回归/流生成动作但未充分利用 VLM 理解，导致动作不安全且不可解释；2) 自回归方法串行生成 CoT 与动作，充分利用理解但延迟高，难以部署。目标是在保留 CoT 辅助动作生成的同时实现低延迟部署。

Method: 提出 AUGUstus，在单一模型中统一扩散式动作生成与自回归 CoT 理解，理解仅服务于生成。通过联合 CoT 监督在共享表示中保留 VLM 空间理解；AUGUstus-mode 将动作生成排在 CoT 之前，使 CoT 在训练时监督可靠动作，推理只需动作输出以降低延迟；并设计统一的 AUGUstus-GRPO 算法联合优化动作与 CoT。

Result: NAVSIMv1 达 94.6 PDMS，NAVSIMv2 达 90.7 EPDMS，为无 scorer 模块的 SOTA 规划；nuScenes 上平均 L2 误差 0.27 m、平均碰撞率 0.05%，优于对比方法。使用 512 张 H800 GPU 训练约 2 天，在内部 1000 km 数据集评测并初步部署于实车，实现 12 Hz 运行。

Conclusion: AUGUstus 通过统一理解与生成、动作优先的 CoT 监督与统一 GRPO 优化，兼顾 VLM 理解利用与低延迟推理，在多个基准取得 SOTA，并验证了实车部署的实用性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models show strong potential for end-to-end autonomous driving by leveraging world knowledge and understanding to excel in long-tail scenarios. However, current VLAs have two limitations: 1) Degeneration into vision-action (VA) models. For low latency, regression/flow-based methods directly generate actions but underuse VLM understanding, causing unsafe, unexplainable actions. 2) Autoregressive high latency. Autoregressive methods sequentially generate chain-of-thought (CoT) and action tokens, fully leveraging VLM understanding, but high latency hinders deployment. To enable low-latency deployment while using CoT to assist action generation, we propose AUGUstus, an Autonomous-driving VLA model with Unified Generation and Understanding. We unify diffusion-based action generation and autoregressive CoT understanding in one model, where understanding only serves generation. Joint CoT supervision preserves VLM spatial understanding in shared representation for safer, more accurate trajectories. AUGUstus-mode orders action generation before CoT, so CoT supervises reliable actions during training while inference needs only action output, enabling low latency. AUGUstus-GRPO, a unified GRPO algorithm, jointly optimizes action and CoT, improving action performance. Experiments show AUGUstus achieves 94.6 PDMS on NAVSIMv1 and 90.7 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2, SOTA planning without scorer module. On nuScenes, it achieves average L2 error 0.27 m and average collision rate 0.05%, best among compared methods. To validate AUGUstus practicality, we train on in-house data with 512 NVIDIA H800 GPUs for ~2 days, evaluate on an internal 1,000 km dataset, and preliminarily deploy on a real vehicle, achieving 12 Hz operation. Project page: https://augustus-ad.github.io

</details>


### [234] [Self-Supervised Learning of Semantically Consistent Visual Features via a Simple 3D Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16988)
*Sebastian Day,Oisin Mac Aodha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督方法，通过对比学习和数据集级分布匹配学习拓扑复杂类别的视觉特征，无需昂贵的实例级分析合成，提升语义对应质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DINOv2、Stable Diffusion等视觉模型提取的特征在语义对应上存在局限，如无法区分对称或重复部件的左右；已有改进依赖监督数据（关键点、相机位姿）或限制性拓扑假设（将对象建模为3D球体）。

Method: 采用简单先验的自监督方法：不依赖实例级分析合成，而是利用对比学习与全局数据集级分布匹配学习类别的粗略形状与外观，并结合额外几何损失，使特征复现真实图像的全局与局部统计特性。

Result: 在多个具有挑战性的物体类别上给出定量结果，验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该自监督方法能学习拓扑复杂类别的特征，克服现有特征在对称/重复部件上的歧义问题，为高质语义对应提供新途径。

Abstract: Visual features extracted from vision models like DINOv2 or Stable Diffusion enable high quality semantic correspondence between images. However, such features exhibit documented limitations that hinder accurate correspondence estimation such as the inability to disambiguate the left from right for categories exhibiting symmetries or repeated parts. Previous attempts to improve these features rely on using supervised data such as annotated keypoint pairs or camera pose information, or make restrictive topological assumptions, such as modelling the object of interest as a 3D sphere. We introduce a new self-supervised approach that allows us to learn features for topologically complex object categories using a simple prior. Instead of relying on an expensive instance-level analysis by synthesis pipeline, our approach makes use of contrastive learning and distribution matching at the global dataset-level to learn the coarse shape and appearance of a category. Combined with additional geometric losses, this enables us to replicate the global and local statistics of visual features which match those that are extracted from real images. Quantitative results are presented across several challenging object categories, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [235] [MaskSense: Confronting the Visual Exploration Trap in Masked Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17009)
*Yawen Shao,Jie Xiao,Kai Zhu,Yu Liu,Hongchen Luo,Xueyang Fu,Yang Cao,Wei Zhai,Zheng-Jun Zha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MaskSense，针对掩码生成模型（MGM）中RL探索与贪婪解码冲突的问题，在采样和优化阶段缓解“视觉探索陷阱”，在文本到图像任务上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将GRPO直接用于MGM时存在根本冲突：MGM的利用式解码缺乏GRPO所需的探索多样性。作者揭示“视觉探索陷阱”——基于置信度的采样优先解析低不确定性背景，牺牲主体多样性探索，导致生成探索空间过早坍缩。

Method: 提出MaskSense框架，包含两部分：(1) 语义锚定路由采样机制，利用语义先验保留高熵主体token探索，并通过探索-利用路由放大组内奖励方差，产生更具区分度的优势估计；(2) 全局熵转移锚定策略，识别最关键的解码步骤并将梯度更新集中于这些步骤。

Result: 在多个文本到图像基准上，MaskSense显著优于基础模型，GenEval准确率从54%提升至86%，HPS从28.89提升至36.39，达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: MaskSense通过在采样与优化阶段同时应对视觉探索陷阱，有效提升了MGM的RL对齐效果，证明了解决探索-利用冲突对掩码生成模型训练的重要性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown strong potential for aligning generative models with human intent, but adapting RL to masked generative models (MGMs) remains largely underexplored. Existing approaches that directly adapt Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to MGMs leave a foundational conflict unaddressed: MGMs' exploitative decoding nature is inherently at odds with the exploratory diversity that GRPO presupposes. In this work, we reveal a structural decoding bias termed the visual exploration trap: confidence-based sampling trades the exploration of diverse subject realizations for the greedy resolution of low-uncertainty background regions, causing premature collapse of the generative exploration space and starving GRPO of the rollout diversity it depends on. To this end, we propose MaskSense, a novel RL framework for MGMs that confronts the visual exploration trap at both the sampling and optimization stages. Specifically, we introduce a semantic anchored routing sampling mechanism that leverages semantic priors to preserve high-entropy subject token exploration while amplifying intra-group reward variance through exploratory-exploitative routing to yield more discriminative advantage estimates. Furthermore, we design a global entropy transition anchoring strategy to identify the most consequential decoding steps and concentrate gradient updates on them. Extensive experiments on multiple text-to-image benchmarks demonstrate that MaskSense substantially improves upon the base model, with GenEval accuracy improving from 54% to 86% and HPS from 28.89 to 36.39, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [236] [DIME: Scaling Facial Representation Learning via Differential Masked Autoencoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17015)
*Hao Yu,Haoyu Chen,Hui Wei,Yan Jiang,Nicu Sebe,Guoying Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DIME 是一种差分掩码自编码器，通过匹配身份图像对的差分重建来学习细粒度人脸表征，在 20M 人脸数据预训练下显著优于 MAE 及专用人脸方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉预训练任务建模单图外观，被身份、姿态、光照主导，细粒度的身份内人脸差异信号微弱，导致在人脸分析任务上出现扩展瓶颈（收益递减）。

Method: DIME 利用同一人两张图的身份共享外观在差分中被抵消的观察：对身份匹配图像对分别重建被掩码图像，并用显式差分方向监督（EDDS）使重建差分方向对齐真实差分方向；EDDS 忽略幅度，使细微变化与大幅姿态/光照变化同等重要；源隔离保证每次重建仅依赖自身图像。仅需身份标签构造预训练对，无需稠密标注，可学得具有部件级语义的稠密表征。

Result: 在 20M 高分辨率人脸图像上预训练。随数据从 6M 增至 20M，AU 检测持续提升：BP4D F1 提高 5.9 点，而 MAE 仅提升 0.5 点。在 AU 检测、AU 强度估计、跨域反欺骗、关键点定位、头部姿态估计、人脸解析和人脸生成等任务上均优于专用人脸方法。

Conclusion: 通过差分建模范式规避人脸表征学习的扩展瓶颈，DIME 证明身份匹配差分信号能有效驱动细粒度人脸表征学习，并具备良好的可扩展性。

Abstract: Scaling up data and model capacity has driven substantial progress in visual representation learning. However, conventional pretext tasks exhibit diminishing returns on fine-grained facial analysis. We attribute this to a scaling bottleneck: these tasks model each image's appearance and are dominated by identity, pose, and illumination, so subtle within-identity facial differences contribute little to the training signal. We introduce DIME, a differential masked autoencoder for large-scale facial representation learning. DIME builds on a simple observation: two images of the same person share identity-specific appearance, so their difference exposes facial changes. DIME reconstructs both masked images in an identity-matched pair and, through an Explicit Differential Direction Supervision (EDDS) objective, aligns the direction of their reconstructed difference with the true difference, while source isolation makes each reconstruction depend only on its own image. Shared appearance cancels in this difference, and because EDDS ignores magnitude, subtle facial changes count as much as large pose or illumination changes. DIME uses identity labels only to form pretraining pairs, requires no dense annotations, and learns dense facial representations with emergent part-level semantics. We pretrain DIME on 20 million high-resolution facial images consolidated from existing face datasets. DIME's AU detection performance continues to improve as pretraining data scales from 6M to 20M images, with its BP4D F1 increasing by 5.9 points, while MAE gains only 0.5 points on the same subsets. DIME also outperforms specialized facial methods on AU detection, AU intensity estimation, cross-domain anti-spoofing, landmark localization, head pose estimation, face parsing, and face generation.

</details>


### [237] [PerturbBridge: Direct Phenotypic Supervision for Cellular Perturbation Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17066)
*Yucheng Yang,Xiaoxiao Sun,Huangqingbo Sun,Elaine Sui,Emma Lundberg,Serena Yeung-Levy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PerturbBridge是一个随机数据到数据的桥模型，通过在训练中直接监督扰动特异性表型，联合优化桥回归与可微的生物响应损失，从而提升虚拟细胞模型的表型保真度与采样效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚拟细胞模型应捕捉特定扰动引起的表型，但现有基于图像的模型通常仅训练和评估以匹配真实图像分布，未显式优先考虑扰动特异的生物响应。近期方法通过强化学习后训练或推理时引导加入生物信号，引发一个核心问题：生物响应信息应在生成流程的何处进入？

Method: 提出PerturbBridge，一种随机数据到数据的桥模型，在训练时直接监督预测扰动图像中的扰动特异性表型。该方法联合优化桥回归与可微的生物响应损失，生物梯度通过冻结的图像编码器回传。此外引入基于下游分类与检索的扰动-响应评估。

Result: 在三个显微基准（扰动谱分析和亚细胞成像）上，PerturbBridge在生物保真度、图像质量和采样效率上超越CellFlux。BBBC021上机制分类分别提升5.66和7.5个百分点（形态学与学习视觉特征）；JUMP和AllenCell上检索Hit@10和Hit@1分别提升1.77和7.15个百分点；BBBC021与JUMP上以少80%的模型评估次数达到更低FID。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在训练中直接监督扰动响应可提升表型保真度，同时实现高效的细胞图像生成。

Abstract: Virtual cell models should capture phenotypes induced by specific perturbations. However, image-based models are typically trained and evaluated to match real-image distributions, which alone does not explicitly prioritize perturbation-specific biological responses. Recent approaches add biological signals through reinforcement-learning post-training or inference-time steering, raising a central question: where should biological response information enter the generative pipeline? We introduce PerturbBridge, a stochastic data-to-data bridge model that directly supervises perturbation-specific phenotypes in predicted perturbed images during training. PerturbBridge jointly optimizes bridge regression and differentiable biological response losses, with biological gradients passing through a frozen image encoder. We further introduce perturbation-response evaluations based on downstream classification and retrieval. Across three microscopy benchmarks for perturbation profiling and subcellular imaging, PerturbBridge surpasses CellFlux in biological fidelity, image quality, and sampling efficiency. On BBBC021, mechanism-of-action classification improves by 5.66 and 7.5 percentage points with morphological and learned visual features, respectively. On JUMP and AllenCell, retrieval Hit@10 and Hit@1 improve by 1.77 and 7.15 percentage points, respectively. On BBBC021 and JUMP, PerturbBridge achieves lower FID with 80% fewer model evaluations than CellFlux. Overall, these results show that directly supervising perturbation responses during training improves phenotypic fidelity while enabling efficient cellular image generation. Code is available at https://github.com/yyc1215lll-creator/PerturbBridge.

</details>


### [238] [A unified three-branch deep learning framework for automated detection and counting of wildlife in aerial imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17067)
*Zeyu Xu,Tiejun Wang,Andrew Skidmore,Megan Claase,Harry Wells,Isla Duporge,Ramiro D. Crego,Richard Lamprey*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个三分支深度学习框架（WildSeg、WildMatch、WildDet），统一完成航拍野生动物调查中的条带划分、图像重叠匹配和动物检测计数任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航拍野生动物调查的自动化需同时解决三个问题：可靠的动物检测、观测条带的一致划分，以及连续图像间重复覆盖的校正，现有方法缺乏统一且高效的解决方案。

Method: 框架分三模块：WildSeg结合杆状物分割与几何精修，从机载标记划分计数条带；WildMatch用师生蒸馏学习稠密图像对应关系，在不依赖地理定位元数据的情况下识别重叠区域；WildDet融合双尺度检测、特征融合、密度监督与空图门控，实现动物检测计数。

Result: 在南苏丹大尼罗河迁徙景观的四种羚羊斜视航拍图像上评估：WildSeg实现可靠杆提取；WildMatch以更轻更快的模型接近教师精度，且两模块在缩放图像上保持高精度；WildDet对四种物种检测均提升，相对YOLO11将计数MAE、RMSE和平均偏差分别降低21.0%、4.6%和27.8%。

Conclusion: 通过将空间调查约束与动物检测相结合，该框架为大规模航拍图像集的野生动物监测和种群调查提供了实用且计算高效的方案。

Abstract: Automating aerial wildlife surveys requires reliable animal detection, consistent delineation of observation strips, and correction for repeated coverage between successive images. We present a unified three-branch deep learning framework that integrates these tasks through WildSeg, WildMatch and WildDet. WildSeg combines rod segmentation with geometric refinement to delineate counting strips from aircraft-mounted markers. WildMatch uses teacher-student distillation to learn dense image correspondences and identify overlapping survey areas without relying on geolocation metadata. WildDet combines dual-scale detection with feature fusion, density supervision and empty-image gating to support animal detection and counting. We evaluated the framework using oblique aerial imagery of four antelope species from the Great Nile Migration Landscape in South Sudan. WildSeg achieved reliable rod extraction, while WildMatch approached teacher-level accuracy with a substantially lighter and faster model. Both modules maintained high accuracy on resized images, improving processing efficiency. WildDet improved detection performance across all four species and reduced detection-based count MAE, RMSE and mean bias by 21.0%, 4.6% and 27.8%, respectively, relative to YOLO11. By connecting spatial survey constraints with animal detection, the framework provides a practical and computationally efficient approach to processing large aerial image collections for wildlife monitoring and population surveys.

</details>


### [239] [Rethinking LLM-Guided Visual Question Answering: Does Deeper Knowledge Integration Really Help?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17079)
*Aneerban Saha,Vijay Kumar,Sameer Madhav D.,Priyam Srivastava,Dhruv Bansal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对比将LLM生成的知识引导整合进VQA架构的两种策略，发现浅层晚期融合优于深层注意力注入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识型VQA需要超越图像内容的常识与事实推理；现有工作用LLM作为知识源，但引导应多深地整合进视觉语言架构尚不清楚。

Method: 用Llama 3.3 70B生成结构化推理引导、视觉聚焦概念、干扰项及外部知识；在冻结ViT + FLAN-T5框架、OK-VQA基准上对比决策级晚期融合与注意力矩阵注入两种策略。

Result: 浅层晚期融合最优（39.4% exact match，比无引导基线+10.0），优于深层注意力修改（31.8%）；另提出LLM数据增强流程，通过问题改写将训练数据扩大十倍以上。

Conclusion: 整合深度必须与数据规模/数据稀缺程度相匹配，而非越深越好。

Abstract: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires reasoning that extends beyond visible image content, demanding external commonsense and factual knowledge. While recent work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) as knowledge sources, the question of how deeply such guidance should be integrated into a vision language architecture remains underexplored. In this work, we generate structured reasoning guidance, visual focus concepts, distractor elements and external knowledge using Llama~3.3~70B and systematically compare two integration strategies within a unified frozen ViT + FLAN-T5 framework on the OK-VQA benchmark: decision level late fusion and attention-matrix injection. Contrary to the prevailing assumption that deeper integration is superior, we find that shallow late fusion achieves the strongest results (39.4% exact match, +10.0 over the no guidance baseline), outperforming deep attention modification (31.8%) under data scarce fine-tuning. We further contribute an LLM based augmentation pipeline that expands training data more than tenfold via question paraphrasing. Our findings indicate that integration depth must be matched to the data regime.

</details>


### [240] [Scaling Unified Multimodal Models to Long-Horizon Interleaved Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17080)
*Ziqiao Peng,Yutao Cui,Wang Lin,Zhong-Yu Li,Qingwen Gu,Tianhui Song,Chengyou Jia,Guozhen Zhang,Xuerui Qiu,Qixun Wang,Miles Yang,Zhao Zhong,Yonglong Tian,Hongyan Liu,Jun He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个原生训练于交错多模态数据的大型统一多模态模型（UMM），并引入视觉记忆框架，将原生交错生成能力扩展到长程自回归轨迹，同时提出LongMIG-Bench评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有UMM多用于短轨迹或简化视觉内容的演示，在长程交错生成中，生成图像在上下文中持续累积，无关或瑕疵的视觉状态会干扰后续合成，而先前建立的字符与场景在长时间间隔后仍需被恢复，这是核心挑战。

Method: 提出视觉记忆框架：维护持久化的视觉参考、选择性检索与场景相关的历史状态（同时保留完整语义历史），并采用少步自 rollout 使模型适应不完美的生成历史。

Result: 模型实现了高保真的长程交错生成，具备强角色与场景一致性；并提出LongMIG-Bench用于评测长程文本到多图和图像到多图生成。

Conclusion: 视觉记忆机制能够将原生交错生成扩展到显著更长的轨迹，验证了其在长程多模态生成中的有效性。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) provide an interface for interleaved text-image generation, where generated visual states can directly inform subsequent reasoning and synthesis. However, existing systems are still primarily demonstrated on short trajectories or simplified visual content. We develop a large UMM natively trained on interleaved multimodal data, with strong capabilities in image synthesis, text rendering, complex composition, and multimodal planning, and study how to extend these native capabilities to substantially longer autoregressive trajectories. The main challenge is that generated images continuously accumulate in context: irrelevant or imperfect visual states interfere with future synthesis, while previously established characters and scenes must still be recovered after long intervals. We introduce a visual-memory framework that maintains persistent visual references, selectively retrieves scene-relevant historical states while preserving the complete semantic history, and uses few-step self-rollout to adapt the model to imperfect generated histories. We further introduce LongMIG-Bench for evaluating long-horizon text-to-multi-image and image-to-multi-image generation. Our model achieves high-fidelity long-horizon interleaved generation with strong character and scene consistency, demonstrating how visual memory can scale native interleaved generation to substantially longer trajectories.

</details>


### [241] [Contrastive learning for video reuse detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17098)
*Tristan J. B. Cann,Arjun Biswas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于Siamese网络和对比学习微调的框架，用于识别视频关键帧的潜在来源，通过降维至不到10%的关键视觉集，实现高效准确的成分视频识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 其他来源素材的混用引发版权问题，损害权利人利益；社交媒体内容"混剪"趋势及专业定制素材库发展，使内容复用识别方法有广泛应用需求。

Method: 构建基于Siamese网络的框架，使用对比学习进行微调，将大型视频数据集降维为关键视觉集，并据此识别组件素材。

Result: 在来自素材库的视频集上测试，平均识别准确率超过0.95，关键帧集通常小于完整集的10%。

Conclusion: 该框架为大型视频数据集分析做出两项贡献：大幅缩减数据规模，并实现高效有效的成分视频识别。

Abstract: The incorporation of footage from other sources has long been a concern from a copyright perspective, as such usage can harm the interests of rights holders. Recent trends in the ``remixing'' of social media content and the development of bespoke stock libraries for specialist causes mean that methods to identify content reuse will have a range of applications. In this paper, we develop a framework based on a Siamese network fine tuned using contrastive learning to identify potential sources for key frames in a given video. This framework makes two contributions to analysis of large video datasets. Firstly, we demonstrate its utility at reducing complex video data to a set of key visuals typically less than 10\% of the size of the full set. Secondly, we show that these reduced sets allow for efficient and effective identification of component footage. We test this method over a set of videos compiled from a stock footage library and demonstrate its effectiveness for constituent video identification with average accuracy greater than 0.95.

</details>


### [242] [EgoProbe: Benchmarking Long-Range and Exact Memory in Streaming Egocentric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17128)
*Haokai Pang,Yuqian Fu,Yifei Wang,Yujiao Shen,Tianwen Qian,Mohamed Elhoseiny,Hongbo Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EgoProbe基准，从"多远（长程保持）"和"多准（干扰下事件特定回忆）"两个维度评估流式第一人称视频记忆能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式自我中心视频系统需实时处理观察，且查询可能指向久远过去；现有工作仅探索跨长时间间隔的回忆，但反复出现的物体、动作、地点还要求模型区分哪个细节属于哪个事件。

Method: 基于长时自我中心视频，用事件锚定数据引擎扩展回忆间隔、识别相关事件、构造事件锚定干扰项，并经人工验证。包含两个子集：EgoProbe-Base（无中间相关事件的长程回忆）和EgoProbe-Echo（含相似中间事件与干扰项）；Echo采用由粗到细多轮探测，首轮考粗粒度事件回忆，二轮考目标事件特定细节检索。

Result: 跨多种模型的评测揭示长程回忆存在显著局限，且在相关经历中恢复目标事件细节更具挑战；即使模型正确回答粗粒度问题，也常无法回忆指定事件的具体细节。

Conclusion: EgoProbe揭示了这一未被充分探索的失败模式，为推进流式自我中心视频理解中的长程且精确记忆提供了测试平台。

Abstract: Egocentric video provides a continuous first-person record of everyday activities, making it a natural foundation for wearable AI assistants. Unlike offline video understanding, streaming systems must process observations as they arrive, while queries may refer to experiences from the distant past. Recent work has begun to explore whether information can be recalled across long temporal gaps. Yet remembering how far is only part of the challenge: recurring objects, actions, and locations also require models to remember exactly which detail belongs to which event. We introduce EgoProbe, a benchmark that evaluates streaming egocentric memory along these two complementary dimensions: long-range retention, i.e., how far, and event-specific recall under interference, i.e., how exact. Built on long-form egocentric videos, EgoProbe uses an event-grounded data engine to extend recall intervals, identify related events, and construct event-grounded distractors, followed by human verification. It contains two subsets: EgoProbe-Base, which evaluates long-range recall without intervening related events, and EgoProbe-Echo, which challenges models with similar intervening events and event-grounded distractors. EgoProbe-Echo adopts coarse-to-fine multi-turn probing: the first turn evaluates coarse-grained event recall, while the second tests whether the model can retrieve the target-specific detail associated with the designated event. Extensive evaluation across diverse models reveals substantial limitations in long-range recall, with further challenges in recovering target-event details among related experiences. Even when models correctly answer coarse-grained questions, they often fail to recall the specific details of the designated event. EgoProbe exposes this underexplored failure mode and provides a testbed for advancing long-range and exact memory in streaming egocentric video understanding.

</details>


### [243] [MARS: Systematic Multi-Level Acceleration for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17141)
*Zengyuan Zuo,Yongchang Zhang,Guangyu Zhao,Tianze Zhang,Biao Wu,Meng Fang,Yiwu Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MARS是一个免训练、即插即用的多级加速框架，通过去除冗余注意力计算、按运动粒度自适应加速扩散推理、以及跨查询重用视觉表征并结合在线验证，实现世界动作模型的高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）虽能联合预测未来世界状态与机器人动作，但其沉重的视觉编码与迭代生成推理带来高延迟，限制了高频闭环控制的应用。现有免训练加速方法通常只优化单一阶段，加速有限或在激进复用时控制性能下降。

Method: 作者系统剖析WAM推理开销，发现Transformer计算、扩散去噪与连续策略查询中存在大量冗余，且冗余可否安全去除取决于其对动作预测与控制敏感度的影响。基于此提出MARS：1）选择性移除低影响的注意力计算；2）根据运动粒度自适应加速扩散推理；3）跨连续查询推测性重用预测的未来视觉表征并进行在线验证。

Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO和RoboCasa上分别实现最高4.00倍、3.94倍和2.10倍的端到端加速，同时任务成功率接近原始策略；方法可跨不同模型主干泛化，并在仿真与真实机器人实验中验证有效。

Conclusion: MARS通过多级协同加速显著提升WAM推理的效率—性能权衡，具备免训练、即插即用与良好泛化能力，代码已开源。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising alternative for embodied intelligence by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions. However, their heavy visual encoding and iterative generative inference incur substantial latency, limiting their applicability to high-frequency closed-loop control. Existing training-free acceleration methods typically optimize a single stage, yielding limited speedups or degraded control under aggressive reuse. In this work, we systematically profile the inference overhead of WAMs and observe abundant redundancy across Transformer computation, diffusion denoising, and consecutive policy queries. However, the safe removal of such redundancy depends strongly on its impact on action prediction and control sensitivity. Based on these observations, we introduce \textbf{MARS}, a training-free and plug-and-play framework for multi-level WAM acceleration. MARS selectively removes low-impact attention computation, adaptively accelerates diffusion inference according to motion granularity, and speculatively reuses predicted future visual representations across consecutive queries with online verification. Together, these complementary mechanisms provide remarkable acceleration while limiting approximation error. Extensive experiments across LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboCasa show that MARS achieves up to $4.00\times$, $3.94\times$, and $2.10\times$ end-to-end speedups, respectively, while maintaining task success rate close to the original policy. Moreover, MARS generalizes across different model backbones and across simulation and real-robot experiments, substantially improving the efficiency--performance trade-off of WAM inference. Our code is available at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/MARS.

</details>


### [244] [Multics: Generative Multi-Player World Model with Hierarchical Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17201)
*Kaiyi Huang,Wangbo Yu,Yukun Huang,Jiwen Yu,Kunhao Liu,Donglin Yang,Wenbo Hu,Ying Shan,Xihui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Multics 提出一种分层通信的多玩家视频世界模型，通过分组令牌实现组内聚合与跨组交流，支持玩家数量扩展且降低注意力开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多玩家世界模型扩展性差：全连接通信（如 Solaris）随玩家数增长导致注意力成本呈二次增长；集中式方法（如 γ-World）因共享全局表示而受无关事件干扰。

Method: 提出分层通信框架，跨玩家、分组、全局三层交换信息。引入组令牌作为中间表示聚合局部相关玩家信息，连接全局令牌实现跨组通信；组令牌参数在组槽间共享以适应不同玩家数。并提出基于近期相机轨迹的预算约束动态分组机制。

Result: 在 4 和 6 玩家设置下达到 SOTA，跨玩家一致性、玩家动作与相机可控性、抗干扰能力均提升；可从 4 玩家训练泛化到 6/8/10 玩家推理；相比全连接通信减少自注意力计算。

Conclusion: 分层通信与动态分组有效解决多玩家世界模型的可扩展性与干扰问题，实现无需重训练的玩家数泛化。

Abstract: Multi-player interactive world models aim to simulate shared environments from multiple players' perspectives, but achieving robust generation while scaling to more players remains challenging. Existing approaches that rely on fully-connected communication (e.g., Solaris) incur quadratic attention costs as the number of players grows, while centralized approaches (e.g., $γ$-World) suffer from interference between unrelated events in a shared global representation. To address these challenges, we present Multics, a multi-player video generation framework with hierarchical communication that structures information exchange across player, group, and global levels. This hierarchy introduces group tokens into self-attention as intermediate group-level representations that aggregate locally relevant player information. These tokens connect to global tokens for cross-group communication, while the hierarchical topology limits direct mixing between unrelated local events. Group-token parameters are shared across group slots, allowing the same communication module to accommodate varying numbers of players without introducing new group-specific parameters. We further propose budget-constrained dynamic grouping based on recent camera trajectories, which adaptively groups relevant players while limiting unnecessary communication. Experiments demonstrate that Multics achieves state-of-the-art performance in 4- and 6-player settings, with improved cross-player consistency, player-specific action and camera controllability, and interference robustness. Moreover, Multics generalizes from 4-player training to 6-, 8-, and 10-player inference without retraining, while reducing self-attention computation compared with fully-connected communication.

</details>


### [245] [AReA: Adaptive Receptive-Field Attention for Efficient High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17227)
*Javad Rajabi,Koorosh Roohi,David B. Lindell,Babak Taati*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的AReA注意力机制，让感受野随去噪过程从粗到细演化，解决DiT超分辨生成的失真与算力问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT在超出训练分辨率生成时，token数随分辨率剧增导致全注意力二次开销，且输出结构失真、细节退化。作者将问题归因于均匀全注意力：每步关注所有token既昂贵，又使模型面对超出训练范围的token与相对距离，导致分布外。

Method: 观察到去噪中注意力有效感受野逐渐收窄（早期全局成结构、后期局部修细节），据此提出免训练机制AReA：早期用跨尺度粗注意力作用于下采样K/V捕获全局上下文，后期在逐步收缩的窗口内做局部注意力。

Result: 无需额外参数或训练，AReA在多种目标分辨率和不同模型上一致超越当前免训练基线，同时更快、更高效。

Conclusion: 将注意力感受野与去噪时程对齐的粗到细设计，是提升DiT高分辨率生成质量与效率的有效免训练方案。

Abstract: Generating images beyond the training resolution of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) remains challenging, as the number of tokens grows rapidly with resolution, full attention becomes expensive, and outputs often suffer from structural distortions and degraded detail. We identify uniform full attention as the common source of both problems. Attending to all tokens at every step causes quadratic cost and exposes the model to more tokens and relative distances beyond the training range, pushing the model out of distribution. We observe that attention's effective receptive field narrows during denoising, from global in early steps that form structure to local in later steps that refine details. We propose AReA, a training-free attention mechanism whose receptive field evolves from coarse to fine, following the denoising progression. In early steps, AReA applies cross-scale coarse attention over downsampled keys and values, capturing global context, while in later steps it applies local attention within progressively shrinking windows. Without additional parameters or training, experiments show that AReA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art training-free baselines across target resolutions and different models, while also being faster and more efficient.

</details>


### [246] [Beyond Sparse Captions: Aligning Slide-Level Text and Patch-Level Vision in Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17233)
*Daniel Shao,Dongmin Bang,Luca L. Weishaupt,Sophia J. Wagner,Nic G. Reitsam,Ming Y. Lu,Long P. Le,Richard J. Chen,Faisal Mahmood*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LIMIT方法，用病理报告做弱监督对比预训练，冻结视觉编码器只微调文本编码器，构建CONCH-Z在22个任务上达到SOTA零样本性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理视觉语言预训练依赖人工标注的图像-配文数据集（来自社交媒体、教育视频等），这类数据相对组织形态多样性稀疏、难以扩展，且病理医生临床工作中不产生描述性配文。病理报告可在常规诊断流程中规模化生成，是潜在的替代数据源。

Method: 提出LIMIT（Locked Image Multiple Instance PreTraining）：冻结预训练视觉编码器，仅微调文本编码器；报告嵌入作为袋中图像块特征的交叉注意力查询，生成报告条件化的切片表示，用InfoNCE优化。用LIMIT对齐CONCH v1.5的文本编码器与335k临床报告，构建CONCH-Z。

Result: 在22个任务（图像块分类、肿瘤检测、切片亚型分类）上评估，CONCH-Z在零样本性能上超过用人工配文数据训练的VL编码器，达到SOTA，同时缩小了与参数与算力更大的切片级基础模型的差距。

Conclusion: 利用可规模化生成的临床报告进行弱监督对比预训练，可在不强依赖人工配文的情况下取得优异性能，为病理VL预训练提供可扩展新路径。代码与模型开源。

Abstract: Contrastive vision-language (VL) pretraining in computational pathology has generally relied on curated image-caption datasets sourced from social media, educational videos, and research publications. These corpora are sparse relative to the diversity of tissue morphology and difficult to scale further, as pathologists do not routinely produce descriptive captions in clinical practice. We propose to instead leverage slide-level pathology reports which can be generated during routine diagnostic workflows in a scalable manner. A key challenge in this weakly-supervised setting is that pathology reports describe macroscopic, diagnostic findings while patch-level visual features describe microscopic findings. We introduce Locked Image Multiple Instance PreTraining (LIMIT), which addresses this gap by freezing a pretrained vision encoder and fine-tuning only the text encoder: report embeddings serve as cross-attention queries over bags of patch features, producing report-conditioned slide representations optimized via InfoNCE. Using LIMIT, we establish CONCH-Z, which aligns the text encoder of CONCH v1.5 to 335k clinical reports. Evaluated across 22 tasks spanning patch-level classification, tumor detection, and slide-level subtyping, CONCH-Z establishes state-of-the-art zero-shot performance over VL encoders trained on curated caption datasets, while simultaneously closing the gap with slide-level foundation models trained with substantially more parameters and compute. The code and model is available at https://github.com/mahmoodlab/LIMIT.

</details>


### [247] [When Left Is Right? Camera-Motion Understanding beyond Screen](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17242)
*Chong Cheng,Ran Zhang,Xinyuan Li,Alan Zhao,Hao Wang,Xi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CameraVLM，通过联合建模相机运动与屏幕光流并结合语言模型，解决VLM左右方向判断难题，以9B参数超越多数模型与人类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在相机运动（左/右）理解上接近随机猜猜，单独加入相机运动数据或几何表示均无法弥补差距。

Method: 认为需同时满足两条件：表示需耦合影外相机运动与屏上光流动态，且需由语言模型解释而非独立训练。提出 CameraVLM，配对运动状态表示与状态-语言对齐；相机token捕捉屏外运动，光流token捕捉屏上运动，两阶段训练保持语言在环，共同学习相机运动语义。

Result: 9B参数下在三个基准超20个基线上大幅领先所有开源及相机运动专用模型，在48人研究中匹敌或超越GPT-6 Astra及人类观众。

Conclusion: 相机运动理解需同时耦合离屏运动与屏上光流并由语言模型解释，该设计大幅提升方向判断能力。

Abstract: Can a vision-language model tell left from right? Modern VLMs solve visual puzzles and follow hour-long videos, yet when asked whether the camera moved left or right, most do no better than a coin flip. Adding camera-motion data or geometric representations has been tried, separately, and neither closes the gap. We argue that camera-motion understanding needs two conditions at once: the representation must couple off-screen camera motion with on-screen flow dynamics, and it must be interpreted by the language model rather than trained as a standalone pose or depth estimator. We propose CameraVLM, which pairs a motion-state representation with state-language alignment. Camera tokens capture how the camera moves off screen, flow tokens capture how the subject and background move on screen, and a two-stage training strategy keeps language in the loop so that both are learned together with camera-motion semantics. With only 9B parameters, CameraVLM outperforms all open-source and camera-motion-specific models by a wide margin across three benchmarks and more than 20 baselines, and matches or surpasses GPT-6 Astra as well as human viewers in a 48-participant study. Project page: https://3dagentworld.github.io/CameraVLM/

</details>


### [248] [SSM-Attack: Learning Where to Perturb for Black-Box Face Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17323)
*Tunahan Parlayıcı,Erchan Aptoula,Yücel Saygın*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SSM-Attack是一种基于选择性状态空间模型的黑盒人脸隐私保护框架，通过预测扰动预算的空间分配而非合成扰动，实现高效、高质量的人脸保护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人脸识别系统广泛部署，在线照片可在未经本人同意的情况下被匹配，因此需要人脸隐私保护方法。现有基于生成器的方法依赖大型预训练骨干网络、多阶段推理或可见的语义编辑，效率低且质量受限。

Method: 提出SSM-Attack，基于选择性状态空间模型（SSM）的黑盒人脸隐私框架。不合成扰动，而是由状态空间模型在一次线性时间推理中预测扰动预算的空间分配，标记哪些面部位置携带身份证据；随后通过短小的投影式精修在每个像素预算内设置扰动值。

Result: 在三个评估集上均达到最高平均黑盒攻击成功率：CelebA-HQ 87.10%、LADN 86.90%、FFHQ 81.15%（后者来自从未见过该数据集的网络）。分配网络含5.73M参数（含冻结网络为16.13M）。在每像素最大变更0.10的限制下，相比均匀分配，结构相似性提升0.044，PSNR提升1.62 dB，FID改善11.2点，且仅消耗37%的容量。

Conclusion: 强人脸隐私保护不需要大型生成先验，关键在于知道如何用好一个小模型——即合理分配扰动预算的位置。

Abstract: Face recognition systems are deployed widely enough that a photograph shared online can be matched without its subject's consent. Generator-based protection methods rely on heavy pretrained backbones, multi-stage inference or visible semantic edits. We introduce SSM-Attack, a black-box face privacy framework built on Selective State Space Models. Rather than synthesizing the perturbation, the state-space model predicts in one linear-time pass a spatial allocation of the perturbation budget, marking which facial locations carry identity evidence; a short projected refinement then sets the values within this per-pixel budget. Against published benchmark results, SSM-Attack attains the highest average black-box attack success rate on all three evaluation sets: 87.10 percent on CelebA-HQ, 86.90 on LADN and 81.15 on FFHQ, the last from a network that never saw that dataset. The allocation network holds 5.73 million parameters, or 16.13 million with the frozen networks used by its quality terms. Under the same cap of 0.10 on the maximum per-pixel change, allocation improves structural similarity by 0.044, peak signal-to-noise ratio by 1.62 decibels and Frechet Inception Distance by 11.2 points over a uniform map while spending 37 percent of its capacity. Strong facial privacy protection therefore does not require a large generative prior; it requires knowing where to spend a small one.

</details>


### [249] [HairFlow: Modeling 3D Hair Strands with Multi-Modal Conditioned Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17348)
*Yating Wang,Kui Wu,Ran Yi,Zixuan Lu,Tongtong Wang,Zhongtian Zheng,Lizhuang Ma,Yuefan Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HairFlow是一个多模态条件扩散框架，用粗网格和多视角草图作为条件，高效生成可控的3D发丝模型，避免逐实例优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D发丝建模因发型几何复杂、高质量训练数据稀缺、输入观测不完整或有噪声而极具挑战。基础模型虽提供更广的发型先验，但输出无法直接用于发丝渲染与仿真；现有方法需昂贵的逐实例优化，效率低且泛化差。

Method: HairFlow将发丝生成条件建立在两种互补表示上：约束全局形状的粗网格与指定局部发流的多视角草图。框架结合Orientation VAE与条件扩散transformer，生成体场并追踪为显式发丝。为弥补配对草图-发丝训练数据的缺失，提出自动合成管线，生成几何对齐、风格多样的多视角草图。

Result: 实验表明，HairFlow能生成合理且忠实遵循输入条件的3D发丝，适用于多样发型，大幅缩短推理时间，并支持灵活的多模态控制。

Conclusion: HairFlow通过扩散框架与多模态条件实现了高效、可控且泛化的发丝建模，为发丝渲染与仿真提供了可用输出。

Abstract: Modeling 3D hair strands is challenging due to complex hairstyle geometry, scarce high-quality training data, and incomplete or noisy input observations. Foundation models offer broader hairstyle priors, but their outputs are not directly usable for strand-based rendering and simulation. Existing approaches require costly per-instance optimization to fit hair priors to meshes from foundation models and 2D orientations from specialized predictors trained on limited hair data, restricting efficiency and generalization. We present HairFlow, a multimodal conditioned diffusion framework for efficient and controllable hair strands modeling. HairFlow conditions strand generation on two complementary representations: a coarse mesh that constrains global shape and multi-view sketches that specify local strand flow. HairFlow combines an Orientation VAE with a conditioned diffusion transformer to generate volumetric fields that are traced into explicit strands. To overcome the lack of paired sketch-strand training data, we introduce an automatic synthesis pipeline that generates geometrically aligned multi-view sketches with diverse styles representative of inference-time inputs. Experiments show that HairFlow generates plausible 3D strands that faithfully follow the input conditions across diverse hairstyles, substantially reduces inference time, and supports flexible multimodal control.

</details>


### [250] [MID: Mask-Image Distributional Divergence for Evaluating Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17354)
*Vincenzo Marcianò,Xiaoming Zhang,Gianluca Guglielmo,Sebastien Ourselin,Michela Antonelli,Maria A. Zuluaga*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MID（Mask-Image Distributional Divergence），一种无需样本级配对的医学图像分割分布级评估指标，通过比较预测集与参考集的联合图像-掩码分布来评估分割质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学图像分割评估指标（如 Dice、Hausdorff）依赖样本级配对比较，存在两大局限：一是无法用于无标签数据上的预测评估；二是即使有标注，也无法判断一组预测是否符合真实标注总体的分布结构。

Method: 基于"分割质量是联合图像-掩码分布属性"的观察，MID 在参考集与预测集之间比较图像和掩码的联合分布，无需样本级对应关系，从而同时捕获掩码的真实性与图像-掩码一致性。

Result: 在涵盖 CT、MRI、MRA 的13个公开数据集、56个器官组的解剖真实扰动实验中，MID 无需逐样本配对即可追踪平均 Dice 和 Hausdorff 距离；还能检测跨模态与解剖结构的分布偏移、通过受控打乱实验识别图像-掩码错位，并在真实分割模型上给出可靠的模型排名。

Conclusion: MID 提供了一种实用且无需配对的分布级分割评估方案，可补充现有样本级指标，适用于无标签评估、分布偏移检测与模型排名等场景。

Abstract: Current evaluation protocols for medical image segmentation remain largely anchored in sample-wise comparisons, e.g., Dice and Hausdorff distance, which require each prediction to be paired with a ground-truth mask. Yet two limitations arise in practice: they are inapplicable when predictions are made on unlabeled data; and even when annotations are available, they cannot assess whether a collection of predictions matches the distributional structure of the ground-truth population. We introduce MID (Mask-Image Distributional Divergence), a distribution-level evaluation metric for medical image segmentation. MID builds upon the observation that segmentation quality is a property of the joint image-mask distribution: a mask may be anatomically plausible in isolation yet incorrect for the image it accompanies. MID compares the joint distribution of images and masks between a reference set and a set of predictions, without requiring sample-wise correspondence. This captures both mask realism and image-mask consistency. We evaluate MID across 13 publicly available datasets spanning CT, MRI, and MRA. Under anatomically realistic corruptions across 56 organ groups, MID tracks mean Dice and Hausdorff distance without per-sample ground-truth pairing. MID also detects distributional shifts across modalities and anatomies, identifies image-mask misalignment through controlled shuffling experiments, and produces reliable model rankings across real segmentation models. Official implementation available at github.com/erc-caravel/pytorch-mid

</details>


### [251] [WIRE: Weight Space Implicit Representation Encoding of Frozen Video LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17355)
*Ameen Ali,Tamim Zoabi,Lior Wolf,Chaim Baskin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WIRE将视频条件计算从输入激活转移到冻结视频语言模型的临时低秩权重更新，缩短视觉序列以降低预填充、内存和解码成本，同时保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频语言模型将视频表示为长视觉嵌入序列，每个嵌入都要经过所有解码层、存入KV缓存并被每个生成token关注，导致长视频的预填充、内存和生成成本同时上升。

Method: 先用问题条件双向选择性扫描将每帧全分辨率嵌入压缩为少量carrier token，并物理缩短解码器输入；在选定解码层用超网络读取压缩前向传播和被移除的全分辨率特征，生成注意力与前馈投影的LoRA更新；预填充后合并更新，使自回归解码运行未修改的冻结主干。

Result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B上，每帧16个carrier token将视觉流压缩3.5倍，256帧预填充加速3.35倍、1024帧加速4.14倍，按比例缩小KV缓存，单token解码延迟基本不变；在256帧的九个基准设置中，平均准确率最高。

Conclusion: WIRE通过将视频条件计算迁移到临时低秩权重更新，在显著提升效率的同时保持甚至领先的精度，为高效视频语言模型提供了新思路。

Abstract: Video language models represent a video as a long sequence of visual embeddings in a decoder's input. Every visual embedding is processed by every decoder layer during prefill, stored in the key value cache, and attended by every generated token, so a long video raises prefill, memory, and generation cost at once. We present WIRE (Weight Space Implicit Representation Encoding), which reduces this recurring cost by moving part of the video conditioned computation of a frozen video language model from its input activations into a temporary low rank update of its weights. WIRE keeps a short explicit visual context, so the update acts as a correction rather than a replacement of the video. WIRE first compresses the full resolution embeddings of each frame into a small set of carrier tokens using a question conditioned bidirectional selective scan, and physically contracts the decoder input so every decoder layer, cache entry, and decoding step operates on the shorter sequence. Hypernetworks at selected decoder layers read the compressed forward pass together with a readout of the full resolution features removed by contraction and generate LoRA updates to the attention and feedforward projections. The updates are merged after prefill, so autoregressive decoding runs the unmodified frozen backbone. On Qwen3-VL-8B, WIRE with 16 carrier tokens per frame contracts the visual stream by $3.5\times$, reduces decoder prefill time by $3.35\times$ at 256 frames and $4.14\times$ at 1024 frames, shrinks the key value cache proportionally, and keeps per token decoding latency approximately constant. Across nine benchmark settings at 256 frames, it obtains the highest average accuracy among efficient video language models we evaluate under a common 256 frame budget.

</details>


### [252] [Brain2Face: A Study on the Relation of EEG Signals and Spatio-temporal Head Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17356)
*Camilo Andrés Martínez Martínez,Olaf Dünkel,Kartik Teotia,Maurice Rekrut,Christian Theobalt,Marc Habermann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次探索仅用EEG脑电信号驱动3D高斯头部头像表情恢复，构建了64通道EEG与头像表情潜码同步的数据集，并提出EEG-to-expression基线模型及基准协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数字头像驱动依赖手工设计或图像级面部捕捉。作者提出能否仅从脑电信号（EEG）中实现头几何与外观的时空追踪。由于此前研究多聚焦活动与情绪识别，该任务缺乏高质量公开数据集和基准。

Method: 贡献了一个配对EEG与头部几何/外观标注的数据集，将64通道EEG与个性化高斯头像的逐帧表情潜码同步。提出EEG-to-expression模型，以EEG时序序列为输入回归3D高斯头像的潜表情参数。并设计基准协议验证采集与算法设计。

Result: 通过所提基准协议对采集和算法设计进行了验证，建立了该任务的基线性能。

Conclusion: 该工作为理解EEG信号与面部表面及外观变化之间的关系开辟了道路。

Abstract: Driving digital head avatars is classically done by hand-crafted artist design or by image-based facial performance capture. In this work, we ask whether spatio-temporal tracking of the humans's head geometry and appearance can be performed solely from brain signals, i.e., Electroencephalography (EEG). Since prior work mostly focused on activity and emotion recognition, this task is relatively unexplored without even having publicly available high-quality datasets and benchmarks. Thus, we contribute a dataset featuring paired EEG and human head geometry as well as appearance annotations. We synchronize 64-channel EEG with per-frame expression latent codes of a personalized Gaussian head avatar. Second, we introduce a baseline to the task of expression recovery of a head avatar from EEG signals. To this end, we propose a dedicated EEG-to-expression model that takes a temporal sequence of EEG signals as input and regresses the latent expression parameters of the 3D Gaussian head avatar. Lastly, we validate our capture and algorithmic design choices through a benchmark protocol that we introduce to this task. We believe this work paves the way towards better understanding of the relation between EEG signals and facial surface as well as appearance changes.

</details>


### [253] [Bottlenecked semantic compression by representation reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17412)
*Xiaoya Tang,Shilong Liu,Daniel Smolyak,Xiwen Li,Quynh Nguyen,Tolga Tasdizen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReConV提出重建引导的视觉token压缩框架，用Summary Bank压缩共享信息并保留重建残差大的token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT处理长视觉token序列计算开销大，现有方法独立排序并丢弃不重要或冗余的token，可能丢失信息。

Method: 用紧凑的Summary Bank（SMB）概括完整视觉序列，通过轻量位置条件解码器重建当前token，保留重建残差大（信息未被充分捕捉）的token。

Result: 在图像分类与多模态理解任务上取得良好性能-效率权衡；ImageNet上GMACs减少48%仍超越未压缩基线，并支持可复用的图像级表示以高效多轮推理。

Conclusion: 重建引导的token压缩能有效保留细节信息，实现更优的性能-效率平衡。

Abstract: Vision Transformers incur high computational costs when processing long visual token sequences. Existing reduction methods typically rank tokens independently and discard those deemed unimportant or redundant. We propose a reconstruction-guided framework for visual token condensation (ReConV), which summarizes the complete visual sequence with a compact Summary Bank (SMB) and retains tokens whose information is not adequately captured by the SMB, as indicated by their reconstruction residuals. At each compression layer, a lightweight position-conditioned decoder reconstructs the current tokens, leaving shared information compressed in the SMB while explicitly preserving poorly reconstructed details. Experiments on image classification and multimodal understanding demonstrate favorable performance-efficiency trade-offs: ReConV surpasses the uncompressed baseline with 48\% fewer GMACs on ImageNet and enables reusable image-level representations for efficient multi-turn inference. Code is available at TokenDrop.

</details>


### [254] [Know-Thy-Not: Training-Free Targeted Negation in Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17440)
*DoYoung Kim,Changkyu Choi,Adín Ramírez Rivera,YunSeok Choi,Jee-Hyong Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 双编码器视觉语言模型在否定理解上系统性失败，本文证明这是单嵌入框架的固有限制（只能"稀释"否定概念而无法"拒绝"它），并提出免训练的Know-Thy-Not (KTN)方法及COCO-Confusion基准来解决该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双编码器VLM无法区分"有狗的猫"和"没有狗的猫"，评分几乎相同。作者希望揭示该失败是单嵌入框架的内在缺陷，并予以解决。

Method: 理论分析表明，在对比训练下单嵌入方法最多只能忽略被否定概念（dilution），无法惩罚其存在（rejection）。据此提出免训练的KTN，在图像侧引入"拒绝维度"，直接在视觉表征中惩罚被否定概念；并提出COCO-Confusion基准，要求模型具备真正的拒绝能力。

Result: 在9个骨干网络上，KTN在COCO-Confusion上相比原始VLM的mAP提升最高达+25.6，相比最强现有方法提升+9.6。

Conclusion: 单嵌入框架无法处理否定，需引入图像侧拒绝维度；KTN作为免训练方法有效提升否定理解，COCO-Confusion为评估真实拒绝能力提供了新基准。

Abstract: Dual-encoder vision-language models systematically fail at negation, scoring ''a cat without a dog'' nearly identically to ''a cat with a dog.'' We show that this failure is inherent to the single-embedding framework. Under contrastive training, single-embedding methods can at best ignore the negated concept (dilution) but never penalize its presence (rejection). We propose Know-Thy-Not (KTN), a training-free method that introduces an image-side rejection dimension to penalize the negated concept directly in the visual representation. We also introduce COCO-Confusion, the first benchmark requiring genuine rejection to succeed. Across 9 backbones, KTN improves COCO-Confusion mAP by up to +25.6 over vanilla VLMs and +9.6 over the strongest existing method.

</details>


### [255] [TableVision: Recovering Verified Structure from Historical Tables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17448)
*Todd Y. Zhou,James M. Snyder*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TableVision将历史表格的结构恢复作为核心问题，通过动态规划按列求和匹配切分文本块、由见证者读取单元格、门控机制对每列分类（精确对账/标记/扣留），在退化页面上远超现有OCR，并在大规模选举数据中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史登记册普遍存在缺行、跨页、错列、列和与行不匹配等问题；读者能读对数字但丢失表格结构，现有最佳开源读取器虽数字准确率高（99.0%），却只有83.7%进入正确单元格、30列中仅11列正确，退化页面上Textract几乎全错，因此需要以表格结构恢复为问题核心的方法。

Method: TableVision把表格结构恢复当作核心：用动态规划按“多少列累加到末行”将一卷切成块；见证者读取各单元格；门控将每列分类为精确对账、标记为算术有误但忠于页面、或扣留。并提出求和检查理论，说明其看不见哪些错误，以及最优块大小约为θ^(-1/2)行（缺陷率θ）。

Result: 7个干净选举面板：数字复现99.0%，正确归档83.7%（对比最佳开源），30列中11列正确；3个退化1888页面：Textract 1494个数字仅1个正确，TableVision达99.2%，51列全部精确总计检查通过且正确。威斯康星2201列数据：接受2042、标记118、扣留41；一般选举每1000格1.1个缺陷，失败率随列长R按1-(1-θ)^R上升；官方确认934个可测接受和中933个、35个可测标记总计全部正确；部署新增491,359条门控选品行到930万行数据集。

Conclusion: 验证块的设计至关重要；TableVision以结构恢复加求和门控实现了高可靠的表格数字化与规模化部署。

Abstract: Gaps, skips, and mistakes are the normal state of a historical register: rows go missing, tables cross page breaks, columns slip under wrong names, and column sums disagree with the corresponding row entries. Readers read digits correctly but lose the table structure. On seven clean panels of election returns, the best open-source reader reproduces 99.0\% of the digits but files only 83.7\% of the figures in the correct cells and gets 11 of 30 columns correct. TableVision treats table structure recovery as the problem. On three degraded 1888 pages, Amazon Textract files only 1 of 1494 figures correctly; TableVision correctly files 99.2\%, and all 51 columns its exact-total check releases are correct. A dynamic program cuts a volume into blocks by how many columns sum to their last line; witnesses read the cells; the gate classifies each column as exactly reconciling, flagged as faithful to a page whose arithmetic is wrong, or withheld. A theory of the sum check says which errors it cannot see and why its optimal block is about $θ^{-1/2}$ rows at defect rate $θ$. On 2201 columns of Wisconsin electoral data, the gate accepts 2042, flags 118, and withholds 41; failure rises with column length $R$ as $1-(1-θ)^R$ at 1.1 defects per 1000 cells in general elections; official returns confirm 933 of 934 testable accepted sums and all 35 testable flagged totals; and the deployment added 491\,359 gated precinct rows to a 9.3-million-row dataset. One implication is that the design of the verification block is critical.

</details>


### [256] [Efficient Fréchet Distributional Decoder Alignment for Latent Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17466)
*Xianghong Fang,Jiajun Zhu,Esma Aimeur,Dehan Kong,Tim G. J. Rudner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FDDA通过冻结生成器、直接在生成时latent上优化解码器，解决解码器训练-生成分布不匹配问题，仅需一epoch即可显著降低gFID/gFDr⁶并大幅节省时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Fréchet Distribution的latent生成模型后训练只优化latent生成器而冻结解码器；解码器在真实图像重建latent上训练，却在生成时接收生成器latent，存在分布不匹配，限制FD优化收益。

Method: 提出FDDA：冻结latent生成器，用FD目标直接在生成时latent上优化解码器，实现解码器与生成分布的对齐，仅需单epoch训练。

Result: 在11个flow-based与自回归latent模型上一致提升gFID与gFDr⁶；gFDr⁶相比原预训练模型降低34.0–59.6%，在生成器侧FD后训练基础上再降10.2–57.2%；总墙钟时间相比生成器侧FD后训练降低3.6×–328.7×。

Conclusion: 生成器侧后训练未耗尽FD优化收益，通过低成本适配解码器可进一步获得显著提升，FDDA高效且通用。

Abstract: Fréchet Distributional (FD) objectives provide an effective distribution-level signal for post-training generative models. For latent generative models, however, existing FD-based post-training methods optimize only the latent generator while keeping the decoder frozen: the decoder is trained on reconstruction latents obtained from real images but deployed on generator-produced latents at generation time. When these latent distributions differ, this \textbf{decoder train-generation mismatch} means that the decoder is deployed on inputs drawn from a distribution it was not directly trained on. We introduce \textbf{Fréchet Distributional Decoder Alignment (FDDA)}, an efficient post-training method that freezes the latent generator and directly optimizes the decoder on generation-time latents using an FD objective. A single epoch of FDDA consistently improves gFID and gFDr$^6$ across diverse flow-based and autoregressive latent generative models. Across all 11 evaluated models, FDDA reduces gFDr$^6$ by 34.0-59.6\% from the original pretrained models and provides a further 10.2-57.2\% reduction after generator-side FD post-training. FDDA also reduces total wall-clock time by factors of $3.6\times$-$328.7\times$ relative to generator-side FD post-training across these models. These results show that generator-side post-training alone does not exhaust the benefits of FD optimization, and that further gains can be obtained by adapting the decoder at substantially lower cost.

</details>


### [257] [Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Scene Reconstruction: Methods, Systems, and Trade-offs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17513)
*Ashim Dahal,Rabab Abdelfattah,Nick Rahimi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该综述系统梳理了2023年以来3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的文献，将其分为五个重叠类别，并串联成一个端到端管线，重点对比了渲染吞吐与各类场景生成/更新/跟踪/建图/优化的质量、延迟、内存和更新成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS虽能实时渲染，但"渲染已有表示"与"构建、更新、维护场景本身"是不同问题；现有扩展方向（稀疏视图、动态、压缩、流式、SLAM）分散，缺乏统一视角与跨类别权衡分析。

Method: 综述性方法：综合当前文献并分类，将其组织为五个相互重叠的家族——单次生成、动态表示、效率与压缩、流式与沉浸式系统、GS-SLAM；区分"仅渲染吞吐"与任务级成本；结合受控稀疏视图基准测试与原生评估。

Result: 识别并对比了跨类别在质量、延迟、内存、更新成本上的主要权衡关系。

Conclusion: 该综述将分散的3DGS技术按五类整合为面向端到端管线的统一框架，为后续研究提供分类与性能权衡的系统性参考。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) allows for high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis. Since its inception in 2023, its explicit and highly configurable scene representation has been extended toward sparse-view generation, dynamic reconstruction, efficiency and compression, streaming, and simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Although Gaussian Splatting can provide real-time rendering, rendering an existing representation is distinct from constructing, updating, or maintaining the scene itself. In this survey, we synthesize current literature, categorize them and provide a connection of current approaches and tools towards an end-to-end pipeline. Explicitly, we categorize GS scene reconstruction into five overlapping families: single-shot generation, dynamic representations, efficiency and compression, streaming and immersive systems, and Gaussian Splatting SLAM. We distinguish render-only throughput from task-specific scene generation, update, tracking, mapping, and optimization costs, and combine controlled sparse-view benchmarking with native evaluations to identify cross-family quality, latency, memory, and update-cost trade-offs.

</details>


### [258] [TwinPrune: Density-Aware Two-Phase Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17530)
*Kai Liu,Anqi Li,Junxian Li,Zhixin Wang,Zhikai Chen,Renjing Pei,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出统一的"空间密度"信号用于多模态大模型推理两阶段的token重要性打分，并揭示了解码阶段剪枝评估的陷阱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有解码阶段剪枝方法常在仅反映预填充质量的基准上验证，导致评估偏差，缺乏对真实解码性能的有效衡量。

Method: 提出统一的密度信号：预填充阶段用二分合并（bipartite merge），解码阶段用KV驱逐（density top-k eviction）。按打分逻辑拆分基准：预填充探针（MMBench、POPE、ScienceQA）与全流程探针（TextVQA、DocVQA、MM-Vet）。

Result: 在7个模型变体（InternVL-3.5、Qwen3-VL、LLaVA-1.5）和3个全流程基准上实现计算-内存-精度三向Pareto前沿。预填充压缩保持精度、线性扩展、高分辨率下选择快100倍；解码密度top-k在三个保留率下均优于H2O、SnapKV、StreamingLLM，TextVQA 0.125保留率下超H2O 9.6分，InternVL-3.5(2B-38B)保持7-10分优势，且压缩随模型增大损失更小。

Conclusion: 丢弃所有视觉KV对预填充探针精度几乎无影响，但严重降低TextVQA和MM-Vet，说明仅用预填充探针验证解码剪枝存在关键评估陷阱。建议任何解码阶段声明必须用MM-Vet或DocVQA做全流程验证。

Abstract: We propose a unified spatial-density signal to score token importance for both inference phases: bipartite merge for prefill and KV eviction for decode, yielding measurable gains in each stage. To isolate the two phases, we split benchmarks by scoring logic. Prefill probes (MMBench, POPE, ScienceQA) evaluate only the first decoded token; their accuracy reflects prefill logits argmax before any decode KV eviction. Full-pipeline probes (TextVQA, DocVQA, MM-Vet) assess the complete generated sequence and capture both phases. We identify a critical evaluation pitfall: decode pruning claims validated solely on prefill probes measure prefill quality, not decode performance. Experiments show discarding all visual KV during decode barely affects prefill-probe accuracy but degrades TextVQA and MM-Vet drastically; this insensitivity stems from the scoring rule, not compression intensity.Evaluated on seven model variants (InternVL-3.5, Qwen3-VL, LLaVA-1.5) and three full-pipeline benchmarks, our method achieves a three-way Pareto frontier across compute, memory and accuracy. Density-based prefill compression maintains strong accuracy, scales linearly with visual token count, and delivers 100x faster token selection at high resolution. For decode, density top-k KV eviction consistently outperforms strong baselines H2O, SnapKV and StreamingLLM on TextVQA and MM-Vet across three retention ratios. At 0.125 keep ratio on TextVQA, it surpasses H2O by 9.6 points; InternVL-3.5 models (2B to 38B) maintain a 7 to 10 point advantage. Compression scales favorably with model size: every measured 8B to 38B model transition reduces accuracy loss instead of worsening it. We suggest MM-Vet or DocVQA as mandatory full-pipeline validation for any decode-phase claims. Our code is available at https://github.com/Kai-Liu001/TwinPrune

</details>


### [259] [CrossPortrait: Cross-Species Portrait Animation via Adversarial Motion Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17532)
*Gezhong Pan,Zhe Li,Yunfan Tao,Yongheng Zhao,Shiqi Zhou,Juyong Zhang,Xiaosong Jia,Yanyong Zhang,Shuquan Ye,Shaofeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CrossPortrait框架，通过运动分解、物种路由表情编码器和表情级对抗域适应，实现跨物种肖像动画，有效缓解驱动物种泄漏问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨物种肖像动画因不同物种面部结构差异巨大而极具挑战。现有方法多在动物视频上微调人类肖像动画模型，但常出现驱动物种泄漏问题。

Method: 将肖像运动分解为刚性头部姿态和表情关键点；引入物种路由表情编码器，在统一表情编码器中嵌入物种特定的LoRA以适配各物种面部结构并对齐跨物种表情；并采用表情级对抗域适应（Ex-ADA）抑制表情潜在空间中的驱动物种特有信息。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法能在多种物种间实现富有表现力且保持身份的肖像动画，并优于其他最新方法。

Conclusion: CrossPortrait支持人-动物、动物-人及跨物种动物-动物等多种场景，通过缓解物种泄漏、构建共享表情空间，有效提升跨物种肖像动画效果。

Abstract: Cross-species portrait animation, which aims to animate a source portrait of species A using a driving video of species B, is particularly challenging due to substantial anatomical differences in facial structures across species. Previous works typically fine-tune human portrait animation models on animal video datasets but often suffer from driving-species leakage. To address this, we propose CrossPortrait, a novel framework for expressive cross-species portrait animation, supporting diverse scenarios including human-to-animal, animal-to-human and cross-species animal-to-animal (e.g. cat-to-dog) animation. Specifically, we decompose the portrait motion into rigid head poses and expression keypoints. To accommodate species-specific facial structures while facilitating cross-species expression alignment, we introduce a species-routed expression encoder that incorporates species-specific LoRAs into a unified expression encoder. Furthermore, we introduce expression-level adversarial domain adaptation (Ex-ADA) to suppress driving-species-specific information in the expression latents, thereby mitigating species leakage and promoting a shared expression space across species. Extensive experiments show that our method enables expressive and identity-preserving portrait animation across diverse species and outperforms other state-of-the-art approaches.

</details>


### [260] [FlashVSR+: Efficient Video Super-Resolution via Hybrid Attention and Reward-Yield Distribution Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17552)
*Ruchang Yao,Shi Guo,Junhao Zhuang,Mingde Yao,Xin Cai,Jiahao Zhan,Bin Fu,Xinyuan Chen,Yu Qiao,Tianfan Xue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlashVSR+ 通过混合注意力架构与奖励产出分布匹配蒸馏(Ry-DMD)，提升视频超分辨率的高分辨率效率与人类偏好对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频超分模型虽通过扩散蒸馏实现高效单步生成，但高分辨率推理成本高，且蒸馏模型难以对齐人类偏好，需在模型架构与训练策略上改进。

Method: 架构上提出基于强局部性的混合注意力，保留稀疏全局交互以维持长程一致性；训练上提出 Ry-DMD，用奖励加权教师 rollout 将黑盒奖励引入分布匹配，无需对奖励模型反向传播。

Result: DiT 推理最高提速 2 倍，峰值显存降低 45%，可在单张 24GB RTX 4090 上进行无分块 4K 超分；Ry-DMD 还可泛化到 T2I 生成。

Conclusion: FlashVSR+ 在恢复质量、高分辨率效率和用户偏好上均有一致提升，并开源代码、模型与训练数据。

Abstract: Recent video super-resolution (VSR) models achieve efficient one-step generation through diffusion distillation. However, high-resolution inference remains costly, and distilled models are difficult to align with human preferences. These challenges call for improvements in both model architecture and training strategy. We present \textbf{FlashVSR+} to address both limitations. On the architecture side, we introduce hybrid attention based on the strong locality observed in pretrained VSR models, while retaining sparse global interaction for long-range consistency. It achieves up to $2\times$ DiT speedup and 45\% lower peak memory, enabling spatially untiled 4K VSR on a single 24GB RTX 4090. On the training side, we propose Reward-Yield Distribution Matching Distillation (Ry-DMD) for preference-aligned one-step generation. Ry-DMD uses reward-weighted teacher rollouts to incorporate black-box rewards into distribution matching, without backpropagating through the reward model. We further show that Ry-DMD generalizes beyond VSR to T2I generation. Together, FlashVSR+ delivers stronger restoration quality and substantially improves high-resolution efficiency, with consistent gains in user preference. We release our code, models, and training data at \href{https://www.flashvsr.tech}{\textcolor{FlashBlue}{\textbf{www.flashvsr.tech}}}.

</details>


### [261] [Benchmarking Self-Supervised 3D Medical Vision Foundation Models and Transferability Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17573)
*Jiaqi Tang,Yu Wang,Yang Liu,Jing Tao,Fandong Zhang,Zhou Zhen,Xiahai Zhuang,Qingchao Chen,Yining Yang,Yizhou Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文对23个3D医学基础模型在14个分割/分类/回归任务上进行统一基准评测，并提出InsightRank转移性估计器，用于在微调前低成本地对候选模型排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D医学基础模型的评测使用不同数据集、指标和微调协议，模型架构、预训练目标与数据各异，下游任务从体素级掩码到患者级诊断不等，导致公布结果难以直接比较；而直接微调所有候选模型进行适配性能比较计算成本极高。

Method: 在相同14个任务（涵盖多解剖结构、多模态的分割、分类、回归）上统一基准测试23个候选模型；并将多种可转移性估计器与微调后的真实排名进行对比。提出的InsightRank使用任务适配的冻结特征统计量和架构感知的成对比较，在微调前对候选模型排序。

Result: 没有任何候选模型在所有分割任务或所有分类回归任务中均进入前三；同一目标下卷积编码器在某些任务上优于Transformer、在另一些任务上则相反。可转移性估计器的排名一致性因任务类型而异。InsightRank在23模型池上平均Kendall tau-b为分割0.431、分类回归0.352；分割Top 3在9个任务中的4个包含任务最优模型，图像级Top 3在5个任务中均未包含。三模型候选清单将7个分割任务的提取加训练总作业时间减少85.8%。

Conclusion: 该基准为模型选择提供了共同参考，InsightRank提供了更低成本地优先安排微调的方法；但其候选清单效果因目标类型而异。

Abstract: Self-supervised pretraining has expanded the pool of 3D medical foundation models, but published evaluations use different datasets, endpoints and fine-tuning protocols.
