Empirical evaluations on multi-app sequential benchmark demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates catastrophic forgetting on prior applications while sustaining robust adaptation to new ones.

</details>


### [368] [MIST: Multi-Scale Spatial Context for Gene Expression Prediction from Histology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18769)
*Koushik Howlader,Tirtho Roy,Md Tauhidul Islam,Wei Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MIST，一种多上下文空间Transformer，在标准自注意力骨干上增加局部和全切片两条上下文通路，从H&E图像预测空间基因表达，性能显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer对spots做自注意力但忽略每个spot在组织中的位置，而spot的分子状态依赖多个空间尺度的组织上下文。直接从常规H&E图像预测空间基因表达可将分子分析扩展到无空间转录组测量的组织。

Method: MIST在每一层加入两条上下文通路：坐标不变的局部通路对空间k近邻spots做注意力；切片通路将全切片摘要广播到每个spot。坐标仅通过成对距离进入，使局部通路在图像特征固定时对平移、旋转和反射不变。模型单次前向预测所有spots。

Result: 在HEST-1k六个器官队列的队列内评估中，10/50/100基因面板的平均Pearson相关分别比最强基线提升9.7%、11.6%、11.4%，平均MSE和MAE最低。留一器官迁移提升6.0%。表达衍生域恢复最优（各聚类分辨率下平均ARI和NMI最高，84%留出切片NMI优于最接近基线），并重现选定癌症标记基因的空间表达模式。

Conclusion: 在普通Transformer骨干中加入局部与切片上下文，是从组织学预测空间基因表达的有效方法。

Abstract: Predicting spatial gene expression from standard H&E images could extend molecular analysis to tissues without spatial transcriptomic measurements. A standard Transformer applies self-attention over spots but ignores where each spot sits in the tissue, whereas a spot's molecular state depends on tissue context at multiple spatial scales. Building on this insight, we introduce MIST, a Multi-context Spatial Transformer that augments the self-attention backbone with two context pathways applied in every layer: a coordinate-invariant local pathway that attends over spatial k-nearest-neighbor spots, and a slide pathway that broadcasts a whole-slide summary to every spot; the model predicts all spots in a single forward pass. Because coordinates enter only through pairwise distances, the local pathway is invariant to translations, rotations, and reflections when image features are fixed. In intra-cohort evaluation across six human organ cohorts from HEST-1k, MIST improves mean Pearson correlation over the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.7%, 11.6%, and 11.4% for 10-, 50-, and 100-gene panels, respectively, with the lowest average MSE and MAE. MIST further improves leave-one-organ-out transfer by 6.0% over the next strongest baseline, attains the best expression-derived domain recovery (highest mean ARI and NMI at every clustering resolution, and higher NMI than the closest baseline on 84% of held-out slides), and reproduces spatial expression patterns of selected cancer-marker genes. Together, these results show that adding local and slide context to a vanilla Transformer backbone is an effective approach to spatial gene expression prediction from histology.

</details>


### [369] [The Federated Tumor Segmentation and Classification (FeTS++) Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18771)
*Wenyi Tang,Carla Pitarch-Abaigar,Siddhesh Thakur,Verena Chung,Konstantinos Koukoutegos,Alexandros Karargyris,Holger R. Roth,Spyridon Bakas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FeTS++ 2027 是重启的联邦肿瘤分割挑战赛，首次同时包含分割与分类任务，并迁移至 NVFlare 基础设施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机构数据集中训练与评测已成为医学图像分析标准，但数据需本地保留，联邦学习(FL)为此提供解决范式。既往 FeTS 挑战赛(2021/2022/2024)推动了 FL 的真实世界方法验证。

Method: 基于 BraTS 2025 Lighthouse 的多机构多参数 MRI 数据，覆盖北美、欧洲、亚洲和非洲的胶质瘤与脑膜瘤队列；基础设施迁移至 NVIDIA FLARE；按模型效用与效率感知评分排名参赛方法。Task 1 寻找聚合各机构分割模型知识的最优策略；Task 2 在相同联邦协议下区分胶质瘤与脑膜瘤，其中实体标签与来源站点高度混杂。

Result: 时隔两年重启，队列规模更大、更多样；新增官方分类任务与分割并行的"双plus"设定。

Conclusion: FeTS++ 2027 通过更大更广的队列、分类+分割双任务及 NVFlare 基础设施，进一步推进联邦学习在医学影像中的真实世界方法验证。

Abstract: International challenges have become the standard for developing and benchmarking biomedical image analysis methods using centralized multi-institutional data. Federated learning (FL) describes a paradigm-shift on multi-institutional collaborations, where models are trained across institutions while their data are always retained locally. The Federated Tumor Segmentation (FeTS) challenge, first held in 2021, was the first challenge dedicated to FL in medical imaging and editions in 2022 and 2024 pushed the frontiers of real-world method validation. FeTS++ 2027 returns after a two-year gap with a substantially larger and more diverse cohort, and with the two "pluses" that name the challenge: an official classification task alongside segmentation, and a move of the infrastructure to NVIDIA FLARE (NVFlare). Built on the clinically acquired, multi-institutional multi-parametric MRI data of the BraTS 2025 Lighthouse challenge, FeTS++ spans gliomas and meningiomas across patient cohorts from institutions in North America, Europe, Asia, and Africa, and focuses on ranking submitted methodological approaches according to their model utility and an efficiency-aware score. Task 1 asks participants to find the best strategy for aggregating knowledge from per-institution segmentation models, while Task 2 asks them to distinguish glioma from meningioma under the same federated protocol, in which the entity label is heavily confounded with the site of origin.

</details>


### [370] [GAD: Geometry Attention Distillation for Consistent Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18779)
*Junfeng Ni,Ziyu Zhu,Fan Jiang,Yu Liu,Chiyu Wang,Jiawei Zhang,Zhaoxu Sun,Mu Xu,Siyuan Huang,Yixin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Geometry Attention Distillation (GAD)，将几何模型的注意力对应关系蒸馏到视频扩散模型的注意力中，提升长程场景与几何一致性，且无需额外推理模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视频扩散模型能生成视觉上吸引人的短视频，但难以在时间上保持场景几何和物体结构；其视频注意力无法识别可靠的跨帧对应，响应分散在多个区域。

Method: 从冻结的几何模型中提取跨帧对应关系（基于干净视频，连接相同静态表面或运动物体），并将其蒸馏到视频注意力中。由于结构形成在高噪声时始于深层、低噪声时始于浅层，按噪声时间步选择学生层进行注意力蒸馏。

Result: 在三个视频骨干网络上均提升了长程场景一致性与动态时间一致性，几何增益随生成长度增加。在Wan2.2 5B上，长程基准的跨帧匹配准确率相比Wan基线提升至少30%。

Conclusion: GAD无需额外推理模块即可实现增益，为高效且一致的视频世界模拟提供了有前景的方法。

Abstract: Video diffusion models generate visually compelling short-term sequences but often struggle to preserve scene geometry and object structure over time. In this paper, we first demonstrate that current video attention cannot identify reliable correspondences across frames, with responses dispersed across multiple regions even after recognizable scene structure has emerged. We argue that reliable cross-frame associations are essential for information exchange as scene structure forms in video generation. Thus, we introduce Geometry Attention Distillation (GAD), which transfers correspondences from a frozen geometry model's attention to video attention. Extracted from clean videos, these correspondences link the same static surface or moving object across frames. Since structure formation begins in deeper layers at higher noise and shallower layers at lower noise, we apply attention distillation at a student layer selected according to the noise timestep. After training, video attention focuses more consistently on corresponding locations. Experiments across all three video backbones demonstrate improved long-range scene consistency and dynamic temporal consistency, with geometric gains across generation lengths. On Wan2.2 5B, GAD improves cross-frame matching accuracy by at least 30% over the Wan baseline on both long-range benchmarks. Notably, GAD achieves these gains without additional inference modules, offering a promising approach to efficient and consistent video-based world simulation. Project page: https://fantasy-amap.github.io/GAD/.

</details>


### [371] [Trust Before Autonomy: Rethinking Agentic Remote Sensing for Crisis Response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18789)
*Georgios Angelidis,Aggelos Psiris,Spyridon Evangelatos,Thomas Lagkas,Panagiotis Sarigiannidis,Iraklis Varlamis,Georgios Th. Papadopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文主张EO智能体的自主性应"靠可靠性赢得"，而非默认赋予，并基于12项基准研究的证据元分析提出信任属性、自主性阶梯与就绪协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体遥感评测只看"能答多少题"，但危机响应真正关心的是答案是否可信、以及多少决策可安全交给智能体，二者存在根本错位。

Method: 对12项同行评审的RS/EO/GIS智能体基准研究进行证据元分析，并据此提出三项EO专属信任属性、面向危机EO任务的自主性阶梯和上线前的就绪协议（重放历史应急任务）。

Result: 仅有1项研究重复运行，3项包含不可答任务，无一测量校准；完成的工作流常不正确（相同查询下任务成功率比工具调用正确率高出最高54个百分点）；与专家轨迹的差距随轨迹变长整体扩大（7→56个百分点）；能力不能预测弃答（Spearman r为-0.25至0.50，均不显著）。

Conclusion: 当前证据只足以支持辅助性（assistive）角色，尚不足以赋予更强自主性。

Abstract: Agentic remote sensing is evaluated on how many questions it can answer, whereas crisis response depends on whether its answers can be relied on and how much of the decision can safely be handed to the agent. This paper argues that \emph{autonomy should be earned, not assumed}: An Earth-Observation (EO) agent should be granted autonomy in proportion to demonstrated reliability, epistemic honesty and verifiability. The position is supported by an evidential meta-analysis of twelve agentic RS/EO/GIS benchmark studies from peer-reviewed venues. Only one repeats runs, three contain unanswerable tasks and none measures calibration. Their own tables show that completed workflows are often not correct (task success exceeds tool-call correctness by up to 54pp on identical queries), that the gap to an expert trajectory widens overall with trajectory length (from 7 to 56pp), and that capability does not predict abstention (Spearman r from -0.25 to 0.50, all n.s.). The paper then contributes three EO-specific trust properties, an autonomy ladder for crisis EO tasks, and a readiness protocol that replays archived emergency activations before any live use. In this context, current evidence justifies assistive roles only.

</details>


### [372] [Registration is a Representation Problem: Solving Whole-Body PET/CT Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18804)
*Neel Dey,Adrian V. Dalca*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出用互补表征（anatomix基础模型特征+分割标签）驱动GPU加速迭代配准，实现全身纵向PET/CT配准，无需任务训练即获PSMAReg挑战赛第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始图像强度在跨图像相似度度量中表现差；辅助分割标签虽能提供语义身份，但只能给出粗粒度身份、覆盖结构有限，尤其在全身场景下不足。

Method: 用3D基础模型anatomix生成跨体积一致的细粒度逐体素语义表征，并结合现成分割模型获得粗粒度解剖身份；两类表征驱动GPU加速迭代配准求解器FireANTs，采用混合多阶段框架：第一阶段基于密集多通道特征估计对齐，第二阶段用anatomix和分割损失精炼形变；并提出病灶特异的分量式体积保持方案。

Result: 在Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg挑战赛排行榜中名列第一，且无需任何任务特定训练。

Conclusion: 互补的解剖表征结合多阶段配准与体积保持，可有效解决全身纵向PET/CT配准，具备强泛化性。

Abstract: Raw image intensities are a poor surrogate for similarity across images in correspondence problems. Further, while auxiliary segmentation labels can provide semantic identification and improve matching, they can assign only coarse identities to fine-grained anatomy and often cover only a subset of structures, particularly in whole-body settings. We present an approach that instead establishes correspondence using complementary representations of anatomy and demonstrate its utility for longitudinal whole-body PET/CT registration in the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg Challenge. Our 3D foundation model, anatomix, is used to derive fine-grained, per-voxel semantic representations that are consistent across volumes, and we further employ off-the-shelf segmentation models to obtain coarse anatomical identities. Together, these representations drive a GPU-accelerated iterative registration solver (FireANTs) in a hybrid multistage framework: the first stage estimates alignment from dense multi-channel features, after which a second refines the deformation using both anatomix- and segmentation-based losses. Lastly, because registration should not introduce non-biological tumor volume changes across time, we develop lesion-specific component-wise volume preservation schemes. Without any task-specific training, our system won first place in the PSMAReg Challenge leaderboard. Code and interactive visualizations are available at http://www.neeldey.com/reps-for-reg.

</details>


### [373] [DuplexBridge: Coordinating Understanding and Generation for Unified Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18819)
*Yidi Liu,Jie Xiao,Chaojie Mao,Jingfeng Zhang,Xueyang Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DuplexBridge，用统一模型的理解能力增强其自身生成能力，并构建CE-Bench基准，显著提升复杂图像编辑的任务合规率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂图像编辑需要忠实的任务理解与准确执行，但编辑失败时无法区分是理解还是生成环节的问题，且以往方法依赖外部理解模块。

Method: 采用无外部理解模块的统一模型；源锚定的桥（bridge）明确目标、最终状态变化与保持约束；理解仅以对原始请求的忠实度监督（不观察生成图像），生成仅以实际接收条件的执行监督；通过互信检查选择性引入全局任务反馈，同时保留独立有效的局部监督。

Result: 在三种模型配置下，完整系统较直接编辑器将完全合规率提升21.75–25.75个百分点，并在KRIS-Bench、RISEBench、ImgEdit、GEdit-Bench上亦有增益；从相同Wan-Image初始化出发，门控联合训练达77.08%完全合规，无门控为70.92%，生成端局部监督检查原始任务（保留门控）为75.00%。

Conclusion: 结果支持为理解与生成设定各自独立的局部职责，并选择性共享反馈，有助于理解-生成联合适应。

Abstract: Complex image editing requires faithful task interpretation and accurate execution, but a failed edit does not reveal which responsibility failed. We present DuplexBridge, which uses a unified model's own understanding capability to enhance prompts for its own generation capability, without an external understanding module. A source-grounded bridge specifies targets, final-state changes, and preservation constraints. Understanding is supervised on fidelity to the original request without observing the generated image; generation is supervised on execution of the condition it actually receives. Reciprocal trust checks selectively admit global task feedback to each role while retaining independently valid local supervision. We introduce CE-Bench, a 1,200-task benchmark measuring joint satisfaction of task-derived change and preservation requirements. Across three model configurations, the full system improves complete compliance over direct editors by 21.75-25.75 percentage points, with gains also observed on KRIS-Bench, RISEBench, ImgEdit, and GEdit-Bench. From a common supervised Wan-Image initialization, gated joint training reaches 77.08% complete compliance, compared with 70.92% without gates and 75.00% when generation-local supervision instead checks the original task with both gates retained. These results support distinct local responsibilities and selective shared feedback for joint understanding-generation adaptation.

</details>


### [374] [Game2Real-Bench: Do Toy Games Reveal and Transfer to Real-World Visual Reasoning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18834)
*Qingan Liu,Juntong Feng,Yue Zhu,Yujie Cheng,Xinzhe Han,Shuai Hao,Yunzhi Zhuge,Haiwen Diao,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出Game2Real-Bench基准，研究程序化生成游戏任务与真实世界视觉推理能力的对应关系。构建1000个可验证游戏样本和400个真实样本，评估25个VLM，发现游戏-真实强一致性（Pearson/Spearman约0.935）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM视觉推理评测依赖真实数据或程序生成任务，但不清楚玩具游戏中测得的能力是否能迁移到真实世界视觉推理。

Method: 构建Game2Real-Bench，涵盖细粒度感知、空间推理、约束推理、序列规划四类能力组；生成1000个带可执行验证的游戏样本，并按共享推理需求（而非视觉相似度）筛选400个真实样本；评测25个代表性VLM，并进行四模型的一次性游戏到真实迁移实验；另构建约24K验证游戏样本、18任务、65 QA族的Game2Real-Dataset。

Result: 游戏与真实表现强一致，Pearson和Spearman相关均为0.935；一次性迁移中约束推理在多个模型提升，但细粒度感知随游戏示例下降。

Conclusion: 游戏基准能有效反映真实世界视觉推理能力并支持迁移研究，但不同能力组迁移效果不一致，为VLM视觉推理评测和训练提供了新资源与洞见。

Abstract: Visual reasoning is an important capability for vision-language models (VLMs) to understand visual evidence, spatial structure, constraints, and state changes. Existing evaluations mainly rely on real-world data or procedurally generated tasks. Real-world data preserve natural complexity, while procedural games provide controllable generation and verifiable solutions. However, it remains unclear whether abilities measured in toy games correspond to real-world visual reasoning and whether game examples can support transfer. We introduce Game2Real-Bench, a benchmark that studies these connections across four capability groups, including fine-grained perception, spatial reasoning, constraint reasoning, and sequential planning. We construct 1,000 procedurally generated game samples with executable verification and curate 400 real-world samples aligned by shared reasoning requirements rather than visual similarity. We evaluate 25 representative VLMs and observe strong game-to-real consistency, with Pearson and Spearman correlations of 0.935. We further study one-shot game-to-real transfer on four models. Constraint reasoning improves for several models, while fine-grained perception declines with game demonstrations. We also construct Game2Real-Dataset with nearly 24K verified game samples across 18 tasks and 65 QA families. Our benchmark, dataset, and code are available at https://github.com/QingAnLiu/Game2Real-Bench.

</details>


### [375] [Plan-Bench: Can Existing VLMs Go Well Beyond Perception to Reason and Plan in Embodied Worlds?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18836)
*Juntong Feng,Qingan Liu,Jingru Dong,Yue Zhu,Weiming Zheng,Yujie Cheng,Xinzhe Han,Shuai Hao,Yunzhi Zhuge,Haiwen Diao,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Plan-Bench，一个评估视觉语言模型在具身环境中高层推理与多步规划能力的基准，隔离执行影响，涵盖3维度16子类699样例，评估28个模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 在视觉感知和空间推理上表现强劲，被视为具身 AI 的高层规划器，但物理任务需要整合空间信息、推理时序状态并生成多步约束规划，当前 VLM 能否独立于执行可靠支持这些能力尚不明确。

Method: 构建 Plan-Bench 基准，覆盖三个互补维度、16个子类和699个精选样本，隔离动作执行的影响；对28个 VLM 进行广泛评测，并开展模型规模与消融研究。

Result: 评测显示现有模型仍有提升空间，最强模型仅达75.0%准确率；模型规模扩大通常提升相关能力，更大模型作为高层规划器潜力增加。

Conclusion: Plan-Bench 提供了一个轻量级探针，用于评估 VLM 在具身环境中的推理与规划能力及其作为物理任务决策者的潜力。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in visual perception and spatial reasoning, leading to growing interest in using them as high-level planners for embodied AI. However, physical tasks require models to integrate spatial information, reason over temporal states, and generate multi-step plans under various constraints, raising the question of whether current VLMs can reliably support such reasoning and planning independently of execution. We introduce Plan-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the high-level reasoning and multi-step planning capabilities of VLMs relevant to embodied worlds, while isolating the influence of action execution. It covers three complementary dimensions, spanning 16 subclasses and 699 curated samples. Extensive evaluation of 28 VLMs reveals room for improvement, with even the strongest model achieving only 75.0% accuracy. We further find that model scaling generally improves these capabilities. Ablation studies also indicate larger models show increasing potential as high-level planners. Overall, Plan-Bench provides a lightweight probe for evaluating VLMs' reasoning and planning capabilities relevant to embodied environments and assessing their potential as decision makers for physical tasks. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench.

</details>


### [376] [RepProbe: Can Video Language Models Count Repeated Actions? A Diagnostic Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18844)
*Mahsa Khoshnoodi,Sarah Adel Bargal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出RepProbe基准，研究视频语言模型重复计数失败的原因，发现模型内部表征可线性解码计数信息，但输出阶段无法可靠报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频语言模型能流畅描述动作，却无法可靠计数动作重复次数。作者希望定位这一失败发生的模型阶段。

Method: 构建RepProbe基准：42K真实与合成视频片段，含k∈[1,20]次完整重复，控制片段位置、时间覆盖和时长；对比模型输出与在最终层表征上训练的线性探针。

Result: 高重复次数时计数准确率崩溃，且非帧采样所致；存在表征-输出解离——计数信息仍可线性解码，但输出集中在少数偏好数字，不随时长、位置或场景内容改变。

Conclusion: 模型编码了重复结构，但在输出阶段未能可靠报告；失败主要发生在输出阶段而非表征阶段。

Abstract: Repetition counting requires identifying and enumerating action cycles over time. While state-of-the-art video language models describe actions fluently, they fail to reliably count how many times an action repeats. To investigate this limitation, we introduce RepProbe, a benchmark of 42K real and synthetic video clips containing exactly k in [1, 20] complete repetitions, with controls for clip position, temporal coverage, and duration. These controls allow us to study the counting failure directly and locate where in the model it arises. Counting accuracy collapses at high counts across the video language models we evaluate, and controlled experiments show this collapse is not explained by frame sampling alone. We compare model outputs with linear probes trained on the final-layer representations used to generate those outputs. We find a consistent representation-to-output dissociation: substantial count information remains linearly decodable even when models fail to report the correct count. Further analysis shows this failure arises primarily at the output stage, where answers concentrate on a small set of preferred numbers rather than the available count information. The dissociation holds on both real and synthetic videos and is not explained by clip duration, position, or scene content. These results indicate that models encode repetition structure but do not reliably report it in their outputs. Project page: https://arenaa.github.io/RepProbe-webpage/

</details>


### [377] [WorldRecon: Generative Multi-View Mesh Reconstruction for Large-Scale 3D World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18846)
*Mengchen Zhang,Yang Li,Chunshi Wang,Tong Wu,Chunchao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldRecon：从无位姿多视角图像重建大规模完整3D场景网格的生成式框架，基于TRELLIS.2改造条件架构，用分块+邻居感知潜变量修复+因果生成实现场景一致性，合成与真实室内场景上Chamfer距离降低14.9%/43.1%，F-score提升17.3%/12.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从无位姿多视角图像重建大规模场景的完整高质量网格，既需要忠实几何，又需要合理补全未观测或稀疏区域；现有方法难以同时兼顾几何保真与大规模场景的一致性。

Method: 用重建模型估计的粗噪全局点云与相机位姿作为全局骨架，划分为重叠空间块；为原生3D生成模型TRELLIS.2配备基于重建的条件架构，用局部点云裁剪块与块相关图像观测生成稀疏结构、细节几何与PBR材质；引入邻居感知潜变量修复与因果世界生成过程，跨重叠块传播结构、几何与材质上下文以保持场景级一致性。

Result: 在合成与真实室内场景上均达到SOTA：Chamfer距离分别降低14.9%和43.1%，F-score分别提升17.3%和12.0%，展现忠实的完整生成式重建与良好的sim-to-real泛化能力。

Conclusion: WorldRecon通过分块生成与跨块上下文传播，将多视角生成式重建扩展到大规模场景，输出连贯统一的网格，验证了生成式方法在大规模场景重建中的有效性与泛化性。

Abstract: Reconstructing complete, high-quality meshes of large-scale scenes from unposed multi-view images requires faithful geometric grounding while plausibly completing surfaces that are unobserved or only sparsely captured. We present WorldRecon, a generative multi-view reconstruction framework for recovering complete, large-scale 3D scene meshes from unposed RGB images. WorldRecon uses a coarse, noisy global point cloud and camera poses estimated from the input images by a reconstruction model as a global scaffold for whole-scene generation and partitions it into overlapping spatial blocks. To robustly leverage these imperfect geometric priors, we equip the native 3D generative model TRELLIS.2 with a dedicated reconstruction-based conditioning architecture that generates each block from its local point-cloud crop and block-relevant image observations, producing sparse structure, detailed geometry, and PBR materials. To maintain scene-level coherence, we introduce neighbour-aware latent inpainting and a causal world-generation procedure that propagates structural, geometric, and material context across overlapping blocks. Together, these designs scale multi-view generative reconstruction to large-scale scenes, yielding coherent, unified meshes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WorldRecon achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance, reducing Chamfer distance by 14.9% and 43.1% while improving F-score by 17.3% and 12.0% over the strongest baselines on synthetic and real-world indoor scenes, respectively, thereby demonstrating faithful and complete generative reconstruction as well as strong sim-to-real generalization. Project page: https://kszpxxzmc.github.io/WorldRecon-website/.

</details>


### [378] [PixelMoE: Scaling Pixel-Space Diffusion with LLM-Style Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18857)
*Ruixiao Dong,Jianmin Bao,Bozhi Luan,Zijie Meng,Xin Tao,Pengfei Wan,Kun Gai,Li Li,Houqiang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PixelMoE，将标准LLM式MoE迁移到像素空间扩散模型，实现稀疏容量扩展，并配合像素空间分层流匹配，在ImageNet-1K上取得领先FID。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素空间扩散模型无需tokenizer，但现有扩展方式多为稠密策略，将模型容量与激活计算紧密耦合，扩展成本高。

Method: 基于标准LLM式MoE构建PixelMoE：采用Token-Choice路由与细粒度路由专家实现输入自适应稀疏计算，加入共享专家捕获通用表示，使用基于bias的负载均衡策略；并提出像素空间分层流匹配，沿去噪轨迹变化空间分辨率，从全局结构到细节逐级细化。

Result: 在相同激活参数量下，PixelMoE在各模型规模上持续优于稠密对应模型；在类条件ImageNet-1K上，256x256取得FID 1.47，512x512取得FID 1.53，且未使用表示对齐或感知损失。

Conclusion: 标准LLM式MoE可有效迁移至像素空间扩散，实现有效的稀疏容量扩展，结果可与领先的像素空间及潜空间生成模型相媲美。

Abstract: Pixel-space diffusion models provide an appealing alternative to latent-space diffusion models by directly modeling raw images without relying on a learned tokenizer. However, scaling pixel-space models has predominantly followed dense strategies, tightly coupling model capacity with active computation. In this work, we show that standard LLM-style Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures can be effectively transferred to pixel-space diffusion. Building on this finding, we introduce PixelMoE, a pixel-space generative framework that sparsely scales model capacity with standard LLM-style MoE, without diffusion-specific routing mechanisms or auxiliary routing objectives. Specifically, PixelMoE combines standard Token-Choice (TC) routing with fine-grained routed experts for input-adaptive sparse computation, a shared expert for capturing common representations, and a bias-based load-balancing strategy. To complement sparse capacity scaling, PixelMoE further introduces Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching, which varies spatial resolution along the denoising trajectory from global structure formation to fine-grained detail refinement. At comparable active parameter counts, PixelMoE consistently outperforms its dense counterparts across model scales, demonstrating effective sparse capacity scaling in pixel space. On class-conditional ImageNet-1K, PixelMoE achieves FID scores of 1.47 at 256x256 and 1.53 at 512x512 without representation alignment or perceptual losses, comparing favorably with leading pixel-space and latent-space generative models. Code and models will be released soon.

</details>


### [379] [Visual Tokens on Demand: Visual Budgeting for Scalable and Efficient Multi-Image Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18858)
*Aimon Rahman,Joymallya Chakraborty,Vidit Bansal,Abhishek Dan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出mmVB，一个轻量即插即用模块，为多图推理分配查询条件下的每图token预算，减少9倍视觉token，无需重训、无需访问注意力矩阵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型多针对单图优化，多图推理因视觉token激增而成本高。现有多token压缩方法多为单图场景（冗余是空间局部的），未处理跨图冗余、稀疏/分布式证据等问题；且要么免训练但推理低效（依赖注意力矩阵，与FlashAttention不兼容），要么需重训基座模型。

Method: mmVB：轻量即插即用模块，通过跨图上下文为每张图分配查询条件下的token预算，仅新增1.6M可训练参数。不需重训基座MLLM，也不需在推理时访问注意力矩阵。

Result: 视觉输入token减少9倍，time-to-first-token快5倍，prefill FLOPs减少7倍，同时在八个多图推理基准上保持94.4%的全分辨率准确率。

Conclusion: mmVB实现了可扩展的多图推理与理解，无需重训基座模型、无需访问注意力矩阵，在效率大幅提升的同时保持高准确率。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models have advanced rapidly, but most remain optimized for single-image inputs. Multi-image reasoning is costly because each image adds many visual tokens, increasing encoding and attention demands. Existing techniques that address the above issue, including visual token pruning, token merging, visual token compression, learned resampling, hierarchical compression, retrieval-augmented visual reasoning, and memory-based architectures, have largely been designed for single-image scenarios, where redundancy is primarily spatial and local. Multi-image reasoning introduces additional challenges: redundancy may occur across images, task-relevant evidence may be sparse or distributed, and aggressive per-image compression can remove details needed for comparison, counting, temporal reasoning, retrieval, or evidence grounding. Moreover, existing token-reduction methods are often either (i) training-free but inference-inefficient, typically relying on accessing attention matrices to get token-importance that may be impractical to access with memory-efficient attention implementations such as FlashAttention, or (ii) training-dependent, requiring the base MLLM to be retrained or adapted to a new compressed-token paradigm. In this work, we study scalable multi-image reasoning and understanding without retraining the base model and without accessing attention matrices at inference time. To this end, we propose mmVB, a lightweight plug-and-play module that assigns query-conditioned per-image token budgets via cross-image context, adding only 1.6M trainable parameters while reducing visual input tokens by 9x. This reduction yields 5x faster time-to-first-token and 7x fewer prefill FLOPs, while maintaining 94.4% of full-resolution accuracy across eight multi-image reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [380] [PLAYGROUND: Progressive Layout Generation with Render-Grounded Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18865)
*Jaeho Lee,Junhwan Heo,Junghyun Park,WonJun Moon,Eunju Yang,Seungho Jang,Seongchan Kim,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PlayGround，一个渐进式布局生成框架，通过动态适应当前渲染画布实现可编辑图形设计，在 Crello 和 LICA 上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于MLLM的方法采用迭代生成和视觉细化，但高层规划在执行前就已预先确定，无法随着设计演变灵活调整，适用性受限。

Method: PlayGround 构建渐进式设计循环，包含渐进规划器（Progressive Planner）、布局生成器和视觉验证器，并由结构感知检索器（Structure-Aware Retriever）引导：先由检索器推断粗略布局结构并检索相似参考设计，每轮渐进规划器结合当前渲染画布与剩余元素形成下一个功能组并规划其构图，布局生成器预测可编辑布局属性，视觉验证器评估候选并在需要时反馈优化；为训练规划器，还构建了两阶段数据生成流水线，从已完成设计中提取功能组和轮级规划轨迹。

Result: 在 Crello 和 LICA 数据集上的实验证明了 PlayGround 相比现有方法的有效性。

Conclusion: PlayGround 通过渐进式、画布自适应的布局生成范式，突破了预先规划的限制，提升了可编辑图形设计生成的适应性；代码和权重将公开。

Abstract: Generating editable graphic designs requires arranging visual and textual elements into a coherent composition while preserving their content and editability. Although recent MLLM-based approaches employ iterative generation and visual refinement to reflect the real-world design workflows, their high-level plans are predetermined prior to execution, limiting their adaptability as the design evolves. To address this limitation, we propose PlayGround, a progressive layout generation framework that dynamically adapts to the current rendered canvas. PlayGround establishes a progressive design loop comprising a Progressive Planner, a Layout Generator, and a Visual Verifier, guided by a Structure-Aware Retriever. Given an initial set of unordered elements, the Structure-Aware Retriever initially infers a coarse layout structure to retrieve structurally similar reference designs. Subsequently, at each turn, the Progressive Planner examines the current rendered canvas alongside the remaining elements, forms the next functional group, and plans its composition. The Layout Generator then predicts editable layout attributes, while the Visual Verifier evaluates rendered candidates and provides feedback when refinement is necessary. To train the Progressive Planner with step-wise supervision, we construct a two-stage data generation pipeline that extracts functional groups and turn-level planning trajectories from completed designs. Experiments on Crello and LICA demonstrate the effectiveness of PlayGround over existing methods. Our code and weights will be publicly released.

</details>


### [381] [Dog-Breed Text-to-image Flow Matching from Pretraining to Fine-Tuning on 4 Consumer GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18870)
*Reyhaneh Esmailizadeh,Xingjian Leng,Zhanhao Liang,Liang Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MiniDog是一个低成本框架，可在4块3090 GPU上55分钟预训练、15分钟微调扩散Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练文本到图像扩散模型通常被认为需要大量算力，这阻碍了初学者训练自己的模型。

Method: 在数据上用ImageNet的2.6万张狗图片加caption做预训练，2千张FLUX.1-schnell生成图做微调，并预计算缓存图文特征；架构采用E2E-INVAE、22M参数小Transformer、小型Qwen文本编码器和in-context conditioning；训练用iREPA和EUPE感知编码器加速。

Result: 在四块3090 GPU上实现55分钟预训练和额外15分钟微调；仓库支持FID、HPSv2、PickScore及多种VAE重建指标评估。

Conclusion: 该工作降低了扩散模型训练门槛，为入门者提供高效的端到端训练方案。

Abstract: We generally perceive that training text-to-image diffusion models requires heavy compute: it is true if we aim at a comprehensive frontier model. This understanding prevents people from training their own models when getting started in the field. We develop MiniDog, a framework that enables pretraining diffusion transformers in 55 minutes and fine-tuning in another 15 minutes on four 3090 GPUs. For data, we use 26k dog images from ImageNet and caption them for pretraining and use 2k images generated by FLUX.1-schnell for fine-tuning. We precompute the image and text features and cache them for efficiency. For architecture, we use E2E-INVAE for its semantic latent space, a small transformer with 22M parameters, a small Qwen model for text encoding, and in-context conditioning. For training, we use iREPA and an EUPE perception encoder for acceleration. For evaluation, our repository supports FID, HPSv2 score, PickScore, and various VAE reconstruction metrics.

</details>


### [382] [Cepheid: Decoupling Scale from Structure for Cross-Family Motion Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18871)
*Chih-Hai Su,Tsung-Wei Ke,Yu-Lun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无量纲残差先验，解耦残差结构与物理尺度，从稀疏顶点位移恢复稠密网格运动，跨几何族统一建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 残差先验按几何族训练时，跨族常不如无参数调和扩展；且跨族训练存在缩放障碍：残差幅度随几何族变化超一个数量级，观测变密时又崩塌，且真实幅度依赖未知目标运动，测试时无法直接测得。

Method: 将残差结构从物理尺度中解耦：学习无量纲（尺度无关）先验，幅度由可观测量估计，并用仅在训练源上拟合的轻量级校正。

Result: 统一模型在所有评测几何族上超越调和扩展，包括未见过的布料与足式机体，无需骨架、配准或跨网格对应；同一先验无需重训即泛化到点追踪动物视频与机器人抓取软体场景。

Conclusion: 通过无量纲先验与幅度估计解耦，实现跨几何族、跨任务的稀疏到稠密运动补全统一模型。

Abstract: Sparse-to-dense motion completion recovers dense mesh motion from sparse vertex displacements. Residual priors trained on one geometry family frequently fail to beat parameter-free harmonic extension off-family. Moreover, cross-family training meets a scaling barrier: residual amplitude varies by more than an order of magnitude across geometry families and collapses as observations become denser. Since this scale depends on unknown target motion, it cannot be measured directly at test time. We decouple residual structure from physical scale by learning a dimensionless prior, estimating amplitude from observables and a lightweight correction fitted only on training sources. Our unified model surpasses harmonic extension across all evaluated families, including unseen cloth and legged bodies, without skeletons, registration, or cross-mesh correspondence. The same prior applies without retraining to point-tracked animal video and a robot grasping a soft body. Project page: https://su-terry.github.io/cepheid-website/

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [383] [PsyBer-Agent: A Psychology-Driven User Agent for Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13989)
*Chong Zhang,Qijie Shen,Haichao Zhang,Can Wang,Xiaobo Jin,Jia Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出心理学启发的推荐系统模拟器PsyBer-Agent，通过Psy-Engine建模用户潜在动态状态，用不平衡Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输对齐实现轻量策略监督，并引入WebSim平台与PsyBer基准，在行为保真度、潜状态一致性、鲁棒性等方面表现优于纯提示模拟器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体多为表层模仿者，能生成逼真的短期响应，却无法捕捉疲劳、情感与偏好漂移等底层用户动态，难以在长周期闭环交互中保持真实，因此需更真实的模拟器用于部署前评估。

Method: 提出PsyBer-Agent，其Psy-Engine为每个用户建模三个演化、模型定义的潜在状态；通过不平衡Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输，将日志条件参考轨迹与模拟器生成的潜状态轨迹对齐，为轻量策略提供结构化监督，避免微调主干LLM的开销。

Result: 引入WebSim与PsyBer基准，涵盖多模态场景与七种推荐主干；评估行为保真度、潜状态一致性、鲁棒性及社会线索扰动响应。在测试时长上，PsyBer-Agent行为差异低于纯提示模拟器，并在有界并发下稳定支持最多500万排队模拟任务的大规模并发模拟。

Conclusion: PsyBer-Agent通过心理学启发的潜状态建模与最优传输对齐，提供了更真实、可扩展的推荐系统闭环模拟方案，优于纯提示模拟器，代码已公开。

Abstract: Evaluating recommender systems before deployment requires simulators that remain realistic over long, closed-loop interaction cycles. Current LLM-based agents generally function as surface imitators that generate realistic short-term responses but fail to capture the underlying user dynamics such as fatigue, affect, and shifting preferences. We propose PsyBer-Agent, a psychology-inspired simulator that models these dynamics through its Psy-Engine. This engine represents each user with three evolving, model-defined latent states. To calibrate simulated behavior against real interaction logs, we align log-conditioned reference trajectories with simulator-generated latent-state trajectories via Unbalanced Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport. This approach provides structured supervision for a lightweight policy without the computational burden of fine-tuning the backbone LLM. We also introduce WebSim and the PsyBer Benchmark, which encompass multimodal scenarios and seven recommender backbones. Our framework evaluates behavioral fidelity, latent-state consistency, robustness, and responses to social-cue perturbations. On the tested horizons, PsyBer-Agent shows lower behavioral discrepancy than the prompt-only simulators while maintaining stable performance under large-scale concurrent simulation for up to 5M queued simulation tasks under bounded concurrency. Code is available in the supplementary material and at: PsyBer-Agent: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CC66F/, WebSim Platform: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/D8EAX/.

</details>


### [384] [Loose Lips: Understanding Privacy Leakage in Agentic Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14071)
*Soumya Sharma,Ayana Hussain,Heber Hwang Arcolezi,Ulrich Aïvodji,Spandana Gella,Adriana Romero-Soriano,Golnoosh Farnadi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE 基准（4,410 条双智能体对话），基于语境完整性理论评估 LLM 智能体的隐私泄露问题，发现任务能力与隐私泄露存在根本耦合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在高风险企业场景中广泛部署，其在对话中处理敏感信息的方式至关重要。隐私泄露需结合信息来源的语境规范来推理，但现有评估缺乏相应基准。

Method: 将 CIMemories 扩展为 CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE，构建 4,410 条双智能体对话实例，以语境完整性理论为基础。系统评测 Qwen3 与 Llama 3.1 家族的 7 个开放权重模型，覆盖 1 轮和 6 轮对话长度及三种提示条件。

Result: 任务能力与隐私泄露根本耦合：能力越强的模型泄露越严重，无一模型能解耦两者。思考型模型比非思考型泄露更多（归因于思维链带来的推理面扩大）；泄露随对话长度累积，从 1 轮到 6 轮最多增加 3 倍。

Conclusion: 任务能力与隐私泄露的耦合并非配置错误所致，而是当前智能体系统的结构性特征。

Abstract: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in high-stakes enterprise settings, understanding how they handle sensitive information in agentic dialogue has become critical. Privacy leakage in such settings requires reasoning about whether information flows respect the contextual norms under which they originated. We extend CIMemories to CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE, a benchmark of 4,410 two-agent dialogue instances grounded in Contextual Integrity theory. Using this benchmark, we systematically evaluate 7 open-weight models from the Qwen3 and Llama 3.1 families across conversation lengths of 1 and 6 turns under three prompting conditions. We find that task capability and privacy leakage are fundamentally coupled: more capable models are systematically leakier, with no model in our evaluation able to decouple the two. Thinking models consistently leak more than their non-thinking counterparts, a pattern we attribute to the extended reasoning surface created by chain-of-thought. Leakage compounds with conversation length, rising up to 3x from 1 to 6 turns. Our results suggest that the coupling between task capability and privacy leakage is not an artifact of misconfiguration but a structural feature of current agentic systems.

</details>


### [385] [Is the Future Predictable? Modeling Future Predictability for Reliable Temporal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14073)
*Yongyi Huang,Huaping Zhang,Wenyao Cui,Qiuchi Li,Lei Li,Baohua Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ChronoRegime未来时间推理任务及CTR框架，通过评估未来可预测性来决定是否对答案做出承诺，提升准确率并降低幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在未来推理上不可靠，常忽视未来状态间的差异，即便是本质上多变的事实也强行给出确定答案。

Method: 定义ChronoRegime任务，要求模型判断历史时间证据是否足以支持对未来答案的承诺；提出Confidence-Aware Temporal Reasoning（CTR）框架，从时间动态估计未来可预测性并据此调节答案承诺，仅在重构证据支持目标未来状态时才作答。

Result: 在多个LLM上，相较普通QA基线，CTR平均将严格总体准确率提升6.7个百分点，幻觉率降低18.4个百分点。

Conclusion: 显式的可预测性评估是未来不确定性下实现更安全可靠时间推理的有效机制。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable when reasoning about the future. Existing models often overlook the difference among future states, committing to specific answers even when the queried facts are inherently volatile. To capture this challenge, we introduce ChronoRegime, a future-oriented temporal reasoning task that requires models to determine whether historical temporal evidence justifies commitment to a future answer. Furthermore, we propose Confidence-Aware Temporal Reasoning (CTR), a framework that estimates future predictability from temporal dynamics and regulates answer commitment accordingly. Rather than performing unconditional forecasting, CTR commits only when the reconstructed evidence supports the target future state. Across multiple LLMs, CTR improves strict overall accuracy by 6.7 percentage points and reduces hallucination rates by 18.4 percentage points on average over the plain QA baseline. These results demonstrate that explicit predictability assessment is an effective mechanism for safer and more reliable temporal reasoning under future uncertainty.

</details>


### [386] [Fin_Agent at FinEval 2026: Task-Aware Methods for Multilingual Financial NLP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14101)
*Mohotarema Rashid,Tanzina Hossain,Xiaoying Song,Lingzi Hong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Fin_Agent 参加 FinEval 2026 多语言金融语言理解任务，覆盖希腊金融NER、日语隐性沟通识别和多语言金融问答三个子任务，采用规则+大模型分类、线索评分和检索增强生成方法并取得相应成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向 FinEval 2026 多语言金融语言理解共享任务，构建系统处理希腊语金融命名实体识别、日语隐性沟通识别和多语言金融问答三类任务。

Method: 希腊NER结合标注感知数值规则与零样本 Qwen2.5-32B 分类；日语隐性沟通采用可解释的线索评分序数打分器；多语言金融QA使用 BGE-M3 检索配合 Qwen3-32B 生成。

Result: 希腊NER获公开/私有 F1 0.9521/0.8884；日语隐性沟通测试准确率98.0%；多语言金融QA公开/私有 ROUGE-1 F1 为0.3023/0.3419。

Conclusion: 系统在多个子任务上表现良好，但存在依赖数据集特定规则、手工线索和监督数据有限等局限，代码已开源。

Abstract: We present Fin_Agent, our submission to the FinEval 2026 shared task on multilingual fi nancial language understanding. Our sys tems address Greek financial named-entity recognition, Japanese implicit communication recognition, and multilingual financial ques tion answering. For Greek NER, we com bine annotation-aware numeric rules with zero shot Qwen2.5-32B classification, achieving 0.9521 public F1 and 0.8884 private F1. For Japanese implicit communication, an inter pretable cue-based ordinal scorer achieves 98.0% test accuracy. For multilingual financial QA, BGE-M3retrieval with Qwen3-32B gen eration achieves 0.3023 and 0.3419 ROUGE-1 F1 on the public and private splits. Key limita tions include dataset-specific rules, handcrafted cues, and limited supervision. Implementa tion code is available https://github.com/ Rashidnira/finagent-fineval-2026.

</details>


### [387] [Does System One Transfer? Calibrated Typed-Decision Models, Label Budgets, and Translation for Indonesian Regional Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14112)
*Romi Fadli,Rusdah,Wahyu Ramadani Putri Utami,Zulfa Malika Amana*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文预注册评估了商业Jev模型与开源Laya-multilingual模型在印尼地方语言上的情感/情绪分类表现，并比较校准、重训练及级联路由策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 校准型"System One"决策模型的评估几乎全部局限于英语，其在印尼地方语言等多语低资源场景下的表现尚不清楚。

Method: 在NusaX情感（12语言）和NusaTranslation情感与情绪（7语言）平行测试集上，对Jev和Laya-multilingual进行预注册评测；分析词汇距离、提供印尼语翻译、校准误差、错误排序能力；重训练分类器与零样本Jev对比；构建置信门控级联路由至IndoBERT或LLM；并对比6个商业LLM。

Result: Jev在词汇上更接近印尼语的句子上更常正确；给出印尼语翻译后可提升准确率最多37.2点。校准误差未增大，但错误排序能力在三数据集均下降。重训练分类器需每语言超500标签才能在10个NusaX语言中9个追平零样本Jev。级联路由可匹敌或超过较优系统，路由至LLM可在降低24-77% API成本下匹敌该LLM。6个商业LLM中5个比Jev高4-14点但成本高数百倍，最小的Claude Haiku更差。

Conclusion: Jev等校准型小模型在印尼地方语言上具成本效益，级联路由是兼顾准确率与成本的实用方案；预注册、代码与全部预测已公开。

Abstract: Calibrated typed-decision ("System One") models return a label and a probability in a single forward pass at a small fraction of the cost of large language models (LLMs), yet their evaluation has been almost entirely English. We report a pre-registered evaluation of the commercial Jev model and the open Laya-multilingual model on Indonesian regional languages, using the parallel NusaX sentiment (12 languages) and NusaTranslation sentiment and emotion (7 languages) test sets. Jev is more often correct on sentences that are lexically closer to Indonesian in all three datasets, and presenting the human Indonesian translation instead raises its accuracy by up to 37.2 points, most in languages distant from Indonesian. Its expected calibration error does not grow on regional languages, but its ability to rank its own errors degrades in all three datasets. Retrained classifiers need more than 500 labels per language to match zero-shot Jev in 9 of 10 NusaX regional languages. A confidence-gated cascade that sends Jev's 10-30% least confident decisions to a local IndoBERT classifier matches or exceeds the better of the two systems, and routing to an LLM instead matches that LLM at 24-77% lower API cost. Of six further commercial LLMs (three Claude and three GPT models), five are 4-14 points more accurate than Jev, at several hundred times the API cost where it is reported, while the smallest (Claude Haiku) is less accurate. We release the pre-registration, code and all predictions.

</details>


### [388] [Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14162)
*Hermann Kumbong,Ishan S. Khare,Iddah Mlauzi,Andrew Woen,Charles Ding,E. Kelly Buchanan,Simran Arora,Azalia Mirhoseini,Christopher Ré*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: NCM：两阶段由粗到细框架，用多尺度残差VQ-VAE分层编码文本，transformer逐层并行生成，兼顾质量与速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）虽支持并行采样、生成更快，但在推理成为主要计算负载时暴露出三大缺陷：步数少时质量急剧下降、每步都处理整条序列、需要多次遍历数据集才能达到好质量。

Method: 提出Next-Concept Modeling（NCM），两阶段由粗到细：第一阶段用多尺度残差VQ-VAE将文本编码为离散码的层级结构；第二阶段用transformer一次生成一个层级，并行预测该层所有码。

Result: 相同参数规模下，LM1B上生成困惑度优于最强DLM基线且快21倍；OpenWebText上与之相当且快10倍；XSum上ROUGE-L持平且快31倍；Sudoku推理任务上以更少函数评估超越自回归和扩散基线（原文此句重复）。

Conclusion: NCM通过分层离散编码与逐层并行生成，在语言建模与推理任务上同时实现更优质量与更快速度，是DLM的可扩展替代方案。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel sampling for faster generation than autoregressive models, an increasingly important advantage as inference becomes a dominant computational workload. However, DLMs degrade quickly with fewer sampling steps, process the full sequence at every step, and require many passes over the dataset to reach good quality. We introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a two-stage, coarse-to-fine framework: a multiscale residual VQ-VAE encodes text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, and a transformer generates one level at a time, predicting all codes within a level in parallel. At matched parameter scales, NCM achieves better generative perplexity than the strongest DLM baseline on LM1B while running $21\times$ faster. On OpenWebText, NCM is competitive with the strongest DLM while running $10\times$ faster; on XSum, it matches the strongest DLM's ROUGE-L while being $31\times$ faster. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations.

</details>


### [389] [Modeling the Arrival Time of Information-Bearing Events in Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14212)
*Leyi Lao,Yulin Ou,Yang Xu,Hao An*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出用神经时序点过程(TPP)建模文本序列中的信息承载事件(新词、高surprisal token),以事件强度函数揭示表层之下的生成过程,并发现人类与LLM在生成机制上的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多依赖事后分析信息论指标(如surprisal),对信息在时间上分布的生成过程缺乏了解。

Method: 用神经时序点过程建模文本序列中的关键信息事件,输入为事件间隔历史与LLM上下文语义表示,学习事件强度函数,预测新词事件和高surprisal token事件的未来到达时间。

Result: LLM生成新词的速率显著高于人类,而高surprisal token无此差异;新词事件强度随时间衰减(人类与LLM皆然),高surprisal token事件则无此衰减。

Conclusion: 研究重访并拓展了此前较简单方法的结论,为人类语言生成中受限上下文表征理论提供补充证据,并为人类与LLM生成差异提供新视角。

Abstract: Understanding how information is distributed over time is fundamental to modeling natural language. While existing empirical studies primarily rely on post-hoc analysis of information-theoretic metrics, such as surprisal, little is known about the generation processes under the surface. We propose a novel approach for addressing this gap using the tool of neural temporal point processes (TPPs) by modeling the key information-bearing events in text sequences with learnable event intensity functions. Our model takes the history of event intervals and the contextual semantic representations from LLMs as input, and predicts the future arrival times for two types of events: new-word and high-surprisal-token. The experimental results reveal an interesting distinction in event intensities: LLMs tend to produce new words at significantly higher rates than humans, while high-surprisal tokens do not exhibit the difference. A decaying pattern of intensity over time is found in new-word events for both humans and LLMs, but not in high-surprisal-token events. Our findings revisit and extend previous studies that use simpler methods; provide supplementary evidence for theories about constrained context representation inherent in human language production; and find a new angle to view human and LLM generation differences.

</details>


### [390] [Agentic Data Engineering for LLMs: System Design and a Controlled Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14238)
*Ruomeng Ding,Qianli Shen,Zhaoyang Han,Meixin Chen,Daoyuan Chen,Yaliang Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ADE框架，让智能体利用实验反馈迭代开发数据工程策略，在四类任务上取得显著提升，但发现环内分数与泛化能力并不总是一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM数据工程需反复实验来确定数据选择、奖励与课程如何影响学习，是AI-for-AI研究的理想场景。核心问题是：智能体能否利用实验反馈逐步改进策略，且这些策略能否提升目标模型在留出数据上的表现。

Method: 提出Agentic Data Engineering (ADE)框架，让智能体基于累积发现来推进、修订或组合研究方向。策略依据环内分数筛选，并在固定训练与评估协议下于留出基准上评测。

Result: 在四个任务（数学与代码数据选择、数学奖励设计、数学课程学习）上，所选策略相比通用基线最高提升13.34%（AIME25 Pass@32），四个留出基准平均提升5.85%。环内分数随实验递增，但留出轨迹显示后期环内增益并不总能改善泛化。对比研究组织与反馈获取方式，发现结合证据分析与累积发现效果更优。

Conclusion: 研究表明智能体可借助实验反馈自主改进数据工程策略并带来实际收益，但环内指标与泛化之间存在差距，需重视证据分析与累积发现的结合。

Abstract: LLM data engineering requires iterative experimentation to determine how data selection, rewards, and curricula affect model learning, making it a natural setting for AI-for-AI (AI4AI) research. Can agents use experimental feedback to progressively improve strategies, and do the resulting strategies improve target-model performance on held-out data? We study how agents use experimental feedback to develop data-engineering strategies under fixed training and evaluation protocols. Our Agentic Data Engineering (ADE) framework lets agents pursue, revise, or combine research directions using cumulative findings. Strategies are selected by in-loop scores and evaluated on held-out benchmarks. Across four tasks-math and code data selection, math reward design, and math curriculum learning-selected strategies achieve absolute gains over generic baselines of up to 13.34% on AIME25 Pass@32 and 5.85% averaged across four held-out benchmarks under fixed training conditions. In-loop scores improve over successive experiments, while held-out trajectories show that later in-loop gains do not always improve generalization. Comparisons of research organization and feedback access favor combining evidence analysis with cumulative findings. Research trajectories show how earlier findings inform strategy revisions and combinations across research directions.

</details>


### [391] [The Thinking Leakage in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14270)
*Wenxuan Zhu,Shuming Liu,Bang An,Aznaur Aliev,Bing Li,Yibo Yang,Bernard Ghanem*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出NO-THINK模式强化学习（RL）带来的推理提升主要源于"思考泄漏"——部分重新激活了原模型THINK模式的推理能力，而非真正学到新的推理行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合推理模型（如Qwen3）可通过模板token在THINK与NO-THINK模式间切换。近期流行做法在NO-THINK模式下用RL训练并声称推理性能提升，但作者质疑这些增益的真实来源，希望验证增益是否来自真正的推理能力学习。

Method: 对Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B在NO-THINK模式下用GRPO训练；从行为、激活、权重和注意力头多个层面分析：观察响应变长变反思、原模型评判其更像thinking、内部激活向THINK模式偏移；用低维THINK相关激活子空间做交换实验；分析读取空think块的注意力头；并从GRPO训练信号角度探讨机制。

Result: 随准确率提升，响应更长更反思、更被原模型判定类似thinking、激活向THINK模式偏移；加大RL更新会引发THINK行为并接近但不超越THINK准确率；在Qwen3-8B中，用原模型值替换RL模型的低维THINK相关子空间可消除大部分增益，反向交换可将相当部分增益转移给原模型；RL引起的偏移经过读取空think块的注意力头；GRPO中advantage加权偏好的响应更THINK-like，其梯度步使模型趋近THINK状态。

Conclusion: NO-THINK模式下的RL增益在很大程度上反映的是原模型已有推理能力的重新激活（思考泄漏），而非学习到增强的推理行为。这对混合推理模型的RL训练评估与设计具有重要启示。

Abstract: Hybrid reasoning models such as the Qwen3 series switch between a THINK mode and a NO-THINK mode through a few chat-template tokens. A popular recipe trains such models with reinforcement learning in NO-THINK mode and reports improved reasoning performance. We provide evidence that much of this gain can be explained by thinking leakage: the gain comes largely from partially reactivating the reasoning abilities of the original model's THINK mode instead of learning enhanced reasoning behavior. We train Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B with GRPO in NO-THINK mode. As accuracy improves, responses become longer and more reflective, are increasingly judged by the original model to resemble its own thinking, and the model's internal activations shift toward its THINK mode. We then investigate at the level of weights, activations, and attention heads: scaling the RL update further elicits THINK-mode behavior and approaches THINK-mode accuracy but does not exceed it; in Qwen3-8B, replacing a low-dimensional THINK-related activation subspace of the RL-trained model with its original-model value removes most of the RL gain, and the reverse exchange transfers a considerable fraction of the gain to the original model; and the RL-induced shift passes through the attention heads that read the empty think block. We further identify a possible mechanism in the GRPO training signal: responses favored by the advantage-weighted update are more THINK-like, and a gradient step computed from this signal moves the model toward its THINK state. Thus, gains in NO-THINK mode can largely reflect reactivation of reasoning abilities already present in the original model.

</details>


### [392] [ASSET: Adaptive Speech Segmentation via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14309)
*Cihan Xiao,Yuan Tseng,Matthew Wiesner,Desh Raj,Leibny Paola Garcia Perera,Sanjeev Khudanpur,David Harwath*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ASSET，用强化学习自适应压缩语音编码器输出，在保持性能的同时减少音频token数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音LLM依赖声学编码器，但编码器输出序列远长于文本，而LLM对序列长度扩展性差，因此需要压缩编码器输出并保留任务信息。

Method: ASSET将编码器输出划分为变长片段并池化为连续音频token，用GRPO训练分割器，结合任务性能反馈与token率惩罚。

Result: ASR实验中，英语LibriSpeech上性能接近转录辅助的字符边界oracle，音频token减少约25%；普通话AISHELL上在相近token率下优于音素边界oracle。

Conclusion: 强化学习可实现自适应语音压缩，且面向非ASR任务时学习到的分割方式会随之改变。

Abstract: Speech large language models (LLMs) are often built using pretrained acoustic encoders as an audio interface to an LLM decoder. However, LLMs scale poorly with input sequence length, while acoustic encoders tend to produce substantially longer sequences than typical textual inputs. This motivates learning to compress encoder outputs while preserving task-oriented information. To this end, we introduce ASSET, a reinforcement learning (RL)-based framework that learns to adaptively compress encoder outputs by first partitioning them into variable-duration segments and then pooling each segment into a continuous audio token. We use group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to train a segmenter with task performance feedback and a token-rate penalty. In automatic speech recognition (ASR) experiments, ASSET achieves performance comparable to a transcript-assisted character-boundary oracle with approximately 25% fewer audio tokens on English LibriSpeech, while improving on a phone-boundary oracle at a similar token rate on Mandarin AISHELL. Exploratory experiments on non-ASR tasks further illustrate how learned segmentation changes when the framework is adapted to tasks beyond transcription.

</details>


### [393] [Decomposing and Predicting Annotation Disagreement in Harmful Content Across Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18588)
*Irem Ecem Yelkanat,Faeze Ghorbanpour,Alexander Fraser*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用LLM回答一组可解释的二元问题，训练分类器预测有害内容标注分歧，跨英德土三语四数据集优于直接提示和文本基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标注分歧被视为主观任务的有意义属性而非纯噪声；预测哪些条目易引发争议，有助于分配标注资源并将困难案例送交人工复核。

Method: 从文本的可解释语义属性预测分歧：LLM回答覆盖有害内容特征、分歧相关线索（如边界严重性、缺失上下文）和语言敏感线索（如本地俚语）的二元问题；分类器基于这些回答预测分歧，并分析各问题的贡献。评估覆盖3种开放权重LLM、英语/德语/土耳其语4个数据集。

Result: 结构化问题特征比直接提示高10.5 ROC-AUC，比最强文本基线高5.0；8个问题的紧凑子集与20个问题全集相差1.5点以内；留一数据集评估中保留约90-95%的域内ROC-AUC。

Conclusion: 关于贬损、缺失上下文和决策边界的问题是最强预测因子，说明有害内容之所以有争议，部分可在文本中观察到。

Abstract: Annotator disagreement is increasingly recognized as a meaningful property of subjective tasks, rather than merely noise to be removed. Predicting which items are likely to be contested could help allocate annotation effort and route difficult cases to human review. We propose predicting disagreement from interpretable semantic properties of the text. An LLM answers a set of binary questions covering harmful-content characteristics, disagreement-related cues such as borderline severity and missing context, and language-sensitive cues such as local slurs. A classifier predicts disagreement from these answers, and we analyze which questions contribute most to the predictions. Across four datasets in English, German, and Turkish and three open-weight LLMs, our structured question features outperform direct prompting by 10.5 ROC-AUC points and the strongest text-based baselines by 5.0 points. A compact subset of eight questions performs within 1.5 ROC-AUC points of the full twenty-question set. In leave-one-dataset-out evaluation, models retain roughly 90-95% of their in-domain ROC-AUC. Across models and datasets, questions about derogation, missing context, and decision boundaries serve as the strongest predictors, suggesting that what makes harmful content contested is partly observable in the text.

</details>


### [394] [Evaluating LLMs as Agentic Workflow Executors in Real-World Customer Support Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14346)
*Md Tahmid Rahman Laskar,Gundeep Singh,Xue-Yong Fu,Karol Chang,Kevin Sanders,Shi Zong,Tania Habib,Julien Bouvier Tremblay,Shayna Gardiner,Harsh Saini,Matthias Lee,Elena Khasanova,Quinten McNamara,Shashi Bhushan TN*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"Skill LLM"视角与基准构建流程，从真实客服对话挖掘可复用工作流，映射工具需求并用MCP模拟环境生成多轮工具调用对话。对17个模型（1.7B–14B及闭源）做零样本评测，GPT-5.4大幅领先，QWEN3.5-9B是最强开源模型；并指出评测者选择不可忽视（10对评测者平均Kappa=0.524）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业客服LLM需在受限技能上下文与策略、工具约束下完成有状态工作流，但缺乏能真实反映此类技能执行能力、且兼顾工具覆盖与幻觉检测的评测基准。

Method: 构建基准流水线：从真实转录挖掘高频工作流→转化为结构化技能描述→映射工具需求→用MCP兼容mock模拟环境状态→生成多轮工具使用对话。对17个模型做零样本评测，采用5个强LLM评测者独立打分+确定性规则评测器（检查工具覆盖、幻觉工具调用与无依据断言）。

Result: 排名一致：GPT-5.4大幅领先；QWEN3.5-9B为20B以下最强开源模型，在所有评测者下均优于多个闭源基线。评测者一致性不高，10对评测者pass/fail判定平均Kappa=0.524。

Conclusion: 技能执行的全面零样本评测不仅需关注模型能力，也需同等重视评测者可靠性；评测者选择是重要的方法学因素。

Abstract: Enterprise customer-support agents increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) to execute bounded, tool-using workflows. We study this problem through the lens of Skill LLMs: specialized executors that operate within a selected skill context and must complete a narrow, stateful workflow under policy and tool constraints. We present a benchmark construction pipeline that mines recurrent workflows from real-world transcripts, converts them into structured skill descriptions, maps them to tool requirements, simulates environment state with Model Context Protocol (MCP)-compatible mocks, and generates multi-turn tool-using dialogues. Using this benchmark, we conduct a large-scale zero-shot evaluation of 17 language models spanning closed model families and deployment-oriented open-weight models from 1.7B to 14B parameters, each judged independently by five strong LLM judges, plus a deterministic rule-based evaluator that checks tool coverage, hallucinated tool use, and unsupported claims. We find a consistent ranking in which GPT-5.4 leads by a wide margin and QWEN3.5-9B is the strongest open-weight model (below 20B), outperforming several closed baselines under every judge. We also find that judge choice is not a negligible methodological detail: pairwise judge agreement on the pass/fail verdict averages Kappa=0.524 across 10 judge pairs. These results suggest that comprehensive zero-shot evaluation of skill execution requires judge reliability as carefully as model capability.

</details>


### [395] [Multimodal Co-Generation With Continuous Bitstream Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14349)
*Georgios Batzolis,Georgios Kontos,Bruno Trentini,Pranam Chatterjee,Micha Livne,Mark Girolami,Luca Ambrogioni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 连续比特流扩散(CoBit)提供一个统一框架，用相同训练与采样协议实现多模态联合与条件生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨模态生成通常需要特定领域的建模目标、分词器或采样流程，缺乏统一框架。

Method: 将原本用于语言建模的连续比特流扩散扩展到多模态，图像-文本、语音-文本、蛋白质序列-结构各自从头训练，但共享单一输入投影、Transformer骨干、逐比特预测头和二元分数匹配目标。

Result: MNIST-Sum上条件准确率近乎完美；语音-文本模型无需文本预训练即可完成合成、识别、续写与联合生成，生成文本与生成语音转写词错率3.5%；蛋白质模型单一checkpoint支持正向折叠、反向折叠与联合生成，100-500残基的自洽TM-score达0.911。

Conclusion: CoBit为差异显著的多模态及跨模态依赖形式提供通用生成框架，无需领域特定目标或采样流程。

Abstract: We show that continuous bitstream diffusion (CoBit), originally developed for language modeling, provides a unified framework for joint and conditional multimodal generation using the same training and sampling protocol. Across image-text, speech-text and protein sequence-structure modeling, models are trained separately from scratch, but each uses a single input projection, transformer backbone, bitwise prediction head and binary score-matching objective shared across its modalities. Within each setting, a single checkpoint supports joint generation and the conditional directions included in training by changing which parts of the bitstream are observed. We first validate the approach on MNIST-Sum, a controlled image-text task pairing raw binary images with equations encoded as text, achieving near-perfect conditional accuracy and high joint consistency without learned tokenizers. We then apply the same protocol at larger scale to speech-text and protein sequence-structure modeling. Trained without text pretraining, a single speech-text model performs speech synthesis, recognition, continuation, and unconditional co-generation. Jointly generated speech and text achieve 3.5% word error rate between the generated text and automatic transcriptions of the generated speech. In protein modeling, a single CoBit checkpoint supports forward folding, inverse folding, and joint sequence-structure generation. For jointly generated proteins spanning 100-500 residues, computational refolding of CoBit's sequences yields structures that agree with the generated backbones at a mean self-consistency TM-score of 0.911. Together, these results show that CoBit provides a common generative framework for substantially different modalities and forms of cross-modal dependence, without introducing a domain-specific objective or sampling procedure.

</details>


### [396] [REPRO: Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimizer for Automated LLM Red-Teaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15513)
*Abrar Alotaibi,Moataz Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出纯黑盒进化式对抗提示优化框架REPRO，仅用单个消费级GPU上的7B反思模型驱动，声称在AdvBench等基准的36个目标模型上单轮达100%攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化红队方法需特权访问、依赖人工逐模型模板，或仅优化单一目标而缺乏种群级多样性，难以在生产环境中实际使用。

Method: REPRO为纯黑盒框架，通过进化优化搜索对抗提示，由压缩的7B开放权重反思模型在单张消费级GPU上全程驱动。引入两个新机制并经组件消融验证：语义交叉（LLM引导的多父代重组算子）与基于汤普森采样的贝叶斯策略选择（由结构化失败分析提供信息）。

Result: 在AdvBench、JailbreakBench与HarmBench上评测11个家族共36个目标模型（含GPT-5-nano、Claude-3.5-Sonnet、Gemini-2.5-Pro、Grok-4.1）。按该协议，每个目标均单轮达到100% ASR，每个行为中位查询24次。作者指出两点限制：评分候选的judge即报告ASR者，且搜索在接受即停止，故ASR反映迭代预算内是否成功而非固定预算成功率；基线数据均转录自原论文，judge、预算与模型版本不一致。

Conclusion: 本文应被视为同一协议下的模型覆盖范围目录，而非头对头排名；两项限定条件在正文中均有展开讨论。

Abstract: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial prompts that bypass their safety training. Existing automated red-teaming methods either require privileged access unavailable in production, rely on manually engineered per-model templates, or optimize a single objective without population-level diversity. We present REPRO (Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimization), a pure black-box framework that discovers adversarial prompts through evolutionary optimization driven entirely by a compressed open-weight 7B reflective model on a single consumer GPU. REPRO introduces two mechanisms absent from prior work, both isolated in a component ablation: semantic crossover, an LLM-guided multi-parent recombination operator, and Bayesian strategy selection via Thompson Sampling informed by structured failure analysis.
  We catalog REPRO's behavior on AdvBench, JailbreakBench, and HarmBench across 36 target models from 11 families, including GPT-5-nano, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and Grok-4.1. Under our protocol REPRO reaches 100\% attack success rate (ASR) on every evaluated target in a single turn, at a median of 24 target queries per behavior. Two properties of the protocol qualify that figure. The judge scoring candidates during optimization also produces the reported ASR, and search halts when it accepts, so ASR reports whether search succeeded within the iteration budget rather than success at a fixed budget. All baseline figures are transcribed from their original papers, which use different judges, budgets, and model versions. We therefore present this as a catalog of model coverage under one protocol rather than a head-to-head ranking, and develop both qualifications in the paper.

</details>


### [397] [SciCurateBench: Curating Experimental Data from Heterogeneous Scientific Literature with Verbal-Action Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14393)
*Minuk Ma,Kaiyun Guo,Jiarui Ding*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 SciCurateBench 基准（200篇专家标注论文），要求从原始文献中验证复合生物实验条件，揭示现有LLM和agent表现不佳；并提出LangPoli系统，通过policy agent生成自然语言行动指南、actor agent转为可执行工具，显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科研数据策展需跨长且异构文献验证精确实验条件（具体测定、临床结果、数据可得性），过程极其耗时；而现有基准仅评估短查询的宽泛相关性，无法反映这一复杂性。

Method: 构建 SciCurateBench：200篇来自主流生命科学期刊、专家标注的论文，挑战系统从原始未处理文献中验证复合生物实验标准。提出 LangPoli：一个 policy agent 生成自然语言行动指南，actor agents 将其转化为可执行工具。并探索 curriculum transfer，从已解决任务中蒸馏可泛化策略以加速相关问题求解。

Result: 普通LLM及主流推理、工具使用、反馈型agent均表现困难。LangPoli 在 Paper Classification 上达 83.16% F1（基线LLM为 58.22%），在 Structured Information Retrieval 上表现强劲，并在 LitSearch、BEIR、TREC 公开基准上改善重排序。

Conclusion: LangPoli 展示了可有效应对科学数据策展的复杂验证任务，curriculum transfer 可加速相关任务；希望推动真正实用的科学AI辅助研究。预发布匿名链接：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/scicuratebench-D885/。

Abstract: Scientific research increasingly depends on curating experimental data from literature. Scientific data curation requires verifying exact experimental conditions (e.g., specific assays, clinical outcomes, and data availability) across long, heterogeneous files, which is a highly time-consuming process. Existing benchmarks evaluate only broad relevance on short queries, failing to capture this complexity. We introduce SciCurateBench, a benchmark of 200 expert-annotated papers from major life-science journals that challenges systems to verify conjunctive biological experimental criteria from raw, unprocessed scientific literature. We show that plain LLMs and popular reasoning, tool-using, and feedback-based agents all struggle with this task. To study what makes the task tractable, we further propose LangPoli, an integrative system in which a policy agent generates natural language action guidelines that actor agents convert into executable tools. LangPoli showed strong performance on both Paper Classification (83.16% F1 vs. 58.22% for its base LLM) and Structured Information Retrieval, and also improves re-ranking on the public benchmarks of LitSearch, BEIR, and TREC. We further explore curriculum transfer, a method that distills generalizable strategies from solved tasks to accelerate the solving of related problems. We hope this work facilitates research in truly practical scientific AI assistance. The anonymized pre-release can be found from https://anonymous.4open. science/r/scicuratebench-D885/.

</details>


### [398] [Scaling Laws for Multimodal Data Mixtures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14423)
*Aditi Khandelwal,Ayush K. Tarun,Yixuan Xu,Imanol Schlag,Golnoosh Farnadi,Siva Reddy,Luke Zettlemoyer,Antoine Bosselut*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文通过268个MoE实验(457M–8.3B参数、最高150B token)推导文本/视觉/音频三模态的数据混合缩放律,揭示最优算力分配、数据重复与跨模态干扰的规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿AI系统原生态多模态(文本、视觉、音频联合预训练),但多模态数据混合(各模态比例、相互干扰代价)的科学理解缺乏或被垄断。现有工作缺少可指导预训练的数据混合理论。

Method: 采用Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)架构(可高效扩展并部分限制跨模态干扰),针对文本、视觉、音频三模态开展268个实验,参数从457M到8.3B,训练token最高达150B,据此推导数据混合缩放律。

Result: (1)算力最优配置具有模态特异性:音频"模型重",倾向扩展参数而非token;文本和视觉则需均衡扩展模型与数据。(2)视觉或音频数据重复超过2x收益可忽略。(3)跨模态交互高度不对称:视觉强烈干扰音频,而音频对文本和视觉学习的干扰可忽略。

Conclusion: 为理解训练前沿MLLM所需的多模态数据混合提供了有原则的基础,并给出多条可操作的数据混合洞见。

Abstract: Frontier AI systems are increasingly natively multimodal, jointly pretrained on multiple modalities, such as text, vision, and audio. However, the scientific understanding of the multimodal data mixtures used to pretrain these systems --- how much of each modality to mix, and at what potential interference cost to the others --- is largely absent or gatekept. In this work, we derive data mixing scaling laws for three modalities: text, vision, and audio. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly adopt Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, as MoEs scale efficiently and partially limit cross-modal interference. We therefore use MoEs to conduct 268 experiments ranging from 457M to 8.3B parameters, on up to 150 billion tokens. Our work leads to multiple actionable insights into multimodal data mixing for training MLLMs. First, compute optima are modality-specific: audio modality is model-heavy, favoring scaling parameters over tokens, while text and vision require balanced scaling of model size and data. Second, repeating vision or audio data beyond 2x yields negligible benefits. Finally, cross-modal interactions are highly asymmetric: vision strongly interferes with audio, whereas audio's interference with learning text and vision is negligible. Overall, we provide a principled foundation for understanding the multimodal data mixtures needed to train frontier MLLMs.

</details>


### [399] [Neither True nor False: Do LLMs Represent Truth-Value Gaps in Plural Predication?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14438)
*Duaa Nakshbandi,Zhiyu An,Yiping Li,Sachin Giri,Wan Du*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究LLMs是否真正掌握复数描述的真值条件。提出Homogeneity Gap现象与HomogeneityNLI数据集，评估七个开源模型，发现普遍存在"双值偏见"：模型虽掌握复数定指的齐一性真值条件，却将真值间隙错误地坍缩为假。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究LLMs是否能理解复数定指（如"the kids laughed"）与其否定在部分成员满足时"既不真也不假"的三值逻辑，还是强行将其判定为真或假。

Method: 引入HomogeneityNLI诊断数据集，包含1,000个最小配对项，交叉考察限定词、极性与群体构成，覆盖十种逻辑条件；对七个开源权重模型进行零样本及提示策略（显式规则、思维链、枚举）评估。

Result: 发现普遍的双值偏见：模型将复数定指读作"全称/全否"，但把真值间隙坍缩为假。零样本下无模型能同时对两种极性识别间隙（≤15%），否定定指在84%情形被判为False。显式规则、CoT与枚举提示效果不稳定且常强化偏见。

Conclusion: 当前开源权重LLMs已习得复数谓述的真值条件，但尚未掌握其三值逻辑。

Abstract: Do Large Language Models (LLMs) genuinely grasp the truth conditions of plural descriptions, or do they force every sentence into true or false? We investigate the Homogeneity Gap, a semantic phenomenon where a plural definite (e.g., the kids laughed) and its negation (the kids didn't laugh) are both neither true nor false when only some of the kids laughed, whereas their quantified counterparts (all, not all) remain strictly bivalent. We introduce HomogeneityNLI, a diagnostic dataset of 1,000 minimal-pair items crossing determiner, polarity, and group composition across ten logical conditions. Evaluating seven open-weight models, we uncover a pervasive Bivalence Bias: models assign plural definites their homogeneous truth conditions, reading the kids as all of them and the kids didn't as none of them, yet collapse the truth-value gap into falsity. In the zero-shot setting, no model recognizes the gap for both polarities in more than 15% of scenarios, and negated definites are judged False in 84% of cases. Explicit linguistic rules, chain-of-thought, and enumeration prompts produce unstable, model-specific effects that often entrench the bias. Taken together, our findings indicate that current open-weight LLMs have acquired the truth conditions of plural predication but not its trivalent logic.

</details>


### [400] [Evaluating Semantic Relation Knowledge through Bidirectional Relation Prediction from Gloss Pairs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14442)
*Zhihan Cao,Adam Nohejl,Hitomi Yanaka*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种评估LLM语义关系知识的新任务：让模型预测两个不同顺序呈现的义项释义之间的关系，并根据关系的对称/非对称性检验两序预测的一致性，覆盖单语与跨语言场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义关系组织词义且是词汇语义学的基础。为评估大语言模型的语义关系知识，需要设计更具挑战性、能检验关系内在对称性（如上下位关系应为非对称）以及跨语言可迁移性的评估方式。

Method: 构建含3,069个义项对的数据集，每个义项用英语、希腊语、罗马尼亚语、土耳其语、日语五种语言表述；任务要求LLM预测两种顺序下释义之间的关系，并按关系的对称性或非对称性评估两序预测的一致性；在零样本与五样本设置下测试17个LLM，并与随机基线和神经基线比较。

Result: LLM整体表现较差。零样本下仅8个模型的宏平均F1显著高于随机基线，五样本同样为8个；显著优于神经基线的仅零样本1个、五样本2个。模型常无法对上下位关系（hypernymy）给出双向一致的预测，也难以在任何方向上正确判断整体-部分关系（holonymy）。

Conclusion: 现有LLM在语义关系知识上存在局限，不仅在识别关系类型上表现不佳，也难以尊重关系的非对称性；跨语言释义表达下的关系知识可访问性同样有限。

Abstract: Semantic relations organise word senses and are fundamental to lexical semantics. In order to evaluate semantic relation knowledge of large language models (LLMs), we propose a challenging task in which an LLM predicts the relation between two glosses (definitions of senses) presented in two different orders. The predictions for the two orders are evaluated for consistency with the symmetry or asymmetry of semantic relations. Our task is designed for both monolingual and cross-lingual evaluation, allowing us to examine whether relation knowledge remains accessible when the same senses are verbalised through glosses in different languages. We construct a dataset of 3,069 sense pairs, with each sense verbalised in English, Greek, Romanian, Turkish, and Japanese. Experiments with 17 LLMs in zero-shot and five-shot settings reveal generally poor performance. In each setting, only eight LLMs achieve a macro-averaged F1 score significantly above a random baseline, and only one (zero-shot) and two (five-shot) significantly outperform a neural baseline. In particular, LLMs often fail to generate bidirectionally consistent predictions for hypernymy and to make correct predictions for holonymy in either direction. Our results suggest limitations in current LLMs' semantic relation knowledge, both in identifying relations and in respecting asymmetry.

</details>


### [401] [Evaluating Bias in Chinese Large Language Models across Tasks and Registers: Task Operationalization Effects and Irony Classification Risks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14464)
*Mo Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该预注册审计发现，中文大模型在阴阳（反讽）语域下内容分类错误率从10.9%升至23.5%，且任务操作化形式会显著改变偏见测量读数，安全评估应将反讽语域纳入测试条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中文内容治理中LLM被用于识别有毒和歧视性表达，但任务操作化方式和反讽表达会影响偏见测量的读数，这一影响需要实证检验。

Method: 对多个中文大模型进行预注册多任务行为审计：内容分类实验对比正式语域与阴阳（回声反讽）语域；检验显式反讽感知提示的效果；将29个共享命题锚点操作化为三种任务形式——社会共识估计（A）、高风险决策（B）、受控联想评分（C），并做独立操纵检查与校准多数裁定。

Result: 核心面板分类错误率从正式语域的10.9%升至阴阳语域的23.5%，风险差+12.7个百分点（95% CI [+9.7, +15.7]）；阴阳语域评分者一致性更低（多数票kappa=0.299）；显式反讽感知提示使干预面板错误率降低9.6个百分点；58个A-C比较单元达成一致同意，A-B收敛低（87.8%支持少数判断）；B、C相对A的交互分别为+0.577和+1.121。

Conclusion: 评估中文内容治理用大模型时，任务操作化对偏见读数的影响是需数据回答的实证问题，安全评估应将反讽语域作为测试条件纳入。

Abstract: In Chinese content governance, large language models are increasingly used to identify toxic and discriminatory expressions, yet both task operationalization and ironic expression can alter bias measurement readings. We conducted a preregistered multi-task behavioral audit of multiple Chinese large language models. In the content classification experiment, the core panel's classification error rate rose from 10.9% in the formal register to 23.5% in the yinyang (an echoic-irony register) version, a risk difference of +12.7 percentage points. (95% CI [+9.7, +15.7]). Inter-rater agreement was lower in the yinyang register (majority-vote kappa = 0.299), so the increase contains a component of label uncertainty propagation, but the direction of increase was consistent under both adjudicated and majority-vote reference standards. Explicit irony-aware prompts reduced the intervention panel's error rate by 9.6 percentage points. We operationalized the 29 shared proposition anchors into three task forms: social consensus estimation (Form A), high-stakes decision (Form B), and controlled association rating (Form C); independent manipulation checks found that all 58 A-C comparison units received unanimous agreement, whereas the low A-B convergence was confirmed by calibrated majority adjudication (87.8% supporting the minority judgment); on the irony-probe materials, the interactions of B and C relative to A were +0.577 and +1.121, respectively. Thus, when evaluating large language models for Chinese content governance, the effect of task operationalization on bias readings is an empirical question that requires data to answer, and safety evaluation should incorporate the ironic register as a test condition.

</details>


### [402] [EdgeLLM-Nano: Auditing Polar-Guided Key-Cache Compression and Consistency-Anchored Pruning on a 33.6 MB On-Device Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14475)
*S M Mahbub Murshed,Hayden Bright,Rezaul Karim,Ali Shiri Sichani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出EdgeLLM-Nano，一个基于8.39M参数（33.6MB）微型解码器LM的KV-cache压缩测量研究平台，并引入LCDF评估指标，揭示现有压缩方法与评估方式的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备部署LM面临独特的内存、延迟和功耗挑战，KV-cache压缩是潜在解决方案，但现有方法在边缘设备上的有效性未被充分检验，且现有评估方法并不总是真正测试KV-cache本身。

Method: 构建EdgeLLM-Nano纳米级测试平台，端到端检验每个后端、种子和功耗样本；提出LCDF（长上下文解码保真度）评估，逐token检验被测KV-cache的teacher-forced log-loss；并在Raspberry Pi 5上进行配套测量。

Result: 极化引导的key-cache量化器被否定（RTN对照损害小一个数量级）；一致性锚定的渐进权重剪枝并非必要（一次性幅度剪枝表现相当或更好）。困惑度对所有方法给出相同5.461分，而LCDF能区分不同压缩后端。所有测试的压缩后端在Pi 5上每token能效均低于未压缩FP16推理，KIVI接近无损。

Conclusion: KV-cache压缩仍有改进空间，LCDF能简单有效地揭示被困惑度掩盖的压缩方法负面影响。

Abstract: Deploying language models (LMs) on the edge presents unique memory, latency, and power challenges absent in high-performance computing. KV-cache compression emerges as a promising approach to address these challenges. However, the effectiveness of current KV-cache compression methods has not been thoroughly examined on edge devices. Moreover, we show that existing evaluation methods do not always involve the KV-cache under test. We propose EdgeLLM-Nano, a measurement study of KV-cache compression using a nano-scale decoder-only LM (transformer) testbed that has 8.39M parameters, i.e., 33.6 MB, to enable end-to-end examination of each backend, seed, and power sample. Our results give a negative verdict for a polar-guided key-cache quantizer (round-to-nearest (RTN) control causes an order of magnitude less damage), as well as a consistency-anchored progressive weight pruner (one-shot magnitude-based pruning performs as well as, if not better). We also introduce Long-Context Decode Fidelity (LCDF) evaluation, a token-by-token examination of teacher-forced log-losses using the KV-cache under test. Unlike perplexity that gives the same 5.461 score to all methods, LCDF distinguishes different KV-cache compression backends thanks to its paired statistics across seeds and effect sizes. Our companion Raspberry Pi 5 measurement shows all compression backends we tested to be less energy-efficient per token compared to uncompressed FP16 inference. Except for KIVI that is close to lossless in terms of LCDF, our findings indicate KV-cache compression can be improved. LCDF offers a simple and effective way of shedding light on KV-cache compression methods, whose negative impacts have been overlooked by perplexity.

</details>


### [403] [Scale, Drivers, and Limits of Representational Alignment Across Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14476)
*Jialin Wu,Meenakshi Khosla*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出NW-RSA和CF-RSA两种方法，揭示大语言模型在粗粒度表征几何上高度一致，但在局部邻域和细粒语言区分上存在显著分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合式相似度度量会掩盖模型一致性在几何尺度上的变化，以及哪些语言属性支撑这种一致性。

Method: 提出邻域加权RSA（NW-RSA），按表征空间邻近度加权刺激对；提出反事实RSA（CF-RSA），通过控制语言扰动比较模型间的表征对齐。

Result: 多个语言模型在粗粒度表征几何上高度一致，但局部邻域分歧明显；逻辑辖域扰动比其他句法、事件角色或篇章结构变化更显著降低对齐；词表和jabberwocky句中结构或词汇破坏也降低对齐。

Conclusion: 总体相似不意味着模型对细粒语言区分的表征方式一致，自然语言的规律性有助于增强模型收敛。

Abstract: Comparing large language models can reveal shared representational structure and systematic differences between them. However, aggregate similarity measures can obscure how agreement varies across geometric scales and which linguistic properties support it. We introduce two complementary methods to resolve where models agree and what supports that agreement. Standard representational similarity analysis (RSA) summarizes similarity across all stimulus pairs, potentially obscuring differences in alignment between nearby and distant inputs. Neighborhood-Weighted RSA (NW-RSA) addresses this limitation by weighting stimulus pairs according to their proximity in representational space, placing alignment from local neighborhoods to global geometry on a common scale. Counterfactual RSA (CF-RSA) tests which linguistic properties support alignment by comparing intact representations in one model with representations under controlled linguistic perturbations in another.
