Result: 在7个竞赛数学、研究生科学和编程基准上，CoT缩短31%且准确率不变，优于5个推理时基线；自调试编码代理中每轮思考token减少20%，任务性能不变；可泛化到其他模型家族；与训练式压缩结合可进一步缩短CoT。

Conclusion: DoubtLess通过减少重复检查来缩短CoT，token节省主要来自正确答案首次出现之后，且无需训练、准确率无损。

Abstract: Reasoning models achieve strong performance through long chains of thought (CoT), but often spend more tokens than needed to solve a problem. Existing ways to shorten the CoT require additional training for each model, add a fixed steering vector to the model's hidden states, or use decoding heuristics such as stopping early or banning words like "wait", which can reduce accuracy. We propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which a much smaller reasoning model steers the large one towards brevity. The small model reads the large model's CoT so far twice, once prompted to be brief (the brief thinker) and once prompted to be verbose (the verbose thinker), and the difference between its two logit vectors, scaled by a strength, is added to the large model's logits at every step of the CoT. On seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, DoubtLess shortens the CoT of Qwen3-32B by 31% with unchanged accuracy, outperforming five inference-time baselines. We also show that DoubtLess reduces thinking tokens per turn by 20% in a self-debugging coding agent with unchanged task performance. It also generalizes to two other model families with unchanged accuracy. When combined with training-based compression, it further shortens the CoT of a model already trained for brevity. Ablations and behavioral analysis show that DoubtLess reduces repeated checking, with most token savings coming after the correct answer first appears in the CoT. Our code is available at https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess.

</details>


### [626] [Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18868)
*Wenbo Hu,Shraman Pramanick,Krishna Kumar Singh,Nanyun Peng,Kai-Wei Chang,Yong Jae Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TeV-Gym长时程智能体训练数据集与PPRS奖励塑形方法，训练出Tev-27B模型，在长时程任务上达到顶尖闭源模型水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体对自动化发现和递归自我改进至关重要，但开源模型在长时程任务上表现不佳，主要缺乏训练数据和可行训练方案；长复杂任务难以构建与验证，且奖励稀疏。

Method: 提出Tev-Gym数据集：首个带可验证、密集、渐进奖励的长时程智能体训练数据集，覆盖7个领域共1,170个已验证任务环境，基于"潜在世界优先"方法构建（先构造任务域、工作流及每步期望状态的完整正确隐式规范，再逐步渲染为智能体环境）；并设计进度-潜力奖励塑形（PPRS），将进度转化为密集的每步奖励。

Result: 训练得到Tev-27B，在ALE-CM（计算与数学科学域）Pass@5上匹配GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5；仅用ALE相关数据训练，却能泛化至Terminal-Bench 3.0/4.0子集，超越GLM 5.2和Gemini 3.7 Flash，在中长时程任务（如TB 2.1）上达到Claude Opus 4.8水平。

Conclusion: 通过潜在世界优先的数据构造与PPRS密集奖励塑形，可有效解决长时程智能体训练的数据与奖励难题，实现了强性能与良好泛化。

Abstract: Long-horizon agents have drawn growing attention for their ability to work autonomously -- from hours to days -- on economically valuable tasks, a capability essential to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet open-source models still struggle on long-horizon tasks, largely for lack of both training data and a working recipe, and scaling both is hard: long, complex tasks are difficult to curate and verify, and their rewards are sparse. We address both. First, we introduce Tev-Gym, the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards -- 1,170 verified task environments across 7 domains. It is built on a latent-world-first approach that first constructs a latent world: a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain, workflow, and expected state after each step. Each task is then progressively rendered from this specification into an agent-facing environment, enabling controllable complexity and a natural progress metric. Second, we turn this metric into a training recipe: via progress-potential reward shaping (PPRS), we convert progress into a dense per-step reward that improves training efficiency and makes otherwise-intractable tasks trainable. Training with this recipe yields Tev-27B, which achieves substantial gains on the Agents' Last Exam computing and math sciences domains (ALE-CM), matching GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 at Pass@5. Despite training only on ALE-related data, it generalizes to the Terminal-Bench (TB) 3.0 and 4.0 subsets, surpassing GLM 5.2 and Gemini 3.7 Flash, and reaches Claude Opus 4.8-level performance on middle-horizon tasks such as TB 2.1.

</details>


### [627] [Subgraph-Aware Training of Language Models for Knowledge Graph Completion Using Structure-Aware Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.12703)
*Youmin Ko,Hyemin Yang,Taeuk Kim,Hyunjoon Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SATKGC框架，将知识图谱的结构归纳偏置引入PLM微调，以提升知识图谱补全性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于PLM的KGC方法仅关注文本信息编码，忽略了知识图谱的长尾分布及其多种拓扑结构（子图、最短路径、度等），这成为提升精度的主要障碍。

Method: SATKGC包含两点：(i) 子图感知的小批量采样，促进难负样本采样并缓解训练中实体出现频率不平衡；(ii) 新的对比学习，基于知识图谱结构特性更关注批次内较难的负三元组和正三元组。

Result: 在三个KGC基准数据集上的大量实验证明了SATKGC的优越性。

Conclusion: 该研究首次全面地将知识图谱的结构归纳偏置融入PLM微调，有效提升了KGC性能。代码已公开。

Abstract: Fine-tuning pre-trained language models (PLMs) has recently shown a potential to improve knowledge graph completion (KGC). However, most PLM-based methods focus solely on encoding textual information, neglecting the long-tailed nature of knowledge graphs and their various topological structures, e.g., subgraphs, shortest paths, and degrees. We claim that this is a major obstacle to achieving higher accuracy of PLMs for KGC. To this end, we propose a Subgraph-Aware Training framework for KGC (SATKGC) with two ideas: (i) subgraph-aware mini-batching to encourage hard negative sampling and to mitigate an imbalance in the frequency of entity occurrences during training, and (ii) new contrastive learning to focus more on harder in-batch negative triples and harder positive triples in terms of the structural properties of the knowledge graph. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to comprehensively incorporate the structural inductive bias of the knowledge graph into fine-tuning PLMs. Extensive experiments on three KGC benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of SATKGC. Our code is available.

</details>


### [628] [Mira-Embeddings-V1: Domain-Adapted Semantic Reranking for Recruitment via LLM-Synthesized Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17738)
*Zhaohua Liang,Zhilin Wang,Renjie Cao,Yining Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: mira-embeddings-v1：用LLM合成监督数据重塑嵌入空间，并用轻量BoundaryHead精排，在招聘候选重排任务上显著提升召回与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 招聘候选人检索本质是"召回+重排"两阶段流程：上游retriever已给出候选列表，目标是在有限审核预算下重排使合格候选人尽量靠前。难点在于缺乏大规模人工标注的工业训练对，且同职位标题但职责范围不同的岗位易混淆。

Method: 从真实JD出发构建五阶段提示流水线，生成多样化正样本与难负样本以多角度塑造语义空间；采用两轮LoRA适配：先JD–JD对比训练，再在异构文本数据上做JD–CV三元组对齐；最后用轻量BoundaryHead MLP对Top-K结果重排，区分同标题不同范围的岗位。全程无需大规模人工标注。

Result: 本地300个真实JD池（候选来自生产retriever）：Recall@50从68.89%提升至77.55%，Precision@10从35.77%提升至39.62%。全球池44,138候选（Qwen3-32B评分）：Recall@200达0.7047，基线为0.5969。

Conclusion: LLM合成监督配合边界感知重排，无需重型cross-encoder即可取得稳健且显著的性能提升。

Abstract: Candidate sourcing for recruiters is best viewed as a two-stage retrieval and reranking pipeline with recall as the primary objective under a limited review budget. An upstream production retriever first returns a candidate shortlist for each job description (JD), and our goal is to rerank that shortlist so that qualified candidates appear as high as possible. We present mira-embeddings-v1, a semantic reranking system for the recruitment domain that reshapes the embedding space with LLM-synthesized training data and corrects boundary confusions with a lightweight reranking head. Starting from real JDs, we build a five-stage prompt pipeline to generate diverse positive and hard negative samples that sculpt the semantic space from multiple angles. We then apply a two-round LoRA adaptation: JD--JD contrastive training followed by JD--CV triplet alignment on a heterogeneous text dataset. Importantly, these gains require no large-scale manually labeled industrial training pairs: a modest set of real JDs is expanded into supervision through LLM synthesis. Finally, a BoundaryHead MLP reranks the Top-K results to distinguish between roles that share the same title but differ in scope. On a local pool of 300 real JDs with candidates from an upstream production retriever, mira-embeddings-v1 improves Recall@50 from 68.89% (baseline) to 77.55% while lifting Precision@10 from 35.77% to 39.62%. On a supportive global pool over 44,138 candidates judged by a Qwen3-32B rubric, it achieves Recall@200 of 0.7047 versus 0.5969 for the baseline. These results show that LLM-synthesized supervision with boundary-aware reranking yields robust gains without a heavy cross-encoder.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [629] [Algorithms with Smoothed Polynomial-Time Complexity for Deterministic Discounted-sum and Mean-payoff Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14150)
*Ali Asadi,Krishnendu Chatterjee,Ruichen Luo*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究图上回合制确定性博弈（折扣和与平均收益目标）的平滑复杂度，提出新的分析技术，证明策略迭代的变体在一般博弈图上达到平滑多项式时间，并给出高概率与期望时间保证，解决了该问题的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 这类博弈属于 NP ∩ coNP，多项式时间算法存在性是重大开放问题；确定性算法最坏情况指数时间，但策略迭代在实践中高效，因此研究其平滑复杂度。此前仅有遍历性博弈的高概率平滑多项式结果。

Method: 针对策略迭代（策略改进）算法的一个变体，提出新的分析技术。

Result: 对一般博弈图证明该算法达到平滑多项式复杂度，同时给出高概率保证和期望运行时间保证。

Conclusion: 去除了先前工作的遍历性限制，并将高概率保证强化为期望运行时间保证，从而解决了该类博弈平滑复杂度的开放问题。

Abstract: Turn-based deterministic games on graphs are two-player zero-sum games played on finite directed graphs, where the vertex set is partitioned between the Max and the adversarial Min Player. The respective player chooses outgoing edges from their vertices. We consider these games with the classical discounted-sum and mean-payoff objectives. The goal of the Max Player is to maximize the objective against the adversarial Min Player. These games lie in NP $\cap$ coNP and are among the rare combinatorial problems that belong to this complexity class, yet the existence of a polynomial-time algorithm is a major open question. All known deterministic algorithms require exponential time in the worst case, while the classical strategy iteration (policy iteration) algorithm is remarkably efficient in practice, which motivates the study of the smoothed complexity of these games. Previous results established a smoothed polynomial-time bound only for the restricted class of ergodic games and presented only a high-probability guarantee. Our main result is a new analysis technique for a variant of the strategy iteration algorithm, and we show these algorithms achieve smoothed polynomial complexity for general game graphs with both high-probability and expected runtime guarantees. In particular, our result removes the ergodicity restriction of prior work and strengthens the high-probability guarantee to the stronger expected-runtime guarantee, thereby resolving the open question on the smoothed complexity of these games.

</details>


### [630] [Assortment Optimization under the Mallows Model: Independent-Utility Choice Equivalence and Its Algorithmic Implications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14329)
*Danny Segev*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文揭示Mallows选择模型中的独立效用结构，并据此给出多项式时间的近似方案(PTAS)，用于Mallows模型下的选品优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有Mallows选品优化工作要么依赖结构简化/参数限制，要么仅有准多项式近似，能否在真正多项式时间求得近最优选品仍悬而未决。

Method: 核心结构刻画：显式构造一组互相独立的效用，对所有供给集合同时复现Mallows选择概率，实现精确选择等价；通过有限支撑归约(多项式规模分布)控制所有选品的收益损失，将问题接入Bowers等(FOCS 2025)独立随机效用选品近似框架。

Result: 得到O(n^{Õ(1/ε²)})时间的近似方案，且允许任意产品价格、集中参数与模态排序。

Conclusion: 打通了Mallows相关难题与独立随机效用近似框架之间的联系，首次实现Mallows选品优化的多项式时间近似。

Abstract: The Mallows model is a well-established construct in preference modeling, describing random rankings through their Kendall-Tau distance from a reference permutation. Its compact parameterization and interpretable treatment of preference uncertainty have made it influential across statistics, machine learning, probability, and revenue management. In the latter domain, recent literature has studied the embedding of Mallows-driven choice into assortment optimization. Early approximation schemes in this context require stylized structural simplifications or restrictive parametric assumptions. In the absence of these levers, a highly involved quasi-polynomial-time approximation scheme has subsequently been proposed, leaving wide open the question of whether near-optimal assortments can be computed in true polynomial time.
  The main contribution of this focused technical paper resides in closing these gaps by uncovering a striking independent-utility structure within Mallows choices, and turning this representation into a polynomial-time approximation scheme. Our central structural characterization explicitly constructs a single collection of mutually independent utilities, reproducing Mallows choice probabilities simultaneously for all offered sets. This exact choice equivalence connects pending Mallows-related challenges to the recent approximation framework of Bowers et al. (FOCS 2025) for assortment optimization under independent random utilities. We make this connection algorithmically feasible through a finite-support reduction that produces distributions of polynomial size while controlling revenue loss uniformly over all assortments. Fused together, these ingredients lead to an $O(n^{\tilde{O}(1/ε^2)})$-time approximation scheme for assortment optimization under the Mallows model, while allowing arbitrary product prices, concentration parameters, and modal rankings.

</details>


### [631] [Diffusion-Based Auctions for Multi-Winner Banner Ads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14473)
*Lilian Sun,Henry Huang,Fucheng Warren Zhu,Giannis Daras,Constantinos Daskalakis*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 提出基于扩散模型的横幅广告拍卖框架，允许多个竞标者共同赢得同一广告位，并通过出价强度影响最终展示的广告图像，扩展了结果空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准横幅广告拍卖只有单一赢家展示其广告，结果空间有限；作者希望通过扩散模型让多个竞标者共同影响最终广告图像，实现更丰富的拍卖结果。

Method: 将竞标者的出价与文本描述结合成驱动扩散模型逆向过程的分数，采样一组候选图像，再从中选择福利最大化的图像作为拍卖结果。

Result: 实验从三方面评估：(1) 相对单赢家分配规则的效率提升；(2) 分配规则的单调性；(3) 结合Myerson引理或Clarke规则支付时的近似激励相容性。随着蒙特卡洛样本数增加，三方面均有提升，同时保持图像质量。

Conclusion: 该框架在保持图像质量的同时，在效率、单调性和近似激励相容性上均优于传统单赢家拍卖规则。

Abstract: We propose a new framework for banner ad auctions, leveraging diffusion models to allow for multiple bidders to co-win a single banner ad opportunity, and in particular influence the ad shown on the banner depending on the strength of their bids, enabling a far richer outcome space compared to standard banner ad auctions, where there is a single winner who shows their ad. In our framework, the outcomes are images (what ad to show) and each bidder expresses their preferences over outcomes by declaring their value per unit of alignment between the image chosen by the mechanism and a textual description of their desired image. Our proposed mechanism combines the advertisers' bids and textual descriptions into a score that drives the reverse process of a diffusion model. This is used to sample a set of candidate images from which the welfare maximizing one is eventually chosen. Extensive experimentation evaluates our proposed mechanism around the following axes: (1) efficiency improvements of our allocation rule relative to the single-winner allocation rule; (2) monotonicity of our allocation rule; and (3) approximate incentive compatibility when combining our allocation rule with Myerson lemma-based or Clarke rule-based payments. Improvements along all these axes are shown with the number of Monte Carlo samples. Meanwhile, these benefits are attained while preserving the image quality.

</details>


### [632] [Beyond Independent Values: Optimal Auctions with Correlated Valuations for LLM-Native Advertising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14646)
*Shiman Sheng,Mingyu Guo*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 提出AffMyerson拍卖机制，利用广告主价值间的相关性（源于共享对话上下文）提升LLM广告位拍卖收益，同时保持真实性与个体理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 会话助手中的赞助内容拍卖中，多位广告主读取同一对话，其支付意愿高度相关（共同需求），但现有LLM广告拍卖将其视为独立，忽略相关性导致收益损失。

Method: 将广告主价值建模为多元正态分布，用精度矩阵的符号条件刻画正相关性（affiliation）；设计神经网络参数化保证输出满足该条件；闭式推导条件虚拟价值；无需矩阵求逆，定价O(n^2)；并推广至对数正态族。

Result: LLM-agent竞标下，AffMyerson收益比带调优保留价的二价拍卖高6.2%，比Ronen前瞻拍卖高6.1%，比独立假设下的Myerson拍卖高9.2%；真实关键词查询上仍高4.5%。收益增益随相关性变化。

Conclusion: 利用价值相关性可显著提升LLM广告拍卖收益；该机制对估计误差稳健（不影响真实性），适合查询时实时运行，为LLM广告提供实用且理论可证的拍卖方案。

Abstract: Conversational assistants are becoming the place where people ask what to buy, and sponsored content is moving into their answers. Several advertisers then compete for one sponsored slot, and all of them read the same conversation, so their willingness to pay usually moves together. Existing auctions for LLM advertising treat these values as independent. We therefore present AffMyerson, an auction that captures this correlation and turns it into revenue. We model the advertisers' values given the conversation as a multivariate normal and turn the economic premise of positive dependence (affiliation) into a sign condition on the precision matrix. We design a neural parameterization whose every output satisfies it. We prove that every prior in this family yields a truthful, ex-post individually rational auction, so estimation error can cost revenue but never truthfulness. We derive the conditional virtual values in closed form. By the design of the prior, pricing an auction needs no matrix inversion and takes O(n^2) time, fast enough to run at query time. We also work out the log-normal family used in empirical ad-auction work. There we prove that the auction is truthful for every prior and revenue-optimal when the prior is correct, and that the virtual value is regular everywhere whenever the conditional spread is below a loose threshold, which our fitted priors stay well under. With LLM-agent bidders, AffMyerson earns 6.2% more than a second-price auction with a tuned reserve, 6.1% more than Ronen's lookahead auction with the same prior, and 9.2% more than Myerson's auction run as if values were independent. This gain is still 4.5% on real keyword search queries where willingness to pay is hard to read. The correlation comes from common demand. Agents that judge the conversation bid together and agents told to calculate do not. The gain from conditioning moves with the correlation.

</details>


### [633] [Best-of-Both-Worlds Fair Division via Subsidies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14994)
*Surya Panchapakesan,Rohit Vaish*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明：若某一类不可分物品估值下的每个实例都存在可用补贴实现无嫉妒的P分配，则该类实例存在支撑于P分配的前期无嫉妒彩票（BoBW），即BoBW存在性可归约到envy-freeability。该归约对加性物品、家务及混合情形给出新证明；但对三代理人失效（给出反例），并在字典序估值下得到三代理人的EFX+PO+envy-freeable结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究带补贴的公平分配与不可分物品的best-of-both-worlds（BoBW）公平性之间的关系，寻找从envy-freeability到BoBW存在性的统一归约框架。

Method: 建立一般归约：对任意scale-free的事后性质P（如EF1、EFX、PO）和任意scale-free估值类V（如加性、次模、次可加、单调），若V中每个实例都存在可用补贴实现无嫉妒的P分配，则每个实例存在支撑于P分配的前期无嫉妒彩票。证明使用线性规划对偶。

Result: 该归约为加性物品、家务及物品与家务混合的BoBW存在性提供替代证明。归约的逆命题对两代理人成立，但对三代理人失败：给出四个物品的单调次模估值反例，其中存在前期无嫉妒且事后EF1的彩票，但不存在同时EF1且envy-freeable的分配。对字典序估值，证明三代理人可同时实现EFX、Pareto最优与envy-freeable（因而得到EFX+PO的BoBW保证），并表明四代理人下EFX与envy-freeable可能不兼容。

Conclusion: BoBW存在性可由envy-freeability通过LP对偶一般性导出，但该归约并非可逆：逆命题仅两代理人成立，三代理人起失效。字典序估值下结果依代理人数而变：三代理人可达EFX+PO+envy-freeable，四代理人则EFX与envy-freeable可能冲突。

Abstract: We study the relationship between fair division with $\textit{subsidies}$ and $\textit{best-of-both-worlds}$ (BoBW) fairness for indivisible items. We prove a general reduction of BoBW existence to envy-freeability. Specifically, for any scale-free ex-post property $P$ (e.g., EF1, EFX, PO) and any scale-free valuation class $\mathcal{V}$ (e.g, additive, submodular, subadditive, monotone), if every instance in $\mathcal{V}$ admits a $P$-allocation that can be made envy-free using subsidies, then every such instance admits an ex-ante envy-free lottery supported on $P$-allocations. The proof uses linear programming duality. As applications, the reduction gives alternative proofs of BoBW existence results for additive goods, chores, and mixtures of goods and chores. The converse of our general reduction holds for two agents but fails for three: We provide a four-good counterexample with monotone submodular valuations where an ex-ante envy-free and ex-post EF1 lottery exists, but no allocation is simultaneously EF1 and envy-freeable. For lexicographic valuations, we prove simultaneous EFX, Pareto optimality, and envy-freeability (and hence BoBW guarantees for EFX+PO) for three agents, and show that even EFX and envy-freeability can be incompatible for four agents.

</details>


### [634] [Polynomial Algorithms for Simultaneous Share-Based and Envy-Based Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15437)
*Hannaneh Akrami,Arash Ashuri,Kurt Mehlhorn*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究不可分物品分配中同时实现基于份额与基于嫉妒的公平性，提出多项式时间算法同时保证精确EFL、(1-ε)-MXS和2n/(3n-1)-APS，并给出伪多项式时间算法实现精确MXS/EFL组合及RMMS/EFL组合，最后证明MXS与RMMS间阈值计算弱NP难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的APS近似算法缺乏嫉妒保证，而同时满足MXS/EFL或RMMS/EFL的构造又无伪多项式时间保证，因此需要统一并改进这两类公平性要求。

Method: 设计组合算法：用(1-ε)近似处理MXS并结合精确EFL与APS近似；进一步给出保证精确MXS/EFL及RMMS/EFL的伪多项式算法；还通过归约证明阈值计算的弱NP难性。

Result: 得到(1-ε)-MXS、EFL、2n/(3n-1)-APS的多项式时间解；伪多项式时间下精确MXS/EFL与APS近似；固定代理数下精确RMMS/EFL；并证明MXS-RMMS阈值弱NP难。

Conclusion: 该工作统一并强化了份额公平与嫉妒公平的同时实现，同时指出通过独立计算残差有效阈值扩展到精确MXS存在计算障碍。

Abstract: We study the simultaneous achievement of share-based and envy-based fairness in the allocation of indivisible goods with nonnegative additive valuations. The AnyPrice share (APS) is a strengthening of the maximin share (MMS). A polynomial-time algorithm is known to guarantee a $2n/(3n-1)$ approximation of APS, but without an accompanying envy-based guarantee. Separately, allocations simultaneously satisfying minimum EFX share (MXS) and envy-freeness up to one less-preferred good (EFL), and subsequently the stronger requirement of residual maximin share (RMMS) together with EFL, have been shown to exist. However, the known constructions do not provide pseudopolynomial-time guarantees.
  We develop algorithms that combine these share-based and envy-based fairness requirements. First, for every $\varepsilon \in (0,1)$, we give an algorithm that computes an allocation satisfying exact EFL, $(1-\varepsilon)$-MXS, and $2n/(3n-1)$-APS. Its running time is polynomial in the binary input length and $1/\varepsilon$. Thus, we match the previously established polynomial-time APS approximation while simultaneously guaranteeing exact EFL and an arbitrarily close approximation to MXS.
  Second, we provide a pseudopolynomial-time algorithm that simultaneously guarantees exact MXS, exact EFL, and $2n/(3n-1)$-APS. Third, for every fixed number of agents, we obtain a pseudopolynomial-time algorithm that simultaneously achieves exact RMMS and exact EFL.
  Finally, we establish that computing a numerical threshold between MXS and RMMS is weakly NP-hard, even for additive valuations. This identifies a computational barrier to extending our polynomial-time approach to exact MXS through independently computed residual-valid share thresholds.

</details>


### [635] [Randomized Algorithm for MMS Allocation of Chores with Online Agent Arrivals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15443)
*Haolong Li,Fangxiao Wang,Xiaowei Wu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究agent到达模型下不可分chores的在线公平分配，以ex-post MMS比为指标。二元加性成本达期望3/2+o(1)且下界3/2-o(1)，高概率最优比2；一般加性成本期望及高概率比2+o(1)，并可扩展到goods。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在agent逐个到达、成本函数即时揭示且分配不可撤销的在线场景下，研究不可分chores的公平分配，刻画随机在线算法在MMS意义下能达到的公平性极限。

Method: 以ex-post MMS近似比ρ(X)衡量公平性，分析期望比与高概率保证。针对二元加性成本设计随机在线算法并证明下界；针对一般加性成本提出加权舍入（weighted-rounding）算法；并推广到加性goods。

Result: 二元成本：期望比3/2+o(1)，下界3/2-o(1)，任意n期望比≤1.755；变体以高概率达最优比2。一般成本：期望与高概率均为2+o(1)，任意n期望比≤2.594。goods可获常数期望比，且每agent以概率≥1-85x²得到≥x分数MMS（x≤1/15）。

Conclusion: 该工作给出agent到达模型下chores公平分配的在线算法与匹配下界，二元情况近乎最优，一般情况达常数2+o(1)，且方法可扩展至goods，为在线公平分配提供理论与实践保证。

Abstract: We study the fair allocation of $m$ indivisible chores among $n$ agents in the agent-arrival model against an oblivious adversary. The chore set and the number of agents are known in advance. When agent $i$ arrives, her nonnegative additive cost function $c_i$ is revealed, and the algorithm must immediately and irrevocably assign her a subset of the unallocated chores. We focus on the notion of maximin share (MMS) and measure the fairness of the realized allocation $X$ by the ex-post MMS approximation ratio $ρ(X)$. We measure an algorithm's performance by its expected ratio, and also the guarantees that hold with high probability.
  For binary additive costs, we achieve an expected ex-post MMS ratio of $3/2+o(1)$, and show that every randomized online algorithm has an expected ratio of at least $3/2-o(1)$. For every $n$, the expected ratio is at most $1.755$. A variant of our algorithm guarantees an approximation ratio of $2$ with high probability, which is optimal. % For general additive costs, we present a weighted-rounding algorithm that achieves an expected ratio of $2+o(1)$, which also holds with high probability. The expected ratio is at most $2.594$ for every $n$. We also show that similar algorithms extend to additive goods, achieving a constant expected ex-post MMS ratio and guaranteeing every agent an $x$-fraction of her MMS with probability at least $1-85x^2$ for every $x\le1/15$.

</details>


### [636] [Lasso Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15480)
*Krzysztof Żyndul*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究有限图上的lasso博弈，对比loop语义与lasso语义对复杂度和记忆需求的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图博弈通常只关注循环（loop）部分，但完整lasso路径（头+环）也可能决定胜负，需研究这种语义转变带来的影响。

Method: 定义在带标签/权边有限图上、首次成环即结束的博弈，比较loop语义（只看环）与lasso语义（看整条路径）；分析mean-payoff、parity、mod-k等目标的可判定性、位置确定性与记忆需求。

Result: lasso语义下mean-payoff不再位置确定，阈值问题PSPACE完全；lasso parity等价于weak parity，位置确定且多项式时间可解；mod-k两种语义均PSPACE完全；loop语义位置确定的博弈在lasso语义下2^n记忆足够，且lasso mean-payoff与mod-k存在指数记忆下界。

Conclusion: lasso语义可显著改变博弈复杂度与最优策略所需记忆；满足特定封闭性的位置确定目标等价于parity目标。

Abstract: We study games on finite graphs with labelled or weighted edges in which plays end as soon as the first loop is formed. The resulting play has a lasso shape: a path (head) followed by a cycle (loop). We consider two semantics for determining the winner: the loop semantics, where only the loop matters, and the lasso semantics, where the entire play is taken into account. We show that adopting the lasso semantics may have a dramatic impact on both the complexity of the game and the memory required to play optimally. Mean-payoff games with lasso semantics are no longer positionally determined, and the threshold problem – deciding whether the value of the game is at least 0 – is PSPACE-complete. In contrast, lasso parity games are equivalent to weak parity games, remain positionally determined and are solvable in polynomial time. Furthermore, we show that if a positionally determined winning objective is closed under cyclic permutation and both the objective and its complement are closed under concatenation, then it is equivalent to the parity objective. Finally, we consider mod-k games, where the winner depends on the length of the path modulo k >= 2. We show that these games, in both semantics, are PSPACE-complete. Alongside computational complexity, we analyze the memory required to play optimally. We establish that for any game positionally determined in loop semantics, memory of size 2^n is sufficient in lasso semantics. We complement this by showing exponential memory lower bounds for lasso mean-payoff and mod-k games.

</details>


### [637] [Robust Proportionality Axioms for Additive Utilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15516)
*Piotr Skowron*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文将比例代表性的"plus"公理(EJR+、Core+)从批准制偏好推广到一般加性效用偏好，基于"支付"视角进行分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有plus比例公理虽有多项式时间可验证性和强代表性保证，且不要求偏好群体凝聚，但仅局限于批准制偏好，无法适用于更一般的加性效用场景。

Method: 基于对比例性的"支付"解释：候选人的成本由其支持者分摊，目标是平衡选民的总支付额。以此框架将EJR+和Core+推广到一般加性效用。

Result: 给出了EJR+和Core+在一般加性效用下的推广形式与形式化分析。

Conclusion: 扩展了比例代表性plus公理的适用范围，为加性效用下的参与式预算提供了新的公平性分析框架。

Abstract: We study the model of participatory budgeting, in which a subset of candidates is selected subject to a budget constraint. Voters express their preferences by assigning a numerical utility to each candidate. Our focus is on formal analysis of proportionality, a central notion of fairness in multi-winner elections. Intuitively, proportionality means that each group of voters should influence the election outcome roughly in proportion to its size. Recent "plus" axioms of proportionality are particularly appealing notions: they are verifiable in polynomial time, and they provide strong representation guarantees without requiring groups of voters to have cohesive preferences. However, their existing formulations are restricted to approval-based preferences. We generalise extended justified representation plus (EJR+), and Core plus (Core+) to general additive utilities. Our approach builds on a payment-based interpretation of proportionality: candidates' costs are shared among their supporters, with the aim of balancing voters' total payments.

</details>


### [638] [Improving the Bounds on Approximating Weighted Maximin Share for Chores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15520)
*Trung Thanh Nguyen,Khaled Elbassioni,Jörg Rothe*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究带任意正权重的不可分杂务分配问题，证明存在4.124234528-WMMS公平分配，并给出多项式时间算法求4.12424-WMMS分配；同时构造下界实例使最优WMMS近似因子趋于e，从而将既有差距从[2,12]缩小到[e,4.12424]。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不可分杂务分配中的带权重最大最小份额（WMMS）公平性此前最佳近似因子区间为[2,12]（Li等），上下界之间差距较大，需要进一步收紧以更准确刻画该问题的可近似性。

Method: 针对任意正权重与加性非负成本函数，构造并分析WMMS分配的存在性，证明上界4.124234528；对权重与成本为二进制有理数的实例，设计多项式时间算法（时间依赖代理数、杂务数及输入二进制编码总长）求4.12424-WMMS分配；并通过构造具有严格正且同序成本的实例族推导下界。

Result: 证明每个实例都存在4.124234528-WMMS分配；给出求4.12424-WMMS分配的多项式时间算法；构造实例族使最优WMMS近似因子收敛到e，将先前[2,12]的差距缩小为[e,4.12424]。

Conclusion: 该工作显著缩窄了带权重不可分杂务WMMS公平分配的近似因子区间，确立了近乎紧确的上界与趋于e的下界，为后续研究提供了更精确的界限与算法框架。

Abstract: We investigate the problem of allocating indivisible chores among agents with arbitrary positive weights and additive nonnegative cost functions. An allocation is said to be $α$-weighted-maximin-share (WMMS) fair if the cost incurred by each agent is at most $α$ times her weighted maximin share. We establish that every instance admits a $4.124234528$-WMMS allocation. Moreover, for instances in which all weights and costs are rational numbers represented in binary, we give an algorithm that computes a $4.12424$-WMMS allocation in time polynomial in the number of agents, the number of chores, and the total binary encoding length of the input. Complementing these upper bounds, we construct a family of instances with strictly positive, identically ordered costs for which the optimal WMMS approximation factors converge to $e$. Together, our results substantially narrow the previously best-known gap of $[2,12]$ established by Li et al.~\cite{LWX26} to $[e,4.12424]$.

</details>


### [639] [Fair Allocation with Dichotomous Preferences over Item Complements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15801)
*Soumyajit Pyne,Vignesh Viswanathan,Wenhao Yang,Yair Zick*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究代理人对物品组（而非单个物品）具有二分次模偏好的公平分配问题，发现加入物品互补性会导致计算困难，但在互补束规模受限时给出多项式近似算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平分配模型多针对单个物品，而实际场景（如选课分配）中代理人的偏好常作用于物品组且含互补性。作者希望将二分次模偏好从单个物品扩展到物品组，并检验这一"微小"扩展是否可行。

Method: 将二分次模偏好扩展为对物品组的偏好；分析含物品互补时的功利/纳什最优分配的复杂度；对互补束大小至多 k 的情形，借助组合优化工具设计多项式时间近似算法，构造 1/k-maxUSW、近似纳什福利最大化以及 1/(k+1)-近似 maxUSW EF-X 分配。

Result: 含物品互补时，计算功利最优或纳什最优分配是 NP-hard；当互补束大小 ≤ k 时，存在多项式算法计算 1/k-maxUSW 和近似纳什福利最大化分配；PO+EF-1 可能不存在，但可多项式时间计算 1/(k+1)-近似 maxUSW EF-X 分配，且每个代理人 i 的效用至少为 (MMS_i − k)/(k+1+1/n)。

Conclusion: 对物品组的二分次模偏好虽是自然扩展，但互补性带来显著计算障碍。受限互补束规模可恢复可计算性，但相比标准二分次模情形的简单顺序方法，需要更复杂的组合优化工具。

Abstract: We study the problem of fair allocation when agents have dichotomous submodular preferences over groups of, rather than individual, items. These preferences naturally extend existing models, and have a natural interpretation in settings such as course allocation. We show that this seemingly minor extension results in computational intractability barriers: computing a utilitarian or Nash-optimal allocation with item complements is NP-hard. However, when agents' complementary bundles have size at most $k$, there exist poly-time algorithms that compute $\frac1k$-\maxUSW allocations and approximate Nash-welfare-maximizing allocations. While PO+EF-1 allocations may not exist in the complementary preference setting, it is possible to compute $\frac1{k+1}$-approximately \maxUSW EF-X allocations in polynomial time; furthermore, these allocations offer each agent $i$ a utility of at least $\frac{\MMS_i - k}{k+1 + \frac1n}$, where $\MMS_i$ is agent $i$'s maximin share guarantee.
  While the standard dichotomous binary submodular setting admits simple sequential techniques for computing fair and efficient allocations, our results for the complements setting require more complex tools from combinatorial optimization.

</details>


### [640] [The Voter Model with Opinion Graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16684)
*Petra Berenbrink,Thorsten Götte,Martin Hoefer,Tim Koglin*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究带意见图的选民模型(EdgeVOG),分析其稳定时间、意见存活概率及支持度上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典选民模型缺少"有限信任"机制,即个体只接受与自己观点相近(在意见图中相邻)的观点,需研究此类受限交互下的动力学性质。

Method: 在意见图G上定义两种过程:普通EdgeVOG(均匀随机采样交互对)与生产性EdgeVOG(仅采样意见相邻的对),利用期望分析、鞅/集中不等式等工具给出稳定时间、存活概率与支持度界。

Result: ①普通EdgeVOG对任意图与初态在O(n²logn)步内稳定(期望且高概率),期望界渐近紧;生产性EdgeVOG期望稳定时间恰为初始相容对数量,高概率为O(n²logn)。②观点i存活概率≥p_i=s_i/(s_i+Σ_{j∈N(i)}s_j),且存活少于(1-δ)μ的概率≤exp(-δ²μ/(2(Δ²+1)))。③若最大度Δ且初始支持≤ŝ,则任一观点支持量≤Õ(min{n,Δ⁶ŝ})高概率成立,由此得到生产性EdgeVOG在广泛配置下的近线性稳定界。

Conclusion: 有限信任显著影响选民动力学,给出了稳定时间紧界、存活概率下界与支持度集中界,并为生产性过程提供近线性稳定保证。

Abstract: We study the \emph{voter model with opinion graph}, a generalization of the standard (pull) voter model that adds a notion of bounded confidence. In this process, we consider a finite set $A$ of $n$ agents. Each agent $u \in A$ has an opinion $x_u \in O$, where we model opinions as vertices in an undirected opinion graph $G = (O,E)$ with $|O|=q$. In each step, an agent $u$ interacts with another agent $v \in A$. In contrast to classical voting, $u$ adopts the opinion $x_v$ if and only if $x_v$ and $x_u$ are neighbors in $G$. The process is stable once all remaining opinions are an independent set in $G$. We analyze two variants of the process: the ordinary EdgeVOG process, which samples a pair of interacting agents uniformly at random from all possible pairs, and the productive EdgeVOG process, which samples only pairs with neighboring opinions in $G$.
  We show the following:
  - For every opinion graph and every initial configuration, ordinary EdgeVOG stabilizes within $O(n^2\log n)$ steps in expectation and with high probability. The expectation bound is asymptotically tight. For the productive EdgeVOG process, the expected stabilization time is exactly the initial number of compatible agent pairs, while $O(n^2\log n)$ steps suffice with high probability.
  - An opinion $i$ with initial support $s_i$ survives with probability at least $p_i:=s_i/(s_i+\sum_{j\in N(i)}s_j)$. Further, let $μ= \sum_{i \in O} p_i$, then we show the probability that less than $(1-δ)μ$ opinions survive is at most $\exp(-δ^2μ/(2(Δ^2+1)))$ for every $0\leqδ\leq1$.
  -If $G$ has maximum degree $Δ$ and every opinion initially has support at most $\hat{s}$, then no opinion ever acquires more than $\tilde{O}(\min\{n,Δ^6\hat{s}\})$ agents with high probability. This yields near-linear stabilization bounds for productive EdgeVOG for a large class of configurations.

</details>


### [641] [The Complexity of Exact and Approximate Nash Equilibria in Anonymous Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16848)
*Zhengyang Liu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文证明：对任意固定有理数 c>0，在 n 人双策略匿名博弈中计算 2^{-n^c}-近似纳什均衡是 PPAD-完全的；精确计算在可分离线性归约下是 FIXP-完全的，近似到精确均衡距离为 FIXP_a-完全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究匿名博弈中近似与精确纳什均衡计算问题的复杂度下界，刻画 PPAD 与 FIXP/FIXP_a 的完全性。

Method: 通过系数估计近似模拟电路约束，将近似计算归约到 PPAD；对精确计算，用三策略构造利用多项式根精确实现电路门，并在可分离线性归约下建立 FIXP-完全性；近似到精确均衡距离为 FIXP_a-完全。

Result: 双策略匿名博弈中 2^{-n^c}-近似纳什均衡为 PPAD-完全，即使一策略恒支付 1/2 且除两玩家外另一策略在至多五个对手计数外为常数；精确计算为 FIXP-完全，近似到精确均衡距离为 FIXP_a-完全。

Conclusion: 匿名博弈的均衡计算复杂度被完整刻画：近似是 PPAD-完全，精确是 FIXP-完全，且近似到精确均衡距离为 FIXP_a-完全。

Abstract: We prove that, for every fixed rational $c>0$, computing a $2^{-n^c}$-approximate Nash equilibrium in an $n$-player two-strategy anonymous game is $\mathsf{PPAD}$-complete. This holds even when one strategy always pays $1/2$ and, for all but two players, the other is constant outside at most five opponent counts. The reduction uses coefficient estimates to simulate circuit constraints approximately. Exact computation requires eliminating the simulation error: with three strategies, a separate construction uses polynomial roots to implement circuit gates exactly. This yields $\mathsf{FIXP}$-completeness of exact equilibrium computation under separable-linear reductions and $\mathsf{FIXP}_a$-completeness of approximation in distance to an exact equilibrium.

</details>


### [642] [Online Fair Division with Upgrade Recourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16943)
*Yichen Huang,Nicholas Teh*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究不可分商品的在线公平分配。在不可撤销分配下MMS无法保证正比例，作者引入"升级式回收"（重分配不使任何受影响代理变差），分为物品级和捆绑级两种。物品级最优MMS因子约为1/ln n；捆绑级可通过多换一获得常数保证（2人精确MMS，多人>1/2 MMS）；预测可将离线MMS保证迁移到在线，损失为预测误差加性项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线不可撤销分配中，任何算法都无法保证正的MMS比例，而重分配可恢复公平却可能损害已持有物品的代理。本文探讨在重分配必须保证受影响代理不变得更差（升级约束）的前提下，能维持多少公平性。

Method: 提出两种升级回收形式：(1) 物品级升级——代理持有的每件商品必须保留或被其同等或更高价值的另一件不同商品替换；(2) 捆绑级升级——仅要求代理总价值不下降。分析最优MMS因子，并研究固定选择序列、允许几换一的交换机制，以及利用未来商品预测的算法框架。

Result: 物品级升级下最优MMS因子约为1/H_n≈1/ln n，固定选择序列几乎可达；仅用排序信息时，n≤33无法通过真实价值改善该因子，n增大时改善幅度消失。捆绑级升级保证显著更强：通过多换一交换，2人可达精确MMS，任意人数可达>1/2 MMS，并附带 envy-freeness 松弛。预测可使在线算法继承离线MMS保证，仅损失有界的加性预测误差；但物品级升级下若坚持预测正确时精确MMS，预测错误时无正保证。

Conclusion: 升级式回收中，约束强度决定可维持的公平程度：物品级升级下MMS因子退化至对数级且价值信息帮助甚微，而捆绑级升级将消失因子转为常数，并通过预测框架连接在线与离线保证，同时揭示了精确性与鲁棒性之间的权衡。

Abstract: We study the online fair division of indivisible goods. In the standard model, where assignments are irrevocable, no algorithm can guarantee any positive fraction of the maximin share (MMS). Reassigning earlier goods can restore fairness, but it may take value away from agents who already hold them. We ask how much fairness can be maintained if every reassignment must leave each affected agent at least as well off. We consider two forms of such upgrade recourse. Under item-level upgrades, each good an agent holds must be kept or replaced by a distinct good she values at least as much; under bundle-level upgrades, only her total value must not decrease. For item-level upgrades, we show that the optimal MMS factor is essentially $1/H_n \approx 1/\ln n$, where $H_n$ is the $n$-th harmonic number, and that fixed picking sequences nearly attain it. Since these sequences use only the agents' rankings of individual goods, knowing the actual values cannot improve the optimal factor for up to 33 agents, and improves it by at most a vanishing margin as $n$ grows. Bundle-level upgrades allow substantially stronger guarantees. By permitting several-for-one exchanges, they turn this vanishing factor into a constant: we achieve exact MMS for two agents and more than half of MMS for any number of agents, in both cases together with relaxations of envy-freeness. Finally, we show that predictions about future goods let online algorithms inherit any offline MMS guarantee, losing only an additive term bounded by the prediction error. Under item-level upgrades, however, insisting on exact MMS when predictions are correct leaves no positive guarantee when they are wrong.

</details>


### [643] [An Introduction to Contract Theory for Computer Scientists](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17336)
*Paul Duetting,Michal Feldman,Inbal Talgam-Cohen*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 一篇面向计算机科学家的合约设计综述，连接经济学基础与算法工具，涵盖线性合约、组合合约与学习算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 向计算机科学家介绍合约设计，通过基于结果的支付激励努力。动机来自在线劳动市场、激励感知的算法分类、AI智能体生态等应用场景，需要计算视角的合约设计方法。

Method: 介绍经典委托-代理模型与基本概念；展示最优合约可通过线性规划计算，并指出其不透明且脆弱；转向更简单的线性合约，讨论近似保证与鲁棒（max-min）最优性；从单智能体扩展到多智能体的组合合约；通过学习算法视角处理部分信息情形。

Result: 系统梳理了最优合约的线性规划可计算性及其不透明、脆弱的问题，说明线性合约在近似保证与鲁棒最优性上的价值，并绘制了多智能体组合合约的可处理性与近似性的算法图景，同时总结了部分信息下的学习算法方法。

Conclusion: 本文是一份简洁易读的入门指南，将经济基础与算法工具相连，并指出新理论与新应用的开放方向。

Abstract: This survey introduces contract design to computer scientists: using outcome-based payments to incentivize effort. We discuss applications that motivate a computational approach to contract design, ranging from online labor markets, to incentive-aware algorithmic classification, to emerging ecosystems of AI agents. We present the classic principal-agent model and introduce basic concepts. We show how optimal contracts are computable via linear programming, and why they can be opaque and brittle. Motivated by this we turn to simpler contract formats, specifically linear contracts. We discuss approximation guarantees, and robust (max-min) optimality of such contracts. We then move beyond the single-agent setting to combinatorial contract settings with multiple agents, mapping the algorithmic landscape of tractability and approximation. Finally, we discuss partial information settings through the lens of learning algorithms, and outline open directions. The goal is a concise, accessible entry point that connects economic foundations with algorithmic tools and highlights opportunities for new theory and applications.

</details>


### [644] [Dynamic Run-Out Pricing for Perishable Goods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17416)
*Farbod Ekbatani*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究有限库存、易腐产品的动态定价问题，提出DROP算法及其尾部分布扩展TA-DROP，实现渐近最优收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卖家在容量约束和随机异质估值下，需在即时销售与未来机会之间权衡，传统方法难以有效处理这一动态定价难题。

Method: 提出基于当前库存和未来需求实时调价的DROP算法；针对重尾Pareto估值引入TA-DROP，通过故意抬高价格保护库存。

Result: 在有限或指数估值分布下，DROP期望收益随市场规模增长收敛到最优收益，且绝对差趋于0；TA-DROP在Pareto分布下恢复渐近最优性并具多项式收敛速率。

Conclusion: DROP简单可解释且渐近最优，TA-DROP能修正重尾估值下的低价问题，为动态定价提供有效方案。

Abstract: I study a dynamic pricing problem in which a seller with limited inventory must sequentially price a perishable product for arriving customers with heterogeneous valuations. The key difficulty lies in balancing immediate sales against future opportunities under capacity constraints and stochastic customer valuations. I propose a simple, interpretable, and asymptotically optimal dynamic pricing algorithm, called Dynamic Run-Out Pricing (DROP), that adjusts prices in real time based on current inventory and anticipated future demand.
  Under the assumption that customers' valuations follow bounded or exponential distributions, our theoretical results show that DROP's expected revenue converges to the optimal revenue as market size grows. Unlike traditional notions of near-optimality, where the ratio of the algorithm's revenue to the optimal revenue converges to 1, I show that the absolute difference between the two revenues converges to 0 as the market size increases, underscoring the algorithm's effectiveness.
  Furthermore, I extend our analysis to heavy-tailed valuation distributions, specifically the Pareto distribution, where standard run-out heuristics severely underprice inventory by ignoring the value of waiting for extreme valuations. To correct this, I introduce the Tail-Aware DROP (TA-DROP) heuristic, which intentionally inflates prices to protect inventory, and I prove that it restores asymptotic optimality with a strict polynomial convergence rate.

</details>


### [645] [A Stochastic Growth Model for Online Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17443)
*Farbod Ekbatani,René Caldentey*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文用马尔可夫过程刻画双边平台渐进式增长，求解最优准入、指派与补偿策略。平台以最大可行速率招纳服务者直至内生目标规模，资深补偿可作为补贴式增长的运营替代。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有文献多用静态市场出清或总量动态模型研究"鸡生蛋"难题，未刻画通过服务端级别的准入、指派与补偿决策实现的渐进增长，也未纳入前瞻性服务者的跨期参与约束。

Method: 将平台增长建模为马尔可夫过程：服务者与顾客按泊松过程到达，顾客需求随活跃服务者数量非递减；在温和条件下刻画最优准入、指派与补偿策略。

Result: 平台以最大可行速率招纳服务者，直到达到内生目标规模，该规模可能小于静态市场出清最优值；基准模型中发现以资历为基础的补偿机制。

Conclusion: 资深补偿可充当财务补贴式增长的运营替代：平台不用前期补贴吸引早期服务者，而是用未来现金流回报其在需求有限时的加入及帮助平台达到后续高需求状态。

Abstract: We investigate the growth trajectory of online platforms operating as market makers in two-sided matching markets. Their expansion, often referred to as the ``chicken-and-egg dilemma'' in the literature, poses an inherent challenge: service providers find value in joining the platform because of the presence of customers, while customers are drawn to the platform by the availability of service providers. Much of the existing literature addresses this expansion challenge through either a static market-clearing lens or aggregate dynamic models, emphasizing how network externalities shape a platform's growth trajectory and equilibrium size. These approaches do not fully capture how gradual growth must be implemented through server-level admission, assignment, and compensation decisions. Embedded in this growth process are intertemporal participation constraints that the platform must satisfy to attract and retain forward-looking servers.
  To explicitly account for the stochastic dynamics of a platform's gradual growth, we model the system as a Markov process. Potential servers and customers arrive according to Poisson processes, and customer demand is non-decreasing in the number of active servers. Under mild conditions, we characterize the platform's optimal admission, assignment, and compensation policies. The platform admits servers at the maximum feasible rate until it reaches an endogenous target size, which can be smaller than the static market-clearing optimum. In the baseline model, seniority-based compensation acts as an operational substitute for financially subsidized growth: instead of using upfront subsidies to induce early server participation, the platform uses future cash flows to reward early servers for joining when demand is limited and for helping the platform reach later, higher-demand states.

</details>


### [646] [Unit-Demand Pricing for Min-Buying Customers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17450)
*Titing Cui,Michael Hamilton,Jourdain Lamperski,Kasra Tari*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究"min-buying"行为下的单位需求定价问题，发现统一定价在此模型下比拟线性模型更有效：对称同分布估值下统一定价最优，非对称正则估值下统一定价可保证约69.86%的最优收益且该比例是紧的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统单位需求定价研究多基于拟线性（quasi-linear）效用模型，即顾客选择最大化自身效用的商品。但现实中顾客常采用"满足性"策略，如min-buying——只购买价格最低且效用非负的商品。作者希望探究在这种更保守的需求模型下，非统一定价的价值是否依然显著。

Method: 在min-buying行为下分析单位需求定价的最优性：(1) 对称环境：对独立同分布（i.i.d.）估值证明统一定价最优，并向可交换（exchangeable）且相关联（affiliated）分布推广；(2) 构造可交换但非关联的估值分布，展示统一定价与最优单品定价之间存在对数级差距，并证明该差距是紧的；(3) 非对称环境：估值独立但不同分布、且为正则分布时，分析统一定价的收益保证。

Result: min-buying下：(1) i.i.d.估值时统一定价最优，该结论可推广至可交换且相关联分布；(2) 存在可交换但非关联分布，使统一定价与最优单品定价的差距为项目数的对数级，且此差距是紧的，与拟线性情形的最坏差距一致；(3) 独立但不同分布的正则估值下，统一定价保证约69.86%的最优单品定价收益，且该界是紧的。

Conclusion: 在min-buying等满足性行为这一更保守的需求模型下，非统一定价的价值大幅降低甚至完全消失；统一定价往往接近最优，说明定价策略的复杂性收益在现实顾客行为下可能被高估。

Abstract: We study the unit-demand pricing problem under \textit{min-buying} behavior, where customers purchase the lowest-priced item that yields non-negative utility. In contrast to the quasi-linear model, we show that uniform pricing becomes substantially more effective under min-buying. First, we study symmetric environments. We show that for min-buying customers with independent and identically distributed valuations, a uniform price across items is optimal. We then extend this optimality result to all valuations drawn from exchangeable and affiliated distributions. However, uniform pricing is not optimal in all symmetric environments: for min-buying customers we construct an exchangeable and non-affiliated valuation distribution for which the gap between uniform pricing and optimal item pricing is logarithmic in the number of items. This gap is tight and matches the worst-case gap in the quasi-linear setting. Next, we consider asymmetric environments in which valuations are independent but not identically distributed. When these valuations are regular and customers are min-buying, we show that a uniform price guarantees approximately 69.86\% of the optimal item-pricing revenue and this is tight. Overall, our results highlight that the value of non-uniform pricing substantially diminishes, and often disappears entirely, under more conservative demand models in which customers engage in satisficing behaviors such as min-buying.

</details>


### [647] [Improved Combinatorial Auctions with and without Samples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17517)
*Aviad Rubinstein,Sahil Singla*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文为组合拍卖（离线、秘书、带样本先知模型）提出新机制，在$m$件物品、$n$个XOS买家的社会福利最大化上取得更优保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 改进Dütting等（FOCS 2024）的带样本先知机制（运行时间与样本复杂度）以及Assadi等（SODA 2021）在秘书/离线模型的$O((\log\log m)^2)$近似，解决其公开问题。

Method: 基于统一的新技术，构造通用真实（universally truthful）、多项式时间机制，用于带样本先知、秘书与离线模型。

Result: 带样本先知：$(2+\eps)$近似，每分布$O(\log\log m)$样本，近似紧（受先知不等式限制）；较前人运行时间指数级更快、样本复杂度双指数级更低。秘书与离线：$O(\log\log m)$近似（优于此前$O((\log\log m)^2)$）。

Conclusion: 本文机制统一改进了三个模型的社会福利近似保证，回答了Dütting等与Assadi等提出的公开问题。

Abstract: We give new mechanisms for combinatorial auctions in the offline, secretary, and prophet-with-samples models. Specifically, we obtain the following guarantees for social welfare maximization with $m$ items and $n$ XOS buyers:
  * In the prophet-with-samples version, buyers arrive in adversarial order and draw their values from independent distributions. We give a universally truthful, polynomial-time $(2+\eps)$-approximation mechanism using $O(\log\!\log m)$ samples from each distribution. The approximation factor is tight even for a single item and without the incentive constraints, due to the classic prophet inequality. Compared to the previous state-of-the-art with the same guarantees [Dütting--Kesselheim--Lucier--Reiffenhäuser--Singla (FOCS 2024)], our running time is exponentially faster, and our sample complexity is doubly-exponentially lower, resolving two explicit open problems by Dütting et al.
  * Using the same techniques, we also obtain improved mechanisms in the secretary and offline versions, where the values are worst-case, and buyers are processed in either random order (secretary) or without any timing restrictions (offline). After a long line of works, the state of the art in both models is an $O((\log\!\log m)^2)$-approximation due to [Assadi--Kesselheim--Singla (SODA 2021)], who explicitly ask whether it can be improved to $O(\log\!\log m)$. We indeed obtain an $O(\log\!\log m)$-approximate universally truthful mechanism for the secretary and offline models.

</details>


### [648] [A Matroid Generalization of Weighted Popular Matching: Characterization and Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17744)
*Yuni Iwamasa,Yusuke Kobayashi,Ryoga Mahara,Kenjiro Takazawa*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出加权popular公共独立集问题，统一了加权popular匹配与popular公共独立集两类推广，给出首个多项式时间算法，其核心是解无关的刻画，并由此解决加权popular匹配带拟阵约束、加权popular分支等多个未解问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: popular匹配已有众多推广：加权popular匹配（Mestre的多项式算法）与拟阵约束下的popular问题（最一般形式为popular公共独立集，由Kavitha等给出多项式算法）。但两者尚未统一，加权popular匹配带拟阵约束等若干问题此前未被解决。

Method: 引入加权popular公共独立集问题，同时推广加权popular匹配与popular公共独立集；建立加权popular公共独立集的解无关（solution-independent）刻画，并基于该刻画设计多项式时间算法。

Result: 给出加权popular公共独立集问题的首个多项式时间算法，并作为推论得到多个此前未解问题的多项式算法，包括带拟阵约束的加权popular匹配与加权popular分支。

Conclusion: 该工作统一并推广了popular匹配的两大方向，所得解无关刻画与多项式算法为解决更一般的加权拟阵约束popular问题提供了框架。

Abstract: We study a problem that unifies two major generalizations of popular matchings in the one-sided preference model. In a bipartite graph in which each vertex, or applicant, on one side has preferences over the adjacent vertices, a matching is called popular if it does not lose a head-to-head election against any other matching. Since the seminal work of Abraham, Irving, Kavitha, and Mehlhorn, who gave the first polynomial-time algorithm for finding a popular matching, numerous generalizations of the popular matching problem have been investigated. Two prominent directions are weighted popular matchings, in which each applicant is assigned a voting weight, and popularity problems under matroid constraints. The former admits a polynomial-time algorithm due to Mestre, while the most general form of the latter is the popular common independent set problem, for which a polynomial-time algorithm is given by Kavitha, Makino, Schlotter, and Yokoi.
  In this paper, we introduce the weighted popular common independent set problem, which simultaneously generalizes weighted popular matchings and popular common independent sets. Our main result is the first polynomial-time algorithm for this problem. A key ingredient of the algorithm is a solution-independent characterization of weighted popular common independent sets, which we establish in this paper. As consequences of our algorithmic result, we obtain polynomial-time algorithms for several previously unresolved problems, including weighted popular matchings with matroid constraints and weighted popular branchings.

</details>


### [649] [Truthful Two-Facility Location with Candidate Locations in Metric Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18006)
*Panagiotis Kanellopoulos,Alexandros A. Voudouris*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究带私有位置的诚实设施选址问题，设施有已知批准偏好，优化社会成本或最大成本；给出线度量与一般度量的确定性及随机机制近似比紧界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前工作仅研究线度量与确定性机制，本文希望补全近似比并探索随机化改进及一般度量空间。

Method: 设计并分析诚实（策略proof）设施选址机制，分别针对线度量和一般度量空间，考察社会成本与最大成本、确定性与随机化机制。

Result: 线上社会成本确定性下界为7（匹配上界），随机化严格更优；最大成本确定性最优3仍紧。一般度量中确定性紧界为社会成本2n-1、最大成本5；随机化对社会成本给出紧刻画，最大成本近乎匹配的上下界。

Conclusion: 完整刻画了该类诚实设施选址问题在确定性与随机化机制下的近似性能，随机化可显著改进，一般度量下获得紧或近乎紧结果。

Abstract: We study a truthful facility location problem in which agents have private positions in a metric space and known approval preferences over two distinct facilities. Each agent incurs a cost equal to her total distance from the facilities she approves. The goal is to locate the facilities at a given set of candidate locations so as to approximately minimize either the social cost or the max cost, while incentivizing the agents to report their positions truthfully. This problem was previously studied for line metrics and deterministic mechanisms. We first settle the approximation ratio of deterministic mechanisms for the social cost on the line by establishing a lower bound of $7$, matching the upper bound from previous work, and show that randomization leads to a strict improvement. For the max cost, we show that the previously known optimal deterministic guarantee of $3$ remains tight even for universally strategyproof mechanisms. We then turn to general metric spaces. For deterministic strategyproof mechanisms, we obtain tight approximation ratios of $2n-1$ for the social cost and $5$ for the max cost. We also show that randomization yields substantial improvements for both objectives: for the social cost, we obtain a tight characterization, while for the max cost we establish nearly matching upper and lower

</details>


### [650] [When Does Opponent Modeling Pay Off? Spatial Inference Stabilises Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18229)
*Marcel Petran,Stefan Edelkamp*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究在部分可观测竞争博弈中,用带事后重标记对手目标的Transformer生成对手子目标热力图,并早期融合进dueling double DQN;该模块稳定训练、提升零样本迁移,其增益受可见度、对手意图和资源密度约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分可观测竞争博弈中,智能体须基于对未见对手意图的信念行动。普通TD(0) DQN在一步配置中易出现退化种子,训练不稳定;作者希望引入显式对手建模来稳定训练并支持迁移。

Method: 设计空间对手模型:用 hindsight-relabelled 对手目标训练的Transformer,依据对手观测轨迹输出子目标热力图,并早期融合进 dueling double DQN。在对称常和觅食博弈(部分可观测)中评估,并进行零样本迁移、全信息跟踪对手测试、密集地图测试及部署时置零热力图的 blindfold 消融。

Result: 对手模型智能体从不崩溃,而普通TD(0) DQN在四分之三的一步配置中出现退化种子;训练成功时恢复大部分对称博弈价值。可零样本迁移到未见觅食对手,取得正向目标优势;但在全信息跟踪对手(其意图即学习者)与资源密集地图上失去该优势。盲消融显示优势来源为训练时稳定化(主导、在难以信用分配时依然存在)与部署时推理(随稀疏地图雾变薄而减弱)。

Conclusion: 对手目标推断是一种稳定性与迁移机制,其价值由可度量的边界条件决定:可见度(雾厚度)、对手意图与资源密度。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning agents in partially observable competitive games must act on beliefs about an unseen opponent's intent. We study a spatial opponent model: a transformer trained with hindsight-relabelled opponent goals that outputs a subgoal heatmap from the opponent's observed trajectory, fused early into a dueling double DQN. In symmetric constant-sum foraging games with partial observability, the module stabilises training. Plain TD(0) DQN suffers degenerate seeds in three of four one-step configurations, whereas the opponent-model agent never collapses and, wherever training succeeds, recovers the majority of the symmetric game value. Transfers zero-shot to a foraging opponent unseen by the learner, with a positive goal advantage over the baseline, and loses this edge exactly where an information argument predicts: against a full-information tracking adversary whose intent is the learner itself, and on resource-dense maps where both agents saturate. A blindfold ablation, zeroing the heatmap at deployment, decomposes the advantage into two mechanisms: training-time stabilisation, which dominates where the credit assignment is hard and survives blinding on the dense map, and deployment-time inference, whose reliance shrinks as fog thins on the sparse map. We conclude that opponent-goal inference is a stability-and-transfer mechanism whose value is governed by measurable boundary conditions: visibility (fog thickness), opponent intent, and resource density.

</details>


### [651] [Linear Last-Iterate Convergence Rates for Optimistic Learning in Harmonic Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18560)
*John Lazarsfeld,Anas Barakat,Jacob Abernethy,Vidya Muthukumar,Georgios Piliouras,Andre Wibisono,Juba Ziani*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 证明OFTRL的last iterate在多玩家调和博弈中以线性速率收敛到纳什均衡，适用于熵、Tsallis、log-barrier等正则化，并可推广到Extragradient FTRL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 调和博弈中均衡收敛速率问题重要，但缺乏对last iterate在线性速率下的收敛保证，尤其是乐观FTRL方法。

Method: 基于OFTRL的对偶视角，证明乐观性与调和博弈全局结构交互导致对偶迭代上能量函数耗散，建立紧的定量界。

Result: 在温和博弈正则条件下，OFTRL的last iterate线性收敛到纳什均衡，适用于一大类正则化。

Conclusion: OFTRL及其Extragradient FTRL变体在调和博弈中具有线性收敛保证。

Abstract: We prove that the last iterate of Optimistic Follow-The-Regularized-Leader (OFTRL) converges at a linear rate to a Nash equilibrium in multiplayer harmonic games. Our result holds under a mild game-regularity condition and for a large family of regularizers, including entropy, Tsallis, and log-barrier. Our analysis is based on a dual perspective of OFTRL: we prove that the interaction between optimism and the global structure of harmonic games leads to the dissipation of an energy function along the dual iterates, for which we establish tight quantitative bounds. Our result also holds for the Extragradient FTRL variant.

</details>


### [652] [CLS Hardness of 2D Min-Max Optimization with Product Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18678)
*Alkis Kalavasis,Panagiotis Patsilinakos,Stratis Skoulakis,Manolis Zampetakis*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究一维min-max优化中近似一阶Nash均衡的计算复杂度，证明其至少与CLS一样难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究最简单的min-max设置（一维min和max玩家、乘积约束）是否能在多项式时间内求解，填补该基础问题的复杂度空白。

Method: 黑盒设定下进行下界查询复杂度分析，证明需要Ω(1/√ε)次查询；白盒设定下从End-of-Potential-Line进行归约，建立CLS困难性。

Result: 黑盒查询复杂度下界为Ω(1/√ε)；白盒情形下为CLS困难，除非CLS⊆P否则不存在多项式时间算法。

Conclusion: 即便最简单的一维min-max设置也至少与CLS同难，不存在多项式时间算法（除非CLS⊆P）。

Abstract: We study the complexity of computing approximate first-order Nash equilibria in min-max optimization problems with one dimensional min and max players and product constraints. For black-box access to the objective, we prove that any algorithm requires $Ω(1/\sqrtε)$ queries to find an $ε$-first-order Nash point. In the white-box setting, we establish CLS-hardness by reducing from End-of-Potential-Line. These results show that even the simplest min-max setting with one dimensional min and max players is at least as hard as CLS and therefore does not admit polynomial-time algorithms unless $\mathsf{CLS}\subseteq \mathsf{P}$.

</details>


### [653] [The Geography of (Concurrent) Block Proposing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18812)
*Ciamac C. Moallemi,Mallesh M. Pai,Dan Robinson,Christoph Schlegel*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究区块链中提议者的地理选址经济激励，建模为提议者先选位置、再进行共同价值首价拍卖的博弈。单一提议者选址于加权中位数；多提议者下信息租金取决于信息接收时间差的方差，造成地理去中心化的经济动力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区块链的抗审查性与韧性取决于验证者/提议者的实际物理位置，但对其选址背后的经济激励缺乏形式化理解，尤其不清楚多个并发提议者会如何影响地理位置分布。

Method: 构建两阶段博弈：提议者先选择地理位置，随后为出块机会参与首价拍卖，共同价值由地理分散信息源驱动。分别分析单一提议者与多并发提议者情形，并用序数势函数与加权二-median问题刻画均衡。

Result: 单一提议者最小化方差加权延迟，位于信息源加权中位数处，并与主导源共址。两提议者时，双方同时获知的信息不产生租金，预期利润正比于自身相对对手提前获得信息的标准差。选址博弈以共同未观测方差为序数势，故加权二-median的全局解为均衡；两个信息源时，无论一方多弱，两提议者各居一处；提议者数不少于源数时，规则出价下均衡位置互异。

Conclusion: 多个并发提议者不仅限制单个提议者的交易纳入控制权，还通过奖励独占（而非共享）信息，形成推动地理去中心化的经济力量。

Abstract: The resilience and censorship resistance of a blockchain depend on where the validators and proposers of that blockchain physically operate. We study the economic incentives behind this location choice, both with a single proposer and with multiple concurrent proposers. Formally, we study a game where proposers first choose locations and then compete in a first-price auction for an opportunity whose common value is driven by information from geographically dispersed sources. A single proposer minimizes variance-weighted delay, locating at a weighted median of the sources and co-locating with any dominant one. By contrast, with two proposers, information both observe equally early earns no rent, and each proposer's expected profit is proportional to the standard deviation of the information it receives before its rival. We show that the location game admits the jointly unobserved variance as an ordinal potential, so global solutions of a weighted two-median problem are equilibria. With two sources, one proposer locates at each, however weak one is. With more proposers and at least as many sources, equilibrium locations are distinct under regular bidding. Multiple concurrent proposers thus do more than limit any single proposer's control over inclusion: by rewarding exclusive rather than shared information, they create an economic force toward geographic decentralization.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [654] [Artificiality's First Exam: An LLM-Referenced C-test for Supraintelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14005)
*Jose Hernandez-Orallo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出首个以LLM作为表示机器的Levin Kt测试，通过逆问题生成可认证的高难度测试项，在任何人或前沿模型解决前提供比特级难度度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准随人类或当前AI校准会循环化或迅速饱和，需要一种能评估超越当前机器与出题人的能力的方法。

Method: 以Levin Kt为理论基础，将LLM视为UTM（提示即自然语言程序），形式化度量并设计轻量级生成与认证流程，考察参考机器能力及考官-考生差距的影响。

Result: 生成首批认证测试项并施测于12个LLM，得到的智能体特征曲线随难度下降，延伸至可认证但超越前沿智能的超智能窗口区域。

Conclusion: 基于Levin Kt与LLM的测试可在超越现有能力的高难度区持续生成可认证项目，为评估潜在超智能提供新范式。

Abstract: Under the accelerated pace of AI development, any benchmark whose difficulty is calibrated with humans or current AI systems becomes circular, or saturates soon. How can we then evaluate machines that may become more capable than the current machines and the people who write the tests? One answer to the question hinges on inverse problems, inductive inference questions for which difficulty depends on the complexity of the underlying mechanism, given the observations and the previous knowledge. Levin's Kt, a computable variant of Kolmogorov complexity, puts a theoretical upper bound to that difficulty, balancing the simplest representation encoding for the mechanism and the logarithm of the time steps to run that mechanism. Previous tests derived from Levin's Kt, such as the original C-test, are based on minimalistic Universal Turing Machines (UTM), capable of very limited representations and no previous knowledge. Reasoning large language models (LLM) are UTMs that capture a compendium of human culture as knowledge, using prompts as natural language programs. This paper presents the first test based on Levin's Kt with LLMs as representational machines. Fresh test items can be produced at high difficulties, estimated in a ratio scale measured in bits, before any human or frontier model can solve them. We formalise the measure, devise a lightweight generation and certification pipeline, explore the effect of the power of the reference machine and the gap between examiner and examinee. We produce a first battery of certified items administered to twelve LLMs. The resulting agent characteristic curves decrease with difficulty, down to the uncharted high-difficulty region, the supra-intelligence window of items we can certify, yet beyond generations of frontier intelligence.

</details>


### [655] [The Silent Failures in Agentic Data Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14115)
*Xue Li,Hongqian Xia,Daniel Gomm,Aécio Santos,Cornelius Wolff,Madelon Hulsebos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文认为现有 agentic 数据科学评测只关注下游预测性能和代码正确性，忽视了方法论与领域知识，因此从失败模式分析、可控测试套件和定性评估三个角度重新评测，发现大多数智能体方案至少存在一种失败模式，且数据泄漏与预测性能正相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型降低了代码编写门槛，推动了数据科学智能体（agentic DS）发展。但现有评测只看预测性能和代码正确性，掩盖了数据泄漏、验证不当等方法论失败，阻碍了稳健系统的开发。因此需要超越准确率来评测 agentic DS。

Method: 从三个角度评测：1）对常见 agentic DS 框架和模型在 220 个数据科学任务上的失败模式做大规模分析；2）构建可复用、可扩展的测试套件，用精心设计的任务在受控条件下测试六种特定失败；3）将 agentic DS 流程与 Kaggle 竞赛中的专家方案做定性对比。

Result: 大多数 agentic 方案至少包含一种失败模式，无论 harness 复杂度或模型能力如何。数据泄漏失败的发生与预测性能呈正相关，证明必须超越准确率评测智能体。定性分析显示，相比竞赛获胜的数据科学家，DS 智能体普遍缺乏问题解决创造力和领域知识。

Conclusion: 原则性的失败模式分析应成为 agentic DS 评测的必要组成部分；本文揭示的洞见对构建可信赖的 agentic DS 流程至关重要。

Abstract: Large language models have significantly lowered the barrier to writing code. Naturally, this has also led to the development of data science agents that promise automating the design and execution of data science from task formulation to model development. Existing evaluations of agentic data science (agentic DS) assess downstream predictive performance and code correctness, providing preliminary insight in agentic DS capabilities. We argue that these evaluations overlook the fundamental principles of data science: methodological data science- and domain knowledge. As such, only assessing downstream performance masks methodological failures such as data leakage and inappropriate validation, limiting the development of robust agentic DS systems. In this paper, we evaluate agentic DS beyond accuracy from three different angles: 1) a large-scale analysis of failure modes in common agentic DS frameworks and models across 220 data science tasks, 2) a reusable and extensible test suite with curated data science tasks that test for six specific failures in a controlled manner, and 3) a qualitative assessment of agentic DS pipelines against expert solutions on Kaggle competitions. We find that the majority of agentic solutions contain at least one failure mode despite the complexity of agentic harness or model capacity. Moreover, we identify a positive correlation between the occurrence of data leakage failures and predictive performance, confirming the necessity to evaluate agents beyond accuracy. Our qualitative analysis shows that DS agents generally lack problem solving creativity and domain knowledge, compared to competition-winning data scientists. We believe that principled failure mode analysis, as presented here, should be integral part of agentic DS evaluations, and that the insights we surface will be key in developing trustworthy agentic DS pipelines.

</details>


### [656] [ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14118)
*Hansi Yang,Linji Hao,Hongyan Hao,An Wang,Han Wu,Qi Gu,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ClawLoop 框架，实现无需外部教师模型、最少先验依赖的 harness 型 agent 自我改进闭环，在多个基准上取得一致提升，且合成任务可迁移至更小模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 在沙盒环境中直接操作文件系统与 shell，但针对此类 harness-based agent 的后训练流程稀缺，且多为一次性、依赖教师模型：由更强外部模型合成任务并收集轨迹，训练一次即止，评估结果仅供人工参考而不回流。这类流程受限于外部模型能力与人类先验范围，无法自我提升。

Method: ClawLoop 由三阶段构成自维持循环：(1) 任务合成：通过两种互补构造流程生成多样化任务池，施加诊断驱动的难度增长，并进行无 agent 与有 agent 的任务验证；(2) 训练：用 SFT 和/或 RL 更新 agent；(3) 诊断与反馈：分析 agent rollout 行为，生成能力分析报告，作为下一轮任务合成的反馈。整个过程无需外部教师模型。

Result: 以 Qwen3.6-27B 作为循环模型，在 SkillsBench、Claw-Eval-Live、ClawGym-Bench 上均获得一致提升；迭代优化的任务进一步迁移到更小的 Qwen3.5-4B 与 9B 模型，在所有基准上都有增益，独立于循环模型验证了数据质量。

Conclusion: ClawLoop 证明 harness-based agent 可在无外部教师、最小先验依赖下实现自我改进，且迭代生成的高质量任务具备跨模型迁移能力。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven their deployment toward general-purpose harness environments, where LLM-based agents operate in sandbox workspaces and interact directly with file systems and shells. While numerous post-training pipelines exist for tool-use agents, their counterparts for harness-based agents remain scarce and are predominantly one-shot and teacher-dependent: a stronger external model synthesizes tasks and collects trajectories, the target agent is trained once, and evaluation results are consumed by human researchers rather than fed back into the loop. Such pipelines are inherently bounded by the capability of the external model and the scope of human prior, leaving no room for self-improvement. To address these limitations, we propose ClawLoop, a framework that enables self-improving without any external teacher model and with minimal prior dependencies. ClawLoop composes three phases into a self-sustaining cycle: Task Synthesis, which generates a diverse pool of training tasks via two complementary construction routines, applies diagnosis-conditioned difficulty growth followed by both agent-free and agent-based task validation; Training, which updates the agent via SFT and/or RL; and Diagnosis and Feedback, which analyzes the agent's rollout behaviors to produce a capability analysis report that will be used as feedback for task synthesis in the next iteration. Using Qwen3.6-27B as the loop model, ClawLoop yields consistent improvements on SkillsBench, Claw-Eval-Live, and ClawGym-Bench. The iteratively refined tasks are further transferred to smaller-scale Qwen3.5-4B and 9B models with gains across all benchmarks, validating data quality independently of the loop model.

</details>


### [657] [Correction Training for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14136)
*Donghoon Ahn,Runqian Wang,Alexei A. Efros,Taesung Park,Yash Belhe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"校正器"框架，缓解扩散模型因曝光偏差导致的训练-推理差距，显著提升无引导及无条件生成的样本质量，并可蒸馏回基础模型以消除额外推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型迭代采样中，去噪器训练时输入为真实图像加噪，而推理时输入来自自身不完美的预测，存在曝光偏差（训练-推理差距），导致无引导（如不加CFG）时样本质量差。

Method: 训练一个校正器，输入为基础模型的预测，以相同真值目标进行监督，将校正变为显式学习任务。采样时每步对去噪器的干净样本预测迭代精炼，可反复作用于自身输出，逐层修正中间预测以防早期伪影残留。

Result: 在DiT、SiT、JiT上评估，大幅提升无引导及无条件生成的FID；性能可与CFG竞争；校正+CFG进一步改善多样性并减轻CFG过饱和问题；通过将精炼预测蒸馏回基础模型可摊薄额外推理成本，且不损失质量增益。

Conclusion: 校正步骤能有效缩小扩散模型的训练-推理差距，提升样本质量同时保持多样性，为无引导生成提供可行方案，且推理成本可经蒸馏消除。

Abstract: Iterative sampling in diffusion models can lead to error accumulation due to exposure bias. The denoiser is trained on real images interpolated with noise, but at inference its inputs are constructed from its own imperfect predictions from the earlier steps, something it has never seen at training time. This might be one reason diffusion models often struggle without additional help, such as CFG. We introduce a correction step for diffusion models which attempts to reduce this training-inference gap. The corrector takes the base model's prediction as input and is trained against the same ground-truth target. This makes correction an explicit learning task, with training inputs provided by the base model. During sampling, at each denoising step, we iteratively refine the denoiser's clean-sample prediction. This allows us to correct predictions at intermediate denoising steps, preventing early artifacts from persisting into the final sample. Although the corrector is trained only on predictions from the base denoiser, it can be applied repeatedly to its own outputs at inference for better results. This simple framework leads to substantial improvement in sample quality while largely preserving diversity. We evaluate our method across DiT, SiT, and JiT. Our method substantially improves upon previously reported FID scores for unguided generation and, notably, unconditional generation, where producing high-quality samples without guidance has been particularly challenging. Our method achieves performance competitive with classifier-free guidance (CFG), and combining correction with CFG further improves diversity and reduces oversaturation typical of CFG. Finally, we show that the additional inference cost of correction can be amortized by distilling the refined predictions back into the base diffusion model, retaining the quality gains without additional inference-time overhead.

</details>


### [658] [Reels-RSI: Program-Level Self-Improvement for Code-Rendered Explainer Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14495)
*Wei Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Reels-RSI将解释性视频视为程序而非像素，通过代码级自改进（规则、教训、剧本）提升生成质量。111条reel实验显示规则能捕获历史缺陷、加固弱导演，但偏好信号存在位置偏差等四种失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释性视频（如几何题讲解、天空为何蓝）常被当作普通像素视频生成任务。作者认为它们是不同的产物：由程序（脚本、分镜、逐帧动画代码）经确定性渲染器转成帧。程序可读、可diff、可测试、可审计，而像素只能被观看，因此自改进应在程序层面而非权重或提示词层面进行。

Method: 提出Reels-RSI，一个面向任意agent harness的开源reel导演。自改进发生在程序层：每次修订记录代码快照；回溯将检查发现与修复diff配对并提炼教训；可被静态检查捕获的教训编译为带必失败/必通过样例的规则（使记忆单元测试化）；新规则回溯作用于此前所有作品。有界且经基准门控的步骤允许agent重写导演剧本，仅在盲配对判断偏好时保留，且任何内容进入记忆都需人工决策。

Result: 在111条reel上（现场研究、两次剧本演化、2x2记忆消融、更弱导演、48-reel学习曲线、评判可靠性研究）发现：现场学到的规则捕获了其存在前创作的帧中四个潜在缺陷，之后为零；规则对强导演是审计（8条无防护reel零违规），对弱导演是护栏（无防护30次违规 vs 5次）；教训缩短修订循环但不复利、不改变评判；首次重写的11-1判定源于投票设计的位置偏差（评委62-81%选第二个展示的reel），掩盖了以13个事实换工艺的脚本。记录了偏好信号的四种失效模式及相应检查与修复。

Conclusion: 将解释性视频建模为可审计程序并让自改进发生在程序层面是可行的；规则既能审计强系统也能护栏弱系统，但基于偏好的评判信号存在显著位置偏差和多种失效模式，需要更可靠的评估设计。代码、规则、教训与数据均已公开。

Abstract: Explainer videos -- a worked geometry problem, why the sky is blue, how a dynasty fell -- are usually one more target for pixel video generation. We argue they are a different kind of artifact: a program (script, storyboard and per-frame animation code) that a deterministic renderer turns into frames. A program can be read, diffed, tested and audited; pixels can only be watched. Reels-RSI is an open-source reel director for any agent harness; its self-improvement happens at the program level rather than in weights or prompts. Every revision pass is logged with a code snapshot; a retrospective pairs each check finding with the diff that fixed it and proposes lessons; a lesson that a static check can catch is compiled into a rule with a must-fail and a must-pass example, so the memory is unit-tested; and a rule learned today runs over everything made before it. A bounded, benchmark-gated step lets an agent rewrite the director's playbook, kept only when blind pairwise judgments on held-out topics prefer it; nothing enters memory without a human decision. Across 111 reels -- a field study, two playbook evolutions, a 2x2 memory ablation, a weaker director, a 48-reel learning curve and a judge-reliability study -- we find that the rule learned in the field caught four latent defects in frames authored before it existed and none after; that rules are an audit for a strong director (eight unguarded reels, no violation) and a guard for a weaker one (thirty violations unguarded versus five); that lessons shorten revision loops but do not compound or move the judge; and that the first rewrite's 11--1 verdict was a position bias in our vote design (judges pick the second-shown reel 62--81% of the time), masking scripts that traded thirteen facts for craft. We document four failure modes of the preference signal, which check caught each, and the fixes. Code, rules, lessons and data are public.

</details>


### [659] [Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0: Automating Diverse Task Construction and Measuring Sustained Agent Progress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14146)
*Zongxia Li,Zhongzhi Li,Yucheng Shi,Ruhan Wang,Junyao Yang,Chengsong Huang,Zhichao Liu,Xiyang Wu,Anhao Li,Yue Yu,Ergan Shang,Fuxiao Liu,Tong Zheng,Ninghao Liu,Lichao Sun,Haitao Mi,Leowei Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LHTB 2.0 是一个长时程终端智能体基准，通过流程奖励与密集进度阶梯评估智能体在数小时工作流中的持续进展，而非仅靠最终状态判定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有终端基准多用二值终态检查，无法衡量智能体在长时程任务中是否能持续取得进展，且会丢弃大量中间进度信息。

Method: 保留原 46 个任务，修复任务与评测基础设施缺陷，并扩展 31 个任务；用参数化参考实现生成场景、揭示 6 个作为行为证据、留出 3 个评测，并以密集进度阶梯奖励部分进展、防止记忆公开输出；同时将评测时长从 90 分钟延长至 3 小时，每 30 分钟记录验证器检查点。最终包含 13 个领域、8 类任务的 77 个任务。

Result: 在 15 个前沿模型的 1,145 次模型-任务评分中，GPT-6-astra 以密集平均奖励 0.69 领先，37 个任务达到 R≥0.95；GPT-5.6-sol 以 0.67 紧随其后，32 个任务达到同阈值。在 30 个重建任务上，二值验证器平均分仅 0.221，而密集阶梯平均分为 0.653，说明只看结果会丢弃大量中间进展。

Conclusion: LHTB 2.0 提供了一个更广泛、更稳健、流程感知的测试平台，用于研究智能体数小时级别的可靠执行。

Abstract: Long-horizon terminal benchmarks measure whether an agent can sustain progress through extended workflows with process rewards, not only whether its final state passes a binary check. We present Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0 (LHTB 2.0), an extension of Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench that preserves its 46 original tasks while correcting task and evaluation-infrastructure defects and extending 31 tasks. LHTB 2.0 contains 77 tasks across 13 domains and eight task types. The extended tasks are produced through a systematic reconstruction-task pipeline. We start from a working scientific or engineering artifact, then use a parameterized reference implementation to generate multiple scenarios, reveal six as behavioral evidence, hold out three for evaluation, and use dense progress ladders to reward partial progress while preventing memorization of public outputs. We also extend the evaluation horizon from 90 minutes to three hours and record verifier checkpoints every 30 minutes, enabling direct measurement of sustained progress within a run. Across 1,145 scored model-task runs from 15 frontier models, GPT-6-astra leads with dense mean reward 0.69 and 37 tasks at R at least 0.95, followed by GPT-5.6-sol with dense mean reward 0.67 and 32 tasks at the same threshold. On the 30 reconstruction tasks, binary verifier scores average 0.221, whereas dense ladder scores average 0.653, showing that outcome-only evaluation discards substantial intermediate progress. LHTB 2.0 provides a broader, hardened, and process-aware testbed for studying reliable agent execution over hours.

</details>


### [660] [VETNET: Assembling Benchmark Datasets for AI-Driven Veterinary Innovation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14149)
*Katherine J. Koebel,Renata Ivanek,Parminder Basran,Jennifer Sun,Casey Cazer,Gayatri Anil,Tommaso Banzato,Liz Barton,Dottie Cimino Brown,Leszek Bukowski,Marta Castelhano,Simon Coghlan,Christopher De Sa,Nikki Dutta,Hala Ghali,Julio Giordano,Joshua Glass,David C. Hogg,Nicholas Hollingshead,Adam Kiehl,Ziang Liu,Monica Meduri,Param Mohapatra,Kim Nayyer,Amelia Nelson,Peter-John Mantyla Noble,Christopher Pinard,Beryl Rabindran,Scott Ross,Ron Seccia,Moira Sheehan,Fei Wang,Tracy L. Webb,Kilian Q. Weinberger,Heather M. Whitney,Chen Xin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VETNET 是一个面向动物科学与兽医领域的开放基准数据集与评估框架生态，通过标准化高质量数据和跨机构协作，推动兽医AI发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类医学AI进展迅速，而兽医AI发展碎片化，缺乏标准化、高质量的数据与统一评估体系，两者之间存在明显差距。

Method: 构建 VETNET 生态系统，整合实时基准数据集与评估框架，并联合学术与非学术机构进行多机构协作。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验或量化结果，仅提出该框架的设计目标与定位。

Conclusion: VETNET 有望通过标准化数据与协同评估加速动物科学和兽医医学领域的AI创新。

Abstract: VETNET represents an ecosystem of live benchmark datasets and evaluation frameworks designed to accelerate AI-driven innovation in animal science and veterinary medicine through standardized, high-quality datasets and multi-institutional collaboration across academic and non-academic sectors. This framework addresses the gap between AI advances in human medicine and the fragmented state of veterinary AI development.

</details>


### [661] [Unconstrained CTI-REALM with Open-Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14180)
*Sahil Garg,Ruhi Gottumukkala,Vishal Agarwal,Shubham Vishwakarma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 开放权重模型在足够多交互轮次下，能以不到封闭模型十分之一的成本匹配最强封闭模型；并揭示了基准的消息上限混淆问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织在为安全任务选择语言模型代理时，需在可自审的开放权重模型与昂贵封闭前沿模型间抉择，而现有基准的评分可能受消息上限等混淆因素影响。

Method: 在CTI-REALM基准上，用统一的运行框架、评分器和LLM评审团评估26个模型（19个开放权重、7个封闭）；放松消息上限限制，并引入阶段级指标，通过执行检测查询并对照答案键评估输出。

Result: 在公布的消息上限下，领先开放与封闭模型难分高下；放松限制后，被截断的模型恢复，最高奖励归属开放权重模型。价格与能力相关性弱，相似奖励模型成本相差超一个数量级。不同模型在不同阶段领先，输出中思考比例与奖励无关。
