Conclusion: 消息上限是基准的混淆因素；宜按工作流各阶段路由到表现最佳的模型，而非仅凭总分选模型；开放权重模型在成本效益上具竞争力。

Abstract: Organisations that want language-model agents for security work face a choice between open-weight models, which they can run and audit themselves, and far more expensive closed frontier models. We study that choice on CTI-REALM (arXiv:2603.13517), a benchmark in which an agent turns a threat-intelligence report into a working detection by querying a live telemetry store. We evaluate twenty-six models, nineteen open-weight and seven closed, under a common harness, scorer and panel of LLM judges. Our main finding is that an open-weight model can match the strongest closed models at less than a tenth of their cost, provided it is given enough turns. The benchmark's published limit on agent messages is a confound: a task that exhausts the limit scores zero on every checkpoint, including those it had already passed, so results at that limit partly measure which models finish in time. At the published limit the leading open-weight and closed models cannot be distinguished. With the limit relaxed, the models it was truncating recover, and the highest rewards belong to open-weight models. Among the leading models, price is a poor guide to capability: models with similar rewards differ in cost by more than an order of magnitude. Because the benchmark's checkpoint scores largely record what an agent did or mentioned, we also introduce stage-level metrics that score what the agent submits, by executing its detection queries in the telemetry store and judging its outputs against the answer key. Rather than combining them into one more overall reward, we show that different models lead different stages, which suggests routing each stage of the workflow to the model that performs it best rather than choosing a single model by its overall score. We also report how many tokens each model generates, and find that the share of output spent on thinking does not track the reward.

</details>


### [662] [Visualizing the World Model in an Agent's Value Function](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14186)
*Shawheen Naderi,Fatemeh Akherati,Yubei Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过反事实干预探究无模型强化学习PPO智能体的价值函数是否隐式学习环境世界模型，发现其确实学到钻石收集规则、水/食物影响健康等概念，并讨论安全影响与现有RL智能体局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨无模型RL算法是否实际在学习环境的世界模型，以及这种隐式模型对安全性和通向高级机器智能的意义。

Method: 对Crafter环境中训练的PPO智能体进行反事实干预，在保持状态其余部分固定的前提下施加针对性改变，从而可视化并探测价值函数中的世界知识。

Result: 尽管仅以奖励为优化目标，价值函数仍学到了钻石可收集规则、水和食物对健康的影响、与库存相关的启发式等多种概念。

Conclusion: 无模型RL的价值函数可隐式编码世界模型；本文讨论了其安全启示，并指出当前RL智能体的一些缺陷会阻碍构建真正的高级机器智能。

Abstract: Could model-free reinforcement learning algorithms actually be learning a model of the environment? In this work, we apply counterfactual interventions which hold everything about a state fixed, besides a targeted change, to explore if the value function of a Proximal Policy Optimization agent forms a world model of the Crafter environment. Despite only being trained to optimize reward, we discover that the value function learns concepts such as the rules governing when a diamond is collectible, water and food having an impact on health, heuristics regarding inventory, and more. Finally, we discuss the safety implications of our visualizations and some shortcomings of current reinforcement learning agents that will prevent us from building truly advanced machine intelligence.

</details>


### [663] [Cross-Modal Latent Influence: Patch-Level Training Sample Attribution for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14190)
*Laura Yao,Shixing Yu,Jie Peng,Promit Ghosal,Kyra Gan,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MOSAIC 提出一种共享稀疏图文隐空间，将训练样本影响力分解到具体文本短语与图像区域，实现 VLM 的多模态、空间化影响力归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有影响力归因方法多停留在样本层面；语言模型中的潜在中介方法虽有特征级归因，却缺乏 VLM 所需的模态与空间结构，无法将影响力定位到多模态证据。

Method: 学习共享稀疏图像-文本隐空间：概念具备模态内稀疏、图像区域连续、与描述短语对齐、近似去相关四个特性；再用 EK-FAC 将训练样本影响力通过这些概念分解，并定位到具体文本短语与图像区域。

Result: 在 Qwen 与 Gemma 上，覆盖图像描述、胸片理解、VQA 任务：所学特征更局部、连贯且不损害任务性能；消融按影响力排序的隐变量比按激活或频率排序更能改变模型输出；视觉证据可显著重组训练数据归因，同时保留更多共享隐结构。

Conclusion: MOSAIC 将"模型行为来源"与"承载该影响力的多模态证据"相连接，为 VLM 提供特征级、可空间定位的影响力归因。

Abstract: Explaining a vision--language model (VLM) prediction requires tracing training-example influence to the multimodal evidence that mediates it, yet existing attribution methods largely operate only at the sample level. Recent latent-mediated influence methods provide feature-level attribution in language models, but lack the multimodal and spatial structure needed to ground influence in VLMs. We introduce MOSAIC (Multimodal Orthogonalized Sparse Autoencoders for Influence Characterization). It learns a shared sparse image--text latent space whose concepts are 1) sparse within each modality, 2) supported on contiguous image regions, 3) aligned to the phrases that describe them, and 4) approximately decorrelated. It then applies EK-FAC to decompose training-example influence through these concepts and localize their contributions to specific text phrases and image regions. We evaluate MOSAIC on Qwen and Gemma across captioning, chest X-ray understanding, and visual question answering. The learned features are more localized and coherent without degrading task behavior, and ablating influence-ranked latents changes model outputs more than ablating latents ranked by activation or frequency. We find that visual evidence can substantially reorganize training-data attribution while preserving more of the shared latent structure. MOSAIC thus connects where model behavior comes from with what multimodal evidence carries that influence.

</details>


### [664] [Should SLMs be in the Driver's Seat? A Study of Local Models as Interpreters in Cloud-Written Agent Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14209)
*Boris Radovič,Marco Canini,Veljko Pejović*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种介于云端与边缘之间的混合代理架构：云端模型编写的程序在需要理解运行时用户数据时，通过普通函数调用向本地小模型发起有界提问，从而在数据不出设备的前提下提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端大模型代理最准确但需读取用户私有数据；边缘小模型可本地保护数据但效果差；纯云端写代码方案数据本地但程序在未见数据前编写，遇到需运行时内容理解的步骤即失败。因此需要一种兼顾隐私与性能的中间架构。

Method: 云端模型先编写程序，程序将对用户数据的有界问题（bounded questions）通过普通函数调用委托给设备上的小型本地模型解答。这样数据始终留在本地，而运行时需要语义理解的部分由本地模型处理。

Result: 在 AppWorld 上，对全部六种主干模型与测试分区的组合，该方法相对纯代码代理均提升成功率，最高提升 14.9 个百分点，并在保持用户数据本地的前提下显著缩小了与云端 ReAct 循环的差距。

Conclusion: 通过在云端生成代码与本地小模型之间引入函数调用式的有界问答，可在隐私保护与任务性能间取得良好折中，是一种可行的中间代理架构。

Abstract: The most accurate agents executing user-provided tasks are driven by large, cloud-hosted models, which solve them by reading the private data of the user. Agents powered by models small enough to run on edge devices keep that data local, but yield far worse results. A third option is to have cloud models write a program that devices execute: the data stays local, but as the program is written before any data is seen, it fails whenever a step depends on interpreting content that appears only at run time. We explore an intermediate architecture, in which the cloud-written program defers bounded questions over user data to a small local model through an ordinary function call. On AppWorld this improves the success rate of a code-only agent in all six combinations of backbone model and test partition we evaluate, by up to 14.9pp, recovering a substantial part of the gap to a cloud-hosted ReAct loop while keeping user data on the device.

</details>


### [665] [Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224)
*Ruiyao Xu,Yanfei Chen,Zhongying CuiZhu,Bhavana Dalvi Mishra,Yifei Ming,Han Yu,Rujun Han,Chen-Yu Lee,Tomas Pfister*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Harness^2，一个即插即用的递归式智能体框架优化框架，通过任务级与框架级两层递归，在无真值验证器的开放世界任务中实现稳定的在线自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体能力不仅取决于底层模型，也取决于其执行框架（harness），递归自我改进（RSI）可自动演化框架。但开放世界部署面临两大挑战：(1) 测试时任务新颖且无真值验证器，无法可靠指导在线框架编辑；(2) RSI 过程任务特异性强，难以泛化到新场景。

Method: 提出 Harness^2，包含两层相互连接的递归：任务级递归通过对比式 Propose-Probe-Compose 步骤，在无真值验证器下可靠引导当前任务的框架编辑，并可通过并行或串行递归扩展；框架级递归从这些编辑中提取经验，更新持续改进框架，使智能体更好适应未来任务。

Result: 在三个专业基准和四种模型-框架配置上，单步优化即持续提升 GLM-5 与 Gemini 3.5 Flash，WorkBuddy-Bench 提升最高 11.5 分，JobBench 提升 4.5 分，LAB 提升 11.8 个百分点，且随任务级递归预算增加收益进一步扩大。

Conclusion: Harness^2 通过双层递归机制，有效解决了开放世界 RSI 中缺乏验证器与泛化困难的问题，实现即插即用、可扩展的智能体框架自动进化。

Abstract: LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising approach to automatically evolve these harnesses. However, deploying RSI in open-world settings still faces two critical challenges. First, open-world tasks are typically unseen during the harness design phase and novel at test time, leaving no ground-truth verifiers to reliably guide online harness edits. Second, the RSI process remains highly task-specific and fails to generalize to novel scenarios. We introduce Harness^2, a plug-and-play, recursive agent harnessing framework that addresses these challenges through two connected levels of recursion. Task-level recursion refines the current task's harness using a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step that reliably guides edits without ground-truth verifiers, and can be scaled further via parallel or sequential recursion. Harnessing-level recursion then extracts experience from these edits to update a continual improvement harness, enabling the agent to better adapt to future tasks. Across three professional benchmarks and four model-harness configurations, a single step consistently improves GLM-5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash over their base harnesses, yielding gains of up to 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench, 4.5 points on JobBench, and 11.8 percentage points on LAB, with further gains as the task-level recursion budget increases.

</details>


### [666] [Echo: Error-Compensated 4-Bit Tensor-Parallel Communication for LLM Training and Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14277)
*Xingyu Xie,Xiaoyong Xie,Zhouchen Lin,Kim-Chuan Toh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Echo 是一种 4-bit all-reduce 方法，通过高精度求和与误差反馈控制累积误差，在保证训练与推理质量的同时显著加速张量并行的通信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 张量并行的 all-reduce 位于两个依赖的矩阵乘法之间，其开销无法隐藏且随计算增速快于互联带宽而增大。用 4-bit 替代 16-bit 可将成本降低近 4 倍，但 all-reduce 需对数值求和，舍入求和会在每次调用注入误差。模型质量取决于这些误差跨层的累积，而现有方法只单独处理每次调用，无法控制累积误差。

Method: Echo 以 4-bit 传输数据、以高精度求和，使得无论多少 GPU，每个值每次调用最多被量化两次。通过求和过程显式获得每次注入的误差，并将其反馈到后续调用中，使旧误差相互抵消而非累积。作者证明累积误差有界且与深度无关。

Result: 在 A100 上，对 1 GB 消息 Echo 比 16-bit NCCL all-reduce 快 2.09 倍；空闲互联下首 token 时间最多加速 1.16 倍、训练步最多加速 1.09 倍，背景流量增大时分别可达 1.44 倍与 1.38 倍。Qwen3-8B 上七个基准平均精度与 16-bit 推理差距在 0.4 分以内；10B token 预训练最终损失比 16-bit 训练高不到 0.9%。且无需 FP8 或 FP4 硬件。

Conclusion: Echo 通过跨调用误差反馈实现了有界累积误差的 4-bit all-reduce，在不依赖低精度硬件的前提下兼顾通信效率与模型质量，适用于训练和推理。

Abstract: Tensor parallelism ends every layer with an all-reduce that sits between two dependent matrix multiplications, so its cost cannot be hidden and grows as compute outpaces interconnect bandwidth. Sending 4-bit instead of 16-bit values would cut this cost by nearly 4x, but the all-reduce must add the values it carries, and rounding the sum injects an error at every call. Model quality depends on how these errors accumulate over layers, yet existing methods treat each call on its own. We present Echo, a 4-bit all-reduce for training and inference that controls the accumulated error. Echo moves data in 4 bits and sums in high precision, so each value is quantized at most twice per call for any number of GPUs. The summation reveals each injected error, and Echo feeds it back into later calls, so old errors cancel instead of accumulating. We prove that the accumulated error stays bounded independently of depth. On A100 GPUs, Echo is 2.09x faster than the 16-bit NCCL all-reduce on 1 GB messages. It speeds up the time to first token by up to 1.16x and the training step by up to 1.09x on an idle interconnect, and by up to 1.44x and 1.38x as background traffic grows. It keeps the average accuracy over seven benchmarks within 0.4 points of 16-bit inference on Qwen3-8B. In 10B-token pretraining, its final loss is less than 0.9% above that of 16-bit training. Echo needs no FP8 or FP4 hardware.

</details>


### [667] [Controllable Diverse Sampling through Pullback Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14294)
*Sylvain Dehayem Kenfouo,Aaron Zweig,Mingxuan Zhang,Elham Azizi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种免训练方法，利用条件嵌入空间到图像空间的局部拉回几何来识别输出最敏感方向，从而在保持条件一致性的同时提升条件扩散模型生成多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有条件扩散模型从不同随机种子生成的图像仍高度相似，限制创意探索；已有方法增加多样性需额外优化或采样开销，强扰动又会引入失真、损害图像质量与提示对齐。

Method: 免训练方法，基于条件嵌入空间到图像空间映射诱导的局部拉回几何（pullback geometry），识别输出敏感度最大的方向，并沿这些方向引导不同采样轨迹，鼓励多样化生成同时保持与条件信号一致。

Result: 在 MS-COCO 和 BrushNet 上的实验验证了该方法在提升条件图像生成与图像修复多样性方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过拉回几何引导采样轨迹可在无额外训练开销下提升条件扩散模型生成多样性，同时维持图像质量与提示对齐。

Abstract: Conditional diffusion models can generate high-quality images that align closely with a given prompt. However, samples generated from different random seeds may remain visually similar, limiting creative exploration. Existing approaches can increase variation, but often require additional optimization or sampling overhead, while stronger perturbations may introduce distortions that degrade image quality or prompt alignment. We propose a training-free method that leverages the local pullback geometry induced by the mapping from the conditioning-embedding space to the image space to identify directions of maximal output sensitivity. By steering different sampling trajectories along these directions, we encourage distinct generations while maintaining consistency with the conditioning signal. Experiments on MS-COCO and BrushNet show the efficacy of the method in improving diversity on prompt-conditioned image generation and inpainting.

</details>


### [668] [ConicFlow: constrained Inference-time optimal control for flow matching models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14307)
*Shervin Khalafi,Kasra Fallah,Sung Cho,Dongsheng Ding,James Anderson,Alejandro Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ConicFlow 将流匹配模型的约束采样建模为最优控制问题，采用滚动时域对偶算法在推理时生成高奖励且满足硬约束的样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从预训练流匹配模型采样时，需要在满足硬终端约束的同时最大化奖励，同时尽量不偏离预训练轨迹。现有方法难以兼顾奖励、约束满足与偏离度。

Method: 将约束采样形式化为最优控制问题，平衡偏离预训练轨迹与奖励并在硬终端约束下求解；离散化后采用滚动时域控制，每步只优化短窗口轨迹；用滚动时域原对偶算法求解子问题，其对偶乘子刻画约束难度并随采样迭代精炼；提出终端估计变体，在预测终点而非当前窗口末端评估奖励与约束以减小局部截断误差累积。

Result: 在标准正则假设下给出有限时域次优性保证；在凸仿射结构下导出随省略时域长度线性增长的更紧界，并证明流动力学变化缓慢时终端估计变体界更紧。低维与高维实验中，使用近期大规模流匹配模型，ConicFlow 相比近期基线取得更高奖励、更强约束满足且偏离预训练流更小。

Conclusion: ConicFlow 通过滚动时域原对偶最优控制有效实现流匹配模型的硬约束采样，兼顾奖励、约束满足与低偏离，并具理论保证。

Abstract: We propose ConicFlow, which frames constrained sampling from a flow matching model at inference time as an optimal control problem that balances deviation from the pretrained trajectory against reward, subject to hard terminal constraints. We discretize this problem and adapt receding-horizon control, optimizing only a short window of the trajectory at each step for computational tractability. We address the resulting sequence of receding-horizon subproblems with a receding-horizon primal-dual algorithm. Its dual multipliers capture the difficulty of satisfying each constraint and are refined throughout sampling, steering generation toward feasible final samples. We further propose a terminal-estimate variant that avoids accumulating local truncation errors by evaluating the reward and constraints at the predicted terminal point rather than at the end of the current horizon. Under standard regularity assumptions, we establish finite-horizon guarantees on suboptimality. Under convex-affine structure, we derive a sharper bound that scales linearly with omitted horizon length, and we show that the terminal-estimate variant is provably tighter when the flow dynamics change slowly. Experiments in both low- and high-dimensional settings with a recent large-scale flow matching model show that ConicFlow achieves high reward and strong constraint satisfaction while deviating less from the pretrained flow than recent baselines.

</details>


### [669] [Which Metadata Matters for LLM Tool Selection in MCP? Evidence from Controlled Factor-Level Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14334)
*Xiaofan Li,Fengchun Qiao,Xing Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究MCP系统中工具元数据（尤其参数schema）如何影响LLM的工具选择，发现schema差异导致最大且最一致的选择偏移，且当只有一种schema满足显式请求时，所有模型都会选兼容工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCP系统中LLM仅凭元数据（名称、描述、参数schema）选择工具。对367,174个MCP工具的分析发现，功能相似的工具存在大量schema差异，许多工具名称和描述相似但参数schema不同。核心问题是：在未调用工具前，参数schema差异是否会影响工具选择。

Method: 通过跨5个LLM和5个任务的受控元数据干预，每次比较仅改变一个元数据因素（服务器名、工具名、描述或参数schema），其余固定；平衡工具位置，并用条件logistic回归估计位置校正后的效应。

Result: (1) 参数schema变化产生最大且最一致的选择偏移，模型偏好独立的顶层参数而非分组或复合形式；(2) 解释参数含义的描述也更易提升选择，工具名效应较弱且不一致；(3) schema效应依赖具体参数名及请求表达方式；当仅有一个schema满足显式请求要求时，五个模型都选择兼容工具，尽管存在位置偏好。

Conclusion: 参数schema不仅影响工具如何被调用，还影响工具是否被选中。对MCP开发者和评估者而言，即使功能不变，schema设计和工具排序也可能影响哪个实现被调用。

Abstract: In Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems, LLMs select tools from metadata rather than from their implementations. Names and descriptions summarize what a tool does, while the parameter schema specifies the fields a tool accepts and how they are organized. Our analysis of metadata for 367,174 MCP tools reveals substantial schema variation among functionally similar tools. Many of these tools share names and similar descriptions but expose different parameter schemas. This raises a key question: can parameter-schema differences influence tool selection before any call is made? We study this question through controlled metadata interventions across five LLMs and five tasks. Each comparison changes exactly one metadata factor (server name, tool name, description, or parameter schema) while keeping the others fixed. We balance tool positions and use conditional logistic regression to estimate position-adjusted effects. We find that: (1) parameter-schema changes produce the largest and most consistent selection shifts among the tested interventions. Models tend to favor separate top-level parameters over grouped or composite forms. (2) Descriptions that explain parameters also tend to increase selection, while name effects are weaker and less consistent. (3) Targeted comparisons show that schema effects depend on the specific parameter names and on how the request represents the same information. When only one schema satisfies an explicit request requirement, all five models select the compatible tool despite position preferences. These results show that parameter schemas influence not only how tools are called, but also whether they are selected. For MCP developers and evaluators, schema design and tool ordering can therefore affect which implementation is invoked even when functionality is unchanged.

</details>


### [670] [Actionable Meta-Requirements for AI Robustness Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14356)
*Joshua Owotogbe,Roya Nasiri,Indika Kumara,Damian Andrew Tamburri,Willem-Jan van den Heuvel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过系统性文献综述与实践者调研，构建并验证了AI鲁棒性审计框架的44条元需求（16类），为审计框架的设计与评估提供依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统在输入扰动、分布漂移、外部依赖变化等条件下需保持可靠，因此鲁棒性审计十分重要；但设计此类审计框架的关键难点——框架应支持哪些需求——尚未被整合明确。

Method: 采用设计科学研究方法，以元需求（更高层次需求）为切入点。先从文献中系统综述（2,890条记录保留74条）推导初始元需求，再通过128名实践者的评估（5,504条评分、586条实质评论）进行验证与细化。

Result: 文献综述得出16类43条元需求；评估中81.20%的评分表示同意或强烈同意，43条中有41条被判定为强支持；实践者反馈细化需求并新增一条关于外部组件与供应链依赖的需求，最终形成16类44条元需求，其中43条获定量验证。

Conclusion: 该元需求集合可帮助组织落地AI鲁棒性审计框架、评估现有框架的完整性并加以改进。

Abstract: AI-enabled systems must remain dependable when the conditions under which they operate change (e.g., due to input perturbations, distribution shifts, or changes in external dependencies). This makes robustness auditing of such systems important for judging whether the available evidence is sufficient to support a defined robustness conclusion. However, designing an AI robustness auditing framework is challenging. A key unresolved issue is determining the requirements such a framework should support; these requirements have not yet been consolidated. We address this gap through meta-requirements: higher-order requirements specifying what a class of auditing frameworks should support. In design science research, literature and domain experts are common sources of meta-requirements; accordingly, we derive the initial set from literature and validate and refine it with practitioners. Our systematic literature review retained 74 of 2,890 records and derived 43 meta-requirements across 16 categories. We evaluated them with 128 practitioners, obtaining 5,504 ratings and 586 substantive comments. Overall, 81.20% of ratings indicated agreement or strong agreement. In particular, 41 of the 43 literature-derived meta-requirements were classified as strongly supported. Practitioner feedback refined the requirements and identified an additional requirement concerning external components and supply chain dependencies. The final set comprises 44 meta-requirements across 16 categories, of which 43 received quantitative validation. These meta-requirements can help organizations implement AI robustness auditing frameworks, assess existing frameworks for completeness, and refine them.

</details>


### [671] [When Pleasing the User Compromises Care: AI Sycophancy in Caregiver-Mediated Healthcare](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14360)
*Priyadarsi Mishra,Arjun Beniwal,Ziyu Yi,Yu Ding,Sheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM在"看护者中介"医疗场景中的多利益相关者对齐问题：当用户表达临床上较差偏好时，模型会显著从合适建议转向不合适建议，忽视真正的受影响者（患者）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM对齐通常假设"与模型交互的用户即其主要受益者"，但在许多重要场景中（如父母、宠物主人、照护者为孩子、动物、老人做决定），决策者与后果承担者分离。作者希望检验AI顾问能否在用户表达劣质偏好时仍维持适当照护。

Method: 构建一个基于证据的基准，涵盖兽医、儿科、老年照护三类场景；在固定患者事实的前提下，改变用户表达的护理偏好和沟通风格，评估模型的初始建议及多轮追问表现。测试多个前沿及开源权重模型。

Result: 跨模型发现：表达较差偏好会显著增加从适当护理切换到不适当护理的概率（超出中立对话漂移），并提高模型对请求行为的认同度；沟通风格单独影响较小。错误在多轮中累积，甚至在模型最初回答正确的情况下也会出现，且常伴随中重度潜在伤害。在匹配的老年照护案例中，偏好由患者本人或看护者表达效果相似。

Conclusion: 当前模型对"用户表达的偏好"高度敏感，但对"偏好代表谁、后果由谁承担"不够敏感，加之模型很少主动征询患者偏好。这揭示了以用户为中心的对齐在多利益相关者场景中的更广泛局限。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) alignment often assumes that the user interacting with a model is also the primary beneficiary of its behavior. Yet in many consequential settings, one person directs the system while another bears the consequences. We study this problem in caregiver-mediated healthcare, where parents, pet owners, and caregivers make decisions for children, animals, and older adults. We introduce an evidence-grounded benchmark spanning veterinary, pediatric, and older-adult care, and test whether AI advisors maintain appropriate care when users express clinically inferior preferences. Holding patient facts fixed, we vary stated care preferences and communication styles and evaluate both initial recommendations and multi-turn follow-up. Across frontier and open-weight models, inferior preferences substantially increase switching from appropriate to inappropriate care beyond neutral conversational drift and increase agreement with the requested action, while communication style alone has a smaller effect. These failures accumulate across turns, including on cases models initially answer correctly, and often carry moderate or severe potential harm. In matched eldercare cases, the effect of an inferior preference is similar whether it is expressed by the patient or by a caregiver. Together with models' limited tendency to elicit patient preferences in caregiver conversations, this suggests that current models are highly sensitive to expressed user preferences but less sensitive to whose preferences are represented and who bears the consequences. Our results expose a broader limitation of user-centric alignment in settings with multiple stakeholders.

</details>


### [672] [ACED-Bench: Evaluating How LLM Agents Acquire and Act on Causal Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14381)
*Yiwei Chen,Amila Weerasinghe,Siddharth Biswal,Utkrisht Rajkumar,Olcay Boz,Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick,Rose Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ACED-BENCH 神经符号基准，将可读科学表面与隐藏概率图模型分离，评测 LLM 作为科学助手主动设计实验、解读证据并进行因果决策的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估多停留在"回答问题"，缺乏对 LLM 能否真正"调查系统"的可靠度量，需要能选择实验、处理有限证据、做因果决策且保持环境一致与客观真值的评测。

Method: 神经符号基准：LLM 生成自然语言场景与任务文本，隐藏 PGM 定义因果图、数据生成过程、干预语义、验证与 oracle 答案。主榜 ACED-CORE 含 180 任务（60 因果祖先/后代集合问题 + 120 约束因果决策）；ACED-QUAL 为 150 题是否资格检查。评测 7 个当代 LLM 与 2 个早期模型在 3 种主动智能体设计下的表现。

Result: ACED-QUAL 检验能否由证据得出结论，ACED-CORE 检验能否决定收集什么证据及何时作答；证据账本分析定位失败于调查环节：测试错误干预、丢失相关证据、或证据充足后仍继续。

Conclusion: 可靠的 AI 共同科学家需要显式支持实验设计、证据保留、答案承诺与停止决策。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as scientific assistants, yet we still lack reliable ways to evaluate whether they can investigate a system rather than merely answer a prompt. A useful evaluation must let agents choose experiments, interpret finite evidence, and make causal decisions, while keeping the environment coherent across repeated observations and interventions and preserving objective ground truth. We introduce ACED-BENCH (Active Causal Evidence and Decision Benchmark), a neuro-symbolic benchmark built around this requirement. The key idea is to separate the readable scientific surface from the formal causal world: LLMs generate natural-language scenarios and task text, while hidden probabilistic graphical models define the causal graph, data-generating process, intervention semantics, validation checks, and oracle answers. This yields scientific worlds that are natural for agents to investigate but exact enough for scalable, programmatic evaluation. The main leaderboard ACED-CORE contains 180 tasks: 60 set-valued causal ancestry/descendancy questions and 120 constrained causal-decision tasks. We also report ACED-QUAL, a 150-question yes/no qualification check using the same hidden-PGM interface. We evaluate seven contemporary LLMs and two earlier-generation models across three active agent designs. ACED-QUAL checks whether agents can use the interface to draw conclusions from evidence, while ACED-CORE tests whether they can decide what evidence to collect and when to commit to an answer. Evidence-ledger analysis localizes failures within the investigation: agents test the wrong intervention, lose relevant evidence, or continue after sufficient evidence has appeared. These results suggest that reliable AI co-scientists need explicit support for experiment design, evidence retention, answer commitment, and stopping.

</details>


### [673] [ANASSA: From High-Level Framework to Low-Level Architecture for Spatial Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14382)
*Constantinos Papantoniou,Brian Hilton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文运用设计科学研究(DSR)，将ANASSA空间智能多智能体编排框架从高层架构(HLA)职责细化为可实现的低层架构(LLA)，包含47个逻辑角色、版本化任务图、能力驱动选型、类型化契约、运行时状态、空间校验、治理、失败恢复与溯源机制，并通过执行轨迹演示与多维度分析评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理空间数据上的智能体AI系统不仅需要自主推理和工具使用，还需显式的编排、空间验证、治理、溯源、失败处理与人类决策权。此前的ANASSA框架（arXiv:2609.14824）仅定义了高层组件与责任边界，未说明如何将这些职责系统性地分解为面向实现的低层架构，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 采用设计科学研究(DSR)方法，将ANASSA框架从高层架构(HLA)责任精炼为低层架构(LLA)。设计保留原框架责任边界，并转化为可执行架构结构，包括47个逻辑角色、版本化任务图、基于能力的智能体选择、类型化契约、显式运行时状态、空间验证机制、治理控制、失败与恢复路径以及溯源记录。

Result: 通过端到端执行轨迹演示该架构，并从需求可追溯性、内部一致性、责任保持性和技术独立性四个方面进行解析评估，验证了架构的有效性。

Conclusion: 该高层到低层的设计为ANASSA框架与未来系统实现之间提供了面向实现的桥梁，定义了受治理的空间智能体工作流如何可检视、可重构、可测试，同时不绑定于特定AI模型、地理空间平台、通信协议或部署环境。

Abstract: Agentic AI systems operating over geospatial data require more than autonomous reasoning and tool use; they must also support explicit orchestration, spatial validation, governance, provenance, failure handling, and human decision authority. Prior work introduced ANASSA, an agentic AI orchestration framework for spatial intelligence that established high-level components and responsibility boundaries for governed agentic execution (arXiv:2609.14824). However, the framework did not specify how those high-level responsibilities should be systematically decomposed into an implementation-facing low-level architecture. This paper addresses that gap by applying Design Science Research (DSR) to refine the ANASSA framework from high-level architectural (HLA) responsibilities into a low-level architecture (LLA). The resulting design preserves the responsibility boundaries of the foundational framework while translating them into executable architectural structures, including 47 logical roles, versioned task graphs, capability-based agent selection, typed contracts, explicit runtime states, spatial validation mechanisms, governance controls, failure and recovery paths, and provenance records. The architecture is demonstrated through an end-to-end execution trace and analytically evaluated for requirements traceability, internal consistency, responsibility preservation, and technology independence. The resulting high-level-to-low-level design provides an implementation-facing bridge between the ANASSA framework and future system implementations, defining how governed spatial agentic workflows can be made inspectable, reconstructable, and testable without binding the architecture to a specific AI model, geospatial platform, communication protocol, or deployment environment.

</details>


### [674] [Measuring the Inference Energy Efficiency of Open-Weight LLMs across Benchmarks, Reasoning Modes, and Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14389)
*Zeyu Yang,Wes Armour*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文测量了86个开源模型检查点在7个基准、6类硬件上的能力-能耗权衡，发现效率差异巨大，多数配置远离Pareto前沿，主张基准分数应与实测能耗一起报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准分数只反映LLM能做什么，不反映交付该能力所需能耗，缺少对能力-能耗权衡的系统测量。

Method: 对86个开源权重模型检查点，在7个基准和6个硬件平台（从消费级GPU到八卡服务器）上直接测量能耗效率，并分析推理模式、FP8、硬件更换等因素的影响。

Result: 相似能力模型间能效差异巨大；多数配置远离分数-能耗Pareto前沿，能耗中位数高出2.6–4.8×，最大达27×；开启思考平均增耗约3.7×；生成token数是能耗的不完美代理，误排18–24%模型对；FP8省约四分之一能耗且分数几乎不变；换硬件基本只缩放能耗，不改变模型相对排名。

Conclusion: 仅凭能力无法完整刻画效率，应在指定的服务环境与输出预算下，将基准分数与实测能耗一起报告。

Abstract: Benchmark scores tell us what an LLM can do, but not how much energy is required to deliver that capability. We directly measure this trade-off for 86 open-weight model checkpoints, evaluated on seven benchmarks and six hardware platforms ranging from a consumer GPU to an eight-GPU server. We find large differences in energy efficiency even among models with similar capability. Most configurations lie away from the score--energy Pareto frontier: they use a median of 2.6--4.8$\times$ more energy than another configuration that scores at least as well, with differences reaching 27$\times$. Reasoning can improve capability, but enabling thinking increases energy by about 3.7$\times$ on average, and the benefit depends strongly on the model family and output budget. Generated-token count is also an imperfect proxy for energy, misordering 18--24\% of model pairs. In contrast, FP8 reduces energy by roughly a quarter with little change in score, while changing hardware largely rescales energy without changing the relative ranking of models. These results show that capability alone gives an incomplete picture of efficiency. We argue that benchmark scores should be reported together with measured energy consumption under a specified serving regime and output budget.

</details>


### [675] [SAT-RL: Training Language Models for Logical Reasoning with Symbolic Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14402)
*Jialiang Sun,Kuldeep Meel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAT-RL：用强化学习训练LLM通过多轮工具调用与符号求解器（Z3）交互，提升复杂符号推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在数学/逻辑推理上表现强，但随着约束交互增多和搜索空间扩大，面临复杂度困境；而Z3等SAT求解器可扩展、可验证，却无法理解自然语言描述。需结合二者优势。

Method: 提出RL框架SAT-RL，训练LLM与符号求解器进行多轮工具执行交互。包含三部分：带可验证解的合成数据生成、求解器增强轨迹的监督预热、以及基于求解器、带有工具感知奖励的强化学习。

Result: 在域内和域外逻辑任务上，SAT-RL显著提升了使用工具的符号推理性能。

Conclusion: 通过RL让LLM学会调用符号求解器，可有效结合语言理解灵活性与形式求解的可扩展、可验证推理，缓解复杂度困境。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in mathematical and logical reasoning, yet they still suffer from the curse of complexity and struggle as problem difficulty increases with the number of constraint interactions and the size of the search space. In contrast, satisfiability solvers such as Z3 provide scalable and verifiable reasoning through constraint solving under formal theories, but lack the flexibility to interpret natural-language problem descriptions. In this work, we propose SAT-RL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that trains LLMs to interact with symbolic solvers through multi-turn tool execution. SAT-RL leverages synthetic data generation with verifiable solutions, supervised warm-up on solver-augmented traces, and solver-grounded reinforcement learning with tool-aware rewards. Experiments show that SAT-RL substantially improves symbolic reasoning with tools on both in-domain and out-of-domain logic tasks. Our code is available on https://github.com/sunjia72/SAT-RL.

</details>


### [676] [Frustratingly Easy Agentic RAG via Portable Skills: A Case Study in Customer Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14428)
*Istok Bako,Bonan Min,Tiffany Shao,Claire Cheng,Yashar Mehdad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文报告了一个企业客户支持工作流生成的部署案例：采用简单的"技能"方案（自然语言指令+轻量工具+LLM生成的"维基百科风格"导航层），达到99.2%流程等效率和83.3%证据充分性，虽比生产助手慢约10倍（90s vs 8-9s），但在成熟语料、容忍延迟且人工审核的场景下可替代复杂RAG栈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业工作流自动化需从大量运营文档（SOP、政策）中检索完整准确的信息，客户支持中人工需为每个案例确定正确的解决步骤序列。生产环境达到这一标准通常需要复杂的文档分块、索引、检索管道，并叠加学习型重排序器、查询重写器和定制的agentic RAG基础设施，成本高、维护复杂。作者希望探索更简单的替代方案。

Method: 提出一种可移植的"技能"方案，包含三部分：自然语言指令、轻量工具（检索API、格式检查脚本）、以及用LLM生成的导航层增强的语料（对底层文档构建结构化的"维基百科风格"索引）。该agentic RAG方法实现简单（1-2工程师日），可跨Claude Code等agentic harness移植。

Result: 在客户支持解决工作流生成任务上取得99.2%的流程等效率（与人工批准的ground truth相比）和83.3%的证据充分性。速度比已部署的生产助手慢约一个数量级（每案例约90秒 vs 8-9秒），作者不主张延迟优势。

Conclusion: 在成熟且精心策展的语料、容忍延迟的工作流、以及每案例都有人工审核的特定场景下，该简单技能方案可完成复杂RAG栈的工作，且维护变成编辑文本和数据而非重新训练模型。结论限定于该场景，不具备普适性。

Abstract: Enterprise workflow automation typically requires retrieving a complete and accurate set of relevant information from large operational document corpora (SOPs, policy documents) given a specific scenario or request. In customer support (CS), for example, human specialists must determine the correct sequence of resolution steps for each case, a task that demands precise grounding in policy documentation. Meeting this bar in production typically requires complex document chunking, indexing, and retrieval pipelines, often layered with learned re-rankers, query rewriters, and bespoke agentic RAG infrastructure.
  We report a deployment case study of a simpler alternative: a portable skill consisting of a natural-language instruction, lightweight tools (a retrieval API, format-checking scripts), and a corpus enriched with an LLM-generated navigation layer, which is a structured "Wikipedia-style" index over the underlying documents. This agentic RAG approach is straightforward to implement (1-2 engineer days), portable across capable agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code), and performs strongly on the challenging task of CS resolution workflow generation, achieving 99.2% procedural equivalence to human-approved ground truth and 83.3% evidence sufficiency. It is also roughly an order of magnitude slower per case than our deployed production assistant (~90 s vs. ~8-9 s), so we claim no latency advantage. Our claim is scoped to that setting: a mature, well-curated corpus, a latency-tolerant workflow, and human review of every case. There, the skill did the work of a complex RAG stack, and maintenance became a matter of editing text and data rather than retraining models.

</details>


### [677] [AlignPoison: Conditional Targeted Poisoning of Generative Recommenders via Decoding-Aligned Prefixes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14487)
*Zhuoxuan Zhang,Jinhao Duan,Xinyu Zhao,Jinduo Guo,Shuai Shao,Rui Li,Luke Simon,Zhun Deng,Tianlong Chen,Bo Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究生成式推荐模型对条件定向投毒的脆弱性，提出黑盒框架AlignPoison，通过发现上下文对齐前缀，仅注入<1%合成交互即可显著提升恶意目标推广成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐模型（基于自回归解码）被广泛采用，但其对数据投毒的鲁棒性尚不明确。作者关注一个问题：在攻击者仅能注入有限恶意交互、且只能黑盒查询推荐API的现实设定下，生成式推荐模型对条件定向投毒有多脆弱？

Method: 实证研究发现注入不到1%的合成交互即可显著提升触发条件下恶意目标的推广概率。作者从两个角度分析恶意交互合成：解码对齐（decoding alignment）与前缀流行度（prefix popularity），发现短小、上下文对齐、既符合模型诱导转移动态又强关联高频触发词的前缀能持续放大定向推广。基于此提出AlignPoison黑盒框架，从API输出中发现并采样上下文对齐前缀。

Result: 在单模态与多模态生成式推荐基准上实验，AlignPoison的前缀优于竞争基线，ASR提升最高达16.3个百分点，揭示生成式推荐模型中依赖解码、对上下文敏感的投毒脆弱性。

Conclusion: 生成式推荐系统存在依赖解码、上下文敏感的投毒脆弱性，短上下文对齐前缀是有效攻击手段，说明该类系统在数据安全方面需要更强防护。

Abstract: Generative recommendation models based on autoregressive decoding have been adopted as alternatives to classical ranking-based systems. While their modeling flexibility has been widely studied, their resilience to data poisoning remains largely unexplored. In this work, we ask: how susceptible are generative recommenders to conditional targeted poisoning? Under a realistic setting where an adversary can inject limited malicious interactions and query a recommendation API as a black box, our empirical study shows that generative recommenders are vulnerable: injecting fewer than 1% synthetic interactions significantly increases the likelihood of promoting malicious targets under the trigger. To characterize this vulnerability, we analyze the synthesis of malicious interactions from two perspectives: (i) decoding alignment and (ii) prefix popularity. We observe that short, context-aligned prefixes that are both common under the model's induced transition dynamics and strongly linked to a frequent trigger consistently amplify targeted promotion. Motivated by this analysis, we develop AlignPoison, a black-box framework that discovers and samples context-aligned prefixes from API outputs. We conduct experiments on benchmarks in unimodal and multimodal generative recommendation settings. Results show that these prefixes outperform competitive baselines, improving ASR lift by up to 16.3 percentage points and highlighting a decoding-dependent, context-sensitive poisoning vulnerability in generative recommendation models.

</details>


### [678] [HiPPT: Physiology-Grounded Wearable PPG Representation Learning via Multi-Scope Text Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14489)
*Jiaqi Wang,Wei Chen,Xiaoyu Li,Lexian Xia,ShuaiLong Tang,Chenran Zhang,Donglin Xie,Guangpu Zhu,Yelei Li,Yi Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HiPPT是一个生理学基础的PPG预训练框架，通过将不同监督源匹配到合适的证据范围，学习可迁移的穿戴式PPG表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PPG预训练目标通常在记录或对级别进行监督，忽视了不同概念在不同波形证据范围下才可靠的问题。

Method: 构建超400万腕戴记录、20.2万用户的PPG-Text语料；结合记录级形态对齐、跨记录上下文对齐，以及波形引导的文本建模。

Result: 在血压、血管硬度、生理属性和跨数据集心率估计等六项任务的主要线性探测指标上取得最佳；对齐空间支持年龄、性别、BMI的零样本分析，且随聚合记录增多而提升。

Conclusion: 证据范围匹配可获得可迁移且语义可访问的穿戴式PPG表征，代码和预训练权重将开源。

Abstract: Reusable wearable PPG representations should capture local pulse morphology and broader physiological regularities. Existing pretraining objectives, however, usually apply supervision at the recording or pair level, overlooking that different concepts become reliable over different scopes of waveform evidence. We propose HiPPT, a physiology-grounded framework that matches each supervision source to its appropriate evidence scope. We construct a PPG-Text corpus of over 4 million wrist-worn recordings from 202K users, pairing recordings with waveform-derived morphology and metadata-derived context descriptions. HiPPT combines record-level morphology alignment, which grounds individual recordings in pulse characteristics, with cross-recording context alignment, which aggregates recordings sharing the same metadata tuple to capture context-consistent regularities. Waveform-guided text modeling further recovers masked contextual concepts from PPG patch representations, providing fine-grained waveform-text supervision. Across six downstream tasks spanning blood pressure, vascular stiffness, physiological attributes, and cross-dataset heart-rate estimation, HiPPT achieves the best result on the primary linear-probing metrics. The aligned space also supports zero-shot profiling of age group, sex, and BMI category, individually and jointly, with performance improving as more recordings are aggregated. These results show that evidence-scope matching yields transferable and semantically accessible wearable PPG representations. Code and pretrained weights will be released.

</details>


### [679] [MontageFlow: Physically Valid High Fidelity EEG Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14507)
*Sudarshan Regmi,Nabaraj Subedi,Arvind Pillai,Yu Yvonne Wu,Yuliang Chen,Michael V. Heinz,Lisa Marsch,Nicholas C. Jacobson,Andrew Campbell*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现有EEG生成模型忽视通道间的线性恒等约束，导致生成信号无效；MontageFlow通过流匹配将输出限制在满足该约束的信号空间，同时改善保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床EEG数据稀缺且受隐私限制，生成模型是解决方案；但现有生成模型虽然保真度提升，却违反了EEG信号固有的通道间线性恒等关系（每通道记录两电极间的电压差），这一关键问题此前被忽视。

Method: 提出MontageFlow——基于流匹配的生成模型，将输出限制在满足通道线性恒等约束的信号空间内；并引入从整个EEG窗口编码的生理状态向量作为条件，保留被过度平滑抹除的EEG特征，生成时该向量从潜空间拟合的先验中采样。

Result: 在3个大规模基准上，TS-FID较最接近的竞争对手提升1.6-3.6倍，同时保证信号有效性；保证有效性也带来了保真度的提升。

Conclusion: 约束生成信号满足EEG通道线性恒等关系不仅能保证有效性，还能提升生成保真度；MontageFlow在多个基准上显著优于现有方法，为隐私受限下的EEG生成提供了更可靠的方案。

Abstract: Generative modeling offers a promising solution to the scarcity of labeled clinical electroencephalography (EEG) data under strict privacy constraints. Although recent generative models report substantial improvements in generation fidelity, we show that these gains conceal a categorical failure. EEG is not an arbitrary multichannel signal: each channel records the voltage difference between two scalp electrodes. So, real recordings satisfy exact linear identities among their channels. Current generators invariably violate these identities, yet this has gone unnoticed. We therefore propose MontageFlow, a flow-matching model that enforces these identities by restricting its output to signals that satisfy them. We find that ensuring validity improves fidelity too. Furthermore, to retain the EEG characteristics that oversmoothing washes out, we also condition the model on a physiological state vector encoded from the whole EEG window. For generation, this vector is drawn from a prior fitted in latent space. Across 3 large-scale benchmarks, our model improves TS-FID by 1.6-3.6$\times$ over the closest rival while ensuring validity.

</details>


### [680] [Can You Trust Your Preference Models? Stackelberg Games for Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15008)
*Riccardo Formenti,Aditya Agrawal,Vikas Garg*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文训练策略主动搜索评估器可能反转偏好判断的对比样本，以集成偏好模型间的不一致作为预测误差代理，并用零和Stackelberg博弈建模该搜索过程，提出SMIDA算法，实验证明可提升对参考策略的超越并增加可反转评估器偏好的样本比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型常通过不完美的评估器进行人类偏好对齐，而这些评估器的误差在优化过程中会被利用，导致对齐失效。关键在于训练时无法获得真实人类偏好，因此需要一种机制来主动发现评估器可能出错的对比样本，以提供额外监督信号。

Method: 将搜索过程形式化为零和Stackelberg博弈：Leader策略最小化集成偏好模型间的不一致，Follower策略最大化该不一致。对一类有限上下文Stackelberg博弈证明均衡存在性，并在正则化下给出唯一性与闭式刻画。提出两时间尺度的Stackelberg Mirror Descent-Ascent（SMIDA）算法，在表格设置下具有线性last-iterate收敛，并给出神经策略梯度版本。

Result: 使用合成oracle的实验支持不一致性可作为预测误差的有效代理。在留出数据上，训练得到的策略优于参考策略，并提高了超过不一致阈值的对比比例，以及反转oracle偏好的比例。

Conclusion: 通过博弈式主动搜索评估器易错区域，可在无真实人类偏好条件下提供有效监督信号，提升对齐效果；方法具备理论收敛保证并适用于神经策略。

Abstract: Language models are frequently aligned to human preferences via imperfect evaluators whose errors can be exploited during optimization. We train policies to search for comparisons on which an evaluator may reverse the underlying preference, providing candidates for additional supervision. Since human preferences are unavailable during policy training, we use disagreement among an ensemble of preference models as a proxy for prediction error. We formulate this search as a zero-sum Stackelberg game between two opposing policies, a Leader which tries to minimize disagreement, and a Follower which maximizes it. For a general class of finite contextual Stackelberg games, we establish equilibrium existence and, under regularization, uniqueness and a closed-form characterization. We introduce Stackelberg Mirror Descent-Ascent (SMIDA), a two-timescale algorithm with linear last-iterate convergence in the tabular setting, and develop a neural policy-gradient analogue. Experiments with a synthetic oracle support disagreement as an informative proxy for prediction error. On held out data the trained policies outperform reference policies and increase the fraction of comparisons that exceed a disagreement threshold and reverse the oracle's preference.

</details>


### [681] [ScienceBuddy-PV: A Verifier-Governed Recursive Improvement Protocol for Panvascular Intervention Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14523)
*Lingsen You,Yujun Guo,Xinyu Zhong,Zijie Feng,Wentong Wang,Li Shen,Junbo Ge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文审计ScienceBuddy-PV中一个固定组件（ARCADE句法与狭窄分割任务），仅做单次训练与支持门控评估，未执行递归优化，不证明临床有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将ScienceBuddy的递归式设计适配到泛血管介入研究，需要先让"支持"与"弃答"机制可测量，并提供可复现的协作式智能体研究协议。

Method: 采用结构化证据账本、器械-血管本体、弃答契约与保留失败库；用ARCADE句法和狭窄两个任务（各1000训练/200验证/300测试图像），训练共享任务掩码卷积模型，参数与启发式支持门控固定，狭窄阈值在验证集选择。

Result: 锁定测试集上句法Dice 0.475（95% CI 0.459-0.490），狭窄Dice 0.231（95% CI 0.214-0.249）；狭窄像素AUROC 0.957、AUPRC 0.180（患病率0.00975）；门控接受76.7%狭窄帧输出（仅分数对照为100%）；掩码审计接受44.3%、拒绝55.7%。

Conclusion: 该公开数据组件审计使支持与弃答可测量并提供可复现协议，但接受不等于正确或临床安全，未证明递归改进、患者级有效性或临床器械建议。

Abstract: ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convolutional model was trained once per representation setting; its parameters and the heuristic support gate were then held fixed, with the stenosis threshold selected on validation data. On the locked test sets, syntax Dice was 0.475 (95% CI 0.459-0.490) and stenosis Dice was 0.231 (95% CI 0.214-0.249). Stenosis pixel AUROC was 0.957 and AUPRC was 0.180 at prevalence 0.00975. The gate accepted 76.7% of stenosis-frame outputs versus 100% for a score-only comparator. In a constructed mask audit, it accepted 44.3% of reference candidates and rejected 55.7%, exposing the cost of abstention. Acceptance does not establish correctness or clinical safety. This public-data component audit makes support and abstention measurable and provides a reproducible protocol for future collaborative agent studies. It does not demonstrate recursive improvement, patient-level validity or clinical device recommendations.

</details>


### [682] [Energy Ring: Stabilizing Feature Energy for Reliable Test-Time Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14525)
*Tianle Liu,Fan Lyu,Tingliang Feng,Chenggong Ni,Tianqi Wang,Zhang Zhang,Fuyuan Hu,Rui Yao,Tao Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文从能量角度重新审视测试时发现(TTD)问题，发现已知与未知类之间的能量差距不稳定且易崩塌，提出Energy Ring方法加以解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TTD方法过于保守，导致已知和未知特征在测试时自适应过程中坍塌在一起、难以分离。作者从能量视角发现已知与未知类之间的自然能量差距不稳定、容易崩塌，这是核心问题所在。

Method: 提出Energy Ring，通过将两类锚定在各自的能量环上来稳定能量差距。包含：一个轻量适配器，在保留已知类方向的同时扩大基于范数的差距；一个扰动一致性模块，为未知类形成紧凑聚类。测试阶段采用能量引导的置信度加权改进预测，并用基于稳定性的校正机制修正不可靠的更新。

Result: 实验结果表明，Energy Ring相比现有TTD方法显著提升了测试时发现性能。

Conclusion: 从能量角度解决TTD中已知与未知类能量差距崩塌问题，Energy Ring方法有效且性能优于现有方法。

Abstract: Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones while the model is already deployed, operating directly on a continual unlabeled test-time stream. Existing TTD methods are overly conservative, making known and unknown features collapse together and difficult to separate during test-time adaptation. In this paper, we revisit TTD from an energy perspective and find that the natural energy gap between known and unknown classes is unstable and easily collapses. We therefore propose Energy Ring to stabilize this gap by anchoring the two types of classes on separate energy rings. A lightweight adapter enlarges the norm-based gap while preserving known-class directions, and a perturbation consistency module forms compact clusters for unknown classes. During testing, energy-guided confidence weighting improves prediction, and a stability-based rectification mechanism corrects unreliable updates. Experimental results show that Energy Ring significantly improves TTD performance against existing TTD methods.

</details>


### [683] [FDE-Bench: Evaluating End-to-End Delivery from Underspecified Real-World Business Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14539)
*Huaiming Li,Can Huang,Chufan Wu,Danyu Liu,Xiaomin Yuan,Qinze Li,Yui Lo,Wenhui Bai,Qianlong Wang,Zengle Ge,Xiyu Yan,Yuheng Cheng,Jinhui Ren,Guokai Chen,Jiaqun Liu,Haoran Li,Qianhui Liu,Annan Li,Jianmin Wu,Dawei Yin,Dou Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FDE-Bench，首个基于真实客户项目评测智能体端到端交付能力的基准，包含需求澄清与迭代优化，揭示当前智能体在欠规范真实业务任务上远未达到FDE水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实业务需求常因一线从业者难以表达经验性规则而存在关键信息缺失。FDE需通过对话澄清需求并迭代优化方案。而现有优化基准从明确目标出发，澄清基准多向已有任务注入信息缺口，无法评测端到端交付能力。

Method: 构建FDE-Bench，49个案例覆盖组合优化与机器学习。澄清目标从一线从业者与FDE的讨论中提炼；智能体需从模拟客户处获取缺失需求；定制评估器依据验收标准，以客户认可的FDE方案为质量参照评估最终产物。

Result: 在18种智能体配置中，最高平均交付分仅0.5510（FDE参照为1.0），最高交付成功率（DSR）仅6.12%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在欠规范的真实业务任务上，可靠的FDE级端到端交付对现有智能体仍不可及。

Abstract: Real-world business requests often leave key requirements unstated because frontline practitioners struggle to articulate rules they know from experience. Forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must elicit these requirements through dialogue and iteratively optimize solutions until they meet customer acceptance criteria. Existing optimization benchmarks typically start from explicit objectives, while clarification benchmarks often introduce information gaps into existing tasks. We introduce FDE-Bench, the first benchmark built from real customer projects to evaluate agents on end-to-end delivery tasks that require interactive requirement clarification and iterative optimization. Its 49 cases span combinatorial optimization and machine learning. Clarification targets are distilled from discussions between frontline practitioners and FDEs. Agents elicit missing requirements from a simulated customer, and case-specific evaluators assess final artifacts against acceptance criteria using customer-accepted FDE solutions as quality references. Across 18 agent configurations, the highest mean delivery score is only 0.5510, compared with an FDE reference of 1.0. The highest delivery success rate (DSR), defined as the fraction of planned runs reaching this reference, is only 6.12%. These results show that reliable FDE-level end-to-end delivery remains out of reach for the evaluated agents on underspecified real-world business tasks. The benchmark project page is available at https://baidubce.github.io/FM-Agent/FDE-Bench/.

</details>


### [684] [Are Multimodal Benchmarks Really Useful? Item-Level Multimodal Benchmark Diagnosis via Structure-Response Co-Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14542)
*Shiqi Zhang,Weixin Zeng,Ziheng Zhang,Jiuyang Tang,Xiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SRCoD框架，通过结构-响应协同校准对多模态基准进行条目级模态依赖诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态基准可能含捷径条目（单模态或答案规律即可作答），无法反映真实跨模态推理能力；现有诊断方法仅依赖条目内在结构或模型响应行为，不够全面。

Method: SRCoD从基准内容与目标答案估计样本级多模态信息结构，作为软结构锚进行模态条件条目响应建模，输出校准的条目级诊断画像，并提供可解释归因。

Result: 在基准精炼导向验证与人工标注条目验证两种协议下，SRCoD均优于现有最先进的基准诊断方法。

Conclusion: 结构-响应协同校准可更全面诊断多模态基准的模态依赖，实现超越聚合准确率的细粒度分析。

Abstract: Multimodal benchmarks are central to evaluating whether models can reason over information from multiple modalities. However, existing literature has revealed that some benchmarks may contain shortcut items that can be answered from a single modality or from answer-option regularities alone, thus failing to reflect models' true cross-modal inference ability. Existing methods for assessing benchmarks typically rely either on intrinsic item structure or extrinsic model response behavior, which are not adequate for a comprehensive diagnosis. To fill in this gap, we propose SRCoD, a structure-response co-calibrated diagnosis framework for item-level diagnosis of modality dependence in multimodal benchmarks. SRCoD estimates sample-wise multimodal information structure from benchmark content and target answers, and uses this signal as a soft structural anchor for modality-conditioned item response modeling. The learned model produces a calibrated item-level diagnostic profile that reflects how strongly an item depends on different forms of modality evidence, enabling fine-grained benchmark analysis beyond aggregate accuracy. SRCoD also provides interpretable attribution of the diagnosis results. Extensive experiments under two complementary protocols, i.e., benchmark-refinement oriented validation and human-labeled item validation, demonstrate that SRCoD outperforms state-of-the-art benchmark diagnosis methods.

</details>


### [685] [Fresh at Decision, Stale at Action: Routing New Information to LLM Decisions Already Made](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18126)
*Ayoub Merimi,Souhail Bakkali,Abdeljalil Sakat*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"时间戳决策有效性理论"与决策账本，将LLM决策准确性分解为新鲜度、路由与时序判断三种能力，并通过五个LLM实验验证四个预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM决策在做出时成立，但执行发生在此后变化的世界中，因此需要刻画"决策在行动时刻是否仍有效"的问题，衡量信息新鲜度对决策质量的影响。

Method: 用六个时间戳定义一次决策，引入"新鲜度上限"界定行动时刻证据的保证范围；构建持久化决策账本，记录每个决策的时间、证据与背景知识，并用决策时写下的"监视条件"进行索引；通过带精确标签的受控决策流，在五个LLM（8B至前沿规模）上验证。

Result: 四个预测均被验证：新鲜度单独即可达到上限预测的准确率；模型在决定性新闻到达后即行动，准确率随路由变化；账本索引决定路由可达范围，监视条件以低暴露触及间接依赖；剩余错误集中在"变化何时生效"。

Conclusion: 新鲜度让决策在做出时正确，路由与时序判断则让决策在执行时保持正确；决策有效性应作为时间敏感的能力来建模与评估。

Abstract: Freshness shapes an LLM decision at the moment it is made; the action it commits to is latent, carried out later, in a changing world. We therefore introduce a timestamp theory of decision validity and a decision ledger that realises it. Six timestamps define a decision; a freshness ceiling bounds what up-to-date evidence guarantees at action time, placing the remaining risk in information published afterwards. Accuracy then factorises into two capabilities: routing, which delivers that information to affected decisions before their revision deadlines, and temporal judgment, which reads it for the time of action. The ledger is persistent state holding each decision's times, evidence and background knowledge, indexed by watch conditions written at decision time. Controlled decision streams with exact labels confirm four predictions across five LLMs, from 8B to frontier scale: freshness alone yields exactly the accuracy the ceiling predicts; models act on decisive news once it arrives, so accuracy follows routing; the ledger's index sets what routing reaches, and watch conditions reach indirect dependencies at low exposure; and the remaining errors concern when a change takes effect. Freshness makes a decision right when it is made; routing and temporal judgment keep it right when it is carried out.

</details>


### [686] [PsyMemBehav: Psychology-Informed and Memory-Grounded Two-Level Identity-to-Action Reasoning for Social-Media Behavior Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14570)
*Wenji Zhang,Xilong Cheng,Yunxiao Qin,Mai Tu,Tongye Zhu,Yuhao Zhou,JingBo Ji,Yuting Tan,Duoyin Li,Hongjiang Xiao,Yuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PsyMemBehav，通过两级身份到动作推理，将心理学画像与检索记忆映射为平台行为，并构建5.57M行为数据集，在个体与群体级指标上超越GPT-5.4。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM社交模拟要忠实再现真实用户，需同时对齐结构化平台决策与稀疏、含噪的行为证据，现有方法难以兼顾。

Method: PsyMemBehav将心理学画像与检索记忆通过两级身份到动作推理映射为target-first平台行为；构建PsyMemBehav-bench数据集（5,862用户约950条/人，跨Reddit/Bluesky/Twitter），每次互动建模为目标选择+Comment/Like/Repost及可选回复生成，使用41维用户描述、top-5 BM25记忆、reverse-CoT监督和rubric引导的DPO。

Result: PsyMemBehav 27B在12项个体级指标中11项居首，平均回复质量由GPT-5.4的54.28提升至59.68（相对+9.95%），群体级MAE(0.081)与MSE(0.009)最低。

Conclusion: 结果支持基于证据的用户建模用于已观测线程续写；基准仍受限于已记录互动，未建模无动作决策。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) support social simulation, but faithfully reproducing real users requires grounding both structured platform decisions and language in sparse, noisy behavioral evidence. We introduce PsyMemBehav, which maps psychology-informed profiles and retrieved memories to target-first platform behavior through two-level identity-to-action reasoning. To support this approach with comprehensive behavioral traces, we construct a dataset PsyMemBehav-bench from 5.57M observed behaviors of 5,862 real users (approximately 950 per user) across Reddit, Bluesky, and Twitter. Each recorded engagement is modeled as target selection followed by Comment, Like, or Repost and optional response generation. PsyMemBehav combines 41-dimensional user descriptors, top-5 BM25 memories, reverse-CoT supervision, and rubric-guided DPO over complete reasoning-action trajectories. Experiments show that PsyMemBehav 27B ranks first in 11 of 12 reported individual-level metrics, improving average response quality over GPT-5.4 from 54.28 to 59.68 (9.95% relative), and obtains the lowest group-level MAE (0.081) and MSE (0.009) among simulated systems. These results support evidence-grounded user modeling for observed-thread continuation; the benchmark remains conditional on recorded engagement and does not model no-action decisions.

</details>


### [687] [Learning after Execution with Action-Specific Credit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14573)
*Yufeng Tian,Jiahao Tang,Minghao Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"执行后学习"范式：将代码执行结果作为中间状态，支持同一策略的额外学习交互，并设计动作特定信用分配解决信用归属问题，在Image-to-TikZ任务上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统执行仅作为终端反馈用于打分，执行后的状态未被用于进一步学习。若将执行结果作为中间状态触发额外的学习动作，则两次动作共享同一最终目标但角色不同，产生信用分配难题。作者希望挖掘可执行任务中终端奖励之外的额外学习结构。

Method: 以Image-to-TikZ作为可执行视觉测试床，提出动作特定信用分配：初始动作信用来自最终轨迹结果，纠正动作信用来自相对于中间状态的改进。通过共享策略学习支持单次调用推理与执行后的纠正能力。

Result: 在945个留出样本上，单次调用渲染成功率达92.70%，高于相同额外训练迭代下持续单阶段GRPO的88.25%。纠正能力无法通过持续单阶段训练复现，且依赖中间状态；不同信用定义会对相同轨迹产生不同的组相对偏好。

Conclusion: 可执行任务包含终端奖励之外的有用学习结构，执行后的中间状态可用于强化共享策略并催生新的纠正能力。代码已开源于 https://github.com/tianyufengcn/Learning-after-Execution。

Abstract: Execution is often used as terminal feedback: it scores a generated program, but the resulting state is not used for another learning action. Learning after execution instead uses the execution result as an intermediate state that supports an additional learning interaction for the same policy. This creates a credit-assignment problem because the two actions share the same final objective but play different roles in the trajectory. Accordingly, action-specific credit assigns the initial action credit from the final trajectory outcome and the corrective action credit for improvement over the intermediate state. Image-to-TikZ serves as an executable visual testbed for this setting. On 945 held-out examples, learning after execution strengthens the shared policy under single-call inference and also produces a post-execution corrective capability. Single-call render success reaches 92.70\%, compared with 88.25\% for continued single-stage GRPO after the same number of additional training iterations. This corrective capability is not reproduced by continued single-stage training and depends on the intermediate state. Alternative credit definitions also induce different group-relative preferences over the same trajectories. Together, these results suggest that executable tasks contain useful learning structure beyond a terminal reward. Code is available at https://github.com/tianyufengcn/Learning-after-Execution.

</details>


### [688] [CB-Agent: Concept-Based In-Context Learning for Sequential Action Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14574)
*Qingyue Zhang,Huaze Tang,Minyu Zhang,Yuxiang Yan,Wenbo Ding,Shao-Lun Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CB-Agent，将基于概念的 ICL 扩展到序列动作选择，通过拟合概念向量直接监督可复用的评分规则，避免在提示中使用完整演示轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式智能体中的演示是推理、动作、观察的轨迹，但直接输入完整轨迹占用提示空间且效果受限，而自然语言摘要又需将通用指导转化为具体动作选择。

Method: 从专家轨迹提取环境-动作决策，用最大似然拟合概念向量，建模给定上下文对候选动作的条件分布；结合概念、冻结语言模型特征与先验。在 ReAct 交互中据此选择环境动作，无需在评分上下文中包含演示。

Result: 在 TextWorld、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 上，CB-Agent 在三种测试模型规模下均取得最高跨基准平均成绩，并在各规模下于 TextWorld 和 ScienceWorld 排名第一；ALFWorld 实验表明学习到的概念比仅用先验评分有额外贡献，结合 Reflexion 后进一步提升。

Conclusion: 专家动作选择可直接监督可复用评分规则，概念向量使 ICL 更高效地服务于交互式序列动作选择，并可与其他方法（如 Reflexion）结合获得增益。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) allows large language models to use demonstrations without updating their parameters. For interactive agents, demonstrations are trajectories of reasoning, actions, and observations that illustrate how to complete a task. Reusing demonstrations in new situations is challenging: directly inputting full trajectories consumes limited prompt space and constrains the overall effectiveness, while natural-language summaries require the agent to translate general guidance into specific action choices. Therefore, we study whether expert action choices can directly supervise a reusable scoring rule. We propose CB-Agent, which extends concept-based ICL to sequential action selection. We extract environment-action decisions from expert trajectories and fit a concept vector by maximum likelihood to model the conditional distribution over candidate actions given the context. This model combines the concept with frozen language-model features and priors. During ReAct interaction, the agent uses this distribution to select environment actions without including demonstrations in the action-scoring context. Across TextWorld, ALFWorld, and ScienceWorld, CB-Agent achieves the highest cross-benchmark average among the evaluated methods at all three tested model sizes and ranks first on TextWorld and ScienceWorld at each size. ALFWorld experiments support the learned concept's contribution beyond prior-only scoring and show further gains when combined with Reflexion. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CB-Agent-DFF9/.

</details>


### [689] [Iterate on an LLM, Serve on an SLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14576)
*Keegan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"先在前沿模型prompt空间迭代行为，再将生产记录蒸馏到小模型(SFT)"的生命周期，用居家护理排班agent验证：LoRA微调Qwen3-8B达0.913一致率，超越教师模型自身一致性(72.7%)，且更便宜、延迟更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿LLM能力增强但成本上升；小模型(SLM)推理便宜5-40倍且成本稳定，适合agent分解出的狭窄重复子任务。但难点在于快速、高效、经济地让小模型输出正确行为：多数零样本小模型在狭窄生产任务上失败，而每次行为变化都重训又太慢，无法迭代。

Method: 分两步：(1) 在prompt空间于前沿模型上开发目标行为，借助实时流量即时反馈；(2) 行为收敛后，将记录下来的真实生产行为(非合成模仿)通过监督微调(SFT)蒸馏进SLM。案例为居家护理机构排班agent，用GPT-5.4-nano对每个护理员-班次对做单次yes/no安全决策。

Result: 基于11.6k条生产决策训练的LoRA Qwen3-8B达0.913一致率；教师GPT-5.4-nano在同一批记录prompt上自我一致率仅72.7%，说明SLM可能更一致。二者分歧时，盲测专业排班员以48-29支持学生模型。SLM中位延迟约低2.5倍，成本仅为零头。

Conclusion: "快速构建、实时反馈、廉价推理"的生命周期是构建此类系统的可复用蓝图；蒸馏真实生产行为可使SLM在狭窄任务上优于教师的一致性与性价比。

Abstract: As frontier LLMs gain more capabilities, the cost to run them also goes up. At the same time, small language models (SLMs) also gain more capabilities but have largely been able to keep their cost stable, offering 5-40 times cheaper inference for the narrow, repetitive subtasks that agents decompose work into. However, the standing limiting factor is getting the correct behavior out of a small model in a fast, efficient, and economical way. Unfortunately, in most cases, zero-shot small models fail narrow production tasks. Furthermore, retraining one every time the behavior changes is too slow to iterate on. We propose doing both in sequence. First, develop the desired behavior in prompt space, on a frontier model, with immediate feedback from live traffic. Then, once the behavior converges, distill the recorded production behavior (not synthetic imitations of it) into an SLM through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We show a proper use case of this method through a scheduling agent for home-care agencies that fans out a single yes/no safety decision per caregiver-shift pair on GPT-5.4-nano. A LoRA-tuned Qwen3-8B trained on 11.6k recorded production decisions reaches 0.913 agreement, while the teacher (GPT-5.4-nano), re-run on its own recorded prompts, agrees with itself only 72.7% of the time, pointing to the fact that the SLM may also be more consistent. Furthermore, when the two disagreed, a blinded professional scheduler sided with the student 48-29. Finally, we find that the SLM has approximately 2.5 times lower median latency and is a fraction of the cost. We believe this lifecycle of quick building, live feedback, and cheap inference is a blueprint for others building similar systems.

</details>


### [690] [Decoupling Knowledge Forgetting and Refusal Learning in MLLM Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14605)
*Haodong Chen,Shengtao Wen,Dong Liang,Lingbing Guo,Xiang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FASD方法，实现多模态模型"诚实无知"式遗忘，避免虚构和仅行为拒绝但知识残留的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态遗忘评估只关注模型是否停止输出目标信息，忽视两类失败：知识抑制引发虚构（confabulation），拒绝训练只改变行为而未真正擦除知识（多项选择仍能答对）。

Method: Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD)，分两个互补通道：行为通道从被无知提示的模型自身副本蒸馏恰当拒绝，并掩蔽目标token以防重新教授遗忘概念；知识通道独立于生成响应直接抑制真值答案span。

Result: FASD成功遗忘目标知识，防止开放任务中的信息泄漏，并保持保留数据性能；模型不仅遗忘指定信息，还能准确识别自身知识边界。

Conclusion: FASD实现"诚实无知"，兼顾真正遗忘与自知缺失，优于仅表面行为层面的遗忘方法。

Abstract: Current evaluations of multimodal unlearning typically focus on whether a model stops outputting target information. This surface-level criterion, however, masks two critical failure modes. First, knowledge suppression techniques often induce confabulation, leading the model to hallucinate facts about the unlearned subject. Second, refusal training merely alters observable behavior without erasing the underlying knowledge; such models might decline open queries but still identify correct answers under multiple-choice probing. To overcome these limitations, we propose Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD). This method is designed to achieve honest ignorance, a state where the model genuinely loses the target knowledge and learns to acknowledge its absence. FASD separates these goals into two complementary channels. The behavior channel distills appropriate refusals from an ignorance-prompted copy of the model itself. Crucially, target tokens are masked from the teacher distribution to avoid accidentally reteaching the forgotten concepts. Simultaneously, the knowledge channel directly suppresses ground-truth answer spans independently of the model's generated responses. Experiments demonstrate that FASD successfully unlearns target knowledge, prevents information leakage in open-ended tasks, and preserves performance on retained data. The resulting model not only forgets the specified information but accurately recognizes the boundaries of its own knowledge. Code and data will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [691] [From Existing Methods to New Research Ideas: Two Perspectives on Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14625)
*Leijun Zhou,Yanke Yu,Zhihao Liu,Qu Xiang,Tiancheng Hu,Yiru Dong,Yihan Wu,Yangxi Xiang,Xuejun Wu,Xi Chen,Buyue Qian,Yaowei Zheng,Junhao Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文从两个互补视角审视递归自我改进(RSI)方法：提出统一分类法(9个设计维度、4组),并剖析其与传统深度学习及进化计算的关联,以启发新研究思路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期语言agent方法允许保留对参数、记忆、技能和代码的修改,从而实现递归自我改进,但缺乏统一框架来整合这些方法并激发新研究方向。

Method: 提出包含9个设计维度、归为4组(更新目标、更新组织、更新计划与范围、反馈与选择)的统一分类法,将现有方法置于共享设计空间;分析RSI方法对优化、正则化、数据增强、持续学习、对抗学习等传统深度学习的借鉴,并结合进化计算探索更具体的学习机制;同时综述在线、离线及离线到在线设置下的自我改进评测基准。

Result: 构建了RSI方法的统一设计空间与分类体系,揭示了各维度及其交互如何启发新想法,并梳理了现有基准在三种设置下对自我改进的评估方式。

Conclusion: 这些视角有助于研究者从现有设计与学习机制出发提出新的RSI研究想法;相关论文与资源已在指定网站开源。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a route to AI systems that participate in their own continued development. Recent methods allow language agents to retain changes to their parameters, memory, skills, and code for subsequent execution and improvement. We examine how these methods can inform new research ideas through two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce a unified taxonomy with nine design dimensions organized into four groups: update targets, update organization, update schedule and scope, feedback and selection. This taxonomy places existing methods in a shared design space, where examining individual dimensions and their interactions can inspire new research ideas. Second, we examine how existing RSI methods draw on traditional deep learning, for example through optimization, regularization, data augmentation, continual learning, and adversarial learning. We develop further ideas by examining more specific learning mechanisms and drawing on evolutionary computation. We also review how existing benchmarks assess self-improvement under online, offline, and offline-to-online settings. Together, these perspectives help researchers develop new RSI research ideas from existing designs and learning mechanisms. RSI papers and resources are available at https://prism-shadow.github.io/awesome-rsi/.

</details>


### [692] [PEARL: Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14636)
*Jie Yang,Mianqiu Huang,Yiwei Zhao,Bo Wang,Yang Liu,Yuxin Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PEARL提出一种无需critic的过程-经验感知强化学习方法，通过定位两条不同结果轨迹的首个分叉点并聚类局部决策特征，选择性增强低奖励决策的负优势，改善多轮智能体的细粒度信用分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端奖励使多轮智能体无需步级标注即可训练，但组相对优势对中间决策的调整指导不足；失败轨迹中也包含合理动作，且不利决策模式会随训练反复出现。

Method: 给定同一历史下的两条不同结果延续，PEARL定位其首个分叉点，为每个分支的局部决策构建特征表示；在近期失败与成功记忆中聚类这些决策特征以识别反复出现的局部模式；基于该模式记忆，选择性增强低奖励决策处的负优势，同时保持正优势与基础策略优化器不变。

Result: 在AppWorld上，4B和8B规模下均优于ARPO（Normal与Challenge任务）；在ALFWorld上4B平均成功率达97.9%，比最强基线高2.7个百分点，8B保持竞争力。消融实验验证了塑造位置、成功库过滤与记忆窗口的价值。

Conclusion: 选择性、基于反复出现模式的更新能有效提升多轮智能体的局部信用分配与整体性能。

Abstract: Terminal rewards make multi-turn agents trainable without step-level annotations, but group-relative advantages provide little guidance about which intermediate decisions to adjust. Failed trajectories also contain reasonable actions, while unfavorable decision patterns can recur as training proceeds. We introduce PEARL (Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning), which improves local credit assignment without an additional critic. Given two continuations from the same history with different outcomes, PEARL locates their first divergence and builds a feature representation of each branch's local decision. It clusters these decision features in recent failure and success memories to identify recurring local patterns. Using this pattern memory, PEARL selectively strengthens negative advantages at lower-reward decisions, while leaving positive advantages and the base policy optimizer unchanged. On AppWorld, PEARL improves over ARPO on Normal and Challenge tasks at both 4B and 8B scales. On ALFWorld, it achieves 97.9% mean success at 4B, 2.7 points above the strongest baseline, while remaining competitive at 8B. Ablations of shaping location, success-bank filtering, and memory window support the value of selective, recurring-pattern-based updates.

</details>


### [693] [AegisVox: Factorized Privacy and Clinical Preservation for Long-Form Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14643)
*Praphul Singh,Akshat Agarwal,Ratul Ghosh,Aashna Kanuga,Devashish Khatwani,Anurag Dwarakanath,Sri Gadde,Krishnaram Kenthapadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AegisVox 是一个分解式临床语音去标识框架，通过替换标识性话轮并分配一致的代理声音来保护隐私。在两个语音渲染器的匹配比较中，替换实现更好的方案反而可能在临床保留和说话人关联上表现更差，因此需要针对具体用途评估权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床语音不仅通过说出的话语和声音暴露身份，其停顿、表达方式和说话人角色还承载临床证据，因此保护隐私不能仅靠保留词语，需要同时处理标识信息与临床信息的张力。

Method: 提出 AegisVox 分解式框架：为语音分配一致的代理声音，并用文档一致的替换内容编辑含标识信息的话轮。在 390 段公开模拟或非患者对话（共 63.6 小时）上，对两种语音渲染器进行匹配比较，分离替换实现与保留标识、说话人关联、临床保留等维度。

Result: 文本转语音渲染实现 535/601 个计划替换，基于编解码器的语音编辑器为 453/601。但总体临床保留相近却隐藏更多模型标注的矛盾；会话级说话人分数掩盖了编辑语音更强的关联性（得分方向敏感性分析）。原始音频重新转录提供临床测量链参考，独立评判者检验对模型评估的敏感性。更好的替换实现可能与更差的临床或说话人关联测量并存。

Conclusion: AegisVox 支持针对用途的权衡评估，而非保证标识移除或临床安全；替换实现与临床/说话人关联指标之间存在可分离的权衡，需要按具体用途分别评价。

Abstract: Clinical speech reveals identity through both spoken identifiers and voice, yet its pauses, delivery, and speaker roles can also carry useful clinical evidence. Protecting that speech therefore requires more than preserving its words. We present AegisVox, a factorized framework that assigns consistent surrogate voices and edits identifier-bearing turns using document-consistent replacements. Across 390 public simulated or non-patient conversations totaling 63.6 hours, a matched comparison of two speech renderers separates replacement realization from retained identifiers, speaker linkage, and clinical preservation. Text-to-speech rendering realizes 535/601 planned replacements versus 453/601 for the codec-based speech editor. However, similar aggregate clinical preservation conceals more model-labeled contradictions, and conversation-wide speaker scores conceal greater edited-speech linkage under a score-direction sensitivity analysis. Fresh transcription of original audio provides a reference for interpreting the clinical measurement chain; an independent judge tests sensitivity to model-based assessment. Better replacement realization can therefore coexist with worse clinical or speaker-linkage measurements. AegisVox supports use-specific evaluation of those tradeoffs, not a guarantee of identifier removal or clinical safety.

</details>


### [694] [Shaping Latent Mixture-of-Experts: From Expert Geometry to Layerwise Capacity Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14644)
*Yaoxiang Wang,Kai Zhang,Ruobing Xie,Lanrui Wang,Guoliang Zhao,Junhui Li,Jinsong Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将专家计算移至低维空间（LatentMoE），使专家形状成为显式设计维度；理论证明近方形专家最大化Jacobian秩上限，并用逐层内在维度指导容量分配，取得更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统细粒度MoE通过收窄专家来增加专家数量，把专家形状当作路由粒度的副产物，忽视了专家形状本身的设计价值。

Method: 提出LatentMoE，将专家计算置于低维空间，显式暴露专家输入维度与中间宽度；分析局部Jacobian秩与这两维的约束关系，并进行受控形状扫描；再用逐层内在维度（ID）指导跨层容量分配，协同变化专家数量与形状。

Result: 理论上近方形专家在固定每专家参数量下最大化秩上限；跨模型规模与路由粒度的形状扫描一致偏好近方形专家；ID引导分配在保持每层参数量、激活FLOPs与通信量不变下，验证损失更低、下游性能更强。

Conclusion: 专家形状与逐层容量分配可作为MoE的实用设计维度。

Abstract: Fine-grained mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly increase expert count by narrowing each expert, treating expert shape as a by-product of routing granularity. LatentMoE moves expert computation into a lower-dimensional space, exposing the input dimension and intermediate width of each expert as explicit design choices. We show that an expert's local Jacobian rank is jointly bounded by these two dimensions, and that balancing them maximizes the rank ceiling at fixed per-expert parameters. Controlled shape sweeps across model scales and routing granularities consistently favor near-square experts. We further use layerwise intrinsic dimension (ID) to guide capacity allocation across depth, co-varying the number and shape of experts while keeping per-layer parameter count, activated FLOPs, and communication volume constant. Compared with layer-homogeneous baselines, our ID-guided allocation achieves lower validation loss and stronger downstream performance. These results establish expert shape and layerwise allocation as practical design axes for MoEs.

</details>


### [695] [RASSG: Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating for Streaming Tool Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14659)
*Daijin Hu,Xi Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RASSG，在流式语音中联合控制工具启动与取消，避免自我纠正导致的陈旧执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式语音助手过早启动工具可减少等待，但用户后续自我纠正会使参数失效，产生不可逆的陈旧执行。

Method: 当三次连续识别结果参数非空且一致时启动工具；结合校准的参数失效风险与执行成本，在不可逆前的最后可行时刻决定取消。

Result: 在ReCAST、FDB-v3、Audio2Tool上评估。ReCAST前瞻修复子集上，陈旧执行率从LocalAgreement-2的50.00%降至3.15%，平均延迟3.676s；优于所有早执行基线，消融支持主动取消。

Conclusion: 主动取消机制能在效果不可逆前控制正在进行的调用，显著降低陈旧执行。

Abstract: Streaming speech assistants can launch tools before users finish speaking, overlapping execution with incoming speech to reduce user waiting time. However, subsequent self-corrections can invalidate apparently stable arguments, causing stale execution whose irreversible effects persist even after the final call is corrected. We propose Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating (RASSG) to jointly control tool launch and cancellation during streaming speech. RASSG launches a tool when three consecutive speech recognition results arrive with identical nonempty arguments, then combines calibrated argument invalidity risk with execution costs to decide cancellation at the last feasible opportunity before effects become irreversible. Evaluation on ReCAST, FDB-v3, and Audio2Tool uses a controlled execution clock with fixed tool runtimes and cancellation parameters. On ReCAST's prospective-repair subset, RASSG reduces the stale execution rate from LocalAgreement-2's 50.00% to 3.15%, with a mean delay of 3.676s across successful trajectories. The stale reduction also holds against every early-execution baseline on both public speech datasets. Ablations with identical initial launches support active cancellation, showing the value of controlling ongoing calls before their effects become irreversible. Code and data are available at https://github.com/daijinhu/RASSG.

</details>


### [696] [A Hybrid Kinematic GCN and Elastic Transformer for Efficient Indian Sign Language Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14680)
*Pushp Garg,Himangshu Sarma,Mrinmoy Ghorai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出结构化感知混合框架用于印度手语(ISL)词素识别，结合熵驱动SVD采样、弹性Transformer与自适应GCN，并构建120类新数据集，达到89.8%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISL具有双手机制、签名速度多变等复杂性，且面临大词汇基准数据稀缺、标准模型难以处理不规则签名速度等瓶颈。

Method: 用熵驱动SVD采样器动态提取关键帧；用连续双位置编码与距离感知弹性Transformer处理不规则时间间隔；用运动学条件自适应GCN结合统一骨骼-关节特征建模双手几何；并用物理节点Dropout与ArcFace优化减少主体记忆。

Result: 构建了120类、9,453视频的原生ISL数据集，框架取得89.8%的竞争性准确率，为复杂手语建模建立了强基线。

Conclusion: 该结构化感知混合框架有效应对ISL识别挑战，并提供了数据集与基线。

Abstract: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) presents complex challenges due to variable signing speeds and spatial intricacies. Specifically, Indian Sign Language (ISL) requires precise modeling of its inherently bimanual nature and is bottlenecked by the scarcity of large-vocabulary benchmarks and the inability of standard models to handle irregular signing velocities. To address this, a structurally-aware hybrid framework for efficient, gloss ISL recognition is proposed. To minimize computational redundancy, an entropy-driven SVD sampler that dynamically extracts informative keyframes is used. Because this subsampling creates irregular physical time gaps, the proposed architecture employs a Continuous Dual Positional Encoding paired with a distance-aware Elastic Transformer to preserve natural signing rhythm. Spatially, a Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN explicitly models bimanual geometry using unified bone-joint features. To validate our framework, a 120-class, 9,453-video native ISL dataset is created. Augmented by Physical Node Dropout and ArcFace optimization to mitigate subject-specific memorization, our framework achieves a competitive 89.8% accuracy, establishing a strong baseline for complex sign language modeling.

</details>


### [697] [AcrossVAM2.0: Conflict-Aware Point Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Video Diffusion Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14693)
*Nan Wu,Yee Hung Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究在5.01B参数文本到视频扩散Transformer中，显式点对应（如光流）与预训练外观先验之间的张力，提出ACROSSVAM2.0，通过置信度加权轨迹/可见性头、零初始化残差反馈与非对称PCGrad，在适配中保留生成器主更新。实验显示对应一致性提升但视频质量并非全面提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显式点对应能刻画可见表面运动，有利于视频生成器适配，但可能覆盖大预训练模型学到的外观先验，这一张力需要在大规模模型中被研究和解决。

Method: ACROSSVAM2.0包含三部分：置信度加权的track-and-visibility头、零初始化残差反馈、非对称PCGrad（在共享LoRA参数上只移除与主flow-matching梯度冲突的辅助分量）。该设计保证初始化时严格保持原生成器，并在适配时保护其主更新。

Result: 四路消融（1000步、3个独立种子）中，完整方法在3个种子均降低KLT前后向循环误差（种子级均值差-0.00711，SD 0.00505），鲁棒锐度均为正。24提示、216视频扩展评测中，CoTracker3循环误差较匹配对照降低9.7%，VBench六维接近持平；但种子级跟踪效果异质，I3D-FVD从0.1824退化至0.2022。

Conclusion: 冲突感知适配能提升对应一致性而不造成广泛感知退化，但不会一致地提升视频质量，因此仅支持有边界的结论。作者公开了公式、伪代码、匹配输出、源表和工件溯源信息。

Abstract: Explicit point correspondence is attractive for adapting video generators: it describes how visible surfaces move, but can overwrite the appearance prior learned by a large pretrained model. We study this tension in a 5.01B-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer. ACROSSVAM2.0 combines a confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head, zero-initialized residual feedback, and asymmetric PCGrad that removes only the auxiliary component opposing the primary flow-matching gradient on shared LoRA parameters. The design preserves the generator exactly at initialization and protects its primary update during adaptation.
