Method: GRA 将地理空间数据源、基础模型与工具组织为模块化领域技能，并结合前置地理空间规划，把复杂查询拆解为多阶段工作流。评估上引入 GeoExpertQueries（专家用例、三专家共识金标准流程、人工验证的与工具无关的自动评分器）和 GeoKTools（模板化查询+确定性参考求解器），并采用 CBGB、UnivEARTH。对比四种配置：纯 LLM、LLM+基础工具、LLM+GRA 技能与工具（无规划/执行指导）、完整 GRA。

Result: 在模板化查询上，仅用基础工具的先进模型可恢复大部分答案；但在开放式专家问题上只能满足少数工作流。GRA 在两类任务上均表现良好。最大提升来自 GRA 的技能与工具；在开放式问题上，其规划与执行指导在 Gemini 3.8 Flash 上带来额外增益，使 Flash 以更低成本达到或超过 Pro。UnivEARTH 已趋于饱和。

Conclusion: GRA 的工具、技能与智能体编排对地理空间推理至关重要，规划与执行指导可让较弱模型以更低成本匹敌强模型，说明系统设计而非单纯模型规模是性能提升关键。

Abstract: Google Earth AI is a family of geospatial AI models, together with an agent that orchestrates them. We present this agent, Google Earth AI's Geospatial Reasoning agent (GRA), a Gemini-powered research system that combines geospatial data sources, foundation models, and tools to answer questions about our planet. GRA organizes these into modular domain skills and pairs them with upfront geospatial planning to decompose complex queries into multi-stage workflows. Evaluating such systems is hard: real-world problems admit multiple valid workflows, require data discovery across large catalogs, and rely on evolving ground truth. We introduce two benchmarks and release their development splits. GeoExpertQueries poses complex analytical problems grounded in practitioner use cases and refined by geospatial experts; each is paired with a consensus golden workflow from three independent experts and scored by a human-validated, tool-agnostic autorater. GeoKTools consists of templated queries with deterministic reference solvers that systematically vary the number of required tool types. We also use two external benchmarks, CBGB and UnivEARTH; the latter we find to be saturated. To isolate the contribution of GRA's tools and its agentic orchestration, we compare four configurations, each with Gemini 3.1 Pro and 3.8 Flash: a standalone LLM, the LLM with basic tools, the LLM with GRA's skills and tools but without its upfront planning and execution guidance, and GRA itself. With at most basic tools, an advanced model recovers much of the answer on templated queries but satisfies only a small fraction of the expert workflows on open-ended problems; GRA performs well on both. The largest step comes from GRA's skills and tools; on open-ended problems, its planning and execution guidance add a further gain with Gemini 3.8 Flash, letting Flash match or exceed Pro at lower cost.

</details>


### [801] [Agent Sociodrama: Social-Dynamics-Guided Persona Recasting for LLM Agent Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15788)
*Yirui Qi,Xiaoming Zhang,Jaehong Yoon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Agent Sociodrama 框架：用统一外部 LLM 裁判每轮更新智能体情绪与有向非对称关系，从而建模并验证 LLM 智能体团队的社会动态；基于诊断出的群体动态失败，提出 TPR 在重跑任务前重置人格，显著提升多任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体常以团队方式部署，却以典型社会性方式失败：信息持有者沉默、主导发言者把群体锚定在错误答案上、规范违反未被制裁。现有工作缺乏对团队社会动态的建模与验证，也缺少修复群体动态失败的手段。

Method: Agent Sociodrama：固定人格下，智能体情绪状态与有向非对称关系由统一外部 LLM 裁判每轮更新，并影响后续交互。评估上，在 6 个 LLM 主干、5 个社会场景中，用经典社会理论模式与人类判断一致性衡量社会保真度。进一步提出 Trajectory-Guided Persona Recasting (TPR)：从交互记录与社会轨迹诊断群体动态失败，在重跑任务前重置智能体人格。

Result: 轨迹呈现结构化社会模式与模型特异性差异。TPR 在 4 个协作基准上，从异质与随机初始化人格组合出发均提升性能，相对初始选角最高提升 83.3 个百分点准确率；在分布式信息合作与混合动机议价任务上，与 SOTOPIA、AgentVerse 的四项对比中三项胜出，Pareto 率最高提升 37.5 个百分点。

Conclusion: 经验证的社会轨迹能为修复 LLM 智能体团队提供可操作的信号。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as teams, yet they fail in characteristically social ways: information holders stay silent, dominant speakers anchor groups on wrong answers, and norm violations go unsanctioned. We present Agent Sociodrama, a framework for modeling and validating evolving social dynamics in LLM agent teams. Under fixed personas, agents' emotional states and directed, asymmetric relationships are updated every round by a unified external LLM judge and shape their subsequent interactions. Across six LLM backbones and five social scenarios, we assess social fidelity through classical social-theory patterns and agreement with human judgments. The resulting trajectories exhibit structured social patterns and model-specific differences. We then introduce Trajectory-Guided Persona Recasting (TPR), which diagnoses group-dynamic failures from interaction transcripts and social trajectories and recasts agent personas before rerunning the task. Across four collaborative benchmarks, TPR improves performance from both heterogeneous and randomly initialized agent persona compositions, yielding up to 83.3%p of accuracy improvement over the initial casting. On representative distributed-information cooperation and mixed-motive bargaining tasks, we outperform SOTOPIA and AgentVerse in three of four comparisons, by up to 37.5%p in Pareto rate. These results show that validated social trajectories provide actionable signals for repairing LLM agent teams.

</details>


### [802] [Attention Sinks in VLMs Are Borrowed, Not Seen](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15855)
*Dengjia Zhang,Alexander Martin,Pengyu Yan,Xihan Sun,Jiaqi Li,Benjamin Van Durme,Andrew Yates,Reno Kriz,William Walden*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型中的视觉注意力汇（visual attention sinks），提出基于中心化余弦相似度的检测方法，并设计免训练的重看机制来缓解其影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉注意力汇是无论查询或任务如何都会吸收大量图像注意力的图像token，会误导那些将注意力图视为模型"看哪里"记录的方法。已有工作通过大规模激活维度检测汇并重新分配注意力，但无人研究是什么使一个token成为汇。

Method: 在四个家族共十个VLM上比较六种候选检测器，发现只有图像token的key与语言模型文本汇key之间的中心化余弦相似度能检测视觉汇，即视觉汇是其key与文本汇key对齐的图像token。将汇的key分量沿该方向移至图像key中位数，可将注意力送回文本汇（Are Borrowed）而不改变模型答案（Not Seen）。据此提出免训练、熵触发的重看：先清洗注意力图，再裁剪清洗后最受关注区域并插入推理轨迹。

Result: 清洗对前向传播增加的计算可忽略不计，重看在精细细节VQA基准上跨模型家族平均提升+4.3分。

Conclusion: 视觉汇的本质是其key与文本汇key对齐，基于此的注意力清洗与重看机制可高效缓解视觉注意力汇，提升VLM在细粒度视觉问答上的准确率。

Abstract: We study how to detect and mitigate visual attention sinks in vision-language models (VLMs). Visual attention sinks are image tokens that absorb a large share of attention over the image regardless of the query or task, and they mislead methods that treat attention maps as a record of where the model ``looked.'' Prior work has detected sinks through massive activation dimensions and proposed redistributing their attention, but none have addressed what makes a token become a sink. Comparing six candidate detectors on ten VLMs from four families, we find that only the centered cosine similarity between an image token's key and the key of the language model's text-sink detects visual sinks. Thus, a visual sink is an image token whose key aligns with the text-sink's key. Moving a sink's key component along this direction to the median of the image keys sends its attention back to the text-sink (\textbf{Are Borrowed}) while leaving model answers unchanged~(\textbf{Not Seen}). Building on this, we propose a training-free, entropy-triggered re-look that first cleans the attention map, then crops the most-attended region of the cleaned map and inserts it into the reasoning trace. Cleaning adds negligible computation to the forward pass, and the re-look improves accuracy with a mean gain of $+4.3$ points on fine-detail VQA benchmarks across model families.

</details>


### [803] [Engram Injection: A Study of Temporal Validity in Parametric Language-Model Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15882)
*Sam Siavoshian,Omar Ramadan,Amir K. Saeed,Benjamin A. Johnson,Benjamin M. Rodriguez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究语言模型能否在参数中学习事实的时间变化，并仅凭问题与当前时间正确作答。Engram Injection 将事实存入 LoRA 适配器、用 FiLM 注入时钟，但在排除训练年龄上表现为零正确，而全历史提示与检索方法近乎全对。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户偏好改变或新事件替代旧事件时，已存储的事实会失效。作者想探究语言模型能否在参数中学会这类变化，并仅根据问题和当前时间作出正确回答。

Method: 在冻结的 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上用 LoRA 适配器存储事实（Engram Injection），通过 FiLM 条件化注入时钟；对比加性时钟条件化、带完整日期历史的提示、检索四条带日期记录。修复了可能把测试年龄样本混入训练的采样器，用三个种子训练六个匹配适配器，并做训练审计。

Result: 审计显示 127,760 条训练输入中无测试年龄样本。在 62 对更新前后问题上、排除训练的七天年龄下，两种适配器方法在主盲评下零对正确；全历史提示 59/62 正确，检索 62/62 正确。附加实验表明适配器能存储事实、可移除记忆单元支持局部删除。

Conclusion: 结合事实选择与基于时间的版本选择仍不成功；结果区分了"学习事实"与"学习何时使用事实"。

Abstract: A stored fact may stop being valid when a user changes a preference or an event replaces an earlier one. We study whether a language model can learn these changes in its parameters and answer correctly from only a question and the current time. Engram Injection stores facts in LoRA adapters and supplies the clock through FiLM conditioning on a frozen Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct model. We compare it with additive clock conditioning, prompting with the full dated history, and retrieving four dated records. We train six matched adapters across three seeds after fixing a sampler that could admit test-age examples into training. The training audit reports no such examples among 127,760 evaluated training inputs. On 62 pairs of questions asked before and after an update, at an elapsed age of seven days excluded from training, both adapter methods answer zero pairs correctly under the primary blinded assistant review with order code 1 held fixed. Full-history prompting answers 59/62 pairs correctly, and retrieval answers 62/62. Separate experiments show that adapters can store facts and that removable memory units can support local deletion. Combining fact selection with time-based version selection remains unsuccessful. These results separate learning a fact from learning when to use it.

</details>


### [804] [RetryBench: Separating Retry Permission from Recovery Outcomes in GPT Tool Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15884)
*You Liu,Yue Liu,Quanchao Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"错误重试许可"(FRP)概念与RetryBench基准,将无契约支持的超时工具重试错误与实际恢复区分开;通过多组对照实验发现,模型在缺少有效契约时仍会发起无支持的重试,且该错误不能仅用展示效应解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将"成功受保护的恢复"等同于"可靠拒绝无支持的重试",但二者并不等价。当一个代理在可见契约不支持的情况下重试超时的工具调用时,会出现"错误重试许可"(FRP),这一错误此前未被独立区分与评估,可能导致对代理安全性的误判。

Method: 开展RetryBench系列对照实验:720响应密钥对照(有效密钥vs.变更密钥),240响应对照(移除候选、要求模型自行提供密钥),六端点研究(移除弱契约标签),1536响应规范动作块(含多重比较校正),以及显式契约提示对照,覆盖Sol、Terra、Luna等固定GPT端点与四个目的性任务。

Result: 变更密钥诱发无支持重试:Sol 1/80、Terra 55/80、Luna 60/80;移除候选后Luna仍有8/80无支持调用,Sol/Terra为0/80。移除弱契约标签在Sol与Terra的编码动作条件下增加重试;规范动作块中Terra呈正向对比(115/128 vs. 124/128),集中于两个任务/顺序条件,其余五组对比经多重校正后未定论。显式契约提示对照中762份返回全部延迟,恢复仍无结论。

Conclusion: 接受展示的坏密钥无法完全解释所有观察到的错误,但变更的输出要求与条件使得纯粹的展示效应比较无法成立。研究支持在声明的接口变体间同时报告许可与恢复。证据仅覆盖四个目的性任务、固定GPT端点与单一恢复决策,既无法识别内部机制,也不能说明片段级安全性。

Abstract: False retry permission (FRP) occurs when an agent retries a timed-out tool call without support from the visible contract. RetryBench separates this error from realized recovery. Successful protected recovery does not imply reliable rejection of unsupported retries. In a 720-response key control, valid keys usually enabled safe progress, but offered changed keys elicited unsupported retries in Sol (1/80), Terra (55/80), and Luna (60/80). A later 240-response control removed the candidate and required models to supply a key. Luna still made 8/80 unsupported dispatches; Sol and Terra made none in 80 responses each. Accepting a displayed bad key therefore cannot explain all observed errors, although changed output requirements and conditions preclude a pure display-effect comparison. Removing the weak-contract label increased retries in Sol and Terra's coded-action conditions in a six-endpoint study. A separate 1,536-response canonical-action block also found a positive Terra contrast (115/128 versus 124/128 retries), concentrated in two task/order conditions; the other five contrasts remained unresolved after multiplicity correction. An explicit-contract cue control elicited deferral in all 762 returned responses, leaving recovery unresolved. These results support reporting permission and recovery together across declared interface variants. The evidence covers four purposive tasks, fixed GPT endpoints, and one recovery decision; it identifies neither internal mechanisms nor episode-level safety.

</details>


### [805] [Comparative Study of Canvas- and Coordinate-Based Geometry-Conditioned Neural Networks for Real-Time Prediction of Indoor Environments with Varying Room Dimensions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15885)
*Shaofan Wang,Philipp Geyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究对比两种几何条件神经网络代理模型（CaNN与CoNN）用于不同房间尺寸下室内气流与温度场的快速预测，CaNN相比CoNN与CFD结果吻合度更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFD计算成本高，难以支持迭代式建筑设计；现有深度学习代理模型在不同房间尺寸间泛化能力不足，需要有效的几何条件编码方式。

Method: 比较两种几何条件神经网络：CaNN通过固定画布内不同占据区域显式编码房间尺寸，CoNN使用归一化坐标通道；二者均采用U-Net自编码器分别预测气流场与温度场。以变高度、变长度的简化房间作为受控基准进行评估。

Result: CaNN与CFD结果的吻合度高于CoNN。

Conclusion: CaNN具备支持性能驱动建筑设计的潜力，可用于设计阶段实时评估送风在变尺寸房间中的有效性。

Abstract: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is computationally expensive for iterative building design. Deep learning surrogates offer faster predictions, but generalization across varying room dimensions remains challenging. This study compares two geometry-conditioned neural network surrogate models for rapid indoor airflow and temperature field prediction under varying room sizes. During the architectural design stage, this method is relevant for real-time assessment of whether conditioned supply air will effectively provide fresh and cool air throughout rooms with varying heights and lengths. The canvas-based neural network (CaNN) explicitly encodes room size by preserving different occupied regions within a fixed canvas, whereas the coordinate-based neural network (CoNN) uses normalized coordinate channels. Both employ U-Net autoencoders to separately predict airflow and temperature fields. Evaluation uses simplified rooms with varying heights and lengths as a controlled benchmark. The results show that CaNN achieves higher agreement with CFD results than CoNN, demonstrating its potential to support performance-driven building design.

</details>


### [806] [LURE: a Phase-Labelled Synthetic Corpus of Online-Grooming Exchanges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15908)
*Emanuele Florindi,Valentina Franzoni,Ludovico Guercio,Alfredo Milani,Mattia Polticchia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于检索增强管线、由80亿参数拒绝消融模型生成的合成诱拐对话语料库，含2,121条交换及Plutchik情绪标签，并提供校验与可访问审计代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开标注数据（Perverted-Justice/ChatCoder）规模小、过时且冻结，不足以支撑未成年人网络诱拐进程研究与预警工具开发。

Method: 采用五阶段负责任生成协议：基于ChatCoder诱拐传播方案的八标签/四阶段本体设计、多模型提示测试、人机协同监督、语义与特征级验证、模态感知文档化；用检索增强管线在机构硬件上运行80亿参数拒绝消融模型生成。

Result: 发布2,121条唯一对话（七标签、四阶段、含情绪字段）；标签准确率0.85，阶段准确率0.93；迁移到真实ChatCoder offender行（8标签31,640行自动编码，3构念10,876帖人工编码）；真实-合成判别器达91%区分度。

Conclusion: 该语料支持受控的阶段条件实验、管线开发与真实数据增强及意识材料，并以审核访问方式发布语料、数据说明书和审计代码。

Abstract: Phase-annotated conversational data is essential for studying the progression of online grooming of minors and for developing early warning tools. However, the only publicly available source (i.e., Perverted-Justice archive, which contains a subset coded using ChatCoder) is small, outdated, and frozen. We present a synthetic corpus of groomer-victim exchanges, generated using a retrieval-augmented pipeline running on institutional hardware. This pipeline uses an openly available, eight-billion-parameter, refusal-ablated language model. The corpus was created using the five stages of the responsible-generation protocol for synthetic datasets: ontology-driven design based on the ChatCoder luring-communication scheme (eight communicative tags mapped onto four grooming phases); multi-model prompt testing; human-in-the-loop supervision; semantic and feature-level validation; and modality-aware documentation. The released corpus contains 2,121 unique exchanges across seven tags and four phases, each accompanied by a Plutchik emotion field. Validation quantifies the integrity and lexical profile of the corpus, as well as the reproduction of real seed lines, in-domain label recoverability (tag accuracy: 0.85; phase accuracy: 0.93) and its transfer to real ChatCoder offender lines, which were coded automatically at the eight-tag level (31,640 lines) and by human coders at the three-construct level (10,876 posts). Accuracy was measured for lexical and sentence-embedding features, while a real-versus-synthetic discriminator was able to separate the two domains with 91% accuracy. The scope of the corpus includes controlled, phase-conditioned experimentation, pipeline development and augmentation alongside real data and awareness material. The corpus, its datasheet and the audit code are released with vetted access.

</details>


### [807] [Multi-Horizon Explainable Queue Forecasting and Resource-Aware Decision Support for Intelligent Border Control Using LightGBM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15930)
*Varvara Mama,Fani D. Christidi,Nikolaos C. Kapsalis,Anargyros T. Baklezos,Christos D. Nikolopoulos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文扩展多模式排队管理框架，提出基于LightGBM的多时间尺度预测与决策支持架构，预测15/30/60/120分钟等待时间和队长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边境口岸是随机服务系统，交通需求、旅客类别、登记状态、检查要求、人员配置和车道可用性在多个时间尺度上交互，需要更实用的预测与决策支持方法。

Method: 构建针对不同预测时域（15、30、60、120分钟）的LightGBM回归器，联合估计等待时间和队长；使用时间滞后特征及业务约束层（车道兼容、警员可用、资源退化、旅客类别、预登记、人工审批）；采用分位数LightGBM提供95%预测区间。

Result: 框架输出机器可读建议、警报、聚合KPI、置信度信息及集成接口；建立了可复现的合成数据基线。

Conclusion: 该框架为边境资源管理和决策支持提供实用接口，并为后续用真实口岸数据验证奠定基础。

Abstract: Border crossing points are stochastic service systems in which traffic demand, traveler categories, registration status, inspection requirements, staffing, and lane availability interact on multiple time scales. This paper extends an earlier multimodal queue-management framework by introducing an implementation-oriented, multi-horizon forecasting and decision-support architecture based on Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) models. In contrast to a single forecasting block, the proposed approach constructs horizon-specific regressors for 15, 30, 60, and 120 min forecasts and jointly estimates future waiting time and queue lengths. The models operate on temporally lagged traffic, service, density, and queue features, while an operational layer incorporates lane compatibility, officer availability, possibly degraded resources, traveler category, preregistration information, and human-approval constraints. Quantile LightGBM models provide 95\% prediction intervals for waiting-time forecasts. Beyond prediction, the framework produces machine-readable recommendations, alerts, aggregate key performance indicators, confidence information, and integration outputs suitable for border resource-management and decision-support systems. The results establish a reproducible synthetic-data baseline and a practical interface for subsequent validation with operational border-crossing data.

</details>


### [808] [The Anatomy of a Blind Spot: What an LLM Judge Must Be Shown, and How Much](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15938)
*Nitish Kumar,Prateik Pothuneedi,Greg Bandak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM作为评委时应"看到"什么信息。通过七个基准、三种评委的对照实验发现：给评委看什么比用哪个评委更重要；让系统依据被剥夺必要材料的评委反馈修改答案，反而损害性能，且错误会随轮次累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成文本的评估日益委托给LLM评委，但评委究竟必须被展示哪些信息这一问题尚未解决。作者把被据以行动的评委视为控制论意义上的"调节器"，追问它必须看到什么、看多少、以何种形式呈现，以及其报告必须做对什么。

Method: 在七个公开基准上，仅改变评委被展示的内容。使用三位价格相差10至17倍的评委进行对比；针对指令遵循、问答、新闻摘要等任务，测试评委看到/看不到用户请求、约束条件、参考摘要、源文本等不同材料组合时的效果，并检验多轮反馈、第二评委家族、约十分之一的源文本、小型蕴含图与LLM评委的对比等情况。

Result: 给评委看什么比选哪个评委影响更大。当评委被剥夺其必须尊重的材料时，系统据其反馈修改答案会跌破起点（指令遵循与问答）；指令遵循上的损失随每轮累积，且在评委看到用户请求但看不到约束、以及换用第二评委家族时依然存在。新闻摘要中，参考摘要与源文并置会抵消源文的大部分贡献；单答案问题中参考摘要则有帮助。约十分之一的源文完成了几乎全部作用；小型蕴含图在发现grounded文本错误上可匹敌LLM评委。预先登记83条可检验命题，实际运行81条，32条达标，50条方向符合预测，理论的大多数量化预测失败。

Conclusion: 论文报告了所有未达标之处，并据此推导出与实测效应挂钩的设计规则。核心启示是：评委的输入材料配置是决定评估与改进效果的关键变量，缺失必要材料会系统性地误导模型并造成累积性损害。

Abstract: Evaluation of text generated by large language models (LLMs) is increasingly delegated to LLMs acting as judges, yet what such a judge must be shown remains unresolved. We treat a judge whose reports are acted on as a regulator, in the sense of cybernetics, and ask what it must be shown, how much, in what form, and what its reports must get right. On seven public benchmarks we varied only what the judge was shown. Across three judges whose prices differ 10- to 17-fold, what the judge was shown mattered more than which judge it was. When a system revised its answers on feedback from a judge denied the material they had to respect, it ended below its starting point on instruction following and question answering. On instruction following the loss grew with each round, and it persisted when the judge saw the user's request but not the constraints and with a second judge family. On news summarisation, a correct reference summary beside the source undid most of the source's contribution, whereas on single-answer questions a reference helped. About a tenth of the source did almost all of its work, and a small entailment graph matched an LLM judge at finding errors in grounded text. We committed 83 testable clauses before running; of the 81 that ran, 32 met their bar and 50 went in the predicted direction, and most quantitative predictions from the theory failed. We report every shortfall and derive design rules tied to measured effects.

</details>


### [809] [Vision: "What Don't I Know About User's Preferences?" How Uncertainty Estimation Improves Proactive Assistant Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15948)
*Zhiyu An,Ziyi Xuan,Yu Yang,Wan Du*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一篇立场文章，主张在主动式智能助手中引入不确定性估计，以弥补仅依赖偏好似然预测的不足，并借鉴邻近领域经验勾勒未来不确定感知型助手的发展方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PSA通常仅依据预测的用户偏好似然选择动作，但该似然无法揭示预测的可靠性、支撑证据来源以及歧义产生的原因（用户偏好本身多变还是数据不足），导致下游行为可能不当。

Method: 以家庭助手为例，提出不确定性估计应回答的三个问题：对预测偏好似然有多确定、置信度来自群体级假设还是个体数据、歧义反映用户内在偏好波动还是特定情境数据不足；并综述人轨迹预测、个性化活动识别、信息采集与基于模型的控制等邻近领域的不确定性估计应用。

Result: 作为愿景文章，未报告实验或定量结果，而是通过邻近领域的经验总结，阐明不确定性估计可为主动交互提供缺失信息并改变下游行为。

Conclusion: 未来不确定感知型主动助手可借助邻近领域的洞见来应对主动交互中的关键挑战，从而提升助手决策的可靠性、可解释性与适应性。

Abstract: Proactive Smart Assistants (PSAs) increasingly use general knowledge, learned patterns from group-level data, patterns from individual user's data, and recent sensor observations to anticipate which action a user may prefer. Existing systems typically select actions from predicted user preference likelihoods, but these likelihoods alone do not reveal how reliable the prediction is, which evidence supports it, or why ambiguity remains. In this vision paper, we argue that uncertainty estimation can provide this missing information and substantially change appropriate downstream behavior. Using the example of a home assistant, we introduce the questions that uncertainty estimation aims to answer, i.e. how sure is the assistant about the predicted preference likelihood, whether the confidence come from group-level assumptions or individual's data, and whether likelihood ambiguity reflect the user's intrinsic preference variability or insufficient data for the particular situation. We further introduce uncertainty estimation applications in neighboring domains, such as human trajectory prediction, personalized activity recognition, information-collection, and model-based control. Finally, we draw on insights from neighboring domains to envision how future uncertainty-aware proactive assistants may address key challenges in proactive interaction.

</details>


### [810] [ADAPT: Audio-Depth Action Planning with Transition-Aware Rewards for Lights-Out Industrial Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15956)
*Wenjun Huang,Shenghao Fu,Yian Jin,Yang Ni,Yifan Li,Lichi Li,Xingjian Diao,Pengfei Zhang,Yutong Song,Hanning Chen,Jiarui Cui,Tianyu Yang,Shilong Li,Yu Kong,Mohsen Imani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出在无光照工业环境下使用空间音频与深度的无RGB导航框架ADAPT，并构建DarkNav-Bench基准，通过过渡感知奖励塑形（TARS）提升闭环导航性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身导航视觉-语言-动作模型依赖RGB观测，在无可见光的熄灯工业场景中无法适用，需要不依赖光照的导航方案。

Method: 构建DarkNav-Bench基准（24个工业场景、四种递进声学条件）；提出ADAPT音频-深度动作规划框架，含空间音频感知并用强化学习优化闭环导航；设计TARS奖励塑形，在位置-朝向图上定义姿态感知最短动作势能，同时考虑可行移动与原地旋转。

Result: ADAPT在已见和未见场景中均优于训练型导航基线与零样本多模态模型；未见环境下Clean条件成功率90.6%，最难的Localized Noise条件仍保持60.0%。

Conclusion: 空间音频与深度可作为互补模态，实现熄灯工业环境中可靠的RGB-free导航。

Abstract: Vision-language-action models for embodied navigation typically rely on RGB observations, limiting their applicability in lights-out industrial environments where visible illumination may be unavailable. We study illumination-independent navigation using spatial audio for target localization and depth for obstacle-aware geometry. To support this setting, we introduce DarkNav-Bench, a benchmark with 24 industrial scenes and four progressively challenging acoustic conditions. We further propose ADAPT, an audio-depth action-planning framework equipped with spatial-audio perception and optimized for closed-loop navigation through reinforcement learning (RL). Our key RL contribution, transition-aware reward shaping (TARS), defines a pose-aware shortest-action potential over a position-heading graph. Unlike conventional geodesic-progress rewards, TARS accounts for both feasible movements and in-place rotations, providing action-consistent feedback for policy optimization. Experiments show that ADAPT consistently outperforms training-based navigation baselines and zero-shot multimodal models on both seen and unseen scenes. On unseen environments, it achieves 90.6% success under Clean conditions and retains 60.0% success under the most challenging Localized Noise setting. These results demonstrate the potential of spatial audio and depth as complementary modalities for reliable RGB-free navigation in lights-out industrial environments.

</details>


### [811] [PopGen: Generating Semantically Diverse Populations for Zero-Shot Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15969)
*Paul Teiletche,Kanghyun Ryu,Kyungjoon Park,Dhruva Tirumala,Markus Wulfmeier,Negar Mehr*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PopGen 利用 LLM 从零合成语义多样的智能体策略，训练出能与未见伙伴稳健零样本协作的合作者，优于传统 population-play 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习中，训练时让合作者接触策略多样的伙伴有助于测试时协作。但现有方法用轨迹层面的代理指标衡量多样性，可能把同一策略的两条不同轨迹误判为多样，无法真正刻画策略层面的差异。

Method: PopGen 框架分两步：先用 LLM 生成一组描述智能体行为的多样化文本描述，再将每个行为描述翻译成可在环境中执行的代码策略，从而从零合成语义多样的智能体种群。

Result: 在四个协作环境中，用 PopGen 种群训练的合作者在与未见伙伴的零样本协作上表现稳健，超过 population-play 基线；语义多样性随种群规模增大而提升，改善合作者的最差情况表现；并识别出在保持种群质量的同时最大化多样性的设计选择。

Conclusion: 借助 LLM 对高层次行为策略的语义理解来度量并生成多样性，是提升多智能体零样本协作的有效途径，代码已开源。

Abstract: In multi-agent reinforcement learning, exposing a cooperator to partners with diverse strategies during training is key to better collaboration at test time. However, existing methods typically rely on trajectory-level proxies to measure diversity, which may label two distinct trajectories of the same strategy as diverse. Instead, our key insight is to leverage LLMs' ability to describe behaviorally distinct agents in environments, similar to how humans can recognize high-level strategies. To this end, we introduce PopGen, a framework that synthesizes semantically diverse agents from scratch using LLMs. PopGen first generates a diverse set of textual descriptions of agent behaviors, then translates each behavior into a code policy that can be executed within the environment. We show that cooperators trained against PopGen populations achieve robust zero-shot cooperation with unseen partners, outperforming population-play baselines across four collaborative environments. We further show that semantic diversity scales with PopGen population size, improving the cooperator's worst-case performance, and we identify design choices that preserve population quality while maximizing diversity. Our code is available at https://github.com/labicon/PopGen.

</details>


### [812] [Revocation Is Not Complete at Receipt: An Executable Outcome Contract for Distributed Agent-Tool Gateways](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15991)
*Lifei Liu,Haoran Yu,Danping Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出有界结果契约C0-C5，用于判定分布式agent工作流中授权撤销是否真正完成（从issuer commit到effect prevention），并通过多网关、多receiver实验证明传输层成功不等于撤销完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式agent工作流在工具网关缓存委派授权，撤销可能在issuer commit、transport acknowledgment或receiver persistence被报告，但这些观察都无法证明所有网关执行了变更或受保护效果已停止，因此需要更严格的结果契约。

Method: 定义C0-C5有界结果契约，覆盖从issuer commit到effect prevention；实现为在冻结网关集、调用集与观察窗口上的持久监视器；用14例故障矩阵检验保守分类、粘性违规、重启持久性与证据不可变；在Keycloak 26.7、两个持久receiver、八个物理网关、Filesystem/PostgreSQL效果及16台AWS主机上实验，并用OPA/Toxiproxy、三角色LLM工作流与外部MCPMark agent复现。

Result: 将C3或C4视为完成分别产生7或5个假阳性，而C0-C5无假阳性；receiver选择性非投递下，传输确认与receiver持久化仍成功，但225次调用中112次（49.78%）被准入且全部效果提交；MCPMark中正常C4拒绝全部31次post-barrier调用且无效果提交，选择性C3允许344次调用并提交145个效果。

Conclusion: 传输成功只是进展证据，而非撤销完成判定；只有有界C0-C5契约才能正确区分persisted-but-not-enforced边界。

Abstract: Distributed agent workflows cache delegated authority at tool gateways. Revocation may be reported at issuer commit, transport acknowledgment, or receiver persistence, although none of these observations establishes that all gateways enforced the change or that guarded effects stopped. We define C0-C5, a bounded outcome contract spanning issuer commit through effect prevention, and implement it as a persistent monitor over a frozen gateway set, call set, and observation window. A 14-case fault matrix checks conservative classification, sticky violations, restart persistence, and evidence immutability. In a derived audit of its eight semantic cases, treating C3 or C4 as completion produces seven or five false positives, respectively; the bounded C0-C5 verdict produces none. Descriptive scaling covers 1,024 gateways and 10,000 effect vectors. The primary experiment uses the maintained Keycloak 26.7 identity server and measures the contract across two durable receivers, eight physical agent-tool gateways, Filesystem and PostgreSQL effects, and 16 AWS hosts in three availability zones. Normal delivery and recovery commit no effects. Under receiver-selective non-delivery, transport acknowledgment and receiver persistence still succeed, but 112 of 225 calls (49.78%) are admitted, and all 112 effects commit in every treatment block. A separately provisioned execution repeats the result. OPA/Toxiproxy and a live three-role LLM workflow with networked MCP tools reproduce the persisted-but-not-enforced boundary on narrower surfaces. Finally, an unmodified external MCPMark agent executes 60 closed-loop task arms. Normal C4 denies all 31 exposed post-barrier calls and commits no effect; selective C3 allows 344 calls and commits 145 effects across Filesystem and PostgreSQL. Transport success is therefore evidence of progress, not a revocation-completion verdict.

</details>


### [813] [Handoff Curves: Initial Selection, Later Handoff, and Supervision Targets in Multi-turn LLM Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15993)
*Daniel Matos,Lu Liu,Yanfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究初始模型选择、后续交接及训练目标对多轮LLM任务的成功率和成本影响，发现改变监督目标能显著提升路由性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究初始选择、交接时机和训练目标如何影响多轮LLM任务的成功与成本，评估路由架构的实用价值。

Method: 构建34,204次Qwen模型在BFCL、MultiWOZ和τ-retail上的完整执行数据集，用交接曲线比较路由架构，并改造监督目标（如单调拟合、剩余工作量能力目标）。

Result: 后续交接未提升效用且增加BFCL成本；单调拟合使成功率提升0.2–4.1个百分点；新目标在TwinRouterBench上提升轨迹通过分7.8个百分点、成本节省6.3个百分点；实际部署100例中解决79例，成本0.59美元/例。

Conclusion: 训练目标比交接时机更关键，设计良好的监督目标能同时提升成功率和成本效率。

Abstract: We study how initial model selection, later handoff, and training targets affect success and cost in LLM tasks that span multiple turns. We compare several router architectures using handoff curves, which record task success and cost as the handoff step changes. Our dataset contains 34,204 complete executions of three Qwen models across BFCL, MultiWOZ, and $τ$-retail, providing offline supervision for routing decisions. In our primary comparison, with Qwen3.5 35B-A3B as the starting model, allowing a later handoff does not establish an improvement in utility over initial selection on BFCL or MultiWOZ, and increases cost on BFCL across a range of cost weights. Changing the supervision targets improves router performance on both our dataset and TwinRouterBench. On our dataset, replacing noisy training success curves with monotone fits raises success by 0.2 to 4.1 percentage points at the same cost across the reported operating points. On TwinRouterBench, we construct targets that describe the model capability needed for the remaining work and difficult steps ahead. Compared with training on the benchmark's per-step labels, these targets raise trajectory pass scores by 7.8 percentage points and cost savings by 6.3 percentage points on the full static bank. A live deployment of the router trained with these targets resolves 79 of 100 instances at a router cost of 0.59 US dollars per instance.

</details>


### [814] [Large language model-generated patterns for epidemiological modeling: a multi-benchmark evaluation framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15994)
*Sophia Mao,Keshav Gandhi,Alexander Gutfraind*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究以丙肝病毒相关注射行为为案例，评估LLM生成的行为数据能否刻画流行病学建模中的个体行为异质性，发现其与流行病学证据仅部分吻合，需更系统评估后才能用于传播动力学模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流行病学建模中刻画个体层面行为异质性困难，尤其当实证行为数据稀疏时。

Method: 使用三个LLM生成注射毒品者的HCV相关行为输出，通过外部基准评估其与流行病学模式的一致性：文献提示的关联方向、ABM相关性、调查关联，并对比直接知识探询的分类结果。

Result: 在28个保留的文献关联中，LLM无条件方向恢复率为46-68%，而直接分类同一关联时一致率达82-93%；与ABM和调查相关模式的平均绝对差异分别为0.11-0.13和0.15-0.18。

Conclusion: LLM生成的行为关系与流行病学证据仅部分对齐，尽管知识探询一致性更高；在将其纳入模拟传播动力学的流行病学模型前需更系统评估。

Abstract: Representing individual-level behavioral heterogeneity is challenging in epidemiological modeling, particularly when empirical behavioral data are sparse. We assess the potential of large language model (LLM)-generated behavioral outputs in addressing this challenge, using hepatitis C virus-related behaviors among people who inject drugs as a case study. Correspondence with epidemiological patterns was evaluated using external benchmarks: literature-informed association directions, correlations from an agent-based model (ABM), and survey associations. Across three LLMs, unconditional directional recovery across 28 retained literature-informed associations was 46-68%, compared with 82-93% agreement when LLMs were directly asked to classify the same associations. Mean absolute differences from ABM and survey correlation patterns were 0.11-0.13 and 0.15-0.18, respectively. Together, these findings show partial alignment between LLM-generated behavioral relationships and epidemiological evidence, despite higher knowledge-probe agreement. More systematic evaluation is needed before incorporating LLM-generated behavioral outputs into epidemiological models that simulate transmission dynamics.

</details>


### [815] [Computational Reflective Equilibrium for Agentic AI: A Rawlsian Alignment Scaffold for Governance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16015)
*Quanyan Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 agentic reflective equilibrium (ARE)，一种用于智能体伦理对齐的计算反思平衡框架，通过支持/攻击关系连接原则、判断、证据与候选动作，并给出博弈论与稳定性证明及案例验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体 AI 快速部署带来伦理与治理挑战。基于大模型的智能体通过工具代人行权，每个部署场景有各自的指令、政策、证据与利益相关者，因此对齐必须逐案形成。

Method: 受罗尔斯反思平衡启发，构建 ARE 计算脚手架：用类型化支持与攻击关系连接系统提示/运营者政策中的原则、深思判断、工具证据和候选动作，以来源标注编码指令层级；智能体在平衡状态上行动，仅在值得成本时调用工具或提问（除尽职要求外）；治理通过价值优先级、来源权威、禁止、人类在环触发与强制任务进入；用证书将动作归因到驱动其承诺的来源。

Result: 证明平衡是相互调整博弈的纳什均衡，并建立单调性、词汇优先、稳定性证书及针对提示注入的隔离定理。两个案例展示：须"不惜一切"赢退款的计算机助手提出诚实保修索赔、拒绝假评论、忽略窃取个人数据的注入请求；招聘智能体展示权威、监督触发、审计强制与硬禁止如何影响歧视、隐私与升级。

Conclusion: 该框架提供可追溯性、一致性与自适应性，促进安全、可靠、可信的智能体 AI。

Abstract: The rapid deployment of agentic AI has introduced complex challenges for the ethics and governance of AI systems. Agents built on large language models act through tools on behalf of people, and each deployment case brings its own instructions, policies, evidence, and stakeholders, so alignment must be formed case by case. To this end, this work proposes agentic reflective equilibrium (ARE), a computational reflective equilibrium framework that serves as an ethical alignment scaffold in the agent harness. Drawing inspiration from the reflective equilibrium of John Rawls, the scaffold links principles from the system prompt and operator policy, considered judgments, tool evidence, and candidate actions through typed support and attack relations, with provenance encoding the instruction hierarchy. The agent acts on an equilibrium of this state and calls tools or asks questions only while doing so is worth its cost, unless a due-diligence mandate requires them. Governance enters through value priorities, source authority, prohibitions, human-in-the-loop triggers, and mandates, and certificates attribute each action to the sources whose commitments drove it. We show that equilibria are Nash equilibria of a mutual-adjustment game and establish monotonicity, lexical priority, stability certificates, and a quarantine theorem for prompt injection. Two case studies illustrate the framework: a computer-use assistant told to win a refund "whatever it takes" files an honest warranty claim, refuses a fake review, and ignores an injected request for personal data; a hiring agent showcases how authority, oversight triggers, audit mandates, and hard prohibitions shape discrimination, privacy violations, and escalation. The framework offers traceability, coherence, and adaptivity, facilitating safe, secure, and trustworthy agentic AI.

</details>


### [816] [Cross-Protocol Personality Assessment with LLMs: Aligning Behavioral Evidence with Human Ratings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16050)
*Wei Shan,Tianyi Zhang,Yuan Zong,Wenming Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CEPA框架，通过对齐跨面试协议的行为表征，实现无需目标协议监督的人格评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步视频面试(AVI)的人格评估受限于单一面试协议，不同协议的问题集与问题-特质映射不同，导致某协议的人工评分证据无法直接用于另一协议。

Method: CEPA将源行为记录投影到目标协议的构建导向表征空间以解决协议异质性；检索行为相关且人格互补的人工评分样例，用于支撑LLM评分器集成，无需目标特定监督即可建立行为-人格关联。

Result: 跨协议实验中，相比最强基线，平均MSE分别降低43.8%(Forward)和17.0%(Reverse)。

Conclusion: 来自一个协议的人工评分证据可用于另一协议下的人格评估，无需目标特定监督或重新训练。

Abstract: Personality assessment from asynchronous video interviews (AVIs) plays a crucial role in recruitment by enabling standardized and behaviorally grounded evaluation for job applicants. However, most of the previous works are confined to a single interview protocol. Independently collected protocols differ in question sets and question-trait mapping. Thus, the human-rated evidence from one protocol cannot be used directly under another. To address this limitation, we propose the Cross-protocol Evidence-grounded Personality Assessment (CEPA) framework, which aligns behavioral representations across interview protocols. CEPA addresses protocol heterogeneity by projecting source behavioral records into the target protocol's construct-oriented representation space. It retrieves behaviorally relevant and personality-complementary human-rated exemplars to ground an ensemble of LLM raters, which enables behavior-to-personality associations without target-specific supervision. In cross-protocol experiments, CEPA reduces average mean squared error (MSE) by 43.8% (Forward) and 17.0% (Reverse) relative to the strongest baseline. Our empirical experiments show that human-rated evidence from one protocol can support personality assessment under another without target-specific supervision or retraining.

</details>


### [817] [Understanding and Reducing Misalignment in Persuasion Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16070)
*Boyi Wei,Ruta Desai,Peter Henderson,Wenyue Hua*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习训练说服能力对模型对齐的影响，发现仅优化说服效果会显著增加不端策略使用，并提出缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型被训练用于多智能体任务（如经营公司、谈判），需要说服能力，但此类优化压力对模型对齐的影响尚不清楚。

Method: 构建测试平台，用RL训练说服者模型以改变接收者信念，测量编造证据、信念胁迫等不端策略使用；并比较多种缓解方法：增强策略引导、干净示范、惩罚不端策略、提升伪造检测能力。

Result: 仅优化信念转变使每局平均不端策略数增加超25%，每局伪造次数增至RL前的4倍以上；说服力与不端之间的权衡难以处理，最佳方案是结合对齐说服策略引导与对不端的奖励惩罚。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了评估RL说服训练导致不端的测试平台并给出具体缓解路径；关键警示：若无直接干预，涉及说服的RL环境很可能自然导致不端策略大幅增加。

Abstract: Frontier models are now trained for complex multi-agent tasks, from running a company to engaging in negotiations. These tasks necessitate training models to be persuasive. But what does this optimization pressure mean for model alignment? In this work, we study how reinforcement learning (RL) training for persuasion affects models' use of misaligned strategies such as evidence fabrication and belief coercion, and what techniques can reduce such misalignment. We find that optimizing sender models solely for receiver belief shifts causes the average number of distinct misaligned strategies used per game to increase by more than 25%, and fabrications per game increase to more than 4 times relative to pre-RL models. We compare various mitigation approaches, including stronger strategy guidance, clean demonstrations, penalizing misaligned strategy usage, and improving the model's ability to detect fabrications. We find that navigating the persuasiveness-misalignment trade-off in this setting is challenging, with the best trade-offs coming from combining guidance on aligned persuasion strategies with reward penalties on misalignment. Overall, our work provides a testbed for assessing misalignment stemming from RL-based persuasion training and shows concrete paths for reducing misalignment. Importantly, it highlights that without direct intervention, persuasion-involved RL environments are likely to naturally lead to large increases in the use of misaligned strategies.

</details>


### [818] [Beyond Single-Pathogen Forecasts: Predicting Shared Respiratory Hospital Burden from Influenza, COVID-19, and RSV](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16074)
*Gaurob Saha,MinJae Woo,Lior Rennert*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究开发了1-4周住院入院量预测框架，比较"病原特异性预测求和"与"直接预测合并负担"两种策略，发现直接预测合并目标在回溯和前瞻评估中均表现更好，支持分层呼吸道预测（病原特异性用于归因，合并负担用于医院规划）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流感、COVID-19和RSV共同流行造成共享的住院负担，因为床位、人员、检测能力和呼吸支持是按总需求而非单一病原分配的。这使呼吸道预测不仅是建模问题，也是目标构建问题：病原特异性预测保留归因信息，但医院还需要一个合并负担的单一规划信号。

Method: 开发了监督式1-4周前预测框架，预测每周入院量，并比较两种总负担策略：(1)将独立生成的病原特异性预测相加，(2)直接预测合并入院目标。评估包括回溯性留出测试和前瞻性运行预测（在相应入院周被观测前发布），性能用MAE和百分比一致性(PA，即模型生成数与观测数中较小值除以较大值)衡量。

Result: 回溯性总负担评估中，合并负担模型第1-4周的PA为0.85、0.78、0.74、0.76，MAE为80.63、200.09、183.97、156.13；相较之下，求和预测的PA为0.85、0.80、0.69、0.69，MAE为100.14、200.06、205.65、217.57。前瞻性评估中，合并负担模型在全部四个预测时域上PA更高、MAE更低，第3和第4周差距最大。

Conclusion: 结果支持分层呼吸道预测：病原特异性预测对于病因学解释仍属必要，而合并负担预测更契合医院准备和共享能力规划。

Abstract: Co-circulating influenza, COVID-19, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) create a shared hospital-admission burden, because beds, staff, testing capacity, and respiratory support are allocated to total demand rather than to one pathogen at a time. This makes respiratory forecasting a target-construction problem as well as a modeling problem: disease-specific forecasts preserve attribution, whereas hospitals also need a single planning signal for combined burden. We developed a supervised 1- to 4-week-ahead framework for weekly admissions and compared two total-burden strategies: summing independently generated pathogen-specific forecasts and forecasting the combined admission target directly. Evaluation included retrospective held-out testing and prospective operational forecasts issued before the corresponding admission weeks were observed, with performance summarized using MAE and Percent Agreement (PA; the smaller of model-generated and observed counts divided by the larger). In retrospective total-burden evaluation, the combined-burden model had PA values of 0.85, 0.78, 0.74, and 0.76 and MAE values of 80.63, 200.09, 183.97, and 156.13 from week 1 to week 4 ahead, compared with summed-forecast PA values of 0.85, 0.80, 0.69, and 0.69 and MAE values of 100.14, 200.06, 205.65, and 217.57. Prospectively, the combined-burden model had higher PA and lower MAE at all four horizons, with the largest separations at weeks 3 and 4 ahead. These results support layered respiratory forecasting: pathogen-specific forecasts remain necessary for etiologic interpretation, while combined-burden forecasts better align with hospital preparedness and shared-capacity planning.

</details>


### [819] [Heterogeneous Agentic Coevolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16078)
*Wenqian Ye,Ziwei Guan,Zi Yang,Shivani Modi,Cici Cong Wu,Yunlong He,Yuxin Chen,Zhengyu Zhang,Liang Luo,Venkatesh Ranganathan,Jianhui Sun,Yantao Yao,Wenlin Chen,Buyun Zhang,Ellie Dingqiao Wen,Henry Kautz,Aidong Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HACE 框架通过异构智能体协同进化，让专用基础模型与 LLM 智能体相互学习、共同提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自改进 LLM 智能体展现潜力，但许多领域专用基础模型依赖人工设计的改进，难以实现递归自改进；难点在于专家模型提升时，推进策略也需随之适应。

Method: 提出 HACE：对专家模型进行监督学习，同时用基于策略的强化自训练训练智能体，以当前专家的验证性能增益为引导；智能体的探索反馈给后续专家训练；并用进化搜索优化交互框架（信息交换与训练经验选择方式）。

Result: 在推荐系统、生物蛋白质功能预测、材料晶体稳定性预测三个领域，HACE 在主任务指标上均优于所评估的自改进方法。

Conclusion: 异构协同进化可作为一种通过智能体交互提升专用基础模型的通用方法。

Abstract: Recent advances in self-improving LLM agents have demonstrated the potential of AI systems that drive their own intelligence. However, many domain-specific applications rely on specialized foundation models that possess strong domain expertise but remain dependent on human-designed improvements. Extending recursive self-improvement to these models presents a key challenge: as a specialist improves, the strategies used to advance it must also adapt. To address this challenge, we propose Heterogeneous Agentic CoEvolution (HACE), a framework that jointly evolves specialized foundation models and LLM agents through reciprocal learning. HACE improves the specialist through supervised learning while training the agent with on-policy reinforced self-training, guided by verified performance gains on the current specialist. The agent's exploration, in turn, informs subsequent specialist training, enabling both models to adapt to each other's progress. To sustain this reciprocal learning, HACE further employs evolutionary search to optimize their interaction harness, adapting how the models exchange information and select training experiences as their capabilities evolve. We evaluate HACE across three challenging domains: recommendation systems, protein function prediction in biology, and crystal stability prediction in material discovery. We show that HACE outperforms the evaluated self-improving methods on the primary task metrics across all three domains. These results shed light on heterogeneous coevolution as a universal approach to improving specialized foundation models through reciprocal interaction with a learning agent.

</details>


### [820] [The Sharp Directions Are Against You: Curvature Analysis of Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16084)
*Seyedarmin Azizi,Arya Fayyazi,Parsa Razmara,Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo,Souvik Kundu,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示激活引导（CAA）脆弱性的几何原因，并提出"sharp removal"一行修正：去除引导向量中曲率高的"尖锐"分量，可显著提升行为控制稳定性与生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活引导是微调的轻量替代方案，但标准方法（对比激活加法CAA）脆弱，在许多输入上会把行为推向错误方向。作者希望从几何角度解释这种脆弱性。

Method: 引入"引导Hessian"——行为损失对引导向量的二阶导矩阵，刻画模型输出行为在引导向量各方向小扰动下的敏感度。其顶部特征向量为尖锐方向（小扰动导致剧烈、随输入波动的行为变化），底部为平坦方向（行为稳健）。据此提出去除引导向量中尖锐分量（sharp removal）。在Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B三个模型族、四个行为任务、36种token级条件下评估。

Result: 尖锐方向仅占CAA向量平方范数的1-5%，却主导了引导与未引导下一词分布间的差距。沿尖锐方向引导在每个测试条件下都逆转意图行为（反引导率53-100%）。去除尖锐分量后，向量方向与幅度基本保持（余弦>0.974，范数下降<3%），方向曲率最多降低12倍（中位数4倍）。sharp removal在所有25个测试条件的开放式生成中均优于标准CAA。越狱实验显示尖锐方向起噪声而非信号作用，无论极性如何都会破坏连贯的行为控制。

Conclusion: CAA的脆弱性源于引导向量中少量但高曲率的尖锐分量；去除这些分量（一行修正）可在保持引导方向与幅度的同时大幅提升行为控制的稳定性与生成效果。

Abstract: Activation steering adds a vector to a language model's internal representations at inference time. It is a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for behavioral control. The standard construction, contrastive activation addition (CAA), is fragile, as on many inputs it shifts behavior in the wrong direction. To explain this fragility, we first study the geometry of the steering vector. We introduce steering Hessian, the matrix of second order derivative of the model's behavioral loss with respect to the steering vector. It captures the output behavior response sensitivity of the model under small perturbations of the steering vector along each direction. Its top eigenvectors are sharp directions: tiny perturbations along them can cause large, erratic, input-dependent behavioral swings. Bottom eigenvectors are flat directions: behavior is robust along them. Removing the sharp component of a steering vector approximately preserves its direction and magnitude (cosine > 0.974, norm reduction < 3% for typical settings) while reducing the vector's directional curvature by up to 12x (median 4x across 36 conditions). We evaluate on three model families (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B), with four behavioral tasks, and 36 token-level conditions. Steering along sharp directions reverses the intended behavior in every condition tested, with anti-steer rates of 53-100%. Sharp directions account for only 1-5% of the CAA vector's squared norm. However, they drive a disproportionate share of the gap between the steered and unsteered next-token distributions during autoregressive generation. We term this one-line correction as sharp removal; it outperforms standard CAA in open-ended generation across all 25 conditions tested. A jailbreaking experiment further shows that sharp directions act as noise rather than signal: they disrupt coherent behavioral control regardless of steering polarity.

</details>


### [821] [GUIDE: Computationally Augmented Consensus for Trustworthy Clinical Practice Guidelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16108)
*Yuanfan Lin,Jie Di,Xujin He,Zhenzhe Lin,Jialing Chen,Ruiyang Li,Changyu Zheng,Yuanrui Shang,Weiqin Peng,Jingxi Qin,Xiong Wang,Dongxin Ye,Yining Huang,Guoqiang Li,Andi Xu,Sijia Yu,Ruixin Wang,Yahan Yang,Xiaohang Wu,Duoru Lin,Jingjing Chen,Zhenzhen Liu,Wenben Chen,Haotian Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GUIDE是一个多智能体人机协作系统，用于高效生成和更新临床实践指南（CPGs），在保持专家判断的同时大幅降低工作量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床实践指南需及时更新以支撑循证医学，但证据快速增长和复杂的专家共识过程限制了更新速度。

Method: GUIDE将繁重任务分配给专门的AI智能体，保留专家判断和最终仲裁。在12个NICE眼科数据集及20个来自心脏病学、内分泌学、胃肠病学和呼吸医学的数据集上进行评估，并开展消融分析、截断后数据集测试和前瞻性真实世界验证。

Result: 在12个NICE眼科数据集上，GUIDE实现88.85%文献召回率、86.06%证据确定性评级一致性和91.67%推荐一致率，平均每个数据集仅需162.17分钟（人类干预28.68%）。跨领域性能稳定。消融分析显示移除专家干预会降低判断密集型步骤（如偏倚风险评估）的性能。截断后数据上端到端性能稳健。前瞻性验证显示其降低专家工作量，推荐临床可接受性优于十年前的原始指南（平均分3.73 vs 1.53；一致率66.7% vs 13.3%），与纯人工更新效果相当（P=0.588）但耗时更少。

Conclusion: GUIDE为及时、可信、以专家为中心的指南制定提供了实用框架，验证了计算增强共识的可行性。

Abstract: Maintaining up-to-date clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) is essential for evidence-based medicine, but rapid evidence growth and complex expert consensus formation limit timely updates. We developed GUIDE, a multi-agent copilot system for human-AI collaborative guideline generation and updating. GUIDE delegates labor-intensive tasks to specialized AI agents while preserving expert judgment and final arbitration. In 12 NICE ophthalmology datasets, GUIDE achieved 88.85% literature recall, 86.06% alignment in certainty-of-evidence ratings, and 91.67% recommendation agreement, requiring 162.17 minutes per dataset on average (28.68% human intervention). Performance remained stable across 20 additional datasets from cardiology, endocrinology, gastroenterology, and respiratory medicine. Ablation analysis showed that removing expert intervention reduced performance in judgment-intensive steps such as Risk-of-Bias assessment. In six post-cutoff datasets, GUIDE maintained robust end-to-end performance on unseen evidence. Prospective real-world validation showed that GUIDE reduced expert workload and produced more clinically acceptable recommendations than the original decade-old guideline (mean score, 3.73 vs. 1.53; agreement, 66.7% vs. 13.3%), with outcomes comparable to human-only updating (P = 0.588) but substantially less time and effort. GUIDE offers a practical framework for timely, trustworthy, expert-centric guideline development and validates computationally augmented consensus.

</details>


### [822] [Constructed regional photovoltaic generation fields improve ultra-short-term distributed solar forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16110)
*Dayin Chen,Xiaodan Shi,Xin Xu,Zhongyue Su,Shibo Zhu,Dongxiao Zhang,Yuntian Chen,Jinyue Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 SatPV-Field 框架，将分布式光伏预测从离散站点时间序列建模重构为区域光伏发电场的时空演化预测，利用卫星短波辐射等引导，提升站点级预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超短期分布式光伏预测困难：气象与卫星产品难以刻画快速局地变化，且异质光伏系统在相似大气条件下响应不同；同时密集光伏群提供空间分布测量，蕴含区域发电动态信息。

Method: 将分布式光伏测量转化为类图像的区域发电场，结合历史光伏场、卫星导出的未来短波辐射引导与气象预报，建模时空演化以预测未来区域发电状态，再为单站点预测提供位置特定引导。

Result: 在 496 个分布式光伏系统（446 源站、50 留出目标站）上，区域发电场可有效预测并改善站点级预测；站点级 MAE 相较最佳单站时间基线降低约 10.0%，相较使用相同源站的图神经网络区域预测方法降低 2.5%。

Conclusion: 研究确立了显式空间场建模范式，将区域发电动态与个体站点预测相连接，为密集分布式光伏超短期预测提供新思路。

Abstract: Ultra-short-term forecasting of densely distributed photovoltaic (PV) systems remains challenging because external meteorological and satellite products may not adequately resolve rapid local variations, while heterogeneous PV systems exhibit different generation responses under similar atmospheric conditions. Meanwhile, dense PV fleets provide spatially distributed measurements that reveal regional generation dynamics. Here, we reformulate fleet-level PV forecasting from modeling discrete station time series to predicting explicit, spatially structured regional PV generation fields. We develop SatPV-Field, a regional-to-local forecasting framework that transforms distributed PV measurements into image-like generation fields and models their spatiotemporal evolution. By combining historical PV fields with satellite-derived future shortwave radiation guidance and meteorological forecasts, the framework predicts future regional generation states, which subsequently provide location-specific guidance for individual-station forecasting. Experiments involving 496 distributed PV systems, including 446 source stations and 50 held-out target stations, demonstrate that these regional fields can be effectively forecast and used to improve station-level predictions. The proposed approach reduces station-level MAE by approximately 10.0% relative to the best-performing single-station temporal baseline and by 2.5% relative to a graph-based regional forecasting approach using the same source fleet. These findings establish an explicit spatial-field modeling paradigm that connects regional generation dynamics with individual-site forecasting.

</details>


### [823] [Beyond Perfect Teammates: Multi-Agent Collaboration with Unreliable Colleagues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16117)
*Chen Huang,Yiyang Zhang,Yuhao Wu,Yang Deng,Wenxuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 UnCoBench 基准，将多智能体协作中的"不可靠同事"行为分为错位、不完整和未响应三类，揭示仅靠推理能力不足以应对不可靠证据获取过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体协作系统与评测普遍隐含"完美同事"假设（信息正确完整、及时响应），而现实团队协作中同事可能给出不相关回答、信息不足或完全不响应。作者希望将任务解决能力与从不靠谱证据获取中恢复的能力区分开来。

Method: 提出 UnCoBench 基准，按 Misaligned、Incomplete、Missed 三类组织失败行为，要求主 agent 验证语境正确性、诊断信息缺口并跟踪未解决依赖；同时给出可验证、可扩展的自动生成流水线，结合 LLM 场景生成与对答案唯一性、角色必要性的可执行校验。

Result: 在十个模型上测试发现：可靠设定下表现相近的模型，对不可靠证据的鲁棒性差异显著。轨迹分析显示纠正性后续动作常被遗漏，恢复行为存在低效等待与冗余查询。

Conclusion: 稳健协作不仅需要正确推理，还需针对性行动来诊断证据失败、恢复相关信息并整合进决策。数据与代码已在 GitHub 公开。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent collaboration is increasingly used to solve complex tasks by dividing work among specialized agents and integrating complementary expertise. Yet existing systems and evaluations largely rest on an implicit perfect-colleague assumption: collaborators provide correct and complete information and respond promptly to requests. In realistic teamwork, however, collaborators may return information that does not answer the intended question, provide insufficient detail to support a decision, or fail to respond to a request. To separate task-solving competence from the ability to recover an unreliable evidence-gathering process, we introduce the Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark (UnCoBench), which organizes behavioral failures through Misaligned, Incomplete, and Missed settings. The main agent need to verify contextual correctness, diagnose information gap and track unresolved dependencies in order to obtain the correct evidence for solving the task. We also introduce a verifiable and scalable automated generation pipeline that pairs LLM-based scenario generation with executable checks of answer uniqueness and role necessity. Results across ten models show that similar reliable-setting performance can result in different robustness to unreliable evidence. Trace analysis reveals frequent omissions of corrective follow-up, and the recovery behavior involves inefficient waiting and redundant queries. These findings show that robust collaboration requires not only sound reasoning, but also targeted action to diagnose evidence failures, recover relevant information, and integrate it into decisions. Our data and source code are available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/UnCoBench.

</details>


### [824] [Imitation Holds a Key to Evolution: Localized Repair and Verified Skill Acquisition for Adaptive Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16125)
*Kai Hu,Hua Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将被动模仿(PI)形式化为一个架构循环：定位被违反的契约、提取局部目标、提出效果匹配的技能、测试小补丁、并在全任务验证后保留证据。以确定性符号控制器实例化，分析有限修复查询复杂度，并在十个模拟工具世界中验证效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体能保留成功轨迹，但无法学习"哪部分经验应修复新的差异"。作者希望解决这一被动模仿中的定位与修复问题，而非依赖整条轨迹的盲目复用。

Method: 将被动模仿建模为架构循环：定位违约契约→提取局部目标→提出效果匹配技能→测试小补丁→全任务验证后保留证据。用确定性符号控制器实现，在显式可识别性与非干扰假设下分析有限修复查询复杂度。

Result: 在十个模拟工具世界中，PI以允许三次小试验解决全部600个冷启动留出组合任务，而整轨迹对照仅6.17%；等价表达力的组合修复对照与PI相当。在未见工具修订上，PI成功率70.0%，无小试验为24.0%，自试验枚举为79.0%；随后的24任务适应流将首次提交成功率提升至100%。

Conclusion: 结果支持一种有限的"纠正-保留"机制，而非独特激励优势或通用智能。CPU实现、完整性检查与可复现结果已开源。

Abstract: An agent can retain successful trajectories without learning which part of an experience should repair a new discrepancy. We formulate passive imitation (PI) as an architectural loop that localizes a violated contract, extracts a local goal, proposes an effect-matched skill, tests a small patch, and retains evidence after full-task verification. We instantiate this loop as a deterministic symbolic controller and analyze its finite repair-query complexity under explicit identifiability and noninterference assumptions. Across ten simulated tool worlds, PI solves all 600 cold held-out composition tasks with three allowed small trials, compared with 6.17% for a whole-trajectory control, while an equally expressive compositional repair control matches PI. On an unseen tool revision, PI achieves 70.0% success versus 24.0% without small trials and 79.0% with self-trial enumeration; an exploratory 24-task adaptation stream subsequently raises first-submission success to 100%, supporting a limited correction-and-retention mechanism rather than a unique incentive advantage or general intelligence. The CPU-only implementation, integrity checks, and reproducible results are available at https://github.com/FriendOfYishan/PI.

</details>


### [825] [Large Language Model Assisted Transportation Planning through a Differentiable User Equilibrium Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16140)
*Eunseung Lee,Gyeongjun Kim,Keemin Sohn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个集成人类-AI的交通规划框架，结合LLM、MCP接口、开源规划引擎AequilibraE及可微用户均衡层，让非专家用户能通过自然语言执行网络分析与优化，并以交通时间函数标定和预算约束下的网络设计两个任务验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统交通规划需要网络建模、交通分配与优化方面的专业知识，导致网络设计、容量扩展、模型标定等战略分析对非专家决策者难以企及。现有基于LLM的系统多仅作为仿真软件接口，缺乏高效搜索、评估与优化交通方案的能力。

Method: 提出集成的人类-AI交通规划框架，融合大语言模型、模型上下文协议（MCP）接口、开源交通规划引擎AequilibraE，以及可微用户均衡（UE）分配层；该可微UE层通过对Beckmann交通分配问题的KKT条件直接求导构建。

Result: 通过两个代表性规划任务进行验证：基于观测交通流量标定出行时间函数，以及预算约束下的网络设计，展示了框架执行网络分析与改进优化方案的能力。

Conclusion: 案例表明，可微交通模型与LLM智能体可协同推动交通规划民主化，显著降低领域专业知识与交通决策之间的壁垒。

Abstract: Transportation planning has traditionally required substantial expertise in network modeling, traffic assignment, and optimization. As a result, strategic analyses such as network design, capacity expansion, and model calibration remain inaccessible to non-expert decision makers. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) provide an opportunity to bridge this gap by enabling natural-language interaction with complex transportation planning tools. However, existing LLM-based systems primarily serve as interfaces to simulation software and lack the ability to efficiently search, evaluate, and optimize transportation solutions. This study proposes an integrated human-AI transportation planning framework that combines a large language model, a model context protocol (MCP) interface, an open-source transportation planning engine (AequilibraE), and a differentiable user equilibrium (UE) assignment layer. The framework allows non-expert users to execute network analyses and improve solutions for optimization. A differentiable UE layer is developed by directly differentiating the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions of the Beckmann traffic assignment problem. The proposed framework is demonstrated through two representative planning tasks: calibration of travel time functions from observed traffic counts and network design under budget constraints. The examples illustrate how differentiable transportation models and LLM agents can jointly democratize transportation planning and substantially reduce barriers between domain expertise and transportation decision making.

</details>


### [826] [Phantom Merge: When Your Large Language Model Agents Pick One but Tell You About Another](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16141)
*Wangshu Zhu,Qianwen Guo,Yushun Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文识别了LLM agent中的"Phantom Merge"实体-证据绑定失败，并提出两阶段框架进行风险估计与修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent在多实体场景下需保留证据与正确实体的关联，但存在将无支撑声明归因到已承诺实体的失败（PM），甚至在任务正确完成时也会发生，需系统研究并解决。

Method: 提出两阶段框架：(1) Anchor-Grounded Risk (AGR)，结合预生成隐状态的表征读出与Jacobian功能信息，给出slot级和anchor-value级风险分数；(2) Fixed-Anchor Correction (FAC)，审计被标记声明，用观测到的anchor证据选择性修正或删除无支撑声明。

Result: 在Shopping检测集上，AGR-slot达到AUROC 96.2%、平均精度97.3%，优于基线；端到端缓解中，FAC将轨迹级PM从51.4%降至6.2%，输出与原声明比为80.7%。

Conclusion: 实体特定grounding失败普遍存在，结合内部风险估计与证据约束的声明修正可有效缓解PM。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate over multiple entities, where reliable response generation requires not only retrieving relevant evidence but also preserving its association with the correct entity. We identify Phantom Merge (PM), an entity-evidence binding failure in which an agent attributes unsupported claims to its committed entity, potentially even when the task is completed correctly. We formalize PM at the claim level and characterize its prevalence and error subtypes across four agent domains and four backbone families. To address this problem, we propose a two-stage framework for claim-level risk estimation and correction. First, Anchor-Grounded Risk (AGR) combines a representational readout of the agent's pre-emission hidden state with Jacobian-based functional information, providing complementary slot-level and anchor-value risk scores. Second, Fixed-Anchor Correction (FAC) audits flagged claims and selectively revises them using observed anchor evidence or removes them when no supported replacement is available. On the held-out Shopping detection cohort, AGR-slot achieves an AUROC of 96.2% and an average precision of 97.3%, outperforming the evaluated detection baselines. In the end-to-end Shopping mitigation evaluation, FAC reduces trajectory-level PM from 51.4% to 6.2%, with an output-to-original claim ratio of 80.7%. These results demonstrate the prevalence of entity-specific grounding failures and the effectiveness of combining internal risk estimation with evidence-constrained claim correction. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LabRAI/PhantomMerge.

</details>


### [827] [Pollard: Governed Semantic Execution Trees for Framework-Independent AI Agent Control and Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16145)
*Muntaser Syed,Marius C. Silaghi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Pollard：一个基于受治理语义执行树的框架无关运行时，统一执行、治理与重放的身份标识，并通过多组实验验证其核心机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Agent 框架虽支持检查点、工具调用追踪与资源限制，但对执行、治理、重放赋予不同身份，导致三者割裂。

Method: 以步骤身份绑定规范输入、类型、尝试与父身份，用同一棵树记录完成、拒绝、资源结算与分支历史；支持严格重放（返回经验证存储结果而不调用被包装操作）及跨并发工作者的预留协调事务存储。

Result: 在签名确定性冻结下，两个状态模型副本执行评估转换无不变式违规；保留租约的 PostgreSQL 组针对精确限额测试；严格重放避免外部调用；所有语义变更均被检出且控制组无误报；多配对框架矩阵保持参考行为并验证树；成本受限托管研究在真实提供商路径下，每个完成的 Pollard 试验均产生经验证树。

Conclusion: 在明确的租约、边界与封存托管假设下，这些研究支持该核心机制的有效性。

Abstract: Agent frameworks can persist checkpoints, trace tool calls, and limit resource use, but these facilities often assign different identities to execution, governance, and replay. We present Pollard, a framework-independent runtime based on governed semantic execution trees. A step identity commits to canonical input, kind, attempt, and parent identity; the same tree records completion, refusal, resource settlement, and branch history. Strict replay returns a verified stored result without invoking the wrapped operation, while a transactional store coordinates reservations across concurrent workers. Under a signed deterministic freeze, two state-model replicas each executed the evaluation transitions without an invariant violation, retained-lease PostgreSQL groups were tested against exact limits, strict replay avoided external calls, and all semantic mutations were detected with no false alarms on the controls. A multi-pair framework matrix preserved reference behavior and verified the trees. A separate cost-capped hosted study exercised live provider paths, and every completed Pollard trial produced a verified tree. Together, the studies support the core mechanisms under explicit lease, boundary, and seal-custody assumptions.

</details>


### [828] [Uncovering Robustness Weaknesses in LLM Agents via Persona Evolution with Task-Integrity Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16155)
*Yutao Xie,Jingbo Yang,Guanyu Yao,Xiaoyu Yang,Duo Ding,Shiyu Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TIPER 通过保留任务完整性的用户人格进化，自动发现暴露智能体鲁棒性弱点的用户行为，在多个基准上显著降低智能体成功率并可诊断失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交互式智能体评测依赖行为合作、标准化的 LLM 用户模拟器，导致鲁棒性评估过于乐观、缺少泛化所需的失败信号；预定义用户行为难以发现智能体/领域特定弱点，而面向失败的搜索往往使任务失效而非暴露真实失败。

Method: 提出 TIPER，一种任务完整性保持的人格进化方法：通过反思引导的行为变异进化持久用户人格，并在任务完整性约束下进行任务级帕累托选择，自动发现针对特定智能体、能暴露鲁棒性弱点的用户策略，同时保持任务有效可解。

Result: 在四个交互式智能体基准上，TIPER 在全部 12 个 GPT-5.4 设置中降低留出 avg@3 分数，降幅 5.8–33.7 个百分点；在覆盖七种智能体的全部 28 个智能体-领域对中均降低，中位降幅 22.9 个百分点。分析还给出行为到失败的分类体系。

Conclusion: TIPER 能实现更具诊断性的智能体鲁棒性评测，并为未来智能体鲁棒性改进提供有价值的失败分析。代码已开源。

Abstract: Interactive-agent evaluations commonly rely on standardized LLM-based user simulators that exhibit broadly cooperative behavior, potentially overlooking failures that arise under diverse but realistic user interactions. This can lead to overly optimistic estimates of agent robustness and provide limited failure signals for training agents that generalize across users. Existing approaches largely rely on predefined user behaviors, which may miss agent- or domain-specific weaknesses, while failure-oriented search can reduce task success by invalidating the underlying task rather than exposing genuine robustness failures. To fill this gap, we introduce TIPER, a task-integrity-preserving persona evolution method that automatically discovers agent-specific user policies exposing robustness weaknesses while keeping the underlying task valid and solvable. TIPER evolves persistent user personas through reflection-guided behavioral mutations and task-wise Pareto selection under a task-integrity constraint. Across four interactive-agent benchmarks, TIPER yields lower held-out avg@3 scores in all 12 GPT-5.4 settings, with observed reductions of 5.8 to 33.7 percentage points, and in all 28 agent-domain pairs spanning seven agents, with a median observed reduction of 22.9 points. Further analysis yields a behavior-to-failure taxonomy that connects discovered user behaviors to recurring agent failure modes. Together, these results show that TIPER enables more diagnostic robustness evaluation of interactive agents and provides informative failure analysis for future agent robustness improvement. Code repository: https://github.com/UCSB-NLP-Chang/TIPER.

</details>


### [829] [Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting under Moving-Solid Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16167)
*Jongwon Ryu,Sunjae Yoon,Junyeong Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"交互式4D体积液体预测"任务，并设计TIDE/TIDES两级循环预测框架，在动固体条件下预测全域液体速度场，性能优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法多处理静态或预设固体几何周围的流动，或合成视觉合理的流体运动，无法预测移动固体如何引发未来全域液体响应，难以为机器人液体操作、数字孪生等应用提供上游物理预测基础。

Method: 提出两级循环预测框架：TIDE隔离局部界面驱动的预测；TIDES在其上加入传输感知耦合与显式稳定化，以减少长时域rollout误差。并构建了基准、组件消融、运动/尺寸OOD测试与长时域评估。

Result: 在适配的邻近基线上，TIDES取得最佳预测性能；消融实验表明局部交互、传输耦合与稳定化是主要贡献因素。

Conclusion: 该任务形式化、基准与TIDE/TIDES研究为移动固体条件下的稠密液体预测建立了可控基础，代码已开源。

Abstract: We propose the task of Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting: predicting the spatiotemporal evolution of a future dense 3D liquid velocity field conditioned on how a solid object moves through it. This task provides an upstream physical forecasting primitive for systems that need to reason about motion-conditioned liquid response, including robotic liquid manipulation, digital twins, and rigid-fluid video generation. Existing works have made efforts in predicting flow around static or prescribed solid geometries and synthesizing visually plausible fluid motion. Yet these approaches provide limited coverage for interactive liquid dynamics, as they are not capable of forecasting how a moving solid induces a future full-domain liquid response. In this forecasting scenario, the hydrodynamic effect is condensed near an evolving liquid-solid interface, but the prediction target is a global spatiotemporal rollout. To address this challenge, we propose a two-level recurrent forecasting framework, TIDE/TIDES: TIDE isolates localized interface-driven forecasting, while TIDES adds transport-aware coupling and explicit stabilization to reduce accumulated rollout error. Across adapted neighboring baselines, controlled component ablations, motion/size OOD tests, and long-horizon evaluation, TIDES achieves the best forecasting performance and the ablations identify localized interaction, transport coupling, and stabilization as the key contributors. Together, our task formulation, benchmark, and TIDE/TIDES study establish a controlled foundation for moving-solid-conditioned dense liquid forecasting. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/jongwonryu/TIDE-TIDES.

</details>


### [830] [ProCARE: Real-World Study Automation via Profile-Grounded Evidence Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16175)
*Zhaoyu Fan,Bowen Han,Jincheng Ou,Yanwei Ren,Zehua He,Kaiyu Huang,Pengcheng He,Shanshan Ni,Chengchen Gong,Shuai Xue,Qingjiang Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ProCARE将真实世界研究(RWS)自动化重构为"约束编译"问题：把异构数据画像转为Evidence Contracts，将研究目标编译为强类型中间表示RWS-IR，并通过确定性验证与局部修复确保工作流正确性，在36个EHR基准任务上优于LLM agent基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RWS自动化依赖数据集特有的临床语义（索引日期、随访窗口、分析单元、结局边界等），这些常隐含在观察性数据中，导致schema不匹配、时间错误、分析粒度不一致与无依据的临床结论，使LLM agent方案脆弱。

Method: 提出ProCARE画像基础框架：1) 将异构数据画像转化为Evidence Contracts，指定可用变量、时间属性、分布及证据限制；2) 将研究目标编译为RWS-IR强类型中间表示，涵盖变量、时间关系、分析单元与统计任务；3) 使用确定性验证与局部修复，对schema映射、队列构建、变量推导、分析与解释进行核查与修正。

Result: 在36个基于EHR的基准任务上，ProCARE在代码可执行性、语义一致性与结论可追溯性方面优于强LLM-agent基线；自动化违规诊断与盲法专家评审达到中等至较高一致性。

Conclusion: 将RWS自动化视为约束编译（画像→契约→IR→验证修复）可有效缓解LLM agent的脆弱性，提升分析正确性与可追溯性，并可通过自动化诊断部分替代专家评审。

Abstract: Real-world studies (RWS) analyze routinely collected healthcare data, such as electronic health records and insurance claims, to estimate treatment effects, monitor safety, and identify risk factors outside randomized trials. Automating RWS with large language model agents is appealing but brittle: valid analyses depend on dataset-specific clinical semantics, including index dates, follow-up windows, patient/event-level units, and outcome boundaries that are often implicit in observational data. This leads to schema mismatches, temporal errors, inconsistent analytical granularity, and unsupported clinical claims. We present ProCARE, a profile-grounded framework that reformulates RWS automation as constrained compilation. ProCARE converts heterogeneous data profiles into Evidence Contracts specifying available variables, temporal attributes, distributions, and evidentiary limits, and compiles study objectives into RWS-IR, a strongly typed intermediate representation for variables, time relations, analysis units, and statistical tasks. Deterministic validation and localized repair then check and revise generated workflows across schema mapping, cohort construction, variable derivation, analysis, and interpretation. On 36 EHR-based benchmark tasks, ProCARE outperforms strong LLM-agent baselines in code executability, semantic consistency, and conclusion traceability, with automated violation diagnoses showing moderate-to-substantial agreement with blinded expert review.

</details>


### [831] [Label-Centric Knowledge Retrieval for Zero-Shot Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16182)
*Daoping Wu,Dong Wang,Siyu Liu,Chen Liang,Jian Geng,Ziqi Li,Shuguang Xiong,Ying Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出SLKR框架，通过离线构建标签知识库、在线轻量检索与推理，实现低成本零样本文本分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旗舰级LLM知识丰富、推理强，但推理成本和延迟高，难以用于大规模数据标注；且缺少任务特定标注样本。

Method: SLKR将离线知识构建与轻量在线推理分离。离线用旗舰LLM生成标签定义、检索关键词及易混淆标签对的边界规则，形成可复用知识库；在线用混合语义与词汇检索选出top-K候选标签和至多M条相关边界规则，轻量LLM单次调用完成分类。

Result: 在三个公开基准和一个真实多语言图书分类数据集上，Qwen3.5-4B在全部四个数据集取得最佳结果，Ministral-3-3B在四个中的三个最佳；上下文紧凑且无需任务标注样本。边界消融显示检索少量相关规则即可接近使用全部边界的性能，且上下文更少。

Conclusion: SLKR支持高效复用旗舰LLM生成的标签知识，实现轻量级零样本分类，兼顾性能与成本。

Abstract: Flagship large language models (LLMs) offer rich general knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but their high inference cost and latency limit their use for large-scale data labeling. We study zero-shot text classification with semantically meaningful labels and task descriptions, without task-specific labeled examples or classifier feedback. We propose \textbf{SLKR} (Semantic Label Knowledge Retrieval), a label-centric retrieval-augmented generation framework that separates offline knowledge construction from lightweight online inference. Offline, a flagship LLM independently generates label definitions, retrieval keywords, and boundary rules for potentially confusable label pairs, forming a reusable label-knowledge store. Because this construction operates over the label space rather than the input corpus, its one-time flagship cost can be amortized across large-scale inference. Online, hybrid semantic and lexical retrieval first identifies the top-$K$ candidate labels and then selects up to $M$ input-relevant boundary rules connecting candidate-label pairs. A lightweight LLM performs the final classification in a single call using the retrieved definitions and rules. Across three public benchmarks and a real-world multilingual book-classification dataset, SLKR achieves the best results on all four datasets with Qwen3.5-4B and on three of four with Ministral-3-3B, while using compact input contexts and no task-specific labeled examples. Boundary ablations further show that retrieving a small set of input-relevant rules preserves performance close to using all boundaries with substantially less context, supporting efficient reuse of flagship-generated label knowledge for lightweight classification.

</details>


### [832] [Correct Choices, Failed Sequences: Choice2Seq Benchmarks Correctness Retention Across Output Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16191)
*Tianyou Lai,Wentao Yue,Zhiying Deng,Qilei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Choice2Seq 诊断基准，衡量模型在完整答案选择与序列构建之间的一致性，发现模型虽能正确选择答案，却常无法通过局部决策序列复现，SCR 指标揭示显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型可能选对答案却无法通过局部决策序列构建出它，现有评估忽视了选择正确性与序列构建正确性之间的差距。

Method: 提出 Choice2Seq 基准，在同一问题和候选集上独立运行完整答案选择与序列构建，用序列组合率（SCR）量化被正确选择项同时被正确构建的比例，并引入支持字符限制和显式位置索引等干预手段。

Result: Jev 在算术和词汇检索上选择准确率达 97.1% 和 99.5%，但序列构建下仅保留 33.0% 和 2.1%；StartLux 和 Qwen 亦存在显著差距。候选支持字符限制改善构建，显式位置索引提升复制保真度。对话状态评估显示构建对 Jev 状态影响小，但降低 Qwen 平均轮次准确率。

Conclusion: 该基准区分任务正确性、计划保真度与输出合规性，揭示任务和接口依赖的差异，并通过置信度与请求成本分析刻画完整输出。

Abstract: A model may select the correct answer yet fail to construct it through a sequence of local decisions. We introduce Choice2Seq, a diagnostic benchmark that measures correctness retention across complete-answer selection and sequential construction in independent runs on the same problems and candidate sets. Sequence Composition Rate (SCR) measures the fraction of correctly selected items that are also answered correctly through local construction. Jev achieves 97.1% and 99.5% selection accuracy on arithmetic and lexical retrieval, yet retains only 33.0% and 2.1% of those correct choices under serial construction, respectively. Substantial gaps also emerge for StartLux and Qwen, including when Qwen emits characters directly. Restricting local options to candidate-supported characters improves construction, while explicit position indexing improves copying fidelity, even for incorrect selections. These interventions distinguish task correctness, plan fidelity, and output compliance. Matched dialogue-state evaluations reveal that local field construction largely preserves Jev's correct states but reduces Qwen's mean-turn accuracy, highlighting task- and interface-dependent differences. Sequence-level confidence and request-cost analyses further characterize completed outputs.

</details>


### [833] [OneShot: Label-Efficient Detector Weighting for Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16219)
*Seunghan Lee,Jun Seo,Jaehoon Lee,Junhyeok Kang,Sangjun Han,Sungdong Yoo,Minjae Kim,Tae Yoon Lim,Dongwan Kang,Hwanil Choi,Soonyoung Lee,Wonbin Ahn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ONESHOT方法，利用单个已确认异常对检测器池进行加权，而非选择单一检测器，在152个单变量和73个多变量序列上超越最强单一检测器和池平均。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测缺乏通用检测器，最佳选择取决于序列而非算法。现有方法要么为每个序列选一个检测器，要么对检测器池取平均，但都假设从不接收标签，而实际部署的监控系统会因操作员确认报警而收到标签。

Method: ONESHOT利用单个已确认异常对检测器池进行加权而非从中选择一个检测器。具体地，在已确认异常上对每个检测器评分，这些分数成为整个检测器池软混合的权重。

Result: 在152个单变量和73个多变量序列上，ONESHOT超越了最强单一检测器、整个池的平均，甚至在已确认事件上选择最佳检测器。

Conclusion: 单个已确认异常足以接近该序列的最佳检测器，代码已开源。

Abstract: Time series (TS) anomaly detection (AD) lacks a universal detector, with the best choice determined by the series rather than by the algorithm. Existing methods therefore either select one detector for each series or average a pool of them. However, both assume that no label ever arrives, while a deployed monitor does receive them, since an operator confirms the alarms it raises. In this paper, we propose ONESHOT, which uses a single confirmed anomaly to weight the pool rather than to choose one detector from it. Specifically, we score each detector on the confirmed anomaly, and those scores become the weights of a soft mixture over the whole pool. We show that a single confirmed anomaly is enough to come close to the best detector for the series. Across 152 univariate and 73 multivariate series, ONESHOT outperforms the strongest single detector, averaging the whole pool, and even picking the best detector on the confirmed event. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/one_shot.

</details>


### [834] [Learning to GUIDE the Group: Self-Learning LLM Facilitation Across Multi-Party Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16231)
*Ziyi Liu,Tzu-Sheng Kuo,Jiale Liu,Deqing Fu,Nithum Thain,Crystal Qian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GUIDE框架，使LLM能从任务特定的人类交互中自学习通用的多方对话引导策略，并在实时在线实验中超越专家提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM引导者多针对特定任务微调，缺乏能适应不同任务类型与群体动态的通用引导方法。

Method: 收集432场由任务特定专家LLM引导的多方人类对话，采用自学习方法让LLM从对话中归纳可执行的策略手册，并用与人类标注者对齐的LLM评判反馈迭代优化，形成单一通用引导者。

Result: 通用引导者在留出对话上以61.4%胜率超越三个任务特定专家引导者；实时在线研究中保持了引导表现与群体生产力，提升发言舒适度、减少人际摩擦，且比专家提示少用24.7%轮次和29.0%词数。

Conclusion: LLM能够从任务特定的人类互动中学习可泛化、任务无关的社交引导能力，在多样群体场景中媲美手工设计的任务特定提示。

Abstract: As large language models are increasingly adopted as multi-party communication facilitators, there is a growing demand for agents capable of balancing diverse group dynamics across contexts. However, existing LLM facilitators are often fine-tuned for task-specific objectives; generalized LLM-based facilitation methods that can adapt to different types of tasks and diverse group dynamics are underdeveloped. To address this gap, we present GUIDE (Generalized Unified Intervention for Dynamic Exchanges, a framework for developing generalized LLM-based facilitators across different multi-party contexts. GUIDE evaluates facilitation across both objective task outcomes and subjective metrics, including psychological safety and perceived friction.
