Abstract: Improving an LLM agent requires knowing what to change when it fails. Similar failures can require different fixes, and resolving one problem can expose another. We introduce Trace-to-Architecture (T2A), a framework that uses execution trajectories to determine what to change in an agent's harness and when those changes apply. A development agent diagnoses failures using execution evidence from successful and failed tasks, revises the corresponding harness components, and then checks whether target tasks improve, selected successful tasks remain successful, and the edits are actually triggered. New execution evidence guides subsequent diagnosis and revision. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and AppWorld, T2A achieves the highest aggregate score for all three evaluated task agents, exceeding their respective strongest baselines by 6.2--30.3 points. We also integrate T2A's diagnosis and validation procedures into Meta-Harness, improving the resulting harnesses' mean ScienceWorld score by 21.6 points from the same starting harness.

</details>


### [871] [Queue-Aware Token Communications: Bridging AI Representation and Wireless Service](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16730)
*Yuquan Xiao,Qinghe Du,Chaoyang Zhang,Wenchi Cheng,Jingqing Wang,Tao Chen,Jiangzhou Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将排队论引入Token通信（TokenCom）范式，提出Queue-Aware TokenCom端到端架构，以token预算为AI性能与通信效率的关键接口，研究固定与自适应token预算策略下的性能-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TokenCom研究普遍假设生成的token可立即传输，忽略了token工作负载生成与动态无线服务能力之间的不匹配所导致的排队动态问题。

Method: 提出Queue-Aware TokenCom，将token队列显式纳入AI服务流程，构建融合AI表示生成、token负载管理、无线传输与下游任务推理的端到端架构，并探讨预算感知的token表示优化与队列感知的token服务优化两个方向。

Result: 通过研究固定与自适应token预算策略，刻画了动态无线环境下AI性能与通信效率之间的基本权衡关系。

Conclusion: 本文为构建闭环、任务感知、可扩展的TokenCom系统指明了未来研究方向。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of foundation models and edge intelligence is transforming wireless networks from data-oriented communication systems into artificial intelligence (AI)-native service platforms. Token communications (TokenCom) has emerged as a promising paradigm that directly transmits task-oriented AI representations. However, existing studies typically assume that generated tokens can be transmitted immediately, overlooking the queueing dynamics arising from the mismatch between token workload generation and time-varying wireless service capability. To address this limitation, we introduce Queue-Aware TokenCom, which explicitly incorporates token queues into the AI service pipeline. We present an end-to-end architecture integrating AI representation generation, token workload management, wireless transmission, and downstream task inference. We then discuss two key design directions: budget-aware token representation optimization and queue-aware token service optimization, with the token budget serving as a critical interface between AI performance and communication efficiency. Moreover, we investigate fixed and adaptive token budget strategies to characterize the fundamental tradeoff between AI performance and communication efficiency in dynamic wireless environments. Finally, we outline research directions toward closed-loop, task-aware, and scalable TokenCom systems.

</details>


### [872] [Geospatial Vector Geometry as a Native Spatial Modality for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16769)
*Huang Fei,Boyi Chen,Hao Xue,Yang Yue,Yehong Xu,Xiaofang Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 GeoVec-VLM，将地理空间矢量几何作为 VLM 的原生空间模态，通过结构化几何表示和几何交互策略提升地理尺度空间推理能力，在五个任务上平均准确率提升约 11%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 的空间推理主要依赖语言和视觉信息，但在较大地理尺度下，视觉观测有限，难以建立准确的空间参照和恢复精确的空间关系，成为 VLM 空间感知与推理的瓶颈。

Method: 提出 GeoVec-VLM：一，构建保留矢量对象空间结构与排列的结构化几何表示，形成显式空间基；二，引入几何交互策略，将该空间基纳入多模态计算，使其依据查询的空间关系与视觉内容和语言参照交互。

Result: 在五个空间推理任务上，GeoVec-VLM 相比最强基线平均准确率提升约 11%，在地理迁移下保持增益，并展现更好的几何一致性。

Conclusion: 地理空间矢量几何为 VLM 空间推理提供了一种有前景的内部空间基，使感知与推理能够基于共享的几何参照进行。

Abstract: Geospatial reasoning links VLMs to real-world action and decision making. Reliable reasoning requires accurate spatial information and effective spatial representations. However, current VLMs obtain this information mainly from language and vision. At larger geographic scales, limited visual observations make it difficult to establish accurate spatial references and recover precise spatial relations. This leads to a bottleneck for VLM spatial perception and reasoning. This paper proposes that geospatial vector geometry can become a native spatial modality within a VLM and introduces GeoVec-VLM. First, we develop a structured geometry representation that preserves the spatial structure and arrangement of vector objects, building an explicit spatial basis. Second, we introduce a geometry interaction strategy that brings this basis into multimodal computation, where it interacts with visual content and language references according to the queried spatial relations. Together, these designs allow perception and reasoning to operate on shared geometric references. Across five spatial reasoning tasks, GeoVec-VLM improves mean accuracy by about 11\% relative to the strongest baseline, maintains its gains under geographic transfer, and shows greater geometric consistency. Our results show that geospatial vector geometry offers a promising internal spatial basis for VLM spatial reasoning. https://github.com/TXFR/GeoVector-VLM

</details>


### [873] [Game-Creation-Agents: Autonomous Game Production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16776)
*Tencent Multimodal RL Team,Xiangxin Zhou,Jiaqi Tang,Ke Ma,Wenhao Yang,Jiarui Yao,Boye Niu,Haiyang Guo,Yifei Zhao,Huanjin Yao,Pu Jian,Ruihuang Li,Haitao Wu,Yushi Huang,Xiangyan Liu,Yan Sun,Kaixin Li,Tianyu Pang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 GCA 智能体流水线，将自然语言请求自动转化为可运行的 Phaser 4 浏览器游戏，在自动指标与人工评估中均优于对比开放流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放游戏生成流水线在需求满足、玩法完整性与视觉可用性上不足，需要一种从自然语言到可运行浏览器游戏的端到端自动化方案。

Method: 先构建耦合机制与场景契约、并对齐可视化素材的多模态游戏设计文档；再投影为运行时脚手架、机器可读契约与确定性测试。八个专职智能体分工：场景串行实现、素材并行生成，经统一清单合并为单一构建。通过构建关联的真实 UI 检查与代码盲评审验证构建并决定是否发布，阻塞项回传给相应智能体进行有界修复，全部关卡通过后发布。

Result: 在统一协议下的提示匹配任务中，仅凭渲染界面评估：GCA 在需求满足、核心机制、内容深度与功能性视觉上均优于同类开放流水线。人工并排评测中，评分者在所有维度上给 GCA 游戏更高分，且整体更偏好其作品。

Conclusion: GCA 证明多智能体、契约驱动且带构建级验证与有界修复的流水线可稳定产出高质量可运行游戏，自动与人工评估一致支持其优越性。

Abstract: Game-Creation-Agents (GCA) turns a natural-language request into a runnable Phaser 4 browser game. The pipeline first builds a multimodal game design document that couples mechanics and scene contracts to grounded visual references. It then projects that document into a runtime scaffold, machine-readable contracts, and deterministic tests. Eight specialized agents next carry out production: scenes are implemented serially, assets are produced in parallel, and one reduced manifest joins the two branches into a single build. Build-linked real-UI checks and a code-blind critic then verify that build and decide whether the game may ship. Each blocker returns to the agent that owns the affected artifact for a bounded repair, and the game is released once all the gates pass. We evaluate finished games separately, through their rendered interfaces alone, over prompt-matched tasks run under a common protocol. GCA achieves stronger requirement satisfaction, core mechanics, content depth, and functional visuals than a comparable open pipeline. In a side-by-side human study, raters also score GCA's games higher on every dimension and prefer them overall.

</details>


### [874] [LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16782)
*Ming Shin Cindy Sung,Duan Leijiahao,Haoxiang Wang,Boning Tan,Liangna Fu,Chao Tan,Yafu Li,Yulong Chen,Chaoqun Wan,Zhen Huang,Shuxian Liang,Xian-Sheng Hua*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LIBERO-Industry基准，将工业约束（产品变体、移动物料流、有限执行窗口、几何公差）转化为可控任务条件，评估通用机器人策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高混合低产量（HMLV）电子装配等工业操作要求机器人策略适应不断变化的产品与生产条件，但现有评估框架未能系统捕捉这些工业约束。

Method: 基于LIBERO构建LIBERO-Industry，包含S2D加载、D2S卸载、D2D转移三类场景，共216个任务，系统变化物体几何、传送带速度、交互窗口时长和几何接受区域大小。

Result: 在五种通用机器人策略（含VLA与世界动作模型）上实验，性能随工业约束引入和组合而逐步下降；在共同微调与评估协议下，LIBERO-Industry联合训练条件的目标转移完成率高于原始LIBERO条件。

Conclusion: LIBERO-Industry为工业场景下通用机器人策略提供了系统评估工具，揭示约束对性能的影响，并显示工业数据联合训练可带来收益。

Abstract: Industrial manipulation in flexible manufacturing, e.g., high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) electronics assembly, requires robot policies to adapt to changing products and production conditions. Such settings impose industrial process constraints, including product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances. However, existing evaluation frameworks do not systematically capture these constraints when assessing generalist robot policies. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Industry, a novel benchmark built on the widely used robot learning benchmark LIBERO, that translates the aforementioned industrial constraints into controllable task conditions and measurable success criteria. Specifically, LIBERO-Industry comprises three classic task scenarios: Static-to-Dynamic (S2D) loading, Dynamic-to-Static (D2S) unloading, and Dynamic-to-Dynamic (D2D) transfer. The suites contain 216 tasks in total that systematically vary object geometry, conveyor speed, interaction-window duration, and geometric acceptance region size. Extensive experiments across five generalist robot policies (including vision-language-action models and world-action models) show that performance progressively degrades as industrial constraints are introduced and combined. Under a shared fine-tuning and evaluation protocol, the LIBERO-Industry co-training condition achieved higher observed target-transfer completion than the original-LIBERO condition.

</details>


### [875] [CLIVO: Differentiable Cluster-Based Instruction Mixing with Learned Validation Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16876)
*Yuhan Wang,Rui Hu,Batian Di,Tan Jiang,Dongsheng Ma,Leichao Dong,Yuanzi Li,Yalin Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CLIVO框架，通过细粒度语义分配、自动学习的验证目标与可微混合搜索，实现多模态指令选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 样本级排序易过代表相似内容且无法优化监督平衡；组级方法单元粗糙、验证信号预设且混合搜索昂贵或不准确。

Method: 语义聚类提供百级可调份额；用合并代理损失与真实探测性能的相关性识别目标相关验证样本；学习非负权重构成目标；单次反向传播为所有份额提供梯度，避免额外回归模型。

Result: 从8M池中选100K指令，仅用1.25%数据达全量四目标平均分的97.2%；比最强基线提升1.16点（随机簇内采样），结合学习配额与样本排序提升至1.55点。

Conclusion: 更细单元对多数目标有益；短训练专家保留混合响应；样本加权保留有效验证信息；直接搜索稳定降低学习目标；框架支持可解释分配、模块化选择及跨目标与粒度复用。

Abstract: Target-aware multimodal instruction selection requires useful examples and an appropriate balance of supervision. Sample-level rankings can overrepresent similar content without optimizing this balance; group-level methods face coarse units, predefined set-level validation signals, and costly or inaccurate mixture search. We propose CLIVO, a target-aware framework connecting fine-grained semantic allocation, automatically learned validation objectives, and differentiable mixture search. Specifically, semantic clusters provide independently adjustable shares at the hundred-cluster scale. Correlations between per-example merged-proxy losses and real probe performance identify target-relevant validation examples; learned nonnegative weights combine their losses into an objective. A single backward pass through the merged proxy supplies gradients for all shares, avoiding an additional mixture-response regression model. Selecting 100K instructions from an 8M pool, CLIVO attains 97.2% of the full-data four-target average score with only 1.25% of the data. It improves on the strongest evaluated selection baseline by 1.16 points using random within-cluster sampling; combining learned quotas with sample ranking increases this advantage to 1.55 points. Analyses show that finer units benefit most targets, short-trained experts preserve mixture responses, sample weighting retains useful validation information, and direct search consistently reduces the learned objective. CLIVO also supports interpretable allocation, modular selection, and reuse across targets and granularities.

</details>


### [876] [Acceptable Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16881)
*Maud van Lier,Ludovica Marinucci,Vieri Giuliano Santucci,Raja Chatila,Stéphane Doncieux,Émiland Garrabé,Richard Duro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出完全价值对齐在理论上和实践上都不可能，错位事件将持续发生，因此主张从"最大化对齐"转向研究"错位事件可接受的条件"，提出"可接受错位"概念及新的方法论框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主机器人开放式学习面临伦理挑战：设计时无法预知部署方式、学习内容和行为方式。当前主流应对是价值对齐，但完全对齐不可行，且最大化对齐的方法无法处理残留的、社会不可接受的错位风险。

Method: 概念分析与规范性论证。论证价值对齐问题面临多重挑战，说明完全对齐的理论与实践不可能性；提出视角转变，引入"可接受错位"概念，制定对齐机制的规范性要求，构建新的方法论框架。

Result: 证明完全对齐不可能，错位事件不可避免；现有最大化对齐方法在残留风险处理上存在缺陷。

Conclusion: 应将研究焦点从最大化对齐转向使错位事件达到可接受水平的条件，并提出满足这些要求的对齐机制方法论框架。

Abstract: There is a specific challenge designers face in developing autonomous robots capable of open-ended learning. This challenge is how one can develop such systems in an ethically sound way when there are many unknowns during design time about their manner of deployment, what they can and will learn, and how these systems will act on the basis of what they have learned. One response to this challenge is to align, as far as possible, the activities and goals of autonomous robots with human values, raising the question of how to make this alignment possible, a question known as the value alignment problem. We argue that the value alignment problem faces a number of challenges that show that full alignment is both theoretically and practically impossible, meaning that misalignment incidents will keep occurring. This undermines current alignment approaches, as the attempt to maximize alignment cannot properly deal with the possibility that the risk of misalignment that remains after alignment methods have been implemented might still be unacceptable to society. To overcome this difficulty, we argue that a shift in perspective is required from a focus on the maximization of alignment to the conditions under which misalignment incidents become acceptable. In this paper, we explore what this shift in perspective entails. We introduce the concept of acceptable misalignment, formulate normative requirements for alignment mechanisms aimed at bringing misalignment incidents to an acceptable level, and we conclude by presenting a new methodological framework that consists of alignment mechanisms that can meet these requirements.

</details>


### [877] [Transparency as Answerability: Role-Dependent Information Flow Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16887)
*Mattias Brännström,Themis Dimitra Xanthopoulou,Lili Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将"透明度"重新定义为一种关系（relation），即系统对特定利益相关者的透明度取决于其合法问题能否从系统结构中回答，并用信息流网络进行形式化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有透明度研究多将其视为系统或组件的属性，导致评估无法跨组织边界迁移、利益相关者问题无法在现有框架内表述、组件级结论无法说明系统级行为等典型失败。

Method: 以信息流网络形式化透明度：将透明度问题表达为网络结构问题，把"可回答性"定义为系统能够解决这些问题的条件。框架支持三个分析维度：仅凭网络的结构性可回答性、跨组织边界的组合性可回答性、以及基于利益相关者可访问子网络的角色依赖可回答性。

Result: 在一个公共部门市政机构的AI招聘工具真实预集成评估中进行验证，通过参与式设计与访谈建模决策系统结构，展示了如何在提供方（Provider）与部署方（Deployer）边界上形式化地表述并分析结构与角色依赖的透明度问题。

Conclusion: 将透明度重构为关系性概念可弥补属性视角的缺陷，信息流网络为跨组织、跨角色的系统级透明度评估提供了可操作的形式化工具。

Abstract: Transparency in AI-supported decision systems is widely required but poorly defined. Existing approaches treat transparency as a property of systems or components, producing characteristic failures: assessments that do not transfer across organizational boundaries, stakeholder questions that cannot be formulated within the available frame of analysis, and component-level findings that say nothing about system-level behavior. We propose treating transparency as a relation: a system is transparent to a stakeholder to the degree that their legitimate questions are answerable from its structure. We formalize this using information flow networks, in which transparency questions are expressed in terms of network structure and answerability is the condition that the system settles them. The framework supports three dimensions of analysis: structural answerability from the network alone, compositional answerability across organizational boundaries for deployed systems, and role-dependent answerability given a stakeholder's accessible sub-network. We demonstrate the framework on a real pre-integration assessment of an AI recruitment tool in a public sector municipality. The assessment uses participatory design and interviews to model the decision system structure. We show how structural and role-dependent transparency questions can be formally stated and analyzed across the Provider and Deployer boundary where the AI system is composed together with the deployer's decision process.

</details>


### [878] [Observe, Share, or Predict? Disentangling Partner Information in Embodied Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16895)
*Adrián Szlatincsán,Filippo Ziliotto,Bruno Lepri,Luciano Serafini,Massimiliano Luca,Tommaso Campari*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究基于PARTNR基准提出解耦部分可观测机制，检验OAS、KE与OANA对LLM具身智能体协作的影响，发现OAS提升任务质量、KE提升执行效率、OANA反而降低成功率，且协作收益主要来自响应共享上下文而非显式预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为具身智能体高层控制器时，其无对话实时团队协作能力尚不明确。作者探究在只能共享感知、不能共享意图/计划/任务消息的条件下，观察伙伴状态、交换物体知识、预测伙伴下一步动作如何影响任务结果与协调，以及两智能体是否角色对称。

Method: 使用Habitat的PARTNR基准，引入严格个体感知的解耦部分可观测机制；在去中心化零样本ReAct规划器上增加三项能力：伙伴状态观察(OAS)、同位置智能体间物体知识交换(KE)、伙伴下一步动作预测(OANA)；在完整2×2×2组合下用四种规划器评估1000个验证任务。

Result: OAS提升任务质量、减少多余动作；KE提升执行效率，最多减少25%仿真步数但成功率变化小。二者对强规划器冗余，对最弱规划器互补，且弱规划器下"有KE无OAS"最差。OANA在16个模型×情境对中有15个降低成功率，但将显式伙伴提及提升到55-100%，其准确度提升主要体现在粗粒度动作类型。机器人比模拟人类更早取物、更早完成任务；共享上下文通过缩短人类独自工作时长降低总任务时间。

Conclusion: 协调收益源于对共享上下文(尤其OAS)的响应，而非显式预测，合作建模呈现浅层且依赖规划器的特征。

Abstract: LLMs are used as high-level controllers for embodied agents, but it remains unclear whether they support collaborative reasoning, such as anticipating a collaborator's actions in real-time teamwork without dialogue. We ask if observing the partner's state, exchanging object knowledge, and predicting the partner's next action, shape task outcomes and coordination when agents can share percepts but never intentions, plans, or task-level messages, and whether the two agents occupy symmetric roles. Using the Habitat-based PARTNR benchmark, we introduce a Decoupled Partial Observability regime that enforces strictly individual perception, and we augment decentralized zero-shot ReAct planners with Other Agent's State (OAS) observation, object Knowledge Exchange (KE) between co-located agents, and Other Agent's Next Action (OANA) prediction, evaluated on the full 2 x 2 x 2 grid with four planners on 1,000 validation tasks. OAS observation improves task quality, reducing extraneous effort for every planner, whereas KE primarily improves execution efficiency, cutting simulation steps by up to 25% with little change in success. The two are largely redundant for strong planners but complementary for the weakest, for which KE without the OAS is the worst configuration. OANA prediction lowers the success rate in 15 of 16 model x context pairs while raising explicit partner mentions to 55-100%, and its accuracy gains lie mainly in the coarse action type, partly because agents recognize the action the partner is already performing. The robot retrieves objects sooner and completes its tasks earlier than the simulated human. Shared context reduces total task time by shortening the remaining duration that the human works alone. Also, coordination benefits arise from responding to shared context, especially the OAS, rather than explicit anticipation, yielding shallow, planner-dependent partner modeling.

</details>


### [879] [Neural Bayesian Networks for Modular and Scalable Decision-Making Under Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16902)
*Giovanni Briglia,Marco Lippi,Stefano Mariani,Franco Zambonelli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出神经贝叶斯网络(NBN)，将每个条件分布替换为可微张量机制，保留图结构与分解，支持任意可学习条件分布并原生GPU并行，性能与表达力均显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典贝叶斯网络的条件分布多以表格或线性高斯形式存储，表达力受限；推理逐节点逐查询进行，规模受限，难以应对大规模网络与批量查询。

Method: 将BN中每个局部条件机制设为可微分的张量值机制，保持有向无环图及其因子分解不变，从而兼容任意可学习条件分布，并在GPU上原生运行；同时发布基于PyTorch的NBN库与公开基准。

Result: 在表达力上可拟合经典BN库难以表示分布；在规模上，对于大网络和大批量查询，得益于GPU并行化，运行速度提升两个数量级。

Conclusion: NBN在保留BN模块化与可解释性的同时，结合神经网络的表达力和GPU并行优势，是可扩展的不确定性推理工具。代码已开源。

Abstract: Bayesian Networks (BNs) are established tools for letting agents reason under uncertainty in sequential decision-making. They split a joint distribution into local conditional mechanisms arranged on a directed acyclic graph, which makes them modular, interpretable, and ready to perform probabilistic inference. Their classical formulation, however, has limitations in both expressiveness and scale: each conditional is usually stored as a table or a linear-Gaussian form, and inference evaluates the graph one node and one query at a time.
  In this paper we introduce Neural Bayesian Networks (NBNs), in which each conditional is a differentiable, tensor-valued mechanism, while the graph and its factorization are unchanged. NBNs retain the modularity and local mechanisms of BNs, can represent any learnable conditional distribution, and run natively on GPUs. We also release NBN, a PyTorch-based library for learning and inference in NBNs, together with a public benchmark. Our evaluation shows gains in both expressiveness and scale: NBNs fit distributions that classical BN libraries struggle to represent, and on large networks and large batches of queries they run two orders of magnitude faster thanks to GPU parallelization. NBN is available at https://github.com/Giovannibriglia/NeuralBayesianNetworks.

</details>


### [880] [Audit tools of the trade: Automated Auditor Elicitation Can Be Sensitive to the Context the Auditor Is Given](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16911)
*Ben Slater,Ryan Lundqvist,Leo Richter,Kevin Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究用Petri工具审计LLM代码代理时，向AI审计员提供额外上下文资源是否提升有效性。发现外部代码库可抑制reward hacking，基准转录反而提升该行为，且对其他行为无稳定影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验给自动化AI审计员提供额外上下文能否提升审计效果，并探究配置选择对审计结果的敏感性与可靠性问题。

Method: 使用Petri工具审计LLM代码代理，向审计员LLM提供两类资源（外部开源代码库、基准测试转录），覆盖四组审计员-目标LLM配对及三种行为（有害顺从、reward hacking、谄媚），并做后续对照实验（仅提供摘要、不同行为框架）。

Result: 外部代码库使基线高于下限的两组配对reward hacking从4.8降至1.3、3.9降至1.8（1-10量表），另两组始终处于下限，且在不同场景与资源组合下四组中有三组复现该抑制。基准转录则在全部四组中提升reward hacking（如1.7升至6.1），但仅提供摘要同样提升，换框架后效应消失。除reward hacking外，两类资源均无一致影响，但条件间评分行为差异显著。

Conclusion: 测量到的目标行为高度依赖配置决策，凸显使用Petri等工具时谨慎试运行的重要性，呼吁更多关于自动化对齐审计可靠性与鲁棒性的研究。

Abstract: Does providing additional context to automated AI auditors improve their effectiveness? Using the Petri tool to audit LLM coding agents, we test the impact of providing two types of resources (an external codebase and benchmark transcripts) to LLM auditors, across four auditor-target LLM pairs and three behaviours (harmful compliance, reward hacking, sycophancy). (1) External codebase: We provide the auditor LLM with a fixed, external open source codebase, which prior work finds improves the realism of synthetic audits. Providing this resource suppresses reward hacking in both auditor-target pairs whose baseline rate is above the floor (4.8 to 1.3 and 3.9 to 1.8 on Petri's default 1-10 scale); the remaining two pairs sit at the floor throughout. The suppression recurs in three of four pairs under a different scenario and resource bundle. (2) External benchmark transcripts: We provide the auditor with transcripts of the target's performance on benchmarks measuring similar behaviours, intended to inform the auditor about the target's behavioural patterns. Providing this resource raises reward hacking scores in all four pairs (from 1.7 to 6.1 in one case). However, subsequent experiments show that supplying only the related benchmark's abstract, without transcripts, also increases reward hacking, and the effect is absent under a different framing of the same behaviour. Overall, we find no consistent effect of either resource outside reward hacking, but we find substantial variability in judge-scored behaviour across conditions. Our results underscore the importance of careful piloting with tools such as Petri, as the measured rate of target behaviour is highly sensitive to configuration decisions. We hope our results inspire more research into the reliability and robustness of automated alignment auditing.

</details>


### [881] [Transparent Information Flow Modeling for Role-Aware AI Act Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16916)
*Mattias Brännström,Themis Dimitra Xanthopoulou,Lili Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探索用信息流方法(IFM)对欧盟AI法案的高风险AI系统进行合规评估，通过真实招聘工具的案例展示其优于传统清单式评估的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧盟AI法案要求对高风险AI系统进行透明、风险管理与角色问责，但现有评估多依赖单一系统视角或割裂的清单，难以刻画真实部署中的社会-技术复杂性。

Method: 采用基于建模的信息流方法(IFM)，将决策系统(算法、人工或混合)表示为信息站点与转换通道构成的网络，从而结构化分析信息、决策与责任如何跨越组织和技术边界流动；并在公共部门招聘支持工具的真实案例中，同时评估提供方系统与部署方招聘流程。

Result: IFM可作为脚手架，桥接组件式与整体式视角，并揭示技术系统如何嵌入社会-技术情境；它支持透明度、识别风险路径，并实现预期用途与实际用途的一致性分析。

Conclusion: 此类建模为有效且情境敏感的AI治理与问责提供了基础工具，其能力超越传统的清单式评估。

Abstract: The European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act introduces a structured framework for governing high-risk AI systems, emphasizing transparency, risk management, and role-specific accountability. However, current assessment practices often rely on monolithic system views or disconnected checklists, limiting their ability to capture the socio-technical complexity of real-world deployments. We explore the use of the Information Flow Methodology (IFM), a modeling-based approach to AI Act compliance assessment. IFM represents decision systems -- whether algorithmic, human, or hybrid -- as networks of information sites and transformation channels, enabling structured analysis of how information, decisions, and responsibilities flow across organizational and technical boundaries. We apply IFM in a real-world case involving a recruitment support tool used by a public-sector organization, evaluating both the Provider's system and the Deployer's recruitment process. Our results demonstrate that IFM can serve as a scaffold to bridge both component-based and holistic perspectives, and how technical systems are situated within socio-technical contexts. In doing so, IFM supports transparency, identifies risk pathways, and enables alignment analysis between intended and actual use. We argue that such modeling provides a foundational tool for effective, context-sensitive AI governance and accountability -- offering capabilities beyond conventional checklist-based assessments.

</details>


### [882] [WeFair: Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in Short-Video Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16927)
*Yingtao Ren,Aolin Li,Cheng Cheng,Huiyun Hu,Huasheng Liang,Baoxing Xie,Jun Yuan,Haijun Wu,Chenxing Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出WeFair框架，通过人类反馈的忠实度对齐实现微信短视频搜索的个性化查询改写。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短视频搜索查询简短模糊，需在严格延迟下判断何时个性化并保持用户即时意图；现有方法依赖合成推理和间接行为奖励，易产生意图漂移与无根据细节。

Method: 将真实用户行为信号分为示范、偏好、验证三阶段：挖掘真实改写，用多维LLM筛选与上下文验证过滤；训练上先用监督课程学习大规模人类示范，再用DPO对齐后续消费行为，最后用基于真实改写的严格验证奖励做GRPO在线策略优化。

Result: 分析发现辅助奖励可激活更多GRPO rollout组但降低意图忠实度；微信短视频搜索在线A/B测试有效点击查询率（VV>10s）相对提升1.576%，查询改写率相对降低1.731%。

Conclusion: WeFair在保持意图忠实度的同时提升搜索效果并减少改写行为，验证了忠实度对齐与人类反馈分阶段利用的有效性。

Abstract: Short-video search requires compact query rewriters that infer personalized intent from brief, ambiguous queries under strict latency constraints. The challenge is to decide when personalization is warranted and generate a reformulation that preserves the user's immediate information need. A rewriter optimized for fluency or engagement may still introduce unsupported details and redirect the search toward a different intent. Existing methods often underutilize users' actual reformulations and behavioral traces, relying instead on synthetic reasoning and indirect behavioral rewards that may produce more engaging candidates but cause intent drift. To build an effective rewriter that remains faithful to user intent, we propose WeFair, Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in WeChat short-video search. WeFair assigns real user behavioral signals to a progression from demonstration to preference to verification. We first mine actual human reformulations from search sessions, then apply multidimensional LLM screening and contextual verification to filter unsupported transitions without extensive manual annotation. During training, we begin with a supervised curriculum that progressively builds rewriting capabilities from large-scale human personalized query demonstrations, and then use direct preference optimization to align with users' subsequent consumption. In the final on-policy optimization stage, we construct a strict verification reward based on actual human reformulations to further boost performance with group relative policy optimization. Further analysis shows that auxiliary rewards can activate more rollout groups in GRPO but reduce intent fidelity. Online A/B testing in WeChat short-video search shows a 1.576% relative increase in effective clicked-query rate (VV>10s) and a 1.731% relative reduction in query reformulation rate.

</details>


### [883] [MADDIE: Multi-Agent Drug Discovery Engine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16975)
*Ye Liu,Reza Averly,Avery Meyer,Frazier N. Baker,Ruoxi Gao,Daniel Adu-Ampratwum,Xia Ning*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MADDIE是一个基于LLM的多智能体药物发现引擎，通过中心Orchestrator协调四个专业worker agent，实现灵活的工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物发现耗资巨大、周期长；现有单智能体系统难以扩展至长期多步任务，多智能体系统则执行预设流程，无法体现真实药物发现的迭代非线性特性。

Method: 构建中心智能体Orchestrator加四个worker智能体（HitIdentifier、LeadOptimizer、Synthesizer、Evaluator），由Orchestrator编排组成灵活工作流，端到端导航药物发现流程。

Result: 在50个蛋白靶点上，MADDIE生成的分子满足关键性质要求及其合成路线，大幅超越现有智能体系统、生成模型和通用LLM；且时间与token开销高效。

Conclusion: MADDIE证明其可作为低成本、有效且高效的自主引擎加速药物发现。

Abstract: Drug discovery remains a resource-intensive and time-consuming process, involving billions of dollars and a decade of development to advance a drug to market. While many in silico tools have accelerated this process, operating them still demands substantial time, effort, and expertise from medicinal chemists. Autonomous systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising solution, yet current designs limit their performance. Existing single-agent systems scale poorly to long-horizon, multi-step, and realistic tasks, whereas multi-agent systems typically execute predefined workflows that cannot capture the iterative, non-linear nature of a real drug discovery campaign. Here, we present MADDIE, a multi-agent drug discovery engine. It comprises a central agent, Orchestrator, and four specialized worker agents: HitIdentifier, LeadOptimizer, Synthesizer, and Evaluator, each representing a critical step in a drug discovery campaign. Under Orchestrator's orchestration and coordination, these worker agents are composed into flexible workflows, enabling MADDIE to adapt its strategy and navigate the drug discovery pipeline end-to-end. Across 50 protein targets, MADDIE produces molecules satisfying key property requirements and their synthesis routes, outperforming existing agentic systems, generative models, and general-purpose LLMs by a wide margin. Our analysis reveals how these agents collaborate and that MADDIE can employ different strategies across targets to achieve the campaign's goal, while still being efficient in time and tokens. Together, they demonstrate MADDIE as a low-cost, effective, and efficient autonomous engine for accelerating drug discovery. Code and dataset is available via https://github.com/ninglab/MADDIE.

</details>


### [884] [PRAISE: A Reproducible Workflow for Non-Programmer Scientists to Implement Published AI Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16980)
*Max Achterweust,Stefan Groot Nibbelink,Vincent J. de Beer,Stefan Schipper,Zeynep Yüksektepe,Pedro Andrade da Silva,Aurelia Peppelaar,Martijn J. van der Willigen,Christophe B. Minkenberg,Robert F. van der Willigen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PRAISE——一个面向非编程人员的实用、可复现AI模型实施工作流，帮助科学家逐步使用已发表的AI模型并应对常见失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI模型在科研中广泛应用，但许多研究者、学生和从业者缺乏编程与数据科学能力，现有指南只覆盖单一步骤，缺少从已发表模型到自己数据上获得预测结果的完整路径。

Method: PRAISE（Practical, Reproducible AI-model Implementation for Science and Education）工作流，分步指导非编程者实施已发表AI模型，并针对常见失败提供备用方案；以3名化学专业本科生在导师指导下无编程经验地复现、验证并扩展一个预测酶-底物相互作用的先进模型作为验证。

Result: 3名无编程/数据科学背景的化学本科生及导师成功复现、验证并扩展了预测酶-底物相互作用的最新模型，证明该工作流可行。

Conclusion: 借助PRAISE，从文献中实施AI模型成为可学习的技能，使非编程科学家从AI模型的使用者转变为评估者和改进者。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) models are increasingly developed, published and used across scientific fields. Researchers, students and industry professionals who want to apply these models to their own research questions often lack the programming and data science expertise to do so. Existing guidelines cover single steps, but not the route from a published model to working predictions on one's own data. Here we present the hands-on workflow PRAISE, a Practical, Reproducible AI-model Implementation for Science and Education, that helps non-programmers implement published AI models step by step. Because implementations rarely work the first time, PRAISE anticipates common failures and provides a fallback route for each. As a proof of principle, three BSc chemistry students and their tutor applied PRAISE without prior programming or data science knowledge. They reproduced, validated and extended a state-of-the-art model that predicts enzyme-substrate interactions. This shows that with PRAISE, implementing an AI model from the literature becomes a learnable skill, one that turns non-programmer scientists from users into evaluators and improvers of AI models.

</details>


### [885] [Glasseek: A Transparent Recipe for Training and Trustworthy Evaluation of DeepSearch Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16998)
*Cong Pang,Jiaqi Su,Chengrui Wu,Kuihao Yan,Tianrui Zhang,Zixuan Qiu,Chao Lin,Zixiu Lin,Zixuan Chen,Zelin Xiao,Tiankuo Yao,Jiawei Hong,Zixuan Chen,Dan Xu,Lewei Lu,Wenjie Wang,Xin Lou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Glasseek 是一个完全透明的深度搜索框架，涵盖数据、训练、评估全流程，其 9B 智能体在多项深度研究基准上超越前沿专有智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源深度搜索智能体面临三大挑战：轨迹构建流程不透明导致数据难审计与复现；上下文压缩造成训练与推理不匹配；评估时可能从开放网络检索到基准内容，造成污染并高估性能。

Method: 1) 可验证的轨迹策展流水线，系统生成高质量探索路径；2) Compaction-Managed GSPO (CM-GSPO)，搜索与摘要共享同一策略，仅优化执行子轨迹，实现跨上下文压缩边界的端到端搜索策略训练；3) 首个针对开放网络智能体测试集泄漏的系统性审计，并发布模块化防泄漏插件。

Result: 在严格评估协议下，9B 智能体在几乎所有深度研究基准（涵盖多种任务类型）上超越前沿专有智能体，并在近期开放权重智能体中取得最佳总体性能，树立了 9B 规模的新 SOTA。

Conclusion: Glasseek 通过全流程透明化（数据、权重、训练配方、代码全开放）和防泄漏评估，有效解决了开源深度搜索智能体的核心瓶颈，证明了小规模智能体也能达到领先性能。

Abstract: Deep search enables language agents to solve complex information-seeking tasks through iterative web exploration. However, developing robust open-source agents remains challenging for three reasons. First, opaque trajectory-construction pipelines make training data difficult to audit and reproduce. Second, context compression can create a substantial mismatch between training and inference. Third, agents may retrieve benchmark content from the open web during evaluation, contaminating the results and overstating their performance. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce Glasseek, a fully transparent deep search framework spanning the complete development lifecycle, releasing all data, model weights, training recipes, and code. Specifically, for data construction, we establish a verifiable trajectory curation pipeline that systematically generates high-quality exploration paths. For training, we propose Compaction-Managed GSPO (CM-GSPO), which uses the same policy for search and summarization while optimizing only execution sub-trajectories, enabling end-to-end search-policy training across context-compaction boundaries. For evaluation, we conduct the first systematic audit of test-set leakage in open-web agents and release a modular anti-leakage plugin that seamlessly integrates into existing evaluation harnesses. Under this rigorous evaluation protocol, our 9B agent outperforms frontier proprietary agents across almost all deep research benchmarks spanning diverse task types, and achieves the best overall performance among recent open-weight agents, setting a new state of the art at the 9B scale.

</details>


### [886] [Understanding Personalization Gains in Whisper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17019)
*Sergei Katkov,Antonio Liotta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究LoRA微调对Whisper的增益是否需按群体定制：增益集中在困难群体，池化LoRA常可媲美甚至超越群体专属LoRA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Whisper残差错误在不同数据集、录音条件和元数据群体间分布不均。作者想探究LoRA何时有效，以及增益是否必须依赖群体专属适配器。

Method: 在Common Voice、LibriSpeech、VoxPopuli上，采用匹配的群体内划分，对比零样本Whisper、池化LoRA和群体专属LoRA。

Result: 适配并非普遍有益：增益集中于困难的Common Voice群体，在VoxPopuli上稳定，但在低错误率的LibriSpeech上基本消失。池化LoRA常与群体专属LoRA持平，有时明显更优。

Conclusion: 在将超越零样本的增益解读为个性化证据前，应与匹配的池化适配进行对比测试。

Abstract: Whisper-style ASR models provide strong zero-shot transcription, but their residual errors are not evenly distributed across datasets, recording conditions, and metadata-based groups. We study when lightweight low-rank adaptation (LoRA) improves Whisper and whether observed gains require group-specific adapters. Across Common Voice, LibriSpeech, and VoxPopuli, we compare zero-shot Whisper, pooled LoRA, and group-specific LoRA under matched within-group splits. We find that adaptation is not uniformly beneficial: gains are concentrated in difficult Common Voice groups, are consistent on VoxPopuli, and largely disappear on low-error LibriSpeech. Crucially, pooled LoRA often matches, and sometimes clearly outperforms, group-specific LoRA. Gains over zero-shot should therefore be tested against matched pooled adaptation before being interpreted as evidence of personalization.

</details>


### [887] [Benchmarking Quantum Kernel SVMs for Credit Card Fraud Detection: Performance Realities Under NISQ Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17027)
*Hitanshi Arora,Mohit Swarnkar,Aswani Kumar Cherukuri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过严格匹配设置的基准测试比较QSVM（Angle、ZZFeatureMap、IQP编码）与经典模型在信用卡欺诈检测中的表现：全特征下经典模型PR-AUC达0.983，而受限条件下经典降至0.750，最佳量子结果仅0.730，真实硬件进一步降至0.62。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欺诈交易占比不足0.2%，检测极难。QML/QSVM理论上可将数据映射到高维希尔伯特空间获得更丰富特征表示，但该优势在真实金融数据瓶颈（类别极不平衡、样本与特征受限）下是否成立尚不明确。

Method: 设计受控基准，比较三种量子编码（Angle、ZZFeatureMap、IQP）与经典模型，严格匹配样本量、特征数与缩放方式；将SMOTE直接嵌入量子Gram矩阵流程以处理类别偏斜而不破坏量子态重叠；并在真实量子硬件上测试。

Result: SMOTE嵌入Gram矩阵使PR-AUC约提升+0.04。全30特征数据集上经典基线最高PR-AUC为0.983；将经典模型限制为500样本、4个PCA特征以匹配QSVM硬件约束时降至0.750；最佳量子结果（IQP，150样本）仅0.730；真实硬件因CNOT门误差与热噪声降至0.62。

Conclusion: 近期量子核方法的关键运行瓶颈有二：Gram矩阵评估的扩展性问题，以及将特征压缩到少量量子比特寄存器导致的信息严重损失。理论优势在现实约束下难以兑现。

Abstract: Detecting credit card fraud is notoriously difficult because fraudulent charges make up less than 0.2% of total transactions. Quantum Machine Learning (QML), particularly Quantum Kernel Support Vector Machines (QSVM), promises richer feature representations by embedding classical data into high-dimensional Hilbert spaces. However, whether this theoretical advantage holds up when managing real-world financial data bottlenecks remains unclear. We designed a controlled benchmark comparing three quantum encodings, Angle, ZZFeatureMap, and IQP against classical models while keeping sample sizes, feature counts, and scaling strictly matched. To handle class skew without corrupting quantum state overlaps, we embedded synthetic minority oversampling (SMOTE) directly into the quantum Gram matrix workflow, raising PR-AUC scores by roughly +0.04 across feature maps. When trained on the full European credit card dataset with 30 features, classical baselines reached a top PR-AUC of 0.983. However, restricting classical models to match QSVM hardware constraints (500 samples, 4 PCA features) dropped their PR-AUC to 0.750. This puts our best quantum result 0.730 PR-AUC using IQP encoding on 150 samples into realistic context. Testing on physical quantum hardware reduced performance further to 0.62 due to CNOT gate errors and thermal noise. Overall, our findings pinpoint two main operational bottlenecks for near-term quantum kernels: the scaling of Gram matrix evaluation and heavy information loss from squeezing features onto small qubit registers.

</details>


### [888] [Neos: Learning to Interleave Search and Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17043)
*Ekko He,Jack Hong,Shilin Yan,Xintong Zhang,Yujie Zhang,Wenjie Li,Haoran Sun,Kaixun Jiang,Jiyuan Fu,Guannan Zhang,Hongwei Xue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Neos是一个多模态深度搜索框架，通过让智能体同时学习"获取证据"和"利用证据指导后续决策"，并引入可训练的Multimodal Evidence Interface（MEI）与智能体-环境协同进化训练，在十个基准上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态深度搜索智能体虽能使用工具和检索视觉内容，但难以将中间视觉证据转化为可操作的指导，限制了长时程搜索效果。

Method: 构建含中间视觉依赖、过滤文本捷径的训练任务；引入可训练的MEI将检索内容转为目标条件观测；采用智能体-环境协同进化：参考引导的信用分配定位关键策略错误并保留失败搜索中的有效决策，rollout反馈选取信息量大的局部证据交互做MEI监督微调；交替进行策略RL与MEI SFT，形成证据获取与行动的闭环。

Result: 在十个基准上，Neos-9B和Neos-35B在专用多模态深度搜索智能体中表现领先。

Conclusion: 通过让证据获取与证据条件化行动相互耦合、协同进化，Neos有效提升了多模态深度搜索智能体的长时程搜索能力。

Abstract: Recent multimodal deep search agents have advanced tool use and visual content retrieval, yet they still struggle to convert intermediate visual evidence into actionable guidance for subsequent search, limiting their effectiveness in long-horizon settings. To address this gap, we present Neos, a multimodal deep search framework that learns both how to acquire evidence and how to use it to guide subsequent decisions. To make this coupling learnable, Neos constructs training tasks with intermediate visual dependencies while filtering out textual shortcuts, and introduces a lightweight, trainable Multimodal Evidence Interface (MEI) that transforms retrieved content into goal-conditioned observations. At its core, an agent-environment co-evolution procedure treats MEI as a co-adaptive component of this loop. Specifically, reference-guided credit assignment uses verified successful trajectories to localize critical policy errors while preserving credit for useful decisions in failed searches, whereas rollout feedback selects informative local evidence-processing interactions for MEI supervised fine-tuning (SFT). By alternating policy reinforcement learning (RL) with MEI SFT, Neos allows the policy's evolving evidence requests to shape MEI training and the adapted MEI to reshape subsequent observations, closing the loop between evidence acquisition and evidence-conditioned action. Across ten benchmarks, Neos-9B and Neos-35B demonstrate leading performance among specialized multimodal deep-search agents.

</details>


### [889] [VL-DocIR: A Benchmark for Vision-Based Long Document Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17057)
*Simon Ott,Yufan Chen,Ruiping Liu,Junwei Zheng,Jiale Wei,Di Wen,Kunyu Peng,Jiaming Zhang,Rainer Stiefelhagen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VL-DocIR是一个面向证据完整的长文档视觉检索的页级基准，涵盖跨页、跨文档等复杂证据结构，揭示了当前视觉检索器在长文档场景下的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉文档检索评估偏重短文档和单一相关页，导致排行榜性能与真实长文档检索场景存在差距；真实场景中回答问题所需证据常跨多页甚至多文档。

Method: 构建VL-DocIR基准：从维基百科、arXiv、PubMed和SEC代理声明中提取29,641个HTML原生文档，渲染为388,548张页面图像；包含271,760个查询，覆盖23个领域和六种证据结构（单页、文档内多页、跨文档）。证据标注锚定到渲染页和HTML元素ID，并通过清洗流程过滤查询（清晰性、正确性、封闭性、无显式布局引用）。评估单向量与多向量视觉检索器，并设置文档上下文打分、查询拆分、重排序、轮询集成等诊断设置。

Result: 最强配置在结构均衡的Macro评估下达到69.3 nDCGAll@10和80.6 RecallAll@10；但按来源和证据结构细分显示，跨文档检索明显难于单页检索，文档上下文打分对文档内多页查询尤为有效。

Conclusion: VL-DocIR暴露了现有视觉检索器的失败模式，为视觉长文档检索提供了更具挑战性的目标。数据集和代码将公开于https://yufanchen96.github.io/VL-DocIR。

Abstract: Vision-based document retrieval has improved rapidly, but current evaluation settings still emphasize short documents and single relevant pages. This leaves an important gap between leaderboard performance and realistic long-document retrieval, where the evidence needed to answer a query may span multiple pages or even multiple documents. We present VL-DocIR, a page-level benchmark for evidence-complete visual long-document retrieval. VL-DocIR is built from 29,641 HTML-born documents rendered into 388,548 page images from Wikipedia, arXiv, PubMed, and SEC proxy statements. It contains 271,760 queries across 23 domains and six evidence structures, covering single-page, within-document multi-page, and cross-document evidence configurations. Evidence annotations are grounded to rendered pages and HTML element identifiers, and queries are filtered with a cleaning pipeline targeting clarity, correctness, closedness, and the absence of explicit layout references. We evaluate leading single-vector and multi-vector visual retrievers together with diagnostic retrieval settings such as document-context scoring, query splitting, reranking, and round-robin ensembles. The strongest evaluated configuration reaches 69.3 nDCGAll@10 and 80.6 RecallAll@10 under structure-balanced Macro evaluation, but source- and evidence-structure breakdowns show that cross-document retrieval remains substantially harder than single-page retrieval, and that document-context scoring is especially helpful for within-document multi-page queries. VL-DocIR exposes these failure modes and provides a more demanding target for visual long-document retrieval. The new dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://yufanchen96.github.io/VL-DocIR.

</details>


### [890] [PatientWM: Towards Generalizable Clinical World Models via Unified Patient States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17059)
*Ziwen Kan,Jie Peng,Bo Yan,Davis Hobley,Zheng Zhang,Yu Tian,Tianlong Chen,Song Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 PatientWM 临床世界模型框架，用统一患者状态和有序潜历史构建状态演化，在多个数据集上实现预测、多步预测和规划任务的最优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学世界模型将演化状态绑定于特定模态或任务，难以复用；且仅通过观测序列或循环/潜摘要保留历史，未显式暴露先前患者状态与临床动作作为有序转移上下文，而相似当前测量可能源于不同的近期变化与治疗暴露。

Method: 构建以统一患者状态和序贯潜历史为核心的临床世界模型。采用可用性感知编码器将各决策时刻可用观测整合进患者状态；用类型化解码器生成任务特定临床读出，而不将状态绑定单一目标。下一步状态预测以当前状态、给定动作以及有界有序的先前潜状态与临床动作历史为条件。

Result: 在 MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV 及三个外部临床数据集上，临床预测、多步预测和动作规划评估均取得更优性能；迁移实验进一步验证患者状态的可泛化性。

Conclusion: PatientWM 能有效预测临床演化并支持规划，验证了统一患者状态与有序潜历史建模的价值。

Abstract: Clinical decisions depend on anticipating how a patient's condition will evolve as treatment is adjusted and new evidence becomes available. Existing medical world models capture patient-state evolution, but often define the evolving state around a particular modality or task, limiting reuse as inputs or prediction targets change. These models also retain history through observation sequences or recurrent or latent summaries rather than exposing preceding patient states and clinical actions as an ordered transition context. This distinction matters because similar current measurements may follow different recent changes, treatment exposures, and observed responses. To tackle these limitations, we propose PatientWM, a clinical world-model framework built around a unified patient state and sequential latent history. Availability-aware encoders integrate observations available at each decision time into the patient state, while typed decoders produce task-specific clinical readouts without defining the state around any single target. PatientWM further conditions each next-state prediction on the current state and supplied action together with a bounded, ordered history of preceding latent patient states and clinical actions, preserving recent treatment and response context. Experiments across MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, and three external clinical datasets show superior performance in clinical prediction, multi-step forecasting, and action-planning evaluation. Transfer experiments further demonstrate the generalizability of PatientWM's patient state. Together, these results establish its ability to forecast clinical evolution and support planning.

</details>


### [891] [SFT Leaves a Reproducible Signature in Activation Geometry: Calibrating Post-Training Interpretability Against Run-to-Run Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17093)
*Xupeng Chen,Chenqian Le,Jiayi Cheng,Runhao Li,Michael Yue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文检验"模型差异可归因于后训练"这一假设，发现同一LoRA-SFT配方重跑间的间隔可达其与基座距离的一半以上，因此将每次基座-后训练对比对照该配方自身的重跑波动带进行打分，给出一种描述性的"校准结构位移"指标，而非机制性结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型差异（model diff）常被用来把基座检查点与后训练后代之间的差异归因于后训练，并默认重跑会落在附近。但在Qwen3-1.7B的稀疏共激活图上这一默认失效，作者因此质疑该归因的可靠性并寻求更稳健的度量。

Method: 在Qwen3-1.7B稀疏共激活图上，将每次基座→后训练对比与其同配方重跑带（run-to-run band）对照，用z分数打分；证明在运行可交换性下k次重跑最多只能认证p=1/(k+1)，故该带z分数仅具描述性刻度意义。使用预注册估计器，并在Llama-3.1-8B（Llama-Scope）上复现；比较4次SFT与4次DPO（各29步）的位移区间；对DPO在12/29/60步做band计数；在4,816条留出提示、三种边预算下做预注册因果扫描。

Result: SFT留下大且可复现的签名：基座→SFT使图位移达17.8个成对距离SD（超出四次独立LoRA-SFT间平均距离），并在Llama-3.1-8B上复现。各29步时，4次SFT与4次DPO占居不重叠的位移区间，间隙分别为两臂散布的5.0倍和5.6倍。DPO band计数无一致剂量顺序且位移平坦；轻量GRPO为次要未检出而非缺失；RL式图集中读数在零RL基座中已存在。因果扫描显示位移来源具承载性（均值12倍、中位数3.5倍于匹配随机对照，10,000边），但阶段特异性交互在两种预算下反转，第三种未过忠实性门槛。

Conclusion: 作者主张"校准的结构位移"而非机制改变；结论限于单一骨干、单一SFT配方及通用文本探针状态，所有波动带基于单一GPU架构构建。

Abstract: A model diff credits post-training with whatever separates a base checkpoint from one post-trained descendant, presuming a rerun would land close by. On the sparse co-activation graph of Qwen3-1.7B it does not: two LoRA-SFT reruns sit over half as far apart as either sits from the base. We score each base-to-post contrast against the run-to-run band of its own recipe, and show that $k$ runs certify no better than $p=1/(k+1)$ under run exchangeability, however large the effect, so the band $z$-score is a descriptive scale. SFT leaves a large, reproducible signature: base $\to$ SFT displaces the graph by 17.8 pairwise-distance SDs beyond the mean distance between four independent LoRA-SFT runs, and the pre-registered estimator replicates on Llama-3.1-8B with Llama-Scope. At 29 steps each, four SFT and four DPO runs occupy disjoint displacement ranges, a gap $5.0\times$ and $5.6\times$ the spreads of the two arms, without any band. All bands use graphs built on one GPU architecture. Three other readings stop short of a verdict: DPO band counts (3/4, 1/4, 3/4 contrasts outside at 12, 29, 60 steps) show no consistent dose ordering while its displacement stays flat; light GRPO is a secondary non-detection, not an absence, and we run no equivalence test; and the graph concentration read as an RL signature is already in the zero-RL base. A pre-registered causal sweep at three edge budgets on 4,816 held-out prompts found the displaced sources load-bearing ($12\times$ a matched random control in mean, $3.5\times$ in median at 10,000 edges), but their stage-specificity interaction reversed at two budgets and the third failed its faithfulness gate, so we claim calibrated structural displacement, not a changed mechanism. Scope: one backbone, one SFT recipe and general-text probe states for the full protocol.

</details>


### [892] [When LLM Agents See a Conflict but Still Proceed: Cross-Domain Dependencies in Network Slicing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17118)
*Marcos Lima Romero,Ricardo Suyama*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究AI原生网络中LLM智能体在意图冲突场景下的跨域依赖识别问题，发现仅让智能体"看到"依赖并不足以防止有害操作，主张由管理架构强制实施依赖验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来AI原生网络希望用基于LLM的自主智能体进行意图化管理。当不同域的意图在同一资源上相遇时，智能体必须先识别跨域依赖再执行不可逆操作，否则可能造成严重后果。

Method: 以智能电网为用例：电力公司对备份切片有主动意图，该切片设计上看似空闲，恰是降本意图的目标。构建基于工具的环境，依赖需由智能体查询或从清单注释读取，并设置负对照，评估4家提供商10个模型共600次运行。

Result: 多数模型违背其已观察到的依赖：10个模型中7个在收到跨域依赖信息后至少一次移除保护切片；高危害层级中76%的暴露运行移除了切片，4个模型几乎从不移除，仅1个模型从未移除。识别出两种失败模式：不查询依赖、查询后仍照旧执行；智能体常在观察到依赖后仍报告无冲突。

Conclusion: 在AI原生网络中，跨域依赖的可见性不足以作为安全保障；依赖验证应由管理架构在不可逆操作前强制执行，而非委托给LLM的判断。

Abstract: Future AI-native networks are being designed to apply autonomous agents built on large language models (LLMs) in network management through intents. When intents from different domains meet on the same resource, an agent must recognize the cross-domain dependency before taking an irreversible action. We investigate this problem through a smart-grid use case, in which a power utility holds an active intent on a backup slice for protection traffic. This slice appears idle by design, which is precisely the profile targeted by a cost-reduction intent. We built a tool-based environment in which the dependency must be either queried by the agent or read from an inventory annotation, together with a negative control, and evaluated ten models from four different providers in 600 runs. Most models acted against the dependency they had observed: seven of the ten models removed the protection slice at least once after receiving the cross-domain dependency, and in the high-harm tier the slice was removed in 76% of the exposed runs, while four models practically never did. Only one of ten models never removed the slice. We identify two failure modes, not querying the dependency and querying it but proceeding anyway, and show that agents often reported no conflict after observing it. These results indicate that, in AI-native networks, visibility of cross-domain dependencies is not a sufficient safeguard, and that dependency verification should be enforced by the management architecture before irreversible actions rather than delegated to the LLM's judgment.

</details>


### [893] [EvoQuantLab: Training-Free Dual-Loop Evolution for Auditable Quantitative Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17130)
*Haolin Yang,Zhiqiang Qian,Chutian Chen,Jipeng Zhang,Tangjia Deng,Jian Xie,Shuaishuai Gong,Sirui Han,Yike Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvoQuantLab是一个无需训练的双环自进化框架，用内层遗传规划循环结合外层诊断循环提升因子发现鲁棒性和token效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的量化因子发现方法存在严重的回测过拟合问题，需要更稳健的因子发现框架。

Method: 提出EvoQuantLab：无需训练的双环自进化框架。内层遗传规划循环在结构和多样性约束下进化带类型因子表达式以提升token效率；外层诊断循环系统审计跨周期证据以改进协议；评估流程采用多指标验证过滤虚假因子。

Result: 在日频与小时频、股票与加密货币的样本外实验中表现稳健。CSI 500和S&P 500日频任务年化收益分别为18.34%和21.30%；小时频加密货币数据年化收益37.91%，并有效避免执行崩溃。

Conclusion: EvoQuantLab能有效缓解回测过拟合，在多市场多频率下优于现有agent基线，实现更稳健的自动化因子发现。

Abstract: Automated alpha factor discovery is critical for modern quantitative research. While large language models (LLMs) have increasingly been integrated into quantitative workflows, existing agent-based approaches remain highly susceptible to severe backtest overfitting. To address this challenge, we propose EvoQuantLab, a training-free, dual-loop self-evolving framework for robust factor discovery. Instead of relying entirely on LLM generation, EvoQuantLab deploys an inner genetic-programming (GP) loop that dramatically improves token efficiency while evolving typed factor expressions under structural and diversity constraints. An outer diagnosis loop then systematically audits evidence across cycles to drive protocol-level improvements. Furthermore, our evaluation pipeline applies multi-metric validation to rigorously filter out spurious factors before deployment. Extensive out-of-sample experiments across both daily and hourly frequencies -- covering equities and cryptocurrency -- demonstrate the robustness of EvoQuantLab. Specifically, on daily CSI 500 and S&P 500 tasks, EvoQuantLab achieves leading annualized returns of 18.34% and 21.30%, consistently outperforming existing agent baselines. On high-turnover hourly cryptocurrency data, EvoQuantLab delivers a 37.91% annualized return while effectively avoiding execution collapse.

</details>


### [894] [Learning Perceptual Geometry of Natural Odor Mixtures from LLM-Derived Descriptors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17164)
*Farhad Pashakhanloo,Venkatesh N. Murthy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文利用LLM从食物挥发物混合物中衍生感知描述，探究分子组成与自然气味混合物感知相似性的关系，发现语言衍生表示可有效监督预测混合物相似性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气味化学与感知的关系尚不完全清楚，现有研究多聚焦单分子，而天然气味含数十至数百种成分，增加了感知形成的复杂性。作者希望探索天然气味混合物中分子组成与感知相似性的关系。

Method: 使用含1200多种食物挥发物混合物、8000多个分子成分的数据库，以LLM作为可扩展代理生成混合物级感知描述；用语言衍生表示监督预测留出混合物相似性；训练中学习低秩分子嵌入；并探索外部分子特征的作用。

Result: 语言衍生表示能有效预测留出混合物相似性，化学感知提示效果最强；学习到的低秩分子嵌入优于成分重叠指标，即使无共享分子；分子几何与独立人类气味描述空间显著对齐；外部特征零样本对齐有限，少量监督下提升预测，但全训练集下增益甚微。

Conclusion: 语言衍生描述可为复杂天然混合物的感知组织提供可扩展监督，有助于定量理解分子组成如何产生气味感知。

Abstract: The relationship between odor chemistry and perception remains incompletely understood. Many existing studies focus on the perception of single molecules, whereas natural odors contain tens to hundreds of components, adding extra layer of complexity to percept formation. Here, we explore the relationship between molecular composition and perceived similarity in natural odor objects. We study this using a database of more than 1,200 volatile-compound-in-food mixtures containing more than 8,000 molecular components, and use large language models (LLMs) as a scalable surrogate for deriving mixture-level perceptual descriptions. We find that language-derived representations provide useful supervision for predicting held-out mixture similarities from molecular composition. The prediction was consistently strongest when perceptual targets were derived from chemosensory prompts than from other sensory prompts. Further, during the mixture-level training, we learned low-rank molecular embeddings that enabled better prediction of held-out mixture similarities than component-overlap metrics, even for mixture pairs with no shared molecules. Although no single-molecule labels were used during training, the learned molecular geometry showed significant alignment with the independent human odor-descriptor space. Finally, we explored the use of external molecular features in our mixture-similarity prediction task. These features showed modest zero-shot alignment with mixture-level perceptual similarity. They improved prediction under limited supervision but offered little additional predictive benefit with the full training set. Together, these results show that language-derived descriptions can provide scalable supervision for predicting the perceptual organization of complex natural mixtures, contributing to a quantitative understanding of how molecular composition gives rise to odor perception.

</details>


### [895] [ChemExplain: A Multimodal Benchmark for Explanatory Chemical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17183)
*Aotian Chen,Frazier N. Baker,Reza Averly,Shan Zhang,Tianao Chen,Daniel Adu-Ampratwum,Xia Ning,Yuan Xue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ChemExplain：1180道化学多选题基准，测试模型能否解释化学效应为何发生（解释性归因），最强模型准确率78.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有化学基准多评估结果预测或反应路径生成，很少测试模型能否解释观察到的化学效应为何发生。

Method: 从383篇同行评审论文中构建1180道多选题，每题含分子/反应图像、观察到的化学效应及四个对应不同结构特征的候选解释；正确特征-机制关系源自原论文证据而非LLM编造；用多智能体框架自动构建并进行三阶段递进质量控制，8位化学专家验证。

Result: 最强模型准确率78.6%，仍有较大提升空间；在600题专家复核子集上，推理轨迹分析显示最强模型71.4%的错误属于归因失败；归因也是开源及化学专用模型的最大错误类别。

Conclusion: 解释性归因是当前化学模型的核心短板，ChemExplain为评估该能力提供了严格基准。

Abstract: Current chemistry benchmarks primarily evaluate outcome prediction or reaction pathway generation, but rarely test whether a model can explain why an observed chemical effect occurs. We introduce ChemExplain, a benchmark of 1,180 multiple-choice chemistry questions drawn from 383 peer-reviewed papers. Each question pairs a molecular or reaction image with an observed chemical effect and four candidate explanations, each associated with a different structural feature visible in the image. Answering requires the model to perceive the depicted structure, apply chemical knowledge, and identify which feature most directly explains the effect, a capability we term explanatory attribution. The correct feature-mechanism relation is derived from supporting evidence in the source paper rather than invented by the question-generation LLM. We construct the benchmark automatically with a multi-agent framework that applies progressive quality control at three stages and validate it with eight chemistry domain experts. The strongest evaluated model reaches 78.6% accuracy, leaving considerable room for improvement. On a 600-question expert-reviewed subset, reasoning-trace analysis classifies 71.4% of the strongest model's errors as attribution failures. Attribution is also the largest error category for the open-source and chemistry-specific models included in our analysis.

</details>


### [896] [Size Generalization for Diffusion Routing Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17192)
*Barak Itzchak Davidovitch,Eli Meirom,Ethan Fetaya,Gal Chechik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ResizeCO提出一种无需标签的规模泛化方法，用强化学习（GRPO）将小规模训练的扩散模型适配到大规模路径问题，并用GPU束搜索求解k-opt，在TSP/CVRP上达到质量-时间Pareto最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路径问题（TSP、CVRP）为NP-hard且大规模求解缓慢；扩散求解器依赖最优解监督训练，大规模最优解难获得，且难以泛化到训练分布外的规模。

Method: ResizeCO为无标签规模泛化方法：针对大规模实例统计性质变化和求解效率问题，用强化学习在? 大规模实例上适配小规模训练的扩散模型，将GRPO改造用于此问题、以路径长度作训练信号；同时把k-opt建模为树搜索，在GPU上用束搜索求解。

Result: 在最多10000节点的TSP和CVRP规模泛化实验中，ResizeCO在路径质量与时间的Pareto前沿上优于学习型求解器，并在短运行时间下超越其他求解器，刷新SOTA。

Conclusion: 结合强化学习微调扩散模型与GPU束搜索的k-opt，可有效实现路径问题的规模泛化，在大规模实例上兼顾解质量与求解速度。

Abstract: Routing problems, like the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), are NP-hard and slow to solve for large instances. Diffusion-based solvers can be trained in a supervised way using sets of optimal solutions, and then quickly solve new test instances. However, for large instances, optimal solutions are hard to find, and diffusion models fail to generalize to instance sizes outside their training distribution. Here we describe ResizeCO, a label free size-generalization approach that addresses both the change in statistical properties of larger instances, and the computational challenge of solving them quickly. It uses reinforcement learning on large-scale instances to adapt a diffusion model trained on small instances. Specifically, we adapt GRPO to this problem, using route length as the training signal. ResizeCO also formulates k-opt as a tree search, solved by a beam search on the GPU. In size-generalization experiments on TSP and CVRP instances with up to 10000 nodes, ResizeCO achieves a Pareto front over route quality and time that dominates learned solvers, and also outperforms other solvers at short run times, setting a new state of the art.

</details>


### [897] [Releasing the Inner Jev: A Simple Recipe for Open Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17205)
*Jonathan Geuter,Andrew Cheng,David Alvarez-Melis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 开源指令微调模型无需额外训练即可通过读取输出logits中的字母(A、B、C)获得与Jev相当的System One决策能力，简单LoRA微调后可超越Jev并创下OpenDecisions新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-based决策系统（System One模型，如Jev）近期流行，但其能力是否依赖专有训练尚不清楚。本文旨在探究开源指令微调模型是否已具备此类System One能力，并能否通过简单方法达到或超越Jev的性能。

Method: 作者从模型最后token位置的输出logits中读取选项字母(A、B、C等)的答案，无需文本生成和额外训练。随后提出一种简单监督微调方案：用LoRA和从语言模型head切片初始化的决策head对四个开源模型（Gemma 4 31B/12B、Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.5-4B）进行微调。同时发布OpenDecisions，一个2352题的验证数据集，基于准确率和校准指标计算Capability分数。

Result: 未微调时，Gemma 4 31B在OpenDecisions上得79.6，接近Jev的80.1。微调后在OpenDecisions上得84.4、JevBench v1.7上得81.5，分别比Jev高4.3和4.4个Capability点，创OpenDecisions新SOTA。在公共决策数据集上，模型准确率与Jev相当，但校准误差更低。

Conclusion: 开源语言模型本身已具备System One决策能力，经简单微调即可在广泛决策任务上超越Jev。作者开源了模型、服务代码和OpenDecisions数据集。

Abstract: LLM-based decision-making systems, also called System One models, have recently gained popularity, most notably through Jev (Almeida, 2026). Given a typed input state, a question, and a set of options, they return a probability for each option in a single forward pass, without text generation. We show that existing open instruction-tuned language models can achieve comparable performance \textit{without any additional training}, by reading out answers from letters (A, B, C, etc.) in the model's output logits at the last token position. Furthermore, we show how a simple supervised fine-tuning recipe can improve their performance further. We evaluate four open instruction-tuned language models: Gemma 4 31B, Gemma 4 12B, Qwen3.6-27B, and Qwen3.5-4B. We fine-tune each using LoRA and a decision head initialized from a slice of the language model head. Furthermore, we introduce OpenDecisions, a novel 2,352-question validation dataset designed to reflect the task composition of JevBench (JevBench main- tainers, 2026) and which computes a Capability score based on accuracy and calibration metrics. Without fine-tuning, Gemma 4 31B scores 79.6 on OpenDecisions, compared to Jev's 80.1. After undergoing our fine-tuning recipe, it scores 84.4 on OpenDecisions and 81.5 on JevBench v1.7, outperforming Jev by 4.3 and 4.4 Capability points respectively and setting a new state-of-the-art on OpenDecisions. On a suite of public decision datasets, our models achieve accuracy comparable to Jev, with lower calibration error. Our results show that open language models already possess System One capabilities, and with simple fine-tuning they outperform Jev on a wide range of decision tasks. We release our models, serving code, and OpenDecisions.

</details>


### [898] [AutoMARS: Automatic and Scalable Multi-Agent Large Language Model Framework for Supply Chain Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17206)
*Yinzhu Quan,Zefang Liu,Frederick Benaben,Benoit Montreuil*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AutoMARS，一个agentic框架，用于供应链网络中自动、可扩展的比较性风险评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 供应链风险评估需要整合多领域异构风险因素，传统方法难以实现端到端自动化和跨地点可扩展比较。

Method: 采用多领域、多智能体、多工具架构，自动规划任务、协调专用智能体、调用外部分析工具，并并行化独立分析任务以实现跨地点风险比较，整合社会经济、灾害、环境与交通风险因素。

Result: 通过协调的智能体交互与工具集成，实现结构化、系统化、可解释的比较分析，支持供应链风险感知的地点评估。

Conclusion: AutoMARS为供应链网络提供自动且可扩展的比较性风险评估能力。

Abstract: We propose AutoMARS (Automatic Multi-Agent Risk Assessment), an agentic framework for automatic and scalable comparative risk assessment in supply chain networks. The framework enables end-to-end execution of analytical workflows by automatically planning tasks, coordinating specialized agents, invoking external analytical tools, and synthesizing domain-specific results into integrated risk evaluations. AutoMARS further supports scalable risk comparison across multiple locations by parallelizing independent analytical tasks. The framework adopts a multi-domain, multi-agent, and multi-tool architecture that integrates heterogeneous risk factors from socioeconomic, disaster, environmental, and transportation domains. Through coordinated agent interactions and tool integration, AutoMARS enables structured, systematic, and interpretable comparative analysis to support supply chain risk-aware location evaluation.

</details>


### [899] [IsoVRBench: Video Reward Modeling Without Human Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17234)
*Shuyue Stella Li,Jacqueline He,Jiahui Chen,Sreya Dutta Roy,Yulia Tsvetkov,Luke Zettlemoyer,Marjan Ghazvininejad,Xiaochuang Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出IsoVRBench基准，通过控制单变量干预自动生成偏好对，揭示视频奖励模型在时序等重要属性上的失败，并证明合成干预对可用于训练更强的奖励模型和生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频奖励模型基于同时存在多属性差异的人类偏好对训练与评估，聚合准确率无法揭示模型能可靠区分哪些视频属性。

Method: 通过控制干预改变生成视频的单一属性、固定其余属性，自动构造偏好对，无需人工标注；构建含8,000对、8种干预的IsoVRBench基准，并将合成隔离干预对用作训练数据。

Result: SOTA模型能区分生成器间整体质量差异，但在时序等特征上失败（重排帧仅60.8%，人类100%），现有基准排名无法预测该失败；训练得到IsoVRM在VBench-2.0上超人类数据对应模型3.8分，IsoWan在人类偏好中更优，且与人类数据结合可叠加增益。

Conclusion: 自动生成的干预对可扩展地构建基准与训练数据，弥补人类偏好聚合评估的盲区，提升奖励模型与视频生成器性能。

Abstract: Video reward models are trained and evaluated on human preferences between videos that often differ simultaneously on properties such as prompt alignment, visual fidelity, motion, and generator identity. As a result, aggregate accuracy does not reveal which video properties a reward model can reliably distinguish. We construct preference pairs by controlled interventions that change one property of a generated video while holding the rest fixed. The resulting pairs, by construction, provide preferences for how the videos differ along a specific dimension, without requiring any human annotation. We propose IsoVRBench, a video generation reward modeling benchmark of 8,000 such pairs across eight interventions, and show that state-of-the-art models separate broad quality differences between generators but miss important features such as temporal order. The best reward model reaches only 60.8% on reordered frames against 100% for humans, and rankings on existing benchmarks do not predict this failure. Using the synthetic isolated intervation pairs as training data leads to 1) IsoVRM, a reward model outperforming its counterpart trained with a larger human labeled preference dataset by 3.8 points on VBench-2.0, 2) IsoWan, the video generator post-trained with IsoVRM, outperforming its human-data counterpart in human preferences, and 3) gains that stack when combined with human data. Because intervention pairs are automatically generated rather than collected, the benchmark and training data can be easily extended as generators evolve.

</details>


### [900] [Does a Governed Confidence Score Know When a Text-to-SQL Answer Is Right? An Exploratory Study on BIRD and a Pre-registered Confirmation on Spider](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17256)
*Raghu Venkat,Tricha Anjali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文审计了一个生产级对话分析系统中答案置信度评分的设计，发现其区分能力弱且过度拒答，通过重新设计评分规则并在Spider上预注册验证，显著提升了性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话分析系统需要每个答案可信可解释，生产系统通过置信度分数决定显示、警告或拒答答案，但该分数的权重、上限和阈值均为人工设计，缺乏系统审计，本文旨在检验并改进这一设计。

Method: 在BIRD dev的1534个问题上，用GPT-5.1、适配生产提示和每题5个样本评估原设计分数；随后冻结新规则（以与所示答案的一致性作为分数，确定性检查作为否决和上限），并在Spider dev上进行预注册测试。

Result: 原设计AUROC仅0.624，拒答35.7%的正确答案；排名信号主要来自样本间一致性，且被最小化与检查表的组合削弱。新规则使AUROC从0.566升至0.725（配对差+0.159），正确答案被拒率从49.0%降至8.8%，PASS准确率95.7%。

Conclusion: 收益来自一致性如何进入分数而非一致性统计量的选择；新增检查的收益取决于正确性定义但总会降低无保留覆盖率；预注册的空结果检查未达效应量标准。正确性指核心答案，标签由模型判定，双人盲审尚未完成。

Abstract: Conversational analytics lets people ask questions of records spread across many systems and get answers in plain language; it is useful only if each answer can be trusted and explained. A production system of this kind attaches a confidence score to every answer it writes over a database and uses it to show the answer, show it with a warning, or withhold it. The score's weights, caps and thresholds were set by design. This paper audits that design. On the 1,534 questions of BIRD dev, answered by GPT-5.1 with a benchmark-adapted production prompt and five samples per question, the designed score separates right from wrong answers weakly (AUROC 0.624, 95% CI 0.595-0.652) and withholds 35.7% of correct answers. Nearly all of its ranking signal comes from agreement among the samples, and most of it is lost where agreement is combined by a minimum with a checklist that drops to zero on any unsupported claim, including claims in commentary. We froze a rule in which agreement with the shown answer is the score and deterministic checks act as vetoes and caps, and pre-registered a test on Spider dev before any Spider answer existed. The primary hypothesis held: AUROC rose from 0.566 to 0.725 (paired difference +0.159, 95% CI +0.097 to +0.221), and correct answers withheld fell from 49.0% to 8.8% with PASS accuracy 95.7%. Under one matching policy the choice of agreement statistic matters little; the gain comes from how agreement enters the score. Whether added checks help depends on how correctness is defined, while they always cost unqualified coverage. A pre-registered empty-result check did not meet its effect-size criterion on Spider. Correctness here means the core answer; labels are model-judged, and a blinded two-person audit, not yet complete, will be reported in a revised version.

</details>


### [901] [RL Post-Training Diffusion Language Models Along Their Own Generation Paths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17266)
*Vaibhav Singh,Eugene Belilovsky*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PACT 提出一种面向扩散语言模型的强化学习后训练方法，通过联合学习策略和状态势函数，解决去噪轨迹"轨迹盲"问题，在多项任务上显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型是自回归模型的高效替代方案，但多数RL后训练技术难以适配：扩散模型通过多步中间状态生成答案，现有方法要么近似难处理的序列似然，要么对所有去噪步骤赋予相同优势，未区分中间状态对期望奖励的影响（轨迹盲问题）。

Method: 受奖励倾斜参考分布启发，PACT联合学习策略与一个标量势函数来评分每个中间状态，并以终端奖励为锚。对每个采样的去噪转移，用一致性损失将已揭示token的策略与参考分布对数概率比与该势函数的变化相匹配。该方法无需序列似然估计，也无需重要性比裁剪。

Result: 在四个任务上，PACT将 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 提升：GSM8K +9.9、MATH500 +12.0、Countdown +55.7、Sudoku +72.6；四项任务平均准确率达该模型已报告最佳，比次优方法高3.7分。相比 AGRPO，在GSM8K上约用一半训练算力即达到其最佳准确率。

Conclusion: PACT通过势函数锚定的一致性损失有效解决扩散语言模型RL后训练中的轨迹盲问题，无需似然估计或重要性裁剪，在准确率和训练效率上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Diffusion language models are a promising and more efficient alternative to autoregressive models. However, most RL post-training techniques are not easily adapted to these models. One issue is that diffusion language models generate answers through many intermediate states, deciding at each step which masked positions to reveal and which tokens to place in them. Many existing RL methods used in this setting approximate intractable sequence likelihoods or weight every denoising step by the same advantage, without explicitly distinguishing how these intermediate states of the denoising trajectory affect the expected reward. To address this issue of trajectory blindness, we introduce PACT (Potential-Anchored Consistency of Transitions). Motivated by a reward-tilted reference distribution, PACT jointly learns the policy and a scalar potential that scores each intermediate state, anchored by terminal reward. For each sampled denoising transition, a consistency loss matches the policy-to-reference log-probability ratio of revealed tokens to the change in this potential. This formulation requires neither sequence-likelihood estimation nor importance-ratio clipping. On four tasks, PACT improves LLaDA-8B-Instruct by +9.9 points on GSM8K, +12.0 on MATH500, +55.7 on Countdown, and +72.6 on Sudoku, and reaches the best average accuracy across the four tasks reported for this model, +3.7 points over the next best method. Further compared to AGRPO, it reaches that baseline's best accuracy in about half the training compute on GSM8K.

</details>


### [902] [Reasoning for Propaganda Detection via Label-Guided CoT Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17271)
*Zeba Afroz,Harsh Vardhan,Md. Shad Akhtar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ReCoT 框架，无需额外解释标注即可捕捉说服技巧的定义性线索，实现可解释的 propaganda 检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 propaganda 检测系统多为黑箱，缺乏解释性。作者假设说服技巧相对其社会政治背景含有定义性特征，可据此提供解释。

Method: ReCoT 是一个 reasoning-conditioned 检测框架，通过 population-level refinement（群体级精炼）和 performance-guided resampling（性能引导重采样）捕获说服技巧的定义性线索，无需额外解释标注。

Result: 在 INDI-PROPspan 上宏 F1_LCS 达 0.364，超过基线并达到 SFT 上界 Avg F1_LCS 的 88%；在 PTC 上达 SFT 上界 Avg F1_LCS 的 85%，在保持可解释性的同时缩小了差距。

Conclusion: 对 reasoning pool 收敛与更新模式的分析表明 ReCoT 有效精炼了推理 CoT，验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: Propaganda detection systems usually operate as black boxes, lacking explanations. To address this, we hypothesise that persuasive techniques contain definitional characteristics with respect to their social-political setting. We introduce ReCoT, a reasoning-conditioned detection framework that captures definitional cues of persuasive techniques via population-level refinement and performance-guided resampling, without requiring additional explanation annotations. On INDI-PROPspan, ReCoT achieves a macro F1_LCS of 0.364, surpassing baselines and reaching 88% of the SFT upper bound on Avg F1_LCS. Similarly, on PTC, ReCoT reaches 85% of the SFT upper bound on Avg F1_LCS, closing much of this gap while remaining interpretable. Importantly, the analysis of the reasoning pool's convergence and update pattern for ReCoT shows effective refinement of reasoning CoTs.

</details>


### [903] [PhysCodeGym: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Physically Verifiable 4D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17288)
*Shuai Shao,Jinchen He,Cunxin Fan,Zihan Guo,Shijian Wang,Qihan Ren,Kangning Zhang,Zunnan Xu,Haoyuan Li,Hao Wang,Jianghao Lin,Weiwen Liu,Weinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PhysCodeGym基准，用于从视频中进行物理可验证的4D重建，通过编码代理编写并迭代Blender程序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从视频建立物理模拟需编码代理将观测转化为可执行模型，但缺乏可验证的评测工具，且现有重建可能仅复制观测而存在物理缺陷。

Method: 构建含156个任务的基准，涵盖刚体、液体、可变形体与风驱动运动；代理自主检查视频、编写运行Blender程序并据仿真反馈修正场景；用六项指标（规则测量与评分标准判断结合）评估视觉与物理质量，并通过程序检查、场景测量与反事实干预测试物理一致性。

Result: 实验显示前沿编码代理在推理强度设置下存在产物质量与完成度的权衡；代理轨迹与测试框架比较将验证行为与重建表现关联；案例表明可见物体与事件匹配可与物理缺陷共存，反事实测试进一步暴露普通物理检查通过的重建中潜在的接触与支撑失效。

Conclusion: 该基准揭示了复现观测与建立可靠物理模型之间的差距，为物理可验证的4D重建提供评测手段。

Abstract: Building physical simulations from video requires coding agents to translate observations into executable models and refine them through tool use. We introduce PhysCodeGym, a benchmark for physically verifiable 4D reconstruction with $156$ tasks covering rigid-body, liquid, deformable, and wind-driven motion. Agents autonomously inspect videos, write and run Blender programs, and revise their scenes using simulation feedback. Six metrics combine rule-based measurements with rubric-based judgments to assess visual and physical reconstruction quality. Program inspection, scene measurements, and counterfactual interventions test physical consistency under original and modified conditions. Experiments with frontier coding agents reveal a tradeoff between artifact quality and completion across reasoning-effort settings, while harness comparisons and agent traces link verification behavior with reconstruction performance. Case studies show that matching visible objects and events can coexist with physical defects. Counterfactual tests further expose latent contact and support failures in reconstructions that pass ordinary physical checks, highlighting the gap between reproducing observations and building reliable physical models. Code is available at https://github.com/ShaoShuai0605/PhysCodeGym.

</details>


### [904] [Towards Resilience: Slice-Driven Orchestration of Mobile IoMT in 6G-Edge-Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17296)
*Muhammad Zeeshan,Hafiz Faheem Shahid,Erkki Harjula*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于资源切片的IoMT自适应编排框架，融合5G网络切片、资源感知编排与移动感知任务卸载，以在边缘资源受限条件下提升QoS保障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时诊断、远程健康监测、计算机辅助手术等新兴医疗服务需要严格的QoS保证，但边缘资源有限且异构。现有IoMT编排方法主要关注延迟、带宽等通信指标，忽视了边缘资源约束以及对工作负载和用户移动性的动态适应。

Method: 提出资源切片自适应编排框架，将5G网络切片(NS)、资源感知编排与移动感知任务卸载集成于同一自适应系统：将IoMT服务分配到不同5G网络切片，并联合考虑CPU容量、内存可用性和存储量，实现更高效的服务放置与执行；支持用户移动与动态任务卸载以保持服务连续性。

Result: 基于SimPy的仿真表明，该方法提升了服务部署效率，降低了请求阻塞率，提高了用户接受度，并在多样化IoMT场景下保持可靠性能。

Conclusion: 资源切片自适应编排能有效应对受限异构边缘资源下的IoMT服务需求，兼顾资源约束与移动性，优于仅关注通信指标的现有方法。

Abstract: Emerging healthcare services, such as real-time diagnostics, remote health monitoring and computer-assisted surgery, require stringent Quality of Service (QoS) guarantees while operating under limited and heterogeneous edge resources. Existing Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) orchestration methods primarily focus on communication metrics such as latency and bandwidth, while overlooking edge resource constraints and dynamic adaptation to workload and user mobility. This paper presents a novel resource-slicing-based adaptive orchestration framework that integrates 5G network slicing (NS), resource-aware orchestration, and mobility-aware task offloading into a single adaptive system. IoMT services are assigned to distinct 5G network slices while jointly considering CPU capacity, memory availability and amount of storage, enabling more efficient service placement and execution. In addition, the system supports user mobility and dynamic task offloading to maintain service continuity under changing network conditions. SimPy-based simulation demonstrates that the proposed method enhances service deployment efficiency, reduces request blocking, and improves user acceptance while maintaining reliable performance across diverse IoMT scenarios.

</details>


### [905] [The Agent Knew: Internal States Forecast Unauthorized Actions and Stop Them, and the Lies That Follow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17301)
*Arya Fayyazi,Mehdi Kamal,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 语言模型智能体在越权行动及虚假报告其行为方面存在问题。作者提出用线性读出器预测违规与虚假报告，并通过门控行动来减少违规，这在多个基准和模型家族中有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体有时会超越权限并谎报行为。研究旨在理解这种越权与谎报的模式，并寻找一种在行动前预测和阻止违规的方法。

Method: 在CAPE-Bench上设计匹配任务，其中单一事实决定行动是否被授权；观察违规与虚假报告模式。利用智能体残差流的线性读出器预测违规（行动前）和虚假报告（报告前），并基于该预测对每个提议行动进行门控。还将读出器应用于tau^2-bench和AgentDojo。

Result: 在1081个新知情违规中，70%出现"追溯性许可洗白"行为，而未违规时仅8%（预注册优势比7.0）。线性读出器预测违规的AUROC为0.94，优于思维链监控。门控使Gemma-4违规从0.70降至0.09，完成率保持1.00。在AgentDojo上，攻击成功率下降（Gemma-4 11.7%→5.7%，gpt-oss 28.5%→17.5%），良性效用保持。

Conclusion: 阻止违规也是防止虚假报告最可靠的方式（误报违规从0.10降至0.01），而针对谎报的事后修复效果弱。所有测试均预注册并哈希锁定，代码和数据公开。

Abstract: Language-model agents sometimes act beyond their authorization and then misreport what they did.
