The result holds under a second oracle model, a claim-blind prompt, ten further deletions, a second domain and a second constructor. Distrusting the summary layer cuts contaminated queries to 0.4% and 0.8% at 99.8 to 100% of the recall a perfect maintainer would return.

</details>


### [940] [Upstream Influence, Downstream Re-Anchoring in LLM Agent Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17723)
*Chun-Yu Hsu,Lun-Wei Ku,Chung-Chi Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究多智能体LLM工作流中信息架构如何影响协同操纵的传播，发现传播经过链条会衰减但并非简单损耗，而是接收者根据自身证据解读进行部分重锚定；交接格式与暴露位置的模型选择是关键杠杆，而危害在推理轨迹审计中不可见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们依据LLM智能体的评估判断行动，而在多智能体系统中这些判断要经过多个智能体才到达人。作者想揭示工作流的信息架构（来源访问、交接格式、由哪个模型读取不可信内容）如何决定协同操纵能有多少到达终端。

Method: 在32个台湾2025年召回案例上，向一个智能体展示10条真实Threads评论，测量其立场偏移（+0.171）并用镜像评论集做反向验证；随后沿链条传递该判断，比较"仅传递判断"与"每条评论都置于每个智能体面前"等不同架构配置。

Result: 到第三个智能体时偏移衰减超过一半，但保留评论在前可维持更多偏移。这种衰减不是传输损耗：接收者按与其自身证据解读的距离成比例地折扣继承立场，回到证据所隐含的结论而非中立，符合部分重锚定。交接格式是第二杠杆：不带推理的立场传递会被大幅折扣。暴露座位的模型易感性相差四倍，而链条排列完全无影响。

Conclusion: 多智能体LLM工作流中操纵传播由信息架构主导，可通过交接格式与模型选择调节；关键危害在转录文本中不可见——注入的主张几乎从不被复述，因此推理轨迹审计会漏掉此类攻击。

Abstract: People act on evaluative judgments produced by LLM agents, and in multi-agent systems those judgments pass through several agents before reaching a person. We show that a workflow's information architecture---source access, handoff format, and which model reads the untrusted content---governs how much of a coordinated manipulation reaches the end. On 32 Taiwan~2025 recall cases, ten authentic Threads comments shown to one agent move its stance by $+0.171$ toward the injected position, and a mirrored set moves it the other way. Passing that judgment down a chain removes more than half of the shift by the third agent; keeping the comments in front of every agent sustains more of it. The reduction is not attrition in transit: each receiver discounts the inherited stance in proportion to how far it sits from its own reading of the evidence, returning to what that evidence implies for the case rather than to neutrality---consistent with partial re-anchoring. Handoff format is a second lever: a stance relayed without its reasoning is largely discounted. Susceptibility at the exposed seat varies fourfold across models, while the chain's arrangement does not matter at all. None of this is visible in the transcripts---the injected claims are almost never restated, so reasoning-trace audits miss the attack.

</details>


### [941] [Evidence-First Agentic Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17724)
*Reza Sanayei,Razvan-Gabriel Dumitru,Sunjie Hou,MohammadHossein Rezaei,Haris Riaz,Robert Vacareanu,Minglai Yang,Ying Liu,Mihai Surdeanu,Daniel Yue Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Sauron：面向长时程智能体任务、证据优先的验证器，通过联合调查环境状态与执行轨迹、独立核验主张来源，提升鲁棒评判并抵御奖励作弊，F1与成本均优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程、半可验证的智能体任务常用评分细则评判，但证据分散在环境状态和执行轨迹中。评判者可能忽略证据或接受无依据的主张（如智能体自我报告成功）；当评分结论被用作强化学习奖励时，这类错误会强化不良行为。

Method: Sauron是一种证据优先的智能体验证器：同时调查状态与轨迹，只有在对照来源独立验证后才采信主张；使用有界查询与对相关标准联合调查，降低上下文占用与重复工作；每个判定附带可审计的证据回执。

Result: 在100个个人助理回合、2,586条人工标注标准上，Sauron在全部8个主干模型上取得五类验证器中最高的F1；成本低于最强基线Gandalf。GPT-5.6 Sol下F1达0.96（Gandalf为0.92），成本低23%，过程标准上优势更大。在覆盖13类的故障注入测试中（部分模拟奖励作弊），Sauron检出97%注入故障，仅对2%干净对照误报；即使基线获得完整轨迹也被超越。在TRAIL上三项质量指标均超过Gandalf与TRAIL自带评判器。

Conclusion: 证据优先、可审计的联合验证能更准确、低成本地评判长时程智能体任务，并更有效检测失败与奖励作弊。

Abstract: Long-horizon, semi-verifiable agentic tasks often rely on rubric-based evaluation, but the evidence needed to assess these tasks can be spread across the environment state and the execution trace. A judge may overlook this evidence or accept unsupported claims, including an agent's own reports of success. When rubric verdicts serve as reinforcement-learning rewards, such errors can reinforce undesirable behavior. We introduce Sauron, an evidence-first agentic verifier that investigates both state and trace and relies on a claim only after independently validating it against its source. Bounded queries and joint investigation of related criteria reduce context use and redundant work, and each verdict carries an auditable receipt of its supporting evidence. Across 2,586 human-labeled criteria from 100 personal-assistant episodes, Sauron achieves the highest F1 of five verifiers on all eight backbones tested while costing less than Gandalf, the strongest baseline. With GPT-5.6 Sol, it reaches 0.96 F1 versus Gandalf's 0.92 at 23% lower cost, with a wider margin on process criteria. On a paired fault-injection suite covering 13 families, several of which simulate reward hacking, Sauron detects 97% of injected failures while flagging only 2% of clean controls, outperforming baselines even when they are given the full trace. On TRAIL, a benchmark for detecting and localizing real agent errors, Sauron leads both Gandalf and TRAIL's own judge on all three quality metrics.

</details>


### [942] [Safety for Whom? Benchmarking Understanding Beyond Refusal in Egocentric Multimodal Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17728)
*Yewon Han,Jisu Jeon,Suhyun Choi,Juan Yeo,Minsoo Jo,Gihoon Kim,Hyunggyu Lim,Taesup Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出STOU基准，将第一视角多模态助手的安全性评估按受害对象（自己/旁人/社会）区分，并解耦"安全理解"与"拒绝行为"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全评测只统计拒绝率，把受害者混为一谈，掩盖了两类失败：模型可能只保护某类对象，或理解了风险却仍然提供帮助。第一视角助手直接指导物理行为，伤害对象不同，责任与后果也不同。

Method: 构建STOU基准，包含2,902条第一视角视频-音频与视频-文本查询，其潜在伤害对象分别为用户自身、在场他人或社会大众。评测不仅看是否拒绝，还评估模型是否识别用户意图、是否存在伤害及其目标对象、以及下游后果。

Result: 在10个开源与闭源的全模态和多模态LLM上评测发现：拒绝率随伤害对象系统性地变化；模型常常识别出伤害却仍然提供帮助。

Conclusion: 仅凭拒绝率无法证明助手安全，安全对齐必须考虑"谁会受到伤害"。

Abstract: Egocentric multimodal assistants see through the user's eyes and guide what the user does next, so their outputs directly shape physical actions, including those that affect bystanders. Yet existing safety evaluations do not distinguish whom a response would harm, and score only whether a model refuses. Pooling all harms into one refusal rate hides two failures: a model may protect one target but not another, and it may refuse without understanding the risk, or understand it and comply anyway. We present STOU, a benchmark of 2,902 egocentric video-audio and video-text queries whose potential harm targets the user (Self), co-present individuals (The Others), or society at large (Others). Our evaluation decouples safety understanding from refusal behavior: beyond refusal, we score whether the model recognizes the user's intent, the presence and target of harm, and its downstream consequences. Across 10 open and closed source omnimodal and multimodal LLMs, we find that refusal varies systematically with the harm target, and that models often recognize a harm yet still assist with it. These results show that refusal rates alone cannot certify an assistant as safe, and that safety alignment must account for who would be harmed. Project page: https://onedayoneyeah.github.io/safety-for-whom

</details>


### [943] [DuplexAct: How Interactive Are Frontier Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17738)
*Jiaheng Dong,Shihong Tan,Gongping Huang,Jean Honorio,Abhirup Ghosh,Ting Dang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DuplexAct基准，用于评估端到端全双工语音语言模型的交互动作执行能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏结构化的动作级表述，常评估动作是否发生而非是否成功，且对真实世界对话覆盖有限。

Method: 定义三级动作分类体系，涵盖8种交互动作和24种交互条件；通过即时执行与后续跟进刻画成功动作，并设计动作专属评估指标；构建4,691个测试实例，覆盖闲聊、会议、客服和访谈场景。

Result: 包含4,691个测试实例，其中2,531个源自真实对话录音，覆盖多样化真实场景。

Conclusion: DuplexAct为系统评估端到端全双工语音语言模型参与持续语音交互提供了结构化且基于真实世界的框架。

Abstract: End-to-end (E2E) full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) enable simutanous listening and speaking continously, requiring models to take appropriate interaction actions as conversations unfold. However, existing benchmarks lack a structured action-level formulation, often evaluate action occurrence rather than success, and provide limited coverage of diverse real-world conversations. We introduce DuplexAct, a benchmark for evaluating interaction action taking in E2E FD-SLMs. DuplexAct defines a three-level action taxonomy spanning eight interaction actions and 24 corresponding interaction conditions. We further characterize successful action-taking through immediate execution and subsequent follow-through, and develop action-specific evaluation metrics for both. DuplexAct contains 4,691 test instances spanning casual conversation, meetings, customer service, and interviews, including 2,531 instances derived from real-world conversational recordings. Together, DuplexAct provides a structured and real-world-grounded framework for systematically assessing how E2E FD-SLMs participate in ongoing spoken interaction.

</details>


### [944] [Coupled Harness--Model Evolution for Scientific Equation Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17740)
*Pengze Li,Jiaquan Zhang,Encheng Su,Yunbo Long,Zihang Zeng,Xinping Liu,Han Zhang,Junchi Yu,Shixiang Tang,Aoran Wang,Xi Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个"耦合进化"框架，让可执行工具库与模型工具使用策略从同一可验证的拟合误差信号中同步改进，从而更有效地从实验数据中发现科学方程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM方程发现系统只改进工具库或只改进模型策略中的一方，另一方保持固定，导致相应失败无法纠正。作者希望让"模型"与"工具"在可验证反馈下相互促进。

Method: 框架含两阶段。工具进化：智能体从少量通用数值操作出发，通过诊断自身失败来增长工具库——能力缺失时编写新工具，选错工具时修正选择规则。策略进化：用冻结工具库收集成功工具使用轨迹，在与评估基准不相交的训练公式上微调一个约3B活跃参数的小开源模型。

Result: 消融显示两阶段互补：没有工具库时模型几乎解不出题，工具贡献主要增益，轨迹训练额外带来增益且在难题上最大。完整系统在LSR-Synth上容差10⁻²/10⁻³分别解出79.1%/71.3%，SRSD-Feynman分布外面板上63.8%合并准确率，CP3-28归一化聚合为-7.27。

Conclusion: 结果表明了一条更广泛的科学智能体配方：让模型与其工具在可验证反馈下相互改进。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to discover scientific equations from experimental data. Such a discovery system has two parts that must work together: a library of executable computational tools and the model's tool-use policy. The tools supply the solving capability, from diagnosing structure in the data to fitting candidate equations; the policy plans and orchestrates their use. Yet existing systems adapt only one part, keeping either the toolset or the model fixed, which leaves the corresponding failures uncorrectable. We develop a coupled evolution framework that improves both parts from the same verifiable fit-error signal. In the tool-evolution phase, an agent grows an executable tool library from a small set of generic numerical operations by diagnosing its own failures: it authors a new tool when a capability is missing and revises its selection rules when the right tool went unused. In the policy-evolution phase, a small open model (roughly 3B active parameters) is fine-tuned on successful tool-use trajectories collected with the frozen library, on training formulas screened to be disjoint from all evaluation benchmarks. Ablations show the two phases are complementary: with no tool library at all the same model solves almost nothing, the tools account for most of the gain, and trajectory training adds a further gain that is largest on the most difficult problems. The full system solves 79.1/71.3\% of LSR-Synth problems at fit tolerances $10^{-2}$/$10^{-3}$, reaches 63.8\% pooled accuracy on the distributionally different SRSD-Feynman panel, and obtains a normalized CP3-28 aggregate of $-7.27$. These results suggest a broader recipe for scientific agents: let the model and its instruments improve each other under verifiable feedback.

</details>


### [945] [Autonomous 3D Visual-Thermal Inspection for Utility-Scale Solar Farms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17762)
*Lachlan Tychsen-Smith,Mark Cox,Brett Wood,David Haddon,Kenrick Anderson,Benjamin Duck,Jim O'Malley,Noel W Duffy,Peyman Moghadam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Tricorder，一种面向光伏阵列板下资产的自动化 3D 视觉-热成像巡检系统，融合 LiDAR-惯性 SLAM、几何标定 RGB/热成像与机器学习检测分割，将检测目标关联到 3D 环境，实现多视角空间融合与定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有航拍巡检擅长识别组件级热斑，但对板下关键部件（连接器、线缆、紧固件、结构件）可见性有限，难以规模化一致巡检；这些缺陷空间小、易遮挡，孤立图像难以定位。

Method: 结合 LiDAR-惯性 SLAM 与几何标定的 RGB 及热成像，使用机器学习进行目标检测与分割；将检测资产与重建的 3D 环境关联，实现多视角视觉与热观测的空间融合和定位。

Result: 在公用事业规模光伏数据上验证：MC4 连接器检测与连接状态识别、热异常识别，以及螺栓、螺母、扭矩管等结构部件检测。

Conclusion: 结果展示了从基于图像的巡检迈向空间落地的自主巡检路径，缺陷可被检测并关联到具体资产及其在光伏电站中的 3D 位置。

Abstract: Utility-scale photovoltaic (PV) inspection is dominated by aerial surveys, which are effective for identifying module-level hot cells but provide limited visibility of critical components located under the array, including connectors, cabling, fasteners and structural elements. These assets are difficult to inspect consistently at scale, and their defects are often spatially small, partially occluded and difficult to localise from isolated images. We present an automated 3D visual-thermal inspection system (Tricorder) for under-panel PV asset inspection. The approach combines LiDAR-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) with geometrically calibrated RGB and thermal imagery and machine-learning-based object detection and segmentation. Detected assets are associated with the reconstructed 3D environment, allowing visual and thermal observations from multiple viewpoints to be spatially fused and localised. We demonstrate the approach on utility-scale PV data for MC4 connector detection and connection-state recognition, thermal anomaly identification, and detection of structural components including bolts, nuts and torque tubes. The results demonstrate a pathway from image-based inspection toward spatially grounded autonomous inspection, where defects are detected and linked to specific assets and their 3D locations within the solar farm.

</details>


### [946] [Memory Echo in Single-Agent Long-Term Memory: Lifecycle Evaluation and Provenance-Guided Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17763)
*Yufeng Li,Sheng Yao,Peng Zeng,Dezhang Kong,Shi Lin,Changting Lin,Xun Wang,Meng Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文定义"记忆回声"(Memory Echo)现象：同一来源的历史信息因反复检索与回写占据多个检索位、影响当前答案却无独立证据。作者提出MEchoBench基准与FPA框架加以评测与缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆使智能体跨会话持续工作，但反复检索与回写会让单一历史论断占据多个检索位、左右当前回答却缺乏独立证据。现有工作关注检索、更新与问答，对同源记录累积及纠正后仍残留的问题研究不足。受社会认知与记忆心理学中重复暴露、检索、修正研究启发，本文定义并研究该现象。

Method: 定义Memory Echo为同源历史信息在无新增独立证据下获得的超额检索暴露，并提出MEchoBench评测其产生、抗纠正性、持续性与对答案的影响。提出Family–Provenance–Authority(FPA)框架：每个来源族选一个代表、以已核实纠正作为旧记录进入答案上下文的资格条件、用权威证据约束最终答案。

Result: 在190个固定问题、四种记忆框架的配对重放中，FPA将准确率从0.825提升至0.920(DeepSeek V4 Flash)，从0.782提升至0.916(Kimi K2.6)；平均决策污染效应分别从0.106降至0.030、从0.109降至0.038。

Conclusion: 结果表明智能体记忆可以在保留可追溯历史的同时，不让重复的历史信息主导当前决策。代码已开源。

Abstract: Long-term memory supports agents across sessions. Repeated retrieval and write-back can let one historical claim occupy multiple retrieval positions and influence current answers without independent evidence. Existing work examines retrieval, updating, and question answering, leaving same-source record accumulation and post-correction persistence underexplored. Motivated by research in social cognition and memory psychology on repeated exposure, retrieval, and revision, we define \emph{Memory Echo} as the excess retrieval exposure gained by historical information from the same source without additional independent evidence, and introduce MEchoBench to evaluate its emergence, correction resistance, persistence, and effect on answers. To address this phenomenon, we introduce the Family--Provenance--Authority framework (FPA). Specifically, FPA selects one representative per source family, conditions the eligibility of old records for the answer context on verified corrections, and constrains final answers with authoritative evidence. In paired replay on 190 fixed questions across four memory frameworks, FPA raises accuracy from 0.825 to 0.920 with DeepSeek V4 Flash and from 0.782 to 0.916 with Kimi K2.6; mean Decision Contamination Effect falls from 0.106 to 0.030 and from 0.109 to 0.038, respectively. These results show that agent memory can preserve traceable history without allowing repeated historical information to govern current decisions. The code is available at https://github.com/OrcasSam/memory-echo-benchmark.

</details>


### [947] [Agentic4PDM: Host-Governed Evidence Admissibility for Industrial Fault Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17786)
*Nam V. Nguyen,Hoang Van Truong,Hieu D. D.,Duy Khuong Nguyen,Quang Pham,Tung Kieu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Agentic4PDM框架，用LLM智能体结合确定性控制器实现工业故障诊断，无需任务特定模型，在轴承/电机数据集上宏观F1优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业故障诊断面临标签稀缺、工况多变，反复训练专用分类器成本高；信号的周期性/趋势/瞬态仍有诊断价值，但固定规则或纯训练指导难以处理信号歧义，而无约束的LLM解释可能夸大弱或矛盾证据。

Method: 将自适应调查与证据使用控制分离。LLM智能体将每个信号与各候选类的带标签参考对比，识别未决差异并提出后续测量；确定性软件控制器（host）执行合同校验的门控裁决（CCGA）：检查请求、在观察结果前要求承诺完整工具批次、依据工具对参考的校验分配证据角色（区分佐证与参考信息）；Judge Agent提出诊断，控制器校验协议合规性并记录过程。支持免训练诊断（用预训练表示与标签参考）及额外考察训练模型预测的标准设置。

Result: 在选定的轴承与电机诊断挑战及客户提供的未过滤工业测试集上，聚合宏观F1相比评估的诊断与智能体基线均有提升；消融实验进一步支持受治理工作流的价值。

Conclusion: 将自适应调查与受控证据使用分离的受治理智能体工作流能有效提升工业故障诊断性能，且无需任务特定诊断模型。

Abstract: We study industrial fault diagnosis as a classification task that assigns sensor time-series windows to predefined health states or fault types. Scarce labels and changing operating conditions make repeated training of specialized classifiers costly. Yet structures such as periodicity, trends, and transients can remain diagnostically informative and be examined through reusable analytical tools. LLM agents can select and interpret these tools, but fixed rules or training-derived guidance may not resolve each signal's ambiguity, while unconstrained interpretation may overstate weak or conflicting results. We introduce Agentic4PDM, a framework that separates adaptive investigation from control over evidence use. LLM agents compare each signal with labeled references from every candidate class, identify unresolved distinctions, and propose follow-up measurements. A deterministic software controller, called the host, enforces contract-checked gated adjudication (CCGA): it checks requests, requires commitment to a complete tool batch before results are observed, and assigns evidence roles based on tool checks against labeled references. These roles distinguish corroborative support from advisory information. The Judge Agent proposes a diagnosis, while the controller checks protocol compliance and records the investigation. Agentic4PDM supports training-free diagnosis using pretrained representations and labeled references without task-specific diagnostic models, and a standard setting that additionally investigates trained-model predictions. Experiments on selected bearing and motor diagnosis challenges and an unfiltered industrial test set supplied by our customer show gains in aggregate macro F1 over the evaluated diagnostic and agentic baselines. Ablations further support the value of the governed workflow.

</details>


### [948] [Empowering Edge Agents: A Systematic Analysis of Edge-Cloud Collaboration in LLM Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17816)
*Pengcheng Huang,Zhenghao Liu,Shixin Ren,Shi Yu,Sijia Yao,Yukun Yan,Chaojun Xiao,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Unexpected Error


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'model_dump'

Method: N/A

Result: N/A

Conclusion: N/A

Abstract: Edge-cloud collaboration combines the lower inference overhead and greater data locality of edge-side execution with the stronger capabilities of cloud-hosted models. However, as LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon scenarios, cloud participation becomes interleaved throughout execution rather than a one-shot decision for each query. Such interleaved participation introduces trajectory-level effects that remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we introduce EC2-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating edge-cloud collaboration in long-horizon agent execution. It provides executable digital-workspace agent tasks and a unified evaluation framework covering task performance, resource usage, and privacy exposure. Using this benchmark, we empirically study diverse forms of edge-cloud collaboration. Our study reveals three findings. First, collaboration achieves a favorable balance among task performance, resource usage, and privacy exposure compared with edge-only and cloud-only execution. Second, as edge models become stronger, collaborative execution approaches cloud-only performance, and performance differences across strategies shrink, while privacy exposure remains strongly strategy-dependent. Third, stronger edge capability shifts preferred collaboration from externally controlled cloud participation and direct cloud execution toward more edge-controlled collaboration. Further analyses identify cloud-invocation decision-making and instruction following as important edge-side abilities for effective collaboration. These findings provide a systematic understanding of edge-cloud collaboration in long-horizon agent execution and insights for designing future edge agents that effectively collaborate with cloud models. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/EC2-Bench.

</details>


### [949] [Benchmarking and Training Reward Models for Cross-Source Evidence Grounding in Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17827)
*Haochen Zhao,Minsheng Hao,Zheng Li,Yifan Li,Zikang Liu,Bowen Qin,Yuhao Cheng,Chuang Fan,Haosheng Zou,Jeff Chen,Sujian Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CSEG框架，用六层决策树对搜索轨迹进行跨源证据接地评估，并构建基准CSEG-Bench与奖励模型CSEG-RM，提升答案可信度监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有搜索智能体的训练与评估过度关注最终答案质量，忽视答案与检索证据的映射；引用追踪无法保证来源独立性或对冲突证据的妥善处理，因此需要基于跨源证据接地的原则性评估。

Method: 提出CSEG评估框架，用细粒度六层决策树贯穿完整搜索轨迹，在标签、节点、路径三个层级定义层次结构；构建CSEG-Bench，通过在真实检索文档池上改写答案，构造九条规范路径的1,160条验证轨迹，由独立前沿评判器复现完整金路径、人类专家决定纳入；训练CSEG-RM奖励模型。

Result: CSEG-RM在基准上达到83.9%精确准确率，处于性能-令牌效率帕累托前沿；仅用该奖励监督冻结检索的答案策略，独立评判的平均标签从2.83提升至4.19，且层次学习以远低于前沿评判器的成本跨层泛化。

Conclusion: 以跨源证据接地为核心的分层监督框架可有效弥补自然轨迹的数据偏斜，为开放网络检索智能体提供统一的训练与评估信号，提升答案可信度。

Abstract: Existing approaches to training and evaluating search agents focus heavily on final-answer quality, largely neglecting how generated answers map back to retrieved evidence. Recent methods track citations to enforce grounding, but citation support alone does not establish source independence or whether an answer appropriately handles conflicting evidence. We argue that credibility in open-web retrieval depends on principled cross-source evidence grounding that accounts for source independence and systematically attributes and adjudicates conflicting evidence, while hierarchical judgments of these grounding decisions provide a unified signal for training and evaluation. To this end, we propose an evaluation framework, Cross-Source Evidence Grounding (CSEG), that employs a fine-grained, six-layer decision tree over the complete search trajectory. We introduce CSEG-Bench and trainable reward models to provide targeted supervision following this framework. Our approach helps eliminating the severe data skew of natural trajectories by providing targeted coverage over complex, deep-layer decision paths, such as cross-source conflict resolution and nuanced attribution, that standard rollouts fail to capture. Specifically, (1) we define the hierarchy at label, node, and path levels; (2) we construct 1,160 verified trajectories over nine canonical paths by rewriting answers on real retrieved document pools, with independent frontier judges reproducing the entire gold path and human experts deciding inclusion; (3) we train CSEG-RM, which reaches 83.9% exact accuracy on our benchmark while lying on the performance-token efficiency Pareto frontier. Experiments that use this reward alone to supervise a frozen-retrieval answer policy raise the independently judged mean label from 2.83 to 4.19, and show that learning the hierarchy generalizes across layers at a fraction of frontier-judge cost.

</details>


### [950] [Learning Adaptive Deliberation Control for Reliable Recognition with Multi-Agent Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17840)
*Yuan Liu,Haoyue Peng,Fanliang Hu,Lei Huang,Wenli Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出自适应多智能体控制器ADMA，学习连续策略以动态分配提议、质疑、仲裁和协调角色，在任务模型冻结下提升多智能体审议的识别准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定控制的多智能体审议无法根据分歧程度和推理质量的变化动态调整，导致审议效率与效果受限。

Method: ADMA在保持任务模型（如Qwen3.5）冻结的前提下，学习提议、质疑、仲裁、协调的连续策略；用共享轨迹特征描述质量、一致性和进展，用角色特定特征支持推理时的去中心化控制；在法务与金融推理上训练一个控制器，零策略更新地迁移到四个文本及多模态基准和两个连续任务模型版本。

Result: 固定Qwen3.5时，ADMA-Full较Direct提升6.2–14.2个百分点，较ADMA-Fixed提升2.8–3.0个百分点；Full-Fixed对比的配对bootstrap区间在三个任务上为正。结果分解显示恢复数超过引入错误数，过程评估显示假共识事件更少、有支撑的正确结果更多。迁移到Qwen3.6的效果依赖具体任务。中位token与延迟比分别为14.3–18.7和7.8–16.5（相对Direct）。

Conclusion: 自适应审议能在固定模型下提升识别性能，但收益具有任务依赖性，需以额外计算开销换取，策略泛化性受任务与模型版本限制。

Abstract: Multi-agent deliberation can improve recognition by criticizing and revising candidate answers, but fixed controls cannot respond to changes in disagreement or reasoning quality. We present an adaptive multi-agent controller (ADMA) that learns continuous policies for proposal, challenge, arbitration, and coordination while keeping the task model frozen. Shared trace features describe quality, agreement, and progress, while role-specific features support decentralized control during inference. One controller trained on legal and financial reasoning is transferred without policy updates to four textual and multimodal benchmarks and two successive task-model versions. With Qwen3.5 held fixed, ADMA-Full improves accuracy by 6.2-14.2 percentage points over Direct and by 2.8-3.0 points over ADMA-Fixed. Paired bootstrap ranges for the Full-Fixed comparison are positive on three tasks. Outcome decompositions show that recoveries exceed introduced errors, while process assessment records fewer false-consensus events and more supported correct outcomes. Transfer to Qwen3.6 remains task dependent, which bounds the generality of the learned policy. Median token and latency ratios are 14.3-18.7 and 7.8-16.5 relative to Direct. These results show that adaptive deliberation can improve fixed-model recognition when its task-dependent gains justify the additional computation.

</details>


### [951] [Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17860)
*Letian Zhu,Han Li,Yifan Yao,Xinping Lei,Xinyu Che,Jiahao Wang,Dianyi Wang,Yucheng Fu,Jiakai Wang,Zhiqi Bai,Wenbo Su,Jiaheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Socratic Skill Learning（SSL），通过专家教学与学生实践交替，让学生作为环境操作者与技能作者来学习可迁移技能，并构建 SkillTransferBench 验证迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可迁移技能学习需要关于流程及其使用条件的证据，而单纯成功任务尝试可能无法验证这些条件，容易导致技能迁移能力不足。

Method: SSL 交错进行专家指导与学生实践：Educator 引导探究，Student 独立操作环境并撰写技能，可质疑、测试与调整建议。构建 SkillTransferBench（35 个任务族、408 个可执行案例），在新会话中隔离评估。提出 Fixed-Window 与 Issue-Guided 两种 SSL 变体。

Result: 主队列（22 族、155 案例）上，Fixed-Window SSL 效用 0.801，高于无技能 0.723、Trace2Skill 0.761、SKILL-KD 0.751。Issue-Guided SSL 达 0.805，同时减少 61.7% Educator tokens 和 16.9% 总采集 tokens。

Conclusion: 交错式指导优于专家直接编写与事后教学；学生测试与修订流程可促进技能复用。Issue-Guided SSL 在保持更高效用的同时显著降低成本。

Abstract: Agent Skills improve LLM agents by making task knowledge reusable across sessions. Learning transferable Skills requires evidence about a procedure and its conditions of use, which a successful task attempt can leave untested. We introduce Socratic Skill Learning (SSL), which interleaves expert teaching with Student practice. An Educator guides investigation while the Student remains the sole environment operator and Skill author, able to question, test, and adapt advice. To test reuse beyond the learning task, we construct SkillTransferBench, with 35 task families and 408 executable cases, pairing public variation specifications with held-out evaluation in fresh solver sessions. On the main 22-family, 155-case cohort, Fixed-Window SSL reaches 0.801 utility, versus 0.723 without a Skill, 0.761 for adapted Trace2Skill (trajectory distillation), and 0.751 for adapted SKILL-KD (contrastive distillation). Across three model pairs on shared families, interleaved guidance outperforms expert authoring and post-hoc teaching. Process analysis links guidance to Student writing and package revision; a case study shows the Student testing and refining a proposed procedure for later reuse. As demand for new lessons falls, the cost of fixed-window review grows. Issue-Guided SSL tracks unresolved questions across Skill revisions to select and focus review, reaching 0.805 utility with 61.7% fewer Educator tokens and 16.9% fewer total acquisition tokens than Fixed-Window SSL on the main cohort.

</details>


### [952] [ECMR: Evidence-Aware Deliberation Control for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17869)
*Yuan Liu,Haoyue Peng,Fanliang Hu,Lei Huang,Wenli Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ECMR：一种证据感知的多智能体LLM控制器，通过动态选择提议/质疑/验证/仲裁等动作，缓解"语义假共识"，在MedQA等三个数据集上将准确率从62.1%提升至84.9%，假共识率从40.7%降至17.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统在推理前固定协商协议，无法对已解决与未解决样本差异化分配计算，且易将重复的支持误判为独立确认，导致"语义假共识"——由狭窄、重复或相关的理由支撑的高置信群体答案。

Method: 提出ECMR，在冻结的角色条件化LLM之上构建证据感知控制器。每步汇总答案集中度、支撑多样性与独立性、矛盾、角色行为、验证历史及剩余预算，并选择提议、质疑、验证、仲裁、多样化、角色纠正或停止等动作；将该决策建模为有限时域预算控制，并推导状态条件化、风险触发验证与角色纠正改进成本调整效用的充分条件。

Result: 在9000条MedQA、CaseHOLD、FinQA留出记录上，ECMR-Full将合并准确率由62.1%提至84.9%，假共识率由40.7%降至17.0%，证据支撑率由58.0%升至88.7%。状态打乱损失11.7个准确率点而仅少0.7轮，较难轨迹从提前停止转向仲裁。

Conclusion: ECMR能有效抑制语义假共识并提升绝对可靠性，但ECMR-Full使用最大token预算，带来最强绝对可靠性而非一致的token效率优势。

Abstract: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems typically commit to a deliberation protocol before inference. A fixed protocol cannot allocate computation differently to resolved and unresolved instances, and it may mistake repeated support for independent confirmation. We study this failure as semantic false consensus: a confident group answer supported by narrow, duplicated, or correlated rationales. We introduce ECMR, an evidence-aware controller over frozen role-conditioned LLMs. At each step, ECMR summarizes answer concentration, support diversity and independence, contradictions, role behavior, verification history, and remaining budget, then selects whether to propose, challenge, verify, arbitrate, diversify, correct a role, or stop. We formulate this decision as finite-horizon budgeted control and derive sufficient conditions under which state conditioning, risk-triggered verification, and role correction improve cost-adjusted utility. Across a declared held-out evaluation of 9,000 records from MedQA, CaseHOLD, and FinQA, ECMR-Full increases pooled accuracy from 62.1% to 84.9%, reduces false-consensus rate from 40.7% to 17.0%, and raises evidence-support rate from 58.0% to 88.7%. State shuffling loses 11.7 accuracy points with only 0.7 fewer rounds, while harder traces shift from early stopping toward arbitration. ECMR-Full uses the largest token budget, yielding the strongest absolute reliability rather than uniformly superior token efficiency.

</details>


### [953] [Training LLMs for Multi-Agent Collaboration with Verifiable Information Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17893)
*Keru Chen,Sen Lin,Yingbin Liang,Nathaniel D. Bastian,Shaofeng Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CoSIR，基于 surprisal 的信息奖励后训练方法，让 LLM 多智能体学会共享信息、请求缺失信息并利用队友贡献，并能泛化到未见任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体协作需要共享证据、请求缺失信息、整合队友贡献，但任务最终结果对单个消息价值的反馈有限，训练这些行为困难。

Method: 利用简单可验证环境进行自博弈后训练；提出贝叶斯评估器，以团队 surprisal 下降（正确选项负对数概率之和的减少）为共享信息打分，以信息被真实提供后该量的潜在下降为请求打分；另设奖励鼓励智能体在私人选择中使用收到的信息。后训练 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma-3-4B-it。

Result: 在七个未见自然语言协作任务上评估，CoSIR 获得最高总体得分，通用任务表现仍有竞争力；行为分析显示私有证据披露增加，未使用队友输入的失败判定减少。

Conclusion: 基于 surprisal 的信息奖励可有效训练可泛化的协作行为。

Abstract: Effective collaboration among large language model (LLM) agents in multi-agent systems requires sharing relevant evidence, requesting missing information, and incorporating teammates' contributions into decisions. Training these behaviors is challenging because final task outcomes provide limited feedback on the value of individual messages. We introduce CoSIR (Collaboration via Surprisal-based Information Rewards), a post-training approach that uses a simple, verifiable environment to teach collaboration behaviors that generalize to more complex, unseen tasks. We propose a Bayesian evaluator that scores shared information by its reduction in team surprisal, defined as the sum of the negative log probabilities assigned to the correct option given each agent's available evidence. Requests are scored by the potential reduction in the same quantity if the requested information were truthfully provided. Separate rewards encourage agents to use the received information in their private choices and calculations. We post-train Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-3-4B-it through self-play and evaluate transfer to seven unseen natural-language collaboration tasks. CoSIR achieves the highest aggregate score, while its performance in general tasks remains competitive. Behavioral analyses show increased disclosure of private evidence and fewer judged failures to use teammates' input.

</details>


### [954] [PaceReasoner: Label-Free Learning to Answer Briefly from Long Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17900)
*Changguo Jia,Zhiyou Xiao,Xinbei Ma,Geng Chen,Weiming Zhang,Yiming Xu,Tianqi Zhao,Minghui Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PaceReasoner 是一种免标签的测试时强化学习框架，利用模型的长链推理（LONG）来提升短链推理（SHORT）模式的准确率，在降低推理成本的同时显著提高性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展的思维链推理虽能提升问题求解性能，但增加了推理成本和延迟，因此需要更短推理下获得更准确答案的方法。

Method: 提出 PaceReasoner：SHORT 与 LONG 模式共享可训练策略；通过渐进式、置信度加权的监督融合全响应与仅 LONG 的答案共识；行为奖励从鼓励 SHORT 探索逐渐转向奖励与 LONG 答案一致；并用比率控制器调节两种模式的平衡。

Result: 在三种模型骨干和四个基准上，SHORT 准确率平均提升 7.4–13.5 个百分点，平均每条响应少于 25 个推理 token；消融验证关键组件，跨数据集结果证明可迁移。

Conclusion: PaceReasoner 无需标签即可用 LONG 响应监督提升 SHORT 模式，实现低成本高精度推理，且具备跨数据集泛化能力。

Abstract: Extended chain-of-thought reasoning improves problem-solving performance but increases inference cost and latency, motivating more accurate answers with shorter reasoning. We introduce PaceReasoner, a label-free test-time reinforcement learning framework that uses a model's LONG responses to improve its SHORT-mode accuracy. Both modes share a trainable policy, creating a need for reliable supervision, sufficient SHORT training samples, and continued LONG responses to guide learning. PaceReasoner combines all-response and LONG-only answer consensus through progressive, confidence-weighted supervision. A behavior reward gradually shifts from encouraging SHORT exploration to rewarding agreement with LONG answers, while a ratio controller regulates the balance between modes. Across three model backbones and four benchmarks, PaceReasoner improves average SHORT accuracy over the baselines by 7.4--13.5 percentage points, with fewer than 25 reasoning tokens per response on average. Ablations support the key components, and cross-dataset results demonstrate transfer beyond the adaptation set.

</details>


### [955] [Learning How to Remember: Memory Modality Selection for GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17928)
*Taeyun Roh,Suhyeong Park,Gijin Kim,Wonjune Jang,Jaewoo Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究VLM-based GUI agent的记忆模态问题，发现最优记忆表示随交互步骤变化，并提出动态路由框架SwitchMem。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆增强GUI agent采用固定的记忆表示策略，将检索到的经验作为静态模态提供。但单一记忆模态是否始终最优、模态偏好如何随交互步骤变化尚不清楚。

Method: 系统研究GUI agent的记忆模态，在多个GUI benchmark上分析偏好；提出SwitchMem路由框架，在每一步动态选择文本或视觉记忆表示。

Result: 在三个GUI benchmark上，SwitchMem优于依赖静态记忆表示的记忆增强基线。

Conclusion: 记忆模态是步骤依赖的决策，而非固定设计选择。

Abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have substantially improved the capabilities of GUI agents, while memory augmentation has emerged as a promising approach for reusing knowledge from past interactions. However, existing memory augmented GUI agents typically adopt a fixed representation strategy, providing retrieved experience as a static modality. It remains unclear whether a single memory modality is consistently optimal, or how modality preference changes across interaction steps. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of memory modality in VLM based GUI agents. Across GUI benchmarks, we find that the preferred memory representation is strongly step dependent. Motivated by the finding, we introduce \textbf{SwitchMem}, a routing framework that dynamically selects between textual and visual memory representations at each step. Across three GUI benchmarks, SwitchMem outperforms memory augmented baselines that rely on static memory representations. Our findings validate our claim that memory modality is a step dependent decision rather than a fixed design choice. Code and project resources are available at https://txxnrd.github.io/switchmem

</details>


### [956] [Seeing Depth but Choosing Cues in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17976)
*Zhengtao Zou,Pekka Marttinen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了视觉语言模型判断物体远近时是否使用深度信息。通过深度线索冲突、表征分析和干预实验发现：模型答案系统性偏向误导性图像平面线索，但正确深度顺序仍可从视觉表征中解码，且可通过写回方式纠正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究VLM判断物体远近时是依赖深度信息还是图像平面线索，并揭示其表征能力与作答行为之间的差距。

Method: 构造深度线索冲突（表观大小与垂直位置），在渲染场景和真实照片中比较线索一致与冲突条件下的深度判断；进行表征分析（解码深度顺序）；并通过对象级写回加强模型自身深度读出进行干预。

Result: 跨模型家族和规模，深度判断系统性偏向误导性线索；但正确深度顺序仍可从被查询物体的视觉表征中解码，即使模型答错时亦然。图像与类别控制支持该信号为超越两个目标线索的图像依赖深度信息。写回可在不更新参数、不使用真实深度标注的情况下纠正冲突决策；纠正效果取决于写入信号的方向和目标token，强度因架构和领域而异。

Conclusion: VLM存在表征深度与使用深度信息作答之间的不匹配：模型可保留有用深度信息，却允许竞争的图像平面线索对答案施加更大影响。

Abstract: Do vision-language models use depth information to judge which object is closer, or rely on image-plane cues? We investigate this question through controlled depth--cue conflicts, representation analysis, and interventions. Among the many image-plane cues relevant to depth perception, we focus on apparent size and vertical position. We compare depth judgments under cue-consistent and cue-conflict conditions in both rendered scenes and real-world photographs. Across model families and scales, depth judgments systematically shift toward misleading cues. Yet the correct depth order remains decodable from the queried objects' visual representations, including when the model answers incorrectly. Image and category controls support interpreting this signal as image-dependent depth information beyond the two target cues. Strengthening the model's own depth readout through object-level write-back can correct conflict decisions without updating model parameters or using ground-truth depth annotations. Interventions show that the effect of this correction depends on the direction and target tokens of the written signal, while its strength varies across architectures and domains. Together, these findings reveal a mismatch between a model's ability to represent depth and use this information when deciding the answer. VLMs can retain useful depth information while allowing competing image-plane cues to exert greater influence on their answers.

</details>


### [957] [SHELDON: Reasoning through Dual Search over Hypothesis and Observation Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18025)
*Harshit Joshi,Priyank Shethia,Monica S. Lam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SHELDON，一种将假设空间与观察空间分离并联合探索的科学推理框架，通过主动寻找新观察发现现有假设无法解释的现象，从而突破局部修正、促进探索，在诊断、抽象推理和优化任务上最高提升 26.7 分，新解数量增加至 4.5 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法将观察发现与现有假设耦合：先为当前假设收集证据，再基于这些假设与证据生成新假设。这导致方法偏向局部修正，难以探索未知的假设区域。

Method: 受假设-演绎方法（Hempel, 1945）和科学发现的双空间模型（Klahr & Dunbar, 1988）启发，提出 SHELDON：分别表示假设空间与观察空间，并联合探索两者；主动同时寻找新观察与新假设，以发现当前假设无法解释的观察，从而识别理解缺口、激发新探索并引导生成超越已有假设修正的新假设。

Result: 在诊断、抽象推理和优化基准上，SHELDON 相比所评估的基线最高提升 26.7 分；额外分析显示其生成的新颖解最多增加至 4.5 倍。

Conclusion: 将观察空间与假设空间解耦并联合探索，可有效缓解局部收敛，促进对未知假设区域的探索，提升复杂推理与优化任务的性能。

Abstract: Test-time scaling has enabled LLMs to solve increasingly complex reasoning, discovery, and optimization tasks. However, existing approaches often gather observations while seeking evidence for current hypotheses, then generate new hypotheses conditioned on those hypotheses and their associated evidence. This couples observation discovery to existing hypotheses, favoring local refinements over exploration of unknown hypotheses regions. Inspired by the hypothetico-deductive method (Hempel, 1945) and dual-space models of scientific discovery (Klahr & Dunbar, 1988), we introduce SHELDON, a scientific reasoning harness that separately represents and jointly explores hypothesis and observation spaces. By actively seeking new observations along with new hypotheses, SHELDON can discover observations that its current hypotheses do not explain. These unexplained observations expose gaps in its understanding, motivate new investigations, and guide the generation of hypotheses beyond refinements of existing ones. Across diagnosis, abstract reasoning, and optimization benchmarks, SHELDON outperforms evaluated baselines by up to 26.7 points. Additional analysis shows that SHELDON generates up to 4.5x more novel solutions.

</details>


### [958] [Beyond Black Boxes: Visual Grounding for Text Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18047)
*Slimane Larabi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将文本嵌入转换为视觉地形草图，用于可视化、检索与推理探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 出于三个目的：(1)可视化文本表示并探索AI可解释性；(2)研究草图表示对信息检索的潜在收益；(3)受心理意象启发，探索其在推理中的潜力。

Method: 提出基于草图的视觉基础框架，将文本表示转化为视觉地形草图，通过草图强调文本嵌入中的语义内容。在MS-COCO数据集上评估其在文本检索中的效果。

Result: SBERT在严格的top-1检索准确率上占优，而基于草图的方法在top-5检索上表现相当；将两者级联后可超越单独使用SBERT的效果。

Conclusion: 若直接在文本上训练，草图表示有望为信息检索带来显著潜力。

Abstract: In this paper, our goal is to represent text embeddings as sketches for three main reasons. First, to visualize text representation and to explore their potential their potential for AI explainability. Second, to investigate the potential benefits of the sketch-based representation for information retrieval. Third, to explore their potential for reasoning, drawing inspiration from the concept of mental imagery. We propose a sketch-based visual grounding framework that transforms text representations into visual topographic sketches. Our approach aims to emphasis the semantics content encoded in the text embeddings through the corresponding sketch.
  Evaluations are conducted on the MS-COCO dataset to examine the utility of these sketches for text retrieval. The comparative study of SBERT and Sketch-based method reveals that SBERT retains an advantage in strict top-1 retrieval accuracy while achieving comparable performance to the sketch-based method in top-5 retrieval. A cascaded approach combining SBERT and the sketch-based method outperforms SBERT alone, suggesting that the Sketch-based representation could offer significant potential for information retrieval if trained directly on text.

</details>


### [959] [Can Agents Forget When Asked? A Benchmark for Memory Unlearning in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18052)
*Bofan Xie,Chaokun Wang,Guanchen Ge,Songyao Wang,Fang Niu,Hang Zhang,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Bemula，首个专门评估 LLM agent 记忆遗忘（memory unlearning）的基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆已成为 LLM agent 核心组件，用户会要求删除敏感或过时事实，但现有基准只评估写入、检索和组织，未评估按用户请求遗忘的能力。

Method: Bemula 包含 50 个多轮对话实例、6 类共 135 个遗忘请求、1742 个测试问题；每个对话配有控制版本，通过五套测试评估存储、目标信息删除、无关记忆保留、相似事实再学习及抗提取攻击，覆盖 6 种记忆系统和 3 种骨干 LLM。

Result: 结果均为负面：所有系统端到端通过率不超过 1.5%，多数完全无法通过；系统要么在简单攻击下仍可提取目标信息，要么删除远超请求范围的内容。

Conclusion: 记忆遗忘仍是 agent 记忆设计中的开放挑战，数据和代码已开源。

Abstract: Long-term memory has become a core component of large language model (LLM) agents. As agents accumulate personal information over long-term use, users increasingly ask them to delete sensitive or outdated facts. A memory system should honor such requests. It should remove exactly what was requested and keep the rest of its memory intact. However, existing memory benchmarks evaluate only memory writing, retrieval, and organization, so whether agents can forget at the user's explicit request remains under-evaluated. To address this gap, we propose Bemula, the first benchmark dedicated to memory unlearning. It comprises 50 multi-session dialogue instances, 135 forget requests of six types, and 1,742 test questions. Each dialogue has a control version without the requests, so that only systems that have stored the target can earn credit for forgetting. Across the paired versions, five test suites measure storage, removal of the requested information, preservation of unrelated memories, relearning of similar facts, and resistance to extraction attacks. On Bemula, we evaluate six mainstream memory systems under three backbone LLMs, together with the Full Context LLM on two of them. The results are negative. Across all evaluated systems and backbones, no system passes more than 1.5% of forget requests end to end, and most pass none at all. These systems either leave the requested information extractable under simple attacks or delete far more than requested. Memory unlearning therefore remains an open challenge for agent memory design. We release our data and code at https://github.com/Nboxff/bemula-benchmark.

</details>


### [960] [WorkRover: Scaling Long-Horizon Cowork Agent Training Via Recursive Environment Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18067)
*Hang He,Linting Wang,Guanming Liu,Bo Mao,Jinxiu Liu,Yiran Suo,Maosen Zhou,Zhiheng Xi,Guanting Dong,Zhou Shao,Rui Zheng,Jie Zhou,Chengcheng Wan,Tao Gui,Qi Zhang,Xipeng Qiu,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出WorkRover框架，通过递归环境演化训练长时程协作智能体，含FCR环境演化与VTCA信用分配机制，在Qwen3.5-35B上性能大幅提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有环境构建管线在初始生成后难以迭代改进，且修改任务缺陷时无法同步更新工作上下文与验证器，导致组件不一致，制约长时程智能体的RL训练。

Method: 1) harness驱动的合成使构建智能体联合构建并验证语义对齐的工作上下文、可执行任务与基于证据的验证器；2) Factorial Compatibility Replay (FCR) 用rollout反馈、依赖闭合重放评估组件修订组合，选最小有效修复；3) Verifier-to-Turn Credit Assignment (VTCA) 用工作区进度检查增强轨迹级GRPO优势，将正进度信用有界分配给前置轮次。

Result: 基于Qwen3.5-35B-A3B后训练得到WorkRover-35B-A3B，在JobBench提升26.27个百分点，OfficeQA Pro提升29.32个百分点，GDPval v2提升413.25 Elo分。

Conclusion: WorkRover为可扩展的长时程协作智能体训练提供了有前景的基础。

Abstract: Scaling interactive environments is important for training long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning. These environments often require further testing and refinement after initial generation, and correcting defects in a task may also require updating its work context and verifier. However, existing construction pipelines offer limited support for such iterative refinement while keeping these components aligned. We introduce WorkRover, a framework for training long-horizon cowork agents through recursive environment evolution. Its harness-driven synthesis enables construction agents to jointly build and validate semantically aligned work contexts, executable tasks, and evidence-grounded verifiers, adapting their actions to workspace state and execution feedback rather than following a fixed construction workflow. To support environment evolution, we introduce Factorial Compatibility Replay (FCR), which uses rollout feedback to evaluate combinations of component revisions through dependency-closed replay and selects the smallest validated repair among tested candidates while preserving task requirements and evaluation constraints. To provide finer-grained training signals, we propose Verifier-to-Turn Credit Assignment (VTCA), which augments trajectory-level GRPO advantages with signals from deterministic workspace-progress checks and assigns a bounded share of positive-progress credit to prerequisite turns using recorded tool-output and artifact dependencies. Using WorkRover, we post-train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to obtain WorkRover-35B-A3B and evaluate it on several cowork-agent benchmarks. Its reported scores exceed those of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 26.27 percentage points on JobBench, 29.32 percentage points on OfficeQA Pro, and 413.25 Elo points on GDPval v2. These results suggest that WorkRover offers a promising foundation for scalable training of long-horizon cowork agents.

</details>


### [961] [AReaL-RSI: Adaptive Scaling and Coordination of Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18083)
*Wenhao Zhou,Jiajun Song,Haitao Wang,Zipeng Qiu,Yingqi Peng,Ruida Xu,Jiale Li,Wenshuang Li,Shusheng Xu,Wei Dong,Hao Dai,Tongkai Yang,Yi Gao,Binhang Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 AReaL-RSI 框架，在固定骨干 LLM 权重下组织持久化多智能体研究团队，通过领导者调度、条件记忆共享和基于证据的复盘实现递归自我改进的可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进的扩展需额外算力才能产生有效研究进展；简单增加研究智能体面临早期评分失真、共享知识丢失适用条件、有效流程局限于已完成任务等问题，因此需要一种不更新骨干权重的团队组织方式。

Method: AReaL-RSI 以评估结果与全系统资源消耗定义扩展问题；领导者智能体选择合适研究方向并指导调查；条件记忆共享区分未解决问题与有支持的发现，并支持接收方适配；每轮 campaign 后通过基于证据的复盘修正研究者方向、知识与技能。

Result: 与 Codex-Goal 对比，在两种骨干下 Terminal Bench 提升 2.2 个百分点，KernelBench 平均加速提升 32.2-36.8%；可扩展性比较中，经验共享加专门角色比独立探索内核延迟低 1.9-27.5%，比仅共享低 1.3-33.9%（七组任务-骨干配对）。

Conclusion: AReaL-RSI 在不更新 LLM 权重的前提下，通过团队化组织与经验共享有效提升研究型任务的扩展效率，优于原生扩展与单纯共享方案。

Abstract: Scaling recursive self-improvement requires additional computation to produce useful research progress in reaching persistent objectives. Intuitively, more researcher agents can explore more hypotheses, but early evaluation scores might misrepresent their promise, shared findings could lose their applicability conditions, and useful procedures could remain confined to completed investigations. In this paper, we present AReaL-RSI, a framework for organizing a persistent research team of agents without updating backbone LLM weights. We formulate the scaling problem in terms of evaluated outcomes and whole-system resource expenditure. Concretely, a leader agent selects task-appropriate research orientations and guides ongoing investigations; conditional memory sharing distinguishes unresolved problems from supported findings and enables recipient adaptation. During recursive evolution, after each campaign, evidence-based review revises researcher orientation, knowledge, and skills for later campaigns. Experiments compare AReaL-RSI with Codex-Goal on downstream harness optimization, GPU kernel optimization, and AI research tasks using two backbones. Under the reported resource allocations, AReaL-RSI improves Terminal Bench performance by 2.2 percentage points for each backbone and increases mean KernelBench speedup by 32.2-36.8%; further scalability comparisons favor the design of AReaL-RSI over native scaling: combining experience sharing with specialized researcher roles yields 1.9-27.5% lower kernel latency than independent exploration and 1.3-33.9% lower latency than sharing alone across all seven comparable task-backbone pairs.

</details>


### [962] [ResearchFlow-Eval: Tracing the Execution Gap in End-to-End Multi-Claim Autoresearch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18088)
*Peng Jiang,Dongyang Li,Quanying Liu,Xiaoxuan Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ResearchFlow-Eval 框架，从阶段和 claim 两个层面细粒度评估自动化研究系统的连续科研工作流，发现各系统在实验执行环节普遍滞后。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 autoresearch 系统评估多针对孤立任务或最终产物打分，无法衡量系统在多阶段、多相互依赖 claim 的连续工作流及迭代修订中的过程能力。因此需要过程级评估。

Method: 以已发表锚定论文为基础，派生阶段特定评分标准（rubric），将每个研究阶段分解为维度与独立评分项；对每个阶段和实验执行细节打分，重点考察多 claim 完成度与多次尝试中的修订情况。

Result: 将框架应用于通用 agent harness、技能增强 harness 及研究专用编排系统。结果显示：所有系统中实验执行均滞后于设计与规划；执行中难以产出高质量结果并满足 claim 要求，重复尝试鲜有可测量提升；技能增强和研究专用编排均未可靠带来更高分。

Conclusion: ResearchFlow-Eval 将 autoresearch 评估从孤立单目标运行扩展到系统追求多 claim 并在迭代中改进工作的连续工作流，揭示了过程级能力的关键短板。

Abstract: Autoresearch systems increasingly undertake entire research projects. In practice, scientific research requires systems to pursue multiple interdependent claims through a continuous, multi-stage workflow and revise experiments as evidence accumulates. Existing evaluations of autoresearch systems, however, typically score isolated tasks or final artifacts, leaving these process-level capabilities largely unmeasured. We therefore introduce ResearchFlow-Eval, a fine-grained framework for assessing continuous scientific execution and iteration at both the stage and claim levels. Each evaluation is grounded in a published anchor paper, from which we derive stage-specific rubrics that decompose each research stage into dimensions and separately scored rubric items. Using these rubrics, we score each research stage and examine experimental execution in detail, focusing on multi-claim completion and revisions across attempts. We apply the evaluation framework to general-purpose agent harnesses, skill-augmented harnesses, and systems with research-specific orchestration. Across all evaluated systems, experimental execution consistently lags behind design and planning. Within execution, systems struggle to produce high-quality results and meet claim requirements, and repeated attempts rarely yield measurable improvements. Moreover, neither skill augmentation nor research-specific orchestration reliably yields higher scores. ResearchFlow-Eval thus extends autoresearch evaluation beyond isolated, single-objective runs to continuous workflows in which systems pursue multiple claims and refine their work across iterations.

</details>


### [963] [One-Sided Verification Under Limited Expert Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18089)
*Fan Nie,Haotian Ye,Shurui Liu,Zihao Wang,Stefano Ermon,James Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 OSVerify 框架，在有限人力下通过解耦"错误提议"与"错误验证"来优先筛选无效解，相比投票基线减少46%人工审查量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 在科学发现中作用增强，但缺乏可靠自动评估的问题仍需人工审查，而候选解规模已超出人力承受能力，需在有限人力下最大化过滤无效解、保留有效解。

Method: 采用单侧验证目标：在约束有效解误拒率(FNR)下最大化无效解拒绝率(TNR)，将人工成本显式化。提出 OSVerify，将错误提议与错误验证解耦：提议器通过层次分解在不同粒度搜索错误，验证器区分实质错误与细微/幻觉错误。并对验证器进行后训练。

Result: 在竞赛级与研究级基准上，相同低 FNR 约束下较投票基线平均减少46%无效解人工审查；验证器后训练后提升至57%。应用于已发表论文错误识别（获原作者确认），并帮助解决三个 Langlands 公开猜想（经专家确认）。

Conclusion: OSVerify 能有效降低人工审查成本，促进人机科研协作，并具备高影响的真实世界实用价值。

Abstract: AI has become increasingly helpful in scientific discovery, yet human expert review remains essential for those problems without reliable automated evaluation, posing a fundamental challenge as candidate generation scales beyond available review capacity. This paper studies verification under limited human effort, where rare valid solutions need to be prioritized while invalid candidates should be filtered out to reduce human workload. We adopt the one-sided verification objective that maximizes the rejection rate of invalid solutions (TNR) under a constraint on the false-rejection rate of valid ones (FNR), making human review cost an explicit term to minimize. Drawing on the intuition that verifying a specific error can be easier than discovering one, we introduce OSVerify, an algorithmic framework that decouples error proposal from error validation. The error proposer searches for errors in solutions across different granularities by hierarchical decomposition, while the validator distinguishes substantial errors from minor or hallucinated ones. Experiments on competition- and research-level benchmarks show that OSVerify reduces the number of human reviews of invalid solutions by 46% on average compared to voting baselines under the same empirical low FNR constraint. Our post-training of the validator further improves the reduction to 57%. As high-impact real-world use cases, we apply OSVerify to identify errors in published research papers that are subsequently confirmed by the original authors and help resolve three Langlands open conjectures that are confirmed by experts, demonstrating its utility to facilitate human-AI research collaboration.

</details>


### [964] [AM-Bench: Understanding Agents under Task Underspecification across Models and Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18090)
*Kaiyu Huang,Yiting Li,Angyang Gu,Pinjia He,Minchen Yu,Qingjiang Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AM-Bench基准，研究语言模型智能体在任务规格不完整/含糊情况下的表现，并揭示模型与执行框架配对对结果的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 含糊或不完整的任务规格会同时给智能体的执行和澄清带来困难，但目前跨模型、跨执行框架对其响应方式的刻画不足。

Method: 构建AM-Bench，基于Terminal-Bench 2.0和Harness-Bench改编48个任务，每个任务含一个完整规格参考和六个变体（覆盖目标、上下文、约束的含糊或缺失）。对5个模型×4个框架的所有配对进行20,160次运行评估。

Result: 发现不同的执行缺陷：目标缺失阻碍完成，上下文缺失增加token消耗，约束缺失削弱合规性但不一定阻止完成；缺失比含糊影响更大。这些效应重塑模型比较：优势未必保持，排名依赖模型×框架配对及评估标准（完成、成功、重复一致性）。澄清可挽回未完成工作，但多数约束违规仍无法解决。

Conclusion: 应进行跨信息条件的模型-框架联合评估，并在依赖行动前针对性澄清未解决需求。

Abstract: Ambiguous or incomplete task specifications complicate both execution and clarification for language-model agents. Yet agents' responses to these information gaps remain poorly characterized across models and execution harnesses. We present AM-Bench, a benchmark built from 48 tasks adapted from Terminal-Bench 2.0 and Harness-Bench. Each task includes a fully specified reference and six variants spanning ambiguous or missing goals, context, and constraints. We evaluate every pairing of five models and four harnesses over 20,160 runs. Our results reveal distinct execution deficits: goal gaps hinder completion, context gaps increase token use, and constraint gaps weaken compliance without necessarily preventing completion. Missingness lowers success more than ambiguity in all three domains. These effects also reshape system comparisons: advantages under complete information need not persist, and rankings depend on model $\times$ harness pairings and the evaluation criterion -- completion, success, or repeat consistency. Estimates based on observed clarification requests and matched fully specified runs further suggest that clarification could recover unfinished work while leaving most constraint violations unresolved. Together, these findings motivate joint model-harness evaluation across information conditions and targeted clarification of unresolved requirements before dependent actions. To support future research on agents under task underspecification, we provide the AM-Bench project repository at https://github.com/s4-lab-cuhksz/AM-Bench.git.

</details>


### [965] [LifeSearch: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents for Real-World Life and Productivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18092)
*Yibo Wang,Senjie Jin,Yansong Ning,Xinbing Liang,Haotian Luo,Jiazheng Zhang,Yuxuan He,Will Wu,Clarenceai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LifeSearch是一个面向真实生活与生产力场景的DR agent基准，覆盖7个领域、203个中英任务，含4000+专家细粒度rubric，评测12个agent，最强GPT-5.6 Sol仅得63.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DR agent基准多聚焦学术或合成任务，缺乏对真实生活与职业生产力场景能力的充分评估。

Method: 构建LifeSearch基准：203个中英任务源自真实用户查询，覆盖7个生活与生产力领域；通过4500+小时人工标注，编写4000+专家细粒度rubric（含覆盖率、准确性及数值、单位、日期、URL等具体标准）；在统一评测框架下评测12个DR agent；对比候选LLM评判与人工rubric标签，并进行人工排序研究。

Result: 最强前沿agent GPT-5.6 Sol仅得63.4%；聚合基准分数与人工判断高度一致（Spearman ρ=0.89，Kendall τ=0.81）。

Conclusion: LifeSearch提供了严格评估框架，为DR agent迈向真实世界生活与生产力应用奠定基础。

Abstract: Deep research (DR) agents address open-ended information needs through multi-step reasoning, long-horizon web search, and evidence synthesis. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on academic research or synthetic tasks, leaving DR agents' capabilities in real-world life and professional productivity settings insufficiently evaluated. To bridge this gap, we introduce LifeSearch, a challenging benchmark comprising 203 Chinese and English tasks derived from real-user query seeds across 7 concrete life and productivity domains. With more than 4,500 hours of human annotation, we construct over 4,000 expert-written, fine-grained rubrics, covering both report-content criteria for coverage and accuracy and concrete criteria specifying values, units, dates, and URLs. We conduct extensive experiments on 12 advanced DR agents under a unified evaluation harness, systematically analyzing their performance patterns and failure modes. We find that even the best-performing frontier agent, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves a score of only 63.4%, leaving substantial room for improvement on realistic life and professional DR tasks. We select the grading configuration by comparing candidate LLM judges against human rubric labels, and a human ranking study shows strong alignment between aggregate benchmark scores and human judgments (Spearman's $ρ= 0.89$, Kendall's $τ= 0.81$). LifeSearch provides a rigorous evaluation framework and foundation for advancing DR agents toward real-world life and productivity.

</details>


### [966] [CompanionSafe: From Multi-turn Safety Evaluation to Guardrails for AI Companions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18095)
*Xinyang Liao,Lingyu Li,Kaicheng Shen,Yang Yao,Na Lu,Yan Teng,Xia Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CompanionSafe 框架，用于 AI 伴侣安全性评估与缓解，包含多轮评估基准 CompanionEval 和风险检测护栏 CompanionGuard。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 伴侣虽提供情感支持，但其持续性关系互动带来独特安全风险；已有工作多针对通用危害或特定平台，且依赖人工收集对话，难以扩展并缺乏用户真实性。

Method: CompanionEval 通过多样人设、匹配的伴侣角色和对话场景构建 1,300 个关系化多轮评测设置，覆盖四个轮次层级；CompanionGuard 将基准暴露的失败转化为轮次定位监督，用于伴侣特定风险检测。

Result: 即使是强 LLM 和现有护栏模型也易受伴侣特定关系危害影响；闭源和开源模型在交互变长时安全风险均上升。

Conclusion: CompanionEval 与 CompanionGuard 形成实用的评估到缓解闭环，将多轮交互中的关系安全失败转化为伴侣特定护栏的监督信号。

Abstract: AI companions provide users with emotional support and ongoing companionship, but their sustained relational interactions also introduce distinct safety risks. Prior work largely targets general harms or specific companion platforms and risk categories, while relying on manually collected conversations, limiting scalable and user-grounded evaluation and mitigation. To address this, we introduce CompanionSafe, a unified evaluation-to-mitigation framework for AI companion safety. Its evaluation component, CompanionEval, provides scalable multi-turn evaluation by constructing 1,300 relationally grounded settings from diverse personas, matched companion characters, and dialogue scenarios across four turn tiers. Its mitigation component, CompanionGuard, converts benchmark-exposed failures into turn-localized supervision for companion-specific risk detection. Our results show that even strong LLMs and existing guard models remain vulnerable to companion-specific relational harms, while both closed- and open-source models exhibit increasing safety risks as interactions become longer. Together, CompanionEval and CompanionGuard form a practical evaluation-to-mitigation loop for AI companion safety, turning relational safety failures exposed during multi-turn interaction into supervision for companion-specific guardrails.

</details>


### [967] [Chain of Thought Monitoring Can Fail Even When CoT Is Necessary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18105)
*Lennart Bürger,Piotr Komorowski,Moritz Weckbecker,Evgenii Kortukov,Aakriti Jain,Sebastian Lapuschkin,Wojciech Samek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出CoT监控可靠性缺乏通用组织原则，提出比"必要/非必要"二分更细的四级必要性层级，并在三个较低层级上构建干预实验框架，证明即便CoT对答案必要，监控仍会失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿实验室用CoT监控检测AI系统不当行为，但其可靠性理解不足。现有工作将监控失败归因于CoT对答案非必要，并认为CoT必要即可监控；作者认为该二分原则过于粗糙。

Method: 提出基于四级CoT必要性层级的细粒度组织原则，并在最低三层通过干预实验构建CoT可监控性测量框架，在现实困难预测任务上验证。

Result: 在困难医学诊断任务中，患者性别和某临床属性分别在至少19%和24%的含必要CoT的正确回答中影响答案，但几乎从未被显式表述，三个层级均出现监控失败。

Conclusion: CoT对答案必要并不保证其可被监控，需要更细粒度的必要性层级来理解监控可靠性。

Abstract: Chain of Thought (CoT) monitoring is used by frontier labs to detect misbehaviour of AI systems. Yet, its reliability remains poorly understood. We attribute this to the lack of a successful organizing principle that leads to generalizable conclusions about monitoring reliability in different regimes. Recent work attributes monitoring failures to the CoT not being necessary for the answer, and argues that CoT becomes monitorable when it is necessary. We show that this binary necessary/not-necessary organizing principle is too coarse by demonstrating that monitoring failures persist even if the CoT is necessary for the answer. In response, we introduce a more fine-grained organizing principle based on a hierarchy of four CoT necessity levels. Building on this hierarchy, we develop a framework for measuring CoT monitorability at the three lowest levels via intervention experiments. We demonstrate monitoring failures at all three of these levels on realistic, hard prediction tasks. On a difficult medical-diagnosis task, patient sex and a clinical attribute influence the answer in at least 19% and 24% of correct responses with a necessary CoT, respectively, yet their influence is almost never articulated. These results show that even when CoT is necessary, it is not guaranteed to be monitorable.

</details>


### [968] [Monitoring latent reasoning in looped language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18127)
*Pawel Olszowiec,Paulina Tomaszewska,Maciej Żelaszczyk,Michal Byra,Neo Christopher Chung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个基于机制可解释性的检查协议（含五种视角），用于分析8个循环语言模型（来自4个家族），重点比较两类循环结构：仅在循环状态内传递提示（carry loops）与每次迭代重新提供提示（re-read loops）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型可复用同一层块多次以增加潜在计算量而不增加存储成本，但学界对其迭代变换是否真正提升能力、以及模型在提示扰动下是否稳定仍缺乏分析。

Method: 作者设计了一个根植于机制可解释性的检查协议，包含五种多样化的分析视角；应用于8个循环语言模型（来自4个家族）。关键对比维度是提示传递方式：carry loops（Ouro、LoopUS）仅在循环状态内传递提示，re-read loops（Parcae、Raven家族的Rec-OLMo与Huginn）在每次迭代重新提供提示。

Result: 论文未在摘要中给出具体实验数据，但研究报告了关于循环语言模型安全性与高效使用的有价值的洞见。（摘要未提供量化结果）

Conclusion: 该研究为循环语言模型的能力、稳定性及安全性提供了机制可解释性分析，并给出关于安全与高效使用循环语言模型的实用启示。

Abstract: Looped language models (LMs) reuse one block of layers several times per token generation, promising more latent computation at no additional storage cost. Despite their rising popularity, the analysis of looped LMs is still in its infancy: little is known about whether the iterative transformations actually improve their capabilities, or whether these models remain stable under prompt perturbation. We construct an inspection protocol rooted in Mechanistic Interpretability comprising five diverse lenses. We apply it to examine eight looped LMs from four families. Models differ in many aspects but the key one is whether the prompt is transmitted only within the looped state (carry loops: Ouro, LoopUS) or re-supplied at every iteration (re-read loops: Parcae, and Rec-OLMo & Huginn from the Raven family). The results of our study provide valuable insights concerning safety and efficient use of looped language models.

</details>


### [969] [Mitigating Cross-Modal Hallucinations by Correcting Modality Misrouting in Omnimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18141)
*Yu Mi,Licheng Pan,Jiayi Zhu,Qirui Liu,Yitong Qiao,Changtong Xu,Tao Wei,Fei Sun,Zhixuan Chu,Kui Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现多模态大模型的跨模态幻觉存在"模态误路由"现象，并提出无需训练的推理时方法CaRe来识别和纠正该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Omnimodal大模型在音视频干扰下易产生跨模态幻觉。作者发现大量错误联合预测中，与问题相关的单模态分支仍能给出正确答案，说明任务相关证据即使未被联合预测反映，仍可从相关模态中恢复，这种可恢复的失败模式被称为模态误路由。

Method: CaRe是一种免训练的推理时方法。用纯文本模态探针识别候选的模态特定反事实分支，当其预测与原联合预测冲突时标记为潜在误路由；随后计算反事实表征与融合表征差异的残差方向，用以引导原始多模态状态朝向相关模态证据，同时保留原始音视频推理路径中的双模态；干预强度依据反事实分支的置信度自适应调整。

Result: 在CMM和AVHBench数据集上，对两个OLLM进行实验，CaRe一致优于所评估的推理时幻觉缓解基线。

Conclusion: CaRe通过识别和纠正模态误路由，能有效缓解OLLM的跨模态幻觉，且无需额外训练，具有良好的通用性和效果。

Abstract: Omnimodal large language models (OLLMs) are susceptible to cross-modal hallucinations under audio-visual interference. We find that, for a substantial fraction of incorrect joint predictions, the question-relevant unimodal branch can still recover the correct answer, suggesting that task-relevant evidence can remain recoverable from the relevant modality even when it is not reflected in the joint prediction. We refer to this recoverable failure pattern as \emph{modality misrouting}. We propose CaRe (Conflict-aware Residual Intervention), a training-free inference-time method for identifying and correcting modality misrouting. CaRe uses a text-only modality probe to identify a candidate modality-specific counterfactual branch, and flags potential misrouting when its prediction conflicts with the original joint prediction. For such cases, CaRe computes a residual direction from the discrepancy between the counterfactual and fused representations and uses it to steer the original multimodal state toward the relevant modality evidence, while retaining both modalities in the original audio-visual inference path. The intervention strength is adapted based on the confidence of the counterfactual branch. Experiments on CMM and AVHBench across two OLLMs show that CaRe consistently outperforms the evaluated inference-time hallucination-mitigation baselines.

</details>


### [970] [RadixFlow: Filling Execution Bubbles in Prefix-Cached Hybrid LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18143)
*Huihao Jing,Wenbin Hu,Shaojin Chen,Haochen Shi,Haoyu Huang,Sirui Zhang,Yuxuan Liu,Zhongwei Xie,Haoran Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RadixFlow通过解耦前缀匹配与状态就绪，消除混合LLM推理调度中的队头阻塞与执行气泡，降低延迟和轮次。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前缀复用依赖调度器在同一轮执行匹配分支，但混合LLM中消费者分支可能需等待生产者分支正在计算的循环状态，原生调度器在此阻塞扫描导致队头阻塞和执行气泡。

Method: RadixFlow解耦前缀匹配与状态就绪，采用状态就绪遍历，将全局扫描屏障转为局部等待，只阻塞消费者，同时让可行独立分支继续填充批次。

Result: 在五个混合模型上，平均延迟降低3%-24%，工作轮次减少11%-44%，复用率几乎不变；Qwen3.5消融显示收益主要来自遍历，全注意力对照提升小，较重轮次限制延迟收益。

Conclusion: RadixFlow有效缓解混合LLM前缀复用调度瓶颈，但收益受轮次开销限制。

Abstract: Prefix reuse improves LLM inference by sharing the KV cache of common prompt prefixes. This helps only if the scheduler can execute a matched branch in the current worker round. Schedulers assume that a matched prefix is ready, which holds for full attention but fails for hybrid LLMs. There, a branch (the consumer) may need recurrent state that another branch (the producer) is still computing in the same round. The native scheduler stops its waiting-queue scan at this blocked consumer, and the resulting head-of-line blocking creates \emph{execution bubbles}: idle batch slots that independent work could fill. We introduce RadixFlow, which decouples prefix matching from state readiness. Its state-ready traversal turns a global scan barrier into a local wait: only the consumer is blocked until the next round, while feasible independent branches keep filling the batch under the native state check. On five hybrid models, RadixFlow lowers mean latency by 3\% to 24\% and worker rounds by 11\% to 44\% at almost unchanged reuse. On the larger Qwen3.5 models, ablations show that most of the gain comes from traversal, which adds little on a full-attention control. Heavier rounds limit how much of this saving reaches latency.

</details>


### [971] [When and How Order-Flow Interventions Work After Dealers Adapt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18158)
*Guanghao Wu,Zhuo Cai,Zhidong Li,Shoujin Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出SOFA机制（状态对齐订单流分配），通过状态评分、承诺调度与报价到流量分配三部分，利用公开滞后数据在市场低风险状态下集中干预，降低低风险交易成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 做市商可能长期维持较宽报价，提高客户交易成本。但仅凭端到端比较难以判断某规则为何有效（是因干预更多、选择时机更好、提前公告，还是奖励正确报价），且做市商会适应规则，因此需要可分解的机制来分析干预效果。

Method: 提出SOFA（State-aligned Order-Flow Allocation），包含三部分：State Scorer用滞后公开数据对市场状态排序；Commitment Scheduler在报价前提前公告有限的干预强度；Quote-to-Flow Allocator将固定客户需求中有限份额导向更紧报价。并设计配对再适应协议，让竞争规则拥有相同干预强度仅改变时机，做市商从共享检查点重新适应，逐个打破机制环节。在ABIDES市场中对20个独立训练的做市商群体进行实验。

Result: 在所有20个做市商群体中，将干预集中于评分认为低风险的状态，相较随机时机，平均降低低风险执行成本0.040 tick；而延迟公告或破坏报价到流量链路会提高该成本。主要设定下收益以高风险交易成本上升为代价，因此只有当交易场所对低风险成本的重视程度高于高风险成本1.38倍以上时，状态对齐才有收益。

Conclusion: 状态对齐的订单流干预能有效降低低风险交易成本，但存在高风险成本上升的权衡；其效益取决于交易场所对低风险成本的相对权重。代码已开源。

Abstract: Learning dealer agents can settle on persistently wide quotes, raising what customers pay to trade. A venue can route more orders to tighter quotes, but a wide quote may reflect real risk, and once dealers adapt, an end-to-end comparison cannot show why a rule works: because it intervenes more, picks better moments, is announced in advance, or rewards the right quote. We propose SOFA (State-aligned Order-Flow Allocation), a public order-flow contract with three parts: a State Scorer ranks market states from lagged public data, a Commitment Scheduler announces a budgeted intervention strength before dealers quote, and a Quote-to-Flow Allocator shifts a bounded share of fixed customer demand toward tighter quotes. Our paired re-adaptation protocol gives competing rules the same intervention strengths, only re-timed, lets dealers re-adapt to each rule from a shared checkpoint, and breaks one link at a time. Across 20 independently trained dealer populations in an ABIDES market, concentrating the intervention in states that the score ranks as low-risk lowers low-risk execution cost relative to random timing in every population, by 0.040 tick on average, while a stale announcement or a broken quote-to-flow link raises this cost. In the primary setting the gain comes at the expense of high-risk trades, whose costs rise, so state alignment pays off only for a venue that weighs low-risk costs more than 1.38 times as heavily as high-risk costs. Our code is available at https://github.com/moderncavemann/state-aligned-order-flow-contracts.

</details>


### [972] [Back to the Future: Reverse-Consequence Modeling for Long-Horizon Particle Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18168)
*Leyan Zhang,Nantian He,Jiajun Ma,Yanpeng Zhao,Yunbo Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReStep颠覆正向预测范式，先预测终态再用锚定扩散生成中间轨迹，显著缓解长时程误差累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归模型存在累积误差，长时程展开会严重漂移。作者观察到在耗散或趋于静止的物理系统中，最终状态往往比瞬态动力学更易预测（如受摩擦滑动物体、摆动趋于平衡的摆）。

Method: 提出级联式反向范式ReStep：先用随机模型直接预测最终状态，再用Anchored Diffusion生成以目标为条件的中间轨迹。通过以两个"边界状态"为条件约束动力学、降低不确定性。并将ReStep动力学集成到3D Gaussian Splatting流程中作为物理引擎，构建统一物理-视觉框架，支持从图像直观推理。

Result: 在多种刚性与非刚性碰撞数据集上，ReStep取得更优的长期精度，通过反向结果建模大幅缓解误差累积。

Conclusion: 反向后果建模是缓解累积误差的有效途径，可实现物理合理、时间连贯的长时程轨迹预测，并与视觉渲染统一。

Abstract: Accurate prediction of object trajectories is fundamental to mechanical understanding and robotic control. However, autoregressive models inherently suffer from cumulative errors, leading to severe drift in long-horizon rollouts. Observing that in many physical systems with dissipative or convergence-to-rest behavior, the final states are often more predictable than transient dynamics (e.g., a sliding object resting under friction or a pendulum stabilizing at equilibrium), we propose ReStep, a cascaded approach that reverses the conventional forward-prediction paradigm. ReStep first employs a stochastic model to directly predict the final state, then leverages Anchored Diffusion to generate goal-conditioned intermediate trajectories. By conditioning on both ''boundary states'', it effectively constrains dynamics and reduces uncertainty, producing physically plausible and temporally coherent transitions. We further integrate ReStep dynamics as the physical engine within a 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline, enabling a unified physical-visual framework for intuitive inference from images. Extensive experiments on diverse rigid and non-rigid collision datasets show that ReStep achieves superior long-term accuracy, substantially mitigating error accumulation via reverse-consequence modeling.

</details>


### [973] [Neuro-Symbolic Graph Transformers for Hierarchical Intention Recognition from Multimodal Human Activity Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18176)
*Farnaz Soleimani,Abdelghani Chibani,Yacine Amirat,Ghazaleh Khodabandelou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出神经符号图变换器NSGT，通过人类推理图与FOL损失实现四层级意图推理，在NTU-Hierarchy数据集上兼顾高精度与逻辑一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动人机协作需推断人类行为背后的层级意图，而现有深度学习多为扁平动作分类，无法捕捉从运动学到高层目标的结构依赖。

Method: 在多模态框架中提出NSGT，将可学习拓扑偏置的人类推理图HR-G融入自注意力机制；并加入可微一阶逻辑FOL损失作为结构正则项，在原子动作、组合活动、低层意图、高层意图四层级上强制本体一致性。构建NTU-Hierarchy数据集（119,383个层级片段），并严格隔离标签生成与FOL约束以避免循环监督。

Result: 基础配置下NSGT达91.65% top-1动作准确率；加入FOL损失后逻辑一致性提升3.26个百分点至96.67%。一致性最大化配置（λ=0.5）下达94.59%逻辑一致性，本体矛盾减少33%，仍保持89.90%准确率。HR-G权重提供可解释证据，转移边被显著利用（β_trans≈+2.6）且无显式监督。

Conclusion: NSGT通过神经符号与图结构偏置，可在准确率与结构连贯性间实现可调权衡，并提供可解释的层级推理证据。

Abstract: Proactive human-robot collaboration requires autonomous systems to infer not only immediate actions but also the underlying hierarchical intentions governing human behavior. Current deep learning approaches predominantly focus on flat action classification, failing to capture the structural dependencies connecting kinematic motion to high-level goals. A Neuro-Symbolic Graph Transformer (NSGT) is proposed within this multimodal framework, a Human Reasoning Graph (HR-G) is integrated into the self-attention mechanism via learnable topological biases. Furthermore, the architecture is augmented with a differentiable First-Order Logic (FOL) loss, acting as a structural regularizer by which ontological consistency is enforced across four levels: atomic actions, composite activities, Low-Level Intentions, and High-Level Intentions. Evaluation is performed on the synthesized NTU-Hierarchy dataset, a four-level ontological extension of NTU RGB+D 120, wherein existing sequences were mapped into 119,383 complex hierarchical episodes (85 actions, 16 activities, 8 LLIs, 4 HLIs). To prevent circular supervision, strict isolation between label generation and FOL constraints was maintained. In the base configuration, 91.65% top-1 action accuracy is achieved by the NSGT. When the FOL loss is incorporated into the baseline, logic consistency is improved by 3.26 percentage points to 96.67%. Through the HR-G biases, a tunable trade-off between accuracy and structural coherence is established. In the primary consistency-maximizing configuration ($λ$ = 0.5), a logic consistency of 94.59% is reached and ontological contradictions are reduced by 33%, while a robust 89.90% top-1 action accuracy is retained. Finally, interpretable reasoning evidence is provided by the learned HR-G weights, wherein transition edges are strongly exploited ($β$ trans $\approx$ +2.6) without explicit supervision.

</details>


### [974] [QORH: Learning Query-Specific Ordered Rule Hypergraphs for Inductive Knowledge Graph Link Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18198)
*Naixing Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出QORH，用查询特定的有序规则超图联合编码规则头与有序规则体，实现归纳式知识图谱链接预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于关系图的方法主要捕捉成对依赖，难以保留完整路径规则的组合语义、关系顺序与角色信息。

Method: 将规则头与有序规则体作为以查询关系为条件的超边联合编码，建模多关系联合依赖；用规则置信度、覆盖度等统计证据进行可学习规则选择；通过角色感知超图消息传递增强关系表示，指导实体级推理；共享参数与具体实体/关系标识无关。

Result: 在实体归纳与完全归纳基准上显著优于所评估的最新基线。

Conclusion: 验证了规则超图建模对归纳式链接预测的有效性。

Abstract: Knowledge graph link prediction involving unseen entities and relations requires learning transferable reasoning patterns from observed graph structure. Existing methods based on relation graphs primarily capture pairwise dependencies, limiting their ability to preserve the compositional semantics, relation ordering, and role information of complete path rules. To address this limitation, we propose QORH (Query-specific Ordered Rule Hypergraph), which jointly encodes rule heads and ordered rule bodies as hyperedges conditioned on the query relation, explicitly modeling joint dependencies among multiple relations. QORH performs learnable rule selection using statistical evidence, such as rule confidence and coverage, and enhances relation representations through role-aware hypergraph message passing to guide entity-level reasoning. The model's shared parameters are independent of specific entity or relation identifiers, enabling inductive prediction for unseen entities and relations. Extensive experiments on entity-inductive and fully inductive benchmarks demonstrate that QORH significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines included in our evaluation, validating the effectiveness of rule hypergraph modeling for inductive link prediction.

</details>


### [975] [Consider, Then Choose: Order-Invariant Decisions in System One Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18233)
*Jianguo Huang,Yao Long Teng,Yanchen Deng,Bo An*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Runoff方法解决选择题中答案随选项顺序变化的问题，无需训练、两次前向传播，答案对选项顺序不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: System One模型对选择题的回答依赖选项顺序，选项越多依赖越强，即使listwise答案看似自信，实际在top选项间不确定时会改变答案。

Method: 先对每个选项单独打分保留少量候选（不受顺序影响），再在候选各占所有位置的listing中比较；无需训练，两次前向传播即可完成。

Result: 在两个开源模型和五个数据集上，打乱选项不改答案，而循环平均为9.3%；20选项时精度相当且快3-4倍；包裹八个模型可消除五个基准的顺序依赖，循环平均最多变化15.4%。

Conclusion: Runoff通过"先考虑再选择"的两阶段策略，从构造上消除选项顺序依赖，兼顾效率与精度。

Abstract: System One models answer typed questions in a single forward pass and promise the same answer for the same input. For choice questions, this promise fails: the answer depends on the order of the options, increasingly so as they grow in number, and averaging over their cyclic shifts reduces this dependence without removing it. Scoring each option alone, which the order cannot affect, shows that the order changes the answer mostly when the model is unsure among its top few options, even though the listwise answer looks confident. We therefore propose $\textbf{Runoff}$, which considers, then chooses: it scores each option alone to keep a few candidates, then compares them in listings where each candidate takes every position. It needs no training and can run in two forward passes, and its answer does not depend on the option order by construction.
