On two open models and five datasets, it changes no answer under shuffling, against 9.3% for cyclic averaging, and with 20 options it is about as accurate and three to four times faster. Wrapped around eight System One models, it removes the order dependence of the five benchmarks, while cyclic averaging changes up to 15.4%.

</details>


### [976] [Beyond Answer Sharing: TrueMAD for Targeted Peer Engagement in Multi-Agent Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18240)
*Dezheng Bao,Sihang Du,Renhong Huang,Zhizhang Yuan,Yifei Sun,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TrueMAD，一种无需训练、即插即用的测试时机制，在多智能体辩论中加入一对一自由形式的同伴建议，显著提升推理准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准广播式多智能体辩论（MAD）让同伴答案可见，但不要求智能体针对特定同伴观点进行回应；导致可靠推理可能被冲突或多数响应压制，而错误推理因缺乏可操作反馈而持续存在，从而限制最终性能。

Method: TrueMAD在答案广播与自我修订之间引入一对一、自由形式的同伴建议。每个源智能体针对目标的当前推理，给出支持、反驳、改进或进一步提问，目标智能体保留如何修订的控制权。该机制可无参数更新地增强标准MAD及其改进变体（如TrueDMAD增强DMAD）。

Result: 在AIME、GPQA-Diamond和TruthfulQA上，使用Qwen3-30B-A3B，TrueMAD较MAD平均提升智能体级和严格多数准确率3.62和3.52个百分点；TrueDMAD较DMAD分别提升4.72和4.06个百分点。话语、智能体转换与群体层面的分析显示更多针对同伴的审议、更偏向纠错的修订及更有利的共识动态。

Conclusion: 通过引入一对一、针对性的同伴建议，TrueMAD有效克服标准MAD的反馈不足问题，提升推理准确率并优化共识动态，且具骨干无关、可即插即用、无需训练的通用性。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) aims to improve large language model reasoning by exposing agents to alternative solutions and enabling iterative revision. However, standard broadcast-style MAD makes peer answers visible without requiring agents to engage with a particular peer claim. As a result, reliable reasoning may be suppressed by conflicting or majority responses, limiting achievable performance, while erroneous reasoning may persist and degrade final predictions without actionable feedback. We propose TrueMAD, a backbone-agnostic test-time plug-in that introduces one-to-one, free-form peer advice between answer broadcasting and self-revision. Each source agent responds to a target's current reasoning through support, rebuttal, refinement, or further questions, while the target retains control over how to revise. The same mechanism can augment standard MAD and its improved variants without parameter updates. Across AIME, GPQA-Diamond, and TruthfulQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B, TrueMAD improves agent-level and strict-majority accuracy over MAD by 3.62 and 3.52 percentage points on average, while TrueDMAD improves DMAD by 4.72 and 4.06 points, respectively. Analyses at the utterance, agent-transition, and group levels further show more peer-specific deliberation, more correction-oriented revisions, and more favorable consensus dynamics.

</details>


### [977] [Output Discipline Sets the Floor: A Falsification-Guided, Model-Agnostic Agent Protocol for Auditable Hypothesis-Driven Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18298)
*Jing Liu,Yongxing Qi,Ping Yao,Ting Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出模型无关的五阶段闭环智能体框架，通过候选×证据矩阵证伪协议加强输出纪律和推理结构，在中医辨证基准上救弱模型、稳定高方差模型，但对已守纪律模型有成本，并可迁移到抗错误前提的数学推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在可审计、假设驱动的决策任务中，限制大语言模型的并非模型能力本身，而是输出纪律与推理结构：两年模型扩展仅带来-0.03至+0.08的零样本变化，前沿模型仍存在非终止推理、格式不合规和运行间方差大等问题。

Method: 将决策形式化为五阶段闭环的模型无关智能体框架，采用候选×证据矩阵证伪协议：每个候选对每条证据逐一判定，至少半数候选被证伪后才允许结论，幸存者以机器可验证的单行格式输出。

Result: 在五个基础模型上效果符号依零样本文本纪律而定：DeepSeek-V4-Flash提升+0.267/+0.271（完全来自终止救援）；Kimi K3运行间标准差从0.218降至0.007；对已守纪律的Qwen3-4B/32B在预算匹配下损失-0.087至-0.120。消融显示成本来自候选受限格式层，且协议与注入知识内容解耦。协议迁移到数学推理，以89.8%召回、6.8%假阳率（MCC 0.54）检测注入假前提，并恢复到无错误信息上限。

Conclusion: 零样本输出纪律弱时，推理协议决定下限；基础模型能力始终决定上限。

Abstract: What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked against the evidence? On the public TCMEval-SDT benchmark for Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation (200 cases), the binding constraint is output discipline and reasoning structure, not model capability alone: two years of model scaling move zero-shot scores by only -0.03 to +0.08, while output-discipline failures (non-terminating reasoning, format non-compliance, large run-to-run spread) persist even in frontier models. We test this with a model-agnostic agent framework formalizing decision making as a five-stage closed loop, enforced by a candidate x evidence matrix falsification protocol: every candidate is judged against every evidence item, at least half of the candidates must be falsified before a conclusion is licensed, and survivors are emitted in a machine-verifiable single-line format. Across five base models, the effect is sign-conditional on zero-shot output discipline: it rescues models whose discipline fails (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: +0.267/+0.271, entirely termination rescue), reduces a high-variance model's run-to-run standard deviation from 0.218 to 0.007 (Kimi K3), and significantly costs already-disciplined models (-0.087 to -0.120 on budget-matched Qwen3-4B/32B). Ablations attribute the cost to the candidate-bounded format layer and show the effect is independent of injected knowledge content (protocol-knowledge decoupling). The protocol also transfers to misinformation-robust mathematical reasoning, detecting injected false premises at 89.8% recall with a 6.8% false-positive rate (MCC 0.54; a flag-everything baseline scores 0) and restoring accuracy to the no-misinformation ceiling. Where zero-shot output discipline is weak, the reasoning protocol sets the floor; base-model capability always sets the ceiling.

</details>


### [978] [A dataset of formalised theorem statements from the Annals of Mathematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18301)
*Thomas Browning,Katerina Hristova,David Ledvinka,Justus Springer,Hang Lu Su,Jack McKoen,Kevin Buzzard*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 AnnalsChallenge：50 个手工用 Lean 4 + Mathlib 形式化的定理陈述，均取自 2020 年以来发表在 Annals of Mathematics 上的论文主结果，经人工审查与 AI 审计后发布（不含形式化证明），用于评测数学自动形式化进展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 自动形式化数学进展显著，但衡量进展需要既困难又可信的形式化陈述数据集。

Method: 手工用 Lean 4 和 Mathlib 形式化 50 个定理陈述，每篇对应一篇文章的主结果；每条形式化经人工评审并由 AI 审计。

Result: 发布了 AnnalsChallenge 数据集，包含 50 条来自 Annals of Mathematics（2020 年后）论文的高难度形式化定理陈述。

Conclusion: 该数据集为评估自动形式化提供困难且可信的基准；仅发布陈述，不含形式化证明。

Abstract: Recent progress in autoformalisation of mathematics using AI has been impressive. Measuring this progress requires datasets of formal statements that are both hard and trustworthy. We present AnnalsChallenge: 50 formalised theorem statements written by hand in Lean 4 using Mathlib. Each is the main result of a paper published in the Annals of Mathematics since 2020. Every formalisation was manually reviewed and then audited by AI. We release them without formalised proofs.

</details>


### [979] [Efficient Safety Guardrails through Latent Dual-Hypothesis Reasoning with On-Demand Trace Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18304)
*Md Asiful Islam,Fahmida Alam,Mihai Surdeanu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LR-Guard 通过联合学习结构化隐式推理与按需推理重建，实现高效且可解释的安全护栏，在多数场景超越显式推理教师模型，并获 19.4 倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于推理的 LLM 护栏虽提升安全决策质量，但显式推理带来巨大推理开销，需兼顾效率与可解释性。

Method: 将冻结教师模型对安全/不安全提示解析及比较的分析蒸馏为紧凑隐式表示；联合训练使该表示同时服务安全预测与教师显式推理轨迹的重建，无需为每次决策生成中间文本。

Result: 在多数域内与域外设置下，安全分类与解释抽取均优于显式推理教师模型；batch size 为 1 时推理加速 19.4 倍；重建推理轨迹与教师显式推理语义相似度高。

Conclusion: 隐式推理加按需重建可在保持可解释性的同时显著降低推理开销，为高效护栏提供新范式。

Abstract: Guardrail approaches that rely on reasoning-based large language models (LLM) improve safety decisions, but come with substantial inference overhead due to the explicit reasoning. We introduce LR-Guard (Latent Reasoning Guardrail), an efficient and explainable guardrail that jointly learns structured latent reasoning and on-demand reasoning reconstruction. Our method distills a frozen teacher's analysis of safe and unsafe prompt interpretations and their comparison into compact latent representations. Joint training optimizes these representations for both safety prediction and reconstruction of the teacher's explicit reasoning traces, enabling human-readable explanations without requiring intermediate text generation for every decision. Experiments show that LR-Guard outperforms its explicit-reasoning teacher in most in-domain and out-of-domain settings on safety classification and explanation extraction, while achieving a 19.4x inference speedup at batch size one. Further, reconstructed reasoning traces from the latent information exhibit high semantic similarity to the teacher's explicit reasoning.

</details>


### [980] [Complex materials engineering via Provenance Action Graphs: potential, structure and demonstration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18314)
*Yevgeny Rakita,Paul Todd,James R. Neilson,Simon J. L. Billinge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨并验证反应图（reaction graphs）在材料合成中的潜力，事件由反应步骤（动作）及其产物（观察）构成，旨在借助AI学习算法编码合成路径规则，实现正向预测与逆向学习，构建可共享的全球知识库以加速材料发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 技术上有用的材料（尤其是动力学稳定材料）的合成往往依赖多年试错，最终只发表成功配方，而被大量未发表的失败所驱动；进入AI时代，有机会利用学习算法从多维合成路径中编码规则，加速材料发现并构建可共享的知识库。

Method: 以反应图为核心框架，将反应步骤（动作）与输出（观察）作为事件，利用学习算法从多维合成路径中编码规则，支持正向预测和逆向学习两种模式；重点研究固态合成常见过程中的若干场景，因其反应本质为动力学性，需要更细致地监测和控制反应历史。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果，主要阐述研究思路与关注场景，聚焦于固态合成的动力学反应路径建模与知识共享框架。

Conclusion: 反应图有望成为材料合成知识编码与共享的通用工具，通过AI驱动的正向/逆向学习加速材料（尤其是动力学稳定材料）的发现，并建立可由多个数据代理共同贡献与共享的全球知识库。

Abstract: This work discusses and tests the potential of reaction graphs for material synthesis, in which events consist of reaction steps (actions) and their outputs (observations). The importance comes from the requirement to synthesize technologically useful materials, especially those that are kinetically stabilized. Often, it is a science that follows years of trial and error, culminating in (published) successful recipes, but is truly driven by far more (unpublished) failures. The entry into the era of AI provides an opportunity to use learning algorithms to encode rules from multi-dimensional synthesis pathways, regardless of their technological usefulness, and to decode both forward prediction and inverse learning modes. The main incentive is to accelerate material discovery by generating a global knowledge base that can be shared among data agents and contributed to by them. We will focus on several scenarios in the common synthesis process during solid-state synthesis, primarily because these reactions are kinetic in nature and require closer monitoring and control of the reaction history.

</details>


### [981] [AssetForge: Asset-Augmented Task Synthesis for Business Automation Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18330)
*Xiangrui Liu,Shuo Tang,Siheng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AssetForge通过可复用资产库与任务专属Rubrics解耦业务逻辑与基础设施，在AutomationBench上显著提升自动化代理训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练业务自动化代理需要可执行任务（连接自然语言请求、应用状态与可验证终态），但传统Rubrics要求作者为每个任务重建应用接口、初始记录、策略证据与结果检查，导致业务逻辑与重复基础设施工作纠缠。

Method: 提出AssetForge资产增强式任务构建流水线：将可复用构建资产库与任务专属Rubrics配对，资产提供应用接口、世界状态组件、策略/证据载体与原生断言定义，Rubric指导其针对特定业务任务的实例化；通过可执行检查与额外交互式模型审查验证候选任务，返回定向反馈并支持有界修复后再接受。

Result: 在AutomationBench v1.0.6 public-600上，基于6,000个AssetForge样本微调Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，严格pass@1达41.17%，为基线9.33%的4.4倍（+31.83）。相同骨干与GLM-5.3监督下，AssetForge达41.17% vs 传统Rubrics 30.33%（+10.84点，相对+35.7%）。DeepSeek与GLM监督的模型在AppWorld的Test-Normal与Test-Challenge上均优于基线。

Conclusion: AssetForge完整构建流水线的优势得到验证：耦合的资产-Rubric接口引导作者聚焦业务逻辑，可执行检查与模型审查确保任务有效性。

Abstract: Training business automation agents requires executable tasks that connect a natural-language request to an application state and a verifiable end state. Traditional Rubrics requires Authors to recreate application interfaces, initial records, policy evidence, and outcome checks for each task, entangling business logic with repeated infrastructure work. We introduce AssetForge, an asset-augmented task-construction pipeline that pairs a reusable construction-asset library with task-specific Rubrics. The assets provide application interfaces, world-state components, policy/evidence carriers, and native assertion definitions; the Rubric directs their instantiation for a particular business task. Executable checks and an additional model-based review validate each candidate, return targeted feedback, and support bounded repair before acceptance. On AutomationBench v1.0.6 public-600, fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on 6,000 AssetForge examples yields 41.17% on the official strict pass@1 metric, 4.4 times the 9.33% base score (+31.83 points). With the same backbone and GLM-5.3 supervision, AssetForge reaches 41.17% versus 30.33% for traditional Rubrics, a 10.84-point gain (35.7% relative) at the same accepted-example scale (6,000 versus 6,000 examples). Both DeepSeek- and GLM-supervised AssetForge models improve AppWorld completion over the base model on Test-Normal and Test-Challenge. These results establish the advantage of AssetForge's complete construction pipeline on AutomationBench public: the coupled asset-Rubric interface directs Authors toward business logic, while executable checks and model-based review validate their tasks.

</details>


### [982] [ABot-ER: Unified Embodied Reasoning through Agentic Data-Model Co-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18355)
*Qiuyu Ding,Heng-Da Xu,Changda Xia,Jiajun Shen,Zihao Guan,Zhengchen Yuan,Jianfang Zhang,Di Yang,Jiayi Tian,Yuting Xu,Fei Wang,Shiao Liu,Wei Zhang,Xiaolong Wu,Wenbin Tang,Zedong Chu,Mu Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ABot-ER统一具身推理基础模型，通过自演化数据引擎与任务条件自适应训练，在感知、规划、执行三大能力上同时实现专家级深度与广度，达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能需要同时掌握感知、规划与执行，但在单一模型中兼顾通用性与专业化（广度与深度的张力）仍是未解难题。

Method: 1) ABot-ER统一模型，覆盖感知（空间/场景/时序推理）、规划（长时程动作组织）、执行（点定位与可供性）；2) Agentic数据-模型自演化引擎，随能力状态动态调整数据策略；3) 任务条件自适应训练策略，用任务token在共享骨干上激活轻量低秩残差，分离异构输出格式的更新。

Result: 在涵盖三大核心能力、五个能力维度的十二个基准上系统评测，ABot-ER在统一参数框架下于感知、规划和执行均取得SOTA总体性能。

Conclusion: 广度和深度可在统一具身推理中并存共生。

Abstract: We introduce \textbf{ABot Embodied Reasoning (ABot-ER)}, a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that breaks the tension between breadth and depth in embodied reasoning. Embodied intelligence demands the joint mastery of perception, planning, and execution, yet reconciling generality with specialization across this spectrum remains an open challenge. Within a single unified model, ABot-ER commands specialist-level depth across all three competencies, spanning spatial, scene, and temporal reasoning in perception; long-horizon action organization in planning; and point grounding and affordance in execution. The \textbf{Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine} continuously adapts data strategies to the model's evolving capability state. The \textbf{Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy} uses task tokens to activate lightweight low-rank residuals over a shared backbone, separating updates from heterogeneous output formats while retaining shared embodied knowledge. Across a systematic evaluation on twelve benchmarks covering three core competencies and five capability dimensions, ABot-ER achieves \textbf{state-of-the-art overall performance} across perception, planning, and execution within a unified parametric framework, demonstrating that breadth and depth can coexist in unified embodied reasoning.

</details>


### [983] [Delegating Earth science model calibration to knowledge-guided LLM agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18378)
*Zhanliang Zhu,Ziwei Li,Liujun Zhu,Yuchen Liu,Junliang Jin,Jianyun Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出通用校准工具GCH，实现将地球科学模型校准任务端到端委托给语言模型智能体，同时保证科学性与可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 让语言模型智能体可靠地完成地球科学模型在新站点与新问题上的校准，需要保留专家级的科学判断与结果可复现性。

Method: GCH以知识基础设施(KI)和验证约定为约束，由智能体定义参数域、观测映射与目标函数，并生成模型专用代码；GCH用相同声明校验并冻结这些设定，之后数值搜索与评估不再需要智能体判断。

Result: 跨六个模型族执行；雪模型测试中知识引导的5/5规格一次性成功（仅给模型名则0/5），验证NSE达0.81-0.94（默认0.57）；共同目标下独立GR4J公式NSE差异在0.001内，11个已存参数向量可复现指标；VIC十组配对测试中固定搜索非劣于持续智能体提议（边界-0.02 NSE，中位差-0.003）。

Conclusion: 该分离式设计支持端到端校准委托，科学选择可审查且数值评估可复现。

Abstract: Applying process-based Earth science models to new sites and questions often requires expert calibration decisions. Reliable delegation to language-model agents must preserve scientific competence and reproducibility. Here we develop a general calibration harness (GCH) for end-to-end delegation from a calibration request to assessed results. Constrained by a knowledge infrastructure (KI) and a validation convention, agents define parameter domains, observation mappings and objectives, and generate model-specific code. GCH checks the formulations against the same declarations and freezes them before numerical search and assessment, which require no further agent judgement. Agent-authored workflows executed across six model families, with assessment identifying unmet criteria. In snow-model tests, five of five knowledge-guided specifications executed on the first attempt, compared with none of five given only the model name, achieving validation Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency (NSE) of 0.81-0.94 against 0.57 for defaults. Under a common objective, independent GR4J formulations yielded scores within 0.001 NSE; re-evaluating eleven saved parameter vectors reproduced their metrics. In ten paired VIC tests with matched budgets, fixed search was non-inferior to continuing agent proposals (margin, -0.02 NSE; median difference, -0.003). This separation enables end-to-end calibration delegation with inspectable scientific choices and reproducible numerical evaluation.

</details>


### [984] [The Singularity Has a Distribution: Exact Timing Laws and Detection Limits for a Stochastic Intelligence Explosion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18445)
*Xiaoyu Li,Zheng Gao,Chiwun Yang,Zhizhou Sha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究AI自我改进的正反馈回路随机模型，给出爆炸时间的分布、尾行为及检测样本量下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化AI研究会在软件能力与研究投入之间形成正反馈回路，需要理解这种回路何时导致能力"爆炸"以及何时可被检测。

Method: 建立随机乘法增长模型：改进以与当前能力幂成正比的速率到达。分析等量改进(几何加权指数和及其q-级数)、Lomax分布改进(爆炸时间服从Gamma分布)，并构造固定样本检验与确定性监督竞赛模型。

Result: 随机性不改变确定性爆炸阈值，但将爆炸日期替换为显式分布；给出变换、矩、尾行为与双项小时间渐近。已知参数时相对不确定性不随接近爆炸而消失。最小样本量渐近为(12z_α²)^{1/3}ℓ^{-2/3}。增长指数临界附近出现1/t尾与无穷条件平均等待时间。固定部署延迟可阻止爆炸，幂律努力转移会移动增长阈值。

Conclusion: 该模型刻画了AI研究自动化反馈回路的爆炸时间与可检测性，说明时间与检测性取决于改进的粒度。

Abstract: Automating AI research creates a positive feedback loop between software capability and research effort. We study a stochastic realisation of this loop in which independent, positive, multiplicative improvements arrive at a rate proportional to a power of current capability. Within this model, randomness leaves the deterministic explosion threshold unchanged but replaces the blow-up date by an explicit distribution. For equal-sized improvements the explosion time is a geometrically weighted sum of independent exponentials; its $q$-series representation gives its transforms, moments and tail behaviour, including a two-term small-time asymptotic. For Lomax-distributed improvement sizes the explosion time is exactly Gamma distributed. Self-similarity implies that, with parameters known, the relative uncertainty about the remaining time does not vanish as explosion approaches. We formulate a fixed-sample test between constant and geometrically increasing idea-arrival rates. If the baseline rate and the alternative log-rate increment $\ell$ are known, the minimum sample size at error level $α$ is asymptotic to $(12z_α^2)^{1/3}\ell^{-2/3}$, where $z_α$ is the upper-$α$ standard normal quantile. Uncertainty about the growth exponent near its critical value produces a $1/t$ tail with an explicit constant, and hence an infinite conditional mean waiting time, although explosion is certain given a positive exponent. Separate extensions show that a fixed deployment delay prevents explosion in the specified delayed-feedback models, that power-law diversion of effort shifts the growth threshold, and that in a deterministic oversight race a fixed allocation share does not change the asymptotic regime, except at a critical equality of exponents. Numerical illustrations, which are not empirical forecasts, show how timing and detectability depend on the granularity of improvements.

</details>


### [985] [Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18447)
*Thinker Team,Peng Gao,Jichao Jiao,Chen Liao,Daqin Luo,Yiming Ma,Baiyu Pan,Hailin Shi,Jiyuan Wang,Xiangming Xu,Xiongwei Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出统一多模态世界模型Thinker-WM，将RGB、度量深度与机器人动作在共享的Unified Dynamics Transformer中联合建模与生成，支持多种世界模型功能，并在多个基准上排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型在模态与功能上较为碎片化，视觉动态、几何结构与可执行动作通常通过独立接口或下游模块耦合，而非在共享动力学模型中联合表示与演化。

Method: 通过共享的Unified Dynamics Transformer配合模态特定编码器/解码器，在表示层面将外观、几何与动作转换为公共动态表示并由共享参数联合演化，同时保留各自输出结构；引入轻量运动探针验证冻结视觉表示含可恢复运动信息；训练数据约含20K小时第一人称视频、10K小时真实机器人数据、1K小时仿真数据（其中约4K小时带对齐深度监督）。

Result: 支持联合视频-动作生成、世界预测、策略推断、动作条件生成、视频到动作生成、逆向动力学等多种功能；在EWMBench、WorldOlympiad、WorldArena上排名第一，对照实验证明动作条件、几何交互与多功能训练对共享表示的益处。

Conclusion: Thinker-WM表明在表示层面统一多模态与多功能是构建具身世界模型的有效路径，可在多个具身世界模型评测中取得领先性能。

Abstract: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

</details>


### [986] [Autonomous Science Bench: Evaluating AI Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18449)
*Yibo Wen,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Autonomous Science Bench v0.1，包含6个基于真实实验的预算受限科学发现任务，用“发现门”和“学习门”两项指标评估智能体的设计与预测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主科学发现智能体需在有限预算下决定实验；现有基准多提供固定数据或依赖模拟，缺少真实主动实验环境。

Method: 构建6个覆盖生物、化学、材料的预算化 design-build-test-learn 实验 campaign；智能体批量选设计，从实验室服务获得测量并迭代，最终交付预测模型；以发现门和学习门双门校准评估。

Result: 对8种智能体-模型配置、144次试验的试点评估中，最佳配置成功率67%，最难任务24次仅成功3次；两类门揭示不同弱点：有的排序准但发现少，有的发现多但预测新设计表现差。

Conclusion: 单一总体成功率会掩盖智能体的差异化缺陷，双门评估更细粒度；作者发布任务、实验室运行时与公共排行榜。

Abstract: AI agents for autonomous scientific discovery must decide which experiments to run under a limited budget. Most benchmarks for science agents provide fixed datasets, while others that support active experimentation largely rely on simulation. We introduce Autonomous Science Bench, an initial release comprising six budgeted design-build-test-learn campaigns grounded in published experiments across biology, chemistry, and materials science. Agents select batches of designs, receive measurements from a lab service, and use the results to guide subsequent experiments before delivering a predictive model. Success requires passing two calibrated gates: a discovery gate, which evaluates the designs the agent measured, and a learning gate, which evaluates its model's ranking of held-out designs. In a pilot evaluation of eight agent-model configurations and 144 trials, the best configuration succeeds in 67% of trials, while the hardest campaign is solved in only three of 24 attempts. The two gates reveal different weaknesses: some agents build accurate rankings but find too few promising designs, while others find promising designs but fail to predict which unseen designs will perform well. These differences are obscured by overall success rates alone. We release version 0.1 of the campaigns, lab runtime, and public leaderboard at https://yibow.me/autonomous-science-bench.

</details>


### [987] [Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18497)
*Linhai Ma,Yan Wang,Lingfei Qian,Yupeng Cao,Victor Gutierrez Basulto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"derivation gap"概念：当判定输入的文本中没有明确参考依据时，工具调用判定器（tool-call judge）更少接受正确的参数值；并提出DeRef方法通过单独模型生成参考文本来弥补该缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用判定器用于评估LLM代理提出的参数值，但作者发现当输入中缺少对正确值的明确参考（如未被用户提及的默认值、需要推断的值、被截断的文本来源）时，判定器会更少接受正确值。

Method: 评估了七个判定器（包括CLM、Jev等System One模型）；进行无截断基准测试和受控的"来源重定位"测试以证明问题非截断所致；提出DeRef（Derived Reference），让一个单独的模型在不看候选值的情况下阅读完整历史并写出参考供判定器使用。

Result: derivation gap在全部七个判定器上均出现；在无截断基准上，正确默认值的gap最大；来源重定位测试显示判定器偏向输入中可见的错误值而非来源被隐藏的正确值；DeRef在三个基准上提升了所有判定器的参数AUROC，在受控测试上将AUROC从随机水平或更低提升至98.40–99.59。

Conclusion: 工具调用判定器依赖输入中的显式参考而非自身推理，导致系统性拒绝缺参考的正确值；通过外部模型生成参考（DeRef）可显著缓解这一问题。

Abstract: Tool-call judges evaluate argument values proposed by LLM agents. We find that they accept a correct value less often when their input holds no reference for it, that is, no text that says what the value should be. This happens when the value is a default value from the function schema that the user did not mention, when it has to be inferred, or when the text it comes from was cut from the judge input. We call this drop in acceptance the derivation gap. It appears across all seven judges we evaluate, including System One models CLM and Jev. The gap is not only a truncation artifact: correct default values have the largest gap on a benchmark with no truncation. A controlled source-relocation test shows that judges follow the reference in their input: they favor a visible incorrect value over a correct value whose source is hidden. We introduce DeRef (Derived Reference): a separate model reads the full history without seeing the candidate and writes a reference for the judge. Across three benchmarks, DeRef improves overall argument AUROC for all judges tested. On the controlled test, it raises AUROC from chance or below to between 98.40 and 99.59.

</details>


### [988] [The Smart Buildings Challenge: Learning Foundation Models for Real-World Optimization at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18511)
*Judah Goldfeder,Ayush Rai,Philippe M. Wyder,Na Li,Victoria Dean,Donna Vakalis,Jiong Lin,Bing Dong,Michael Rossetti,Nathan Kutz,Sohei Arisaka,John Sipple,Hod Lipson,Yoshua Bengio*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个挑战赛，旨在开发建筑基础模型，使其能以最小配置泛化到新建筑，从而推动建筑优化在全球规模化应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑占美国近40%碳排放，HVAC系统占建筑排放约40-60%、全球能耗15%；尽管AI有进展，建筑仍低效运行。建筑优化对ML应对气候变化潜力巨大，但最大障碍是缺乏策略迁移——现有控制系统（仿真或学习型）无法泛化到其他建筑。

Method: 提出一个挑战赛：参与者在模拟建筑集上构建控制策略，并在未见过的建筑集上评估其策略；建筑在规模、布局、天气、材料属性和HVAC系统等方面各异。

Result: 本文为挑战赛提案，尚无实验结果；成功结果预计可推动全球可持续发展并展示ML应对气候变化的潜力。

Conclusion: 通过建筑基础模型实现跨建筑泛化与最小配置适配，可让建筑优化在全球规模化，助力气候行动。

Abstract: Buildings cause nearly 40\% of carbon emissions in the US. Of total building emissions, HVAC systems are responsible for approximately 40-60\% and account for 15\% of global energy consumption. Despite advances in artificial intelligence, most buildings still operate as inefficiently as they did decades ago. Building optimization, perhaps more so than any other optimization problem, has enormous potential for Machine Learning (ML) driven impact on climate change, in both the short and long term. One of the biggest obstacles for building optimization is the lack of policy transfer. Most building control systems, whether simulation or learning based, don't generalize: they only work well for the building they were developed for, but not for other buildings. To solve this problem, we propose a challenge for the development of building foundation models that easily adapt to new buildings with minimal configuration and thereby enable building optimization to scale across the globe. Participants will build control policies on a set of simulated buildings, and have their policies evaluated on an unseen set of buildings. The buildings vary in size, layout, weather, material properties, and HVAC system. Successful outcomes from this initiative promise a massive leap forward in global sustainability efforts and demonstrate the great potential of ML to combat climate change.

</details>


### [989] [Lost in Implicit Routing: How LLM Agents Fail to Load Relevant Skills at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18522)
*Jinlin Liu,Wei Chen,Xiaojin Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究LLM智能体可复用技能的规模化问题：随着无关技能增多，技能路由崩溃，智能体越来越少加载技能。1000个无关技能时召回率从73.6%降至27.4%，而显式预选仍保持73.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可复用技能让智能体按需加载任务指令，但执行依赖对技能元数据的隐式路由。作者想验证这种设计在技能库扩大时是否可扩展。

Method: 固定SkillsBench任务及其黄金技能，逐步加入无关技能，观察智能体的技能加载行为；对比显式选择、屏蔽无关技能描述、要求智能体先规划技能使用等条件。

Result: 出现技能路由崩溃：1000个无关技能时加载召回率由73.6%降至27.4%，零加载率由9.3%升至51.6%；同一库显式选择保持73.9%召回。加载其他技能（含合理备选）不足以解释下降。仅屏蔽无关技能描述可大致恢复加载；保留元数据时即使要求规划技能，召回仍低于预选。

Conclusion: 问题源于描述的语义干扰以及技能选择与任务执行之间的指令干扰。显式预选是可用的缓解手段，但需权衡覆盖率与延迟。研究为技能协议与评测提供指导。

Abstract: Reusable skills let LLM agents load task-specific instructions on demand, but they make execution depend on implicit routing over skill metadata. We test whether this design scales by holding SkillsBench tasks and their golden skills fixed while adding irrelevant skills. We find skill routing collapse: agents increasingly load fewer or no skills, even though the relevant skills remain available. With 1,000 irrelevant skills, loaded-skill recall falls from 73.6% to 27.4% and the zero-load rate rises from 9.3% to 51.6%, whereas explicit selection from the same library retains 73.9% recall. Loading other skills, including plausible alternatives to golden skills, is too rare to explain this decline. Masking only the descriptions of irrelevant skills largely restores skill loading, yet with the metadata intact, explicitly asking agents to plan skill use still yields lower recall than preselection. These findings point to semantic interference from descriptions and instruction interference when skill choice competes with task execution. We also evaluate explicit preselection as a practical mitigation, including its coverage and latency trade-offs. Our analysis informs skill protocols and evaluation for agents with growing skill libraries.

</details>


### [990] [Input-Conditioned Search for Efficient Test-Time Scaling of Recursive Reasoners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18547)
*Haochen Shi,Tianwen Fu,Qianggang Ding,Yinhan Lu,Yizhan Li,Huan Zhang,Yajie Zhao,Xingdi Yuan,Hengyang Lu,Bang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Input-Conditioned Search (ICS)，通过对同一潜状态施加不同更新映射来探索多样化推理路径，实现高效测试时扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归推理器可通过深度（更多更新）或宽度（扰动生成更多轨迹）扩展推理，但两者都可能收敛到错误的吸引子，无法像人类一样"换角度"重新思考。

Method: 提出 ICS：无需额外训练，搜索输入条件以从预训练推理器中诱导出替代更新映射，对同一潜状态应用不同更新映射来探索多样推理轨迹。

Result: 在六个推理任务上取得最高平均准确率，模型 FLOPs 比基线少两个数量级；控制实验证实 ICS 能从同一状态重定向轨迹；理论与数值验证表明 ICS 可局部消除错误的吸引不动点。

Conclusion: ICS 是一种有效的测试时扩展维度，呼吁进一步研究在训练和测试时塑造递归推理。

Abstract: People often tackle difficult problems by thinking more deeply or exploring more possibilities. Similarly, recursive reasoners, which reason by repeatedly applying a learned update rule to latent states, can also scale inference through more updates (depth) or additional trajectories generated by perturbing latent states (width). When people hit a dead end in their thinking, they may step back and approach the problem from a fresh angle. However, neither depth scaling nor perturbation-based width scaling of recursive reasoners can reliably achieve this: both may converge to incorrect attractors. To address this, we propose to explore diverse reasoning traces by applying different update maps to the same latent state, without any additional training. We realize this idea through \emph{Input-Conditioned Search (ICS)}, which searches over input conditions to induce alternative update maps from the pretrained reasoner. Across six reasoning tasks, ICS achieves the highest mean accuracy, while requiring up to two orders of magnitude fewer model FLOPs than the evaluated scaling baselines. Controlled experiments confirm that ICS can redirect trajectories from the same state. Our theoretical analysis and rigorous numerical verification also confirm that ICS can locally eliminate incorrect attracting fixed points. Together, these findings establish ICS as an effective axis for efficient test-time scaling and motivate further research on shaping recursive reasoning during training and at test time.

</details>


### [991] [Rethinking Quality in Large Language Model Routing: Security-Conditioned Model-and-Budget Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18566)
*Yichi Zhang,Zhenxiang Huang,Yuyang Zhang,Yuchen Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SCRouter是一个面向混合工作负载的LLM路由器，能分别预测效用与安全性，并动态分配token预算，在自建基准SCRouterBench上大幅超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM路由器使用单一质量指标对"模型-预算"动作排序，无法处理混合工作负载：普通查询追求正确性（效用），安全敏感查询追求拒答/抗注入（安全），两者偏好的模型与预算不同。

Method: SCRouter对每个模型-预算组合估计"响应在预算内完成"的概率，据此分别预测效用与安全性；用一个小探针（probe）为每个查询决定两者的权重；最终在加权的效用-安全与成本之间权衡，选择模型与预算。

Result: 构建了SCRouterBench，包含38,869条效用与安全查询（覆盖9个安全维度，每条在12个模型×12个预算共144种组合下作答），外加2,753条域外查询。SCRouter在域内提升基线13-29分，域外提升19-23分。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将效用与安全解耦预测并按查询动态加权，是降低LLM服务成本同时兼顾安全与效用的有效路由范式。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) routers reduce serving cost by choosing which model to call and how many output tokens to grant it for each query. Existing routers rank model-budget actions using a single quality metric. This does not work for mixed workloads. For ordinary queries, a good answer is correct and useful (utility); for security-sensitive queries, a good answer refuses harmful requests or resists malicious instructions (security). These two objectives prefer different models and budgets.
  We propose SCRouter, a router that learns when to prioritize security and how to allocate the token budget. For each model-budget pair, it estimates the probability that the response finishes within budget. It uses this probability to predict utility and security separately. A small probe determines how to weight these two predictions for each query. SCRouter then selects the model and budget by balancing the weighted utility and security against cost. We also build SCRouterBench, a benchmark of 38,869 utility and security queries spanning nine security dimensions, each answered under all 144 combinations of 12 models and 12 budgets, plus 2,753 out-of-domain queries. SCRouter improves the baselines by 13-29 points in-domain and 19-23 points out-of-domain.

</details>


### [992] [Configuring RAG Systems: What Breaks, Where Originates, and How to Fix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18567)
*Liangyu Chen,Youpeng Ma,Yulong Ye,Zezhen Xiang,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个针对RAG系统配置问题的大规模实证研究，分析654个真实配置缺陷，给出完整的分类体系与可操作建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG已成为增强LLM的主流范式，其系统高度可配置，大量故障与配置相关，但目前缺乏对RAG系统配置问题的系统性理解，存在研究空白。

Method: 从10个多样化RAG系统中收集654个真实配置问题，进行大规模实证研究，对症状、根因、相关阶段及修复模式进行完整分类，并结合RAG特有流水线阶段分析。

Result: 构建了症状、根因、相关阶段与修复模式的完整分类体系，得到若干新观察：多数症状出现在早期或晚期阶段，但根因所在阶段可能与症状识别阶段不一致；并提出9条面向实践的洞察。

Conclusion: 揭示了RAG系统配置问题的特征，并将其与RAG流水线阶段强关联，为从业者提供测试、定位与修复配置问题的可操作指导。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a dominant paradigm for improving Large Language Model (LLM) by intertwining it with other components, such as a vector/graph database. Therefore, the resulting RAG systems are often highly configurable, under which a non-trivial amount of failures are related to the configurations. However, there remains a lack of systematic understanding regarding the configuration issues for RAG systems. To bridge this gap, in this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 654 real-world configuration issues collected from 10 diverse RAG systems. Drawing on this, we provide a complete categorization of the symptoms, root causes, relevant stages, and fix patterns of configuration issues for RAG systems, as well as several new observations. Our findings not only reveal the characteristics of configuration issues, but also strongly link them to the unique pipeline stages of RAG, e.g., we found that most symptoms can be observed at the early or late stage, while the stage of the root cause might not be at the same stage as where the symptom is identified. We also provide nine actionable insights to the practitioners on testing, localizing, and fixing the configuration issues for RAG systems.

</details>


### [993] [Order-Consistent Latent Geometry for Reliable Short-Horizon Planning in World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18570)
*Junlin Wu,Wen Fan,Dandan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将潜在规划中"终端欧氏距离排序"的理想条件归约为经典的自逼近（self-approaching）性质，证明潜在路径出现锐角弯折会导致候选动作排序反转，并通过六分支实验验证该排序失效与角度容量（潜维数）的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在规划器常用到目标潜变量的终端欧氏距离对候选动作序列排序。若该分数与真实转移距离完全一致最优，但这比规划所需更强：只需保证在转移最短的 rollout 上，潜距离不逆转真实转移进展。作者指出这一"路径无反转"要求恰是经典自逼近条件，且此前无人将其识别为规划器的兼容性条件。

Method: 将路径无反转要求形式化为自逼近条件；针对视觉世界模型预测的离散潜序列，分析其折线插值；证明锐角弯折会产生非空区域，使终端欧氏距离将转移更差的候选排在真正有进展的候选之前（即便在精确 rollout 下）。再用经典球码界把潜维度解释为角度容量，并设计含零填充三维基线的六分支受控实验。

Result: 理论上证明了锐角弯折导致有限时域候选排序的精确反转，并给出潜维度与角度容量的球码界关系。六分支受控实验（含零填充三维基线）验证了预测的排序失效，并将角度排布与外在环境维度分离开来。

Conclusion: 终端欧氏潜在规划要求潜空间满足自逼近/无反转性质；违反该性质会在有限时域内造成候选排序反转。该视角将规划兼容性问题与球码几何联系起来，并提示通过控制角度排布而非单纯维度来缓解排序失效。

Abstract: Latent planners often rank candidate action sequences by terminal Euclidean distance to a goal latent. Exact agreement with transition distance would make this score ideal, but is stronger than planning requires: along a transition-shortest rollout, the essential requirement is that latent distance does not reverse true transition progress. We show that this pathwise no-reversal requirement is precisely the classical self-approaching condition. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to identify self-approachingness as a planner-facing compatibility condition for terminal Euclidean latent planning and to connect its violation to an exact finite-horizon candidate-order reversal. Because visual world models predict discrete latent sequences, we analyze their polygonal interpolation. We prove that an acute bend creates a nonempty region in which terminal Euclidean distance ranks a transition-worse candidate ahead of one that makes genuine progress, even under exact rollouts. We further interpret latent dimension as angular capacity through a classical spherical-code bound. A controlled six-branch experiment, including a zero-padded three-dimensional baseline, validates the predicted ordering failure and separates angular arrangement from ambient dimensionality.

</details>


### [994] [LLM Agents for Automated Post-Training via Structured Recipe Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18572)
*Ruohong Liu,Bohan Tang,Lekang Jiang,Jack Umenberger,Yiwen Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"任务自适应配方空间优化"新范式,并实例化为SRO方法,通过LLM配方空间设计器与多域配方优化器,在有限实验预算下自动构建和优化后训练配方,在多个目标模型与基准上取得最优效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化后训练需在有限预算下优化数据源、处理、跨域组合与训练配置的耦合决策。现有方法要么搜索固定配方空间,无法适应目标任务;要么用开放式智能体发现任务特定选择,却将其隐含在试次级编辑中,难以系统复用和重组。

Method: 提出"任务自适应配方空间优化"范式,可自适应调整配方空间并显式表示其选择以支持复用、重组和联合优化。实例化为SRO:包含基于LLM的配方空间设计器(构建任务自适应配方空间)和多域配方优化器(用结构化试验证据引导LLM候选构建与多目标贝叶斯试验选择)。

Result: 在所有评估的目标模型与智能体LLM组合中,SRO均取得最高平均分。三能力域、六基准联合后训练中,Qwen3-1.7B+GPT-5.4上SRO达41.1(最强基线15.4);Qwen3-4B+DeepSeek-V4-Flash上达53.8(基线40.8)。

Conclusion: 通过让配方空间自适应目标任务并显式表示选择,SRO实现了系统化复用、重组与联合优化,显著优于固定空间搜索和开放式智能体方法,验证了任务自适应配方空间优化范式的有效性。

Abstract: Automated post-training transforms pre-trained large language models (LLMs) into models capable of handling diverse domains by automatically constructing and optimizing a recipe of coupled decisions over data sources, data processing, cross-domain composition, and training configuration under a limited experimental budget. Existing automation either searches predefined recipe spaces that enable systematic optimization but remain fixed rather than adapting their available choices to the target tasks, or uses open-ended agents that discover task-specific choices but leave them implicit in trial-level edits, limiting their systematic reuse and recombination across trials. To fill this gap, we introduce optimization over a task-adapted recipe space, a novel paradigm that can adapt the recipe space itself to the target tasks while representing its choices explicitly for systematic reuse, recombination, and joint optimization. We instantiate this paradigm with Structured Recipe Optimization (SRO), comprising an LLM-based Recipe-Space Designer that constructs the task-adapted recipe space and a Multi-Domain Recipe Optimizer that uses structured trial evidence to guide LLM candidate construction and multi-objective Bayesian trial selection. Extensive experiments show that SRO achieves the highest average score in all evaluated target-model and agent-LLM combinations. In joint post-training across three capability domains and six benchmarks, SRO reaches 41.1 versus 15.4 for the strongest baseline on Qwen3-1.7B with GPT-5.4, and 53.8 versus 40.8 on Qwen3-4B with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Our code is available at https://github.com/RuohLiuq/SRO.

</details>


### [995] [Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18579)
*Yubo Li,Ramayya Krishnan,Rema Padman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究通过行为探测区分智能体决策错误来源，发现主流模型的大多数错误源于"读了但没做对"（推理/组合失败），而非"读错了"（感知/理解失败），且错误随系统能力提升更多地取此形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: System One 类模型单次打分选动作，快而廉价，但出错时无法判断错误根因：是模型误读了智能体所见信息，还是读对了却行动错误？需要行为学方法厘清错误来源。

Method: 在包含模拟环境、客服策略、工具使用、网页导航和编码的冻结智能体决策状态基准上，为每个"下一步动作"问题配以针对同一状态的事实探测，各自独立作答。测试17个快速系统及一个推理模型。

Result: 跨系统结果一致：多数错误动作发生在"读对"之后；系统越准确，此类错误占比越高。这些错误非噪声，跨各类系统聚集于相同状态。在事实可证明决定动作的场景中，即使模型读对全部事实仍组合失败，用代码组合其自身答案可修复失败。真实状态中，缺失的往往不是事实而是下一步子目标。

Conclusion: 智能体决策错误主要不是感知问题而是推理/组合与子目标规划问题，且该错误模式随系统性能提升而更突出，为改进智能体模型指明方向。

Abstract: System One models choose an agent's next action by scoring a supplied set of options in a single pass. This makes them fast and cheap, but when they choose wrongly there is nothing to inspect: did the model misread what the agent has seen, or read it correctly and still act wrongly? We answer behaviorally. On a frozen benchmark of agent decision states from simulated environments, customer-service policies, tool use, web navigation and coding, we pair every next-action question with factual probes about the same state, each answered independently. Across seventeen fast systems and a reasoning model, the answer is consistent: most wrong actions follow correct reading, and the more accurate a system, the more of its errors take this form. These errors are not noise; they gather on the same states across systems of every kind. Where the probed facts provably determine the action, models that read every fact still fail to combine them, and their own answers, composed by code, repair the failure. On real states, what is missing is often not a fact but the next sub-goal.

</details>


### [996] [Compare to Correct: Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment for LLM Test-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18583)
*Cong Hua,Qianqian Xu,Zitai Wang,Zhiyong Yang,Shilong Bao,Linchao Zhang,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PGLA框架，将对路径间成对置信度比较（受Condorcet原则启发）与投票支持通过KL正则目标结合，作为logit调整项修正投票排序错误，在10个基准、7个模型上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有采样式测试时扩展方法仅用答案频率或路径置信度计算候选分数，未显式刻画竞争答案之间的比较关系，导致投票排序可能出错。

Method: 引入支持不同答案的路径间的成对置信度比较，捕捉答案级比较优势；通过KL正则化目标将其与投票支持结合，理论上证明该比较优势等价于对传统投票logits的调整，形成即插即用的PGLA框架。

Result: 在数学推理、知识推理和代码生成等10个挑战性基准上，使用1.7B至32B参数的7个模型验证有效性；外部奖励分数与在线采样评估进一步证明适用性。

Conclusion: 成对比较证据可补偿较弱的投票支持并纠正基于投票的排序错误，PGLA是一种通用且即插即用的改进方案。

Abstract: Sampling-based test-time scaling enhances LLM reasoning by aggregating multiple reasoning paths for the same query. Existing methods use answer frequencies or path confidence to compute candidate scores, which do not explicitly characterize comparisons between competing answers. Inspired by the Condorcet principle in social choice theory, we introduce pairwise confidence comparisons between paths supporting different answers to capture answer-level comparative advantage. We combine this comparative evidence with voting support through a KL-regularized objective. Theoretically, we show that this comparative-advantage is equivalent to the adjustment to the traditional voting logits. In this way, our proposed Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment (PGLA) framework allows comparative evidence to compensate for weaker voting support and correct voting-based ranking errors. Experiments on 10 challenging benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, knowledge reasoning, and code generation with 7 models ranging from 1.7B to 32B parameters speak to the effectiveness of this plug-and-play term. Additional evaluations with external reward scores and online sampling further demonstrate its applicability.

</details>


### [997] [Auditing Future-Memory Use in Point-in-Time Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18602)
*Rongtian Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究检验PIT代理的可回忆未来事实是否影响其证据收集行为。在两模型48个历史公司比较任务中，均未支持预设的"偏向更易回忆公司"的转移，DeepSeek反而呈现稳健的逆向模式，机制未明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PIT代理即便外部证据遵守历史截止点，仍可能回忆截止后的事实。作者想探究这种"记忆可及性"是否会预测代理的证据收集行为，从而区分记忆、搜索分配与最终输出三个环节。

Method: 设计48个历史公司比较任务。用独立闭卷营收探测识别每个模型在回忆不均等任务上"更易回忆"的公司，并在代理运行前固定预测方向。对比真实与匿名公司身份的配对运行，同时保持外部证据PIT有效。对Qwen与DeepSeek分别评估四个分配指标，并做前瞻性复制及多种稳健性检验。

Result: Qwen与DeepSeek均能回忆未来事实，但都未支持预设的偏向转移。Qwen在28个不均等任务上四个分配估计为负，区间跨零。DeepSeek前瞻复制在20个任务上四个指标均呈逆向模式，区间低于零；经公司、配对、未来事实剔除后仍为负，四个max-T校正符号翻转p值均<.05。后续显式未来事实带来小幅远离"给定事实公司"的转移（区间跨零），但最终选择转向该公司。

Conclusion: 记忆可及性并不预测证据收集方向，甚至可能出现逆向效应，其机制尚不明确。建议将记忆可及性、搜索分配与最终输出的评估分开进行，并对外部证据做截止点检查。

Abstract: Point-in-time (PIT) agents can recall post-cutoff facts even when their external evidence respects a historical cutoff. We examine whether this access predicts evidence gathering in 48 historical company-comparison tasks. Independent closed-book revenue probes identify the better-remembered company for each model on tasks with unequal recall, fixing the predicted direction before agent runs. We then compare paired runs with real or anonymized company identities while keeping external evidence PIT-valid. Both Qwen and DeepSeek recalled future facts, but neither supported the prespecified shift toward the better-remembered company. Qwen's four allocation estimates on 28 unequal-recall tasks were negative, with descriptive intervals spanning zero. A prospective DeepSeek replication showed an inverse pattern across all four metrics on 20 such tasks, with intervals below zero. These estimates remained negative after each company, pair, and future-fact omission, and all four post-hoc max-T-adjusted sign-flip p-values were below .05. In a prospectively specified follow-up, explicit future facts produced small estimated shifts away from the supplied-fact company, with intervals spanning zero, while final choices shifted toward it. The mechanism behind the natural inverse pattern remains unresolved. These findings support separate assessments of memory accessibility, search allocation, and final outputs alongside cutoff checks on external evidence.

</details>


### [998] [AgentStripes: An Evidence-Graded Maturity Model for AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18603)
*Nutan Kumar Naik,Vijay Prasad Poudel,Aditya Kumar Saroj,Saurav Samantray,Abhishek Patel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AgentStripes——一个基于证据分级的AI智能体成熟度模型（0-7级条带、12过程域/40能力、3道关卡、E0-E5证据等级），并通过对30个公开Python智能体仓库的探索性评估进行演示（非验证）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准只报告AI智能体在任务集上"能做什么"，却不说明某一发布版本是否具备使其可靠、安全、可观测的工程控制，以及这种保障有多强的证据支持。

Method: 定义0-7条带（stripes）成熟度级别、12个过程域共40项能力、三道关卡（basic、safety、proof，无论得分多高都可限制级别）及E0-E5证据等级。每项适用能力评分0-3并单独给出证据等级，合并为credit，聚合为按严重度加权的分数并转换为受关卡限制的条带。工具收集证据，语言模型评审员按明确标准解释，算术过程确定。模型在主题层面与标准比较（不声称符合性），并给出未执行的验证协议。

Result: 对30个公开Python智能体仓库进行探索性（非确证性）评估，仅用静态证据：静态证据将最终条带上限压至2，26个仓库止于1条带、4个止于2条带，且该区分不可靠——重新评审使22个仓库中4个的最终条带改变（engine、dossier、panel均变化）；而8次仅panel重复（全部为条带1）无一变化。

Conclusion: 参数为专家约定而非基于结果校准；条带尚未被证明能预测可靠性或安全性。

Abstract: Benchmarks report what an Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent can do on a task suite, but not whether one released version has been engineered with the controls that make it reliable, safe and observable, or how strongly that is shown. This paper proposes AgentStripes, an evidence-graded maturity model for AI agents. It defines levels (0 to 7 stripes), process areas (12 areas holding 40 capabilities), three gates (basic, safety, proof) that hold an agent at a level however high its score, and evidence grades E0 to E5. Each applicable capability receives a rating from 0 to 3 and a separate evidence level; these are combined into a credit, aggregated into a severity-weighted score and converted into stripes that the gates limit. Instruments gather evidence, language-model judges interpret it under explicit criteria, and the arithmetic is deterministic. The model is compared with standards at topic level without a claim of conformance, and an unexecuted validation protocol is specified. An empirical evaluation (exploratory, non-confirmatory) of 30 public Python agent repositories, with static evidence only, is a demonstration and not a validation: static evidence caps every final stripe at 2, 26 repositories end at one stripe and 4 at two, and this distinction is unreliable, since re-judging changed the final stripe of 4 of 22 repositories (engine, dossier and panel changed), whereas none of 8 panel-only repeats, all at stripe 1, changed. The parameters are expert conventions without outcome based calibration, and the stripes have not been shown to predict reliability or safety.

</details>


### [999] [Beyond Answer Voting: Fine-Grained Correction of LLM Reasoning through Graph Alignment across Sampled Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18606)
*Haotian Liu,Yingjian Chen,Xiaohang Xu,Lang Huang,Yusuke Iwasawa,Yutaka Matsuo,Irene Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DDRG通过推理图对齐揭示中间主张级分歧，并用验证器支撑的选择性修正替代自一致性投票，在不扩大采样轨迹的前提下提升多步推理准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自一致性（SC）虽能通过投票改善推理，但只对最终答案投票，无法解决中间主张的分歧，可能导致错误未被修正。

Method: DDRG构建有来源依据的主张图，进行图对齐以暴露主张级冲突，将局部冲突交给答案盲验证器；若验证器支持的驳斥能到达多数答案支撑路径，则执行一次聚焦修复，否则退回精确SC投票。

Result: 在五个基准上，原生零样本DDRG相比直接回答在Qwen2.5-7B和Llama3.1-8B上分别提升宏平均准确率8.65和15.83个百分点，并超过CoT、所评估的GoT/GoV问答适配以及SC。

Conclusion: DDRG将局部验证与选择性修正相连接，在不扩大初始候选轨迹库的情况下提升多步推理表现。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly tackle tasks that require multi-step reasoning, where errors in intermediate claims can affect the final answer. Self-consistency (SC) improves reasoning by voting over sampled final answers, but its vote leaves intermediate disagreements unresolved. To address this problem, we introduce DDRG (Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs), a framework for selective correction from a frozen bank of reasoning traces. Our insight is that graph alignment can expose claim-level disagreements and provide correction evidence without expanding the sampled trace bank. DDRG builds source-grounded claim graphs and sends localized conflicts to an answer-blind verifier. A verifier-supported refutation that reaches the majority answer's supporting path triggers one focused repair; otherwise, DDRG returns the exact SC vote. Experimental results across five benchmarks show that native zero-shot DDRG improves macro-average accuracy over direct answering by 8.65 and 15.83 percentage points for Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3.1-8B. It also exceeds CoT, the evaluated GoT and GoV question-answering adaptations, and SC on this macro metric. DDRG links local verification to selective correction without enlarging the initial candidate bank.

</details>


### [1000] [Can an Agent Learn to Predict Its Own Failure? Outcome-Grounded Confidence Calibration in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18614)
*Ashutosh Hathidara*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 校准行动型LLM每步置信度以预测整段任务成败，而非仅当前步正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 控制LLM智能体需判断何时信任、弃权或移交人类，需每步置信度预测整条轨迹的最终成败；但现有RL方法仅针对当前步决策正确性校准，忽略了任务的长程性。

Method: 在GRPO下用同一任务的多条rollout提供成功标签，以proper scoring rule将每步置信度对齐最终结果；在ALFWorld、TextWorld、WebShop的Qwen2.5-7B轨迹上做离线RL，并在实时ALFWorld上做在线RL（含四种校准奖励及格式控制的对照）。

Result: 离线AUROC从接近随机升至0.68–0.85，最自信的前10%步骤成功率约为平均的4.3倍；在线四种校准奖励提升早期AUROC，ECE从0.42降至0.12以下，选择性执行优于未训练与格式控制基线且不损任务成功率。

Conclusion: 提出分离任务深度、难度与尝试级前瞻的评估协议：训练后智能体首步即可识别将失败的任务，而区分同一任务的成功与失败尝试更难；TextWorld出现部分早期信号。

Abstract: Controlling an acting LLM agent means deciding, at each step of a long-horizon task, whether to trust its next action, abstain, or hand off to a human. That decision needs a per-step confidence signal predicting whether the current rollout will eventually succeed. The agent's own self-reported verbalized confidence is the natural candidate, but existing reinforcement learning methods calibrate it against the correctness of a decision at the current step. We propose a method to calibrate it against the eventual outcome of a multi-step episode: under GRPO, the group of rollouts for a task supplies success labels, and a proper scoring rule scores each step's confidence against the realized outcome. In offline RL on recorded trajectories of a Qwen2.5-7B agent in ALFWorld, TextWorld, and WebShop environments, the AUROC of step confidence against episode outcome rises from near chance to 0.68-0.85, and the top-10% of steps the agent is most confident about succeed ~4.3x more often than average. In online RL on the live ALFWorld agent, four calibration rewards improve early-step AUROC, expected calibration error goes from 0.42 to below 0.12, and selective execution improves over both the untrained agent and a format-only RL control, without degrading task success. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that separates episode depth, task difficulty, and attempt-level foresight, which shows where the gain lies: the trained agent recognizes from its first step which tasks it will fail, while telling a succeeding attempt from a failing one at the same task is harder, with some early-window signal emerging on TextWorld.

</details>


### [1001] [Two Routes to Interoceptive Prioritisation: Dissociating Likelihood Precision and Preference Reweighting in Active Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18617)
*St John Grimbly,Nicolas Kuske,Evert A. Boonstra,Charel van Hoof,Rowan Hodson,Benjamin Rosman,Ryan Smith,Mark Solms,Jonathan P. Shock*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在主动推理框架下比较了应对紧迫生理需求的两种机制——提高内感受精度与提高偏好权重——在觅食网格世界中对生存、感知与身体模型学习的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体需在多个竞争性生理需求间排序；主动推理中可通过提升需求信息的精度或提升缓解该需求结果的偏好来响应紧迫需求，但二者作用差异尚不清楚。

Method: 在三项致命需求的觅食网格世界中，分别及联合施加精度提升与偏好重加权两种干预，考察其对生存率、感知及所学身体模型的影响，并在另外72个布局上做实验。

Result: 精度提升锐化内感受后验并改善生存；偏好重加权使身体状态远离致命边界，并改变学习状态分布，导致所学模型覆盖的需求水平更少、整体质量更低，但在访问到的水平上略高。72个布局的实验未能证实困难布局上的偏好收益预测，但两种干预均提升平均生存率且交互为正。

Conclusion: 仅凭生存率无法完整刻画模型如何优先处理需求并学习身体表征，需同时考虑感知与模型质量等指标。

Abstract: An embodied agent must prioritise among competing bodily needs. In active inference, it can respond to an urgent need by increasing the precision of information about that need or by increasing its preference for outcomes that relieve it. We compare these two interventions, separately and together, in a foraging gridworld with three lethal needs, and ask how each changes survival, perception and the body model the agent learns. Precision sharpens interoceptive posteriors and improves survival. Preference reweighting keeps bodily states further from their lethal boundaries and changes the states from which the agent learns, so its learned model covers fewer need levels, with lower quality across all levels but slightly higher quality on the levels it visits. An experiment on 72 further layouts does not establish the predicted preference benefit on difficult layouts, but both interventions improve average survival there and their interaction is positive. Survival alone therefore gives an incomplete account of how a model prioritises needs and learns about its body.

</details>


### [1002] [To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18638)
*Fabian Gröger,Petar Damjanović,Maria Brbić*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 COMPASS，一种在对齐或合并前评估模型对兼容性的诊断指标，将兼容性分解为 k-NN 重叠（pair-specific ease）与范式级上限两轴，在跨模态对齐与模型合并任务上与下游成功率高度相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合预训练模型（视觉编码器与语言模型对齐、微调检查点合并）是常见策略，但兼容性通常只能在对齐或合并完成后才知道，寻找兼容模型对需要昂贵的经验搜索。

Method: 基于"表示收敛在局部邻域层面最稳健"的观察，COMPASS 将兼容性分解为两个低成本可算的轴：pair-specific ease（两编码器间的 k-NN 重叠）与 paradigm-level ceiling（训练范式允许的最大重叠）。两轴共同给出候选模型对的排序，并指导四种行动：优先、追加算力、更换预训练范式、或降低优先级。

Result: 在 72 组跨模态对齐实验与 392 组 task-arithmetic 模型合并上验证，兼容性估计与下游成功强相关，跨模态对齐平均 Pearson 相关系数 0.91，模型合并为 0.70。

Conclusion: COMPASS 可在对齐或合并前低成本预判模型对兼容性并指导资源分配，为构建组合式 AI 系统提供有效诊断工具。

Abstract: Combining pretrained models is a common strategy for building AI systems, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model or merging fine-tuned checkpoints. However, finding compatible pairs typically requires costly empirical search, as compatibility is known only after alignment or merging. We propose COMPASS (COMPatibility ASsessment Score), a theoretically motivated diagnostic that estimates whether a model pair will be compatible prior to alignment or merging. Building on the observation that representational convergence is most robust at the level of local neighborhoods, COMPASS decomposes model compatibility into two cheap-to-compute axes: a pair-specific ease, defined as the $k$-NN overlap between the two encoders, and a paradigm-level ceiling, capturing the maximum overlap their training paradigms allow. Together, these two axes provide a ranking of candidate model pairs and prescribe how to act on each pair: (i) prioritize pairs that already agree and whose paradigms are compatible, (ii) invest additional compute on pairs with compatible paradigms but low initial agreement, (iii) switch the pretraining paradigm when it cannot support sufficient agreement, or (iv) deprioritize pairs that score poorly on both axes. We apply COMPASS to $72$ cross-modal alignment experiments and $392$ task-arithmetic model merges and show that compatibility estimates by COMPASS strongly correlate with downstream success, achieving average Pearson correlation of $0.91$ on cross-modal alignment tasks and $0.70$ on model merging.

</details>


### [1003] [Knowing the User Is Not Knowing What We Established: Grounding Awareness in Personal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18684)
*Jiajun Chen,Xinyue Chen,Yicheng Jiang,Hua Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"Grounding Awareness"概念，指出智能体记忆用户偏好不等于知道双方共同确立的约定，并构建基准测试及轻量级扩展Grounding Layer来改善智能体行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个人智能体记忆研究主要聚焦于学习用户知道、偏好和想要什么，但"了解用户"并不等于了解用户与智能体共同确立的约定。助手提出的建议不应仅因被记住就成为被授权的指令，这一关键区别被忽视。

Method: 引入Grounding Awareness概念，即区分已接受、未确认、被修改和限定范围的约定并据此选择行动的能力。开发受控基准测试，检验智能体能否区分用户已接受与未接受的提议，以及是否仅在适当场景应用已接受的约定。追踪记忆写入、检索和行动选择中的失败。提出Grounding Layer——一种轻量、免训练的扩展，显式追踪grounding状态并检查重要行动。

Result: 在多个智能体和记忆系统上发现：强记忆性能并不能保证Grounding Awareness；提供更完整的用户信息反而可能增加对未确认提议的执行；持久记忆会导致智能体将这些提议当作真实用户指令处理。

Conclusion: 记忆能力与Grounding Awareness可以脱节。Grounding Layer在不修改模型或记忆系统的前提下，显著改善了智能体行为，为个人智能体的安全可靠部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Personal-agent memory has largely focused on learning what users know, prefer, and want. However, knowing the user does not necessarily mean knowing what the user and the agent have established together. An assistant's proposal should not become an authorized instruction merely because it is remembered. We introduce Grounding Awareness, the ability to distinguish accepted, unacknowledged, revised, and scoped arrangements when selecting actions. We develop a controlled benchmark to test whether agents can tell the difference between proposals users have accepted and those they have not, and whether they apply accepted arrangements only where appropriate. Across multiple agents and memory systems, we find that strong memory performance does not ensure Grounding Awareness. More surprisingly, providing more complete user information can increase execution of unacknowledged proposals, while persistent memory can cause agents to treat these proposals as if they were user instructions. We trace these failures through memory writing, retrieval, and action selection. Finally, we introduce Grounding Layer, a lightweight, training-free extension that explicitly tracks grounding status and checks consequential actions, substantially improving agent behavior without modifying models or memory systems.

</details>


### [1004] [Unlocking Token Rewards via Training-Free Reward Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18704)
*Sitong Wu,Haoru Tan,Bin Xia,Xichen Zhang,Jingyao Li,Shaofeng Zhang,Xiaojuan Qi,Bei Yu,Jiaya Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出P2T，一种无需训练的方法，从已有深度奖励模型中直接提取token级奖励信号。通过基于梯度的估计器，用单次前向和反向传播近似token影响，实现精确信用分配，显著提升LLM推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过程奖励模型（PRM）提供宏观过程奖励，但缺少token级信用分配信号；而计算每个token的影响需要N次前向传播，代价过高，难以直接用于强化学习。

Method: 核心思想是将过程奖励归因到每个token：将token替换为语义空token时的奖励变化定义为其影响。采用一阶泰勒近似，将影响简化为token嵌入与空token嵌入之差同奖励梯度的内积，仅需一次前向和反向传播即可获得token级奖励，无需额外训练奖励模型。

Result: 在挑战性推理基准上，P2T显著提升策略优化效率与推理泛化能力：Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct在MathVista上比结果奖励高4.9%；Qwen2.5-Math-7B在AIME24上高11.5%。

Conclusion: P2T是一种高效、无需训练的token级奖励提取方法，通过梯度估计实现精确信用分配，有效增强LLM推理能力，代码将开源。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose an extremely efficient, training-free method to extract token-level reward signals directly from an existing deep reward model. Our core idea is to attribute the overall process reward to individual tokens by estimating each token's influence. This influence is defined as the change in the final macroscopic reward (e.g., the process reward) when a token is replaced with a semantically null token. Naively calculating this influence is computationally infeasible, requiring N forward passes through the PRM for an N-token sequence. We overcome this bottleneck by proposing a highly efficient gradient-based estimator. Specifically, we use a first-order Taylor approximation, which simplifies the influence calculation to the inner product of the difference between the token embedding and the null token embedding, and the gradient of the reward with respect to the token embedding. This requires only a single forward and backward pass. The resulting token-level rewards enable standard RL algorithms to perform precise credit assignment without requiring additional reward model training. Experiments on challenging reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method substantially improves policy optimization efficiency and enhances the generalization of LLM reasoning capabilities. Our P2T outperforms the outcome reward by +4.9% on MathVista for Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, and +11.5% on AIME24 for Qwen2.5-Math-7B. The code will be released via https://github.com/stonewst/P2T.

</details>


### [1005] [Beyond the Verdict: Agentic Code Judging with Verifiable Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18760)
*Zheye Deng,Sha Li,Changlong Yu,Xin Liu,Qin Lu,Priyanka Nigam,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出用模型仅凭题面与源码对竞赛编程候选程序进行判定与诊断（生成反例作为可核查证据），构建USACO-JUDGE评测集并训练35B MoE智能体验证器ARBITER，显著提升反例成功率与判定准确率，并在代码选择、精化及IOI案例中超过基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时扩展需要验证器指导候选解选择与修订，但竞赛编程官方评测仅在有限提交预算下给出裁决，不提供失败原因或反例；需要在不消耗官方提交的情况下提供信息丰富的反馈。

Method: 将任务定义为：仅用题面与源代码判定候选程序并诊断错误，生成反例作为可核查证据；构建来自USACO 2026的USACO-JUDGE数据集；在通用执行沙箱中用强化学习训练35B MoE智能体验证器ARBITER。

Result: 错误程序反例成功率从40.61%提升到62.67%；USACO-JUDGE平均二元判定准确率从71.41%提升到87.41%，接近前沿验证性能；在代码选择与精化上优于基线；IOI 2026案例中，ARBITER引导的精化使GPT-OSS-120B在官方提交限制下期望得分超过金牌阈值。

Conclusion: ARBITER表明通过强化学习训练智能体验证器可在无官方提交条件下有效判定和诊断竞赛程序，并提供可核查反例，提升选择与精化表现，接近前沿验证水平。

Abstract: Test-time scaling for large language models (LLMs) can involve generating multiple candidate solutions for selection or revising an earlier attempt. To guide selection and revision, we need a verifier that can estimate candidate correctness and provide evidence of failure. In competitive programming, however, official judging systems provide authoritative verdicts under finite submission budgets, without revealing failure explanations or failing inputs. To provide informative feedback without consuming official submissions, we formulate a task in which a model judges and diagnoses a candidate program using only the problem statement and source code, with generated counterexamples serving as checkable evidence. To evaluate this task, we build USACO-JUDGE from the USACO 2026 contests, using accepted and unaccepted programs written by human experts and multiple LLMs. We then train ARBITER, a 35B mixture-of-experts (MoE) agentic verifier, with reinforcement learning in a generic execution sandbox. Training raises counterexample success on incorrect programs from 40.61% to 62.67% and mean binary verdict accuracy on USACO-JUDGE from 71.41% to 87.41%, approaching frontier verification performance. Beyond verification, ARBITER outperforms baselines in both code selection and refinement. In an IOI 2026 case study, ARBITER-guided refinement raises GPT-OSS-120B's expected score above the gold-medal threshold under the official submission limit.

</details>


### [1006] [Jeva: System One Models from First Principles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18773)
*Qi Li,Xinchao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Jeva：一种决策原生架构，通过请求-选项分离编码、对称聚合与独立覆盖估计，联合满足四种结构需求，兼顾类型化决策、空值检测、置换不变、可扩展与可缓存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前从序列化文本预测答案的系统一模型未尊重决策问题结构，忽视四项要求：空值感知、置换不变、选项可扩展、可缓存。

Method: 共享编码器分别表示请求与每个选项；紧凑决策栈仅针对不可变选项内存细化请求状态；对称聚合实现置换等变概率；共享打分适配可变候选集；独立覆盖估计区分答案缺失与候选竞争；请求无关的选项表示与层投影支持跨请求复用。

Result: 在评测中兼具强类型化决策性能与近乎完美的空值检测，任意测试置换下无决策翻转；可扩展至数千候选，并通过跨请求复用显著降低延迟且不改变决策。

Conclusion: Jeva统一Choice、Noul与Score输出，验证了决策原生架构在结构需求上的联合有效性。

Abstract: System one models enable direct, low-latency decision-making. Yet recent practice of predicting an answer from serialized text does not, by itself, respect the structure of a decision problem. We argue that current designs underemphasize four important structural requirements. (i) null-aware: Models should distinguish answer absence from uncertainty among candidates; (ii) permutation-invariant: Reordering alternatives should not change the decision; (iii) option-scalable: Growing candidate sets should not require redefining the output space; (iv) cacheable: Request-independent computation over recurring alternatives should be reusable across requests. We introduce Jeva, a decision-native architecture that addresses these requirements jointly. A shared encoder independently represents the request and each option, while a compact decision stack refines only the request state against immutable option memory. Symmetric aggregation yields permutation-equivariant probabilities; shared scoring accommodates variable-size candidate sets. A separate coverage estimate distinguishes answer absence from candidate competition, enabling explicit null outcomes. Request-independent option representations and layer projections support reuse across newly assembled sets. These mechanisms unify Choice, Noul, and Score outputs. Across evaluations, Jeva combines strong typed-decision performance with near-perfect null detection and no decision flips under any tested permutations. It scales to thousands of candidates and substantially reduces latency through cross-request reuse without changing decisions.

</details>


### [1007] [BLADE: Auditing Information Use for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18780)
*Xiaoguang Guo,Yaohao Long,Chuxu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BLADE：一种无需训练的框架，通过审计信息使用（而非仅追踪来源）来定位多智能体系统中的失败责任，在Who&When数据集上取得最优步骤准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体协作使失败更难诊断：一个Agent可能误读正确结果，其他Agent却将错误传递下去。现有方法只追踪信息依赖来源，但"知道信息来自哪里"不等于"知道哪里出错"。

Method: BLADE（Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence）为免训练框架。使用Jev进行结构化概率判断，利用依赖概率选出相关源-决策交接点进行审计；在交接点检验接收决策是否忠实且符合任务要求地使用来源，从而区分错误引入、传播与修复；最终结合所有执行步骤形成全局诊断。

Result: 在五个Who&When及Who&When Pro子集、1,228个失败运行上，无需参考答案，在共享Jev决策接口下于八种策略中取得最佳或并列最佳步骤准确率，较All-at-once提升2.2–11.1个百分点。

Conclusion: 将责任证据显式化，有助于构建更可解释、更可靠的智能体系统。

Abstract: Large language model multi-agent systems extend individual agents' capabilities through collaboration across specialized roles, tools, and workflows. Yet collaboration makes failures harder to diagnose: one agent may misinterpret a correct result while others carry the mistake forward. Failure attribution therefore seeks to identify the responsible agent and decisive error step. Recent methods trace dependencies, but knowing where information came from is not the same as knowing where it went wrong. We introduce BLADE (Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence), a training-free framework that moves beyond tracing information to auditing its use. Using Jev for structured probabilistic judgments, BLADE uses dependency probabilities to select relevant source-decision handoffs for auditing. At these handoffs, it examines whether receiving decisions use their sources faithfully and within task requirements, distinguishing error introduction, propagation, and repair. These findings inform a global diagnosis that considers all execution steps. Without reference answers, BLADE achieves the best or tied-best step accuracy among eight strategies under a shared Jev decision interface on 1,228 failed runs across five Who&When and Who&When Pro subsets, outperforming All-at-once by 2.2-11.1 percentage points. Making responsibility evidence explicit offers a path toward more interpretable and reliable agentic systems.

</details>


### [1008] [Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18784)
*Yuchen Lu,Julian McAuley,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CarryOn，一种面向对象上下文运行时，以可复用任务对象组织长时程智能体的续接上下文，在 OSWorld 2.0 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上分别提升 5.8%/7.0% 且降低 token 51.9%/22.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体在持久任务状态中累积进展，却反复处理描述“如何取得进展”的交互历史，效率低下。核心问题：能否围绕可复用进展而非产生它的历史来组织长时程上下文。

Method: CarryOn 不把压缩历史或重构的进展叙述作为续接主依据，而是由续接载体（continuation carriers）、补充执行上下文和近期交互的实时尾部构成上下文视图。关键挑战是历史被淘汰后如何保持该可复用基础有效：CarryOn 跨折叠维护载体记录，结合绑定证据与环境检查修订受影响记录，同时保留不受影响记录并联合更新执行上下文，避免每次折叠重构完整表示。

Result: 在 OSWorld 2.0 和 BrowseComp-Plus 上分别获得 5.8% 与 7.0% 的性能提升，总 token 使用量分别降低 51.9% 与 22.9%。

Conclusion: 以可复用任务对象为中心的上下文组织方式，能在提升任务表现的同时显著减少 token 消耗，为长时程智能体提供了一种比历史压缩更高效的续接范式。

Abstract: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon

</details>


### [1009] [Self-Evolving Agent Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18813)
*Chuyang Wei,Haoxiang Guan,Minghang Zhu,Kexin Zhou,Jiyan He,Xiren Zhou,Huanhuan Chen,Yifei Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将"Harness self-evolution / Harness RSI"形式化为在固定模型权重下、由反馈驱动并跨运行持久化修订智能体软件支架（提示、记忆、工作流、可执行组件）的过程，并给出理论分析与66页综述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型权重之外，智能体行为大量由软件支架决定；支架可持续自我修订，但其可靠性、泛化性、持久化与组织/安全影响缺乏统一形式化与分析框架。

Method: 将修订过程分解为更新目标、提议机制与准入机制；区分解释性状态与工具/代码、仓库级控制逻辑、插件组合；用进化优化刻画搜索，用continual PAC-learning分析可靠性。

Result: 在显式假设下得到期望泛化界、基于历史回归预算的保留界，以及使用新鲜独立验证数据的高概率准入规则；并结合已有工作案例说明模型-支架协同设计、分布式执行与插件复用。

Conclusion: 可靠的Harness RSI部署需要持续验证，因为任务分布与评估器会变化；学习、运行时权限和高影响动作需独立保障。论文提供66页综合讨论、算法、评估与应用影响，并提供持续更新的代码与材料。

Abstract: Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.

</details>


### [1010] [Read the Room Before Your Model Generates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18820)
*Muyao Kong,Zhihao Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Scenario-Actor框架，从Transformer隐状态中提取场景相关结构，用场景嵌入几何表示来决定解码温度，实现可解释的自适应温度选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM温度选择方法多为固定启发式全局设置或上下文/Token级别校准，缺乏对交际场景的可几何解释表示。

Method: Scenario-Actor从Transformer隐状态提取场景相关结构，通过场景嵌入（交际情境的结构化几何表示）确定解码温度，从而自适应调节输出随机性。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，交互式社交场景中目标完成表现强，开放式指令遵循提升显著，多轮对话性能与多个基线相当。

Conclusion: 场景感知的、几何可解释的温度选择能有效提升LLM在多种交互任务中的表现，为解码随机性控制提供了新思路。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generally rely on sampling temperature to regulate the amount of randomness in their outputs. Mainstream methods for selecting temperature typically involve fixed, heuristic global settings and context or token-level calibration, rather than a geometrically interpretable representation of the communicative scenario. In this work, we introduce a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework, the \textbf{Scenario-Actor}, which adapts decoding to the inferred situational characteristics. Scenario-Actor extracts scenario-relevant structures from Transformer hidden states and determines the temperature from scenario embedding, a structured geometric representation of the communicative setting. Empirical results show that on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Scenario-Actor achieves strong goal-completion performance in interactive social scenarios, significant gains on open-ended instruction following, and competitive performance on multi-turn conversation compared to multiple baselines.

</details>


### [1011] [Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18842)
*Hai Zhou,Fan Yang,Zeyi Chen,Lejun Zhang,Chenyang Fu,Jianping Li,Jiayi Zhu,Xianyang Liu,Yingxuan Yang,Lili Meng,Lu Wang,Xinyang Han,Jiankai Sun,Weirui Ye,Guanchu Wang,Wanhua Li,Ming Zhou,Boyi Li,Ming Jin,Kun Shao,Muhao Chen,Guang Chen,Lei Ma,Joey Tianyi Zhou,Costas Spanos,Xia Hu,Mac Schwager,Weinan Zhang,Qian Feng,Shangding Gu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文综述了物理递归自我改进（Physical RSI），提出L0-L5框架区分能力级与元级、任务内与跨任务更新，并指出当前文献尚未实现真正意义上的Physical RSI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人自主性提升，但改进仍主要依赖人类。研究Physical RSI旨在让物理经验驱动机器人在能力与改进程序上实现持久更新，从而跨任务更有效，同时面临噪声观测、连续动力学、高成本试验和不可逆后果等挑战。

Method: 提出L0-L5框架，将能力级更新与元级更新、任务内增益与跨任务增益加以区分，仅将L5定义为经独立验证的递归增益；并围绕执行环境适配与模型训练方法，以及安全与控制机制进行综述分析。

Result: 分析表明，尽管自我改进研究已有显著进展，但现有文献尚未展示符合该框架定义的Physical RSI。

Conclusion: 指出可靠反馈、因果归因、安全保持和基准测试等研究重点，勾勒出机器人自主改进学习方式并保证安全的发展路径。

Abstract: Robots are increasingly autonomous in task execution, yet their improvement remains largely human-driven. This study investigates Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (Physical RSI), in which physical experience guides lasting updates to both a robot's capabilities and its improvement procedure, making subsequent improvement more effective across tasks. Physical RSI faces challenges from noisy observations, continuous dynamics, costly trials, and irreversible consequences. We present an L0-L5 framework that differentiates capability-level from meta-level updates and within-task from across-task gains, reserving L5 for independently verified recursive gain. We study existing methods around harness adaptation and model training, alongside safety and control mechanisms that govern execution and successive updates. Our analysis reveals that, despite substantial progress in self-improvement, the surveyed literature does not yet demonstrate Physical RSI as defined by our framework. We identify research priorities in reliable feedback, causal attribution, safety preservation, and benchmarking, outlining a path toward robots that autonomously improve how they learn while ensuring safety. The GitHub repository for Physical RSI is available at https://github.com/SAIL-Research-Lab/Physical-RSI.

</details>


### [1012] [MFG: Multi-turn Feedback Guided Molecular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18851)
*Trieu Nguyen,Frazier N. Baker,Ruoxi Gao,Daniel Adu-Ampratwum,Xia Ning*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MFG强化学习框架，训练LLM利用多轮反馈逐步优化分子，在十个多目标任务上取得最高成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多目标分子优化需要迭代修改，但现有LLM方法未被显式训练利用反馈，且多聚焦单轮优化。

Method: MFG引入反馈向量（涵盖性质改进与源分子相似度）和反馈对齐的奖励函数，在GeLLM^3O上训练以促进跨轮渐进改进。

Result: 在十个多目标优化任务上，GeLLM^3O-MFG取得最高相似度约束成功率81.50%，优于基线GeLLM^3O的70.81%。

Conclusion: 显式利用多轮反馈训练LLM能有效提升多目标分子优化性能。

Abstract: Multi-objective molecular optimization is a critical process in drug discovery that aims to modify a given molecule to simultaneously improve multiple properties while maintaining a similar overall structure. This process often requires iterative modifications guided by computational or experimental feedback. Recent large language model (LLM)-based methods have begun to explore this iterative approach; however, these methods are not explicitly trained to leverage such feedback, while existing approaches primarily focus on single-turn molecular optimization. To address this gap, we introduce Multi-turn Feedback Guided (MFG) molecular optimization, a reinforcement learning framework that trains an LLM to progressively optimize molecules using feedback from previous turns.
