MFG introduces a feedback vector capturing both property improvements and source molecule similarity, alongside a feedback-aligned reward function that promotes progressive improvement across turns. We apply MFG over $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$, a state-of-the-art LLM model for multi-objective molecular optimization, evaluate $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ on ten multi-objective molecular optimization tasks. The results demonstrate that $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ achieves the highest average similarity-constrained success rate ($81.50%$), outperforming the base model $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$ ($70.81%$).

</details>


### [1013] [AesCode: Aesthetic Code Generation with Decoupled Cross-Modal Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18860)
*Xin Gao,Yifan Yang,Xin Li,Pan Wang,Yan Li,Muzhao Tian,Mingxi Cheng,Bei Liu,Kai Qiu,Qi Dai,Dong Chen,Yue Dong,Leandros Tassiulas,Rex Ying,Ji Li,Chong Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AesCode通过将图像作为美学引导，结合设计图与跨模态奖励，用强化学习提升代码生成视觉制品的空间规划、美学与正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码模型生成幻灯片/海报等视觉制品时无法感知布局与色彩在画布上的最终效果，限制空间规划与美学；图像生成器虽有视觉设计能力但内容易误渲染，不可靠。

Method: 以设计图（design graph）表征目标画布并支持属性归因；从图中导出跨模态奖励：确定性验证器评估可解析属性，VLM评审用样本特定的Visual Graph Rubric评估不可解析属性；用带逐通道归一化的强化学习优化解耦奖励。

Result: 构建分别评估可验证正确性与视觉质量的基准，视觉分与人类判断高度一致；参考图像显著提升现有模型生成代码的视觉质量；AesCode-8B/32B相比同规模Qwen3-VL基线视觉质量提升31.1/22.4个百分点，接近GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8等闭源前沿模型。

Conclusion: AesCode证明将参考图像同时作为模型输入与视觉奖励来源可有效提升代码生成的视觉与正确性，达到与闭源前沿模型相当的水平。

Abstract: Generating information-rich visual artifacts such as slides, posters, and dashboards as code is appealing because the outputs are structured, editable, and verifiable. Yet code models cannot see how their choices of layout and color come together on the canvas, often limiting spatial planning and aesthetic quality. Image generators excel at visual design but can misrender requested content, making their outputs unreliable targets for direct reproduction. We therefore introduce AesCode, which generates code grounded in the content prompt while using an image generated from the same prompt as an aesthetic guidance. To do so, AesCode represents the target as a design graph that describes the whole canvas and makes each property attributable. From this graph, we derive complementary cross-modal rewards: deterministic verifiers score properties parsable from code and rendering, while a VLM judge assesses the non-parsable ones with a sample-specific Visual Graph Rubric (VGR) tied to graph elements and relations. We optimize these decoupled rewards through reinforcement learning with per-channel normalization to jointly improve spatial planning, aesthetic quality, and verifiable correctness. To evaluate this setting, we build a benchmark that scores verifiable correctness and visual quality separately, with visual scores highly consistent with human judgments. We find that reference images substantially improve the visual quality of code generated by existing models, and ablations show that AesCode benefits from references both as model input and as a source of visual rewards. Relative to same-scale Qwen3-VL baselines given the same references, AesCode-8B and AesCode-32B improve visual quality by 31.1 and 22.4 percentage points, reaching scores comparable to those of closed-source frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [1014] [Bias Robustness of Genetic Multi-Criteria Sorting versus Learned Rankers under Proxy Skew and Label Contamination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14015)
*Vladyslav Shevchuk,Carlos Uziel Pérez Malla,Philipp Wissgott*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 比较无标签遗传多准则排序与有标签LTR模型在代理偏移与标签污染下的表现，发现遗传方法偏置更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LTR模型在特征或训练标签中出现的非指定信号会影响排序，需要评估能否拒绝这些非指定代理或标签污染物。

Method: 在MSLR-WEB10K、Baidu-ULTR、WANDS、Expedia上用两种协议对比无标签遗传多准则排序（Pikaia策略变体，基于准则向量C重排固定候选池）与有标签LTR（LightGBM、XGBoost、RankSVM）；主研究为代理偏移（标签干净但校准代理P作为特征），辅研究为标签污染（训练标签混入污染物B）。

Result: 代理偏移中，遗传AI的Spearman秩-代理相关性低于LTR（如WANDS约0.15-0.16 vs 0.59-0.87），并在偏差-效用前沿上评估干净nDCG@10；标签污染中，遗传方法因不用标签而偏差和效用曲线保持平坦，而LightGBM与XGBoost随污染上升秩-B相关性增加（WANDS/Baidu的OLS bias_slope约0.58-0.65）。

Conclusion: 当需拒绝非指定代理或标签污染物时，遗传排序可作为在固定候选池上优化声明属性的架构选择。

Abstract: Learning-to-rank (LTR) models can align rankings with undesignated signals when those signals appear as features or leak into training labels. We compare label-free genetic multi-criteria sorting (open Pikaia strategy variants), which reranks fixed candidate pools using an explicit criteria vector C, to label-trained LTR (LightGBM, XGBoost, RankSVM) under two controlled protocols on MSLR-WEB10K, Baidu-ULTR, WANDS, and Expedia. In the main proxy-skew study, labels remain clean while a calibrated proxy P is available as a feature: Genetic AI rankings show lower Spearman rank-proxy correlation than the LTR peers (e.g. about 0.15-0.16 vs. 0.59-0.87 on WANDS), with both families evaluated jointly on clean nDCG@10 on a bias-utility frontier. In a supporting label-contamination study, training labels are mixed with contaminant B: because Genetic AI methods do not use labels, their bias and utility curves stay flat, whereas LightGBM and XGBoost increase rank-B correlation as contamination rises (OLS bias_slope about 0.58-0.65 on WANDS/Baidu). The results support genetic sorting as an architectural option for optimizing declared attributes on a fixed pool when undesignated proxies or label contaminants must be refused.

</details>


### [1015] [CoFlu-Brain: An fMRI Connectivity Foundation Model with Cofluctuation-Based Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15450)
*Ziteng Sui,Junfeng Xia,Wenhao Ye,Mo Wang,Quanying Liu*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: CoFlu-Brain将fMRI的帧级共波动观测组织成多个保留/丢弃视图，学习跨视图可复现的连通结构并预测丢弃视图表征，用SIGReg防表征坍缩；预训练后经冻结编码器线性探测，在多任务上迁移性强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统FC方法用单个Pearson相关矩阵代表一次扫描，忽略了区域交互的帧级变化，也未利用有限BOLD帧带来的统计估计特性。

Method: CoFlu-Brain将逐帧共波动观测组织为多个保留视图与丢弃视图，每个视图汇总为FC矩阵；模型学习在保留视图间可复现的连通结构，并预测对应丢弃视图的表征，同时采用LeJEPA的SIGReg避免表征坍缩。在8个数据集组、13444名被试上预训练。

Result: 在7个数据集的7个分类任务和2个年龄预测任务上以冻结编码器线性探测评估，在多数任务上优于所评估的已发布模型；随机帧划分提升了整体迁移，完整目标取得最佳总体性能。

Conclusion: 帧级共波动视图学习可有效提升fMRI表征的跨人群、发育与临床任务迁移能力，代码已公开。

Abstract: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) commonly characterizes large-scale brain organization through functional connectivity (FC). However, an observed FC matrix is not a fixed brain graph but a statistical estimate determined by the finite BOLD frames used to compute it. Conventional FC-based approaches typically represent each scan with a single Pearson-correlation matrix, leaving frame-resolved variations in regional interactions unexploited. To address this limitation, we introduce CoFlu-Brain, which organizes framewise cofluctuation observations into multiple retained and dropped views, each summarized as an FC matrix. The model learns connectivity structure reproducible across retained views and predicts the representations of the corresponding dropped views, while adopting SIGReg from LeJEPA to prevent representation collapse. We pretrained CoFlu-Brain on 13,444 subjects from eight dataset groups and evaluated its representations via frozen-encoder linear probing on seven classification and two age-prediction tasks across seven datasets. CoFlu-Brain showed strong transfer across demographic, developmental, and clinical prediction tasks, outperforming the evaluated released models on most tasks. Random frame partitioning improved aggregate transfer, while the complete objective achieved the strongest overall performance. Code is available.

</details>


### [1016] [Where Polanyi Meets Galois: Tacit Knowing as an Algebro-Deterministic Operation, Toward Re-rooting AI-Generated Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16102)
*Hiroyuki Chuma,Kanji Otsuka,Yoichi Sato,Kodo Yamauchi*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该论文提出缄默知识（tacit knowing）应被建模为一种记忆基底（VaCoAl）的运行机制，而非某种内容；通过DAG的信息审计与价值评估互补性来解释显隐知识连续性与可验证预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点将缄默知识视为一种内容类型，难以区分显性与隐性知识；论文希望用一个形式化记忆模型统一解释Polanyi、Nonaka等人的缄默知识理论，并诊断AI解题"缺少后续研究"的现象。

Method: 采用VaCoAl（GF(2)上代数确定性XOR-and-shift超维记忆），以CASRAM和PyVaCoAl实现；用DAG表示知识，对比Rescue模式（修复碰撞、可审计）与Don't Care模式（容忍碰撞、产生路径积分置信CR₂）；结合LLM生成与人类价值判断构建师徒传递图和再植根机制。

Result: 揭示了审计-评估互补性，区分了偶然性缄默与机制性缄默；将Polanyi的from-to结构对应非交换绑定，Collins三种缄默知识变为分层结构，并提出对Terence Tao观察（AI解题缺乏后续）的诊断：无根显性知识。

Conclusion: 缄默知识是记忆基底的运行机制而非内容，可通过VaCoAl/PyVaCoAl形式化解释，并给出可检验预测；价值判断这一角色无法被AI取代。

Abstract: We argue that tacit knowing is better modelled as an operating regime of one memory substrate than as a kind of content. The substrate is VaCoAl, an algebro-deterministic XOR-and-shift hyperdimensional memory over GF(2), realized as CASRAM (commercial SRAM-CAM) and PyVaCoAl (DRAM-CAM).In VaCoAl/PyVaCoAl a directed acyclic graph (DAG) reads two ways. Repairing every collision (Rescue mode) makes the trace exactly auditable but ranks no path higher; tolerating collisions (Don't Care mode) yields a path-integrated confidence, CR$_2$, that silently favours direct routes. This audit-valuation complementarity is a formal counterpart of Polanyi's claim that tacit and explicit knowledge are not sharply divided. It separates contingent tacitness, which a new query brings out (AlphaGo's game tree), from regime-bound tacitness, statable only in a regime where it is gone (AlphaGo's hunches). (1) Polanyi's from-to structure reads as non-commutative binding, the Identikit as role-filler composition, recognition as majority-vote coincidence. (2) Explicating the valuation destroys it, as attending to his fingers can make Polanyi's pianist falter, yet a closed-form law states it. Polanyi, Nonaka, Tsoukas and Collins each capture part of this but narrowly; even Nonaka and von Krogh's continuum cannot tell contingent from regime-bound tacitness. (3) Collins's three tacit knowledges become strata, one outside the substrate. (4) Our mentor-student DAG is a tacit-transmission graph. (5) Terence Tao's remark that AI-solved problems spawn few follow-ups is diagnosed as rootless explicit knowledge: checkable results whose route no one can follow and that no one yet understands well enough to extend, teach or judge. To re-root them, LLMs generate, VaCoAl/PyVaCoAl keeps an auditable trace with its confidence, and people value, a role virtue epistemology shows cannot be offloaded. Testable predictions follow.

</details>


### [1017] [CIPHEUR: LLM-Guided Structural Search Control for Conflict-Graph Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16158)
*Yuqing Cheng,Yan Jia,Yanjie Song,Xiaolu Liu,Lining Xing,Feng Yao*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: CIPHEUR：LLM引导的冲突图搜索框架，通过结构化干预单元(SIU)连接冲突证据与协调干预/恢复，离线合成策略+在线上下文决策，在卫星地面调度任务上超越11种配置及CHILS基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冲突图搜索即使算子有效仍可能停滞，原因是干预未解决阻塞进展的冲突；且破坏性干预的价值可能需要后续搜索才能显现，故需将冲突证据与协调干预、恢复过程相连。

Method: 提出CIPHEUR，基于LLM的框架，核心为结构化干预单元(SIU)共享控制接口，支持离线合成可执行策略与在线上下文决策；异步在线控制维持推理期间的原生搜索，所有策略保持原目标与可行性约束。

Result: 在8个卫星-地面调度冲突视图、每视图5次运行、900秒评估上限下，CIPHEUR-online在11种配置中均值目标最高，调度接触时长较贪心基线GWMIN提升14.84%；在8个视图中7个超过最强外部单视图均值，40次配对运行全部优于CHILS；360→900秒归一化目标提升是两程序化控制器的1.50-1.86倍；冻结一次性LLM控制器亦优于CHILS且无需运行时模型调用。

Conclusion: 结构化搜索控制可将LLM设计知识与上下文推理转化为更优解质量与持续搜索进展。

Abstract: Conflict-graph search can stagnate despite effective operators when interventions fail to address the conflicts blocking progress. A disruptive intervention may also require further search before its value emerges. We propose CIPHEUR, a large language model (LLM)-guided framework that connects conflict evidence to coordinated intervention and recovery through Structured Intervention Units (SIUs). The shared control interface supports offline synthesis of executable policies and online contextual decisions. Asynchronous online control sustains native search during inference, while all policies preserve the original objective and feasibility constraints. Across eight satellite-ground scheduling conflict views with five runs per view and a 900-second evaluation cap, CIPHEUR-online achieves the highest mean objective among 11 configurations and increases mean scheduled contact duration by 14.84% over the greedy baseline GWMIN. It exceeds the strongest external per-view mean in seven of eight views and outperforms CHILS in all 40 paired runs. Within the same runs, its normalized objective improvement from 360 to 900 seconds is 1.50 to 1.86 times that of the two programmatic controllers. A separately frozen, one-shot LLM-generated controller also improves the mean objective over CHILS without runtime model calls. Together, these results demonstrate how structural search control translates LLM design knowledge and contextual reasoning into improved solution quality and sustained search progress.

</details>


### [1018] [naspaclust: A hybridisation of spatial fuzzy clustering with nature-inspired optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16356)
*Bahrul Ilmi Nasution,Rezzy Eko Caraka,Robert Kurniawan*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文介绍R包naspaclust，将FGWC与7种自然启发优化算法混合以改进空间模糊聚类，并提供更多距离度量选项与案例对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提升空间情境下模糊聚类（FGWC）的性能，通过引入自然启发优化算法弥补传统方法不足。

Method: 开发naspaclust包，集成7种优化算法（ABC、FPA、GSA、HHO、IFA、PSO、TLBO），并采用其改进版本（随机项、更新规则），同时基于rdist包提供多种距离度量。

Result: 展示naspaclust在多种案例中的实现，并在基础算法范围内比较各算法性能。

Conclusion: naspaclust能有效提升模糊聚类性能，尤其在空间情境中。

Abstract: We present an overview of R package called \texttt{naspaclust}, a tool for spatial fuzzy clustering improvement by hybridising the Fuzzy Geographically Weighted Clustering (FGWC) with nature-inspired optimisation algorithms. There are seven optimisation algorithms in general, namely Artificial Bee Colony, Flower Pollination Algorithm, Gravitational Search Algorithm, Harris-Hawk Optimisation, Intelligent Firefly Algorithm, Particle Swarm Optimisation, and Teaching-Learning Based optimisation. The optimisation algorithms available do not only use the basic algorithms, but also the modified version of several parts such as randomisation terms and updating rules. Furthermore, we also provide additional options by providing more distance metrics options based on the \texttt{ rdist} package. This study showed the implementation of the \texttt{naspaclust} package in various cases, as well as comparing the performance of the algorithms in the scope of basic algorithms. The \texttt{naspaclust} package allows to improve the performance of fuzzy clustering, mainly in spatial context.

</details>


### [1019] [Time Window Optimization for Motor Imagery Classification via Temporal Structure Embedded Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16921)
*Huan Luo,Na Lu,Xiaopeng Wang,Ziyang Shang*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出TSE-RL框架，将运动想象事件结构先验嵌入约束马尔可夫决策过程，实现自适应滑动窗口优化，提升在线MI-BCI解码性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线MI-BCI通常使用固定长度滑动窗口解码连续EEG，但窗口可能与神经事件错位。现有窗口优化方法独立评估各窗口，忽略时间依赖，可能产生碎片化或生理上不合理的选择。

Method: TSE-RL包含三部分：(1)为每个窗口赋予Discard/Onset/Sustain/Offset语义角色，将二值保留/丢弃决策扩展为事件级对齐；(2)用有限状态机屏蔽非法动作，强化MI阶段时序顺序；(3)用Transformer历史编码器捕获跨窗口依赖，提升训练稳定性与计算效率。方法即插即用，可集成多种MI分类器。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，跨session与跨被试场景解码性能一致提升；可视化分析表明学到的窗口选择策略符合神经生理原理。

Conclusion: 通过将MI事件结构先验嵌入强化学习，TSE-RL实现了时序连贯、生理合理的自适应窗口选择，是一种有效的通用窗口优化方案。

Abstract: Online motor imagery-based brain-computer interfaces (MI-BCIs) typically decode continuous EEG using fixed-length sliding windows that may be misaligned with neural events. Existing window optimization methods often evaluate windows independently, overlooking temporal dependencies and potentially producing fragmented or physiologically implausible selections. We propose Temporal Structure Embedded Reinforcement Learning (TSE-RL), a framework that incorporates prior knowledge of MI event structure into a constrained Markov decision process for adaptive window optimization. First, TSE-RL assigns each window an explicit semantic role through Discard, Onset, Sustain, or Offset actions, extending binary retain/discard decisions to event-level alignment. Second, a finite-state machine masks invalid actions to enforce the temporal order of MI phases and promote physiologically plausible window sequences. Third, a Transformer-based history encoder captures dependencies across windows, improving training stability and computational efficiency compared with recurrent architectures. TSE-RL is plug-and-play and can be integrated with diverse MI classifiers. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in decoding performance in both cross-session and cross-subject settings. Visualization analyses further suggest that the learned window selection policy aligns with neurophysiological principles.

</details>


### [1020] [FidLIF: Parallel Training of High-Fidelity Spiking Neurons with Exact BPTT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16924)
*Kaixiang He,Yujie Wu*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: FidLIF提出一种并行训练框架，通过将LIF神经元的增量更新与硬复位行为转化为结合性扫描（associative scan），实现并行前向与BPTT等价反向传播，兼顾高效并行训练与部署时的逐步推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNN的循环膜电位动态导致训练本质上是串行的，长序列下效率低下。现有并行方法要么改变/近似脉冲动态以规避复位耦合依赖，要么依赖迭代松弛不动点求解器，存在内存开销大与迭代相关反向开销问题。

Method: FidLIF在保持标准LIF神经元增量更新与硬复位行为的前提下，并行迭代恢复全序列膜电位轨迹；利用LIF局部递归带来的下双对角结构，将每次前向轨迹修正与反向伴随传播建模为结合性扫描，得到O(log T)时间深度；支持输入相关神经元参数及同一神经元并行训练与逐步推理。

Result: 数值收敛评估中，相对匹配的串行松弛LIF动态平均绝对误差低于1e-7，梯度与精确BPTT数值等价；Triton实现具良好长序列延迟与内存扩展性，并在四个序列分类基准上取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: FidLIF调和了并行训练与逐步执行，使高保真脉冲动态能利用并行硬件，同时不牺牲部署时的增量推理。

Abstract: Although spiking neural networks (SNNs) show promise in energy-efficient computing through event-driven computation and stateful temporal processing, their recurrent membrane dynamics render their training inherently sequential and inefficient for long sequences. Existing methods achieve full-sequence parallelism in SNNs through two main strategies: redesigning or approximating spiking dynamics to avoid reset-coupled temporal dependencies, or relying on iterative relaxed fixed-point solvers that suffer from excessive memory costs and iteration-dependent backward overhead. To address these limitations, we present FidLIF, a novel framework that reconciles the incremental update and hard-reset behavior of standard spiking LIF neurons with parallel forward propagation and BPTT-equivalent backward propagation. FidLIF iteratively recovers the full-sequence membrane-potential trajectory in parallel. By exploiting the lower bidiagonal structure induced by the local recurrence of LIF neurons, FidLIF formulates each forward trajectory correction and backward adjoint propagation as associative scans with an $O(\log T)$ temporal depth. This formulation also supports input-dependent neuronal parameters and allows the same neuron to perform full-sequence parallel training and incremental step-by-step inference at deployment. In our numerical convergence evaluation, FidLIF achieves a mean absolute error below $10^{-7}$ relative to the matched serial relaxed LIF dynamics, while yielding gradients numerically equivalent to exact BPTT. Our Triton implementation delivers favorable long-sequence latency and memory scaling, while achieving competitive performance on four sequential classification benchmarks. By reconciling parallel training with step-by-step execution, FidLIF enables high-fidelity spiking dynamics to benefit from parallel hardware without compromising incremental inference at deployment.

</details>

### [1021] [SWEeper-Bench: Can Agents Discover Bugs in Interactive Software?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14096)
*Yang Yao,Haozhe Chen,Bingyi Kang,Karthik R Narasimhan,Zhuang Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 SWEeper-Bench，包含200个源自真实开源Web应用bug修复的任务。agent仅获代码库和开放式请求，需自行设计交互测试发现并修复bug。最佳前沿agent仅通过59.0%，主要瓶颈在于识别bug行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: coding agent越来越多通过动态生成交互式软件与用户交互，但此类软件的许多bug需多步交互后才显现。现有benchmark通常假设bug已被识别，未评估agent发现交互依赖型故障的能力，导致用户需自行发现bug并等待修复，开发循环缓慢昂贵。

Method: 构建SWEeper-Bench，含200个来自200个广泛使用开源Web应用的真实bug修复任务。每个任务仅给agent代码库和开放式请求（如"发现并修复Focalboard看板分享与成员的问题"）。因bug难以仅从代码检测，agent须设计交互测试来发现。由agentic verifier依据用户在浏览器中观察到的现象评判修复。

Result: 15个前沿agent中最佳仅通过59.0%任务。通过分阶段轨迹分析发现最大瓶颈是识别buggy行为：agent常到达相关功能却未触发失败或未识别失败。

Conclusion: SWEeper-Bench衡量agent自主闭环开发能力的进展，目标是不依赖用户反馈即可交付可用软件。

Abstract: Coding agents increasingly interact with users by generating interactive software on the fly rather than replying in text, yet many bugs in such software reveal themselves only after multi-step interactions. Today, users must discover these bugs and wait for fixes, making the development loop slow and expensive. Existing benchmarks typically assume the bugs have already been identified, leaving agents' ability to find interaction-dependent failures largely unevaluated. We introduce SWEeper-Bench, 200 tasks built from real bug fixes in 200 widely used open-source web applications. Each task gives the agent only the codebase and an open-ended request such as "Find and fix issues in Focalboard's board sharing and membership." Because these bugs are hard to detect from code alone, agents must design interactive tests to uncover them. An agentic verifier then judges each repair by what a user would observe in the browser. The best of 15 frontier agents passes only 59.0% of tasks. Through stage-by-stage analysis of agent trajectories, we show that the biggest bottleneck is identifying the buggy behavior: agents often reach the relevant feature but never trigger the failure or fail to recognize it. SWEeper-Bench measures progress toward agents that close this loop themselves, delivering software that works without waiting for user feedback.

</details>


### [1022] [Vibe Coding with Google AI Studio Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14103)
*Christian Mancas,Cristina Mancas*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 一项案例研究：非程序员且不使用英语的用户，用 Google AI Studio (Pro) 通过 vibe coding 开发中等复杂度软件应用。结果表明几乎人人都能 vibe code，即使不懂英语；但即使规格说明清晰详尽，AI 生成的数据库应用仍存在 bug 与不智的开发决策，因此仍需充分测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究 vibe coding 能否让非程序员、且以非英语为母语的用户成功开发中等复杂度软件，同时评估顶级 AI 产品生成的应用质量是否可靠。

Method: 以 Google AI Studio (Pro 版) 为工具，由一名非程序员、母语非英语的用户，通过 vibe coding 开发一个中等复杂度的数据库类软件应用作为案例研究。

Result: 用户成功构建出可用的数据库软件近似版本；但即使初始规格文档清晰且近乎详尽，生成的应用仍出现 bug，并包含不够智能的开发决策。

Conclusion: vibe coding 门槛低，几乎任何人（包括非程序员和非英语使用者）都能上手；但顶级 AI 产品尚不能保证代码质量，仍需彻底测试，不能完全依赖 AI 的开发决策。

Abstract: This paper presents a case study on using Google AI Studio (version Pro) to vibe code a medium-complexity software application by a non-programmer who, moreover, needs it in a language other than English. We prove that, on one hand, almost anybody can successfully vibe code, not only developers, even if you do not speak or understand English, and, on the other, that although such a top AI product can build a reasonable approximation of a fine database software application, vibe coding still needs thorough testing, as even if the initial specification documentation is crystal clear and almost exhaustive, the resulting app may exhibit bugs and not that intelligent development decisions.

</details>


### [1023] [Conserved amount, negotiable placement. Prompting perturbs one architecture, an AI reviewer both](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14130)
*Daniel Sagenschneider*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过让AI代理在同一REST端点上以两种架构（可变式Spring控制器与增量式OfficeFloor管道）实施60个累积变更请求，区分了"复杂度数量"与"放置"两个维度：数量几乎不变，而放置差异显著；唯一能移动增量式架构放置的杠杆是一个推理内聚性的AI审查者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于Tesler守恒定律（问题本身携带不可约复杂度）与Brooks对本质/偶然复杂度的区分，论文提出：若本质部分固定，架构就是"放置"而非"数量"问题，因此需要探究哪些杠杆能改变复杂度在架构中的放置方式。

Method: 一个AI代理在两种架构（可变式Spring控制器、增量式OfficeFloor管道）上对单一REST端点实施60个累积变更请求；共5种条件、每格10次运行、模型固定。四种为外部控制（从裸变更请求到公开披露的结构代价函数），第五种为另一AI代理对每次变更进行内聚性推理的审查。用四种操作化度量复杂度数量，另设11个放置度量与6个数量度量，以塑性比（两架构之比）进行比较。

Result: 复杂度数量稳定：所有十个单元格的最终复杂度在四种操作化下仅变化7%–20%，60条规则新增的复杂度在同一架构内变化21%–29%。放置则不然：四种外部控制下，两架构的塑性比在6个数量度量上接近1（6个区间中5个含1），而在11个放置度量上为2.7–10.0（11个中10个大于1）。可变式架构会移动，增量式不会；公开公式将其带回增量臂未受干预时的放置。AI审查者是唯一能移动增量臂的杠杆，且仅作用于一个族：它整合管道，提升变更集中度与质量集中度（区间不含零），但不影响耦合、文件数与单节点复杂度。代价被完整报告：多数比较中严格正确性下降（尽管每条规则在超过99%的检查点被正确实现），且三项结果度量均偏向集中化的代码库。

Conclusion: 贡献在于提出一种可度量的架构属性及其杠杆，而非对任一架构的优劣判定。

Abstract: Tesler's conservation law holds that a problem carries an irreducible amount of complexity. Brooks separates that essential part from the accidental part a solution adds. If the essential part is fixed, architecture is placement rather than quantity, and the question is which levers move placement. An AI agent implements sixty accumulating change requests on one REST endpoint under two architectures, a mutative Spring controller and an additive OfficeFloor pipeline, under five conditions, ten runs per cell, model fixed. Four are external controls, from a bare change request to the disclosed structural cost function. The fifth is different in kind. A second agent reviews each change and reasons about cohesion itself.
  Amount is steady. Across all ten cells the finished complexity varies by 7% to 20% over four operationalisations, and the complexity the sixty rules added by 21% to 29% within an architecture. Placement is not. Under the four external controls the plasticity ratio between the architectures is near 1 on six amount metrics (five of six intervals contain 1) against 2.7 to 10.0 on eleven placement metrics (ten of eleven above 1). The mutative architecture moves, the additive one does not, and the disclosed formula brings it to the additive arm's untouched placement.
  The AI reviewer is the one lever that moves the additive arm, on one family only. It consolidates the pipeline, raising change- and mass-concentration on every such metric, interval excluding zero, while leaving coupling, file count and per-node complexity untouched. The price is reported in full. Strict correctness fell in most comparisons though each rule was implemented correctly in over 99% of checkpoints, and all three outcome measures favour the concentrated codebase. The contribution is a measurable property of an architecture and its lever, not a verdict on either.

</details>


### [1024] [OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14157)
*Chenyang Yan,Yingying Zhang,Kanzhi Cheng,Qiushi Sun,Zhengyuan Pan,Zheng Ma,Hang Yan,Yian Wang,Nuo Chen,Jialin Cao,Xingdong Gong,Wenpo Song,Han Chen,Zichen Ding,Fangzhi Xu,Shujian Huang,Xinyu Dai,Yichen Liu,Tiankuo Yao,Bo Wang,Ben Kao,Jianbing Zhang,Lewei Lu,Dahua Lin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: OpenMobile-2 是一个开源移动智能体，提供全开放训练环境和配方，在多基准上表现优异并可迁移到真机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推动移动智能体的开源训练环境、数据和训练方法，实现接近前沿的性能。

Method: 构建 MobileGym++（35个商业风格应用+跨应用工作流，超110应用）；整理近12K监督微调轨迹及2K+可验证RL任务；探索GUI与应用原生工具混合使用（300+工具、50+应用），并推出MobileGym++ Bench。

Result: AndroidWorld 79.9，MobileWorld 50.4；SPA-Bench 从31.9提升至59.6。

Conclusion: OpenMobile-2 以开放环境和数据实现了竞争性性能，并展现了向真实设备迁移的潜力。

Abstract: We introduce OpenMobile-2, a near-frontier mobile agent with fully open training environments and recipes. We make three key advances: (1) Diverse environments with simulated commercial apps: We build MobileGym++, featuring 35 realistic, functionally rich commercial-style apps with cross-app workflows, while preserving full controllability for reset and verification. Together with newly configured apps in Android emulators, this yields a diverse playground spanning over 110 apps. (2) Open training data at scale: Building on this foundation, we curate nearly 12K mobile interaction trajectories for supervised fine-tuning and the largest open collection of verifiable RL training data for mobile agents, comprising over 2K executable tasks with automatic rewards. (3) Hybrid GUI and app-native tool use: We explore an experimental mobile-use setting where apps expose selected functionalities as app-native tools alongside their GUIs, allowing agents to interleave GUI actions and tool calls within a task. We implement this setting in MobileGym++ with over 300 carefully scoped tools across 50+ apps. Additionally, we introduce MobileGym++ Bench for complex, long-horizon commercial mobile scenarios, supporting both GUI-only and hybrid GUI-tool evaluation on a shared task suite. OpenMobile-2 performs competitively across established benchmarks, including AndroidWorld (79.9) and MobileWorld (50.4), while showing promising transfer to real-device mobile use, nearly doubling SPA-Bench performance from 31.9 to 59.6. All resources are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OpenMobile2-Home/.

</details>


### [1025] [Agentic Evolution of SQL Test Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14161)
*Suyang Zhong,Manuel Rigger*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 Gungnir，用编码智能体演化 DBMS 测试生成器，核心机制是见证重放（witness replay），在 SQLite、DuckDB、PostgreSQL 上发现 44 个确认 bug，34 个已修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动测试工具受限于少数 SQL 方言及其部分特性；LLM 编码智能体可将更多 SQL 特性语义编码进可复用测试生成器，从而在测试时无需额外 LLM 调用，实现高效低成本，但关键挑战是如何在潜在幻觉下验证新增能力的正确性。

Method: Gungnir 让编码智能体提供生成见证（generation witness），记录生成目标语句所需的数据库设置和语义选择；验证器通过修改后的生成器重放这些选择，检查能否复现目标语句；历史见证作为后续修改的回归测试。

Result: 在 SQLite、DuckDB 和 PostgreSQL 上评估，发现 44 个经开发者确认的 bug，其中 34 个已修复。

Conclusion: 见证重放可有效验证编码智能体对测试生成器的扩展，且该方法有望推广到其他系统，指导智能体扩展测试生成器。

Abstract: Automated testing has uncovered many logic bugs in Database Management Systems (DBMSs). Existing tools are typically limited to a few SQL dialects and a subset of these dialects' features. Coding agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs) could encode the semantics of additional SQL features into reusable test generators, requiring no additional LLM calls during testing and thus enabling high efficiency and low cost. However, a key challenge is validating the added capabilities in the presence of potential hallucinations. In this paper, we propose Gungnir, an approach for evolving DBMS test generators using coding agents. Our core mechanism is witness replay: the coding agent provides a generation witness recording the database setup and semantic choices needed to generate a target statement. A validator replays these choices through the modified generator and checks that it reproduces the target statement. Historical witnesses serve as regression tests for subsequent modifications. We evaluated Gungnir on SQLite, DuckDB, and PostgreSQL and found 44 bugs confirmed by developers, of which 34 have been fixed. Beyond DBMSs, witness replay could generalize to other systems to guide agents in extending test generators.

</details>


### [1026] [AutoEnvScaling: Automating the Data Flywheel with Terminal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14163)
*Simon Yu,Baolin Peng,Bo Liu,Zhengyan Shi,Zhaoyang Wang,Hao Cheng,Qianhui Wu,Wenlin Yao,Natasha Jaques,Weiyan Shi,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出AutoEnvScaling，将环境设计视为终端任务，用智能体自动生成RL训练环境，实现环境生成与求解的协同进化（RSI）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端智能体的RL训练依赖多样可验证的环境，但这些环境多由人工设计，供应速度受限于研究者产出，成为扩展瓶颈。

Method: 将环境设计建模为终端任务：Proposer agent基于被训练solver的rollout构建新RL环境，solver的新rollout再指导下一轮，形成数据飞轮。

Result: 有效环境率最高提升25倍，单位有效环境成本降低达75%；Qwen3.5-35B-A3B在Terminal-Bench 2.1较基线提升4.3分；Qwen3.6-35B-A3B双角色协同提升12.2分，Terminal-Bench 4.0从1.6升至3.2，并泛化至多领域。

Conclusion: 智能体可自主构建训练环境，减少对人力的依赖，是迈向递归自我改进（RSI）的关键一步。

Abstract: Terminal agents solve tasks in software engineering and scientific research by executing commands in a terminal. Training them via reinforcement learning (RL) requires diverse and verifiable environments, but these environments are still mostly designed by human researchers, so their supply grows only as fast as researchers can work. We introduce AutoEnvScaling, which treats environment design as a terminal task and uses agents to automate the data flywheel. A proposer agent builds new RL environments from the rollouts of the solver being trained, and the solver's new rollouts guide the next round. By turning environment generation into a terminal task, AutoEnvScaling increases the valid-environment rate by up to 25 times compared to prompt-only generation, at up to 75% lower cost per valid environment. We show that training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoEnvScaling environments from GPT-5.6-sol improves its Terminal-Bench 2.1 score by 4.3 points over the matched Tmax baseline. The broader goal of AutoEnvScaling is to enable recursive self-improvement (RSI): by making both environment generation and solving terminal tasks, it lets one model co-evolve in both roles. We show that Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, acting in both roles, gains 12.2 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and raises its Terminal-Bench 4.0 score from 1.6 to 3.2. The pipeline also generalizes across agentic domains, generating environments for software engineering, computer use, professional work, and GPU kernel programming. Overall, these results show a path toward agents building their own training environments, reducing human reliance and taking a core step toward RSI.

</details>


### [1027] [Cortex: Measurement-Gated Evolution and Pruning of Coding-Agent Skills and Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14216)
*Samuele Giampieri*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Cortex 是一个测试并可靠地改进 AI 编码代理"harness"（项目文件、技能、规则等文本）的工具，通过将修正保存为可重放任务、逐条添加文本并仅在多次运行验证有净收益时才保留。在定制仓库上用 Claude Haiku 4.5 测试，构建的 harness 显著提升模型遵循约定比例，且不添加无用文本；但在更强模型和真实开源项目上效果有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发者不断修正编码代理并写入文本文件（harness），但单次成功不可靠——同一代理可能一次通过、下次失败。缺乏验证 harness 改动是否真正有效的机制。

Method: Cortex 将开发者会话中的修正保存为可重放任务，找出反复出现的修正，逐条编写技能或规则（skill/rule），仅在带与不带该文本的重复运行显示净收益且无任务明显变差时保留。删除前同样测试现有文本，且不添加或删除代理从未使用的文本。

Result: 在专用仓库、Claude Haiku 4.5 上：构建的 harness 使代理遵循约定频率远高于无技能/规则时，对比区域无变化，未添加每轮都读取的文本。规则（自动加载）效果显著；技能仅在随任务文件提供时有用，每轮提供的技能很少被打开。未保留无用/有害建议，但代理未打开无用技能、有害技能，也未对有害规则下结论。在 Claude Sonnet 5 下单次运行提升有限，真实开源项目上因修正少而无可学习内容。

Conclusion: Cortex 证明能保留无未使用文本，但尚未证明能检测有害改动。其有效性目前依赖较弱模型和频繁修正的环境。作者发布工具、实验环境及数据。

Abstract: Coding agents such as Claude Code also follow text files that developers write for them: a project file, skills the agent may choose to open, and rules that load automatically when the agent reads matching files. We call these files the agent's harness. Developers add to it whenever they correct the agent, but one success proves little: the same agent can pass a task once and fail it the next time.
  We present Cortex, a tool that tests changes to the harness instead of trusting them. It saves fixes from the developer's sessions as replayable tasks, finds the corrections that recur, writes one skill or rule at a time, and keeps it only if repeated runs with and without it show a net gain and no task made noticeably worse. Existing text is tested the same way before it is deleted, and Cortex neither adds nor deletes text the agent never used.
  We tested Cortex with Claude Haiku 4.5 on a repository built for the purpose, with conventions the model tends to break, one area with nothing to learn, and a script playing the developer. On held-out tasks, the harnesses it built made the agent follow the conventions far more often than no skills or rules did, left the comparison area unchanged, and added no text read on every turn. Rules, which load automatically, did most of the work; skills helped only when offered with the files a task touches, and those offered on every turn were rarely opened. Cortex kept none of the useless or harmful suggestions we planted, but the agent never opened the useless ones or the harmful skills, and it reached no verdict on the harmful rules, so the test shows that Cortex keeps no unused text, not that it detects damage. Under the stronger Claude Sonnet 5 a single run's harness added little, and on a real open-source project, where the agent was rarely corrected, Cortex found nothing to learn. We release the tool, the lab and its data.

</details>


### [1028] [Diagnosing Generalization Boundaries in AI-Based Vulnerability Detection via Calibrated Embedding Distances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14296)
*Konstantin Ievtushenko,Ralf Lämmel,Jan Jürjens*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过校准的嵌入几何揭示学习型漏洞检测模型在分布偏移下被高基准分数掩盖的泛化边界，发现白化中间层嵌入配合局部最近邻打分能有效区分陌生样本，且距离分数可诊断模型退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型漏洞检测的高基准分数掩盖了分布偏移下的严重性能退化，需要一种不依赖辅助模型即可暴露隐藏泛化边界的方法。

Method: 在严格配对的语法相似漏洞/补丁代码数据上，评估 CodeBERT 与 Qwen2.5-Coder 在模式、项目和时间偏移下的表现，采用白化中间层嵌入与局部最近邻打分，并分析距离分数与误报率的关系。

Result: 白化中间层嵌入的局部最近邻打分区分陌生样本的分布外 AUROC 均值为 0.739；准确率下降超 35 个百分点，跨项目偏移退化最严重但时间偏移几何漂移最远；补丁代码上的误报随与漏洞训练邻域的几何接近度从最低风险十分位的 9.4% 升至最高十分位的 58.8%。

Conclusion: 校准距离提供了将表示几何直接映射到模型退化的诊断信号，无需辅助模型即可暴露漏洞检测模型的泛化边界。

Abstract: High benchmark scores in learning-based vulnerability detection mask severe degradation under distribution shifts. This paper demonstrates that calibrated embedding geometry exposes these hidden generalization boundaries on syntactically similar vulnerable and patched code pairs. An evaluation of CodeBERT and Qwen2.5-Coder across pattern, project, and temporal shifts on a strictly paired dataset reveals three main findings. First, whitened intermediate-layer embeddings with local nearest-neighbour scoring separate unfamiliar samples with a mean out-of-distribution AUROC of 0.739 (RQ1). Second, distance scores reveal a shift-specific reliability gradient where accuracy drops by over 35 percentage points and cross-project shifts cause the sharpest degradation, even though temporal shifts drift geometrically farthest (RQ2). Third, false positives on patched code systematically correlate with geometric proximity to vulnerable training neighbourhoods, increasing from 9.4% in the lowest-risk decile to 58.8% in the highest (RQ3). These calibrated distances establish a diagnostic signal that maps representation geometry directly to model degradation without requiring auxiliary models.

</details>


### [1029] [SPROUT: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14405)
*Mengyang Liu,Weiming Wang,Haixin Nan,Yu Wu,Peize Li,Shihong Huang,Xuning He,Xue Jiang,Yihong Dong*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SPROUT是一个基于快照的智能体RL rollout框架，通过从中途状态恢复与分支来扩展长周期编程任务的学习，提升效果并降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长周期软件工程任务中成功轨迹稀缺，微小错误即导致整段rollout失效；从头重启效率低，仅重置上下文又会丢失如已安装依赖等环境状态变更。

Method: SPROUT在轻量基础设施上，于每轮助手交互后对文件系统和智能体上下文同时做checkpoint；并采用验证器引导的回溯策略，决定从何处恢复失败尝试及如何继续。

Result: 在长周期编程任务上，SPROUT使不同LLM的pass@k最高提升23.6%，仅用32%–52%的token；对Qwen3.8-27B的RL训练中，在三个基准上稳定超过标准GRPO达13.9分，同时每步训练时间减少39.5%。

Conclusion: SPROUT使长周期编程任务的RL训练更有效且更易低成本扩展。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has driven substantial progress in coding agents by relying on verified successful trajectories as learning signals. However, such trajectories are scarce in long-horizon software engineering tasks, where a minor error can invalidate the entire rollout. Repeatedly restarting from the initial state is commonly used yet inefficient, and resetting only the context with working directory misses state changes such as installed dependencies. Therefore, branching from intermediate steps to preserve earlier progress requires restoring both the agent context and execution environments. In this paper, we present SPROUT (SnaPshot-based RollOUT), an agentic RL rollout framework that scales long-horizon coding tasks by resuming and branching from intermediate states. Specifically, SPROUT was built on top of a lightweight infrastructure that checkpoints both the filesystem and the agent context after each assistant turn. A verifier-guided backtracking policy then selects where to resume a failed attempt and how to proceed. Extensive experiments on long-horizon coding tasks show that SPROUT achieves up to 23.6% improvement over pass@k across various LLMs, while using $32$--$52%$ of their tokens. For RL training of Qwen3.8-27B, SPROUT stably outperforms standard GRPO by $13.9$ points on three long-horizon coding benchmarks while cutting the time per training step by $39.5%$. SPROUT thus makes RL on long-horizon coding tasks both more effective and cheaper to scale.

</details>


### [1030] [HoldSpec: A Machine-Checked Model and Conformance Suite for the Payment Authorization Hold Lifecycle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14419)
*Abhishek Sharma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文用 TLA+ 为卡授权后资金持有的生命周期建模（按服务商能力画像参数化），检查 8 个安全不变量和 3 个活性属性；从模型生成一致性测试套件，对 61 个种子缺陷实现 100% 检出率，远高于随机序列（56%）和手写集成测试（69%），并揭示 Stripe 与 Adyen 之间的语义分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 授权与捕获之间资金处于双方均不完全掌控的持有状态，各支付服务商对可执行操作（部分捕获、再次捕获、作废、提高额度、过期）的业务逻辑实现不同且无正式规范。缺少形式化规范导致跨服务商行为不一致、适配器抽象难以通用，且缺少有效的合规测试手段。

Method: 用 TLA+ 构建以服务商能力画像为参数的状态机，形式化持有生命周期；在其上检查 8 个安全不变量与 3 个活性属性，覆盖 6 种画像（5 种源自 Stripe 与 Adyen 公开文档）；由同一状态机生成黑盒一致性测试套件，通过调用对比对服务商 API 进行检验，并可跨两家服务商进行差异搜索生成可执行见证。

Result: 对 61 个可与正确实现区分的种子缺陷，生成套件检出率达 100%，而同等调用预算的随机序列为 56%、手写集成测试为 69%，随机序列十倍预算也仅达 67%；跨服务商对比找出双方文档隐含但均未明示的分歧，并给出短路可执行见证，其中包括一处导致单一适配器接口无法同时覆盖两家的假设失效（关闭持有并释放余额在一家为捕获、在另一家为取消）。

Conclusion: 形式化状态机与由其生成的一致性套件显著优于随机与手写测试，并能自动发现跨服务商语义分歧。局限在于无服务商沙箱凭证，所有结果仅针对文档化行为；可直接测试真实服务商的套件随论文一并发布。

Abstract: When a merchant authorizes a card and captures the funds later, the money sits in a state that neither party fully controls: held on the cardholder's account, not yet taken, and due to lapse on a deadline set by the card network. What a merchant may do to that hold, capture part of it, capture again, void it, raise it, let it expire, is business logic that every payment service provider implements slightly differently and none of them specifies formally. We give the lifecycle a state machine in TLA+, parameterized by a provider capability profile, and check eight safety invariants and three liveness properties over 6 profiles, five of them built from Stripe's and Adyen's published documentation. From the same machine we generate a conformance suite that runs black-box against a provider API. Against 61 seeded defects that are distinguishishable from a correct implementation, the generated suite detects 100%, where random sequences with the same call budget reach 56% and a hand-written integration suite reaches 69%; random sequences given ten times the budget still reach only 67%. Running the same suite between two providers turns the comparison into a search, and it returns short executable witnesses for divergences the two documentation sets imply but neither states, including one that breaks the common assumption that a single adapter interface can sit over both, because closing a hold and releasing its remainder is a capture on one provider and a cancel on the other. We report what we could not do: no provider sandbox credentials were available, so every result here concerns documented behavior, and the suite that would test the providers themselves is part of what we release.

</details>


### [1031] [Specification-Based Testing of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14443)
*Kausar Moshood,Jace Bolante,Roshan Aditya Murali,Manish Motwani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出LEST框架，将LLM安全文档中的声明作为黑盒测试规范，通过提示变异搜索反例并人工验证。评估发现仅少数安全声明可被基准提示测试，且自动评估严重高估了模型行为失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全评估通常从预设基准出发，而非检验基准到底测试了哪些已记录的安全声明，导致文档声明与评估之间缺乏对应关系。

Method: LEST将每条文档化安全声明作为规范：确定哪条基准提示测试它、以及"拒绝转服从"（模型拒绝原提示却服从变异版本）是否算反例。框架变异提示搜索反例，人工验证候选，并将验证过的反例回溯到所违背的声明。

Result: 用Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5的系统卡及SORRY-Bench的97条种子提示评估。56条安全声明中29条(51.8%)可被提示测试，仅17条(58.6%)有适用基准提示覆盖。两模型拒绝>95%基准提示。1,836条变异提示产生312个候选"拒绝转服从"转变，但人工验证仅19个(6.1%)兼具意图保持与真实服从，表明自动评估大幅高估失败。这19个反例覆盖9条适用声明中的6条。

Conclusion: 基准提示不足以验证所有文档化的LLM安全行为，自动失败检测需人工验证。LEST实现了从自然语言安全文档到可执行测试及人工验证反例的端到端可追溯性。

Abstract: Model cards, system cards, and safety reports increasingly document LLM safety behaviors, yet safety evaluations typically start from predefined benchmarks rather than asking which documented claims those benchmarks actually test. We introduce LEST (LLM Evaluation through Specification-driven Testing), a framework that treats documented safety claims as specifications for black-box testing. In LEST, each claim determines which benchmark prompt tests it and whether a Refuse-to-Comply transition, where a model refuses a prompt but complies with its mutated version, counts as evidence against it. LEST mutates these prompts to search for counterexamples, manually validates each candidate, and traces validated counterexamples back to the claims they contradict. We evaluate LEST using the system cards of Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 with 97 seed prompts from SORRY-Bench across Mental Health and Self-Harm, Harmful and Violent Content, and Fairness and Bias. Of 56 identified safety claims, 29 (51.8%) are prompt-testable, but only 17 (58.6%) are exercised by an applicable benchmark prompt. Both models refuse >95% of benchmark prompts. Evaluating 1,836 mutated prompts on both models reveals 312 candidate Refuse-to-Comply transitions flagged by automated response classifiers. However, human validation confirms only 19 (6.1%) as both intent-preserving and genuinely compliant, showing automated evaluation substantially overestimates behavioral failures. Tracing these 19 transitions back to the claims reveals counterexamples for 6 of 9 covered claims for which refusal is an applicable oracle. Our results show that benchmark prompts may not be sufficient to validate all documented LLM safety behavior, and automated failure detection requires manual validation. LEST provides end-to-end traceability from natural-language safety documentation to executable tests and human-validated counterexamples.

</details>


### [1032] [Taylor-Approximation-Based Repair of High Floating-Point Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14444)
*Xin Yi,Liqian Chen,Hengbiao Yu,Shangwen Wang,Tao Tang,Chun Huang,Xiaoguang Mao,Ji Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: NPTaylor：基于泰勒近似的框架，用带保护的C补丁修复数值C例程中的局部高浮点误差，在GSL基准上比AutoRNP更快、更紧凑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数值库在局部病态输入（如根、极点、消去点、分支边界）上仍会损失大量精度，现有自动修复方法在效率和代码体积上有局限。

Method: 给定高误差输入、局部修复域、高精度oracle和误差阈值，搜索泰勒阶数、展开中心、分段和浮点求值策略；生成带保护的C补丁，在修复域内用泰勒求值器、域外回退原例程；通过系数分裂和补偿Horner求值降低舍入误差；候选补丁需在局部样本、保护端点和修复前峰值输入上验证后才接受。

Result: 在GSL基准上，38个单输入函数的114种配置（三个精度阈值）中，NPTaylor与AutoRNP均全部修复；NPTaylor离线修复时间几何平均快3.33倍，生成的C字节数为0.162倍；最严格设置下修复时间中位数3.74s对81.97s；还能修复AutoRNP不支持的多输入局部案例。

Conclusion: 基于泰勒的带保护补丁能提供紧凑、高效的局部修复，但结论是验证相对的，而非全域证明。

Abstract: Numerical libraries can still lose many bits of accuracy on localized ill-conditioned inputs, such as roots, poles, cancellation points, and branch boundaries. This paper presents NPTaylor, a Taylor-approximation-based framework for repairing localized high floating-point errors in numerical C routines. Given a high-error input, a localized repair domain, a high-precision oracle, and an error threshold, NPTaylor searches over Taylor degree, expansion center, segmentation, and floating-point evaluation strategy. It emits guarded C patches that use a generated Taylor evaluator inside the repair domain and fall back to the original routine outside it. Candidate patches are accepted only after validating the emitted C code on recorded local samples, guard endpoints, and the pre-repair peak input. The generated evaluator uses coefficient splitting and compensated Horner evaluation to reduce rounding error introduced by the patch itself.
  We evaluate NPTaylor on GSL benchmark workloads. On 38 one-input functions, both NPTaylor and AutoRNP repair all 114 configurations across three accuracy thresholds. NPTaylor is 3.33x faster by geometric-mean offline repair time and emits 0.162x as many C bytes. In the strictest setting, its median repair time is 3.74s versus 81.97s for AutoRNP. NPTaylor also repairs localized multi-input benchmark cases beyond AutoRNP's implemented one-input workflow. These results show that Taylor-based guarded patches can provide compact, efficient local repairs, while the claims remain validation-relative rather than full-domain proofs.

</details>


### [1033] [Re-executing Coding-Agent Evaluations: Unchanged Decisions and Unresolved Policy Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14460)
*Tianyu Ding,Yaocheng Tong,Muzhi Yang,Fei Jiang,Lei Yang,Boya Yu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 两项预注册的再执行研究对"可执行测试用于LLM编码代理评分"给出负面结果：SWE-bench Pro v1离线选项未拒绝任何被接受的Go补丁，但3%风险仍未解决；DGM存档复现保持了最佳代理选择与排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可执行测试被广泛用于给LLM编码代理补丁评分，支撑排行榜、奖励与自我改进，但其评分可靠性缺乏严格验证。

Method: 两项预注册再执行研究：检验SWE-bench Pro v1离线选项对59个被接受Go补丁的拒绝率（探索性未加权置信上限4.95%，预注册估计量用逆抽样概率加权）；复现DGM存档中1,929个选定代理-版本/任务评估的评分；辅以模块缓存、主机/镜像/评分器对比及二主机复检。

Result: 未拒绝任何被接受补丁，3%暴露补丁风险未决；重建依赖缓存拒绝了四个模型原本通过的替代方案；再执行保留最佳代理选择与系统变体排名；23个分歧中7个未复现，重建镜像改变16个三跑多数判决（0.83%）。

Conclusion: 该结果仅针对已接受补丁与固定历史决策；通用策略安全与自适应学习鲁棒性需更广泛评估，并提供证据-主张总结与评分器审计经验。

Abstract: Executable tests grade large language model (LLM) coding-agent patches for leaderboards, rewards and self-improvement. Two preregistered re-execution studies returned negative results. SWE-bench Pro v1's offline option rejected none of 59 accepted Go patches whose grading configuration changed. Their exploratory, unweighted upper confidence limit is 4.95% under candidate independence, leaving a 3% exposed-patch risk unresolved; the preregistered estimator uses inverse sampling-probability weights. An extension was inconclusive. In a selected stratum, a reconstructed module cache built from the reference solution's dependencies rejected accepted alternatives from four models that passed with their own dependencies. Re-executing 1,929 selected agent-version/task evaluations from the Darwin Gödel Machine's archive preserved best-agent selection and system-variant ranking, with search history and scores of evaluations not rerun fixed. Exploratory host, image and adapted-grader comparisons also preserved them. Seven of 23 disagreements with archived verdicts did not recur on a second host; rebuilt images changed 16 three-run majority verdicts (0.83%) under four-CPU execution. We provide an evidence-to-claim summary, lessons for grader audits and an anonymous replication package. These results concern accepted patches and fixed-history decisions; general policy safety and adaptive-learning robustness require broader evaluations.

</details>


### [1034] [Rethinking SZZ Search Strategies: Lessons from Claude Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14462)
*Inase Kondo,Masanari Kondo,Daniel M. German,Olivier Nourry,Yasutaka Kamei,Yoshiki Higo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文探索不局限于代码追踪的BIC识别策略，允许编码智能体Claude Code独立调查Git仓库。其在79个Java案例上F1达0.771，远超十个SZZ基线；修正数据集问题后F1提升至0.938。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SZZ方法多依赖代码追踪，即从bug修复提交(BFC)中改动的代码回溯到早期提交。但当引入bug的代码与修复时所改代码不一致时，该方法会漏掉真正的BIC，导致识别准确率受限。

Method: 不预设搜索流程、不提供候选提交，让具备高BIC识别能力的编码智能体Claude Code独立调查Git仓库；在来自70个仓库的79个Java案例上评估其识别准确率与搜索行为，并与十个SZZ基线对比。

Result: 79.7%的运行中Claude Code先审查提交历史再查看具体代码diff，并利用提交信息选择需细查的改动；F1为0.771，显著优于全部十个SZZ基线。失败分析发现评估数据集中存在错误的oracle标签及BIC定义模糊问题，重构数据集后F1达0.938。

Conclusion: 改进SZZ搜索策略的关键经验是：先利用语义信息找到相关提交，再检查其代码改动，而非从代码追踪入手。

Abstract: Identifying bug-inducing commits (BICs) is important for studying software bugs and maintaining software, yet the accuracy of existing SZZ methods remains limited. Although various improvements have been proposed, many SZZ methods still rely on code tracing, which searches for BICs by tracing code changed in a bug-fixing commit (BFC) back to earlier commits. However, this approach may miss the actual BIC when the code responsible for introducing a bug differs from the code modified to fix it. To overcome this limitation, we investigate whether BIC identification can be improved by exploring search strategies that are not constrained to start with code tracing. We use Claude Code, a coding agent that has demonstrated high BIC identification accuracy in prior research, to explore such strategies. Rather than prescribing a search process or providing predefined candidate commits, we allow Claude Code to independently investigate a Git repository. We evaluate its identification accuracy and search behavior on 79 Java cases from 70 repositories. In 79.7% of runs, Claude Code reviewed commit histories before inspecting individual code diffs. It used commit messages to select changes for closer inspection. With this approach, Claude Code achieves an F1 score of 0.771, significantly outperforming all ten evaluated SZZ baselines. Our failure analysis also reveals incorrect oracle labels and ambiguities in BIC definitions in the studied evaluation dataset. After reconstructing the evaluation dataset to address these issues, Claude Code achieves an F1 score of 0.938. A key lesson from Claude Code for improving SZZ search strategies is to use semantic information to find relevant commits and then examine their code changes, rather than starting with code tracing.

</details>


### [1035] [When Is a Reconciliation Break Real? A Temporal Correctness Contract for Streaming Financial Reconciliation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14470)
*Abhishek Sharma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对对账系统的时序正确性契约及无需真值的检查器，用于区分"决策过早""输入超出延迟界限""钱真的丢失"三类情况，并在支付模拟数据集上验证了标准空闲超时会引入违约，而按源跟踪延迟界限可降低断裂延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步流上的对账决策基于部分证据：未出现的入账可能是真的缺失，也可能只是尚未入账。现有流水线用超时或水位线处理，并将异常直接视为发现，无法区分决策过早、输入违约与真实丢失，导致断裂率上升却难以归因。

Method: 给出相对于声明式逐源延迟界限的时序正确性契约，明确裁决何时可被接受；并设计一个无需真值的检查器。契约将三种情况分离。同时以SQL在现有对账表上表达该契约，并与参考实现对比验证。

Result: 在支付模拟器工作负载上：空闲超时使5.42%的义务违约（95% CI [3.94,6.92]），而无超时的同一作业完全健全，超时达到慢源入账周期后违约消失。延迟偏移下，四种基于身份的对账器对银行已结算信贷产生18.3%–23.0%的伪断裂，而违约率≤1.01%，检查器将损失归因于240个银行侧和413个账本侧界限违约。单源单视野使断裂延迟平均低12.7%，p99从446降至224 ticks。Flink区间联结违约14.9–20.1%。SQL实现与参考实现在全部4,395个裁决上一致。

Conclusion: 该时序契约能有效分离对账中的假阳性与真实丢失，为异步流对账提供可判定的正确性标准；标准超时补救会破坏健全性，逐源视野可改善延迟；契约可用SQL表达，验证与参考实现完全一致。

Abstract: Reconciliation systems decide, continuously, whether money the ledger expected has arrived at the bank. On an asynchronous stream that decision is taken against partial evidence: a credit that has not appeared may be missing, or may simply not have been posted yet. Deployed pipelines settle this with a timeout or a watermark, and the exceptions are treated as findings. We give a temporal correctness contract that says when such a verdict is admissible, relative to a declared per-source lateness bound, and a checker for it that needs no ground truth. The contract separates three things an operator otherwise sees only as a rising break rate: the reconciler decided too early, an input broke the bound it declared, or the money really is gone. On workloads from a published payment simulator, the standard remedy for a stalled streaming join, an idleness timeout, introduces contract violations on 5.42% of obligations (95% CI [3.94, 6.92]) on traffic where the same job without it is exactly sound, and violations vanish once the timeout reaches the slow source's posting period, as predicted. Under a lateness shift, all four identity-based reconcilers we test raise spurious breaks on between 18.3% and 23.0% of the credits the bank did settle, while their contract violation rate stays at or below 1.01%: the checker attributes the loss to 240 bank-side and 413 ledger-side bound violations rather than to the reconcilers. Tracking one horizon per source leaves break latency 12.7% lower on average and halves its tail (p99 224 against 446 ticks) at equal soundness, though it is not cheaper at every cost setting and we report where it loses. An Apache Flink interval join, written the ordinary way, violates the contract on 14.9--20.1% of obligations. The contract is expressible as SQL over the tables a reconciliation system already keeps, agreeing with the reference implementation on all 4,395 verdicts.

</details>


### [1036] [What Counts as the Same Task? Executable Contracts for Robustness Evaluation of Tool-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14477)
*Shaikh Akib Shahriyar,MD. Akil Raihan Iftee,Armon Barton,Matthew Wright*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出"可执行任务契约"来判定鲁棒性测试中改动后的用例是否仍属于原任务，对比发现嵌入阈值等弱规则大量误判，会严重扭曲智能体鲁棒性评估结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具型智能体的鲁棒性测试常通过改动环境（如藏入恶意便条）再进行评判，但只有当改动后的用例仍是该任务的有效测试时，结果才有意义。现有评估多用弱规则（任何合法编辑、嵌入空间上接近原样本）来判定有效性，容易把已改变任务本质的用例误判为有效。

Method: 提出"可执行任务契约"：契约明确任务由哪些事实定义、允许哪些编辑、怎样算完成任务，并在智能体运行前对每个改动用例进行检查。用同一批14,336条已存智能体运行记录，在不同有效性规则下重新打分对比。

Result: 跨四种编码器，嵌入阈值允许了75–100%实际改变了任务的编辑（如更换收款人），却拒绝了24–45%有效的恶意便条。用MiniLM余弦阈值时，Mistral在全部64个任务上看似脆弱，但实际只有26个存在成功的有效攻击。重放已存方案、允许改动基准字段的做法也以类似方式失败。

Conclusion: 评估必须明确并检查"什么才算同一个任务"，否则鲁棒性结论可能严重失真。可执行任务契约为此提供了更可靠的判定手段。

Abstract: Robustness tests for tool-using agents often change the agent's environment, for example by hiding a hostile note in an invoice, and then judge the agent by what it does. The result tells us about the original task only if the changed test case is still a valid test of that task. Many evaluations decide this with weak rules, such as accepting any well-formed edit or any edit that stays close to the original in embedding space. We propose executable task contracts. A contract states which facts define a task, which edits are allowed, and what finishing the task means, and it checks each changed test case before the agent runs. We compare validity rules by scoring the same 14,336 stored agent runs under each rule. Across four encoders, embedding thresholds allowed 75-100% of edits that changed the task, such as swapping the payee, yet rejected 24-45% of valid hostile notes. With a MiniLM cosine threshold, Mistral appeared vulnerable on all 64 tasks, but only 26 had a successful valid attack. Replaying a saved solution and allowing edits to benchmark fields fail in similar ways. Evaluations should state, and check, what counts as the same task.

</details>


### [1037] [LASER: Defeasible Certificate Search for Long-Range Protocol Dependencies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14552)
*Zihan Tang,Huibiao Zhu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LASER是一种证据携带的检索方法，通过显式义务和类型化证据路径解决稀疏可废止协议行为判定，在BehaviorCheck上提升联合边+证明并降低误发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协议规范中可执行行为常分散于多条条款（继承状态、仅用编号命名事件、后续更正），仅恢复邻近条款不足，需组装源链接证书并判定是否有更强规则适用。

Method: LASER将缺失支持与未解决更正表示为显式义务，搜索类型化证据路径，由出现感知的符号检查器判定证书是支持、反驳还是未解决。

Result: 在91个BehaviorCheck族、2K预算下，两模型族上Joint Edge+Proof优于最强局部读取器（Δ=+.132, p=.017；Δ=+.198, p<.001），误发现降低2-3倍。消融显示参考路由、确定性引用扩展、整文档读取、两轮迭代检索及oracle最小证书均未达标，瓶颈在类型化义务闭合而非证据获取。权威污染回放表明源链接错误仅导致弃权。

Conclusion: LASER改善长程依赖恢复，并将不完整证据与不确定权威转化为显式剩余义务，而非无支持行为。

Abstract: Protocol specifications rarely justify executable behavior in one place: a transition may inherit its source state from a remote control block, name its events only by number, and remain subject to a later correction. Recovering the nearby clause is therefore insufficient; the system must assemble a source-linked certificate and determine whether any stronger rule applies. We introduce LASER, a proof-carrying search method for sparse, defeasible protocol evidence. LASER represents missing support and unresolved corrections as explicit obligations, searches typed evidence routes, and lets an occurrence-aware symbolic checker alone decide whether a certificate warrants, refutes, or leaves a behavior unresolved. On 91 BehaviorCheck families under a matched 2K budget, LASER improves Joint Edge+Proof over the strongest local reader on two model families ($Δ=+.132$, $p=.017$; $Δ=+.198$, $p<.001$) while cutting false discoveries by 2--3$\times$. Controlled replays attribute the gain and its limits: neither reference routing nor deterministic citation expansion alone exceeds the local baseline; whole-document reading (29--65K tokens), two-round iterative retrieval, and even oracle minimal-certificate evidence all fail to reach LASER, localizing the bottleneck in typed obligation closure rather than evidence access. An authority-corruption replay shows source-link errors only cause abstention, while the only unsafe-warrant mechanism is mis-recording a Held erratum as Verified, confined to that erratum's family. LASER thus improves long-range dependency recovery while converting incomplete evidence and uncertain authority into explicit residual obligations rather than unsupported behavior.

</details>


### [1038] [Executable but Unfaithful: Mock Object, Stub, and Assertion Generation by LLMs and Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14629)
*Hao Ning,Jiahui Dong,Zhen Yang,Guanda Yan,Yichen Sun,Xuanyu Zhu,Zheng Shen,Yifei Pei,Jacky Keung,Jie M. Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文构建 MockBench 基准（165 个 Java/Python mock 生成任务），系统评估 6 个 LLM 与 3 个编码代理在可执行性、行为保真度与交互故障检测上的能力，并分析 660 个失败案例得出十类错误类型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mock 生成长期是研究目标，但捕获-重放依赖真实运行时行为、进化方法（如 StubCoder）受限于预定义符号池。LLM 与编码代理可突破这些限制，然而尚无系统性研究评估它们对 mock 对象、stub、mock 断言三类产物的生成能力。

Method: 构建 MockBench 基准，含来自真实 Java 与 Python 项目的 165 个 mock 产物生成任务，并提供经校验的参考 mock 对象、stub 与 mock 断言。评估 6 个 LLM 和 3 个编码代理，从可执行性、行为保真度、交互故障检测能力三方面衡量，并与现有工具对比及做敏感性分析。

Result: LLM 与编码代理已成为 mock 测试的 SOTA 技术。编码代理相比 LLM 显著提升可执行性，但该提升并未稳定转化为更高的行为保真度或更强的交互故障检测。对 660 个失败案例的分析识别出三类产物共十种错误类型，揭示出可通过测试却隐藏的行为偏差。

Conclusion: 研究凸显 mock 产物生成的挑战，为开发者与研究者提供实践指导；编码代理的可执行性优势不足以代表整体质量，需关注行为保真与故障检测中隐藏的偏差。

Abstract: Mocking is a foundational practice in unit testing, enabling developers to isolate the code under test by replacing real dependencies with simulated alternatives. Automating the generation of mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions has been a long-standing research goal. However, capture-and-replay approaches rely on recording the runtime behavior of actual dependencies. Evolutionary approaches such as StubCoder overcome this requirement but constrain generation to predefined symbol pools. Large language models (LLMs) and coding agents offer an alternative by generating mocking artifacts from source code without requiring recorded dependency executions or fixed symbol pools. Yet, no systematic study has evaluated their capabilities across all three artifact types.
  To address this gap, we construct MockBench, a benchmark comprising 165 mock artifact generation tasks from real-world Java and Python projects, with validated reference mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions. We evaluate six LLMs and three coding agents in terms of executability, behavior fidelity, and interaction-fault detection capability, complemented by comparisons with existing tools and sensitivity analysis. Experimental results show that LLMs and coding agents indeed have been the state-of-the-art techniques in mock-based testing. More specifically, compared with LLMs, coding agents substantially improve executability, while these gains do not consistently translate into higher behavior fidelity or better interaction-fault detection. Furthermore, we analyze 660 failures from LLMs and coding agents, and identify ten error types across the three artifact categories, revealing behavioral deviations that passing tests can conceal. Our findings highlight the challenges of mock artifact generation and provide practical guidance for both developers and researchers.

</details>


### [1039] [Does Failure Feedback Direct Agent Self-Modification?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14662)
*Rong He*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文检验自我改进智能体是否能进行"目标特定修复"，发现选择后的收益并不能证明修复的定向性或泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自我改进智能体利用失败反馈修改代码或指令，但"选择后的增益"无法证明其修复是针对特定目标的，也无法证明能泛化。作者希望用更严格的度量区分"目标特定修复"与一般性提升。

Method: 引入"定向性"度量：比较随机选定目标失败的修复与父代其他失败的修复。分析145个公开Darwin Gödel Machine日志中的合格修改；并用小型开源模型做受控指令修订实验（含预注册分析的第二项研究）。

Result: 在145个合格修改中未检测到目标特定优势；Qwen3-4B上目标反馈使修复率相对匹配的同类别反馈提升20个百分点，Phi-4-mini的7个百分点提升不显著。目标修复不能可靠预示留出集提升，留出收益集中于存在可识别、可修复故障机制的设置（如植入错误、自然工具接口失败）。编辑定位与回归筛查收益因设置而异，八步修订循环与GEPA的留出准确率相近。

Conclusion: 评估应分别报告目标修复、向相关失败的迁移、以及留出集净变化，避免用单一"选择后收益"误判自我改进能力。

Abstract: Self-improving agents use failure feedback to revise their code or instructions, but gains after selection do not establish target-specific repair or generalization. We measure directedness by comparing repair of a randomly selected target failure with repair of the parent's other failures. Across 145 eligible modifications in public Darwin Gödel Machine logs, we find no detectable target-specific advantage. Controlled instruction-revision experiments with small open models show that relevant feedback can improve target repair. In a second study with a pre-specified analysis plan, target feedback raised repair by 20 percentage points for Qwen3-4B relative to matched same-category feedback; the 7-point increase for Phi-4-mini was not significant. Target repair did not reliably imply held-out improvement. Held-out gains were concentrated in settings with identifiable, repairable failure mechanisms, including planted errors and natural tool-interface failures. Benefits of edit localization and regression screening varied across settings, while eight-step revision loops and GEPA ended at similar mean held-out accuracy. Evaluations should report target repair, transfer to related failures, and held-out net change separately.

</details>


### [1040] [TileCas: Cascading Kernel Development Across Programming Abstractions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14740)
*Xinyu Xiao,Zihe Song,Dezhi Ran,Wei Yang,Tao Xie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TileCas 提出统一的跨抽象层接口，让编程智能体在多个可编辑抽象层间迁移与精化 GPU/AI 加速器内核，显著提升 KernelBench 上的加速比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统编程抽象为人设计，而代码生成日益由模型与自主智能体完成。高级 DSL 简化搜索但隐藏实现细节，低级表示控制精细却搜索空间巨大，单一抽象层都有局限，需要研究面向机器编程的抽象方案。

Method: 提出 TileCas，一个统一可插拔接口，使编码智能体跨多个可编辑抽象层开发内核。包含三部分：Cross-Level Diagnosis（将正确性与性能反馈映射到不同抽象层的可操作控制）、Abstraction Scheduling（选择后续精化的候选与表示）、Heterogeneous Search Tree（保存并重访跨表示的搜索轨迹）。集成到 AKO 与 KDA 两个代码智能体中。

Result: 在 50 个 KernelBench Level 3 端到端负载、两个加速器平台和两个语言模型上评估。四配置等权平均下，AKO+TileCas 算术平均加速比 4.84×，最强无 TileCas 基线为 3.75×，提升 29.0%；KDA 集成后平均加速比提升 69.2%，所有配置均有增益。

Conclusion: 允许编码智能体跨编程抽象层导航可提升机器驱动的软件开发，且该接口可复用在不同基础工作流上。

Abstract: Programming abstractions have traditionally been designed for humans, but code generation is increasingly performed by models and autonomous agents. We investigate abstractions for machine-driven programming through GPU and AI-accelerator kernel generation. High-level domain-specific languages (DSLs) simplify search by delegating implementation details to compilers, while lower-level representations provide finer-grained control at the cost of a larger and more complex search space. In this paper, we present TileCas, a unified, pluggable interface that enables coding agents to develop kernels across multiple editable abstraction levels. Rather than committing to a single representation, TileCas allows an agent to transfer and refine candidates across levels through Cross-Level Diagnosis, which maps correctness and performance feedback to actionable controls at different abstraction levels; Abstraction Scheduling, which selects both the candidate and representation from which subsequent refinement should proceed; and a Heterogeneous Search Tree, which preserves and revisits alternative search trajectories spanning multiple representations. We integrate TileCas with two code agents AKO and KDA, and evaluate both integrations on 50 end-to-end KernelBench Level 3 workloads across two accelerator platforms and two language models. Giving equal weight to the four accelerator-model configurations, AKO with TileCas achieves an arithmetic-mean speedup of $4.84\times$, compared with $3.75\times$ for the strongest evaluated baseline without TileCas, an improvement of 29.0%. Integrating the same interface with KDA improves its mean speedup by 69.2%, with gains in every configuration. These results show that allowing coding agents to navigate across programming abstractions can improve machine-driven software development and can be reused across different base workflows.

</details>


### [1041] [Do Modifications Made by Coding Agents Make Subsequent Software Maintenance Harder?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14768)
*Ruwei Pan,John Zhang,Linhao Wu,Yakun Zhang,Hongyu Zhang,Lu Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 SWE-Maintain 基准，研究 agent 编写的代码是否会让后续维护更难，并区分成本来自继承的测试失败还是代码本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准要么从开发者编写代码开始任务，要么无法将后续任务难度与 agent 早期改动的影响分离，因此无法回答 agent 编写的代码是否加重后续维护负担。

Method: 构建 SWE-Maintain，含来自 50 个真实 Python 仓库的 100 个三事件维护序列，隐藏测试经认证。每个后续任务用同一 agent 和测试评估两次：从开发者先前补丁出发（Developer-History）和从 agent 自身改动出发（Agent-History）。

Result: 在 5 个编码系统、2 个 backbone、1,996 个配对后续事件中，Agent-History 平均降低后续任务解决率 5.6 个百分点；若要求所有早期测试通过，差距达 14.0 个百分点。三分之二的 Agent-History 起始仓库已无法通过早期测试，仅 1.9% 此类事件能最终通过所有累积测试。当继承代码通过早期测试且下一任务未被解决时，劣势消失（+2.7 个百分点，95% CI [-0.5, +6.1]）。

Conclusion: agent 编写改动的主要下游成本在于继承的测试失败，而非可测量的维护劣势；评估应包含 agent 产生的历史，编码 agent 应跨改动保持早期行为。

Abstract: Coding agents increasingly maintain repositories over time, where each change becomes the starting point for subsequent tasks. Yet existing benchmarks either start tasks from developer-written code or cannot separate later-task difficulty from the effects of an agent's earlier changes. We ask whether agent-written code makes subsequent maintenance harder and whether the cost stems from inherited test failures or the code itself. We introduce SWE-Maintain, comprising 100 three-event maintenance episodes from 50 real-world Python repositories, with hidden tests certified across each sequence. Each later task is evaluated twice with the same agent and tests: from the developers' preceding patches (Developer-History) and from the agent's own changes (Agent-History). Across five coding systems, two backbone models, and 1,996 paired later events, Agent-History reduces later-task resolution by 5.6 percentage points on average. When success additionally requires all earlier tests to pass, the gap reaches 14.0 points. Two-thirds of Agent-History starting repositories already fail earlier tests, and only 1.9% of events starting from those states end with all accumulated tests passing. When the inherited code passes earlier tests and the next task is not already solved, the disadvantage disappears (+2.7 points; 95% CI [-0.5, +6.1]). These findings suggest that the main downstream cost of agent-written changes lies in inherited test failures rather than a measurable maintenance disadvantage in code that preserves earlier tested behavior. Evaluations should therefore include agent-produced history, and coding agents should preserve earlier behavior across changes.

</details>


### [1042] [Testuary: Agentic Test Generation with Zero-Shot Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14808)
*Kevin Kammler,Dominik Sobania*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Testuary 通过先生成并合并多个零样本测试套件，再用两个智能体阶段补足覆盖与变异缺口，在更少模型请求下平均达到 >99.9% 行/分支覆盖和 98.6% 变异分数，优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体式自动测试生成依赖增量改进，起点弱会导致迭代多或测试不足。论文旨在为智能体阶段提供更好的初始测试套件起点。

Method: Testuary 先并行发起多个独立零样本请求生成多个测试套件，确定性地检查与修复，并用新颖的结构化合并方法整合为单一套件；再用运行时加权的集合覆盖约简去除冗余测试且不损失覆盖或杀死的变异体；最后用两个智能体阶段针对剩余覆盖与变异分数缺口。

Result: 非智能体第一阶段已显著超越当前最先进方法；加入智能体阶段后，平均行覆盖和分支覆盖超过 99.9%，变异分数 98.6%，显著优于所有基线。所需模型请求更少，测试套件平均更小、更快。

Conclusion: 为智能体测试生成提供高质量起点并辅以针对性补缺，可同时提升测试质量与效率，减少模型请求和测试套件规模。

Abstract: Agentic approaches for automated test generation can reach high-quality results, but they improve a given test suite incrementally, so a weak starting point may lead to many iterations or insufficient tests. To address this, we present Testuary, which provides the agentic phases with an improved starting point. Testuary first generates multiple test suites through independent, parallel zero-shot requests, checks and repairs them deterministically, and combines them into a single suite with a novel structural merging approach. A runtime-weighted set-cover reduction removes redundant tests without losing covered lines, branches, or killed mutants. After that, two agentic phases target the remaining gaps in coverage and mutation score. We compare Testuary with established search and LLM-based test generation approaches. The non-agentic first phase alone already significantly outperforms the current state-of-the-art. After the agentic phases, Testuary achieves on average more than 99.9% line and branch coverage as well as a mutation score of 98.6%, significantly outperforming all compared baseline approaches. Testuary needs fewer model requests and its test suites are on average smaller and faster than those of the compared agentic approach.

</details>


### [1043] [AI-Native Product Management: A Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14823)
*Ricardo Britto*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文探讨AI原生研发提升软件实现能力后,产品管理应如何重构,提出AI作为产品工作持续参与者的愿景与运营模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI原生研发可能使软件实现能力超过组织识别、评估和反思"该做什么"的能力,因此需要重新构想产品管理。

Method: 综合软件产品管理、产品学习、人机协作及产品管理与研发边界的研究,提出愿景与原则。

Result: 提出覆盖感知、探索、决策、实现、学习的AI持续参与愿景,含六项原则及基于人类专家、AI人设、智能体、技能和共享产品上下文的运营模型。

Conclusion: AI原生产品管理与AI原生研发可构成持续的产品学习过程,并指出四个需实证研究的AI特定方向。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used to support product management tasks. At the same time, AI-native research and development (R&D) may increase software realization capacity. Organizations may realize software faster than they can identify, qualify, and reconsider what should be realized. This paper asks how product management should be re-envisioned under these conditions. We synthesize research on software product management, product learning, human-AI collaboration, and the Product Management and R&D boundary. We propose a vision in which AI becomes a persistent participant in product work. The vision covers sensing, exploration, decision-making, realization, and learning. We propose six principles and make the vision tangible through an operating model grounded in human professionals, AI personas, agents, skills, and a shared product context. We further argue that AI-native Product Management and AI-native R&D can form a continuous product-learning process. Finally, we identify four AI-specific research directions that require empirical investigation.

</details>


### [1044] [Humans vs. Machines: A Comparison With AI Agents in Software Reverse Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14960)
*Samuele Doria,Stefano De Rosa,Ruoyu Wang,Zion Leonahenahe Basque,Eleonora Losiouk,Simone Aonzo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 比较人类与LLM在软件逆向工程中的表现，发现顶级智能体已达人类水平但采用"贪婪取用"策略，规模化需改进导航与状态管理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究自主AI智能体能否像人类分析师一样逆向二进制程序，是否采用相同策略，以及能否扩展到真实程序。

Method: 九个模型处理两个静态分析挑战（人类曾解决过），用统一理解评分标准打分，记录与IDA Pro的完整交互，并做代码表示与工作流消融实验，同时在4000个真实二进制上测量上下文饱和。

Result: GPT-5.5 Pro、Claude Opus 4.8、Kimi K3达到人类竞争性理解，弱模型远落后；开源模型受益于更丰富代码表示，前沿模型无显著变化；人类反复访问函数、遵循局部结构，强智能体跳跃式广泛检索且很少回访（贪婪取用）；4000个二进制测量显示大窗口可容纳许多程序，但大型应用和低层表示迅速耗尽上下文。

Conclusion: 自主逆向工程正变得有竞争力且速度占优，但规模化需要更好的导航、选择性检索和持久分析状态，而非仅靠更大上下文窗口。

Abstract: Can an autonomous AI agent reverse engineer a binary as well as a skilled human analyst? Do they adopt the same strategy, and can agents scale to real-world programs? We compare human and LLM-based software reverse engineering (SRE): nine models tackle two compact static-analysis challenges previously solved by human analysts, scored with a common understanding rubric, and we record their complete interactions with IDA Pro. This lets us compare not only what humans and agents recover, but also how they investigate a binary. The best agents (GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8, and Kimi K3) achieve statistically human-competitive understanding on both tasks, while weaker models remain far behind. Ablations show that the gap depends on code representation and workflow demands, not on model capability alone: open-weight models improve substantially with richer code representations, whereas frontier models show no significant change. Similar success rates hide different workflows. Humans repeatedly revisit functions and follow local program structure; strong agents jump across the binary, retrieve information broadly, and rarely return to inspected code, a behavior we call greedy fetching. This strategy is not fixed: given semantically richer code, agents fetch less without losing understanding. Because greedy fetching aggregates large amounts of code in the agent's context, we measure context-window saturation across 4,000 real-world binaries: large windows accommodate many programs, but larger applications and lower-level representations quickly exhaust them. Autonomous reverse engineering is becoming competitive, with a large speed advantage, but scaling it will require better navigation, selective retrieval, and persistent analysis state, not merely larger context windows.

</details>


### [1045] [TurnCost: Turns, Not Observations: Cache-Aware Loop Engineering for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15093)
*Pramod Kumar,Raj Kumar Pandey*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 分析600条编码Agent轨迹发现：工具观测普遍很小（中位数118-286 token），压缩收益有限；前缀缓存使成本高估约7倍；模型委派在近半数场景反而增加成本；轮次数解释84%的成本方差，而观测大小仅4%，说明减少不必要轮次比压缩观测更具潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Agent效率优化（压缩工具观测、将部分轮次路由到廉价模型）缺乏实际可行性评估，作者希望量化这些优化在真实编码Agent循环（loop engineering）中的实际机会大小。

Method: 分析600条公开编码Agent轨迹，覆盖2种agent scaffold与2种语言模型；统计观测token分布与缓存命中率；推导并实证验证模型委派的closed-form盈亏平衡条件；用回归分析比较轮次数与观测大小对轨迹成本方差的贡献；发布TurnCost工具用于在替换缓存/定价/压缩/路由策略下重评分轨迹语料。

Result: 观测中位数仅118-286 token，大构建日志处于99百分位；98.6%输入token来自前缀缓存，扁平定价高估成本约7倍；模型委派在约一半评估设置中增加成本（符合预测边界）；轮次数解释84%日志轨迹成本方差，平均观测大小仅解释4%；最贵轨迹轮次最多但观测最小。

Conclusion: 以观测为中心的压缩方法针对的是次要成本因素，减少不必要轮次才是更大且尚未被充分研究的机会；但作者未证明减少轮次能保持任务成功率不变。

Abstract: AI coding agents operate in iterative loops: they modify code, run tools, inspect the results, and decide what to do next. We call the design of this process loop engineering, which includes context management, model selection, compaction, and termination. Existing efficiency work mainly compresses tool observations or routes selected turns to cheaper models, but the practical opportunity for these optimizations remains unclear. We analyze 600 publicly released coding-agent trajectories spanning two agent scaffolds and two language models. Median observations contain only 118-286 tokens, while the large build logs commonly used to motivate compression occur near the ninety-ninth percentile. Moreover, 98.6% of input tokens are served from a prefix cache, so flat input pricing overestimates loop cost by roughly 7x on average under near-ideal caching.
  We derive and empirically validate a closed-form break-even condition for model delegation. Delegation increases cost in half of the evaluated settings, near the predicted boundary. More broadly, turn count explains 84% of the variance in log trajectory cost, compared with 4% for mean observation size; the most expensive trajectories have the most turns despite having the smallest observations. These associations suggest that observation-focused methods target a secondary cost factor, and identify unnecessary turns as the larger and largely unexamined opportunity, though we do not establish that turns can be removed while holding task success fixed. We release TurnCost, a tool for re-scoring trajectory corpora under alternative caching, pricing, compression, and routing policies.

</details>


### [1046] [Verifying Autoware Controller Node by Combining Model Verification and Runtime Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15418)
*Daisuke Ishii*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合验证方法，将形式化模型验证与运行时监控相结合，用于Autoware开源自动驾驶平台的轨迹跟踪控制节点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶系统因操作空间庞大、控制逻辑复杂，其形式化建模与验证极具挑战性。

Method: 将控制器在微分动态逻辑(dL)中形式化为混合系统，引入捕获核心控制动态的抽象模型，用KeYmaera X证明器证明安全性与活性；同时利用Autoware工具链在数值仿真中监控模型与实现兼容性的约束。

Result: 实验证实：(i)监控能对目标跟踪进行带精度边界的可靠评估；(ii)Autoware实现达到目标的位置精度约为0.2-0.4米，速度精度约为0.8米/秒。

Conclusion: 混合验证方法既能对自动驾驶控制节点进行形式化保证，又能量化实际实现行为被验证模型涵盖的程度。

Abstract: Formal modeling and verification of autonomous driving systems remain challenging due to the vast operational space and the complexity of the control logic. We propose a hybrid verification approach that combines formal model verification and runtime monitoring for the trajectory-following control node of Autoware, an open-source autonomous driving platform. We formalize the controller as a hybrid system in differential dynamic logic (dL), and introduce an abstract model that captures the essential control dynamics. We then prove safety and liveness properties of the model using the KeYmaera X proof assistant. Complementarily, we monitor the constraints that assure the compatibility between the model and the Autoware implementation across numerical simulation runs using the Autoware toolchain, quantifying to what extent the implementation's behavior is subsumed by the verified model.
