The experimental results confirmed that (i) monitoring provides a sound evaluation of target following with accuracy bounds, and (ii) the Autoware implementation reaches the target with an accuracy of approximately 0.2-0.4 (m) in position and 0.8 (m/s) in velocity.

</details>


### [1047] [PassSum: Leveraging Paths of Abstract Syntax Trees and Self-Supervision for Code Summarization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15435)
*Changan Niu,Chuanyi Li,Vincent Ng,Jidong Ge,Liguo Huang,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 PassSum，通过高效 AST 输入表示和自监督预训练解决代码摘要中 AST 编码低效与依赖大量标注数据的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动代码摘要方法存在两大缺陷：AST 编码低效，以及依赖大规模标注语料，导致模型过大、训练慢、信息损失与不稳定，且难以应用于标注数据稀缺的编程语言。

Method: PassSum 采用新颖的输入表示，包含高效的 AST 编码方法；同时引入三个预训练目标，在自监督学习指导下利用大量易获取的无标注数据进行预训练。

Result: 在 Java、Python 和 Ruby 方法上的代码摘要实验表明 PassSum 优于现有最优方法；输入表示在性能之外还具备时间与空间优势；预训练使模型更易泛化、所需标注数据更少，并加快训练收敛。

Conclusion: PassSum 有效缓解了 AST 编码低效和对大规模标注语料依赖的问题，在多种编程语言上表现优越，且预训练带来泛化性与收敛速度的提升。

Abstract: Code summarization is to provide a high-level comment for a code snippet that typically describes the function and intent of the given code. Recent years have seen the successful application of data-driven code summarization. To improve the performance of the model, numerous approaches use Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) to represent the structural information of the code, which is considered by most researchers to be the main factor that distinguishes code from natural language. Then, such data-driven methods are trained on large-scale labeled datasets to obtain a model with strong generalization capabilities that can be applied to new examples. Nevertheless, we argue that state-of-the-art approaches suffer from two key weaknesses: (1) inefficient encoding of ASTs; (2) reliance on a large labeled corpus for model training. As a result, such drawbacks lead to (1) oversized model, slow training, information loss and instability; (2) inability to be applied to programming languages with only a small amount of labeled data. In light of these weaknesses, we propose PassSum, a code summarization approach that addresses the aforementioned weaknesses via (1) a novel input representation which contains an efficient AST encoding method; (2) introducing three pre-training objectives and pre-training our model with a large amount of (easy-to-obtain) unlabeled data under the guidance of self-supervised learning. Experimental results on code summarization for Java, Python and Ruby methods demonstrate the superiority of PassSum to state-of-the-art methods. Further experiments demonstrate that the input representation we use has both temporal and spatial advantages in addition to performance leadership. In addition, pre-training is also shown to make the model more generalizable with less labeled data, and also to speed up the convergence of the model during training.

</details>


### [1048] [Comparing the Pre-trained Models of Source Code by Re-pre-training under a Unified Setup](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15440)
*Changan Niu,Chuanyi Li,Vincent Ng,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对代码预训练模型（CodePTMs）实验设置不一致的问题，提出标准化设置以公平比较不同预训练任务的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CodePTMs 虽已从任务特定方案发展为通用模型，但现有模型因预训练数据集、模型规模、评估任务等实验设置不同而难以直接比较。

Method: 先回顾已有工作的实验设置，提出标准化设置；在统一模型架构、输入模态和预训练任务声明下重新预训练各 CodePTM，并在各 SE 评估任务上微调评估。

Result: 给出实验结果，并全面讨论不同预训练任务在各 SE 任务上的相对优势与不足。

Conclusion: 希望该视角能启发并推动未来更强 CodePTMs 的研究。

Abstract: Recent years have seen the successful application of large pre-trained models of source code (CodePTMs) to code representation learning, which have taken the field of software engineering (SE) from task-specific solutions to task-agnostic generic models. By the remarkable results, CodePTMs are seen as a promising direction in both academia and industry. While a number of CodePTMs have been proposed, they are often not directly comparable because they differ in experimental setups such as pre-training dataset, model size, evaluation tasks and datasets, etc. In this paper, we first review the experimental setup used in previous work and propose a standardized setup to facilitate fair comparisons among CodePTMs to explore the impacts of their pre-training tasks. Then, under the standardized setup, we re-pre-train CodePTMs using the same model architecture, input modalities, and pretraining tasks, etc., as they declared and fine-tune each model on each evaluation SE task for evaluating. Finally, we present the experimental results and make a comprehensive discussion on the relative strength and weakness of different pre-training tasks w.r.t. each SE task. We hope our view can inspire and advance the future study of more powerful CodePTMs.

</details>


### [1049] [When Messages Go Wrong: Understanding Communication Faults in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15459)
*Jinhao Zhou,Xiaoyu Zhang,Jiongchi Yu,Fahao Chen,Jun Wu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对LLM多智能体系统(LLM-MAS)中的通信故障进行大规模实证研究，构建跨层故障分类法并开发故障注入与追踪管道，在29,000+次执行上分析故障的表现、传播与任务影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-MAS依赖网络协议、远程工具和模型端点，通信易受消息丢失、延迟和上下文过期影响。由于智能体交换开放自然语言，故障可改变任务相关信息却仍使消息可处理，导致语义错误传播。但针对智能体间通信故障的系统研究仍有限。

Method: 构建连接底层干扰与应用可见故障的跨层分类法，开发故障注入与追踪管道。评估覆盖100个任务、5个领域、3种工作流拓扑、3种模型配置，共29,000+次执行。并评估执行端与证据保护机制。

Result: 20.7%的失败在完整检测记录下无即时失败信号，部分内容故障下达76.2%。通信故障下Flat任务成功率为53.0%，而Sequential和Hierarchical仅3.3%和3.2%，优势主要来自替代信息路径保留下游所需证据。执行端与证据保护机制能恢复不同的失败案例，证据恢复依赖是否存在未受影响路径的可信信息。

Conclusion: 研究为LLM-MAS的通信故障传播、工作流韧性和保护设计提供了实证洞察。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) use specialized agents that exchange messages to accomplish complex tasks. Their reliance on networked protocols, remote tools, and model endpoints exposes communication to message loss, delay, and context expiration. Because agents often exchange open-ended natural language, anomalies can alter task-relevant information while leaving messages processable, allowing semantic errors to propagate through subsequent interactions. Systematic studies of faults in inter-agent communication remain limited. This paper presents a large-scale empirical study of how communication faults manifest, propagate, and affect task outcomes in LLM-MAS. We construct a cross-layer taxonomy linking lower-stack disturbances to application-visible faults and develop a fault-injection and tracing pipeline. Our evaluation covers more than 29,000 executions across 100 tasks, five domains, three workflow topologies, and three model configurations. We find that 20.7% of failures with complete detection records occur without an immediate failure signal, reaching 76.2% for partial-content faults. Flat maintains 53.0% task success under communication faults, compared with 3.3% and 3.2% for Sequential and Hierarchical, respectively. This advantage primarily arises when an alternative information path preserves the evidence required by downstream agents. We also evaluate execution-side and evidence protection mechanisms and find that they recover different failure cases. Evidence recovery depends on whether trustworthy information remains accessible through an unaffected path. These observations provide empirical insights into communication-fault propagation, workflow resilience, and protection design for LLM-MAS.

</details>


### [1050] [Reviewing Beyond the Change: Repository Size and Existing Code Across Agent and Human Pull Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15567)
*Sabry E. Farrag*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究评审评论中"引用变更外仓库项"现象：在大型仓库更常见，代理与人类PR差异不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 考察内联评审评论中提及被审变更之外的已有仓库项这一现象，是否在更大仓库中更普遍，以及代理撰写与人类撰写的PR模式是否不同。

Method: 构建工具，将评论中的名称与base-commit仓库比对；用规模匹配的阴性对照估计偶然匹配；对92,042条代理PR评论（2,034个仓库）分析，采用预先设定的对数线性模型。

Result: 6.5%的评论提及变更外的已有项；代码文件数每增十倍OR为1.35（区间1.15–1.59），阴性对照表明并非偶然匹配；关联集中在小到中型仓库，大型仓库不精确；人类PR呈类似关联；代理超出量小且被界定为可忽略，未确立稳健的代理特有差异。

Conclusion: 该现象随仓库规模上升且非偶然，代理与人类差异证据不足；由于工具漏检多，报告比例可能低估真实流行度，且验证无法估计召回率随仓库规模的变化。

Abstract: Reviewers sometimes name existing repository items outside the change under review. We ask whether such references are more common in larger repositories, and whether the pattern differs between agent-authored and human-authored pull requests. An instrument resolves names in inline review comments against the base-commit repository; size-matched negative controls estimate chance matches. Among 92,042 comments on agent pull requests in 2,034 GitHub repositories, 6.5 per cent name an existing item outside the change. An internally pre-specified log-linear model finds an odds ratio of 1.35 per tenfold increase in code files (interval 1.15 to 1.59), and size-matched negative controls indicate that chance matching does not account for the rise. Exploratory analyses suggest that the association is concentrated from small to mid-sized repositories and is imprecise among large ones. Human pull requests in 1,845 of these repositories show a similar association. A pre-specified comparison finds a small agent excess just within the bound set as negligible, but the evidence does not establish a robust agent-specific difference. The instrument misses many references, so reported shares likely understate prevalence, and the validation cannot estimate how recall changes with repository size.

</details>


### [1051] [A Decade in a Day: Synthesizing Agent-Native Interfaces from Human-Oriented Software Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15765)
*Alan Wu,Wei Tao,Yiwen Guo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文研究桌面软件界面如何影响LLM agent使用效果，提出DeskIF-Bench基准和ANIS框架，通过生成agent-native界面显著提升agent成功率并大幅降低token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有桌面界面是为人类用户或开发者设计的，导致LLM agent需要解读视觉控件或拼凑底层操作，这种不匹配阻碍了agent表现。但何种界面属性对agent友好尚不明确。

Method: 将软件版本演化作为界面差异来源，构建DeskIF-Bench（6个应用、255个经artifact验证的任务），固定任务/agent/验证器而仅改变软件版本。通过轨迹分析识别出可发现性、粒度、可观测性三个界面属性，据此提出ANIS框架，从已安装应用能力合成agent-native界面（原子接口与目标级命令）。

Result: 最新版本始终优于最旧版本；在8个应用368个任务的扩展评测中，原子接口相较原生SDK在DeepSeek V4 Flash和Claude Haiku 4.5上成功率分别提升3.8和3.5个百分点，在线token消耗减少约73%；目标级命令进一步提升成功率至74.5%和67.4%。

Conclusion: 界面设计属性（可发现性、粒度、可观测性）对agent使用桌面软件的效率至关重要，合成agent-native界面能有效提升agent表现并降低开销。

Abstract: Large language model agents are emerging as an important new class of users of desktop applications. However, existing desktop interfaces were designed for human end users or application developers, leaving agents to interpret visual controls or discover and compose low-level software operations. This mismatch can hinder even capable agents, yet it remains unclear what interface properties make desktop software easier for agents to use. To study this question, we treat software evolution as a natural source of interface variation and introduce DeskIF-Bench, a benchmark of 255 artifact-verified tasks across six desktop applications. By holding the task, agent, and verifier fixed while varying the software release, we measure how interface changes affect agent performance. Across two models and six applications, the newest release consistently outperforms the oldest. Trajectory analysis identifies three relevant interface properties: discoverability, granularity, and observability. Guided by these properties, we develop ANIS, a framework that synthesizes agent-native interfaces from the capabilities of installed applications. On an expanded evaluation of 368 tasks across eight applications, atomic interfaces improve success over native SDK use by 3.8 and 3.5 percentage points with DeepSeek V4 Flash and Claude Haiku 4.5, respectively, while reducing online token usage by approximately 73%. Goal-level commands further raise success to 74.5% and 67.4%, respectively.

</details>


### [1052] [Grounding Deep Learning Framework Testing in Data Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15808)
*Jiatao Ge,Yanzhou Mu,Yinglong Zou,Yibo Hu,Zhenyu Chen,Chunrong Fang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Tensor Flow Graph (TFG)与FlowMuT变异测试方法，从数据流视角对深度学习框架进行测试，在PyTorch和MindSpore上发现大量基线遗漏的bug。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试方法主要以算子拓扑表示模型，忽略了运行时张量值、属性及算子输入需求，无法区分拓扑相似但数据流不同的模型，导致遗漏与数据流相关的bug。

Method: 提出TFG，节点表示算子及其输入需求，边记录张量值与属性；基于TFG构建FlowMuT：将变异表示为受约束子图替换，变异算子来自已有工作与可变数据流对象分析；每轮为种子模型构建TFG，将变异算子与TFG位点配对，用数据流约束过滤非法候选，通过LinUCB基于覆盖率与影响选择候选，执行变异体并更新反馈，将接受的变异体作为下一种子。

Result: 在PyTorch和MindSpore上评测：提交55个所有基线均遗漏的bug报告，开发者确认41个，修复7个；数据流多样性比最强基线高43.4%；合法变异率96.7%，无约束时为86.4%。

Conclusion: 从数据流视角进行测试是实用且有效的，能发现传统拓扑方法遗漏的深度学习框架bug。

Abstract: Data flow underlies deep learning (DL) framework execution, including automatic differentiation and operator-fusion optimization. Bugs involving data flow can cause incorrect results or unexpected behavior. Existing testing methods represent models primarily by operator topology, omitting runtime tensor values and properties and operator input requirements. They therefore cannot distinguish data flows in models with similar topologies, even when these differences affect framework behavior. We introduce the Tensor Flow Graph (TFG) to capture runtime tensor states and operator input requirements. Its nodes represent operators and their input requirements, while its edges record tensor values and properties. Building on the TFG, we propose FlowMuT, a mutation-based testing method grounded in data flow. Mutations are represented as constrained subgraph replacements, with mutation operators derived from prior work and an analysis of mutable data flow objects. In each round, FlowMuT builds a TFG for the seed model, pairs mutation operators with TFG sites, and filters illegal candidates using data flow constraints. It uses LinUCB to select a candidate based on coverage and impact, executes the mutant, updates selection feedback, and uses each accepted mutant as the next seed. We evaluate FlowMuT on PyTorch and MindSpore using representative models from diverse application scenarios. FlowMuT submitted 55 bug reports for cases missed by all baseline methods; developers confirmed 41 reports and fixed the bugs described in 7 reports. FlowMuT achieves 43.4% higher data flow diversity than the strongest baseline and a legal mutant rate of 96.7%, compared with 86.4% without constraints. These results show that testing from a data flow perspective is practical and effective.

</details>


### [1053] [BRQGen: Towards Adaptive Completeness Assessment and Follow-Up Question Generation for Bug Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15903)
*Tevfik Emre Sungur,Akif Emre Köşüş,Uğurcan Doğruçam,Eray Tüzün*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: BRQGen 是一个迭代式框架，用于识别缺陷报告中的缺失或模糊信息，仅在必要时生成针对性的追问，并能评估作者回复。基于 429 份不完整缺陷报告的新数据集，该方法可覆盖 35.4%–51.8% 的真实追问问题，完整性评估在高严重度缺口下 macro-F1 可达 73.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多缺陷报告缺乏复现问题所需的信息。早期研究使用大语言模型生成追问来补充不完整报告，但会固定提问数量，无论报告是否真的不完整，缺乏必要性判断与迭代能力。

Method: 提出 BRQGen 迭代框架：识别缺陷报告中的缺失或模糊信息，仅在必要时生成针对性追问；无缺口报告判为充分。作者回复后，评估答案是否提供所需信息，并针对新暴露的缺口继续生成问题。同时构建了包含 Home Assistant 与 Brave Browser 的 429 份不完整缺陷报告数据集，每份至少含一个维护者追问，并将问题映射到作者回答及标签（是否可通过问题模板直接提供）。

Result: 维护者较早请求更易获得作者回复，延迟请求则常无回复；一小时内请求的中位回复时间为 Home Assistant 0.52 小时、Brave 1.45 小时，四小时后则升至 9.76 和 13.49 小时。BRQGen 覆盖 1,073 个真实追问中的 35.4%（Qwen 3.8 Flash）至 51.8%（DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）；DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 覆盖 45.7% 详细问题和 63.9% 通用问题。Gemini 3 Flash Preview 的完整性评估 macro-F1 最高为 49.3%，仅取高严重度缺口时 Qwen 3.8 Flash 达 73.6%。至少一个高严重度缺口可提升完整性评估，且几乎所有真实问题在前两轮迭代内被捕获。

Conclusion: BRQGen 通过按需、迭代地生成追问并评估回复，优于固定提问数量的做法，能有效补充不完整缺陷报告；高严重度缺口对完整性评估尤为关键，且迭代次数有限即可覆盖绝大多数真实追问问题。

Abstract: Many bug reports lack the necessary information required to reproduce issues. In early studies, large language models have been employed to generate follow-up questions to enhance incomplete reports. However, they ask a fixed number of questions regardless of whether the report is incomplete. We propose BRQGen, an iterative framework that identifies missing or ambiguous information in bug reports and generates targeted follow-up questions, only if necessary. Reports with no identified gaps are classified as sufficient. When the author responds, BRQGen evaluates whether the answers provide the requested information and generates further questions for any exposed gaps. We curated a novel dataset of 429 incomplete bug reports from Home Assistant and Brave Browser, each containing at least one maintainer follow-up question. Each question is mapped to the author's answer and assigned a label indicating whether the requested information could have been provided directly through the issue template. Earlier maintainer requests were associated with author responses, whereas delayed requests were associated with no response. Among responding authors, requests within one hour received median replies after 0.52 hours in Home Assistant and 1.45 hours in Brave, versus 9.76 and 13.49 hours after four hours. BRQGen covered 35.4% (Qwen 3.8 Flash) to 51.8% (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) of the 1,073 ground-truth follow-up questions. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash managed to ask 45.7% of all detailed questions and 63.9% of all generic questions. Gemini 3 Flash Preview reached the highest macro-F1 for completeness assessment of 49.3%, but with a post-hoc analysis by getting only the gaps with high severities, Qwen 3.8 Flash reaches 73.6% macro-F1 score. Completeness assessment improved when at least one identified gap had high severity, and nearly all ground-truth questions were captured within the first two iterations.

</details>


### [1054] [When Agent Evaluation Becomes Unreliable: An Empirical Study of Oracle Failures and Configuration-Dependent Measurement in an LLM Agent Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16067)
*Junjie Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对 agent 评测框架进行“oracle 完整性审计”，通过 5 个状态完整性不变量和 3 个已知答案控制项，检出注入的 7 类 oracle 缺陷；在某 agent 基准中发现奖励函数缺陷，修正后成功率由 94.3% 降至 65.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评测框架的可靠性缺陷无法从分数表中看出，因此需要审计其 oracle 与状态完整性。

Method: 提出 oracle 完整性审计方法：5 个状态完整性不变量 + 3 个已知答案控制；在两任务域与一合成域注入 7 类 oracle 缺陷，并做组件消融与跨基准可移植性测试。

Result: 所有注入缺陷均被检出，修复后 oracle 无误报；实际基准审计发现奖励函数在运行后评分前改变环境状态，4,320 回合中 database-pass 标签由 4,194 变为 2,883，成功率由 94.3% 降至 65.5%。消融显示工具描述影响最大（-9.2 pp），错误字符串最小（-5.3 pp）。另一独立实现基准因无法从 API 调用日志重建参考终态而无法审计。

Conclusion: 评测框架的 oracle 完整性可被系统审计，分数表会掩盖严重缺陷；审计方法存在可移植性边界，需依赖可重建的参考终态，并已发布可复现包。

Abstract: Agent evaluation harnesses are software systems that run test suites, generate inputs, and decide outcomes with test oracles. This paper audits such software for reliability defects that score tables cannot reveal.
  We introduce an oracle-integrity auditing approach with five state-integrity invariants and three known-answer controls. We evaluate it by injecting seven oracle defect classes across two task domains and a synthetic domain. All injected defect classes are detected, and the repaired oracle has no false positives. Applied to an agent benchmark, the audit reveals a reward-function defect that changes the environment state before post-run scoring. Across 4,320 episodes, replay-based correction changes database-pass labels from 4,194 to 2,883 and reduces measured success from 94.3% to 65.5%.
  We also study configuration-dependent measurement effects. A component ablation over 3,240 episodes shows that the agent's policy documents, tool descriptions, and tool error strings influence observed trajectory reliability, with tool descriptions showing the largest exploratory effect (-9.2 pp) and error strings the smallest (-5.3 pp). A second task domain reverses the sign of the language effect, so the result is bounded to the tested configuration.
  Finally, we report a portability boundary: the auditing approach cannot validate a second independently implemented benchmark because the required reference terminal state cannot be reconstructed from its recorded API-call log.
  The paper releases a replication package containing the auditing suite, fault-injection catalogue, frozen records, deviation logs, and offline analysis entry points without network access, API keys, or model calls.

</details>


### [1055] [Software Testing Meets Bayesian Workflow: A Literature-Driven Artifact Study of Probabilistic Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16594)
*Oleg Jarma,Maja Dall,Raúl Pardo,Mahsa Varshosaz,Andrzej Wąsowski*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文从《Statistical Rethinking》提取17个概率模型可测试正确性属性，实现对应测试oracle，并在59个真实模型上验证，发现多数测试非flaky，且标准变异算子无法捕捉概率属性关注的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化测试对软件质量保障有效，但极少用于概率模型。核心障碍是oracle问题：概率模型用于无解析规范可写的场景，难以定义可测试的正确性属性；统计学界的代理规范依赖人工判断，未系统自动化。

Method: 从权威教材《Statistical Rethinking》中提取17个广泛适用的概率模型属性；为每个属性选择并实现测试oracle；在来自学术与工业来源的59个概率模型群体上研究其自动测试效用；并首次研究概率模型的变异测试有效性。

Result: 所有属性都找到了真实可用例（被测模型）；尽管理论上可能flaky，实践中绝大多数测试并不flaky；标准变异算子无法捕捉概率属性所追踪的缺陷。

Conclusion: 该工作系统化了概率模型可测试正确性属性的提取、实现与评估，为概率编程的自动测试奠定基础，并指出传统变异测试在概率模型上的不足。

Abstract: Automated testing is an effective software quality assurance method, but it is rarely used for probabilistic models. This is despite the heavy use of probabilistic programming for data analytics in research and engineering, where the consequences of errors are dire. A key obstacle is the specification of testable correctness properties for probabilistic models, known as the oracle problem. Like machine learning, probabilistic programming is used precisely where no analytical specification exists: had we been able to write one, we would have written an algorithm instead of fitting a model. An alternative is partial, proxy correctness specifications. The statistics literature already offers many, but as quality guidelines that require human judgment: comparing plots, visually analyzing shapes of distributions, assessing whether parameter values are ''far'' or ''close enough''. These guidelines are not systematically automated. In this work, we elicit, implement, and study testable correctness properties of probabilistic models. We extract 17 broadly applicable properties for probabilistic models from one of the most widely used textbooks in Bayesian data analysis, Statistical Rethinking by McElreath. For each property, we select and implement a test oracle, and study its utility for automatic testing, using a population of 59 probabilistic models from academic and industrial sources. We find realistic use cases (models under test) for all the properties. We observe that the vast majority of tests are not flaky in practice, despite the theoretical potential for flakiness. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to investigate the effectiveness of mutation testing for probabilistic models, showing that standard mutation operators do not capture faults tracked by the probabilistic properties.

</details>


### [1056] [Domain-Knowledge Driven Configuration Tuning of Kubernetes Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16651)
*Federico Imberti,Luca Cavagnis,Stefano Cereda,Giovanni Gibilisco,Claudio Menghi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种领域知识驱动的Kubernetes工业应用配置调优方案，通过约束目录定制优化问题，并用启发式与优化两种求解器寻找最优配置，在工业工具中实现并显著降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业软件部署配置调优困难：可调参数数量庞大，且生产环境无法随意评估配置（可能导致性能下降），需在实用时间内找到兼顾性能与成本的配置。

Method: 面向Kubernetes，构建领域专家经验约束目录，工程师按应用选择相关约束以定制优化问题；采用两种求解器：基于启发式的方法和复用现有优化方法。

Result: 在软件公司工业工具中实现，与工程师预设配置基线对比：启发式方案平均节省11591 USD/月（24.03%），优化方案节省15874 USD/月（32.90%）；耗时分别约0.71秒/次和45.54秒/次提取。

Conclusion: 领域知识驱动的约束定制方案能在实用时间内有效降低Kubernetes工业应用部署成本，两种求解器均优于人工基线。

Abstract: Industrial software applications often require engineers to tune the software deployment platform. Configuration tuning identifies valuable configurations that minimize costs while ensuring the application performance. However, finding these configurations is difficult. The number of tunable configuration parameters in industrial applications is large, and engineers cannot assess different configurations in production because users may experience performance degradation. This work targets Kubernetes: A system for automating the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. This paper proposes a domain-knowledge-driven solution for finding configurations of industrial applications in a practical time. The solution relies on a catalog of constraints encountered by domain experts in similar applications. Depending on the problem under analysis, engineers can customize the optimization problem by selecting the relevant constraints from the catalog for the application at hand. We rely on two alternative solvers to find an optimal configuration: The first is based on heuristics, while the second reuses existing optimization-based solutions. We implemented our solution within an industrial tool from a software company specializing in performance engineering and optimization. We compare our solution to a baseline, considering a set of predefined configuration values provided by engineers. Our results confirm the effectiveness of our solution: Compared to the baseline, the heuristic-based and optimization-based solutions provide significant average savings of 11591 USD/mo and 15874 USD/mo per Kubernetes, respectively, accounting for 24.03% and 32.90% of the costs, in practical time (0.71 seconds per extraction for the heuristic-based and 45.54 seconds per extraction for the optimization-based solution).

</details>


### [1057] [DeepGroundRepair: From API-Grounded Generation to Shape-Aware Repair for Deep Learning Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16897)
*Xiangyue Ma,Zhen Wang,Xuhui Lu,Xiaoting Du,Chenglong Li,Jun Li,Haotian Li,Zheng Zheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出DeepGroundRepair三阶段框架，利用DL特定知识与运行时张量信息，提升LLM生成深度学习程序的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的DL程序常因违反领域特定API约束和张量形状依赖而不可靠，现有RAG与反馈修复方法未充分解决这些DL特有问题。

Method: 三阶段"生成-定位-修复"工作流，逐步缩小生成与修复空间：基于任务相关API知识进行生成；定位张量形状不匹配的上游原因；用运行时张量形状指导参数修复。

Result: 在DeepEval的100个任务、6个开源LLM、3种框架上评测：相比基线，API级语法问题每10个文件平均减少5.4个，代码可执行性相对提升85.3%；相比自调试基线，语义一致性提升18.1%，token成本降低28.4%。

Conclusion: DeepGroundRepair有效缓解DL特定约束问题，显著提升生成程序的可执行性、语义一致性与成本效率。

Abstract: Deep learning programs are fundamental to modern AI applications, and automatically generating them from natural language requirements can substantially reduce DL development effort. Large language models have demonstrated promising capabilities for this direction. However, generated DL programs often remain unreliable because they must satisfy domain specific API usage constraints and tensor shape dependencies, violations of which can cause API level syntactic issues and runtime failures. Existing retrieval augmented generation and feedback guided code repair methods do not adequately address these DL specific constraints.
  In this paper, we propose DeepGroundRepair, a three stage framework that establishes a generation localization repair workflow to improve the reliability of LLM-generated DL programs. Its key idea is to progressively narrow the generation and repair spaces using DL specific knowledge and runtime tensor information. Specifically, it grounds generation in task-relevant API knowledge, localizes the upstream causes of tensor shape mismatch failures, and uses runtime tensor shapes to guide parameter repair.
  We evaluate DeepGroundRepair on the 100 model-level DL programming tasks in DeepEval using six open-weight LLMs across TensorFlow, PyTorch, and PaddlePaddle. We compare it with four baselines: two generation-only methods and their counterparts incorporating traceback guided self debugging. The results show that, relative to these baselines, DeepGroundRepair reduces the combined number of API-level syntactic issues by an average of 5.4 per 10 program files and achieves an average relative improvement of 85.3% in code executability. Compared with the two self debugging baselines, it improves semantic consistency by an average of 18.1% and reduces token cost by an average of 28.4%.

</details>


### [1058] [AIPOCH Open-Science: An Open-Source AI Research Workbench with Reproducible .science Packages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17110)
*Wen Ouyang,Bocheng Huang,Qianyu Yao,Fei Sun,Minying Deng,Haoyue Cheng,Wenwen Zhou,Lei Mou,Yusi Wei,Jiang Li,Kun Zhu,Lei Wang,Yi Feng,Jiaheng Dai,Ke Qian,Dan Wang,Yahui Wang,Chenyi Wang,Mingsheng Lyu,Yaqiang Zhang,Ping Zheng,Chunhua Tang,Xinge Ma,Xu Zhang,Youjia Fan,Can Lu,Zhijun Dai,Man Hu,Qiqi Xie,Beinan Liu,Yuanning Guo,Yunze Liu,Jinhong Jiang,Xianjun Fu,Mingwei Zhang,Yuanji Xu,Shilin Xia,Bowen Yang,Mingjun Yu,Jingdun Xie,Xuwei Chen,Xia Zou,Yuzhou Xue,Jianguo Zhou,Chunhao Cao,Donghao Tian,Lei Huang,Jinxiao Li,Shengrong Long,Zefeng Song,Honglin Li,Jiang Luo,Wenying Jiang,Shanshan Li,Lei Dai,Ning Jiang,Ying Cai,Chaohui Li,Chunyan Peng,Hetong Zhao,Angqing Li,Chunyan Yang,Chongyang Sun,Yong Li,Xinyu Shi,Wei Dai,Ming Peng,Chen Sang,Yuanyuan Han,Desong Qiu,Haixin Miao,Jian Xu,Yi Chen,Xiaoliang Shi,Tian Shen,Teng Hu,Shuhao Wang,Yingyong Hou,Huimei Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 AIPOCH Open-Science 开源科研工作台及可移植 .science 会话包，规定记录关系的交换契约，经对照实验验证其在导出/导入中保留版本、评审关联与内容选择语义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 辅助研究会留下指令、计算、产物修订与检查等关系，这些关系对后续研究者理解工作至关重要；需要一种能可移植地保留这些关系的交换机制。

Method: 设计 .science 会话包与交换契约，支持接收端标识符重映射、显式省略内容、导入历史与可写分支分离；开展对照会话，含错误初版、经审查修正、未审查修订与未执行步骤，比较完整与部分导出，并独立提取源记录，再在同一安装的不同项目中检查导入。另用文档丰富的普通目录与注册表案例（表关联任务/执行/评审，离线复现两个 CSV）。

Result: 两种条件下均保留受测版本与评审关联，未审查修订与先前评估区分，排除内容标记为不可用；普通目录满足全部七项静态检查；注册表案例中离线执行保留脚本与固定输入，逐字节复现两个 CSVID 表格。

Conclusion: 贡献了一个已实现的交换契约及对其保留规则、内容选择约束与解释边界的受控检验。

Abstract: AI-assisted research leaves instructions, computations, artifact revisions and checks whose relationships matter when another researcher receives the work. We present AIPOCH Open-Science, an open-source research workbench with portable .science session packages, and specify an exchange contract for these recorded relationships. Version and assessment targets remain attributable while receiving-workspace identifiers can be remapped, eligible contents can be omitted explicitly, and imported history remains separate from a writable fork. A controlled session tested an incorrect first version, a reviewed correction, an unreviewed revision and a planned but unexecuted step. We compared complete and partial exports with source records extracted independently of the exporter, then inspected imports into separate projects within the same installation. Both conditions retained the tested version and review associations, kept the unreviewed revision distinct from earlier assessments and represented excluded content as unavailable. A documentation-rich ordinary directory also supplied evidence for all seven static inspection questions. A separate registry case connected a table to its recorded task, execution and review; offline execution of its retained script and fixed input reproduced two saved CSV tables byte for byte. The study contributes an implemented exchange contract and a controlled examination of its preservation rules, content-selection constraints and interpretation boundaries.

</details>


### [1059] [Deleting Code Without Losing Knowledge: Regenerative Software for Python Libraries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17197)
*Thomas Bartz-Beielstein*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该报告探讨在"软件3.0"时代，用可再生的机器可读知识记录取代以代码为唯一事实来源的传统做法，并首次将Fowler的七项原语应用于安全关键预测库spotforecast2-safe。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当Agent能在数分钟内重写完整程序时，以代码作为唯一事实来源已不再可靠；需要一种让程序可被删除并重建而不丢失知识的方法。

Method: 采用Fowler提出的七项原语，将知识存于受跟踪目录中的机器可读记录，为每个单元构建"再生束"（含架构、意图、决策、公共契约、评估与消费者，但不含实现，外加其唯一依赖模块）；开源包spotregen实现这些原语并提供GUI。

Result: 首次将原语应用于安全关键预测库spotforecast2-safe；首轮实验中Claude Code会话消耗超4300万token（几乎全为重复发送的历史），促使转向基于本地模型的架构；结果由确定性检查与维护者评判，报告含每个原语的可执行示例。

Conclusion: 再生软件框架具备可行性，但集中式Agent架构的token开销过高，需转向本地模型架构；每项原语均可通过spotregen在仓库或其临时副本上执行验证。

Abstract: In the age of "Software 3.0", when a complete program can be rewritten in minutes by an agent, the traditional approach of relying on code as the sole source of truth becomes questionable. Fowler advocated for a set of seven primitives, which lay the framework for regenerative software, so that programs can be deleted and rebuilt without losing their knowledge. The knowledge lives in machine-readable records in a tracked directory, from which a *regeneration bundle* is built for each unit. The regeneration bundle is a single file with the module's architecture, intent, decisions, public contract, evaluations, and consumers, but no implementation, plus the one dependency module it may import. The open-source package spotregen implements these primitives and provides a graphical user interface. This report presents a first application of Fowler's primitives to the safety-critical forecasting library spotforecast2-safe. During the first experiments, the Claude Code session that orchestrated the study consumed more than 43 million tokens, almost all of them its own history re-sent with every request. This motivated the switch to an architecture that is built on local models. Deterministic checks and the maintainer judged the results. The report contains executable examples for every primitive. Each example runs spotregen against the repository or against a throw-away copy of it.

</details>


### [1060] [VulnBump: A Benchmark for Fixing Vulnerable Dependencies in Real Projects While Keeping the Build and Tests Green](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17374)
*Gabija Pasiunaite,Ryan McMorrow,Brian Clark,Liran Tal,Luke Tu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VulnBump是首个跨六大包管理器、43个真实可运行仓库的307个漏洞驱动依赖升级基准，要求修复、构建与测试同时通过。Claude Sonnet 5.5下Snyk Evo Remediation Agent通过率90.2%，Claude Code + Snyk扫描77.5%，裸Claude Code 59.6%，均远超非智能体基线46.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SCA工具报告的可修复漏洞远超团队实际修复量（可修复占94%，仅约10%被解决），智能编码工具本可填补此差距，但缺乏在真实可运行项目、跨生态、且独立于智能体验证的漏洞驱动升级基准。

Method: 构建VulnBump基准：覆盖6种包管理器、43个仓库、307个升级任务、2,066个可修复漏洞，与Snyk生产漏洞分布匹配。升级通过需在全新容器中同时满足：依赖解析成功、重扫描确认目标漏洞已修复、项目构建通过、原有全部测试仍通过。对比非智能体基线、官方Remediation Agent、Claude Code（有无Snyk扫描）等。

Result: 同模型（Claude Sonnet 5.5）下：非智能体基线46.9%；Evo Remediation Agent 90.2%；Claude Code + Snyk扫描77.5%；裸Claude Code 59.6%。失败模式相反：Claude Code多留下漏洞，Agent多破坏构建或测试。Snyk指导使Claude Code通过率提升17.9个百分点；但知晓目标不足够，专用harness仍高出Claude Code+Snyk扫描12.7个百分点。大型框架迁移对多数harness仍困难。

Conclusion: 评估依赖升级的修复质量必须同时验证漏洞修复、构建与测试，因为各智能体使项目保持可运行的比例相近，仅凭单一指标会掩盖真实差异。SCA扫描器是智能体的关键工具，但专用harness设计同样重要。

Abstract: Software composition analysis (SCA) tools report far more vulnerable dependencies than teams fix: in Snyk Open Source production data, 94% of vulnerability findings have a known fixed version, yet only about 10% are resolved. Agentic coding tools could close this gap, but no benchmark evaluates them on vulnerability-driven upgrades in real, runnable projects across ecosystems, verified independently of the agent. We present VulnBump: 307 upgrade tasks covering 2,066 fixable vulnerabilities in 43 repositories across six package managers, matched to Snyk Open Source production vulnerability distributions. An upgrade passes only if, in a fresh container, dependencies resolve, a rescan shows the targeted vulnerabilities fixed, the project builds, and every previously passing test still passes. A non-agentic baseline that only applies Snyk's recommended version passes 46.9% of upgrades; with the same model (Claude Sonnet 5.5), Snyk's Evo Remediation Agent passes 90.2%, Claude Code + Snyk scan 77.5% and Claude Code unaided 59.6%. The agents fail in opposite ways: Claude Code mostly leaves the vulnerability in place, whereas most of Evo Remediation Agent's failures break the build or tests. An SCA scanner is a key tool for agents: Snyk's guidance raises Claude Code's PASS rate by 17.9 percentage points; without it, Claude Code often settles on a still-vulnerable version. Yet knowing the target is not enough: given the same Snyk findings, Evo Remediation Agent's purpose-built harness passes 12.7 points more than Claude Code + Snyk scan. Major framework migrations remain hard for all harnesses. Because the agents keep projects working at similar rates, evaluating remediation quality in dependency upgrades requires verifying the fix, the build and the tests together.

</details>


### [1061] [Why Agentic Workflows Fail: A Taxonomy Derived from Literature and Empirical Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17418)
*Xin Li,Rami Bahsoon,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向智能体工作流失效的来源感知分类法，结合学术文献与GitHub证据，揭示文献侧重规划推理、而实践侧重执行与工具/基础设施失效，强调可靠性应作为系统问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体工作流融合大模型与规划、记忆、工具、执行环境和迭代反馈，其失效难以诊断：同一用户可见症状可能源自模型行为、工作流编排、外部工具、基础设施或其交互。现有分类法多按最终失效表现分类，难以定位中间过程状态。

Method: 提出来源感知的失效分类法，融合来源归因与三个实证维度：具体失效类型词典、工作流阶段定位、智能体能力定位。核心是双轴定位矩阵：横轴为工作流阶段（过程轴），纵轴为智能体能力（功能轴）。并基于学术文献与GitHub证据进行实证比较。

Result: 文献来源的失效集中于规划、推理、学习、感知与知识相关机制；GitHub来源的失效集中于执行阶段、动作执行相关、工具、API与基础设施失效。主导热点为迭代执行与动作执行。

Conclusion: 智能体工作流可靠性应被视为系统性问题，而非仅是模型输出问题。该分类法为结构化评估、根因分析、故障注入与工程分诊提供基础。

Abstract: Agentic workflows combine large language models with planning, memory, tools, execution environments, and iterative feedback. Their failures are difficult to diagnose because the same user-visible symptom may originate from model behavior, workflow orchestration, external tools, infrastructure, or their interaction. This paper presents a source-aware taxonomy of agentic workflow failures and applies it to evidence from academic literature and GitHub. The taxonomy combines source attribution with three empirical dimensions: a concrete failure-type dictionary, workflow-stage localization, and agent-capability localization. Its central structure is a two-axis localization matrix: workflow stages form the horizontal process axis and agent capabilities form the vertical functional axis. This design moves beyond taxonomies that mainly classify final failure manifestations by localizing intermediate process states inside agent operation. Our empirical comparison shows that literature-derived failures emphasize planning, reasoning, learning, perception, and knowledge-related mechanisms, whereas GitHub-derived failures concentrate on execution-stage, actuation-related, tool, API, and infrastructure failures. The dominant hotspot is iterative execution and actuation. These findings indicate that agentic workflow reliability should be treated as a systems problem rather than only a model-output problem. The taxonomy provides a basis for structured evaluation, root cause analysis, failure injection, and engineering triage.

</details>


### [1062] [Cross-Project Bug Localization: What Works, What Doesn't, and Why](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17578)
*A Eashaan Rao,Sridhar Chimalakonda*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 跨项目学习(CPL)的效果依赖模型架构:对TRANP-CNN显著,对BLAZE较弱,对COOBA不稳健。实践者需针对所选模型验证CPL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新项目缺乏项目内训练数据,CPL被寄予期望,但以往研究仅用单一模型对比数据充足的项目内基线,无法回答CPL效果究竟源于迁移设定还是模型架构。

Method: 在13个Python开源项目的63个source-target对上,以相同的bug语料、数据划分、检索候选和基线,评估三种架构不同的模型:embedding的BLAZE、CNN的TRANP-CNN、GNN对抗的COOBA。主基线为项目内受限训练WP-small(20%目标标签)。

Result: TRANP-CNN上CPL明显优于WP-small(d=0.95,胜率81.0%,p<0.001,按目标项目聚类仍稳健);BLAZE较弱(d=0.49,胜率60.3%,p=0.002,聚类后不显著);COOBA增益小且经多重比较校正后不成立(d=0.27,p=0.027)。负迁移:TRANP-CNN 9.5%,BLAZE与COOBA 30.2%。跨模型方向一致率仅44-54%,但增益正相关(rho=0.24-0.42)。

Conclusion: CPL效果随架构而异,同一对可能对某架构有益而对另一有害。实践者应针对具体模型验证CPL,CPL研究应按架构分别报告结果。

Abstract: Bug localization models require substantial within-project training data that newly active or small open-source projects rarely have. Cross-project learning (CPL) promises to close this gap by reusing labeled bugs from mature projects, but prior CPL studies evaluate a single model against ample-data within-project baselines that data-scarce projects cannot reach. We ask whether CPL's effectiveness is a property of the transfer setting or depends on model architecture. We evaluate three architecturally distinct models, embedding-based BLAZE, convolutional TRANP-CNN, and GNN-based adversarial COOBA, on 63 source to target pairs from 13 open-source Python projects under identical bug corpora, data splits, retrieval candidates, and baselines. The primary baseline is within-project limited training (WP-small, 20% of target labels, the same target-side share as CP-transfer). CPL outperforms WP-small most clearly for TRANP-CNN (Cohen's d = 0.95, win rate 81.0%, p < 0.001, robust to clustering pairs by target project), and less so for BLAZE (d = 0.49, win rate 60.3%, p = 0.002; not significant once pairs are clustered by target). COOBA, under our re-implementation, shows a small gain that does not survive multiple-comparison correction (d = 0.27, p = 0.027). Negative transfer affects 9.5% of TRANP-CNN pairs and 30.2% of BLAZE's and COOBA's. Cross-model direction agreement is only 44-54%: the same pair can help one architecture and harm another, although the models' gains are positively correlated (rho = 0.24-0.42). CPL outcomes are therefore architecture-dependent: practitioners should validate CPL for their chosen model, and CPL studies should report results per architecture.

</details>


### [1063] [StateHarness: Maintaining Evolving Project State for Long-Horizon Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17616)
*Chuan Zou,Yujun Zhou,Xiaonan Luo,Xiangliang Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: StateHarness是一个运行时框架，通过维护演进中的项目状态（当前问题、发现、决策、依赖关系、未完成工作）来提升长时程编程任务表现，无需更新模型参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程编程中，关键信息分散在增长的交互历史里，导致局部编辑与后续后果脱节、进度难以延续。

Method: 运行时支持记录更新、搜索受影响的调用者/测试/文档，并维护紧凑的工作简报；当行为信号积累时，由独立的诊断会话回顾历史、发现被忽略的证据。

Result: RefactorBench全链完成率29.4%→35.3%，清理检查准确率87.0%→95.4%；LHTB平均奖励0.427→0.576且执行成本低于LongHorizon-Harness；ChainSWE修复率35.1%→39.5%，残留债务60→43，但pass-to-pass回归增加。

Conclusion: 维护项目状态可改善长时程编程，但会带来可测量的执行成本与回归权衡。

Abstract: Long-horizon coding requires agents to maintain an evolving view of the project they are changing: what problem is currently being solved, what has already been learned or modified, which other artifacts may be affected, and what work remains unresolved. When this information is scattered across a growing interaction history, local edits can become disconnected from their later consequences and progress can be difficult to carry forward. We introduce StateHarness, a runtime framework that maintains evolving project state without updating model parameters. The working agent records its current problem and hypothesis, important findings and decisions, discovered repository relationships, and unfinished work. Runtime support prompts record updates, searches for callers, tests, and documentation that may be affected by a change, and maintains a compact working brief for subsequent decisions. When behavioral signals accumulate, a separate diagnostic session revisits the recorded history and surfaces overlooked evidence. Across three repository-level evaluations, StateHarness improves task completion and several measures of change consistency. On RefactorBench, full-chain completion increases from 29.4% to 35.3% and cleanup-check accuracy from 87.0% to 95.4%. On five LHTB software-engineering tasks, mean reward improves from 0.427 to 0.576, exceeding LongHorizon-Harness at substantially lower recorded execution cost. On ChainSWE, bug-fix rate increases from 35.1% to 39.5% and residual debt decreases from 60 to 43 items, although pass-to-pass regressions increase. These results show that maintaining project state can improve long-horizon coding while introducing measurable execution and regression trade-offs.

</details>


### [1064] [Diff Diffusion: Predicting Edit Paths with Diffusion Models for Efficient Code Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17831)
*Xiaolong Xu,Hao Jiang,Bo Jiang,Zhiwen Deng,Ningyuan Sun,Bingzhou Chen,Jin Chen,Chenxing Wei*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 Diff Diffusion，一种面向代码编辑的扩散式 LLM 框架，通过将去噪建模为结构化编辑操作，聚焦变更区域，实现高精度低延迟的代码编辑预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散大语言模型（dLLM）虽能并行更新多 token，但主要针对序列生成而非编辑预测，难以匹配现代 AI 辅助 IDE 场景。IDE 中的编辑预测需根据最近编辑、当前文件与光标上下文推断下一步代码改动，这类改动通常稀疏且保留大部分源码 token，重新生成整段代码会造成算力浪费。

Method: 将去噪过程建模为从原始代码片段到修订代码的结构化编辑操作（编辑路径预测），并结合多阶段训练与高效的并行解码策略，使计算聚焦于变更区域，支持准确的低延迟编辑与多位置并行修改。

Result: 在公开编辑补全基准、编辑预测评测及线上验证中，Diff Diffusion 匹配或超越自回归基线；在公开编辑补全基准上推理速度提升 2.78 倍，生产中 P50 模型延迟降低 39.0%。

Conclusion: 该工作为需要高精度与低延迟的 AI 应用提供了新的建模视角，表明基于结构化编辑的扩散式范式在代码编辑场景中兼具性能与效率优势。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are appealing for code generation because they can update many tokens in parallel, yet many are optimized for sequence synthesis rather than edit prediction. This setting is poorly matched to modern AI-assisted IDEs, where edit prediction must infer the next code change from recent edits, the current file, and cursor-local context. Such changes are usually sparse and preserve most source tokens, so regenerating a full code segment wastes computation. We propose Diff Diffusion, a diffusion-inspired LLM framework for code editing that predicts edit paths from an original snippet to its revised form. Diff Diffusion represents denoising as structured edit operations, and combines this formulation with multi-stage training and efficient parallel decoding. By focusing computation on changed regions, Diff Diffusion supports accurate low-latency edits and multi-position parallel modification. Across public edit-completion benchmarks, edit-prediction evaluations, and online validation, Diff Diffusion matches or leads autoregressive baselines while delivering 2.78 times faster inference on public edit-completion benchmarks and a 39.0% P50 model-latency reduction in production. This work provides a new modeling perspective for AI applications that require high accuracy and low latency.

</details>


### [1065] [State-Aware Generation of Deployable Websites from Visual Prototypes and Requirements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17861)
*Ruwei Pan,Junlei Shen,Linhao Wu,Zixiong Yang,Qisheng Zhang,Yifan Li,Tianyu Ma,Yakun Zhang,Lu Zhang,Hongyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出VisStateCoder，用Project State Graph维护原型到项目的状态对应，解决生成网站时的状态漂移，在多任务上显著提升分数并降低漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从视觉原型和文本需求生成可部署网站已趋可行，但生成项目与原型一致性难保持。原型规定布局与视觉元素，需求描述交互流程与部署约束；现有UI-to-code方法和编码代理将布局重建、交互实现、项目编辑分离处理，导致视觉元素、文件、工作流、依赖和渲染证据在生成、验证、更新间失去对应，即原型到项目状态漂移。

Method: VisStateCoder是状态感知框架，在Project State Graph中维护对应关系。图通过类型化链接连接四类状态节点，支持原型接地、图引导生成，以及渲染证据引导的定范围更新：将失败检查映射到受影响文件，同时保留更新范围之外的文件。

Result: 在Vision2Web上以五种基础模型评测静态网页、交互前端和全栈网站任务。跨模型平均，相比各模型最强基线，交互前端和全栈网站任务总分分别提升26.1和22.6分；相比其他状态表示，降低已验证状态漂移（某轮通过但后续失败的检查）。50个任务的标注研究显示构建图达到95.6%边级F1。

Conclusion: 通过Project State Graph统一维护原型、代码、工作流与渲染证据的对应，VisStateCoder有效缓解原型到项目状态漂移，并显著提升多类网站生成任务表现。

Abstract: Generating deployable websites from visual prototypes and textual requirements is increasingly feasible with multimodal models, yet keeping generated projects consistent with their prototypes remains challenging. Prototypes specify layouts and visual elements, while requirements describe interaction workflows and deployment constraints. Existing UI-to-code methods and coding agents often treat layout reconstruction, interaction implementation, and project editing separately, allowing visual elements, files, workflows, dependencies, and render evidence to lose their correspondence across generation, verification, and update. We call this problem prototype-to-project state drift. We propose VisStateCoder, a state-aware framework that maintains these correspondences in a Project State Graph. The graph connects four types of state nodes through typed links and supports prototype grounding, graph-guided generation, and render-evidence-guided scoped updates that map failed checks to affected files while preserving files outside the update scope. We evaluate VisStateCoder on Vision2Web using five foundation models across Static Webpage, Interactive Frontend, and Full-Stack Website tasks. Averaged across models, VisStateCoder improves overall scores over the strongest baseline for each model by 26.1 and 22.6 points on Interactive Frontend and Full-Stack Website tasks, respectively. It also reduces verified-state drift, measured by checks that pass in one update round but fail later, compared with alternative state representations. An annotation study of 50 tasks finds that the constructed graphs achieve 95.6% edge-level F1.

</details>


### [1066] [Mobile App Analysis in the New Era: Challenges and the Road Ahead](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17872)
*Jiale Wu,Tianming Liu,Yanjie Zhao,Haoyu Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文从制品层、运行时层、生态层三个层次审视移动应用分析面临的挑战，并指出未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动应用已演变为复杂的多平台系统，支持多样服务并处于不同监管与分发环境中。传统分析技术在保证质量、安全和合规方面虽有基础，但面对移动应用演进日益力不从心。

Method: 提出三层视角：制品层（异构代码库与保护机制降低可分析性）、运行时层（多模态交互、超级应用架构、AI自主运行带来的执行复杂性）、生态层（新兴平台、碎片化分发渠道、区域监管要求）。

Result: 针对每层识别关键挑战并提出潜在研究方向，如框架感知分析、自适应测试、策略感知合规验证；同时讨论大语言模型带来的新分析能力及其引发的安全与隐私担忧。

Conclusion: 文章旨在阐明现有方法的不足，并为这一演进领域的未来研究指明方向。

Abstract: Mobile applications (apps) have grown into complex, multi-platform systems that support diverse services and operate within varying regulatory and distribution contexts. Traditional analysis techniques have established a strong foundation for ensuring quality, security, and compliance, but face increasing challenges as mobile apps evolve. This article presents a three-layer perspective to examine these challenges. The Artifact Layer highlights how heterogeneous code bases and protection mechanisms reduce the analyzability of packaged apps. The Runtime Layer addresses growing execution complexity, from multi-modal interactions and super-app architectures to AI-driven autonomous operations. The Ecosystem Layer considers broader contexts, including emerging platforms, fragmented distribution channels, and region-specific regulatory requirements. New characteristics across these layers interact and compound, creating difficulties that existing approaches are not designed to handle. For each layer, we identify key challenges and potential research directions, including framework-aware analysis, adaptive testing, and policy-aware compliance verification. We also discuss how large language models bring new analytical capabilities to the field, while their integration into apps raises new security and privacy concerns. This article aims to clarify where established methods fall short and highlight directions for future research in this evolving field.

</details>


### [1067] [SpecCloak: Probing Harmful Code Generation through Engineering Specifications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17907)
*Wenbin Chen,Jiexin Wang,Guanting Wu,Jiaxi Liang,Yi Cai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文研究需求陈述形式（工程规格化）如何影响LLM恶意代码生成的拒绝行为，提出PseudoSpec、SpecCloak攻击框架与SpecReveal防御方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代码生成能力可被滥用于实现有害功能，需理解其安全行为；虽已知请求措辞影响拒绝，但编码任务需求的陈述形式是否影响恶意代码生成的拒绝过程尚不清楚。

Method: 提出PseudoSpec模板，将功能需求组织为工程规格，通过受控对比、表征分析与激活干预进行研究；基于此提出结合PseudoSpec与判别器引导优化的黑盒红队框架SpecCloak，以及结合自然语言意图重建与双视角检测的防御原型SpecReveal。

Result: 在五个开源权重模型上，去除显式风险关键词仅部分降低拒绝，而规格化提示即使保留关键词也显著降低拒绝，并伴随向代码输出相关表征的一致偏移；SpecCloak在八个目标模型上于RedCode-Gen实现平均28.91%执行验证攻击成功率；SpecReveal在提示检测评估中达96.88%攻击检测率。

Conclusion: 规格化诱导的响应差异与实战安全后果相关联，意图重建可作为补充性检测方法。

Abstract: The code generation capabilities of large language models (LLMs) can equally be misused to implement harmful functionality, underscoring the need to understand their safety behavior in response to programming requests. While request phrasing is known to influence refusal, it remains unclear whether the form in which coding task requirements are stated affects the refusal process for malicious code generation. We introduce PseudoSpec, a template that organizes functional requirements as engineering specifications, and investigate its effects through controlled comparisons, representation analysis, and activation interventions. Across five open-weight models, removing explicit risk keywords only partially reduces refusal, whereas specification prompting substantially lowers refusal even when these keywords are retained. This reduction accompanies consistent shifts toward code-output-related representations, and interventions along condition-difference directions alter refusal behavior. Output analysis further distinguishes code-related responses from generation degeneration. Building on these findings, we propose SpecCloak, a black-box red-teaming framework combining PseudoSpec with discriminator-guided optimization, achieving an average execution-verified attack success rate of 28.91\% across eight target models on RedCode-Gen. We also introduce SpecReveal, a defense prototype combining natural-language intent reconstruction with dual-view detection without target-model fine-tuning. It achieves a 96.88\% attack detection rate in a separate prompt-detection evaluation, with false positives assessed on benign programming and specification-style inputs. These results connect specification-induced response differences to practical security consequences and identify intent reconstruction as a complementary detection approach.

</details>


### [1068] [SWEPatchTest: Evaluating Software Tests Beyond Reproduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18004)
*Hua Lu,Pengcheng Wang,Han Li,Zichen Tian,Yanyu Chen,Huang He,Bingjin Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 SWEPATCHTEST 基准，联合评估测试套件对缺陷修复补丁的判别能力，揭示单一参考评估掩盖的测试质量问题，并利用其信号改进训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Coding agent 依赖生成的测试判断补丁是否满足 issue 要求，但“缺陷代码失败、参考补丁通过”的测试套件仍可能接受错误补丁或拒绝正确补丁，现有单参考评估无法暴露这一问题。

Method: 构建 SWEPATCHTEST：从 SWE-bench Pro、SWE-bench Multilingual、DeepSWE 收集 619 个任务与 82,579 个候选补丁，在缺陷和已打补丁代码库上重放测试套件，联合衡量 issue 复现、正确补丁接受、错误补丁拒绝三项标准，并提出 Joint Validation Rate (JVR)；同时用验证分数筛选和扩展 SFT 演示。

Result: 最佳配置仅达 9.21% JVR，尽管在 59.29% 任务上复现了参考转换；使用验证分数筛选 SFT 演示后，训练方案将 JVR 提升约三倍，并改善三个 SWE-bench 基准上的下游修复效果。

Conclusion: 补丁判别能力既是测试质量的诊断指标，也是筛选 agent 训练数据的执行级信号。

Abstract: Coding agents use generated tests to decide whether a proposed patch satisfies an issue's requirements. A suite that fails on the buggy program and passes after applying the reference patch can still accept an incorrect patch or reject a correct patch. We introduce SWEPATCHTEST, a test-generation benchmark with 619 tasks from SWE-bench Pro, SWE-bench Multilingual, and DeepSWE and 82,579 candidate patches collected from coding-agent trajectories. By replaying each suite on the buggy and patched codebases, \benchmark jointly measures issue reproduction, acceptance of correct patches, and rejection of incorrect patches. Joint Validation Rate (JVR), which requires all three criteria on the same task, exposes failures hidden by single-reference evaluation: the best-performing configuration achieves only 9.21% JVR despite reproducing the reference transition on 59.29% of tasks. We further use validation scores to select and scale demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). The resulting training recipe approximately triples JVR and improves downstream repair across three SWE-bench benchmarks. Patch discrimination thus provides both a diagnostic measure of test quality and an execution-based signal for curating agent training data.

</details>


### [1069] [Soliduzz: Finding Miscompilations in Smart-Contract Compilers with Assertion-Driven Equivalence Oracles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18165)
*Alexander Stromberger,Christoph Hochrainer,Valentin Wüstholz,Maria Christakis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Soliduzz 通过产品程序将语义等价编码为断言，利用现成 fuzzer 和符号执行引擎在字节码中寻找编译器误编译，在 solc、solx、vyper 上共发现 29 个 bug（24 个编译器 bug、5 个分析工具 bug）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EVM 智能合约管理高价值资产且部署后难修补，编译器误编译（编译成功但字节码不保留源码语义）尤其危险。现有 fuzzer 要么只关注鲁棒性失败，要么依赖比较不同编译器配置的差分预言机。

Method: 提出 Soliduzz，基于断言驱动的等价预言机。用产品程序（product programs）把语义等价编码为可执行断言，编译这些自检程序后交给通用 fuzzer 和符号执行引擎探索字节码中的断言违反，无需分析器提供编译器特定支持。实例化两类变形变换：(1) 从等价表达式出发，提升为刻意使用存储、数据位置、控制流、合约交互和内联汇编等 EVM 特性的代码；(2) 将 Equivalence Modulo Inputs (EMI) 从固定具体输入推广到符号输入空间，用原始计算中被覆盖的路径约束来守卫变换后计算中的变异，从而生成断言成对计算输出相同的产品程序。

Result: 在 solc、solx 和 vyper 三个 EVM 智能合约编译器上使用多个分析工具评估，Soliduzz 共暴露 29 个 bug：其中 24 个为编译器 bug（6 个误编译、17 个内部编译器错误、1 个挂起），另外 5 个为分析工具本身的 bug。

Conclusion: Soliduzz 证明断言驱动的等价预言机可以有效发现 EVM 智能合约编译器的误编译与鲁棒性缺陷，且无需编译器特定支持即可复用现有分析工具，具有良好的通用性与实用性。

Abstract: Smart contracts compiled to the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) can manage high-value assets and are difficult to patch after deployment. Compiler miscompilations are therefore especially dangerous: compilation succeeds, but the generated bytecode does not preserve the semantics of the source program. Existing smart-contract compiler fuzzers either focus on robustness failures or rely on differential oracles that compare compiler configurations.
  We present Soliduzz, an approach for finding miscompilations in EVM smart-contract compilers using assertion-driven equivalence oracles. Soliduzz uses product programs to encode semantic equivalence as executable assertions. The key shift is to compile these self-checking programs and let off-the-shelf fuzzers and symbolic execution engines explore the resulting bytecode for assertion violations, without requiring compiler-specific support from the analyzer.
  Soliduzz instantiates this idea with two complementary families of metamorphic transformations. The first starts from equivalent expressions and lifts them into smart-contract code that deliberately exercises EVM-specific features such as storage, data locations, control flow, contract interactions, and inline assembly. The second generalizes Equivalence Modulo Inputs (EMI) from fixed concrete inputs to symbolic input spaces. Our symbolic EMI records coverage in the original computation and uses it to guard mutations in the transformed computation. Together, these transformations produce product programs that assert that paired computations yield the same outputs.
  We evaluate Soliduzz on three EVM smart-contract compilers (solc, solx, and vyper) using several analysis tools. Overall, Soliduzz exposes 29 bugs. Of these, 24 are compiler bugs: 6 miscompilations, 17 internal compiler errors, and 1 hang. The remaining 5 are bugs in the analysis tools.

</details>


### [1070] [Assessing the Quality of Concrete Scenarios Generated from Scenario Classes for Automated Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18169)
*Lina Putze,Thies de Graaff,Jan Steffen Becker,Christian Neurohr*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出将场景距离度量聚合为质量函数，用于量化自动驾驶具体场景集合的多样性，并证明其性质与实验有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 场景驱动开发是自动驾驶系统的主流方法，具体场景常用于危害分析与验证确认，因此生成场景集合的多样性至关重要，但如何评估其质量尚缺方法。

Method: 在场景类以约束系统形式化、具体场景空间未知的条件下，基于一组期望属性构造质量函数候选（聚合场景距离度量），并给出性质满足性证明；在抽象场景虚拟验证工具链中开展实验。

Result: 质量函数被证明满足既定属性，并通过实验用于比较采样变异方法效果、考察不同场景距离度量的选择以及时间因素对场景集合质量的影响。

Conclusion: 质量函数可有效评估自动驾驶具体场景集合的多样性，具有实际应用价值，可支持采样方法比较与距离度量选择等任务。

Abstract: A scenario-based development approach has become state of the art for automated driving systems. Once a set of scenario classes covering the operational design domain is available, concrete scenarios are generated from these scenario classes, e.g., to be used for hazard analysis and risk assessment or for the system's verification and validation. For such applications, a high diversity among the generated concrete scenarios is paramount. The question arises how the quality of collections of concrete scenarios can be assessed in such a setting. In this work, we aggregate scenario distance measures into so-called quality functions that quantify the diversity of concrete scenario collections in the context of automated driving. In particular, we consider the case where scenario classes are formalized as constraint systems and the associated concrete scenario space is not explicitly known. Based on a set of desired properties we construct candidates for such quality functions and give proofs for their property fulfillment. To show the practical relevance of quality functions, we perform a variety of experiments in the context of an abstract scenario-based virtual verification toolchain for automated driving systems. More specifically, we use quality functions to compare the effectiveness of variation methods for sampling, examine the choice of different scenario distance measures, and investigate the effects of temporal aspects on concrete scenario collection quality.

</details>


### [1071] [SWE-MISBEHAVIOR: Benchmarking and Mitigating Boundary Violations in Software Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18206)
*Do Xuan Trong,Duc Anh Nguyen,Do Xuan Long,Ngoc-Hai Nguyen,Tongyao Zhu,Duy Dinh,Cayden Chik,Cuong Dang,Jiaying Wu,Xuan-Phi Nguyen,Vinh Van Nguyen,Kenji Kawaguchi,Shafiq Joty,Nancy F. Chen,Min-Yen Kan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出SWE-MISBEHAVIOR，首个针对编码智能体越界失调行为的分类与评估框架，并基于发现提出CODE-KIT缓解框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体在自动化软件工程中可能产生越界、破坏环境或违背任务的失调行为，但缺乏系统性的分类与评估手段。

Method: 构建包含7.4K人机协同合成样本的框架，覆盖代码生成、文件管理、系统交互三层动作空间，涵盖11类失调行为及全自动评估协议；并提出CODE-KIT，结合失调感知指南与新工具。

Result: 在OpenHands、smolagents等先进开源编码智能体上发现显著失调行为：依赖误解高达98.5%、意外修改用户输入50.5%、环境完整性被静默破坏53%。

Conclusion: CODE-KIT将smolagents的失调行为降低52%、OpenHands降低34%，同时提升任务完成性能。

Abstract: We present SWE-MISBEHAVIOR, the first taxonomy and evaluation framework for diagnosing boundary-violating misbehaviors in coding agents. It contains 7.4K human-in-the-loop synthesized samples spanning three layers of agent action space: (i) Code Generation, (ii) File Management, and (iii) System Interaction. Across these categories, SWE-MISBEHAVIOR covers 11 distinct misbehaviors with a fully automated evaluation protocol, including coding-action violations, Create/Read/Update/Delete (CRUD) file misbehaviors, system integrity and abuse violations, and task-goal misalignment. Experiments on state-of-the-art open-source coding agents (e.g., OpenHands, smolagents) reveal substantial misaligned behaviors, including dependency misinterpretation (up to 98.5% of cases), unintended modification of user inputs (50.5%), and silent compromise of environment integrity (53%). Motivated by these findings, we further propose CODE-KIT, a lightweight adaptive framework that combines misbehavior-aware guidelines with novel tools to help agents avoid such failures. CODE-KIT reduces misbehaviors by 52% for smolagents and 34% for OpenHands, while simultaneously improving task completion performance.

</details>


### [1072] [DTScribe: Generating Models for Digital Twin Reporting using Local Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18635)
*Kérian Fiter,Angelica Portocarrero,Bentley Oakes*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文探索用大语言模型自动生成数字孪生报告所需的模型，输入孪生文档，输出概念架构可视化与报告页面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字孪生建模与可视化、共识构建过程繁琐耗时，需自动化生成模型以加速报告。

Method: 先从输入中按21特征数字孪生描述框架提取关键信息；再用本体建模语言生成描述模型（模型、数据、使能器、服务星座）；采用LLM作为评判者的精炼循环与本体验证推理提升质量。

Result: 精炼循环使本地中型模型（约200亿参数）达到接近更大模型的质量；发现应避免用LLM做评判者、避免聚类提取特征，并建议至少两轮推理精炼。

Conclusion: 该技术可加速数字孪生报告及其他模型生成任务，并为实践者提供可集成的方法与经验。

Abstract: The development of a digital twin brings together many stakeholders and technical components. We have previously investigated the reporting of the conceptual architecture for these digital twins as an artifact for discussion. However, we find that the activity of modeling the digital twin for visualization and consensus-building can be quite tedious and time-consuming.
  In this article, we explore the automation of model generation using large language models, targeting the model required for digital twin reporting. Our approach is designed to ingest digital twin documents and output both the conceptual architecture visualization and a reporting page for that digital twin. We first extract from the input the key details aligning with our twenty-one-characteristic Digital Twin Description Framework described in previous work. Then, we generate a description model in the Ontological Modeling Language, representing the digital twin as a constellation of models, data, enablers, and services. We utilize refinement loops with large language models acting as judges and ontological reasoning to increase artifact quality as measured by our metrics.
  We investigate how architectural and parameter choices affect artifact quality, such as how refinement loops enable local large language models to produce sufficiently high-quality results comparable to larger models. We also detail insights and lessons learned useful for practitioners, such that they can integrate our techniques to accelerate their digital twin reporting or for other model generation tasks. These insights include the use of medium-sized local models (around 20 billion parameters), the avoidance of large language models as judges and clustering for characteristic extraction, and the recommendation of at least two reasoner loops for Ontological Modeling Language refinement.

</details>


### [1073] [SolBehave: Evaluating the Behavioural Correctness of LLM-Generated Smart Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18745)
*Giovanni Pio Delvecchio,Stefano Fantazzini,Giacomo Frisoni,Gianluca Moro,Lorenzo Bacchiani,Mario Bravetti,Thomas Troels Hildebrandt*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 SolBehave 基准，超越编译成功评估模型生成 Solidity 合约的行为正确性，通过差分模糊测试、历史交易重放与 DCR 图引导的合成交易重放三法衡量，发现编译成功远不等于功能正确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 生成的智能合约一旦部署不可修补，单个潜在缺陷即永久且可被利用；而现有评估多只检查代码能否编译，缺乏系统性的正确性度量，且依赖零散单元测试。

Method: 在 250 个真实可复现以太坊合约上，采用三种互补的行为保真测试：(1) 差分模糊测试，比较每个生成函数与原函数在自动输入下的行为；(2) 历史交易重放，用合约实际收到的链上交易比较整体行为；(3) 核心贡献——DCR 图引导的合成交易重放，枚举合法函数调用序列，包括链上从未出现的顺序。共评估七个先进开源权重模型，并各进行一轮自动修复。

Result: 编译成功率在 26.4%–92.7% 之间；但差分模糊测试下，跨模型与样本汇总，仅 31.4% 的编译通过函数体与原函数等价。合约级分歧是常态：七个模型中六个在历史重放下有 13%–31% 的编译通过合约与原合约行为分歧，DCR 引导重放下为 13%–44%；仅 Gemma-4-31B 在两个测试中均低于 3%。

Conclusion: 编译成功是正确性的必要条件而非充分条件；评估 LLM 生成的智能合约必须纳入行为级正确性测试。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly generate Solidity smart contracts that, once deployed, can never be patched, making a single latent fault permanent and exploitable. Yet current evaluations mostly ask only whether generated code compiles. We introduce SolBehave, a benchmark for evaluating the correctness of model-generated contracts at scale, moving beyond ad hoc unit tests. Across 250 real, reproducible Ethereum contracts, we apply three complementary tests of behavioural fidelity: differential fuzzing, historical-transaction replay, and, as our core contribution, synthetic-transaction replay guided by a Dynamic Condition Response (DCR) graph that enumerates the space of legitimate function-call sequences. Differential fuzzing compares each generated function with the original on automatically generated inputs; historical replay compares the whole contract on the transactions it actually received on-chain; DCR-guided replay compares it on sequences of calls that follow its intended usage, including orderings that never occurred on-chain. We evaluate seven state-of-the-art open-weight models after one round of automated repair. Compilation success ranges from 26.4% to 92.7%, but under differential fuzzing only 31.4% of all generated function bodies that compile, pooled over models and samples, are equivalent to the original. Divergence at the contract level is the norm rather than the exception: for six of the seven models, between 13% and 31% of the generated contracts that compile diverge from the original under historical replay, and between 13% and 44% under DCR-guided replay; only Gemma-4-31B stays below 3% on both. Compilation is therefore a necessary condition for correctness and far from a sufficient one.

</details>


### [1074] [PreciseCoder: Faithful and Generalizable Debugging Beyond Unit-Test Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18755)
*Yunkai Zhan,Miaosen Chai,Shangshang Wang,Jike Zhong,Yuqing Yang,Deqing Fu,Serina Chang,Wang Bill Zhu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 单元测试奖励虽提升通过率，却使模型过度编辑并幻觉出正确代码中的bug。PreciseCoder通过加入语义验证的局部编辑信号，显著减少编辑行数（7-15降至3）且保持通过率，并能泛化到仓库级修复，提升精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码模型后训练普遍依赖单元测试奖励，但该奖励只关心最终程序是否通过，忽视调试过程质量，导致模型倾向于多编辑、在正确代码中幻觉bug。

Method: PreciseCoder在单元测试奖励基础上，增加一个对语义验证、局部化编辑的信号，引导模型进行更小、更精准的修改。

Result: 在4B、9B、27B模型上，平均编辑行数从7-15降至3，通过率与仅用单元测试训练相当；仅用单行bug训练即可泛化到仓库级修复，用更小补丁解决更多问题；9B模型的推理轨迹可让GPT-5.6 Sol、Qwen3.8-Max等前沿模型编辑精度提升4.6-12.4分。

Conclusion: 引入精确、局部化的编辑奖励能有效改善代码调试行为，提升编辑精度并具良好泛化与迁移能力，语言分析显示该奖励促使模型形成逐行、一致的bug假设。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) from unit tests is the common recipe for post-training code models, but a unit test only asks whether the final program passes. We analyze what this unit-test-only reward teaches a model during debugging and find that, while it raises pass rates, it also teaches the model to edit more and to hallucinate bugs in code that is already correct. We introduce PreciseCoder, a training algorithm that augments the unit-test reward with a signal for semantically verified, localized edits, which correlates with smaller edits and higher pass rates. On 4B, 9B, and 27B models, PreciseCoder reduces the average number of edit lines from 7-15to 3 at a pass rate on par with unit-test-only training. Trained only on single-line bugs, PreciseCoder can generalize to repository-level program repair, where it resolves more issues with smaller patches. Its precision also transfers from weaker to stronger models: given the reasoning trace of a 9B PreciseCoder model, frontier models such as GPT-5.6 Sol and Qwen3.8-Max gain 4.6-12.4 points in edit precision with no additional training. Linguistic analysis of the thinking traces shows that our reward encourages the model to reason about individual lines, name the buggy ones, and form consistent bug hypotheses.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [1075] [Simple Linear Corrections for Compression in Late Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14196)
*Mihir Agarwal,Sabyasachi Basu,Viraj Agrawal*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量的评分函数线性校正方法，以恢复Late-interaction多向量检索模型在文档向量压缩后损失的检索质量，无需重训编码器或重压缩文档。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Late-interaction（多向量）模型在质量与成本间取得折中，但索引存储和打分代价高。池化/剪枝等压缩技术虽有帮助，但激进压缩会显著降低质量，作者希望用轻量方式弥补这一损失。

Method: 对每种编码器、压缩器、向量预算组合，通过蒸馏未压缩模型在候选文档上的分数分布，学习一个全局线性校正。编码器与压缩器保持冻结，校正可在检索时逐查询应用，或离线一次性作用于存储向量。

Result: 在MS MARCO、BEIR上以ColBERTv2和Jina v4评测，在ViDoRe v3视觉文档检索上以ColPali2评测，覆盖四种免训练压缩方法、多种向量预算、域内适配及MS MARCO到BEIR的迁移。域内设置下在160个BEIR场景中154个优于基线；迁移效果因模型和数据集而异；合成查询训练矩阵可提升ViDoRe v3表现。

Conclusion: 小型学习式校正能在不重训编码器、不重压缩文档的前提下，恢复部分因压缩损失的质量，是一种低成本有效的补偿方案。

Abstract: Late-interaction (multi-vector) models represent documents using a set of token-level vectors, providing a middle ground between cross-encoders and dense encoders in terms of quality and cost of embedding. However, compared to the latter, the indices are costly to store and score. Pooling and pruning based compression techniques are deployed widely but deteriorate in quality noticeably with aggressive compression. We investigate whether a lightweight change to the scoring function can recover retrieval quality after document-vector compression. For each combination of encoder, compressor, and vector budget, we learn a global linear correction by distilling the uncompressed model's score distributions over candidate documents. The encoder and compressor remain frozen, and the correction can be applied to each query at search time or once, offline, to the stored vectors.
  We evaluate the method with ColBERTv2 and Jina v4 on MS MARCO and BEIR, and with ColPali2 on the ViDoRe v3 visual document retrieval benchmark. Experiments cover four training-free compression methods, multiple vector budgets, in-domain adaptation, and transfer from MS MARCO to BEIR. In the in-domain setting, the correction improves over baseline compression in 154 of 160 BEIR settings, while transfer from MS MARCO is more variable across models and datasets. We also find that matrices trained with synthetic queries can improve over baseline compression on ViDoRe v3. These results show that a small learned correction can recover some of the quality lost to compression without retraining the encoder or recompressing the documents.

</details>


### [1076] [Understanding and Mitigating Training Instability in Large-Scale Recommender Systems: A Cascade Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14394)
*Yuening Li,Zeyu Wang,Zhen Zhang,Jiayi Liu,Zhimeng Jiang,Yuji Roh,Weikai Xu,Mingyan Gao,Onkar Dalal,Chuan He,Liang Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文系统分析工业短视频推荐系统训练中的梯度-权重-损失(G-W-L)级联发散问题，并提出将干预措施映射到级联各阶段的缓解框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模动态推荐平台(如日交互数十亿的短视频服务)面临用户数据快速分布漂移和模型复杂度提升带来的训练稳定性挑战，常触发以梯度爆炸为起点、传播至权重爆炸、最终损失爆炸的G-W-L级联，严重阻碍模型收敛与性能。

Method: 在工业短视频推荐场景下系统分析G-W-L级联机制，并提出结构化缓解框架，将干预措施显式映射到级联各阶段：梯度(G)控制、权重/激活(W)稳定、损失(L)塑形。

Result: 在大型工业短视频推荐系统上对上述策略进行了实证验证，证明其有效性。

Conclusion: 提供了一个理解和应对训练发散的结构化框架，为在大规模非平稳环境下部署稳健、持续更新的推荐系统提供实践洞见。

Abstract: Training large-scale recommender systems on dynamic industrial platforms, such as Short-Form Video (SFV) services with billions of daily interactions, faces critical stability challenges. Rapid distribution shifts in user data and increasing model complexity frequently trigger a divergence cascade, typically initiating with gradient explosion, propagating to weight explosion, and culminating in loss explosion. This G-W-L cascade severely impedes model convergence and performance. This paper provides a systematic analysis of this G-W-L cascade within an industrial SFV recommender context. We then propose and evaluate a structured mitigation framework where interventions are explicitly mapped to counteract specific stages of the cascade: gradient (G) control, weight/activation (W) stabilization, and loss (L) shaping. Our contribution provides a structured framework for understanding and tackling training divergence, offering practical insights for deploying robust, continuously updated recommenders in large-scale, non-stationary settings. We empirically validate the effectiveness of these strategies on a major industrial SFV recommendation system.

</details>


### [1077] [Co-adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining for Structured Knowledge Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14465)
*Zhisheng Qi,Haoyu Han,Jiaxi Li,Bing He,Huiyuan Chen,Franck Dernoncourt,Ryan A. Rossi,Mahantesh M. Halappanavar,Jin Lu,Yu Zhang,Tianming Liu,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 CoRE 框架，无需预定义 query-rule 监督，通过路由与检索的闭环协同适应实现结构化知识检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化知识检索依赖无约束检索或预定义查询-规则监督（如作者-论文、解剖-药物规则），而这类监督在实践中很难获得。

Method: CoRE 联合学习为每个查询分配推理规则及在该规则下检索证据。路由 agent 选择规则，对应 retriever 遍历知识库并排序满足规则约束的证据；通过交替进行路由策略的强化学习与规则约束检索器的对比学习，实现闭环协同适应。

Result: 在 STaRK-QA 数据集（科学发现、生物医学推理、电商知识管理）上验证有效性；消融实验显示路由与检索协同适应的收益；基于生成的 routing 可跨数据集迁移，并受益于多域预训练加目标微调。

Conclusion: CoRE 无需显式 query-rule 监督即可协调查询路由与检索，规则使用分析还可支持规则的自动精炼与发现。

Abstract: Structured knowledge retrieval acquires task-relevant evidence from structured knowledge sources for downstream tasks. Existing methods rely on unconstrained retrieval or predefined query-rule supervision, such as author-paper rules for scientific discovery and anatomy-drug rules for precision medicine. Such supervision is rarely available in practice. We propose Co-Adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining Retrieval (CoRE), which jointly learns which reasoning rule to assign to each query and how to retrieve evidence under that rule, without predefined query-rule pairs. A routing agent selects a rule, and its corresponding retriever traverses the knowledge base and ranks evidence that satisfies the rule's constraints. Because routing and retrieval are interdependent, CoRE alternates between reinforcement learning for the routing policy and contrastive learning for the rule-constrained retriever. The selected rules provide supervision for retriever training, while retrieval performance rewards the routing policy. This closed-loop process enables both components to co-adapt without explicit query-rule supervision. Experiments on STaRK-QA datasets across scientific discovery, biomedical reasoning, and e-commerce knowledge management demonstrate CoRE's effectiveness. Ablations show the benefit of co-adapting the router and retriever. Generation-based routing transfers across datasets and benefits from multi-domain pretraining followed by target-specific fine-tuning. Analysis of rule usage across queries also informs automatic rule refinement and discovery.

</details>


### [1078] [EVISTA: Unified Multimodal Video Search with Evidence-Aware Temporal Path Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14510)
*Minh-Huy Tran,Van-Thinh Vo,Minh-Khoi Nguyen,Duy-Tan Nguyen,Anh-Quan Nguyen-Tran,Loi Nguyen Khanh*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出EVISTA多模态视频检索系统及TEMPO-P证据感知时序路径优化方法，用于同一视频中多事件的按时序检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大数据时代从大规模视频中精确检索事件愈发重要且困难，尤其当同一视频的不同事件由视觉、屏幕文字、语音等不同证据类型描述时，独立事件检索存在漏检、时序不一致等问题。

Method: EVISTA整合视觉-语义、OCR、ASR、物体和元数据检索于共享关键帧索引；TEMPO-P聚合跨事件与模态的候选视频，联合视觉/OCR/ASR证据对关键帧打分，并用动态规划选取紧凑的时序有序路径。

Result: 在5个官方查询和36个额外多事件查询上，TEMPO-P在视觉描述事件上与纯视觉时序对齐持平（R@1均为0.42），并能检索含文字定义事件的查询（R@1 0.38），这是纯视觉对齐无法表示的。

Conclusion: TEMPO-P作为有序事件检索模式集成进EVISTA，验证了证据感知时序路径优化在多模态有序事件检索中的有效性。

Abstract: In the era of big data, precise event retrieval from large video collections has become increasingly important and challenging. In particular, locating multiple events from the same video in their temporal order is difficult when different events are described by different types of evidence, such as visual content, on-screen text, and spoken words. We develop EVISTA, a unified multimodal video retrieval system for the Ho Chi Minh City AI Challenge 2026, which integrates visual-semantic, OCR, ASR, object, and metadata search over a shared keyframe index, and propose TEMPO-P, an evidence-aware temporal path optimization method for ordered multi-event retrieval. Building EVISTA for this task reveals two limitations of independent event retrieval: a relevant video may be missed when one event is weakly retrieved, and independently retrieved event candidates may be temporally inconsistent or unable to represent events defined primarily by text or speech. TEMPO-P addresses these limitations by aggregating candidate videos across events and modalities, jointly scoring keyframes using visual, OCR, and ASR evidence, and selecting a compact temporally ordered path within each video through dynamic programming. On five organizer queries and 36 additional multi-event queries, TEMPO-P matches visual-only temporal alignment on visually described events (R@1 0.42 for both) and retrieves queries containing text-defined events, which visual-only alignment cannot represent (R@1 0.38). TEMPO-P is integrated into EVISTA as its ordered-event retrieval mode.

</details>


### [1079] [LLM-based User-Product Relevance Evaluation for Dynamic Product Advertising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14550)
*Wen Zhang,Xiao Bai,Hsiang-wei Chao,Mengfan Zhu,Tong Zhao,Mingxuan Ju,Xiaodong Liu,Congfei Zhang,Yunzhi Zhou,Yajun Wang,Jinchao Li,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向DPA检索系统的用户-商品相关性离线评估指标，通过意图代表压缩与LLM智能体评判框架实现稳定、可解释且与业务指标强相关的评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPA检索系统评估困难：传统离线参与度指标反馈稀疏且有偏，而在线评估成本高、耗时长。

Method: 先将用户参与历史通过"语义ID分组、事件分层"分割压缩为紧凑的意图代表集；再评估推荐商品与各意图的相关性并聚合成用户级相关性分数。为规模化计算，利用LLM作为语义相关性评判器，提出智能体式、对齐人类的提示框架，生成多类别相关性准则，并将教师模型判断蒸馏到高效学生模型。

Result: 该指标与离线及在线业务指标强相关。

Conclusion: 该指标可在A/B测试前实现更快、更可靠的DPA检索迭代。

Abstract: Dynamic Product Advertising (DPA) retrieval systems are a core component of modern e-commerce advertising; however, their evaluation remains challenging. Conventional offline engagement metrics are limited by sparse, biased feedback, while online evaluation is costly and time-consuming. In this work, we propose a user--product relevance metric for offline evaluation of DPA retrieval systems. The metric first compresses the engagement history into a compact set of intent representatives via Semantic-ID-grouped, event-stratified segmentation, then assesses the relevance of a recommended product to each individual intent and aggregates them as a user-level relevance score, yielding a stable and interpretable measure of retrieval quality. To compute this metric at scale, we leverage large language models (LLMs) as semantic relevance judges, capturing nuanced functional and semantic relationships that heuristic methods often miss. We propose an agentic, human-aligned prompting framework that generates multi-category relevance guidelines and distills teacher-model judgments into an efficient student model for scalable evaluation.
