TL;DR: 本文研究多组学习中能否仅通过加权ERM oracle达到最优样本复杂度，给出使用Õ((d_G+d_H)/ε²)样本且多项式次oracle调用的算法，并证明匹配下界；在每组样本属于至多k组的特例下，仅需假设类ERM oracle。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多组学习最优样本复杂度算法需记录每个(组,假设)对，对大规模类不可行；oracle型算法速率更差。因此作者追问：仅通过ERM oracle能否达到最优速率。

Method: 提出一种算法，仅通过加权ERM oracle访问(组,假设)对，样本量为Õ((d_G+d_H)/ε²)，oracle调用次数为多项式级。另针对每个输入属于至多k个可列举组的特例，仅使用假设类的ERM oracle。

Result: 算法达到Õ((d_G+d_H)/ε²)样本、多项式次oracle调用；证明即使无限计算也需Ω((d_G+d_H)/ε²)样本的匹配下界。特例下：agnostic需Õ((d_H+log k)/ε²)，每组存在正确假设时需Õ((d_H+log k)/ε)样本。

Conclusion: oracle效率不带来额外样本代价，ERM oracle足以达到多组学习最优速率；在重叠度受限的特例中甚至只需假设类的ERM oracle。

Abstract: In multi-group learning, a single predictor must perform nearly as well as the best hypothesis in a class on every group in a rich, possibly infinite and overlapping, collection of subpopulations. The known algorithms with the optimal sample complexity keep track of every pair of a group and a hypothesis, which is impossible for the large classes of interest, and the known oracle-based algorithms have a worse rate. We ask whether the optimal rate can be attained by a learner that accesses the classes only through an empirical risk minimization (ERM) oracle. We give an algorithm that uses $\tilde{O}((d_G+d_H)/\varepsilon^2)$ samples and polynomially many calls to a weighted ERM oracle over pairs of a group and a hypothesis, where $d_G$ and $d_H$ are the VC dimensions of the group and hypothesis classes and $\varepsilon$ bounds the excess risk on every group, weighted by its probability. We also show a matching lower bound of $Ω((d_G+d_H)/\varepsilon^2)$ samples for every learner even with unlimited computation, so oracle efficiency costs no additional samples. We also consider a natural special case in which every input belongs to at most $k$ groups and these groups can be listed. In this case, an ERM oracle for the hypothesis class alone suffices, with $\tilde{O}((d_H+\log k)/\varepsilon^2)$ samples in the agnostic setting and $\tilde{O}((d_H+\log k)/\varepsilon)$ samples when every group has a hypothesis that is correct on it.

</details>


### [1154] [Contrastive Covariance Subspaces for Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14025)
*Alexandros Xenos,Manos Plitsis,Niki Foteinopoulou,Yannis Panagakis,Ioannis Patras*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Contrastive Covariance Steering (CCS)，一种无需训练的方法，通过投影到对比方差目标求解的低维子空间来去除激活引导向量中的混淆因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活引导依赖纯目标概念方向的向量，但该方向常与无关主题或写作风格等混淆因素纠缠，污染残差流并降低生成质量。

Method: CCS 通过求解对比方差目标，以闭式解获得低维子空间，将引导向量投影其中，保留目标概念变化方向、抑制与其他类别共享的方向。

Result: 在3个LLM和4个引导领域的全部12个设置中均优于所有基线；在AxBench和Emotion上相对次强基线提升48%-70%和13%-27%，比朴素均值差引导最高提升151%。玩具实验验证去除混淆动机，23名评审的人类研究复现LLM评判排名，并支持多轮对话。

Conclusion: CCS 有效去混淆，稳定提升引导效果与鲁棒性，并可扩展至多轮对话，保持概念表达与流畅度。

Abstract: Activation steering controls large language model behavior by adding a direction to hidden activations during inference. For steering to work well, that direction must be a pure signal for the target concept: any confound entangled with it, such as an incidental topic or writing style, is injected into the residual stream alongside the concept itself and degrades the generated text. We introduce Contrastive Covariance Steering (CCS), a training-free method that eliminates this confound variation. CCS projects steering vectors to a low-dimensional subspace obtained in closed form by solving a contrastive variance objective, which retains the directions along which the target concept varies while suppressing directions shared with the other classes. Across three LLMs and four steering domains, CCS consistently beats all baseline steering methods in all $12$ model-domain settings. The largest relative improvement occurs on AxBench and Emotion where we outperform the next strongest steering baseline by $48$ to $70\%$ and $13$ to $27\%$, respectively. Furthermore, CCS outperforms naive difference-of-means steering by up to $151\%$, showcasing the importance of deconfounding concepts. A toy experiment verifies our motivation on why: planting a topic nuisance into the training data reduces unprojected steering by $46\%$, whereas CCS loses only $12\%$ and recovers most of the gap to an oracle that explicitly deletes the planted direction. A human study with $23$ raters on $296$ generations reproduces the LLM judge's ranking. Our extensive ablation verifies the importance of our method's components and robustness to the number of nuisance classes. Finally, we extend our method to multi-turn conversations, where CCS sustains both concept expression and fluency, matching system prompt performance as other steering methods drift.

</details>


### [1155] [DiffNash: Finding Nash Equilibrium in High-Dimensional Continuous Action Spaces with Diffusion Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15932)
*Haichuan Wang,Anagha Satish,Jiale Zheng,Saisneha Ghatti,Lingkai Kong,Kai Wang,Milind Tambe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于扩散模型的博弈均衡求解框架 DiffNash，结合 OMD 的快速收敛与 FP 的样本效率，通过重加权 score-matching 与 ELBO 差的无偏估计解决分布漂移，显著降低 Nash gap。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维连续博弈的均衡计算需学习多模态策略分布，传统神经策略难以表达；扩散模型天然适合，但标准扩散训练需从固定目标分布直接采样，而迭代博弈求解中该分布不断更新、无法获得直接样本。

Method: 推导重加权 score-matching 目标，无需从每次更新后的策略直接采样即可训练扩散策略；提出 DiffNash，融合 OMD 的快速收敛与 FP 的样本效率，通过 replay buffer 复用历史动作；为校正样本复用带来的分布漂移，推导当前与历史策略 ELBO 差的无偏估计，其指数作为重要性权重的可处理代理，避免计算扩散似然。

Result: 在森林保护博弈与连续 Colonel Blotto 博弈上，Nash gap 分别相对最强基线降低 35.6% 与 24.7%，且超参数调优需求极少。

Conclusion: 扩散模型可用于迭代博弈求解中的均衡计算，无需直接目标分布样本；重加权目标与 ELBO 差估计有效缓解分布漂移，DiffNash 在多类连续博弈中表现出色。

Abstract: Computing equilibria in high-dimensional continuous games requires learning and representing rich, multi-modal strategy distributions, something conventional neural policies struggle to achieve. Diffusion models offer a natural solution, but standard diffusion training requires direct samples from a fixed target distribution, which are generally unavailable under iterative game-solving updates. We propose a diffusion-based framework for equilibrium computation that enables diffusion-based variants of Online Mirror Descent (OMD) and Fictitious Play (FP). Our approach derives a reweighted score-matching objective that trains diffusion policies without requiring direct samples from each updated policy. Our main method, DiffNash, combines the fast convergence of OMD with the sample efficiency of FP by reusing past actions through a replay buffer. To correct the resulting distribution shift from sample reuse, we derive an unbiased estimator of the difference between current and past policies' Evidence Lower Bounds, whose exponential provides a tractable proxy for the corresponding importance weight without evaluating diffusion likelihoods. We evaluate our approach on forest protection games and continuous Colonel Blotto games, reducing the Nash gap over the strongest baseline by 35.6% and 24.7%, respectively, with minimal hyperparameter tuning.

</details>


### [1156] [Pick the Mixture, Not the Samples: Combinatorial Data Selection for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14028)
*Luyang Zhang,Jialu Wang,Bebei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将LLM微调的数据选择形式化为组合数据选择(CDS)问题，提出Mixture-then-Select两阶段算法，先分配各域采样量再域内排序，实验超越强基线20-54%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实训练数据池来自多个不同域，评估跨多样任务，同一样本对不同任务贡献不同，且样本间存在交互，子集价值非各样本价值之和。现有数据选择方法基本忽视这些现实问题。

Method: 提出CDS框架，将归因(样本打分)与选择(挑选子集)分离，并建模样本间非加性交互。基于发现的跨域互补性与域内冗余，提出Mixture-then-Select两阶段算法：先决定每域采样数量，再在域内按归因分数排序选取。框架还扩展到预算约束下样本价格变化的数据购买问题。

Result: 理论证明与最优子集的差距随选择规模线性增长且与数据池规模无关。实验中Mixture-then-Select超越强基线20-54%，对不同归因方法、不同模型和数据池规模均鲁棒。

Conclusion: 跨域分配选择为现代LLM更高效有效的数据选择提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: Data selection for LLM fine-tuning faces two facts about real training: data pools draw from many distinct domains, and evaluation spans diverse tasks. As a result, the same sample helps different tasks differently, and samples interact during training so that a subset's value is not the sum of its parts. Current data-selection methods leave these realities largely unaddressed. We formalize them as Combinatorial Data Selection (CDS), a framework that separates attribution (how samples are scored) from selection (which subset to pick) and models the non-additive interactions among samples. On a real instruction-tuning data pool, we find substantial cross-domain complementarity (joint utility exceeds the sum of singletons), alongside redundancy within domains. Inspired by this, we propose Mixture-then-Select, a two-stage algorithm that first decides how many samples to take from each domain, then ranks samples within each domain by attribution score. Theoretically, the gap to the optimal subset is linear in the selection size and independent of data pool size. Empirically, Mixture-then-Select outperforms strong baselines by 20 to 54%, is robust across attribution methods, and works across different models and data pool sizes. The framework also extends to the data purchasing problem under a budget constraint when sample prices vary. Our findings suggest that allocating selection across domains offers a promising path toward more efficient and effective data selection for modern LLMs.

</details>


### [1157] [Exact power indices for plurality-voting ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17980)
*Ilie Sarpe,Theofanis Georgakopoulos,Aristides Gionis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ENPOWER方法，利用Banzhaf和Shapley权力指数解决多数投票集成中的归因问题，在二分类下线性时间精确计算，多分类下低阶多项式时间，并应用于集成剪枝和视觉语言模型集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数投票集成虽规则简单，但单个基分类器对集成预测的影响依赖与其他分类器的交互（如打破平局），难以直接归因。现有方法无法刻画这种交互影响。

Method: 借助合作博弈论中的Banzhaf和Shapley权力指数，构建建模多数投票与随机打破平局的新博弈（覆盖二分类与多分类）。提出ENPOWER方法，基于新的组合公式：二分类给出闭式解，多分类采用普通生成函数表示，实现精确计算。

Result: ENPOWER可在二分类下线性时间、多分类下低阶多项式时间精确计算Banzhaf和Shapley值；实验验证其高适用性，并提供现有方法无法捕获的归因值。

Conclusion: ENPOWER能高效精确归因多数投票集成中各基分类器的贡献，成功应用于集成剪枝与视觉语言模型的提示集成。

Abstract: Plurality-voting ensembles aggregate the predictions of multiple base classifiers and output the most voted class, with ties typically broken at random. Despite the simple aggregation rule, attributing the impact of each base classifier to the ensemble's predictions is far from straightforward. That is, a single base classifier's impact depends on how it interacts with the votes of all other classifiers in the ensemble, for example, in resolving ties, and not only on its own predictions. We address the attribution problem using established tools from cooperative game theory, studying the Banzhaf and Shapley power indices for new games modeling plurality voting and random tie-breaking, for binary and multiclass classification settings. Computing power indices is, in general, intractable. Surprisingly, our methods, collectively named ENPOWER, enable the exact computation of Banzhaf and Shapley values in linear time for the binary classification setting and in low-degree polynomial time for the multiclass setting. The algorithms in ENPOWER rely on new combinatorial formulations of the Banzhaf and Shapley indices, yielding closed-form solutions for the binary case and ordinary generating function representations for the multiclass case. We validate empirically the methods in ENPOWER demonstrating their high applicability, providing attribution values not captured by existing methods. We apply the attribution of ENPOWER to: ensemble pruning and prompt-based ensembling of vision-language models.

</details>


### [1158] [Can We Trust This Evaluation? Instance-Level Reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14029)
*Yang Ba,Michelle V. Mancenido,Rong Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SCUR，一种无标签方法，基于评审面板行为估计实例级评估可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-as-a-judge常用多数投票聚合多评委决策，但该面板决策无法保证单个条目的评估可靠。

Method: 以潜在测量模型为骨干进行测量系统分析，SCUR从中导出三种互补信号——面板不确定性、测量交叉熵、扰动敏感性，并组合成风险分数。

Result: 在五个真实基准上以多数投票错误排序、选择性信任和风险分层进行评估，并证明该方法更擅长检测高共识风险条目（其他方法的盲区）。

Conclusion: SCUR提供无标签的实例级评估可靠性估计，能有效识别高共识风险条目。

Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation commonly aggregates multiple judges' decisions into a majority vote, yet this panel decision process does not guarantee that the evaluation of an individual item is reliable. We propose Structured Cross-fitted Uncertainty Risk (SCUR), a label-free approach for estimating instance-level evaluation reliability based on the judge panel's behavior. A latent measurement model serves as the backbone for measurement system analysis, from which SCUR derives three complementary signals capturing panel uncertainty, measurement cross-entropy, and perturbation sensitivity. These three sources of evidence are combined into a risk score. We evaluate the SCUR approach on five real-world benchmarks using majority-vote error ranking, selective trust, and risk stratification. Furthermore, we show our approach to be more effective at detecting high-consensus risk items, which are the blind spots for many other LLM-as-a-judge evaluation methods.

</details>


### [1159] [Rotate the Loop: Blockwise Conformality for Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14030)
*Alexey Zemtsov,Albina Klepach,Vadim Lomshakov,Andrei Polubarov,Nikita Lyubaykin,Alexander Derevyagin,Vladislav Kurenkov,Alexander Nikulin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 循环Transformer通过共享块复用实现运行时深度，其状态追踪能力取决于循环步间残差线性映射的几何形式；本文提出分块保角注入，使每组坐标拥有独立时间尺度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer是否能在多步循环中保留并读取先前写入的状态，取决于循环步间施加于残差的线性映射。现有机制可能无法在长程上维持可追踪的状态，因此需要从几何角度理解并改进该映射。

Method: 提出分块保角注入（blockwise conformal injections）：将残差拆分为按坐标对齐的若干组，在每组内部进行旋转式变换，使每组拥有各自的时间尺度，同时在组内保持几何精确性。

Result: 在严苛的状态追踪任务（前缀已正确情况下的末token准确率）以及语言建模任务（需在序列末尾检索早期写入的信号）上均取得性能提升。

Conclusion: 循环式学习是否学会追踪状态本质上是一个关于残差线性映射形式的几何问题；分块保角注入通过赋予各组独立时间尺度，有效提升了状态追踪与语言建模表现。

Abstract: Looped transformers reuse one shared block across many recurrent steps, so depth becomes a quantity that can be spent at runtime rather than a stack of distinct layers. Those extra steps help only if a write made on one recurrent step is still readable on later ones, and that depends on the linear map applied to the residual between recurrent steps. We show that whether the loop learns to track state is a geometric question about the form of this map, and we propose blockwise conformal injections: the residual splits into coordinate-aligned groups and rotates inside each one, so every group has its own timescale while the geometry stays exact within it. Our experiments show a performance increase on a demanding form of state tracking - last-token accuracy when the rest of the prefix is already correct - and on language modelling, where a signal written earlier has to be retrieved at the end of the sequence.

</details>


### [1160] [PLDiv: Measuring Dataset Diversity and Semantic Collapse via Persistence Landscapes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14031)
*Yang Ba,Michelle V. Mancenido,Rong Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PLDiv，一种基于持久景观（persistence landscapes）的多样性度量，从几何表示量化数据集的结构组织，无需任务监督，可有效检测语义坍塌并支持数据监控、构建、增强和模型评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代数据管道混合人创、人审和AI生成数据，数据集增长时常加入语义冗余样本而非扩展语义覆盖，损害整体质量。现有多样性指标主要总结词汇变化、熵或成对相似度，对底层数据分布形状的表征有限。

Method: PLDiv基于持久景观（persistence landscapes）推导，从数据集的几何表示刻画其结构组织。它总结数据邻域随邻近样本逐步连接而演变的过程，产生一个可解释的结构多样性标量度量，且无需任务特定的监督。

Result: 无论测量文本生成或图像嵌入的内在多样性，还是检测指令数据集与推理轨迹中的语义坍塌，PLDiv在评估基线中表现具有竞争力，并在语义坍塌时与多样性标签高度一致。

Conclusion: PLDiv能有效支持合成数据监控、数据集构建、数据增强和生成模型评估等应用。

Abstract: Modern data pipelines increasingly combine human-created and human-curated data with AI-generated data for model training and evaluation. As datasets grow, they often add semantically redundant samples rather than expanding semantic coverage, which deteriorates the quality of the whole dataset. Existing diversity metrics primarily summarize lexical variation, entropy, or pairwise similarity, but provide limited characterization of the shape of the underlying data distribution. In this paper, we propose PLDiv, a diversity metric derived from persistence landscapes that quantifies the structural organization of a dataset from its geometric representation. PLDiv summarizes how data neighborhoods evolve as nearby samples progressively connect, producing an interpretable scalar measure of structural diversity without requiring task-specific supervision. Whether measuring intrinsic diversity in text generations or image embeddings, or detecting semantic collapse in instruction datasets and reasoning trajectories, PLDiv performs competitively against evaluated baselines and aligns strongly with diversity labels during semantic collapse. Consequently, it effectively supports applications in synthetic data monitoring, dataset construction, data augmentation, and generative model evaluation.

</details>


### [1161] [A Geometric Perspective on Reward Function Updates in Inverse Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14041)
*Anish Diwan,Jan Peters,Oleg Arenz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从占据空间视角分析逆强化学习(IRL)的奖励更新，提出用占据轨迹上的平均Fisher信息预条件对偶梯度，得到类似自然梯度的凸插值更新，并从镜像下降角度给出收敛性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典IRL用拉格朗日优化求解，但基于梯度的奖励更新忽略了占据空间中问题的几何结构，只提供了部分图景。

Method: 利用最优解及其占据空间几何已知的洞察，分析沿占据空间e-测地线(占据空间直线)的几何如何影响IRL对偶问题的梯度；据此用占据轨迹上的平均Fisher信息预条件对偶梯度，得到对旧奖励与新目标奖励的凸插值更新；再从镜像下降(MD)视角分析这些更新。

Result: 预条件梯度等价于旧奖励与新目标奖励的凸插值，形成高效的自然梯度式更新且计算开销极小；在结果奖励上的策略搜索诱导出策略上的近似熵镜像下降。

Conclusion: 给出了这类几何感知IRL算法的收敛性结果。

Abstract: Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) is classically solved using Lagrangian optimisation, by jointly optimising a primal-dual problem with gradient descent to obtain the optimal reward function parameters and corresponding optimal policy. While this algorithmic view of IRL has been highly influential, gradient-based reward updates only paint a partial picture, largely ignoring the geometry of the problem in occupancy space. In this paper, we present an occupancy-space view of reward updates in IRL. We leverage the insight that both the optimal solution and its geometry in occupancy space are known, and show that the geometry along the e-geodesic (straight line in occupancy space) toward the optimal occupancy directly affects the gradient of the IRL dual problem in reward parameter space. This perspective naturally suggests preconditioning the dual gradient with the average Fisher information along the occupancy trajectory. We show that this preconditioned gradient is just a convex interpolation of the old reward and a new target reward, yielding efficient natural-gradient-style updates with little additional computational overhead. We then analyse these occupancy-space reward updates from a Mirror Descent (MD) perspective, and show that policy search over the resulting rewards induces approximate entropic MD on the policy. Finally, we conclude with convergence results of such geometry-aware IRL algorithms.

</details>


### [1162] [Auditing LLM Program Search for Bermudan Stopping with Primal--Dual Certificates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14063)
*Yuhua Qian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究LLM程序搜索在Bermudan期权最优停止问题上的有效性，发现生成程序未能持续超越Ridge LSMC基准，且搜索是否"有效"取决于报告规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM程序搜索代理通常以驱动搜索的分数来评判，但需检验这种评估方式是否能真正反映搜索进展，以及生成程序是否优于可信基准。

Method: 在Bermudan期权最优停止问题上进行LLM驱动搜索，使用对偶上界U进行有效性审计。审计24次生成尝试（两个流程）、六对反馈-表示消融实验，以及选择冻结后的留出集评估。报告蒙特卡洛界限估计及采样误差。

Result: 无选中的生成程序能一致地或在蒙特卡洛不确定性范围内显著超越Ridge LSMC；留出集差距分数在其0.002以内。在六个一维看跌期权上，高精度二项式参考显示Ridge在蒙特卡洛噪声内接近最优，99%的估计差距归因于对偶界松散。结构化记忆相比仅分数记忆无优势。

Conclusion: 该对偶界可审计有效性，但在当前搜索规模下无法证明进展。搜索是否"有效"取决于报告规则：保留初始参考、在留出集前冻结选择、及计数失败。

Abstract: LLM program-search agents are usually judged by the score that drives their search. We study LLM-driven search over Python exercise policies for Bermudan options, an optimal stopping problem where a trusted evaluator owns the simulation and a dual upper bound~$U$. For any policy, $0 \le V^\star - L_π\le U - L_π$; we report Monte Carlo estimates of both bounds with their sampling error. We audit 24 generation attempts from two pipelines, a six-pair feedback-representation ablation, and a holdout evaluated after selection was frozen. No selected generated program improves on Ridge LSMC consistently or by more than Monte Carlo uncertainty; holdout gap scores lie within $0.002$ of it. On six one-dimensional puts, a high-precision binomial reference places Ridge within Monte Carlo noise of optimal and attributes 99\% of the estimated gap to dual-bound looseness, so this dual audits validity but cannot certify progress at the search's scale. Structured memory showed no benefit over score-only memory in this ablation. Whether search ``worked'' depends on reporting rules: retaining the initial reference, freezing selection before holdout, and counting failures.

</details>


### [1163] [One Model, Multiple Compute Budgets: Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE for Flexible Compute Across Turns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14074)
*Yiyang Fu,Zihao Huang,Dongchen Han,Shukai Gong,Zhen Dong,Qiyang Min,Daquan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE，在单一共享骨干内融合2/4/8三种token-to-concept压缩比，实现多计算预算的灵活分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮交互中每轮计算需求差异大：全用高算力模型浪费算力，而在独立模型间路由切换需重建历史状态。

Method: 共享骨干联合支持CR2/CR4/CR8；轻量全token模块降低成本，比例专属边界路由器支持不同压缩级别，跨比例训练实现同上下文混合比例处理。

Result: PTBench/SFTBench上3种固定模式6项对比均优于算力匹配MoE基线，与独立训练专家相当；CodeChat/CoSQL混合推理分别超Large MoE 5.87/2.68个百分点，FLOPs降41.1%/12.3%；同预算调度下较独立模型路由FLOPs再降78.4%/46.9%。

Conclusion: 单一共享模型可提供多计算预算，支持跨轮次灵活算力分配。

Abstract: Large language models typically support different inference budgets through separate model sizes or fixed compute configurations. In multi-turn interactions, however, compute demand can vary substantially across turns. Using a high-compute model for every turn wastes computation, while routing among independent models may require rebuilding model-specific history states after switches. We therefore ask whether a single shared model can support multiple compute budgets that can be flexibly assigned across turns. We introduce Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE, which jointly supports token-to-concept compression ratios of 2, 4, and 8 (CR2/CR4/CR8) within a shared backbone. Lightweight full-token modules reduce compression-independent cost, ratio-specific boundary routers support distinct compression levels, and cross-ratio training enables mixed-ratio processing within the same context. Across PTBench and SFTBench, the three fixed modes outperform their compute-matched MoE baselines in all 6 comparisons while remaining competitive with independently trained fixed-ratio specialists. On CodeChat and CoSQL, mixed-ratio inference improves the accuracy--compute trade-off, outperforming the Large MoE by 5.87 and 2.68 percentage points while reducing FLOPs by 41.1% and 12.3%, respectively. Under the same turn-wise budget schedule, Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE further reduces FLOPs by 78.4% and 46.9% relative to routing among independent models. These results demonstrate that a single shared model can provide multiple compute budgets for flexible compute allocation across turns.

</details>


### [1164] [A Physics-Informed Hybrid Forward-Inverse Machine Learning Framework for High-Dimensional Sparse Recipe Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14097)
*Md. Muqtadir Fuad,Md. Istiak Adnan,Ridwan Al Aziz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种融合物理信息与不确定性感知的三模块框架（前向质量模型、稀疏逆向重构器、可行性约束排序层），用于流程工业中的高维稀疏配方制定，并在工业纺织染色场景中验证，实现低误差的配方重构与决策支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流程工业中高维稀疏配方制定面临协变量非线性关联、稀疏性约束与多准则容差限制，传统基于物理的方法（如Kubelka-Munk）因简化假设和工业过程波动无法有效生成稀疏候选配方。

Method: 提出混合物理信息、不确定性感知框架，含三个模块：(a) 多目标前向质量模型；(b) 稀疏逆向重构器；(c) 可行性约束排序层。采用按配方分组的交叉验证，在多光源质量评估下结合过程与生产信息、目标反射率、K/S值及光谱描述符进行验证。

Result: 前向质量模型中，仅用光谱特征(R_λ, K/S)的HGB与用配方-过程特征的GBDT表现最佳，out-of-Fold MAE分别为0.1655和0.1523；逆向重构中分量式中位数融合达到配方向量MAE 0.0295；探索性CATE表明碱调整对红色和浅色可降低误差(CATE=-0.196)。

Conclusion: 该框架为工业配方领域提供人机协同决策支持工具，可减少昂贵的实验室试验。

Abstract: High-dimensional sparse recipe formulation in process industries involves nonlinear association of various covariates, bounded by sparsity constraints and multi-criteria tolerances. Traditional physics-based classical methods (such as Kubelka-Munk) fail to generate sparse candidate recipes properly due to their simplified assumptions and industrial process variations. This study proposes a hybrid physics-informed uncertainty-aware framework that is structured into three modules: (a) Module A, a multi-target forward quality model; (b) Module B, a sparse inverse reconstructor; and (c) Module C, a feasibility-constrained ranking layer. Then it has been validated in an industrial textile dyeing context with recipe-grouped cross-validation under multi-illuminant quality assessment comprising process and production information, target reflectance, K/S values, and spectral descriptors. Histogram Gradient Boosting (HGB) with spectral-only features ($R_λ$, K/S) and Gradient Boosting Regressor (GBDT) with recipe-process features outperforms other configurations with out-of-Fold MAE of 0.1655 and 0.1523 in the forward quality model. For inverse reconstruction, a component-wise median blend achieved a recipe-vector MAE of 0.0295. Exploratory conditional treatment effect (CATE) suggests an observational association that alkali adjustment reduces error for red and pale shades (CATE = -0.196). This framework provides a human-in-the-loop decision-support tool that minimizes costly laboratory trials across industrial formulation domains.

</details>


### [1165] [From Prototype to Massing: Learning Graph Correspondence for Scalable Facade Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14098)
*Yiliang Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于原型驱动的工作流：用异质属性图和孪生图注意力网络，将设计原型的外立面分段逻辑迁移到更大目标体量，top-1准确率达96.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑尺度下的外立面划分通常依赖手工或参数化系统，而参数化需将设计意图编码为显式规则。论文探索一种补充性工作流：让设计师创作的"原型"提供可迁移的划分逻辑，实现项目尺度的传播。

Method: 将原型与目标体量表示为异质属性图；采用带实例局部三元组监督的孪生图注意力网络，将两者分段嵌入共享度量空间；通过多对一最近邻检索，把原型Pattern路由到更大目标体量；并用Rhino演示器将预测对应关系转为可复用外立面Pattern。

Result: 在原始85/15语料内留出集上，原型到体量的top-1准确率为96.5%，对比报告的76.5%原始特征基线。四个建成项目的定性应用展示了该方法适用于不同体量组织。

Conclusion: 该贡献并非自动化外立面生成，而是一种作者模型：已解决的几何可充当项目尺度传播的计算规范。

Abstract: Facade articulation at building scale is usually resolved manually or through parametric systems that encode design intent as explicit rules. This paper investigates a complementary workflow in which a designer-authored prototype supplies transferable articulation logic. Prototype and target massing are represented as heterogeneous attributed graphs, and a Siamese graph attention network with instance-local triplet supervision embeds their segments in a shared metric space. Many-to-one nearest-neighbor retrieval then routes prototype Patterns to the larger target. On the original 85/15 within-corpus holdout, prototype-to-massing top-1 accuracy reached 96.5%, compared with a reported 76.5% raw-feature baseline. A Rhino demonstrator converts predicted correspondence into reusable facade Patterns, and qualitative applications on four built projects show the workflow across distinct massing organizations. The contribution is not automated facade generation, but an authoring model in which resolved geometry serves as a computational specification for project-scale propagation.

</details>


### [1166] [ULPack: Reference-Conditioned Lossless Compression of Checkpoint Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14184)
*Aniket Srinivasan Ashok*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ULPack是一种无损压缩编解码器，利用参考权重指数预测位移位长，对有序整数残差的条件熵建模，将检查点轨迹存储降低最多27%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究模型训练需要检查点轨迹，但存储成本限制了时间分辨率。相邻检查点数值接近，现有无损编解码器要么基于XOR位模式，要么忽略轨迹特定的条件结构。

Method: 发现参考权重的指数可在无辅助信息下预测其在有序浮点空间中位移的位长。ULPack通过将有序整数残差的熵模型条件化于参考指数来利用这一依赖关系。

Result: 在bfloat16、float16和float32轨迹上，ULPack相比ZipNN降低最多27%存储，相比zstd-19降低21%，相比FM-Delta降低11.5%。在两条密集轨迹上，压缩随更新缩小和参考条件增强而改善，低阶位近似均匀设定了压缩下限，早期检查点信息贡献较少。

Conclusion: ULPack通过条件化参考指数有效压缩检查点轨迹，显著优于现有方法；压缩下限由低阶位均匀性决定，早期检查点价值有限。

Abstract: Studying model training requires checkpoint trajectories, whose storage cost limits temporal resolution. Although adjacent checkpoints are numerically close, existing lossless codecs either operate on XOR bit patterns or ignore trajectory-specific conditional structure. We show that a reference weight's exponent predicts the bit length of its displacement in ordered floating-point space without side information. We introduce \textbf{ULPack}, a lossless codec which exploits this dependence by conditioning entropy models of ordered-integer residuals on the reference exponent. Across bfloat16, float16, and float32 trajectories, ULPack reduces storage by up to 27\% against ZipNN, 21\% against zstd-19, and 11.5\% against FM-Delta. Across two dense trajectories, compression improves as updates shrink and reference conditioning strengthens, while near uniform low-order bits set the remaining compression floor and earlier checkpoints add little information.

</details>


### [1167] [RES-MR: Risk-Aware Reasoning for Explainable and Safe Medication Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14474)
*Cong Wang,Jin Li,Shoujin Wang,Yishuo Li,Huilin Gu,Wenpeng Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RES-MR，一种基于LLM的风险感知推理框架，实现可解释且安全的用药推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用药推荐方法多为黑箱、缺乏可解释性，且使用固定的、与患者无关的安全约束，忽略个体风险容忍异质性，对脆弱人群有风险。

Method: 两阶段训练：一是可解释临床推理蒸馏，基于图检索的患者知识在合成推理轨迹上微调；二是风险感知策略优化，用解耦药物因子构建患者特定参考原型，进行风险边界校准并借助奖励塑形与裁剪引导安全推荐。

Result: 在基准数据集上，RES-MR在准确性、安全性和可解释性上显著优于SOTA基线。

Conclusion: RES-MR有效结合可解释推理与个性化安全约束，提升用药推荐的可信度与安全性。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Medication recommendations seek to deliver personalized drug combinations based on patients' clinical information, where ensuring transparent decision-making and personalized safety are of paramount importance. However, existing approaches predominantly operate as ``black boxes'', offering limited interpretability and hindering clinician trust. Furthermore, they typically rely on fixed, patient-agnostic safety constraints, neglecting the heterogeneity of risk tolerance across individuals, which poses significant risks to vulnerable populations. To address these gaps, we propose \textbf{RES-MR}, a novel Risk-aware Reasoning framework for Explainable and Safe Medication Recommendation using LLMs. RES-MR follows a two-stage training paradigm: (1) an explainable clinical reasoning distillation stage to elicit diagnostic capabilities by fine-tuning on synthesized reasoning trajectories, grounded in patient-specific knowledge from graph retrieval; and (2) a risk-aware policy optimization stage to dynamically balance therapeutic efficacy with personalized safety. This stage employs disentangled drug factors to construct patient-specific reference prototypes that capture desired therapeutic drug features and risk features to avoid. These prototypes enable risk boundary calibration and guide the model toward safe recommendations via reward shaping and clipping. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that RES-MR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in terms of accuracy, safety, and explainability. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/wangcong2001/RES-MR.

</details>


### [1168] [Refined Grid Sampling for Efficient Implicit Neural Representations of Large-Scale Scientific Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14205)
*Guang Zhao,Xihaier Luo,Sean McCue,Luke P. Van Roekel,Seungjun Lee,Yihui Ren,Shinjae Yoo,Wei Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Refined Grid Sampling (RGS)，通过分层网格采样、误差精炼和动态分辨率调整加速隐式神经表示(INR)的训练，在高分辨率Navier-Stokes场重建中以固定时间预算获得更高精度，并在达到全网格训练精度时比基线快达6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐式神经表示(INR)适合建模高维物理场，但因需评估稠密坐标网格而训练低效。现有坐标剪枝策略依赖局部误差函数，容易对相关点过度采样，且全网格误差评估带来大量额外开销。因此需要更高效的采样策略。

Method: 提出Refined Grid Sampling (RGS)，结合三种机制：分层网格采样(stratified grid sampling)、基于误差的精炼(error-based refinement)、动态网格分辨率调整(dynamic grid-resolution adjustment)。该设计在不评估全网格误差的情况下减少空间冗余。

Result: 在高分辨率Navier-Stokes场实验中，RGS在固定墙钟时间预算内取得更高的重建精度，并达到全网格训练的精度，速度比所评估的基线快达6倍。

Conclusion: RGS通过避免全网格误差评估并减少空间冗余，显著提升INR训练效率，在高维物理场建模中兼顾精度与速度。

Abstract: Implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a powerful framework for modeling high-dimensional physical fields, but their training remains inefficient because evaluating dense coordinate grids is computationally expensive. Existing coordinate-pruning strategies rely on local error functions that can oversample correlated points and incur substantial overhead from full-grid error evaluation. We introduce Refined Grid Sampling (RGS), which combines stratified grid sampling, error-based refinement, and dynamic grid-resolution adjustment. This design reduces spatial redundancy without evaluating errors over the full grid. On high-resolution Navier--Stokes fields, RGS achieves higher reconstruction accuracy within a fixed wall-clock budget and reaches the accuracy of full-grid training up to $6\times$ faster than the evaluated baselines.

</details>


### [1169] [Agreement versus Softmax under Spatial Disambiguation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14210)
*Michał Zakrzewski,Mariia Shpir,Taras Rumezhak,Volodymyr Karpiv*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 跨epoch一致性作为per-query logits的替代，在ScanRefer的Multiple查询上是严重误校准的误校准指标；Multiple场景的误差主要是同类错实例，而非错类别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ScanRefer的Multiple查询需要空间消歧，当per-query logits未被记录时，常用跨epoch一致性作为替代。本文检验该替代在Unique与Multiple上的校准与误差结构。

Method: 在ScanRefer完整验证集（9,508查询，GeoClassifier+真值proposals）上比较object-level softmax与固定终期一致性、多数投票一致性的ECE；并做误差分解（同类错实例、几何缺失H2、错类别H1）。

Result: object-level softmax在Unique和Multiple上ECE相近（0.068 vs 0.102，scene-bootstrap间隔含零）。固定终期一致性ECE为0.041 vs 0.272（差+0.231），多数投票为0.045 vs 0.318。Multiple误差中同类错实例占45.6%，H2占59.6%，H1占16.7%。默认协议下H1非单调模式不成立，予以撤回。无logit阈值对空间难查询排序差。

Conclusion: 若仅记录一致性，应在Multiple上校准弃权，并连同H1一起报告错实例率；一致性不可跨场景直接比较校准。

Abstract: ScanRefer Multiple queries require spatial disambiguation: several instances of the target class are present, and the referencer must pick one. When per-query logits were never logged, a common substitute is cross-epoch agreement. On the full ScanRefer validation set (9,508 queries; GeoClassifier with ground-truth proposals), object-level softmax is similarly miscalibrated on Unique and Multiple (ECE 0.068 vs. 0.102; the scene-bootstrap gap interval includes zero). Fixed-final agreement on the same checkpoints reports ECE 0.041 vs. 0.272 (gap +0.231). Modal-vote agreement is 0.045 vs. 0.318. Most Multiple errors are same-class wrong-instance (45.6%); geometric miss (H2) is 59.6%, and wrong-category (H1) is 16.7%. A non-monotone H1 pattern does not appear under the default fixed-final protocol, and we retract it. Logit-free thresholds rank spatially hard queries poorly. If only agreement was logged, calibrate abstention on Multiple and report wrong-instance rates with H1.

</details>


### [1170] [Embedding Graph Kernel Entropy (EGKE): Fine-grained Hallucination Detection for LLMs from Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14214)
*Dilrangi Sankalpana,Pragatheeswaran Vipulanandan,Uthayasanker Thayasivam,Kamal Premaratne*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 EGKE，用 BGE 句嵌入上的 RBF 核替换 KLE 中基于 NLI 的语义图，保留图拉普拉斯与冯诺依曼熵框架，实现更高效且具竞争力的幻觉检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义熵（SE）和核语言熵（KLE）依赖单独加载的 NLI 分类器估计成对语义相似度，计算开销大。

Method: EGKE 将 KLE 的 NLI 语义图替换为在 BGE 稠密句嵌入上应用的 RBF 核，其余图拉普拉斯、热核与冯诺依曼熵公式保持不变，从而在连续嵌入空间中直接计算对称、高效的相似度。

Result: 在 30 组实验（多问答数据集与开放权重 LLM 系列）上，以 AUROC 和 AUARC 评估，RBF 方法取得与当前最优方法相当的幻觉检测性能。

Conclusion: EGKE 提供了一种无需 NLI 分类器、计算更高效的幻觉检测方案，性能与 SOTA 方法竞争力相当。

Abstract: Hallucination detection is critical for ensuring the reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world deployments. While recent works, such as Semantic Entropy (SE) and Kernel Language Entropy (KLE), identify hallucinations by measuring semantic disagreement across multiple generated responses using Natural Language Inference (NLI) models, these methods depend on separately loaded NLI classifiers to estimate pairwise semantic similarity, introducing significant computational overhead. We propose Embedding Graph Kernel Entropy (EGKE), a variant of Kernel Language Entropy (KLE) that replaces its NLI-derived semantic graph with a Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel applied to dense sentence embeddings generated by a BGE embedding model, while retaining KLE's graph Laplacian, heat kernel, and von Neumann entropy formulation unchanged. By computing similarities directly in a continuous embedding space, the proposed method provides a symmetric and computationally efficient alternative to NLI-based semantic comparison. We evaluate our approach across 30 experimental setups (covering multiple question-answer datasets and open-weight LLM families) using both AUROC and AUARC, and demonstrate that this RBF-based method achieves competitive hallucination detection performance against state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [1171] [ARMED: Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Medication Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16440)
*Kyungkeon Chung,Se Un Park,Hyejin Lee,Junyoung Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ARMED：一种自适应临床RAG框架，通过动态扩展检索与相关性门控，提升用药推荐质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于语言模型的检索增强生成（RAG）用药推荐系统依赖固定检索流程，难以适应多样的临床检索场景，且会引入噪声或无关证据。

Method: ARMED先观察初始检索结果，在需要时执行补充或回退式多查询检索；引入相关性门控，仅激活临床相关的同患者历史，并将检索证据组织为结构化的查询级临床证据。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV上，ARMED持续优于先前的静态检索基线，整体用药推荐质量得到提升。

Conclusion: 结合本地可运行的小语言模型与自适应检索，ARMED无需依赖外部语言模型API或任务特定微调即可支持用药推荐。

Abstract: Medication recommendation requires jointly considering diagnoses, comorbidities, longitudinal patient history, and treatment interactions. Although recent retrieval-augmented generation approaches using language models have shown promise for clinical recommendation, most existing systems rely on fixed retrieval pipelines that cannot adapt to diverse clinical retrieval scenarios and may introduce noisy or irrelevant evidence. We propose ARMED, an adaptive clinical RAG framework that dynamically expands retrieval according to retrieval sufficiency and current-admission relevance. ARMED first observes the initial retrieval outcome and selectively performs supplementary or fallback multi-query retrieval when additional evidence is needed. The framework also incorporates a relevance gate that activates only clinically relevant same-patient history and organizes retrieved evidence into structured query-level clinical evidence. Experiments on MIMIC-IV demonstrate that ARMED consistently outperforms previous static retrieval baselines and improves overall medication recommendation quality. By combining locally runnable small language models with adaptive retrieval, ARMED supports medication recommendation without relying on external language model APIs or task-specific fine-tuning.

</details>


### [1172] [Learnable Low-Rank Polynomial Sketch for Effective Linear Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14219)
*Zongyue Qin,Haoran Deng,Jason Cong,Yizhou Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 LLoPS，一个可学习的低秩多项式草图框架，用于线性注意力中的多项式核近似，理论上保证更小的近似误差，并在多个基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Softmax 注意力具有序列长度的二次复杂度，难以应用于长上下文；线性注意力通过替代核实现线性时间，但高次多项式核的精确计算不可行，现有方法依赖近似核并引入不可忽视的近似误差。

Method: 从多项式核近似视角出发，指出已有线性注意力方法仍非最优，提出可学习低秩多项式草图（LLoPS），学习一个低秩多项式草图来近似多项式核，并给出理论证明其近似误差严格小于现有方法。

Result: 在大量基准测试中，LLoPS 相比多种线性注意力基线取得最高性能。

Conclusion: LLoPS 是一个原则性且灵活的框架，能在保持线性复杂度的同时更精确地近似多项式核，从而提升线性注意力表现。

Abstract: Softmax attention in Transformers suffers from quadratic complexity in sequence length, making it impractical for long-context applications. Linear attention alleviates this issue by replacing the exponential kernel with alternative functions that enable linear-time computation. Among existing linear attention approaches, recent studies have shown that polynomial kernels are particularly effective, as they exhibit sparse and spiky behavior similar to softmax attention, which emphasizes large dot products while suppressing irrelevant interactions. However, the exact computation of high-degree polynomial kernels is infeasible for high-dimensional representations. As a result, prior work relies on approximate polynomial kernels. This introduces a non-negligible approximation error. In this paper, we show that, from the perspective of polynomial kernel approximation, existing linear attention methods are still suboptimal. We propose \textbf{L}earnable \textbf{Lo}w-Rank \textbf{P}olynomial \textbf{S}ketch (LLoPS), a principled and flexible framework for approximating polynomial kernels with linear attention. Our method learns a low-rank polynomial sketch that provably achieves a strictly smaller approximation error than existing approaches. Experiment results show that LLoPS achieves the highest performance across extensive benchmarks, comparing with various linear attention baselines.

</details>


### [1173] [Learning Non-Gaussian SEMs with Conditional Risk, and Why the Direction of Recursion Matters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14246)
*Ujas Shah,Panagiota Birmpa,Rebecca Morrison*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文把方差型SEM恢复方法中的条件方差替换为条件风险，将自顶向下和自底向上方法推广到非高斯噪声，理论表明自顶向下方法更普适，模拟验证了更好恢复效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方差型方法恢复高斯线性结构方程模型时依赖条件方差，且自顶向下与自底向上方法似乎可互换，但这些方法对非高斯噪声的适用性有限，需要统一推广并厘清两方法的差异。

Method: 用条件风险（负对数似然下线性预测的最小期望损失）替换条件方差，将递归识别源节点（自顶向下）与汇节点（自底向上）的方法推广至非高斯噪声；最小二乘方法成为其特例。

Result: 相比最小二乘方法和专为非高斯设计的LiNGAM方法，匹配损失方法结构恢复更准确；非高斯下自顶向下方法对任意有限微分熵噪声都正确，而自底向上方法需额外正则条件，在零均值指数或柯西噪声下可能失败。模拟验证了这两个结论。

Conclusion: 条件方差并非本质，条件风险可统一推广方差型SEM方法；非高斯噪声下自顶向下方法更稳健，自底向上方法有失效风险。

Abstract: Variance-based methods recover a Gaussian linear structural equation model (SEM) with equal or suitably constrained error variances, either by recursively identifying the source nodes with smallest conditional variance (top-down method) or sink nodes with highest conditional variance (bottom-up method). We show that the use of conditional variance is incidental: replacing it with the conditional risk, i.e., the minimal expected loss of linear prediction under the negative log-likelihood of the noise distribution, extends both methods to non-Gaussian noise. Existing methods are the least-squares special case. This yields two main results. First, exploiting the noise distribution improves structure recovery: the matched-loss procedures recover the SEM more accurately than their least-squares counterparts and the LiNGAM methods, which are designed for non-Gaussianity. Second, the two methods, interchangeable in the Gaussian setting, separate under non-Gaussian noise: the top-down method is correct for every noise density with finite differential entropy, whereas the bottom-up method requires a regularity condition and can fail without it, for instance under mean-zero exponential or Cauchy noise. Simulations confirm both results.

</details>


### [1174] [Adaptive-Depth Is a Finishing Stage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14252)
*Andrei Piterbarg,Sean McLeish,Dhruv Pai,Benjamin Keigwin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 fixed-first training：只在训练最后短阶段变化循环 transformer 深度，前期用固定深度训练，可大幅降低训练计算量且性能几乎不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 transformer 可复用同一层并灵活调整推理计算，但现有自适应深度方法需从训练一开始就在多个深度下训练，成本高。

Method: fixed-first training：训练前期（如前 67%）使用固定深度，仅在最后短阶段变化深度以覆盖完整推理深度范围。

Result: 200M 模型：固定深度 2 训练前 67%，训练计算降 45%，各推理深度 NLL 与全程多深度训练相差 <0.5%。1B 模型：初始深度 4，计算降 31%–37%，墙钟时间降 32%–39%，NLL 差 <0.8%，下游差异在种子波动内。

Conclusion: 可在短收尾阶段才训练完整深度范围，性能仅小幅变化，显著节省训练成本。

Abstract: Looped transformers reuse the same layer multiple times, allowing inference compute to be adjusted without changing the model. Recent adaptive-depth methods train the model across multiple loop depths from the beginning of training. We introduce fixed-first training, which varies model depth only during a short final phase of training. At 200M parameters, training a model of fixed-depth 2 for the first 67% of the run reduces modeled training compute by 45% while keeping mean negative log-likelihood (NLL) across inference depths within 0.5% of training across depths throughout. At 1B parameters, training initially at depth 4 reduces modeled compute by 31% to 37% and wall-clock time by 32% to 39%, while keeping final NLL within 0.8% and downstream differences within the observed seed variation. These results show that training over the full range of depths can be reserved for a short finishing phase with only small changes in performance.

</details>


### [1175] [Comparing GenAI to Machine Learning and Manual Review for eDiscovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16925)
*Gordon V. Cormack,Maura R. Grossman,Jeremy Pickens*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文质疑Redgrave LLP案例研究结论，指出aiR与RAL的召回率不可直接比较，考虑到方法目标、评估者分歧及权衡差异后，aiR与人工审查相当；CAL模型仅用2000份样本即达SOTA效果与更高效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Keeling等人基于Redgrave LLP案例，声称Relativity生成式AI工具aiR召回率88%远高于RAL的64%。作者认为该比较存在方法论缺陷，需重新审视其有效性与结论。

Method: 对Redgrave数据进行分析，考量方法目标差异、评估者间分歧、召回率-精确率与成本-收益权衡；并评估采用连续主动学习（CAL）的成熟机器学习模型，仅用2000份初审者相关性判定样本训练的表现。

Result: 计入上述差异后，aiR与人工审查效果相当（而非显著优于RAL）；采用CAL的既有机器学习模型仅需2000份样本训练，即达到SOTA效果并具备更高效率。

Conclusion: 生成式AI与机器学习的召回率比较需谨慎，忽略目标、分歧与权衡会误导结论；CAL模型在少量样本下即可高效达优，应作为更可靠的评估与部署基准。

Abstract: Keeling et al. [Keeling2026Generative] report on a case study recently conducted by Redgrave LLP in which they assert that Relativity's Generative AI Review tool (aiR) achieved 88% recall while Relativity Assisted Learning (RAL), its machine-learning tool, achieved 64% recall. These results are not comparable because the methods employed have different objectives, because of inter-assessor disagreement, and because they represent different recall-precision and cost-benefit trade-offs. Our analysis of the Redgrave data indicates that, when these differences are taken into account, aiR and manual review are comparable. Furthermore, established machine-learning models employing Continuous Active Learning (CAL) show state-of-the-art effectiveness, and superior efficiency, when trained only on a sample of 2,000 first-pass-reviewer responsiveness determinations.

</details>


### [1176] [Variance Fingerprints: Component-Wise Identification of Content Factors by Augmentation Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14260)
*D. Hudson Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨能否通过设计增强来识别自监督学习中的内容因子，提出在记录增强强度下让因子跨视图波动但保持均值，理论上证明了条件高斯模型中因子的可辨识性，并设计了联合估计学习器，实验验证了非线性混叠下近乎完美的因子恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于增强的自监督学习能恢复跨视图共享的内容，但无法将潜在因子分离到独立坐标。作者希望研究增强设计是否可使这些因子具备可辨识性，从而实现组件级识别。

Method: 允许内容因子在增强视图间波动，但保持每个源实例的均值不变；每个实例收到固定且记录的增强强度集合。当因子对这些强度变化响应不同时，其变化模式可区分因子。作者推导了条件高斯模型下（在解码器与支撑集假设下）因子可被辨识至置换、缩放与平移。随后开发学习器，利用记录的强度跨实例联合估计变化模式，支持每实例少视图学习。

Result: 合成实验在非线性混叠下实现近乎完美的因子恢复；受控 dSprites 实验显示，即使未告知学习器哪个增强对应哪个表征坐标，针对已知因子的增强也能改善坐标对齐。

Conclusion: 增强设计可为自监督学习提供超出共享内容的识别信息，为组件识别提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Augmentation-based self-supervised learning can recover the content shared across views without separating its underlying factors into individual coordinates. We ask whether augmentations can be designed to make those factors identifiable. Our approach allows content factors to fluctuate across augmented views while preserving their mean for each source instance. Each instance receives a fixed, recorded set of augmentation strengths that controls how much its factors fluctuate. When factors respond differently to changes in these strengths, their patterns of variation provide information that distinguishes them. Under suitable decoder and support assumptions, we prove that these differences identify individual factors in a conditional Gaussian model, up to permutation, scaling, and translation. We then develop a learner that uses the recorded strengths to estimate these patterns jointly across instances, enabling learning from few views per instance. Synthetic experiments demonstrate near-perfect factor recovery through nonlinear mixing. Controlled dSprites experiments show improved coordinate alignment using augmentations that target known factors, even without telling the learner which augmentation corresponds to which representation coordinate. These results suggest a route to component identification in self-supervised learning: augmentation design can supply identifying information beyond shared content alone.

</details>


### [1177] [KNN Implementation Details Can Dramatically Change Performance: An Example from Cover Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16940)
*Amol Khanna,Edward Raff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文以Cover Tree为例，指出近邻搜索算法中常被忽视的实现细节会显著影响性能与结论。作者实现了RustKNN，统一比较三种构建变体与三种查询模式，并通过严谨计时实验揭示查询策略、基参数、微优化与基准设置的关键影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近邻搜索算法虽应用广泛，但其关键实现细节在文献中很少被审视；这些细节会实质影响性能，甚至改变对算法优劣的判断，因此需要系统梳理与量化这些影响。

Method: 以Cover Tree为案例，开发RustKNN：一个统一的Rust实现，涵盖三种构建变体与三种查询模式；进行多数据集实验，比较查询策略、cover tree基参数、五种微优化，并对不同基准（全近邻与held-out）进行评测。计时表报告20次独立分配中位数及bootstrap 95%置信区间。

Result: (1) 最优查询策略依赖k与数据集：k=1时单树在四个最大数据集中的三个最快，k≥5时双树在三个最大数据集上最快，选错查询模式可带来最高7.5×运行时差距；(2) 基参数2（理论）/1.3（实践）并非双树搜索的安全默认：1.3仅在七个数据集之一最优，在covtype上比最优慢1.6×；(3) 五种微优化中仅early-exit距离计算效果一致，且随维度增大（d=32无效果，d=54为1.31×，d=784为1.49×）；(4) 全近邻与held-out基准给出不同的实现排名。

Conclusion: 实现细节会实质性改变Cover Tree等近邻搜索算法的性能结论；应避免默认参数与单一基准，需按k、数据集与维度选择查询策略和优化。RustKNN已开源，便于复现与后续统一评测。

Abstract: Nearest neighbor search algorithms are widely used and have a long history, but we find that key implementation details are seldom reviewed in articles about them. These details can materially impact performance, and thus change the conclusions one makes about a given algorithm's superiority. In this article, we highlight these impacts by reviewing the Cover Tree as an example, producing RustKNN, a unified Rust implementation of three construction variants of the Cover Tree with three query modes. Our analysis reveals: (1) the optimal query strategy depends on $k$ and on the dataset (single-tree search is fastest at $k{=}1$ on three of our four largest datasets, while dual-tree search is fastest at $k{\ge}5$ on the three largest), and choosing the wrong query mode can cost up to a $7.5\times$ factor in runtime; (2) the cover tree base parameter, set to 2 in theory and 1.3 in practice, is not a safe default for dual-tree search: 1.3 is optimal on only one of seven datasets, and on covtype it is $1.6\times$ slower than the optimum; (3) among five micro-optimizations, only early-exit distance computation has a consistent effect, and that effect grows with dimension (none at $d{=}32$, $1.31\times$ at $d{=}54$, and $1.49\times$ at $d{=}784$); and (4) all-nearest-neighbor and held-out benchmarks yield different implementation rankings. All main timing tables report medians over 20 independent allocations with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals. RustKNN is open source at https://github.com/CrowdStrike/RustKNN.

</details>


### [1178] [The RNN Homunculus: Learning to Gate Long-Term Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14279)
*Zeyu Fan,Alexandru-Dragos Manolache,Jan van Gemert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究门控RNN的门学习问题，发现当所有样本都需要长程记忆时门控架构仍受梯度消失困扰，但通过加入短依赖样本可帮助其学会长程解，性能可媲美或超越Mamba和xLSTM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 门控RNN（如GRU、LSTM）通常被解释为通过时间构建加性复制路径来缓解梯度消失，但这一解释不完整：有用的门值本身需要用另一个RNN来学习，即"门学习"问题尚未被充分理解。

Method: 通过精心控制的序列分类任务研究门学习问题，分析门控架构在训练样本全部需要长程记忆时的表现，并介入实验：加入短依赖样本，使门控模型学习能捕捉长依赖样本的解并跨类别标签泛化。

Result: 分析显示，当所有训练样本都要求长程记忆时，门控架构同样遭受梯度消失问题；加入短依赖样本后，门控模型能学到有效的长程记忆解。正确学习后，门控RNN的测试准确率可匹配甚至超过Mamba和xLSTM等现代架构。

Conclusion: 门学习是学习长程记忆的核心部分；训练数据可通过以更短依赖形式呈现同一任务来支持门学习，为门控RNN的长程依赖建模提供新视角。

Abstract: Learning long-range dependencies with recurrent neural networks (RNNs) is difficult because of the vanishing gradient problem. Gated recurrent neural networks like GRUs and LSTMs address this problem and are commonly explained by their ability to create additive copy paths through time. This explanation is correct, but incomplete: useful RNN gate values must themselves be learned, which is typically done with another RNN. We study this gate-learning problem through carefully controlled sequence classification tasks. Our analysis shows that gated architectures struggle when all training samples require long-range memory and thus equally suffer from the vanishing gradient problem. We intervene by adding short-dependency samples which let gated models learn solutions that capture long-dependency samples, but also generalize across different class labels. When properly learned, gated RNNs match or even exceed the test accuracy of modern architectures like Mamba and xLSTM. Overall, our results highlight gate learning as a central part of learning long-range memory and show how training data can support this process by exposing the same task over shorter dependencies.

</details>


### [1179] [Layer-wise Input Recoverability in Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14290)
*Maxwell Spiridonov,Alireza Rahmansetayesh,Pierre Baldi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究CNN各层输出对其自身输入的可恢复性，用基于重建的探针在采样输入patch上评估，发现可恢复性随深度下降且更多由层的压缩程度预测，并揭示各架构间学习带来的可恢复性差异不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有信息瓶颈框架通过隐藏表示与网络输入、输出标签的互信息来刻画深度网络，但很少关注某层输出能恢复多少该层自身输入这一问题，作者希望从可恢复性角度理解CNN内部工作机制。

Method: 对卷积层逐个输入patch采样，设计重建式探针（规模只取决于通道数和卷积核大小，不随特征图尺寸增长），用线性和线性加残差MLP解码器，比较预训练、随机及重建优化编码器，以held-out集上输入patch与重建的R²衡量可恢复性；并提出单属性随机控制，将某一预训练属性迁移到随机编码器上。

Result: 在九个ImageNet CNN上，可恢复性总体随深度下降，但更稳定地由层压缩程度预测；学习导致的可恢复性差异（预训练与随机的差）在不同架构间并不一致。单属性随机控制显示：复制预训练奇异向量倾向于提高可恢复性，而复制奇异值谱或激活稀疏性则降低可恢复性，且符号在各模型间一致。

Conclusion: CNN各层对其输入的可恢复性主要由层的压缩特性而非单纯深度决定，且不同架构中学习对可恢复性的影响不一致；奇异向量、奇异值谱和激活稀疏性等属性对可恢复性有方向一致的因果影响。

Abstract: The inner workings of deep neural networks are still not well understood. The information bottleneck framework, which characterizes deep networks by the mutual information between their hidden representations and the network's input, has been used to identify compression of input information with respect to an input image and output labels. We instead study how much of a layer's own input is recoverable from the layer's output in convolutional neural networks (CNNs). A convolutional layer applies its filters to one input patch at a time, so we evaluate recoverability on sampled input patches with a reconstruction-based probe and not on the entire feature map. The probe's size thus depends on channels and kernel size and not on feature map size, which lets our method scale to deep CNNs with wide feature maps. For each layer, we compare pretrained, random, and reconstruction-optimized encoders, using linear and linear-plus-residual-MLP decoders. We measure recoverability as $R^2$ between input patches and their reconstructions on a held-out set. Across nine ImageNet CNNs, recoverability generally decreases with depth but is more consistently predicted by the compression of the layer. Learning-attributed recoverability, the difference between pretrained and random encoders, is not uniform across architectures. We introduce single-property random controls, which transfer one pretrained property onto a random encoder, and find that each control changes recoverability with a consistent sign across models: copying pretrained singular vectors tends to raise recoverability, while copying the pretrained singular-value spectrum or activation sparsity lowers it.

</details>


### [1180] [Learning to See through Action: Predictive Curiosity for Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14302)
*Stelios Zarifis,Panagiotis Filntisis,George Retsinas,Petros Maragos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DySCOVER自监督框架，机器人通过好奇心驱动的交互主动收集经验以改进视觉学习，引入预测性好奇心（世界模型误差）结合重构好奇心，在机械臂实验中发现能持续提升视觉学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类和动物并非从固定数据集学习视觉，而是通过运动、交互并从行动带来的视觉后果中学习。受此发育视角启发，研究机器人能否通过好奇心驱动的主动交互来提升视觉学习。

Method: DySCOVER自监督框架：机器人观察RGB帧，学习视觉自编码器进行编码与重构；训练循环世界模型，基于当前状态与动作预测下一视觉潜在状态。策略仅用内在奖励训练：重构误差鼓励视觉新颖的观察，世界模型误差鼓励后果尚不可预测的转移，从而偏向更复杂的轨迹以丰富经验。

Result: 以机械臂为具身智能体的实验表明，加入预测性好奇心相比仅用视觉好奇心提升了视觉模型；在初始条件、经验容量、具身形式和场景内容的变化下，预测性好奇心均持续改善视觉学习。

Conclusion: 预测性好奇心能够超越仅基于重构的好奇心，有效促进主动视觉学习。

Abstract: Humans and animals do not learn vision from a fixed set of data: they move, interact, and learn from the visual consequences of their actions. Motivated by this developmental view, we study whether robots can improve visual learning by actively collecting experience through curiosity-driven interaction. We introduce DySCOVER, a self-supervised framework for active robot visual learning. A robot observes RGB frames, learns a visual autoencoder that encodes and reconstructs them, and trains a recurrent world model to predict the next visual latent state conditioned on the current state and action. The agent's policy is trained only with intrinsic rewards: reconstruction error encourages visually novel observations, while the world model's error encourages transitions whose consequences are not yet predictable. This prediction error biases the policy toward more intricate trajectories that enrich the agent's set of experiences with observations beyond those encouraged by visual novelty alone. Our experiments conducted with robotic arms as the embodied agents show that adding predictive curiosity improves the vision model over using visual curiosity alone. Across variations in initial conditions, experience capacity, embodiment, and scene content, adding predictive curiosity consistently improved visual learning. These results show that predictive curiosity can improve active visual learning beyond reconstruction-based curiosity alone.

</details>


### [1181] [Decentralized Bandit Learning of Markov Perfect Equilibria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14333)
*Felix Höfer,H. Mete Soner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究折扣无限时域、一般和连续动作马尔可夫博弈中的去中心化bandit学习，利用同时扰动随机逼近，证明几乎必然收敛到唯一平稳马尔可夫完美均衡，达到O(n^{-1/2})速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作多聚焦有限动作或简单博弈结构，去中心化、连续动作、一般和马尔可夫博弈中的均衡学习仍缺乏收敛保证。

Method: 智能体仅观测公共状态与自身实现奖励，采用同时扰动随机逼近（SPSA）同时更新动作；在负即时奖励梯度强单调且步长足够小的条件下进行分析。

Result: 证明完全去中心化过程几乎必然收敛到唯一的平稳马尔可夫完美均衡，取得O(n^{-1/2})收敛速率。

Conclusion: 为连续动作一般和马尔可夫博弈提供了去中心化均衡学习的收敛性与速率保证，并可自然扩展到回合制有限时域学习。

Abstract: We study decentralized bandit learning in discounted infinite-horizon, general-sum Markov games with continuous actions. Agents observe the public state, but only their own realized rewards, and use simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation to update their actions. Under strong monotonicity of the negative running-reward gradients and sufficiently small time steps, we prove that the fully decentralized procedure converges almost surely to the unique stationary Markov perfect equilibrium. We obtain an $O(n^{-1/2})$ convergence rate and present a natural extension to episodic finite-horizon learning.

</details>


### [1182] [Continuous-Time Cloth Dynamics with Physics-Informed Neural ODEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14342)
*Yingdong Ru,Lipeng Zhuang,Zhuo He,Gerardo Aragon Camarasa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ContinuousCloth 是一种连续时间、物理信息驱动的神经求解器，将弹簧-质量 ODE 嵌入神经轨迹模型以模拟布料动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统时间步进模拟器只能在离散积分网格上输出轨迹，无法在任意时间戳查询位移、速度与加速度；同时真实测量存在稀疏与噪声问题，需要更强的物理归纳偏置。

Method: 将弹簧-质量 ODE 作为物理约束嵌入连续时间神经轨迹模型，支持任意时间戳查询，并通过自动微分计算位移、速度与加速度。

Result: 纯物理设置下轨迹精度媲美高精度求解器，运行时间最高减少 17.4 倍；融合稀疏噪声观测后，插值误差在仿真中比纯数据神经基线降低 7.3 倍、真实布料序列降低 2.4 倍；高噪声下参数估计误差比可微求解器基线低 2.6 倍。

Conclusion: ContinuousCloth 兼顾高精度与高效率，并在稀疏、噪声观测下表现出稳健性，适用于插值与参数估计等下游任务。

Abstract: We present ContinuousCloth, a continuous-time, physics-informed neural solver for deformable cloth dynamics that enforces a spring--mass ODE within a neural trajectory model. Unlike classical time-stepping simulators that return trajectories only on a discrete integration grid, ContinuousCloth supports querying at arbitrary timestamps and computing displacement, velocity, and acceleration via automatic differentiation. We evaluate ContinuousCloth along two dimensions. In a physics-only setting, ContinuousCloth achieves trajectory accuracy comparable to high-precision solvers across six diverse boundary-condition scenarios while reducing runtime by up to 17.4 times. When fused with sparse and noisy observations, the spring--mass ODE acts as a strong inductive bias for downstream tasks: interpolation and parameter estimation. That is, ContinuousCloth reduces interpolation error by 7.3 times over a data-only neural baseline in simulation and 2.4 times on real-world cloth sequences, and achieves 2.6 times lower parameter error than a differentiable-solver baseline under high-noise conditions, demonstrating consistent robustness under realistic measurement imperfections.

</details>


### [1183] [On the Depth Transfer of Neural Optimizers via L-Smoothness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14344)
*Maximilian Wong,Chenyu Xu,Jiajin Li,Yiping Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立深度超参数迁移的理论：证明逆深度残差分支缩放 α=Θ(1/K) 可使损失的 Lipschitz 与 L-smooth 常数在固定宽度下与深度无关，从而为 AdamW、Muon、MOGA 等优化器的学习率缩放提供几何解释，并在 GPT-2 与 ResNet 上验证迁移稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模模型训练需在低成本代理模型上发现可迁移的最优超参数，避免大规模训练的灾难性失败。但既有深度迁移分析依赖特定架构、初始化与无限深度动力学，且仅用玩具块启发式论证，缺乏通用理论。

Method: 基于 Xu 等 (2026) 的 L-smooth 框架，将超参数迁移问题转化为损失的 Lipschitz 与 L-smooth 常数随深度 K 的缩放问题。证明在固定宽度、有界参数域及任意 p→q 几何下，逆深度缩放 α=Θ(1/K) 足以使两常数与深度无关；论证仅依赖各残差分支的 Lipschitz 与平滑常数，不假设初始化或层间相关，适用于块深度 ≥2 的一般残差网络。

Result: 理论表明平滑常数控制下降不等式中的曲率惩罚，故在预设范数内更新时无需额外的深度相关曲率校正即可缩放学习率。在 GPT-2（深度 2–128）与 CIFAR-100 ResNet（8–32 残差块）上的学习率扫描显示：Muon 与 MOGA 在该缩放方案下具有稳定的学习率迁移，深度增加 64 倍仍保持共同的最优学习率。

Conclusion: 逆深度残差缩放具有清晰的几何解释，并为 AdamW、Muon、MOGA 等算子范数几何提供了实用的深度超参数迁移准则，实验验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Scaling deep learning models efficiently requires predictable performance transfer across compute regimes. Establishing reliable hyperparameter transfer allows optimal training dynamics and structural choices to be discovered on low-cost proxy models, avoiding catastrophic failures during massive-scale training. Existing depth-transfer analyses are architecture-specific and heuristic: hyperparameter transfer is only justified through toy blocks, and both rely on infinite-depth dynamics, a specific initialization, and feature-learning criteria. Building on $L$-smoothness framework of Xu et al. (2026), we understand hyperparameter transfer as how do the Lipschitz and $L$-smoothness constants of the loss scale with the depth $K$? We show that inverse-depth residual branch scaling $α=Θ(1/K)$ is sufficient to make both constants depth-independent at fixed width, uniformly over the bounded parameter domain and for arbitrary $p\to q$ geometries. Because the bounds depend on each residual branch only through its Lipschitz and smoothness constants, the argument applies to general residual networks (including branches of block depth $\geq 2$ such as transformer and ResNet blocks) without assumptions on initialization or correlations between layer weights. Since the smoothness constant controls the curvature penalty in the descent inequality, our bounds motivate a learning-rate scale without an additional depth-dependent curvature correction for updates bounded in the prescribed norm. This provides a geometric explanation of inverse-depth residual scaling and its application to the operator-norm geometries associated with AdamW, Muon, and MOGA. Learning-rate sweeps on GPT-2 (depths 2--128) and CIFAR-100 ResNets (8--32 residual blocks) confirm that Muon and MOGA exhibit stable learning-rate transfer under these prescriptions, with a common optimal rate across a 64-fold increase in depth.

</details>


### [1184] [Class-Conditional Conformal Prediction for Signal Temporal Logic Inference with Many Classes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14352)
*Yixuan Wang,Danyang Li,Matthew Cleaveland,Roberto Tron,Mingyu Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对多类时序分类中STL公式推断，提出满意度指标与两阶段学习+类条件校准方法，实验揭示分类精度与公式满意度存在偏差及鲁棒性与满意度的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多类时序分类中，STL推断虽能给出可解释公式，但高分类精度并不保证推断公式与真实类别一致被满足，存在满意度与一致性隐患。

Method: 提出正满意度率与码字满意度率两个指标；两阶段流程：先用margin目标学习判别公式，再在固定公式结构与时间区间下将谓词阈值微调至小的正鲁棒性目标；加入满意度与排序惩罚；用解码损失作为非一致性分数并按类单独校准，在类内可交换性下提供有限样本类条件覆盖。

Result: 在naval、合成数据及机器人操作轨迹上实验显示分类精度与公式满意度存在差异；发现鲁棒性紧致度与满意度之间存在数据依赖的权衡；类条件校准可缓解被汇总校准掩盖的欠覆盖问题。

Conclusion: 多类STL推断需同时关注满意度与一致性；所提两阶段方法与类条件校准能在保证可解释性的同时改善覆盖，但精度、鲁棒性与满意度间需权衡。

Abstract: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) inference provides interpretable formulas for time series classification. For multiclass classification, however, accurate predictions do not necessarily ensure that the inferred formulas are satisfied consistently with the true class. We introduce the positive satisfaction rate and codeword satisfaction rate to quantify satisfaction of required formulas and consistency with the complete class codeword, respectively. We develop a two-stage procedure that first learns discriminative formulas using a margin-based objective and then refines predicate thresholds toward a small positive robustness target while fixing the formula structure and temporal intervals. Satisfaction and ranking penalties discourage violations of required formulas and loss of class separation. The decoding loss is used as a nonconformity score and calibrated separately for each class, providing finite-sample class-conditional coverage under intra-class exchangeability. Experiments on naval, synthetic, and robot manipulation trajectories demonstrate discrepancies between classification accuracy and formula satisfaction. The results further reveal a data-dependent tradeoff between robustness tightness and satisfaction, while class-conditional calibration mitigates undercoverage that can be hidden by pooled calibration.

</details>


### [1185] [ConformalGuard: False-Positive-Controlled Action Gating for LM Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14365)
*Bishnu Bista,Dhanraj Haibatrao Jadhav,Vibha Choudhary,Gaurav Saxena,Arun Pandiyan Perumal,Arjun Subedi,Jignesh Ammineni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ConformalGuard——一个模型无关的校准层，通过 conformal calibration 为语言模型分类器提供有限样本的误报率控制，并在 BERT、Claude Sonnet 4 和 GPT-4o 上验证其操作有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型分类器被广泛用于钓鱼筛查、内容审核、欺诈分类等高风险决策，但验证集阈值无法对部署时的误报率提供有限样本控制，存在操作风险。

Method: 将 ConformalGuard 作为模型无关校准层包裹固定打分函数；对比 temperature scaling、isotonic regression 与 conformal calibration，在 BERT、Claude Sonnet 4、GPT-4o 于公开邮件语料上评估；对 GPT-4o 采用三次随机平均降低分数离散性。

Result: 零样本 LM API 分数过于粗糙（仅 10–11 个不同取值），使温度缩放与等渗回归在低 FPR 场景下等同原始阈值。Claude 上 conformal calibration 将 FPR 从 0.040 降至 0.008，召回率从 0.938 降至 0.875；GPT-4o 1% 工作点召回仅 0.564，三次随机平均在 FPR 0.005 时召回提升至 0.732；BERT 在 2% 患病率下每万封邮件减少 25 个误报（95% CI [10, 43]）。

Conclusion: 该保证仅针对可交换性下的合法事件率控制；区分度、工作负载影响及分布漂移下的稳健性仍为经验性问题，需进一步验证。

Abstract: Language model classifiers are increasingly deployed for high-stakes decisions such as phishing screening, content moderation, and fraud triage, yet validation-set thresholds provide no finite-sample control of deployment-time false positives. We present ConformalGuard, a model-agnostic calibration layer that wraps a fixed scoring function with finite-sample control over the rate at which legitimate inputs trigger an intervention tier. Our contribution is empirical and operational, not a new conformal theorem: zero-shot LM API scores can be coarse enough (10--11 unique values here) to make temperature scaling and isotonic regression operationally identical to raw thresholding for low-FPR action gating. We compare these methods with conformal calibration for fine-tuned BERT, Claude Sonnet 4, and GPT-4o on public email corpora. For Claude, conformal calibration reduces FPR from 0.040 to 0.008 while recall falls from 0.938 to 0.875. For deterministic GPT-4o scores, the 1% operating point is too conservative to deploy (recall 0.564); three-run stochastic averaging raises recall to 0.732 at FPR 0.005. At 2% prevalence with BERT, conformal calibration removes 25 false-positive reviews per 10,000 emails (95% CI [10, 43]). The guarantee is legitimate-event-rate control under exchangeability; discrimination, workload effects, and robustness to shift remain empirical.

</details>


### [1186] [History, Adaptation, and Hidden Gain: Two Prospective Tests of Learned Predictive Control in a Synthetic Neural Population](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14368)
*Mahesh Reddy Pagadala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在合成神经元群体的一步预测控制中，单参数在线增益估计可解释基于历史的网络与自适应ARX之间的大部分差距，但高过程噪声下效应显著减弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究基于历史的神经网络预测器相对自适应ARX的差距来源，以及隐藏增益对学习到的动作敏感度的影响。

Method: 对64个LIF神经元的合成群体进行一步预测控制研究；两项前瞻性验证在冻结分析后模拟的植物上进行（第一项：50植物×11条件；第二项：50新植物×9敏感度×2噪声水平），比较去历史网络、参数匹配网络、递归ARX、PI控制器等。

Result: 去200ms输入输出历史显著恶化网络预测（s=0.6时RMSE升2.47Hz）；递归ARX在11条件中10个误差最低；单参数在线增益估计恢复87%自适应ARX收益，作为额外输入降低高增益误差1.84Hz；长训练对网络有差异影响（+2.16Hz）；高噪声下效应缩至≤0.04Hz，增益自适应仅恢复24%。

Conclusion: 在该合成植物中、主噪声水平下，单参数在线增益估计解释了历史网络与自适应ARX的大部分差距及其预测-控制失配，但该结论在高过程噪声下不成立。

Abstract: We study learned one-step predictive control of a synthetic population of 64 leaky integrate-and-fire neurons whose light sensitivity is scaled by a hidden factor s, using two prospective confirmations on plants simulated only after the analysis was frozen. In the first (50 plants, 11 conditions), removing the 200-ms input-output history substantially worsened a parameter-count-matched neural predictor at low and moderate gain (s = 0.6, 0.8; RMSE rose by 2.47 Hz at s = 0.6, 97.5% CI 2.43-2.51). In secondary comparisons, recursively adapted ARX had the lowest mean error of the deployable controllers in 10 of 11 conditions, tuned PI with anti-windup matched or beat the network for s >= 0.7, and training for 10,000 rather than 900 epochs lowered prediction error but worsened control. Development work suggested the network's learned action sensitivity did not track the hidden gain. A second protocol (50 new plants, 9 sensitivities, 2 noise levels) confirmed three pre-specified predictions at the primary noise level. Re-estimating a single multiplicative input gain recovered 87% (95% CI 86-88%) of the benefit of full adaptive ARX. Supplying that online estimate to the network as an extra input reduced high-gain tracking error by 1.84 Hz [1.81, 1.88]. Longer training worsened the plain network by 1.09 Hz but improved the gain-input network by 1.07 Hz, a differential of 2.16 Hz [2.13, 2.20]. Under high process noise (sigma = 2.0) the effects shrank to about 0.04 Hz or less and gain-only adaptation recovered only 24% of the adaptive-ARX benefit. In this synthetic plant, at the primary noise level, one-parameter online gain estimation accounts for most of the gap between a history-based network and full adaptive ARX, and for its prediction-control mismatch.

</details>


### [1187] [Kwai Summary Attention V2 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18654)
*OneRec Team,Chenglong Chu,Guohong Mu,Guowang Zhang,Hao Peng,Hui Wang,Jian Liang,Jiangxia Cao,Jiao Ou,Jiaxin Deng,Lu Ren,Muhao Wei,Ruiming Tang,Tianle Xu,Wenwu Ou,Xingmei Wang,Zhixin Ling,Zhiyuan Liang,Ziqi Wang,Chaoyi Ma,Haixiao Gao,Kuo Cai,Renpu Liu,Ruochen Yang,Wenlong Xu,Xinqi Jin,Yan Sun,Yifan Wang,Yingzhi He,Yiyu Wang,Yusen Huo,Zhaojie Liu,Zihan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出KSA V2，通过让摘要token兼任KV记忆与稀疏索引器两种角色，实现更灵活的KV Cache压缩并降低Full attention层的计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合KSA-Full架构存在瓶颈：(1)各层摘要压缩块必须相同，难以实现灵活KV Cache压缩；(2)Full attention层中摘要token带来额外开销，却仍支付二次预填充成本，对计算不友好。

Method: 提出KSA V2，发现摘要token可承担两种角色：KV记忆与稀疏索引器，据此设计更灵活的KV cache压缩机制并减少Full attention层计算量。

Result: （摘要未提供具体实验结果）

Conclusion: KSA V2在实现更灵活KV cache内存压缩的同时降低了Full attention层的计算成本。

Abstract: Summary-token architectures such as Kwai Summary Attention (KSA) compress distant context into learnable Summary token per chunk, and hybrid variants interleave these layers with full attention to retain exact access to the original text. In such hybrid KSA-Full architecture, the interleaving inserted summary tokens are served as a streaming flow role across different layers. Although effective, however, it also introduce some bottlenecks: (1) the different layers summary compression chunk must be same, therefore hard to reach a flexible KV Cache compression, e.g., different layer set different summary compression chunk window. (2) in the full-attention layers, the summary token introduced additional computation cost, but such layer ignore them and still pay quadratic prefilling, therefore unfriendly to the computation side. Motivated by them, we developed the KSA V2, which not only achieves a more flexible KV cache memory compression but also reduces the computation cost in Full attention layer. Specifically, we found that the summary tokens can serve two roles: the KV memory and sparse indexer.

</details>


### [1188] [When More Memory Fails: Hidden Feasibility Holes in Dynamic Tensor Rematerialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14369)
*Mahesh Reddy Pagadala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DTR训练中存在“可行性漏洞”：更大显存预算反而不如更小预算可行，呈非单调可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们通常假设：能完成训练的显存预算，增大后仍应足够。作者要检验该假设在DTR下是否成立。

Method: 用DTR参考模拟器simrd重放公开训练trace，按预算网格扫描，并对InceptionV4具体失败对进行逐分配追踪。

Result: 0.01步网格在六个确认trace上未发现漏洞（但存在超时未定）；更细采样在InceptionV4（3处）、U-Net（2处）及ResNet-32发现漏洞，均可复现。某InceptionV4案例中更大预算少一次驱逐，却导致后续张量级联重算而失败。测试的两种打分改动未能消除漏洞。

Conclusion: DTR的可行性是非单调的，存在可行性漏洞；结论基于模拟、无分配器模型，GPU实际行为未验证。

Abstract: Dynamic Tensor Rematerialization (DTR) trains neural networks under a memory budget by evicting tensors and recomputing them on demand. A natural expectation is that a budget large enough to complete training stays sufficient when it is increased. Using DTR's reference simulator, simrd, to replay the public DTR training traces, we show that this expectation fails. We call the exceptions feasibility holes: memory budgets at which an eviction policy runs out of memory although both a smaller and a larger budget complete, a form of non-monotone feasibility. Under a written sweep protocol with dated amendments, a 0.01-step budget grid shows no such hole for DTR on any of six confirmatory traces, although unresolved timeouts prevent it from establishing monotonicity. Finer sampling finds holes on InceptionV4 (three regions) and U-Net (two regions), in addition to one on the ResNet-32 development trace. Every hole is reproduced by three repeats and by unmodified simrd. For one InceptionV4 pair (0.2343 versus 0.235 of peak memory) we trace the failure to individual allocations. The larger budget avoids one eviction at an operator where the smaller budget was 173,479 bytes short. The extra data it carries forward forces a later eviction of a tensor needed three operators afterwards, and rebuilding that tensor triggers a recomputation cascade that cannot fit. Keeping that one tensor resident under the same budget prevents the failure. The two simple score changes we tested do not remove holes across traces; both add failing budgets on some traces. All results are from simulation, with no allocator model; behaviour on GPU hardware is untested.

</details>


### [1189] [DPAL: A Test-Time Adaptation Loss for Financial Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14376)
*Wuzhou Lian,Haochun Wang,Yuefan Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DPAL损失，将逐点收益拟合与方向、价格校准项结合，用于金融时间序列预测的测试时自适应，在不改动模型架构下降低重构价格MSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时自适应(TTA)目标主要关注单个时间步的预测误差，未充分考虑金融预测中收益方向以及由收益序列重构的价格轨迹等重要属性。

Method: 提出方向与价格感知自适应损失(DPAL)，将逐点收益拟合与方向项、价格校准项相结合，并在现有TSF-TTA框架中应用，不修改源预测器或适配器架构。

Result: 在多种金融数据集上，DPAL在大多数评估设置中降低了重构价格的均方误差(MSE)。

Conclusion: DPAL通过引入方向与价格感知目标，能有效提升金融时间序列测试时自适应的表现，且易于集成到现有框架中。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) enables time series forecasters to update after deployment as new observations become available. However, adaptation objectives that focus primarily on prediction errors at individual time steps do not fully address the needs of financial time series forecasting. In addition to pointwise return fitting, return direction and the price trajectories reconstructed from sequences of returns are also important. To better account for these properties, we introduce Direction- and Price-Aware Adaptation Loss (DPAL), which combines pointwise return fitting with directional and price-calibration terms. We apply DPAL within existing TSF-TTA frameworks without modifying the source forecaster or the adapter architecture. Across a diverse collection of financial datasets, DPAL reduces reconstructed-price mean squared error in most evaluated settings.

</details>


### [1190] [Clinical value claims in multimodal AI outpace supporting evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14395)
*Jiayu Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文审计了177项多模态与单模态预测模型的对比研究，发现多模态模型的性能提升常被高估，且近期研究中完整基准测试的做法在减少，而多数研究声称有临床价值却缺乏决策效用评估与前瞻性验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗系统需要判断为多模态预测模型额外增加的检查（如影像或化验）是否值得。因此需要准确评估多模态相比单模态模型的真实增益，但现有研究可能存在高估增益、基准不完整等问题。

Method: 审计177项研究：81项来自系统综述，96项来自2025-2026年PubMed记录的概率样本。分析AUROC增益与建模方式的关系，统计完整基准测试、决策效用评估和前瞻性验证的比例，并与研究声称的临床价值进行对照。

Result: 为每个数据源单独拟合模型时AUROC增益更小（调整后差异-0.030；95% CI -0.056到-0.005）。在78项此类研究中，若去掉最强单一数据源的模型，平均增益会从0.046升至0.108。完整基准测试比例从综述研究的69.1%降至近期研究的估计46.0%。约22%评估了决策效用，无一项进行前瞻性评估；但多数研究声称有潜在临床价值（84.0%）或改善护理（估计87.7%）。

Conclusion: 多模态模型的真实增益可能被系统性高估，且近期研究的完整基准测试减少。研究普遍缺乏决策效用评估和前瞻性验证，却常过度声称临床价值；需要更严格的基准和验证规范。

Abstract: Multimodal prediction models add a data source, such as imaging or an assay, to clinical information, and health systems must decide whether that added test is worth acquiring. We audited 177 studies comparing multimodal with unimodal models: 81 from a systematic review and 96 from a probability sample of 2025-2026 PubMed records. Gains in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) were smaller when a study fitted a separate model for every data source (adjusted difference, -0.030; 95% CI, -0.056 to -0.005). Within 78 such studies, leaving out the strongest source's model would have raised the average gain from 0.046 to 0.108. This complete benchmarking fell from 69.1% of review studies to an estimated 46.0% of recent ones. An estimated 22% assessed decision utility and none evaluated a model prospectively, yet most claimed potential clinical usefulness or improved care (84.0% and an estimated 87.7%).

</details>


### [1191] [To Cache or Not to Cache: Understanding and Mitigating Safety Incompatibility in Cross-Model KV Cache Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15721)
*Zhiwei Lin,Jiahao Liu,Yan Liu,Chengpeng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估跨模型KV缓存共享对安全性的影响（"安全不兼容性"），发现幅值/方向依赖模型对与复用配置，value复用比key复用偏差更大，并提出VReparo（学习逐层、逐KV头的仿射映射对齐value张量）来缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨模型KV缓存共享可减少prefill计算，但此前的复用优化只关注延迟与生成质量，其安全性影响（是否偏离接收模型原生的安全行为）尚不清楚，需要系统研究。

Method: 在多种sender-receiver模型对与复用配置下系统评估安全不兼容性；并提出VReparo：离线学习逐层、逐KV-head的仿射映射，在解码前将复用的sender value张量对齐到receiver-native的value。

Result: 安全不兼容的方向与幅值取决于模型对与复用配置；所有评测对中value复用造成的偏差显著大于key复用。在两对模型、full KV复用及SOTA选择性复用设置下，VReparo将平均HarmBench ASR从57.28%降至39.21%，StrongREJECT分数从0.4215降至0.2163，同时保持85.62%的平均TTFT缩减。

Conclusion: 跨模型KV复用存在显著安全隐患，尤其value复用；VReparo能有效降低攻击成功率与有害性得分，同时保留大部分推理加速收益。

Abstract: Cross-model KV cache sharing reduces prefill computation by allowing a receiver model to reuse prefix KV states generated by a related sender model. Existing methods optimize such reuse for latency and generation quality, but its safety implications remain unclear. In this work, we systematically evaluate this issue across diverse sender-receiver pairs and reuse configurations. We refer to deviations from the receiver's native safety behavior as safety incompatibility. Our study shows that both the direction and magnitude of safety incompatibility depend on the model pair and reuse configuration, with value reuse causing substantially larger deviations than key reuse across all evaluated pairs. Furthermore, we propose VReparo, a technique that learns per-layer and per-KV-head affine maps offline to align reused sender value tensors with their receiver-native counterparts before decoding. Across two model pairs under full KV reuse and the state-of-the-art selective reuse setting, VReparo reduces the average HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) from 57.28% to 39.21% and the average StrongREJECT score from 0.4215 to 0.2163 upon our benchmarks, while retaining an average Time to First Token (TTFT) reduction of 85.62%.

</details>


### [1192] [Sparse-TD-JEPA: Improving Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning With Sparse Latent Task Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14400)
*Duaa Nakshbandi,Zhiyu An,Wan Du*

Main category: cs.LG
