### [1229] [Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Dengue Infection Using Clinical and Hematological Data from Bangladesh: A Comparative Analysis of Benchmark and Extended Prediction Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14813)
*Neesha Naimeen,Victor Miranda Soberanis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究用逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost结合SMOTE，基于孟加拉国两家医院2024/2025年临床与血液学数据预测登革热，扩展模型在2024年略优于基准，RDW-CV为关键新增预测因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 登革热在孟加拉国是重大公共卫生问题，且其症状与其他发热性疾病重叠，导致早期诊断困难，需借助机器学习提升预测能力。

Method: 比较Logistic Regression、Random Forest与XGBoost三种模型，使用两个孟加拉国医院数据集（2024年n=1,511；2025年n=1,283），并采用SMOTE处理类别不平衡，纳入临床与血液学特征。

Result: 扩展模型在2024年数据中优于基准（随机森林ROC-AUC由0.640升至0.661），RDW-CV是最稳定的新增有效预测因子；2025年基准表现更高（ROC-AUC 0.904），无法用类别不平衡解释，可能反映数据质量差异。

Conclusion: 机器学习可辅助登革热预测，RDW-CV具潜在价值，但2025年高表现成因不明，需进行外部验证以确认模型的泛化能力。

Abstract: Dengue is a viral infection caused by the dengue virus (DENV) and a major public health concern in Bangladesh, where symptom overlap with other febrile illnesses complicates early diagnosis. This study compares Logistic Regression, Random Forest and XGBoost to predict dengue from clinical and hematological data using two Bangladeshi hospital datasets (2024, n=1,511; 2025, n=1,283) with SMOTE. Extended models outperformed benchmarks within 2024 (Random Forest ROC-AUC 0.640 to 0.661), with RDW-CV the most consistently influential added predictor. 2025 benchmark performance was higher (ROC-AUC 0.904), unexplained by class imbalance and possibly reflecting data quality. External validation is needed.

</details>


### [1230] [Sequence-Structured Decision Learning for Branch-and-Bound in Mixed-Integer Linear Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14835)
*Tengfei Liu,Jinrun Liu,Bai Yan,Yuhui Shi,Qi Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Seq-BnB是一个序列结构化框架，通过共享全局表示联合学习分支和节点选择，减少BnB节点数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习方法孤立地优化分支或节点选择，且多依赖局部视图，未能充分建模搜索树的耦合演化。

Method: 将节点创建、更新、选择与分支事件序列化为类型化token，用自注意力编码器汇总全局历史，二分图神经网络编码当前LP松弛，上下文条件决策头打分分支变量与开放节点，并用DAgger式数据聚合训练。

Result: 在四个MILP基准族上，Seq-BnB处理的BnB节点数一致少于启发式与学习型基线，在标准及更大迁移实例上解时间表现强。

Conclusion: Seq-BnB验证了分支与节点选择的联合学习，并可通过新增动作token和决策头扩展到割选择等其他求解器决策。

Abstract: Branch-and-bound (BnB) solves mixed-integer linear programs by constructing and exploring a search tree. Node selection and branching are two recurrent decisions that directly determine the tree. Learning-based approaches typically optimize either decision in isolation and condition on a mostly local view, leaving the coupled evolution of the search tree insufficiently modeled. This paper proposes Seq-BnB, a sequence-structured framework that learns branching and node selection from a shared global representation of the evolving BnB process. Seq-BnB serializes node creations, node updates, node-selection events, and branching events into typed tokens, producing a causal event sequence of the search trajectory. A self-attention encoder summarizes this global search history, a bipartite graph neural network encodes the current LP relaxation, and context-conditioned decision heads score branching variables and open nodes. To reduce distribution shift between expert demonstrations and learned policies, Seq-BnB is trained with DAgger-style data aggregation. On four MILP benchmark families, Seq-BnB consistently processes fewer BnB nodes than heuristic and learning-based baselines, with strong solution times on both standard and larger transfer instances. While this paper evaluates Seq-BnB instantiation for branching and node selection, it accommodates additional solver decisions, such as cut selection, by introducing new action tokens and decision heads.

</details>


### [1231] [Disentangling Marginal Capacity from Geometry in Optimal-Transport Label Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14853)
*Ali Khodabandeh Yalabadi,Azim Dehghani Amirabad,Artem Moskalev,Yun-Ching Chen,Mehdi Pirooznia,Scott Oloff,Rui Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 最优传输(OT)中源点均匀加权导致各类容量正比于源频率，源目标组成差异使稀有类被系统性欠预测；将传输边缘分布匹配目标组成可显著改善标签迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OT广泛用于对齐分布和迁移标签，但源目标组成偏移会令稀有类在高传输置信度下仍被系统性错误预测；作者想找出该失败的根源并加以修正。

Method: 分析传输边缘（marginal）的作用：指出标准源点均匀加权使各类传输容量正比于其源频率；实验比较下游读出、熵平滑、边缘松弛与将传输边缘匹配目标组成等方法。

Result: 位移质量优先被高容量类吸收而非几何相似类，产生难以从传输计划检测的自信错误；单细胞数据上，oracle组成匹配边缘将macro-F1从0.322提升至0.623，最佳可部署估计器弥补了oracle差距的69%。

Conclusion: 校正传输边缘可提升标签迁移，并将覆盖率相关误差与类可分离性相关的残余误差区分开，说明传输容量与表示几何是两类不同的迁移误差来源。

Abstract: Optimal transport (OT) is widely used to align distributions and transfer labels between unpaired source and target data, but source-target composition shifts can cause rare classes to be systematically under-predicted even with high transport confidence. We identify a source of this failure in the transport marginal: under the standard uniform weighting of source points, each class has transport capacity proportional to its source frequency, which can be insufficient to meet its target demand even when separated well in the embedding space. We show that displaced mass is preferentially absorbed by high-capacity classes rather than geometrically similar classes, producing confident errors that are difficult to detect from the transport plan. Downstream read-outs, entropic smoothing, and marginal relaxation provide limited recovery, whereas matching the transport marginal to the target composition substantially improves label transfer. On single-cell data, the oracle composition-matched marginal raises macro-F1 from 0.322 to 0.623, and the best deployable estimator closes 69% of the oracle gap. Correcting the marginal also separates a coverage-dependent component of error from residual error associated with class separability, showing that transport capacity and representation geometry are distinct sources of transfer error.

</details>


### [1232] [Terrarium: Growing Personal Assistants via Scalable Synthesis of App Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14860)
*Mengzhou Wu,Yuzhe Guo,Jiawen Tao,Xiaokun Yuan,Yuan Cao,Gang Cao,Yuetang Deng,Zhi Gong,Dezhi Ran,Linyi Li,Wei Yang,Tao Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Terrarium: a framework that synthesizes executable "App Worlds" from real-world app info, generates training tasks with evaluator rubrics, and iteratively refines them via agent rollouts. It enables scalable outcome-based RL for general-purpose assistants, improving Qwen3 models substantially on app benchmarks.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Real-world applications are hard to train on at scale because access is restricted and app state is difficult to reset, limiting progress toward general-purpose personal assistants operating over broad app ecosystems.

Method: Terrarium synthesizes executable App Worlds from public Web info and in-app observations, organized into structured app specs guiding self-contained runtimes with callable operations and mutable, resettable state. It then builds state-grounded tasks with evaluator-side outcome rubrics (no reference trajectories) and iteratively validates/refines both via agent rollouts.

Result: A training suite of 275 App Worlds and 13,344 tasks was built for outcome-based RL across Qwen3 at 4B, 8B, and 14B scales. Terrarium-trained models outperform Qwen3 by an average of +18.34 points on τ²-bench and +10.94 points on AppWorld bench.

Conclusion: App-grounded world and task synthesis offers a scalable path toward general-purpose assistants capable of operating across broad application ecosystems.

Abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have brought the vision of a general-purpose personal assistant closer to reality. Such assistants could provide a unified natural-language interface to a broad ecosystem of applications. However, real-world applications do not readily support training at scale because access is often restricted and their state is difficult to reset. To address this challenge, we introduce Terrarium, a framework that synthesizes executable App Worlds from real-world application information, generates training task packages with evaluator-side rubrics from these worlds, and iteratively validates and refines both through agent rollouts. For App World synthesis, Terrarium organizes public Web information and in-application observations into structured app specifications that guide the construction of self-contained runtimes with callable operations and mutable, resettable state. For task synthesis, Terrarium constructs tasks grounded in App World state together with evaluator-side outcome rubrics that assess success without prescribing reference trajectories. We construct a training suite of 275 App Worlds and 13,344 tasks for outcome-based reinforcement learning across three Qwen3 model scales (4B, 8B, and 14B parameters). Across these scales, models trained with Terrarium outperform the corresponding Qwen3 models by an average of 18.34 percentage points on the $τ^2$-bench and 10.94 percentage points on the AppWorld bench. These results suggest that app-grounded world and task synthesis offers a scalable path toward general-purpose assistants capable of operating across broad application ecosystems.

</details>


### [1233] [World2TS: Real-World Event Context for Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14861)
*Zhiding Liu,Jiqian Yang,Mingyue Cheng,Zhi Li,Enhong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 World2TS 框架与数据集，将真实世界事件与时间序列对齐，为上下文感知预测提供数据基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预测基准多将时间序列表示为纯数值历史，忽略事件、干预、中断等外部因素，而这类上下文往往无法从历史值推断；核心障碍是缺乏大规模、事件与序列对齐的数据集。

Method: 构建 world2ts-core 工具：结合智能体驱动的语义推理与网络搜索、命令行执行与验证、人工审核的反馈式发现流程；给定带语义描述的时间序列，自动发现候选事件、整合证据为已验证事件，并在明确时间与语义范围内将其链接到相关序列。

Result: 构建 world2ts-data，覆盖 6 个领域、31 个数据集，含 4,179 条序列、9,710 万观测、1,159 个事件和 56,846 条事件-序列链接；通过数据分析和对照实验证明所收集上下文可提升预测精度。

Conclusion: World2TS 为开发与评估上下文感知预测模型及智能体提供可复用的数据基础。

Abstract: Time-series forecasting plays a vital role in a wide range of real-world applications. Recent approaches have achieved strong performance by modeling temporal correlations and cross-channel dependencies, yet most forecasting benchmarks still represent time series primarily as numerical histories. In practice, time series are observations of complex real-world processes, and their trajectories may reflect events, interventions, disruptions, and changes in measurement or reporting that cannot always be inferred from past values alone. A central barrier to studying context-aware forecasting is therefore the lack of large-scale datasets that align real-world events with the individual series they affect. We present World2TS, a scalable construction framework and large-scale dataset for time-series forecasting with real-world event context. We first develop world2ts-core, a reusable tool that combines agent-led semantic reasoning and Web search, command-line execution and validation, and human review within a feedback-driven discovery workflow. Given heterogeneous time series with semantic descriptions, the workflow discovers candidate events, consolidates retrieved evidence into verified events, and links them to relevant series under explicit temporal and semantic scopes. Using this framework, we construct world2ts-data, which contains 31 datasets across six domains, comprising 4,179 series, 97.1 million observations, 1,159 events, and 56,846 event-series links. We further conduct extensive data analyses and controlled comparative experiments to characterize the dataset and demonstrate the utility of the collected context for improving forecasting accuracy. World2TS provides a reusable data foundation for developing and evaluating context-aware forecasting models and agents. The project homepage is available at https://world2ts.github.io/.

</details>


### [1234] [Blending experimental electron density information to protein-ligand interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14862)
*Seonghyun Park,Shuan Chen,Jun Jin Choong,Noboru Kuno,Gyubok Lee,Kaushalya Madhawa,Keisuke Ozawa,Hikaru Shindo,Sungsoo Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoDE，一种基于实验电子密度图预训练的坐标-密度编码器，将原子占据、电子密度及其梯度融合到统一三维体素网格，用通道式视觉Transformer联合重建掩码，用于结合亲和力回归和口袋条件配体生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质-配体相互作用模型多将复合物表示为单一拟合结构，忽略了结合界面的构象异质性、位置不确定性以及局部密度支持信息。

Method: 将每个结合位点表示为三维体素网格，融合原子占据、实验电子密度及密度梯度幅值；用约10万个精选复合物预训练通道式视觉Transformer，联合重建掩码的原子通道与密度通道。

Result: 在泄漏控制的结合亲和力回归和口袋条件配体生成两个下游任务上，CoDE优于同样预训练的纯坐标编码器，并与任务专用基线保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 密度信息可补充拟合原子坐标，密度融合表示对基于结构的配体生成具有实用价值。

Abstract: Machine learning models for protein-ligand interactions commonly rely on atomic coordinates, which are constructed by fitting molecular models to experimental electron-density maps. However, most models represent each complex as a single fitted structure, which can omit information about conformational heterogeneity, positional uncertainty, and local density support for individual atoms at binding interfaces. To fill this gap, we present CoDE, a Coordinate and Density Encoder, pre-trained on experimental density maps. We represent each binding site on a shared three-dimensional voxel grid combining atomic occupancy, experimental electron density, and its gradient magnitude. Using approximately 100K curated complexes, we pre-train a channel-wise vision transformer to jointly reconstruct masked atomic and density channels, learning a representation that integrates structural and experimental information. We evaluate the frozen encoder on two downstream tasks: (i) binding-affinity regression under leakage-controlled splits and (ii) pocket-conditioned ligand generation. Across these settings, CoDE improves over an identically pre-trained coordinate-only encoder and remains competitive with task-specific baselines, showing that density complements fitted atomic coordinates for protein-ligand interaction modeling and that the density-blended representation is useful for structure-based ligand generation.

</details>


### [1235] [Contrastive Linearized Laplace: Loss Geometry, Valid Repairs, and Reliable Cores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14875)
*Francisco J. Sáez-Maldonado,Luis A. Ortega,Andrés R. Masegosa,Thomas D. Nielsen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出直接使用对比学习嵌入上的Linearized Laplace近似（LLA）无法给出可靠的点式不确定性估计，提出了一种基于LLA的后验框架，将编码器不确定性传播到下游任务（如最近邻检索、聚类分配），并通过曲率刻画与半正定修正获得有效局部高斯近似，在宏基因组分箱和图像分类任务上取得共识分区、可靠核心选择及校准改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对比学习广泛用于学习确定性表示，但本身不提供不确定性估计。后验方法LLA可在不重训编码器的情况下量化不确定性。然而作者发现直接在对比嵌入上使用LLA分布，其嵌入方差无法反映下游决策（如最近邻检索或聚类分配）是否稳定，因此需要将编码器不确定性传播到下游任务。

Method: 提出基于LLA的后验框架，将编码器不确定性传播通过下游任务；刻画对比目标的曲率，并在需要时引入半正定修正，以获得有效的局部高斯近似，且无需重训编码器。

Result: 在宏基因组分箱任务中，后验共分配概率支持共识分区和可靠核心的选择，优于现有基线；在图像分类实验中，包括标准基准和真实组织病理学数据集，校准性能得到改进。

Conclusion: 结果表明，仅依赖嵌入方差不足以评估下游决策稳定性，而将编码器不确定性经LLA传播至下游任务是有效且实用的，可在不重训编码器的情况下带来分区与校准方面的提升。

Abstract: While contrastive learning is widely used to learn deterministic representations, it does not inherently provide estimates of uncertainty. Post-hoc uncertainty estimation methods, such as the Linearized Laplace approximation (LLA), offer a way to quantify uncertainty without retraining the encoder. However, we show that directly using the LLA induced distribution over the contrastive embedding does not yield reliable pointwise uncertainty estimates for downstream tasks: embedding variance alone does not reflect whether decisions such as nearest-neighbor retrieval or cluster assignment are stable. To address this limitation, we develop a post-hoc framework based on LLA that propagates encoder uncertainty through the downstream task. We characterize the curvature of contrastive objectives and introduce positive-semidefinite repairs where needed to obtain valid local Gaussian approximations without retraining the encoder. We test the proposed approach in metagenomic binning and image classification tasks. For metagenomic binning, posterior coassignment probabilities support consensus partitions and the selection of reliable cores, leading to improvements over existing baselines. Additional image classification experiments show calibration improvements on standard benchmarks and real histopathology datasets.

</details>


### [1236] [Pro-t-VAE: Closed-Form Student's t Mixtures for Robust Prototype Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14894)
*Zhikang Xu,Jiarui Xing,Jian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于Student's t混合先验的无监督深度生成框架，用于稳健的图像原型发现，具有闭式ELBO，兼顾稳健性与可解析性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成方法依赖易受噪声影响的高斯先验或计算昂贵的扩散模型，前者缺乏显式隐结构，后者采样迭代、似然不可解，限制原型发现的可扩展性与可解释性。

Method: 通过贝叶斯尺度混合构造Student's t隐空间，得到Student's t混合变分自编码器的完全闭式增强ELBO；将精度视为隐变量，自动调节每个数据点影响力，降低离群点权重。

Result: 在标准视觉基准与神经影像任务上验证，相比SOTA方法具有更好的稳健性、准确性和效率，隐表示分离更清晰、流形学习更稳定；在脑MRI神经退行性疾病分析中恢复了干净且解剖学连贯的原型。

Conclusion: 该框架能保留解剖相关模式，支持临床场景下的精确发现，弥合了统计稳健性与数学可解析性。

Abstract: We present a robust deep generative framework for unsupervised image prototype discovery, built on a heavy-tailed Student's t mixture prior, that bridges statistical robustness and mathematical tractability. Existing generative approaches typically rely on noise-prone Gaussian priors or computationally intensive diffusion models; neither simultaneously provides explicit latent structure nor exact analytic optimization. While diffusion models can yield strong priors, iterative sampling and intractable likelihoods limit scalability and interpretability for prototype discovery. We address these issues by constructing a Student's t latent space via a Bayesian scale-mixture formulation. This yields a fully closed-form augmented ELBO for unsupervised Student's t mixture variational autoencoders, which, to our knowledge, is the first such objective applied to robust image prototype discovery, avoiding biased variational approximations and high computational costs in prior heavy-tailed or diffusion-based frameworks. Treating precision as a latent variable automatically modulates each data point's influence, downweighting outliers to learn a data-dependent measure of trust. The result is improved robustness, accuracy, and efficiency, with well-separated latent representations and more stable manifold learning than state-of-the-art methods. We validate our model on standard vision benchmarks and challenging neuroimaging tasks. In brain MRI-driven neurodegenerative disease analysis, our model recovers clean, anatomically coherent prototypes where clinical noise often collapses rare subtypes. These results highlight the ability of our framework to preserve anatomy-associated patterns for precise discovery in clinical settings. Our code is available at: https://github.com/xuzhikangnba/torch-tvae.

</details>


### [1237] [Prediction with Expert Advice under Heavy-Tailed Losses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14904)
*Yuki Shibukawa,Shinji Ito*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究重尾损失下专家建议预测，刻画极小极大伪遗憾率并给出无需知晓ε和θ的自适应算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仅针对ε=1的重尾算法在ε<1时次优，且额外含K的多项式依赖；同时此前方法需预先知道ε与θ。

Method: 提出自适应重尾FTRL（稳健数据依赖尺度自适应+截断）与自适应重尾OMD，均无需ε和θ；并在已知ε、θ时用Shannon熵正则的FTRL。

Result: 刻画极小极大伪遗憾率为Θ((θT)^{1/(1+ε)}(log K)^{ε/(1+ε)})，并在自约束环境下建立间隙依赖下界；所提算法达到近最优保证。

Conclusion: 给出了重尾专家问题的紧率刻画与参数无关自适应算法，覆盖对抗与自约束两种环境。

Abstract: We study prediction with expert advice over $T$ rounds with $K$ experts under heavy-tailed losses whose $(1+ε)$-moment is bounded by $θ>0$ for some $ε\in(0,1]$. In this setting, existing algorithms designed for the case $ε=1$ can be suboptimal when $ε<1$, suffering an additional polynomial dependence on $K$. We characterize the minimax pseudo-regret rate as $Θ((θT)^{\frac{1}{1+ε}}(\log K)^{\fracε{1+ε}})$ and establish gap-dependent lower bounds in a self-bounded environment. To attain this minimax rate without prior knowledge of either $ε$ or $θ$, we propose Adaptive Heavy-Tailed FTRL, which uses robust data-dependent scale adaptation together with truncation. We further develop Adaptive Heavy-Tailed OMD, which likewise requires neither $ε$ nor $θ$ and achieves near-optimal regret guarantees in both adversarial and self-bounded environments. Finally, when $ε$ and $θ$ are known, an FTRL algorithm with Shannon-entropy regularization achieves optimal regret guarantees in both environments.

</details>


### [1238] [Representation Drift in Continual Learning: LoRA versus N-gram Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14921)
*Hao Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文比较三种持续更新机制（仅更新N-gram记忆表、共享LoRA、逐任务新LoRA合并），发现仅更新记忆表对基座表示漂移最小且不随任务数增长，但新增任务学习弱、任务间干扰导致遗忘；遗忘由所学任务自身输入上的漂移而非通用漂移主导，并给出精确关系。提出"新知识只写入记忆表、冻结骨干"的长期在线学习设计原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期在线学习的语言模型不能缓慢侵蚀自身基座能力，需确定现代LLM中应由哪一部分吸收持续更新，通过测量各选择如何改变模型内部表示来回答。

Method: 在48层MoE模型（含原生预训练N-gram记忆）上，用相同数据和预算训练七任务链，对比三种更新机制：仅更新N-gram记忆表、持续训练一个共享LoRA适配器、逐任务训练新LoRA并合并进骨干。在每个层和任务边界捕获固定上下文表示。

Result: 仅更新N-gram记忆对通用数学/代码输入表示的漂移为26%/15%（相对RMS），合并LoRA为64%/35%，共享LoRA为97%/39%。该漂移不随任务数增长（第一任务后达25%并保持），而两种LoRA持续累积。N-gram通用行为基本不变（无代码题丢失，数学NLL -0.01），改动局限于可检查、可逆的表行；代价是新增任务学习较弱且存储任务相互干扰，旧任务NLL损失与共享LoRA相当。遗忘由所学任务自身输入上的漂移主导（Spearman rho=0.85；Llama-3-8B上rho=0.71），而非通用漂移；并推导出精确关系：冻结头时，每个成对logit margin的变化等于漂移在头差方向上的投影。

Conclusion: 支持长期在线学习的设计原则：新知识只写入记忆表并保持骨干固定；剩余问题（存储任务间的干扰）则位于记忆内部。

Abstract: A language model that keeps learning online must not slowly erode its own base capabilities. We ask which part of a modern LLM should absorb continual updates, by measuring how each choice changes the model's internal representations. On a 48-layer mixture-of-experts model with a native pretrained N-gram memory, we train a seven-task chain under three update mechanisms with identical data and budgets: updating only the N-gram memory table, continually training one shared LoRA adapter, and training a fresh LoRA per task that is merged into the backbone. We capture fixed-context representations at every layer and task boundary. Updating only the N-gram memory changes the base model's representations of general math and code inputs by 26%/15% (relative RMS), against 64%/35% for merged and 97%/39% for shared LoRA. This drift does not grow with the number of tasks: it reaches 25% after the first task and stays there for all seven, while both LoRA variants keep accumulating. Its generic behaviour is essentially unchanged (no code problem lost, math NLL -0.01), and every change is confined to inspectable, reversible table rows. The cost appears elsewhere: N-gram memory acquires new tasks more weakly and its stored tasks interfere with one another, losing as much old-task NLL as shared LoRA. We show that this forgetting is governed by drift on the learned tasks' own inputs, measured from the checkpoint at which each was learned, not by generic drift (Spearman rho=0.85; rho=0.71 on Llama-3-8B), and we derive the exact relations behind it: with a frozen head, every pairwise logit margin changes by the projection of drift onto a head-difference direction. These results support a design principle for long-running online learning: write new knowledge only into the memory table and keep the backbone fixed; the remaining problem, interference between stored tasks, then lies inside the memory.

</details>


### [1239] [TLA-Verus: Generating and Solving Temporal Proof Obligations with LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14923)
*Kseniia Strelbytska,Balázs Szilágyi,Anna Mészáros,Ferenc Huszár*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将TLA+规格转换为Rust验证器Verus，通过确定性转译器和LLM智能翻译器，实现可机器检查的安全性与活性证明，并构建评估数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TLA+虽广泛用于建模分布式系统，但存在两大局限：无法检测实现与规格间的漂移；TLC和TLAPS无法提供任意时序逻辑性质的满意证明。

Method: 将TLA+规格翻译为面向Rust的自动主动验证器Verus，采用两种方式：确定性转译器（deterministic transpiler）与基于LLM的智能翻译器（agentic translator）。

Result: 基于LLM的流水线能够大规模从TLA+规格生成证明义务，并产出安全性（safety）与活性（liveness）性质的完全可机器检查证明。由于Verus中的时序逻辑推理对LLM而言是全新任务，工作还产出了有价值的评估数据集，并据此绘制了当前代际模型在Verus定理证明方面的能力图谱。

Conclusion: 该工作为解决TLA+的两大局限迈出一步，展示了LLM从TLA+生成可检查证明的可行性，并为评估LLM在Verus时序逻辑定理证明能力提供了数据基础。

Abstract: The TLA+ (temporal logic of actions) formal specification toolkit has seen widespread adoption in modeling modern distributed software systems including databases, storage systems, ledgers and coordination protocols. This popularity is despite its two significant limitations for software verification: Firstly, TLA+ offers no way to detect drift between software implementation and mathematical specification; secondly, TLC and TLAPS cannot provide satisfactory proofs of arbitrary temporal logic properties. We take a step towards addressing these shortcomings by translating TLA+ specifications into Verus, an auto-active verifier built for Rust, via both a deterministic transpiler and an agentic translator. We demonstrate that our LLM-based pipeline is able to generate proof obligations from TLA+ specifications at scale, and to produce fully machine checkable proofs of both safety and liveness properties. Since temporal logic reasoning in Verus is a largely new task for LLMs, our work yields a valuable evaluation dataset, which we use to map out current generation model capabilities in Verus theorem proving.

</details>


### [1240] [BSIPipe: Bidirectional Sequence-Level Interleaved Pipeline Parallelism for Long-Sequence Large Language Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14935)
*Yuzhou Ni,Ling Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 BSIPipe，一种双向序列级交错流水线并行方法，通过共调度两条相反 V 形流水线提升长序列训练吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有序列级方法单向调度子序列，吞吐受限。

Method: BSIPipe 共调度两条相反 V 形交错流水线；引入 basic-unit 拼接机制使激活内存不随子序列数增长；采用拓扑感知设备映射与通信-计算重叠消除双向调度死锁风险；并与张量并行组合。

Result: 在 GPT 与 LLaMA3 上，长序列训练相对 SOTA 序列级基线平均加速 1.11×–1.13×。

Conclusion: BSIPipe 有效提升长序列训练吞吐，并与张量并行兼容。

Abstract: Pipeline parallelism has become a critical technique for training large language models. To address the throughput limitation of existing sequence-level methods that schedule subsequences unidirectionally, we propose bidirectional sequence-level interleaved pipeline parallelism (BSIPipe), which co-schedules two opposing V-shaped interleaved pipelines at the subsequence level. To bound the activation accumulation from subsequence scaling, BSIPipe introduces a basic-unit concatenation mechanism that keeps activation memory invariant to the subsequence count. To eliminate communication deadlock risk from bidirectional scheduling, BSIPipe employs a communication optimization strategy that combines topology-aware device mapping with communication-computation overlap. In addition, BSIPipe composes with tensor parallelism to overcome the memory limitation of single-dimensional parallelism, neutralizing its bidirectional memory overhead while maintaining throughput. Experiments on GPT and LLaMA3 demonstrate that BSIPipe achieves average speedups of 1.11$\times$ to 1.13$\times$ in long-sequence training over SOTA sequence-level baselines.

</details>


### [1241] [Compositional Average Velocity Modeling for Efficient Diffusion Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14941)
*Thanh Nguyen,Abu Hanif Muhammad Syarubany,Hwanhee Kim,Chang D. Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: InsQL：基于平均速度建模的单步生成式策略，统一行为正则化actor-critic，去除多步去噪与BPTT，兼顾表达力与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散策略依赖多步去噪和BPTT，计算开销大、难以扩展和部署，需在保留表达力的同时消除迭代采样。

Method: 基于flow-matching，用平均速度建模替代边际速度参数化，引入组合机制，学习跨尺度一致的平均速度；将组合平均速度建模与行为正则化actor-critic统一，仅需单一策略网络，无需蒸馏、多阶段流程和Jacobian计算；推理单次前向，可选价值引导候选选择。

Result: 在标准离线RL基准和真实机器人操作任务上匹配或超越SOTA扩散方法，同时大幅降低训练和推理时间。

Conclusion: 组合平均速度建模是离线RL中高效可扩展的多步生成策略替代方案。

Abstract: Diffusion-based policies have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for offline reinforcement learning, but their reliance on multi-step denoising introduces substantial computational overhead and requires backpropagation through time during training, limiting scalability and practical deployment. In this work, we propose \textbf{Instant Flow Q-Learning (InsQL)}, a single-step generative policy learning framework that retains the expressive capacity of diffusion models while eliminating iterative sampling and BPTT. InsQL builds on the flow-matching perspective of diffusion policies, but replaces marginal velocity parameterization with \emph{average-velocity} modeling and introduces a principled compositional mechanism, yielding a theoretically grounded objective that learns average velocity consistently across scales. This formulation provides a direct noise-to-action mapping and enables single-step action generation. InsQL further unifies compositional average-velocity modeling with behavior-regularized actor--critic optimization in a single framework, requiring only a single policy network and avoiding distillation, multi-stage procedures, and Jacobian computations during training. At inference time, actions are generated in a single forward pass and can be refined via value-guided candidate selection to improve performance. Extensive experiments on standard offline RL benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks show that InsQL matches or surpasses state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods while substantially reducing both training and inference time. Overall, these results establish compositional average-velocity modeling as an efficient and scalable alternative to multi-step generative policies for offline RL.

</details>


### [1242] [Probabilistic Multi-Source Data Selection via Learnable Categorical Priors: Variance Reduction and Guaranteed Derandomization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14942)
*Shizhan Cai,Qixin Zhang,Siyuan Ma,Siyuan Liang,Yongcheng Jing,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对多源双层数据选择问题提出新的概率松弛方法，引入可学习的类别先验参数化仅在可行数据子集上的分布，实现无损取整；并给出可约化的两点梯度估计器及ReSGD算法，具备理论保证并经实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双层数据选择是机器学习与统计中的重要任务，通常将组合优化松弛为连续优化。但现有0-1松弛与概率松弛存在梯度估计不稳定、取整不可行等局限，因此需要更优的松弛方案。

Method: 提出新的概率松弛：引入多个可学习类别先验，参数化仅支撑于可行数据子集上的概率分布，从而天然获得无损取整；证明该松弛存在有效的两点梯度估计器，避免0-1松弛的逆Hessian计算与先前概率松弛的无界评分项；进一步给出该估计器的可约化表示，显著减少下层重训练次数；基于此设计随机梯度算法ReSGD。

Result: 在弱子模性条件下，为ReSGD返回的子集建立了严格的近似保证；大量实验验证了ReSGD的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提概率松弛与ReSGD算法有效克服了现有方法的梯度不稳定与取整不可行问题，并降低计算成本，理论与实验均表明其优越性。

Abstract: Bilevel data selection is a fundamental task with numerous applications in machine learning and statistics. A common strategy for tackling this problem is to relax the original bilevel combinatorial optimization into a continuous one. However, existing methods, including 0-1 relaxation and probabilistic relaxation, still suffer from several limitations, such as unstable gradient estimation and infeasible rounding. To address these issues, this paper proposes a new probabilistic relaxation for the multi-source bilevel data selection problem. Our key idea is to introduce multiple learnable categorical priors to parameterize a probability distribution supported only on feasible data subsets, thus naturally yielding a lossless rounding scheme. We further show that our proposed relaxation admits an effective two-point gradient estimator, which can simultaneously avoid the inverse-Hessian computation required by existing 0-1 relaxation and the unbounded score term appearing in prior probabilistic relaxation. Furthermore, we develop a reducible representation of this estimator, which substantially reduces the number of lower-level retrainings required for gradient computation. Built upon this reducible two-point estimator, we then design a novel stochastic gradient algorithm, termed ReSGD, for multi-source bilevel data selection problem, and establish a rigorous approximation guarantee for the subset returned by ReSGD under weak submodularity. Finally, extensive experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of our proposed ReSGD.

</details>


### [1243] [Exact Phase-Type Point Processes for Certified Measurement and Prediction of Event Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14948)
*Sayak Dutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出用phase-type(Erlang链)状态空间统一处理时序点过程的测量与预测：多尺度phase-type Hawkes模型具凹对数似然与全局最优，用于衡量市场对宏观新闻的吸收速度；EPF-X神经点过程结合Erlang更新通道，在多个数据集预测表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序点过程既用于测量市场机制（价格吸收新闻速度、市场自我反应比例），也用于预测下一事件。作者希望找到一种代数结构能同时服务这两个目标，并提供精确似然。

Method: 测量端：构建多尺度phase-type Hawkes过程，参数线性进入、对数似然凹，通过Fenchel对偶gap证书求全局最大；马尔可夫嵌入给出含回声的外生冲击闭式响应，稳定性由分支矩阵谱半径<1判定。预测端：提出EPT-X，在线性Hawkes主干上加入历史依赖的Erlang混合更新通道，强度与补偿器闭式、状态仿射递归可并行扫描训练，并可从测量模型认证拟合初始化。

Result: 对6个市场约670次2022-2026预定宏观发布（含安慰剂检验）：CPI、非农、PPI与FOMC声明的直接反应约1秒内被吸收，市场自身回声将一半反应拉伸至16-137秒。EPT-X在全部5个LOBSTER订单簿流及Retweet、Taobao上测试似然最优，StackOverflow上与最佳已发表模型持平。另发现EasyTPP的IntensityFree实现会在评分前截断短间隔，且Amazon数据gap在两固定区间上均匀分布。

Conclusion: phase-type状态空间可同时支撑可认证的市场测量与高性能预测，二者可衔接（预测模型从测量模型初始化）；同时指出现有基准实现中的数据预处理问题。

Abstract: Temporal point processes are used both to measure market mechanisms, for example how fast prices absorb news and how much of the reaction is the market responding to itself, and to predict the next event. We show that one algebraic object, the phase-type (Erlang-chain) state space, serves both purposes with exact likelihoods. For measurement, we build a multiscale phase-type Hawkes process whose parameters all enter linearly. Its log-likelihood is concave, and we compute the global maximum together with a Fenchel duality-gap certificate. A Markov embedding gives the response to an exogenous shock, echoes included, in closed form, and this response is stable if and only if the spectral radius of the branching matrix is below one. Applied to six markets around 670 scheduled macroeconomic releases (2022-2026) with a built-in placebo test, the model shows that the direct reaction to CPI, payrolls, PPI and the FOMC statement is absorbed in about a second, while the market's own echoes stretch half of the response to 16-137 s. For prediction, we introduce EPT-X, a neural point process that adds a history-dependent mixture-of-Erlang renewal channel to a linear Hawkes backbone. Its intensity and compensator remain in closed form, its states follow an affine recursion that trains with a parallel scan, and it can start from the certified fit of the measurement model. EPT-X has the best test likelihood on all five LOBSTER order-book streams and on Retweet and Taobao, and is level with the best published model on StackOverflow. We also find that the EasyTPP implementation of IntensityFree clamps short inter-event times before scoring, and that the gaps of the EasyTPP Amazon data are uniform on two fixed intervals.

</details>


### [1244] [Counterfactual Rollouts for Offline Contrastive Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14953)
*Tingrui Huang,Ai Bo,Junzhe Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出CauCRL，用因果反事实转移解决离线对比强化学习中的演示者隐藏信息导致的混杂问题，提升目标达成任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对比强化学习假设无未观测变量同时影响动作与结果，但当离线演示来自拥有学习者未知信息的演示者时，该假设失效，critic会吸收虚假的动作-结果关联。

Method: 用混杂马尔可夫决策过程形式化该设定，引入反事实转移区分数据可识别与不可识别部分；对所有相容转移取最小化得到最坏情况占据度量，下界真实占据。CauCRL从正负离线演示中学习悲观的
反事实转移，并在反事实rollout上训练critic。

Result: 在混杂目标达成任务上，CauCRL相比标准CRL显著提升成功率。

Conclusion: 通过因果建模反事实转移并对critic进行悲观训练，可缓解离线演示混杂带来的虚假关联，提升对比强化学习鲁棒性。

Abstract: Contrastive reinforcement learning (CRL) learns goal-conditioned values by associating state--action pairs with the states subsequently reached, assuming that no unobserved variable jointly affects the recorded action and its outcome. When offline demonstrations come from a demonstrator with information hidden from the learner, this assumption fails and the critic absorbs spurious action--outcome associations. We formalize this setting with confounded Markov decision processes and introduce counterfactual transitions that separate what the data identify from what they do not; minimizing over all compatible transitions yields a worst-case occupancy that lower-bounds the true one. Causal Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CauCRL) learns a pessimistic counterfactual transition from positive and negative offline demonstrations and trains the critic on counterfactual rollouts, substantially improving success rates over standard CRL on confounded goal-reaching tasks.

</details>


### [1245] [HiPAD: A Unified Gait, Audio-Visual, and Personality Fusion Network for Depression Detection, with a Hierarchical Personality Ablation and the Calibration Limits of Domain-Adapted LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14961)
*Karol Chlasta,Piotr Struzik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HiPAD单融合网络参加MPDD-AVG 2026全部六个子赛道，核心发现是约150 token的人格描述携带的抑郁信号超过音频、视频和步态的总和。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用一个在所有子赛道完全一致的架构，使子赛道间的差异归因于数据而非模型，从而系统研究人格描述、领域自适应及特征类型对抑郁检测的影响。

Method: 各模态用共享BiLSTM编码，缺失模态零填充；仅在步态、音频、视频至少两种存在时使用跨模态注意力；人格特征不进入注意力，以拼接方式融合。并做四级人格消融(L0-L3)、LoRA/QLoRA领域自适应、手工艺特征与深度特征对比。

Result: 仅步态加人格(TLS 0.647)优于任何含音视频的配置；移除全部人格特征使TLS降至0.499-0.507并接近随机；LoRA/QLoRA领域自适应提升二分类Cohen's κ约0.13但降低总体得分，冻结RoBERTa-large更佳；手工艺临床特征(eGeMAPS、OpenFace)优于通用深度特征(wav2vec2、DenseNet)；统一系统跨赛道G-Score为0.482。

Conclusion: 在每队列不足100名受试者的条件下，限制因素在于表征规模和输出校准，而非架构选择；人格描述是最关键的抑郁信号来源。

Abstract: We present HiPAD, a single fusion network submitted to all six sub-tracks of the MPDD-AVG 2026 depression-detection challenge, covering the Elder and Young cohorts and three modality sets (gait, audio-visual, and both), each combined with personality descriptions. The network encodes each available modality with a shared BiLSTM, zero-pads absent modalities, and applies cross-modal attention only when at least two of gait, audio and video are present. Personality, which dominates our results, is kept out of the attention and fused by concatenation. Because the architecture is identical in every sub-track, differences between them reflect the data rather than the model, and we use this to study three questions. Our main finding is that the personality description, roughly 150 tokens about who the subject is, carries more depression signal than audio, video, and gait combined: gait plus personality alone (TLS 0.647) beats every configuration that includes audio and video. First, a four-level ablation of the personality description (L0-L3) quantifies this: removing every personality-derived feature, including the Big Five scores that earlier MPDD ablations keep, lowers the Track-Level Score by 0.499 to 0.507 and leaves the model at chance. Second, domain-adapting the personality encoder with LoRA (7B) or QLoRA (72B) on PHQ-8/9 data raises binary Cohen's $κ$ by 0.13 but lowers the overall score by distorting the PHQ-9 regression; a frozen RoBERTa-large encoder does better at this sample size. Third, at fixed architecture, handcrafted clinical features (eGeMAPS, OpenFace action units) outperform generic deep features (wav2vec2, DenseNet) on the audio-visual tracks. The unified system reaches a cross-track G-Score of 0.482; with under 100 subjects per cohort, the limiting factors are the size of the representation and the calibration of the outputs, not the choice of architecture.

</details>


### [1246] [Cross-Material Magnetic Core Loss Prediction via Operating-Condition Matching and Partial Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14964)
*Cong Yao,Yu Zheng,Zehao Hou,Rui Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出T-PCOT，基于条件支撑部分最优传输的Transformer迁移方法，用于跨材料磁芯损耗预测，在九个对比中均降低误差，达SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨材料磁芯损耗预测需在有限测量下适应新材料响应，而全局特征对齐忽略了源域与目标域激励覆盖的差异，导致对齐效果不佳。

Method: T-PCOT利用频率、磁通摆幅、温度和波形描述符构建可比工况稀疏图；采用容量约束的部分最优传输计划，将对齐分配到源测量并留下高成本目标质量不匹配；该计划在训练前由实测输入构建，引导局部波形特征一致性；并用重要性加权采样在小批量优化中兼顾均匀源回归与传输目标。

Result: 在三种材料对和三种目标标签预算下，T-PCOT在全部九个对比中均优于T-MKMMD。宏平均MRE从12.60%降至9.65%，P95从30.94%降至25.06%，相对降低23.41%和19.01%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，通过工况支撑组织跨材料对齐相比全局对齐方法具有预测优势，T-PCOT在磁芯损耗迁移学习中达到当前最优性能。

Abstract: Cross-material magnetic core loss prediction requires adapting to new material responses with limited measurements. Global feature alignment overlooks differences in source and target excitation coverage. This motivates selecting comparable samples and controlling each source measurement's alignment contribution. This paper proposes T-PCOT, a Transformer transfer method based on condition-supported partial optimal transport. Frequency, flux excursion, temperature, and waveform descriptors define a sparse graph of comparable operating conditions. A capacity-constrained transport plan distributes alignment across source measurements and leaves costly target mass unmatched. The plan is constructed from measured inputs before training and guides local waveform-feature consistency. An importance-weighted sampling scheme preserves both uniform source regression and the transport objective during minibatch optimization. Experiments on three material pairs and three target label budgets show that T-PCOT reduces mean relative error (MRE) and 95th-percentile error (P95) relative to Transformer-based multiple-kernel maximum mean discrepancy (T-MKMMD) in all nine comparisons. Macro MRE decreases from 12.60% to 9.65%, and macro P95 from 30.94% to 25.06%, corresponding to relative reductions of 23.41% and 19.01%. Controlled comparisons and ablations examine the roles of input processing, condition correspondence, and source capacity. The results demonstrate the predictive advantage of organizing cross-material alignment through operating-condition support over the compared global alignment method. The proposed method achieves state-of-the-art predictive performance in magnetic core loss transfer learning.

</details>


### [1247] [HodgePhaseNet: Discrete Hodge Decomposition of Semantic Flows in Transformer Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14971)
*Kiyotaka Kasubuchi,Kazuo Fukiya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HodgePhaseNet 将语义转换建模为有限单纯复形上的反对称 1-余链，用 Hodge 分解分离梯度、旋度和调和分量，并提出相应注意力接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有 WavePhaseNet、QuantumPhaseNet、ModularPhaseNet 提供互补相位表示，但无法将成对关系分离为全局一致方向、局部复合环流和更大未填充周期的持续性环流，因此需要新的分离框架。

Method: 在有限定向单纯复形上，用顶点-边关联矩阵 B1 和边-面关联矩阵 B2 对 1-余链 Ω 做唯一正交分解 Ω=B1^TΦ+B2Ψ+H，满足 B1H=0、B2^TH=0；给出显式投影算子、稀疏实现、可积性与规范结果、数值验证，并重新设计注意力接口，限定在允许的有序 query-key 对上，且从可见前缀构造复形以保持因果边界。

Result: 给出显式投影算子、稀疏实现、可积性与规范相关结果及一个验证性数值示例；注意力偏置在边方向任意选择下保持一致，并保持解码器因果信息边界；注意力输出的规范不变性依赖不变特征或适当补偿特征。

Conclusion: 顶点嵌入的简单差没有余恰当或调和分量，因此真正的关系编码器不可或缺。局部环流不必然是矛盾，调和流也不必然是缺失知识；这些解释及事实错误是否减少需受控实证评估。本文是数学与架构提案，不提供外部自然语言性能结果。

Abstract: WavePhaseNet introduced frequency-resolved semantic representations, QuantumPhaseNet introduced gauge-covariant phase connections, and ModularPhaseNet made a finite cyclic phase channel and its cycle holonomy computable in an ordinary Transformer. These constructions are complementary, yet they do not by themselves separate an observed collection of pairwise relations into a globally consistent direction, circulation around local compositions, and circulation that persists around a larger unfilled cycle. HodgePhaseNet addresses this separation by representing semantic transitions as an antisymmetric real-valued 1-cochain on a finite oriented simplicial complex. With vertex-edge incidence matrix $B_1$ and edge-face incidence matrix $B_2$, every such field has a unique orthogonal decomposition $Ω= B_1^TΦ+ B_2Ψ+ H$, where $B_1H=0$ and $B_2^TH=0$. The three component fields are unique even when their potentials are not. We give explicit projectors, a sparse implementation, integrability and gauge results, a verified numerical example, and a redesigned attention interface. The attention bias is defined on allowed ordered query-key pairs, remains consistent under arbitrary choices of edge orientation, and preserves a decoder's causal information boundary by constructing its complex from the visible prefix. Gauge invariance of the attention output is conditional on using invariant or appropriately compensated features. A simple difference of vertex embeddings has no coexact or harmonic component; a genuine relation encoder is therefore indispensable. Local circulation is not automatically contradiction, and harmonic flow is not automatically missing knowledge. These interpretations and any reduction in factual error require controlled empirical evaluation. This paper presents a mathematical and architectural proposal, not external natural-language performance results.

</details>


### [1248] [Fitting Every Hint Is Not Enough: Premature Floods in Recurrent Algorithmic Reasoners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14982)
*Amin Najafgholizadeh,Mohsen Afsharchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 循环算法推理器在小图上逐步训练，在大图上长步运行时会提前判定节点可达（premature flood）。作者定位两条成因路径并提出审计输入范围与深图测试建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环算法推理器虽能复现每一步训练提示，但在深图上仍失败，存在"精确若干步后提前宣布节点可达"的现象，需要查明其成因与规避方法。

Method: 在SALSA-CLRS的广度优先搜索上，用带度输入的GRU处理器、GIN与PGN进行实验，分析隐藏状态、邻居聚合方式（求和/平均）、推理时输入分布尾部、反向传播方式及训练图分布等影响。

Result: GRU处理器中洪泛由隐藏状态携带，度输入落在训练分布尾部时触发；提高推理输入使洪泛更早且六个模型均不计步。无度输入时邻居求和代替平均也会破坏处理器。GIN/PGN某些种子从固定步开始洪泛。钳制度输入或加200张稠密训练图可消除GRU所有失败；步间detach状态避免洪泛（23种子中0失败 vs 全反传6失败），但求和或残差更新无效，两种已发表补救措施仍有洪泛。基准最深Delaunay图1600节点上，一个GIN种子从第18步洪泛。

Conclusion: 建议审计每个输入与聚合的取值范围（可捕获第一条路径），并在深图上测试（可捕获两条路径）。

Abstract: Recurrent algorithmic reasoners are trained with per-step hints on small graphs and run for many more steps on large ones. On breadth-first search in SALSA-CLRS, we find that a reasoner can reproduce every training hint and still fail on deep graphs: after some exact steps, it declares nodes reached before the search gets there. We call this a premature flood and trace two routes to it. In our GRU processor with a degree input, the flood is carried in the hidden state and set off when that input is in the tail of the training distribution. Setting the input higher at inference brings the flood sooner, and none of the six flooding models counts steps. Without the input, summing the neighbors' states instead of averaging them also breaks the processor. In the benchmark's own GIN and PGN, trained with its code, some seeds instead flood from a fixed step, on sparse and dense graphs alike. Clamping the degree input or adding 200 dense training graphs removes every failure of the GRU processor. Detaching the state between steps avoids the flood in that processor (0 of 23 seeds, against 6 under full backpropagation) but not with sums or a residual update, and two published remedies leave floods. None of the benchmark's test sets is both deep and dense, but its deepest one shows the second route: on its Delaunay graphs at 1,600 nodes, one GIN seed floods from step 18. We therefore recommend auditing the range of every input and aggregate, which catches the first route, and testing on deep graphs, which catches both.

</details>


### [1249] [Mixing Regularization for Average-Reward $Q$-Learning and $Q$-Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14988)
*Julien Roger,Sam Bodmer,Jian Qian,Benjamin Riviere*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究平均奖励强化学习，在给定奖励无关的 m-步混合策略下，通过向该策略正则化来控制学习策略的收缩与探索，给出多种正则化 Q-学习的有限时间分析，并扩展到 Q-planning 与数值验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平均奖励设置的 Bellman 算子仅在 Markov 链混合时才在 span 范数下收缩，现有工作通常假设收缩性（如环境混合），缺乏对仅给定混合策略情形的通用分析。

Method: 给定 reward-agnostic 的 m-步混合策略，将学习策略向其正则化以控制收缩和探索；对可实例化为多种正则化的 Q-学习算法进行有限时间分析，并研究 Q-planning 变体，规划视为时间局部化学习。

Result: 分析揭示了控制收缩、探索和算子偏差的、依赖正则化的新对象；单步情形速率匹配 Q-iteration 与同步 Q-学习已知最优速率，m-步混合得到新速率；Q-planning 中规划视界 H 在边界偏差与样本复杂度间权衡；数值实验验证强混合策略提升收敛与探索，且理论与 α-散度族正则化的收敛和偏差排序一致。

Conclusion: 在仅有混合策略而无环境混合假设下，向混合策略正则化可有效控制平均奖励 Q-学习的收缩与探索，提供统一有限时间保证，并覆盖规划与多种正则化选择。

Abstract: The average-reward setting for reinforcement learning is challenging because its Bellman operator is known to contract in span only when the underlying Markov chain is mixing. Whereas existing work typically assumes a contraction property, e.g., through environment mixing, we consider the setting where we are given a reward-agnostic $m$-step mixing policy, and we control the contraction and exploration properties of the learned policy by regularizing toward the mixing policy. We provide finite-time analysis of $Q$-learning algorithms that can be instantiated with multiple choices of regularization, with guarantees measured with respect to the regularized fixed point. Our framework exposes novel regularizer-dependent objects that control contraction, exploration, and operator bias. In the one-step setting, our rates match the best known rates for $Q$-iteration and synchronous $Q$-learning, and for $m$-step mixing we derive new rates. We also study $Q$-planning variants, and show that planning acts as time-localized learning, where the planning horizon $H$ trades off the bias from the boundary value against the sample complexity. Finally, we present numerical studies validating the analysis: (i) knowledge of a strong mixing policy improves convergence and exploration, and its advantage increases with bottleneck severity and, (ii) our theory predicts the convergence and bias rankings of regularizers from the $α$-divergence family.

</details>


### [1250] [Characterizing the Separability Gap in Prior-Data Fitted Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14989)
*Julius Kobialka,Manuel Hülskamp,Thomas Nagler,David Rügamer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出常见PFN先验并非可分离，导致预测依赖查询特征，并在后验收敛与误设下分析其影响，进而提出利用无标签数据的SemiTabICL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准PFN理论假设任务先验可分离，即特征分布与标签生成机制独立；作者要检验这一假设是否成立及其后果。

Method: 证明常见PFN先验在简单设定下亦不可分离，刻画基于上下文后验与基于上下文加查询特征后验的预测差异，分析后验收敛与误设情形；并训练显式使用无标签观测的PFN（SemiTabICL）。

Result: 差异在后验集中时消失；在误设下不可分离性可能以牺牲条件标签拟合换取更好特征拟合，影响特征归因、贝叶斯优化与鞅检验；SemiTabICL准确率优于匹配的监督基线。

Conclusion: PFN评估需明确无标签数据使用规则，特征与标签分布间的依赖是一个重要的先验设计选择。

Abstract: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) are transformers pretrained on simulated datasets to approximate Bayesian posterior predictive distributions. Standard PFN theory assumes a separable task prior, under which the feature distribution and the mechanism generating labels from features are independent. We show that common PFN priors are non-separable, even in simple settings. Consequently, standard pretraining targets a predictive distribution based on a task posterior updated using both the labeled context and the query features. We characterize its difference from the predictive based on the context posterior alone and show that this difference vanishes under posterior concentration. Under misspecification (i.e., when the true joint distribution lies outside the prior's support), however, prior non-separability can favor better feature fit at the expense of conditional label fit. We illustrate the consequences for feature attribution, Bayesian optimization, and martingale checks of Bayesian behavior. The same dependence also enables PFNs to learn from additional unlabeled observations. We demonstrate this with SemiTabICL, a PFN explicitly pretrained to use these observations, which improves accuracy over a matched supervised baseline. Our findings highlight the need for explicit rules on unlabeled data use in PFN evaluation and establish the dependence between feature and label distributions as a consequential prior design choice.

</details>


### [1251] [Recurrent In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14998)
*Tejas Vaidhya,Gaurav Sahu,Irina Rish*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Tab-Loop 用 4 个共享参数的 ICL 块重复 $k$ 次替代 TabICLv2 的 12 个独立块，参数量减少 62% 却在预训练和推理算力对齐下匹配甚至略优于基线，表明表格基础模型的 ICL 阶段更需要深度而非独立参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型通过上下文学习（ICL）适应新数据集，但与其他 transformer 一样，将计算深度与独立参数化的层数绑定。作者质疑 ICL 阶段是否真的需要每层独立的参数集，还是只需要深度。

Method: 提出 Tab-Loop：将 TabICLv2 的 12 个非绑定 ICL 块替换为 4 个绑定（共享权重）块，重复应用 $k$ 次，其他部分（编码器、解码器、合成先验、训练配方）与基线完全一致，并在相同算力下训练非绑定基线作为对照；另设 4 块非绑定对照（参数量与 Tab-Loop 相同，训练表多 32%）。

Result: 在匹配预训练算力（18.2 EFLOP）与推理算力（12 次块应用）下，Tab-Loop 以少 62% 参数（10.4M vs 27.6M）匹配基线：留出集 log loss 0.4583 vs 0.4588，200 个 TALENT 数据集平均准确率 84.10% vs 83.92%，38 个 TabArena 数据集 Elo 1409 vs 1396；4 块非绑定对照落后（83.46%；Elo 1343）。准确率随循环次数上升并超出训练范围仍保持，继续训练更深循环可扩展有效范围，以基线 4–5 倍推理算力达到其 stage-2 分数。

Conclusion: 在该规模下，表格基础模型的 ICL 阶段更需要深度而非独立参数；权重共享使深度成为推理时的可选项。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models adapt to new datasets through in-context learning (ICL), and, like most transformers, they tie computational depth to the number of independently parameterized layers. We ask whether the ICL stage of such a model needs a distinct set of parameters for every layer, or only depth. We introduce Tab-Loop, which replaces the 12 untied ICL blocks of TabICLv2 with 4 tied blocks applied $k$ times and changes nothing else: the encoders, decoder, synthetic prior and training recipe are shared with an untied baseline trained for the same compute. At matched pretraining compute (18.2 EFLOP) and matched inference compute (12 block applications), Tab-Loop matches the baseline with 62\% fewer parameters (10.4M vs.\ 27.6M): held-out log loss is 0.4583 vs.\ 0.4588, mean accuracy on 200 TALENT datasets is 84.10\% vs.\ 83.92\%, and Elo on 38 TabArena datasets is 1409 vs.\ 1396. A 4-block untied control with Tab-Loop's parameter count, which sees 32\% more training tables for the same compute, trails both (83.46\%; Elo 1343). Because weights are shared, depth becomes a choice made at inference. Accuracy rises with the number of loops through the trained range and holds beyond it, and continued training with deeper loops extends the useful range, reaching the baseline's stage-2 scores at 4--5$\times$ its inference compute. At this scale, the ICL stage of a tabular foundation model needs depth more than it needs distinct parameters.

</details>


### [1252] [Conformal Sequential Decision Making With Cost and Sublinear Policy Regret Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15011)
*Jayadev Naram,Giuseppe Durisi,Matteo Zecchin,Osvaldo Simeone*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OCEA算法，解决 episodic 序列决策中每回合硬成本约束与性能竞争兼顾的问题，并证明其满足逐回合成本约束及次线性期望策略遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理（如控制机器人或网络设备）常需在每回合满足硬成本约束（安全违规率、能耗、失真等），同时保持接近参考策略的累积奖励，现有方法难以同时保证硬约束与竞争性能。

Method: 将问题建模为状态序列任意、奖励与成本可依赖同回合历史动作的episodic序列决策问题；提出online conformal episodic agent (OCEA)，每回合用遗憾受控算法选一个候选动作，当剩余预算无法承担下一轮最大成本时切换为零成本动作。

Result: 证明OCEA对任意状态序列及内部随机性实现均满足逐回合成本约束，同时对满足相同成本约束的比较器类达到次线性期望策略遗憾。

Conclusion: OCEA可应用于风险规避控制与带失真保证的在线压缩，兼顾硬成本约束与竞争性能。

Abstract: Automated decision makers, such as AI agents that control robots or network devices, must often satisfy hard cost constraints while maintaining competitive performance. In such settings, a cost measure, such as a safety violation rate, energy consumption, or a distortion level, must stay within a given budget in every episode of operation. Furthermore, a cumulative reward metric, accounting for per-step performance, must stay close to the reward of a meaningful reference policy. We formulate this setup as an episodic sequential decision problem in which the state sequence is arbitrary, and the reward and cost may depend on past actions within the same episode. We propose the online conformal episodic agent (OCEA), a policy that selects one candidate action per episode using a regret-controlled algorithm, and switches to a zero-cost action when the remaining budget cannot absorb the maximum cost of one more round. We prove that OCEA satisfies per-episode cost constraints for every state sequence and for every realization of its internal randomness, while achieving a sublinear expected policy regret with respect to the best action sequence in hindsight from a comparator class satisfying the same per-episode cost constraints. We apply OCEA to risk-averse control and online compression with distortion guarantees.

</details>


### [1253] [Algorithmic Fairness Over Time: Advances & Prospects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15015)
*Miriam Rateike*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇短文/立场文章，提出一个分类体系，用于区分近期研究中的静态公平性与时间性公平性概念，并展望未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在存在反馈循环的场景下，某一步的算法决策会影响后续步骤观测到的数据，从而引入选择偏差或数据分布漂移。忽视这些效应会导致不公平，且随着模型在社会中持续部署，不公平可能随时间加剧。因此需要理解如何度量并保证算法决策模型随时间推移的公平性。

Method: 作者构建了一个分类体系（taxonomy），对近期进展中不同类型的静态与时间性公平性概念进行区分；随后通过识别常见的隐含时间假设、待解决的开放问题及其他挑战，提出未来研究展望。

Result: 提出了静态公平性与时间性公平性的分类框架，并梳理出若干常见的隐含时间假设、开放问题与挑战。

Conclusion: 该文呼吁增强对公平性的时间维度理解，并为后续研究指明了方向。

Abstract: In the presence of feedback loops, algorithmic decisions at one time step can influence observed data in subsequent steps, potentially introducing selection bias or shifts in data distribution. Research has demonstrated that ignoring these effects can lead to unfairness, which may worsen over time as the model remains deployed within society. This raises important questions of how to measure and ensure fairness of algorithmic decision-making models over time. In this short paper, we present a taxonomy that distinguishes between different types of static and temporal fairness notions in recent advancements. We then suggest prospects for future research by identifying common implicit temporal assumptions, open questions to enhance our temporal understanding of fairness, and other open challenges.

</details>


### [1254] [PATTERN Can Be Solved from Memory: Generator-Aware Baselines for Synthetic Node Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15020)
*Amin Najafgholizadeh,Mohsen Afsharchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PATTERN基准因训练/测试共享同一批模式而可被无需训练的模式匹配器以99.2%准确率"作弊"超过所有已发表模型，作者建议合成基准应报告新模板分数并公布生成器基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PATTERN这类合成节点分类基准被广泛用于排名图神经网络，但其生成器一次性抽取100个模式并在所有数据划分中重复使用，导致测试图包含训练图中出现过的模式，模型排名可能被这种数据泄漏所扭曲，需要检验该基准的有效性。

Method: 构造一个无参数的匹配器：从训练标签中读取模式并在测试图中查找；同时对比CKGConv、GRIT等已发表模型在"重用模式"与"全新模式"图上的表现，并做扣留模式、每图换用新模式的训练实验，以及在CLUSTER和Minesweeper上的生成器推理测试。

Result: 匹配器在重用模式下达99.2%类加权准确率（最佳已发表模型89.8%，无模式推理86.8%）；CKGConv和GRIT在新模式图上甚至低于该模式盲预测器，从CKGConv训练中扣留模式会降低其准确率；每图用新模式训练可提升新模式下约2个点。生成器推理在CLUSTER上追平最佳结果，在Minesweeper上无训练即超过所有已发表结果。

Conclusion: PATTERN等合成基准因模式重用而存在严重的数据泄漏与评估偏差；建议合成基准同时报告全新模板与重用模板的分数、公开基于生成器的基线，并说明指标如何加权与池化。

Abstract: PATTERN, a synthetic node-classification benchmark still used to rank graph networks, plants a random subgraph in a random host graph and asks which nodes belong to it. Its generator draws 100 patterns once and plants the same ones in every split, so each test graph carries a pattern that also appears in 100 training graphs. A matcher that reads these patterns off the training labels and looks them up in each test graph reaches 99.2 class-weighted accuracy with no trained parameters, against 89.8 for the best published model. Inference under the generator without the patterns reaches 86.8. Two published models, CKGConv and GRIT, score lower on patterns they have not seen: on new graphs with fresh patterns both fall below this pattern-blind predictor, and withholding patterns from CKGConv's training lowers its accuracy on the test graphs that carry them. Training CKGConv with a new pattern in every graph raises its accuracy on fresh patterns by about 2 points, to the level of the pattern-blind predictor, at some cost on the reused patterns. The same kind of inference under the generator matches the best published result on CLUSTER and, without any training, scores above every published result we found on Minesweeper's released board. We recommend that synthetic benchmarks report scores on fresh templates beside reused ones, publish baselines built from their generators, and state how their metric is weighted and pooled.

</details>


### [1255] [InCLAD: A Continual Learning Benchmark for Industrial Visual Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15032)
*Łukasz Marcjan,Dorota Wilk-Kołodziejczyk,Roberto Corizzo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将工业异常检测重构为持续(task-incremental)基准，提出跨组件、跨数据集的半监督持续学习场景，从图像级检测和像素级定位两方面评估模型的持续性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工业异常检测基准多为静态的、孤立的，无法反映部署中检测系统需随时间从一种工业组件扩展到另一种组件的真实需求；且现有流程要么假设全监督缺陷标签，要么仅研究单一数据集，半监督检测器在异构组件序列上的表现尚不明确。

Method: 将持续工业异常检测定义为task-incremental问题：每个组件为一个任务，学习目标保持半监督。把基准组织为一系列相关组件级任务的序列，定义random、easy-to-hard、hard-to-easy多种场景，并额外提出跨多数据集的挑战性场景；从图像级异常检测和像素级异常定位两个互补视角评估持续性能。

Result: 构建了持续工业异常检测基准，涵盖单数据集与跨数据集的多种任务序列场景，并建立了图像级检测与像素级定位双视角的持续性能评估体系。

Conclusion: 通过将工业异常检测从静态train/test问题重构为持续基准，为研究演化工业环境中的知识保持、适应与泛化提供了具体路径。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly detection benchmarks have advanced rapidly, yet they remain largely static and therefore underrepresent deployment settings in which inspection systems must be extended from one industrial component to another over time. In our setting, continual industrial anomaly detection is framed as a task-incremental problem: each component defines a task, while the learning objective remains semi-supervised. The goal extends beyond conventional anomaly detection, since models should preserve their performance on all components as they are sequentially exposed to new components. This framing is especially relevant because many existing industrial pipelines either assume fully supervised defect labels or study only isolated datasets, leaving open the question of how semi-supervised anomaly detectors behave across a sequence of heterogeneous components. We address this gap by organizing the benchmark as a sequence of related component-level tasks and by defining multiple scenarios, including random, easy-to-hard, and hard-to-easy. In addition to single-dataset continual scenarios, we propose challenging scenarios spanning across multiple datasets. We further evaluate continual performance from two complementary perspectives: image-level anomaly detection and pixel-level anomaly localization. By recasting industrial anomaly detection as a continual benchmark rather than a static train/test problem, our work establishes a concrete path toward studying knowledge retention, adaptation, and generalization in evolving industrial environments.

</details>


### [1256] [Sparsity Saves Compute, Not Samples: Oracle Inequalities for Dense and Sparse Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15039)
*Sagar Ghosh,Huy Nguyen,Alessandro Rinaldo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究MoE最小二乘估计的统计误差，在专家门控均Lipschitz下给出稠密与稀疏路由的oracle不等式及minimax下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE依赖输入相关的自适应路由，但其自适应路由的统计代价尚未被充分理解。

Method: 引入Gated Hilbert Space与范数‖·‖_Δ分离路由与专家误差；利用经验表示推导oracle不等式；对稀疏Top-k/Top-p路由因选择映射不连续，按样本上诱导的选择模式划分门控类，用Natnarajan维刻画路由复杂度。

Result: 稠密MoE达到快速率Õ((Kd_{pr,e}+d_{pr,g})/n)；稀疏路由速率与稠密一致，仅多出由选择器Nat...维控制的可加路由代价；线性softmax门控下路由代价与门控项同阶；线性专家下证明匹配minimax下界Kd_{pr,e}/n，速率最优（至对数因子）。

Conclusion: 参数Lipschitz本身不足以刻画稀疏MoE，路由复杂度条件不可省略；所给速率在常见门控/专家设定下达到最优。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine specialized experts through an input-dependent routing mechanism, and their sparse variants underpin many modern large-scale systems. Yet the statistical cost of adaptive routing remains only partially understood. We study the estimation error of least-squares MoE estimators when both the experts and the gating network are Lipschitz in their parameters. We represent each MoE as a gate--expert pair in a Gated Hilbert Space, whose norm $\|\cdot\|_Δ$ separates the contributions of routing and expert discrepancies. Using its empirical representation, we derive an oracle inequality with a fast rate of order $\tilde{\mathcal O}\big((Kd_{\mathrm{pr},e}+d_{\mathrm{pr},g})/n\big)$ for dense MoEs with $K$ experts. For sparse Top-$k$ and Top-$p$ routing, the selection map is discontinuous in the gating parameters. We handle this by partitioning the gating class according to the selection patterns it induces on the sample. The resulting bounds match the dense rate up to an additive routing cost governed by the Natarajan dimension of the selector. We show that such a routing-complexity condition cannot be dropped: Lipschitz continuity in the parameters alone does not suffice. For linear softmax gating, the routing cost is of the same order as the gating term. Finally, for linear experts, we establish a matching minimax lower bound of order $Kd_{\mathrm{pr},e}/n$, showing that the rates are optimal up to logarithmic factors.

</details>


### [1257] [Information-Theoretic Foundations of Online Temperature Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15043)
*Jin Sima,Nikolaos Papagiannis,Ananth Grama,Wojciech Szpankowski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Entropic Online Sampling (EOS)，在线学习采样温度以最大化熵并控制交叉熵预算，证明其相对离线最优仅损失 O(R log n)，且在混合分布下 R=Õ(√n)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 解码中的重复退化生成问题，温度、nucleus、top-k 等静态启发式方法无法自适应。依据 Kac 引理和 AEP，平稳源重复块的所需时间随熵指数增长，因此需要在保持输出合理的前提下最大化采样分布熵。

Method: 将问题建模为在一个交叉熵预算下最大化采样分布熵。离线解为温度采样，逆温度为预算的 Lagrange 乘子。在线场景中逐次观察到条件分布 p_1,...,p_t，需因果地选择 q_t，而预算耦合整个时间范围。提出 EOS 算法，在每个前缀上重新求解温度以估计这一全局影子价格，并给出一个预算收紧（budget-tightened）变体。

Result: EOS 相对离线最优损失 O(R log n) 熵，超支预算 O(R log n)，R 为实例相关漂移参数；预算收紧变体在相同速率下严格可行。任何严格可行的在线算法至少损失 Ω(R)，故 EOS 在 log n 因子内最优。条件分布来自有限混合时 R=Õ(√n)。实验显示 EOS 能跟踪离线温度，在熵上优于固定温度采样。

Conclusion: EOS 为在线采样温度选择提供了理论最优（至 log n 因子）的因果算法，有效缓解 LLM 解码退化问题。

Abstract: Repetitive, degenerate generation is a persistent failure of LLM decoding, and the standard remedies (temperature, nucleus, and top-$k$ sampling) are static heuristics. By Kac's lemma and the AEP, a stationary source takes time exponential in its entropy to repeat a block. We therefore maximize the entropy of the sampling distributions under one cross-entropy budget that keeps the output plausible under the model. Offline, the solution is temperature sampling, with the inverse temperature as the budget's Lagrange multiplier. \emph{Our contribution is the online problem}: the conditionals $p_1, p_2, \dots$ are revealed one at a time, and the sampling distribution $q_t$ must be chosen causally from $p_1, \dots, p_t$ while the budget couples the entire horizon. The optimal temperature is thus a global shadow price that must be estimated from a prefix. We propose Entropic Online Sampling (EOS), which re-solves for the temperature on each prefix. We prove it loses $O(R\log n)$ entropy against the offline optimum while overshooting the budget by $O(R\log n)$, with $R$ an instance-dependent drift parameter. A budget-tightened variant is exactly feasible at the same rate. Conversely, every exactly feasible online algorithm must lose $Ω(R)$, so EOS is optimal up to a $\log n$ factor. When the conditionals are drawn from a finite mixture, $R=\tilde{O}(\sqrt{n})$. Experiments confirm that EOS tracks the offline temperature and beats fixed-temperature sampling in entropy.

</details>


### [1258] [The Optimal Decoder is Tilted Temperature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15058)
*Nikolaos Papagiannis,Ananth Grama,Wojciech Szpankowski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将解码建模为带熵下限与交叉熵上限约束的pass@k最大化问题，证明最优解为"倾斜温度"条件采样规则 q* ∝ (p e^{ηV})^{1/T}，并据此提出在线算法J-EOS与离线方法CTD，在代码生成任务上优于标准及自适应解码基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 更大采样预算下提高采样温度有益，但最优温度如何确定及其原理尚不清楚。作者希望回答"最优温度是什么"以及"为何有效"，并将经验性调温上升为理论结论。

Method: 将解码刻画为满足两项约束（防多样性坍塌的熵下限、防不合理的交叉熵上限）的pass@k最大化，证明其闭式解为倾斜温度采样 q* ∝ (p e^{ηV})^{1/T}，其中V为验证器势，普通温度采样、验证器贪婪、奖励倾斜策略均为特例。在线设置中提出J-EOS，联合跟踪两个约束乘子并仅用二值通过/失败反馈学习V；离线设置中证明当模型校准良好时，其对数概率与正确性成仿射关系，倾斜坍缩进指数，最优退化为普通温度采样，由此提出CTD：离线拟合单个标量、推理零额外开销。

Result: 理论证明在多样性预算随k自然缩放时最优温度随k单调递增。面向代码生成设计实用解码算法，并在HumanEval、MBPP等基准上评估，连同CTD一起相比标准解码与自适应解码基线取得提升。

Conclusion: 解码温度调优可被形式化为受约束的pass@k最大化，其最优解为倾斜温度采样；在线可由J-EOS从二值反馈学习，校准良好时可退化为零开销的CTD，并在代码生成基准上验证有效性。

Abstract: Larger sample budgets benefit from higher sampling temperatures in LLMs, but what temperature tuning optimizes and why it works remain poorly understood. We seek to answer these questions: we pose decoding as pass@$k$ maximization subject to two constraints that encode critical decoding failure modes: an entropy floor preventing diversity collapse, and a cross-entropy ceiling preventing implausibility. We prove that this maximization takes the form of a single closed-form conditional sampling rule, the \emph{tilted temperature} $q^\star \propto \bigl(p e^{ηV}\bigr)^{1/T}$. Here, the tilt comes from a verifier potential $V$ that quantifies how likely a partial generation is to eventually pass. Ordinary temperature sampling, verifier-greedy decoding, and reward-tilted policies represent special cases. We further show that, under a natural rule for scaling the diversity budget with sample size $k$, the resulting optimal temperature increases with $k$, turning empirical choice into a theorem. The optimum still needs the unknown verifier potential, which we estimate using two design approaches. In the online setting, our J-EOS algorithm jointly tracks the two constraint multipliers and learns the verifier potential from binary pass/ fail feedback alone. In the offline setting, we show that when the model is calibrated, its log-probability tracks correctness up to an affine map. Under this condition, the tilt collapses into the exponent and the optimum reduces to ordinary temperature sampling. Calibrated Temperature Decoding (CTD) then fits one scalar offline and samples with zero additional inference-time overhead relative to temperature sampling. Building on these decision rules, we design a practical decoding algorithm for code generation and evaluate it alongside CTD on benchmarks including HumanEval and MBPP, showing improvements over standard and adaptive decoding baselines.

</details>


### [1259] [Toward a Multimodal Foundation Model for Plasma State Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15076)
*Bin Xia,Chuanfei Dong,Boting Li,Yilan Qin,Zikang Xie,Sung Hyun Son,Adam J. Stanier,Jongsoo Yoo,Hantao Ji,Ahmed Diallo,Han Ding,John Wise*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个面向磁重联等离子体状态重建的多模态基础模型概念验证，用250个合成VPIC模拟训练5.5M参数的残差3D U-Net，从稀疏、异构、不完整观测中重建磁场和电子密度，验证了双向跨模态预测耦合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 等离子体实验通过稀疏、异构、不完整的诊断手段观测耦合物理状态，受FLARE装置启发，需从有限观测中重建完整等离子体状态。

Method: 在固定电子beta β_e0=0.2下用250个合成VPIC模拟（225训练/25验证），训练5.5M参数残差3D U-Net。模型结合保留全部24帧的空间池化、全局时空自注意力与旋转位置编码；对磁场和密度模态分别施加随机、网格、块、时间四种掩码模式，用单一权重实现稀疏传感、跨模态补全、密度超分辨和时间补全。

Result: 密度完全隐藏时，仅0.1%磁场空间可见度即可将密度NRMSE中位数从约0.9降至0.1；磁场缺失或极稀疏时，观测密度能改善电流密度重建；无磁场观测时约1%密度可见度可接近全磁场观测的密度重建精度，但电流结构更依赖直接磁场测量；完整磁场条件还能稳定补全缺失的未来密度帧。

Conclusion: 结果证明了该模拟区域内存在双向跨模态预测耦合，但跨等离子体区域泛化及向实验测量的迁移尚未验证。

Abstract: Plasma experiments observe coupled physical states through sparse, heterogeneous, and incomplete diagnostics. We present a proof of concept toward a multimodal foundation model for plasma state reconstruction during magnetic reconnection, motivated by the Facility for Laboratory Reconnection Experiments (FLARE). Using 250 synthetic VPIC simulations at fixed reference electron beta $β_{e0}=0.2$, with 225 training runs and 25 disjoint validation runs, we train a 5.5M-parameter residual 3D U-Net to reconstruct three magnetic-field components and electron density from incomplete observations. The model combines spatial-only pooling, which preserves all 24 temporal frames, with global spatiotemporal self-attention and rotary positional encoding. Independently masking magnetic and density modalities across random, grid, block, and temporal patterns enables sparse sensing, cross-modal completion, density super-resolution, and temporal completion with a single set of weights and no task-specific retraining. With density fully hidden, just 0.1% magnetic spatial visibility reduces median density NRMSE from approximately 0.9 to 0.1. Conversely, observed density improves current-density reconstruction when magnetic data are absent or extremely sparse. With no magnetic observations, roughly 1% density visibility approaches the density reconstruction accuracy achieved with fully observed magnetic fields, although current structure remains more dependent on direct magnetic measurements. Full magnetic conditioning also stabilizes completion of missing future density frames. These results demonstrate bidirectional cross-modal predictive coupling within this simulation regime. Generalization across plasma regimes or to experimental measurements remains untested.

</details>


### [1260] [On the Theoretical Limits of Learning Unconstrained Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15078)
*Prajwal Ananth,Shuwen Yue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论上证明，仅靠能量与力匹配（energy-and-force matching）不足以保证 MLIP 的采样准确性：在无约束假设类下，预测误差与采样精度之间的关系随维度指数级病态，可出现"预测误差指数衰减但分布几乎完全不匹配"的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究表明放松物理归纳偏置可提升 MLIP 的效率与精度，但由此引出一个关键问题：能量与力的匹配是否足以保证 MD 采样分布正确。作者希望从理论层面回答这一疑问。

Method: 在无约束假设类设定下，理论分析预测误差与学习分布/目标分布之间总变差距离（total variation distance）的关系；识别两类失效机制；并在显式假设下分析局部、保对称模型的行为；最后给出保证平衡态精度与快速弛豫的条件。

Result: 证明该关系在维度上指数级病态：随维度指数衰减的预测误差可与接近最大的总变差距离共存。识别两种失效机制：(1) 动力学捕获（kinetic trapping），即使从能量力精确匹配的训练构型出发，弛豫到准确的学得平衡也需指数级长时间；(2) 平衡态不匹配（equilibrium mismatch），学得的稳态分布本身远离目标分布。在显式假设下，平衡态不匹配即使在局部保对称模型中也会持续存在，单原子误差很小而分布差异随系统规模趋于最大。同时给出保证平衡精度的全局能量控制条件，以及快速弛豫所需的附加条件。

Conclusion: 能量与力匹配本身不足以确保 MLIP 采样正确，二者关系存在维度指数级病态。需引入全局能量控制条件以保证平衡态精度，并额外条件保证快速弛豫。这为设计更可靠 MLIP 的归纳偏置与训练目标提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) accelerate molecular dynamics (MD) simulations by learning the energies and forces that govern atomic motion. Recent work has shown that relaxing physical inductive biases can improve computational efficiency and predictive accuracy, raising the question of whether energy-and-force matching alone is sufficient to ensure accurate sampling. We show that, for unconstrained hypothesis classes, the relationship between prediction error and sampling accuracy is exponentially ill-conditioned in dimension. In particular, prediction errors that decay exponentially with dimension can coexist with nearly maximal total variation distance between the learned and target distributions. We identify two failure mechanisms. The first is kinetic trapping, where relaxation to an accurate learned equilibrium requires exponentially long times, even when simulations are initialized from training configurations at which energies and forces are matched exactly. The second is equilibrium mismatch, where the learned stationary distribution itself remains far from the target. Under explicit assumptions, we show that equilibrium mismatch can persist even in local, symmetry-preserving models, where small per-atom errors coexist with a distributional discrepancy that approaches its maximum as system size increases. Finally, we establish global energy-control conditions that guarantee equilibrium accuracy and identify additional conditions required for rapid relaxation.

</details>


### [1261] [Swarm Telepathy: Prefill-Free KV-Cache Transfer Across Families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15095)
*Abdulrahman Alabdulkareem,Irene Tenison,Yang Zhang,Yada Zhu,Boris Katz,Dan Gutfreund*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SwaT是首个跨家族KV-cache传输方法，实现多智能体系统中的无预填充通信，比文本通信平均准确率高40%、速度快4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体系统通过离散文本通信，限制带宽与能力并造成冗余计算；已有KV-cache传输方法受限于同家族模型或无法跨上下文，需接收方预填充文本。

Method: 提出SwaT (Swarm Telepathy)，首个跨家族KV-cache传输方法，支持多家族多智能体系统的无预填充通信；结合KV-cache压缩技术，保持收发双方模型冻结、无需微调。

Result: 在12个LLM、6个家族、17个基准上表现优异；准确率平均提高40%，墙钟时间平均快4倍；可将VLM的视觉能力迁移至纯文本接收方LLM；训练仅需<50M tokens和<1 GPU-day。

Conclusion: SwaT实现了高效跨家族KV-cache通信，兼顾精度、速度与低训练成本，并支持跨模态能力迁移。

Abstract: LLM multi-agent systems split work across agents that communicate through text. An agent summarizes its findings, another agent receives the text. This constrains communication to discrete tokens and costs redundant compute, limiting bandwidth and capabilities of multi-agent systems. Recent works demonstrate KV-cache transfer between LLMs but they either require the LLMs to be within the same family or cannot function across context, thus requiring the receiver to prefill text. We present SwaT (Swarm Telepathy), the first cross-family KV-cache transfer method that allows prefill-free communication in multi-family multi-agent systems. In an agent-to-agent communication setting, combining SwaT with recent advances in KV-cache compaction beats text-to-text communication in both accuracy and speed, with a mean of $40\%$ higher accuracy and a mean of $4\times$ faster wall-clock time. Experiments show SwaT achieves high performance on 17 benchmarks across 12 LLMs and 6 families. Additionally, given a sender Vision-Language Model (VLM), SwaT is able to transfer the vision capabilities to a text-only receiver LLM exceeding text-to-text communication despite SwaT being trained on text-only data. SwaT keeps both sender and receiver models frozen without fine-tuning and only requires $<50M$ tokens and $<1$ GPU-day to train.

</details>


### [1262] [Anchors Enhance Controllability and Reasoning of Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15097)
*Feiyu Qu,Zheng Huang,Andrea Zanette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AnchorDLM框架，通过生成控制锚点（内容+位置）并置于冻结DLM输出序列引导生成，用RL联合优化，提升可控性与推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）具备可控文本生成潜力，但其可控性（在满足任务约束的同时保持原有能力）尚缺乏探索。DLM的双向注意力允许控制词元从任意位置引导生成，但有效引导依赖内容与位置的匹配。

Method: AnchorDLM中，锚点生成器为每个查询生成由短输出片段及其位置组成的锚点，将其作为控制词元置于指定位置初始化冻结DLM的输出序列并引导去噪。用强化学习训练锚点生成器，联合优化锚点内容与位置，奖励基于DLM输出的答案正确性和约束满足度。并从离散流匹配（DFM）视角解释锚点放置起到了重塑初始速度场的作用。

Result: 在代码生成和数学推理任务上，跨五个DLM骨干模型的实验表明，AnchorDLM提升了可控性，并在多样化基准上进一步带来推理性能增益。

Conclusion: AnchorDLM通过可学习的内容-位置锚点引导冻结DLM生成，有效增强可控性与推理能力，为DLM可控生成提供了新思路。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer new opportunities for controllable text generation. However, their controllability, defined as the ability to satisfy task constraints while preserving their original capabilities, remains underexplored. DLMs' bidirectional attention allows control tokens to guide generation from arbitrary positions in the output sequence, but effective guidance depends on the compatibility between their content and placement. To this end, we propose AnchorDLM, a framework in which an anchor generator produces an anchor consisting of a short output fragment and its position for each query. The anchor is placed as control tokens at the specified position to initialize the output sequence of a frozen DLM and guide subsequent denoising. We train the anchor generator with reinforcement learning (RL) to jointly optimize anchor content and placement, using rewards computed from the DLM's generated outputs based on answer correctness and constraint satisfaction. Moreover, through the lens of discrete flow matching (DFM), we interpret anchor placement as helping to reshape the initial velocity field that guides generation. Experiments on code generation and mathematical reasoning across five DLM backbones show that AnchorDLM improves controllability and further yields gains in reasoning performance across diverse benchmarks.

</details>


### [1263] [Random Feature Pruning for Multi-Class Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15101)
*Mohammad Amin Omidi,Babak Seyfe,Shahrokh Valaee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SEED-MAX算法并结Fisher检验，用于减少W-RKS随机特征冗余，在多分类任务中以约92%剪枝率保持分类精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: W-RKS特征提取存在大量冗余且无效的随机特征，需要有效的特征选择方法以降低冗余。

Method: 将特征选择建模为顺序嵌套模型选择问题，提出Successive Empirical Excess Risk Difference Maximization (SEED-MAX)递归计算经验风险以选取最简约有效特征；并推导正确选择概率的解析下界，进一步用Fisher检验加速剪枝。

Result: 理论下界表明，随训练集增大，正确特征选择概率可任意接近1；在UCR时间序列数据集上，SEED-MAX结合Fisher检验达到约92%剪枝率且分类精度几乎无损。

Conclusion: SEED-MAX与F-Test结合能有效去除W-RKS冗余特征，在保证精度的同时大幅剪枝，代码已开源。

Abstract: Weighted sums of random kitchen sinks (W-RKS) is a commonly used feature extraction technique for supervised learning tasks. A major drawback of this method is the redundancy and ineffectiveness of many extracted random features. This paper investigates efficient methods for reducing such redundancy in multi-class classification problems. We specifically formulate feature selection as a variant of the sequentially nested model selection problem and introduce the Successive Empirical Excess Risk Difference Maximization (SEED-MAX) algorithm. It recursively computes empirical risks to identify the most parsimonious yet informative set of features. We derive an analytical lower bound for the probability of correct feature selection by the SEED-MAX algorithm. This lower bound on the probability of correct feature selection can be made arbitrarily close to one by increasing the training dataset size. To further enhance the rate of pruning, we evaluate the features retained by SEED-MAX using the Fisher test (F-Test). Empirical evaluations on UCR time-series classification datasets show that the sequential application of SEED-MAX with the Fisher test achieves approximately 92 percent rate of pruning with negligible degradation in classification accuracy. Implementations of the SEED-MAX and SEED-MAX-F-Test methods are available at https://github.com/OmidiAmin/seed-max-ftest.

</details>
