### [1264] [scHFBiMamba: a bidirectional Mamba autoencoder for cardiac disease-state classification from single-nucleus RNA-seq data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15117)
*Ugo Lomoio,Pietro Hiram Guzzi,Pierangelo Veltri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: scHFBiMamba用双向Mamba自编码器(BiMambaAE)+MLP实现心衰单核RNA测序的物种、细胞类型和疾病状态联合分类，参数比稠密DAE少14.6倍，性能更优且提供可解释基因归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估紧凑的双向状态空间自编码器能否在心脏衰竭单核RNA测序数据中提升多任务分类性能，同时保持参数高效和可解释性。

Method: 在Ruz Jurado等稠密DAE+MLP框架基础上，提出scHFBiMamba：BiMambaAE将16,545基因映射到350维潜表示(13.2M参数)。对比六种编码器-分类器配置，用McNemar检验+BH校正，并在冻结表示上评估九种分类器；用SHAP衍生基因与DEG基于HF相关GO关键词做通路富集比较。

Result: BiMambaAE+MLP聚合F1最高(13输出池化macro-F1=0.966 vs DAE的0.957，类别均值macro-F1=0.977 vs 0.970)，显著提升细胞类型和疾病状态准确率(校正p=7.1e-3、4.8e-6)，物种F1=1.000。SHAP衍生基因通路富集F1=0.105，优于DEG的0.053。

Conclusion: 紧凑双向状态空间自编码器可超越更大的稠密自编码器，参数更少且分类更准，支持多任务预测与假设生成的基因层面解释。

Abstract: To evaluate whether a compact bidirectional state-space autoencoder improves joint classification of species, cell type, and disease state from single-nucleus RNA-sequencing profiles in heart failure (HF), while yielding interpretable gene attributions. Building on the dense denoising autoencoder (DAE) and MLP framework of Ruz Jurado et al., we developed scHFBiMamba, combining a bidirectional Mamba autoencoder (BiMambaAE) with an MLP head. BiMambaAE maps 16,545-gene profiles to 350-dimensional latent representations using 13.2M parameters, about 14.6-fold fewer than the dense DAE (192.9M). We compared six encoder-classifier configurations on 38,275 held-out cardiac nuclei using McNemar tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and assessed nine classifiers on frozen representations. Biological relevance was evaluated by comparing SHAP-derived differentially explained genes with differentially expressed genes against curated HF-related Gene Ontology keywords. BiMambaAE+MLP achieved the highest aggregate F1: pooled macro-F1 across 13 outputs was 0.966 versus 0.957 for DAE+MLP, and the mean category macro-F1 was 0.977 versus 0.970. It significantly improved cell-type and disease-state accuracy (adjusted p=7.1e-3 and p=4.8e-6, respectively), with species F1 of 1.000. SHAP-derived differentially explained genes achieved a pathway-enrichment benchmark F1 of 0.105 versus 0.053 for differentially expressed genes. Compact bidirectional state-space autoencoders can outperform substantially larger dense autoencoders for joint cardiac transcriptomic classification while reducing parameters. scHFBiMamba enables accurate multi-task prediction and hypothesis-generating gene-level interpretation. Code: https://github.com/UgoLomoio/scHFBiMamba.

</details>


### [1265] [ShellElastic: Scalable Elastic Pretraining with Simultaneous Maximal Updates and Hyperparameter Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15124)
*Can Jin,Yan Kang,Yifan Gong,Chongjian Ge,Mingze Xu,Yuanjun Xiong,Dimitris N. Metaxas,Hongwu Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 \Ours，一种将隐藏维度组织为密集核心与逐层外壳的弹性 Transformer，使得单次全宽前向即可包含所有子网络的精确隐藏状态，并以固定计算图实现高效联合训练；同时给出 \muE 扩展实现所有子网络同时最大更新与超参可迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型需支持多样推理预算，但为每个预算单独训练模型会重复预训练成本。现有弹性模型（共享权重超级网络中嵌套子网络）面临三大障碍：每步负载可变难以分布式扩展、超参跨模型规模迁移有限、无法保证所有子网络同时被最大程度更新。

Method: 将隐藏维度组织为密集核心加连续外壳，使每个隐藏矩阵为块下三角结构，从而一次全宽前向pass即包含所有子网络精确隐藏状态的前缀，联合训练保持固定计算图，单步成本近似只训练最宽子网络。进一步提出 \muE：将最大更新参数化 \mup 扩展到 \Ours 及其他弹性架构，其缩放规则可证明使超级网中所有子网络同时被最大更新（\muI），并在加宽或增加外壳时保持该性质（\muT）。

Result: 实验表明，\Ours 单次训练产生的子网络在参数量匹配时优于 MatFormer 与完全弹性基线，并接近需数倍训练步数分别训练的模型；扫描验证在小规模非弹性代理上调好的超参在弹性族和更大超级网上仍接近最优。

Conclusion: \Ours 通过块下三角的核-壳结构与 \muE 参数化，解决了弹性训练的扩展性、超参迁移与同步更新问题，实现高效且高性能的弹性 Transformer 训练。

Abstract: Foundation models need to support diverse inference budgets, yet training a separate model for each budget duplicates pretraining effort. Elastic models train several nested sub-networks inside one weight-shared supernet, but existing recipes face three obstacles: variable per-step workloads that hinder distributed scaling, limited hyperparameter (HP) transfer across model sizes, and no guarantee that all sub-networks are maximally updated at once. We present \Ours, an elastic transformer that organizes hidden dimensions into a dense core and successive shells, so that every hidden matrix is block lower triangular. One full-width forward pass contains every sub-network's exact hidden states as prefixes, so joint training keeps a fixed computation graph and costs about as much per step as training the widest sub-network alone. We further introduce \muE, an extension of maximal update parameterization (\mup) to \Ours and other elastic architectures. Its scaling rules provably keep all sub-networks of a supernet maximally updated simultaneously (\muI), and keep doing so when the supernet is widened or given more shells; sweeps confirm that HPs tuned on a small non-elastic proxy stay near-optimal for elastic families and larger supernets (\mbox{\muT}). A single \Ours run produces sub-networks that outperform MatFormer and fully elastic baselines at matched parameter counts, and approach separately trained models that together take several times the steps.

</details>


### [1266] [To Defer or Not to Defer? Online Learning with LLMs and Congested Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15128)
*Vasileios Saketos,William Reveillard,Alexandre Proutiere,Sebastian Dalleiger,Ming Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM与人类专家协作中考虑专家队列拥塞的在线延迟决策问题，提出KL-PBD算法学习未知置信信号可靠性，实现最优遗憾界并在真实数据集上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI系统常用LLM处理常规查询、将不确定案例移交专家，但专家容量有限时需同时考虑LLM可靠性与队列拥塞；且置信信号可靠性未知，反馈仅在被延迟时被选择性观测并因排队而延迟。

Method: 将有容量约束的专家延迟问题建模为在线序贯决策：每查询观测LLM置信信号，决定直接输出或延迟；使用KL下置信界（KL-PBD）学习未知可靠性参数以指导决策。

Result: 对K个置信水平和时域T，KL-PBD在准确率远离延迟边界时达到O(K log T)的间隔相关遗憾，最坏情况为Õ(√(KT))；并证明匹配下界说明速率最优（至对数因子）。在合成实例及GSM8K、NuminaMath、MedMCQA（Qwen LLMs）上验证。

Conclusion: KL-PBD为容量受限专家协作提供了理论最优的延迟决策方法，兼具理论保证与实证有效性。

Abstract: Modern AI systems increasingly combine large language models (LLMs) with human experts, using the LLM to handle routine queries while deferring uncertain cases for expert review. When expert capacity is limited, however, deferral decisions must account not only for the reliability of the LLM but also for congestion in the expert queue. We formulate this as an online sequential decision-making problem in which, for each query, the system observes the confidence signal of the LLM's answer and must decide whether to output the answer or defer the query to a capacity-constrained expert. The reliability of the confidence signal is initially unknown and must be learned from expert feedback, which is both selectively observed (only deferred queries are labeled) and delayed by queuing. We propose \texttt{KL-PBD}, a learning algorithm that uses Kullback--Leibler lower confidence bounds on the unknown reliability parameters to guide deferral decisions. For $K$ confidence levels and horizon $T$, \texttt{KL-PBD} achieves $O(K\log T)$ gap-dependent regret when the accuracy at every confidence level is bounded away from the deferral boundary, and $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{KT})$ worst-case regret. We establish matching lower bounds, showing that these rates are optimal up to logarithmic factors. Finally, we validate our approach on synthetic instances and real-world question-answering datasets, namely GSM8K, NuminaMath, and MedMCQA, using Qwen LLMs.

</details>


### [1267] [When Dynamic Scaling Fails: A Scale-State Feedback Governs Recurrent-State Quantization in Linear-Attention and SSM LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15139)
*Yuhang Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究线性注意力与状态空间LLM中循环状态量化问题，发现量化器尺度与状态之间的反馈导致误差累积，提出应"约束尺度而非定位离群值"，并需报告比特宽度的验证解码时长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环状态在长解码中持续被重写，量化状态是降低成本的天然手段，但每步应用的量化器位于循环内部，误差会累积，INT4初期无损但千步后崩溃，亟需理解失效机制。

Method: 分析量化器尺度与状态的反馈机制；将尺度绑定到全精度参考以消除范数爆炸；对比离群值感知方案与持久缩放；跨层比特分配实验（含文章不相交划分下的学习分配）。

Result: 尺度绑定消除范数爆炸但仅恢复1.8/5.4 nats；剩余为分辨率问题，离群值定位无效，所有离群值感知方案均劣于简单持久缩放；学习分配退化为保护前几层的平凡规则；32K时group-wise INT4不比丢弃状态更好。

Conclusion: 数值不稳定与功能性退化是可分离的失败；应约束量化尺度而非定位离群值，并报告比特宽度被认证的对应解码时长。

Abstract: Linear-attention and state-space LLMs carry long context in a fixed-size recurrent state, and quantizing that state is the natural way to cut its cost during long decode. Unlike a weight tensor, the state is rewritten at every step, so a quantizer applied at each step sits inside the recurrence and its errors compound. INT4 that leaves synthetic recall perfectly intact at the start destroys it a thousand steps later. The mechanism is a feedback between the quantizer scale and the state it is derived from. Yoking that scale to a full-precision reference removes the resulting norm explosion entirely, yet recovers only 1.8 of the 5.4 nats lost, so numerical instability and functional degradation are separable failures. The remainder is a resolution problem that locating outliers does not solve, since every outlier-aware scheme here loses to plain persistent scaling. Allocating bits across layers does help, but under article-disjoint splits a learned allocation collapses onto the trivial rule of protecting the first few layers. Run out to 32K, group-wise INT4 is worth no more than discarding the state. Contain the scale rather than locate outliers, and report the decode horizon at which a bit-width was certified.

</details>


### [1268] [Sensor-Aware Joint Data Fusion and State Estimation under Sparse Multi-rate Distribution Grid Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15156)
*Pooja Algikar,Stefano Fenu,Kumarsinh Jhala,Siby Plathottam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出异构图潜ODE与图Transformer状态估计器，解决多速率异构传感器下配电网状态估计问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代配电网因本地储能与发电接入导致复杂度提升，运营商难以直接监测。传统方法要求时间同步且部分可观测，而稀疏异构传感器的多速率监测通常依赖机器学习，且常用两阶段流水线（先融合后估计）存在局限。

Method: 提出异构图潜变量ODE，对测量函数和采样过程进行类型化并局部化到特定母线上，配合图Transformer状态估计器，专门针对多速率异构传感器布局求解DSSE。

Result: 在多个IEEE标准拓扑上验证有效性，随着可观测性下降仍保持性能。

Conclusion: 该方法能有效应对多速率异构传感器布置及可观测性退化条件下的配电网状态估计任务。

Abstract: Distribution-system state estimation is a growing necessity for the modern power grid as the addition of local storage and generation add system complexity that an operator or aggregator is not able to directly monitor. Classical methods work well when all system elements are time-synchronized and at least partly observable, but multi-rate monitoring of sparse heterogeneous sensors typically relies on machine learning approaches. It is a common practice in the literature to structure this task as a two-stage pipeline, first fusing data from disparate sensors and then feeding the fused pseudo-measurements to a separately trained state estimator. We propose a heterogeneous latent graph ODE in which measurement functions and sampling processes are typed and localized on specific buses, paired with a graph- transformer state estimator solving DSSE specifically for multi-rate heterogeneous sensor placements, and demonstrate its effectiveness across multiple IEEE standard topologies as observability degrades.

</details>


### [1269] [Beyond Adjacent Layers: Graph-Guided Layer Fusion for Compressing Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15159)
*Muhammad Usama,Yeoreum Jung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FCM：利用跨层CKA相似图与谱社区检测发现功能区，做深度压缩（层融合），在多数LLM上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM深度压缩方法只对单层打分或仅分组相邻/连续层，隐含假设功能冗余是局部的，缺乏验证。

Method: 对13个模型（6个架构族，1.6B-14B）计算全对CKA相似矩阵；构建L×L相似图，用谱社区检测找功能等价层簇，保留每簇Block-Influence最高的层，并用LoRA恢复；依据校准数据上的预设规则在cosine与CKA相似度间选择。

Result: 非相邻层高相似对是相邻层的3.6-15.9倍。2x压缩下，FCM在13个模型中12个perplexity低于ShortGPT（10个显著，Qwen3-4B最多降50%），仅Mistral-7B略差；对比FlattenGPT、SWM、DeltaLLM在10/13最优（平均排名1.15），并在3个锚点模型上超MKA。20个zero-shot推理单元中15个不差于ShortGPT，并改善MMLU、LAMBADA、HumanEval pass@1及生成质量。Qwen2.5-7B参数量减46%、峰值VRAM降42%、解码吞吐增84%。谱分组优于Fisher连续分割41%、均匀分割51%，优势延伸至3x及14B规模。

Conclusion: 功能冗余并非局部，跨层谱社区分组是有效的LLM深度压缩策略，FCM在多模型、多任务及压缩比与规模上表现稳定且高效。

Abstract: Existing depth-compression methods for large language models (LLMs) score layers individually or group only adjacent or contiguous layers, implicitly assuming that functional redundancy is local. We test this assumption by computing full pairwise Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) similarity matrices for thirteen LLMs from six architecture families (1.6B-14B parameters). Non-adjacent layers have 3.6-15.9x more high-similarity pairs than adjacent ones, a structure that prior similarity-based layer merging has not systematically exploited. We propose Fusion via Community Mining (FCM), which builds the full L x L similarity graph, uses spectral community detection to find clusters of functionally equivalent layers, keeps the highest-Block-Influence layer in each cluster, and applies LoRA recovery; a pre-specified rule computed only on calibration data chooses between cosine and CKA similarity. At 2x compression, FCM lowers mean perplexity below ShortGPT on twelve of thirteen models, significantly on ten (Welch's t-test with Holm-Bonferroni correction; up to 50% on Qwen3-4B), with Mistral-7B the only loss (+13.4%). Against FlattenGPT, SWM, and DeltaLLM under matched calibration and recovery, FCM gives the best perplexity on ten of thirteen models (mean rank 1.15), and it also outperforms MKA on three anchor models. FCM matches or exceeds ShortGPT on 15 of 20 zero-shot reasoning cells and also improves MMLU, LAMBADA, HumanEval pass@1, and free-form generation quality. The 2x-compressed Qwen2.5-7B has 46% fewer parameters, 42% lower peak VRAM, and 84% higher decode throughput on a single A100. Spectral grouping outperforms Fisher contiguous segmentation by 41% and uniform partitioning by 51%, and FCM's advantage grows beyond a 2x crossover up to 3x and persists at the 14B scale. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/fcm-layer-fusion

</details>


### [1270] [LexiCan: Lexicographic Canonicalization of Point Clouds for Machine Learning Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15171)
*Daniel Sanchez,Djordje Mihajlovic,Federica Valeau,Luka Benić,Raghuwansh Raj,Soutrik Sarangi,Snir Hordan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LexiCan是一种新的3D点云规范化方法，证明在O(3)/SO(3)下不变，在分子数据集上达到~1e-6精度且速度极快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有规范化方法存在旋转不连续跳跃和不变性误差，导致分子表示歧义。

Method: 提出LexiCan规范化，选择唯一轨道代表元，实现可证明的O(3)/SO(3)不变性。

Result: 在QM9和QM-sym上旋转不变性达~1e-6埃，缓解不连续跳跃，速度快数个数量级；在QM9预测和ModelNet40分类上表现更优。

Conclusion: LexiCan提供了更精确、更高效且更鲁棒的3D点云规范化方案。

Abstract: Canonicalization resolves the rotational and permutation ambiguity of 3D point clouds by selecting a unique orbit representative, maintaining their geometric information while allowing standard architectures, such as Transformers, to operate on them. Existing canonicalizations, however, exhibit discontinuity jumps on molecular configurations and non-trivial invariance errors in popular molecular datasets, which lead to ambiguity in their representation. To bridge this gap, we introduce LexiCan, a canonicalization that is provably invariant under either $O(3)$ or $SO(3)$, empirically invariant to rotations to within $\sim 10^{-6}$ angstroms on the QM9 and QM-sym molecular datasets, and mitigates discontinuity jumps on QM-sym, while running orders of magnitude faster than an existing canonicalization. Finally, non-invariant models perform better on QM9 property prediction and ModelNet40 shape classification with LexiCan than with that canonicalization.

</details>


### [1271] [Only What You've Signed up For: Secure Workflows with Constrained Diffusion Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15177)
*Michael Cardei,Anjun Hu,Chenrui Ma,Francesco Pinto,Chawin Sitawarin,Chulin Xie,Ferdinando Fioretto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoDA框架，通过在扩散语言模型的去噪过程中直接施加任务相关的安全策略，将token分布投影到合规集合上，从而防御提示注入攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着智能体AI系统承担越来越复杂且后果严重的任务，防范提示注入变得至关重要。现有防御多依赖检测或推理注入的恶意指令，难以抵御优化注入本身的自适应攻击。

Method: 利用扩散语言模型（dLLMs）逐步精炼全序列预测的特性，CoDA在每一步去噪时将token分布投影到符合策略的集合上，使约束在整个生成过程中持续得到满足，直接在去噪过程中强制执行任务相关的安全策略。

Result: 在静态与自适应提示注入攻击下，对当前最先进的多个扩散语言模型系列进行评估，CoDA显著降低了攻击成功率，同时保持有竞争力的任务效用和实用的推理开销。

Conclusion: CoDA为扩散语言模型智能体提供了一种在生成过程中持续满足安全策略的防御范式，能有效抵御提示注入且开销可控。

Abstract: As agentic AI systems take on increasingly complex and consequential tasks, securing them against prompt injection becomes critical. Existing defenses often rely on detecting or reasoning about injected malicious instructions and can therefore remain vulnerable to adaptive attacks that optimize the injection itself. Diffusion language models (dLLMs), an emerging framework for language generation, offer a new opportunity for security enforcement: by iteratively refining their sequence wide predictions, they enable broader-scope constraint enforcement throughout generation. This paper introduces Policy-Constrained Diffusion Agents (CoDA), a framework that enforces task dependent security policies directly within the denoising process of diffusion language models. At each denoising step, CoDA projects token distributions onto a policy-compliant set, maintaining constraint satisfaction throughout generation. We evaluate CoDA across state-of-the-art diffusion language model families under both static and adaptive prompt-injection attacks. Results demonstrate substantial reductions in attack success rate with competitive task utility and practical inference overhead.

</details>


### [1272] [Game-Theoretic Reinforcement Learning based Topology-Agnostic Defense for Virtual Power Plants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15183)
*Pooja Algikar,Stefano Fenu,Kumarsinh Jhala,Siby Plathottam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向VPP-operated DER的混合扰动式网络-物理防御方法，融合博弈论规划、无模型强化学习与贝叶斯信念更新，在无需馈线拓扑信息的情况下实现对协调网络攻击的检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DER经VPP聚合后扩大了攻击面，协调网络攻击可扰乱配电、输电与市场运行；现有网络-物理防御假设可获取电网模型与运行状态，而第三方聚合商往往不具备这些信息。

Method: 在贝叶斯信念更新框架下，将Stackelberg博弈（VPP为领导者）与无模型RL结合；用多输出高斯过程+HMC推断攻击者类型、检测概率与置信度；对后验信念做矩匹配高斯传播；RL策略自适应整合领导者动作与探索。

Result: 在IEEE 13-Bus和123-Bus馈线及DER组合上评估，在攻击者模型不确定与馈线重构条件下有效检测，且无需显式馈线拓扑知识。

Conclusion: 双级博弈规划、非参数贝叶斯推断与自适应RL的结合是VPP网络安全的可行方向。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of distributed energy resources (DERs) aggregated by virtual power plants (VPPs) elevates cybersecurity risk by expanding the attack surface. A coordinated cyberattack has the potential to disrupt distribution-system, bulk-system, and market operations. Existing cyberphysical defense strategies largely assume access to grid network models and operating conditions, which may not be available to third-party aggregators. This paper proposes a novel hybrid, perturbation-based cyber-physical defense for VPP-operated DERs that blends game-theoretic planning with model-free reinforcement learning (RL) under a Bayesian belief-update framework. Topology agnosticism is defined from the VPP information and implementation perspective: the VPP does not require access to the feeder topology, line parameters, switching configuration, or full system state. This work advances the state of the art through three contributions: (1) a multi-output Gaussian process with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for discrete attacker-type inference, probability of detection, and confidence of detection for modeling the belief distribution; (2) moment-matched Gaussian propagation of posterior beliefs across episodes; and (3) an RL policy that adaptively integrates Stackelberg leader (VPP) actions with exploration. Furthermore, we establish equilibrium existence and derive an episode-level closed-loop utility bound connecting attacker-belief uncertainty with GT-RL action alignment. Evaluations on IEEE 13- and 123-Bus feeders with DER portfolios demonstrate effective detection under attacker-model uncertainty and evaluated feeder re-configuration conditions, while requiring no explicit feeder-topology knowledge. Overall, the results indicate that combining bi-level game-theoretic planning, nonparametric Bayesian inference, and adaptive RL is a promising direction for VPP cybersecurity.

</details>


### [1273] [DeltaNet-PC: Test-Time Memory Without Backpropagation Through Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15185)
*Todd Morrill,Richard Zemel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出DeltaNet-PC，通过将每步记忆更新视为隐变量，从概率预测编码模型推导出序列逐字记忆机制，实现测试时快速存储与回忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序列信息测试时记忆是智能系统的基础能力，但Transformer和线性注意力用BPTT训练，内存开销巨大；预测编码虽用局部更新但缺乏序列测试时记忆。

Method: 将每步记忆更新ΔS_t建模为隐变量（而非慢权重），对标准PC概率模型取对数概率，推导出PC原生的逐字序列记忆更新规则，并与DeltaNet等线性注意力选择建立联系。

Result: 广泛实证测试显示系统的扩展能力、内存占用及从证据推断上下文（如bank河流vs银行）的能力；可存储单序列、多序列及键值关联记忆对，且回忆准确率完美。

Conclusion: DeltaNet-PC为序列数据提供PC原生测试时记忆方案，统一了PC与线性注意力，并实现多种记忆任务的完美回忆。

Abstract: Test-time memorization of sequential information is a foundational capability for any intelligent system that needs to rapidly store and retrieve data, as demonstrated by the attention mechanism in large language models. However, Transformers and linear attention variants are trained via backpropagation through time (BPTT), which has drawbacks such as its enormous memory requirements. Predictive coding (PC), an algorithm that optimizes a prediction-error energy function with local updates, offers a compelling solution but still lacks test-time memory for sequential data. We develop a solution to this problem by treating the per-step memory update $ΔS_t$ as a latent variable, as opposed to a slow weight to be learned. By taking the log probability of a standard PC-based probabilistic model, we derive a PC-native solution for verbatim sequence memory, and relate our update rule to common choices in the linear attention literature (e.g., DeltaNet). We present an extensive set of empirical tests to probe our system's properties, including its scaling capacity, memory footprint, and ability to infer a context from evidence (e.g., bank (river) vs. bank (money)). We show how DeltaNet-PC can be used for storing single sequences of data, multiple sequences of data, and key-value associative memory pairs with perfect recall accuracy.

</details>


### [1274] [Exploring Jailbreak Vulnerability Across Depth-Based Dynamic Inference in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15207)
*Lass Najmuldeen,Seyedhamidreza Mousavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究深度动态推理（早期退出）对LLM越狱攻击鲁棒性的影响，发现浅层出口更鲁棒、深层出口更易优化攻击损失，且对抗后缀对效率影响一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM计算开销大且易受越狱攻击，深度动态推理可高效推理，但其对鲁棒性的影响尚未被探索。

Method: 系统研究深度动态推理对LLM越狱鲁棒性的影响，分析不同退出深度的鲁棒性与攻击损失。

Result: 1) 浅层出口比深层出口更鲁棒；2) 深层出口更易优化对抗后缀并达到更低攻击损失；3) 对抗后缀对不同深度出口的效用影响一致。

Conclusion: 这些发现可指导设计对越狱攻击更鲁棒的动态推理方法。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to be computationally expensive and vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, in which adversarial prompts bypass safety alignment and induce harmful responses. To address this inefficiency, a range of techniques have been proposed to enable efficient LLM inference. Depth-based dynamic inference has demonstrated promising results by enabling outputs to be generated from intermediate layers. It offers the flexibility to adjust model behavior based on the available resource budget. However, how this flexibility affects the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks remains unexplored. In this paper, we address this gap via a comprehensive investigation into the impact of depth-based dynamic inference on the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks. Specifically, we make the following key observations: 1) Shallow exits are consistently more robust to jailbreak attacks than deeper ones; 2) Exit depth affects how easily the adversarial suffix can be optimized, with deeper exits reaching lower attack loss; and 3) Adversarial suffixes affect utility uniformly across exit depths. These insights can help design dynamic inference methodologies that are more robust to jailbreak attacks. Code is available at https://github.com/LassNajmuldeen/balcony-jailbreaking

</details>


### [1275] [Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs in Learnable Low-Rank Subspaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15225)
*Chuang Tong,Ling Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AdaSub-ZO是一种前向仅有(f前方无反向)的LLM微调框架，通过学习式低秩子空间降低零阶优化方差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零阶优化可在高维参数空间实现内存高效微调，但方差高；现有方法用随机低秩子空间限制扰动，但这些子空间常与任务相关下降方向不对齐。

Method: AdaSub-ZO不依赖固定随机矩阵，而是从有限差分反馈中逐层迭代学习投影矩阵，以跟踪任务感知的下降方向；同时引入子空间动量加速机制，在演化的子空间基上平滑噪声梯度估计。

Result: 在自然语言理解任务上，AdaSub-ZO优于现有ZO基线，显著降低梯度估计方差并加速收敛。

Conclusion: AdaSub-ZO通过学习可学习低秩子空间与子空间动量，有效缓解ZO微调的方差问题，提升LLM前向仅有微调的性能与收敛速度。

Abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). However, ZO optimization suffers from high variance in high-dimensional parameter spaces. While recent methods restrict perturbations to random low-rank subspaces, these subspaces often misalign with task-specific descent directions. We propose AdaSub-ZO, a novel forward-only fine-tuning framework in learnable low-rank subspaces. Instead of relying on fixed random matrices, AdaSub-ZO iteratively learns layer-wise projection matrices directly from finite-difference feedback to track task-aware descent directions. Furthermore, AdaSub-ZO incorporates a subspace momentum acceleration mechanism to smooth noisy gradient estimates across evolving subspace bases. Extensive experiments on natural language understanding tasks demonstrate that AdaSub-ZO outperforms existing ZO baselines, substantially reducing gradient estimation variance and accelerating convergence.

</details>


### [1276] [EvolvAttack: Backdooring self Evolving VLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15244)
*Chuan Zou,Yang Xiang,Zexin Li,Xiaonan Luo,Simin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"自演化后门"这一新型攻击面：后门载荷在初始VLM智能体中休眠，随智能体演化逐步激活，需视觉触发器与足够的演化记忆状态共同作用，静态扫描几乎无法检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自演化机制让VLM智能体通过演化记忆持续适应，但也带来仅在部署后才浮现的恶意行为风险。传统后门可通过对静态模型测试触发输入来暴露，但自演化智能体的攻击需要视觉触发与演化记忆状态的共同出现，因此静态扫描（干净记忆）几乎检测不到。

Method: 提出记忆感知后门训练（memory-aware backdoor training），将触发器激活与智能体的演化记忆耦合，仅在触发器与载荷相关记忆共现时才释放载荷，否则保持良性行为。

Result: 在3种VLM骨干、4种智能体流程以及基于时近性、语义和奖励的记忆演化下，攻击保持正常功能，演化前几乎不激活（0.5%攻击成功率），但在100次交互内攻击成功率超过95%。

Conclusion: 揭示了自演化智能体特有的隐蔽威胁，表明静态安全扫描不足，需要面向演化过程的新型防御。

Abstract: Self-evolving mechanisms let vision-language model (VLM) agents continually adapt through evolving memory, but they also allow malicious behavior to emerge only after deployment. We introduce a new attack surface, the self-evolving backdoor, whose payload stays dormant in the initial agent and is progressively activated as the agent evolves. Unlike conventional backdoors, which can be exposed by testing triggered inputs on a static model, our attack requires both a visual trigger and a sufficiently evolved memory state; static scanning with clean memory thus yields near-zero attack success and may deem the agent benign. We realize this through memory-aware backdoor training, which couples trigger activation with the agent's evolving memory while preserving benign behavior unless the trigger co-occurs with payload-related memory. Across three VLM backbones, four agent pipelines, and recency-, semantic-, and reward-based memory evolution, the attack preserves normal functionality and stays nearly inactive before evolution (0.5% attack success rate), yet exceeds 95% attack success within 100 interactions, revealing a stealthy threat unique to self-evolving agents.

</details>


### [1277] [ObsSpec: Accelerating Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation Speculation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15246)
*Kyle Montgomery,Wang Zhang,Chenguang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ObsSpec用小型世界模型预测工具输出，在环境执行同时让策略提前生成，仅在预测与真实观测完全匹配时保留投机结果，实现无损rollout收集，将agent延迟降低9.3%-14.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用型agent在模型生成与工具执行间串行交替，每次需等待工具调用完成才能继续生成。这种串行执行在需要大批量多轮rollout的agentic RL中代价高昂。

Method: 提出ObsSpec观测投机流水线：用小型世界模型在环境执行时预测工具输出，使策略提前开始下一次生成；仅当预测与实际观测完全匹配时才保留投机工作以保证无损；通过协同训练让世界模型随策略学习保持更新。

Result: 在终端使用任务上，0.6B世界模型的预测66.4%完全匹配真实观测，且快约16倍。ObsSpec将8B和32B策略的agent延迟分别降低9.3%和14.2%，并通过受控实验刻画了其降低延迟的适用场景。

Conclusion: 由于ObsSpec将策略生成与工具执行重叠，它与现有RL加速技术在架构上兼容。代码已开源。

Abstract: Tool-using agents alternate between model generation and tool execution, waiting for each tool call to complete before starting the next generation. This sequential execution is costly during agentic reinforcement learning (RL), which requires large batches of multi-turn rollouts. We introduce ObsSpec, an observation speculation pipeline for agentic RL that uses a small world model to predict tool outputs while the environment executes, allowing the policy to begin its next generation early. ObsSpec retains speculative work only when the predicted and actual observations match exactly, making rollout collection lossless, while co-training keeps the world model up to date as the policy learns. On terminal-use tasks, predictions from a 0.6B world model exactly match actual observations in 66.4% of attempts and arrive roughly 16 times faster. Using these predictions, ObsSpec reduces agent latency by 9.3% and 14.2% for 8B and 32B policies. Across controlled experiments, we characterize the regimes in which ObsSpec reduces agent latency under shared policy resources. Finally, because ObsSpec overlaps policy generation with tool execution, it is architecturally compatible with existing techniques for accelerating RL. Code is available at https://github.com/kylemontgomery1/verl-recipe/tree/obsspec/obsspec.

</details>


### [1278] [Correlation-Aware Reconstruction for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15250)
*Md. Johir Raihan,Zahra Zamanzadeh Darban,Yueyang Liu,Flora D. Salim,Levin Kuhlmann,Mahsa Salehi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CARMA提出双隐空间VAE，将时序动态与通道间相关性分离建模，提升多变量时序异常检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有重建式检测器将时序演化与通道间结构压缩到单一纠缠表示中，缺乏显式机制隔离跨通道依赖，导致跨通道异常（各传感器单独正常但联合行为偏离）检测率低。

Method: 提出CARMA，一种重建式变分自编码器，含两个互补隐空间：捕捉序列动态的时序隐空间，以及通过重建窗口成对Pearson相关性训练的关联隐空间；二者在信号解码器中融合，基于重建误差检测异常。

Result: 在TSB-AD-M基准（17数据集、180序列）对比29个基线方法，在多个无阈值与区间感知指标上显著超越全部基线，VUS-PR达0.4929。

Conclusion: 消融表明：移除关联分支性能下降；无监督增加第二隐空间仅恢复部分增益；用显式相关目标监督关联隐空间带来剩余增益，并在异常处产生更锐利的误差响应。

Abstract: Reconstruction-based detectors for multivariate time series anomaly detection typically learn a single entangled representation of normal behavior and flag anomalies based on reconstruction error. However, real-world anomalies are not only isolated spikes in a single channel but also disruptions in the relationships between channels, where each sensor individually appears normal, but their joint behavior deviates from the norm. Because these models compress both temporal evolution and inter-channel structure into this single space, they lack an explicit mechanism to isolate such inter-channel dependencies from normal temporal dependencies, leading to lower detection rates for cross-channel anomalies. We propose CARMA (Correlation-Aware Reconstruction for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection), which is a reconstruction-based variational autoencoder with two complementary latent spaces: a temporal latent that captures sequential dynamics, and a correlation latent that is trained to reconstruct the window's pairwise Pearson correlations. Both representations are fused in the signal decoder, and anomalies are detected from the reconstruction error. We evaluate CARMA on the TSB-AD-M benchmark suite (17 datasets, 180 series) against 29 baseline methods, and show that it significantly outperforms all of them across multiple threshold-free and range-aware metrics, achieving a VUS-PR of 0.4929. Ablations show that removing the correlation branch degrades performance, that adding a second latent without supervision recovers only part of the gain, and that supervising the correlation latent with an explicit correlation target accounts for the rest and produces a sharper error response at anomalies.

</details>


### [1279] [LeHami: Symplectic Latent Dynamics for World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15267)
*Romina Yalovetzky,Randall Balestriero,Yann LeCun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA (LeHami)，用辛leapfrog积分的作用条件哈密顿流替代标准预测器，保证相位空间体积守恒，在视觉摆环境中显著改善长时程预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无约束自回归预测器在长时程rollout中会使潜分布收缩，需要几何结构提供推理时保证。

Method: 将预测器替换为作用条件哈密顿流，作用于结构潜态(q,p)，用精确辛leapfrog步积分；从学习位置表征的时间导数得到动量分量。

Result: 在保守与驱动视觉摆环境中，长时程速度预测显著优于无约束JEPA，潜体积保持恒定，支持未见子帧步长积分与数值时间反演。

Conclusion: 几何结构可提供与表征正则互补的推理时保证，用于潜在世界模型。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models directly in latent space, but unconstrained autoregressive predictors may contract the latent distribution over long rollouts. We introduce Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA (LeHami), which replaces the standard predictor with an action-conditioned Hamiltonian flow over a structured latent state (q, p) integrated using an exactly symplectic leapfrog step. This construction preserves phase-space volume at every rollout step and rules out uniform contraction, asymptotically stable fixed points, and merging of distinct latent states, independently of the learned parameters or action sequence. We obtain the momentum-like component from temporal derivatives of the learned position-like representation, providing an explicit second-order state for prediction and control. On conservative and actuated visual pendulum environments, LeHami substantially improves long-horizon velocity prediction over an unconstrained JEPA world model and empirically maintains constant latent volume where the baseline contracts. The learned flow also supports accurate integration at unseen sub-frame step sizes and numerical time reversal. These results show how geometric structure can provide inference-time guarantees that are complementary to representation regularization in latent world models.

</details>


### [1280] [Imperfect Verifiers, Exact Targets: Inference-Time Scaling for Continuous Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15281)
*Kijung Jeon,Molei Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出CS-VGB（连续状态验证器引导回溯），一种面向连续生成模型的推理时扩展方法，通过配对的去噪与再加噪操作从奖励倾斜分布中采样，即使中间验证器不准确，其平稳分布仍等于目标奖励倾斜分布，并具指数收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有验证器引导的推理时扩展依赖中间验证器打分来引导生成，但不完美的验证器会扭曲采样分布；单纯反复精炼也无法保证恢复到理想的奖励倾斜分布。

Method: CS-VGB通过反复的去噪与再加噪实现回溯，使用正确配对的去噪和再加噪转移，在陈述的正则条件下使清洁检查点的平稳分布等于奖励倾斜目标；该方法可实例化于扩散模型和一步随机后验映射。

Result: CS-VGB在验证器存在误差时仍能指数收敛到目标，所需更新次数随检查点数量线性增长；在可解析设定中能恢复目标分布而对比方法失败；在ImageNet提示生成、CelebA面部属性生成和多机器人规划任务中，随推理预算增长奖励与成功率持续提升，且超越仅去噪基线的平台期。

Conclusion: CS-VGB提供了一种理论上稳健、对验证器误差具有鲁棒性的推理时扩展框架，能够在连续生成任务中高效采样奖励倾斜分布，并随计算预算增加持续获益。

Abstract: Verifier-guided inference-time scaling uses additional computation to score intermediate states and steer generation toward better outputs. However, imperfect intermediate verifiers can distort sampling, and repeated refinement alone does not ensure recovery of the desired reward-tilted distribution. We introduce Continuous-State Verifier-Guided Backtracking (CS-VGB), an inference-time scaling method for sampling from reward-tilted distributions with continuous generative models through repeated denoising and renoising. With correctly paired denoising and renoising transitions, the stationary distribution of CS-VGB at the clean checkpoint equals the desired reward-tilted target, even when intermediate verifiers are inaccurate. Under stated regularity conditions, CS-VGB converges exponentially to the target despite verifier error, and the expected number of updates needed to reach a clean sample grows only linearly with the number of checkpoints. In analytically tractable settings, we empirically demonstrate that CS-VGB recovers the desired reward-tilted distribution despite verifier error, whereas the compared verifier-based sampling methods fail to recover the target under the same verifier errors. We also instantiate the framework with diffusion models and one-step stochastic posterior maps. Across prompt-guided ImageNet generation, facial-attribute generation on CelebA, and multi-robot planning, recurrent CS-VGB search improves reward and task success as inference budgets grow, with image-generation rewards continuing beyond the observed plateaus of denoising-only baselines.

</details>


### [1281] [FragFlex: Fragment-Based Flexible Molecular Generation for Exploring Vast Chemical Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15284)
*Sihyun Park,David Ryan Koes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FragFlex：一种在片段级别进行节点插入/删除的变长离散扩散模型，可灵活生成分子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物发现需探索巨大化学空间；现有分子图扩散模型多需预先固定图大小，而原子级插删难以兼顾分子大小、原子类型与化学有效性。

Method: 在去噪过程中，片段图层面联合学习分子大小、片段身份及片段间连接；再通过神经附着位点预测器与价态感知组装器，将片段图转为原子级分子。

Result: 在千万级分子生成实验中，达到近乎完美的化学有效性，同时保持高唯一性。

Conclusion: FragFlex 在化学有效性与唯一性之间取得良好平衡，支持灵活尺寸的分子生成。

Abstract: Drug discovery requires efficient exploration of an astronomically large chemical space. Molecular graph diffusion models offer a promising approach to this task, but many require graph size to be fixed before generation. Although atom-level insertion and deletion can enable flexible-size generation, jointly modeling molecular size, atom types, and bonds while maintaining chemical validity remains challenging. We introduce FragFlex, a flexible-length discrete diffusion model that performs node insertion and deletion at the fragment level. During denoising, FragFlex jointly learns the size, fragment identities, and inter-fragment connectivity of the fragment graph. A neural attachment-site predictor and valence-aware assembler then convert the generated fragment graph into an atom-level molecule. In large-scale experiments generating 10 million molecules, FragFlex achieves near-perfect chemical validity while maintaining high uniqueness, demonstrating a strong balance between the two.

</details>


### [1282] [WisdomNet: trustable machine learning toward error-free classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15299)
*Truong X. Tran,Ramazan S. Aygun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"可信任学习"及WisdomNet架构，通过引入共轭神经元拒绝不可靠预测，实现0%误分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 即使高精度分类器(如>95%)仍会产生误分类，因此无法完全依赖其输出，需要一种能避免误分类或在不确定时拒绝决策的机制。

Method: 提出可信任学习方法并应用于神经网络，设计WisdomNet架构：在任意已有模型中增加一个"共轭神经元"，用于指示网络是否能正确分类；若不能则标记为"reject"或交由人类专家。可适用于MLP、CNN及深度网络等多种架构。

Result: 在不同数据集和多种网络架构(多层感知机、卷积神经网络、深度网络)上评估，WisdomNet能将分类错误率降至0%，同时将难以分类的数据标记为"reject"，其比例仅约10%以内。

Conclusion: WisdomNet可实现零误分类，且拒绝率较低，为构建可信赖的分类器提供了可行方案，并可推广到已有模型。

Abstract: Misclassification is a critical problem in many machine learning applications. Since even the classifier models with high accuracy (e.g., > 95%) still introduce some misclassification error, it may not be possible to rely on the output of a classifier. In this paper, we introduce trustable learning, which prompts the learning model to yield only the true output, thus avoiding misclassifications. Whenever the model cannot decide the output accurately, the learning model should indicate that there could be a misclassification error if it is forced to classify, and hence, it should reject to make a decision or defer it to a human expert. Therefore, we develop a methodology for trustable learning and apply it to artificial neural networks and show that it is possible to develop a classifier with 0% misclassification error. We propose a novel neural network architecture named WisdomNet that could provide zero prediction error by introducing an additional neuron named as conjugate neuron that would indicate whether the network is able to classify the data correctly or not. The WisdomNet architecture can be applied to any previously built model, and we have evaluated WisdomNet with several network architectures such as multilayer perceptron, convolutional neural network, and deep network on different data sets. The results show that the WisdomNet is able to reduce the classification error rate to 0%, while labeling the data is difficult to classify as `reject' at a low percentage of within around 10%.

</details>


### [1283] [Accuracy and Uncertainty in Machine Deception Detection (Research White Paper)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15314)
*Heng-Sheng Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出机器欺骗检测器(MDD)：读取LLM所有层、仅用响应标签学习欺骗证据token，并校准阈值使假阳性率低于预设水平；用集成度量子不确定性，成员一致才报警。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于内部激活的欺骗检测器（类似测谎仪）依赖特定层、在更广泛测试上性能下降，且不报告检测分数的不确定性，限制其实用性与可信度。

Method: 读取语言模型每一层激活，仅凭响应标签学习哪些token携带欺骗证据；校准报警阈值控制假阳性率；用检测器集成评估每个分数的不确定性，仅在成员一致时以指定置信度报警。

Result: 计划在指令式诚实/欺骗陈述上训练，在Liars' Bench的5个未见欺骗任务上测试，使用6个Qwen3模型(0.6B–32B)；将展示欺骗特征所在层及其随模型规模的变化。（旨在实现，尚无实证结果）

Conclusion: 该白皮书以检测精度与分数不确定性为双重目标，提升欺骗报警的可信度，并揭示欺骗特征的层级位置随模型规模的变化规律。

Abstract: A deception detector is only as useful as the trust its alarms deserve. Like a polygraph, detectors that read a language model's internal activations can catch deceptive responses that look honest. Yet current detectors depend on which layers they read, weaken on broader tests, and do not state how certain their alarms are. This white paper proposes the Machine Deception Detector, which targets both detection accuracy and the uncertainty of detector scores. The detector reads every layer of the language model, learns which tokens carry evidence of deception using only response labels, and calibrates its alarm threshold so that its false--positive rate stays below a prescribed level. An ensemble of such detectors measures the uncertainty of each score and raises an alarm only when its members agree, with a confidence level that sets how certain each alarm must be. The proposed evaluation trains on instructed honest and deceptive statements, tests on five unseen deceptive tasks of Liars' Bench read by six Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, and is designed to also show which layers carry the deception feature and how this changes with model size.

</details>


### [1284] [CIViC: Evidence Gates for Audio-Conditioned Visual Prediction on Proxy Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15327)
*Mengzhe Geng,Max W. Y. Lam,Yuewen Cao,Shoukang Hu,Jing Xu,Marc Tessier,Xu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CIViC四门协议，将音频影响的解释与干预、留出任务比较或端点控制绑定，并在三个代理任务上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅移除音频会改变视觉预测器输出，但无法判断任务是否真的使用了预期的音频信息，需要更严谨的评估协议。

Method: CIViC四门协议：将解释与干预实验、留出任务比较或端点控制相链接；在演员不相交人脸光栅测试、合成音频特征混合、源视频不相交SpeakerVid代理任务上演示。

Result: 静态人脸光栅中跨演员音频替换按注册规则检测到小效应，但时间端点常数音频拟合更优（四个种子）；合成混合中条件增强拟合RMSE更高（0.1807 vs 0.1707）且差距随训练缩小；SpeakerVid中五特征归零拟合整帧RMSE更低，而对齐音频分段漂移误差更低。

Conclusion: 输出激活、留出误差与端点控制在不同代理任务上支持不同解释，单凭音频移除不足以判断音频信息是否被真正使用。

Abstract: Removing audio can shift a visual predictor's output without showing whether the task uses the intended audio information. We introduce Conditional Input and Visual Interpretation Checks (CIViC), a four-gate protocol that links an interpretation to an intervention, held-out task comparison, or endpoint control. We demonstrate CIViC on actor-disjoint face-raster tests, a synthetic audio-feature mixture, and source-video-disjoint SpeakerVid proxy tasks. In the static face-raster test, cross-actor audio replacement meets the registered detection rule with a small effect; on a separate temporal endpoint, constant-audio fits score better than audio-trained fits in four matched seeds. In the synthetic mixture, the condition-augmented fit has higher 1,000-step RMSE than the audio-only fit (0.1807 vs. 0.1707), with the gap shrinking during training. In the SpeakerVid proxy, the five-feature-zero fit (five low-level audio summaries zeroed; identity, dialogue, and condition inputs retained) has lower whole-frame grayscale RMSE than aligned audio across four held-out conditions and five paired seeds, while aligned audio has lower segment-drift error. The results show that output activation, held-out error, and endpoint controls support different interpretations across these proxy tasks.

</details>


### [1285] [Anchor-and-Harvest Curriculum: A Fully Unmasked Non-LLM Curriculum for Craftax](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15328)
*Jiayu Zhu,Luyuan Li,Yuyuan Shi,Hanyi Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AHC——一种无需LLM推理、基于规则的课程训练系统，用于Craftax-Full，在相同学生架构下比原生PPO-GTrXL取得更高回报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索在Craftax-Full上，不依赖LLM推理、不使用动作掩码的显式课程学习方法，是否能达到与LLM生成课程相当的回报水平。

Method: AHC为领域知识驱动的规则式训练系统，结合成就导向任务、初始状态进度采集、难度自适应、有界选择与原始任务练习；不使用LLM推理，保留全部43个动作。评估采用每模型1024个固定世界各10次随机rollout，共2,005,401,600次PPO rollout转移。

Result: 三个主AHC运行原生任务回报46.70±0.57（样本SD），原生PPO-GTrXL为41.91±1.01；额外三组AHC为46.08±1.23。两项单组件消融回报相近，联合冻结难度并移除继承进度降至45.14±2.79。回报差异主要来自Intermediate成就，最深楼层成就仍未解决。AHC与三种14B诊断配置回报接近80B DiCode均值45.88，低于235B均值48.55。

Conclusion: 显式课程无需LLM推理即可在Craftax-Full上达到与LLM生成课程相当的回报，且无需动作掩码。

Abstract: We introduce Anchor-and-Harvest Curriculum (AHC), a domain-informed, rule-based training system for Craftax-Full. AHC combines achievement-oriented tasks, harvested initial-state progress, difficulty adaptation, bounded selection, and original-task practice. It uses no LLM inference and keeps all 43 actions available. At 2,005,401,600 PPO rollout transitions, three primary AHC runs obtain native-task return $46.70\pm0.57$ (sample SD), compared with $41.91\pm1.01$ for fresh native PPO-GTrXL with the same student architecture and evaluation protocol. Evaluation uses ten stochastic rollouts on each of 1024 fixed worlds per model. An additional cohort of three AHC runs reaches $46.08\pm1.23$. Two single-component ablations retain similar mean returns, while jointly freezing difficulty and removing inherited progress gives $45.14\pm2.79$. All-67-achievement profiles show that most of the return difference comes from Intermediate achievements, while the deepest-floor achievements remain unsolved. A Skill-Preflight diagnosis with a 14B teacher shows how prerequisite and floor-access constraints restrict practice. AHC and three 14B diagnostic configurations reach aggregate returns near the reported 80B DiCode mean of 45.88 and below the 235B mean of 48.55. These results show that an explicit curriculum without LLM inference can reach returns comparable to those reported for LLM-generated curricula on Craftax-Full, without action masking.

</details>


### [1286] [Full Waveform Inversion with a Learned Preconditioner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15331)
*Jeongjin Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究用神经算子（FNO/JI-FNO）从RTM图像学习预条件器改进FWI，JI-FNO表现最好且稳定，标准FNO不稳定；指出仅预测RTM图像不足，需准确的神经导数与目标函数一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FWI重建速度模型能力强，但受病态性、对更新方向敏感及曲率方法高成本限制，寻求低成本有效的预条件器。

Method: 比较投影FWI与神经预条件FWI；用标准FNO或雅可比信息FNO（JI-FNO）训练于RTM图像，将学习RTM映射的正算子应用于修正真实Devito FWI梯度；并考察非线性神经高斯牛顿内求解的失效模式。

Result: JI-FNO预条件器模型误差最低，数据残差衰减与基线投影FWI相当；标准FNO不稳定、模型恢复更差；直接匹配神经RTM输出与FWI梯度会产生目标空间不匹配，无法提供可靠下降方向。

Conclusion: 仅前向预测RTM图像不足以实现有效学习预条件；准确的神经导数与目标函数一致性对生成有用反演更新至关重要。

Abstract: Full-waveform inversion (FWI) is a powerful approach for reconstructing subsurface velocity models, but its practical performance is limited by ill-conditioning, sensitivity to the update direction, and the high cost of curvature-based methods. In this project, we investigate whether a neural operator trained on reverse-time-migration (RTM) images can provide a useful learned preconditioner for FWI. We compare projected FWI against neural-preconditioned FWI using either a standard Fourier neural operator (FNO) or a Jacobian-informed FNO (JI-FNO). The neural preconditioner applies the normal operator of the learned RTM map to modify the true Devito FWI gradient. Our experiments show that the JI-FNO preconditioner achieves the lowest model error while maintaining data-residual decay comparable to baseline projected FWI. In contrast, the standard FNO preconditioner is unstable and gives worse model recovery, despite using the same neural-preconditioning framework. We also identify a failure mode of a nonlinear neural Gauss Newton-type inner solve: directly matching the neural RTM output to the FWI gradient creates an objective-space mismatch and does not yield a reliable descent direction. These results suggest that forward RTM-image prediction alone is insufficient for learned preconditioning; accurate learned derivatives and objective-consistent use of the neural operator are critical for producing useful inversion updates.

</details>


### [1287] [ZOIF: Zeroth-Order Influence Function Estimation for LLM Data Selection Using Only Forward Passes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15336)
*Lisong He,Yunxuan Jiang,Haishan Ye,Xiangyu Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZOIF 提出一种完全基于前向传播的零阶影响函数框架，用于大语言模型的高效数据选择，避免反向传播与 Hessian 矩阵的存储开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 影响函数可用于训练样本选择、模型编辑与高效微调，但扩展到 LLM 时面临十亿级 Hessian 矩阵不可解、反向传播中间激活内存开销巨大的问题，现有近似方法仍依赖 BP。

Method: ZOIF 将影响估计分解为三个无 BP 阶段：(1) 用零阶估计近似平均代理梯度；(2) 将逆 Hessian-向量积重构为辅助零阶优化问题，避免显式求逆；(3) 沿已计算的参数更新方向做前向有限差分，得到逐样本影响分数。

Result: 实验中 ZOIF 选出的数据子集下游效用与基线相当、有时更优，同时峰值内存显著降低，总计算时间相近。

Conclusion: ZOIF 为资源受限场景下的大规模数据选择提供了实用的无 BP 方案，兼顾效果与内存效率。

Abstract: Influence functions enable principled data selection for large language models (e.g., identifying influential training samples for model editing, debugging, or efficient fine-tuning). However, scaling IFs to LLMs is hindered by the intractability of billion-scale Hessian matrices and the prohibitive memory overhead of backpropagation (BP). While many classical IF approximations reduce Hessian complexity, they still rely on BP for gradient computation, requiring massive storage for intermediate activations that impedes practical data selection at scale. To address this, we propose ZOIF, a zeroth-order framework for influence estimation that operates entirely via forward passes, enabling memory-efficient data selection under resource constraints. ZOIF decomposes influence estimation into three BP-free stages: (1) approximating the average proxy gradient via zeroth-order estimation; (2) reformulating and solving the inverse Hessian-vector product as an auxiliary zeroth-order optimization to bypass explicit inversion; and (3) deriving per-sample influence scores via a forward finite difference along the previously computed parameter update direction. Experiments show that ZOIF selects data subsets with downstream utility competitive with, and in some cases exceeding, the evaluated baselines, yet at substantially lower peak memory cost and with comparable overall computation time.

</details>


### [1288] [CodeWalk: Generating Coding Benchmarks by Walking a Problem Graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15345)
*Jiaxin Fang,Runyuan He,Arnav Gupta,Sahil Kumawat,Huanzhi Mao,Alvin Cheung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出通过组合已有编码问题来近乎零成本地生成新编码问题，无需语言模型生成或验证。将原子问题组合为level-N任务，仅当所有原子问题均未被解决且联合参考解通过评估检查时保留。在四种编码设置中实例化，任务对前沿模型具挑战性，且可作为有效的训练数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量编码问题收集成本高昂，SWE-bench等基准依赖大量人工整理，合成替代方案又依赖昂贵的模型生成与验证。因此需要一种低成本、无需模型参与的问题生成方法。

Method: 将问题生成形式化为代码组合：把已验证的原子问题组合成level-N任务，仅当每个原子问题仍未被解决且联合参考解能通过评估时使用的同一检查时保留该任务。整个过程程序化，不需要语言模型生成或验证。在四种编码设置中实例化：多bug修复、证明补全、复杂度分析、克隆等价。

Result: 生成的任务对前沿模型具有挑战性，随组合深度增加所有模型性能均下降。作为训练数据也有用：对生成任务进行拒绝采样微调，可提升Qwen3.5-9B在所有组合层级上的表现。

Conclusion: 通过组合现有编码问题可近乎零成本地生成高质量编码任务，兼具评测挑战性和训练价值，为编码问题生成提供了无需模型参与的高效途径。

Abstract: High-quality coding problems are expensive to collect. Benchmarks such as SWE-bench rely on substantial human curation, while synthetic alternatives typically rely on costly model generation and validation. In this work, we show that new coding problems can be created at almost no cost by composing existing ones. We formulate problem generation as code composition: verified atomic problems are combined into level-$N$ tasks, and a task is kept only if every atomic problem remains unsolved and a joint reference solution passes the same check used at evaluation time. The entire task-construction process is programmatic and requires no language-model generation or validation. We instantiate this approach in four coding settings: multi-bug repair, proof completion, complexity analysis, and clone equivalence. The generated tasks are challenging for frontier models, which all degrade as compositional depth increases. The generated tasks are also useful as training data: rejection-sampling fine-tuning on them improves Qwen3.5-9B at every composition level.

</details>


### [1289] [Siam-ALS: An Explainable Siamese Deep Learning Framework for Early ALS Detection Using EEG and Eye-Tracking Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15351)
*Abdur Rahman,A. A. M. Muzahid,Istiak Ahmed,Dipto Biswas,Hua Han,Yujin Zhang,Ferdous Sohel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Siam-ALS：一种可解释的孪生深度学习框架，联合建模EEG与眼动信号用于ALS检测，在EEGET-ALS数据集上取得0.988准确率和0.998 AUROC，并具良好泛化性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ALS诊断因症状异质且依赖临床评估而具挑战性，亟需利用患者生理信号的客观数据驱动方法。

Method: 采用双模态编码器的孪生框架：卷积EEG编码器捕获时空神经模式，MLP眼动编码器建模眼动动态；经权重共享孪生分支融合为64维联合嵌入，用轻量分类器预测并结合成对度量学习应对小样本。采用严格被试级交叉验证，并用6种XAI方法（SHAP最佳）评估可解释性。

Result: 在EEGET-ALS上准确率0.988、AUROC 0.998，优于经典机器学习、深度学习和非孪生融合方法；在独立BigP3BCI数据集上AUROC约0.98，验证跨BCI范式泛化性。

Conclusion: Siam-ALS为多模态ALS检测提供了准确、可泛化且可解释的框架。

Abstract: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) diagnosis remains challenging due to heterogeneous symptoms and reliance on clinical assessment, underscoring the need for objective, data-driven approaches that leverage patient-generated physiological signals. We propose Siam-ALS, an explainable Siamese deep learning framework that jointly models synchronized electroencephalography (EEG) and eye-tracking (ET) signals. EEG captures ALS-related changes in brain activity, while ET provides information about oculomotor control, allowing the model to learn complementary patterns associated with ALS. The framework employs two modality-specific encoders: a convolutional EEG encoder that captures spatiotemporal neural patterns and an MLP-based ET encoder that models oculomotor dynamics. These modality-specific features are processed through weight-sharing Siamese branches and fused into a compact 64-dimensional joint embedding. A lightweight classifier is used to predict ALS, while pairwise metric learning helps the model learn more effective patterns from the small, diverse ALS datasets. Performance was evaluated on the public EEGET-ALS dataset using strict subject-level cross-validation, where Siam-ALS achieved an accuracy of 0.988 and an AUROC of 0.998, demonstrating strong performance compared with classical machine learning, DL, and non-Siamese fusion approaches. Cross-dataset evaluation on the independent BigP3BCI dataset achieved an AUROC of approximately 0.98, supporting the generalization capability of Siam-ALS across different BCI paradigms. To enhance interpretability, six XAI methods were evaluated in the learned embedding space, with SHAP achieving the highest, though statistically comparable, fidelity in identifying important EEG and ET patterns that contribute to ALS predictions. Overall, Siam-ALS provides an accurate, generalizable, and explainable framework for multimodal ALS detection.

</details>


### [1290] [Adversarial Detection for Pre-trained Classifiers via Lipschitz-Margin Analysis with Certification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15359)
*Rui Zhang,Xinle Cao,Huazhen Yu,Jian Liu,Youwen Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出面向检测的认证防御方法，将认证$\ell_2$鲁棒性归约为Lipschitz常数估计，实现无需重训练、认证的对抗样本检测，在多数据集和骨干网络上优于五个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有认证$\ell_2$防御存在代价权衡：随机平滑需要大量噪声查询，Lipschitz网络限制架构且牺牲干净精度。安全关键场景中漏检攻击比误报干净输入代价更高，因此转向检测认证。

Method: 证明从认证$\ell_2$鲁棒性到认证检测的Lipschitz-margin归约，将问题简化为处理单个Lipschitz常数$L$。提出两类检测器：$\mathbb{D}_{Adv}$从单对防御方扰动估计$L$，$\mathbb{D}_{lc}$加入局部margin质心保持估计高于认证要求，均可部署于任意预训练分类器而无需重训练。

Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10、ImageNet-1k及四种骨干网络(LeNet-5、VGG16、ResNet-50、ViT-B/16)上，检测器匹配或超越五个基线(CTT、SortNet、CRM、ContraNet、A$^2$D)。CIFAR-10+1-Lipschitz SortNet达100%认证检测且FPR最低；标准CIFAR-10 VGG16上拒绝所有预算内对抗样本，其中62-82%同时被拒绝且正式认证。

Conclusion: 检测导向的认证方法可在不牺牲干净精度、不重训练的前提下获得强认证检测保证，适用于安全关键部署。

Abstract: Deep classifiers deployed in safety-critical services like autonomous-driving perception remain vulnerable to small adversarial perturbations. Certified $\ell_2$ defenses today face a costly trade-off: randomized smoothing (RS) requires hundreds of noisy queries per input, while Lipschitz networks (LN) constrain the architecture and sacrifice clean accuracy. We take a detection-oriented approach instead: rather than certifying that predictions are invariant inside an $\ell_2$ ball, we certify that adversarial inputs within an $\ell_2$ ball are \emph{detected} --- a guarantee aligned with security-critical deployments where missing an attack is costlier than flagging a clean input.
  To realize this, we prove a Lipschitz-margin reduction from certified $\ell_2$ robustness to certified detection, which reduces the problem to handling a single Lipschitz constant $L$. We introduce two detector families: $\mathbb{D}_{Adv}$, which estimates $L$ from a single defender-side perturbed pair, and $\mathbb{D}_{lc}$, which augments that pair with a local margin centroid to keep the estimate above what the certificate requires. Both deploy on any pretrained classifier without retraining. With a valid global bound, the detector is fully certified at that radius; with a local estimate $L'$, certification is sample-wise and applies only when our certified condition holds.
  Across MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet-1k on four backbones (LeNet-5, VGG16, ResNet-50, ViT-B/16), our detectors match or outperform five baselines (CTT, SortNet, CRM, ContraNet, A$^2$D). For CIFAR-10 with 1-Lipschitz SortNet, our reduction delivers $100\%$ certified detection at the lowest FPR among compared certified detectors; on the standard CIFAR-10 VGG16, our detectors reject all evaluated in-budget adversarial examples, with 62-82\% both rejected and formally certified.

</details>


### [1291] [ANTE: Anticipate, Then Execute -- Learning Internal World Models for Coding Agents from Verified Beliefs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15368)
*Yi Ge,Kangrui Ruan,Jifan Chen,Manish Prajapat,Christian Bock,Xiaoyang Wang,Rein Houthooft,Aritra Sengupta,Varun Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ANTE，一个让编码智能体先预测动作后果再执行、并用真实执行校验预测来分配逐步信用（credit）的 agentic RL 框架，显著提升 SWE-bench 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体缺乏前瞻性：策略不预测动作后果，稀疏的终端奖励难以归因到早期步骤，导致错误编辑可能在信号到来前不可逆地损坏仓库状态。已有 code world model 要么在 RL 前冻结，要么仅作为环境输出的辅助 next-token 损失，未能有效利用预测。

Method: ANTE（Anticipate, Then Execute）：在动作前生成内部 belief（预测），由真实执行校验这些预测，并转化为逐步信用。核心组件 BAPO（Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization）将已确认的预测锚定在策略自身预测上，生成 per-step advantage，并支持 trust-or-abstain 决策。推理阶段用 ANTE-TTO 在无外部打分器的情况下选择候选动作，实现测试时扩展。

Result: Qwen3-32B 在 SWE-bench Verified 上 pass@1 从 25.0% 提升到 57.2%，比无 belief 状态的匹配 GRPO 基线高 6.2%；world model 准确率在 RL 过程中从 44% 升至 69%；学到的前瞻能力可跨 harness 和分布外领域迁移。

Conclusion: 目标是构建一个知道"过去发生了什么、现在成立什么、下一动作将达成什么"的 code world model，通过预测-执行-信用闭环提升编码智能体的前瞻性与可靠性。

Abstract: Rapid advances in large language models have made software engineering agents capable of tackling complex coding tasks. Within a containerized environment, a coding agent receives tool responses or execution results, and determines its later actions by those earlier results. However, most existing coding agents never look ahead: their policies do not anticipate the consequences of actions, and the terminal reward barely attributes a failure to certain earlier steps, so an ill-judged edit can corrupt the repository state irreversibly before any signal arrives. Recent code world models aim to address these challenges, but they are either trained and then frozen before reinforcement learning (RL), or reduced to an auxiliary next-token loss on the environment's outputs. We present ANTE (Anticipate, Then Execute), an agentic RL framework that verifies the policy's pre-action predictions by real execution and turns them into per-step credit for its actions and trust-or-abstain decisions. With an internal belief stated before each action, Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization (BAPO) turns the settled predictions into per-step advantages by anchoring credit on the policy's own forecasts. To turn the trained forecasts into better actions at inference, thereby facilitating effective test-time scaling, ANTE-TTO (test-time optimization) selects among candidate actions without an external scorer. ANTE raises Qwen3-32B from 25.0% to 57.2% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, 6.2% above a matched GRPO baseline trained without the belief state; its world model's accuracy climbs from 44% to 69% during RL, and the learned foresight capability transfers across harnesses and out-of-distribution domains. In summary, we aim to build a code world model that knows what has happened, what holds now, and what the next action will achieve.

</details>


### [1292] [E8 Lattice Key Quantization for Low-Bit KV-Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15384)
*Sasho Nedelkoski,Alexander Acker,Soeren Becker,Dominik Scheinert,Odej Kao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于E8格矢量量化(VQ)的KV缓存压缩方法，用2-bit keys和2-bit values(k2v2)在保持接近基线质量的同时实现约6倍压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理受内存限制，KV缓存压缩至关重要。现有标量量化方法面临质量-保真度权衡：2-bit精度性能不稳定，需用3-bit keys才能维持质量。

Method: 对KV keys采用基于E8格的矢量量化，利用相邻维度相关性；并采用基于表的非对称打分算法，避免注意力计算中显式码本反量化，保持解码吞吐与标量基线持平。

Result: 在五种LLM家族上，E8 k2v2约6倍KV压缩，比标量k3v2小约20%，同时保持接近基线的长上下文困惑度；在80%的模型-数据集-上下文设置中优于标量k3v2。

Conclusion: E8格VQ在同等吞吐下提升每字节质量，表明结构化key量化是KV压缩栈的有用原语，可拓展长上下文LLM推理的质量-内存前沿。

Abstract: Compressing the key-value (KV) cache is essential for serving long-context large language models (LLMs) under memory constraints. While current scalar quantization methods achieve significant compression, they typically face a quality-fidelity trade-off, either suffering from performance instability at 2-bit precision or necessitating 3-bit keys to maintain model quality. In this work, we demonstrate that a uniform low-bit k2v2 configuration (2-bit keys and 2-bit values) can preserve near-baseline quality by using vector quantization (VQ) based on the $E_8$ lattice for KV keys. We show that structured VQ exploits correlations across adjacent dimensions to achieve signal-to-quantization-noise ratios (SQNR) higher than those of independent scalar quantization at the same key payload rate. To ensure practical utility, we adapt a table-based asymmetric scoring algorithm that avoids explicit codebook dequantization during attention computation and preserves decode-throughput parity with scalar baselines. Across five LLM families, our $E_8$ k2v2 approach yields \textasciitilde$6\times$ KV compression, roughly 20\% smaller than scalar k3v2 (3-bit keys and 2-bit values), while retaining near-baseline long-context perplexity. In our full-suite perplexity evaluation, $E_8$ improves over scalar k3v2 in 80\% of model--dataset--context settings. These results indicate that $E_8$ lattice VQ improves quality per byte while keeping throughput at parity, suggesting that structured key quantization is a useful primitive for KV-compression stacks. Overall, our work provides a low-overhead primitive for expanding the quality-memory frontier in long-context LLM inference.

</details>


### [1293] [Approximation in Contrastive Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15388)
*Yuanfan Li,Zihan Zhang,Yiming Ying,Ding-Xuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从逼近论角度解释对比表示学习(CRL)中内积打分 $f(x)^\top g(y)$ 为何能有效逼近不可分的PMI目标，给出谱逼近、神经网络一致性与下游检索误差的标定率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CRL的人群目标被识别为两模态间的点互信息(PMI)，但标准内积分数 $f(x)^\top g(y)$ 为何能有效逼近一般不可分的PMI目标尚不清楚。

Method: 将PMI与紧算子联系，证明 $D$ 维内积模型执行秩-$D$谱逼近，误差由谱尾控制；进一步研究神经网络实现，分析深度网络的普适一致性与逼近误差率，并在结构化低秩数据模型下给出中等宽度编码器的改进率；最后建立从对比超额风险到下游检索误差的标定。

Result: $D$ 维内积模型的逼近误差受谱尾控制；深度网络打分函数普适一致，逼近率取决于PMI的光滑性；低秩数据模型下中等宽度编码器可达改进率；在密度比Tsybakov噪声条件下获得快速标定率。

Conclusion: 为内积式对比学习中PMI逼近提供了理论解释，并刻画了其逼近误差与下游检索性能的联系。

Abstract: Contrastive representation learning (CRL) is a fundamental paradigm for
  learning transferable representations. Recent work
  identifies its population target as the pointwise mutual information (PMI)
  $\log\frac{p(x,y)}{p_X(x)p_Y(y)}$
  between two modalities $X,Y$, where $p$ is the joint density function and
  $p_X,p_Y$ are the marginals. However, it remains unclear why standard inner-product scores $f(x)^\top g(y)$ can effectively approximate a generally nonseparable population target PMI. In this paper, we address this question from the aspect of approximation for CRL. By linking PMI to a compact operator, we show that $D$-dimensional inner-product models perform rank-$D$ spectral approximation, with error controlled by the spectral tail. We then study neural network realizations: in general settings, we show that deep neural network scoring functions are universally consistent, and the approximation error rates depend on the smoothness of the PMI function; under structured low-rank data models we obtain improved rates attained by moderate-width encoders. Finally, we establish a fast calibration rate from contrastive excess risk to downstream retrieval error under a density-ratio Tsybakov noise condition.

</details>


### [1294] [DC-Flow: Target-Conditioned Cyclic Peptide Design via Delayed-Coupling Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15391)
*Yitian Wang,Minjie Cheng,Yaning Cui,Maohua Yang,Dongdong Wang,Hongteng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DC-FLOW分阶段生成框架，通过延迟耦合流匹配解决环肽设计中的结构-序列协同问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环肽设计需协调界面侧链与宏环闭合。现有端到端生成器同时更新几何与化学变量，将残基分配到无序坐标；预测器辅助流程因缺乏提议-过滤反馈且忽略3D结构建议，易陷入局部最优。

Method: 基于延迟耦合流匹配(Delayed-Coupling Flow Matching)的分阶段框架。先让目标条件骨架成型再激活序列与侧链，消除结构歧义后做化学分配；将延迟激活反馈回骨架，耦合流实现骨架几何与残基身份的协同演化。对预测器辅助流程提供带轨迹引导的3D提议，支持级联测试时缩放。

Result: 实验显示DC-FLOW提升环化保真度、多样性与界面能量学，在固定候选预算下显著提高高置信环肽结合物的产出。

Conclusion: DC-FLOW通过分阶段耦合生成有效克服现有两类范式的缺陷，为环肽设计提供更可靠的宏环闭合与界面堆积。

Abstract: Target-conditioned cyclic peptide design requires coordinating interfacial side chains with macrocyclic closure. Existing end-to-end generators concurrently update geometric and chemical variables from noise, assigning residues to disordered coordinates. Meanwhile, predictor-assisted workflows often get stuck in local traps because they lack feedback in the propose-and-filter stage and ignore 3D structural proposals during sequence search. To overcome the drawbacks of these two paradigms, we propose DC-FLOW, a staged generative framework built around Delayed-Coupling Flow Matching. In principle, DC-FLOW postpones sequence and side-chain activation until a target-conditioned backbone takes shape, resolving structural ambiguity before chemical assignment. Then, it feeds delayed activations back into the backbone, achieving co-evolution of backbone geometry and emerging residue identities by coupling their flows. This mechanism enables more reliable macrocyclic closure and favorable interface packing. For predictor-assisted workflows, DC-FLOW supplies 3D proposals with in-trajectory guidance, enabling cascaded test-time scaling to prune redundant backbones and terminate unpromising refinement early. Extensive experiments show that DC-FLOW improves cyclization fidelity, diversity, and interface energetics, substantially increasing the yield of confident cyclic peptide binders under a fixed final-candidate budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/mianqiu00/DCFlow.

</details>


### [1295] [WUSPruner: Second-Moment-Optimal Transforms for Structured Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15394)
*Shengkun Tang,Dan Alistarh,Zhiqiang Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WUSPruner提出基于变换的LLM结构化剪枝框架，通过WUS变换选择最优基使剪枝重建损失最小化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化剪枝通常直接在原表示空间选择删哪些维度，但坐标删除的效果本质上取决于所在基。因此需要研究：专门为坐标删除应如何选择基。

Method: 将基选择形式化为局部线性重建问题，直接最小化剪枝引起的重建损失。受WUSH中二阶矩变换启发，构造由激活和权重统计联合得到的WUS变换；证明在正定二阶矩下，WUS变换在所有可逆基变换中使局部重建损失最小。所得基中激活与权重二阶矩同时对角化并平衡，使删除误差分解为独立谱贡献，给出坐标选择准则。据此开发基于分块WUS变换和紧凑输入投影的可扩展剪枝方法。

Result: 在Llama和Qwen 8B至72B模型上，在语言建模、知识、常识推理、数学和代码生成基准上均持续优于结构化剪枝基线，同时降低推理延迟和内存占用。

Conclusion: WUSPruner表明为坐标删除优化基选择可显著提升结构化剪枝效果，兼顾性能与推理效率。

Abstract: Structured pruning is typically formulated as identifying which model dimensions to remove, often within the model's original representation. However, the effect of coordinate deletion fundamentally depends on the basis in which pruning is performed. This raises a more fundamental question: how should the basis be chosen specifically for coordinate deletion? We introduce WUSPruner, a transform-based framework for structured pruning of large language models. We formulate basis selection as a local linear reconstruction problem that directly minimizes the reconstruction loss induced by pruning. Inspired by the second-moment transformation in WUSH, we consider a WUS transform constructed jointly from activation and weight statistics. We show that under positive-definite second moments, WUS transform minimizes the local reconstruction loss over all invertible changes of basis. In the resulting basis, the activation and weight second moments are simultaneously diagonalized and balanced, causing the deletion error to decompose into independent spectral contributions and yielding a principled criterion for coordinate selection. Guided by this result, we develop a scalable pruning method based on blockwise WUS transformations and compact input projections. Experiments on Llama and Qwen models from 8B to 72B parameters show consistent improvements over structured pruning baselines across language modeling, knowledge, commonsense reasoning, mathematics, and code generation benchmarks, while also delivering practical reductions in inference latency and memory usage.

</details>


### [1296] [GA-SVD: Generation-aware Singular Value Decomposition for LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15398)
*Shengkun Tang,Cong Zeng,Zongfang Liu,Dan Alistarh,Zhiqiang Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GA-SVD，面向LLM生成任务的低秩压缩框架，含生成感知白化与进化式全局秩分配，在多种模型与基准上达到SoTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM参数庞大导致内存和计算开销高，难以在资源受限场景部署；现有SVD低秩压缩方法主要面向选择题基准，在生成任务上性能保持差，且秩分配策略多为启发式。

Method: GA-SVD包含两部分：1）Generation-Aware Weight Whitening（GAWW），利用on-policy知识蒸馏的梯度构建与生成行为对齐的白化变换；2）进化式全局秩分配方法，在给定全局压缩比下搜索有效的逐层秩分配。

Result: 在Mistral-7B、Qwen3系列、Llama-3.3等模型上，针对选择题与生成基准的广泛实验表明，GA-SVD持续优于现有SVD基线，达到SoTA，并可扩展至700亿参数模型。

Conclusion: GA-SVD通过生成感知白化与进化式全局秩分配，有效提升LLM低秩压缩在生成任务上的表现，兼顾压缩效率与性能，且具备大规模模型可扩展性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong generalization across a broad range of reasoning and generation tasks, but their large parameter counts impose substantial memory and computation costs, hindering deployment in practical resource-constrained settings. One-shot low-rank compression is a promising solution since it reduces model size and inference cost effectively. However, existing SVD-based methods primarily target multiple-choice benchmarks and often fail to preserve performance on generation tasks. Moreover, their rank allocation strategies are typically heuristic. We propose GA-SVD, a generation-aware low-rank compression framework for LLMs. First, we introduce Generation-Aware Weight Whitening (GAWW), which leverages gradients from on-policy knowledge distillation to construct whitening transformations aligned with generative behavior. Second, we develop an evolutionary global rank allocation method that searches for effective layer-wise rank allocation under a given global compression ratio. Across extensive experiments on Mistral-7B, Qwen3 series, and Llama-3.3 models, evaluated on both multiple-choice and generative benchmarks, GA-SVD consistently outperforms existing SVD-based baselines and achieves state-of-the-art (SoTA) results. We further demonstrate scalability by applying our method to models with up to 70B parameters.

</details>


### [1297] [Harnessing VLM in Embodied RL: From Reward Regressor to Success Detector via Exploration-Augmented Key-Observation Gating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15401)
*Xin Liu,Yutong Jiang,Jian Su,Ziheng Wang,Chuang Wang,Haoran Li,Dongbin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出VLMeg，将VLM作为成功检测器而非奖励回归器，通过探索增强的关键观测门控实现高效具身奖励设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM奖励回归方法需大量标注，且主要面向微调预训练策略，在从零开始的RL设置中表现差。根本原因在于回归精确奖励与VLM擅长的多模态VQA能力不匹配。

Method: VLMeg核心为探索增强关键观测门控：先基于与生成成功轨迹的相似度判断当前episode是否值得评估；再从值得评估的episode中选取混淆度最低的关键观测交给VLM评估作为episodic reward。引入基于生成轨迹的先进探索激励，以应对值得评估episode稀疏问题。

Result: 在MetaWorld的12个挑战性无奖励任务上实现SOTA从零RL，优于先进VLM基线；在3个真实世界实验中无需任何真值奖励即可实现有效RL。

Conclusion: 让VLM充当成功检测器比奖励回归更契合其固有能力，门控机制减少冗余调用并提升检测精度，探索激励提升RL效率。

Abstract: VLMs provide promising solutions to embodied reward design. Most current methods that train VLMs as reward regressors not only require extensive annotations but are also primarily designed for finetuning pretrained policies, and perform less well in the more challenging from-scratch RL setting. This issue stems from a fundamental mismatch: regressing precise rewards is misaligned with what VLMs naturally excel at. We posit that it is more aligned with VLMs' inherent multi-modal VQA capabilities for the models to function as success detectors, and propose VLM success reward via Exploration-Augmented Key-Observation Gating (VLMeg) to well harness VLM for embodied reward design. As the core of VLMeg, the proposed exploration-augmented key-observation gating first determines whether the current RL episode is judgment-worthy based on its similarity to a generated success trajectory. Then, the key observation with the lowest confusion from the judgment-worthy episode will be selected for VLM evaluation as episodic reward. This gating mechanism not only avoids redundant calls but also enables higher detection accuracy of VLM. Considering the sparsity of judgment-worthy episodes, the advanced exploration incentives based on the generated trajectory are introduced, enabling more efficient exploration toward judgment-worthy trajectories for more VLM reward triggers and thus gaining higher RL efficiency. Extensive experiments in MetaWorld demonstrate VLMeg achieves state-of-the-art from-scratch RL, outperforming advanced VLM-based baselines on 12 challenging reward-free tasks. Furthermore, VLMeg also enables effective RL without any ground-truth reward in 3 challenging real-world experiments. Code will be open after acceptance at https://github.com/Raina915/VLMeg.

</details>


### [1298] [Riemannian Graph Tokenizer for Structural Knowledge Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15427)
*Qimin Zhou,Haibo Liu,Yujie Wang,Li Sun,Chuan Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出黎曼图分词器（RGT），通过黎曼几何连接结构知识与量化表示，实现跨域图结构知识迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型成功依赖分词器，但图分词器仍处早期，面临非欧结构与结构语义捕获的挑战；如何设计图分词器以支持结构知识迁移是关键问题。

Method: 1) 定义几何词表（树、环、序列）捕获基本结构模式；2) 构建带黎曼直通估计器的黎曼量化器，将多域图结构分词为离散token；3) 引入几何对齐解码器，将各流形token投影到统一切空间以保证一致性与可迁移性。

Result: 提供理论分析与几何解释支撑方法有效性；在多样数据集的大量实验表明RGT显著提升跨图域的结构知识迁移能力。

Conclusion: RGT借助黎曼几何有效桥接结构知识与量化表示，为图分词与跨域结构知识迁移提供新思路。

Abstract: Foundation models are at the forefront of artificial intelligence. A tokenizer, converting the raw input into discrete representations that the model can understand, plays an important role to the success of foundation models. Unlike the text tokenizer that is well studied in large language models, graph tokenizer is still at its early stage, facing the challenges of tackling the non-Euclidean structures and capturing the structural semantics. How to design a graph tokenizer for structural knowledge transfer? To this end, we propose a Riemannian Graph Tokenizer (RGT) that bridges the structural knowledge and quantized representations to support cross-domain structural knowledge transfer. The connection is established by Riemannian geometry. Specifically, we first define the geometric vocabulary (trees, cycles and sequences), which captures fundamental structural patterns and reflects the intrinsic geometry of graph. Second, we construct a Riemannian quantizer with Riemannian Straight-Through Estimator to tokenise graph structures across multiple domains into discrete tokens. To ensure consistency and transferability across diverse geometric spaces, RGT further incorporates a geometry-aligned decoder that projects manifold-specific tokens into a unified tangent space. The theoretical analysis and geometric interpretations are provided to support the effectiveness of our proposed method. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that RGT significantly enhances structural knowledge transferability across graph domains.

</details>


### [1299] [Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization for Robust Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15428)
*Chang-Hoon Jeong,Kisung Shin,Hanwool Sul,Byoung-Tak Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PLATO，通过在训练中让策略接触分布外（off-support）的潜在任务表示，提升基于上下文的离线元强化学习（COMRL）在参数外推任务上的泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: COMRL 主要靠更好的任务表示，把任务身份与行为策略伪影分离，隐含假设"干净表示可迁移到分布外任务"。但分布外任务上编码器会产生训练支持外的潜在，而策略从未在此训练过，导致泛化缺口。

Method: PLATO 假设任务潜在位于低维流形上，分布外任务离训练中心更远。它沿中心向外扰动推断出的潜在以合成反事实任务；用学到的解码器集成在每个扰动潜在处生成短轨迹，并在悲观权重（对集成不一致的步骤降权）下用想象转移更新策略。

Result: 理论上证明扰动以可控幅度离开训练支持，分布外泛化误差由扰动半径界定，并给出扰动潜在处认知分歧有下界的条件。在 8 个 MuJoCo 连续控制基准上，PLATO 在分布外回报上持续优于强 COMRL 基线，且在分布内任务上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过主动在训练中暴露 off-support 潜在并结合悲观优化，PLATO 有效缩小了 COMRL 的分布外泛化缺口，兼顾分布内性能。

Abstract: Context-based offline meta-reinforcement learning (COMRL) has advanced almost entirely through better task representations, which separate task identity from artifacts of the behavior policy so that the latent reflects the task alone. The implicit expectation has been that a clean representation will transfer to out-of-support (parameter-extrapolation) tasks. On such a task, however, the encoder produces a latent outside the training support, where the policy has never been trained. We address this gap with Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization (PLATO), which exposes the policy to off-support latents during training. PLATO assumes a mild manifold hypothesis: task latents lie on a low-dimensional manifold, and out-of-support tasks lie farther from the training centroid. It exploits this geometry by perturbing inferred latents outward from the centroid to synthesize counterfactual tasks. A learned decoder ensemble then rolls out short trajectories at each perturbed latent, and the policy is updated on the imagined transitions under a pessimism weight that down-weights steps on which the ensemble disagrees. We prove that the perturbation leaves the training support by a controllable margin and that the out-of-support generalization gap is bounded by the same perturbation reach, and we give explicit conditions, verified empirically, under which the epistemic disagreement at the perturbed latent stays bounded away from zero. On eight MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, PLATO consistently improves out-of-support returns over strong COMRL baselines while remaining competitive on in-distribution tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/deephoony/plato.

</details>


### [1300] [World Modeling through Spectral Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15429)
*Holger Molin,William Peng,Marco Bagatella,Randall Balestriero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SpecWM，一种基于谱表示学习的 JEPA 框架，通过目标相似度核显式指定世界模型应保留的信息，并验证核的选择能控制物理量的可恢复性及提升控制规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型应保留哪些信息这一问题尚未明确；作者希望通过谱表示学习的视角，显式地规定观测之间应保留的关系，从而引导潜在世界模型保留对控制有用的信息。

Method: 提出 SpecWM：在 JEPA 框架中引入目标相似度核，显式指定观测之间的关系，并训练编码器在嵌入几何中复现这些关系。核可以多种多样，从物理状态信息到仅需轨迹内观测顺序的全自监督时间核。作者还分析了目标的全局最优、线性可恢复性与干扰不变性条件，并在理想设定下将时间核相似度与行为后继度量联系起来。

Result: 核的选择强烈决定表示中哪些物理量可恢复；时间谱对齐显著提升 CEM 规划成功率：OGBench Cube 从 52% 到 68%，OGBench Scene 从 49% 到 77%，CALVIN 从 29% 到 51%（相比 LeWorldModel）。

Conclusion: 显式指定表示几何是一种简单有效的方式，可引导潜在世界模型保留对控制有用的信息。

Abstract: How do we tell a world model what information to preserve? We study this question through the lens of spectral representation learning. We introduce SpecWM, a JEPA framework that explicitly specifies desired relationships between observations through a target similarity kernel and trains the encoder to reproduce those relationships in its embedding geometry. Different kernels provide different supervision, ranging from physical state information to a fully self-supervised temporal kernel requiring only the ordering of observations within trajectories.
