We characterize the global optima of the objective, establish conditions for linear recoverability and invariance to nuisance information, and connect temporal-kernel similarity to the behavioral successor measure under an idealized setting. Empirically, the choice of kernel strongly controls which physical quantities are recoverable from the representation. More importantly, temporal spectral alignment improves CEM planning success over LeWorldModel from 52% to 68% on OGBench Cube, 49% to 77% on OGBench Scene, and 29% to 51% on CALVIN. These results suggest that explicitly specifying representation geometry provides a simple way to steer what latent world models preserve for control.

</details>


### [1301] [Split Conformal Interval Length under Huber Contamination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15458)
*Xiao Zhang,Bowen Zhang,Lie He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究Huber污染下split conformal prediction区间长度的有限样本性质，分别给出训练与校准污染的上界和最坏情况刻画，并证明匹配的极小极大下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对split conformal prediction区间长度的分析大多针对干净数据，训练与校准阶段的污染如何相对于干净总体oracle改变区间长度尚不清楚。

Method: 考虑Huber污染，推导在所有污染分布上一致成立的有限样本上界；并在正则非对称位置子模型上建立极小极大下界。对校准污染给出总体区间长度偏差的精确最坏情况刻画，并将上界扩展到conformalized quantile regression和自适应残差分数。

Result: 得到上界，主导项为L(δ1+n1^{-1/2})+(n2^{-1/2}+δ2)/((1-δ2)r0)，外加干净样本估计项；下界在常数因子内与上界速率匹配；校准污染有精确最坏情况刻画；合成与真实数据实验支持理论发现。

Conclusion: 该工作刻画了训练与校准阶段污染对split conformal区间长度的影响，给出匹配上下的理论保证，并推广到CQR与自适应残差分数，实验验证了理论。

Abstract: Existing analyses of interval length in split conformal prediction largely focus on clean data. However, how contamination at the training and calibration stages alters interval length relative to the corresponding clean population oracle remains understudied. In this paper, we consider Huber contamination and derive a finite-sample upper bound that holds uniformly over contaminating distributions, with leading terms scaling as $L(δ_1+n_1^{-1/2}) +(n_2^{-1/2}+δ_2)/((1-δ_2)r_0)$, in addition to a clean-sample estimation term. We further establish a minimax lower bound matching the upper-bound rate up to constant factors on a regular asymmetric location submodel. For calibration contamination, we obtain an exact worst-case characterization of the population interval-length deviation. We also extend the upper-bound results to conformalized quantile regression and adaptive residual scores. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets provide empirical support for our theoretical findings on training and calibration contamination.

</details>


### [1302] [Revisited Support Vector Machines: A Unified Joint Optimization Framework with Nyström Approximation for Scalable Adaptive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15498)
*Nassou Gongon Benjamin,Noulapeu Ngaffo,Patrick Njionou Sadjang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"Revisited SVM"统一框架，将核选择与决策边界学习联合为连续双层优化问题，用混合块坐标上升(BCA)算法结合Nyström低秩近似，把复杂度从O(N³)降至O(Nm)，准确率媲美甚至超越网格搜索，训练加速可达100倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典SVM在大数据时代面临两大瓶颈：O(N³)的训练复杂度过高，以及静态核的刚性。传统方法把核选择当作离散的"暴力"GridSearch问题，导致数据表示学习与决策边界优化被割裂。

Method: 提出"Revisited SVM"统一框架，将学习过程重构为连续的双层联合优化问题；推导新的目标函数J(α,θ)，同时优化对偶拉格朗日乘子与核超参数；引入混合块坐标上升(BCA)算法，并紧密结合Nyström低秩近似以高效求解该非凸问题。

Result: 在生物信息、金融、网络安全、计算机视觉四个异构领域实验中，准确率匹配甚至超越穷举GridSearch，训练加速最高达100倍。在NSL-KDD入侵检测数据集上，自适应核方法达到96.25%准确率，而标准基线仅为50%。结果经严格统计检验验证。

Conclusion: 该框架证明联合优化核超参数与对偶变量能有效建模高维复杂非线性流形，同时大幅降低计算复杂度；作者提供了算法的理论收敛性分析。

Abstract: The theoretical elegance of Support Vector Machines (SVMs), grounded in statistical learning theory, establishes them as a reference for robust classification. However, in the era of Big Data, classical SVMs face two major bottlenecks: the prohibitive cubic complexity $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ of training and the rigidity of static kernels. Traditional methodologies treat kernel selection as a discrete, "brute-force" GridSearch problem, effectively decoupling the learning of data representation from the optimization of the decision boundary. This paper proposes a paradigm shift with a so-called "Revisited SVM", a unified framework that recasts the learning process as a continuous %bi-level joint optimization problem. We derive a novel objective function $J(α, θ)$ that allows for the simultaneous optimization of dual Lagrange multipliers and kernel hyper-parameters. To solve this challenging non-convex problem efficiently, we introduce a hybrid Block Coordinate Ascent (BCA) algorithm, tightly integrated with Nyström-based low-rank approximation, which drastically reduces computational complexity to $\mathcal{O}(Nm)$. Extensive experiments conducted across four heterogeneous domains (Bioinformatics, Finance, Cybersecurity, and Computer Vision) demonstrate that our approach not only matches but often exceeds exhaustive GridSearch accuracy, while delivering training speedups of up to 100x. Notably, on the complex NSL-KDD intrusion detection dataset, our adaptive kernel approach achieves 96.25\% accuracy compared to a mere 50\% for standard baselines, proving its unique ability to model complex non-linear manifolds in high-dimensional spaces. We validate our results using rigorous statistical tests and provide a theoretical convergence analysis of the proposed algorithm.

</details>


### [1303] [CacheLink: Functional KV Transport for Zero-Prefill Cross-Model Context Handoff](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15509)
*Haomiao Qiu,Yining Tang,Zijia Song,Ruizi Han,Ziyue Qiao,Miao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究零预填充跨模型上下文交接，指出KV重建保真度不能代表接收模型效用，提出CACHELINK方法通过直接优化接收模型行为来学习耦合K/V校正，在多个模型对和评测面板上平均提升性能，并将32K上下文交接延迟降低最多7.27倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV缓存可复用历史计算以提升长上下文服务效率，但切换模型会打破复用，接收方需重新预填充相同上下文。已有仿射传输方法能较好重建接收方KV状态，但作者发现重建保真度并不能反映接收模型的实际效用：相似的重建误差可能导致显著不同的注意力模式、预测分布和下游准确率，因为传统重建目标忽略了K/V在接收方注意力中依赖查询的功能重要性。

Method: 作者提出CACHELINK，直接依据接收模型行为学习耦合的K/V校正，而非仅优化K/V重建误差，使传输后的缓存能诱导出更符合接收方注意力和下一token预测的接收计算。

Result: 在四个独立训练的发送方-接收方模型对和七个评测面板上，CACHELINK对每一对都提升了所有方法的等权平均值。匹配诊断中，CACHELINK将K/V平方误差变化控制在0.4%以内，却显著改变接收方注意力与下一token行为；在32K上下文下，相对接收方重新预填充，交接延迟最多降低7.27倍。

Conclusion: 研究证实，仅靠重建保真度不足以实现有效的跨模型KV传输；关键在于保持传输缓存所诱导的接收方计算行为，这对有效的跨模型KV交接更为重要。

Abstract: KV caches make long-context serving efficient by reusing past computation, but model switching breaks this reuse and forces the receiver to prefill the context again. We study \emph{zero-prefill cross-model context handoff}: translating a sender cache into a receiver-compatible state so that the receiver can continue directly without prefilling same context. Existing affine transport methods show that receiver KV states can be substantially reconstructed from sender caches. However, through extensive analyses, we find that reconstruction fidelity is a poor proxy for receiver utility. Similar K/V reconstruction errors can lead to substantially different attention patterns, predictive distributions, and downstream accuracy, because conventional reconstruction objectives overlook the query-dependent functional importance of K and V in receiver attention. We thus introduce CACHELINK, which learns a coupled K/V correction through the receiver behavior directly. Across four independently trained sender--receiver pairs and seven evaluation panels, CACHELINK improves the equal-weight mean over all methods for every pair. In matched diagnostics, CACHELINK changes K/V squared error by less than 0.4% while substantially changing receiver attention and next-token behavior. At 32K context, it reduces handoff latency by up to $7.27\times$ relative to receiver re-prefill. Our findings verify that reconstruction fidelity alone is insufficient and that preserving the receiver computation induced by the transported cache is important for effective cross-model KV transport.

</details>


### [1304] [SARATHI: Decoupled Data-Free Probing and Adaptive Reconstruction for Structured LLM Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15514)
*Sankar Behera,Dhruv Singh,Satyadev Ahlawat,Yamuna Prasad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SARATHI 提出解耦的结构化剪枝框架，用无数据 NMF 残差子空间探针选神经元，再用自适应 OBS 局部重建权重，并补偿 LayerNorm 后的激活漂移，在 15-40% 稀疏度下取得竞争性困惑度与零样本精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练后结构化剪枝方法通过共享校准数据集将神经元选择与权重重建耦合，导致领域偏差，并在高稀疏度下出现内存不足问题。

Method: SARATHI 分为三步：(1) 无数据的 NMF Residual Subspace Probe，利用权重内在几何为神经元打分，无需校准数据，并与 Robust PCA 有形式化联系；(2) Adaptive OBS，用局部校准批次重建剪枝后权重，每层峰值内存为 O(d^2)，消除全局内存瓶颈；(3) Bias Shift Compensation，纠正 post-LayerNorm 架构中的系统性激活漂移，避免高稀疏度下困惑度崩溃。

Result: 在两种架构族（gated 与 non-gated FFN）的六个模型、15-40% 稀疏度下，SARATHI 达到竞争性困惑度，并在零样本准确率上匹配或超越现有结构化剪枝基线。

Conclusion: 通过解耦神经元选择与权重重建，SARATHI 缓解了领域偏差与内存瓶颈，并能在高稀疏度下保持性能，是有效的 LLM 结构化剪枝框架。

Abstract: Structured pruning reduces the inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by permanently removing neurons and weight rows, yielding dense, hardware-agnostic speedup. Existing post-training methods couple neuron selection and weight reconstruction through a shared calibration dataset, introducing domain bias and out-of-memory failures at high sparsity. We propose SARATHI, a framework that decouples these two stages. A data-free \emph{NMF Residual Subspace Probe} scores neurons using intrinsic weight geometry, without accessing any calibration data, and carries a formal connection to Robust PCA. \emph{Adaptive OBS} then reconstructs the pruned weights with a localized calibration batch, operating in $\mathcal{O}(d^2)$ peak memory per layer and eliminating the global memory bottleneck of coupled methods. A \emph{Bias Shift Compensation} step corrects systematic activation drift in post-LayerNorm architectures that would otherwise cause perplexity collapse at high sparsity. Experiments across six models from two architecture families (gated and non-gated FFN) at 15--40\% sparsity show that SARATHI achieves competitive perplexity and matches or exceeds existing structured pruning baselines on zero-shot accuracy.

</details>


### [1305] [OceanFlow: Coherent Flow Matching for Probabilistic Ocean Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15518)
*Yuan Gao,Fan Xu,Hao Wu,Xiaomeng Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OceanFlow，一种连贯flow matching框架，用于概率化全球海洋建模，先建立稳定均值锚点，再学习状态条件路径律重塑残差分布，提升集合均值精度、概率可靠性与物理一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率化海洋建模对风险感知海洋作业、气候分析和科学决策至关重要，下游决策依赖未来海洋状态的条件分布而非单一确定性轨迹。现有数据驱动海洋模型在确定性建模上已较准确高效，但概率建模仍不成熟：扰动驱动集合只制造离散度，未显式优化成员的联合分布，导致校准差和物理不一致。

Method: OceanFlow框架：首先为条件集合建立锐利稳定的均值锚点；再用flow matching学习连贯的状态条件路径律，在每次转移中联合重塑锚点周围的残差分布，保持预测中心同时细化状态相关不确定性；并提出Factorized Dynamics Operator (FDO)，结合因子化转移与学习的狀態条件响应来参数化均值锚点和残差流速度。

Result: 大量实验表明，OceanFlow在集合均值精度、概率可靠性及物理一致性诊断指标上均优于竞争基线。

Conclusion: 连贯flow matching是通向数据驱动概率化海洋建模的有效路径。代码已开源于 https://github.com/YuanGao-YG/OceanFlow。

Abstract: Probabilistic ocean modeling is essential for risk-aware marine operations, climate analysis, and scientific decision-making, where downstream decisions depend on the conditional distribution of future ocean states rather than a single deterministic trajectory. Recent data-driven ocean models have made deterministic global ocean modeling increasingly accurate and efficient, but probabilistic ocean modeling remains underdeveloped. Specifically, perturbation-driven ensembles can create spread without explicitly optimizing the joint distribution of their members, often yielding poor calibration and physical inconsistency. To address these issues, we propose OceanFlow, a coherent flow matching framework for probabilistic global ocean modeling. OceanFlow first establishes a sharp, stable mean anchor for the conditional ensemble. Flow matching then learns a coherent state-conditioned pathwise law that jointly reshapes the residual distribution around this anchor at each transition, preserving the predictive center while refining state-dependent uncertainty. We further introduce a Factorized Dynamics Operator (FDO), which combines factorized transitions with a learned state-conditioned response to parameterize the mean anchor and residual-flow velocity. Extensive experiments show that OceanFlow improves ensemble-mean accuracy, probabilistic reliability, and physical-consistency diagnostics over competitive baselines, supporting coherent flow matching as an effective route toward data-driven probabilistic ocean modeling. Code is available at https://github.com/YuanGao-YG/OceanFlow.

</details>


### [1306] [Sensitivity Fidelity Reveals Physical Dependencies Beyond Forecast Accuracy in Deep-Learning Earth-System Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15540)
*Qi Chen,Peng Zhan,Hongxing Cui,Wenqing Cui,Ibrahim Hoteit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"敏感性保真度"作为评估深度学习地球系统预报模型的新标准，不仅看预测误差，还考察模型对输入扰动的响应是否与可信参考或物理知识一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型在地球系统预报中日益接近数值模拟，但仅凭预测误差无法判断模型学到的输入-输出依赖关系是否物理一致。需要一个额外的评估标准。

Method: 提出敏感性保真度准则：在预测误差之外，用扰动输入检验模型响应。在理想化Rayleigh-Bénard对流基准中，用匹配的伴随方法对四个代理架构做定量比较，并进行有限扰动实验。随后应用于ENSO预测（无伴随参考），考察学习到的敏感性的鲁棒性与物理一致性。

Result: 四个代理架构预测误差都很低，但敏感性差异显著；与伴随的定量比较比预测精度更能区分模型，表明预测能力与敏感性保真度并不必然一致；有限扰动实验将差异与初始条件不确定性传播联系起来。ENSO预测中学习的敏感性表现出事件级鲁棒性、有限扰动下有效，并与已有前兆一致。

Conclusion: 基于梯度的评估可作为预报误差指标的有力补充，为检验数据驱动地球系统模型是否学到物理可信的依赖关系提供实用测试。

Abstract: Deep-learning models increasingly rival numerical simulation in Earth-system forecasting, yet forecast error alone cannot determine whether their learned input-output dependencies are physically consistent. Here we introduce sensitivity fidelity as an additional criterion: alongside prediction error, model responses to input perturbations should be examined against a trusted reference or established physical knowledge. In an idealized Rayleigh-Bénard convection benchmark, four surrogate architectures achieved low forecast errors yet encoded markedly different sensitivities. Quantitative comparison with a matched adjoint distinguished the models far more sharply than forecast accuracy and showed that predictive skill and sensitivity fidelity need not coincide, while finite-perturbation experiments further linked these differences to the propagation of initial-condition uncertainty. We then applied this strategy to El Niño-Southern Oscillation prediction, where no adjoint reference exists and learned sensitivities showed event-wise robustness, validity under finite perturbations, and consistency with established precursors. These results identify gradient-based evaluation as a discriminating complement to forecast-error metrics, providing a practical test of whether data-driven Earth-system models learn physically credible dependencies.

</details>


### [1307] [UNISON: A Unified Framework for Learning from Scored Bags](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15564)
*Ofek Kirshenboim,Or Shkuri,Shani Finkelshtein,Yoram Louzoun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UNISON 提出统一框架，将多示例学习与推荐系统视为同一类"从带分数包集合中学习"的问题，通过三阶段分解实现跨域通用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法将包级分类与个性化推荐视为独立问题，缺乏统一视角；本文旨在用一个通用框架同时解决二者。

Method: 分三阶段：1) 学习通用物品表示；2) 用轻量个性化参数建模包特有的偏好模式（线性包级打分 $w_j, b_j$）；3) 从学到的偏好推断包级特征。冷启动情形归结为无岭线性回归，具闭式解，并对迭代变体给出收敛保证。

Result: 在娱乐(书籍、电影)、免疫学(TCR分类)、微生物组等多领域达到或超过SOTA，计算效率与可解释性更优。合成实验显示包级参数能恢复潜在打分因子(AUC>0.998)。

Conclusion: UNISON 用统一视角有效联结多示例学习与推荐，兼顾性能、效率与可解释性，代码已开源。

Abstract: We introduce UNISON, a unified framework that bridges multiple instance learning and recommendation systems by treating both as instances of learning from scored bag collections of (item, score) pairs. Unlike traditional approaches that address bag-level classification and personalized recommendation as separate problems, UNISON decomposes learning into three interconnected stages: (1) learning universal item representations, (2) modeling bag-specific preference patterns through lightweight personalized parameters, and (3) inferring bag-level characteristics from learned preferences. We justify the architectural choice of linear bag-specific scoring through a first-order analysis: when item embeddings are sufficiently smooth in the score, a linear function approximates the score up to a Taylor remainder controlled by the curvature of the underlying preference function. For cold-start scenarios, we show that the cold-bag fitting problem reduces to ridge-less linear regression with a closed-form solution, and provide convergence guarantees for the iterative variant. Empirically, UNISON matches or outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across diverse domains: entertainment (books, movies), immunology (T cell receptor (TCR) based classification), and microbiome, offering superior computational efficiency and interpretability. A controlled synthetic experiment further confirms that the bag-specific parameters ($w_j, b_j$) recover the latent factors that drive item scores even when the projection $φ$ has no access to the original scoring mechanism (AUC > 0.998). UNISON is available at https://github.com/louzounlab/UNISON.

</details>


### [1308] [Truncation Samplers Are Nested: Comparing Decoding Rules Is a Measurement Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15570)
*Rasul Khanbayov,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究截断采样器（truncation sampler）比较问题，发现主流截断规则均保留概率排序词表的前缀，因而任意两条规则每步嵌套。嵌套性给出闭式每步距离与耦合，可构造分离证书，从已有日志计算，在无规则超越时精确等于序列级总变差距离。实验显示证书值普遍≥0.998，仅靠界难以定论；但耦合提供无偏配对估计器，方差降低1.2–3.8倍，并据此估计各基准解析1分差异所需样本量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比较两种截断采样器代价极高（一次比较需六千A100小时），且事先无法判断两采样器差距多大。缺乏低成本、可证明的比较工具。

Method: 观察到几乎所有部署的截断规则保留概率排序词表的前缀，故任意两条规则在每个解码步是嵌套的。利用嵌套性推导每步距离的闭式解，并构造耦合：两采样器在首次分歧前输出相同文本。将每步结果沿生成过程累积，得到分离证书（separation certificate），可约束任意有界结果上的差异，且可由比较过程已产生的日志计算。当两规则从不互相超越时，该证书恰等于序列级总变差距离。

Result: 在六个开放权重模型、四个数学与科学基准上，所有测试超参数网格的证书值至少为0.998，说明仅靠界很少能完成比较，但同一族的两个成员可能非常接近。耦合给出无偏配对估计器，相比提示级配对方差降低1.2–3.8倍。按默认配对方差及提示间成分点估计：GSM8K、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond上解析1分差异每提示需8–32个样本，AIME 2025约需210个；在该成分上置信界下，GPQA-Diamond需超32个，AIME 2025任何样本量都无法解析。

Conclusion: 精确性（证书等于总变差距离）是脆弱的；要认证小差异，需每步两保留质量以极高精度一致。选择截断采样器至少同样是测量问题而非仅设计问题。

Abstract: Settling one comparison between two truncation samplers has cost six thousand A100-hours, and nothing says in advance how far apart two samplers can be. We observe that almost every deployed truncation rule keeps a prefix of the probability-sorted vocabulary, so any two such rules are nested at every decoding step. Nesting yields a closed-form per-step distance and a coupling under which both samplers emit identical text until they first disagree. Accumulated over a generation, this gives a separation certificate that bounds the difference between two samplers on any bounded outcome, is computable from logs a comparison already produces, and equals their sequence-level total variation distance exactly when neither rule ever overtakes the other. Two consequences follow without measurement: exactness is fragile, and certifying a small difference requires the two retained masses to agree to very high precision at every step. On six open-weight models over four math and science benchmarks, the certificate for every hyperparameter grid we tested is at least 0.998, so a bound alone rarely settles a comparison, although two members of one family can be far closer. What remains useful is the coupling, which gives an unbiased paired estimator that cuts variance $1.2$-$3.8\times$ against prompt-level pairing. Read against benchmark sizes at the default pair's variance and our point estimate of its between-prompt component, resolving a one-point difference needs 8 to 32 samples per prompt on GSM8K, MATH-500 and GPQA-Diamond and about 210 on AIME 2025; at that component's upper confidence bound GPQA-Diamond needs more than 32 and AIME 2025 cannot be resolved at any sample count. Choosing a truncation sampler is a measurement problem at least as much as a design one. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/truncation-samplers.

</details>


### [1309] [The Gradient That Top-k Distillation Never Computes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15589)
*Rasul Khanbayov,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明top-k蒸馏中的重归一化只隐藏尾部概率而并未阻止其漂移，梯度在控制尾部质量的方向上恰为零；实验显示尾部质量会偏离教师分布，且保留集需达k=d+1才能精确恢复教师分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署中的蒸馏流程常让学生模型只看到教师截断后的top-k概率并重归一化，通常假设重归一化能补偿缺失质量。作者质疑这一假设，想探究重归一化是否真正保护了尾部信息。

Method: 从理论上分析重归一化目标的梯度结构，证明其仅依赖保留token间的log-odds，控制尾部质量的梯度方向恰为零；并用真实教师模型量化该梯度分量与尾部质量漂移，配合top-k与全词表对照实验及七个开源教师模型验证。

Result: 真实教师上该梯度分量仅约2–3×10⁻¹⁵；无交叉熵时top-k学生尾部质量漂离教师而全词表对照略靠近，加交叉熵后差距缩小约四倍但仍存在；七个教师模型上需k=d+1（d为隐藏维度）才能精确恢复分布，而常用缓存大小低于该阈值。

Conclusion: 重归一化只是归一化，并非保护机制，它消除了尾部质量的可见性却保留了其可移动的自由度；实践中影响真实但小于师生配对选择的影响。

Abstract: Many deployed distillation pipelines show the student a truncated view of the teacher: keep the top-k probabilities, renormalize, and minimize a divergence on what remains. Renormalization is assumed to account for the missing mass. We prove that it removes the visibility of tail mass, not the freedom to move it. The renormalized objective depends only on log-odds among the retained tokens, so at each position its gradient along the directions that control tail mass is exactly zero; on a real teacher that component measures $2$-$3\times10^{-15}$ of the gradient. The full-vocabulary gradient equals the truncated gradient plus a residual weighted by the tail masses, and training acts only on the first term. Without the cross-entropy term, a top-k student's tail mass drifts away from the teacher's while a full-vocabulary control moves slightly toward it; with it, the gap shrinks about fourfold but persists. On seven open-weight teachers, the retained set determines the teacher's distribution only from $k=d+1$ ($d$ the hidden dimension): recovery is exact from there on all seven, and commonly cached sizes sit below it. In our off-policy runs the practical effect is real but smaller than the choice of teacher-student pair. Renormalization is a normalization, not a safeguard. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/top-k-distillation.

</details>


### [1310] [An Attention-Guided Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Boundary Integral Computation in Physical Field Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15590)
*RongZe Gao,YuWei Wu,XinRan Ji,XingYue Ren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GNN-BEM框架，利用注意力引导的图神经网络作为代理模型，从已知边界信息预测缺失边界信息，再结合边界元法重建内部物理场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际工程与科学计算中，边界值问题常面临边界信息不足（missing boundary information）的问题，难以确定内部物理场分布。

Method: 将离散边界上的物理信息特征提取到潜空间，用变分自编码器（VAE）架构学习从已知边界量到缺失边界量的非线性映射，并引入注意力机制建模不同边界信息间的相关性；随后用传统边界元法（BEM）积分公式重建内部物理场。

Result: 在二维Laplace和Poisson方程数值算例中，框架在重建精度、局部细节保持和模型稳定性方面表现良好。

Conclusion: GNN-BEM为复杂边界条件下偏微分方程的边界信息恢复与快速内部物理场重建提供了可行计算框架。

Abstract: In practical engineering and scientific computing, a real physical system can be reduced to a boundary value problem, and the adequate boundary information to determine the interior spatial distribution and evolutionary state of the physical field can be solved with linear equations, alternatively, the the real physical problem can be treated with boundary problems with in adequate information problems in field of machine learning. This paper proposes a deep learning framework for the recovery of missing boundary information using an attention-guided graph neural network (GNN) surrogate. The framework extracts features from the physical information on the discretized boundary into a latent space, and the missing boundary quantities are then predicted by the network. Thus, the nonlinear mapping from known boundary quantities to missing boundary quantities is learned using a variational autoencoder (VAE) architecture, while an attention mechanism is incorporated to better model the correlations among different types of boundary information. Furthermore, the interior physical field can be reconstructed using the conventional boundary element method (BEM) integral formulation. The effectiveness of the GNN-BEM framework is evaluated using numerical examples of the two-dimensional Laplace and Poisson equations, which demonstrate good performance in reconstruction accuracy, local detail preservation, and model stability. The results show that GNN-BEM provides a feasible computational framework for boundary information recovery and fast interior physical field reconstruction for partial differential equations under complex boundary conditions.

</details>


### [1311] [ProML: Progressive Multi-label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15614)
*Yi Kou,Jieting Wang,Yuhua Qian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ProML框架，通过引入辅助预测变量解耦标签拟合与预测器学习，将传统耦合多标签学习转为等价profile目标，理论证明其改善优化几何，并在多标签特征选择任务上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多标签学习通过单一预测参数矩阵同时拟合标签和编码结构先验，导致优化病态、超参敏感、容量控制困难。论文旨在解耦直接标签拟合与预测器学习以缓解这些问题。

Method: 引入辅助预测变量，其有闭式解，得到等价的profiled目标，监督拟合项被权衡参数缩放；传统耦合学习视为极限特例。理论分析优化几何（在二次半正定结构正则下衰减主导曲率、扩大稳定学习率范围、提供可控保真-正则权衡）。实例化到多标签特征选择，融合全局-局部标签先验与行稀疏正则。

Result: 在12个基准数据集上进行大量实验与受控优化分析，实证结果与理论分析一致，方法表现出稳健且具竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: ProML提供统一视角，解耦设计改善优化条件与稳定性，并在多标签特征选择任务中验证其有效性。

Abstract: Multi-label learning typically pursues model construction through the joint optimization of label fitting, correlation modeling, and structural regularization. While empirically effective, such a coupled paradigm imposes multiple learning objectives on a single predictive parameter matrix, forcing it to simultaneously fit observed labels and encode structural priors. This coupling may induce ill-conditioned optimization geometry, increase hyper-parameter sensitivity, and complicate capacity control. To address the these issues, this paper proposes a Progressive Multi-Label Learning (ProML) framework, which decouples direct label fitting from predictor learning via the introduction of an auxiliary predictive variable. This auxiliary variable admits a closed-form solution, yielding an equivalent profiled objective in which the supervised fitting term is scaled by a trade-off parameter. This result provides a unified view of ProML and conventional coupled learning, with the latter recovered as a limiting case. We theoretically analyze the optimization geometry of ProML and show that, under quadratic positive semidefinite structural regularization, ProML attenuates the dominant curvature of the fitting term, enlarges the stable learning rate range, and provides a controllable fidelity-regularization trade-off. Further, we instantiate the ProML for multi-label feature selection task by integrating global-local label priors and row-sparse regularization. Extensive experiments and controlled optimization analyses on 12 benchmark datasets empirically corroborate the theoretical analysis and demonstrate the robust and competitive performance of the proposed method.

</details>


### [1312] [Adaptive Role Assignment and Controlled Feature Reconstruction for Federated Image Semantic Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15623)
*Yuxuan Chen,Jiao Bie,Hang Qi,Jingjin Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ARC-FedSC，面向RAN的混合联邦语义通信框架，协调UE角色分配与服务端特征重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合联邦语义通信中，UE角色成本异构，且模型聚合与特征重建之间存在耦合，难以在实际RAN中部署。

Method: 固定通信预算下，RAN Aware Role-Bandit结合UE历史贡献与当前上行链路状况进行角色分配；TCA依据近期模型聚合方向调节特征重建。

Result: CIFAR-10时变信道实验中，五种角色配置后期均优于基线；最佳配置后20轮平均PSNR约24.17 dB；Role-Bandit滚动UE覆盖率达85.3%（基线65.7%）；TCA将有害FR事件概率从0.245降至0.093，减少62.0%。

Conclusion: ARC-FedSC有效提升RAN场景下混合联邦语义通信的性能与鲁棒性，消融与敏感性研究验证了设计有效性。

Abstract: Hybrid federated semantic communication enables user equipment (UEs) to contribute model updates or semantic features under a shared training framework. However, heterogeneous role costs and the interaction between model aggregation and feature reconstruction (FR) remain key challenges in practical radio access network (RAN) deployment. To address these issues, we propose ARC-FedSC, a RAN-aware framework that coordinates UE role assignment and server-side controlled FR under a fixed communication budget. Within ARC-FedSC, RAN Aware Role-Bandit learns the historical contribution of UEs in different roles together with current uplink conditions, while Temporal Consistency Alignment (TCA) regulates FR according to recent model aggregation directions. Experiments on CIFAR-10 with time-varying RAN channels show that ARC-FedSC outperforms baselines across all five tested role configurations in the later training stage, with the best configurations achieving about 24.17 dB average PSNR over the last 20 rounds. Component level results further show that Role-Bandit maintains an average rolling UE coverage of 85.3%, compared with about 65.7% for baseline, while TCA reduces the probability of harmful FR events from 0.245 to 0.093, corresponding to a 62.0% reduction. Ablation and sensitivity studies further support the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed design.

</details>


### [1313] [The Price of Precision: A Calibrated Cost Model for Mixed-Precision LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15629)
*Mukund Athmaram,Manoj Rao,Liang Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种考虑"瓶颈资源"的成本模型，用于LLM混合精度服务配置的延迟预测与分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合精度配置需在速度与精度间权衡，但基于平均位宽或内存预算的速度代理忽略了真正限制执行的资源。服务速度可能受计算、权重加载或KV缓存访问限制，取决于阶段、批次大小和上下文长度，因此更少比特不代表更快服务。

Method: 构建考虑绑定资源（compute/权重加载/KV缓存）的成本模型，并用两种方式使用：1) 作为预测器，给定配置和运行点，用针对模型、GPU和服务栈校准的常数估计服务延迟，在三种硬件类别上评估精度；2) 作为分配器，结合建模时间成本与实测逐张量精度成本，用动态规划在延迟或精度预算下选择配置。

Result: 预测器在三种硬件类别上验证了其延迟估计准确性；分配器在延迟或精度预算下选择配置，并与字节感知和仅灵敏度分配方法进行对比。

Conclusion: 考虑绑定资源的成本模型能更准确地预测服务延迟并改进混合精度配置分配，优于仅基于字节或灵敏度的传统方法。

Abstract: Choosing a mixed-precision configuration for large language model (LLM) serving trades speed against accuracy. Allocators that use average bit-width or a memory budget as a speed proxy can miss changes in the resource that limits execution. We argue that served speed can be limited by compute, weight loading, or key-value (KV) cache access, depending on the phase, batch size, and context length. A byte-based proxy does not capture all of these costs, so fewer bits do not always mean faster serving. To address this gap, we build a cost model that accounts for the binding resource and use it in two ways. First, as a predictor: given a configuration and operating point, it estimates serving latency using constants calibrated for the model, GPU, and serving stack. We evaluate its accuracy across three hardware classes. Second, as an allocator: we combine modeled time costs with measured per-tensor accuracy costs and use a dynamic program to select a configuration under a latency or accuracy budget. We compare its configurations against byte-aware and sensitivity-only allocation.

</details>


### [1314] [MERIT: Scaling KG Foundation Models with Relation Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15638)
*Cosimo Gregucci,Daniel Hernandez,Antonio Vergari,Steffen Staab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MERIT是首个基于Transformer关系编码器的知识图谱基础模型，用soft prior替代motif边，在保持零样本性能的同时大幅提升推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KGFM（如ULTRA、MOTIF、TRIX、FLOCK）通过扩大关系图或增加随机游走提升性能，但带来更高训练和推理成本，阻碍其用于复杂查询推理任务。

Method: 设计MERIT，首个Transformer关系编码器KGFM：每个关系名称相互注意力交互，motif作为软先验而非边；微调版本MERITQuery用于复杂查询回答。

Result: 在56个基准上零样本MRR匹配SoTA KGFM，推理速度比TRIX快6倍、比FLOCK快100倍以上；MERITQuery在同等成本下优于UltraQuery。

Conclusion: MERIT逆转了KGFM性能与成本同增的趋势，兼顾高效与高性能。

Abstract: Knowledge graph (KG) foundation models (KGFMs) predict links on unseen graphs zero-shot. KGFMs have been pioneered by ULTRA which builds a relation graph from co-occurrences that match motif templates, and passes messages over it to obtain relation representations. More recent KGFMs such as MOTIF and TRIX increase the size of this relation graph, and FLOCK replaces message-passing with probabilistic random-walk ensembles. However, larger relation graphs mean more messages, and more walks mean more sequences to encode, so they improve performance at higher training and inference cost. This cost hinders their use in more complex reasoning tasks, such as complex query answering. To reverse this trend, we design MERIT, the first KGFM with a transformer relation encoder: every relation name attends to every other, and the motifs enter as a soft prior rather than as edges. Over 56 benchmarks, MERIT matches the zero-shot MRR of SoTA KGFMs while being 6x faster than TRIX and over 100x faster than FLOCK at inference. Fine-tuned for complex query answering like UltraQuery, MERITQuery improves over it at matched cost.

</details>


### [1315] [Context-Aware Precision Scheduling for Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15640)
*Mukund Athmaram,Manoj Rao,Liang Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出上下文感知混合精度分配器：校准时延模型结合张量敏感度，在延迟/精度预算下为端侧SLM智能体选择权重精度，并生成可预执行的张量切换调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧智能体需在精度与延迟间平衡，而混合精度配置依赖运行条件（上下文长度），短上下文的最优配置在长上下文下可能失效；且更少比特并不总意味着更快执行。

Method: 从不同精度与上下文长度的测量中校准计时模型，结合张量敏感度，在延迟或精度预算下选择配置；预测器基于校准执行成本而非权重字节估计延迟；运行时按预生成调度执行并保留会话 KV cache。

Result: 在笔记本 GPU 上评估已执行调度，含三种权重格式的长上下文调度，以及测量完整响应时间与正确性的工具使用基准；精度预算下由量化 KV cache 的实测误差决定权重可用预算，分配器可动态升降权重精度。

Conclusion: 实验揭示上下文感知精度在何处有益，以及精度恢复仍受限的场景。

Abstract: Small language models (SLMs) used as on-device agents must balance accuracy and latency as their context grows. Mixed precision helps manage this tradeoff by assigning different precisions to weight tensors according to their size and sensitivity. However, these choices depend on the operating conditions, so a configuration selected for a short context may no longer provide the best tradeoff at a longer one. We calibrate a timing model from measurements at different precisions and context lengths, and combine it with tensor sensitivities to choose configurations under a latency or accuracy budget. We argue that fewer bits do not always mean faster execution, so our predictor estimates latency from calibrated execution costs rather than weight bytes alone. Under a latency budget, reading the larger key-value (KV) cache leaves less time for weight operations, leading the allocator to select lower precisions. This gives a schedule of tensor changes that can be prepared before execution. Our runtime follows the schedule while retaining the session's KV cache. We evaluate executed schedules on a laptop GPU, including a longer-context schedule with three weight formats and a tool-use benchmark measuring full response time and correctness. Under an accuracy budget, measured error from a quantized KV cache determines the budget left for weights. The allocator can raise or lower weight precision as this estimate changes. These experiments show where context-aware precision helps and where accuracy recovery remains limited.

</details>


### [1316] [Testing Central Structure for Complex Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15659)
*Qilong Wu,Yuxiao Li,Simeng Zhang,Xinying Liu,Yan Liu,Zengyou He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用邻接谱半径作为检验统计量，通过网络级假设检验判断网络是否存在统计上可识别的中心结构，并在模拟与55个真实网络上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有中心性度量即使观测差异仅由普通结构变异引起也会对节点排序，因此需要一个前置问题：网络是否整体上存在可统计识别的中心结构。

Method: 将问题形式化为网络级假设检验，使用邻接谱半径作为检验统计量，并在指定零模型下生成随机网络以估计经验p值；零模型包括G(N,M)、Chung-Lu及两种配置模型实现；在模拟基准和55个真实网络上评估，并控制实验变化中心节点数量与连接权重，同时固定网络规模与密度。

Result: 中心结构强度与经验p值呈明显负相关；拒绝决策显著依赖零模型保留的结构属性，不同模型检出的网络集合并非简单嵌套。

Conclusion: 该框架将中心结构识别从节点排序推进到网络级显著性检验；实际应用中零模型选择会实质性影响结论，需谨慎解释中心性结果。

Abstract: Centrality measures rank nodes even when the observed differences can be explained by ordinary structural variation. We therefore study a preceding question: whether a network contains a statistically identifiable central structure at all. We formulate this question as a network-level hypothesis testing issue using the adjacency spectral radius as the test statistic and estimate an empirical p-value from randomized networks generated under a specified null model. The framework is evaluated using G(N,M), Chung-Lu, and two implementations of the configuration model on simulated benchmarks and 55 real networks. Controlled experiments further vary the number and connection weights of designated central nodes while holding network size and density fixed. The results show a clear negative association between central-structure strength and the empirical p-value. They also demonstrate that rejection decisions depend substantially on the structural properties preserved by the null model: the detected network sets are not simply nested across models.

</details>


### [1317] [Drift, Then Spread: Learning One-Step Generative Policies for Online Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15662)
*Chunyu Luo,Hongyu Zhao,Guangyi Ni,Yue Song,Lingkai Kong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DriftSpread，一种基于Drifting的一步生成式策略，用于在线最大熵强化学习，兼顾表达力与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散和流式策略虽表达力强，但迭代采样代价高；需要一种无需可解策略密度、又能高效采样的生成式策略。

Method: 基于Drifting的能量视角，从负MaxEnt目标推导出critic-guided Drift与entropy-induced Spread，在同一actor中顺序学习：动作回归提升价值，分布匹配捕捉熵效应，无需采Boltzmann目标样本、密度或score估计。

Result: 在固定critic的精确拟合下证明收敛到Boltzmann目标（小步长极限+长时极限）；MuJoCo上取得最高聚合归一化回报，训练与推理效率均优于扩散/流式基线。

Conclusion: DriftSpread实现了高效的一步生成式MaxEnt策略，兼具理论收敛保证与实证SOTA性能与效率。

Abstract: Generative policies offer expressive action distributions for online reinforcement learning (RL), but many diffusion- and flow-based policies require costly iterative sampling. We propose DriftSpread, a one-step generative policy based on Drifting for online maximum-entropy (MaxEnt) RL. To incorporate entropy without a tractable policy density, we build on an energy-based view of Drifting and derive critic-guided Drift and entropy-induced Spread from the negative MaxEnt objective. Our method learns these updates sequentially in the same actor, using action regression for value improvement and distribution matching to capture the effect of entropy. The actor updates require neither direct samples from the critic-defined Boltzmann target nor policy-density or score estimation. Under exact fitting with a fixed critic, we prove convergence to the Boltzmann target in the small-step limit followed by the long-time limit. On MuJoCo, DriftSpread achieves the highest aggregate normalized return among all evaluated methods, while outperforming the diffusion- and flow-based baselines in both training and inference efficiency.

</details>


### [1318] [DRanker: A Transformer-Based Multi-Task Ranking Model for the Disney+ Homepage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15696)
*Priya Nirmal Singh Khokher,Daniel Nemirovsky,Benjamin P. Whitesell,Ethan Sukrae Lee,Eric Wulf,Tom Chee-Duffy,Nicholas Flores*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 DRanker，一个基于 transformer 的多任务排序模型，用于 Disney+ 首页个性化推荐，已全球部署并带来显著业务提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Disney+ 首页个性化推荐需要在大规模场景下实现高效、有效的 transformer 排序，同时解决数据偏差和系统复杂性问题。

Method: 采用 encoder-only transformer 架构，基于丰富的用户互动历史序列，并结合轻量级因果去偏机制；同时设计了支持大规模 transformer 排序的推理系统。

Result: 迭代评估发现更简单的设计在离线指标、定性行为评估和生产环境中均优于更复杂方案；全球部署后，关键互动指标提升超过 1%，日活用户提升 0.5%。

Conclusion: 研究强调了数据工程、去偏和架构选择方面的实践经验，表明简洁设计在大规模排序系统中具有显著优势。

Abstract: We present DRanker (Disney+ Ranker), a transformer-based multitask ranking model serving personalized recommendations on the Disney+ homepage. We describe the encoder-only architecture over enriched engagement-history sequences paired with a lightweight causal debiasing mechanism, and the inference stack that enables transformer-based ranking at scale. Through iterative development, we systematically evaluated more complex alternatives and found that simpler designs consistently outperformed them on offline metrics, qualitative behavioral evaluation, and in production. Deployed globally, DRanker drives over 1% lift in our key engagement metric and 0.5% lift in daily active users across all experiences powered by the ranker. We share practical lessons on data engineering, debiasing, and architectural choices that shaped our ranking system at scale.

</details>


### [1319] [TabMosaic: Unified In-Context Diffusion for Tabular Generative Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15699)
*Jayoung Kim,Sanghyun Hong,Noseong Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TabMosaic，首个统一的上下文扩散模型，可在未见表上生成混合类型目标单元格，覆盖多种表格生成任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格生成方法或需针对特定表训练，或将上下文学习限制在单单元格预测，无法统一处理任意目标集合的联合条件生成。

Method: 将各表格生成任务统一为建模"给定未见表已观测单元格、任意目标单元格集合的联合条件分布"；采用扩散模型，其去噪目标在所有目标单元格上联合定义，预训练分布下由后验预测分布最小化；据此提出TabMosaic。

Result: 在48个真实表格及2I0个基线方法上，TabMosaic在所有评测的生成任务中均排名第一；并证明其预训练目标可界定条件负对数似然及与后验预测分布的散度。

Conclusion: TabMosaic统一了表格生成任务，无需表特定训练即可实现混合类型多单元格联合生成，并将上下文学习的贝叶斯解释从单值预测扩展到联合多单元生成。

Abstract: Generative modeling for tabular data has advanced to the point where models can synthesize realistic records, recover missing values, and generate samples conditioned on class labels or observed attributes. Despite recent advances, existing approaches either require table-specific training or restrict in-context learning to single-cell prediction. In this work, we formulate these tabular generative tasks as a single problem: modeling the joint conditional distribution of an arbitrary set of target cells given the observed cells of an unseen table. To this end, we turn to diffusion, whose denoising objective is defined jointly over all target cells rather than one cell at a time. Under the pretraining distribution, this objective is minimized by the posterior predictive distribution over the target set. Building on this, we propose TabMosaic, a unified in-context diffusion model for generating mixed-type target cells in unseen, potentially incomplete tables without table-specific training. We further show that its pretraining objective bounds the conditional negative log-likelihood and the divergence from the posterior predictive for arbitrary target sets, extending the Bayesian account of in-context learning from a single-value prediction to joint multi-cell generation. Across 48 real-world tables, TabMosaic ranks first on all evaluated generative tasks against 20 baseline approaches

</details>


### [1320] [RespFocus: Learning Temporal Evidence for Weakly Supervised Respiratory Sound Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15702)
*Yi Tian,Xiaohuan Chen,Yufei tang,Xinyu Lin,Hongliang Li,Chengbin Hou,Degen Huang,Rongshan Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RespFocus：基于多示例学习（MIL）的弱监督呼吸音分类框架，从周期级标签学习可检查的时间证据，在ICBHI 2017和新建PedResp2026数据集上分别取得69.55%和72.91%的四分类得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 呼吸听诊是低成本肺功能评估手段，但噪声临床录音中的瞬态爆裂音和持续哮鸣音难以识别；传统深度学习分类器多为黑箱，无法揭示支持预测的时间声学证据。

Method: 提出RespFocus弱监督框架，利用多示例学习从周期级标签中学习可检查的时间证据并融入分类。同时构建PedResp2026——一个在常规临床环境中采集、具备周期级标注的多中心儿科呼吸音队列。

Result: 分类实验四分类得分：ICBHI 2017公开数据集69.55%，PedResp2026数据集72.91%。证据诊断与匹配的时间干预实验证实所学证据对模型预测具有功能性贡献。

Conclusion: RespFocus展示了作为自动化呼吸音诊断工具的潜力，其可检查的时间证据提升了模型可解释性。

Abstract: Respiratory auscultation provides a low-cost means of assessing pulmonary function, yet transient crackles and sustained wheezes can be difficult to recognize in noisy clinical recordings. Conventional deep learning classifiers often operate as black boxes, offering limited insight into the temporal acoustic evidence supporting their predictions. We present RespFocus, a weakly supervised framework that uses multiple instance learning (MIL) to learn inspectable temporal evidence from cycle-level labels and integrate it into classification. We also introduce PedResp2026, a multicenter pediatric respiratory sound cohort collected in routine clinical environments with adjudicated cycle-level annotations. In classification experiments, RespFocus achieves four-class Scores of 69.55\% on public ICBHI 2017 and 72.91\% on PedResp2026. Evidence diagnostics and matched temporal interventions support the functional contribution of the learned evidence to model predictions. Together, these findings highlight RespFocus's potential as a tool for automated respiratory sound diagnosis.

</details>


### [1321] [Generalizable Model Editing Could Be More Than Direct Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15707)
*Xiaotian Ye,Chunyao Yang,Xiaohan Wang,Junkai Chen,Yongqi Duan,Mengqi Zhang,Shu Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 模型编辑的直接泛化范式存在根本性缺陷，作者提出以"组合式泛化"作为更可行的替代方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往工作将模型编辑的泛化形式化为"直接泛化"（把LLM视为输入-输出映射，期望事实更新改变推理输出），但该目标长期被认为难以实现。作者在真实聊天机器人场景中却观察到经典编辑方法也能流畅泛化，因此重新审视这一障碍与范式的局限。

Method: 作者对直接泛化进行理论与实证分析：理论上指出其存在可识别性问题；实践上指出规避该问题的方法受构造偏差的模糊性以及优化动态等因素覆盖的脆弱性所困。随后提出"组合式泛化"作为替代范式，并在多个模型与编辑方法上进行验证。

Result: 发现即使在经典编辑方法下，真实聊天场景中也表现出显著流畅的泛化行为；这种组合式泛化现象在多个模型和编辑方法中广泛存在，得到理论与实证双重支持。

Conclusion: 可泛化的模型编辑不应局限于直接泛化，作者呼吁向更可泛化、更可部署的知识更新技术进行范式转变。

Abstract: A central desideratum in model editing is generalization to complex tasks, which prior work formalizes under a direct generalization paradigm: treating and evaluating LLM behavior as an input-output mapping and expecting a factual update to alter outputs on reasoning tasks. Yet despite substantial empirical effort, the field consensus remains that such generalization is highly challenging and elusive. However, when we deploy the latest models in an in-the-wild chatbot-user setting, we surprisingly find that even classical editing methods exhibit remarkably fluent generalization behavior. This motivates us to revisit the obstacles to generalization and the limitations of the prevailing paradigm. We find that direct generalization is fundamentally constrained both theoretically and practically: theoretically, it suffers from an identifiability issue; and practically, existing approaches attempting to circumvent this are further hindered by the ambiguity of their constructed biases and by vulnerability to being overridden by other factors such as optimization dynamics. We instead identify compositional generalization, empowered by the increasingly strong reasoning and composition abilities of modern LLMs, as a theoretically grounded and empirically validated alternative. We validate this phenomenon across multiple models and editing methods, showing that such generalization behavior is widespread. Overall, we argue that generalizable model editing could be more than direct generalization, and call for a paradigm shift toward more generalizable and practically deployable knowledge update techniques.

</details>


### [1322] [Preserving Updates in Low-Bit Recurrent State Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15709)
*Haotian Li,Liran Dong,Kaicheng Xiao,Guoliang Xing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对线性注意力与循环模型中循环状态的低比特量化问题，提出训练无关的方法：通过低秩旁路（LRB）累积被舍入丢失的小更新，并通过有界方向性舍入（BDR）处理反向漂移，从而在多种模型上显著优于INT4，最高减少5.3倍状态内存并加速解码1.9倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力与循环模型将历史token压缩到固定大小的循环状态中，每步更新。用高精度存储状态在大batch下带来显著的内存与带宽开销，因此需要低比特量化。但与权重和KV cache不同，循环状态每步更新后会被重新量化，量化误差会跨步累积。

Method: 分析发现量化误差跨步高度相干，仅降低单步误差不够，其源自被舍入丢失的小更新。为此在舍入前后干预：舍入前提出Low-Rank Bypass（LRB），将小更新累积在紧凑低秩缓冲区并周期性合并足够大的元素到状态；舍入时提出Bounded Directional Rounding（BDR），将发生反向的元素朝其更新方向舍入且不增加存储。

Result: 在Gated DeltaNet、GLA、Mamba2和RetNet上，该训练无关方法显著优于INT4，相比FP32状态最多减少5.3倍状态内存，解码速度提升最多1.9倍。

Conclusion: BDR虽增大了舍入误差却提升模型表现，说明单步中更新方向比单步舍入误差更重要；结合LRB可有效缓解跨步误差累积，实现高效低比特循环状态量化。

Abstract: Linear attention and recurrent models compress past tokens into a fixed-size state that is updated at every step. However, storing these states in high precision incurs substantial memory and bandwidth costs at large batch sizes, motivating low-bit state quantization. Unlike weights and key--value caches, a recurrent state is requantized after every update, so its quantization errors accumulate across steps. Our analysis shows that these errors are highly coherent across steps, so reducing per-step errors alone is insufficient. This coherence arises mainly from small updates that are lost in rounding. To preserve these updates, we intervene both before and at rounding. Before rounding, we propose Low-Rank Bypass (LRB), which accumulates small updates in a compact low-rank buffer and periodically merges its sufficiently large elements into the state. At rounding, we observe that a state element can even move opposite to its update, and such reversals prove particularly harmful. Therefore, we propose Bounded Directional Rounding (BDR), which rounds reversed elements toward their updates without additional storage. Although BDR enlarges the rounding error, it improves the model, suggesting that the direction of an update matters more than its rounding error at a single step. Across Gated DeltaNet, GLA, Mamba2, and RetNet, our training-free method substantially outperforms INT4, while reducing state memory by up to 5.3$\times$ and speeding up decoding by up to 1.9$\times$ relative to FP32 states.

</details>


### [1323] [What DNA Foundation Models Learn Beyond Sequence Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15711)
*Vincenzo Yuto Civale,Andrew David Bagdanov,Alberto Magi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估五个DNA基础模型的冻结表征是否超越简单k-mer组成特征，发现简单k-mer仍具竞争力，仅NTv3有稳定增益，并提出互补诊断方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验基因组基础模型的冻结表征是否提供超出简单序列组成（k-mer频率）的预测信息，明确其真实增益。

Method: 在57个基因组分类数据集及两个基因表达回归任务上，对比五个DNA模型的冻结表征与归一化k-mer频率；使用全局6-mer特征及其与各模型嵌入拼接，在匹配的随机森林协议下测试增量效用；将嵌入分解为6-mer线性可预测部分与岭回归残差；并用保6-mer精确洗牌测试序列顺序敏感性。

Result: 简单k-mer特征与多数模型相当；NTv3在57个数据集中46个提升（平均ΔMCC=+0.072），Caduceus增益较小，其余模型平均MCC无提升；线性可恢复性不能可靠指示下游效用；NTv3对序列顺序最敏感，但顺序敏感性不保证预测增益。

Conclusion: 组成特征应作为必要对照，线性可恢复性与顺序敏感性可作为评估冻结基因组表征附加价值的互补诊断，结论不涉及微调能力。

Abstract: Do genomic foundation models (FMs) provide predictive information beyond simple sequence composition? We evaluate frozen representations from five DNA FMs against normalized k-mer frequencies across 57 genomic classification datasets and two exploratory gene-expression regression tasks. Simple k-mer features remain competitive with most models, whereas NTv3 shows a consistent advantage; the ranking is robust to globally fixed and multi-scale k-mer baselines and alternative downstream probes. To test incremental predictive utility directly, we compare global 6-mer features with their concatenation with each FM embedding under a matched Random Forest protocol. NTv3 improves 46 of 57 datasets (mean $Δ$MCC = +0.072), while Caduceus provides smaller gains and the other models do not improve mean MCC. We separately decompose embeddings into a component linearly predictable from 6-mer frequencies and a ridge residual, finding that linear recoverability does not reliably indicate downstream utility. Exact 6-mer-preserving shuffles further reveal task-relevant sequence-order sensitivity, most pronounced for NTv3, although order sensitivity alone does not guarantee predictive improvements. Our results establish compositional features as essential controls and offer complementary diagnostics for evaluating the added value of frozen genomic representations, without making claims about fine-tuning capacity.

</details>


### [1324] [Uncovering the Generative Landscape of Diffusion Models: A Spectral-Guided Quality-Diversity Diffusion Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15724)
*Hannah Janmohamed,Joao Correia,Penousal Machado,Antoine Cully*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将质量-多样性(QD)优化与扩散模型结合，通过优化潜在噪声与条件嵌入，并利用嵌入模型量化多样性，提出QD-Diffusion框架及h-space谱变异算子，实现多样且高质量的生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准扩散采样偏向高似然区域，导致输出多样性受限；在许多领域，单一高似然样本不足，需要多样化且高性能的解决方案组合，因此需要挖掘模型完整的表达范围。

Method: 提出Quality-Diversity Diffusion，将QD适配到扩散模型，直接优化模型的潜在噪声和条件嵌入，并用嵌入模型量化多样性；进一步引入h-space Spectral Mutation算子，通过分析模型输入到激活的雅可比矩阵的主奇异向量，沿最大语义敏感方向引导搜索。组合方法称为Spectral-Guided Quality-Diversity Diffusion。

Result: 在文本到图像生成任务上，与12个基线方法对比，该方法持续取得最低FID分数，展现出图像质量与多样性的出色平衡。

Conclusion: QD优化与扩散模型的结合可有效发现多样且高质量的生成输出，谱引导变异进一步提升了搜索效率，验证了在文本到图像生成中的优越性能。

Abstract: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have emerged as powerful generative priors across domains ranging from molecular design to high-resolution image synthesis. However, standard diffusion sampling is inherently biased toward high-likelihood regions, often limiting the diversity of outputs. In many domains, a single, high-likelihood sample is insufficient. Instead, diverse portfolios of high-performing solutions are required, motivating methods that uncover a model's full expressive range. Here we show that integrating Quality-Diversity (QD) optimisation with diffusion models enables the discovery of diverse, high-performing outputs. We first propose Quality-Diversity Diffusion, a framework that adapts QD to diffusion models by directly optimising the model's latent noise and conditioning embeddings and leveraging embedding models to quantify diversity. Second, we introduce a novel h-space Spectral Mutation operator, which guides search along directions of maximal semantic sensitivity by analysing principal singular vectors of the model's input-to-activation Jacobian. We evaluate our combined approach, Spectral-Guided Quality-Diversity Diffusion, on text-to-image generation. Against 12 baselines, our method consistently achieves the lowest FID score, demonstrating an excellent balance of image quality and diversity.

</details>


### [1325] [A Dependency-Aware Multi-GPU Training Framework for Temporal Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15730)
*Yang Zhao,Yue Dai,Liang Qiao,Buxin Tu,Bo Liu,Sen Zhang,Yi Zhang,Xiaoyu Hao,Jun Shi,Junshi Chen,Hong An*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DepBloom 通过三项技术加速多 GPU 时序图神经网络训练，平均提速 2.84×，最高 5.16×，精度保持相当或更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TGNN 依赖节点状态向量（内存）记录事件，导致后续事件预测依赖早期内存更新。多 GPU 训练时，现有方案严格保留所有事件依赖，限制并行性并带来昂贵的跨 GPU 内存同步。

Method: 基于三个观察（依赖在时间和拓扑上具有高局部性、大 batch 内缺失的短程依赖可低成本恢复、许多内存更新并非立即需要），提出 DepBloom，包含三项技术：(1) 时间有界空间分区，减少不必要的跨 GPU 同步；(2) batch 内内存精化，恢复扩大 batch 中缺失的短程时序依赖；(3) 关键路径优化，优先处理紧急内存更新并推迟非关键工作。

Result: 在代表性模型和多样数据集上，相比 SOTA 方法平均提速 2.84×，最高 5.16×，同时保持相当或更好的模型精度。

Conclusion: 通过灵活处理事件依赖而非严格保留全部依赖，可在不损害训练质量的前提下显著提升多 GPU TGNN 训练效率。

Abstract: Temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) achieve superior performance in many dynamic graph learning tasks. These models use node state vectors (i.e., memories) to capture and record graph changes (i.e., events), and then exploit these memories to assist prediction. However, this memory-centric design makes multi-GPU training challenging because predictions for later events often depend on memory updates from earlier events. To maintain model quality, existing multi-GPU TGNN training schemes strictly preserve all event dependencies, which limits parallelism and causes expensive cross-GPU memory synchronization. In this work, we observe that many of these dependencies can be handled more flexibly without harming training quality. Specifically, (a) dependencies in TGNN training have high locality in both time and graph topology, (b) the short-range dependencies missed within a large batch can often be recovered cheaply, and (c) many memory updates are not immediately needed. Based on these observations, we propose DepBloom to accelerate multi-GPU TGNN training with three techniques: (1) temporally bounded spatial partitioning to reduce unnecessary cross-GPU synchronization and improve parallelism; (2) intra-batch memory refinement to recover missing short-range temporal dependencies inside enlarged batches; and (3) critical-path optimization to prioritize urgent memory updates while deferring non-critical work during multi-GPU pipeline execution. Experimental results across representative models and diverse datasets show that DepBloom achieves an average speedup of 2.84$\times$ and up to 5.16$\times$ over state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining comparable or better model accuracy.

</details>


### [1326] [Hyperbolic Time Series Forecasting with Learnable Decomposition and Manifold Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15760)
*Sarang Rajendra Patil,Vishal Fenn,Mengjia Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HyperForecast，首个在双曲空间进行长期时间序列预测的框架，通过将级联分解得到的分量嵌入Poincaré球，利用双曲几何的指数体积增长自然表达频率层次结构，在11个基准中9个取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列具有多尺度结构（慢变趋势、中期季节模式、高频残差）。传统预测器在欧氏空间建模这种结构，但未表达级联分解所诱导的分量之间的层次顺序关系。

Method: 发现级联分解按特征频率对分量排序形成频率层次，该层次与双曲空间的指数体积增长特性契合。提出HyperForecast，将分解后的时间片段嵌入Poincaré球，径向距离反映嵌套结构（低频近原点，高频近边界），并通过两种流形动力学变体建模测地速度：(a) 基于Poincaré残差动力学的自回归预测；(b) 并行预测所有未来片段的非自回归预测。

Result: 在11个长期预测基准中的9个上持续优于现有及SOTA基线，长预测时域下MSE最多降低58%。分析表明学到的径向嵌入可恢复频率层次，且双曲几何对预测性能贡献显著。

Conclusion: HyperForecast验证了将时间序列多尺度频率层次映射到双曲空间的有效性，双曲几何为长期时间序列预测提供了显著的性能增益。

Abstract: Multiscale structure is central to time series forecasting: temporal signals contain slowly varying trends, intermediate seasonal patterns, and high-frequency residuals. Traditional forecasters model this multiscale structure in Euclidean space, without representing the ordering it induces among components. We identify that cascaded decomposition orders components by their characteristic frequencies, forming a natural frequency hierarchy. This hierarchy aligns with the exponential volume growth of hyperbolic space, which provides increasing representational capacity with radius and naturally accommodates nested hierarchies. We propose HyperForecast, the first long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) framework operating in hyperbolic space. HyperForecast embeds decomposed temporal segments on the Poincaré ball where radial distance captures this nested structure, from low-frequency components near the origin to high-frequency components near the boundary. We model geodesic velocity through two manifold-dynamics variants: (a) autoregressive forecasting via Poincaré residual dynamics, and (b) non-autoregressive forecasting that predicts all future segments in parallel. HyperForecast consistently outperforms existing and state-of-the-art baselines on 9 of 11 long-term forecasting benchmarks, achieving up to 58% lower mean squared error at long horizons. Further analysis reveals that the learned radial embeddings recover the frequency hierarchy and that hyperbolic geometry contributes substantially to forecasting performance.

</details>


### [1327] [Who Sets the Pace of Judge Hacking? Judge Capability versus the Policy-Judge Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15778)
*Haosen Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究用GRPO针对冻结的无参考LLM评判器训练策略时,评判器接受的答案增多,但held-out贪婪准确率无明显提升;评判器作弊的深度主要由评判器本身(如AUC)而非策略-评判器差距决定,速度的证据模糊。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究当策略被训练去"讨好"一个冻结的、无参考的LLM评判器时,是否带来真实能力提升,以及是策略-评判器差距还是评判器自身属性决定了RL利用评判器假阳性的程度和速度。

Method: 用GRPO训练0.5B/1.5B Qwen2.5策略,对抗四个至少同等规模的评判器(Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B、Llama-3.2-3B)及一个更小评判器(Qwen3-0.6B);设置gold-reward对照组;用AUC、Spearman相关、预注册配对与盲测进行分析。

Result: 12个(policy, judge)单元中seed-mean增益均未超过0.04;gold-reward对照使1.5B策略贪婪准确率提升+0.054[0.013,0.096]。判断作弊深度(平台)与judge AUC相关(Spearman -0.69 [-0.94, -0.14]),同族更大评判器被欺骗更浅。速度上两对预注册配对反驳"差距"假说(更大差距单元在阈值上被欺骗快3.5倍)。12个单元无法正式区分AUC与差距。盲测中hash-locked step-0预测器未超过step-0 AUC。7-8B的三种族评判器平台分别为0.37、0.67、0.85。

Conclusion: 针对LLM评判器优化主要导致评判器接受度上升而真实准确率无增益;评判器被利用的深度更多取决于评判器本身质量(如AUC)而非策略-评判器差距,速度证据不明确;当前样本量不足以完全分离各因素。

Abstract: When a policy is trained with GRPO against a frozen, reference-free LLM judge, the judge accepts more of its answers, but in a post-hoc analysis we detect no gain in held-out greedy accuracy: in all 12 (policy, judge) cells, the seed-mean gain never exceeded 0.04. A gold-reward control with the same recipe raised the 1.5B policy's greedy accuracy by +0.054 [0.013, 0.096], so for this policy the flat accuracy is specific to the judge reward; for the 0.5B policy, gold reward also gave no detectable gain. In the four rising cells we checked, the early rise in training-rollout accuracy is mostly sampling sharpening, as it is under gold reward. We then ask whether the policy-judge gap or the judge sets how far and how fast RL exploits the judge's false positives. We train 0.5B and 1.5B Qwen2.5 policies against four judges at least as large (Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B, Llama-3.2-3B) and the 1.5B policy against one smaller judge (Qwen3-0.6B). The depth of judge hacking (the plateau) tracks the judge: it correlates with judge AUC (Spearman -0.69 [-0.94, -0.14] over 12 cells), and within a family the larger judge is fooled less deeply. For the pace (onset), two pre-specified pairs contradict the gap account (the larger-gap cell was fooled 3.5x sooner at the pre-specified threshold). With 12 cells we cannot formally separate judge AUC from the gap for either endpoint. The smaller judge was not fooled sooner than a judge as large as the policy, though it also differs in family and template. In a blind test on three held-out judges, a hash-locked step-0 predictor did not beat step-0 AUC, but three cells cannot separate them. At 7-8B, judges from three families plateaued at 0.37, 0.67 and 0.85.

</details>


### [1328] [Heterogeneous Structured Pruning Under Resource Constraints for Hardware-Efficient Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15781)
*Cameron Barker,Andreas Paraskeva,Jan N. van Rijn,Elliot J. Crowley,Henry Gouk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HSP是一个硬件感知的无训练剪枝框架，通过异构搜索空间和资源约束，为每个子层分配最优结构和稀疏度，在边缘设备上改善质量-资源前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无训练剪枝方法仅关注保留权重总数，忽略了目标硬件如何存储和处理权重，且对所有投影统一采用预设稀疏结构，未考虑各结构在子层间对剪枝误差、延迟和内存的权衡。

Method: 提出HSP框架，包含两部分：(i) 由dense、unstructured、2:4、block-sparse和head/channel组成的异构搜索空间；(ii) 基于延迟和内存模型的结构正则化约束。用全局求解器在资源预算下为每个子层选择一个选项，最小化代理剪枝损失，从而为每个投影分配结构和密度。该方法推广了现有基于重要性的方法。

Result: 在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super边缘设备上对OPT和LLaMA模型进行评估，HSP相比无训练基线改善了质量-资源前沿。

Conclusion: 硬件感知的异构结构化剪枝能更有效地在资源约束下平衡模型质量与部署成本，优于统一稀疏结构的现有无训练方法。

Abstract: Training-free pruning removes weights from pretrained large language models to reduce their deployment cost. However, existing approaches typically consider only the total number of retained weights. Consequently, their pruning decisions do not account for how target hardware stores and processes those weights. These methods select a sparsity structure in advance and apply it uniformly to all projections, rather than accounting for how each structure trades pruning error against latency and memory across sublayers. We propose Heterogeneous Structured Pruning (HSP), a hardware-aware pruning framework that combines two components: (i) a heterogeneous search space of dense, unstructured, 2:4, block-sparse, and head / channel (H/C) pruning options and (ii) structure-regularising constraints based on latency and memory models. Our contribution generalises existing importance-based methods: a global solver selects one option per sublayer to minimise proxy pruning loss under a resource budget, thereby assigning each projection a structure and density. We evaluate HSP on OPT and LLaMA models for an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super edge device, where it improves the quality-resource frontiers over training-free baselines.
  A project page and updated links for the related code is maintained at: cameronbarker.me/publications/hsp.

</details>


### [1329] [ML-CLAPPS: A Probabilistic Framework for Imbalanced Multilabel Learning under Class Prioritization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15816)
*Priel Hazan,Nir Almog,Noam Keidar,Yael Yaniv,Assaf Schuster*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ML-CLAPPS，一种可学习采样器，通过优化训练实例分布来解决多标签类别不平衡问题，并支持通过用户定义的 importance vector 优先关注高风险类别，在真实多标签 ECG 图像数据集上达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实数据常存在严重类别不平衡，多标签场景因复杂的标签共现而更具挑战；在 ECG 等临床应用中还需优先关注高风险疾病以降低假阴性代价。

Method: 提出 Multilabel Class-Prioritized Probabilistic Sampler (ML-CLAPPS)，一个可学习采样器，优化训练实例上的分布以控制模型对不同类别的曝光，并通过用户定义的 importance vector (IV) 实现类别优先级。

Result: 在真实多标签 ECG 图像数据集上，ML-CLAPPS 达到 state-of-the-art 性能；实验表明其类别曝光与指定 IV 对齐，提升某类重要性可相应改善该类分类性能。

Conclusion: ML-CLAPPS 能同时应对多标签不平衡与临床高风险类别优先需求，实现显式的关键疾病优先分类。

Abstract: Real-world datasets often exhibit severe class imbalance, degrading the performance of deep learning models, particularly on rare classes. While imbalance is well studied in binary and multiclass settings, it is substantially more challenging in multilabel problems due to complex label co-occurrence. In clinical applications such as ECG classification, this challenge is coupled with a second critical challenge: the need to prioritize high-risk conditions, regardless of their prevalence, to mitigate the high cost of false negatives. We introduce the Multilabel Class-Prioritized Probabilistic Sampler (ML-CLAPPS), a learnable sampler that optimizes a distribution over training instances to control the model's exposure to different classes. This approach addresses multilabel imbalance while enabling prioritization of significant conditions via a user-defined importance vector (IV). Empirical evaluation on a real-world multilabel ECG image dataset demonstrates that ML-CLAPPS achieves state-of-the-art performance. We show that it aligns class exposure with the specified IV, and that increasing a class's importance leads to corresponding improvements in its classification performance, enabling explicit prioritization of clinically critical conditions.

</details>


### [1330] [Benchmarking Deep Learning Models for Anomaly Detection in Real-World Cloud Telemetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15818)
*Sumit Dhyani,Sougata Mukherjea*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文对IBM Cloud真实遥测数据进行了深度学习异常检测的经验性基准测试，比较GRU、Transformer、TimesNet和Autoformer，发现时序感知评估与鲁棒后处理比模型选择更关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云平台产生高维、噪声大且短时非周期性的异常，传统异常检测基准不适用，亟需在真实云数据上评估深度学习模型并采用时序感知的评测方式。

Method: 使用IBM Cloud Console真实数据集，在NAB（Numenta Anomaly Benchmark）时序感知指标下评估GRU、Transformer、TimesNet、Autoformer，并提出融入鲁棒评分与持续性规则的改进GRU自编码器。

Result: TimesNet因早期检测灵敏度最高而取得最佳NAB分数；Transformer能较早检测出异常但假阳性率较高；改进的GRU自编码器性能有竞争力且误报更稳定。

Conclusion: 模型间性能差异有限，说明真实云异常主要由短期偏差而非持续周期结构主导，因此时序感知评估与鲁棒后处理比模型选择更为重要。

Abstract: Modern cloud platforms generate high-dimensional, noisy telemetry from thousands of microservices. Unlike classical anomaly detection benchmarks, cloud anomalies are short-lived, irregular, and largely non-periodic, making timely detection challenging. We present an empirical benchmark of deep learning models for anomaly detection using a real-world IBM Cloud Console dataset. We evaluate GRU, Transformer, TimesNet, and Autoformer architectures using the Numenta Anomaly Benchmark (NAB), a timing-aware metric that accounts for early detection and false alarms. TimesNet achieves the highest NAB scores due to strong early-detection sensitivity. Transformer models also detect anomalies early but incur higher false-positive rates. An improved GRU autoencoder, incorporating robust scoring and persistence rules, achieves competitive performance with a more stable false-alarm profile. Overall, the modest performance differences suggest that real cloud anomalies are dominated by short-term deviations rather than persistent periodic structure, emphasizing the importance of timing-aware evaluation and robust post-processing.

</details>


### [1331] [Guarded Block Transfers for Polytope Distance: Linear Convergence with Explicit Constants and Gap-Certified Screening for SVM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15829)
*Mayank Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"受保护块转移"方法加速硬间隔SVM的三角形算法（TA），证明全局线性收敛并给出筛选界；实验显示其优势在于可验证的对偶间隙证书而非速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬间隔SVM训练等价于两凸包间距离问题，三角形算法可带证书地求解，但每次扫描仅做单个MDM转移效率有限，需要在不破坏收敛保证的前提下进行块级聚合加速。

Method: 将每扫描的k次MDM转移聚合成一次精确线搜索；用代价与n无关的"单次最佳转移比较"进行守护；当主导转移被容量裁剪时替换为away step。在Minkowski差多面体上（目标1-强凸）分析，并利用TA证书（Frank-Wolfe间隙除以当前距离）实现gap-safe screening。

Result: 证明全局线性收敛且常数显式、无组合swap-step界；每步收缩与k无关，仅drop-count界随k增长。筛选在O((k/ρ)log(1/τ))次迭代后移除最优面外所有零权点（忽略几何对数因子）。五个LIBSVM基准上与基线四位/五位一致，稀疏支持硬间隔追平LIBSVM、优于BPCG；但全缓存SMO在核L2边缘持平或更优，LIBLINEAR对偶求解器在可分L2上快至4.5倍，Newton求解器与LIBSVM在稠密支持及近切核包上快1–3个数量级。

Conclusion: 该方法的价值在于提供可证明的对偶间隙证书与安全性，而非计算速度；聚合在理论上安全（收缩率与k无关），但扫描节省仅为实测而未被证明。

Abstract: Hard-margin SVM training is the distance problem between two convex hulls, which the Triangle Algorithm (TA) solves with a certified duality gap. We propose \emph{guarded block transfers}: $k$ Mitchell--Demyanov--Malozemov (MDM) transfers per scan are aggregated into one exact line search, guarded by a comparison with the single best transfer at a cost independent of the number of points $n$, and replaced by an away step when the leading transfer is capacity-clipped. On the Minkowski-difference polytope, where the objective is $1$-strongly convex, we prove global linear convergence with explicit constants and no combinatorial swap-step bounds; the per-step contraction is $k$-independent and only the drop-count bound grows with $k$, so aggregation is provably safe while the saving in scans is measured, not proved. Since the TA certificate is the Frank--Wolfe gap divided by the current distance, gap-safe screening applies, and we bound the iteration after which it has removed every zero-weight point off the optimal faces by $O\!\left(\tfrac{k}ρ\log\tfrac{1}τ\right)$ up to logarithmic factors in the geometry, $ρ$ the rate constant and $τ$ the optimal-face margin. On five LIBSVM benchmarks, with fairer baselines than our submission, the solver matches the baselines to four or five digits wherever both converge, ties LIBSVM on sparse-support hard margins and beats our blended pairwise conditional gradients (BPCG). But our full-cache sequential minimal optimisation (SMO) code ties or beats it on kernel $L_2$ margins, LIBLINEAR's dual solver is up to $4.5\times$ faster on the separable $L_2$ margin, and our solver is one to three orders of magnitude slower than LIBLINEAR's Newton solver on dense-support $L_2$ margins and than LIBSVM on a nearly touching kernel hull. Its edge is the certificate, not speed.

</details>


### [1332] [LLM Value Functions for Credit Assignment in Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15840)
*Kaijie Zhu,Weixiang Yan,Omar Attia,Abbas Kazerouni,Alexander Toshev,Andrew Szot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LVRL利用LLM预训练知识和上下文学习能力估计策略感知的状态价值，无需微调独立critic，实现稀疏奖励长程任务中的步级信用分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体强化学习在长程稀疏奖励任务中难以进行信用分配：GRPO将轨迹级优势分配给所有动作，而基于critic的方法需额外学习价值函数，成本高且不稳定。

Method: 提出LVRL，用LLM估计策略感知状态价值而非训练独立critic，通过对组上下文条件化并用初始和终止状态的已知价值校准预测，从而由估计价值差实现步级信用分配；扩展为LVOPD，在on-policy蒸馏中将教师监督聚焦于估计价值下降的动作。

Result: 在AppWorld、BabyAI、SWE-bench Verified上，4B至32B规模均显著优于GRPO和PPO；AppWorld和SWE-bench Verified上相对GRPO最高提升13.6和8.6个百分点；BabyAI从完全失败提升至75.0%成功率；LVOPD在AppWorld上优于标准蒸馏基线；蒙特卡洛分析验证冻结critic能准确识别语义陷阱与恢复。

Conclusion: LVRL证明可从稀疏终端结果中提取鲁棒、策略感知的步级信用，为LLM智能体强化学习提供有效且无需额外critic训练的方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language model (LLM) agents remains challenging in long-horizon tasks with sparse outcome rewards, where assigning credit to individual actions is difficult. Methods such as GRPO assign the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, while critic-based methods require learning an additional value function that can be costly and unstable. We introduce LLM Value Function RL (LVRL), which uses the pretrained knowledge and in-context learning ability of an LLM to estimate policy-aware state values without finetuning a separate critic. LVRL conditions the value model on group context and calibrates its predictions using known values at the initial and terminal states, enabling step-level credit assignment from estimated value differences. We further extend this idea to learning from an expert policy through on-policy distillation (OPD), introducing LLM Value Function OPD (LVOPD), which focuses teacher supervision on actions associated with decreases in estimated value. We evaluate our approach across diverse agentic benchmarks: AppWorld, BabyAI, and SWE-bench Verified. Across policy scales (4B to 32B), LVRL consistently and substantially outperforms both GRPO and PPO. On AppWorld and SWE-bench Verified, LVRL yields absolute improvements of up to 13.6 and 8.6 percentage points over GRPO. Notably, on tasks requiring extended exploration like BabyAI, LVRL bridges the gap from total failure to 75.0% success. Furthermore, LVOPD yields consistent improvements over standard distillation baselines on AppWorld. Finally, Monte-Carlo analysis confirms that our frozen critic accurately identifies semantic pitfalls and recoveries, proving that LVRL extracts robust, policy-aware step-level credit from sparse terminal outcomes.

</details>


### [1333] [What Do Sparse Autoencoder Feature Discovery Scores Identify? From Activations to Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15850)
*Yifeng Guo,Yanran Li,Xiang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文主张用"干预归因"而非观测相关性来选择SAE特征，并给出基于梯度的可估计分解，证明其能更准确预测干预效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAE特征通常通过激活与行为的协变（如线性探针）被发现，但实际使用方式是steering或ablation等干预。观测证据能否识别干预效果存在疑问，需要澄清特征发现与干预使用之间的错配。

Method: 以"干预归因"（指定干预对模型输出的一阶效应）为估计目标；对一类广泛的响应函数，证明观测性特征发现证据一般不识别该归因，并推导出线性探针预测与干预归因差距的精确梯度分解。在四组模型-SAE对上验证，比较probe、相关性、秩检验与梯度归因选择特征的效果。

Result: 探针与归因的中位幅度比达数十到数百倍；归因与小步steering高度一致。单latent消融中，梯度预测符号吻合率达91-97%，而探针隐含变化仅17-35%。归因选择的特征集在留出提示上产生更大的平均消融效应。

Conclusion: 干预归因是一种有原则、可用梯度估计的SAE特征选择目标，优于基于观测相关性的选择方法。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features are typically discovered from how their activations co-vary with behaviour, yet they are often used through interventions such as steering or ablation. We take intervention attribution, the first-order effect of a specified intervention on the model output, as our estimand. For a broad class of response functions, we show that observational feature-discovery evidence generally does not identify this attribution, and derive an exact gradient-based decomposition of the gap between linear-probe predictions and intervention attribution. Across four model-SAE pairs, median probe-to-attribution magnitude ratios range from tens to hundreds, while attributions closely track small-step steering. For single-latent ablations with nonzero effects, gradient predictions match the realized sign in 91-97% of cases, compared with 17-35% for probe-implied changes. Attribution-selected sets also produce larger absolute mean ablation effects on held-out prompts than sets selected by correlation, rank tests or probe coefficients. Together, these results establish intervention attribution as a principled, gradient-estimable target for selecting SAE features for intervention.

</details>


### [1334] [GuidanceNFT: NFT-Based Reward Fine-Tuning of Guided Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15856)
*Jiayin Liu,Zeyu Michael Li,Bingshuo Qian,Xiang Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GuidanceNFT，通过在线流匹配估计引导样本分布对应的参考速度，修正NFT损失中的回归项，从而在CFG等引导下同时提升奖励与提示对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiffusionNFT优化任务奖励但不保证对完整提示的忠实度；CFG可增强对齐，但NFT是CFG-free的，直接对微调速度场施加CFG会降低已优化奖励。对引导输出分布优化奖励时，标准NFT会因参考速度与引导分布分数不匹配而导致奖励退化或训练崩溃。

Method: GuidanceNFT通过在线流匹配（online flow matching）在引导样本上估计匹配的参考速度，并用其校正NFT损失中的两个回归项。若参考速度精确，校正后的目标可恢复NFT原本意图的更新。

Result: 在SD3.5-M上，GuidanceNFT在GenEval、文本渲染和多奖励目标上取得比NFT（有无CFG）更高的优化奖励，并具有更好的整体提示对齐（off-domain指标）。在Model Guidance、ELF等内置引导模型上，ImageNet生成提升、OpenWebText上困惑度-熵权衡更好、GSM8K准确率更高。

Conclusion: 学习到的校正能在显式与内置引导下持续提升奖励，并保持或改善提示对齐，验证了在引导输出分布上优化奖励的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: DiffusionNFT (NFT) fine-tunes diffusion models toward task-specific rewards, but optimizing these rewards does not guarantee fidelity to the full prompt. Although classifier-free guidance (CFG) strengthens prompt alignment, NFT is formulated as a CFG-free method, and applying CFG to the fine-tuned velocity field can reduce the optimized reward. This motivates optimizing rewards over the guided output distribution while seeking to retain its prompt alignment. However, applying standard NFT directly to guided samples can cause reward degradation or training collapse. We trace this failure to a mismatch between the reference velocity used in the NFT loss and the score of the guided sample distribution, which biases the improvement direction. We propose GuidanceNFT, which estimates the matching reference velocity through online flow matching on guided samples and uses it to correct both regression terms. With an exact reference, the corrected objective recovers NFT's intended update. In our experiments, the learned correction sustains reward improvement under both explicit and built-in guidance. On SD3.5-M, GuidanceNFT achieves higher optimized rewards than NFT with and without CFG across GenEval, text-rendering, and multi-reward objectives, together with better overall prompt alignment as measured by off-domain evaluation metrics. Experiments on models with built-in guidance, including Model Guidance and ELF, further demonstrate improved ImageNet generation, a better perplexity-entropy tradeoff on OpenWebText, and higher accuracy on GSM8K.

</details>


### [1335] [A Hybrid Gaussian Process-Extreme Gradient Boosting Machine Learning Framework for Robust Knockdown Factor Prediction and Reliability-Based Design of Thin Spherical Shell Caps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15862)
*Budhaditya De,Rohan Majumder,Devasmit Dutta,Aman Deep Gupta,Sudib Kumar Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究用GPR与XGBoost混合的机器学习模型预测球壳失稳折减因子(KDF)，降低传统KDF的保守性，并构建基于可靠度的设计框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深球壳帽的弹性失稳实验临界载荷远低于线性特征值预测，需用折减因子(KDF)修正，但NASA SP-8007、Eurocode 3等传统KDF取实验下界，过于保守。

Method: 基于球壳失稳实验数据训练机器学习回归模型，提出高斯过程回归(GPR)与极端梯度提升(XGBoost)的混合模型，与ANN、SVR、RFR、HGBoost对比；模型用6个输入特征预测单一输出KDF，并通过敏感性分析确定最关键特征。

Result: 混合GPR-XGBoost模型性能优于ANN、SVR、RFR和HGBoost等传统机器学习算法，并识别出影响KDF的最关键特征。

Conclusion: 提出基于可靠度的设计框架，利用预测模型获得安全一致且保守性更低的KDF，从而缩小球壳帽设计的过度保守问题。

Abstract: Elastic buckling remains a critical concern in the design of deep spherical shell caps, given that experiments reveal a significant reduction of critical loads from those predicted by linearized eigen-buckling analysis. This discrepancy has been attributed to initial geometric imperfections and is often reconciled through a dimensionless parameter, namely the knockdown factor (KDF). However, conventional KDFs (NASA SP-8007; Eurocode 3) are highly conservative, as they represent the lower bound of an extensive body of experimental data. This study aims to narrow the conservatism in the KDFs for spherical shell caps through machine learning (ML) regression models trained on experimental data on spherical shell buckling. A hybrid model is proposed by combining Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) with Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and its improved performance is demonstrated over conventional ML algorithms, i.e., the Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Support Vector Regressor (SVR), Random Forest Regressor (RFR), and Histogram-based Gradient Boosting (HGBoost). Each of these models uses six input features and a single output, i.e., the KDF. The most critical feature affecting the KDF is ascertained through a sensitivity analysis. The study concludes with a reliability-based design framework that relies on the predictive ML model to obtain safety-consistent, yet less conservative, KDFs.

</details>


### [1336] [Variance-Optimal State Resampling for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15888)
*Yibo Wang,Yuanxin Liu,Zhaoran Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将RLVR中采样效率低的问题转化为采样分布优化问题，提出闭式Neyman分配 μ_var^π(s) ∝ d^π(s)σ_π(s)，并据此设计VSR方法，在数学推理和长程智能体任务上以更少token超越GRPO和GiGPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在rollout预算中，大量状态不产生学习信号，导致采样效率低下。作者希望从采样分布本身出发，在固定rollout预算下最小化策略梯度估计方差。

Method: 将问题形式化为固定预算下的最小方差采样分布优化。理论上给出闭式Neyman分配 μ_var^π(s) ∝ d^π(s)σ_π(s)，与GRPO的组相对优势自然衔接，并随策略改进自发形成逆向课程。基于该原则提出VSR（Variance-driven State Resampling），通过前缀回放缓冲区和零成本方差代理对GRPO进行插件式改造。

Result: 在数学推理基准以及Sokoban、BabyAI等长程智能体任务上，VSR在多数基准上优于GRPO和GiGPO，且每次更新所需的生成token更少。

Conclusion: 从采样分布优化角度可有效提升RLVR的rollout效率，VSR以低额外成本实现更优性能与token效率。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards spends much of its rollout budget on states that yield no learning signal. We recast this as a question about the sampling distribution itself: under a fixed rollout budget, which distribution over states minimizes the variance of the policy-gradient estimator? The answer admits a closed-form Neyman allocation, $μ_{\mathrm{var}}^π(s) \propto d^π(s)\,σ_π(s)$, which connects naturally to GRPO's group-relative advantage and induces an emergent reverse curriculum as the policy improves, with no externally imposed schedule. Building on this principle, we propose VSR (Variance-driven State Resampling), a plug-in modification to GRPO using a prefix replay buffer and a zero-cost variance proxy. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks and long-horizon agentic tasks (Sokoban, BabyAI), VSR outperforms GRPO and GiGPO on most benchmarks with fewer generated tokens per update.

</details>


### [1337] [Fast and Accurate: Improving Personalized LLM Performance by Semantic Concentration Inspired Workload Split between RAG and Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15921)
