Although several studies explored differences in brain structure and function between sexes, the main contribution of this study lies in incorporating SVAE to learn a compact, regularized latent representation for the task of sex classification. Initial exploratory data analysis shows that these features can capture the differences in sex-specific latent space patterns. Subsequently, the learned latent space SVAE features are fed to different ML models for sex classification. Among the considered ML classifiers, the multi-layer perceptron yields the highest accuracy of 80% in classifying sex. This demonstrates the effectiveness of SVAE in learning compact, informative representations from DWI connectome for sex classification. The present work highlights the potential of using DWI brain connectomics and deep learning to differentiate sex, paving the way for future research on diverse populations that may include transgender individuals, to better understand sex-related variations in brain structure.

</details>


### [1375] [A Production-Grade, High-Efficiency Agentic RL Framework for Frontier LLMs with Validated Recipes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16352)
*LoonSage Team,Bowei Song,Caiwei Zhao,Chuwen Liu,Dechuang Gu,Dong Fang,Feiyu Xie,Huaiyu Li,Hui Zhang,Jian Tian,Jian Wang,Jie Zhao,Liguang Li,Maoyun Wang,Meiyan Yang,Minghan Zhu,Pai Liu,Pandeng Yao,Renbao Tian,Ru Yang,Shuai Jia,Shuai Tan,Shuailong Li,Shuliang Li,Teng Jin,Tianze Yang,Wenbo Cui,Wenjing Bai,Wenkang Wu,Xiaowei Jiang,Xiaoyi Dong,Yanpeng Wang,Yanwen Wang,Yaohui Ma,Yawen Wang,Yihang Zhang,Yingjie Yan,Zhanbiao Lian,Zhenyu Lu,Zhida Hu,Zhihui Hao,Zhihui Hu,Zhiwen Xiao,Zhiyi Gao,Zhongwei Qi,Zhuangzhuang Wu,Ziqian Liu,Ziyue Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoongSage是一个面向智能体任务的原生、全异步强化学习框架，核心代码约14K行，基于Megatron和SGLang构建，通过AgentFlow、TransferMesh和Teacher Manager实现高效异步训练与多教师蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型后训练中RL日益关键，能力前沿从静态推理转向涉及外部工具调用、多轮交互和长时决策的智能体任务，而现有主流RL框架愈发笨重，带来较高的采用、使用和调试成本。

Method: LoongSage采用约14K行轻量核心，基于Megatron分布式训练和SGLang高吞吐推理，用单一控制器进程集中编排，GPU组件封装为Ray actor；提出统一执行范式的AgentFlow编排白盒与黑盒智能体；集成滑动窗口策略限制轨迹陈旧度，并采用拓扑感知的TransferMesh按最快传输路径同步权重；还引入内存高效的Teacher Manager解耦教师模型扩展与GPU显存限制，原生支持多教师同策略蒸馏。

Result: 在四次完整训练运行中，涵盖复杂强化学习与多教师蒸馏，任务奖励稳步提升，训练-推理差距持续受控，全异步流水线消除同步空闲气泡，保持硬件利用率。

Conclusion: LoongSage为智能体RL提供了轻量、异步、高效的框架方案，能有效应对现有框架的笨重问题，并支持复杂训练与蒸馏任务。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a critical phase in the post-training pipeline of large language models (LLMs). As the frontier of LLM capabilities shifts from static reasoning to agentic tasks--characterized by external tool invocation, multi-turn interactions, and long-horizon decision-making--existing mainstream RL frameworks have grown increasingly unwieldy, raising the overhead of adoption, usage, and debugging. To address these challenges, we present LoongSage, an agent-native, fully asynchronous RL framework with a lightweight core of roughly 14K lines of code. Built upon Megatron for distributed training and SGLang for high-throughput inference, LoongSage centralizes orchestration within a single controller process and encapsulates all GPU-resident components as Ray actors. It introduces AgentFlow, a unified execution paradigm that orchestrates both white-box and black-box agents. For asynchronous execution, it integrates sliding-window strategies that bound trajectory staleness, and employs TransferMesh, a topology-aware synchronization mechanism that routes weights after each step over the fastest transport available to each receiver. Beyond agentic RL, LoongSage incorporates a memory-efficient Teacher Manager that decouples the scaling of teacher models from GPU memory constraints, natively supporting Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Extensive evaluations across four complete training runs, spanning complex reinforcement learning and multi-teacher distillation, demonstrate that task rewards improve steadily while the train-inference gap is kept under continuous control, and the fully asynchronous pipeline removes synchronous idle bubbles, sustaining hardware utilization.

</details>


### [1376] [LoopQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16368)
*Zhixiong Zhao,Zukang Xu,Xing Hu,Lifeng Liu,Guangyu Sun,Dawei Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LoopQuant，一个面向循环语言模型(LoopLMs)的循环感知训练后量化(PTQ)框架，解决低比特部署中跨循环激活动态、异构循环敏感性与递归误差传播问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoopLM通过递归复用共享Transformer模块提升参数效率，但重复计算带来跨循环激活动态、异构循环敏感性和递归误差传播，现有面向前馈Transformer的PTQ方法无法应对，低精度下性能大幅下降。

Method: 三大核心组件：1) 跨循环分布规范化(CLDC)，学习共享的量化友好表示并保持参数共享；2) 交互感知的循环级精度分配(ILPA)，在固定比特预算下建模任务级循环敏感性与跨循环交互来分配激活精度；3) 循环条件任务校准(LCTC)，通过轻量任务空间校准对齐量化推理与低比特递归轨迹。

Result: 在多种LoopLM架构上持续优于现有低比特PTQ方法。Ouro-2.6B上W4A4性能超越所有W4A8基线，模型内存减少65.3%，相比朴素INT4仅增加3.4%存储开销，解码速度比BF16快1.7倍。

Conclusion: LoopQuant在精度、压缩与推理效率间取得良好平衡，为低比特LoopLM推理提供实用、易部署的解决方案。

Abstract: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) improve parameter efficiency by recursively reusing shared Transformer modules, yet their repeated computation over evolving recurrent states poses new challenges for low-bit deployment. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods, largely designed for feed-forward Transformers, fail to account for cross-loop activation dynamics, heterogeneous loop sensitivity, and recursive error propagation, leading to substantial performance degradation at low precision. To address these challenges, we propose LoopQuant, a loop-aware PTQ framework for accurate and efficient low-bit quantization of LoopLMs. LoopQuant is built on three core components: 1) Cross-Loop Distribution Canonicalization (CLDC) learns a shared quantization-friendly representation across recurrent states while preserving parameter sharing; 2) Interaction-Aware Loop-wise Precision Allocation (ILPA) allocates activation precision under a fixed bit budget by modeling task-level loop sensitivity and cross-loop interactions; and 3) Loop-Conditioned Task Calibration (LCTC) further aligns quantized inference with the low-bit recursive trajectory through lightweight task-space calibration. Extensive experiments across LoopLM architectures demonstrate that LoopQuant consistently outperforms existing low-bit PTQ methods. On Ouro-2.6B, LoopQuant under W4A4 surpasses all W4A8 baselines in performance, while reducing model memory by 65.3% with only 3.4% additional storage overhead over naive INT4 and achieving a 1.7 times decoding speedup over BF16. These results demonstrate a strong balance among accuracy, compression, and inference efficiency, providing a practical and deployment-friendly solution for low-bit LoopLM inference. The code is available at [https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/LoopQuant].

</details>


### [1377] [Sampling from Neural Operator Priors to Solve Partial Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16396)
*Andrew Millard,Joshua Murphy,Zheng Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将神经算子先验与伪自举序贯蒙特卡洛（pBS SMC）结合，用于在函数空间中求解PDE，并提出将DPM++适配到引导采样的新提议分布，实现更优的误差-时间权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDE天然存在于函数空间，结合稀疏观测与PDE残差的引导采样配合神经算子先验是新兴方向，但需要能处理不可解密度提议的引导采样框架。

Method: 将神经算子先验与pBS SMC配对，pBS SMC可容纳无解析密度的提议分布；并提出将DPM++算法适配到引导采样场景以构造新提议。

Result: 在五个基准PDE系统上，该提议在测试的每个采样步数下均达到最佳误差-时间权衡；结合pBS后在多数逆问题设定下误差最低，采样步数少时增益最大。

Conclusion: 适配DPM++的引导提议配合pBS SMC能高效提升PDE求解精度与效率，尤其适合少步采样场景。

Abstract: Guided sampling with sparse observations and PDE residuals has recently been combined with neural operator priors to solve partial differential equations in function space, their natural setting. We pair such a prior with pseudo-bootstrap sequential Monte Carlo (pBS SMC), a guided sampling framework that accommodates proposals without tractable densities, and introduce a new proposal by adapting the DPM++ algorithm to the guidance setting. Across five benchmark PDE systems this proposal attains the best error--time trade-off at every step count tested, and wrapping it in pBS gives the lowest error on most inverse-problem settings, with the largest gains when few sampling steps are used.

</details>


### [1378] [Learning $ω$-Powered Conditional Distributions with Importance-Weighted Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16419)
*Maciej Falkiewicz,Frantzeska Lavda,Jason Ramapuram,Alexandros Kalousis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出重要性加权条件流匹配(IW-CFM)，用冻结的模型密度比重新加权，从而显式学习CFG所隐含的"幂化"条件分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFG常被解释为从幂化条件分布$p_\omega \propto p_\text{cond}^\omega p_\text{uncond}^{1-\omega}$采样，但当$\omega=\gamma$时CFG并不精确采样该分布，存在偏差。

Method: IW-CFM用冻结的条件/无条件流模型计算密度比，对条件流匹配样本重加权；精确归一化权重下，其梯度等于幂化目标上的流匹配。实际使用自归一化估计与正则化经验近似处理高维数据，并训练轻量摊销校正器。

Result: 合成数据上IW-CFM能恢复解析幂化目标，而数值匹配的CFG($\gamma=\omega$)出现明显偏差；ImageNet上摊销校正器比重匹配及固定引导的CFG与加权/过滤参考分布更对齐；CLIP分析显示整体位移与类别异质性(含非单调轨迹)并存。

Conclusion: 该工作为研究并近似模型定义的幂化条件分布提供了实用途径。

Abstract: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) with guidance scale $γ$ is commonly motivated by the $ω$-powered conditional distribution obtained by setting $ω=γ$, but CFG does not, in general, sample from this distribution exactly. We study whether the powered target can instead be learned explicitly. We introduce Importance-Weighted Conditional Flow Matching (IW-CFM), which reweights conditional flow-matching examples using density ratios obtained from frozen conditional and unconditional flow models. With exact normalized weights, the resulting objective has the same gradient as flow matching on the powered target; in practice, we use self-normalized estimation and a regularized empirical approximation for high-dimensional data. On synthetic distributions, IW-CFM recovers analytical powered targets for which numerically matched CFG, $γ=ω$, exhibits a visible mismatch. On ImageNet, an amortized lightweight corrector achieves better alignment than fixed- and matched-guidance CFG with the corresponding weighted and filtered reference distributions. We additionally present an exploratory CLIP analysis of powered-density rankings on real ImageNet data. Aggregate shifts across selected prompt-specific contrasts coexist with heterogeneous classwise responses, including nonmonotonic trajectories. These results provide a practical route for studying and approximating model-defined powered conditional distributions.

</details>


### [1379] [Resample the Answer: Where to Spend Test-Time Compute in Recursive Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16427)
*Maxime Illouz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GAR通过重采样答案状态恢复递归推理失败，显著提升Sudoku-Extreme等基准，超越扰动z的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归推理模型失败常归因于坏吸引域，已有测试时扰动方法对y/z选择的影响及计算效率不明。

Method: 受控实验发现失败轨迹携带于答案状态y。提出Gated Answer Resampling（GAR）：重采样y，配合模型自身halting head，仅重启被拒绝的谜题。

Result: 无训练与超参搜索，每谜题至多64次重启，Sudoku-Extreme 85.9%→99.4%，Pencil Puzzle Bench验证68.8%→85.6%；同checkpoint下以1/42~1/197计算量超越PTRM。

Conclusion: 重采样答案状态比扰动z更高效，GAR在性能与测试时计算效率上均优于现有测试时方法。

Abstract: Recursive reasoning models such as the Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) iteratively refine two latent states: an answer state y, decoded into the output, and a reasoning state z, which is never decoded. Many of their failures have been attributed to bad basins, regions of latent space that trap the recursion on wrong answers. Recent test-time approaches perturb y, z or both to recover these failures, but the impact of this choice on performance, test-time compute efficiency and scaling properties remains unclear. Through controlled experiments on TRM, we find that a failed trajectory carries its failure in its answer state. At equal compute, in depth and in width, resampling y recovers more failures than any perturbation of z we tested, and the performance gap widens as the test-time compute budget grows. Our approach, Gated Answer Resampling (GAR), pairs this resampling of the answer state with the model's own halting head and restarts only the puzzles that the head rejects. With at most 64 restarts per puzzle and no training or hyperparameter search, GAR takes TRM from 85.9% to 99.4% on Sudoku-Extreme and from 68.8% to 85.6% on Pencil Puzzle Bench validation. On the same checkpoints, GAR also outperforms Probabilistic TRM (PTRM), which perturbs z at each step, even when PTRM uses 42 to 197 times as much compute.

</details>


### [1380] [ECHO: Correcting Time Series Foundation Model Forecasts with Historical Analogues and Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16433)
*Boya Zhang,Xilin Dai,Yilin Wang,Qiang Xu,Luyao Dong,Xing He,Wen Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ECHO，一种黑盒时间序列基础模型（TSFM）预测校正框架，融合历史相似片段与历史预测误差两类信号，在5个TSFM和9个数据集上全部降低MSE，宏平均相对降幅9.26%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TSFM虽具通用预测能力，但其预测常与目标领域的时间特征不匹配；且仅能黑盒访问模型，因此需要轻量级预测校正，但如何利用可用信息进行校正尚待解决。

Method: ECHO包含两个互补模块：AnalogE结合检索到的历史相似片段、当前上下文与基础预测，通过跨域预训练学习可迁移校正；RecentE从历史预测误差中学习目标领域特定的残差校正，并随因果可用反馈累积而迭代优化；最终依据观测到的预测表现动态组合两者。

Result: 在5个代表性TSFM与9个真实数据集共45个骨干-数据集组合中，MSE全部下降，宏平均MSE平均相对降低9.26%；增益在长周期预测中同样存在。

Conclusion: 利用历史相似片段与历史预测误差两种互补信号进行黑盒校正，可有效提升TSFM在目标领域的预测精度，且方法轻量、通用、无需模型内部访问。

Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) provide general-purpose forecasting capabilities, yet their forecasts can remain misaligned with the temporal characteristics of a target domain. This motivates lightweight forecast correction even when only black-box access to the TSFM is available. Our key observation is that two forms of historical information provide complementary correction signals: historical analogues reveal how similar contexts evolved, while past forecast errors reveal a TSFM's characteristic deviations in the target domain. Based on this observation, we propose ECHO, a black-box forecast correction framework that learns from both sources. ECHO uses AnalogE to assess retrieved historical analogues together with the current context and base forecast, learning transferable corrections through cross-domain pretraining. In parallel, RecentE learns target-specific residual corrections from past forecast errors and refines them as causally available feedback accumulates. ECHO dynamically combines the two corrections according to their observed forecasting performance. Across 5 representative TSFMs and 9 real-world datasets, ECHO reduces MSE in all 45 backbone--dataset settings, yielding an average relative reduction of 9.26\% in macro-average MSE. Its gains also extend to long-horizon forecasting.

</details>


### [1381] [StructZO: Structured Zeroth-Order Optimization for Memory-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16451)
*Xuanlin Yang,Jia Li,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出StructZO结构化零阶优化框架，在激活诱导子空间内做大查询ZO估计并施加谱控制，将有效估计维度从mn降到mr，显著缩小ZO与一阶优化差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零阶(ZO)优化器仅用前向评估降低反向传播内存开销，但与Adam等一阶(FO)优化器仍有明显性能差距。作者认为该差距不仅源于缺少显式梯度，还因FO微调受益于低秩优化几何、大规模信号聚合和良态更新方向。

Method: StructZO在激活诱导的信息子空间内进行大查询ZO估计，对降维后的空间更新施加谱控制，再映射回原始参数空间，从而在紧凑、几何感知的空间中聚合同向信号，同时避免反向传播的激活和优化器状态内存开销。

Result: 理论上，当诱导子空间捕获集中的优化相关方向时，StructZO将有效ZO估计维度从mn降至mr，剩余投影误差由激活Gram矩阵的谱尾部控制。实验上，在OPT系列和Llama3.1-8B及多种下游任务上，平均相对提升最高8.7%，单项任务最高26.9%，平均仅落后FO-Adam约1.5%。

Conclusion: 结构化且谱控制的ZO更新可实质性缩小ZO与FO优化之间的差距，为内存高效LLM微调提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models at scale is increasingly limited by the memory cost of backpropagation. Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimizers reduce this burden by relying only on forward function evaluations, but they still exhibit a substantial performance gap to first-order (FO) optimizers such as Adam. We argue that this gap does not arise solely from the absence of explicit gradients: FO fine-tuning also benefits from informative low-rank optimization geometry, large-scale signal aggregation, and well-conditioned update directions. Motivated by this, we introduce StructZO, a structured Zeroth-Order optimization framework for memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning. StructZO performs large-query ZO estimation within an activation-induced informative subspace and applies spectral control to the resulting reduced-space update before mapping it back to the original parameters. This lets ZO aggregate useful directional signals in a compact, geometry-aware space while avoiding the activation and optimizer-state memory costs of backpropagation. We show theoretically that, when the induced subspace captures concentrated optimization-relevant directions, StructZO reduces the effective ZO estimation dimension from $mn$ to $mr$, with the remaining projection error governed by the spectral tail of the activation Gram matrix. Empirically, across OPT-series and Llama3.1-8B on diverse downstreamtasks, StructZO improves over the strongest existing ZO baselines by up to $8.7%$ relative on average and up to $26.9%$ relative on individual tasks, while remaining within $1.5%$ of FO-Adam on average. These results suggest that structured and spectrally controlled ZO updates can substantially narrow the gap between ZO and FO optimization.

</details>


### [1382] [SLEM: Spectrum-Aware Latent Expert Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16484)
*Dohyeon Kim,Bedionita Soro,Bruno Andreis,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SLEM，一种免校准的MoE专家合并框架，在VAE结构化隐空间中合并专家，性能优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE虽高效扩展容量，但需将所有参数常驻内存，内存开销大。现有专家合并方法存在两点不足：(i)参数空间的直接凸插值不保证对应函数层面的有效插值；(ii)依赖校准数据估计相似度或合并系数，受校准分布影响。

Method: SLEM在专家权重的结构化隐表示（VAE）中进行合并，无需校准。基于隐空间相似度对层内与跨层专家分组，并从专家权重谱中推导合并系数；随后执行几何感知的隐空间插值，再解码为合并后的专家权重。

Result: 在通用知识基准上与现有方法性能相当或更优；在涉及数学推理与代码生成的生成类基准上取得更高的平均性能。

Conclusion: SLEM通过隐空间几何感知合并与免校准的谱系数推导，有效压缩MoE内存开销，并在知识与生成任务上展现优势。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale model capacity efficiently by activating only a small subset of experts for each input, while still requiring all parameters to be stored in memory, resulting in substantial memory overhead. Expert merging techniques have recently emerged as a promising compression paradigm that reduces this overhead by consolidating multiple experts into a smaller set. However, existing approaches have two key limitations: (i) direct convex interpolation in parameter space is not generally guaranteed to yield meaningful interpolation of expert functions; and (ii) estimating expert similarity or merging coefficients often relies on calibration data, introducing dependence on the calibration distribution. To address these limitations, we propose Spectrum-Aware Latent Expert Merging (SLEM), a calibration-free expert merging framework that occurs in a structured latent representation of expert weights using a VAE. SLEM groups experts within and across layers based on latent similarities and derives merging coefficients from expert weight spectra. It then performs geometry-aware latent interpolation and decodes the resulting representations into merged expert weights. Compared with existing expert merging methods, SLEM achieves comparable or better performance on general knowledge benchmarks and higher average performance on generation benchmarks involving mathematical reasoning and code generation.

</details>


### [1383] [Growing and Transferring Pathways for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16489)
*Haolin Tian,Yikang Li,Tonghan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GrowRL 通过结构增长将 RL 学到的更新组织为紧凑计算通路，实现参数高效且可跨模型迁移的强化学习适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL 能显著提升大语言模型推理能力，但训练成本高，若能复用 RL 获得的计算可提升价值。然而现有 RL 更新与预训练权重纠缠，难以显式保留和迁移。

Method: 冻结预训练主干，在每层 Transformer 添加独立的因果注意力分支和前馈网络分支；输出投影零初始化以在初始时保持原策略；仅训练新增通路，训练后通路保持显式结构，可迁移到结构兼容的目标模型并在冻结目标主干下继续适配，还支持顺序迁移多条通路。

Result: 在五种主干上实验，以少量可训练参数取得有竞争力的数学推理和分布外性能；学习通路在三个迁移方向上均带来即时增益，目标侧仅 10 次更新后的性能已接近 100 次更新。

Conclusion: 计算通路可作为参数高效且可复用的强化学习适配单元。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can substantially improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but an effective training run requires considerable resources. Reusing the computation acquired through RL across models would extend the value of that training. We propose GrowRL, an RL method that organizes learned updates into compact computational pathways through structural growth. GrowRL freezes the pretrained backbone and adds an independent causal attention branch and a feed-forward network branch at each Transformer layer. Zero-initialized output projections preserve the pretrained policy at initialization, and RL updates only the added pathways. The learned pathways remain explicit after training, allowing transfer to structurally compatible target models and subsequent adaptation with the target backbone frozen. The architecture also supports sequential transfer of additional pathways. By keeping the learned attention and feed-forward computation separate from the pretrained weights, GrowRL provides an explicit structure for preserving and reusing the outcome of an RL run. Experiments across five backbones show competitive mathematical reasoning and out-of-distribution performance with a small number of trainable parameters. Learned pathways provide immediate gains across all three transfer directions, with performance after only 10 target-side updates already close to that after 100 updates in every case. These results support computational pathways as parameter-efficient and reusable units of reinforcement learning adaptation.

</details>


### [1384] [Drafting Agents, Not Just Tokens: Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16491)
*Xin Xu,Ke Cheng,Hao Wang,Yangru Huang,Yanghao Xiao,Zhichao Chen,Zhisheng Zhong,Xun Liu,Yi Li,Qian Li,Haibin Lv,Jun Zhang,Jie Jiang,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement (SpecRSI)，在预算有限下通过“提前起草、完整验证”的方式改进智能体，并配合 VATS 预算分配与 GVO 学习改进器，在多项科学基准和编码验证中超越 Janus、MetaRSI-v1 与 HGM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体通过连续修订改进时，需在有限预算下平衡探索与评估：搜索过窄可能错过有效的编辑序列，而完整评估每个中间版本又可能耗尽预算，导致改进序列尚未产出验证收益就无以为继。

Method: 提出 Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement (SpecRSI)：在前代智能体尚未完全评估前即起草可执行的后继智能体，但采纳前必须完整验证。提出 Verification-Aware Tree Search (VATS)，利用续作的预测验证回报在“继续编辑”与“待完成检查”之间分配预算；提出 Group Verification Optimization (GVO)，在已完成搜索上学习改进器，同时保持真实评估器固定。

Result: 主科学对比中，终端增益超过 Janus 达 33.3%–40.0%；在全部 50 个科学 backbone–task 对中均优于 Janus；在二十个 backbone 上的宏平均系统得分超过 MetaRSI-v1 达 1.85%–2.38%。编码验证成功率达 69.4%，高于 HGM 的 64.3%，且目标成本指数低 20.8%。

Conclusion: SpecRSI 通过推测式起草与严格验证的分离，有效提升了有限预算下递归自我改进的效率与效果，并在科学推理与编码验证任务上取得一致优势。

Abstract: Improving an agent through successive revisions requires balancing exploration and evaluation under a limited budget. A narrow search can miss useful sequences of edits, while fully evaluating every intermediate version can exhaust the budget before those sequences yield a verified improvement. We introduce Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement (SpecRSI), which drafts executable successor agents before their predecessors are fully evaluated, while requiring complete verification before adoption. Verification-Aware Tree Search (VATS) allocates the budget between further edits and outstanding checks using the predicted verified return of a continuation. Group Verification Optimization (GVO) learns the improver from completed searches while keeping the real evaluator fixed. In the main scientific comparison, terminal gains exceed Janus by 33.3%--40.0%. Additional evaluations show that SpecRSI outperforms Janus in all 50 scientific backbone--task pairs and exceeds MetaRSI-v1 by 1.85%--2.38% in macro-average system score across twenty backbones. Coding-validation success reaches 69.4% versus HGM's 64.3% at a 20.8% lower target-cost index.

</details>


### [1385] [pi-Net: Empirical Latent Representations for Differentiable Physics Heads in Data-Scarce Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16504)
*Akshay Dhalpe,Arnab Chattopadhyay,Shahriar Bakrani Balani,Eric Cortanéa,Sasu Tarkoma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 pi-Net，一种物理信息隐变量模型，通过将量纲分析与可微物理头结合，解决不完美模拟器问题，在数据稀缺的 GMAW 案例中以 60 个样本达到 R²=0.864。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多物理系统预测建模面临两难：物理模拟器计算昂贵，纯 ML 算法则需要大量数据且不透明。将量纲分析引入有向计算图虽结构合理，但通常产生欠定系统，导致不完美的模拟器。

Method: pi-Net 是一种物理信息隐变量混合架构：编码器将输入映射到物理归一化的隐空间，再由可微物理头（differentiable physics head）解码为最终预测，从而解决上述不完美模拟器问题。

Result: 在真实且数据稀缺的气体金属电弧焊（GMAW）案例上，仅用 60 个实验样本即取得 R²=0.864，显著优于纯数据驱动基线，并提供因果、过程级的可解释性。

Conclusion: pi-Net 证明了在数据稀缺场景下，融合物理约束与隐变量建模可兼顾预测精度与可解释性，优于纯数据驱动方法。

Abstract: Developing reliable predictive models for multi-physics systems often forces a compromise between computationally demanding physical simulators and data-hungry, opaque machine learning (ML) algorithms. While incorporating dimensional analysis into directed computation graphs offers a structurally sound alternative to explicitly solving partial differential equations (PDEs), such formulations typically yield underdetermined systems that act as imperfect simulators. We introduce pi-Net, a physics-informed latent variable model that resolves these imperfect simulators. The hybrid pi-Net architecture consists of an encoder that maps inputs into physically normalized latent space, which are then decoded into final predictions by a differentiable physics head. Evaluated on a real-world, data-scarce Gas Metal Arc Welding (GMAW) case study, the framework achieves an R2 of 0.864 with only 60 experimental samples. The results demonstrate that pi-Net significantly outperforms purely data-driven baselines in data-scarce regimes while providing causal, process-level explainability.

</details>


### [1386] [Asymptotic Risk of Learning-Rate Schedules for Least-Squares Regression with Discretely Distributed Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16518)
*Noé Colomban,Francis Bach,Fabian Schaipp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究流式最小二乘（Slock 模型）下 SGD 最后一次迭代，给出常数与 WSD 学习率计划的精确有限时间风险和渐近等价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解 WSD（预热-稳定-衰减）学习率调度在随机梯度下降中的最优性机理，特别是冷却长度对风险的定量影响。

Method: 在幂律源条件和容量条件下，对离散特征分布（Slock 模型）解耦各特征方向的动力学，推导常数与 WSD 调度的精确有限时间风险及渐近等价。

Result: 调优基学习率后缩放律为 Θ(T^{-q})，q 与冷却相对长度 c 无关；但任何固定的 c>0 冷却都能将风险按多项式因子改善，且线性衰减（c=1）使常数最小。最优风险仅通过 bT 依赖批量 b 与视野 T（直到临界批量）。

Conclusion: WSD 调度中冷却阶段的相对长度不影响缩放指数，但任意冷却均可带来多项式级收益；线性衰减最优。

Abstract: We study the last iterate of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) on streaming least squares with discretely distributed features (Slock's model), which decouples the dynamics across eigendirections. Under power-law source and capacity conditions, we derive the exact finite-time risk and asymptotic equivalents of constant and Warmup-Stable-Decay (WSD) schedules. With a tuned base learning-rate, the resulting scaling law decays as $Θ(T^{-q})$, where $T$ is the horizon, and $q$ is independent of the cooldown length $c \in (0,1]$ but is strictly smaller for the constant schedule: any cooldown of fixed relative length $c > 0$, however short, improves the risk by a polynomial factor, while its length only affects the constant, which is minimized by linear decay ($c = 1$). Finally, we show that the optimal risk depends on the batch size $b$ and horizon $T$ only through $bT$, up to a critical batch size.

</details>


### [1387] [Reinforcement Learning with Hawkes-Structured Networks for Market Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16524)
*Fernando Acero,Philipp Plank,Yufei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免模型强化学习框架HSN，用可学习的指数混合滤波器编码Hawkes订单流，实现高效做市。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实市场订单到达具有聚集、自激发的非马尔可夫特性（Hawkes过程），传统方法难以建模无限维状态，做市面临挑战。

Method: 先建立非渐进性能界，量化用有限指数加权特征近似无限维Hawkes状态的损失；据此设计Hawkes-Structured Network（HSN），通过可学习指数混合滤波器编码历史订单流，并用免模型RL端到端联合优化特征表示与报价策略。

Result: 在单资产与多资产做市任务中，针对指数混合、幂律和机制切换核，HSN优于通用神经网络架构，获得更高交易奖励，并隐式恢复底层订单流强度。

Conclusion: 结合理论分析与结构化神经设计，HSN能有效处理一般Hawkes订单流下的做市问题，兼顾性能与可解释性。

Abstract: Market making under realistic order-flow dynamics is challenging due to the clustered, self-exciting nature of order arrivals, which are naturally modeled by non-Markovian Hawkes processes. We propose a model-free reinforcement learning (RL) framework for market making with general Hawkes order-flow dynamics. We first establish non-asymptotic performance bounds that quantify the loss incurred by approximating the infinite-dimensional Hawkes state using a finite collection of exponentially weighted features. Guided by this analysis, we introduce the Hawkes-Structured Network (HSN), a novel neural architecture that encodes historical order flow through a learnable mixture-of-exponentials filter. HSN is trained end-to-end using model-free RL, jointly optimizing the feature representation and quoting policy directly from reward feedback. Experiments on single- and multi-asset market-making problems with mixture-of-exponentials, power-law, and regime-switching kernels demonstrate that HSN outperforms general-purpose neural architectures, achieving higher trading rewards while implicitly recovering the underlying order-flow intensities.

</details>


### [1388] [Learning Graded Sparse Mechanisms: A Representation Theorem and Certified Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16537)
*Mark Kozdoba,Shie Mannor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"分级稀疏机制"（元素更新强烈依赖少数、微弱依赖多数，且依赖对象与数量随状态变化）的监督学习，用公理化方法刻画该类函数，证明其恰为加权多重集上某运输度量的Lipschitz球，并据此给出基于稀疏剖面与经验传输距离的泛化界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: flocks、人群、学习粒子模拟器、图网络邻域聚合等场景中普遍存在"分级稀疏"更新机制，但其作为一类带分级（每个元素有权重）的函数尚未被系统研究。

Method: 用公理定义函数类：每个元素的影响力被其权重上界限制、对权重依赖正则、无元素被区分；证明表示定理，说明该类恰为加权多重集上运输度量的Lipschitz球，且度量由公理唯一确定；再由几何性质导出泛化界；在Vicsek flock上实验验证。

Result: 泛化界以两种方式依赖数据：一是通过数据的稀疏剖面限制速率，指数来自剖面且不依赖元素数量，多个自然情形下有匹配下界（至常数）；二是经验界为样本两半在该度量下的运输距离（可由匹配精确计算）加浓度项。Vicsek flock在4种交互规则、2个噪声水平下，证书均非空且仅为平凡值的很小比例。

Conclusion: 该工作为分级稀疏机制提供了公理化的表示理论、与数据稀疏结构相关的泛化保证，以及非平凡的实证证书。

Abstract: In a variety of multi-agent and physical environments, an element's update depends strongly on a few other elements and weakly on many, and both the identity and the number of the elements that matter change with the state of the system. Such graded sparse mechanisms are common, for instance, in flocks, crowds, learned particle simulators and the neighborhood aggregation of graph networks, yet they have received little systematic study as a class of functions with the grading given. In this paper we study the supervised learning of the mechanism when the grading is provided by the environment, as a weight on every element. First, we define the class by axioms, where each element's influence is capped by its weight, the dependence on the weights is regular, and no element is distinguished, and prove a representation theorem: the class is exactly the Lipschitz ball of a transport metric on weighted multisets, and the metric is forced by the axioms. Next, the geometry of the representation gives generalization bounds that depend on the data in two ways. One is via the sparsity profile of the data -- the law of how many elements matter and by how much -- which bounds the rate over all designs with that profile, with an exponent from the profile and no dependence on the number of elements. In a number of natural cases we also show matching lower bounds, up to constants in the exponent. The other is empirical: due to the representation result, classical empirical discrepancy bounds apply to the class as they stand, and the resulting bound is the transport distance between the two halves of the sample in the class's own metric, computed exactly by a matching, with an additional concentration term. Finally, we study a simulated Vicsek flock under four interaction rules at two noise levels, and show that the certificate is non-vacuous, a small fraction of the trivial value on every rule.

</details>


### [1389] [DeepFlow: Two Convergent Differentiable Approaches for Pairwise Conditional Random Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16546)
*John S. H. Baxter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种具有可证明收敛性的算法，用于在深度学习中引入空间正则化的概率图模型，以提升图像和信号分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础概率模型通过定义网络最终激活层并赋予输出概率解释，构成现代深度学习的基础。增加最终激活层复杂度（如空间正则化）可在不显著增加数据的情况下提升性能，但挑战在于确保这些复杂概率图模型与深度学习结合时能良好收敛并具有有意义的导数。

Method: 提出两种具有可证明收敛性质的算法，使空间正则化可应用于图像和信号分类模型，并结合严格数学分析与计算机模拟实验。

Result: 通过数学分析和 in silico 实验，展示了不同解法类型之间的性能差异。

Conclusion: 两种算法可支持复杂的空间正则化概率模型与深度学习结合，并在图像和信号分类任务中表现出不同性能。

Abstract: Basic probabilistic models form the basis of modern deep learning largely by defining the final activation layer of a network and allowing the networks outputs to be interpreted through a probabilistic lens. By increasing the complexity of these final activation layers to include features such as spatial regularisation, allow for these models to improve in performance without requiring significantly more data. The challenge however is to ensure that these more complex probabilistic graphical models adapt well to being used in tandem with deep learning, that is, ensuring they converge and have meaningful derivatives. The goal of this paper is to show two algorithms with provable convergence properties to allow this type of regularisation for image and signal classification models. Through both rigorous mathematical analysis and in silico experiments, we can show the differing performance between these solution types.

</details>


### [1390] [Optimal Transport PAC-Bayes Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16560)
*Armin Beck,Peter Ochs,Jalal Fadili*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将PAC-Bayesian泛化界中的KL散度替换为一般的最优传输(OT)距离（含全变差与Wasserstein-p距离），从而得到新的泛化界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KL散度虽然分析方便，但要求后验关于先验绝对连续，带来支撑集约束，限制了后验选择；同时KL散度不考虑概率空间的几何结构。

Method: 将PAC-Bayesian界中的KL散度替换为一般的最优传输(OT)距离，包括全变差距离和Wasserstein-p距离，推导新的泛化界。

Result: 推导出以一般OT距离表达的新PAC-Bayesian泛化界，推广了经典KL形式的界。

Conclusion: 用OT距离替代KL散度可获得更灵活的PAC-Bayesian界，放宽支撑集约束并纳入概率空间的几何信息。

Abstract: PAC-Bayesian generalization bounds are among the strongest distribution-dependent guarantees in statistical learning and are typically expressed in terms of the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between a prior and posterior distribution. While analytically convenient, the KL divergence requires the posterior to be absolutely continuous w.r.t. the prior, imposing support constraints that can substantially restrict the choice of posterior. Moreover, the KL divergence does not account for the underlying geometry of the probability space. In this work, we derive new PAC-Bayesian bounds replacing the KL divergence with general optimal transport (OT) distances, including the total variation and Wasserstein-$p$ distances.

</details>


### [1391] [The Language of Looking: Motion Tokens Reveal Domain-Dependent Local Structure in Gaze Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16565)
*Virmarie Maquiling,Enkelejda Kasneci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究用运动token化作为诊断工具，考察人类注视序列局部结构的跨域可迁移性。发现虽可共享运动token词汇表，但相同token在不同数据集中被组织成不同的局部转移模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类注视是解析环境语义的主要高带宽接口，常被视为序列建模。然而注视是否在不同领域间表现可迁移的局部结构尚不清楚。作者希望探究这种局部序列结构的可迁移性。

Method: 采用运动token化（motion tokenization）作为诊断视角，在四个多样化数据集上进行实验，并结合信息论诊断手段评估行为序列。

Result: 注视可以共享可复用的运动token词汇表，但相同的运动token会依据数据集和任务语境被组织成不同的局部转移模式。这揭示了在低语义运动token表示下简单数据池化的局限性。

Conclusion: 研究指出朴素数据池化的限制，并提出一个通过信息论诊断来评估行为序列的框架。

Abstract: Human gaze is the primary high-bandwidth interface through which we parse the semantics of our environment. While often modeled as a sequence, the degree to which gaze exhibits transferable local structure across domains remains underexplored. Using motion tokenization as a diagnostic lens across four diverse datasets, we investigate the transferability of local sequence structure. We demonstrate that while gaze can share a reusable motion-token vocabulary, identical motion tokens are organized into different local transition patterns depending on the dataset and task context. Our results show the limitations of naive data-pooling under low-semantic motion-token representations and provide a framework for evaluating behavioral sequences through information-theoretic diagnostics.

</details>


### [1392] [Characterizing and Mitigating Distributional Bias in Physics-Informed Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16582)
*Tanja Bien,Samir Darouich,Lluís Pastor-Pérez,Vinh Tong,Loay Mualem,Mathias Niepert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 物理约束残差惩罚与数据保真度存在冲突，作者识别出"规避"和"泄漏"两种问题，提出数据锚定惩罚来解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理信息生成模型通过残差惩罚增强约束满足，但提高约束满足不等于提高对数据分布的保真度，二者存在冲突，需要分析并解决这一问题。

Method: 在残差正则扩散模型中分析该冲突，识别出两种后果：一是不同可行状态附近相同预测误差的残差代价不同，偏好低残差敏感度状态（规避）；二是此偏好可延伸至数据支撑外的可行状态（泄漏）。据此提出数据锚定惩罚，用干净训练样本处的残差雅可比加权预测误差并归一化幅度，无需改变模型架构或采样流程。

Result: 在受控合成系统、三个PDE系统以及使用流匹配的分子过渡态生成任务上验证了锚定方法的优势。

Conclusion: 数据锚定惩罚能够消除模型向低敏感度状态迁移的动机，在保持架构和采样不变的前提下改善物理约束与数据保真度的平衡。

Abstract: Physics-informed generative models augment a data-fitting objective with residual penalties that encourage physical constraints to hold in generated samples. However, improving constraint satisfaction need not improve fidelity to the data distribution. We study this conflict in residual-regularized diffusion models and identify two possible consequences. First, the same prediction error can incur different residual costs near different feasible states, preferring states with lower residual sensitivity (avoidance). Second, this preference can extend to feasible states outside the data support, where the residual also vanishes (leakage). Motivated by this analysis, we propose a data-anchored penalty that weights prediction errors by the residual Jacobian at the clean training sample and normalizes the resulting magnitude. This removes the incentive to relocate to less sensitive states without changing the model architecture or sampling procedure. Experiments on a controlled synthetic system, three PDE systems, and molecular transition-state generation with flow matching demonstrate the benefits of anchoring. Code is available at https://github.com/TanjaBien/anchored_diffusion.

</details>


### [1393] [OctMole: Multiscale 3D Molecular Generation with Hierarchical Spatial Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16586)
*Yu-Tong Jin,Yi-Yang Tian,Qiwei Ye,Peng-Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OctMole是一个多尺度八叉树流(octree flow)框架，用于3D分子生成，通过分层占据流与联合原子流分解，实现全局结构与亚胞几何精度，并在QM9/GEOM-DRUG上取得优异性能与效率，还支持空间条件生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成精确3D分子需同时确定可变原子数量、种类与几何，且跨尺度：全局形状粗粒度涌现，化学键需精细局部精度。现有原子基扩散/流模型多在单尺度操作，而稠密空间场在高分辨率下代价高昂。

Method: 提出OctMole，多尺度八叉树流框架。分层占据流从粗到细逐步解析稀疏分子支撑；联合原子流为被占据叶节点分配原子类型与连续胞内偏移。该分解结合高效全局结构与亚胞几何精度，并用cell corruption提升对生成支撑的鲁棒性。

Result: 在QM9与GEOM-DRUG上取得强化学、分布与几何质量，在GEOM-DRUG上相对Uni-3DAR提升明显，相对稠密3D生成有显著效率增益。额外能力：中间占据状态与选定区域提供空间条件，无需任务特定重训练，支持多尺度形状条件、区域编辑、linker生成与形状插值。

Conclusion: OctMole以多尺度八叉树流分解实现高效精确的3D分子生成，并提供灵活的空间条件能力。代码与预训练权重已开源。

Abstract: Generating accurate 3D molecules requires jointly determining a variable number of atoms, their identities, and geometry across spatial scales: global shape emerges coarsely, whereas chemical bonds demand fine local precision. Existing atom-based diffusion and flow models operate largely at a single scale, while dense spatial fields become costly at high resolution. We introduce OctMole, a multiscale octree flow framework for 3D molecular generation. A hierarchical occupancy flow progressively resolves sparse molecular support from coarse to fine, and a joint atom flow assigns atom types and continuous in-cell offsets to occupied leaves. This decomposition combines efficient global structure with subcell geometric precision, while cell corruption improves robustness to generated support. On QM9 and GEOM-DRUG, OctMole achieves strong chemical, distributional, and geometric quality, with particularly clear gains over Uni-3DAR on GEOM-DRUG and substantial efficiency gains over dense 3D generation. As an additional capability, intermediate occupancy states and selected regions provide spatial conditioning without task-specific retraining, supporting multiscale shape conditioning, regional editing, linker generation, and shape interpolation. Code and pretrained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/octree-nn/octmole and https://huggingface.co/Disembo/octmole, respectively.

</details>


### [1394] [HyBRA-EEG: Hyperbolic Global-Local Brain-Region Aggregation for Self-Supervised EEG Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16589)
*Xin Liu,Feng Lu,Wei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HyBRA：基于双曲全局-局部脑区聚合的自监督EEG表示学习框架，统一异构电极蒙太奇，在六个基准数据集上平均平衡准确率最优，且以少96.8%参数量超越/匹敌CSBrain。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG表示学习面临噪声信号、跨被试差异及不同数据集与记录设置下异构电极蒙太奇的挑战。现有自监督方法虽通过统一token/序列表示提升迁移性，但通道相关设计仍可能编码蒙太奇或数据集特有的规律。

Method: HyBRA将异构通道观测映射到固定脑区token空间，结合电极坐标、脑区先验和特征相关的双曲距离；引入通道证据注入分支保留细粒度判别线索；token经Region-Time Transformer处理，并用潜特征与区域级信号的掩码重建进行自监督预训练。

Result: 在六个基准数据集上平均平衡准确率超过对比方法。OpenBMI-MI六折受控评估中，平衡准确率与CSBrain持平，AUROC提升1.84个百分点、AUPRC提升5.23个百分点，参数量减少96.8%。TUAB与TUEV上双曲匹配优于欧氏距离或余弦相似度。

Conclusion: 基于双曲空间脑区聚合的通道感知设计可有效统一异构EEG蒙太奇，兼顾参数效率与跨数据集迁移性能。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) representation learning is challenged by noisy signals, inter-subject variability, and heterogeneous electrode montages in different datasets and recording settings. Recent self-supervised EEG pretraining methods improve transferability by converting heterogeneous recordings into unified token or sequence representations, but channel-aware designs may still encode montage- or dataset-specific regularities. We propose HyBRA, a self-supervised framework based on hyperbolic global-local brain-region aggregation. HyBRA maps heterogeneous channel observations into a fixed regional token space by combining electrode coordinates, region priors, and feature-dependent hyperbolic distances. A channel-evidence injection branch preserves fine-grained discriminative cues during aggregation. The resulting tokens are processed by a Region-Time Transformer and pretrained with masked reconstruction of latent features and region-level signals. HyBRA outperforms the compared methods in average balanced accuracy on six benchmark datasets. Under a controlled six-fold evaluation on OpenBMI-MI, HyBRA matches CSBrain in balanced accuracy, improves AUROC by 1.84 percentage points and AUPRC by 5.23 percentage points, and uses 96.8\% fewer parameters. Matched comparisons on TUAB and TUEV show higher balanced accuracy for hyperbolic matching than for Euclidean distance or cosine similarity.

</details>


### [1395] [Towards Modality-Agnostic Seizure Classification: A Unified Deep Learning Framework for Heterogeneous EEG and Intracranial EEG Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16596)
*Ramya Sundaram,Muhammad Aslam Jarwar,M Uma,Sunder Ali Khowaja,Qurat-Ul-Ain Mastoi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出统一多模态信号协调框架(UMSH)，融合EEG与iEEG进行分类，结合cGAN数据增强和EEGNet-ViT分类网络，实现鲁棒的癫痫发作分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有癫痫预测系统多为单模态，EEG与iEEG通常被分别分析，限制了在多临床条件下的适用性，因此需要能同时处理异构EEG与iEEG的统一框架。

Method: 提出UMSH框架协调不同采样率与记录条件的信号；用条件GAN(cGAN)生成合成样本缓解类别极度不平衡；采用EEGNet-ViT进行特征提取与分类，兼顾局部判别模式与全局上下文。

Result: 实验结果表明该框架能有效实现鲁棒的癫痫分类，验证了EEG-iEEG多模态学习的潜力。

Conclusion: 融合EEG与iEEG的多模态学习有助于推动下一代癫痫监测和临床决策支持系统的发展。

Abstract: Seizure prediction and detection, essential for clinical treatment of epilepsy, remain the crucial task of this neurological disease. EEG and iEEG are widely used to analyze epilepsy due to its capability of capturing discriminative brain activities at high time resolution. However, existing works generally analyze either EEG or iEEG seizure activity separately, where EEG analysis has been well-researched, while more and more works consider iEEG for its higher specificity at the spatial level and signal quality. Currently, most of the existing seizure prediction systems are single-modal in nature, which limits its application to a variety of clinical conditions. Therefore, a common framework to analyze seizures with both EEG and iEEG signals needs to be developed. This paper presents a new framework of multimodal seizure classification integrating the heterogeneous EEG and iEEG recordings from different subjects and sources. A specific framework, called Unified Multimodal Signal Harmonization (UMSH), is developed for harmonizing signals with varied sampling rates and recording conditions. Moreover, to handle the extremely class-imbalanced problem in the data sets, we use a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) based data augmentation technique to generate synthetic samples to balance the class distribution. The proposed framework uses the EEGNet-Vision Transformer (EEGNet-ViT) as the feature extraction and classification network to learn the local discriminative patterns as well as global contextual information in the multimodal seizure data. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework for robust seizure classification, emphasizing the potential of integrated EEG-iEEG multimodal learning in advancing next-generation epilepsy monitoring and clinical decision-support systems.

</details>


### [1396] [DEFlow: Deep Equilibrium Flow Maximum-Entropy Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16597)
*Ruslan Ageev,Huaze Tang,Runqing Miao,Jiarong Li,Wenbo Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DEFlow 提出用隐式欧拉积分替代显式欧拉采样，将流策略的中间动作作为平衡系统联合求解，实现少步采样且保持可解动作密度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表达性流策略可表示多种高价值动作，但难以在少量积分步内采样并同时保持可解的动作密度。

Method: 将显式欧拉采样替换为隐式欧拉积分，把所有中间动作作为平衡系统联合求解；结合隐式微分与离散变量变换公式计算最终动作密度，从而在 soft actor-critic 中实现离策略训练，且无需对求解器迭代反向传播。

Result: 在四个 Multi-Goal docking 变体上，平均成功覆盖率相对最强基线提升约 10%；在五个操作任务中的四个取得最高时间平均回报，并在五个 MuJoCo 任务上保持总体竞争力。

Conclusion: 结果支持隐式流策略用于同时需要多样性与精确性的任务，代价是额外的非线性与线性求解开销。

Abstract: Expressive flow policies can represent multiple high-value actions, but sampling them with few integration steps while retaining tractable action densities remains challenging. We introduce DEFlow, a deep equilibrium flow policy that replaces explicit Euler sampling with implicit Euler integration and solves all intermediate actions jointly as an equilibrium system. We combine implicit differentiation with a discrete change-of-variables formula for the final-action density, enabling off-policy training within soft actor-critic without backpropagating through solver iterations. DEFlow achieves an average relative improvement of approximately 10% in mean successful coverage over the strongest baseline across four Multi-Goal docking variants. It also achieves the highest mean time-averaged return on four of five manipulation tasks, while remaining broadly competitive across five MuJoCo tasks. These results support implicit flow policies for tasks requiring both diversity and precision, at the cost of additional nonlinear and linear solves. Primary

</details>


### [1397] [DR-APO: Decoupled-Representation Advantage-Guided Policy Optimization from Continuous Control to Embodied Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16618)
*Runhua Zhang,Yingjie Niu,Chao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DR-APO，将策略改进与策略表示解耦，为高斯、扩散和流匹配策略提供统一的优化原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL方法依赖特定策略表示，缺乏统一优化接口；基于似然的目标与多步生成过程耦合会削弱更新信号，而生成策略特定方法依赖多候选生成与评论家选择，对策略本身提升有限。

Method: DR-APO通过优势引导的目标改进和表示兼容的直接动作拟合，将策略改进与策略表示解耦，适用于高斯、扩散和流策略。

Result: 五个MuJoCo-v5任务中，高斯策略下与SAC相当，扩散与流匹配策略下取得最佳纯策略聚合性能；NavDP后训练将成功率从70.33%提升至89.55%（仿真）、25%提升至65%（真实导航）。

Conclusion: 结果验证了跨高斯、扩散和流策略的统一策略改进原则，从连续控制学习到具身策略后训练均有效。

Abstract: Policy representations in reinforcement learning have expanded beyond Gaussian policies to diffusion and flow-matching based generative policies. However, existing RL methods remain representation-specific, lacking a unified optimization interface for emerging generative policies. In particular, extending likelihood-based objectives to multi-step generative policies couples optimization to their internal generation process, where accumulated likelihood ratios can weaken the update signal. Meanwhile, generative-policy-specific methods often rely on multi-candidate generation and critic-based selection, improving overall return while providing limited improvement to the policy itself. We introduce DR-APO (Decoupled-Representation Advantage-Guided Policy Optimization), which decouples policy improvement from policy representation through advantage-guided target improvement and representation-compatible direct action fitting, providing a shared optimization principle for Gaussian, diffusion, and flow policies. Across five MuJoCo-v5 tasks, DR-APO remains competitive with SAC for Gaussian policies and achieves the best aggregate policy-only performance for both diffusion and flow-matching policies. NavDP post-training improves the Success Rate (SR) from 70.33% to 89.55% in simulation and from 25% to 65% in real-world navigation. These results demonstrate a unified policy-improvement principle across Gaussian, diffusion, and flow policies, from continuous-control learning to embodied-policy post-training.

</details>


### [1398] [AeroChem: Closed-loop Physics-Informed State Space Modeling for Long-term Chemically-Reactive Air Quality Forecasting--Extended Version](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16630)
*Kien Le Trung,Tung Kieu,Dinh Duc Nha Nguyen,Cuong Do,Bin Yang,Phi Long Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AeroChem闭环物理信息状态空间框架，用神经卡尔曼融合修正潜在物理状态并回馈模拟器，缓解长期漂移，并发布HanoiAir数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期空气质量预报受远距离传输、气象变异与非线性化学反应影响；纯数据驱动模型易长期漂移、缺物理一致性，现有物理信息方法多为开环、仅在输出层融合。

Method: AeroChem采用双分支协同校正：UDE过程分支提供结构化但不完美的物理先验；Mamba虚拟测量分支捕捉长程时序并给出概率虚拟观测；神经卡尔曼融合每步校正潜在物理状态并将后验回馈模拟器形成闭环。同时构建HanoiAir数据集（污染物、气象、排放清单）。

Result: 在HanoiAir与一个公开基准上，AeroChem提升了长期稳定性与突变情况下的预报能力。

Conclusion: 闭环物理信息状态空间设计可有效抑制长期漂移并增强对突发变化的预报，配套数据集支持真实场景评估。

Abstract: Accurate long-term air quality forecasting is challenging due to long-range transport, meteorological variability, and nonlinear chemical reactions underlying secondary pollutant formation. Purely data-driven models often suffer from long-horizon drift and lack physical consistency, while existing physics-informed approaches commonly follow open-loop designs that fuse neural and physical components only at the output level. We propose AeroChem, a closed-loop physics-informed state space framework for chemically reactive air quality forecasting. AeroChem adopts a two-branch co-correction design: a UDE-based process branch provides a structured but imperfect physical prior, while a Mamba-based virtual measurement branch captures long-range temporal context and produces probabilistic virtual observations. Neural Kalman Fusion couples the two branches by correcting the latent physical state at each forecasting step and feeding the posterior state back into the simulator, reducing long-horizon drift. We further introduce HanoiAir, a real-world dataset integrating pollutant concentrations, meteorology, and emission inventories. Experiments on HanoiAir and a public benchmark show that AeroChem improves long-horizon stability and sudden-change forecasting.

</details>


### [1399] [ACED: Reference-Anchored Aggregation of Natural-Language and Executable Evidence for Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16635)
*Yiyi Lu,Jiaxiang Geng,Bing Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ACED框架，将自然语言自洽答案设为默认、可执行程序输出作为支持证据（非可互换投票），通过平滑支持、加权对数池和带校准的相对证据边距来整合两类证据。在五个数学应用题基准上匹配或优于基线，GSM8K上ACED-ALL达86.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言自洽与可执行程序提供互补的测试时证据，但任一通道都可能支持同一语义错误，简单投票式整合不可靠。

Method: 以自洽答案为默认，将可执行输出作为支持证据；把来源特定的答案计数转换为平滑支持，通过加权对数池组合，仅当超过校准的相对证据边距时才覆盖默认答案；同一规则同时支持候选选择与纯可执行答案的接纳。

Result: 在五个数学应用题基准上匹配或超越对应基线。GSM8K上ACED-CANDIDATE以仅3次有害覆盖恢复了89.7%的可获得候选集增益；ACED-ALL达86.9%准确率，高于PoT直接聚合的82.6%。

Conclusion: 保留证据来源（provenance）能够实现自然语言与可执行推理更可靠的整合。

Abstract: Natural-language self-consistency and executable programs provide complementary test-time evidence for mathematical reasoning, yet either channel may support the same semantic error. Thus we propose ACED, a reference-anchored framework that treats the self-consistency answer as the default and executable outputs as supporting evidence rather than interchangeable votes. ACED converts source-specific answer counts into smoothed supports, combines them through a weighted logarithmic pool, and overrides the reference only when a calibrated relative-evidence margin is exceeded. The same rule supports both candidate selection and admission of executable-only answers. Across five math word-problem benchmarks, ACED matches or outperforms the corresponding baselines. On GSM8K, ACED-CANDIDATE recovers 89.7% of the attainable candidate-set gain with only three damaging overrides, while ACED-ALL reaches 86.9% accuracy versus 82.6% for direct Program-of-Thought aggregation. These results show that preserving evidence provenance enables more reliable integration of natural-language and executable reasoning.

</details>


### [1400] [Learning Deployable Causal Action Geometry under Temporal Non-Stationarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16644)
*Changjian Liu,Tianyu Wang,Yuwei Xu,Xiaoxuan Deng,Zhilin Zhang,Yong Gao,Chuan Yu,Jian Xu,Bo Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列中连续决策的响应规律，提出“可部署因果动作几何”以捕获在结果水平漂移下仍稳定的动作-响应形状，并设计两阶段正交估计器，实验与淘宝A/B测试验证其有效性和迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实决策系统中，时间非平稳性导致结果漂移，简单合并模型会混淆动作效应与基线漂移，甚至反转动作排序；即使一步响应可识别，跨时间泛化仍本质上不适定，因此需要寻找不随结果水平漂移而改变、对决策稳定的响应部分。

Method: 提出“可部署因果动作几何”：在选定链接尺度上锚定掉与动作无关的水平偏移，并剖析掉正幅度变化后保留的动作-响应形状；基于该目标设计两阶段正交估计器，先通过交叉拟合获得锚定响应的试点估计，再在链接、表示和形状类上进行诚实的剖析选择。

Result: 估计器对受限目标具有 oracle 保证；在近似持续性条件下，产生的决策规则在未来时期保持近最优。合成数据与 Dominick's 数据支持该目标及其迁移行为；在随机淘宝 A/B 测试中，部署系统将 GMV 和购买次数分别提升 1.16% 和 1.70%。

Conclusion: 通过聚焦时间非平稳下稳定的动作-响应几何，可在无需跨时间完全泛化的前提下实现可迁移、近最优的决策，并在真实大规模 A/B 测试中取得显著业务收益。

Abstract: Learning a response law for continuous decisions from observational time series is central to many real-world decision systems, yet temporal non-stationarity poses a fundamental challenge: as outcomes drift over time, naively pooled models can conflate action effects with shifting baselines and even reverse action rankings. Even when the one-step response is identifiable, unrestricted cross-time generalization remains fundamentally ill-posed. We therefore seek the part of the response that remains stable for decisions even when outcome levels do not. We propose deployable causal action geometry: the action-response shape that remains after anchoring away action-independent level shifts on a selected link scale and profiling out positive amplitude variation. Building on this target, we develop a two-stage orthogonal estimator that first obtains cross-fitted pilot estimates of anchored responses and then performs honest profiled selection over link, representation, and shape classes. The resulting estimator admits oracle guarantees for the restricted target and, under approximate persistence, produces decision rules that remain near optimal in future periods. Experiments on synthetic data and Dominick's support the proposed target and its transfer behavior. In a randomized Taobao A/B test, the deployed system improves GMV and purchase counts by \(1.16\%\) and \(1.70\%\).

</details>


### [1401] [Learning Incompressible 3D Flows from Sparse Samples: A Set Transformer Approach to Divergence-Free Kernel Fitting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16645)
*Ramzi Idoughi,Radouan Boukharfane,Peter Wonka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DFK-Former 是一种 set-to-field transformer，能从稀疏、含噪、不规则采样的 3D 观测中直接前馈预测无散度核表示参数，实现精确不可压缩的连续速度场重建，精度提升最高 4.6 倍，速度提升超三个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀疏且被污染的数据中恢复无散度速度场需要兼顾物理一致性、表达能力和鲁棒性。现有无散度核方法需针对每个场单独迭代优化系数，成本高，且在观测不足时难以唯一确定场。

Method: 提出 DFK-Former，一种 set-to-field transformer，对输入样本数量和顺序不变，单次前向预测无散度核表示参数，生成精确满足不可压缩性的连续无网格速度场；并引入自适应、各向异性无散度核以增强表达能力。

Result: 在不同稀疏度、噪声与遮挡条件下，包括迁移到真实 DNS 湍流数据，均取得显著精度与效率提升：端点误差最多降低 4.6 倍，单场重建时间从 9.8 秒降至 7.5 毫秒，加速超过三个数量级。

Conclusion: 直接前馈预测无散度核参数是一种实用且有效的范式，可用于从稀疏观测中进行物理一致的速度场重建。

Abstract: Recovering divergence-free velocity fields from sparse and corrupted observations requires reconciling physical consistency, expressive representations, and robustness to missing data. We introduce DFK-Former, a set-to-field transformer that reconstructs divergence-free velocity fields from sparse, noisy, and irregularly sampled 3D observations. The model is inherently invariant to the number and ordering of input samples and predicts the parameters of a divergence-free kernel representation, producing continuous, mesh-free velocity fields that satisfy incompressibility exactly by construction rather than approximately through soft constraints or projection operators. Unlike existing divergence-free kernel approaches, which estimate kernel coefficients via a separate optimization for each field, DFK-Former predicts these coefficients directly in a single forward pass. This eliminates costly iterative fitting while providing a learned prior that enables accurate reconstruction even when observations are insufficient to uniquely determine the field. To enhance representational power, we introduce adaptive and anisotropic divergence-free kernels that preserve exact incompressibility guarantees while capturing more complex flow structures. Extensive experiments across varying levels of sparsity, noise, and occlusion, including transfer to real Direct Numerical Simulation (DNS) turbulence data, demonstrate substantial gains in both accuracy and efficiency. DFK-Former reduces endpoint error by up to 4.6x compared to per-field divergence-free-kernel optimization, while reconstructing each field in 7.5 ms instead of 9.8 s, yielding a speedup of more than three orders of magnitude. These results establish direct, feed-forward prediction of divergence-free kernel parameters as a practical and effective paradigm for physically consistent velocity-field reconstruction from sparse observations.

</details>


### [1402] [IND-Eval: Aligning Evaluation and Simulation for Industrial Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16652)
*Vebjørn Haugland,Pavel Gulin,David Foss,Peet Cremer,Erlend Aune,Simone Casolo,Andreas Solbrå,Milad Mobarhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出工业时间序列基准IND-Eval，评估Chronos-2/TiRex-2/TimesFM-3，发现TimesFM-3最优但存在领域差异；通过振荡器增强仿真提升特定领域性能，50/50混合配方可兼顾专精与通用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准（如GIFT-Eval）对工业时间序列关注不足，缺乏更细采样分辨率与多元预测的覆盖；工业真实数据稀缺，难以直接弥补领域差距，需要领域代表性评估来指导模型选择与仿真数据设计。

Method: 构建IND-Eval公共基准，将跨领域工业时间序列整理为源特定的预测任务；评估Chronos-2、TiRex-2、TimesFM-3（源平衡聚合nMASE与nCRPS）。进一步以两个海上油井监测场景为案例，用振荡器增强的仿真流程改进通用模拟器覆盖率，并对比三种训练配方。

Result: TimesFM-3取得最低源平衡聚合nMASE与nCRPS，并在两项指标下各领先9个来源中的7个；源特定例外说明需领域代表性评估。案例中振荡器增强仿真降低目标领域预测误差，但削弱原生单变量GIFT-Eval子集性能；50/50混合配方在全部四个事件-指标对上误差最低，并挽回大部分GIFT-Eval性能损失。

Conclusion: 领域代表性评估既能指导模型选择，也能指导仿真数据配比设计，但揭示了专精化与通用性之间的权衡。

Abstract: We introduce IND-Eval, a public benchmark that organizes industrial time series across domains into source-specific forecasting tasks. Relative to established benchmarks such as GIFT-Eval, it emphasizes finer sampling resolutions and a greater prevalence of multivariate forecasting. Evaluating Chronos-2, TiRex-2, and TimesFM-3, we find that TimesFM-3 achieves the lowest source-balanced aggregate nMASE and nCRPS and leads seven of nine sources under each metric; source-specific exceptions reinforce the need for domain-representative evaluation for model selection. These findings also motivate improving domain alignment during pretraining, where real industrial data are often too scarce to close domain-specific gaps directly; we therefore investigate whether a domain's statistical structure can guide simulator design. In a case study on two offshore well-monitoring regimes, we improve a general simulator's coverage using an oscillator-augmented simulation pipeline. This lowers forecasting error in the target domain but reduces performance on the subset of GIFT-Eval with natively univariate targets. A 50/50 mixture of the general and augmented simulation recipes achieves the lowest error among the three training recipes for all four event-metric pairs in the case study while recovering most of the lost GIFT-Eval performance. Together, these results illustrate how domain-representative evaluation can guide model selection and the composition of simulated data while revealing a trade-off between specialization and generality.

</details>


### [1403] [Counting with Attention and LayerNorm: Norm Scaling and Representation Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16653)
*Ayyub Shaffy,Manoj Dhakal,Safal Shrestha,Keith W. Ross*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究单层注意力中计数任务的参数成本，分析 softmax 注意力与层归一化位置如何影响计数表示的参数范数上界 B_min，并给出回归与分类两种读出方式的理论 rates 及实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计数对 transformer 是简单任务，但在长序列上会失败。作者希望从单注意力层的角度，理解 softmax 注意力和 layer normalization 如何塑造计数恢复的表示，并量化精确计数所需的参数范数成本。

Method: 在最大长度 L 下研究单层注意力的计数能力，聚焦回归读出并兼顾分类读出。通过定义 B_min（保证舍入后精确计数所需的最小训练向量范数上界），推导不同注意力与归一化配置下的紧致增长 rates；并在 post-normalized 模型上进行实验。

Result: 回归任务中，未归一化线性注意力可在与 L 无关的参数范数下精确计数；softmax 回归需舍入且参数范数随 L 增长。固定模型维度下，B_min 在无归一化时按 L 增长，bare post-normalization 下按 L^{3/2} 增长，learned post-normalization 下按 L^{3/4} 增长。bare pre-normalization 会限制注意力分数，超过有限长度后任何参数范数都不够。分类读出在所有归一化位置下范数有界，但 dense head 存储成本随计数增加。实验复现了两种读出的差异。

Conclusion: 该研究刻画了自注意力、层归一化位置和读出选择如何共同决定单头最小架构中计数表示的几何与参数成本，并揭示了 learned post-normalization 以更小范数计数的反直觉现象。

Abstract: Counting is a simple task on which transformers can nevertheless fail at long sequence lengths. We study the cost of counting in a single attention layer, up to a maximum length $L$, focusing on how softmax attention and layer normalization shape the representation from which the count is recovered. We mainly focus on regression read-out but also consider classification read-out. For regression, we show unnormalized linear attention counts exactly at parameter norms independent of $L$. For softmax attention, regression cannot count exactly with finite parameters; it recovers the count after rounding, but only when the vector parameter norms grow with $L$. We measure this cost by $B_{\min}$, the smallest bound that can be placed on every trainable vector to ensure exact counting after rounding, and derive tight rates. At fixed model dimension, $B_{\min}$ grows as $L$ without normalization, as $L^{3/2}$ under bare post-normalization, and as $L^{3/4}$ with learned post-normalization. The last rate is unexpected: post-normalization discards the magnitude that carries the count and might be expected to make counting harder, yet with a learnable gain it counts at a smaller norm than softmax without normalization. Bare pre-normalization is different: it bounds the attention scores, so beyond a finite length no parameter norm suffices. A classification read-out keeps every norm bounded under every placement, but a dense head stores one output vector per count and costs more in storage. Experiments on the post-normalized model reproduce this split between the two read-outs. Together, our theoretical and empirical findings characterize how self-attention, layer-normalization placement, and read-out choice shape the representation geometry and parameter cost of counting in the minimal single-head architecture studied here.

</details>


### [1404] [Guidance Without Labels: Flow Matching from Coupled Gaussian Mixtures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16654)
*Stanislas Ducotterd,Bassam El Rawas,Michael Unser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将流匹配的高斯源替换为拟合的高斯混合，并通过熵最优传输耦合数据点与混合分量，得到的传输等价于标准高斯源问题加一个引导式校正项，从而可复用预训练速度场。在CIFAR-10和CelebA-HQ上以更少步数取得更优FID。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准流匹配模型将高斯源与数据分布独立配对传输，配对方式可能次优。作者希望用更贴合数据结构的源分布（高斯混合）并借助最优传输获得更好耦合，同时避免从头训练大模型。

Method: 用拟合的高斯混合替代高斯源，通过熵最优传输将每个数据点耦合到某个混合分量。证明所得传输在标准高斯源问题基础上仅差一个引导式校正项，因此可复用预训练速度场。该校正项为拟合混合的闭式函数，另加一个由小型校正网络学习的项。

Result: 在已发布的CIFAR-10与CelebA-HQ检查点上测试：所有步数下FID均改善；在CelebA-HQ上约用一半步数即达到基线质量。仅闭式项（无需训练）已带来大部分提升，小型校正网络贡献其余部分。

Conclusion: 通过高斯混合源与熵最优传输耦合及引导式校正，可在复用预训练速度场的前提下改善流匹配生成质量与采样效率。

Abstract: Flow matching models are typically trained to transport a Gaussian source to the data distribution, with source and target samples paired independently. We replace the source with a fitted Gaussian mixture and couple each data point to a mixture component through an entropic optimal transport problem. We show that the resulting transport reduces to the standard Gaussian-source problem up to a guidance-like correction, which enables the reuse of a pretrained velocity field. This correction is a closed-form function of the fitted mixture plus a term that we learn with a small correction network. We test our model on published checkpoints for CIFAR-10 and CelebA-HQ. It improves FID at every step count, and on CelebA-HQ it reaches the quality of the baseline with about half the steps. The closed-form term alone, with no training, already delivers most of this improvement; the small correction network accounts for the rest.

</details>


### [1405] [Compression Through Time: An Interplay of Separability, Stationarity and Capacity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16660)
*Nikolaus Kopp,Franz Pernkopf,Bernhard Geiger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究离散化LSTM中信息论压缩的时间动态，发现序列末端出现明显压缩，并由类可分性、时间平稳性和网络容量三种机制共同决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信息论与几何压缩已被广泛用于解释泛化，但循环网络中的压缩时间动态尚不清楚，作者希望揭示压缩何时、为何发生及其对泛化的影响。

Method: 使用离散化LSTM（有限嵌入空间便于直接估计信息量），提出并检验三种竞争机制：类可分性、共享循环动态下随激活状态传播的压缩压力（依赖时间平稳性）、有限表征容量对持续压缩的对抗作用；通过受控合成干预与真实序列任务系统测试。

Result: 在多个数据集的最后时间步观察到显著压缩；类可分性、时间平稳性和网络容量被确认为时间压缩的关键决定因素。

Conclusion: 压缩可充当正则化：当存在多余容量时可能有益，但若消耗任务所需记忆则有害于泛化。

Abstract: Information-theoretic and geometric compression have been widely studied as possible explanations for generalization. Yet their temporal dynamics in recurrent networks remain largely unexplored. Using discretized LSTMs, whose finite embedding space enables direct estimates of information quantities, we observe pronounced compression across the final timesteps of many datasets. We explain this effect through three competing mechanisms: (i) class separability permits stronger compression at the final timestep; (ii) shared recurrent dynamics propagate this pressure across timesteps with similar activation states, making its extent depend on temporal stationarity; and (iii) limited representational capacity opposes prolonged compression because it restricts information available for subsequent computation. We systematically test these mechanisms through controlled synthetic interventions and real-world sequence tasks. Our results identify class separability, temporal stationarity, and network capacity as key determinants of temporal compression, and suggest that compression acts as a regularizer-potentially beneficial when excess capacity is available, but harmful to generalization when it consumes memory needed for the task.

</details>


### [1406] [Making LoRA Identifiable: Orthogonal Alignment for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16664)
*Pratik Rakesh Singh,Mohammadi Zaki,Akash Saha,Aneesh Mukkamala,Pankaj Wasnik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SOAR两阶段框架，通过Stiefel流形约束与正交Procrustes对齐解决持续LoRA学习的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PEFT用于持续学习可降低训练成本并缓解灾难性遗忘，但现有方法（每任务新LoRA分支、正交损失、门控）内存随任务数线性增长；单LoRA方法虽省内存却存在LoRA参数空间表示对齐不足。

Method: 两阶段框架：1）约束A矩阵位于Stiefel流形上，将坐标错位化简到正交旋转矩阵空间；2）对B矩阵引入正交Procrustes对齐估计最优旋转，并配合逐秩保留合并策略，量化新旧任务表示间的方向一致性。

Result: 在多个模型和基准上广泛实验，证明SOAR在无额外内存开销的情况下取得强持续学习性能。

Conclusion: SOAR通过几何对齐实现高效持续LoRA学习，兼顾性能与可扩展性。

Abstract: There is growing interest in applying Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) to Continual Learning, as it enables faster training, mitigates catastrophic forgetting, and facilitates better adaptation to new tasks. Prior approaches have explored a range of strategies, including extending new LoRA branches for each incoming task, training under orthogonal loss objectives across all task-specific LoRA modules, and employing gating mechanisms to integrate new and existing LoRA modules. However, these methods incur memory costs that grow linearly with the number of tasks, limiting their scalability. More recent approaches investigate training a single LoRA by leveraging asymmetries in its parameterization; however, they often suffer from insufficient representational alignment across the LoRA parameter space. To address these limitations, we propose Stiefel Optimization and Aligned Rotation (SOAR), a two-stage framework for continual LoRA learning. First, we constrain the A matrix to lie on the Stiefel manifold, thereby reducing coordinate misalignment to the space of orthogonal rotation matrices. Second, we introduce an Orthogonal Procrustes alignment procedure for the B matrix to estimate the optimal rotation, coupled with a per-rank retention merging strategy that quantifies directional agreement between representations of new and previously learned tasks. We conduct extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks, demonstrating that SOAR achieves strong continual learning performance without incurring additional memory overhead.

</details>


### [1407] [Feature-Context Consistency: Unsupervised Adversarial Detection with Drift Stability on Attributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16694)
*Firas Bayram,Maxime Cordy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CB-RBM：利用特征-上下文一致性（CB 分数）作为单一结构信号，在无标签、存在分布漂移的演化属性图上实现对抗检测，并提供最坏情况理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 演化属性图上的对抗检测面临两大挑战：欺诈标签迟到或缺失，以及自然分布漂移侵蚀已训练决策边界。现有检测器在有标签、分布稳定时效果好，但无标签且漂移下难以维持。

Method: 识别"特征-上下文一致性"（节点属性与聚合邻域属性的对齐）作为同时应对两大挑战的结构信号，并在受限玻尔兹曼机框架内将其形式化为 Context Boost (CB) 分数（CB-RBM）。理论上证明两个最坏情况保证：(1) 合法节点与对抗节点期望 CB 的严格分离，且当对抗者上下文远离合法邻域上下文时，间隙随模型容量线性增长；(2) CB 分布在自然漂移下的 Wasserstein-Lipschitz 界。

Result: 在 XBlock 以太坊钓鱼（约15.3万节点）与 Reddit 封禁用户检测（约1.1万节点）上验证，附录另含两个跨领域数据集。零标签下 CB-RBM 在四种对抗攻击上 AUROC ≥ 0.96，漂移下 FPR 接近校准目标 5%，优于监督 GNN（数百标签）、无监督图异常基线，以及 FPR 崩溃至 89–100% 的标准 RBM。

Conclusion: 通常需要独立机制实现的无标签运行与漂移稳定性，在此可由数据的单一结构规律导出。代码已开源。

Abstract: Adversarial detection on evolving attributed graphs faces two challenges: fraud labels arrive late or not at all, and natural distributional drift erodes any trained decision boundary. Modern detectors can reach strong detection rates when labels are available and the distribution is stationary; sustaining that quality without labels and under drift is the open problem. We identify feature-context consistency -- the alignment between a node's attributes and its aggregated neighborhood attributes -- as a single structural signal that addresses both. We formalize it as the Context Boost (CB) score within a Restricted Boltzmann Machine framework (CB-RBM) and prove two complementary worst-case guarantees: a strict separation between the expected CB of legitimate and adversarial nodes, with gap growing linearly in model capacity, whenever the adversary's context stays far enough from legitimate neighborhood context; and a Wasserstein-Lipschitz bound on how far the CB distribution moves under natural drift. We validate on XBlock Ethereum phishing (~153K nodes) and Reddit banned-user detection (~11K nodes), with two further datasets in the appendix spanning diverse domains. With zero labels, CB-RBM achieves AUROC >= 0.96 on four adversarial attacks and keeps FPR close to its calibrated 5% target under drift -- outperforming supervised GNNs (hundreds of labels), unsupervised graph-anomaly baselines, and a standard RBM whose FPR collapses to 89-100%. What typically requires separate mechanisms -- label-free operation and drift stability -- here follows from a single structural regularity of the data. Code: https://github.com/serval-uni-lu/CB-RBM.

</details>


### [1408] [Attention-Graph Curvature for the Verification of Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16709)
*Kanghyeon Kim,Johannes F. Lutzeyer,Yanzhu Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究注意力图的有向Forman曲率是否包含推理步骤正确性信息，并将其作为特征加入步骤级验证器，在ProcessBench上提升了验证性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型能解Erdős问题和IMO题，但自然语言解答无法被证明助手验证，错误步骤会污染后续推理，因此需要尽早检测错误。已有方法基于前向传播特征做快速验证，本文探索注意力图曲率这一局部几何量是否携带步骤正确性信息。

Method: 计算模型注意力图上的有向Forman曲率（由某条边周围注意力权重得到的局部量），将曲率值追加到四种步骤级验证器的输入中，在ProcessBench上进行对比评估。

Result: 追加曲率值提升了四种验证器的整体平均性能；以步骤中每个token为输入的ReProbe提升最大；引入曲率使语言模型前向传播时间平均增加18%。

Conclusion: 注意力图的有向Forman曲率确实蕴含步骤正确性信息，可作为有效特征增强步骤级验证器，但需付出约18%的前向计算开销。

Abstract: Language models have recently solved open Erdős problems and achieved gold-medal level performance on International Mathematical Olympiad problems. But their solutions, written in natural language, cannot yet be verified by proof assistants. An erroneous reasoning step can invalidate every step that comes after, so it is advantageous to detect errors early. Several methods have been proposed to detect erroneous reasoning quickly based on the features of the forward pass of the language model that performs reasoning. In this work, we study whether the directed Forman curvature of that model's attention graph, a local quantity computed at an edge from the attention weights around it, carries information about a step's correctness. To do so, we evaluate four per-step verifiers on ProcessBench with and without the curvature appended to their input. Appending curvature values improves the overall mean performance of all four verifiers. ReProbe, the verifier that takes every token of a step as input, shows the largest improvement. Adding the curvature increases the time of the language model's forward pass by 18% on average.

</details>


### [1409] [Learn from Move: the Next Step for GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16720)
*Jiahao Lu,Yize Shen,Chuanyuan Tan,Mianqiu Huang,Shicheng Fang,Xinchi Chen,Yining Zheng,Yuxin Wang,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 LatentGUIWorld 基准与 MOVE 框架，训练 LatentLearner-9B 在需交互探索的环境中学习控制，RL 后 egocentric Drag 与 Ten-Choice 成功率分别达 92.0% 和 75.3%，并能改进 GUI grounding。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GUI agent 基准主要通过延长任务跨度来增加难度，但"在陌生环境中探索并成功完成任务"这一关键挑战仍未被充分评测。

Method: 构建 LatentGUIWorld 基准：6 个任务按控制所需证据分为 I0（先验知识+观测）、I1（交互揭示隐藏语义）、I2（从动作-响应关系识别动力学）三对。提出 MOVE，将移动与按键事件分离并暴露中间视觉反馈，配合迭代探索与控制的示范。采用 SFT 与联合 RL 训练 LatentLearner-9B。

Result: 前沿模型在 I2 任务上尤其困难。消融表明动作粒度与多步示范均有提升。SFT 后 LatentLearner-9B 总体成功率 50.0%，媲美部分前沿模型；联合 RL 将 egocentric Drag 与 Ten-Choice 提升至 92.0% 和 75.3%。egocentric Drag 中误差归一化命令与理想增益补偿的 Pearson 相关从 0.610 升至 0.803。相同格式 RL 后 GUI grounding 五基准平均 67.37%，优于常规 RL 的 66.72%。

Conclusion: 模型可通过交互学习探索并适应环境动力学；MOVE 格式同时有助于提升 GUI grounding 表现。

Abstract: Existing benchmarks for GUI agents primarily focus on increasing task difficulty by extending task horizons. Besides, enabling agents to explore unfamiliar environments and successfully complete tasks within them is also a critical yet challenging problem. We introduce LatentGUIWorld, a benchmark of six tasks in three matched pairs organized by the evidence needed for control: $I_0$ uses prior knowledge and available observations, $I_1$ requires interaction that directly reveals hidden semantics, and $I_2$ identifies dynamics from action-response relationships. Frontier models struggle especially on $I_2$ tasks. We introduce MOVE, which separates movement from button events and exposes intermediate visual feedback, together with demonstrations of iterative exploration and control. Ablations show that both action granularity and multi-step demonstrations improve performance. After SFT, LatentLearner-9B achieves 50.0% overall success on LatentGUIWorld, comparable to several frontier models. Joint RL further raises egocentric Drag and Ten-Choice success to 92.0% and 75.3%. Behavioral analysis reveals multi-step exploration. In egocentric Drag, RL increases Pearson correlation between error-normalized commands and ideal gain compensation from 0.610 to 0.803. Together, these behaviors show that models learn to explore through interaction and adapt their control to environment dynamics. The same format improves GUI grounding after RL, reaching 67.37% mean accuracy across five benchmarks versus 66.72% for conventional RL.

</details>


### [1410] [Before Attention Sinks Form: Hidden-State Geometry Reveals and Modulates Their Formation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16745)
*Fan Yang,Yue Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究注意力sink形成前的隐藏状态变化：发现在sink形成前约2-3层存在可测量的谱结构信号，且仅修改隐藏状态的奇异值即可因果性地改变后续sink行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究多在注意力sink形成之后进行分析，本文反其道而行，追问sink形成前是否存在可测量的隐藏状态几何变化，以及改变这一几何是否会影响后续sink的形成。

Method: 为排除网络深度干扰，在同一模型、同一层内比较不同prompt；利用隐藏状态的简单谱摘要来预测sink时序；随后在注意力已计算完成后，仅对后层隐藏状态的奇异值进行干预，并与范数匹配的随机谱扰动对照，测试其在Qwen2.5、GLM-Z1、GPT-OSS上的效果。

Result: 隐藏状态的谱摘要能在现有注意力之外提供额外信息，最清晰的prompt特异性信号出现在sink形成前约2-3层的短窗口内，且信号强于单一极端激活值；预测力随cohort变化。谱干预可改变后续sink行为；在Qwen2.5中伴随下一层对位置0的query-key偏好下降，且所学谱方向在较少训练数据下仍稳定。

Conclusion: 注意力sink形成前存在短暂的隐藏状态谱重组，直接扰动该几何可以因果性地改变后续sink的形成，说明谱结构是sink出现的前兆而非事后现象。

Abstract: Attention sinks are usually studied after they have formed. We ask whether a measurable hidden-state change appears beforehand and whether changing that geometry alters what happens later. To remove network depth as a shortcut, we compare prompts in the same model and at the same layer. When sink timing varies across prompts, simple spectral summaries of the hidden states add information beyond current attention, with the clearest prompt-specific signal in a short window about two to three layers before sink formation. The predictive strength varies across cohorts, so we treat the spectrum as a readout of a pre-sink state change rather than a universal warning statistic. The signal is broader than one measured extreme activation. We then modify only the singular values of the post-layer hidden states after current attention has already been computed. These interventions change later sink behavior in Qwen2.5, GLM-Z1, and GPT-OSS relative to norm-matched random spectral perturbations. In Qwen2.5, the immediate suppressive effect is accompanied by a reduction in next-layer query--key preference for position~0, and the learned spectral directions remain stable when estimated from substantially less training data. Together, the results show that attention sinks are preceded by a short spectral reorganization of hidden states, and directly perturbing this geometry can causally alter subsequent sink formation.

</details>


### [1411] [NFMap: Topographic 2D Manifold Learning with Invertible Normalizing Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16750)
*Héléna Alexandra Gaspar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NFMap将生成式拓扑映射(GTM)与双射归一化流结合，实现具有固定混合网格先验、显式似然和可逆映射的2D可视化降维方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GTM的潜在到数据映射是灵活性有限的RBF网络，无法实现完全可逆、任意位置回映数据空间的能力，且在大数据集上存在地图拥挤问题。

Method: 在2D潜在地图上放置固定混合网格先验，将GTM的RBF映射替换为归一化流使其完全可逆；潜空间与数据同维，拆分为2维可导航地图与off-manifold残差，并支持重尾Student-t混合成分以缓解拥挤。

Result: 具备参数化嵌入、显式似然与投影新点能力，似然在化学数据集上是有效的OOD信号；流的目标惩罚体积收缩，残差被压缩的方差必须重现于可导航地图。

Conclusion: 残差尺度是局部邻域保真度与全局距离保真度之间的主要控制量，其效果依赖数据维度并与潜在网格范围耦合。

Abstract: We present NFMap, a dimensionality reduction method for 2D visualisation that extends Generative Topographic Mapping (GTM) with a bijective normalizing flow. Like GTM, NFMap places a fixed mixture grid prior over a 2D latent map, giving a parametric embedding, an explicit likelihood, and the ability to project new points onto an existing map; the likelihood is an effective out-of-distribution signal on chemical datasets. Unlike GTM, whose latent-to-data mapping is an RBF network of bounded flexibility, NFMap's mapping is a normalizing flow, and is therefore fully invertible: any location on the map can be carried back to data space. To alleviate map crowding on large datasets, NFMap additionally supports heavy-tailed Student-t mixture components. NFMap maps data to a latent space of the same dimension, split into a 2-dimensional navigable map and an off-manifold residual. Because the flow is bijective and its objective penalises volume contraction, variance squeezed out of the residual must reappear in the navigable map. The residual scale is the main control between local neighbourhood fidelity and global distance fidelity; its effect depends on the dimensionality of the data and is coupled to the extent of the latent grid.

</details>


### [1412] [Is the Platform Part of the Measurement? A Protocol and Simulation Study for Cross-Platform Equivalence of Machine-Labelled Policy Sentiment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16757)
*Asad Ikram,Ella Haig*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出跨平台比较机器标注情感时隐含"同一分类器在各平台测量同一构念、同一量表"的假设，主张用心理测量学工具把"平台"建模为测量面向，并提出一套六步协议来检验平台分数能否直接合并。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
