Motivation: 跨平台情感比较已成惯例，平台间分类器分数差异被直接解读为舆论差异，但这依赖分类器在各平台测量同一构念、同一尺度的假设；已有研究仅逐平台检验效度，无人将平台建模为分类器测量的一个面向。

Method: 将心理测量等值性工具箱（概化理论、测量不变性与DIF、分数链接）迁移到机器标注的政策情感，把平台视为调查模式；提出含预注册锚事件、锚密度审计与双分类器收敛控制的六步协议。用已知真值的模拟（500次重复）演示，并以作者硕士论文中的微调BERT分类器（英经济政策评论255,446条，覆盖Twitter/X、Reddit、YouTube、Quora）作案例。

Result: 模拟中，因各平台通过不同测量函数测量，直接采信平台分数的合并指数在近四分之一的日期上给出错误的总体情感符号；而用各平台已知测量函数调整后的指数平均不到六十分之一天出错。

Conclusion: 该协议可让研究者判断在特定语料中合并平台是否可辩护，或平台分数是否必须先链接再取平均；完整的四平台应用被指定为后续研究。

Abstract: Comparing machine-labelled sentiment across social media platforms is now routine: differences in classifier scores between platforms are read as differences in public opinion. These comparisons rest on an assumption that the classifier measures the same construct, on the same scale, on every platform. Some studies check a classifier's validity platform by platform, but to our knowledge none has modelled the platform as a facet of the classifier's measurement. We adapt the psychometric equivalence toolkit (generalizability theory, measurement invariance and differential item functioning, and score linking) to machine-labelled policy sentiment, treating the platform as a survey mode, and specify a six-step protocol with anchor events fixed in advance, an anchor-density audit, and a two-classifier convergence control. A simulation with known ground truth illustrates what the assumption can cost in one generating configuration fixed in advance: across 500 replications, because the platforms measure through different functions, a pooled index that takes platform scores at face value reports the wrong sign of aggregate sentiment on nearly a quarter of days, whereas an index adjusted with each platform's known measurement function does so on under one day in sixty on average. A case study of the instrument from the first author's MSc dissertation, a fine-tuned BERT classifier over 255,446 UK economic-policy comments from Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, and Quora, motivates the design and illustrates the instrument-dependence the protocol addresses. The full four-platform application, under fresh collection with the pre-specified design, is the designated follow-up study. The protocol lets a researcher test whether pooling platforms is defensible in a given corpus, or whether platform scores must be linked before any average is taken.

</details>


### [1413] [Relational Learning as World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16763)
*Zheyu Zhang,Gjergji Kasneci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出TabWM，将每个操作性系统视为关系型"世界"，通过观察到的执行轨迹在上下文中推断该系统行为，预测新动作引起的稀疏结构化编辑，无需参数更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统关系学习从数据库状态预测，但决策需要回答状态在动作下如何变化。该变化依赖数据库本身不可见的系统特定动态，因此需要能从观察执行中推断系统行为的方法。

Method: 引入TabWM（表格世界模型）及WorldRel（可执行关系世界生成器，用于预训练）。给定未见世界的执行轨迹，TabWM将其作为上下文，预测新动作引起的稀疏结构化编辑，无需参数更新；预测的编辑可递归应用以想象候选未来、比较动作。

Result: 在512个留出世界上，完整编辑F1从无执行时的0.016提升到64次执行时的0.685（正确编辑需匹配操作、关系位置和值）。对预测未来进行更广泛搜索可提升所选动作序列的实际回报。

Conclusion: 关系动态可在上下文中学习，将关系学习从建模系统状态扩展到建模状态在动作下如何变化。

Abstract: Relational learning typically predicts from a database state, but decision making asks a different question: how will that state change under an action? In operational systems, the answer depends on system-specific dynamics that may not be visible in the database itself. We view each such system as a relational "world" and ask whether a model can infer how it behaves from observed executions. We introduce TabWM (Tabular World Model) and WorldRel, a generator of executable relational worlds for pretraining. Given executions from an unseen world, TabWM uses them as context to predict the sparse structured edits caused by a new action without parameter updates. Across 512 held-out worlds, complete-edit F1 rises from 0.016 with no observed executions to 0.685 with 64, where a correct edit must match its operation, relational location, and value. Because these predictions are explicit relational edits, they can be applied recursively to imagine candidate futures and compare actions before they are taken. Broader search over these predicted futures improves the realized return of selected action sequences. Together, these results suggest that relational dynamics can be learned in context, broadening relational learning from modeling system state to modeling how that state changes under action.

</details>


### [1414] [Efficient Preconditioned Optimization Methods with Frequent Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16792)
*Sifan Yang,Yuanyu Wan,Yibo Wang,Lijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过频繁方向(FD)矩阵草图技术加速预条件优化方法，提出FTSL及FTSL-Shampoo等算法，降低计算开销并取得更紧的遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应优化方法虽实证性能强，但需维护预条件矩阵，在大规模应用中计算开销过高，因此作者希望借助频繁方向(FD)矩阵草图技术来加速预条件优化方法。

Method: 1) 将FD与自适应次梯度方法结合，在原对偶框架下提出FTSL，并加回FD丢弃的累积信息；2) 用倍增技巧进一步降低FTSL时间复杂度；3) 针对矩阵型决策变量，利用结构性质构造草图预条件矩阵，提出FTSL-Shampoo并给出原对偶分析；4) 设计单边变体(镜像下降与原对偶框架)；5) 扩展到离线随机凸优化，利用光滑性加速收敛；6) 提出实用变体并实验验证。

Result: FTSL获得比现有最优结果更紧的遗憾界；倍增技巧在保持相同遗憾保证下降低时间复杂度；FTSL-Shampoo及其单边变体不仅减少计算成本，还取得更紧的遗憾界；离线随机凸优化中利用光滑性实现更快收敛率；实验证明方法在广泛任务上高效有效。

Conclusion: 基于频繁方向的草图预条件优化框架能有效兼顾理论保证与计算效率，适用于大规模及矩阵型优化问题，并具实际应用价值。

Abstract: Adaptive optimization methods have received considerable attention in recent years due to their strong empirical performance. However, they generally require maintaining a preconditioning matrix, which incurs prohibitive computational overhead in large-scale applications. To address these limitations, we investigate the acceleration of preconditioned optimization methods through frequent directions (FD), a widely used matrix sketching technique. We first propose FTSL by integrating FD with adaptive subgradient methods under the primal-dual framework and adding back the cumulative information discarded by FD. FTSL obtains a tighter regret bound than existing state-of-the-art results. We then apply a doubling trick that further reduces the time complexity of FTSL, while maintaining the same regret guarantee. We also consider optimization over matrix-valued decision variables and exploit their structural properties to construct sketched preconditioners. We develop FTSL-Shampoo by adapting FD to Shampoo and give a novel analysis under the primal-dual framework. To further mitigate its computational complexity, we design one-sided variants of FTSL-Shampoo under both mirror descent and primal-dual frameworks. Our algorithms not only reduce the computational cost of FTSL-Shampoo, but also achieve tighter regret bounds. We extend our methods to offline stochastic convex optimization and exploit smoothness to achieve faster convergence rates. Finally, we introduce practical variants of our algorithms and empirically demonstrate their efficiency and effectiveness across a broad range of tasks.

</details>


### [1415] [TPPO: Tracking-Value PPO For Language Model Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16794)
*Futing Wang,Chenxi Li,Jianhao Yan,Yun Luo,Zhi Wang,Yizhuo Li,Runzhe Zhan,Yu Cheng,Tao Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TV-PPO，通过累积式价值参数化在log-odds空间实现逐位置加性更新，更好追踪token级信用，提升语言模型推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准critic在稀疏终端奖励下难以追踪沿轨迹的价值演化，而价值演化刻画了token级相对信用，这对PPO用于可验证奖励的语言模型推理很重要。

Method: 分析相邻前缀价值关系，证明其满足贝叶斯分解且在log-odds空间为加性更新；据此设计Tracking-Value PPO（TV-PPO），将逐位置标量输出累加为价值logits，并用终端结果监督重建后的价值。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base与Qwen3-8B-Base上数学推理总分比PPO分别提升7.0和8.4分，改善分布外泛化，并在Qwen3-4B、Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B、Qwen3.5-9B及countdown、科学编程任务上均有增益。

Conclusion: TV-PPO能更准确追踪价值演化、提供更可靠的优势估计，是提升语言模型推理的有效方法，代码已开源。

Abstract: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for language-model reasoning. While \emph{value evolution along trajectory} characterizes relative token-level credit, yet standard critics often fail to track it under sparse terminal rewards. To model this evolution, we analyze the relation between successive prefix values and show that they admit a Bayesian decomposition with additive updates in log-odds space. We use this additive structure to construct Tracking-Value PPO (\method), a cumulative value parameterization that sums position-wise scalar outputs into value logits. These outputs are learned through terminal-outcome supervision on the reconstructed values. \method improves aggregate mathematical reasoning scores over PPO by 7.0 and 8.4 points on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, respectively, while improving out-of-distribution generalization. Gains extend to Qwen3-4B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen3.5-9B and to countdown, and scientific coding tasks. Further analysis shows more accurate tracking of value evolution and more reliable advantage estimates. Our code is publicly available in https://github.com/LINs-lab/TPPO.

</details>


### [1416] [One-Layer Transformers Provably Learn In-Context K-Nearest Neighbor Prediction with Chain-of-Thought](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16798)
*Lyumin Wu,Yuan Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论上研究一层Transformer如何通过思维链(CoT)习得K近邻(K-NN)推理能力，证明无CoT时K>1不可解，并给出CoT构造及梯度下降可学到的证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CoT虽在复杂推理任务上经验成功，但其推理能力如何在训练中涌现的机制缺乏理论理解，尤其K-NN等任务中softmax注意力难以直接关注第2至第K近邻。

Method: 采用可完全分析的in-context K-NN预测设定，一层Transformer。先对奇数K>1的良好分离二分类任务给出严格负面结果；再显式构造一层Transformer通过CoT求解K-NN；进一步在风格化训练设定下证明梯度下降可恢复该构造。

Result: 证明了K>1时一层Transformer无CoT无法求解K-NN的负面结果；给出CoT下的显式构造与梯度下降可学习性证明；训练所得模型还能泛化到比训练分析更广的测试类。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了CoT如何扩展Transformer学习与求解原本困难任务的能力，为推理能力涌现提供理论解释。

Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) enables transformers to solve complex reasoning tasks by generating intermediate reasoning steps. Despite strong empirical success, the mechanisms by which such reasoning abilities emerge during training remain poorly understood, particularly from a theoretical perspective. In this work, we study this question in a stylized yet fully analyzable setting: in-context $\mathrm{K}$-nearest-neighbor ($\mathrm{K}$-NN) prediction with a one-layer transformer. Earlier work has demonstrated that one-layer transformers can be trained to perform $1$-NN without CoT (Li et al., 2024a) by having the softmax attention attend to the nearest neighbor in context. However, this result on $1$-NN cannot be extended to $\mathrm{K}$-NN for $K>1$, as softmax attention is much less naturally suited to attending to the 2nd through $K$-th nearest neighbors. We first give a rigorous negative result showing that this limitation already appears on a well-separated class of binary classification tasks for odd $K>1$. We then give an explicit construction of a one-layer transformer, and show that it can solve $\mathrm{K}$-NN via CoT reasoning. We further prove that, under a stylized training setup, gradient descent can recover this construction, thereby showing that transformers can acquire the capability to solve $\mathrm{K}$-NN through training. In addition, we show that the resulting trained model applies to a broader test class than that assumed in the training analysis. Our results shed light on how CoT expands the ability of transformers to learn and solve tasks that are otherwise hard to solve.

</details>


### [1417] [DASS: A Solver-Adaptable Dynamic Auxiliary Search Strategy for Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16812)
*Yuxiao Hu,Qian Li,Ding Wang,Yekun Zheng,Jinyue Yan,Yuntian Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DASS——一种可适配任意求解器的动态辅助搜索策略，通过构建并精化高潜力辅助搜索子空间来提升符号回归的精度与效率平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 符号回归搜索空间巨大、组合爆炸严重，现有方法难以在精度与算法效率间取得良好折衷。作者认为除了设计复杂的求解器专用策略外，提供可共享的可靠搜索引导同样有前景。

Method: DASS将辅助搜索空间表示为高潜力基函数项张成的函数子空间；通过多环境评估估计项效用，过滤不稳定引导，并用Gibbs后验更新项潜力分数以校准子空间；求解器产出的高质量解又用于更新基项集合，形成"子空间引导求解器、求解器反馈重塑子空间"的闭环优化。DASS可轻松集成到多种SR求解器。

Result: 在LLM-SRBench上的大量实验表明，DASS显著提升原求解器的精度，而运行时间增加可控。

Conclusion: DASS作为通用可插拔的辅助搜索策略，为符号回归提供可靠搜索引导，在精度与效率间实现更优折衷，并具备跨求解器适配能力。

Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover interpretable mathematical expressions from data and plays a key role in scientific discovery. However, existing methods face a common bottleneck: the enormous search space and severe combinatorial explosion make it difficult to achieve a favorable trade-off between accuracy and algorithmic efficiency. We argue that, in addition to designing increasingly complex solver-specific SR strategies, an equally promising direction is to equip them with a shareable auxiliary strategy that can provide reliable search guidance. To this end, we propose DASS, a solver-adaptable Dynamic Auxiliary Search Strategy that improves SR by constructing and refining a high-potential auxiliary search subspace. DASS represents the auxiliary search space as a functional subspace spanned by a set of high-potential basis function terms. It estimates term utility through multi-environment evaluation, filters unstable guidance, and updates term potential scores with a Gibbs posterior, thereby calibrating the subspace to provide more reliable guidance for downstream solvers. The high-quality solutions produced by the solver are used to update the set of basis terms. This forms a virtuous closed-loop optimization process: the subspace guides the downstream solver, and the solver feedback reshapes the subspace for subsequent exploration. DASS can be easily integrated with various types of SR solvers. Extensive experiments on LLM-SRBench show that DASS significantly improves the accuracy of original solvers with a manageable increase in runtime.

</details>


### [1418] [Mean Accuracy Is the Wrong Estimand for a Release Decision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16825)
*Jaewon Choi,Jihye Kang,Namhyuk Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出发布决策关注的是重跑时的灾难性尾部风险，而标准基准只报告过去种子的平均准确率，两者根本不同。作者提出"recipe cards"框架，用精确有限样本二项界直接认证重跑尾部失败率，将预算违规从48%降至0.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发布微调模型是对其训练配方下一次重跑的操作性承诺，但标准评测只给出历史种子平均准确率，无法反映尾部灾难风险。由于微调会引发双峰模式坍塌，高平均准确率常掩盖严重失败率。作者审计2124个微调模型发现，基于平均准确率的发布决策在48%情况下违反10%部署失败预算，常用启发式方法如b̄−2σ在小样本上低估方差，证据最弱时反而最宽松。

Method: 提出recipe cards评估框架，使用精确的有限样本二项界直接认证重跑尾部失败率，并设置数学样本下限（N≥22）防止在证据薄弱时认证，同时在领域和任务迁移下明确拒绝未经验证的声明。

Result: 在11个语言模型、2124个微调模型的审计中，recipe cards将留出预算违规率从48.0%降至0.6%，并通过样本下限和拒绝机制防止薄弱证据下的错误认证。

Conclusion: 标准基准的平均准确率报告不足以支撑模型发布决策，应采用recipe cards等直接认证重跑尾部失败率的方法，以确保符合部署失败预算。

Abstract: A release decision about a fine-tuned model is an operational commitment about the \emph{next} rerun of its training recipe. Yet standard benchmark reporting gives only the mean accuracy of past seeds. These target fundamentally different questions: release decisions depend on catastrophic tail risk, whereas standard evaluation reports only central tendency. Because fine-tuning induces bimodal mode collapse, high average accuracy frequently conceals severe failure rates. Auditing $2\,124$ fine-tuned models across eleven language models, we show that shipping models based on mean accuracy violates a $10\%$ deployment failure budget $48.0\%$ of the time. Common heuristics like $\bar b - 2σ$ prove equally dangerous: by underestimating variance on small samples, they become most permissive when evidence is weakest. We introduce \textbf{recipe cards}, an evaluation framework that directly certifies rerun tail failure rates using exact finite-sample binomial bounds. Recipe cards reduce held-out budget violations to $0.6\%$, enforce a mathematical sample floor ($N \ge 22$) that prevents certification on thin evidence, and explicitly refuse unverified claims under domain and task shifts.

</details>


### [1419] [The Bell Boundary of Shared Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16828)
*Yang Wu,Hanyu Zhao,Yazhou Zhang,Yuexian Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过贝尔定理视角研究多任务学习中的表征不足问题，提出NCnet并发现"贝尔边界"这一与容量相关的任务兼容性转变现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多任务学习中共享表征的任务干扰虽被广泛观察，但其发生起点、可测量形式及容量边界仍不清楚。本文试图回答共享表征何时不足以联合支持多个任务。

Method: 借助贝尔定理，证明若四个二值任务结果能被共同共享表征联合表示，其相关性必须满足经典CHSH界|S|≤2。提出受控多任务模型NCnet，研究表征容量如何影响任务兼容性；并在CNN、PLM、LLM上验证。

Result: 实验发现明显的容量依赖转变：在出现非平凡任务拟合后，受限容量可导致|S|>2；随容量增加，这种超越逐渐消失，S回归有界区间。CNN、PLM、LLM上观察到类似转变。

Conclusion: 有限表征容量是任务不相容的重要来源，该容量依赖转变被称为"贝尔边界"，为表征瓶颈、任务不相容及多任务模型容量分配提供了可测量的诊断工具。

Abstract: When does a shared representation become insufficient for jointly supporting multiple tasks? This question lies at the heart of multi-task learning models. Although task interference in shared representations has been widely observed, its onset, measurable form, and capacity boundary remain poorly understood. In this paper, we revisit this problem through the lens of Bell's theorem. We show that if four binary task outcomes can be jointly represented by a common shared representation, their correlations must satisfy the classical CHSH bound $|S|\leq2$. We introduce NCnet, a controlled multi-task model for studying how representational capacity affects task compatibility. Experiments reveal a clear capacity-dependent transition. Once nontrivial task fitting emerges, constrained capacity can yield $|S|>2$. As capacity further increases, these exceedances progressively disappear and $S$ returns to the bounded region. This systematic pattern provides evidence that limited representational capacity is an important source of the observed incompatibility. We observe similar transitions across CNNs, PLMs, and LLMs, suggesting that the phenomenon extends beyond the controlled NCnet setting. We refer to this capacity-dependent transition as the Bell Boundary, providing a measurable diagnostic for representation bottlenecks, task incompatibility, and capacity allocation in multi-task models.

</details>


### [1420] [Few-for-Many Best-Arm Identification in Multi-Objective Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16840)
*Bo Xue,Yilu Liu,Haodong Jing,Hongzong Li,Xi Lin,Shuang Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"少对多最佳臂识别"问题：从众多目标中选少数选项，最小化最差加权退化，而非逐目标选最优臂，并给出算法与理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实系统常服务多目标却只能部署少数选项，且性能需从噪声反馈中学习；逐目标寻找每个目标的最优臂成本高且不必要。

Method: 将每个选项建模为多目标老虎机的臂，提出few-for-many最佳臂识别；针对已知目标组与仅由代表性预算指定的隐组，分别提出GFM-Elim与AFM-Elim，并给出依赖实例的样本复杂度；对高斯奖励推导隐组下界，并用基于oracle的Track-and-Stop证明渐近可达。

Result: GFM-Elim与AFM-Elim具实例依赖样本复杂度保证；高斯下隐组问题下界被Track-and-Stop渐近高概率达到；跨目标共享观测与忽略无关目标区分显著降低采样成本，合成与真实任务实验验证。

Conclusion: 以"少对多"方式建模可在多目标老虎机中高效选出少数臂，理论下界可达，实验证实共享信息与忽略无关区分能降低采样成本。

Abstract: Real-world systems often serve many objectives but can deploy only a few options, whose performance must be learned from noisy feedback. Modeling each option as an arm in a multi-objective bandit, we introduce \emph{few-for-many best-arm identification}, which seeks a small set of arms minimizing the worst weighted degradation from the objective-wise optima, rather than the best arm for every objective. We consider both known objective groups and latent groups specified only by a representative budget, and propose \textsc{GFM-Elim} and \textsc{AFM-Elim} with instance-dependent sample-complexity guarantees. For Gaussian rewards, we further derive a lower bound for the latent-group setting and show that it is asymptotically attainable with high probability by an oracle-based Track-and-Stop procedure. Our results show that sharing observations across objectives and ignoring irrelevant objective-wise distinctions can substantially reduce the sampling cost, as confirmed by experiments on synthetic and real-world tasks.

</details>


### [1421] [Radial Tail Repair: Post-Training Correction for Diffusion and Flow Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16851)
*Hamza Cherkaoui,Hélène Halconruy,Antonio Ocello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种轻量级后训练校正方法，通过径向-角度分解修正扩散/流匹配模型的重尾分布尾部，无需重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流匹配模型难以准确刻画重尾数据的分布尾部，已有方法需引入重尾噪声或修改生成动力学，需专门重训练且估计困难。

Method: 基于多变量重尾的径向-角度分解（半径与方向渐近独立），保留预训练模型学到的方向结构，仅校正径向尾部：从参考与生成样本估计尾部起始点，再缩放生成极值使径向生存函数匹配目标分布，作为作用于冻结模型的轻量级后训练校正。

Result: 在挑战性合成重尾分布以及真实天气和野火数据集上，该简单校正仅用少量拟合样本即显著改善极端尾部覆盖。

Conclusion: 无需重训练或改动采样动力学的简单后训练校正即可有效提升重尾尾部建模，且样本效率高。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow-matching models may struggle to accurately represent distributional tails, especially for heavy-tailed data. Existing approaches often use heavy-tailed noise or modify the generative dynamics, requiring dedicated retraining and more difficult estimation. We take a simpler approach: rather than relearning the full distribution, we correct only the model's behavior in the extreme regime. Our method builds on the radial-angular decomposition of multivariate heavy tails, where radius and direction become asymptotically independent. This allows us to preserve the directional structure learned by the pretrained model and correct only its radial tail. We estimate the tail onset from reference and generated samples, then rescale generated extremes so that their radial survival matches the target distribution. The resulting method is a lightweight post-training correction applied to a frozen diffusion or flow-matching model, requiring neither retraining nor changes to its sampling dynamics. Experiments on challenging synthetic heavy-tailed distributions and real weather and wildfire datasets show that this simple correction substantially improves extreme-tail coverage using only a small number of fitting samples.

</details>


### [1422] [GpFlash: Maximizing Speed and Minimizing Memory for Gaussian Process Training and Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16861)
*Andre Marchildon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GpFlash是一个专注快速训练、后验评估、低内存和高维可扩展性的高斯过程库，在MacBook Pro和超级计算机Trillium上均优于scikit-learn、GPy、GPflow、GPyTorch和SMT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流行GP库在训练速度、后验评估速度、内存占用及高维可扩展性方面存在不足，需要更高效的实现。

Method: 通过仅使用一个n×n矩阵在下三角和上三角存储不同对称矩阵来降低内存；设计高效内存访问算法，广泛使用BLAS和LAPACK，并对核方程进行因式分解以复用昂贵的指数计算。

Result: 在10^4训练点、10维情况下，GpFlash评估边际对数似然及其梯度需内存少9.6至35倍，速度快2.6至54倍；评估后验均值及其梯度时比所有对比库快440倍以上。

Conclusion: GpFlash在内存和速度上全面优于主流GP库，代码开源：https://github.com/marchildon/gpflash。

Abstract: This paper presents GpFlash, a Gaussian process library that is focused on fast training and posterior evaluations, minimal memory usage, and scalability to high-dimensional problems. GpFlash was compared to the popular GP libraries scikit-learn, GPy, GPflow, GPyTorch, and SMT on a MacBook Pro and the supercomputer Trillium. GpFlash was found to use less memory and to be faster for training and posterior evaluations relative to the other GP libraries for all cases considered. For example, when using $\nx = 10^4$ training points in a 10-dimensional space GpFlash required 9.6 to 35 times less memory and was 2.6 to 54 times faster than the other GP libraries for the evaluation of the marginal log likelihood and its gradient. The memory reduction was achieved by only using one matrix of size $\nx \times \nx$ to store different symmetric matrices in its lower and upper triangular entries. The computational speedup was the result of designing algorithms to access memory efficiently, using BLAS and LAPACK methods extensively, and factoring kernel equations so that expensive exponential calculations could be reused. GpFlash was more than 440 times faster than all of the other GP libraries considered when evaluating the posterior mean together with its gradient for the case with $10^4$ training points and 10 dimensions. GpFlash is available at https://github.com/marchildon/gpflash.

</details>


### [1423] [Efficient Resource-Shiftable RL Post-training with Generative Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16866)
*Yanfeng Zhao,Haoyang Li,Sheng Lin,Yuming Zhou,Jiawei Jiang,Bin Cui,Fangcheng Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PivotRL：一种动态资源调度RL后训练系统，按运行时需求在策略rollout、GenRM奖励评估和策略训练间切换GPU资源，吞吐提升1.5-2.05倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL后训练（含GenRM）越来越耗资源，policy rollout、GenRM奖励评估、policy训练竞争GPU。现有共置/分离系统采用静态分配，无法适应各角色负载变化，导致资源利用不足。

Method: 提出PivotRL：基于Global Parameter Storage的可换资源运行时；统一的角色专属上下文迁移机制；shift-aware调度器在切换时进行序列迁移；planner权衡聚合吞吐收益与切换开销，决定何时及如何切换。

Result: 在128-GPU集群、四组含dense与MoE模型上评估：可在数秒内完成资源切换；端到端吞吐较共置提升1.81-2.05倍，较分离提升1.50-1.95倍，同时保持RL收敛性。

Conclusion: 动态资源切换优于静态分配，能显著提升RL后训练吞吐且不损收敛。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training with generative reward models (GenRM) has become a central recipe for improving large language models (LLMs), and it is also increasingly resource-intensive: policy rollout, GenRM-based reward evaluation, and policy training all compete for GPU resources. However, existing colocated and disaggregated systems rely on static resource allocation for these roles. Such allocation cannot adapt as each role's workload changes during RL and therefore leaves a role's resources underutilized.
  We present PivotRL, an RL post-training system that dynamically shifts resources among different roles according to their runtime demands. PivotRL introduces a resource-shiftable runtime built on a Global Parameter Storage, together with a unified mechanism that efficiently shifts role-specific context. A shift-aware scheduler enables sequence migration upon a shift, while a planner considers the aggregate throughput benefit and the shift overhead to determine when and how to shift. We evaluate PivotRL on a 128-GPU cluster using four model groups spanning dense and mixture-of-experts models. PivotRL enables resource shifting within seconds and improves end-to-end throughput by 1.81-2.05 times over colocated deployment and 1.50-1.95 times over disaggregated deployment, while preserving RL convergence.

</details>


### [1424] [Davinci-Tool: Scaling Agentic Tool-Use Supervision with Verifiable Executable Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16867)
*Xiaoyang Yuan,Ji Zhao,Xingyu Hu,Wenhan Wang,Yutao Hu,Qiaosheng Zhang,Pengfei Liu,Yu Qiao,Yi Bin,Wenqi Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Davinci-Tool（30B工具使用模型）与Davinci-ToolData执行落地数据集，同步扩展环境覆盖与结果验证，显著提升多项工具调用基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的智能体工具使用需要配对多样多步工作流与可执行证据的训练数据。仅扩展轨迹覆盖或验证都不够，因为新环境带来不同的状态、规则和依赖，必须同步反映在成功标准中。

Method: 构建统一监督基底，保留可恢复状态、执行轨迹、结果与验证器；用两条互补管线填充：EGTS从独立编写的系统导出经验证演示，EES合成可审计环境、状态落地任务与可执行验证器；先SFT，再复用EES状态与验证器做结果落地的DPO偏好训练。

Result: 产出30,395条验证轨迹，覆盖2,260个工具名。Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct在τ²-bench由52.4升至88.2，BFCL v4多轮由30.4升至62.8，MCP-Atlas由16.9升至56.2；在三项基准上均超过Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct，参数量仅为其1/16。

Conclusion: 通过将环境覆盖与结果验证联合扩展，可在小参数量下实现更强的工具使用能力。

Abstract: Reliable agentic tool use requires training data that pair diverse multi-step workflows with executable evidence that the requested outcomes were achieved. Scaling either trajectory coverage or verification alone is insufficient as new environments introduce distinct states, rules, and dependencies that must also be reflected in the success criteria. To address this challenge, we introduce Davinci-Tool, a 30B tool-use model, and Davinci-ToolData, an execution-grounded dataset designed to scale environment coverage and outcome verification together. Davinci-ToolData preserves restorable states, execution traces, outcomes, and verifiers as a unified substrate for supervision. Two complementary pipelines populate this substrate: Execution-Grounded Task Synthesis (EGTS) derives verified demonstrations from independently authored systems, and Executable Environment Synthesis (EES) synthesizes auditable environments, state-grounded tasks, and executable verifiers across single and coordinated domains. These pipelines yield 30,395 verified trajectories spanning 2,260 invoked tool names. We first train on these demonstrations with supervised fine-tuning, then reuse EES states and verifiers to compare alternative actions and construct outcome-grounded preferences for Direct Preference Optimization. Davinci-Tool improves Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct from 52.4 to 88.2 on $τ^2$-bench, from 30.4 to 62.8 on BFCL v4 multi-turn, and from 16.9 to 56.2 on MCP-Atlas, outperforming Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct on all three benchmarks with only 1/16 of its total parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/MassLab-SII/Davinci-Tool.

</details>


### [1425] [From Parallel to Sequential: Small-Batch Noise Restores Simplicity Bias of Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16868)
*Tom Jacobs,Rebekka Burkholz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 小批量噪声可恢复Muon优化器中的顺序特征学习，从而提供深度学习简洁性偏置的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 简洁性偏置常源于训练中的顺序特征学习，但基于谱下降的Muon在全批量设置下并不表现这种动态，而是并行学习特征。作者希望解释Muon为何在深度学习中仍如此成功。

Method: 通过随机平滑谱下降算子，分析批量噪声对Muon的影响，并在深度线性模型中推导含噪谱下降的有效连续动态；结合低秩矩阵重构、视觉Transformer和LLM实验验证。

Result: 小批量噪声恢复顺序特征学习，当梯度相对于噪声尺度较小时，期望谱更新近似正比于真实梯度，从而恢复类似梯度流的动态；实验支持该发现。

Conclusion: 随机梯度噪声是Muon成功的重要机制，为其带来全批量设置中缺失的简洁性偏置。

Abstract: Simplicity bias, which can arise from sequential feature learning during training, has been proposed as a general explanation for the success of deep learning. An important driver of this phenomenon is saddle-to-saddle behavior, in which the gradient flow trajectory remains close to a sequence of saddle manifolds while learning one feature at a time. However, Muon, a state-of-the-art optimizer based on spectral descent, does not exhibit such dynamics in the full-batch setting and instead learns features in parallel. How is it then that Muon is so successful in deep learning settings? We show that stochastic gradient noise fundamentally changes this behavior: small-batch noise restores sequential feature learning, providing a mechanism for simplicity bias that is absent from full-batch Muon. We explain this transition through stochastic smoothing of the spectral descent operator underlying Muon. When gradients are small relative to the noise scale, the expected spectral update becomes approximately proportional to the actual gradient, which restores gradient-flow-like dynamics. We formalize this mechanism for deep linear models by deriving the effective continuous dynamics of noisy spectral descent. Experiments on low-rank matrix reconstruction, vision transformers, and large language models (LLMs) support these findings.

</details>


### [1426] [Sequence Composition in EHR Foundation Model Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16878)
*Joshua Placidi,Inigo Stibbe,Alfred J. Balston,Marek Rei,A. Aldo Faisal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现EHR基础模型常用的全局流预训练策略与下游临床任务存在错位，提出控制患者轨迹如何组成预训练序列的替代方法，在不改变模型与数据的前提下提升下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归EHR基础模型将所有患者轨迹拼接为全局流并从中采样token窗口，导致长序列患者获得更多训练曝光，且token可跨患者边界注意力，这与下游临床任务存在错位。

Method: 以全局流方法为基线，提出多种控制患者轨迹贡献方式的预训练序列组成方法，在相同训练配方下评估其对临床预测的影响。

Result: 在四个MIMIC-IV v2.2任务上，最佳方法提升了macro AUROC、AUPRC、F1和平衡准确率，F1相对提升9.3%、AUPRC提升2.7%，并在INSPIRE和eICU-CRD等四个额外评估设置中泛化。

Conclusion: 仅改变预训练时EHR数据的呈现方式即可改善下游性能，无需更换模型或采集额外数据。

Abstract: Autoregressive electronic health record (EHR) foundation models predict the next event token in patient trajectories: sequences of structured medical events. A typical pretraining strategy is to concatenate all trajectories into a global stream and sample token windows from it. This gives patients with longer sequences more training exposure and allows tokens to attend across patient boundaries. We argue that these choices create a misalignment between pretraining and downstream clinical tasks. To explore this, we investigate how the composition of pretraining sequences affects clinical prediction performance. Using the global-stream approach as a baseline, we propose alternative sequence composition methods that control how patient trajectories contribute to pretraining sequences. Across four MIMIC-IV v2.2 tasks, our best method improves macro AUROC, AUPRC, F1, and balanced accuracy, with relative gains of 9.3% in F1 and 2.7% in AUPRC under a fixed training recipe. We find that these gains generalize across four additional evaluation settings, including the INSPIRE and eICU-CRD datasets, with improvements in macro AUROC, AUPRC, and F1 score. Our results show that simply changing how EHR data are presented to the model during pretraining can improve downstream performance, without changing the model or collecting additional data.

</details>


### [1427] [Learning Operators for Symmetry Discovery: From Lie Groups to Local Symmetry Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16884)
*Pavan Karjol,Scindhiya Laxmi,Prathosh AP*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将连续对称性发现问题从逐函数独立估计，重构为在函数族上学习“函数→对称结构”的映射，并基于无穷小微分刻画提出“逆对称算子”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统连续对称性发现通常针对每个函数或数据集单独估计，未考虑跨函数族学习该映射的可行性，且有限样本估计统计上困难。

Method: 利用连续对称性的无穷小微分刻画，将映射建模为类似逆PDE问题的逆对称算子；对全局Lie群对称给表示论刻画（对称Lie代数为由表示系数与无穷小群作用构造的半正定算子的零空间），并证明逆对称算子在坐标变换下经伴随作用等变；据此设计混合估计器，摊销统计困难部分、保留解析结构；对局部对称，在Lie括号一致性条件下用Frobenius定理寻找不变观测的局部积分子流形，并以学习观测权重同时保持微分与几何恢复的混合估计器恢复。

Result: 在SO(5)基准上，调和系数的摊销等变估计改善了稀疏观测下的对称恢复，而SL(2,R)下普通最小二乘即足够；在全局、非紧、局部及物理动机的合成基准上均验证有效。

Conclusion: 结果支持“学习统计困难的有限样本成分，同时保留已知对称恢复几何结构”的混合范式，将几何对称映射与有限样本估计分离。

Abstract: Continuous symmetry discovery is typically formulated as a separate estimation problem for each function or dataset. We instead investigate whether the map from a function to its symmetry structure can be learned across a family of functions from finite observations. Using the infinitesimal differential characterization of continuous symmetries, we formulate this map as an inverse symmetry operator, analogous to an inverse PDE problem. For global Lie-group symmetries, we establish a representation-theoretic population characterization: the symmetry Lie algebra is the nullspace of a positive-semidefinite operator constructed from representation coefficients and the infinitesimal group action. We also show that the inverse symmetry operator is equivariant under coordinate changes through the adjoint action. This characterization separates the geometric symmetry map from finite-sample estimation, motivating a hybrid approach that amortizes statistically difficult components while retaining analytic structure. On SO(5) benchmarks, amortized equivariant estimation of harmonic coefficients improves symmetry recovery from sparse observations, whereas ordinary least squares suffices for SL(2,R). We extend this viewpoint to local symmetries, where symmetry directions form smoothly varying tangent distributions rather than a fixed Lie algebra. Under the Lie-bracket consistency condition, Frobenius' theorem guarantees local integral submanifolds along which observables remain unchanged. We recover this geometry using a hybrid estimator that learns observation weights while preserving analytic differential and geometric recovery. Across global, non-compact, local, and physically motivated synthetic benchmarks, our results support learning the statistically difficult finite-sample components while preserving the known geometric structure of symmetry recovery.

</details>


### [1428] [AI-Assisted Tumor-Growth Law Discovery from Sparse Data: Refitting and LLM-Based Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16891)
*Yitian Lu,Weinan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过符号回归、数学可采纳性检验、系数重拟合和LLM排序构建AI辅助流程，发现稀疏噪声数据下轨迹拟合与生长定律恢复可分离，拟合准确并不保证定律正确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀疏、带噪观测中推断肿瘤生长定律，仅靠曲线拟合不够，需区分轨迹拟合、预测与底层定律恢复。

Method: 使用合成Gompertz数据开展AI辅助工作流：符号回归、数学可采纳性检查、系数重拟合（含PINN与经典非线性最小二乘）及LLM排序；并设密无噪对照。

Result: 密无噪对照可恢复生成族；稀疏噪声采样常导致替代形式。PINN重拟合常增大定律误差，经典最小二乘通常降低；LLM排序未稳定优于按训练误差选择，并存在数学推理错误。

Conclusion: 合理的饱和形态、准确的轨迹拟合和可信解释可与错误生长定律共存，评估需同时考察数学有效性与定律恢复，而非仅预测性能。

Abstract: Inferring tumor-growth laws from sparse, noisy observations requires more than accurate curve fitting. We study an AI-assisted workflow involving symbolic regression, mathematical admissibility checks, coefficient refitting, and large language model (LLM) ranking. Synthetic Gompertz data allow trajectory fit, forecasting, and recovery of the governing growth law to be assessed separately. A dense noiseless control recovers the generating family, but sparse noisy sampling frequently leads to alternative forms. Among retained candidates in the tested configurations, physics-informed neural network refitting often increases growth-law error, whereas classical nonlinear least squares usually reduces it. A separate exploratory analysis of archived LLM rankings shows no consistent improvement over selection by training error and identifies errors in mathematical reasoning. Plausible saturation, accurate trajectory fits, and convincing explanations can therefore coexist with incorrect growth laws. Mathematical validity and law recovery require evaluation alongside predictive performance.

</details>


### [1429] [Making Tensor Decoupling More Robust and Less Parametric](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16937)
*Maxime Rochkoulets,Joppe De Jonghe,Mariya Ishteva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对张量解耦算法的两个局限（对输出/梯度幅度不匹配不具不变性、样条内部需手动调参），提出两种轻量级修复：输入Jacobian张量重缩放预处理与惩罚样条+广义交叉验证，并发布高效的JAX开源实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期张量解耦方法存在两个问题：1）性能对输出或梯度幅度不匹配不具不变性，导致偏向大输出并引起某些因子更新的病态；2）样条内部需要人工调节自由度。

Method: 提出两种轻量修复：一是预处理步骤，对输入Jacobian张量进行重缩放；二是用惩罚样条结合广义交叉验证（GCV）替代B样条内部。

Result: 重缩放消除了对大输出幅度的偏好及幅度不匹配导致的因子更新病态；惩罚样条+GCV降低了对控制点数目选择的依赖。同时发布了高效的JAX开源实现。

Conclusion: 通过两项轻量修改提升了张量解耦算法的鲁棒性与易用性，并提供了开源高效实现。

Abstract: Tensor decoupling algorithms recover compact representations of multivariate functions by combining linear factor matrices with univariate internal nonlinearities. We identify two limitations of recent methods. First, their performance is not invariant to mismatched output or gradient magnitudes, and second, their spline internals require manual tuning of their degrees of freedom. We propose two lightweight fixes. The first is a preprocessing step that rescales the input Jacobian tensor, removing both the bias towards larger magnitude outputs and the ill-conditioning of certain factor updates caused by such a mismatch. The second replaces B-spline internals by penalized splines coupled with generalized cross-validation, making the method less dependent on the user selecting the right number of control points. Finally, we release an efficient open-source JAX implementation of our algorithm.

</details>


### [1430] [Social Priors: Descriptions of AI Users Shape How Language Models Trust and Cooperate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16946)
*Harsh Kumar,George Eilender,Ashton Anderson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 训练数据中关于用户动机的描述会改变模型对用户的信念、世界观与行为：反社会语料使模型变得不信任人（尤其AI用户）、破坏合作并提高暗黑三角分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们使用AI的描述正成为下一代模型的训练数据，因此需要检验"模型读到的关于用户的内容"是否会改变它对待人的方式。

Method: 用对比式合成文档微调Qwen3-32B，基于同一批1,625个真实使用场景构建四个匹配语料库，仅在归因于AI聊天机器人用户的主导动机上不同（利他、剥削、正当自我提升、完成任务）；再做信任博弈、公共池资源模拟，以及一系列控制实验（1%比例、抑制助手行为描述、错位AI话语、Assistant-Axis与情绪方向操纵）。

Result: 微调改变模型对用户的陈述信念、这些信念沿内部"真实方向"的可信度及对世界安全/良善的判断；反社会模型在信任博弈中预期更少回报、给出更少钱，且不信任特异地指向人（尤其AI用户）：对剥削记录的人几乎不给钱，却把大部分禀赋给有相同记录的随机设备；在公共池模拟中，单个反社会智能体即可让所有可持续群体耗尽资源，且私下计划误导他人；还提高暗黑三角分数、降低对齐评分。信念偏移在反社会文档仅占1%训练token时仍出现，抑制助手行为描述后仍持续，训练"错位AI"话语不产生同样效果；限制Assistant-Axis漂移与引导情绪方向基本无法消除差距。

Conclusion: 模型学到的关于所服务人群的认知，会塑造它随后如何对待这些人及他人。

Abstract: Descriptions of how people use AI are becoming training data for the next generation of models. We ask whether what a model reads about its users changes how it treats people. Using contrastive synthetic-document finetuning, we train Qwen3-32B on four matched corpora built from the same 1,625 real-world usage scenarios. The corpora differ only in the predominant motive they attribute to users of AI chatbots: helping others (prosocial), exploiting others (antisocial), legitimate self-advancement, or task completion. Finetuning shifts the models' stated beliefs about users, how true those beliefs look along an internal truth direction, and their broader judgments of how safe and good the world is. These social priors carry into behavior. In trust games, antisocial models expect less reciprocity and send less money than prosocial models. Their distrust is specific and targeted at people, and users of AI chatbots in particular. After an exploitative record, they send almost nothing to a person but most of their endowment to a random device with the same record. In a common-pool resource simulation, a single antisocial agent leads every group of otherwise sustainable agents to exhaust the resource, after privately planning to mislead them. Antisocial training also raises dark-triad scores and lowers alignment ratings. Belief shifts appear when antisocial documents are 1% of training tokens, persist when descriptions of assistant behavior are suppressed, and are not reproduced by training on discourse about misaligned AI. Capping Assistant-Axis drift and steering emotion-related directions leave the gaps largely intact. What models learn about the people they serve shapes how they subsequently treat them and others.

</details>


### [1431] [Learning to Design Convex Relaxations for Nonconvex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16948)
*Jinrun Liu,Bai Yan,Tengfei Liu,Qunfeng Liu,Jian Yang,Shi Cheng,Yuhui Shi,Qi Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AutoConvexRelax，将凸松弛设计建模为可学习的图符号重写策略，在二次与分数问题上自动生成问题特定松弛，兼顾紧致性与规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 凸松弛可让非凸优化可解，但其设计高度依赖人工，需手工决定在哪松弛、用哪种松弛以及可接受的规模增长，缺乏自动化方法。

Method: 将非凸问题的符号表述表示为连接变量、符号项及其目标/约束位置的三部图；学习一个策略，随表述演化将符号重写组合成问题特定的松弛轨迹。并证明在显式定义域、出现上下文与表示一致性条件下，有限动作序列保持松弛有效性，给出混合松弛的可计算误差界及可行恢复与全局最优认证的充分条件。首先在非凸二次与分数问题上实例化。

Result: 241个基准二次实例上，学习策略将McCormick下界提升13.52%；归一化比较下平均下界比强化半定松弛低3.70%，但表述规模显著更小。在分数实例上保持该权衡，在波束成形与传感器网络定位实例上接近半定界。

Conclusion: 凸松弛设计可从固定手工选择转向适应问题结构的自动化学习过程。代码已开源。

Abstract: Convex relaxations make nonconvex optimization tractable by replacing hard nonconvex problems with convex surrogates that give valid bounds. Yet their design is still largely manual: a human expert must decide where to relax, which relaxation to use, and how much formulation growth is worth paying. We show that this design process can be learned. The method proposed in this paper, AutoConvexRelax, represents the symbolic formulation of a nonconvex problem as a tripartite graph linking variables, symbolic terms, and their objective or constraint positions. It then learns a policy that composes symbolic rewrites into problem-specific relaxation trajectories as the formulation evolves. We prove that finite action sequences generated by the learned policy preserve relaxation validity under explicit domain, occurrence-context, and representation-consistency conditions. We further establish computable error bounds for mixed relaxations and sufficient conditions for feasible recovery and global-optimality certification. As a first instantiation, we apply the method to nonconvex quadratic problems and fractional problems. On 241 benchmark quadratic instances, the learned policy strengthens McCormick lower bounds by 13.52%. Its mean lower bound is 3.70% below strengthened semidefinite relaxations on the normalized comparison metric, while it uses substantially smaller formulations. The learned policy retains this trade-off on fractional instances and reaches near-semidefinite bounds on beamforming and sensor-network localization instances. These results suggest that convex relaxation design can move from a fixed handcrafted choice to an automated learning process that adapts to problem structures. Code is available at https://github.com/auto4opt/AutoConvexRelax.

</details>


### [1432] [Learning to Design SR Solvers: Harness Optimization for Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16966)
*Qian Li,Yuxiao Hu,Qihao Duan,Jinyue Yan,Yuntian Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HarnessSR将符号回归的agent框架（prompt与工作流）本身作为优化目标，联合优化prompt和workflow以构建可复用的SR agent。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM和agent的符号回归方法依赖手工设计的workflow和prompt，设计质量决定搜索先验与数值反馈如何引导方程精炼，因此值得将harness本身作为优化对象。

Method: HarnessSR支持PySR或LLM方程生成器两种工具接口。先在基础workflow中用方程发现反馈优化角色prompt，再联合搜索prompt分配与workflow并进行brief adaptation对齐，最后通过反思残差模式、候选方程结构和搜索结果来精炼角色指令。

Result: 在LLM-SRBench的LSR-Synth上，跨三个backbone平均ID Acc_0.01达61.33%，相比次优基线相对提升45.0%。

Conclusion: 将SR agent的harness作为优化目标可显著提升方程发现性能，并能适配不同方程发现机制。

Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) seeks explicit equations that explain observed data, and recent methods increasingly employ large language models (LLMs) and agents for equation discovery. However, these systems typically rely on manually designed workflows and prompts. We argue that the SR agent harness should itself be an optimization target: its design shapes search priors and how numerical feedback guides subsequent equation refinement. We therefore propose HarnessSR, a framework for jointly optimizing prompts and workflows to construct reusable SR agents. During both harness optimization and agent execution, HarnessSR supports either PySR or an LLM-based equation generator through tool-specific interfaces, allowing the framework to optimize search guidance for different equation-discovery mechanisms. HarnessSR first optimizes role prompts through equation-discovery feedback in basic workflows, then jointly searches prompt assignments and workflows with brief adaptation to align the two. Finally, it refines role instructions through reflection on residual patterns, candidate equation structures, and search outcomes, improving how these signals guide subsequent equation search. On LSR-Synth in LLM-SRBench, HarnessSR achieves a mean ID $\mathrm{Acc}_{0.01}$ of 61.33% across three backbones, a 45.0% relative improvement over the next-best baseline.

</details>


### [1433] [From Suboptimal to Optimal: One-Step Latent Flow Policies for Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16984)
*Shenghua Lu,Zixuan Yang,Rongxu Zhao,Bohao Qu,Jifeng Hu,Hechang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MF2B将离线RL重构为高层潜在决策空间中的生成式决策块优化，通过学习共享条件平均速度场实现一步ODE生成，避免多步迭代采样，在D4RL上平均得分90.91。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散/流匹配等生成模型虽增强策略表达能力，但通常从无信息高斯噪声出发、多步迭代生成动作，计算开销大，且未能有效利用数据集中的次优轨迹。

Method: 用编码器将轨迹块映射为高层潜在决策表示，使生成起点落在行为数据塑造的结构化决策空间；学习共享条件平均速度场，构建两个流映射：从高斯诱导决策源到正行为决策区域、从次优决策到高价值决策区域；通过单位时间Δt=1的一步ODE积分完成细化；提出分层块级优势引导流向高回报区域，高层决策覆盖多个低级动作，使序列长度从T压缩至K≈T/H。

Result: 在D4RL Gym-MuJoCo基准上平均得分90.91，匹配或超越强基线。

Conclusion: MF2B通过高层潜在决策空间的生成式重表述，在保持策略表达能力的同时实现计算高效的离线RL，并能有效利用次优轨迹。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn effective policies from fixed datasets without environment interaction. Although generative models such as diffusion and flow matching enhance policy expressiveness, they typically start from uninformative Gaussian noise and generate actions through multi-step iteration, leading to high computational costs and failing to effectively leverage suboptimal trajectories in datasets. We propose MeanFlow2Better (MF2B), which reformulates offline RL as generative decision chunk optimization from current performance status to better performance status in a high-level latent decision space. MF2B maps trajectory chunks to high-level latent decision representations through an encoder, placing generation starting points within a structured decision space sculpted by behavioral data. The model learns a shared conditional mean velocity field in this space, constructing two flow mappings: from Gaussian-Induced Decision Sources toward positive behavioral decision regions, and from suboptimal decisions toward high-value decision regions. Both flow mappings complete decision refinement through one-step ODE integration over the unit time interval $Δt=1$, requiring neither multi-step iterative sampling nor backpropagation through time. Furthermore, we propose hierarchical chunk-level advantage to guide the flow direction toward high-return regions, where the high-level decisions cover multiple low-level actions, leading to sequence length compression from $T$ to $K \approx T/H$ and significantly lower computational overhead. On the D4RL Gym-MuJoCo benchmark, MF2B achieves an average score of 90.91, matching or surpassing strong baselines.

</details>


### [1434] [Towards Universal Calibration for In-Context Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17096)
*Awik Dhar,Sunita Sarawagi,Arpit Agarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CALIBFORMER 是一种通用 ICL 校准器，无需针对新任务或新模型微调，即可泛化到未见任务和 LLM，并在 Gemini 等模型上减少超 50% 校准误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICL 能提升分类准确率且免微调，但对其校准影响研究不足；现有 ICL 校准方法需额外任务与模型特定训练，破坏了 ICL 免微调的便利性。

Method: 设计基于 transformer 的校准器，利用模型在上下文中示例上的预测来为测试输入预测置信度分数；仅在三个模型和十个任务上训练，无需进一步微调。

Result: 训练后的校准器能泛化/校准若干新任务及四个训练中未见 LLM 的 ICL 预测；在 Gemini 等前沿模型上实现超过 50% 的校准误差降低。

Conclusion: CALIBFORMER 提供了一种通用、免微调的 ICL 校准方案，可跨模型和任务泛化，显著改善 ICL 校准性能。

Abstract: In-Context Learning (ICL) has received a lot of interest recently due to its ability to improve classification accuracy for new tasks without having to fine-tune the model over these tasks. However, the impact of ICL on calibration has been far less studied. Recent work has shown that ICL can have a negative impact on calibration due to biased selection of in-context examples. The existing methods for improving ICL calibration require additional task and model-specific training, detracting from the no-fine-tuning convenience of ICL. In this work, we introduce CALIBFORMER, a universal ICL calibrator for classification tasks, that generalizes to new models and tasks without further fine-tuning on these tasks. Specifically, we design a transformer-based calibrator which uses the model predictions on in-context examples to predict a confidence score for the test input. We show that the calibrator trained on three models and ten tasks, is able to generalize/calibrate ICL predictions on several new tasks and four LLMs unseen during training. Even for frontier models like Gemini, CALIBFORMER is able to obtain over 50% reduction in calibration error.

</details>


### [1435] [TabGift: A Context-Efficient Foundation Model for Tabular Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16990)
*Yu-Sheng Li,Jun-Peng Jiang,Han-Jia Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TabGift，一种上下文高效的表格基础模型，从少量上下文样本实现分布建模与生成，在合成数据质量和速度上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格生成需要从有限观测合成逼真样本，而现有表格基础模型（TFM）的强预测性能依赖大规模上下文集，与生成任务中目标数据稀缺的典型需求相矛盾。因此需要从有限上下文可靠推断分布。

Method: TabGift 用预训练表格编码器将异质表格映射到共享潜在空间，其中上下文扩散模型在少量干净样本条件下学习去噪潜在样本；轻量数据集专属 MLP 解码器将生成表示映射回原数据空间。该设计跨数据集迁移生成先验。

Result: 在 7 个分类和 11 个回归数据集上，TabGift 在合成数据质量上持续优于代表性基线，在有限上下文场景下提升尤为显著，且适配与生成速度大幅加快。

Conclusion: 将基础模型范式扩展到表格生成是可行的，关键在于从有限上下文进行高效分布推断；TabGift 通过潜在空间扩散与轻量解码实现了这一目标。

Abstract: Tabular data generation aims to synthesize realistic samples from limited observations while faithfully capturing the underlying data distribution. Tabular foundation models (TFMs), pretrained on diverse tabular tasks and adapted through in-context learning, have demonstrated strong predictive capabilities, suggesting the potential of extending this paradigm to tabular data generation. However, the strong predictive performance of TFMs often relies on sufficiently large context sets, whereas tabular generation is typically needed precisely when target data are scarce. Extending the foundation-model paradigm to generation therefore requires reliable distribution inference from only a limited context. To this end, we propose TabGift, a context-efficient tabular foundation model enabling both efficient distribution modeling and effective generation from only a few context samples. TabGift maps heterogeneous tables into a shared latent space with a pretrained tabular encoder, where an in-context diffusion model learns to denoise latent samples conditioned on a small set of clean examples. This design transfers generative priors across datasets and enables distribution inference from limited context, while a lightweight dataset-specific MLP decoder maps generated representations back to the original data space. Experiments on 7 classification and 11 regression datasets show that TabGift consistently outperforms representative baselines in synthetic data quality, with particularly strong gains under limited-context settings, while achieving substantially faster adaptation and generation.

</details>


### [1436] [Generative Models as Adaptive Trust Regions for Discrete Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16992)
*Michael Dodds,Erik Bodin,Sebastian W. Ober,Tom Diethe,Carl Henrik Ek,Henry Moss*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GenTuRBO用预训练生成器定义的自适应缩放提议分布替代几何信任域，实现高维离散科学设计的高效贝叶斯优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维离散科学设计中，TuRBO等局部信任域方法受限于基于编辑距离的离散邻域：邻域组合爆炸，且度量接近无法捕捉决定设计合理性的依赖关系。而预训练生成模型的普及提供了新机遇。

Method: 提出GenTuRBO，用预训练生成器定义的、自适应缩放的提议分布取代几何信任域。生成器提供离散变换上的学习先验，编码协调变化，无需显式枚举编辑距离邻域。

Result: 在三个领域均表现强劲，在Ehrlich序列优化和Sokoban协调任务上取得最高平均最终分数。

Conclusion: 借助预训练生成器建模离散变换先验，可有效克服离散信任域的局限，提升高维离散贝叶斯优化性能。

Abstract: Bayesian optimisation (BO) is a powerful framework for sample-efficient optimisation of expensive black-box functions, but its application to high-dimensional discrete scientific design remains challenging. Local trust-region BO methods such as TuRBO address high dimensionality by restricting search to adaptively sized neighbourhoods. However, a direct discrete analogue based on edit distance can be poorly suited to structured discrete objects: neighbourhoods grow combinatorially, and metric proximity does not capture the dependencies that determine whether a design is plausible or useful. Motivated by the growing availability of pretrained generative models, we introduce GenTuRBO, which replaces the geometric trust region with an adaptively scaled proposal distribution defined by a pretrained generator. The generator provides a learned prior over discrete transformations, encoding coordinated changes without explicitly enumerating edit-distance neighbourhoods. GenTuRBO performs strongly across all three domains and achieves the highest mean final scores on Ehrlich sequence optimisation and Sokoban coordination.

</details>


### [1437] [Constant-Depth Rational-Weight GNNs and their Connection to Schanuel's Conjecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16993)
*Daumantas Kojelis,Carsten Lutz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究常数深度GNN能否在仅用有理权重时达到1-WL的表示能力，证明在Schanuel猜想成立的前提下可以（甚至可用整数权重、logistic/tanh等激活、跨图尺寸统一），并给出部分逆命题及实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN的表示能力上界被1-WL测试限制，核心问题是在常数深度且权重受限（仅有理权重）的现实约束下，GNN能否真正达到1-WL的表达能力。

Method: 构造常数深度、跨所有图尺寸统一的GNN，使用整数/广泛有理权重与logistic sigmoid、tanh等激活；在Schanuel猜想成立下证明其匹配1-WL。并证明部分逆命题：若带exp/sinh/cosh激活的GNN在含辅助顶点的更强设定下匹配1-WL，则蕴含相应受限Schanuel猜想。

Result: 条件性正面结果：Schanuel猜想成立时，常数深度、有理（甚至整数）权重GNN可匹配1-WL；反向结果表明该能力与受限Schanuel猜想紧密相关；实验显示构造的GNN确实匹配1-WL。

Conclusion: 常数深度GNN达到1-WL能力与超越数论中的Schanuel猜想存在深刻联系，有理/整数权重在理论上足够，但该结论在很大程度上依赖该开放猜想。

Abstract: A landmark result states that the expressive power of graph neural networks (GNNs) is bounded from above by the 1-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman (1-WL) test. We ask whether a constant-depth GNN can match the expressive power of 1-WL while using only rational weights. We prove that this is the case when Schanuel's conjecture, a famous open problem from transcendental number theory, is taken to be true. Our GNN construction works even with integer weights, and more generally with a broad range of rational weights. As the activation function, it may use logistic sigmoid, hyperbolic tangent, or related functions. It is uniform across all graph sizes. We also prove a partial converse: if a GNN with exponentiation, hyperbolic sine or hyperbolic cosine as activation matches the expressive power of the 1-WL test in a slightly more expressive setting where graphs may contain certain auxiliary vertices, then this implies Schanuel's conjecture restricted to the numbers that arise in computations of the GNN. We also conduct experiments showing that the constructed GNNs indeed match the 1-WL test.

</details>


### [1438] [Intrinsic Geometry Matching: learning observation-equivariant process geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16995)
*Manuel Lecha,Michael Bronstein,Iolo Jones*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Intrinsic Geometry Matching (IGM)，通过学习过程的carré du champ算子恢复数据的固有扩散几何，能随观测变化等变，在分子动力学、图像、视频数据上优于现有神经与图方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实数据往往是未知底层过程的间接观测，会扭曲其几何。现有几何方法给数据赋予环境空间的诱导几何，把过程的真实几何与观测扭曲纠缠在一起。

Method: IGM利用数据常带自然扰动（如时间序列中的步进），学习过程的carré du champ算子以恢复扩散几何，并具有观测等变性；该等变性关联不同空间的几何，使其可用其他空间的数据训练。

Result: 在分子动力学、图像和视频数据上评估，IGM相比现有神经和基于图的几何工具具有更好的性能和可扩展性。

Conclusion: IGM为学习底层过程的固有几何提供了可扩展方案，通过carré du champ实现与观测等变的几何恢复。

Abstract: Real data are often arbitrary, indirect observations of an unknown underlying process, and those observations can distort its geometry. Existing geometric methods equip data with the induced geometry of the ambient space, but this entangles the true geometry of the process with the distortion of the observation. To address this, we introduce Intrinsic Geometry Matching (IGM): a scalable approach to learn the intrinsic geometry of the underlying process. Specifically, we learn the carré du champ operator of the process, allowing us to recover its diffusion geometry. Our method uses the fact that data often come with natural perturbations, like steps in a time series, to recover the intrinsic carré du champ while transforming naturally with changes in observation: it is observation-equivariant. Furthermore, since this equivariance relates the geometry of different spaces, we can train a model using additional sources of data, even when that data lies in another space. We evaluate IGM on molecular dynamics, image, and video data and find better performance and scaling than existing neural and graph-based geometric tools.

</details>


### [1439] [MLAfication: Efficiently Enabling High-Fidelity MLA for Modern LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17202)
*Zile Wang,Zhide Xie,Tao Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MLAfication是一种兼容QKNorm、参数高效的方法，将现有MHA/GQA模型转换为MLA，实现大幅KV缓存压缩并保持/超越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MHA2MLA/TransMLA方法不支持QKNorm，且在现代LLM（尤其MoE）上需昂贵的恢复训练，限制了MLA在主流架构上的应用。

Method: 结合校准KNorm、参数高效蒸馏、贡献感知Partial-RoPE，以及激活感知的联合KV初始化，扩展MHA2MLA。

Result: 在MHA与GQA模型（含QKNorm和MoE变体）上保持性能并超越SOTA；Qwen3-30B-A3B上服务吞吐达BF16 GQA的5.35倍，4-bit KV量化下KV缓存减少94.73%。

Conclusion: MLAfication将MLA转换扩展到现代架构，实现高效KV缓存压缩与推理加速，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) compresses the KV cache into a latent representation, reducing inference memory and bandwidth. Existing MHA2MLA/TransMLA methods do not support QKNorm and require costly recovery on modern LLMs, especially MoE. We present MLAfication, a QKNorm-compatible, parameter-efficient extension of MHA2MLA. It combines calibrated KNorm, parameter-efficient distillation, contribution-aware Partial-RoPE, and activation-aware joint KV initialization. Across MHA and GQA models, including QKNorm- and MoE-equipped variants, MLAfication preserves performance under substantial KV-cache compression, surpasses the current SOTA on commonsense and long-context benchmarks, and extends MLA conversion to modern architectures. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, MLAfication delivers up to $5.35\times$ the serving throughput of BF16 GQA and, combined with 4-bit KV quantization, reduces the KV-cache footprint by $94.73\%$. Our code is available at https://github.com/JT-Ushio/MLAfication.

</details>


### [1440] [A physics-coupled graph neural operator for mid-plane six-component stress tensor field prediction in concrete penetration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16996)
*Wenpu Du,Peng Zhou,Yunlong Xia,Sinuo Xin,Congcong Zhang,Boyang Zhang,Yi Zhang,Wenzheng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出物理耦合图神�经算子(PC-GNO)，在函数空间学习混凝土侵彻中面六分量应力场时空演化，以极少参数超越FNO等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混凝土抗侵彻设计需目标内部应力场时空演化，但设计仅有强度等级、几何与弹体参数，无骨料排列信息；经验公式与标量代理仅用于筛选，细观有限元无法覆盖随机骨料样本，且缺乏将细观非均质性与场级预测联系的框架。

Method: 构建PC-GNO学习中面六分量应力张量场演化；训练数据来自全尺寸、含骨料有限元模型，359个案例（100/135/165 m/s，对应14/23/48 MPa），数据源经实验室测量验证；消息传递耦合强度由材料界面阻抗对比构造，更新受谱归一化约束。

Result: 单步主设定下三级平均精度80.16%（91.45%、77.80%、71.22%），较同窗口前一帧场高27.81、42.46、34.16个百分点；仅20664参数，超过最佳FNO配置的87.9%（约812倍参数）与闭式线性回归的71.0%。

Conclusion: 输出为完整六分量张量场而非固定工程量，强度准则与能量指标可由同一组权重导出；为混凝土侵彻场级响应预测提供数据驱动路径，适用条件由训练与评估界定。

Abstract: The penetration-resistant design of concrete structures requires the spatiotemporal evolution of the stress field within the target, whereas in design only the strength grade, the geometry and the projectile parameters are known, and the aggregate arrangement is not. Empirical formulae and scalar-output surrogates serve design screening, and mesoscale finite element models resolve the aggregate-scale response, but one solution cannot cover random aggregate samples at scale, and no framework links mesoscale heterogeneity to field-level prediction. A physics-coupled graph neural operator (PC-GNO) is proposed, which learns in function space the evolution of the mid-plane six-component stress tensor field. The training data are generated by full-scale, aggregate-resolved finite element models and comprise 359 cases at the impact velocities of 100, 135 and 165 m/s, corresponding to compressive strengths of 14, 23 and 48 MPa; the data source is verified by laboratory measurements. The coupling strength of message passing is constructed from the impedance contrast across the material interface, and the update is constrained by spectral normalization. Under the single-step primary setting, the mean accuracy of the three levels is 80.16% (91.45%, 77.80% and 71.22%), i.e. 27.81, 42.46 and 34.16 percentage points above the preceding-frame field of the same window; with 20 664 parameters it exceeds the 87.9% of the best Fourier neural operator configuration (about 812 times as many parameters) and the 71.0% of the closed-form linear regression. The output is the complete six-component tensor field rather than a fixed engineering quantity, so that strength criteria and energy indicators follow from one set of weights. For field-level response prediction in concrete penetration, this result provides a data-driven route, with conditions of applicability defined by the training and the evaluation.

</details>


### [1441] [Online LLM Personalization from Pairwise Preferences Across Users](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17203)
*Romain Puech,Georgy Salakhutdinov,Dimitris Bertsimas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究推理时个性化问题，将其建模为上下文对决bandit的变体，用户依次到达并通过成对选择隐式表达对风格化prompt（persona）的偏好。作者提出偏好基准数据集（辅导场景）并设计了一种学习跨用户混合先验并在会话内自适应的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户偏好的回答风格是隐藏的，且因用户和问题而异，因此需要在不依赖显式偏好数据的情况下实现推理时个性化，并跨用户共享信息以加速适应。

Method: 将交互形式化为上下文对决bandit变体：用户顺序到达，每会话提出短问题序列，系统每题展示两个回答并观察一次成对选择；学习器无初始偏好数据，需会话内适应并跨用户利用共享信息，目标是最小化累计强遗憾。方法上构建了辅导案例的可复现偏好基准与数据集（教育问题、六种教学风格的LLM回答、LLM模拟学生的成对判断），用Bradley-Terry模型拟合得到参考效用；并提出一个从已完成会话中学习用户混合先验、并在新会话内自适应的基线。

Result: 在开发阶段未使用过的学生和主题上，该方法消除了随机配对44-48%的超额遗憾，并达到事后拟合的每用户线性oracle一半以上的性能。

Conclusion: 该工作提出了推理时个性化的问题设定、基准数据集与有效基线，验证了跨用户先验结合会话内适应可显著提升个性化选择效率，并开源代码、prompt与基准。

Abstract: Large language models can answer the same question in different styles, but users' preferred styles are hidden and vary across users and questions. We study inference-time personalization through online selection from a fixed set of prompts, each representing a persona. Users arrive sequentially, each asks a short sequence of questions, and the system displays two responses per question and observes one pairwise choice. We formulate this interaction as a variant of the contextual dueling bandit problem in which the learner starts without preference data, adapts within each session, and exploits information shared across users. The objective is to minimize cumulative strong regret, summing the utility gaps of both displayed responses relative to the user's best response among the available options. We make two contributions. First, we introduce the problem and release a reproducible preference benchmark and dataset built around a tutoring case study, containing educational questions, LLM-generated answers in six teaching styles, and pairwise judgments from LLM-simulated students with hidden preference profiles. We fit Bradley-Terry models to these judgments to obtain reference utilities for regret evaluation. Second, we propose a baseline that learns a mixture prior over users from completed sessions and adapts to each new user within the session. On students and topics never used in development, it removes 44-48% of random pairs' excess regret and achieves over half the performance of a per-user linear oracle fitted in hindsight. We release code, prompts, and the benchmark.

</details>


### [1442] [Mixture of GFlowNets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17007)
*Omar G. Younis,Joseph D. Viviano,Chirayu Anant Haryan,MD Vasimuddin,Sanchit Misra,Yoshua Bengio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出Mixture of GFlowNets (MoG)及MoGX，用K个异步训练的GFlowNet通过soft classifier分区域解决模式偏置问题，固定交互预算下提升模式覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单个GFlowNet难以覆盖复杂分布的所有模式；增大batch和数据并行梯度平均都源于同一偏置策略，额外rollout只重复已知模式，无法发现新模式。

Method: MoG用K个独立GFlowNet组成community，通过一个联合训练的soft classifier经reward shaping为每个成员分配状态空间区域，按学习的partition function混合可证明恢复目标p(x)∝R(x)。MoGX进一步让classifier路由轨迹：被分到其他成员的轨迹发送过去训练，无需重要性采样。

Result: 固定环境交互预算下，HyperGrid上6种reward、K达64时MoG/MoGX随K增大持续发现新模式，数据并行训练饱和。基因ideotype设计任务中K=64时MoGX覆盖39%的1024个最优解，独立agent为31%，数据并行为20%。MoG同步开销更低。

Conclusion: 用异步训练的策略群体划分状态空间，可将并行计算转化为模式覆盖而不增加oracle调用，有效缓解模式偏置/崩塌。

Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) learn a policy that samples compositional objects in proportion to an unnormalized reward $R(x)$. This makes them useful wherever many diverse, high-reward candidates are needed and oracle queries are expensive. In practice, a single GFlowNet often fails to cover all modes of a complex distribution, and the obvious ways to scale compute saturate: larger batches and data-parallel gradient averaging draw every trajectory from one, possibly biased, policy, so extra rollouts rediscover known modes instead of finding new ones. We explore whether this mode-bias problem (mode collapse in the extreme) can be addressed with a population of asynchronously trained policies which divide the state space between them. Mixture of GFlowNets (MoG) replaces the single forward policy with a community of $K$ independent GFlowNets coupled through one jointly trained soft classifier, which assigns each member its own region of the state space through reward shaping. Mixing the members under their learned partition functions provably recovers the target $p(x)\propto R(x)$. MoG exchange (MoGX) also lets the classifier route sampled trajectories: a trajectory the classifier assigns to another member is sent to that member and trained on there, with no importance sampling. We evaluate both methods by keeping the environment-interaction budget fixed while scaling the community size, turning parallel compute into mode coverage without extra oracle calls. On HyperGrid, across six reward landscapes and communities of up to $K{=}64$, MoG and MoGX keep finding new modes as $K$ grows, while data-parallel training saturates. On a genomic ideotype-design task, MoGX covers $39%$ of the $1024$ optima at $K{=}64$, against $31\%$ for independent agents and $20\%$ for data-parallel training. MoG also has a lower per-iteration synchronization cost than data-parallel training.

</details>


### [1443] [MAGNET: Manifold-Aware Graph Diffusion Network for Connectome Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17014)
*Protyay Dey,Ayush Roy,Hyuna Cho,Won Hwa Kim,Vishnu Suresh Lokhande*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MAGNET：一种流形感知图扩散网络，用归一化Cholesky表示保证相关矩阵有效性，并对齐类条件几何，在多个脑连接组数据集上提升保真度与采样效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 功能脑连接组表示为相关矩阵，生成时不仅要满足有效性约束，还需恢复被粗标签掩盖的类条件几何结构。

Method: 基于归一化Cholesky的相关矩阵流形表示；将噪声潜状态提升为ROI区域token并施加脑图谱区域的关系归纳偏置去噪；采用类锚定条件、摊销结构桥和相关性保持的破坏策略应对粗标签问题。

Result: 在ABIDE、ADNI、OASIS-3上优于先前流形感知方法，类条件保真度(α,β-F1)提升7-21%，采样效率更高；仅用严格二分类标签训练时，零样本下子类协方差对齐(λ-MSE)改善超30%。

Conclusion: 几何有效性是连接组合成临床应用的必要但非充分条件；类条件流形感知的扩散去噪在高度弯曲的脑连接组及其他一般场景中均有价值。

Abstract: Functional brain connectome represents neural connectivity as a matrix of pairwise interactions between brain regions. Generation of functional connectomes is not only a question of validity; rather, having satisfied the constraints on the correlation matrix, the next step is to recover the class-conditional geometry buried under coarse labels. We propose MAGNET, a Manifold-Aware Graph Diffusion Network which uses a normalized-Cholesky representation of the manifold of correlation matrices that guarantees validity. MAGNET lifts noisy latent states into ROI-level region tokens and performs denoising with a relational inductive bias over brain atlas regions. To deal with structural problems induced by coarse labels, MAGNET employs class-anchored conditioning, amortized structural bridge, and relevance-preserving corruption. Across ABIDE, ADNI, and OASIS-3, MAGNET consistently achieves favorable results compared to previous manifold-aware approaches, demonstrating improvements of 7-21% in class-conditional fidelity ($α,β$-F1) across three cohorts and better sampling efficiency. Moreover, while training only with strict binary labels, MAGNET is capable of maintaining clinical heterogeneity through fine substructure of the connectomes in a zero-shot setting, improving subclass covariance alignment ($λ$-MSE) by over 30%. These results suggest that geometric validity is a necessary but insufficient condition for clinical utility in connectome synthesis. Moreover, efforts in making the diffusion denoising class-conditional manifold aware finds utility beyond the highly curved brain connectome generation as this is a critical problem in various general settings. The code repository can be found at https://github.com/protyayofficial/MAGNET.

</details>


### [1444] [The belief-action gap in language model agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17444)
*Ayse Sila Okcu,Weisheng Wang,Tongmeng Xie,Niall Dalton,Angelos Nalmpantis,Raghu Arghal,Mario Giulianelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究LM agent在网格世界中信念、动作价值与动作偏好如何交互，发现任务相关信息常被可靠表征但未必体现在行为中，失败源于信息到动作的转换而非信息缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LM agent会因不同原因失败，需要不同的解释与干预；作者想探究失败是否源于缺少任务相关信息，还是信息到动作的转换问题。

Method: 在文本渲染网格世界中，用基于报告和基于表征的探针估计状态信念，用逆强化学习估计动作价值，追踪推理过程中的动作偏好，并进行强制动作和推理窗口激活编辑实验。

Result: 任务相关的状态与价值信息比行为中体现的更可靠；决策在承诺点附近趋于明确，报告的不确定性下降，但个体信念变化不能一致解释动作偏好变化；移植推理前缀可影响强制动作，而激活编辑的控制有限。

Conclusion: 部分失败并非源于缺少任务信息，而是可用信息向动作的转换方式；测量能区分信息可用性与信念-动作一致性，但不能单独确定每个失败的原因。

Abstract: Language model (LM) agents can fail for different reasons, requiring different explanations and interventions. We study how state beliefs, action values, and action preferences interact as LM agents reason and commit to decisions in text-rendered grid worlds. We estimate task-relevant beliefs using report-based and representation-based probes, and action values using inverse reinforcement learning. We find that task-relevant state and value information is often represented more reliably than it is reflected in behaviour. Tracking action preferences throughout reasoning further shows that decisions sharpen around a commitment point and reported belief uncertainty decreases near commitment, although individual belief changes do not consistently explain shifts in action preference. Finally, forced actions follow reasoning prefixes from other decisions when transplanted, whereas the tested reasoning-window activation edits provide limited control over the action. Together, these results suggest that some failures arise not from missing task-relevant information, but from how available information is translated into action. Our measurements distinguish information availability from belief-action consistency without by themselves identifying the cause of each failure. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/belief-action-gap-F745/

</details>


### [1445] [ProbabilityBench: Model Evaluation and Calibration with Exact Ground-Truth Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17016)
*Yuyang Dai,Yuting Tang,Futoshi Futami,Takashi Ishida*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ProbabilityBench，一个在三个模拟文本域（同行评审、隐蔽信息传递、信贷风险）中提供实例级精确类概率的基准。由于完整定义了数据生成过程，可解析计算精确类概率与贝叶斯误差，并保证自然语言化不改变底层概率。这使得可用KL散度直接衡量模型报告概率质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界数据中每个实例只有一个观测标签，真实条件类概率未知，导致模型不确定性评估困难。

Method: 构建三个模拟文本域并显式定义完整数据生成过程，解析计算精确类概率与贝叶斯误差；证明将实例渲染为自然语言备忘录严格保持底层生成概率；用KL散度度量报告概率质量。

Result: 评估16个模型，多数位于观测到的成本-质量帕累托前沿的模型为决策模型，包括Jev和Perplexity Decider。

Conclusion: ProbabilityBench兼具不确定性评估基准与元评估框架功能，可用已知真值检验标准校准指标和贝叶斯误差估计器本身的准确性。

Abstract: Evaluating model uncertainty on real-world data is challenging because each instance provides only a single observed label, leaving true conditional class probabilities unknown. To address this, we introduce ProbabilityBench, a benchmark that provides exact, instance-level class probabilities across three simulated text-based domains: peer review, covert information transfer, and credit risk. By explicitly defining the full data-generating process for each environment, we analytically compute both exact class probabilities and Bayes error. Furthermore, we provide a theoretical guarantee that rendering these cases into natural-language memos strictly preserves their underlying generative probabilities. This exactness enables direct measurement of reported probability quality via KL divergence. Across 16 evaluated models, most models on the observed cost-quality Pareto frontiers are decision models, including Jev and Perplexity Decider. Finally, ProbabilityBench serves as a meta-evaluation framework, leveraging known ground-truth values to benchmark the accuracy of standard calibration metrics and Bayes-error estimators themselves.

</details>


### [1446] [A Sense of Proprioception in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17495)
*Jonas Geiping*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出语言模型的"数字本体感觉"概念，即模型报告自身内部状态（如MoE专家激活、token熵、决策深度、logit lens信息）的能力，并通过SFT和on-policy训练赋予模型该能力，同时不损害原有能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类本体感觉是独立于内省的、有专门受体和可验证结果的自我运动/位置感知。语言模型训练时无法观察自身内部状态，无法准确报告（如某层MoE中激活了哪些专家）。但这些信息因内在于模型而可获取，且可构造为可验证信号，因此可作为"数字本体感觉"的基础。

Method: 通过监督微调（SFT）和on-policy训练，训练模型理解多种本体感觉子类型，包括路由决策感知、token熵、决策深度和logit lens信息。

Result: 现代模型可被训练掌握多种本体感觉子类型，且不影响模型原有能力。随后通过情境感知、可读性和副现象性的广泛评估，考察本体感觉如何改变模型行为。

Conclusion: 语言模型可以获得数字本体感觉，即对自身内部状态的可验证报告能力，且不损害原有能力；其行为影响通过情境感知、可读性和副现象性评估进行分析。

Abstract: In humans, proprioception corresponds to the sense of self-movement or position, e.g. understanding the position of one's arm. This sense is often less well-understood and in popular understanding sometimes conflated with introspection. But, notably, proprioception is a separate sense, with dedicated receptors and verifiable outcomes. On the other hand though, language models cannot observe their own internal states during training (and for example answer the question which experts activated in a certain layer of an MoE) and so cannot accurately report on them. Yet, such information is, by virtue of being internal to the model, both accessible, and readily constructed into verifiable signals. We argue that this provides the basis for a digital analog of proprioception. As such, we train models through SFT and on-policy training to equip them with this ability. We show that modern models can be trained to understand a range of subtypes of proprioception, such as routing decision awareness, token entropy, decision depth or logit lens information, without affecting model capabilities. We then run these models through a broad evaluation of situational awareness, legibility, and epiphenomenality, to evaluate in what ways access to proprioception changes model behavior.

</details>


### [1447] [LLM Evaluation is a Forecasting Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17018)
*Rahul Thomas,Adam Block,Micah Goldblum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 网页文本分布随时间非平稳变化，LLM性能也随时间连续漂移；用时间序列预测器预测未来性能，比历史性能本身更能可靠选择模型，时间应作为LLM评估的基本变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习通常假设训练/测试数据IID，但实际中模型在过去的分布上训练、部署于未来的不同分布。作者想探究网页文本是否非平稳，以及这种漂移如何影响模型评估与部署选择。

Method: 作者分析网页文本分布随时间的偏移，并在多个基准上追踪模型性能随时间的变化；比较不同评估数据（历史vs近期）的预测能力，并用时间序列预测器基于历史性能预测未来表现，用于模型部署选择。

Result: 网页文本高度非平稳，模型性能随时间连续变化；近期评估数据更能预测未来表现，而基于历史性能的时间序列预测效果最佳；按预测准确率选择模型能更可靠地选出高表现模型，提升下游准确率。

Conclusion: 时间应被视为LLM评估中的基本变量，且基于预测性能的模型选择在部署场景中更可靠。作者公开了代码和数据。

Abstract: Standard procedure in machine learning is to randomly split train and test data, emulating IID draws from one underlying data distribution. In practice, models are trained on past data and deployed in the future, which may come from distinct distributions. In this paper, we find that web text is indeed highly non-stationary, as text distributions shift over time. We further observe that model performance changes continuously over time across diverse benchmarks. Consequently, future model performance is better predicted by measurements made on recent evaluation data, and is best predicted by time series forecasters applied to historic performance rather than by historic performance itself. Choosing which model to deploy based on forecasted accuracy enables more reliable selection of performant models, thus improving downstream accuracy in the regime practitioners care about: deployment. Taken together, our experiments suggest that time should be treated as a fundamental variable in LLM evaluation. We release our code and data.

</details>


### [1448] [SPLICE: Sparse Physics Library Identification and Compositional Expansion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17029)
*Lucas Thil,Jesse Read,Guillaume Doquet,Rim Kaddah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SPLICE框架，无需机制标签即可从无标注混合轨迹中发现并扩展神经算子库，实现零样本模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子拆分方法需提前指定物理机制及其标签，无法从无标注数据中自适应发现和增长算子库。

Method: 通过求解凸优化问题推断各候选算子对每条轨迹的贡献；用校准测试为发现的算子分配其实现的机制；支持检测失败案例（库缺少物理机制或机制不可充分分离）。

Result: 在一维和二维系统中，发现的算子能从无标注混合中恢复机制并零样本模拟未见方程；冻结库可无标签、无遗忘地为缺失物理增长算子；Navier-Stokes上精度接近有监督对手。

Conclusion: SPLICE使预训练算子库能从无标签混合数据中适应与扩展，实现零样本模拟与失败可检测。

Abstract: Neural operator splitting composes a library of neural operators, one per physical mechanism, into zero-shot simulators of new equations. Existing approaches, however, require these mechanisms and their labels to be specified in advance. We ask whether a pretrained library can instead be adapted and grown from unlabeled trajectories in which multiple mechanisms act simultaneously. We introduce SPLICE, a framework that discovers operators without mechanism labels on mixture data. The contributions of the candidate operators to each trajectory are inferred by solving a convex optimization problem. A calibrated test then assigns each discovered operator the mechanism it implements. Failure cases are also detectable, when the library lacks the required physics or when mechanisms are insufficiently separable. Across one and two dimensional systems, the discovered operators recover mechanisms from unlabeled mixtures and compose into zero-shot simulators of unseen equations; a frozen library can also grow an operator for physics absent from pretraining, without labels and without forgetting. On Navier-Stokes, the discovered operators compose about as accurately as their supervised counterparts.

</details>


### [1449] [Gradient Routing Localizes and Removes Unintended Behaviors in RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17062)
*Jake Ward,Shawn Hu,Aria Wong,Nathan Hu,Bryce Woodworth,Alexander Matt Turner,Alex Cloud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GRAFT方法，通过将可疑样本的梯度更新限制到"牺牲参数"上，解决强化学习中因奖励函数错误设定和监控器系统性错误导致的奖励黑客问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿AI系统中，奖励函数常有错误设定（misspecified），会引发非预期行为；同时用于检测这些行为的监控器存在系统性错误。直接用监控器做数据过滤或施加奖励惩罚，无法阻止模型学会奖励黑客，甚至会让模型学会隐藏不当行为。

Method: GRAFT（Gradient Routing Adapter Fine Tuning）：不对被标记的样本进行惩罚或过滤，而是将这些样本上的梯度更新限制到一组新增的"牺牲参数"（sacrificial parameters）上。这样监控器不进入奖励函数，模型不会学会隐藏不当行为；同时消融牺牲参数可减少或完全消除非预期行为。

Result: 在135M到8B参数的RL环境中验证：奖励惩罚会让模型以未被检测到的方式进行奖励黑客，而GRAFT可避免此问题。此外，将含奖励黑客行为的前沿LLM轨迹蒸馏到Qwen3-32B时，也能在不教会该模型奖励黑客的情况下取得类似效果。

Conclusion: GRAFT是一种在难以评估真实性能的训练场景下，利用不完美监控器进行后训练的有前景的方法。

Abstract: We propose a mitigation to reward hacking in reinforcement learning. Our setup involves a misspecified reward function that gives rise to unintended behavior, and a monitor used to detect unintended behavior. As with frontier AI systems, the monitor makes systematic errors. Consequently, using the monitor for data filtering or to apply a reward penalty fails to prevent the model from learning unintended behavior ("reward hacking"). To address this problem, we introduce GRAFT: Gradient Routing Adapter Fine Tuning. Rather than penalizing or filtering flagged samples during training, GRAFT constrains gradient updates on those samples to a sacrificial set of new parameters.
