This has two benefits: First, because the monitor is not part of the reward function, the model does not learn to hide misbehavior. Second, ablating the sacrificial parameters reduces or entirely stops the unintended behavior while maintaining improved performance on target tasks. We demonstrate these benefits in RL environments where reward penalties cause models to learn to reward hack in undetected ways, training models ranging from 135M to 8B parameters. Additionally, we show a similar effect at a larger scale by distilling frontier LLM trajectories containing reward hacking into Qwen3-32B, without teaching that model to reward hack. Overall, our work suggests GRAFT may be a promising approach for leveraging imperfect monitors during post-training in settings where true performance is difficult to evaluate.

</details>


### [1450] [TILE: Bridging LLMs and Table Foundation Models for Tabular Learning with Strings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17065)
*Félix Lefebvre,David Holzmüller,Gioia Blayer,Myung Jun Kim,Marine Le Morvan,Gaël Varoquaux*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 TILE（Table-Interfaced LLM Embeddings），强调 LLM 与表格之间的接口设计与 LLM 本身同样重要，通过行序列化、中间层提取、列池化和旁路特征四个组件有效提取表格表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实表格常是异构的，混合数值列与自由文本字符串列。表格基础模型擅长数值表格但需将字符串数值化编码，而 LLM 有语义知识却不适合直接做表格预测。现有方法多把 LLM 当作逐单元格的插件式编码器，但如何为表格学习有效提取表示仍未充分探索。

Method: TILE 包含四个组件：(1) 行序列化以提供跨列上下文；(2) 中间层提取以避免面向下一词预测的层；(3) 列池化以消除均值池化的长度偏差；(4) 旁路特征让数值和类别绕过 LLM。该方法与表格基础模型（TFM）配对使用。

Result: 逐单元格应用时更大的 LLM 并未带来更好特征，而使用该接口后同一批 LLM 随规模增长性能稳步提升。在 100 个数据集上，TILE 在 89% 的划分上超过最强基线，覆盖 7 个 LLM 和 10 个表格学习器，并在 108 数据集的 STRABLE 基准上排名第一。

Conclusion: LLM 与表格之间的接口设计至关重要，TILE 为含字符串的表格设立了新的最先进水平，验证了接口优化对表格表示学习的普适增益。

Abstract: Real-world tables are often heterogeneous, combining numerical features with free-form string columns. Table foundation models (TFMs) excel on numerical tables but require strings to be encoded numerically, while large language models (LLMs) hold semantic knowledge but are not designed for tabular predictions. Most existing bridges use LLMs as plug-in encoders for cell strings, yet how to extract representations effectively for tabular learning remains underexplored. We show that the interface between LLMs and tables matter as much as the LLM itself. Applied cell-wise, larger LLMs do not give better features. With our interface, the same LLMs improve steadily with size. TILE (Table-Interfaced LLM Embeddings) combines four ingredients: row serialization to provide cross-column context, intermediate-layer extraction to avoid layers specialized for next-token prediction, columnar pooling to remove mean pooling's length bias, and by-pass features to route numbers and categories past the LLM. Paired with TFMs, TILE sets a new state of the art for tables with strings. Across 100 datasets, it beats the strongest baseline on 89% of splits, with gains across 7 LLMs and 10 tabular learners, and ranks first on the 108-dataset STRABLE benchmark.

</details>


### [1451] [RELAY: Selective Self-Distillation with Adaptive Hand-off for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17623)
*Kunwang Zheng,Xinyu Sun,Yu Cao,Shuocheng Li,Lei Cheng,Ying Liu,Qilong Zhang,Jinlong Chen,Hua Yang,Qianglong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RELAY结合选择性教师蒸馏与GRPO，并用"平台期检测器"在恰当时机移除教师，从而在基于评分标准的强化学习中取得更优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于评分标准（rubric）的强化学习将所有标准压缩为单一奖励，丢失了rubric的细粒度信息，且当一组回答分数相同时GRPO无法获得奖励梯度。虽然用冻结教师读取rubric作为特权上下文可提供token级监督，但作者观察到其相对GRPO的收益会较早进入平台期。

Method: RELAY利用优势值和奖励筛选正优势及低分零优势的rollout进行选择性蒸馏，并监控蒸馏损失以决定何时退役教师。Stage 1将冻结教师的选择性蒸馏与GRPO结合；平台期检测器触发后移除教师，Stage 2仅用GRPO继续训练。

Result: 检测器在一个模型-领域对上校准后，在另外三组设置中无需改动即可复用，触发步数在122–171之间。在全部四个设置中，RELAY的域内得分均高于对比方法：在RaR-Medicine上，Qwen3-1.7B领先GRPO 4.62分，Qwen3-4B领先6.02分。在Qwen3-1.7B/Medicine上，从共享检查点移除教师优于保留、弱化或刷新教师；仅蒸馏覆盖约一半回答token的选定rollout，也优于在相同平均系数下蒸馏全部rollout。

Conclusion: 初步证据表明RELAY的选择性蒸馏与适时移除教师策略优于持续使用或不用教师的方法，但摘要中尚未给出跨更多模型与领域的验证及相对更广泛基线的完整比较。

Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning grades a response against many written criteria but collapses them into one reward, which discards the detail the rubric carries and gives no GRPO reward gradient when a group's responses tie. A frozen teacher that reads the rubric as privileged context provides token-level supervision, but we observe an early plateau in the gains over GRPO. RELAY uses advantages and rewards to select positive-advantage and low-scoring zero-advantage rollouts, and monitors the distillation loss to decide when to retire the teacher. Stage 1 combines selective distillation from a frozen teacher with GRPO; a plateau detector then removes the teacher, and Stage 2 continues with GRPO alone. Calibrated on one model-domain pair and reused unchanged in three others, the plateau detector fires between steps 122 and 171. RELAY scores highest in-domain among the compared methods in all four settings, ahead of GRPO on RaR-Medicine by 4.62 points with Qwen3-1.7B and 6.02 with Qwen3-4B. On Qwen3-1.7B/Medicine, removing the teacher from a shared checkpoint outperforms keeping, weakening or refreshing it. Distilling selected rollouts covering about half the response tokens also outperforms distilling all rollouts at a matched average coefficient.

</details>


### [1452] [Nearest Neighbor Functional Curve Completion for Intraday Probabilistic Revisions of Renewable Generation Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17075)
*Guillermo Terrén-Serrano,Michael Ludkovski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种非参数曲线补全方法，将日前预测与当日上午实测融合为日内概率预测，用于可再生能源发电，校准效果良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代电网日内可再生能源发电预测是关键运营任务，需结合日前预测与当日部分实测生成剩余时段轨迹并量化运行不确定性。

Method: 基于功能曲线补全框架，利用大量完整的预测-实测曲线对，采用函数视角，依据观测部分曲线、日前预测、日期和地理位置构建加权邻域，选取近邻完整曲线形成含函数焦点包络和基于函数深度的预测带的全预测分布；超参数（邻域大小、距离、融合率）按预测更新时刻调优，直接以预测PIT校准为目标。

Result: 合成风电、光伏资产及真实区域风电三个案例研究显示算法实现了优异的校准性能。

Conclusion: 该非参数曲线补全方法能有效融合多源信息，生成良好校准的可再生能源日内概率预测。

Abstract: We propose a nonparametric approach that fuses deterministic initial forecasts and a partial realization into a probabilistic forecast using the framework of functional curve completion. Our motivation is to construct intra-day forecasts for renewable energy generation, which is a key operational task in modern power grids. The aim is to combine the day-ahead (DA) forecast and the morning realized generation profile to create trajectories for the rest of the day, quantifying operational uncertainty. Starting with a large database of complete forecast-actual pairs across many assets, we adopt a functional point of view and construct a weighted neighborhood based on similarity metrics for the observed partial curve, the DA forecast, the day, and the geographical location. The selected complete nearest-neighbor curves provide a full predictive distribution, including functional focal envelopes and predictive bands based on functional depth. The hyperparameters governing neighborhood size, distances, and fusion rates are tuned across forecast update times and directly target probabilistic calibration in terms of the predictive probability integral transform. Three case studies using synthetic wind and solar assets, as well as real-life regional wind generation, showcase that our algorithm is able to achieve excellent calibration.

</details>


### [1453] [DisaggKD: Efficient Knowledge Distillation through Teacher-Student Disaggregation and a Fused Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17644)
*Ruixuan Tu,Yuyang Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DisaggKD 将知识蒸馏中的教师与学生分离到不同节点，通过流式传输隐藏状态、行窗口+词表分片的等价损失，以及预取环形调度，突破单 GPU 显存限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 KD 框架把教师和学生放在同一 GPU 上，单卡显存限制了大教师模型的可用性。

Method: 将教师副本与学生跨节点分离；教师流式传输隐藏状态给学生；使用行窗口和词表分片的 KD 损失，在精确算术下等价于全词表损失且无需构建全词表 logits；用预取环形调度协调生产者与训练器；并给出闭式显存与流量模型定位各布局瓶颈。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B→9B 上，分离布局匹配同损失的共置运行 LM loss 且更快；融合损失还能让共置运行以更少节点更快训练；当学生跨多节点时分离布局显存高效。更大规模配对中，共置+融合损失仍 OOM，而分离布局可训练，因为教师权重与学生状态占满预算。

Conclusion: DisaggKD 通过跨节点分离教师与学生，在保持损失等价的同时提升显存效率与训练速度，使更大教师模型的蒸馏成为可能。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) frameworks place teacher and student on the same GPUs, so per-GPU memory limits the teachers that fit. DisaggKD separates them across nodes: teacher replicas stream hidden states to the student, a KD loss over row windows and vocabulary shards equals the full-vocabulary loss in exact arithmetic without forming the full-vocabulary logits, and a prefetch ring paces producer and trainer. Closed-form memory and traffic models locate the memory limits of each layout. On the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to 9B pair, the disaggregated layout matches the LM loss of the colocated run with the same loss and is faster than that run; our fused loss also lets a colocated run train on as few nodes at faster speed, while the split is memory efficient when the student spans several nodes. On the larger pairs, colocated runs with a fused loss still run OOM where the split trains, because teacher weights and student states fill the budget.

</details>


### [1454] [Masked Diffusion for Travel Diaries Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17109)
*Pascal Jutras-Dubé,Raziq Zaman,Fabian Bastin,Cinzia Cirillo,Ruqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DiaryBridge，将家庭出行日记整体tokenize为单序列，用掩码扩散模型统一实现合成与部分补全，效果优于学习基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有家庭出行调查合成流程将数据拆分到多个模型或裁剪为定长向量，导致跨段依赖断裂、家庭结构分布被截断，表示而非建模成为瓶颈。

Method: 把家庭日记tokenize为整体序列：每个家庭-日为一个token序列，用计数token表示车辆、人员、出行数，用特殊符号区分填充、隐藏、未观测、不适用位置；提出DiaryBridge——掩码扩散模型，从全隐藏序列出发，按任意顺序解掩码，桥接到完整日记分布。

Result: 在2017/2018巴尔的摩区域出行调查真实数据上，DiaryBridge生成反映车辆可用性与就业状态的出行，可利用其他家庭成员日记恢复共享出行，在方式、目的和出发时段上比学习基线更好地复现总需求。

Conclusion: 将对象整体tokenize并用掩码扩散建模，一个模型即可在任意观测子集条件下同时完成合成与部分日记补全，优于拆分/裁剪的现有基线。

Abstract: Because household travel surveys combine household characteristics, variable-length person rosters, vehicle rosters, and trip chains, existing synthesis pipelines split them across separate models or flatten them into cropped fixed-length vectors. Representation, rather than modeling, becomes the bottleneck: splitting severs cross-segment dependence, and cropping truncates the household-structure distribution. We instead tokenize the diary and keep the object whole: each household-day becomes one token sequence with count tokens for vehicles, persons, and trips, and distinct symbols for padded, hidden, unobserved, and inapplicable positions. We introduce DiaryBridge, a masked diffusion model that bridges the fully hidden sequence to the distribution of complete diaries by unmasking positions in any order. One trained model, conditioned on any observed subset, performs synthesis and partial-diary completion alike. Experiments on real data extracted from the 2017/2018 Regional Travel Survey of the Baltimore region show that DiaryBridge generates travel reflecting vehicle availability and employment status, recovers shared trips using other household members' observed diaries, and better reproduces aggregate demand across modes, purposes, and departure periods than the learned baselines.

</details>


### [1455] [DeltaTTG: Training Multi-Turn Agents with a Token-to-Go Progress Meter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17666)
*Xuyan Ye,Xiyan Fu,Shengda Fan,Jiawei Cui,Yankai Lin,Wei Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DeltaTTG 通过学习可复用的进度信号（Token-to-Go）为多轮智能体的 RLVR 提供稠密步级指导，无需任务特定规则或昂贵外部评估器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮智能体 RLVR 依赖稀疏的终端奖励，无法反映单步质量。组内步比较需要可靠的状态匹配和多样的采样结果，而直接步评分往往需要昂贵的外部评估器、人工标注或任务特定启发式。

Method: 提出共享进度计（progress meter）学习可复用进度信号，监督目标为 Token-to-Go（TTG），即任务完成前剩余需生成的 token 数，作为剩余完成工作量的可观测代理。使用来自不同策略记录轨迹的低成本监督，无任务特定进度规则。训练时冻结进度计，其估计变化仅在各步间重新分配由结果导出的优势，不改变奖励，保持每条轨迹优势符号与 token 平均尺度。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、PaperSearchQA、BFCLv3 上，DeltaTTG 相比 GRPO 分别用 Qwen3-4B 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 平均提升 5.7 和 7.2 分，平均优于所有对比 RL 基线，且 actor 训练 GPU 时长接近 GRPO。进一步实验显示样本效率和域外性能提升，进度计能区分步质量并指导测试时动作选择，跨 actor 规模均有效。

Conclusion: DeltaTTG 以低成本可复用进度信号实现了多轮智能体的步级优势重分配，在多项任务上优于 GRPO 及对比基线，兼顾性能与训练效率，并具备跨规模泛化能力。代码已开源。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for multi-turn agents relies on sparse terminal rewards that say little about individual steps. Within-group step comparisons depend on reliable state matching and sufficiently diverse sampled outcomes, while direct step scoring may require costly external evaluators, human annotations, or task-specific heuristics. We introduce DeltaTTG to learn a reusable progress signal through a shared progress meter, using low-cost supervision from diverse policies' recorded trajectories without task-specific progress rules. Its supervision target, Token-to-Go (TTG), the number of tokens remaining to be generated until task completion, serves as an observable proxy for remaining completion effort. During actor training, changes in the frozen meter's estimates redistribute outcome-derived advantages across steps without altering the reward, preserving each trajectory's advantage sign and token-average scale. On ALFWorld, PaperSearchQA, and BFCLv3, DeltaTTG improves the average score over GRPO by 5.7 and 7.2 points with Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, respectively, outperforms all compared RL baselines on average, and keeps actor-training GPU-hours close to GRPO. Further experiments show improved sample efficiency and out-of-domain performance, and support the meter's ability to distinguish step quality and guide test-time action selection across actor sizes. The code is available at https://github.com/Xuyan923r/DeltaTTG.

</details>


### [1456] [Can Rényi Accountants Beat Lossless Accountants for DP-SGD?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17120)
*Jinho Bok*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文质疑无损DP表示（如f-DP）总是优于Rényi DP的观点，针对固定批量、replace adjacency的DP-SGD，重新刻画最坏情况分布并改进Rényi DP界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Rényi DP等松弛方法常被认为给出的(ε,δ)-DP保证不如隐私损失分布、f-DP等无损表示紧。作者探究这一认知是否总是成立，尤其在DP-SGD设定下。

Method: 针对固定批量、replace adjacency的DP-SGD，指出Rényi DP记账可使用与无损框架不同的最坏情况分布（支配对）；将最坏情况分布刻画为二维高斯混合，并据此推导改进的Rényi DP界。

Result: 数值与渐近比较表明，在多种超参数设置下，基于新界的Rényi DP记账可给出比无损框架更好的隐私保证。

Conclusion: 无损表示并不总是优于Rényi DP；合理选择支配对可让Rényi DP在DP-SGD中取得更优的隐私保证。

Abstract: Recent frameworks in differential privacy (DP), such as privacy loss distributions and $f$-DP, provide lossless representations of the privacy leakage of mechanisms. These approaches are often considered to yield tighter $(\varepsilon, δ)$-DP guarantees than those obtained from relaxed notions such as Rényi DP. But is that always the case? We study this question for differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) with fixed-size batches under replace adjacency. Our key observation is that in this setting, privacy accounting based on Rényi DP can use a pair of worst-case distributions (i.e., a dominating pair) that differs from the one used in the lossless frameworks. In particular, we characterize the worst-case distributions as two-dimensional Gaussian mixtures and derive an improved Rényi DP bound for DP-SGD. Numerical and asymptotic comparisons show that across various hyperparameter settings, a Rényi DP accountant based on the new bound can yield better privacy guarantees than those obtained from the lossless frameworks.

</details>


### [1457] [Masked Attention Pooling Is Invariant to Padding and Permutation: A Formal Proof in Lean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17132)
*Yusuf Khaled Sadek,Enes Yilmaz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文定义了带受保护归一化器的掩码注意力池化（masked attention pooling with a guarded normalizer），并用 Lean 4 + mathlib 证明其对行重索引和追加掩码行不变、全掩码袋映射为零；再通过 jax-lean 证书管线将该定理连接到 JAX 内核追踪出的 Jaxpr，完成两个具体形状的翻译证书审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于注意力的多实例学习（MIL）在批训练中需将变长袋填充到公共长度，人们期望池化输出不依赖于填充量或实例存储顺序。但这一期望仅在从分子和 softmax 归一化器中同时移除填充行时成立，而常见实现（仅清零填充特征、用 -∞ 掩码 logits、或用大负数常数掩码）只在特定副作用条件下成立或需要浮点下溢后才精确。

Method: 作者定义了带受保护归一化器的掩码注意力池化，将正确性形式化：在 Lean 4 与 mathlib 中证明其对于任意双射行重索引、以及追加任意有限个具有任意实数特征和 logits 的掩码行均保持不变；并证明掩码位置的值无关、全掩码袋映射为零。定理适用于任意有限索引类型和特征维度。随后使用 jax-lean 证书管线，把定理与从 JAX 内核追踪得到的 Jaxpr 相连，对两个具体形状检查翻译证书，识别生成函数与通用规范，并将两种不变性迁移到导入 Jaxpr 的实数算术语义上。

Result: 所有审计定理仅依赖 Lean 的三个标准公理。证明建立了池化在理想实数算术下的行重索引不变性与追加掩码行不变性，并通过翻译证书将结果转移到 JAX 内核对应的 Jaxpr 语义上。

Conclusion: 论文给出一个经机器验证正确的掩码注意力池化规范，解决了常见填充实现中掩码语义不精确的问题。结论限于理想实数算术；浮点执行、XLA 以及 JAX 追踪器与导入器仍在证明范围之外。

Abstract: Attention-based multiple instance learning (MIL) pools a variable-size bag of instance embeddings into one vector. In batched training, bags are padded to a common length, and the pooled output is expected not to depend on how much padding was added or on the order in which instances are stored. This expectation holds only if padded rows are removed from both the numerator and the softmax normalizer. Common implementation idioms meet it only under side conditions. Zeroing padded features alone does not work. Masking logits with $-\infty$ fails on empty bags and on nonfinite padding. Masking with a large negative constant is exact only after floating-point underflow. We define masked attention pooling with a guarded normalizer and prove in Lean 4 with mathlib that it is invariant under any bijective reindexing of rows and under appending any finite number of masked rows with arbitrary real features and logits. We also prove that values at masked positions are irrelevant and that an all-masked bag maps to zero. The theorems hold for arbitrary finite index types and feature dimensions. Using the jax-lean certificate pipeline, we connect these theorems to the Jaxpr traced from the JAX kernel itself. Lean checks translation certificates for two concrete shapes, identifies the generated functions with the generic specification, and transfers both invariances to the imported Jaxpr's real-arithmetic semantics. All audited theorems depend only on Lean's three standard axioms. The results concern ideal real arithmetic. Floating-point execution, XLA, and the JAX tracer and importer remain outside the proof.

</details>


### [1458] [OpenDGO: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Organizations Across Diverse Application Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17143)
*Xunkai Li,Miao Zhang,Zekai Chen,Xuaner Chen,Yu liu,Rui Qian,Xun Wu,Hongchao Qin,Rong-Hua Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OpenDGO基准框架，研究LLM多智能体组织在不同应用下的适用性，发现不存在通用最优组织。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统多采用预设组织（Star、Chain、Tree）或学习通信图，但多在有限领域内设计与评估，缺乏对"某组织在一种领域有效是否适用于其他领域"的理解。

Method: OpenDGO作为受控基准与分析框架，覆盖六个真实领域与三种协作设置（顺序依赖、并行分解、信息整合）。在匹配的任务、智能体、工具和资源限制下，对比固定组织与学习组织，并分别考察通信图、角色分配、输入分配、资源预算和组件故障。

Result: 不存在"一种组织适用于所有场景"的方案：偏好组织因应用而异；即使相同通信图，在不同角色与输入分配下也会产生不同结果。

Conclusion: 强调需要面向应用的组织设计，理解在给定应用下何种组织合适、在什么条件下合适以及为何合适。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems are increasingly applied across diverse domains, yet different applications require different forms of agent organization. Existing studies typically adopt predefined organizations, such as Star, Chain, and Tree, or learn communication graphs to improve performance on specific tasks. However, these methods are largely designed and evaluated within a limited set of application domains, providing little understanding of whether an organization effective in one domain remains suitable for others with different collaboration requirements. We present \textbf{OpenDGO}, a controlled benchmark and analysis framework covering six real-world domains and three collaboration settings: Sequential Dependency, Parallel Decomposition, and Information Integration. Under matched tasks, agents, tools, and resource limits, OpenDGO compares fixed and learned organizations while separately examining communication graphs, role assignments, input assignments, resource budgets, and component failures. Our results show that there is no ``one-organization-for-all'' solution: preferred organizations vary across applications, and even the same communication graph can yield different outcomes under different role and input assignments. These findings highlight the need for application-dependent organization design, aiming to understand \emph{which organization is suitable for a given application, under what conditions, and why}.

</details>


### [1459] [Checking the Checkers: A Synthesis of Verifier Noise and Robustness in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17824)
*Savyasachi Gupta,Aniruddha Srinivas Joshi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述58项关于RLVR中验证器错误的研究，指出错误的结构比错误率更重要，并整理缓解方法、对比表及报告协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR依赖验证器本身正确的假设，但实际中规则检查器会拒绝正确格式、单元测试会接受错误程序、LLM评判者可能被诱导批准对抗性回答。因此需要系统梳理验证器错误的影响与缓解方法。

Method: 综述58项测量、分析或缓解验证器错误的研究，围绕四个问题：验证器犯什么错、如何影响训练、哪种缓解对应哪种错误、结论如何推广到自生成/评分标准/评判者/无验证器的奖励。

Result: 错误结构比错误率更关键：随机错误主要拖慢学习，但在固定预算或KL正则下也降低最终准确率；策略可学会触发的假阳性会导致平台期或崩溃，即使初始错误率低。错误类型取决于检查内容和构建者而非验证器家族，且随策略改进而变化，多数缓解方法仅针对单一错误类型测试。

Conclusion: 验证器错误的结构性影响应被重视；现有缓解方法覆盖面不足。论文整理对比表、调和文献冲突，并提出报告协议以提升未来结果可比性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a principal recipe for improving the reasoning of large language models (LLMs). It rests on the assumption that the checker scoring each response is itself correct. In practice, rule-based checkers reject correct answers in unexpected formats, unit tests accept incorrect programs, and LLM judges can be led to approve empty or adversarial responses. This work surveys 58 studies that measure, analyze, or mitigate such verifier errors. We ask what errors verifiers make, how they affect training, which mitigations work against which errors, and how the findings extend to self-generated, rubric- and judge-based, and verifier-free rewards. The evidence suggests that the structure of an error matters more than its rate. Random errors mostly slow learning, though under a fixed budget or KL regularization they also lower final accuracy. False positives that the policy can learn to trigger can cause plateaus or collapse, sometimes even with a low initial error rate. Whether a verifier wrongly rejects or accepts depends on what it checks and who built it, not on its family. Its errors shift as the policy improves, and most mitigations have been tested against only one kind of error. We compile the findings into comparison tables, reconcile apparent conflicts in the literature, and propose a reporting protocol to make future results comparable.

</details>


### [1460] [FunDM: Cheap & Label-Free Decision Models from Frozen Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17175)
*Ujjawal K. Panchal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FunDM是一个无标签训练的小型决策头，仅用冻结LLM约2/3的transformer层即可恢复99%多选准确率，并在吞吐和内存上更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型需要为候选答案或动作打分。直接用完整大模型代价高；已有CLM等方法在准确率、效率和泛化上仍不足。作者希望用更少层数、无需正确答案标签即可复现全模型的答案概率。

Method: 训练一个无标签决策头：一次backbone前向同时读入问题与所有选项，头为每个选项输出概率；用KL散度学习全模型的答案概率分布，训练时不需要正确标签；使用冻结模型24/36层并跳过LM head。

Result: +1T变体在8个基准上平均75.0%（全模型75.7%）；MMLU-Pro上吞吐为vLLM批处理的1.56–1.57倍、峰值显存约低1/3；优于CLM、微调CLM和从头训练的CLM式头。Agent头无pass/fail标签学习judge概率，100个held-out任务中平均通过74.4–74.6个（全模型judge为74，CLM式动作头52.0）。

Conclusion: 小型无标签决策头能以更少层数和更低资源接近全模型决策性能，并在多选与agent选择任务上优于现有CLM类方法。

Abstract: Decision models such as Jev score candidate answers or actions. A small decision head trained label-free can recover about 99% of a frozen language model's multiple-choice accuracy while using only two-thirds of its transformer layers. It learns the full model's answer probabilities with KL divergence, without correct-answer labels for training. One backbone pass reads the question and all options together; the head returns probabilities for every option. We call this model FunDM (Fun Decision Model). Using 24 of Qwen3-8B's 36 layers and skipping the LM head, its +1T variant reaches 75.0% mean accuracy over eight benchmarks, versus 75.7% for the full model. On MMLU-Pro, both heads achieve 1.56 to 1.57 times batched vLLM throughput with about one-third lower peak GPU allocator memory. Both heads score higher than released Contrastive Language Models (CLM), fine-tuned CLM, and CLM-shaped heads trained from scratch on the eight multiple-choice benchmarks and coding-agent selection. Separately trained agent heads learn judge probabilities without pass/fail labels and select passing runs for 74.4 to 74.6 of 100 held-out tasks on average, versus 74 for the full-model judge and 52.0 for a CLM-shaped action-trained head. Code is available at: https://github.com/Ujjawal-K-Panchal/FunDM

</details>


### [1461] [ModRes: A modification of the ResPlan dataset ready for floor plan analysis and graph machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17178)
*Emma Shelley,Wassim Jabi,Thomas Woolley,Katerina Kaouri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ModRes 是 ResPlan 数据集经清洗与增强后的版本，含 8,431 个有效且唯一的住宅平面图，提供 2D 几何、图像、3D 表示及三种互补对偶图（含图/节点/边级特征），支持机器学习与空间分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开平面图数据集通常需大量预处理才能可靠使用，且存在无效与重复数据，缺乏结构化的几何、拓扑与语义表示。

Method: 通过专门的清洗流程移除无效与重复平面图；为每个平面图提供 2D 几何、图像、3D 建筑表示，以及三种互补对偶图（CSV/JSON 格式，含连续与分类属性）。

Result: 构建出含 8,431 个有效唯一住宅平面图的数据集，并用图统计特征进行刻画，通过多项案例研究验证其可用性。

Conclusion: ModRes 提供结构化的几何、拓扑和语义表示，可用于自动化空间分析及建筑设计、性能评估的机器学习工作流。

Abstract: Floor plan datasets underpin computational analysis of building layouts, spatial connectivity and graph machine learning. However, publicly available datasets often require substantial preprocessing before they can be used reliably. We present ModRes, a cleaned and enriched version of the ResPlan dataset, containing 8,431 valid and unique residential floor plans. Invalid and duplicate floor plans are removed through a dedicated cleaning workflow, producing a ready-to-use dataset. For each floor plan, ModRes provides two-dimensional geometry, images, three-dimensional building representations and three complementary dual graphs in CSV and JSON formats with graph-, node- and edge-level features. Continuous and categorical graph attributes support machine learning workflows. We characterise the dataset using graph-based statistics and demonstrate its utility through a range of case studies. ModRes provides structured geometric, topological and semantic representations needed to automate spatial analysis and support machine learning-based workflows for building design and performance evaluation.

</details>


### [1462] [CartoVec: General-Purpose Location Embeddings from Open Map Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17190)
*Furkan Gursoy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CartoVec 是一个仅用开放地图数据训练、无需影像的坐标编码器，在下游地理任务中取得最优平均表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经纬度只描述位置，不包含周围环境上下文；现有图像位置编码器依赖影像，结构化开放地图数据的监督价值尚待探索。

Method: 训练坐标编码器预测 Overture 衍生的多尺度目标（土地覆盖、土地利用、交通、地点、连通性），不使用图像或下游标签；冻结嵌入并在美国东北部用空间块交叉验证评估。

Result: 在多数 Census 结果上表现最佳，整体任务套件平均性能最高，但若干对比在各折间差距接近。

Conclusion: 开放地图数据可作为可复用位置表示的有效监督来源，推理时无需地图查询，模型已开源。

Abstract: Geographic coordinates are common inputs in applied machine learning, but latitude and longitude describe position rather than the surrounding environment. Image-grounded location encoders learn this context from satellite or ground-level imagery; structured open map data offers another source of supervision whose utility for continuous coordinate encoders remains less explored. We introduce CartoVec, a coordinate encoder trained to predict Overture-derived land cover, land use, transportation, place and connectivity targets at multiple spatial scales, without image inputs or downstream-task labels. We evaluate frozen embeddings on Census outcomes, Airbnb prices and Philadelphia crime in the US Northeast using spatial block cross-validation. CartoVec has the highest mean performance on most Census outcomes and the highest average across the full suite, with several comparisons close across folds. The findings support open map data as a practical source of reusable location representations with a coordinate-to-vector interface that requires no map lookup at inference. The open-weight model is available at https://huggingface.co/gursoyfurkan/CartoVec.

</details>


### [1463] [Evaluating the Causal Faithfulness of SHAP as a Candidate Attribution Method for SAE Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17898)
*Samuel Xie,Noura Al-Moubayed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统评估了SHAP等归因方法对SAE潜在特征的因果忠实性，发现多数忠实性关联经多重比较校正后不显著，且方法间一致性与因果效应吻合度差；局部归因有方向性优势，归因能较好检测特征影响的存在但难以定位其缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAE能将语言模型表示分解为可解释特征，但特征解释仍以相关性为主。归因方法虽能估计特征影响，其在SAE场景中对真实因果效应的忠实性尚未被系统评估。

Method: 在GPT-2 Small与32768特征的第7层SAE上，用SST-2情感分类任务，对SAE潜在特征应用SHAP归因，并与Integrated Gradients、Gradient×Input及探针权重基线对比；涵盖线性与MLP探针，以特征消融和激活引导（通过语言模型自身logit差衡量）作为因果基准进行评分。

Result: 多数忠实性关联经多重比较校正后不显著；方法间高度一致（ρ=0.42–0.80）但与实际因果效应吻合差，说明方法间一致不能证明因果忠实。局部逐样本归因相比全局平均归因保持方向性优势，但其重要性优势由特征活跃度而非更优因果排序解释。在已知真值的最小对比下，归因对插入情感信号的恢复远高于随机（AUROC 0.792），但无法定位删除（AUROC 0.520）。

Conclusion: 重要性忠实性与方向性忠实性是可分离的属性，需分别评估；归因方法间的一致不应替代因果验证。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders decompose language model representations into interpretable features, but feature interpretation in this literature remains predominantly correlational. Attribution methods offer more direct estimates of feature influence, yet their faithfulness to actual causal effects has not been systematically evaluated in the SAE setting. We apply SHAP-based attribution to SAE latent features and evaluate it against direct causal intervention, using sentiment classification on SST-2 with GPT-2 Small and a 32,768-feature layer-7 SAE as a testbed. We compare SHAP to Integrated Gradients, Gradient$\times$Input, and probe-weight baselines across linear and MLP probe arms, scoring each against feature ablation and activation steering measured through the language model's own logit difference. Most faithfulness associations we measure do not survive multiple-comparison correction, and attribution methods that agree strongly with one another ($ρ= 0.42$--$0.80$) agree poorly with measured causal effects, indicating that inter-method agreement is not evidence of causal faithfulness. Two effects hold under control. First, local per-example attribution retains a directional advantage over global averaged attribution, while its apparent importance advantage is explained by feature activity rather than superior causal ranking. Second, under known-ground-truth minimal pairs, attribution recovers inserted sentiment signal well above chance (AUROC $0.792$) but fails to localize deletions (AUROC $0.520$), suggesting that these methods detect the presence of a feature's influence more reliably than its absence. We argue that importance faithfulness and directional faithfulness are separable properties requiring separate evaluation, and that attribution agreement should not substitute for causal validation.

</details>


### [1464] [FreeSolo: Linear-time Sparse Attention with Zero-Shot Length Extrapolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17191)
*Zekun Shi,Alastair James Arthur Price*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FreeSolo 提出一种原生稀疏注意力机制，通过短程滑窗与长程关键点选择分支，实现线性时间与 O(N log²N) 的变体，并在无需长上下文微调下展现更优的零样本长度外推。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性模型固定状态容量受限，混合全注意力带来二次开销；稀疏注意力加持续预训练(CPT)虽可扩展有效上下文，但泛化超出训练长度仍困难且 CPT 成本高。

Method: 提出 FreeSolo 原生稀疏注意力：短程滑窗分支 + 长程分支选择关键点单元做直接 token 注意力。线性变体 FS-L 通过短 CPT 学习在查询相关选择前剪枝前缀；FS-B 用平衡树搜索，含基数排序构建，算法成本 O(N log²N)。

Result: 在无需长上下文微调的情况下，FreeSolo 相比基线展现出更好的零样本长度外推能力。

Conclusion: FreeSolo 以稀疏注意力兼顾效率与外推，为长上下文建模提供低成本方案。

Abstract: Linear-time sequence models typically store long-context information in a recurrent state. A fixed-size state limits how much information can be stored, while hybrid architectures that add full attention for better recall incur quadratic sequence cost. Alternatively, sparse attention with continued pretraining (CPT) can extend the effective context length. Generalization beyond the trained length remains challenging, however, and CPT can be costly. We introduce FreeSolo, a native sparse attention mechanism with a short-range sliding window branch and a long-range branch that selects keypoint cells for direct token attention. Its linear-time variant, FS-L, learns to prune the prefix before query-dependent selection through short CPT. FS-B searches balanced trees with $O(N\log^2 N)$ algorithmic cost including radix-sort construction. FreeSolo demonstrates better zero-shot length extrapolation than the baselines without long-context fine-tuning.

</details>


### [1465] [HaloBlock: Faster and Better Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17948)
*Zhaohui Zheng,Chenhang He,Jinrui Zhang,Ming-Ming Cheng,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HaloBlock提出一种难度感知的自适应halo机制，用于扩散大语言模型推理，缓解块右端解码困难与块边界上下文不连续问题，在多个模型与基准上提升精度与推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: dLLM虽具备双向注意力和任意顺序解码优势，但推理时存在两个问题：解码难度主要由块右侧token主导，且块式解码导致边界上下文不连续。

Method: 先用双向累积熵刻画块的解码难度；再基于双向解码难度，在每个块两侧自适应分配双向halo区域，平滑跨块上下文传播并降低难token的解码难度。

Result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Dream-7B-Instruct和LLaDA-1.5上，针对数学推理与代码生成基准，HaloBlock实现一致的准确率提升与更高的推理效率。

Conclusion: HaloBlock通过难度感知的自适应halo机制，改善dLLM生成质量并加速收敛，代码已开源。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have attracted increasing research attention due to their bidirectional attention and arbitrary order decoding. However, there are two issues in dLLMs inference: the decoding difficulty is dominated by the tokens on the right side of the block, and the block-wise decoding inherently suffers from boundary contextual discontinuity. To tackle these limitations, we propose HaloBlock, a difficulty-aware adaptive halo mechanism for dLLM inference. We first leverage bidirectional cumulative entropy to characterize block decoding difficulty. Then, based on the bidirectional decoding difficulty, we adaptively allocate bidirectional halo regions on both sides of each block to mitigate boundary contextual discontinuity. The difficulty-aware design of HaloBlock smooths cross-block context propagation and lowers decoding difficulty for hard tokens, yielding better generation quality and faster convergence. Evaluated on LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-7B-Instruct and LLaDA-1.5 across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, HaloBlock demonstrates consistent accuracy improvements and higher inference efficiency. Source codes are publicly available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HaloBlock.

</details>


### [1466] [Match the Canvas, Not Just the Answer: Predictability-Aware SFT for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18001)
*Miao Li,Hanyang Jiang,Hengyu Fu,Baihe Huang,Yating Liu,Yuhang Cai,Changkun Guan,Zhongzhu Chen,Jiecheng Lu,Michael A. Boateng,Pascal Van Hentenryck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出PACS方法，通过利用模型自身可预测性来选择注意力可见输入长度并监督参考token，解决扩散语言模型SFT中的训练-推理不匹配问题，在推理和代码生成基准上取得最高平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）支持按模型可预测性进行并行生成而非固定从左到右，这引入了标准自回归teacher forcing中没有的训练选择：监督目标时哪些参考token可见，以及分配多少生成空间。标准SFT通常用随机掩码进行这些选择，独立于推理过程。分析表明这种训练-推理不匹配会误导监督：随机掩码可能掩盖预测错误或惩罚解码本可解决的不确定性，而注意力可见的输入长度会改变模型偏好的响应表述。

Method: 提出Predictability-Aware Canvas Selection and Supervision（PACS），一种SFT方法。PACS利用模型自身的可预测性来选择每个样本的注意力可见输入长度，并在参考token被置信度引导揭示之前立即对其进行监督。

Result: 在推理和代码生成基准上，PACS在所比较的SFT方法中始终取得最高平均准确率，在个别基准上相比vanilla SFT提升最高达12.84个百分点。代码将在发表后发布。

Conclusion: PACS通过使训练选择与推理过程对齐，有效缓解训练-推理不匹配问题，显著提升扩散语言模型在推理和代码生成任务上的表现。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable flexible parallel generation by resolving tokens according to the model's evolving predictability rather than a fixed left-to-right order. This flexibility, however, introduces training choices absent from standard autoregressive teacher forcing: which reference tokens are visible when a target is supervised and how much generation space is allocated. Standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) typically makes these choices through random masking, independently of inference. Our analysis shows how this training-inference mismatch can misdirect supervision. Random masking can conceal prediction errors or penalize uncertainty that decoding would otherwise resolve, while the attention-visible input length can change which response formulations the model favors, even when the underlying solution is unchanged. Motivated by these findings, we propose Predictability-Aware Canvas Selection and Supervision (PACS), an SFT method. PACS uses the model's own predictability to select each example's attention-visible input length and supervises reference tokens immediately before their confidence-guided revelation. Across reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, PACS consistently achieves the highest mean accuracy among the compared SFT methods, with gains of up to 12.84 percentage points over vanilla SFT on individual benchmarks. Code will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [1467] [inLoRA-MINT: Internal Representations for Auditing Training Data in Domain-adapted LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18051)
*Gonzalo Mancera,Julian Fierrez,Aythami Morales,Ruben Tolosana,Daniel DeAlcala,Francisco Jurado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于中间层表示（激活和参数相关信号）的MINT方法，在严格黑盒条件下检测LoRA微调LLM的训练样本，在4个LLM、3个数据集上取得95%-98%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究成员推断测试（MINT）用于LoRA微调的大语言模型，判断特定样本是否被用于训练，以应对数据隐私、数据泄漏和透明度问题。此前LoRA-MINT框架仅依赖困惑度，能力受限。

Method: 在已有LoRA-MINT框架基础上，提出利用中间模型表示（包括激活值和参数相关信号）构建MINT分类器，无需完整访问模型参数即可区分训练与非训练样本，保持黑盒设定。

Result: 在四个LLM（Qwen、Phi-4、DeepSeek-V3、LLaMA 3.2-3B）和三个数据集（医学、数学、学术推理）上评估，跨架构与领域表现一致，得分95%-98%，对模型配置和数据分布变化具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该方法可高效审计敏感训练数据，支持数据溯源及符合隐私与AI治理法规。虽聚焦LoRA微调，但可扩展至其他LLM适配技术及更广泛的AI模型。

Abstract: This work investigates the application of the Membership Inference Test (MINT) to large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA, aiming to determine whether specific samples were used during training and address concerns about data privacy, leakage, and transparency. Building on our previous LoRA-MINT framework, which relies exclusively on perplexity under a strict black-box setting, we propose an approach based on intermediate model representations, including activations and parameter-dependent signals. These representations enable a MINT classifier to distinguish training from non-training samples without requiring full access to model parameters.
  We evaluated the method on four LLMs (Qwen, Phi-4, DeepSeek-V3, and LLaMA 3.2-3B) fine-tuned on three datasets covering medical, mathematical, and academic reasoning tasks. Results show consistent performance across architectures and domains, achieving scores between 95% and 98%, with robustness to variations in model configurations and data distributions. The proposed approach enables efficient auditing of sensitive training data and supports data provenance and compliance with emerging privacy and AI governance regulations. Although our experiments focus on LoRA-based fine-tuning, the methodology can be extended to other LLM adaptation techniques and, more broadly, to other AI models.

</details>


### [1468] [Density-Matrix Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17214)
*Chiuman Ho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该理论论文提出密度矩阵强化学习(DMRL)，将策略表示为密度矩阵，利用非对角"相干项"记录动作间关系，证明相干项在KL正则微调和二次奖励两个场景下改变结果，其余场景与经典结果一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准策略在每个状态仅存储每个动作的一个概率，无法记录动作之间的关系（哪些动作相容、哪些冲突），即忽略了缺失的结构信息。作者追问这种缺失结构何时真正影响结果。

Method: 将策略存储为密度矩阵（半正定、单位迹，源自量子信息论但作为纯经典数据结构在经典硬件上计算）。对角线为常规动作概率，非对角元为"相干项"，构成新参数，得到密度矩阵强化学习(DMRL)。

Result: 相干项在两个场景下改变结果：(1)以矩阵相对熵正则化到相干参考策略时，最优解含对角参考策略无法产生的相干项，动作概率可依赖参考策略的相干项，与LLM的KL惩罚微调相关；(2)动作是单位向量且奖励为该向量的二次函数时（如LLM评判加权推理路径、耦合机器人传感器），某些相干策略的期望奖励严格高于同动作概率的经典策略，并给出闭式差距。双动作例子中：二者均以0.5分配概率，经典策略期望奖励为0，相干策略为1（最大值）。其他场景与经典结果持平或可迁移。

Conclusion: DMRL将相干项作为额外策略参数，在两种特定设定下带来经典策略无法达到的收益，其余情形保持与经典方法一致。本文为纯理论工作，所有结果均被证明，未报告实证评估。

Abstract: What information does a reinforcement learning policy omit? At each state, a standard policy stores one probability per action. It has no place to record how actions relate to each other, such as which pairs go together and which conflict. We ask when this missing structure matters, and we give exact answers. We store the policy at each state as a density matrix, a positive semidefinite, unit-trace matrix borrowed from quantum information theory. We use it here as a purely classical data structure, computed on ordinary classical hardware. The diagonal holds the usual action probabilities. The off-diagonal entries, called coherences, are new parameters. This gives density-matrix reinforcement learning (DMRL). Coherences change outcomes in two settings. First, suppose a policy is regularized toward a coherent reference policy using matrix relative entropy. The optimum then has coherences that no diagonal reference policy produces, and its action probabilities can depend on the reference policy's coherences. This is relevant to fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) with a Kullback--Leibler penalty. Second, suppose the agent chooses a unit-vector action and the reward is a quadratic function of that vector. This could arise when an LLM judge scores a weighted consolidation of reasoning paths, or when coupled robotic sensors each respond to a mix of actions. Then some coherent policies earn strictly more expected reward than every classical policy with the same action probabilities, and we give the margin in closed form. In a two-action example, both policies assign probability $0.5$ to each action, yet the classical one earns expected reward $0$ while the coherent one earns $1$, the maximum. Outside these two settings, DMRL matches or transfers the classical results. This is a theory paper. All results are proved, and we report no empirical evaluation.

</details>


### [1469] [Compute-optimal data scaling for neural surrogates via multi-fidelity training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17221)
*Paul Setinek,Fabian Paischer,Nils Thuerey,Johannes Brandstetter,Felix Koehler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出将神经PDE代理训练视为在固定数据生成算力预算下对数据量与保真度的联合优化问题，并证明多保真训练可实现数据生成算力上的Pareto最优误差扩展，相比仅用高保真数据训练最多节省6.3倍数据生成算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数值模拟器生成的合成数据成本随模型和数据规模增长成为扩展瓶颈；而PDE样本具有可调数值保真度及已知收敛率决定的成本-精度权衡，这一特性尚未被充分利用。

Method: 将保真度视为细粒度离散谱而非二元区分，在固定数据生成算力预算下，把神经代理训练形式化为数据量与保真度的函数；利用低保真模拟作为额外训练信号，寻找最优保真度混合。

Result: 在多保真最优混合下，训练精度匹配仅用高保真训练，且数据生成算力最多减少6.3倍；在六个PDE问题（结构化网格与无结构网格）、两类误差来源（离散化误差与迭代求解误差）、四种代理架构上共7,000余次训练验证。

Conclusion: 多保真训练能够在数据生成算力上实现Pareto最优误差扩展，为PDE神经代理的可扩展训练提供了高效路径。

Abstract: Neural surrogates for Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) are usually trained on synthetic data from numerical simulators. As models grow and scaling laws demand larger datasets, the cost of data generation often outweighs the training cost and becomes the bottleneck in the scaling quest. Unlike data in other domains, however, each PDE sample has a tunable cost that depends on its numerical fidelity, with the resulting cost-accuracy trade-off governed by known convergence rates. We exploit this property by formalizing neural surrogate training as a function of both data quantity and fidelity under a fixed data generation compute budget, treating fidelity as a fine-grained discrete spectrum rather than a binary distinction. Building on this, we show that multi-fidelity training enables Pareto-optimal error scaling against data generation compute. By using simulations at lower fidelities as an additional training signal, training on the optimal fidelity mixture matches the accuracy of high-fidelity-only training, with up to $6.3\times$ less data generation compute across our settings. We validate these findings across six PDE problems spanning structured grids and unstructured meshes, two distinct error sources (discretization and iterative-solver error), and four surrogate architectures, totaling over 7,000 training runs.

</details>


### [1470] [LoOPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Looped Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18162)
*Wei Fan,Qingyue Yang,Chao-Hong Tan,Qian Chen,Wen Wang,Xiangang Li,Kejiang Chen,Weiming Zhang,Nenghai Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoOPSD通过搜索模型层执行顺序（重复某些层）构建更强的教师模型，并将其优势蒸馏给学生，交替进行搜索与蒸馏，在数学和逻辑推理任务上显著提升模型表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏需要比学生更强的教师，通常靠给教师额外上下文或指令获取，本文探索是否可通过改变同一模型对自身层的使用方式获得更强指导。

Method: 保持模型权重不变，搜索可重复的层以构建更强教师；用该教师对学生生成前缀的预测指导学生；交替进行搜索与蒸馏，每轮从更新后的学生重建教师。

Result: 在数学与逻辑推理任务上多模型均有提升。GSM8K、400 token思考预算下，Qwen3-1.7B准确率从42.30%升至79.61%，后续蒸馏轮次继续带来增益。

Conclusion: 通过搜索层执行顺序构建教师，可将模型额外的计算转化为学生能力的提升，为自蒸馏从模型自身计算中获取监督开辟了新途径。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation improves a model using guidance from the model itself, but it still requires a teacher that provides more useful predictions than the student. Existing approaches obtain such guidance by giving the teacher additional context or instructions. We ask whether it can instead come from changing how the same model uses its own layers. To address this, we introduce LoOPSD, which searches over a model's layer execution order to construct a stronger teacher and distills its advantage into the student. Specifically, we keep the model weights unchanged while searching for layers to repeat, and use the resulting teacher's predictions on student-generated prefixes to guide learning. We then alternate search and distillation, rebuilding the teacher from the updated student in each round so that the student progressively absorbs the gains from alternative layer execution. Experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning tasks show improvements across models. On GSM8K with a 400-token thinking budget, LoOPSD raises Qwen3-1.7B accuracy from 42.30% to 79.61%; subsequent distillation rounds yield further gains beyond the first round. Together, these findings show that by searching layer execution to construct teachers, we can turn a model's additional computation into improved student capabilities, opening a new avenue for self-distillation to derive supervision from the model's own computation.

</details>


### [1471] [MIRRA: Fast, High-Fidelity Molecular Generation with Chemistry-Informed Discrete Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17244)
*Ge Sun,Juan J. de Pablo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MIRRA是一种离散流匹配分子生成器，通过化学特征共享与按需评估身份概率，实现快速高保真分子生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子生成需准确化学选择与高效采样。化学构建块虽缩小图规模，但使每个节点成为数万相关身份中的选择，带来概率评估开销与精度权衡问题。

Method: MIRRA（分子身份表示、刷新与组装）为离散流匹配生成器：从化学知识学习，仅在需要时评估身份概率但保持全部词汇可用；化学特征在相关块间共享信息，并用学习到的身份校正区分分子上下文；采样器先决定哪些位置刷新，再计算其概率，避免无用预测并保留每个采样转移。

Result: 相较各任务最强基线，ZINC250k上化学与图分布误差分别降低29-31%和53-60%，生成速度提升至多8.6倍；性质靶向每秒新增独特命中约7.8-20.8倍；留出聚合物测试集上周期有效性达100%（已知链拓扑），对比聚合物VAE的57.0%。

Conclusion: 结果表明该方法在整个采样过程中保持完整化学词汇可用，实现快速高保真生成。

Abstract: Fast, high-fidelity molecular generation requires accurate chemical choices and efficient sampling. Chemical building blocks reduce graph size, but make each node a choice among tens of thousands of related identities. We introduce MIRRA (Molecular Identity Representation, Refresh and Assembly), a discrete flow-matching generator that learns from chemical knowledge and evaluates identity probabilities only when needed, while keeping every identity in its vocabulary available. Chemical features share information across related blocks, and learned identity corrections distinguish them in molecular context. By deciding which positions will refresh before computing their probabilities, the sampler avoids unused predictions while preserving each sampling transition. Against the strongest baselines in each task, MIRRA reduces chemical and graph distribution errors on ZINC250k by 29-31% and 53-60%, respectively, with generation up to 8.6 times faster. Property targeting yields an estimated 7.8-20.8 times more distinct novel hits per second. On a held-out polymer test set, MIRRA achieves 100% periodic validity with known chain topology, versus 57.0% for a polymer variational autoencoder. These results demonstrate fast, high-fidelity generation with the full chemical vocabulary available throughout sampling.

</details>


### [1472] [LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17246)
*Riccardo De Santi,Federico Di Gennaro,Angelo Gnazzo,Sophia Tang,Pranam Chatterjee,Fanny Yang,İsmail İlkan Ceylan,Michael M. Bronstein,Andreas Krause*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LLM-to-Flow Distillation (LFD)方法，用冻结的LLM作为自适应教师，通过构造课程子目标并利用DPO迭代蒸馏偏好信号来对齐领域专用生成器与高层自然语言发现目标，无需显式代理奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式科学发现需结合高层科学推理与符合设计空间结构的样本生成，但两者割裂：基础LLM有广泛知识却缺乏生成有效序列/几何的先验，领域流/扩散生成器有先验却无法对齐高层目标。且实验科学中常无显式代理奖励或学习预测器难以刻画。

Method: LFD让冻结LLM充当领域生成器的自适应教师。给定如"生成具抗癌活性的肽"的目标，教师构建感知流的当前能力的中间子目标课程，逐步导向原目标；每轮LLM在当前目标下评判采样候选，产生的偏好通过DPO迭代蒸馏进生成器。

Result: 在治疗性肽和小分子结构设计实验中，LFD实现了新的生成控制方式：将任意领域专用科学生成器对齐到以高层自然语言目标表达的科学发现任务。

Conclusion: LFD能提供稠密学习信号，即使初始模型对满足最终目标的设计概率极低，也能实现向覆盖不足、分布外区域的适应，成功桥接科学推理与领域生成器。

Abstract: Generative discovery in science requires coupling high-level scientific reasoning with the ability to generate samples respecting the structure of a design space. Yet these capabilities remain largely separated: foundation LLMs encode broad chemical and biological knowledge, while domain-specific flow- and diffusion-based generators capture the priors needed to produce valid sequences and geometries. We study how to align such scientific generators to high-level natural-language discovery goals without requiring an explicit proxy reward, which is often unavailable or poorly captured by learned predictors in experimental sciences. We introduce LLM-to-Flow Distillation (LFD), where a frozen LLM acts as an adaptive teacher for a domain-specific generator. Given a goal such as 'generate peptides with promising anticancer activity', the teacher constructs a curriculum of intermediate sub-goals aware of the flow's current capabilities, and progressively directs them toward the original discovery goal. At each round, the LLM judges sampled candidates under the current objective. These judgments induce preferences that are iteratively distilled into the generator through DPO. This procedure provides dense learning signals even when the initial model places negligible probability on designs satisfying the final goal, enabling adaptation toward poorly covered, out-of-distribution regions. Experiments on therapeutic peptides and small-molecule structure design demonstrate that LFD enables a new form of generative control: aligning arbitrary domain-specific scientific generators to scientific discovery tasks expressed via high-level natural-language goals.

</details>


### [1473] [Protocol Choices Matter More Than the Aggregation Algorithm: Federated Learning for In-Hospital Mortality Prediction in Care-Unit and Multi-Hospital Federations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17265)
*Rodrigo Tertulino,Ricardo Almeida,Laércio Alencar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究在同一评估协议下系统比较七种联邦学习聚合策略，发现SCAFFOLD在两个联邦中均排名第一但优势极小（≤0.008），而协议选择（预测变量、SMOTE、轮次选择）对AUC-ROC的影响远大于策略选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦学习聚合策略的比较研究很少控制评估协议，导致策略排名可能被协议差异混淆，难以判断算法优劣。

Method: 在MIMIC-IV的12个护理单元与eICU-CRD的49家医院两个联邦上，用同一流程比较FedAvg、FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedAdagrad、FedAdam、FedYogi、FedCluster七种策略；按同一规则在验证集上调参选择，每项比较重复10个随机种子，并用Friedman检验与Holm校正进行显著性检验。

Result: SCAFFOLD在两个联邦（AUC-ROC 0.886与0.819）及18个变体中的17个排名第一，但相对第二名优势不超过0.008；控制本地优化器的对照显示其优势主要来自漂移校正。多医院联邦中联邦训练与集中训练相当。在护理单元联邦中，出院编码预测变量（+0.038）、客户端级SMOTE（最多-0.074）、使用末轮而非最佳验证轮（最多-0.084）对判别力的影响均超过策略选择。验证集上的Platt标定可修复不平衡校正带来的风险失真且不损失判别力。

Conclusion: 比较联邦学习算法前应先固定评估协议；协议选择对结果的影响可能远大于聚合策略本身，推荐使用Platt标定修复概率失真。

Abstract: Federated learning allows hospitals to train a shared mortality model without pooling their records, but published comparisons of aggregation strategies rarely control the evaluation protocol. This study compared seven strategies (FedAvg, FedProx, SCAFFOLD, FedAdagrad, FedAdam, FedYogi and FedCluster) on two federations built with one pipeline: 12 care units of a hospital in MIMIC-IV and 49 hospitals in eICU-CRD. Each strategy was tuned and selected on validation data by the same rule, and every comparison was repeated across 10 seeds with Friedman and Holm-corrected tests. SCAFFOLD ranked first in both federations (AUC-ROC 0.886 and 0.819) and in 17 of 18 variants, but its margin over the runner-up never exceeded 0.008, and a control sharing its local optimizer attributed most of its margin over FedAvg to drift correction. On the multi-hospital federation, federated training matched centralized training. In the care-unit federation, three protocol choices changed discrimination by more than the choice of strategy did: discharge-coded predictors (+0.038 in AUC-ROC), client-level SMOTE (up to -0.074), and evaluating the last instead of the best validation round (up to -0.084). Platt scaling on validation data repaired the risks distorted by imbalance corrections without loss of discrimination. Studies should therefore fix the protocol before ranking algorithms.

</details>


### [1474] [PRISM: Calibrating Black-Box Judges with Counterfactual Probes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18389)
*Kakei Yamamoto,So Kuroki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PRISM，通过显式施加评价偏差探测LLM评审的隐式评分偏差，并用岭回归学习校正，实现无需评分细则（rubric-free）的评分校准，显著提升与人评排名的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为评审可降低人工评估成本，但其分数会系统性地与人评不一致；作者想探究对显式施加的评价偏差的响应，能否用于校正评审的隐式评分偏差。

Method: PRISM保持被评内容不变，测量属性被强调/弱化时的分数变化，用局部敏感度模型将其表示为代理雅可比矩阵，再通过岭回归在人类标签上学习对基线分数的校正；该协议不使用评分细则，仅用总体分数。

Result: 在SummEval摘要与HANNA故事评估的Jev和Sol对比中，PRISM及其学习基线变体显著提升与人评排名的一致性，且与基于rubric的方法相当；SummEval对照实验中rubric质量探测与风格探测取得相近一致性；学习到的系数揭示不同评审间共享与相反的校正方向。

Conclusion: 评审对显式评价偏差的响应可用于校正其隐式评分偏差，PRISM实现了无需rubric的校准，并可揭示不同评审间的共性与对立校正方向。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as judges to reduce reliance on costly human evaluation, yet their scores can systematically disagree with human judgments. We ask whether responses to an explicitly imposed evaluative bias can help correct a judge's implicit scoring biases. We introduce PRISM (Probe-based Residual Inference of Scoring Misalignment), which holds the evaluated content fixed and measures score changes when attributes are emphasized or de-emphasized. A local sensitivity model motivates representing these responses as a surrogate Jacobian. Ridge regression on human labels learns a correction to the baseline score. The resulting scoring protocol is rubric-free: it uses overall scores without requesting criterion-level ratings. In the main Jev and Sol comparisons on SummEval summarization and HANNA story evaluation, PRISM and its learned-baseline variant significantly improve agreement with human rankings over uncalibrated scores while remaining competitive with rubric-based methods. A controlled SummEval comparison yields similar agreement for rubric-derived quality probes and style probes, supporting calibration without reproducing rubric criteria. The learned coefficients reveal shared and opposing correction directions across judges.

</details>


### [1475] [Measuring Learned Equivariance: An Information Theoretic Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17269)
*Claire Schlesinger,Wolfgang Gatterbauer,Robin Walters*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出用NMI和CKA度量神经网络中间表示的等变性，无需已知群作用，验证数据增强能提升变换一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据增强是学习对称性的替代方案，但无法保证网络真正遵守这些对称性；中间表示的群作用未指定，使得测量已学等变性尤其困难。

Method: 在有限离散设定下证明等变性要求原输入与变换输入的表示能相互精确确定，据此提出基于归一化互信息(NMI)的检验；对高维激活使用中心核对齐(CKA)作为可扩展检验，并对正交特征变换给出精确保证。

Result: 在多种架构和任务上，数据增强通常提升变换一致性。

Conclusion: 无需恢复隐藏的变换规则，可直接从表示中探测已学等变性。

Abstract: Learning symmetries through data augmentation offers an alternative to architectural equivariance, but does not guarantee that a network respects those symmetries. Measuring learned equivariance is especially difficult for intermediate representations, whose group actions are not specified. In a finite discrete setting, we show that equivariance requires representations of original and transformed inputs to determine one another exactly, yielding a test based on normalized mutual information (NMI). For high-dimensional activations, we use centered kernel alignment (CKA) as a scalable test, with an exact guarantee for orthogonal feature transformations. Across architectures and tasks, augmentation usually increases transformation consistency, showing that learned equivariance can be probed directly from representations without recovering the hidden transformation rules that relate them.

</details>


### [1476] [Multi-Stream Residual Computation in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18407)
*Ekaterina Alimaskina,Suren Kazarian,Gleb Molodtsov,Aleksandr Beznosikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文为掩码扩散语言模型引入贯穿深度的多残差流及自适应路由，验证了可见与掩码位置自发学习不同路由模式，从而提升重建性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型并行重建掩码token，但其Transformer骨干将可见证据与演化的掩码预测混杂在单一残差流中，难以区分二者互补角色。

Method: 为掩码扩散模型配备贯穿深度的多残差流，并在流间进行自适应路由；通过因果与状态干预分析路由行为，并训练角色条件路由模型。

Result: 预训练中两条流使验证集重建困惑度降低5.71%，外部语料平均降低5.13%；可见与掩码位置自发形成不同路由模式；角色条件路由可恢复加第二条流一半的验证增益。

Conclusion: 额外残差流通过保留早期token表示供后续复用、同时在掩码位置累积证据，实现上下文保持与预测细化并行，该机制在更大模型规模上依然成立。

Abstract: Diffusion language models reconstruct masked tokens in parallel, offering an alternative to autoregressive generation. Yet their Transformer backbones typically carry visible evidence and evolving masked predictions through a single residual stream. We equip masked diffusion models with multiple residual streams that persist through depth and adaptive routing between them, then investigate how they support these complementary roles. On the pretraining task, two streams reduce reconstruction perplexity by 5.71% on validation data and 5.13% on average across external corpora compared with standard residual connections. We observe that, without predefined roles, visible and masked positions learn distinct routing patterns. Causal interventions show that this distinction organizes read and write routing, while token-specific write strength remains important within each role. Guided by these findings, a model trained with role-conditioned routing recovers half the validation gain from adding a second stream. State interventions explain the benefit of the additional stream: it preserves early token representations for later reuse while evidence accumulates at masked positions. This mechanism recurs at a larger model scale, showing how persistent streams support context preservation alongside prediction refinement.

</details>


### [1477] [The Surprising Expressivity of a Single Neuron with Autoregressive Chain-of-Thought](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17283)
*Roey Magen,Nirmit Joshi,Gal Vardi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明单个自回归神经元即可通过CoT模拟任意前馈电路，维度O(ns+s²)、步数O(s²)，与电路深度无关且紧致；阈值神经元可模拟多项式时间图灵机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究自回归+CoT监督下，next-token预测器能有多简单仍可高效模拟通用计算。此前Joshi等(COLT 2025)对阈值激活的模拟界随电路深度指数增长，缺乏深度无关的紧致结果。

Method: 对包括threshold和ReLU在内的广泛激活族，构造单个自回归神经元模拟同激活前馈电路：规模s、n输入的电路由维度O(ns+s²)的神经元用O(s²)生成步模拟；核心证明借助加法组合学中的Sidon集建立新联系。实验上训练单个自回归ReLU神经元模仿CIFAR-10上的教师网络。

Result: 界与电路深度无关，在自然假设下紧致；阈值激活情形改进了Joshi等人的深度指数界；自回归阈值神经元可模拟多项式时间图灵机且从CoT监督中高效可学；实验成功模仿教师网络并取得非平凡CIFAR-10测试准确率。

Conclusion: 极简的自回归神经元（甚至单个）在CoT下即具备强通用计算模拟能力，暗示CoT能补偿模型容量的不足，连接了表达力、可学习性与加法组合学。

Abstract: The success of autoregressive language models trained with Chain-of-Thought~(CoT) supervision raises a fundamental question: How simple can a next-token predictor be while still enabling the efficient simulation of general computation through its autoregressively generated CoT? Surprisingly, we show that a single neuron suffices. For a broad family of activations, including threshold and ReLU, a single autoregressive neuron can simulate any feedforward circuit with the same activation. Specifically, a size-$s$ circuit on $n$ inputs can be simulated by a neuron of dimension $O(ns+s^2)$ using $O(s^2)$ generation steps, with both bounds independent of circuit depth and tight under natural assumptions. For threshold activations, this improves upon the simulation of Joshi et al. (COLT 2025), whose bounds scale exponentially with circuit depth. Consequently, autoregressive threshold neurons can simulate polynomial-time Turing machines, while remaining efficiently learnable from CoT supervision. Our main expressivity result relies on a novel connection to Sidon sets from additive combinatorics. As an experimental illustration, we efficiently train a single autoregressive ReLU neuron to mimic a neural network teacher with nontrivial test accuracy on CIFAR-10.

</details>


### [1478] [Not All Drift Is a Mechanism: Tracing Prompt Adaptation in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18412)
*Mikhail Aleksandrov,Nail Bashirov,Maksim Ivanov,Andrew Tsukanov,Timofey Karyagin,Alexander Miasnikov,Gleb Molodtsov,Valentin Samokhin,Aleksandr Beznosikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文对比离散提示优化、prompt tuning 与 prefix tuning，分析其如何改变稠密及 MoE 语言模型的内部计算，发现适配位置决定任务信息传递方式，且表示层面指标难以区分有效适配与安慰剂。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多以下游性能比较提示适配方法，但相似输出未必来自相似内部计算，缺乏对适配机制的理解。

Method: 研究离散提示优化、prompt tuning 和 prefix tuning 在稠密语言模型与混合专家（MoE）模型中对信息处理的影响，分析适配位置、表示变化与专家路由模式。

Result: 适配位置预测任务信息如何传到输出：优化文本主要改变响应构建，输入级提示将影响写入内容表示，逐层前缀通过注意力维持直接控制；在 MoE 中进一步导致不同专家路由模式。常用表示层面测量对通用上下文变化敏感，难以可靠区分有效适配与匹配安慰剂。

Conclusion: 理解提示适配需区分表示漂移与其中与任务计算对齐且被因果使用的部分，为选择、评估和解释提示适配方法提供实践指导。

Abstract: Prompt-based adaptation offers several ways to specialize a frozen language model, ranging from natural-language prompt optimization to learned continuous prompts. These methods are usually compared through downstream performance, although similar outputs need not arise from similar internal computations. We study how discrete prompt optimization, prompt tuning, and prefix tuning alter the processing of dense and mixture-of-experts language models. Our analysis shows that the location of the adaptation predicts how task information is carried to the output: optimized text primarily changes response construction, input-level prompts write their influence into content representations, and layer-wise prefixes maintain direct control through attention. In MoE models, these differences further induce distinct expert-routing patterns. At the same time, common representation-level measurements respond strongly to generic context changes and do not reliably distinguish useful adaptations from matched placebos. We argue that understanding prompt adaptation requires separating representation drift from the part of that drift that is aligned with, and causally used by, the model's task computation. This perspective provides practical guidance for selecting, evaluating, and interpreting prompt adaptation methods.

</details>


### [1479] [Which Geometry on Which Layer? Measured Sign-Spectral Assignment in Mixed-Optimizer Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17285)
*Hiroki Naganuma,Laura Gomezjurado,Mahdi Ghaznavi,Ganesh Talluri,Atsushi Nitanda,Seng Pei Liew,Ryuichiro Hataya,Ioannis Mitliagkas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将优化器几何选择（sign vs. spectral）从按层类型的固定设定，转为可测量的逐层决策问题，并提出G-Scion实现动态路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代神经网络训练常混合使用多种优化更新规则：嵌入和输出层用AdamW类或sign更新，隐藏矩阵用谱更新。但这些分配通常按层类型固化，缺乏选择合适几何的明确准则。

Method: 1) 对无记忆步骤，推导谱更新与sign更新的有限批次保守下降引理下界之比；2) 该比值闭式解分离信号效率与几何相关的全局曲率因子；3) 在正信号区，用平滑性假设得到双侧界，通过比值跨越显式噪声相关阈值判断哪种更新有更大条件期望下降；4) 基于梯度对齐和Hessian-向量积推导局部方向二次评分，用于G-Scion控制逐层路由。

Result: 在受控输入秩实验中，包含方向曲率的评分在全部七个聚合设定中匹配测得的同迭代排序，而无曲率代理选择相反几何。在31M GPT-2上，输出评分将输出层从谱预热路由到sign，G-Scion在无记忆和匹配动量比较中优于固定Scion。ViT-B/16结果显示谱边缘分配可在语言建模之外优于固定Scion。

Conclusion: 优化器几何不必按层类型硬编码，本文是理解应如何分配几何的第一步。

Abstract: Modern neural-network training uses mixed recipes, assigning AdamW-like or sign-based updates to embedding and output layers and spectral updates to hidden matrices. These assignments are usually fixed by layer type, without a clear criterion for selecting the appropriate geometry. We turn sign-versus-spectral assignment into a measurable, layerwise decision problem. For ideal memoryless steps, we derive a finite-batch ratio of conservative descent-lemma lower bounds for spectral and sign updates. Its closed form separates signal efficiency from a geometry-dependent global curvature factor. In the positive-signal regime, the same smoothness assumption gives two-sided bounds that determine which step has the larger conditional expected decrease when the ratio crosses explicit noise-dependent thresholds. We then derive a local directional quadratic score from gradient alignments and Hessian-vector products and use it in Generalized-Scion (G-Scion) to control layerwise routing. In a controlled input-rank experiment, including directional curvature matches the measured same-iterate ordering in all seven aggregate settings, whereas the curvature-free proxy selects the opposite geometry. On 31M GPT-2, the output score routes the output layer from spectral warmup to sign, and G-Scion improves validation loss over fixed Scion in memoryless and matched-momentum comparisons. ViT-B/16 results further show that a spectral edge assignment can outperform fixed Scion outside language modelling. These results suggest that optimizer geometry need not be hard-coded by layer type and are a first step toward understanding how it should be assigned.

</details>


### [1480] [Teacher-Guided Tool Learning for Small Language Models via Bidirectional KL Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18459)
*Haoxuan Gao,Qin-Wen Luo,Xiang Chen,Yu Tian,Zequn Sun,Xiaofeng Cao,Jiangchao Yao,Sheng-Jun Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SeTPO方法，通过选择性教师引导与持续示范监督，提升小语言模型的工具使用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小语言模型（SLM）借助外部工具可扩展能力，适用于资源受限环境。但SLM仅靠强化学习难以发现有效工具使用行为，而直接教师监督存在师生行为分布不匹配、可能传播错误偏好的问题。

Method: SeTPO协调学生探索与选择性教师引导：在低奖励轨迹上，将基于反向KL的token级教师反馈融入策略优势；同时用辅助的前向KL监督在整个训练过程中保留教师示范行为。在理想化双向KL目标下进行了理论分析。

Result: 理论上证明最优策略的期望奖励不低于教师，同时保留教师概率质量的一定比例。在BFCL v4和API Bank上，SeTPO在三种学生规模下总体性能均优于监督微调、强化学习和蒸馏基线。

Conclusion: SeTPO通过结合选择性教师指导与持续示范监督，有效提升了小语言模型的工具使用能力，兼具理论保证与实证优势。

Abstract: External tools can extend the capabilities of small language models (SLMs), enabling their deployment in resource constrained environments. However, their limited capabilities make it difficult for SLMs to discover effective tool use behaviors through reinforcement learning alone, while direct teacher supervision suffers from teacher student behavioral distribution mismatch and may propagate erroneous preferences. To address these challenges, we propose Selective Teacher guided Policy Optimization (SeTPO), which coordinates student exploration with selective teacher guidance and persistent demonstration supervision. Specifically, SeTPO incorporates reverse KL derived token level teacher feedback into policy advantages on low reward trajectories, while auxiliary forward KL supervision preserves teacher demonstrated behaviors throughout training. Under an idealized bidirectional KL objective, we theoretically establish that the optimal policy achieves expected reward no lower than the teacher's while retaining a guaranteed fraction of the teacher's probability mass. Extensive experiments on BFCL v4 and API Bank demonstrate that SeTPO achieves superior overall performance over supervised fine tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation baselines across all three student scales.

</details>


### [1481] [A Geometrical Approach to Constructing Neural Networks for Perfect Training-set Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17312)
*Akos Hajnal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种按需构建的神经网络，通过几何分析输入数据生成分离超平面并映射为阶跃激活神经元，实现训练集完美分类，并在MNIST上获得紧凑且可解释的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标是在不考虑正则化的情况下，对给定训练集所有样本实现完美分类。传统方法难以兼顾紧凑性、可解释性与可扩展性，因此作者希望从数据的几何结构出发，构建一个结构明确、可解释的神经网络。

Method: 方法基于输入数据的几何分析，按需构建网络，层大小与神经元参数由分析决定。将分离超平面映射为带阶跃激活函数的神经元。网络含两个隐藏层：类间分离层与线性可分变换层。类间分离要求每一对不同类别的双色样本至少被一个超平面分开。通过数据层次化划分实现分离，其副产物为一棵斜决策树，树的叶节点直接定义线性可分层的神经元，该层仅比类间分离层多一个神经元。

Result: 在MNIST数据集上的实验表明，该方法实现完美的训练集分类，并获得紧凑的模型。

Conclusion: 决策树与网络神经元之间的直接对应关系增强了可解释性，构建过程支持并行实现并提升可扩展性。

Abstract: This paper proposes a method for constructing a neural network that achieves perfect classification of all samples in a given training set, without taking regularization into account. The network is constructed on-demand, with its layer sizes and neuron parameters determined through a geometrical analysis of the input data, in which separating hyperplanes are created and mapped to neurons with step activation functions. The proposed architecture consists of two hidden layers with distinct roles: inter-class separation and transformation of the data into a linearly separable representation. Inter-class separation requires every bi-chromatic pair of samples belonging to different classes to be separated by at least one hyperplane. We show that when this separation is achieved through a hierarchical partitioning of the data, the leaf nodes of the oblique decision tree, obtained as a byproduct, directly define the neurons of the linear separability layer, whose size is only one neuron greater than that of the inter-class separation layer. Experiments on the MNIST dataset demonstrate that the proposed method achieves perfect training-set classification, and compact models. The direct correspondence between the decision tree and network neurons enhances interpretability and explainability, while the construction procedure offers opportunities for parallel implementation and improved scalability.

</details>


### [1482] [Readout Scaling Shapes Sparse Feature Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18462)
*Brain Xiao,Sarah Wilson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究readout scaling对稀疏自编码器(SAE)学习的影响，提出readout-canonicalized decision-space (RC-DS)坐标方法，去除奇异值增益同时保留决策信息，并发现训练坐标与因子生成分布匹配时恢复效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Readout scaling会改变SAE学习到的内容，但去除它的收益取决于数据分布。作者希望厘清readout scaling、数据分布与训练方式如何共同影响稀疏学习，并提供一种保留信息的方法来研究readout的贡献。

Method: 提出RC-DS坐标，去除奇异值增益但保留决策信息。通过固定的readout条件数、受控的坐标匹配实验、精确wrapper复现RC-DS训练，并在神经策略和三个固定语言模型checkpoint上与centered-logit训练对比，另设小标签头对照。

Result: 在因子生成先于readout scaling时，条件数100下RC-DS将平均稀疏因子恢复率从0.506提升至0.913。精确wrapper可数值精度复现RC-DS训练。语言模型上，RC-DS在全部18个任务-稀疏度设置中gain-free重建更优，而centered-logit SAE在17个设置中输出logit重建更好；小标签头对照使重建差距从0.0198降至0.0016。

Conclusion: readout scaling、数据分布和训练方式共同塑造稀疏学习。RC-DS是一种保留信息的方法，可用于研究和控制readout的贡献；标签检测与操控测试进一步区分了重建效果与任务特定特征有用性。

Abstract: Readout scaling changes what a sparse autoencoder (SAE) learns, but the benefit of removing it depends on the data. We use readout-canonicalized decision-space (RC-DS) coordinates to remove singular-value gains while preserving retained decision information. At a fixed readout condition number, changing the generating distribution reverses which training coordinates recover known factors best. In our controlled coordinate-matching study, recovery is highest when training restores the space in which the factors were generated. When factors are generated before readout scaling, RC-DS increases mean sparse-factor recovery from 0.506 to 0.913 at condition number 100, compared with centered-logit training under the same budget. An exact wrapper reproduces RC-DS training to numerical precision, isolating training geometry rather than additional information. In neural policies, RC-DS improves mean logit reconstruction under the tested budgets. On three fixed language-model checkpoints, RC-DS has higher mean gain-free reconstruction in all 18 tested task-sparsity settings, while centered-logit SAEs reconstruct output logits better in 17. Small-label-head controls show that longer training reduces the reconstruction gap from 0.0198 to 0.0016. Together, these results show how readout scaling, the data distribution, and training shape sparse learning. RC-DS provides an information-preserving method for studying and controlling the readout's contribution. Separate label-detection and steering tests distinguish these reconstruction effects from task-specific feature usefulness.

</details>


### [1483] [Joint Embedding with Dynamic Integration network (JEDI-net)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17314)
*Rishav Mukherjee,Jeffrey Ahearn Thompson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JEDI-net通过周期性聚类SHAP值识别相似特征重要性模式的潜在子群，并将其身份嵌入网络，使预测能自适应每条观测的预测结构，提升神经网络性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习虽能自动提取复杂元特征，但受未观测潜在因素影响，表现不稳定。显式引入潜在因子信息可让模型根据推断的因子调整行为。由于神经网络本身已捕获复杂特征，对原始特征空间做外部聚类收益有限，因此需按特征重要性模式而非原始特征进行聚类。

Method: 提出JEDI-net统一架构：在优化过程中周期性对SHAP值进行聚类，识别具有相似特征重要性模式的潜在子群，并将子群身份直接嵌入网络，使预测能适应每条观测的预测结构。该方法延续此前的FORCE工作。

Result: 此前FORCE研究已证明该方法能可测量地提升神经网络性能，JEDI-net在此基础上进一步统一了聚类与嵌入过程。

Conclusion: 按特征重要性模式聚类并嵌入潜在子群身份，是发现潜在结构并提升神经网络预测自适应性的有效途径。

Abstract: Deep learning has become the dominant form of machine learning due in part, to its ability to automatically engineer complex meta features from data. However, even deep learning features can perform erratically because of unobserved latent factors. incorporating latent factor information explicitly, can improve performance by letting the model alter its behavior based on such inferred factors. Because neural networks often capture such complexity inherently, external clustering of the original feature space offers limited benefit. clustering observations by feature importance profiles, rather than raw features, offers a principled way to uncover latent structure, since observations with similar importance patterns may share predictive dynamics. In a prior work, Feature Oriented Representation with Clustering and Explanation (FORCE) we showed that this approach measurably improved neural network performance. In this article, we present JEDI-net(Joint Embedding with Dynamic Integration Network) a unified architecture that periodically clusters SHAP values during optimization to identify latent subgroups with similar feature importance patterns, embed their identities directly into the network, allowing predictions to adapt to each observations predictive structure.

</details>


### [1484] [Near-Optimal Regret Bounds for Monotone Stochastic Optimization under Semi-Bandit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17320)
*Tao Hu,Rohan Ghuge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究未知分布下的随机优化问题，提出一种通用的在线到离线归约方法，对强单调随机优化实现 Õ(√(nT)) 期望遗憾，回答了开放问题，并在仅单调条件下改进至 Õ(n^{3/4}√T)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作在半强盗反馈下对单调随机优化只达到 Õ(n√T)，而针对最优停止和 Pandora's box 等特定问题可达 Õ(√(nT))。作者提出开放问题：是否存在通用归约达到更优的 Õ(√(nT)) 速率，以统一并改进这些结果。

Method: 针对强单调随机优化（相对所选离线算法定义），提出 oracle 高效的在线到离线归约：结合 Bernstein 型乐观分布估计与自适应策略轨迹的 Hellinger 稳定性界，按执行策略的探测概率加权聚合平方边际误差。在仅单调且坐标变化一致有界时复用同一算法，获得更弱的近似保证。

Result: 强单调下取得 Õ(√(nT)) 期望遗憾，并保留满足同条件的 oracle 的近似保证；当 T≥n 时该速率在对数因子意义下最优，即使全反馈下亦然。仅单调条件下取得 Õ(n^{3/4}√T) 期望近似遗憾，改进此前关于 n 的线性依赖，且指数 3/4 在其普通遗憾定义下是紧的。框架适用于 prophet inequality、Pandora's box、best-of-K selection、随机背包、随机定向和随机子模最大化。

Conclusion: 论文给出一个通用在线到离线归约，对强单调随机优化达到最优（至对数因子）的 Õ(√(nT)) 遗憾，回答了先前的开放问题，并在较弱的单调条件下显著改进 n 的依赖，框架广泛适用于多种随机优化问题。

Abstract: Stochastic optimization models sequential decision-making under uncertainty, typically assuming known input distributions. When these distributions are unknown, \citet{agarwal2026semibandit} give an online-to-offline reduction for monotone stochastic optimization under semi-bandit feedback, where only probed variables are observed. Its expected regret relative to the offline guarantee is $\widetilde O(n\sqrt T)$, where $n$ is the number of variables and $T$ the horizon. For optimal stopping and Pandora's box, \citet{liu2025improved} achieve $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ using problem-specific algorithms. \emph{Can a general online-to-offline reduction achieve this improved rate?}
  We give such a reduction for strongly monotone stochastic optimization, answering the corresponding open question. Strong monotonicity is defined relative to the chosen offline algorithm. Our oracle-efficient reduction achieves $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ expected regret while preserving approximation guarantees for oracles satisfying the same condition. It combines Bernstein-type optimistic distribution estimates with a Hellinger stability bound for adaptive policy transcripts, aggregating squared marginal errors weighted by the executed policy's probing probabilities. The rate is optimal up to logarithmic factors for $T\ge n$, even under full feedback.
  Under monotonicity and uniformly bounded coordinate-wise variation, the same algorithm achieves $\widetilde O(n^{3/4}\sqrt T)$ expected approximation regret, improving the previous linear dependence on $n$. The exponent $3/4$ is sharp for its ordinary regret over instances and exact oracle choices. Our framework applies to prophet inequality, Pandora's box, best-of-$K$ selection, stochastic knapsack, stochastic orienteering, and stochastic submodular maximization.

</details>


### [1485] [COMPASS: Membership Inference Attack Against Vision Large Language Models via Adaptive Noise Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17332)
*Damien Lo,Hong Kyu Lee,Ruixuan Liu,Li Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出COMPASS，通过自适应校准扰动幅度与成员信号方向，提升VLLM成员推理攻击效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLLM在隐私敏感领域部署引发训练数据暴露担忧。现有灰盒MIA依赖熵统计或生成描述，成本高且区分度低；扰动法仅关注大扰动，对小扰动下的成员行为理解不足。

Method: 系统刻画受控高斯扰动（细粒度噪声级别）下的VLLM成员行为，发现最优扰动幅度与信号方向随模型-数据集对变化，低噪区可反转得分方向。据此提出COMPASS，用松分布匹配的已知非成员参考集自适应校准扰动幅度和得分方向，采用Renyi归一化KL散度与Renyi散度，并对最具信息量的图像-logit位置做max-k聚合。

Result: 在LLaVA v1.5-7B、MiniGPT-4、HuluMed-32B及预训练、指令微调、医学图像数据集上超越基线。通用领域AUC最高达0.88；分布匹配医学评估达0.64 AUC，而最强基线仅随机水平。

Conclusion: 全范围自适应扰动分析是VLLM成员推理的有效方法。

Abstract: Vision large language models (VLLMs) are deployed in privacy-sensitive domains, raising training-data exposure concerns. Existing gray-box membership inference attacks (MIAs) commonly rely on entropy statistics or generated descriptions, requiring costly generation with limited membership separation. Perturbation-based methods instead measure response changes but focus on large perturbations, leaving VLLM membership behavior under smaller perturbations poorly understood. We systematically characterize VLLM membership behavior under controlled Gaussian perturbations across noise levels at fine resolution. We find that optimal perturbation magnitude and membership-signal direction vary across model-dataset pairs. In many settings, a previously unstudied low-noise regime yields stronger separation than large perturbations, with members exhibiting lower divergence than non-members, reversing the conventional score direction. Other settings retain the conventional direction, demonstrating that neither a fixed perturbation magnitude nor a predetermined score orientation is universally reliable. We propose COMPASS, an adaptive gray-box MIA that calibrates both the perturbation magnitude and membership-score direction using a loosely distribution-matched, known non-member reference set. We instantiate COMPASS using Renyi-normalized KL divergence and Renyi divergence, with max-k aggregation over the most informative image-logit positions. Across LLaVA v1.5-7B, MiniGPT-4, and HuluMed-32B, spanning pretraining, instruction-tuning, and medical-image datasets, COMPASS outperforms baselines. On general-domain data, COMPASS achieves AUCs up to 0.88. On the distribution-matched medical evaluation, it reaches 0.64 AUC, while the strongest baseline remains at chance level. These results establish full-range adaptive perturbation analysis as an effective approach to VLLM membership inference.

</details>


### [1486] [On the Statistical Mechanics of Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17347)
*Jerry Yao-Chieh Hu,Yu-An Chen,Maojiang Su,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过现代 Hopfield 模型重新审视 Transformer 注意力的统计力学，提出自由能形式化框架以刻画注意力推理的参数区间和临界阈值，并识别出玻璃相与鲁棒推理相之间的一阶相变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有注意力机制缺乏一个严谨的统计力学理论来描述其相结构与推理可靠性，作者希望借助现代 Hopfield 模型来统一刻画 Transformer 注意力在不同参数条件下的行为。

Method: 构建自由能形式化，纳入查询状态与注意力权重的随机性；将注意力视为对应统计力学系统（现代 Hopfield 模型）在自由能最小化下的运动方程；进一步扩展到具有随机查询和键的注意力情形。

Result: 自由能景观揭示了注意力中的一阶相变，即在玻璃相与鲁棒推理相之间的转变，并给出了相应的参数区间与临界阈值；该结果可推广到随机查询与键的注意力机制。

Conclusion: 本文为一系列 Transformer 注意力机制提供了一个严谨的统计力学框架，用于刻画相结构和推理可靠性，并为理解和设计鲁棒注意力提供了理论工具。

Abstract: We revisit the statistical mechanics of Transformer attention via modern Hopfield models. We present a free-energy formalism to characterize parameter regimes and critical thresholds for robust attention inference. The resulting free-energy landscape incorporates randomness in query states and attention weights. Attention then emerges as the equation of motion of the corresponding statistical-mechanical system (i.e., modern Hopfield model) through the standard free-energy minimization principle.
