This allows us to identify first-order phase transitions in attention between glassy and robust-inference phases. We further extend to attentions with stochastic queries and keys. Together, our results provide a rigorous statistical-mechanics framework for characterizing phase structure and inference reliability across a family of Transformer attention mechanisms.

</details>


### [1487] [Does self-distillation improve reasoning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18613)
*Jason Ken Adhinarta,Raina Wu,Ashutosh Sharma,Avinash Balakrishnan,Rameswar Panda,Polina Golland,Yoon Kim,Zhang-Wei Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统性重审了两种自蒸馏方法(SDPO、OPSD),发现其性能增益无法稳定泛化到未见问题,主要源于过拟合或迁移已有推理行为,而非有效利用特权信息,且自蒸馏梯度与策略梯度对齐较弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自蒸馏方法近期被报告在样本效率和泛化上优于强化学习,但这些增益是否超越同分布评估、是否真正源自特权信息的蒸馏,尚不清楚。

Method: 在代码、科学、工具使用、数学推理任务上重审SDPO和OPSD两种代表性方法,并在Qwen3(1.7B–14B)与OLMo-3-7B模型上进行实验,分析泛化表现及自蒸馏梯度与策略梯度的对齐程度。

Result: 报告的性能增益无法稳定泛化到未见问题,主要由过拟合或迁移已有推理行为解释,而非有效利用特权信息;自蒸馏梯度与直接优化期望奖励的策略梯度对齐较弱。

Conclusion: 有效利用特权信息来提升推理能力仍是一个未解决的开放挑战,并对自蒸馏作为策略改进方向的有效性提出质疑。

Abstract: Self-distillation is an emerging approach that trains a model to imitate its own predictions when conditioned on privileged information, such as correct answers or environmental feedback. Recent methods have reported better sample efficiency and generalization than reinforcement learning (RL), but it remains unclear whether these gains extend beyond in-distribution evaluations and whether they stem from privileged distillation. In this paper, we revisit two representative methods, Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), across code, science, tool use, and math reasoning tasks. We find that their reported gains do not consistently generalize to unseen problems and are largely explained by overfitting or transferring existing reasoning behavior, rather than effectively using privileged information. Moreover, self-distillation gradients show weak alignment with policy gradients that directly optimize expected reward, questioning whether they provide an effective direction for policy improvement. Our experiments across Qwen3 models (1.7B-14B) and OLMo-3-7B suggest that effectively leveraging privileged information to improve reasoning remains an open challenge. Our code is available at https://github.com/sleepypandu/does-sd-improve-reasoning

</details>


### [1488] [HarnessTTT: Learn to Optimize Harness at Test-Time for Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17370)
*Yingzi Ma,Yulong Cao,Nanxi Li,Fang Wu,Yizhe Zhang,James Zou,Yejin Choi,Chaowei Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HarnessTTT是一个测试时学习框架：训练harness提议器，冻结执行器，通过带预算的发现rollout反馈更新提议器，在多个科学发现任务上大幅超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用语言模型做科学发现需要在有限算力预算内找到最佳可行解，但如何利用搜索过程中的反馈来改进搜索流程本身尚未充分研究。

Method: 训练一个harness提议器（执行器冻结），生成含系统提示、可复用技能、工具、中间件和执行控制的可执行harness；每个harness指导一次带预算的发现rollout，其结果作为反馈更新提议器。采用面向发现的策略梯度目标，结合gap归一化奖励、RLOO优势和max-sharpening。

Result: 在数学、系统、GPU内核、启发式编程、航天动力学、生物学等14个任务上，9B冻结执行器在全部11个基准任务上超过OpenEvolve，比Finch-9B最高提升92%，9项取得最好开源<10B结果；Erdős最小重叠达0.380919，优于人类最佳0.380927。27B规模在11/14任务提升；迁移到GPT-5.5在9/14任务上达到或超过最强已报告系统。

Conclusion: harness搜索本身可在测试时被学习：训练过的提议器能让小型冻结执行器高效搜索，且找到的harness可迁移至更强执行器。

Abstract: Scientific discovery with language models requires finding the best valid solution within a finite computational budget. We study how feedback from this search can improve the procedure used to conduct it. We introduce HarnessTTT, a test-time learning framework that trains a harness proposer while keeping the executor frozen. The proposer generates executable harnesses comprising system prompts, reusable skills, tools, middleware, and execution controls. Each harness guides a budgeted discovery rollout, whose outcome provides feedback for updating the proposer. A discovery-oriented policy-gradient objective combines gap-normalized rewards, leave-one-out advantages (RLOO), and max-sharpening to favor high-performing proposals. Generated components are validated before execution, and the search retains the best valid solution and selected harnesses across rounds. Across fourteen discovery tasks in mathematics, systems, GPU kernels, heuristic programming, astrodynamics, and biology, HarnessTTT with a frozen 9B executor improves on OpenEvolve with the same executor on all eleven benchmark tasks (e.g., from 1.17 to 2.64 on circle packing), improves on the discovery-fine-tuned Finch-9B by up to 92%, holds the best open-weight sub-10B result on nine, and reaches 0.380919 on Erdős minimum overlap, better than the best human reference of 0.380927. Scaling the proposer and frozen executor to 27B improves on eleven of fourteen tasks, and transferring the learned harnesses to GPT-5.5 matches or exceeds the strongest reported system of any backbone on nine of fourteen tasks. Together, these results show that harness search can itself be learned at test time: a trained proposer lets a small frozen executor search effectively, and the harnesses it finds carry over to stronger executors.

</details>


### [1489] [Robustly Reliable Learning for Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17381)
*Avrim Blum,Anh Tuan Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出对抗环境回归下的"鲁棒可靠学习"问题，为L-Lipschitz假设类给出最优预测区间算法及复杂度下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在对抗环境中，训练数据可能被污染，且测试点需给出可靠预测。现有可靠学习多关注分类，回归场景缺乏对预测范围的理论刻画，因此需要定义并求解回归的鲁棒可靠学习问题。

Method: 针对L-Lipschitz假设类：(1) 数据L-Lipschitz一致时，提出第b优启发式算法求最紧区间；(2) 一般情形下，将问题归约为刻画成对L-Lipschitz违反的violation graph，利用其核结构提出FPT算法。

Result: 一致情形算法复杂度O(n)且计算最优；一般情形FPT算法耗时O(n^2+b^4)求得精确最优区间；基于SETH建立Ω(n^{2-o(1)})下界，证明算法计算最优。

Conclusion: 该工作为回归鲁棒可靠学习奠定理论与算法基础，并讨论若干开放方向。

Abstract: We introduce the problem of robustly reliable learning for the regression setting in adversarial environments. Given a test point $x_{test}$, a training dataset $S$ of $n$ data points, a corruption budget $b \ll n$, and a real-valued hypothesis class $\mathcal H$, our goal is to output the optimal prediction range $I^*_{x_{test}}(S, b)$, such that any $L$-Lipschitz predictor consistent with all but at most $b$ points in $S$ must predict a value $h(x_{test}) \in I$. We then instantiate the analysis for $L$-Lipschitz hypothesis classes, a natural and widely studied class in the regression setting, focusing on two key scenarios. First, for the restricted case where the corrupted dataset is guaranteed to be $L$-Lipschitz consistent, we propose a simple and efficient $b^{th}$-best heuristic algorithm and prove its correctness in computing the tightest possible range $I^*_{x_{test}}(S, b)$. We then establish its computational complexity of $O(n)$ and show that it is computationally optimal in this scenario. Building on this foundation, we address the general scenario where the dataset $S$ is no longer $L$-Lipschitz consistent. We demonstrate that computing the optimal range in this setting reduces to analyzing a violation graph, which models the pairwise $L$-Lipschitz violations among data points. By leveraging the structural properties of this graph's kernel, we propose a Fixed-Parameter Tractable (FPT) algorithm that computes the exact optimal range in $O(n^2 + b^4)$ time. Furthermore, under the Strong Exponential Time Hypothesis (SETH), we establish a computational lower bound of $Ω(n^{2 - o(1)})$, proving that our algorithm is computationally optimal. Finally, we discuss open directions for the problem of robustly reliable learning for regression.

</details>


### [1490] [Does Pretraining Teach Chemical Language Models Chemistry?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18651)
*Leif Sieben,Yoel Zimmermann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估化学语言模型（CLM）预训练效果，发现其下游性能不随预训练规模增长且饱和于梯度提升基线之下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学语言模型被广泛用于学习可迁移的分子表示，但其预训练究竟带来多少实际收益、能否随规模扩展尚不明确，需系统检验。

Method: 在64个分子性质预测数据集上，对一系列化学语言模型进行系统预训练效果研究，比较不同预训练形式与随机初始化编码器、梯度提升基线。

Result: 预训练增益不可扩展，性能饱和低于梯度提升基线；仅基于传统理化描述符的监督预训练能稳定提升表现，部分预训练形式甚至不如随机初始化编码器；模型能解析分子结构但不优于随机初始化模型。

Conclusion: CLM预训练至多学到类似描述符的性质和低层token统计，除经典分子特征外几乎没有额外捕捉到化学知识。

Abstract: Chemical language models (CLMs) are pretrained on large corpora of molecules with the aim of learning representations that transfer to diverse downstream tasks. Here, we systematically study the effects of pretraining using a series of such CLMs across 64 molecular property prediction datasets. We find that the downstream gains of pretraining in CLMs do not scale and performance saturates below gradient-boosting baselines. Across the regimes evaluated, only supervised pretraining on traditional physico-chemical descriptors consistently improves downstream performance for the CLMs tested whereas some forms of pretraining result in models worse than a randomly initialized encoder. While models can resolve molecular structure well, they do so no better than a randomly initialized model, suggesting that, at best, CLMs learn descriptor-like properties in addition to low-level token statistics during pretraining, but surprisingly little chemistry beyond what classical molecular features already capture.

</details>


### [1491] [Mitigating Black-Box Score-Based Query Attacks via Gradient Confusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17382)
*Ali Javeri,Javad Hezareh,Radin Shahdaei,AmirMahdi Sadeghzadeh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GCD，一种无需重训练、确定性的测试时防御，通过主动混淆输出的梯度方向，增加黑盒对抗攻击的查询复杂度，同时保持零精度损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于随机输出扰动的防御无法阻止攻击者通过增加查询预算或平均随机性来恢复稳定梯度估计，因此需要一种确定性的防御方法。

Method: GCD是一个无需重训练的确定性测试时包装器，主动塑造返回给攻击者的概率向量。基于模型Jacobian求解约束优化问题，将暴露的logit梯度对齐到与真实对抗损失梯度最大程度错位的目标混淆方向。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，针对ResNet-18、ResNet-50、ViT-B/16及四种SOTA攻击，GCD实现SOTA鲁棒性且零干净精度损失。理论上证明GCD可减缓基于梯度估计的攻击，并在随机搜索攻击中引入系统性接受/拒绝错误。

Conclusion: GCD的确定性结构可抵御利用随机性的自适应攻击，适用于安全关键部署场景，优于基于随机化的防御。

Abstract: Score-based black-box adversarial attacks pose a serious threat to deployed machine learning systems by exploiting repeated model queries to craft adversarial examples, requiring neither access to model parameters nor architecture. Existing defenses predominantly rely on stochastic output perturbations, which fail to prevent determined attackers from recovering stable gradient estimates by increasing query budgets or averaging over randomness. In this work, we propose the Gradient Confusion Defense (GCD), a retraining-free, deterministic test-time wrapper that actively shapes the probability vector returned to querying adversaries. By solving a constrained optimization problem grounded in the model's Jacobian, GCD aligns the exposed logit-gradient with a target confusion direction that is maximally misaligned with the true adversarial loss gradient---increasing the query complexity of attacks without sacrificing predictive utility or top-1 accuracy. We provide rigorous theoretical analysis demonstrating that GCD provably slows gradient-estimation-based attacks and induces systematic accept/reject errors in random search-based attacks, with the confusion effect amplifying as the fraction of defended queries increases. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet across multiple architectures (ResNet-18, ResNet-50, ViT-B/16) and four state-of-the-art attacks confirm these predictions: GCD achieves state-of-the-art robustness, while incurring zero clean accuracy degradation. %Crucially, unlike randomization-based defenses, GCD's deterministic structure provides resilience against adaptive attacks that exploit stochasticity, making it well-suited for security-critical deployment settings.

</details>


### [1492] [Bayesian Test-Time Inference of Task-Aligned Similarity from Weak Interactive Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18656)
*Weida Liang,Kenji Kawaguchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BASIS是一种免训练的贝叶斯方法，利用弱测试时反馈推测当前决策任务应采用哪种相似性准则，联合推断目标与准则，并用信息增益选择探测样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在测试时通过相似性比较做决策（检索示例、排序候选、修订回答），但相似性不唯一（词汇、语义、结构、风格）且任务对应的相似性准则会随实例变化，固定准则或固定混合规则在准则漂移时会失败。

Method: 提出BASIS（Bayesian Axis Selection via Interactive Signals）：免训练、基于贝叶斯，从任务专属的准则库中推断支配当前决策的准则；维护候选目标与准则的联合后验，通过标量分数、成对偏好或验证器输出更新，并以期望信息增益选择探测样本。

Result: 在概念恢复上Success@1从56.0%提升到68.1%（六次探测），推理准确率从72.3%到73.1%，回复精炼胜率从61.4%到63.8%；超过同等算力的best-of-N选择（推理72.1%，精炼61.2%）。在准则不匹配和更大候选池下增益最大。

Conclusion: 自适应准则加权解释了大部分收益，联合目标-准则推断带来额外价值；局限性在于BASIS仅在给定准则库中选择，无法发现新准则。

Abstract: Language model systems repeatedly make test-time decisions by comparing similarity: they retrieve exemplars, rank candidates, and revise responses. Yet similarity is not unique: lexical, semantic, structural, and stylistic resemblance can point to different candidates, and the task-aligned notion can change across instances. We introduce BASIS (Bayesian Axis Selection via Interactive Signals), a training-free Bayesian method that uses weak test-time feedback to infer which criterion in a supplied, task-specific library governs the current decision. It maintains a joint posterior over candidate targets and criteria, updates it from scalar scores, pairwise preferences, or verifier outputs, and selects probes by expected information gain. In a finite noisy model, we characterize when the target-criterion pair is recoverable and show why fixed-criterion and fixed-mixture rules can fail under criterion shift. Across concept recovery, reasoning exemplar selection, and response refinement, BASIS improves six-probe concept-recovery Success@1 from 56.0% to 68.1%, reasoning accuracy from 72.3% to 73.1%, and refinement win rate from 61.4% to 63.8% over tuned static mixtures. It also exceeds compute-matched best-of-N selection on reasoning (72.1%) and refinement (61.2%). Gains are largest under criterion mismatch and with larger candidate pools, and matched controls indicate that adaptive criterion weighting explains much of the benefit, with joint target-criterion inference adding further value. BASIS selects only among supplied criteria and does not discover new ones.

</details>


### [1493] [Variable Input Masked Autoencoders for Wrist-Worn Accelerometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17383)
*Harish Haresamudram,Wanting Mao,Aditya Radhakrishnan,Maxwell A. Xu,James M. Rehg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VarMAE是一种可变输入掩码自编码器，学习跨采样率和时间上下文的统一表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可穿戴传感器基础模型使用固定输入时长和采样率，但记录条件、下游任务和部署约束存在巨大差异，需要单一模型适应变化传感配置。

Method: 预训练时对同一信号构建长时长高频率和短时长短频率两个视图（随机裁剪和下采样），在每个视图内做掩码重建，并引入跨分辨率掩码重建目标，用长视图可见token预测短视图掩码token。

Result: 在NHANES大规模数据集预训练，单个预训练编码器在八个基准数据集上匹配或超越受控基础模型基线，仅3.82M参数，参数高效。

Conclusion: 裁剪和下采样形成互补信息瓶颈，使模型学习跨输入时长和采样率有效的表示；单一基础模型可实现广泛迁移能力。

Abstract: Large-scale repositories of wearable sensor data have enabled the development of foundation models for human activities and behavior. However, existing models are pretrained using fixed input durations and sampling rates, despite substantial heterogeneity in recording conditions, downstream tasks, and deployment constraints. We introduce VarMAE, a variable input masked autoencoder that learns a single representation across sampling rates and temporal contexts. During pretraining we construct two views of the same signal: a long duration high frequency view, and a short duration lower frequency view, obtained via random cropping and downsampling. We perform masked reconstruction within each view and introduce a cross-resolution masked reconstruction objective that uses visible tokens from the long view to predict masked tokens from the short view. Cropping and downsampling impose complementary information bottlenecks, encouraging the model to learn representations that remain effective across input durations and sampling rate changes. We pretrain VarMAE on the large-scale NHANES dataset, producing a single pretrained encoder matching or outperforming controlled foundation model baselines on eight benchmark datasets. With only 3.82M parameters, VarMAE is parameter efficient and shows that a single foundation model can achieve broad transfer capabilities across sensing configurations.

</details>


### [1494] [On the Monitorability of Natural Language Autoencoders: Identification vs Discrimination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18727)
*Kevin Yandoka Denamganaï*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文用"指称博弈"框架分析自然语言自编码器(NLA)作为语言模型监督工具的有效性，预测并实验证实：AV的解释能识别自身激活，但难以区分真实解释与高度相似的虚假解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLA被提议作为语言模型的监督工具，其价值取决于人类监控者能否在AV给出的解释中区分真实账户与虚假账户。作者希望从理论上刻画NLA训练与部署之间的差异。

Method: 将NLA训练形式化为生成式指称博弈，将NLA监督部署形式化为判别式、多模态、部分可观测的指称博弈，二者之间存在"多对多"关系的差距。使用NLA自身的AR作为最同情的替代监控模型进行实验。

Result: 在单个已发布检查点上：真账户在全部320次比较中胜过其他激活的账户，但在仅改动单一陈述的流利对手面前仅获胜60.2%(标准误6.7%，随机为50%，n=35)。一个无关联模型进行的意义保持重写仅损失到另一激活账户距离的2.1%，说明失败并非源于私有约定。

Conclusion: 这些虚假对手仅测试转录级别的真值（由被监控模型的对话决定），因此结果只是最简单情形的上界，对被监控模型自身处理过程的断言尚未检验。作者提出若干猜想，使两个结果都成为该框架的推论。

Abstract: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) are proposed as oversight tools for language models: an Activation Verbaliser (AV) writes an English explanation of an activation vector, and an Activation Reconstructor (AR) maps the explanation back to a vector. Their value for oversight depends on a human monitor being able to tell a true account of an activation from a false one, given the Av's explanation. We formalise NLA training and NLA oversight deployment as two different referential games from Emergent Communication: training is a generative referential game, while oversight is a discriminative, multi-modal, partially-observable referential game played over a many-to-many relation between the monitored language model's activations and the accounts that are true of them. The gap between the two games predicts that AV's explanations will identify which activation they describe without discriminating its true account from closely matched false ones, since training never asks explanations to rule anything out. Using the NLA's own AR as a maximally-sympathetic surrogate monitor model, we experimentally confirm this theoretical insight on one released checkpoint: true accounts beat accounts of other activations in all 320 comparisons, but beat fluent rivals differing in a single claim only 60.2% of the time (std.err. 6.7%, chance at 50%, $n = 35$). A meaning-preserving rewrite by an uninvolved model costs only 2.1% of the distance to another activation's account, so the failure is not due to the NLA pair having developed private conventions in the AV's explanations. Our rival accounts test only transcript-level truths, which the monitored language model's conversation settles, so these results bound the easiest case and leave claims about the monitored model's own processing untested. We state conjectures that would make both results consequences of the framework.

</details>


### [1495] [Measure Neural Mappings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17384)
*Ricardo Baptista,Edoardo Calvello,Bohan Chen,Andrew Stuart,Urbain Vaes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并定义 measure neural mappings (MNMs)，将 measure-dependent neural transport 与 ensemble consistency 结合，用于学习概率测度上的算子，并给出非紧测度下注意力机制的定量连续极限与误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学机器学习中的贝叶斯推断与不确定性量化常涉及无界状态空间上的概率测度算子，需要既有理论基础又能保持采样集成一致性的神经网络映射。

Method: 定义 MNMs：结合测度依赖的神经传输与集成一致性；在强次高斯与尾部可积假设下证明注意力机制的定量连续极限；分析自注意力、交叉注意力、多头注意力与分组 Transformer；并将 Set Transformers 视为 measure-to-vector 映射进行理论分析。

Result: 对固定自注意力 Transformer，期望输出 Wasserstein 误差由经验输入 Wasserstein 误差加 N^{-1/2} 注意力项界定；pre-norm 与 post-norm 架构在相应条件下均属 MNMs；交叉注意力、多头注意力与分组评估有对应估计；Set Transformer 得到 N^{-1/2} 欧氏输出误差界。实验在 d=1,2,3,5,10 的七个算子上验证了粒子数依赖，Wasserstein 与 sliced Wasserstein 衰减率接近理论采样基准。

Conclusion: MNMs 为概率测度上的算子学习提供了理论与集成一致性框架，注意力类架构在非紧测度下具有可量化的收敛与误差保证，并获得实验支持。

Abstract: We introduce and define measure neural mappings (MNMs), which combine measure-dependent neural transport with ensemble consistency for learning operators on probability measures. Ensemble consistency requires outputs from growing ensembles sampled from an input law to converge to the specified population output in probability. We establish quantitative continuum limits for attention on noncompact laws under strong sub-Gaussian and tail-integrability assumptions. These laws accommodate unbounded state spaces in scientific machine learning, including Bayesian inference and uncertainty quantification. For fixed self-attention transformers, the expected output Wasserstein error is bounded by the empirical input Wasserstein error plus an additional $N^{-1/2}$ attention term. These self-attention transformers are MNMs under the stated assumptions: pre-norm architectures follow from compact stability after normalization, while post-norm architectures are covered under the stated tail conditions. We prove corresponding cross-attention estimates and extend the results to multihead attention and grouped transformer evaluation, with convergence as the group size grows. For Set Transformers viewed as measure-to-vector mappings, we obtain an $N^{-1/2}$ bound on the expected Euclidean output error under the stated assumptions. Experiments on seven operators in dimensions $d=1,2,3,5,10$ support the predicted particle-count dependence, using one-dimensional Wasserstein computations and Sinkhorn approximations in higher dimensions. The observed Wasserstein and sliced Wasserstein decay rates are close to their respective theoretical sampling benchmarks.

</details>


### [1496] [Cross-Market Meta-Learning for Electricity Price Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17387)
*Delaram Pirhayatifard,Terrence Alsup*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MetaGrid：跨市场元训练的拓扑感知Transformer，用于日前电价预测，单套参数可迁移到新电网。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单市场电价预测数据有限、模型易饱和，且将各节点视为独立序列，忽略了电网拓扑与拥塞带来的空间依赖；跨ISO价格形成共享物理规律与市场设计。

Method: 将跨市场历史作为预训练语料，提出MetaGrid——拓扑感知Transformer，跨市场元训练，得到与区域数无关的参数集以适配未见电网。基准涵盖五个美国ISO，所有模型使用相同价格、日前负荷预测与日历特征。

Result: 在无泄漏基准上取得最低平均MAE，较最佳基线提升3.1%，较同架构从零训练提升7.7%。

Conclusion: 跨市场元训练结合拓扑感知建模可有效提升日前电价预测精度，并实现跨电网泛化。

Abstract: Day-ahead (DA) electricity price forecasting is usually posed per market, with a separate model fitted to each grid's own history. This caps accuracy: statistical and tree-based baselines saturate, while higher-capacity sequence models need more training data than a single market's few years of hourly prices can supply. Such methods also treat each node as an independent series, discarding the spatial dependencies induced by network topology and congestion. Because price formation across independent system operators (ISOs) is driven by shared physics and largely common market design, we instead treat cross-market history as a pretraining corpus. We present MetaGrid, a topology-aware transformer, meta-trained across markets so that a single zone-count-independent parameter set adapts to an unseen grid. On a leak-free benchmark of five U.S. ISOs, where every model receives the same prices, DA load forecasts and calendar features, MetaGrid attains the lowest average MAE, improving on the best baseline by 3.1\% and on the same architecture trained from scratch by 7.7\%.

</details>


### [1497] [JustOPD: On-Policy Distillation from Autoregressive to Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17397)
*Zikun Zhang,Jiayuan Sheng,David D. Yao,Wenpin Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出JustOPD，一种将自回归语言模型（ARM）教师蒸馏到扩散语言模型（DLM）学生的在线策略蒸馏方法，通过训练时采用自回归rollout对齐教师解码顺序，提升数学推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型的在线策略蒸馏研究不足，现有工作集中于DLM到DLM蒸馏，而强教师DLM稀缺。同时ARM的从左到右解码与DLM灵活解码顺序存在不匹配，如何从强ARM蒸馏到弱DLM尚不明确。

Method: 受Ni et al. (2026)启发，提出JustOPD：在训练时使用自回归rollout，使学生的生成过程与ARM教师的从左到右解码对齐，从而实现有效蒸馏，同时在推理时保留DLM的灵活生成顺序能力。

Result: 以Qwen3-14B为教师、Dream-7B为学生进行实验，JustOPD在多种散度选择下均持续提升数学推理性能，优于基础DLM。

Conclusion: JustOPD为ARM到DLM的在线策略蒸馏提供了有效方案，在保持DLM推理灵活性的同时实现了强ARM教师到弱DLM的知识迁移。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a post-training approach for large language models (LLMs) that enables a student model to learn a teacher model's distribution from sequences sampled from the student's own policy. Despite its promising capability, OPD for diffusion language models (DLMs) remains underexplored and existing studies primarily focuses on DLM-to-DLM distillation. The limited availability of strong teacher DLMs and the flexible generation order of DLMs impose additional technical challenges as well. However, it remains unclear how to effectively distill knowledge from a strong autoregressive language model (ARM) into a weaker DLM, given the mismatch between the left-to-right decoding of ARMs and the flexible decoding order of DLMs. Inspired by Ni et al. (2026), we propose JustOPD, an ARM-to-DLM on-policy distillation method that uses autoregressive rollouts during training to align the student's generation process with the ARM teacher's left-to-right decoding. This alignment enables effective distillation from ARM teachers while preserving the DLM's flexible generation-order capability at inference time. Experiments using Qwen3-14B as the teacher and Dream-7B as the student demonstrate that JustOPD consistently improves mathematical reasoning performance over the base DLM across multiple divergence choices.

</details>


### [1498] [Learning to Detect Shifts in Unstructured Data Streams via Monitoring-by-Betting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17399)
*Siyu Zhou,Jialin Ouyang,Fan Xia,Adarsh Subbaswamy,Drew Prinster,Suchi Saria,Augusto Garcia-Agundez,Sarah Pollet,Jinoos Yazdany,Patrick Vossler,Jean Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"渐近e-检测器"，通过testing-by-betting框架将序贯变点检测重新表述为下注游戏，使检测器能在保持虚警率控制的同时自适应更新偏移方向假设，实现对生成式AI系统数据分布偏移的灵敏高效监测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI系统需要持续监测其输入/输出非结构化数据的分布偏移。现有监测方法为控制虚警率，通常要求预先指定偏移检测的差异度量，但这在非结构化数据上产生"灵敏度-广度"权衡：窄定义度量对预期偏移敏感但会漏检意外变化，宽定义度量覆盖更广但灵敏度降低。自适应假设偏移方向虽可突破此限制，却因依赖数据而破坏传统虚警保证。

Method: 通过testing-by-betting将序贯变点检测重构为下注游戏，下注者随新观测不断更新其假设的偏移方向（witness函数）。引入"渐近e-检测器"，用大小m的校准集近似变化前分布，并证明随m增大渐近控制平均虚警运行长度。开发多种自适应监测策略，从基于嵌入学习的黑箱下注器到基于LLM提出概念的可解释下注器。

Result: 校准集小至m=30即可有效控制虚警。在三个真实数据集（含临床AI scribe部署数据）上，相同虚警水平下自适应监测器比固定监测器检测偏移更快。当真实偏移稀疏且可解释时，LLM概念监测器检测最快、最具可解释性，并能指导复杂偏移的根因诊断。

Conclusion: 该工作通过testing-by-betting调和了自适应性与统计有效性，为生成式AI系统的非结构化数据分布偏移监测提供了兼具灵敏性、广度和可解释性的新范式，并在真实部署场景中验证了有效性。

Abstract: Continuous monitoring of generative AI systems requires detecting distribution shifts in the unstructured data they ingest and generate. Existing monitoring methods typically control false alarms by requiring the discrepancy measure used to detect shifts to be *pre-specified*. However, for unstructured data, pre-specification creates a sensitivity--breadth trade-off: a narrowly defined measure is sensitive to the anticipated shift but may miss unexpected changes, whereas a broadly defined measure may detect a wider range of shifts but with reduced sensitivity. Although adaptively hypothesizing the shift direction can overcome this limitation, such data-dependent adaptation generally invalidates conventional false-alarm guarantees. We reconcile adaptivity with statistical validity through testing-by-betting, reframing sequential changepoint detection as a betting game in which the bettor continually updates its hypothesized shift direction, or witness function, as new observations arrive. We introduce *asymptotic e-detectors*, which approximate the pre-change distribution using a calibration set of size $m$, and prove that they asymptotically control the average run length to a false alarm as $m$ increases. Empirically, calibration sets as small as $m=30$ provide effective control. We then develop adaptive monitoring strategies ranging from black-box bettors that learn from embeddings to interpretable bettors based on LLM-proposed concepts. Across three real-world datasets, including data from a clinical AI scribe deployment, adaptive monitors detect shifts faster than fixed monitors at the same false-alarm level. Further, when the true shifts are sparse and interpretable, LLM-concept monitors provide the fastest and most interpretable detection, while also guiding root-cause diagnosis for complex shifts.

</details>


### [1499] [SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18807)
*Wenlin Zhong,Hao Wang,Kun Yuan,Fan Yang,Jinluan Yang,Dian Jin,Xu Tan,Yiquan Wu,Kun Kuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SkillScaffold，一种策略自适应的训练框架，通过低成本技能效用估计与选择性技能注入，提升LLM智能体强化学习的探索与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于技能的RL方法通常假设技能注入有益，或依赖间接反馈/大量采样评估其效用；实验表明基于rollout的效用估计成本高且不稳定，技能收益因候选项和当前策略在不同查询上的能力而异。

Method: 复用结果验证过的训练轨迹生成候选技能，通过结果感知的似然比较估计技能效用，无需针对候选技能的环境rollout；效用指导是否注入及注入哪个技能，无候选有效时保留无技能执行；联合训练Generator与不断演化的Executor，并鼓励技能内化以实现无技能推理。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld和τ²-Bench上，短时与长时任务均优于强智能体RL和基于技能的RL基线；消融与分析验证了基于效用的选择与弃用机制的重要性。

Conclusion: SkillScaffold通过低成本效用估计与选择性注入，有效解决技能RL中效用评估昂贵与收益不确定的问题，提升智能体RL性能并支持技能内化。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from multi-turn interactions with verifiable outcomes. Textual skills can improve exploration by distilling prior interactions into reusable guidance. However, existing skill-based RL approaches often either assume skill injection is beneficial or rely on indirect feedback or rollout-intensive evaluation to assess its utility. Our pilot studies show that rollout-based utility estimation for skill credit assignment is costly and unstable under limited sampling, while skill benefits vary across candidates and depend on the current policy's competence on each query. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillScaffold, a policy-adaptive training scaffold that combines low-cost skill-utility estimation with selective skill injection. By reusing outcome-verified training trajectories, SkillScaffold generates candidate skills and estimates their utility through outcome-aware likelihood comparisons, without candidate-specific environment rollouts. The resulting utility guides whether and which skill to inject, retaining skill-free execution when no candidate is estimated to help. Joint training enables the Generator to produce skills tailored to the evolving Executor. Scaffolded RL encourages skill internalization for skill-free inference. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and $τ^2$-Bench demonstrate gains over strong agentic-RL and skill-based RL baselines across both short- and long-horizon tasks. Ablations and further analyses support the importance of utility-based selection and abstention. Our code is available at https://github.com/Vaidurya00/SkillScaffold.

</details>


### [1500] [Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion for Extreme-Aware Time-Series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17407)
*Lin Jiang,Rongchao Xu,Guang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CrossTF利用时域与频域去噪器之间的差异实现极端感知的时间序列生成，仅需学习少量融合参数，在7个数据集上极端保真度提升26.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖专门表示或极端导向训练目标，可能限制极端事件的多样性或损害整体分布保真度，难以兼顾极端保真与整体质量。

Method: 提出CrossTF框架，基于"跨视图不对称性"发现，冻结时域与频域两个去噪器，在后期跨视图窗口内用极值理论目标结合能量距离约束，仅学习逐步骤融合参数，支持插值与外推。

Result: 在7个真实数据集上与11个基线对比，极端保真度较最强基线提升26.1%，整体性能提升7.4%。

Conclusion: 跨视图差异可作为极端感知时间序列生成中低维优化的有效基础，兼顾极端保真度与整体分布质量。

Abstract: Generating realistic time-series requires faithfully reproducing rare but high-impact extreme events. Existing approaches often rely on specialized representations or extreme-focused training objectives, which may restrict the diversity of captured extremes or compromise overall distributional fidelity. We propose Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion (CrossTF), a framework that exploits discrepancies between time- and frequency-view denoisers for extreme-aware time-series generation. Our key empirical finding is extreme-sensitive cross-view asymmetry: moving along the direction connecting the two views' clean-sample estimates substantially changes extreme fidelity while having limited effects on overall generation quality. We further identify a late-stage cross-view window in which this discrepancy stabilizes and cross-view adjustments have a particularly strong effect on extreme fidelity. These findings motivate a staged optimization strategy in CrossTF: after training and freezing both denoisers, it only needs to learn step-specific fusion parameters within this window using an Extreme Value Theory-based objective under an energy-distance constraint. This formulation supports interpolation between and extrapolation beyond the view-specific estimates while limiting degradation in overall generation quality. Extensive experiments on seven real-world datasets against 11 baselines show that CrossTF improves extreme fidelity by 26.1% and overall performance by 7.4% relative to the strongest baselines. These results highlight cross-view discrepancy as an effective basis for low-dimensional optimization in extreme-aware time-series generation.

</details>


### [1501] [Position: Beyond Training Time, Test-Time Coordination is Essential for Cooperative MARL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17409)
*Dongsu Lee,Sooraj Sathish,Joonkyung Kim,Woojun Kim,Amy Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文主张将"测试时协调"视为MARL问题定义的一部分，提出CTME（集中训练+混合执行）这一新问题设定，以弥补CTDE在环境漂移下无法恢复协调的"可恢复性缺口"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CTDE仅在训练时使用全局信息，执行时无协调通道。当智能体强耦合或环境非平稳、团队需在条件变化后重新对齐时，CTDE失败。这是结构性问题而非算法问题，加训练无法添加执行时缺失的通道，称为"可恢复性缺口"。

Method: 提出CTME（centralized training with mixed execution）设计空间：协调器观察全局状态并发出高层信号，智能体本地执行。CTME不是具体算法，而是使测试时信息结构显式化的MARL问题设定，规定团队级信息、高层信号与训练后更新频率，CTDE为其极限情形。

Result: 为长时程、中心监控的协作系统（仓储机器人、自动存取系统、云资源调度）指出一新研究空间，将测试时协调从部署细节提升为问题定义的一部分。文为立场/问题设定类论文，未报告实验结果。

Conclusion: 并不主张CTDE过时，而是认为移除测试时通道是一种建模选择而非必然；当全局遥测可用且团队需从漂移中恢复时，这是错误的默认做法。

Abstract: We argue that cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) should treat test-time coordination as part of the problem definition rather than a deployment artifact. Our focus is on long-horizon, centrally monitored cooperative systems such as warehouse robotics, automated storage-and-retrieval systems, and cloud-resource scheduling, where teams share a reward, operate under shifting objectives, and already run with global telemetry at deployment. The dominant paradigm in this regime, centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE), uses global information only during training and provides no coordination channel at execution. This is sufficient when agents are weakly coupled or the environment is stationary, but it fails when the team must realign after conditions change. The limitation is structural rather than algorithmic, and more training cannot add a channel that does not exist at execution time. We call this the recoverability gap. To address it, we name the underexplored design space of intermittent test-time coordination as centralized training with mixed execution (CTME), in which a coordinator observes global state and emits high-level signals while agents act locally. CTME is not a particular learning algorithm, but a cooperative MARL problem setting that makes test-time information structure explicit. It specifies team-level information, high-level signals, and update frequency after training, with CTDE recovered as a limit case. We do not argue that CTDE is obsolete. We argue that removing the test-time channel is a modeling choice, not a necessity, and the wrong default when global telemetry is available and teams must recover from drift.

</details>


### [1502] [On Making $\mathrm{SE}(2)$-Invariant Networks Optimal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17424)
*Tomas Karella,Emily Shinkle,Alice Elisabeth Anastasia Allen,Pieter J. Swart,Nicholas Lubbers,Roxana Bujack*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文基于经典不变量理论，推导出关于对称群可证最优（最小且信息保持）的不变特征映射，并提出一个即插即用模块为CNN施加SE(2)不变性（平移+旋转），无需改动非线性或归一化层，在更低计算成本下取得与SOTA等变方法相当或更好的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将平移等变性等归纳偏置扩展到更丰富的对称群（如SE(2)）是架构与计算上的持续挑战，如何以最有效方式编码这类对称性仍需探索。

Method: 借助经典不变量理论推导关于对称群可证最优（最小且信息保持）的不变特征映射；该构造可无缝嵌入标准架构，不修改非线性或归一化层；具体实现为面向CNN的即插即用模块，在标准架构内实现SE(2)不变性，同时捕捉平移与旋转。

Result: 所得模型高效且表达力强；实验显示相比最先进等变方法，在显著更低计算成本下达到相当或更优精度；并对等变性与不变性的关系进行了理论与实证分析，揭示二者在控制鲁棒性与灵活性中的作用。

Conclusion: 通过对不变特征的原理性构造，可高效地在标准CNN中引入SE(2)不变性，兼顾效率与表达力，并加深了对等变性与不变性在鲁棒性、灵活性中作用的理解。

Abstract: Respecting a-priori known symmetries of underlying data is a key principle in designing efficient neural architectures. Convolutional neural networks are a canonical example, encoding translation equivariance. Extending this inductive bias to richer symmetry groups such as $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ in the most effective way possible is an ongoing architectural and computational challenge. Building on classical invariant theory, we derive invariant feature maps that are provably optimal: minimal and information-preserving with respect to the symmetry group. Our construction is designed to integrate seamlessly into standard architectures, requiring no modification to nonlinearities or normalization layers. As a concrete implementation, we introduce a plug-and-play module for convolutional neural networks that enforces $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ invariance, capturing both translations and rotations within standard architectures. The resulting models are both efficient and expressive. Experiments show competitive or improved accuracy compared to state-of-the-art equivariant methods at significantly lower computational cost. Finally, we provide a theoretical and empirical analysis of the relationship between equivariance and invariance, offering insight into their roles in controlling robustness and flexibility.

</details>


### [1503] [When Sparsity Breaks Connectivity: Functional Reachability and Guided Topology Dynamics in Extreme Sparse Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17425)
*Mohammad Pasande,Mateusz Jaworski,Jeroen Rook,Elena Mocanu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出可达性引导的动态稀疏训练（guided DST），通过建模稀疏网络的forward/backward/functional可达性，偏置剪枝与重生长方向，在极高稀疏度下显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态稀疏训练（DST）在极高稀疏度（≥99%）时，周期性的剪枝与重生长会破坏输入-输出信息通路，导致标准幅度/随机更新性能急剧下降。作者希望从可达性角度理解和缓解这一问题。

Method: 在分层稀疏图上形式化forward、backward和functional可达性，推导可达神经元与边的闭式期望，并用蒙特卡洛验证理论。基于该可达性结构，引导剪枝偏向非功能边、重生长偏向功能一致的候选，形成可达性引导的拓扑演化（guided DST）。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100和Tiny ImageNet上，guided DST相比未引导DST大幅缩小精度差距（CIFAR-100在99.9%稀疏度下最高提升+14.4点）；MLP-Mixer在99.99%稀疏度下仍可训练，而未引导随机重生长则严重退化。

Conclusion: 极端稀疏训练可被视为一个保持连通性的动力学过程，可达性引导能有效维持信息通路，代码已开源。

Abstract: Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) periodically prunes and regrows connections, inducing a discrete dynamical mechanism over network topologies. At extreme sparsity ($\ge 99\%$), this dynamic tends to destroy input-output information pathways, and performance with standard magnitude/random updates degrades sharply. We formalize forward, backward, and functional reachability on layered sparse graphs, derive closed-form expectations for reachable neurons and edges, and show that Monte Carlo realizations match the theory. Guided by this reachability-based structure, we bias pruning toward non-functional edges and regrowth toward functionally consistent candidates. We introduce this reachability-driven modification of topology evolution as Reachability-guided in DST, referred to as guided DST. On CIFAR-10/100 and Tiny ImageNet, guided DST recovers large accuracy gaps versus unguided DST (up to $+14.4$ points at $99.9\%$ sparsity on CIFAR-100), and on MLP-Mixer guided DST remains trainable at $99.99\%$ sparsity while unguided random regrowth degrades sharply. These results cast extreme-sparse training as a connectivity-preserving dynamical process. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/mzjaworski/ea_dst.

</details>


### [1504] [EmoXpt: Analyzing Emotional Variances in Human Comments and LLM-Generated Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.06597)
*Shireesh Reddy Pyreddy,Tarannum Shaila Zaman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出EmoXpt情感分析框架，通过分析人类推文并对比ChatGPT的回应，揭示人类与LLM在生成式AI话题上的情感差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI的广泛采用引发多样观点，现有研究多只关注人类情感，忽略了ChatGPT自身的情感表达，因此需要新框架同时评估两者。

Method: 分析提及ChatGPT、OpenAI、Copilot、LLMs等术语的人类推文，并考察ChatGPT对这些推文的回应；提出EmoXpt情感分析框架，同时评估人类观点与ChatGPT回应中的情感。

Result: 实验表明，LLM生成的回应比人类回应更高效、更连贯，且情感上更持续积极。

Conclusion: EmoXpt独特地评估了ChatGPT的情感表达，揭示了人类与LLM在生成式AI情感反应上的显著差异。

Abstract: The widespread adoption of generative AI has generated diverse opinions, with individuals expressing both support and criticism of its applications. This study investigates the emotional dynamics surrounding generative AI by analyzing human tweets referencing terms such as ChatGPT, OpenAI, Copilot, and LLMs. To further understand the emotional intelligence of ChatGPT, we examine its responses to selected tweets, highlighting differences in sentiment between human comments and LLM-generated responses. We introduce EmoXpt, a sentiment analysis framework designed to assess both human perspectives on generative AI and the sentiment embedded in ChatGPT's responses. Unlike prior studies that focus exclusively on human sentiment, EmoXpt uniquely evaluates the emotional expression of ChatGPT. Experimental results demonstrate that LLM-generated responses are notably more efficient, cohesive, and consistently positive than human responses.

</details>


### [1505] [Reinforcement Learning In Partially Verifiable Environments for Colon Cancer Treatment Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17426)
*Li-Ching Chen,Andrés Franco Valiente,Yuta Ishiyama,Zachary R. Chalmers,William Chen,Kelsey Natsuhara,Taema Brinjikji,Madhumita Sushil,Travis Zack,Julian C. Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将肿瘤治疗方案制定建模为部分可观测下的交互式强化学习问题，从真实临床记录中构建患者特异、过程感知的奖励，用GRPO/GDPO优化Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，在信息收集、治疗选择和推理对齐上显著超越基线及GPT-5.2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床决策是部分可观测下的序贯过程，常无唯一正确解。LLM在医学问答上表现强，但扩展到临床推理困难，因为许多任务仅部分可验证。现有临床RL多聚焦诊断终点，而肿瘤治疗决策更复杂，同一患者状态下多条决策轨迹均可被临床辩护。

Method: 将肿瘤治疗规划表述为部分可观测下的交互式RL问题；从真实临床记录观察到的决策过程中构建患者特异、过程感知的奖励；智能体在结构化的患者表征上序贯获取信息，再给出首选治疗方案；使用GRPO和GDPO优化Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。

Result: RL显著提升基础策略，超过前沿模型能力。GDPO训练的模型将Mean@3标量临床奖励较基础Llama提升79.60%，在同一交互环境下超过GPT-5.2达18.82%，同时训练中查询次数减少。

Conclusion: 当患者状态与底层临床决策过程均仅部分可观测时，患者特异、部分可验证的奖励可为交互式临床RL提供有效学习信号。

Abstract: Clinical decision-making is a sequential process of information collection, clinical inference, and forecasting under partial observability, often without a uniquely correct treatment decision. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong medical question-answering capabilities but extending these advances to clinical reasoning remains challenging because many clinical tasks are only partially verifiable. Recent clinical reinforcement learning (RL) work has therefore largely focused on diagnostic endpoints, where correctness can be more directly verified. Oncology treatment decision making is a particularly challenging instance of this problem that extends beyond medical question-answering in which multiple decision trajectories can be clinically defensible for the same partially observed patient state. We formulate oncology treatment planning as an interactive RL problem under partial observability and construct patient-specific, process-aware rewards from decision processes observed in real world clinical records. The agent must learn to sequentially acquire information from a structured patient representation before committing to a first-line treatment recommendation, and is evaluated on information gathering, treatment selection, and reasoning alignment. Using GRPO and GDPO to optimize Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct within this environment, RL substantially improves the base policy beyond frontier model capabilities. The GDPO-trained policy increases Mean@3 scalar clinical reward by $79.60\%$ over base Llama and exceeds GPT-5.2 by $18.82\%$ under the same interactive environment, while reducing query count during training. Overall, our results show that patient-specific, partially verifiable rewards can provide an effective learning signal for interactive clinical RL when both the patient state and the underlying clinical decision process are only partially observed.

</details>


### [1506] [Latent Algorithmic Structure Precedes Grokking: A Mechanistic Study of ReLU MLPs on Modular Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23784)
*Anand Swaroop*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReLU MLP在模加法grokking中学到近似二值方波输入权重，并可通过提取频相构造理想模型达到高精度，说明grokking是"锐化"记忆阶段已编码的算法而非发现新算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作认为grokking产生正弦输入权重分布，但作者在ReLU MLP实验中发现不同现象，欲揭示grokking真正的机制。

Method: 经验观察ReLU MLP在模加法任务中的输入/输出权重分布；用DFT提取各神经元频率与相位，构造理想化MLP（输入为完美二值方波，输出为余弦）。

Result: 输入权重呈近二值方波，中间值仅出现在符号变化边界；输出权重主导Fourier相位满足φ_out=φ_a+φ_b（噪声数据下也成立）。理想模型在从仅0.23%精度的含噪模型提取参数时达到95.5%精度。

Conclusion: grokking并非发现正确算法，而是锐化记忆阶段已编码的算法：输入权重逐步二值化为更干净的方波，输出权重对齐，直至泛化成为可能。

Abstract: Grokking-the phenomenon where validation accuracy of neural networks on modular addition of two integers rises long after training data has been memorized-has been characterized in previous works as producing sinusoidal input weight distributions in transformers and multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs). We find empirically that ReLU MLPs in our experimental setting instead learn near-binary square wave input weights, where intermediate-valued weights appear exclusively near sign-change boundaries, alongside output weight distributions whose dominant Fourier phases satisfy a phase-sum relation $φ_{\mathrm{out}} = φ_a + φ_b$; this relation holds even when the model is trained on noisy data and fails to grok. We extract the frequency and phase of each neuron's weights via DFT and construct an idealized MLP: Input weights are replaced by perfect binary square waves and output weights by cosines, both parametrized by the frequencies, phases, and amplitudes extracted from the dominant Fourier components of the real model weights. This idealized model achieves 95.5% accuracy when the frequencies and phases are extracted from the weights of a model trained on noisy data that itself achieves only 0.23% accuracy. This suggests that grokking does not discover the correct algorithm, but rather sharpens an algorithm substantially encoded during memorization, progressively binarizing the input weights into cleaner square waves and aligning the output weights, until generalization becomes possible.

</details>


### [1507] [Monarch-Muon: Structure-Aware Muon for Fast and Memory-Efficient Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17429)
*Alexander Miasnikov,Ruslan Kabirov,Gleb Molodtsov,Dmitrii Vlashchuk,Vladimir Aletov,Nail Bashirov,Daniil Tikhonov,Maxim Krutikov,Aleksandr Shestakov,Aleksandr Beznosikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Monarch-Muon 是一种结构化矩阵感知优化器，针对 Monarch 因子参数化，将稠密极坐标更新分解为小块独立子问题，降低显存与时间开销并提升质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型训练受墙钟时间与显存限制，Muon 等矩阵感知优化器虽改善优化，但其稠密极坐标更新开销大，加剧了这一权衡。

Method: 针对以 Monarch 因子参数化的权重设计结构化矩阵感知优化器；该结构同时压缩权重、梯度与优化器状态，并将单一稠密正交化替换为多个小型独立更新子问题，通过分块信赖域视角进行形式化。

Result: 质量方面，固定结构下优于 Monarch-AdamW：稠密 257M 上 3.06 vs 3.09，1B MoE 上 2.68 vs 2.77；双块 MoE 变体匹配稠密 AdamW，同时减少 15% 活跃参数和 25.4% 总参数。6.89B 系统测量中，峰值显存从 68.9 降至 52.9 GB，Muon 优化器状态从 14.60 降至 6.77 GB，优化器步耗时从 1288 降至 304 ms。

Conclusion: Monarch-Muon 在保持或提升模型质量的同时显著降低显存占用、优化器状态与步耗时，为大规模模型训练提供了更高效的结构化优化方案。

Abstract: Training large language models is constrained by both wall-clock time and memory footprint, and recent matrix-aware optimizers sharpen this tradeoff: Muon can improve optimization but its dense polar update remains expensive. We propose Monarch-Muon, a structured matrix-aware optimizer for weights parameterized by Monarch factors. The resulting structure reduces weights, gradients, and optimizer state, and exposes small independent update subproblems in place of a single dense orthogonalization; we formalize this through a blockwise trust-region interpretation. In quality runs, Monarch-Muon improves over Monarch-AdamW at fixed structure: 3.06 vs. 3.09 in the dense 257M model and 2.68 vs. 2.77 in the 1B MoE model; the two-block MoE variant also matches dense AdamW while using 15% fewer active and 25.4% fewer total parameters. In 6.89B-parameter systems measurements, Monarch-Muon reduces peak memory from 68.9 to 52.9 GB, Muon optimizer state from 14.60 to 6.77 GB, and the Muon optimizer step from 1288 to 304 ms.

</details>


### [1508] [On Sleep-Wake Disorder Identification from Polysomnographic Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17451)
*Alvise Dei Rossi,Luigi Fiorillo,Giuliana Monachino,Alessia Calzoni,Julia van der Meer,Markus H. Schmidt,Claudio L. A. Bassetti,Silvia Santini,Francesca Faraci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 大规模多队列监督式睡眠分期编码器在与同等规模、同等模态覆盖的自监督PSG基础模型对比时，下游多标签睡眠-觉醒及昼夜节律障碍识别性能反而更优，且迁移学习数据效率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督PSG基础模型被期望捕捉睡眠分期之外的临床信息，但此前很少与在规模与模态覆盖可比条件下预训练的睡眠分期编码器进行比较，缺乏公平的基线评估。

Method: 采用统一的整夜、缺失感知状态空间下游建模框架，在来自未见注册中心的7,906例PSG上，对比自监督PSG基础模型与主流大规模多队列睡眠分期监督编码器的冻结表征，用于六类睡眠-觉醒及昼夜节律障碍组的多标签识别。

Result: PSG基础模型优于仅EEG、单队列的监督基线；但当监督预训练的规模与模态覆盖接近时，这一优势反转。来自神经睡眠评分器的迁移学习取得更高整体性能，并表现出更好的下游数据效率。

Conclusion: 评估PSG基础模型的下游潜力时，必须采用规模与模态匹配的监督预训练基线，否则可能高估自监督方法的实际收益。

Abstract: Self-supervised polysomnography foundation models (PSG FMs) aim to capture clinically useful information beyond sleep staging, yet are rarely compared with sleep-staging encoders pretrained at comparable scale and modality coverage. Using a common whole-night, missingness-aware state-space downstream modeling framework, we compared frozen representations from prominent large-scale, multi-cohort sleep-stage-supervised encoders and self-supervised PSG FMs for multilabel identification of six sleep-wake and circadian disorder groups in 7,906 PSGs from an unseen registry. Although PSG FMs outperformed an EEG-only, single-cohort supervised baseline, this ordering reversed when supervised pretraining approached comparable scale and modality coverage. Transfer learning from neural sleep scorers achieved higher overall performance while exhibiting greater downstream data efficiency. These findings underscore the need for scale- and modality-matched pretrained supervised baselines when assessing PSG FMs' downstream potential.

</details>


### [1509] [Effect of Spherical Parameter Space on Number of Non-Forgetting Tasks and Capacity of Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17453)
*Nazanin Mirhosseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用高维球面几何与聚类点过程建模持续学习，推导非遗忘任务数上限及总信息容量上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为持续学习（非遗忘）提供理论分析框架，刻画任务相似性与依赖对学习能力的影响。

Method: 在高维球面 S^{d-1}(√d)、d→∞ 渐近下，将任务最优解建模为测地学球及 Neyman-Scott 聚类点过程（任务最优服从 vMF 分布），学习算法视为信道，非遗忘要求进入测地学球交集。

Result: 推导出保证非遗忘可行性的任务数 T 上界（κ/d→α 时可行性概率趋近 1），并给出总信息论容量上界。

Conclusion: 高维球面几何与任务聚类结构可定量刻画持续学习的非遗忘极限与容量限制。

Abstract: We propose a continuous learning formulation for $T$ non-forgetting tasks with the spherical parameter space $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}(\sqrt{d})$ in asymptotic regime $d\rightarrow \infty$. Each task $i$ has an optimum $\bmΘ_i$, minimizing its corresponding loss function $R_i(\bm{w})$ on sphere. We reduce each task $i$ to an acceptable loss region modeled by a geodesic ball $B_{\bmΘ_i}(r_i(d))$ on $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}(\sqrt{d})$ centered at $\bmΘ_i$ with radius $r_i(d)$. To model task dependencies (similarities), task optima $\bmΘ_i$ are distributed by a Neyman-Scott clustered point process $Φ$. Cluster centers $\{\bm{Y}_j\}_{j=1}^{N_p}$ form a homogeneous Poisson point process on sphere, while intra-cluster task optima follow a von Mises-Fisher distribution with mean $\bm{Y}_j$ and concentration $κ$. Each task $t\in \{1, ..., T\}$ learning algorithm is considered to be a channel $Q_{t}(\mathrm{d}\bm{w}_t | \bm{w}_{t-1}, \mathcal{K}_{t-1}(\bmθ_{1:t-1}), \bmθ_t)$, where $\bm{W}_t$ is the learned parameter of task $t$ and $\mathcal{K}_{t-1}(\bmΘ_{1:t-1})=\bigcap_{i=1}^{t-1}B_{\bmΘ_i}(r_i(d))$. Since in continual learning, the learner does not need to reach $\bmΘ_t$ exactly to successfully learn task $t$, to avoid forgetting as well as reliable learning, it only needs for the learned parameter vector $\bm{W}_{t}$ to enter $B_{\bmΘ_t}(r_t(d)) \cap \mathcal{K}_{t-1}(\bmΘ_{1:t-1})$. Using this model, we derive an upper bound on $T$ ensuring $\mathbb{P}[\mathcal{K}_{T}(\bmΘ_{1:T}) \neq \emptyset] \rightarrow 1$ as $d\rightarrow \infty$ and $κ/d \rightarrow α$, where $α>0$ is a constant. Finally, for $T$ tasks sampled uniformly from $Φ$, we derive an upper bound for total information theoretic capacity under the non-forgetting constraint for each task.

</details>


### [1510] [Assessing the Performance of AI Models in Misinformation Detection Using Predefined Social Noise Constructs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17469)
*Manar Alsaid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究利用"社会噪声"概念，评估六种文本模型和一种GNN在X平台乌克兰相关推文（50万条）上的虚假信息检测性能。RoBERTa表现最佳（准确率97.17%），GNN达64.52%，LIME显示89.6%预测权重来自语境特征而非孤立关键词。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体用户生成内容泛滥，产生"社会噪声"掩盖有意义的话语；现有虚假信息检测方法多聚焦事实核查，忽视社会噪声对虚假信息放大的作用。

Method: 基于预设社会噪声构念，构建含50万条X平台推文数据集（2024年3月至2025年3月俄乌冲突期间#Ukraine标签），比较六种文本模型与一个图神经网络（GNN）的性能，并用LIME进行可解释性分析。

Result: 机器学习模型准确率79.94%–97.17%；RoBERTa最优（准确率97.17%，kappa 0.9660，MCC 0.9660，AUC 0.9977）；GNN准确率64.52%、AUC 0.899（高于随机分类）；所有文本模型kappa>0.75；LIME显示89.6%预测权重来自语境特征。

Conclusion: 将社会噪声整合进AI流水线可提升虚假信息检测效果，支持大规模社交媒体环境下更有效的缓解策略。

Abstract: Social media platforms generate vast volumes of user-generated content that often obscure meaningful discourse, a phenomenon conceptualized as social noise. While existing misinformation detection methods primarily focus on factual verification, they largely overlook the role of social noise in amplifying misinformation. This study assesses the performance of six text-based models and a graph neural network (GNN) in mitigating the effects of misinformation using predefined social noise constructs. The dataset consists of 500,000 tweets collected from the X platform using the Ukraine hashtag during the Russia-Ukraine conflict from March 2024 to March 2025. Advanced machine learning models achieve strong performance, with accuracies ranging from 79.94% to 97.17%. RoBERTa demonstrates the highest performance, with an accuracy of 97.17%, Cohen's kappa of 0.9660, MCC of 0.9660, and AUC of 0.9977. The GNN achieves an accuracy of 64.52% and an AUC of 0.899, demonstrating performance above random-chance classification by exploiting the relational structure between tweets. All text-based models achieve kappa values greater than 0.75, indicating substantial overall agreement. Explainable AI analysis using LIME reveals that 89.6% of predictive weight is attributed to contextual features rather than isolated keywords. The findings highlight that integrating social noise into AI pipelines enhances misinformation detection and supports more effective mitigation strategies in large-scale social media environments.

</details>


### [1511] [Structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics for partial differential equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17483)
*Kyriakos Flouris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出机器学习PDE代理模型在数值求解器数据上训练时，测试损失无法区分模型学到物理还是离散误差，并提出结构保持保真度诊断指标来识别模型是否尊重已知物理性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDE代理模型通常用数值求解器生成的数据训练，因此训练数据服从的是数值格式的修正方程而非原PDE；在同一求解器数据上计算的测试损失无法区分学到物理的模型和学到离散误差的模型。

Method: 提出一组结构保持保真度诊断（structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics），即简单评分，在无法访问训练数据或控制方程的情况下，衡量学习模型是否尊重某个已知物理性质，如守恒量、对称性或哈密顿结构。

Result: 在五个系统上，这些诊断与相对真实动力学的误差的秩相关最高达0.94，而测试损失与该误差不相关或负相关；对于Burgers、KdV和Navier-Stokes方程，诊断能区分测试损失视为等价的数值格式，包括同阶格式。

Conclusion: 结构保持诊断可有效揭示模型是否学到真实物理而非离散误差，弥补测试损失在评估PDE代理模型时的不足。

Abstract: Machine learning surrogates of partial differential equations (PDEs) are commonly trained on data generated by numerical solvers. Therefore, the training data obey not the PDE but the modified equation of the numerical scheme, and the test loss, computed on data from the same solver, cannot distinguish a model that learned the physics from one that learned the discretization error. Here, we show that the difference is nevertheless visible in the trained model. We propose a suite of structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics, simple scores that measure whether a learned model respects one known property of the physics, such as a conserved quantity, a symmetry or a Hamiltonian structure, without access to the training data or the governing equation. Over five systems, the diagnostics track the error with respect to the true dynamics with a rank correlation of up to $0.94$, while the test loss is uncorrelated or anti-correlated with it. For the Burgers, Korteweg-de Vries and Navier-Stokes equations, the diagnostics separate numerical schemes that the test loss ranks as equivalent, including schemes of the same order. order.

</details>


### [1512] [A Time-Synchronous Prequential Evaluation Framework for Next-Week Student Disengagement Prediction from Moodle LMS Logs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17490)
*David Otoo-Arthur,Terence L. van Zyl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种时间同步的序贯（prequential）框架，用于基于Moodle日志在线预测学生下周的"不活跃开始"这一脱离行为，并按时间顺序进行开发、校准与评估，比较三种在线模型在多阈值策略和不同特征集下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回顾性评估预警模型可能无法反映预测发布时和结果可观测时的真实信息，存在信息泄漏与时间错位问题，故需更贴近实际部署的时间同步在线评估方法。

Method: 按日历时间排序，模型仅用已有结果更新，在每个预测截点保持不变；开发、校准、评估在时间上严格分离。比较SGD-LR、OSELM与ESN三种在线模型，涵盖预测性能、固定/冻结/滚动阈值策略、日历时间变化及四种行为特征集。

Result: 留出评估包含49,329次预测，不活跃开始率为37.68%。区分度相近（AP 0.665-0.679；ROC-AUC 0.755-0.774）。OSELM召回最高，SGD-LR精确率与特异度最高，ESN的MCC与平衡准确率最高。降低阈值提升召回与预警量，但滚动自适应未优于冻结阈值。周度表现与校准概率分布波动但无持续恶化；累积与时间特征单独表现最佳。

Conclusion: 流式预警评估应同时考虑校准、阈值相关性能、预警负担与日历时间变化，而非仅看总体区分度。

Abstract: Retrospective evaluation of early-warning models may not reflect information available when predictions are issued and outcomes become observable. We developed a time-synchronous prequential framework for online prediction of next-week student disengagement, operationalised as inactivity onset, from Moodle logs. Ordered by calendar time, models were updated only with available outcomes and remained unchanged for all predictions at each prediction cutoff; development, calibration and evaluation were chronologically separate. We compared stochastic gradient descent logistic regression (SGD-LR), online sequential extreme learning machine (OSELM) and echo state network (ESN) across predictive performance, fixed, frozen and rolling threshold policies, calendar-time variation and four behavioural feature sets. Held-out evaluation comprised 49,329 predictions with 37.68% inactivity-onset prevalence. Discrimination was similar (average precision 0.665-0.679; ROC-AUC 0.755-0.774). OSELM had the highest recall, SGD-LR the highest precision and specificity, and ESN the highest Matthews correlation coefficient and balanced accuracy. Lower thresholds increased recall and alert volume, whereas rolling adaptation did not improve MCC over frozen thresholds. Weekly performance and calibrated-probability distributions varied without sustained deterioration. During model selection, cumulative-and-temporal features achieved the highest individual-set AP, with modest gains from combining all feature groups. These findings indicate that streaming early-warning evaluation should consider calibration, threshold-dependent performance, alert burden and calendar-time variation alongside aggregate discrimination.

</details>


### [1513] [Longitudinal Learner Participation Profiling in Online Learning: Heterogeneous Consensus Clustering under Unequal Observation Windows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17494)
*David Otoo-Arthur,Terence L. van Zyl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 学习管理系统轨迹聚类识别出的参与画像易受观测窗口长度影响；本文用16,448个学习者-课程序列比较8种参与度指标，经调整后得到四类参与画像，并强调需评估时长效应与聚类一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LMS轨迹聚类用于识别参与画像，但不等的观测窗口可能使画像反映的是课程时长而非真实参与度，需检验并校正这种混淆。

Method: 基于南非某公立大学152门课程的4,599名学习者、16,448个完整序列，评估8种参与度指标（含率与占比形式）；采用按课程分组调整；用K-means、高斯混合、Ward凝聚聚类和K-medoids，结合标准化指标与主成分汇总，对保留的5种指标聚类；并进行逐周序列分析。

Result: 所有指标均与观测窗口长度相关；按课程调整后关系减弱。支持宽泛的两类分组，以及更细的四类共识画像：逐渐下降型、早期集中型、周期变化型、持续活跃型。主要共识中画像归属仅解释时长变异的2.87%，而原始指标为38.18%。平均归属支持度0.739，8.35%低于0.50，其中持续活跃型不确定性最大。逐周序列分析与四类共识仅中度一致。

Conclusion: 参与画像应评估时长效应，比较多种聚类方法与参与度汇总方式，并报告归属一致性；所提四类画像综合了参与的多个方面而非单一序列模式。

Abstract: Learning management system traces are clustered to identify participation profiles, but unequal observation windows may cause profiles to reflect duration rather than participation alone. Using 16,448 complete learner--course sequences from 4,599 learners across 152 courses at a South African public university, we evaluated eight participation measures. All remained related to observation-window length even when expressed as rates or shares. Course-grouped adjustment reduced these relationships. Five retained measures were evaluated using K-means, Gaussian mixtures, Ward agglomerative clustering and K-medoids, with standardised measures and principal-component summaries. Evidence supported a broad two-profile grouping and a more detailed adjusted four-profile consensus: Gradually declining, Early-concentrated, Cyclical variable and Sustained active. Profile membership accounted for 2.87% of the variation in duration in the primary consensus, versus 38.18% using original measures. Mean assignment support was 0.739; 8.35% of assignments fell below 0.50, with greatest uncertainty in Sustained active. Two week-by-week sequence analyses agreed strongly with each other but only modestly with the four-profile consensus, indicating that the profiles combined multiple aspects of participation rather than distinct sequence patterns. Profiling should therefore assess duration effects, compare clustering methods and participation summaries, and report assignment consistency.

</details>


### [1514] [Foundation Models for Event Prediction Across Heterogeneous Event Logs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17503)
*Fabian Spaeh,Sean Jaffe,Shandian Zhe,Bin Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Foundation Event Predictor (FEP)，一种可扩展的上下文学习架构，通过注意力机制实现下一事件预测，在696个数据集预训练，泛化至50个未见数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件日志广泛存在于各领域，但语义、标签空间、交互模式和时间尺度差异大，难以构建单一基础模型直接泛化到未见系统。

Method: FEP采用事件级非参数推理：因果自注意力将上下文与目标历史编码为key/query，观测到的下一上下文事件编码为value，再用交叉注意力进行相关性加权聚合，整个非参数预测过程表达为标准注意力，可用FlashAttention并行。为提高跨系统泛化，引入置换鲁棒嵌入学习和随机固定嵌入解耦事件ID与语义，并用经验分位数变换和鲁棒归一化处理多样时间尺度。

Result: 在696个真实事件数据集上预训练，在50个未见数据集上评测。FEP无需参数适配即可有效泛化到新事件系统，常接近各目标数据集单独训练的强模型性能，并显著优于现有基础模型基线，尤其在困难预测任务上。

Conclusion: FEP提供了一种简单可扩展的上下文架构，实现跨异构事件系统的下一事件预测泛化，展示了基础模型在事件日志领域的潜力。

Abstract: Event logs are ubiquitous across real-world domains, including business processes, manufacturing workflows, healthcare, and many other operational systems. Yet event logs can differ substantially in their event semantics, label spaces, interaction patterns, and temporal scales, making it difficult to build a single foundation model that generalizes directly to previously unseen systems. We address this challenge with the Foundation Event Predictor (FEP), a simple and scalable in-context architecture that performs next-event prediction through learned, event-level nonparametric inference. Causal self-attention encodes context and target histories into key and query representations, respectively, while the observed next context events are encoded as values. Cross-attention then performs learned, relevance-weighted aggregation of next-event outcomes over all context transitions, allowing the entire nonparametric prediction procedure to be expressed as standard attention operations and efficiently parallelized with modern kernels such as FlashAttention. To promote cross-system generalization, we introduce permutation-robust embedding learning and random fixed embeddings to decouple event IDs from persistent semantics, together with empirical quantile transforms and robust normalization to handle diverse temporal scales. We pretrain FEP on 696 real-world event datasets spanning heterogeneous event systems and evaluate it on 50 held-out datasets unseen during pretraining. Across these datasets, FEP generalizes effectively to new event systems without parameter adaptation, frequently approaching the performance of strong models trained separately on each target dataset while substantially outperforming existing foundation-model baselines, particularly on challenging prediction tasks.

</details>


### [1515] [Merit: Making every modality earn its contribution in multimodal attention decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17507)
*Ali Alavi,Donald S. Williamson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MERIT是一个多模态听觉注意力解码器与评估方法，通过Shapley值量化EEG及行为信号各自的准确率贡献，防止行为信号替代脑信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 助听器需通过AAD从多人语音中找到被注意的说话者，但智能眼镜/耳机的眼动、头动等行为信号只反映"看向谁"而非"听到谁"；过度依赖它们会在无法转头或不注视时失效，而现有准确率指标无法揭示脑信号贡献是否被替代。

Method: MERIT对每个输入流在测试样本上打乱、测量准确率下降，并用Shapley值将下降分摊到各流；同时设置两道防线：训练前检查候选音频以防泄题，以及评分函数若忽略脑信号则不能优于随机。

Result: 在含EEG、眼动、头动与场景视频的公开数据集上，MERIT四分类准确率听众内达0.82、未见听众0.74（随机为0.25）；测量显示加入行为流虽提升总准确率，但脑信号贡献份额几乎减半。

Conclusion: MERIT在另两个数据集上发现常用基准存在标签不平衡，并识别出仅凭准确率会被误判为脑解码的结果，强调多模态解码须保留脑信号的核心贡献。

Abstract: More than 1.5 billion people have hearing loss. When several people talk at once, hearing aids amplify every voice alike. Auditory attention decoding (AAD) aims to solve this by reading a listener's brain signals to find the attended talker, letting the device amplify only them. A real device will not see the brain alone; smart glasses and earbuds also track eyes, head, and scene. These behavioral signals help, as people often look at who they listen to. However, they show where a listener looks, not whom they hear. A decoder relying heavily on them fails when a listener cannot move their head or listens without looking - exactly when a brain-based device is needed. A multimodal decoder must use these signals without letting them replace the electroencephalogram (EEG). Accuracy alone cannot show whether it does. We present MERIT, a decoder and evaluation method asking: how much accuracy does each input earn? MERIT shuffles each input stream across test examples, measures the accuracy drop, and splits the result across streams using Shapley values. It also blocks two shortcuts: candidate audio is checked before training so it cannot reveal the answer, and the scoring function cannot beat chance if it ignores the brain. On a public dataset with EEG, eye tracking, head motion, and scene video, MERIT improves on the published benchmark, reaching 0.82 four-way accuracy within listeners and 0.74 on unseen listeners (chance is 0.25). The measurement reveals what accuracy hides: adding behavioral streams raises overall accuracy but almost halves the brain's share of it. On two other datasets, the same tests find a label imbalance in a widely used benchmark and flag results that accuracy alone would report as brain decoding.

</details>


### [1516] [CÆNL: Collapse-Based Active Neural Learning with Objective-Aligned Representation Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17509)
*Saad Alqithami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CÆNL框架，通过动态坍缩正则化(DCR)将主动学习的采集与表示学习耦合，在ImageNet-100 60%标注下超越熵采集约1.7-1.8个百分点，但增益具有任务依赖性且不保证输入鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动学习在采集后续标签时会改变所用表示，这一采集与表示之间的相互作用尚缺乏系统性研究。作者希望理解并利用这种耦合关系，而非将采集策略与表示学习割裂对待。

Method: 提出Collapse-Based Active Neural Learning (CÆNL)，将流程分为采集、动态坍缩正则化(DCR)及其系数策略三部分。DCR惩罚归一化类内/类间散布残差超过冻结参考值的部分，并配有独立的类分离保护项；采用固定、调度、确定性反馈与学习反馈四类系数策略。理论上分析散布不变性、条件局部下降与系数界。

Result: 在ImageNet-100 60%标注下，熵采集+DCR+MACC-Lite在ResNet-50上达73.420±0.512%，ResNet-18上达73.086±0.397%，较纯熵采集高出1.742与1.834个百分点，且通过Holm校正的配对t检验与精确符号翻转检验。独立调参略优但无法证明自适应优越性或等价性。光谱研究显示固定的正则化C4损失略降，CIFAR-10扩散FID变差，AudioCaps字幕效果不确定。早期分类研究中L∞半径8/255的AutoAttack准确率近零，学习控制无额外收益。

Conclusion: 结果支持所评估的组合分类方案，同时表明仅靠干净的几何结构无法保证输入鲁棒性，几何信息的正则化效果具有任务依赖性。

Abstract: Active learning changes the representations used to acquire subsequent labels. We study this interaction through Collapse-Based Active Neural Learning (CÆNL), which separates acquisition, Dynamic Collapse Regularization (DCR), and its coefficient policy. DCR penalizes a normalized within-class to between-class scatter residual above a frozen reference, with a separate class-separation safeguard. Fixed, scheduled, deterministic-feedback, and learned-feedback policies apply this objective. The analysis establishes scatter invariances, conditional local descent, and coefficient bounds, and shows why clean geometry alone cannot guarantee input robustness. Six-seed classification comparisons are complemented by a 104-run study with separate control selection and ten-seed evaluations on each of two backbones. At 60% annotations on ImageNet-100, entropy acquisition with DCR and MACC-Lite reaches 73.420 +/- 0.512% accuracy on ResNet-50 and 73.086 +/- 0.397% on ResNet-18 (mean +/- seed SD), exceeding entropy alone by 1.742 and 1.834 percentage points. Both gains survive Holm correction under paired-t and exact sign-flip tests, with unchanged feedback settings across backbones. Independently tuned constants attain slightly higher mean accuracy; the paired comparisons establish neither adaptive superiority nor equivalence. Separate six-seed spectral studies yield a small fixed-regularization C4 loss reduction, worse CIFAR-10 diffusion FID, and inconclusive AudioCaps captioning effects. Earlier classification studies find near-zero AutoAttack accuracy at L-infinity radius 8/255 and no added benefit from learned control. The results support the evaluated combined classification treatment and identify the task dependence of geometry-informed regularization.

</details>


### [1517] [Towards Green AI: Evaluating Energy Efficiency for Quantized LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17531)
*Petar Basta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次统一评估LLM权重重量化的能耗与碳排放影响，覆盖多模型、多数据集、多GPU，发现量化在长输入短输出时能效最高，融合核int8方法可节能达4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化虽可降低LLM内存占用，但对其能耗和碳强度影响的量化研究稀缺，缺乏系统性评估。

Method: 在Llama 2 7B、Phi 3.5 Mini、OLMo 1B、Qwen 2.5 7B/14B上，使用GLUE MNLI、MMLU、HumanEval、GSM8K数据集，评估10种PTQ策略，在NVIDIA H100、A6000、A100、L4 GPU上测试不同输入/输出长度。

Result: 量化在长输入短输出时能效相对全精度最高；批大小增大时能效略提升但有限；EETQ int8和Bitsandbytes int8等融合核实现最高节能达4倍（对比FP32），精度损失可忽略；能耗与运行时间高度相关。

Conclusion: 运行时间优化可作降低LLM服务环境足迹的可靠代理，并提出按推理需求选择低碳量化策略的方向。

Abstract: While it is known that quantization of large language models (LLMs) reduces memory usage via lower-bit weights, studies quantifying the resulting impact on energy usage and carbon intensity are scarce. We present the first unified evaluation of weight-only quantization strategies for LLM inference across varying input/output lengths and GPUs, highlighting differences in energy efficiency in addition to accuracy degradation and runtime. We study quantized inference on Llama 2 7B, Phi 3.5 Mini Instruct, OLMo 1B, Qwen 2.5 7B, and Qwen 2.5 14B across GLUE MNLI, MMLU, HumanEval, and GSM8K datasets, evaluating 10 post-training quantization (PTQ) strategies on NVIDIA H100, A6000, A100, and L4 GPUs. We identify a novel trend showing that quantization techniques tend to exhibit peak energy efficiency relative to full-precision baselines when inputs are sufficiently long and outputs are short. Furthermore, we show that quantization strategies become marginally more energy-efficient relative to full-precision models as batch sizes increase, though gains are modest. Notably, fused-kernel implementations such as EETQ int8 and Bitsandbytes int8 offer the highest energy savings, up to 4x compared to FP32 on short text generation, with negligible accuracy loss. Finally, we observe that energy usage closely tracks runtime on our evaluated benchmarks, indicating that, in practice, latency optimization can serve as a reliable proxy for reducing the environmental footprint of LLM services. We conclude with suggested directions for strategically selecting low-carbon quantization strategies based on specific inference requirements.

</details>


### [1518] [Chasing Label Shifters: A Change-Aware Framework for Dynamic Graph Node Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17582)
*Junghoon Kim,Seungyoon Choi,Hyunsung Kim,Chanyoung Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文发现动态图神经网络对标签发生变化的节点(shifters)分类效果系统性差于稳定节点,归因于"嵌入惯性",并提出模型无关框架CHASE修复该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实系统(用户行为、研究者领域、企业风险)中节点标签会随时间在快照间变化,正确识别这类"shifter"节点对高风险场景的及时干预至关重要,但现有动态图模型对此系统性失败。

Method: 作者结构分析定位失败原因为"嵌入惯性"：邻域聚合使shifter表示锚定在旧类质心,且旧类邻居越一致越难纠正。据此提出CHASE——模型无关的变化感知框架,可包裹任意动态GNN,含检测标签变化并覆盖陈旧邻域信号的组件。

Result: 在所有测试模型与数据集上一致提升shifter性能(准确率最高+114.9%,F1最高+202.5%),同时保持稳定节点性能;并贡献三个含自然标签变化的动态图基准。

Conclusion: 动态GNN的shifter失败源于嵌入惯性,CHASE作为通用框架能有效缓解该问题并保持稳定性能,同时填补了数据集资源空白。

Abstract: Entities in real-world systems often evolve over time: users shift between information consumption patterns, researchers migrate between fields, and firms transition between financial risk states. When such systems are modeled as dynamic graphs, these transitions correspond to nodes whose class labels change between consecutive snapshots, which we call shifters. Correctly classifying shifters is often more consequential than classifying stable nodes with persistent labels, as detecting such transitions enables timely intervention in high-stakes settings. Yet, we identify a systematic failure mode across all major dynamic graph neural network architectures: shifter performance consistently lags behind stable nodes, with errors concentrated on the old label. Our structural analysis traces this failure to embedding inertia: neighborhood aggregation keeps shifter representations anchored to the old-class centroid, and this effect is strongest precisely where it is hardest to correct, namely for shifters whose neighborhoods remain aligned with the old class. Guided by this finding, we propose CHASE, a model-agnostic CHange-Aware framework for Shifting nodEs that wraps any dynamic GNN with targeted components for detecting label shifts and overriding stale neighborhood signals. CHASE consistently improves shifter performance across all tested models and datasets (up to 114.9% and 202.5% improvement on accuracy and F1 score, respectively) while preserving stable-node performance. We additionally contribute three dynamic graph benchmarks with naturally shifting labels, filling a gap in existing resources. The source code is available at https://github.com/jhkim611/CHASE

</details>


### [1519] [Taming Softmax at the Limits of Muon: A Unified Approach through Hilbert Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17588)
*Aditya Somasundaram,Charles Guille-Escuret,Alexander Moreno,Zhengzhong Liu,Eric Xing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用 Hilbert 距离作为 softmax 模块输出分布变化的自然度量，统一了 RowNorm 与 Compositional Muon 两种优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon 通过线性层输出的 RMS 变化控制权重更新，但将线性输出视为整个模块（含后续非线性）的代理；对 softmax 而言，激活的 RMS 变化不能忠实反映输出分布的变化，因此需要更合适的度量。

Method: 提出 Hilbert 距离来约束输出分布变化。它能界定交叉熵损失变化并限制概率重分配；对 softmax，它表现为预激活扰动的变差半范数，从而把概率约束转化为参数约束。将 Hilbert 距离约束下的最速下降问题作为统一框架求解。

Result: 在 LM head 上，求解行式近似的直径约束问题导出 RowNorm；在缩放点积注意力中，同一原理导出 Compositional Muon 所依据的一阶 query-key 最速下降问题。

Conclusion: Hilbert 距离可作为 softmax 模块优化器设计的指导原则，为已有方法提供统一数学解释。

Abstract: Muon controls weight updates through the RMS movement of a linear layer's output. This implicitly treats the linear output as a proxy for the full module, including the nonlinearity that follows. This proxy can be misleading for softmax, where the RMS shift in activations does not faithfully measure the change in the output distribution. We propose Hilbert distance as a natural metric for bounding changes in these output distributions. Hilbert distance bounds changes in cross-entropy loss and limits probability redistribution. For softmax, it takes the form of the variation seminorm of the preactivation perturbation, allowing probability constraints to be expressed as parameter constraints. Formulating the steepest descent problem with a Hilbert distance constraint brings two recently proposed methods under a unified mathematical framework. For the LM head, solving a row-wise approximation to the resulting diameter-constrained problem leads us to RowNorm \citep{pethick2025trainingdeeplearningmodels}. For scaled dot-product attention, the same principle yields the first-order query--key steepest descent problem underlying Compositional Muon \citep{keigwin2026compositional}. These connections motivate using Hilbert distance as a guiding principle for optimizer design in softmax modules.

</details>


### [1520] [Revisiting the 16x Pretraining Compute Gap between Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17590)
*Guanghan Wang,Bing He,Zhan Shi,Benoit Dumoulin,Hanqing Lu,Volodymyr Kuleshov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视扩散语言模型(DLM)的缩放定律，发现广泛引用的"DLM需约16倍训练算力才能匹敌自回归模型"这一结论已过时，实际差距远小于此。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前有研究声称DLM训练效率远低于ARM（约需16倍算力），使从零预训练DLM看似不可行。但该结论所用方法（ELBO评分、全序列仅解码器架构）已与当前DLM实践脱节，需重新评估。

Method: 采用新协议：按模型自身解码顺序计算精确似然、块扩散训练、编码器-解码器架构，并对实践中使用的不同块大小进行扫描。共研究十种模型变体，约1700个模型。

Result: 精确似然评分将算力倍数降至12.8倍；块扩散训练加编码器-解码器架构在块大小32时降至7.8倍；更小块大小进一步收窄至块大小8的4.6倍和块大小4的3.0倍。并给出最优解码器深度的经验规则、超出拟合范围的算力预算验证及下游基准结果。

Conclusion: 16倍这一数字显著高估了DLM与ARM的预训练成本差距，从零预训练DLM远比此前认为的更可行。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have attracted wide attention for their fast, parallel decoding, but they are believed to be far less efficient to train than autoregressive language models (ARMs): a widely cited study reports that a DLM needs roughly 16x the training compute of an ARM to match its likelihood, a figure that has made pretraining DLMs from scratch look prohibitive at scale. We find that the methodology behind this figure has fallen out of step with current DLM practice: it scores the model with its evidence lower bound (ELBO) and trains a full-sequence, decoder-only model. We therefore revisit the scaling laws of DLMs, adopting the exact likelihood under the model's own decoding order, block diffusion training, an encoder-decoder architecture, and a sweep over the block sizes used in practice. Under this new protocol, we study across ten model variants, about 1,700 models in total, and find that pretraining DLMs is far cheaper than previously thought. Concretely, scoring with the exact likelihood reduces the compute multiple to 12.8x; block diffusion training and an encoder-decoder architecture further reduce it to 7.8x at block size 32, and smaller block sizes narrow it to 4.6x at block size 8 and 3.0x at block size 4. We complement these scaling analyses with an empirical rule for the optimal decoder depth of encoder-decoder block diffusion, a held-out compute budget beyond the fitting range at which the gap between variants persists, and downstream benchmark results where likelihood improvements carry over to accuracy. Overall, the 16x figure substantially overstates the pretraining cost gap between DLMs and ARMs, and pretraining DLMs from scratch is far more viable than previously assumed.

</details>


### [1521] [FedLoRD: Personalized Federated Learning based on Low-Rank Structures of Model Parameter Differences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17621)
*Tsutahiro Fukuhara,Junya Hara,Hiroshi Higashi,Yuichi Tanaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedLoRD 是一种基于全局与个性化模型参数差异低秩结构的个性化联邦学习方法，通过核范数正则化提升个性化模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 PFL 方法在本地训练中用经验性正则化（如 l1、l2 范数）约束模型参数差异，未考虑差异的实际特性，导致先验不匹配和次优个性化模型。

Method: 观察到模型参数差异在每一层近似低秩，提出对逐层差异施加核范数正则化的本地训练问题，并利用核范数的因子化表示将其改写，从而可用普通随机梯度下降高效求解。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上的图像分类实验表明，FedLoRD 优于多种现有 PFL 方法。

Conclusion: 利用模型参数差异的低秩先验可设计更合理的正则化，FedLoRD 有效提升了个性化联邦学习性能。

Abstract: We propose FedLoRD, a personalized federated learning (PFL) method based on the low-rank structure of the differences between the global and personalized model parameters. PFL is a branch of federated learning that aims to learn models tailored to the local data of each client under biased local data distributions. In its local training, each client learns a personalized model by regularizing the difference between its model parameters and the global ones sent from the server. The regularization function needs to be designed with priors on the model parameter difference; however, the existing PFL methods rely on empirical choices (e.g., $\ell_1$- and $\ell_2$-norms), which do not take into account the actual characteristics of the difference. The resulting mismatch of priors can lead to suboptimal personalized models.
